lines.line: Universal Bulin. Can be used to limit break all ships of Elite rarity or below.
They say I'm just like my sister, but we're actually in charge of different colors... What's a color? Sounds yummy!
Buli? Seems like I can help make your fleet stronger, buli!
If I swing this wrench hard enough, I could poke a hole in the office floor, buli!
Buli? Buli? Where are we? What are we gonna do here?
Us Bulins are pretty awesome, buli!
Is there nothing for Bulin to do? Really? Then let's go play! Wheee!
Commander, let's go dig for some treasure, buli~!
Buli? Do you want to be bulified?
Buli? ... ... Buli?
Buli? What's the mission?
Rewards... Can I eat them, buli?
Something strange just popped outta me, buli...
Buli! Look, I'm full of energy!
Buli! The girls are back!
[Cannot be enhanced]
I don't know what I'm doing, but I'm doing it, buli!
Buli? Could it be that... I'm super strong?!
Huh? Am I... no good in battle, buli?
My wrench is the wrench that will pierce the earth!
Wahh~! Commander is a big, big dummy!
My big sis can apparently only strengthen one color. I can strengthen a bunch! Which means... that I'm more powerful than her? Wow! I'm stronger than her, buli!
Bulin is happy that she can help everyone get stronger, but she enjoys playing with you too, Commander! Bulin can help strengthen you... Aww, why not?
I'm not meant for combat, yet you use me anyway, so being the more sensible Bulin, I need to thank you! I guess it's just because we're too cute...? *Kyah~* I might be in love~!
My heart races whenever I see you, Commander! I could dismantle the entire dock for you! Could this be... my inner fire? Buli!
Bulin has been caught~ Ahh, I'm blushing so much! What will I do! Let's buy some new toys and celebrate!
I like this!
Sis, what are you bulin here?

ex.line: Commander, look! I got your office floor all sparkly-clean, buli! It feels even more like a secret base now!
If you keep working so late, I'll have to fix you up with my wrench, buli! It's for your own good!
I wanna go straight to the port's broadcasting station and tell everyone that you're my most valuable treasure, buli!
I made special, lovey-dovey coffee for you! That buli flavor will knock your socks off! ...Hm? Why is your face all scrunched up, buli?
Your heartbeat is going all bulibuli! Let me hear more, buli! Just a little longer.
B-be careful, buli...
Commander, buli! It hasn't been that long, but it feels like a hundred years to me! Give me a biiig hug to make up for it, buli!
Bulin loves you more than anyone, Commander! A hundred times more than I love wrenches, food, and shiny things combined!

lines.line: Bulin? Did I just get an upgrade?! Now I can fight too, bulin!
Bulin? Did I just get an upgrade? Now, I can fight too, bulin!
I want to try out some experimental equipment here in your office, bulin!
That green cat said something about this new equipment being "experimental," bulin. Not sure what that means, but since it looks like my sis, it must be super strong!
This bulibulin has become even strongerer, bulin!
Even though I look a bit like my sis now, she's still the only one in charge of super rares, bulin~
I never get tired! But, Commander, you seem to get tired all the time... does that mean you're weak, bulin?
Bulin? Commander, did you wanna learn how to bulin?
Bulin! I'm about to activate my skill all over you!
Are you not letting me sortie because I'm too OP, bulin?
(I can't believe it... Even with my newfound powers, there's no way to undergo enhancement...)
Witness the power of my new rigging, bulin!
Bulin! I've successfully buli buli'd the enemies!
Ehh? I thought I was supposed to be stronger, bulin?
Within my equipment is the power to end all creation!
Bulin?! I'm in trouble, bulin!
Bulibuli magical transformation! I'm Magical Girl Bulin, here to protect love and justice! I'm super awesome with my new powers, buli!
Bulibuli magical transformation! I'm Magical Girl Bulin, here to protect love and justice! I'm super awesome with my new powers, buli!
Commander, look! My new outfit shines, like, bulibuliii! I'm shinier than the stars in the night sky!
Now that I've signed this contract, I can use super-cool, super-strong magic, buli! This is great, buli! Hehehe, I'm glad we signed that contract together!
Bulin will protect the port, buli!
Where's my magic wand, you ask? I use something much better: a magic wrench, buli!
You're the only one who knows that I'm a magical girl, Commander. Don't tell anyone else, buli!
Do not fear! Magical Girl Bulin is here!
M-my magic is being replenished, buli!
Welcome back, Commander! Are you hurt? I'll just hit you with this love-filled magical wrench, and your pain will all go away!
Our enemies have been purified by the power of love, buli!
I'm all out of magic, buli...
Prototype Bulin MKII. Can be used to limit break all Super Rare ships.
Hahaha! It's your lucky day now that you've met me! We can purin together from this day forward! What for? To make everyone stronger, obviously! How do you purin? Like this! Purin~! Purin~!
Purin~! The herald of good fortune has arrived! Are you ready? Raise your hands and follow me... Purin~ purin~!
Righty tighty, Lefty loosey, Stay calm and Purin on!
Staring at me all day won't turn you into an expert!
Purin~! It's so big in here! There's so much room to run around!
Oh right, it's not my job to just run around, is it? Purin~!
Purin~? I'm too loud? Hmph, who cares what you think!
Purin~ You can't catch me!
Purin~ purin~! (Prototype Bulin MKII continues to spin faster)
Purin~! The next mission has been chosen for you!
I'm just heading out to fetch your rewards, purin! I promise I won't break them!
Purin! Secret skill: Drill Translation!
Let's run around and relax! Purin~!
Yaaaay~! Commander! The girls who went out on a commission have come back! Let's drill something to celebrate!
[Cannot be enhanced]
Purin~! Don't stop until they kneel and cry!
Purin~! I'm the strongest!
So why am I on the battlefield anyway, purin?!
My drill is the drill that will pierce the heavens!
You're pretty amazing to have gotten on my bad side! But I won't get angry just to appease you! Haha! Enjoy your emptiness!
My sister is so dumb. When people talk about our colors, it's not about our hair, it's about ra... rari... ah, now I remember! Reality TV!

I'll let you in on a little secret. My little sister keeps telling people that she's smarter than me. But truth is, she's dumber! I try to be nice and let her feel good about herself, like a big sister should. Ha!
Whee~! I'm flying! So~ high! Hey, don't move! You'll have to catch me if I fall!
You're not an average commander if you managed to conquer my heart. But I won't be shy or blush! Instead I'll give you a growl! Graaaah!
As a simple Bulin, I'm meant to just help strengthen your other ships... But you gave me this ring... You're a strange one! I like you! Come, let's raise our hands together and say purin~ purin~!
Flattering me won't get you anything!
Puriiin! The savior of the fleet disembarks, wielding a heaven-piercing drill in hand, purin! Heheh! I bet you're trembling with excitement at my latest and greatest work outfit, purin!
Puriiin! The savior of the fleet disembarks, wielding a heaven-piercing drill in hand, purin! Heheh! I bet you're trembling with excitement at my latest and greatest work outfit, purin!
My Super Drill is locked and loaded, purin! Let's get to work, purin!
Why is my superpowered form like this, purin? Heck if I know! I just wanted to make something that would make my sister go "cool," purin!
Purin! The port is sooo big! I can see every corner of it when I stand on my Super Drill MKII!
Today's the day I'm gonna show my Prototype Super Drill MKII to everyone, purin! Will you be there, purin?
Purin! It's time for my speech! ...What's it about? About my drill that pierces the heavens, obviously, purin!
Purin! Are you ready to disembark with me, purin?
Purin? P-puriiin! Purin... *blushes*
Welcome back! Let's go for a drive - you, me, and my Super Drill MKII, purin!
[Purin! You cannot strengthen the Super Drill, purin!]
Purin! Behold my superpowered form!
Purin! All the enemies were sooo shocked they ran away!
Purin! All the flashy VFX in the world can't save a sloppy performance, purin...
Purin?! My prototype is going haywire, puriiin!
Seeing my Prototype Super Drill MKII must've rekindled your love, purin! Wahahaha! It's not your fault you're so charmed by it, purin! Since I'm so nice, I'll let you touch it, purin! Here!
Specialized Bulin Custom MKIII. Can be used to Limit Break all Ultra Rare ships.
A wrench, a drill, and a hammer... Wait a sec! Is there some kind of pattern here, bulin?!
Bulin~! Aren't you amazed? Standing before you is the legendary secret unlockable character of the Bulin family, none other than me! Rejoice, for you have been blessed with supremely good RNG, bulin!
Commander, it's hammer time! You'll get super strong, bulin!
If ever in doubt, just tell me to bonk it with my hammer, bulin!
Sleepy, bulin? Then I'll charge you right up! I just need to plug in my... What? That doesn't work, bulin?
You might get a surprise when you collect 1 of each bulin! But I dunno what the surprise would even be!
My Kitty Kabam Hammer goes glimmer-glammer, sparkely sparkle, whooshy-kablam! Check it out, bulin!
This bad boy is my "raison d'etre"! Be careful with it, or you'll get hurt, bulin!
Oh nooooooo! I'm gonna overload, bulin!
A new mission? A good bonk with my hammer should finish it, bulin!
Look here! Smash that Collect All button, bulin!
Is it true that more mail comes in when I go "bulin"?
Bulin? My gear and I both need to recharge, bulin!
Bulin! The commission team has returned with boatloads of rewards!
Glad you asked, but I can't be enhanced, bulin!
I'm fully charged, bulin! Let's show them what a real bulin's made of!
My Kitty Kabam Hammer is the strongest around, bulin!
My batteries are out... My Kitty Kabam Hammer was never made for battle, bulin!
My hammer is the hammer that will bring down the stars, bulin!
Oh heck! My health bar is glowing red, bulin!
You've lost your way, but don't give up! Pull yourself together, bulin!
The other bulins are only one color, but I'm the whole rainbow! Which can only mean one thing: that I'm the strongest of the bunch, bulin!
As thanks for always hanging with me, I'll let you borrow my Kitty Kabam Hammer for an hour, bulin! But don't use it for any mean stuff, okay?
Are you sure you aren't hanging out with me too much, Commander? If this keeps up, the port will be in ruins soon, bulin!
I was made to upgrade fleets, nothing more, and yet you're being so kind to me... I love you, Commander! Let me give you a special type of bonk, bulin! Hm? You'd rather not?
Woohoo! This shiny ring is proof of our love bond, bulin! Watch this! I'm gonna whack it to infinity with my hammer! ...Never, ever whack the ring? Okay then, bulin!
This is ultra useful, bulin!
Bulin Brigade, busting through, bulin!
Let's make 'em taste the rainbow!
Commander, you just breathe easy and get behind me, bulin! This time, the invincible Bulin Brigade will carry out justice for you, bulin!
Commander, you just breathe easy and get behind me, bulin! This time, the invincible Bulin Brigade will carry out justice for you, bulin!
Shh... I'm sneaking into Akashi's storehouse to... Aw, bulin! I've been spotted, bulin! No other choice but to whip out my Kitty Kabam Hammer now, bulin!
Behold, bulin! My costume was made especially for a sneaking mission, bulin! Do you like it, bulin?
Commander, won't you join the invincible Bulin Brigade, bulin? Sure, you're not a bulin... but you can still join, bulin!
Heheh! Once we find Akashi's ledger, we'll have proof to pin on her, bulin!
I'll keep your precious gems safe, bulin! Now let me help you calculate how much Akashi still owes, bulin!
Heheh! Praise me as much as you can, bulin!
Bulin? Be quiet during our special mission, bulin!
Eek! Commander, that's dangerous, bulin!
Bulin? You still have unfinished missions, bulin? Okay, let me handle them, bulin!
Bulin! Bulin! Have a look at the mission rewards! There might be gems in there, bulin!
Commander! I found a suspicious letter, bulin! ...Bulin? Oh, it was just for you...
Bulin? Don't stray too far from me! You might get kidnapped by the baddies, and that'd be terrible, bulin!
Bulin! The commission team is back, bulin! Think they brought back clues leading to her ledger, bulin?
Commander, I'm not doing this just for justice, bulin. If anything, it's because I hate to see Akashi pushing you around, bulin! From now on, I will keep your wallet safe, bulin! I swear it, bulin!
Farragut-class destroyer - Dewey, Hull Number DD-349.

I'm the Farragut-class destroyer, Dewey. I took part in many carrier convoys and support missions. I pride myself on my service history! Although... I sadly couldn't save two of my sister ships who were in trouble... Typhoons can be frighteningly strong...
I'm Dewey, I'm a destroyer. If there's anything I can help with, please just say the word. Whatever I'm tasked with, I'll give it my all!
Welcome back, Commander. Could we inspect the port's emergency relief supplies? You never know when disaster might strike.
Is there something on your mind, Commander? Something you need my help for...?
I love listening to music. My favorite song is made by Lexington!
Eep! S-Sorry, Commander! Typhoons and thunder are just too scary for me...
The caring Yorktown, the cool Enterprise, the peppy Saratoga... The Eagle Union has good people left and right.
My hair is a little messy? Oh, thank you for pointing it out! Please let me return the favor by giving you a massage later!
Hm...? My chest doesn't hurt, so why'd you do that?
If missions feel like a chore to you, let me take care of them!
Isn't it wasteful to simply leave the mission rewards sitting there?
Commander, please check your new intel regularly. By staying up-to-date, you can prevent disaster from striking.
Well done on the last mission! Allow me to take care of the after-combat report, and you can get some rest in the meanwhile.
The commission team has returned! They've brought with them exactly what we needed, so let's put it to good use!
No matter how tough the going gets, I will not let anyone down!
I'll do the best I can for everyone's sake!
I did only what was expected of me. Everyone else deserves the rewards!
I-I messed up...
I'll handle this!
I've taken significant damage... but I'm still in the fight!
You're scarier than any storm, Commander...
Are you hungry, Commander? Then would you like me to cook some curry and rice for you? Just so you know, I can't guarantee you'll like it.
Commander, I cleaned your office earlier. Wouldn't you say it looks more orderly now? I could clean your bedroom too, if you'd like!
Did you lose something, Commander? Then I'll search your room and try to find it!
Commander, does your freshly dried futon feel comfy? Keeping your living environment clean is good for your health. But I'll look after you if you should ever fall sick, so don't worry about that!
Is this... for me? Am I really your most beloved...? Okay! I can't promise I'll be perfect, but I will support you in any way I can, be it at work or in private!
Ah... Commander, thank you! I love this!
Could we perform together again?
I'll keep you covered, Sara!
I never thought I'd get to fight with you again... I'll do my absolute best!
Gridley, just fire whenever you want.
Saratoga went over there, and Lexington is... Oh, Commander, good morning! Are you here to play with us, or were you just out for some fresh air...?
Saratoga went over there, and Lexington is... Oh, Commander, good morning! Are you here to play with us, or were you just out for some fresh air...?
According to the weather forecast, it's gonna be real sunny today.

What's in this notebook? Well, um... It's a story about a girl chasing after the person she longs for the most in her dream... Y-you want to read it? Fine... Ah, um! Please promise to keep it a secret from Miss Lexington!
If you want to know where Saratoga is, I think I saw her playing beach volleyball with the others?
I seem to be a bit too tired to swim... so I'll just enjoy the feeling of rocking around in this floaty ring...
Does anyone need any help? ...Thank goodness, looks like everyone is doing well...
C-Commander, please don't play with my floaty ring. You're going to get my notebook wet...
Eek?! I-I'm gonna flip over...!
There's a new announcement. Hopefully it's not a storm warning...!
Commander, if you're tired, let me give you a massage.
Lexington gave me this Christmas costume as a thank-you for always supporting her. Commander, do you think I look... pretty in it?
Lexington gave me this Christmas costume as a thank-you for always supporting her. Commander, do you think I look... pretty in it?
Merry Christmas, Commander. Umm, may you have a happy holy night.
I'd like to give Lexington a very special present for Christmas... What would you suggest, Commander?
The star at the top of the Christmas tree... I wonder what it could mean?
Commander, don't forget to greet everyone on Christmas. Everyone's looking forward to seeing you.
Gridley took lots of pictures of Lexington for me. I ought to thank her later.
E-Ever since I put on this costume, Benson has been really staring me down...
Pl-Please don't play around with the bells!
Commander, have you bought Christmas presents yet? I'm just making sure...
Mahan-class destroyer - Cassin, Hull Number DD-372!
Mahan-class destroyer, Cassin. I get picked on for being top heavy and not being great at defending the skies... My left eye has nothing to do with the Solomon Islands, alright? Just leave it.
How do you do? I'm Cassin... If you have no business with me, I'd like to stay in the docks...
Even you can't make me leave my room, Commander...
I don't have anything you'd be interested in...
Don't you have anything to say? I'm not great at starting conversations...
Oh, you want to know about my eyes? One of them is fake... Can you guess which?
Everyone is back! That's good...
Mmm... I don't hate this feeling...
Are you interested in shut-in girls?
Hm... We have some uncompleted missions, is that really fine?
Rewards have arrived... Looks like we did well...
New mail... Aren't you going to take a look?
My sister said I'd die from boredom if I always stay in my room... But we all die eventually anyway, so what's the big deal?
Work is finished...
Even if I get stronger... I'd rather stay in my room...
Well... you're keeping me from my time off... I need to teach you some manners!
What? That was it?
What a pain... Might as well head back.
I wanna go home...
Can't you just let me sleep for a while?
What is it, Commander? If you wanna have a chat with me then I doubt you'll have anything interesting to say...
Hmm, how should I say this... If you're free, would you like to take a nap together?
Commander, you don't seem like you've been sleeping well recently... Huh? It's because I keep moving over to your side of the bed?
You're a real gentleman, Commander... but it's actually making me a little angry. Am I really... that unattractive to you?
Commander, you've been preparing this in secret this whole time? I'd have been fine with any kind of gift, but... thank you. I'm as happy as I can be.
For me...? Oh, hmm... Thanks.
I know I said we'd go shopping after school, but walking is so exhausting... I'll just hitch a ride in this cart. Looks sturdy enough...
I know I said we'd go shopping after school, but walking is so exhausting... I'll just hitch a ride in this cart. Looks sturdy enough...
I'm beat. Don't wanna move a muscle... Hey, Commander? Could you push the cart around?
Huh? Is there something... weird about me sitting in the shopping cart?
Do you drink a lot of coffee, Commander? I don't. Staying up all night is not my thing...
I think Downes works here part-time. Just hope she doesn't kerplode anything...
You could stock up on instant noodles so you won't have to go shopping for food for a good while. I think it's a good idea.
Yeah? What? I'm not exactly hogging the entire cart to myself, am I?
There's security cams in here, you know...
Anything interesting happen late- Aahh! For the love of... Watch it where you put those ice-cold drinks!

Commander... I've been cocoooned up in my room for so long that I've started to metamorphize... Eh? It's because of the retrofit? Phew... thank goodness. Well then, guess it's time to go back to my room.

Commander... I've been cocoooned up in my room for so long that I've started to metamorphize... Eh? It's because of the retrofit? Phew... thank goodness. Well then, guess it's time to go back to my room.
Fwaah... Commander, I need to take another nap, so I'm leaving the rest to you...
Mmh... just staying together quietly like this... might be pretty nice too.
Wear my clothes properly? Eh...? Don't wanna~ More importantly, care for an Oxy Cola, Commander?
Mahan-class destroyer - Downes, Hull Number DD-375!

Yahoo! I'm the Mahan-class destroyer Downes! I've had to undergo some pretty serious repairs, and have had to replace half my body! I'm stronger than I ever was now! I promise, you won't be disappointed!
Hey! Are you the commander? I'm Downes. Nice meeting you!
Yo~! Commander, the wind is nice today. Want to go with me and feed our enemies some torpedoes?
Oh? Do you fancy girls with a bit of muscle? Girls like me?
Tsk! I'm so bored~ I wanna blow something up!
My magazine's too easy to hit? It's fine, one day or another it'll blow up anyway!
Oh, Commander, what do you think of the phrase, "I'm only half the person I used to be"? Sounds kinda philosophical, doesn't it?
Ah, that's the spot, right there~
You looking to get bitten?
Looks like you've got some unfinished missions!
Alright, let's go fetch those rewards!
Yo! You've got mail!
Everyone is back! When are we taking off again?
A commission has been completed... Hey, are there any commissions where we can blow stuff up?
Hey, I really want to make something violently explode right now!
Let's go, girls! Show them what we've got!
Weaklings, do you know Downes' power now?
Ow ow ow... My magazine's been...
Eat this!
There's nothing I hate more than the listless!
Hey, Commander, don't be such a slouch! How about going blast fishing with me?
My body? Don't pay it any attention. I've only had half of it replaced. I can still eat and sleep just fine. Nothing's wrong!
Although I really shouldn't care... I still worry if my love will accept me like this... Huh?! Commander! When did you get here? No, it's nothing. I was just... t-t... talking to myself!
Commander, um... what should I say... I... my body may... be full of holes... but my heart is whole... and I give it all... to you...

...... I never thought I would see the day when I would receive this from you... It's not that I don't believe in you, Commander, it's that I don't believe... in myself. But now I can live without worries! Thank you, Commander!
Yay! When did you get this tasteful?!
I heard another person was coming to help out at the store, but I never thought it'd be you, Commander! What am I doing here? Ahaha, well uh, I had a little bit of free time on my hands... right~♪
I heard another person was coming to help out at the store, but I never thought it'd be you, Commander! What am I doing here? Ahaha, well uh, I had a little bit of free time on my hands... right~♪
Yo! Talk about being early! C'mere and gimme a hand stocking these shelves.
Hahahah! Whaddya think of my little creation here? Oh, and don't tell Akashi about it!
Hey, Commander, pass me that triangular can! Cool, thanks!
I reckon I can make an explosive out of stuff lying around the store! ...Look, I'm just saying it's possible!
This fella's almost past its expiration date... Heheh. Should we ask Akashi for permission to do an inventory sweep?
What'd I tell you - two heads are more productive than one!
And this bottle goes ri- Oh crap! ...Phew! Nice catch, Commander! That was a real close one...
Roar! I'm the tiger, Downes! Hehe, Commander, how do you like me now? I feel super fired up right now, so hurry up and let me at 'em!
Roar! I'm the tiger, Downes! Hehe, Commander, how do you like me now? I feel super fired up right now, so hurry up and let me at 'em!
Yo! Commander, let's work hard today as well! If you get tired, I'll raise your spirits with a bang!
Shall we go light things up on the seas? Well, just when you're free, Commander. I'm not that bored yet~
Commander, let me give you a massage! I promise, I'll make all your all your fatigue go away, hehe~
Gridley-class destroyer - Gridley, Hull Number DD-380!
I'm the first ship of the Gridley-class, and I was very active in the Pacific theater. But never mind that now, Commander. Want to look at photos of Sara?
Nice to meet you, Commander! I'm Gridley. I once escorted Saratoga~ She's such a cutie!
Hey, Commander~ So listen, Sara's just soooo cute!
Wow, look at that cutie! No, not me! The one over there!
I've got plenty of pictures of Sara. 800 bucks a print!
Mississippi will bring me back home just fine if I get lost!
Commander, have you seen Sara? I want to try my new camera!
Aaah, that tickles~! I can't keep the camera straight~
Commander! If you do that again, I'll photograph it and report it to the police~
The mission area is so pretty~ C'mon, let's go take some photos!
The rewards are here~! Now we can buy new some film!
Commander~ You've got mail~!
I need to develop these photos~
The girls who went out on a commission are back. I wonder how the photos I asked for turned out?
Now I can snap even more photos of Sara!
You over there! Strike a pose! I'm about to shoot~!
Ten out of ten! Commander, Commander! Take a photo of me too!
Dammit~ I lost focus!
This is for Sara! Haiyah!
You don't get to look at pictures of Sara anymore!
So, Commander, don't you wanna see some awesome photos of Saratoga? Fine, fine, I'll show you! Aren't I nice~
Commander, didn't you promise we'd go see Sara together? What are we waiting for? Let's go!
Look at this one. It's great, right? This one, too. I'm confident about this one. ...Commander, why are you looking at me instead of the photos?
Ah... You don't want to hear about Sara? You want... to know more about... me? Eh... um.... Ah! This is so embarrassing!
Commander, Commander! Strike a pose! 1... 2... 3! Cheese! ...That was a great shot! We'll get a copy each after we develop the film~
I'll give this to Saratoga! Thanks, Commander!
Commander, Merry Christmas! Guhehe~ Won't you attend my "Super Special Sexy Sara (tentative)" photoshoot event?
Commander, Merry Christmas! Guhehe~ Won't you attend my "Super Special Sexy Sara (tentative)" photoshoot event?
Christmas special edition Saratoga photos, one thousand dollars each! Guhehe~ my fangirl power level increases during the holiday season!
Commander, can you take some photos of me with Saratoga?
Thanks for the waterproof camera, Commander! I'll be sure to take good care of it!
What's in this bag? Guhehe~ an album of premium Saratoga photos! As long as I have this, she will always be at my side!
Uwaah! Don't take any pictures!
Gridley-class destroyer - Craven, Hull Number DD-382!
I'm Craven, second ship of the Gridley-class, at your command. As a high speed torpedo destroyer, I was active in the Pacific theater with my little sisters, mainly tasked with night battle support.
Second ship of the Gridley-class, Craven, reporting in. Leave the halftime cheering to me!
Leave today's halftime cheering to me, Commander!
Ahh~ Commander! D-don't get so close all of a sudden!
Even if it's time to rest, we've got to keep fighting and dancing. Never give up!
Northampton thinks she can take me down? Hmph!
Fight~ Come on~ Eagle Union~ ☆!
Commander, I can feel your encouragement. I'll work even harder!
E-even if you're just trying to encourage me, there's... there's this thing called being too passionate!
We've still got unfinished missions, Commander!
I've got your rewards, Commander. Surely they must include some sort of surprise?
You've got new mail! Any inspirational messages to share?
Perfect! We've earned a flawless curtain call today!
No matter where they go, I'll always be my sisters' chealeader! C'mon, Commander! Lets go and greet them!
Now I'll be able to cheer on everyone even harder!
C'mon, everyone~ Let's fight with all we've got today~☆!
Huh, I was just cheering everyone on... Oh well, this works too~
Oh no... My cheering must not have worked...
Do your best, everyone!
I'll go cheer someone else on instead. I might not be coming back today!
Cheering, outside of work? I don't... quite understand what you mean...
You don't look very energetic, Commander. Should I pat you on the head to cheer you up?
If you ever want me to, Commander, I-I would love to come and cheer you on any time...
You. Can. Do. It. Co-man-der! L! O! V! E! Co-man-der! L! O! V! E! Did my cheers of love reach your heart?
Commander, now we need to make a cheerleading team just for you. Hm? Of course I'll be the coach! Nobody else has feelings for you like I do!
Wow! Thanks, Commander! I'll cherish this.
I much rather cheer for my Commander than go to class...but no matter where I go, I will definitely give it my all! Commander, wait for me to come back as the top student of this school year.
I much rather cheer for my Commander than go to class...but no matter where I go, I will definitely give it my all! Commander, wait for me to come back as the top student of this school year.
When you are overwhelmed by all this learning, go for a jog to relax yourself!
If you're struggling with the material, then find a tutor. If that doesn't work, get special training...nothing can’t be solved through special training!
The Commander has always been the best in my heart, so I have to be in his heart, too!
These courses are too hard...Commander, can you tutor me?
I'm on fire!
Gridley-class destroyer - McCall, Hull Number DD-400!
I'm McCall, third ship of the Gridley-class. There isn't much special about me, except that I've lived as long as my big sisters. I'm just relieved know that they're doing well.
Hello, Commander. Just call me McCall. I like to sleep, daydream, and eat popsicles. Please assign me somewhere peaceful, will you?
Commander, can't I just sit around here for today instead?
Sorry, can we keep it brief? I need a new popsicle.
We all get along around here, don't you think? Care for a popsicle?
Ahh... Hawaii was so hot. I felt like I was melting...
... Ah! Oh no! My popsicle melted.
... Are you trying to encourage me?
Ah, it's so hot...
Missions, huh? Whatever happens, happens.
Help me pack up these rewards... Hey, can we have them sent to my house?
*Sigh* There's no end to all this mail...
It's kinda hot in here, got anything to help me cool down?
...Oh, everyone's back. I'll go get some popsicles.
Hm... It's nothing special.
We have to fight? Guess I couldn't avoid it forever...
"Slay the enemy while your blade is still warm"... Is that true for popsicles as well? Oh, it melted...
Whoa, I got so scared I dropped my popsicle...
Let's finish this before my popsicle melts!
(McCall continues licking her popsicle and acts like she didn't notice you.)
I heard those Sakura Empire girls sit around and drink tea all afternoon. I'd like to try that some day!
Tips for daydreaming? Empty your mind and don't think about anything. Don't forget about your popsicle before it melts, though...
Want a taste of my popsicle, Commander? Ah, yeah, it'd be like an indirect kiss, but that's fine... Anyway, can I daydream for a bit and lean on your back?
I used to hope that my days of just eating popsicles and daydreaming would go on forever. But after meeting you, Commander, I think I might have been wrong...
My life's changed ever since I met you, Commander... I'm sure we'll get to do many new things together. But there's one thing I hope won't ever change: that I'll be together with you...
I'd love this better if you unwrapped it for me, too.

Gridley-class destroyer, Maury, Hull Number DD-401
Unlock build after receiving

I'm Maury, the fourth ship of the Gridley-class destroyer squadron. Although I'm the youngest of my class, I'm also the fastest short-distance Union ship! I'm prone to getting hungry a lot? Well, they say that light meals make you live longer, don't they?
You can just call me Maury. As a track athlete, I hold the Union's speed record, reaching a maximum speed of 42.8 knots. Just don't make me run a marathon...
Commander, want to do some warm-ups with me?
Umm... Why are you always watching me do my warm-ups? Do you like watching me sweat?
Commander, want to work out a bit? Sitting for so long is terrible for your body!
I thought we were going for some long distance trip at Wake Island again.
I swear it wasn't my tummy making that noise!
Hm? Is this your way of... cheering me on?
Are you helping me recover? ... Thank you...
...!! Hey! There's a line you shouldn't cross when giving massages.
You've still got some missions to finish up, Commander! Put your back into it, it's the final stretch!
Phew~ I'm exhausted... Save some Oxy-cola for me when the rewards arrive!
You've got new mail. It's about that celebratory party, isn't it?
Rest now so that we can sprint faster later!
I need to get some exercise... Commander, a commission just got completed, so could you send me out on the next one?
Not enough... I can still go faster...!
Lets finish this quick before I get hungry!
Like I said, those guys can't keep up with me!
... I need to get back before everyone starts worrying about me.
Faster... Faster...!
Urgh! Need to go faster...
Sorry, I've got some training to do, so I gotta go!
Commander, is it really okay for you to sit around all day? Get outside and do some sports!
Want me to teach you how to run faster, Commander? There's quite a lot to it, actually.
I feel like I can run even farther when I'm next to you, Commander. What an incredible feeling!
Commander, how about going on a jog with me? I want to share the beautiful scenery I find with you.
No matter how fast I run, I can't escape my feelings for you, Commander...
*nom nom*... Phew! Thanks, Commander. I'll cherish this!
Maury, fourth ship of the Gridley-class destroyer squadron, is back with new equipment! I feel like I can run even faster than before! Commander, can we go for a test run?
Maury, fourth ship of the Gridley-class destroyer squadron, is back with new equipment! I feel like I can run even faster than before! Commander, can we go for a test run?
Arriving by your side at maximum speed! Whew... This isn't tiring at all, really. Just give me a call, and I'll be right by you, no matter how far away you are.
I'd love to give you a hug, but I just got done working out, and I have to take a shower. You may not mind the sweat, but I... Well, it's embarrassing for me
I actually had a hunch that you were looking for me just now. That's what they call athlete's intuition!
You've earned yourself a break. Do you want to go on a relaxing jog with me? Don't worry - if you run out of energy on the way, I'll carry you back!
What a perfect day for some exercise! Commander, how about- *grumble*... Um, how about we grab a bite to charge our batteries?
Heehee. I can still run even faster.
This massage feels really nice... Can I give you one next?
You're massaging THIS spot?! ...Um, it's fine! I don't mind!
Commander! You should remember to check your unfinished missions. I'll help you once you're near the finish line.
That's the paperwork done, at last. What do you say to a little exercise to freshen up?
Fantastic work, Commander! You must be tired after going so far. Do you want a relaxing massage?
The team that went out on a commission is back. I'll run out and welcome them back first.
Commander, I found a route with some incredible scenery! We could run together from the starting point all the way to the finish line... That is, assuming you want to, of course.
Fletcher-class destroyer - Fletcher, Hull Number DD-445!
I'm Fletcher, the big sister of all 175 Fletcher-class destroyers! As the main force of the destroyer fleet, I participated in all the important naval battles~
Hm? You think we've met before? I get it... You know, I have over 100 sisters who look like me! I'll be following your orders from now on, Commander.
Can you recognize me today, Commander? My sisters don't look like this!
I can move quickly, so I probably won't get hit. Well... even if I do, I'll... probably be fine.
Last time someone tried to impersonate me, one of my little sisters told them to name EVERY Fletcher-class ship. That's when they gave up the act~
When I look at my little sisters, it makes me wonder... Maybe our parents were rabbits?
... Commander? Really... Are you thinking about one of my sisters again?
My little sisters would probably like doing this too. Huh? Your hand would get sore from it?
C-Commander, please stop! What if my sisters see this...
I can go on missions with my sisters again. Give the order whenever you're ready, Commander!
I wonder if all my sisters can get an equal share of the rewards...
Who has been writing so many letters to you, Commander? I'm a bit curious...
I'm back~ Wait, huh? Did another one of my little sisters join the fleet while I was gone?
A commission has been completed! Let's see what's next... Wow, there's so many! Almost one for each of my little sisters...
Now I can take better care of my sisters!
There's only a handful of enemies. Let's beat them with sheer numbers!
I've heard that if you collect fifteen stars then one of your wishes will come true~!
*Sob*... You bullies... My sisters will hurt you if they find out about this!
My sisters, give me strength...!
S-sorry, I have to go check up on my little sisters...
Whew... I need to take care of my sisters so much that I don't really have time to think about anything else...
Commander, can you help me a little bit? Thank you... You're stronger than me, after all... I'm a little jealous.
Out of all of us in the fleet... Who do you personally like the most, Commander? ... Counting me as well?
Hm? You want to help me take care of my little sisters? There's a lot of them, and I could use the help, but... Are you really, REALLY sure? In that case... Can I think about it for a bit first...?
A family, huh? ... I already have so many sisters, but you're special to me after all, Commander!
A-are you sure about this?! I mean, if it's possible... could all my sisters get one as well?!
Fletcher-class destroyer - William D. Porter, Hull Number DD-579.

Eagle Union Fletcher-class destroyer William D. Porter, that's me! I've caused my fair bit of trouble before, but everything worked out okay in the end... Hey, wait, is it just me, or am I missing a torpedo?

We finally get to meet, Commander! Whoosh, wow, THUD! Oops, I miscalculated the landing point and nearly rammed into you with my Happy D here... Anyway! I'm the absolutely dazzling William D. Porter, and I'm joining you now with some absolutely amazing ideas!
*yawn*... I got here before the working day started! Surprised? ...Hey, what's with that "I don't buy it" look on your face? You know, I've got a hundred ideas to make sure I'm not late!
I'm William D. Porter, and this is Happy D, my trusty partner! Together, we zip and zoom through the air without a fear in the- Whuaaahhh! Going too fast! I can't control it!
Oh shoot! I spilled my ice cream! Oh gosh, what do I do?! Gotta wipe it off... Happy, Happy, Happy D! In a flash, you'll be squeaky clean!
I'm so sorry, Commander! I didn't spill paint on your new carpet on purpose or anything! Ugh... Could you just please get me out of this stuff?
To cut a long story short, I dropped a bomb into the ocean where it can do no harm! ...Why did I have a bomb, you ask? Ahahaha... Look, it's a long story...
Lookie, Commander! That hole in the ground is shaped just like me! Pretty cool, huh? Wait... Come to think of it, isn't this where I fell yesterday?
A headpat a day keeps the bad luck away!
You desperately want some help?! Fear not! I've got a good idea!
Ahahahaha! Th-that tickles! Okay, I'm sorry! I won't do it again!
Commander, you've still got missions to do! If you can't figure something out, I'm here to offer advice!
Mission complete?! Are we allowed to just breeze through them?!
Got some letters for- Whuaahh! I tripped... The letters got everywhere... I'll pick 'em up right away!
Welcome back, Commander! Huggies! Oopsie, I've got glue on my hands! Oh noes! Now we're totally joined together! Well, looks like we'll just have to "stick together" for a while now, huh? Heehee!
Commander, get on my Happy D and we'll go welcome the girls back! Ready? Supersonic takeoff, let's g- Whuaahhh!
Ooh! I'm feeling SO motivated!
Ooh! I just got an idea!
Woohoo! I'll admit, this turned out nothing like how I imagined it, but all's well that ends well with a surprise victory, right?
Dangit! Blew it again...
Here comes a super-effectively good idea!
Uh-oh! Gotta think of something, quick!
Man... I could go for something fun...
I can prooobably fix up that report I splashed with soda using a hot iron... Whuah?! When'd you get here, Commander?! ...Ask about my report? Uh, it'll be done in a jiffy!
I came up with an idea that fixed that mega-giga problem we had! Gimme some praise, Commander! ...Yay! I'll be sure to come up with something even better next time!
Commander, get on my rigging, quick! Going on an adventure with friends without you just feels sad!
I take proposing to you super seriously, y'know. I'd never fumble the bag on something as important as- Oh no! I said it! I was gonna propose to you tomorrow, and I just let it slip!
We finally made it to this point! Wait, where's the ring? D-don't tell me I dropped it?! ...What? It's on my other hand! Oh, you're right! Phew... Here I thought I'd gone and blundered again!
Oh my gosh! You... You have no idea how much I wanted this!
An adventure? Let me join you! I've got a good idea!
Need help testing your equipment? I'm always available!

ex.line: Welcome, Commander! I've been waiting my butt off! Loads of fun stuff happened while you were gone, but doing fun stuff by yourself is no good! Heehee - come on, praise my good behavior!
We should totally ride the roller coaster! It'll be loads of fun! ...Wait, huh? Where are my tickets? Fine, dangit! Riding Happy D to race the roller coaster should be fun too!
Oh no! Happy D's out of energy and we're gonna fall! Commander, hold on to me! W-we'll make it out of this fine... won't we?!
Wonder where we should go next... You know what? You decide, Commander! You're bound to have a fun idea!
Whenever I'm by your side, I'm filled with endless courage! Next time WILL go better than the last!
I'm topped up on Commander energy! I've got the drive to do anything!
I'm gonna sneak up behind you then leap into a hug! ...Shoot! Owwie...
You can't wait a minute longer?! M-me neither!
I've been taking really good care of the stuff you gave me! What stuff? The memories I made with you, my sweetie, on our adventure, obviously!

lines.line: Commander, um, we agreed that I'd be a maid for a day, right? Ahahaha... See, I couldn't make it in time. Ran into a teensy bit of trouble, and, well... Basically, I need you to come help me!
Commander, um, we agreed that I'd be a maid for a day, right? Ahahaha... See, I couldn't make it in time. Ran into a teensy bit of trouble, and, well... Basically, I need you to come help me!
You're finally here, Commander! Happy D can be such a troublemaker, I tell you... What? I-it was me? But I just wanted to take a shortcut to the pop-up shop at maximum speed... Ahahaha...
I made this appointment today to thank you for getting me outta trouble before, only to end up causing trouble for YOU... I'll make up for it by giving you double the maid service time!
Where are you now, Commander? I'd appreciate your help with something... What trouble am I in, you ask? Uh, ahahaha... It'll cease to be trouble once you show up, I hope...
Um, the hole in the clock tower wasn't my fault! I was just flying near it when suddenly... Hey, wait, why am I missing a torpedo?
Hello? Commander? Do you hear me? Weird... Surely the phone line's not down 'cause of me... Oh! Commander! I thought I was in even deeper trouble for a sec there...
Oh no... Does this mean it's time for my punishment?
C-Commander?! When'd you get inside the booth?!
Commander, it's time for your missions! I may have my hands tied right now, but I can still give you reminders!
You've got mail! Whaddya say this cute maid of yours reads it out for you?
W-welcome back, Commander! Ugh, I'm in so much trouble! Please, you've gotta help me!
Up! Up! ...Whuah! Commander! Happy D won't do as I tell it to!
Commandeeer! Seeing you has totally swept away all my nervousness and worries! Lemme give you a little hug before I go and be a maid!
Fletcher-class destroyer - Charles Ausburne, Hull Number DD-570!
I'm Charles Ausburne of the Fletcher-class, and the world famous Captain of the Little Beavers! I showed my true colors at the Cape of St. George. Want to be my partner in justice, Commander?
Nice to meet you, Commander! I'm Charles Ausburne, Captain of the Little Beavers. Whoever picks on the hopeless and defenseless will receive their punishment in due time!
Good day, Commander. Charles Ausburne, Captain of the Little Beavers, reporting in! Are there any naughty kids who need to be disciplined today?
Weapons and gear are the iron fists of justice!
Become a friend of justice with me!
Justice is justice~!
My sonar shows... it looks like your heart is beating extra fast, Commander!
Mmm, I feel the justice coming from you!
!!... Uh oh... You're evil, Commander!
Commander, let's finish it in one go! Now is the chance to deliver swift justice!
Your rewards have arrived. It's always nice to be rewarded for your hard work, don't you think?
Your mail? Of course! We need help from others if we want to make this world a just one. Reply as soon as you can!
Good work, everyone!
A commission of justice has just been completed!
This is the power of justice!
Little Beavers, full speed ahead at 31 knots! Keep an eye on your sides!
See? This is the real strength of the Little Beavers!
I'll be back! Justice will prevail! *Sob*...
Accept your punishment in the name of justice!
Justice will prevail!
You're the embodiment of evil itself, Commander!
Commander, there's still much injustice in this world, so we can't just stand around and do nothing!
Being partners in justice is never easy. But you've got Ausburne by your side, so I'm sure we'll be fine!
The path of justice is a lonely one. It's rare to have a partner on such a difficult path... What I mean is... I... D-do you want to read some stories about justice with me?
In the stories I read, the hero always goes back to his normal life after defeating evil with his partners. I have to say, I feel a bit sad reading an ending like this...
... Are you sure you want to give this... to me? You've really chosen me? Then I'll follow you until the end!
This will be used for justice. Thank you.
Beavers, full speed ahead at 31 knots!
Who's been naughty?
Justice will prevail!

ex.line: Here comes Captain Ausburne of the Little Beavers! Let's give it our all today, as fellow allies of justice!
I heard that if you go on an adventure together with your fellow ally of justice, the two of you will be able to strengthen your bonds... A date? What's that supposed to be...?
Justice exists not only to defeat evil, but to also protect our precious here-and-now! Let's keep our beautiful oceans safe!
According to my radar, your heart is throbbing fast right now... Ah, wait, why is mine throbbing as well?
Wooah! I can feel the warmth of justice's power flowing through me!
Uhh, erm, I don't think this counts as justice...
Good work out there, everyone! And Commander, upholding justice is fine and all, but don't forget to rest as well!
Justice! Always! Wins! Heheh~

"Even after banishing the forces of evil, the allies of justice did not separate. Instead, they were bound together by the ties formed through fighting alongside each other and lived happily ever after!" -Alrighty! That's the ending I came up with! Pretty awesome, huh?

lines.line: Captain Ausburne of the Little Beavers, upgraded and ready to go! Heh heh, my new-and-improved justice isn't just for show! Evildoers are gonna be in for a bad time!
Captain Ausburne of the Little Beavers, upgraded and ready to go! Heh heh, my new-and-improved justice isn't just for show! Evildoers are gonna be in for a bad time!
Commander, Ausburne is ready to go at any time! I'll always be there to rush to the aid of people in need!
Cannons and riggings make up the fist of justice. Honesty and bravery make up the beating heart of justice!
Our allies of justice become more and more numerous! But, don't get overconfident just because we're getting stronger!
Commander, don't be fooled by those evildoers who pretend to be righteous! With your heart of justice, you'll be able to see right through them!
Woah, is this the "Superhero of Justice's Armaments" that Reno was talking about? It's freakin' cool!
Haah! I'll transfer my power of justice to you, Commander!
*gasp*!! ...As a disciple of justice, how could you have such evil thoughts?!
Good work, everyone! Hehe, even justice needs to rest~
Justice won't be defeated so easily!
Fletcher-class destroyer - Thatcher, Hull Number DD-514!
I'm Thatcher from the Little Beavers. I'm named after Rear Admiral Henry K. Thatcher. Awesome, right? Aren't you surprised?
Hi there, Commander! I'm Thatcher. Want to play a game with me?
What tricks should we play on the other girls today, Commander? Heehee~!
Don't touch my radar! It's our most effective weapon against the enemy during the night!
Commander, don't just stand there, come play with me!
Hahaha, look! Spence's reactions are so hilarious!
Since I don't know when I'll do something wrong, I'll just go ahead and apologize now.
I know what it is you really want to touch, weirdo!
Hoho? You wanna touch me there again?
The game isn't over yet. Don't be lazy!
I'll take these rewards off your hands if you don't want them, Commander!
You've got new mail! I-I'm not hiding it this time!
Good work, Commander! Want me to help you relax? Don't worry, I won't play any tricks on you~!
Another commission complete! I sure hope the girls didn't run into any kamikazes.
Aha! I came up with a new prank!
I missed the Turkey Shoot last time, but this battle is mine!
Pranking Tactics: super effective!
Damn it! My prank failed! Ahh, Spence, get outta the way, I'll end up bumping into you!
How's this~?
You're so boring now, Commander...
You're still upset about that prank? You're no fun!
Commander, I want to always be able to play tricks on you, but... Do you hate me for that?
What would you do if I told you I liked you? Hehe, I'm just joking~!
Close your eyes, Commander~... *Kiss* Did you feel that? That wasn't me... Okay, it was!
Just so you know: you're totally wrong if you think my pranks will end just because I got this ring! My pranks are an expression of love. So, I'm expecting you to take~ good~ care~ of~ me~!
This is really nice! ...Wait, are you trying to wrap me up in ribbons, too?!
Fletcher-class destroyer - Aulick, Hull Number DD-569!
I'm Aulick of the Little Beavers! I was mainly tasked with air rescues. I'm not as strong as the captain, but I'll be more than satisfied as long as you let me fight till the end!
Yaaay! It's so great to meet you, Commander! Just call me Aulick! ... What was that? I said Aulick! My name is Aulick!
Yaaay! Welcome back, Commander!
Don't forget to keep your gear in working order, Commander!
Commander, won't you take Aulick out to play~?
Aulick loves hanging out with all the other Little Beavers!
Ah, Aulick likes the Commander too, of course!
Aren't I so soft and squishy?
C-Commander...! You're naughty!
Commander, you've still got unfinished missions! You're being lazy, aren't you?
Reporting in! Mission rewards have been delivered!
You've got mail, Commander!
This place is great, Commander~ I've grown to like it more and more!
The girls are back from their adventure!
I hope it'll come in use to you, Commander...
Sssh, be quiet! We need to coordinate with our sisters preparing to flank the enemy.
I'd never let you down, Commander!
Why does everything have to hit me in the face?!
It's Aulick, I'm telling you! A-u-lick!
You think it's funny to call me by the wrong name?
Want to take a walk together, Commander?
... After being called sweet for so long, I think I'm starting to get used to it. ... You call me sweet because that's what girls are? I-is that a compliment?
Like a cookie - twist, lick, and dunk. D-do you want to give it a try, Commander?
Commander... H-how sweet am I?
My Little Beaver sisters are for sure going to envy me now.
I love this! Thanks, Commander!
Fletcher-class destroyer - Foote, Hull Number DD-511!
I'm Foote, one of the Fletcher-class Little Beavers. You think you have family issues? Try remembering the names of your thirty older sisters and nearly a hundred younger sisters...
*Tsk* Greetings... I hate greetings. But I suppose it's a formality... Hello, Commander. I'm Foote...
It's so annoying having to greet you every day...
Come on, hurry up. It's exhausting to hold this pose!
*Tsk* Is the food ready yet?
Commander... this doesn't go... oh forget it. It's too much trouble to fix.
Thatcher and Spence are always fighting. Can't they just quiet down?
C-Commander... Could you stop touching me for a while?! I'm getting sore...
Being shy... is also pretty annoying...
Can't you just finish these missions already?
*Sigh* Do I really need to remind you every time you need to collect your rewards?
Mail's here. There, I told you.
Being your secretary is so bothersome... I'm getting tired... Zzz...
I love not having to go out on commissions... but it's annoying that I have to report back to you every time one of the girls come back...
I'm stronger now...? How annoying...
You want me to be the flagship? That's too much work...
You don't need to praise me for something this easy.
*Tsk* Too much trouble. I don't wanna play with these guys anymore.
*Sigh* This is so annoying...
*Tsk* Could you just stop bothering me?
Who would ever be interested in me... You're a real pain in the neck...
You're being surprisingly quiet, Commander. I'll keep you company for a while longer then.
Isn't it annoying to have to call me over all the time? I think I'll just move into your room instead...
I feel like... I want to help you with stuff... Even though that's a bother... I'm so annoyed...
This is annoying... But if it's for your sake then I have no choice...
What's this? It's so cu... Ahem. Thank you very much.
Fletcher-class destroyer - Spence, Hull Number DD-512!

I'm... Spence from the Little Beavers. I took part in the Great Marianas Turkey Shoot with my younger sisters. Oh no! A h-h-hurricane is coming... Sorry, Commander, I forget everything when I get nervous!
Huh...? C-C-C-Commander... Hello... Spence h-has been wanting to talk to you... b-but didn't have the courage to...
C-Commander... N-no, I wasn't waiting that long!
Ah! D-don't touch me anywhere weird, okay...
Commander, it's so warm here! I think I can relax like this...
Thatcher's over there! She's making me anxious~!
Ausburne isn't like Thatcher at all... She actually helps me when I need it!
I'm sorry that I don't live up to your expectations, Commander...
Eeek~! Um... W-what am I supposed to...
Commander... You haven't finished all of your missions...
Remember to claim... that... reward...
C-Commander... You've got mail...
You're back in one piece, Commander... Thank the lord!
The girls are back! I'm so jealous of how awesome they all are!
U-u-umm... I'll try to work harder now!
Commander... I'll work hard not to disappoint you!
Whew, that wasn't easy...
I-I'm so scared!
I-I-I'll try my best!
You're a bit scary, Commander...
Woah! Commander... You scared me...
My big sister said... that I can trust you, Commander...
C-C-Commander, can I come stay with you when it's storming outside? I'm terrified of thunder!
C-C-Commander... I just watched a film in which two people really liked each other... but they couldn't be together in the end... We'll be together forever, right?
So you like me too, Commander? W-w-w-what will I do now... I'm so happy that I can't stop crying...!
Whoa! I can have this?! Thank you!
Benson-class Destroyer - Benson, Hull Number DD-421!
Here comes Benson! I'm way cooler than Anderson. I'm a capital destroyer, and can move at speeds up to 35 knots! My anti-air defenses are just as impressive. I can't wait for you to see me in battle!
Yahoo! Commander! Aren't you charmed by how cute and risqué I am? Huh? W-who am I? ... Hahaha... My name is Benson... It's a pleasure to meet you...
Let's hear your excuse for making the strongest and cutest cutie in the world wait for so long, Commander!
Stop touching my ears! I told you already, they're real! I-I'll bite you!
I'm so cute! The cutest in the universe!
I'm telling you, Commander, Fletcher's house next door is full of people! Us girls need to help her out every now and then~.
If you don't talk to me enough then I'll stop being a bunny! Woof woof!
Whoa! I actually fell asleep! Could this be because of that fabled super hypnosis thing?!
Ah, I feel so hot... I'm burning inside!
A mission? No problem! Easy peasy! Bring it on, whatever it may be!

It's about time you showed up, Commander. Now, show me some spirit! As my lieutenant, don't do anything slovenly that would incur the mockery of others! Very well, let's move out!
It's about time you showed up, Commander. Now, show me some spirit! As my lieutenant, don't do anything slovenly that would incur the mockery of others! Very well, let's move out!
What took you so long, Commander?
Mannerisms, etiquette, dress codes... Hmph. This is all more convoluted than naval battles, that's for sure. Still, I agreed to participate, so I mustn't act like a total simpleton.
What are you looking at? You want a drink, huh? Why didn't you just say so right away?
Even the world's best warrior would succumb to exhaustion if they never stopped fighting. Everyone needs time off for recreation, you know? So enjoy yourself tonight.
Not going to lie, St. Louis's car looked really slick. I'm considering asking for the keys and taking it for a spin later.
Hey! You nearly put your hand on my shoulder there... Try to avoid doing that in public at the very least.
That level of workout is nothing you can't handle. Right, Commander?
You want to play, do you? Come here!
Hah! Pathetic. Can't they send someone who'll put up a fight?
Tonight I am not a renowned naval general, I am a feared commander of witches! And you... Yes, you're not my lieutenant, you are my arcane familiar!
Tonight I am not a renowned naval general, I am a feared commander of witches! And you... Yes, you're not my lieutenant, you are my arcane familiar!
The curtain rises on All Hallows' Eve! Commander, we're leaving!
Darkness may unnerve people, but you need some well-placed lighting to truly frighten them. So, tell me, Commander: have any ideas for setting up a Halloween scene?
Ghosts? Goblins? Hah! On this night, they too are under my control! Hahahaha!
Trick-or-treaters? It's your job to deal with those. Wouldn't want to risk petrifying any children with my terrific costume.
Raising the brim of my witch hat to reveal my razor-sharp fangs - now that's what I'm talking about!
Come, familiar. Get up on the pumpkin and take in the Halloween spirit.
Desperate to once more taste the sting of my whip, are we?
My fangs and ears look very realistic? Of course they do. I had them specially procured just for this holiday.
Baltimore-class heavy cruiser - Baltimore, Hull Number CA-68.

I'm Baltimore, the lead ship of my class of CAs. I was the first CA to be designed and constructed without the limitations of any naval treaties, thanks to which I could equip cutting-edge weaponry for the time. And within this fleet, I will fight for justice and freedom.
Heya. Are you in need of help? I'm Baltimore, a heavy cruiser just passing by... Okay, that's enough jokes for now... Baltimore, awaiting your orders, Commander.
Okay! Let's get to work, Commander!
What you can do, what you should do, and what you will do - the choices one must make. You, however, need only focus on what you do best, Commander.
I'll get this work done in good time. I mean, that's what you should expect of your subordinate, Commander.
SHE'S Quincy?! L-looks pretty different from the one I know... But I guess it's not that unusual for ships to share the same name.
Power alone won't fundamentally solve all one's problems. This should go without saying, Commander, but please try to remember this fact.
Could you fetch me an Oxy-cola? Thanks... Ahhh! That hits the spot!
Eek?! ... Y-you did not just hear that, got it?!
Missions, missions. Let's start by checking the list.
There's our mission rewards. Good to have the money for retrofits and repairs.
You've got a message, Commander. I really think you should check these more often.
Were you hurt, Commander?
Commission complete. I could use some exercise, so could you let me have the next one?
Great! I'm getting fitter and fitter.
All ships, enter formation!
You crooks should've used your powers for good.
Even the good guys face setbacks sometimes...
We've got an opening... Let's take 'em out!
Don't lose control! Focus!
Commander, you ought to open your heart a little.
As long as the will do to right exists, people will live righteously even without being ordered to. I pray that you will stay on the path of justice, Commander.
Let's not be overly formal and get to it: what do you wanna do next? I'm open to chat about pretty much whatever, so if anything's on your mind, just tell me.
You want to go shopping with me? Sure, consider it done. You wanna make a date out of it? I mean, might as... H-hold on! When you say "date," you mean THAT kind of date?!
Man... I doubt I'll ever get used to this... Maybe I should act more girly when... No, this is a me-problem, not a you-problem! ... *Sigh*, I can't think straight when you're around, Commander...

Yes, I vow to be with you through thick and thin, and to love and to cherish for all my life, Commander. ... So, uh, once you put the ring on my fing- W-what is it? Hey, what're you doing?! Ah, ahh...
Thank you, I'll get you something nice in return.
Wichita, don't go overboard, now!
Got a feeling like we'll make a good team!

ex.line: Time to get to work, Commander! Come on, let's get productive! I'll help you out!
You processed all of those documents in just half a day's work? Wow... You're something else. I gotta try harder.
I'm happy to do anything you wanna do. As your, uhh... Gah, I still can't say it!
The weather's nice. Wanna go out and get some exercise? Staying in your office all day is bad for you.
Bremerton recommended a few nice snack bars to me... Say, what if we went together? If you can't leave right now, I could pick some up for you.
Touch me all you want!
Hmm... Nah, I just can't take coffee. Here's your drink back. I'll stick to my Oxy-cola... Ahhh, that's the good stuff!
Eep?! I-I still can't get used to that...
Let me take a look at you... Nice! Glad to see you're not hurt. Take me with you on your next mission, alright?
Phew... I'm tired, Commander. Let me lean on you... Hm? Am I getting too relaxed around you? I-I mean, we're married, and all! Now you're getting me all nervous again...

lines.line: Oh, you wanna observe my club activities, Commander? Ahah, as you can tell, it's just a sports club with the goal of making you sweat. Nothing suspicious about that, is there...?
Oh, you wanna observe my club activities, Commander? Ahah, as you can tell, it's just a sports club with the goal of making you sweat. Nothing suspicious about that, is there...?
Do you know how to get to my clubroom? Or should I show you the way?
Our club is mainly for having fun, so anyone can join. You should join a club you'd like too, Commander.
Yo, Cleveland! Up for another round of basketball later? You bring Independence and I'll get Pittsburgh on the team!
A drink? Sure, I could use one! ... Ahh, that's the ticket!
Oh, my uniform's completely soaked... T-thanks for letting me know...
Eek?! ... W-what are you doing?!
Looks like you worked up a good sweat. Here, a towel. Should I go get a drink for you, too?
Let's do this!
Heya, you here to watch the game? Heh, heavy cruiser Baltimore, the passerby solver of troubles, here to play it cool!
Heya, you here to watch the game? Heh, heavy cruiser Baltimore, the passerby solver of troubles, here to play it cool!
All right, let's do like always and breeze through these tasks.

I'm radiating unusually dark vibes? Thanks for the compliment. I guess these decal tattoos Bremerton recommended are doing their job. As in, they make people a little more cautious around me than they normally would be.
Bremerton's got a real knack for psychological warfare. She often gives me good advice on how to present myself.
I'm an expert at tennis, as you'd expect. If anything, you'd be kinda hard-pressed to find a sport I *don't* excel at.
So Commander, are you free after we're done here? Hahah, what, is it *that* unusual of me to ask if you wanna hang out?
I know I'm eyecatching, but I didn't hope you'd stare so intensely at me... I mean, that's not to say I *don't* want you stare at me, but...
Eep?! Come on, I've *told* you I'm sensitive to this sort of stuff!
Come! We shall fight head-on!
You don't need to know why I look this way. Because if you did, you'd vanish from this world. I'm just kidding around. Hahaha!
Damn, that Bremerton... What did she make me wear this time... Even though I was the one to ask her for advice... Um... Ugh... This doesn't look too weird, right...?
Damn, that Bremerton... What did she make me wear this time... Even though I was the one to ask her for advice... Um... Ugh... This doesn't look too weird, right...?
Oh, you can sit here if you want to, Commander. I'll just... stand here for a while and accustom myself to this look.
Bremerton said, "When you change your look, your mannerisms usually change too" and suggested this dress to me... She must be snickering at me actually wearing it right now...
I should've gone with a less cumbersome outfit, shouldn't I? Maybe something like Cleveland's suit... Yeah, that would've worked...
I'll bet tons of girls want to share a drink with you tonight, right, Commander? Go on, chat with them before I get you wasted. Or you can just stay here, hahahah.
The mirror? It's so I can see my- Oh god!
Woah?! Ah, thanks... Guess it's a real uphill battle, getting used to these high heels...
"H-Hiii! You want to dance with me?" ...Oh god, no, that's way too forced. I need to sound natural for- Eep! W-when'd you get here, Commander?!

"Our meeting here must have been preordained by fate. Hail to you. I am a passing traveler by the name of Baltimore." ...Hahah, it's nothing. Just some lines I came up with to match my traditional getup. Did they do the trick, Commander?

"Our meeting here must have been preordained by fate. Hail to you. I am a passing traveler by the name of Baltimore." ...Hahah, it's nothing. Just some lines I came up with to match my traditional getup. Did they do the trick, Commander?
What's the plan for today, Commander? Feel like visiting a Sakura Empire shrine?
Life is its own journey. You can't live the perfect life, but what's important is living without regrets.
What type of journey do you prefer? One that follows a strictly laid-out plan, or one where you go with the flow?
Why are these other puppies following me? ...You know what, it's all good. It's always good to have more company on a journey.
I'd love to take a shot at a Sakura Empire sport. Like archery. Or maybe kendo?
Getting lost in a foreign land is no big deal as long as you've got friends.
Brrr... Sure is windy today... Oh, hey, Commander. Not feeling cold, are you?

Heya, Commander. You here to spectate the race? Strap in, 'cause it's gonna be wild... My getup? They asked me to help out the grid girls, so yeah. Just hope I'll do a good job of building hype for the race.

Heya, Commander. You here to spectate the race? Strap in, 'cause it's gonna be wild... My getup? They asked me to help out the grid girls, so yeah. Just hope I'll do a good job of building hype for the race.
Commander, give me a "Hell yeah"! The race is about to start!
I asked for a flexible outfit, and this is what I got. I agreed to give the team a hand, and I'm gonna help as much as I can. I'd feel bad if I didn't.
Waving a flag around might look easy, but it's sweaty work... Oh, crap, sorry. I shouldn't be doing that.
How about you give racing a go sometime, Commander? Don't worry about any stakes, it'd just be an exhibition race.
Fun fact: it was Bremerton who came to me for help. I know, right? Even the ever-reliable Bremerton needs a hand sometimes. I was just as surprised as you.
Ohh...
You want me to say the line, am I right? Alright... "Hit it, Commander! Full speed! You're on the final lap!"
Eep! D-don't touch me there...
The race- I mean, the mission's started, Commander!
Mission rewards are in. This calls for a bottle of champagne.
Nice job out there! I like to think you heard me cheering for you. Hahahah! All that matters is you remember we're all waiting for you back at port.
A commission's been completed! The girls definitely deserve a li'l victory gesture.
Change to top gear! Pedal to the metal!
Hands-on action is more my style than cheerleading is!
Keep it together, Commander. It's not over until you throw in the towel.
The scenery is even prettier on days like today... Huh? What do I mean? I mean our w-wedding, obviously... Ugh, quit teasing me already!
The scenery is even prettier on days like today... Huh? What do I mean? I mean our w-wedding, obviously... Ugh, quit teasing me already!
Okay, I'm good and rested, so I'm ready to set sail any time. Commander, um... can we hold hands?
No, I love the heels, since we picked them out together and all. They fit just fine. It's just... I'm still not used to them.
I'm not under the weather or anything - my feet just hurt a little. Don't stare so much... Oh, do you think I'm cute? W-well, okay...
Commander, do I look more feminine today? ...So much so that your heart skipped a beat?
There's a petal on your head. I'll get it... Hm. Can you bend down a little so I can reach you?
Was my veil not on right? O-oh... You just wanted to see my face?
Huh? You wanna bridal carry me? I-I'm fine, I can walk on my own... Eep?!
Eep?! Th-that's not a good idea right now... I mean, this skirt isn't very flexible, or, uh, umm...
Don't just stand there. Get over here and sit with me, would you? I left a spot open for you.

You know, I don't think I've ever said it out loud... I gotta do it right now. I can't run away from it because I'm too shy or nervous or anything. Ahem! Commander... I love you. Haha... I finally said it!
Nevada-class battleship - Nevada, Hull Number BB-36!

Yo! I'm the big sister of the Nevada-class battleships, Nevada! I served in both the Atlantic and Pacific fleets. The President was once on board me, I've changed kidneys, carried two atomic bombs, and even cleared out an entire battlefield!
Are you the commander, young man? I'm Nevada. I'll be working with you from here on out.
Hey, get your spirits up!
At times like these, I tend to like your mindfulness...
Gambling? I'm not usually interested, but I'll give it a shot with you if you're up for it!
Commander, go do what you want while you're still young!
Bantry Bay Squadron? I just missed my chance, you see...
Who knew you were a people person?
Are you that interested in my 'priority defenses'?
As soldiers, completing missions is our divine duty.
Mission rewards have been delivered!
Yo~ Commander! A message!
If you're tired, you can always rest on my shoulders. Don't be embarrassed. Come on!
Commander, the commissions have returned without issue. Make sure to comlement them for their efforts!
Mmm, not a bad feeling!
How lively! Allow me to join in the fun!
Ha, you think you can beat me with such weak firepower and defences?
Tsk, wait and see how I take you on next time!
You are still way off!
I'm a bit disappointed in you...
I'm quite confident in my own luck. Want to gamble a bit?
Commander, Oklahoma told me about a nice shop around here. Wanna have a look? ... Hey, stop standing there like a pole! Let's go
If you like someone, just say it up front. What use is there to hide it? ...It's just not like you at all, Commander!
The idea behind priority defenses? That is to protect our most important areas... What, you want to know how important they are? W-well, if it's you...
Oh you... what are you doing, getting so bold at a time like this? Have you never considered the time and place for such an important thing? Hmph. yeah yeah. I'm not saying no, so bring it.
Nice! I love it!
Howdy, young'un! Aren't you tired from goin' around greetin' fancy people? Come over here and relax with me and some good food.
Howdy, young'un! Aren't you tired from goin' around greetin' fancy people? Come over here and relax with me and some good food.
Here already, young'un? I reckon we oughta get to work, then.
Y'know, that seamstress asked me what I wanted, and I told her I wanted my dress to focus on defense. Look how that turned out... But hey, I kinda like it. It's easy to move in.
There's somethin' that gets me real emotional about seein' Oklahoma chat it up with friends.
I know you're real busy with work, but how about you work on that stamina? You haven't eaten one bite since you've been runnin' around talkin' to people. Here, eat up!
You wanna make a wager? I don't have much to bet in this getup... Oh, I know! Whoever loses has to stay for another drink! How's that, young'un?
Need a break? Hey, go get you some fresh air. I'll hold down the fort.
Kinda feel like I'm developin' in weird ways...
We've got new missions! Just in time to burn off that meal.
There's our mission bonus. Oklahoma called just in time.
You've got mail, young'un. What's it say?
You look beat. Hahaha, how's about I help out and let you lie your pretty little head in my lap? C'mon, don't be shy, now!
Let's give 'em a good whoopin'!
Heh, with this, I won't be outperformed by those fancy greenhorn battleships. Young'un, from now on, just leave everything to Nevada here!
Heh, with this, I won't be outperformed by those fancy greenhorn battleships. Young'un, from now on, just leave everything to Nevada here!
Nevada, always ready for your orders!
Commander, want to go horseback riding together? It doesn't matter if you don't know how, just hang on to my waist!
That Oklahoma, she's ain't so wet behind the ears anymore. Soon she's gonna be all independent.
Though fighting can't eliminate every problem in the world, it certainly can eliminate most of those who would cause problems.
Commander, I've got your back, so you can keep charging forward!
So, you fancy a dance with the devil? As you can see, I'm ready to up the ante. Young'un, what are you going to wager?
Commander, can I... change my wager?
Young'un, want to experience a bridal carry for yourself?
As long I am here, there's no way we can lose!
Your offenses are weak, your defenses are feeble! Your reactions are slow, and your movements are sluggish! Come back when you've trained more!
Nevada-class battleship - Oklahoma, Hull Number BB-37!
I'm Oklahoma of the Nevada class. I served in both the Atlantic and Pacific fleets... I even bore the duty of engaging in 'friendly' diplomacy!
Commander... eh, ah... I'm sorry! I was stunned just by looking at you... Ah, no, no... Nice to meet you! I'm Oklahoma!
Commander~ Please work hard with me today as well~
Huh? What are you looking at? Is there something on my face?
If I don't do something soon, everyone will laugh about the 'Bantry Bay Squadron' again!
In two years... no, one year, I will surpass my sister for sure!
Commander, I will always listen to your troubles if you have any, you hear?
Commander, your hand feels comforting to me...
Whaa?! Geez... My heart wasn't ready for this...
Let's finish the missions like a speedy swifty!
Don't forget to claim your rewards!
I've put your mail on the table, Commander~
Commander, please tell big sis not to worry about me.
The commissions have been completed. It would be nice if this brings peace.
Commander, is there any way i can help you with this?
Everyone, listen to my orders and get into formation!
With this, big sis won't have to worry about me! I think.
*Cries*... I need to work even harder!
Fire~!
I wonder if my eyes are lying...
Is the Commander looking at me? Ehehe, I'm so happy!
Commander, want to go on a date with me? I know a lot of good shops around~
Commander, I was smitten at first sight~ Ehehe. There's no particular reason for love. I just like what I like.
Hmm? Ah, Commander. No need to worry about me. I'll be happy as long as I can keep looking at you like this~
Ehehe~ Commander, let's go and report to big sis about us right now~
Commander, I'm gonna take super good care of this gift from you!

Howdy, Commander! Oh, this outfit? I've been super into this kind of stuff lately! I even added some jack-o-lanterns for extra ambiance and had some Manjuus help out. So what's the verdict? Pretty cool, isn't it?

Howdy, Commander! Oh, this outfit? I've been super into this kind of stuff lately! I even added some jack-o-lanterns for extra ambiance and had some Manjuus help out. So what's the verdict? Pretty cool, isn't it?
Haah... Commander looks so dreamy today as well... Oh, uh, forget you heard anything!
It was real hard work putting together this whole ensemble, but well worth the effort. Maybe I can convince my sis to change into matching costumes next time~
Naughty Manjuus who try to pull hijinks in front of the Commander will be punished by three minutes inside the cannon barrel instead of the time-out room!
I paid extra attention to all sorts of details, from the feathers in my hat to the tassels on my clothes! I'm really glad you noticed them!
I actually made this little Manjuu eyepatch myself. If there are any doodads you want me to make for you, just hit me up!
Alrighty, let's put our best foot forward today as well!
Eep?! Wh-what's gotten into you?!
The two of us did some real good work today, so I'm looking forward to all the praise I'll be getting from my sis! Ehehe~
Commander, I won! Hehe~!
Thanks a ton, Commander. With my new strength, do you think I've managed to catch up to my sister a little? Ehehe, for your sake, I'll work even harder!
Thanks a ton, Commander. With my new strength, do you think I've managed to catch up to my sister a little? Ehehe, for your sake, I'll work even harder!
Howdy, Commander~ Are you doin' well?
Commander, how about we hold a Fleet Problem? I'm pretty good at those~
Commander, wanna go riding with me? We can both ride the same horse, hehe~
Hey Commander, you gotta hear this! I just scored a win against my sister! Yaaay~!
Hmm? What's up, Commander? Do you need my help? Sure~ just leave it to me!
I've already become more independent, so my sister told me that I'll be able to take care of you now! Ehehe~
Commander, it's our victory! V~!
Pennsylvania-class battleship -  Pennsylvania, Hull Number BB-38!
I'm Pennsylvania, lead ship of an improved Nevada class. You can call me "Sister Penn." I really shouldn't brag, but I've sortied on countless successful missions. You can definitely depend on me!
I'm Pennsylvania, lead ship of an improved Nevada class. You can call me "Sister Penn." I've sortied on countless successful missions, so you can be confident in my ability.
Commander, you know you can always share any thoughts you have with me.
