Thanks. This is the first time someone has really cared about me...
Your eyes... Why do they look like those of an abandoned puppy?
Can you please not look at me with those hungry eyes?
You don't have the best imagination, do you?
You dont have to get worked up over tiny things, Commander.
...!! Hold up, are you alright in the head?
I say, have you forgotten a mission?
I left your rewards over there. Don't forget to collect them!
Here, I got your mail. Will ya make sure to reply soon?
Having a drink after battle is something else. You want some?
Commission completed... Not bad. Everyone seems to be growing stronger.
You can depend on me.
Come on, taste my 14-inch guns!
Tsk...Winning like this is so dull...
I was a fool to have any expectations of your commanding abilities.
Is that the best you've got?
You're such a coward...
You and Arizona can hide behind me. I'll protect you.
You want to stand next to me?... Think carefully now. That is a very hard thing to do.

It's alright if you don't want to push yourself further. You've worked very hard. I thought you were joking, but... How do I say this... I'm used to protecting others... But to meet someone who cares about me really is something else.
Mmm, you've worked so hard. I didn't think that you'd be able to catch up with me... You want a reward? How about a kiss? Or an unforgettable evening? Both are fine with me~!

This fleet has turned into a place I can call home... The people I want to protect, and the person who protects me despite being unable to kill a bug, and then the 'me' who becomes so giddy for that person are all here... You idiot *blush*...
For me? Now this is really something. I'll take it.
As an adult, let me protect you!
Cassin, Downes, let Sister Penn handle this!
No more tears...!

ex.line: Commander, if there's anything I can help with, just say the word.
Have you been getting enough food, Commander? What? Am I not allowed to be concerned for you? How rude of you.
There, you deserve a patting. Heheh... Feeling better? You're not a puppy; that's all you're getting for now.
Arizona, I was thinking we could have lunch later. You'll come along, won't you?
Hey...! Downes! Don't throw stuff at me, even if I can catch it in time! I know you won't listen to me, but still...
What can Sister Penn do for you?
Hey...! Why so restless all of a sudden?
Cheers! I'll save the champagne until our next magnificent victory.

lines.line: Halt! Who are you?! ...Oh, it's you, Commander. I briefly mistook you for a spy there. Why are you here? To spectate? Or, God forbid, to gather intel on my army?
Halt! Who are you?! ...Oh, it's you, Commander. I briefly mistook you for a spy there. Why are you here? To spectate? Or, God forbid, to gather intel on my army?
All right, so... Are we good? Phew... Scenes on horseback are always so draining.
You brought lunch? Appreciate it. Be sure to give Arizona something as well.
You falter not even in the presence of a general on her horse... Very good - you'll make an excellent soldier. Together, we will make great conquests!
Are my looks really that exotic to you? Hahah! Your imagination is terribly limited.
While I'm not as good at riding as Chapayev, I'm fairly capable on horseback... You think I'm outstanding, even? Really?
How can Sister Penn help?
Unfortunately for you, this armor is the real deal.
Commission completed. It's vital to keep your troops and horses fed and equipped.
I shall trample our enemies underfoot!
By my spear, the enemy is sundered!
Pennsylvania-class Battleship -  Arizona, Hull Number BB-39!

I am the second ship of the Pennsylvania class battleships, born during summer, Arizona. 
Yes... the 'Tears of Arizona' is referring to me, but it's a little sad to call them tears... you see...
I am the second ship of the Pennsylvania class, born during summer, Arizona. This time, I won't let that tragedy repeat itself...
Commander, do you understand my feelings for wanting to protect my friends?
Even me? ... Thank you very much!
As long as I'm in Commander's memory, I'll never be alone
In order to not forget about them... they... have always been with me
Commander, did my facial expression bother you? I'm sorry...
I've become calmer now...
Uh- Let's pretend that it didn't happen, alright?
Commander... the... the missions. They're not done, you know?
Here's the list, but... Are the physical rewards really that important...?
Commander, there's a mail for you. Interpersonal relationships are important.
It's great to be back, safe and sound.
The wind... A sign of the girls' return
I will protect everyone...!
This time, I will protect all that I want...!
This feels great... It would be good if the nightmares go away at this rate...
No more... Just this once, please let me have it my way...
This time, I'll protect everyone!
I can't cry!... I have to cry for happy times...!
I wonder where I truly belong?
Ahh... Apologies. I was thinking about something sad again...
...Thank you for always listening to me... I've been feeling much better now...
I feel safe around you, Commander... I feel as if I'm not afraid to look ahead after thinking about what happened back then...
I'm sorry... Ah, no, I'm just a little afraid... 'What if Commander doesn't come back after this mission?'... I can't stop my tears just thinking about it...
I won't let that day happen again' you say? ...Thank you. Those are the words that resonated with my heart the most in my life... I believe in you!
Oh, wow! Thank you!
I'll work hard, big sis!
I'm going to protect everyone this time!

I heard these clothes are from the Dragon Empery, but they're a bit... Umm, it's not that I dislike them, but the thought of you seeing me in them is rather embarrassing... B-but it's not like I'm going to start crying...

I heard these clothes are from the Dragon Empery, but they're a bit... Umm, it's not that I dislike them, but the thought of you seeing me in them is rather embarrassing... B-but it's not like I'm going to start crying...
My desire to protect my friends... has been made possible here. Hehe, of course I'll continue to give it my all.
Both in the past and present, being able to help your friends in various ways outside of battle is something to be happy about. Hm? You feel happy just from being with me...?
If wearing this outfit means I can help my friends make wonderful memories, I don't mind doing it.
Do you think I should try to learn some dance steps from a real dancer? Would it be okay if I asked California for help?
Oh, Commander... there's something on your cheek. Let me wipe it off... and done.
Pennsylvania? Oh, it's...
Stay calm, Arizona...
Please keep this a secret from my sister...
The mission rewards have arrived. It's always nice to have extra supplies.
The girls seem to be back from their commissions. Good tidings arrive on the wind.
I'll give it my best shot...!
Dancing might not be my strong suit, but I know how to fight!
Time to evacuate? Understood!

I left the handkerchief I use to wipe my tears back at home. ...I had some trouble finding a good place to stow it away, and moreover, I don't feel like I'll be crying all that much. There's no need for you to worry, Commander.
Tennessee-class battleship -  Tennessee, Hull Number BB-43!

I am the new type of battleship, Tennessee. In terms of combat, my waterline protection and hull armor have been upgraded, and my fire control systems have improved my fighting capabilities further. Commander, your orders?
You're the Commander? Hmm... Looks like you have potential. I'm motivated enough to help with your dreams. Ah, that reminds me, I am Tennessee. Got it memorized?
Commander, it's time to roll!
You can look all you want. Just don't forget about your job.
Commander! If you don't sortie, I'll bring the girls and head to new waters myself!
I totally cannot comprehend why you're so easygoing...
The secret to getting a better figure?... Cease with such jokes.
Mm... 'Cute' doesn't quite fit me.
I'm not a 'Clear' target like in a game!
Hurry and take care of the missions, will you?
Your rewards are here, Commander.
Commander, you've got new mail
When is the next sortie?
The commission team is back? Allow me to show how they should really be handled.
Like a full score and then some... Not bad.
March through the gates of hell! May our image be burned into the eyes of our enemies!
This kind of battle is quite good
Yes. Yes! This is the kind of challenge I'm looking for!
Witness true firepower!
You really are helpless...
My motto is, 'survival of the fittest'
Commander, you are still too weak. Come and train with me, and I will turn you into a proper Commander!
You're looking good these days. Hmm? Ah, not to worry. I've always stuck around with you. I don't want all the training to be in vain, after all.

I'm used to your pace now after all this time. I've yet to get used to staying in a room all day... If anything happens to me because of this, it's all on you. Don't tell me you're gonna dodge the issue.
If I take this, it means I'm yours forever? Fine, but on one condition; I want none of that 'You'll get hurt if you're in the battlefield' crap. I need some action every now and then!
Hahahaha! This is great! Thanks!
Tennessee-class battleship -  California, Hull Number BB-44!

Hello. I am the second of the Tennessee class battleships, California. I was once the flagship of the Pacific fleet, and was part of the Atlantic fleet as well. How about it? Bet you didn't expect that I was a popular one, did you? Hehe~
Hello, Commander. I am California. It's not good to brag, but I'm quite strong you know. Do look forward to it~
Weather, check. Wind, check. A fine sailing day, Commander.
Commander, I will do my best to meet everyone's expectations
I feel different from big sister? That's not true. She might not look it but she's actually kind
Ah~ Big sis didn't say much today... Wha! N-nothing at all!
Ah, where did my undies go? Eheh
This is comfy. Every time big sis scolds me, she comforts me with this afterwards as well.
Wait-... Commander! Where are you touching? Big sis wouldn't do this!
Commander, don't forget to do your missions!
Hahaha, this is good!
It's new mail. Wanna open it up right away?
You looked great just now, Commander!
Commander, the girls from the commissions have returned. Let me do one next time, please~
Now I can reach for further waters~
Don't panic...Calm down... Let's go!
Aaah... that was a great workout
Oof... Big sis will lecture me for sure!
Commander, I'll go play on my own now~
You don't know if you can be friends with someone unless you tried to make them. Commander, wanna hang out together?
*humming* Ah, Commander~ Just who I was looking for. I was thinking about taking you some place to have fun!
We've already had fun throughout the docks. How about we go some place farther? Just the two of us... Heh heh heh...
Tennesee said to me, 'You must be careful who you choose as a partner.' 'Once you do, tell me', she also said. Well, if it's you, Commander, she won't say a word, I think...
Commander, where are we going to play today? ...WHA! ...Seriously, I don't... I'm happy and all, but please don't pull this again. You surprised me...
Wow, I love this! Thanks!
Colorado class battleship— Colorado, hull number BB-45

I'm the lead ship of the Colorado class. In order to gain an advantage in the decisive battle, I'm the first ship to be equipped with 406mm guns. BIG SEVEN... is the most honored title for us battleships.
Are you the one calling me? Well, I've been waiting for this day for a long time. In the name of the BIG SEVEN, Eagle Union battleship Colorado, reporting in.
Commander, you’ve rested long enough. When shall we weigh anchor?
Commander... Can you take your eyes off me?
Commander, although aircraft carriers are really powerful, but battleships are not obsolete. They are indispensable!
Amelia... She was a great woman, though she still cannot be found. Perhaps she is flying freely in another world...
My poor sisters were hurt on that humiliating day. One day, I will have those invaders pay for what they have done!
Commander, please don't touch the main gun that I was just using, you will affect my shooting accuracy.
Shall I load the Commander into a 406mm gun and fire him?
Whether you need fire support or fleet battle, please give the order Commander.
Commander, mission reward has been delivered.
You’ve got new mail. There may be news from my sisters...
Making sure everyone returns home safely is also one of my duties.
A lot of oil and supplies have been shipped in. Looks like we got plenty of both for the next mission.
Emm, as one of the BIG SEVEN, my powers are unquestionable. Although, timely enhancements are still a necessity.
I will not allow you to misbehave anymore... All guns, ready to fire a volley!
Huh? Am I the MVP? Such a piece of cake for one of the BIG SEVEN.
This is not the end of the line...
It's time to show you the true power of the BIG SEVEN!
The bridge was hit? Damage control, now!
Commander, please… don’t come any closer.
I’m proud of my BIG SEVEN title. Unfortunately the battleship era is closing, and a new wave of ships are arriving...
Commander, why do you care about me so much? Many people are afraid of me and keep their distance from me. Perhaps I've been too used to this. But recently, I’ve suddenly felt... so lonely.
The Commander is willing to talk to someone as bad-tempered as me. Such a weirdo... I don't hate talking to the Commander, though.
The Commander's compliment after the end of each battle is something which I crave for. Commander, can you... praise me a little more?
Unknowingly I’ve slowly become more dependent on you, Commander. With the power of the BIG SEVEN, I shall protect you until my dying breath.
Is this meant to improve my temper? Well, I may as well accept it as a one-off...
Hmm-hum-hum... So very cute~♪ ...Commander? Um, about that... Please do me a favor and forget you heard anything.
Hmm-hum-hum... So very cute~♪ ...Commander? Um, about that... Please do me a favor and forget you heard anything.
(If the Commander wasn't waiting for me, I'd have liked to stay like this for a bit longer...)
Commander, um... your gaze is making me a bit uncomfortable. My sisters might be different, but I'm not really used to having people look at me...
The Big Five... Yet another name that we were proud to be called.
I'm not sure what I'll do if there ever comes a time when I can take off my rigging, along the title of the Big Seven... I'm sure that that girl from the Sakura Empire is thinking the same thing.
Where would I like to go? Well... if it's not too much to ask... that place where you can pet cats.
...Hehehe.
It's already been tuned, Commander. Leave it be. It's as delicate as my main guns are.
Don't I feel... cold to the touch?
Commander, there are still some missions left... Make sure you check on them later.
So there's new mail. Maryland's as fast to act as always.
I want to perform for people, not a crowd of trees in the barren wilderness. I'll keep fighting in order to keep it that way... together with my sisters.
I can't let you get caught up in the battle... Shoo, hurry away!
The fact that I can still be helpful to people makes me happy.
Hm-hmm~♪ It's in pretty good condition today, just as you said. Um... would you mind if I played you one more song?
You'd rather stay here and watch the sunset with me than bathe with the rest in the sea? You sure you wanna spend your beach day that way? Err, well... I'm fine with it if you are.
You'd rather stay here and watch the sunset with me than bathe with the rest in the sea? You sure you wanna spend your beach day that way? Err, well... I'm fine with it if you are.
La-la-laa♪ ...Oh, it's a new song me and my sisters made. Thought I'd brush up on it a bit.
Where do you wanna go next time? Ah, there are still some places you suggested to me that I haven't been to yet. Let's do those first. After that... could I suggest a few places?
I'll never get tired of this amazing view. I'd have been worse off if you hadn't told me about it.
Do you not like getting tanned? Me neither, really. Don't tell anyone, though... If people knew, I'd look less reliable both as a Big Seven and as an older sister.
"I'm conserving my stamina for the concert later"... Sounds like a believable excuse, but I don't think you'd buy it. In reality, I'm locking down a seat early for the fireworks show. Heheh.
The sea breeze is starting to get colder. Should we put on some clothes?
Doing this while they're all still there...
I wish I could tell you to forget your missions... Let's get them done so we can all watch the fireworks together.
Mission complete. Now we can enjoy the closing party with peace of mind.
Welcome back, Commander. Have you seen my sisters? No, I'm not worried about them, just wondering if they'd tried to rope you into something. Heehee.
The commission team's back. Will you be back... after you've gone to see them?
We won't go down. No matter what.

You being here for us has helped us find new goals and pleasures. Yeah, I'm not talking about big stuff like being the strongest or world peace. I mean performing with friends, watching fireworks, and enjoying this beautiful view. I value the wonderful times we spend together more than anything else.
You called, and I returned stronger, fiercer, and more complete. Now I await your orders. On my name as a Big Seven, I swear to decimate anyone who stands in your way.
You called, and I returned stronger, fiercer, and more complete. Now I await your orders. On my name as a Big Seven, I swear to decimate anyone who stands in your way.
This is Colorado, standing by. Awaiting orders.
Commander, I agree that my new main guns are cool, but you're staring at them an awful lot... It's not the guns you're looking at, it's me? Oh, I see... *blushes*
At this point, "Big Seven" is just a prestigious title, but that doesn't break my spirit. My era still isn't over yet.
Do you think the sky being blue means anything? It means a lot to me. I mean, it's the same color as the sea... The world beyond is so interesting.
A hot air balloon can cross a mountain, and an airplane can take you beyond the horizon. The view of the future is vast - how does it look to you, Commander?
Mhm...
"Big-barreled guns gun down bugging brigade bigguns begging for beatings"... Your tongue twister makes less sense the more I think about it.
Maybe I should fire you off into space. Heh, I'm just kidding. Keep your warm hands on me a while longer.
Commander, you have a new letter. The stamp and the postmark are a mess...
You've made a small but resolute step toward our goal. Welcome back, Commander.
Combat code red! Everyone, in position!
I've waited long for a victory like this. Our glory shall never fade.
Aim all guns! Unleash full firepower!
Dammit! It was a trap!
You being here helps me stay true to myself in battle. I've always, um, felt drawn to your vision for the future... D-do you think you could tell me more about it today?
Colorado class battleship— Maryland, hull number BB-46

Eagle Union Colorado class battleship, ship no. 2 “Maryland”. As one of the BIG SEVEN, I often attended various celebrations. I escaped the attack on Pearl Harbor from behind Oklahoma. After undergoing retrofit, I successfully completed counter strike attacks on the Sakura Empire Navy. I participated in Operation Magic Carpet and received a total of seven battle stars. Commander, I just saw gunfire over there...oh, nevermind it was the sunset.
I am Maryland, a member of the BIG SEVEN. “Fighting Mary”, yes, that's what they call me! I heard there are many battles ahead. I look forward to them all!
I think I smell gunpowder, has the battle started already? Pfft... turns out it was only Vestal cooking.
Celebration? Honor? Nothing else except for battles will draw my attention.
Fighting beside my sisters is the happiest thing in the world!
I hate foul play, only fair duels are real battles!
Working? ...I don’t know much about that, I’ll just do whatever you tell me to do.
Commander, are we going into battle?
Commander, our fighting power is not in that area of expertise.
If I don’t complete the mission, then I can’t get a battle star.
Mission rewards... Darn, what a waste of time.
When writing a reply back, should I carry an anti-aircraft gun with me...
Sigh, staying in port is so boring...
Even though commissions are an important part of the war, but I'm just not interested in them.
I really wanna try to shoot a volley from my main gun right now…
Dear opponents, do NOT disappoint me!
Haha! This is just the appetizer before the main course!
If only Oklahoma was here...
No matter how many times it takes, I will sink you again!
Now, this is a fun battle!
A saying that I recently heard from my sister, “Never protest your loyalty to the weak”.
I don't know who granted us the title of BIG SEVEN. But if those two keep mentioning it non-stop, then the title should have some special meaning to it.
The war cannot be won by a single person. Without true sisters fighting alongside you and a reliable backline supporting you, no matter how strong you are, your defeat is inevitable!
Not all problems can be solved by fighting? Well, I don't really believe that... but you always seem to find a way to solve things. After all, you are my favorite Commander.
Look into my eyes, as my most trusted companions, is it even necessary to use words to express the feelings I have for you in my heart?
You really treasure these strange rings, do you? ...But since it's your decision, I'll go with it! From now on, I will protect you!
I'll like this, right? Then I'll take it!
I will protect you this time!
Oh, hey, Commander - you here for a break, too? Relax, I won't rat you out to anyone else. Just kick back and enjoy the fireworks.
Oh, hey, Commander - you here for a break, too? Relax, I won't rat you out to anyone else. Just kick back and enjoy the fireworks.
Secured a good seat for the fireworks show for you. C'mon, sit!
Oh yeah, how'd you like the concert me and my sisters put on earlier? I can give you a solo if you dig it - a little private show 'tween you and me.
West Virginia wanted to play a number for the kids. I thought, "Ugh, fine, as long as it gets the blood pumping" and agreed... What she didn't say was we were gonna do a nursery song!
A beach performance oughta be big and exciting. If we can't all let loose, then it ain't relaxation!
Ahh! Love a drink by the beach! You want one, Commander?
Hey! You're gonna mess up my hair!
Hey, wanna go swimming with... Whuh? Can't swim in my jeans? Who cares - I'll just take 'em off!
That was the tit - you ready for the tat?
You've got your mail delivered out here... Sheesh, how much work do you have?
You picked a good time to come back. The fireworks show literally just started.
Commission team's back. Man, look how giddy they are.
I'm gonna pound you into dust!
Hahaha! Now that was a perfect show!
Tsk... Frickin' defeated.

You know how I feel even without having to put it into words. That means we've gotten so close, I'd trust you with my life. You're the reason I keep fighting, and... Gah, it's so embarrassing telling these things right to you!
My retrofit is capital-D done! Hah, I generally know what's changed - the details, I'll discover in live battles! That alright with you?
My retrofit is capital-D done! Hah, I generally know what's changed - the details, I'll discover in live battles! That alright with you?
Fighting Mary has arrived! Just thought I'd say hello before I went off to the battlefield.
Since we're buds, will you fight with me? 'Course, you don't have to force yourself... Hm? Hahahaha! You've become a real fighter!
West Virginia can lull me to sleep in three minutes with her guitar... Huh? Colorado's violin does it in 30 seconds? H-how'd you know?!

There's all kinds of battle freaks. There're those who charge in headfirst, those who fight one-on-one fair and square, and those who just blindly swing their fists around. Me? I dunno what kind I am!
Ugh, work... You stick to what you know best, and I'll stick to what I do best - which means fighting!
We going into battle yet? Not that I'd mind shooting the breeze with you! Hahaha!
Ahh, this where your fighting strength is? Hahaha!
New missions... I hope you get a battle star of your own. Hahaha!
Rewards are here. Take 'em!
Oh, a letter. Alright, you write a reply while I replace the magazines on my AA guns.
Just imagining scenarios all day... Nah, that's not gonna work. You need to get your exercise in or you'll turn weak.
Gonna use those commission resources in the next battle, eh. Could use 'em in the NEXT next battle, y'know.
Strike first! Both with your shells AND fists!
You piles of junk aren't even worth mentioning!
Gah, they got me good...

I don't care if other people see me as a battle maniac, but I wanted to show you a different side of me... Although, I'll only go so far to not be myself. What do you think of me? I'll work hard in my own way depending on how you answer! Hahah!
Colorado class battleship— West Virginia, hull number BB-48.

During a "Naval Holiday", my sisters and I were honored amongst the world's strongest battleships. We were granted the high-profile title of - BIG SEVEN. Although times are changing, the three of us still have the strength to fight any enemy fleet in a decisive battle, please don't forget that.
It’s finally my time to show my strength... Under the guidance of fate, the third ship of Colorado class, West Virginia, reporting in.
You’re late... the exercise has already begun, hurry!
Do not doubt my combat performance, Commander.
The combat exercise didn’t go well… Is the Commander being lazy again?
I will never forget the humiliation I suffered on that day.
On the night of the Surigao Strait, I witnessed the last moments of the Sakura Empire fleet... They truly are a worthy opponent...
This should be... a friendly gesture I suppose.
Commander, it seems you’re rather close to getting lectured by me.
Carrying out missions is an important part of enhancing the strength of the fleet.
The mission was nicely executed, good one.
Could these be letters from my sisters?
What a peaceful port, it reminds me of Hawaii before the war.
The commission fleet is really efficient. I hope the Commander can learn a thing or two about efficiency.
It seems the Spokane Cup this year will still be mine.
The humiliation I once suffered... I'll repay you double!
Have you seen this? This is the inevitably tragic ending of those who dare challenge the BIG SEVEN.
I don't want to recall the humiliation I suffered on that day...!
Have a taste of my 406mm guns!
Getting hit by a torpedo... it feels bad.
Commander's laziness is almost beyond my bottom line.
I was once seriously injured, but then I was greatly enhanced during the process for my repairs…
I’m proud of my BIG SEVEN title. But aircraft carriers seem to be replacing us battleships in naval battles. I am losing myself in all this confusion: this strength that I possess... what is it for?

After joining your fleet, the answer to my question has been gradually answered... This power of mine is destined to protect everyone including you, Commander. My strength still has its value, even if I'm no longer the heroine of the battlefield.

Commander, you have become someone who can completely take charge on the battlefield. At last, my powers have found a worthy partner... What? A love confession? Don't you trick me to say that, you fool——
You’ve decided to perform a pledge ritual with me? Commander really made a bold decision... In that case, I will not let your expectation down. I'll guard you until the very end.
Not bad... I'll treasure it.
Colorado, Maryland, you two ready to rock? Keep your cool! Commander, and everyone in the audience, get ready for the Big Seven's big performance!
Colorado, Maryland, you two ready to rock? Keep your cool! Commander, and everyone in the audience, get ready for the Big Seven's big performance!
Whew... You feeling the heat, Commander? Er, not the weather, I was talking about the performance... Alright, awesome.
Mic test, mic test. Can you hear me clearly, Commander? What about you, Colorado and Maryland?
While I usually play slightly more chill, calm tunes when I'm alone, this case obviously calls for something explosive.
I always thought the ladies of the Royal Navy hated this genre... But as Rodney and more have shown, presumptions do you no good.
A song request? Colorado, Maryland, we're playing the Commander's fave next.
I wasn't trying to tempt you into this...
We've already started, but you've shown up at the perfect time. You're gonna like this next song, Commander.
The commission team's back. Hope they'll make it in time for our last song.
Sink or swim. Let's go.
Do not mess around with a Big Seven. Ever.
Guh... We almost had it...

West Virginia, completing retrofit. Back when I joined the fleet, I said I'd show you my strength - now, after you've made me this much stronger, I feel humbled. Once more, Commander, my strength is yours.

West Virginia, completing retrofit. Back when I joined the fleet, I said I'd show you my strength - now, after you've made me this much stronger, I feel humbled. Once more, Commander, my strength is yours.
Still a while to go until the wargame starts... Hey, Commander. I've been waiting for you.
Although I don't try to appear frail, it does work at tricking the enemy into thinking so. Just like that Sakura Empire Big Seven... Or am I wrong?
"Wee Vee?" Ahahah. You're free to call be my whatever nickname you want.
So, Commander, about that private training we talked about a while ago... You were thinking the same thing? Okay... Should we go, then?
Look, I'm not Colorado...
I accept your affection.
I hope you're ready to face the consequences. Now then... *blushes*
It's about damn time Maryland learned how to file paperwork... Oh, Commander, there's a letter for you.
You like it when the port is bustling? Fair enough. I don't mind either way as long as there's no fighting.
It's unhealthy to overwork yourself, Commander. Let the rest of us greet the commission team.
It's time to face off!
North Carolina class battleship— North Carolina, hull number BB-55.

I am North Carolina class ship no.1. I can be considered the big sister battleship of the Eagle Union~ I don’t particularly like or dislike anything, so to speak. Even though I have fought in all kinds of engagements, I have not gained any fame... I am a little bit troubled by this.

North Carolina here, awaiting your dispatch. Although I may seem to have a bland personality compared to my sisters. But as the saying goes, no personality is still a personality, hehe. Anyways, awaiting your orders, sir.
Welcome back~
Being stared like that makes me a bit shy...
What do I wear inside? It's not something that’s so significant
If I think about it, I certainly have been to many places... seen many landscapes, and also parted ways with many people.
Sometimes I get so envious of my younger sister Washington and how she’s so energetic all the time.
Do you need help with something?
Not good...
It’s not good to leave tasks unfinished.
The mission rewards were sent out, are you not going to pick it up?
You’ve got new mail~
Ah, hold on, your collar is all messed up. Stand still while I fix it... there you go~ (waves).
The commission is over, they should be back soon~
I'll try to work a bit harder~
Don’t be overconfident, and try not to be so nervous while focusing on winning~
If the Commander gives me a few praises, then I will be very happy~
Not so successful... let's try again next time.
Never let your guard down.
Sisters, hold on!
Commander, I'm gonna get angry.
Commander remembers me~ Not that I’m boasting or anything, but I still have confidence in my low sense of existence. (smiles wryly)
If you’re only going by appearances, every child in this fleet looks cute. But in terms of personality, they all have their unique quirks. To be honest, I am a bit envious of them. (strokes chin).

I always believe there is nothing wrong with being ordinary. But after meeting you Commander, I want to change myself a little... after all, my sisters are all so charismatic~ Well.. Commander, are you fond of bunny girls?~

Do you want to eat something later Commander? And then you can accompany me to go shopping, if you want to get something then let’s go together. Then... hehe... let’s take a walk in the park? Commander, everywhere I go as long as I’m with you will be just fine~
Well, your trust deserves to be rewarded... umm... Commander, do you like bunny girls?~
Are you sure? Th-thank you.

ex.line: Good morning, Commander... Mm, this greeting is a bit lacking in individuality. Let me try over... Hello, Commander♡ It's time for some delicious "work time"♪
I know I may be lacking in individuality, but now that I understand your preferences a bit better... it's given me a new direction to work towards. Heehee~♪
Hmm... would it be better if I had a more upbeat personality? Well, you still prefer the way I am right now the best, right?
Are you tired? Come, rest your head on my lap. Heehee, I was just looking for a way to get you to lean on me.
...You want to know what I'm wearing under this? Oh, but you already know~♪ Yes, it's exactly what you think♡
Oh my... Even though I'm supposed to be the big sister~
I'm right here. Call on me anytime you need me.
Commander... Aren't you being a bit too nervous?♪
My, Commander, your clothes are looking a bit disheveled. Allow me... Heehee. As a reward, how about treating me to your first smile of the day?
I love you, Commander... Did that come off as too ordinary? Goodness... You think it's fine, and you want me to say it every day? Very well. I love you, Commander♡

lines.line: Commander? Oh, umm, this is just, err, equipment changing practice... Also, I recall you saying you like bunny girls. You still do, right?
Commander? Oh, umm, this is just, err, equipment changing practice... Also, I recall you saying you like bunny girls. You still do, right?
Welcome back, dear! Is there anything you need a hand with?
"Do I wear this all the time"? Maybe, maybe not. I'll leave the answer up to your imagination.
Whew. This feels so liberating! ...And not in any indecent sense, or anything.
Did Washington manage a proper smile today? She's got features as sharp as a knife, so it's easy to misinterpret her expression.
I am genuinely interested in bunny girl things, but it's quite awkward to actually tell people about them...
It's true - you need the ears, or you can't call yourself a bunny girl. Hehehe~
I'll take that to mean you really like this outfit, am I right? Hehehe~
Could you help out with my ribbon? It's a bit too close for my liking... Ah, thank you.
Maybe I should keep this outfit on and give the commission team a real surprise when they return... Hehehe~ I'm just joking.
Victory isn't the result of individuality. It's the result of good teamwork. Hehehe~
Commander, are you free today? We could go on a date somewhere. Not in this outfit, of course, just my regular one. Thank you for understanding. Hehehe~
Commander, today I'm in a bunny swimsuit, see? You don't see how it's a bunny swimsuit...? Come closer and get a better look, then. Heheheh.
Commander, today I'm in a bunny swimsuit, see? You don't see how it's a bunny swimsuit...? Come closer and get a better look, then. Heheheh.
Over here, Commander! I'm a bit shy to ask for this, but... Could you rub some sunscreen on me? On every inch, every nook and cranny of my back~
You want to nap with me? Mmgh... There, over here, Commander. I made room for you on my air cushion.
The sea breeze is making me sleepy... But you won't pull any frisky pranks on me while I nap, right? Right~?
I saw all sorts of distinctive designs when I was picking out my swimsuit... But this is the one that sits right♪
You're putting sunscreen on my hair, too? Quite the peculiar preference...
Commander, a bit higher... To the right... Oh, you already put some there? Heheh, but you like touching me there, right?
Heehee. Be thorough over here, too♪
Mission complete! Oh, I didn't mean my sunscreen. Keep it up, please!
My air cushion's a bit deflated... Good timing, Commander! Let's inflate it together.
Are you nodding off? Come hither~ The cushion's a bit small, so hold onto my waist... Good night, Commander. May your dreams be full of hopping bunnies~
North Carolina class battleship— Washington, hull number BB-56.

North Carolina class ship no. 2. I am Washington! The thing I like to do the most is to destroy my enemies. Recently, I am practicing on my smile. —— Battle record? I don’t really show off with such things, all in all, how’s my smile?
Hello, Commander, I am Washington... my sister told me that I cannot be so rough once I join the fleet, so I am practicing my smile. Darn, why must I listen to her...
Welcome back... how does my smile look? (Forcibly smiles)
Hmm, you want to know how well I fight?
My smile looks beautiful? You jerk... oops, keep smiling, keep smiling. Thank you for your compliments.
Hey, that rigid South Dakota is still the same. Commander, you see, I am cuter than her.
A true measurement of friendship is their actions and not their words, I don’t like people who are rhetorical in nature.
Don’t touch me as if you’re trying to be intimate with me.
...You wish to die? (Smiles)
A new mission? Haha, now my blood is boiling.
Go grab the reward yourself, I’m not interested.
Hey, your mail.
I’m glad that you didn’t get hurt—— What?! I don’t have feelings for you!
Your memory can’t be worse than mine, right? The commission fleet has returned, won’t you go greet them?
It feels so good to become stronger.
Ok, let’s work out. (Snickers)
Sure enough, I am happiest when all the foes are annihilated~
Oh, I will not forget you!
Out of my way. I'm ready to fight!
I won't let go of victories to my enemies!
You are too weak, it’s no fun playing with you, go practice some more.
What must I do to possess a good smile... think about the things I like? If so, I feel very happy even at the thought of winning against South Dakota... muahahaha...
No, no, that’s not right. If we do it this way, won’t it end much the same like in the past? … Don’t try so hard? You sometimes say stuff like that… Hmm? That was a good smile from me just now?
Lately, my smile has become more natural? Emm, huh (scratches head), I was recently trying to find a new hobby. While I was searching, I realized that being with you is not so bad… (whispers)

I couldn’t help but smile when I saw you, this is the first time that I’m feeling this way... although, I also have other feelings rushing towards me. I suddenly want to see your expression when you are bullied by me—— Commander, stay with me for a while. (Laughs)
Wait wait! We’re doing “that”, right? Is this your new way of teasing me!... Damn, you bastard, I’m not sure if I should cry or laugh about this...
Oh? Alright, who do you want me to send flying?
Sup, Commander? ...Looking good? I don't think this outfit's anything special... You better not be trying to cozy up to me, or I'll knock your teeth out!
Sup, Commander? ...Looking good? I don't think this outfit's anything special... You better not be trying to cozy up to me, or I'll knock your teeth out!
Wipe that stupid grin off your face. I know exactly what you're thinking! I am NOT gonna dress up like my sister today!
Huh. Guess I can't help but crack a smile after having some good grub and a bit of liquor... Meaning, I don't gotta practice smiling anymore!
W-welcome back, dear♪ ...Doesn't hit the same. How does North Carolina do it?
South Dakota's on the piano, huh. I ain't got her level of finesse, so don't go comparing me to her... Wish I could play like that.
Remember our deal, Commander - I'm coming along when you go around greeting people, got it?
Breaktime already? All right, take a load off.
What the-?! Are you drunk out of your mind?!
We've got a new mission. It'll do nicely as an after-dinner workout.
You claimed the rewards yet? ...Oh please, like I give a damn about that!
Back safe and sound. Thank goodness... Uh, no? I-I wasn't... talking about you...
Crap, the commission team must be... Oh, you remembered? Full marks, Commander.
We've got this in the bag, easily.
Now this is something worth celebrating! Am I right?

Heheh, so then South Dakota and I just... Hang on, I feel like I'm talking to myself here! C'mon, tell me a funny story or something! I've smiled like you asked me to, so keep up your end of the deal...
Yo, Commander. Called for a nurse, didn'tcha? ...You didn't? Bullcrap, you totally did! Listen up, you're a patient, so act like it - drop your damn work and let me examine you.
Yo, Commander. Called for a nurse, didn'tcha? ...You didn't? Bullcrap, you totally did! Listen up, you're a patient, so act like it - drop your damn work and let me examine you.
(Gotta smile, gotta smile...) You ready, Commander? Save your files and all that so I can start examining your... Wh-what? Why're you looking at me like that?
Hey... Quit staring at me. What's the big deal? It's just a nurse outfit. F-for your information, I'm just here to do my job... So stop fricking staring!
Ugh. I happened to be on duty, that's all... Man, your temp really is going up. Better give you a thorough examination, then.

You don't think the call-nurse button even beeped? Uh, of course it did, dumbass! Why would I be here if it didn't? Listen - beep-beep-beep! There, it beeped. Now shut up and let me continue my examination.
Nurses gotta be nice to their patients, blah blah blah... If you don't do as I ask, you leave me no choice but to MAKE you comply.
Y-you're ill, so act like it, god dammit!
Hold still, dammit. I'm examining you.
Oh boy, your condition's serious. This calls for emergency measures.
You've still got missions to do? Don't care, you need to rest right now.
The mission rewards can wait, okay? Focus on the examination!
Was that the new letter alert? Are you still working at this hour? I'm confiscating that damn letter!
Stay right where I can see you- Ahem... What I mean is: Don't go wandering around at night. It's dangerous, and you're my patient.
Finished a commission, did you? Hold off on that reception until your full-body examination is done.

The hell? Why's your heartbeat through the roof? ...'Cause I'm standing next to you? L-look, I can't examine you without getting close! And I can't just leave you be, so I gotta nurse you even harder. I'll be tending to you the whole night, so brace yourself...
South Dakota-class battleship -  South Dakota, Hull Number BB-57!

Battleship of Eagle Union, South Dakota. When it comes to battlefields, I wish for you to not leave my side. I will protect you, Commander. 'The Strongest Shield'? Vain titles are worthless. There's meaning only in being useful.
I am South Dakota, Commander. I shall become your shield and protect you from all cannon fire.
Commander, your orders please.
South Dakota, standing by 24/7, Commander.
In the darkness, my will was tempered. I fear nothing.
As long as I am of use to Commander, I am fine with handing my credit over to others.
Those who stand as Commander's enemies, are enemies all the same.
I'm ready to move out anytime.
If this is what you want to do...
Commander, please do not forget about completing the missions.
Commander, the mission rewards have arrived.
There's new mail, Commander.
Good fight out there, Commander.
The commission teams are back... If it is necessary, send me off as well.
My shields have become stronger
Come at me with all you got!
Partial victories aren't worth celebrating, Commander.
I am sorry, Commander... It's a shame...!
This is your stop!
I won't hold back now...!
... I shall follow your orders.
Your will is my command, Commander.
I exist to help you achieve your goals, Commander. Other than that, I have no real value... A skirt? I've never worn something so fluffy before.
Another way to live other than fighting? I... do not know what to do, Commander. I have always lived like this... Can you teach me?
So this is your perspective, Commander... I choose how I live, was what you said... This time, I fight not for my duty, but for the sake of your smile, Commander.
I feel warm when you're by my side, Commander. Your goals bring me the drive to fight. I become happy when I hear your words... I once offered you my shields. From now on... I give you my heart.
You want me to remember so badly that you're giving me something this valuable, Commander?
I've got your back! Give 'em hell!
Sorry for putting you through trouble again.
The game is on, Enterprise!
You wanna go at this again, Washington?
Massachusetts, you have to take this battle seriously.
Kaede's Legion... Nice name!

Massachusetts suggested I learn something useful that's unrelated to combat, so I started playing the piano... It seemed impossible at first, but after actually trying it, I've developed a pretty good feel for it.

Massachusetts suggested I learn something useful that's unrelated to combat, so I started playing the piano... It seemed impossible at first, but after actually trying it, I've developed a pretty good feel for it.
What song should I play for you today...
Aurora asked me to perform with her... I guess it can't hurt to try.
I can't get used to this flimsy dress. I'd rather wear my regular clothes...
My cat goes for the keyboard when I'm not playing... Do you want to practice the piano too, kitty?
We can express so much through music. I suppose that's fitting for someone bad at expressing their feelings like I am.
Music and instruments are simply hobbies. We ought to prioritize our missions, Commander.
Everyone's back safe and sound. Now I can resume practicing with peace of mind.
Without you, I doubt I would've ever come to understand what splendor this world holds, or started playing the piano either... Commander, I'd like to play you a song that's important to me.
South Dakota-class battleship - Indiana, Hull Number BB-58.

I'm Indiana, Eagle Union South Dakota-class battleship. That's about it, really. All you need to know is this - I will grind all your enemies into dust. Put it another way, nobody can mess with you as long as I'm around.
South Dakota-class battleship Indiana, reporting for duty! ...No need to be so stiff and formal? Then... Nice to meetcha, Commander. You're on the victory train with me now, baby!
Oh, you're back, Commander. Office work is sooo lame without you... How do you handle this day in, day out? I'd rather take on a hundred, no, a thousand enemies.
I'm surprised the port's got so much gym equipment! We should go work out, you and I, Commander. It'll put some muscle on your bones AND help clear your mind.
Copying childhood heroes doesn't make you brave. It just makes you a reckless moron.
I brought you lunch, Commander! Steak, fruit salad, and a protein shake with kale! Healthy and nutritious stuff! ...Why are you giving me that weird look?
Tactics? Yeah, I know those give you a battlefield advantage and all. But me, I like the thrill of fighting my foes head-on. Plus, ain't it more satisfying when you win that way?
Hm? Need something?
Hm? We got a combat mission?
I'm "muscular in other places, but squishy here"? Th-the hell are you talking about?!
You've got to do your missions, Commander. Hm? You weren't expecting me to remind you? I may not look it, but I have a good sense of time.
We've got mission rewards waiting. I heard they're selling supplement lucky boxes and I feel like trying my luck.
Commander, you've got mail! Ah, and the mag I ordered has arrived, too.
Cool, you're back. Now drink this protein shake and feed your muscles!
The commission team's back. I wonder if they had any good fights out there...
Ahh! I can feel the power growing within me!
Behold the might of Indiana!
That was too easy! Gimme a more challenging fight next time!
It's alright. Retreating ain't the same thing as losing. We'll try again once we're stronger!
Go to hell!
I'm still in the fight!
Ugh... I hoped you'd be one of the few who'd be my equal and make me use my brain.
The destroyers and submarines around here all clam up or look shocked when they see me... Did I do something wrong or what?
Not only are you good with brain-intensive strategy, you've even got the chops for bodybuilding. AND you work pretty hard. Yeah, I've gotta hand it to you!

("The sun's rays embrace the Earth, and the moon's light kisses the sea. If you hadn't put your lips to mine, the meaning in Mother Nature's pretty work would cease to be." Alright, let's go with that. Now just to sneak it in between the pages of this training mag I'm gonna give the Commander...)

Ahem... So, Commander, did you read that mag I gave you yet? What? You haven't?! ...Well, it's just, I kinda snuck a love letter in there... To hell with it! Read it NOW! One page at a time! Don't you dare flip through it!

Your answer's in this envelope? Alright, let's- Hang on, why'd you put it in an envelope? ...'Cause my feelings struck a chord with you? Oh, okay! Then on the ring goes! Now c'mon, stop standing there and make your vows with me!
Hey, this looks like something that'll up my power!
Hah! Imagine getting to fight alongside you!

ex.line: Look who's back. I sorted through your papers. It was boring as hell, but I put up with it just for you. Hahah!
I did a fantastic job with this paperwork? Well, yeah! Believe it or not, I always get straight A's! ...Why do you look so surprised?
Ugh... The stuff we did yesterday was so intense that I can't stand straight. Hm? Go ahead and take the day off? Hell no! You promised we'd go out today!
You really like petting my head, huh.
Yeah? Do you need a hand?
Seriously? Have you STILL not felt me up enough?!
Ah! Looks like you finished a mission. That's my sweetheart for ya - getting things done on the double. Good!
Nice, you're back. I added some protein and muscle-building supplements in this one. Drink up!
The commission team's back. Their mission went as smooth as it did thanks to your smart commanding.

Alright, I don't need to slip a love letter into EVERY mag... I-I know giving it right to you gets my feelings across better! But! Being married doesn't make embarrassing things any less embarrassing!

lines.line: Oh, look who's here. What am I doing here? Well, I figured through the roof was the fastest way in, so I punched a hole through the ceiling. The bandits are all down for the count, so let me take it from here.

Oh, look who's here. What am I doing here? Well, I figured through the roof was the fastest way in, so I punched a hole through the ceiling. The bandits are all down for the count, so let me take it from here.
Watch your step, Commander. This place is falling apart and one wrong step could send you to the floor below. We've still gotta collect the cash and return it to the bank.
That's that robbery case finally done and dusted. The bandits can cover the tavern's repair bill, heh. Now, you ready to receive your bounty?

You can't arrest bandits with brawn alone. You need a general plan. How do you get in? How do you prevent them from getting away? You need to think on your feet - and you do that by having your boots on the scene! Hahaha!
You think it was funny how they came up to me, swinging a knife, and I just shot 'em? Hahah! I've got the advantage at this range. Times are changing.
It's never too late for justice, but I don't like delayed justice, so I deliver what's long overdue with a bullet!
Cut it out! You're gonna mess up my hat!
You digging my revolver? Ahh. It's been my partner for many years.
Urgh! Can you STOP doing this?! We're in public here!
You got 'em all done, huh? Hell of a good job, Commander! Lemme treat you to a drink!
That stuff floating through the air... Oh, here, Commander. Found a letter with your name on it.
Finished another task, huh? Have some beef jerky. It's got protein in it and fills your stamina right back up. Try a bite.
If this is all you've got, you're not cut out for robbery!

When we get tired of this, let's settle down for a stable, comfortable life. Ahem... Because you've supported me and made a place where I belong. What I'm trying to say is - you're the most important person in the world to me! Don't make me say another word!
Iowa-class battleship - New Jersey, Hull Number BB-62.

I am battleship New Jersey, the indomitable Black Dragon of the Eagle Union. When I say "indomitable," I'm not just tooting my own horn, hehe~♪ If you knew more about me, you'd know exactly what I'm talking about.
The indomitable Black Dragon of the Eagle Union is none other than me, New Jersey! You're about to witness true power! Haha, just messing~♪ Don'tcha just love flashy introductions?
Glad you made it. Do you already have a plan for what you wanna do? And how do I factor into those plans?
Thanks for finishing the equipment inspection. All systems nominal! ...Oh my, you seem to be unable to take your eyes off me~ Not that it bothers me though? Besides, don'tcha like this sort of stuff?
Iowa versus Yamato, huh? A real classic. Don'tcha just love that kind of stuff?
I go for the fruity stuff~ green apple, orange, and soda water. As for coffee... Not my favorite, I guess?
How much stuff should I be doing as your secretary? ...Lemme think, how does 40% sound? If I did everything, wouldn't that make me the commander? Heh.
About that matter... I must admit that you have a point, Commander. How about taking my suggestion next time though?
It's now the age of carriers? ...Dunno about that. If carriers are able to evolve, what's to say that battleships can't also evolve?
They call me Big J or the Black Dragon of the Eagle Union! ...What, got a problem with talking myself up a bit?
Done having your fun yet? Hehe, now it's my turn~♪ Take a seat!
I'll take any work-related requests, but anything outside of that... won't come cheap. Just kidding~♪
Commander, don'tcha just love being put on the defensive? In more ways than one~♪
Did you already accept this mission? Sounds good, let's take care of it together.
Since we already got the hard stuff out of the way, why not take a little break? It's gonna be pretty easy to prioritize whatever is left~
You've got new mail. Heh, dont'cha just love the anticipation~?
Wanna check the battle results~♪ Yeah? Who do you wanna start with? Oh, you'll do it yourself? I'll listen in while enjoying some ice cream over here.
Your commission fleet's back. Are your words of praise not the best reward you can give them? Hehe~♪
Some say that the age of battleships is over. They haven't met the Iowa class.
Everyone, Level 1 combat readiness! Set sail!
Course: steady! Objective: completed! Enemies who can stop us: none! Heheh, don'tcha love it when things go smoothly?
Unbelievable... I'm actually getting cornered?! ...I'm not gonna be able to sleep 'til I figure out how to set things straight!
Fire control, I'm counting on you!
I know just the thing to turn this situation around!
Ah, so you're the kind of person who makes girls cry. Yeah, you'd better feel bad about it.

We'll only get in each other's way if we keep an ambivalent relationship. Say, don'tcha think getting touchy-feely might help break the ice? ...Just kidding~ See, you're already not as nervous~ Hehehe~♪
Look at that, you're already starting to chat me up. So, what's on your mind today? Something a bit more technical? Small talk about daily life? ...Oh, you want me to choose?

My my, look who's all run down today... I knew it, you've been overworking yourself. C'mere, lie down here and let me take care of you. Yeah, my thighs make for a pretty good pillow substitute huh? Don'tcha just love this kind of stuff~?

Commander, would you prefer I take the lead, or would you rather do it? Hold up~ I'll see for myself when the time is right, so there's no need for you to answer in words. After all, don'tcha just love being toyed with~?

Commander, I can already hear everything you're thinking. As long as you're fine with it, I don't have any objections~ After all, I still owe you a proper confession, don't I? Hehe, don'tcha think that's what mutual love is supposed to look like?
This is just what I wanted! Haha!
A larger-caliber Iowa? No, not quite...
As if I'd lose to some carriers!
Freedom and firepower: an unstoppable force!
Oh? Finally, a worthy opponent? How interesting~
We owe a lot to you, Miss Heroine.

ex.line: Hey there, honey~♪ What are we going to do today?
♪~What am I staring at so intently? You of course, honey. You're always ogling me up and down, so what's wrong with me also being mesmerized by you? Hehe~♡
Might be fun scrapping with Yamato and Musashi. Honey, who do you think would win?
Honey, I love you and all, but you can't cut in line, okay? Especially when it's my ice cream that's coming out. If you're that thirsty, I have some juice for you.
A job well done, hooney~ You're totally amazing. All right, let's get started on the next job~
I was just looking for you, honey~ See, there's something I'd like you to buy for me... pretty please?
I know, you absolutely love this kind of stuff, dontcha~ Ahaha~♪
Welcome back from your sortie! Wanna celebrate the occasion with a kiss? ...Yeah, yeah, I know, I'll get started on the report~♪
Honey's looking my way~! Let's do this!

lines.line: One, two, jump! Woah, think I nailed it this time~♪ So, how many points would you give me for that? Naturally, a perfect 100, right? Don'tcha just love it when things go smoothly?
One, two, jump! Woah, think I nailed it this time~♪ So, how many points would you give me for that? Naturally, a perfect 100, right? Don'tcha just love it when things go smoothly?
Can't take your eyes off me, huh? Nothing wrong with that though~ Just who do you think I am? Ahaha~♪
Hey, you over there, you're blocking the view! Jeez, I was hoping to treat you to the best seats in the house, Commander.
Keep the spotlight on me! That's right, keep your eyes on the red-hot dance of the Black Dragon, New Jersey!
Being a superstar sure is exciting, isn't it? After all... I didn't come all the way from Planet Bunny for nothing! ...Err, that didn't come across right...
Of course, this dance is something I'd only show you and my closest friends, hehe~
Your honest feedback, please! Tell me what you really think, okay?
I never said you couldn't touch, but... try to mind the time and place, yeah?
Shouldn't you be staring at those reports instead of at me? Alright, fine by me. Take a good look at this jump and spin. Oh, you liked that a whole lot, huh?
Roar forth, dragonfire! Ahaha!

Sooo hot... Are you alright, honey? You're not heat-exhausted, are you? I'll share my drink with you if you're thirsty, but in return, I'll need you to put my sunscreen on for me. Heheh, that's just what you like to do, right, honey~?

Sooo hot... Are you alright, honey? You're not heat-exhausted, are you? I'll share my drink with you if you're thirsty, but in return, I'll need you to put my sunscreen on for me. Heheh, that's just what you like to do, right, honey~?
It's a scorcher out there... Midsummer sunlight is rough no matter where you go. Honey, did you put on sunscreen? We'd better get some on you~ Hahaha♪
What's up? Oh, are you taken by my swimsuit? Hahah, well, it is me you're looking at. Of course you'd be stunned! Besides, that's just proof of your superb taste, since you picked it!
Aloe works as sunscreen, too? Then get to putting it on me! ...Whoa, it's all slippery and sticky... Hyah?!
Mm... I want ice cream now... Okay! Want one, honey? Don't worry- all of us Eagle Union ships brought ice cream.
Wanna go see Ticonderoga with me later? Tanning is fun and all, but I'd love to lie down in a cool place. You decide, honey.
I'm counting on you, honey!
Hyah?! Geez, honey. I know you like this stuff, but c'mon... *blushes*
Good work out there! Oh, honey, you look a little burned. Hahaha, I'm kidding! Here, I'll get you a drink. Take it easy♪
Commission team's here! ...You're still putting on your sunscreen? Come ooon.
I won't let my honey shed a single tear!
Once we're done, I'll spread stuff on you! That chilly, slick, sticky stuff, nice and slow... Hahah! I thought you might like me doing this. Do you?
Phew... It was really hard to cinch the ending, but I can handle anything! So, honey, did you like it? Hellooo, honey? Aww, are you so mesmerized that you can't speak? Hahaha!
Phew... It was really hard to cinch the ending, but I can handle anything! So, honey, did you like it? Hellooo, honey? Aww, are you so mesmerized that you can't speak? Hahaha!
You're right on time. Welcome, honey! When I saw you stunned and gawking, I just knew this surprise was a success.
I built this entire set myself, of course! This is easy stuff for the big, strong Black Dragon of the Eagle Union! Ting An deserves some of the credit for getting me the tools, though.
Mm, those flowers smell good~ Do you think they have ice cream with this flavor? I bet it'd be really tasty!
Did putting this together take a long time? Hmm... I mean, I guess it did. But what matters to me is that you like it!
Ack... How did my ribbon get tangled in my hair accessory? Honey, help me untangle them! ...I'm too far for you to see? Then get closer, silly!
You love this outfit, huh? Okay, pick. Which do you like more - the usual me, or me in this dress? ...Geez, don't hesitate now. You're supposed to say you love both, silly!
So this is a Dragon Empery-style bun? It sure is hard to tie...
It's cold at night, y'know? Come here, honey~ Huuug!
Heheh~ Did that make your heart skip a beat? You must really love this outfit!
Don't just stand there, honey. Dance with me! I'll teach you how, so don't worry if you've never done it~ Now, give me your hand and try spinning with me! Hahaha!

There's this thing they say in the Dragon Empery... Umm, something about the moon waxing and waning and driving people apart... Anyway, the moon here never wanes! And that means I'll always get to be with you♡
There you are, honey! I've got a super-special, super-speedy gift for you before the race! Get over here, aaand... Mwah!
There you are, honey! I've got a super-special, super-speedy gift for you before the race! Get over here, aaand... Mwah!
Over here, honey! Hehe, this is the best seat in the house! I've got the AC at my back, and I can still see you as soon as you arrive! Ah, perfection.
Everyone's getting into the racing mood! You'd better warm up soon, honey! But first, a little good-luck charm... Mwah!
Look at the track, honey! It's sparkling in the sun like a glorious road to victory!
I put some new ice cream flavors in your car's freezer! Give 'em a try, honey!
After the race, let's go on a nice drive together. It's my turn to take the wheel! I promise you it'll be both exciting and super-safe!
What's the matter? Want more kisses? Haha, I thought so♡
Ready to drive? Then let me send you off with one last kiss!
Geez, honey... I know the trunk is spacious, but c'mon...
You're right on time, my honey! Hehe♪ Guess my cheers worked like a charm, after all.
And the Black Dragon takes the gooold!
Now that you're here, things are really heating up! Know what's even hotter, though? Me, because my heart's burning for you♡ It's your turn now, honey! Promise me you'll win with a kiss.
The indomitable Black Dragon... I mean, the adorable New Jersey makes her bridal appearance! Hehe~ Stunned, arent'cha? Of course you are, honey~♪ How wouldn't you be?
The indomitable Black Dragon... I mean, the adorable New Jersey makes her bridal appearance! Hehe~ Stunned, arent'cha? Of course you are, honey~♪ How wouldn't you be?
Welcome back, honey~♪ Let's put our best foot forward today as well!
Mm~♪ Hmm, what am I staring at so intently? You, of course~ Honey, even though you're always gazing so passionately at me, am I not allowed to return the favor? Ehehe~♡
Because I'm wearing this outfit today, I'll totally... still be able to fight. Don'tcha just love a bride who knows how to kick ass~♪
Think we should have Ty bring some ice cream over? I think I'm in the mood for strawberry. You okay with that, honey?
You've been working real hard? Who's smart, handsome, and totally awesome~ Yes, you are~ Now, onto the next job, right?
What's the matter, honey? Oh, did you perhaps want me to give you a good head-patting?
I already know. You totally love this kind of stuff, dont'cha? --Ahaha~♪
Work, work... honey, what's our next mission?
Mission complete~♪ I'll handle the rewards, so you can to take a break! ...It's not time for that yet? Ahaha...
Good work out there! Mmwah~ Yup, that was a "welcome back kiss!" You totally loved that, didn'tcha~♥
The commission fleet's back. Will you be coming with me, honey?
Coming right at ya, double time!
A bouquet-toss for victory~♪ Ahaha, I've been wanting to try that for a while now~
My honey won't lose faith in me over something like this...!
Honey, keep your eyes on me♪

Regardless of which one of us makes the first move, you'll always be the honey I know and love♪ That~ is~ why~ today, I'll show you a different side of me that'll have you falling head-over-heels for me again! Ahaha!
Long Island-class escort carrier - Long Island, Hull Number CVE-1!
Hehehe, I am Long Island. Eagle Union's first escort carrier~ Using cute little planes to protect merchant ships, as well as sea lanes... That is my job~
Hehe, I'm Long Island~ Hello, Commander. Actually, I have another name. Do you want to know?
Roooaar! ... Hehehe, were you shocked? I'm like a ghost that's going to haunt you every day!
Can't see me... can't see me... can't see me...
Russian roulette~ candy time~ Pick the one~ with wasabi inside~
Let's drink together, eh? Cheeers~ Bfft! So bitter... I ended up drinking what the Commander is supposed to drink!
Commander~ Do my sleeves~ look like those of a ghost~?
Commander, you dummy~! There's glue here~! ...Wh-What?! I'm stuck?! What do I do?!
Wh- what you touched isn't me! What you touched... is...a... a ghost!
Commander~ there's a new mission~ Once you are done~ let's sleep?
Sneaky... sneaky... Apply glue to Commander's rewards...
Long Island used [Switcheroo] on Commander's mail! I am amazing!
Com~man~der~ No one has returned yet~
The girls who went out on commission aren't back yet~ Not yet~ ...Ah, they're back now!
Long Island's... EXP points... have been increased!
Ehehe, let's party~ I'm gonna scare you to the point you're spilling fuel!
Hehehe~ Look at them! They don't even know what hit them!
No... No way... Could they possibly have seen me?!
Phew... I almost flashed everyone...
Commander... He can't see me... He can't see me...
*ears covered* Ghosts do not talk~~~
The right answer is... BOO! Hahahahaah I Scared you! ... Ehhh... Commander, you suck at playing along...
Hehehe, Long Island the ghost has 'accidentally' possessed Commander, and cannot leave ever again~ Now Commander has no choice but to spend his every day life like this!
