I finally got a chance to meet you, Commander! I'm B class' Beagle! The best of what I can do are escort missions! If you need my help just let me know! I am quite a worker!
Welcome back, Commander!
Commander, want to hang out together?
Eh?! Y-You want to catch a rabbit? ...I don't get it, but for you, Commander, I'll give it a try!
Commander, what a nice weather today~ Let's take a walk, alright?
Hmm? Now that I think about it, I used to go to a lot of different places. ...Ah, Commander, I'll tell you all sorts of things about the places I have been to!
Ehehe, that tickles, Commander!
Eeek! Commander, you perv...
Commander, there's a new mission!
Commander, I brought the mission rewards~
Commander, there's mail! Play with me after you're done reading it!
Commander, good work out there~! *nuzzle*
Commander, the girls out for commissions have returned! How about we greet them? Come on, hurry up~
For your sake, Commander, I'm gonna work harder!
Beagle, tally ho!
Ehehe, Commander, pat my head~
*cries*... I lost...
For the Commander!
Commander... do you hate me...?
I'm full of energy today, Commander!
My hairstyle? Ehehe, it was born this way you know? It's as fluffy as a puppy~ Commander, wanna touch it?
Commander, how about a walk? ...Walk by yourself? No no, it's not fun having a walk alone! I'm walking with you, Commander! Commander~ walk with me~!
Commander, is there something I can do? Anything is alright, you know? You see, I'm happy being of use to you, Commander!
Are you fine with giving me this...? Yes... I got it! Then for you, Commander, I'm gonna work extra, extra hard! Ehehe, I'm getting motivated!
Yay! I like this! Thank you, Commander!
B-class destroyer ー Bulldog, Hull Number H91!

I, Bulldog, am the youngest of the B class. My accomplishments were the acquisition of encoded transmission machines, codebooks, and the witnessing of the signing of the surrender treaty. If you are not an idiot, Commander, you should know the worth of such accomplishments.

Good day. I'm B class' Bulldog. ...I'm an adult so please do not judge me by my looks. I hope you aren't an adult who does that, Commander. 
I'll be in your care.
I was thinking you'd be back soon since you think about the fleet...
I'm happy that I'm so treasured by you, Commander, but please don't have any weird expectations. Yes, weird expectations.
Are you an idiot, Commander?
The best thing I can do is submarine subjugation
Commander, if your hand is on my head for more than 3 seconds, I'll bite down on it, you hear?
What is it? If it's your personal needs, Commander, I'll have to refuse.
Lil' B! Lil' X! Target the Commander!
If you need the secretary to even notice the progress of your missions, then you are truly an idiot.
Are you so lazy that you don't even want to collect the rewards?
You are low on [communication power] but please, read your mails properly
Commander, looking at me with eyes full of expectations will not cause me to give you candies, you know? You're an adult as well, aren't you?
Commander, have you forgotten when you took the commissions?
You do have strange expectations of me, don't you Commander?
Commander, we're fighting. Please concentrate.
This was a given. Please don't touch my head like I'm a child.
Sometimes we win, sometimes we lose. It's not such a big deal. ... Tsk...
Lil B, Lil X, I'm counting on you
The fleet? Hmm... I can't say that I like it, but I don't hate it either...
There used to be 4 Single Barrels. Lil' A and Lil Y were retired because of submarine fighting, so now I'm left with Lil' B and Lil' X... I feel... a little bit lonely
I don't mean to boast, but I'm good at concealing my emotions. Are you saying you don't dislike emotionless girls? ...I see. You are a pervert, Commander.
Commander, you are an idiot and a pervert, but I've never said that I hated people like them before, you know? ...But to make someone smaller than you say such things, you are truly a dumb pervert.

Commander, are you getting ready to head outside? ... What are you worried about? You think we're heading to the police station? What an undependable adult. Hah... There's a more important place to go, isn't there?
I won't fawn over you just because you gave me something I like.
C-class destroyer ー Comet, Hull Number H00!

I am Comet of C class. My first assignment was at the Far East, and then I got transferred to The Home Fleet to be equipped with water mine rails. Actually, I'm a little worried about rumors of something happening to the homeland...
I'm Comet of the C-class destroyers! I'm happy that I have your support, Commander!
♪Lalala♪~ Is my song a good one?
Commander~ Is Comet dazzling and shining~? Nnngh... This is so embarrassing...
Commander, why are you not giving me attention?
I'm a little homesick... Just a little!
I, er-hm! I'm everyone's idol, Comet! Should I change my pose a little?
If I become an idol, I'll let you shake my hand too, Commander
Wha! If someone see this, I won't be able to become an idol~!
Commander... as a manager of idols, please complete your missions properly!
Wow! Such a huge reward! --Ahem!...
Waa~ It's a letter from home~!
It feels good to have you around, Commander~
Commander, the commission team has returned! ...How about I go with them next time!
I am one step closer to becoming an idol!
A-Amazing... Does everyone fight like this??
Everyone, Today, I... Comet, am dazzling everyone again~
*cries* ...I can't grow up if I can't endure this after all...
I wanna become the top idol!
I had enough already... *cries*...
Awww... I miss my home after all...
Commander, do you think a small girl like me can become an idol?
If you become my manager, Commander, I feel like I'm going to have the courage to try harder...
Commander, am I shining~? Ehehe, being approved by you makes me so happy~
It's alright if I don't become a superstar like Ms. Lexington... Why? Because I've already got something far more valuable...
This is SO cute! Thanks, Commander!
Do ya reckon... I you think I've become more idol-like? Mhm! As a new idol, I'll show y'all... I'll show you how hard I work as a new idol!
Do ya reckon... I you think I've become more idol-like? Mhm! As a new idol, I'll show y'all... I'll show you how hard I work as a new idol!
Although the long hours I spent practicing by myself were lonely, being able to see everyone's smiling faces while I was on stage made me really happy!
Commander, wanna help me come up with a signature pose?
Ugh... I wanna be able to snack all day like Cygnet, but my figure...
I am everyone's idol, Comet~ Hmm... whaddya think about this pose, Commander?
Even if I manage to become an actual idol, I won't leave your side, Commander!
Eek! Cut that out... I-I'm an idol after all!
Even though I'm an idol, I won't fall behind when it comes to combat!
C-class destroyer ー Crescent, Hull Number H48!

I'm teh C-class destroyer Crescent. I was assigned to the Home Fleet just like my sisters, but I've been to Red Sea and Indian Ocean before. I'll give you a painful reminder if you look at me like I'm a child. Hmph!

You're the Commander? You totally look like you've never fought before. I am C-class's Crescent, and I'm not a child! Despite how I look, I have a lot of experience. I'm not afraid of anything. No~thing at~ all~!
Commander, whatcha doin? ...Ah... no... *ahem* --I didn't say anything!
From the way you are looking at me, you must be thinking of 'this and that' kind of stuff! What?... That's... I mean lewd... Wha!
If there's anything, just leave it to me! What? ...N-Nothing at all? --Ahaha... haha...
I am su~per strong. Small fries like that just run away when they see me!
Please take proper care of a cutie like me! Because... I-I'm cute... yes!
That's like child's play. Eh? ...No more? W-well, I'm an adult as well... ahaha...
Ah... ugh... that spot...!! It's fine because I'm an adult?! D-don't treat me like an idiot!
Missions! There are missions! Geez, don't let other people remind you every time!
WIth this amount, it's a little insufficient-- Eeeeh?! Don't take it all away!
Here, your mail. Haa... There's no way someone like you would get love letters... *side glance*
You didn't bump into our own allies, did you, Commander?!
Commander, the commission team has come back. I'm an adult as well, so won't you send me out next time?
With this, I'm growing closer to adulthood...!
Little chicks, you will not die an easy death! ... Th-That's so embarrassing!
I could've won faster without these people getting in the way! Eh? ...D-don't give me that look!
You ally ships should've tried harder! Ah, I-I'm sorry! I let my emotions got the better of me...
I'm also an adult!
I'm even more adult than you are, Commander!
There's no way someone like you would have friends, Commander...
Commander... You know... I said mean stuff to you before... Well... T-that's right! I mean... ugh --It's nothing! Hmph!
Commander, why are you so kind to a girl like me... Everytime I get nervous I say mean things... Everytime it happens, I feel that it's inexcusable... My chest feels like it's being ripped apart...
Commander, if I say bad things, then get angry with me, alright? If you're the one angry, I... what?... I'm precious, so you won't get angry at this extent? .... Ugh... you dummy...
Are you really fine with a girl like me? Really? You can't take this back! It's too late if you regret this, you know? ... H-hmph! On account of how you chose me, I-I'm staying with you thankfully!
This is more than enough coming from a country bumpkin like you~
Cute? Pretty? Is that all? Can't you expand your vocabulary a little? Jeez... Commander, you really should learn to whisper sweet nothings into my ear!
Cute? Pretty? Is that all? Can't you expand your vocabulary a little? Jeez... Commander, you really should learn to whisper sweet nothings into my ear!
O-of course! As a full-fledged lady, you can trust me with anything!
Shouldn't you give a cute lady like me some preferential treatment?
Comet, dump that stupid commander and let me be your manager!
Commander, are you scared? Since there's no helping it, you can hold onto my hand.
Stupid Commander! The standard for maturity isn't one's size!
C-class destroyer ー Cygnet, Hull Number H83!
I-I'm the C-class's Cygnet... Before I went abroad, I had always been in the Home Fleet... I may not look like it but... I'm good at fishing! Uh... I... I'll do my best!
I am... I'm the C-class destroyer Cygnet... yes! For the sake of getting fish and chips, I will do my best!
C-Commander... you've finally come~ This place is huge... I was lost...
Uwee~ This is so embarrassing... Why do I have strike such a pose...
You're always so quiet, Commander. I'm sleepy. ZZZZ... Huh? I... I-I'm not sleeping!
What do I like...? I'm too embarrassed to say it... Eh? I-It's an order? I... I like to eat delicious meals
That girl's clothes are so beautiful... Eh? No no no! I-I'm just complimenting, s-s-so I don't think those clothes will suit me!
It's so warm...
Commander... I don't understand... Why am I getting hotter?
Commander, it will be bad if you don't do your m-missions~
Blah~ So many rewards~
Wha! Something rang... Mail? ...W-what's that?
Ehehe... Getting on the bed, rolling around~~ Eeeh! Commander~ Did you see that?! Awww...
Co-Commander... the commissions are done. Ca- Can I greet them together with you?
Even though I've become stronger... I-I'm gonna hide behind my sisters...
Nnnggh... This is so scary~ But... there's fish and chips if we win! I'm gonna do it!
D-Did I win? Eh? Eeeh?! I'm first place?!
*cries* Daddy... it's dangerous here... I want to go home...
I-I'm not weak too!
Com-commander is scary... I wanna go home...
Huh... Whaaaa~! Commander, why are you staring at me while I'm eating?...
Did I... say something embarrassing...?
I was lonely when I left the countryside, but with you, Commander, every day has been fun. That's why this is my second home... It would be better if you can hold back on teasing me, though...
Every day I am well-fed, and I enjoy watching you, Commander. ...Something more enjoyable? I've never thought about it... What? You'll show me something important next time?
... Eh, eeeeeeeh!!!! ...Ugh ...You're mean, Commander... N-no, it's not like there's anything worth getting happier than this! I-I'm about to cry
ZZZ... Looks delicious...

ex.line: C-Commander... I've been waitin' for ya~ Ah, um, I'm a tad peckish...
Next I've got... Eh, hey! Righto, what a pose that was! Eheheh~
Just like that time I went fishing with Minneapolis... Ahey! Like that... Heh heh. That's my "St. Lawrence River" technique. Wh-what do you think?
Y-you think I'm cute? Hehehe... the Commander thinks I'm cute... eheheh...
Commnader, y-ya know I'm an idol? W-w-w-we can't do that... but... um...
Eheheh... Now I got the bed to mysel- Huh?! Commander! What're ya doin' here?! Th-this ain't my room? It's yours? Waah... I'm so sorry...
Cy-Cyget is victorious~! Saratoga, I don't think I'm cut out for this!
Waaaaahhhh~ Commander... let's get out of heeere...
♪ Fish and chips ♪ with salt or with mayonnaise? I'll feed 'em to ya, Commander! Eheheh... open up~

lines.line: Well, the swimsuit that Hood gave to me is a little tight, don't you think? Want to play beach volleyball? Do you think... can we win?
Ooh... the swimwear that Hood gave me is a little tight... Huh? Play beace volleyball with Sara...? Am I... gonna win...?
C-Commander, welcome back~ Haa... Air conditioners are such wonderful inventions... Phew... This feels nice...
Hood gave this swimwear to me as a present but, how is it?... It's not inappropriate for me, right?
Ah Hood, you are the most beautiful thing in the world! I feel a bit ashamed.... Hwe... This punishment is so embarrassing...
The barbecue party happens after sunset... Ehehe, I'm looking forward to that as well~
Sara's face darkened when she saw me... Do you think she dislikes me?...
Commander, are you going to take a picture of me?
Wah! Commander, my... my swimwear is tight, so... please don't touch it, ok?
Commissions are done, and so is the grilled fish~ Here you go, Commander. How about it?
H-happy Christmas! A-after that... umm... I have this present for ya, Commander...
H-happy Christmas! A-after that... umm... I have this present for ya, Commander...
Christmas feast! I-it's a real Christmas feast! Haah... I wanna stuff mahself silly♪
Hawawa... for some reason, I'm not gettin' full no matter how much I eat today...
Uuu... Hood? I'm not a real cygnet... even if I don't eat this much, I'm still not flyin'...
My tummy is sticking out? N-no way that's true... Ugh... startin' tomorrow, I'm gonna go on a diet... Startin' tomorrow...
Ah, um... Please... don't do that... Uuuu...
Aww... it took me a while to get changed... Commander, did I keep you waiting long? Hehe... th-that's good. Let's get going, then~
Aww... it took me a while to get changed... Hope I didn't keep ya waitin' too long, Commander? Hehe... th-that's good. Let's get goin', then~
There you are, Commander! I was worried ya lost me...
Comet and Crescent picked this outfit for me, but... ain't it a bit too showy? Erm... it's too much, innit? Um... n-never mind!
It's so cold I'd rather stay inside and eat fish and chips come wintertime... But goin' out with you's pretty nice too!
Commander, I heard there's gonna be one of them fireworks shows for New Year's! What say we go together?
Commander, umm... what do ya think of me, Comet, and Crescent doin' like a New Year's concert for ya all dressed up like this in Sakura Empire clothes?
Hold your hand so I don't get lost?! Erm, um, uh, I think holdin' your sleeve's good enough, Commandeeer...!
Here, Commander, I got ya some fish and chips... Oh, was I supposed to give ya mochi for New Year's instead?

My New Year's wish? Oh, I got lots... Let's see... I hope everyone in the fleet stays safe. And I hope I can become a big, famous idol... And, Commander, I hope you'll be there with me the whole way...
G-Good day, Master... C-Commander, please don't stare at me so much... Uuu... Saratoga told me that this was part of marketin' yourself as an idol...
G-Good day, Master... C-Commander, please don't stare at me so much... Uuu... Saratoga told me that this was part of marketin' yourself as an idol...
Welcome back, Comm... Um, M-Master!
I thought I'd understand if I tried for myself but, the Maid Team really amazing... Compared to them, I'm just... Uuu...
Commander is looking at me... Uu... I don't think these frilly clothes suit me after all...
Eek! ...S-sorry, Commander, I knocked over the bucket again... Uuu...
"Do your best, Cygnet! I know you'll be able to do it" ...That's what Saratoga told me, so I'll have to work harder...!
Umm... "Thank you for all your support!" ...Speak up, and b-bend forward a bit...? I, I don't think I can do that...
Eeep?! .......S-Sorry, Commander! I wasn't trying to hit you with the mop on purpose...
Sorry, Commander... I was trying to water the garden, but I got water all over the commission rewards...
G-g-good work, M-Master... Ah, umm, would you like some fish and chips?
Being a maid is hard work... but if I do this, I get to wear this cute outfit, and also get to stay by Commander's side... Hauu... What should I do...
C-Commander? Erm... They picked me to be a cheerleader for the Royal Navy team at the sports thing, so I'm practicin' my cheers... D-don't stare at me like that... I'm shy enough... Already...
C-Commander? Erm... They picked me to be a cheerleader for the Royal Navy team at the sports thing, so I'm practicin' my cheers... D-don't stare at me like that... I'm shy enough... Already...
I heard it was Hood who said I should be a cheerleader... So I won't let her down...! But these moves ain't easy... Maybe it shouldn't be me...
If I cock this up, it'll make Hood and the whole Royal Navy look bad... You believe in me, Commander? I-I'll do my best then!
Craven did her best to teach me how to cheer, but I'm still not very good...
Ships of the Royal Navy! And everyone on the field! Umm, gooooooooo...! I need to be louder?! I really don't think I can...
Saratoga says idols have to be "multi-talented"! S-so I have to do this! I will!
Aiieee...?! That was close... If you didn't catch me, Commander, I would've fallen right over...
I'm feelin' kinda funny... M-must be I'm too tired is all?
Fish and chips...! No, no, a cheerleader's gotta watch her figure... Maybe just a little's okay? J-just a little! Thanks, Commander!
This outfit is a little tight... Yes, really? I understand. I've got to work harder for the Royal Navy!
These clothes are tight after all... I-Is that so? I see! For the sake of having the royal cuisine, I will work harder!
I'm relaxed when I'm next to you, Commander... Eh? I-I haven't said anything! You must've heard something!
Commander... umm... that... we've run out of fish and chips... Can we... go buy them?
I'm cute? I-I-I-I'm totally not cute! Ugh... You're making fun of me, Commander!
E-even I... am not oblivious to all things! ...B-but if it's you, Commander...
F-class destroyer ー Foxhound, Hull Number H69!
I'm Foxhound, the F-class destroyer of the Royal Navy. Compared to my sisters, I'm the first to get special enlarged designs, so I'm a little better developed! Hehe...
Foxhound answering your call, Commander! Eh? Why don't I have nine tails? Because I'm not actually a fox... Anyways, I'll be in your care from now on!
Commander~ Hehe, what interesting things shall we do today?
Big sis said that... I seem to be bigger than her... What is she talking about?
I don't want to go to such a cold place...
Commander, if you want to treat me like an animal, I'm a dog, not a fox, alright? Actually, I'm just a girl!
Throw a bone at me and I'll bite you instead!
Mmm... stop touching me... Your hand is so hot...
HEY! What are you thinking? Stop touching me like that!
There are still unfinished missions!
Remember to claim your rewards!
You've got new mail!
Awooo.... *woof*! Did you hear that?
*Sniff* I think... I think the girls have finished their commissions~!
Hmm... *sniffs* My reconnaissance capabilities are improved!
Let me see your tricks!
Hehehe, can the most cunning fox beat an old hound like me?
Whew! I'm glad we were quick to escape!
I'm not a fox, but a doggy!
Commander, you have a weird smell!
*Sniff* ... ... Commander, you smell kind of nice for once...
Commander, there's something on your face... *lick* Eh? ....Why did I lick you? Well, my body moved on its own and....
Commander! Ehehe... It feels so good to be held by you... *Whew*... zzz...
I like the Commander... *rubs* I really like the Commander... *Rubs* I like Commander the most *RUBS*...
Commander, what's that? It doesn't look like a collar... Oh? It's for me? I want it, I want it! I'll treasure whatever you give me forever, Commander!
*Sniff*... It smells nice!
I've grown so much that I can't jump like I used to... Commander, are you surprised by my post-retrofit appearance? *Giggle*

I'm the Royal Navy F-class destroyer, Foxhound! I started in the Home Fleet, got reassigned to the Mediterranean Fleet, then the Eastern Fleet, then lastly I was sent abroad! We F-class and E-class destroyers were the first to receive an enlarged design, so we have some pretty good growth! *Giggle*~
I've grown so much that I can't jump like I used to... Commander, are you surprised by my post-retrofit appearance? *Giggle*
Commander~! *Giggle*... *A-ahem*! Don't forget to give it your all today...
Commander, listen to my bell~ It sounds super sweet!
It feels like you haven't patted me much since I got retrofitted... Commander, pat my head, c'mon~!
By the way, Commander, some call me "Qu'Appelle"~ What do you think? Does it sound cool?
It might be hard to quit my old habits, in spite of my growth... *Sniff sniff*
Commander, I can help! Show me~ Hmm... change this here... and maybe here...
F-class destroyer ー Fortune, Hull Number H70!
Royal Navy's F-class destroyer, Fortune. ...I was transferred to the navy of the Maple Monarchy along with my younger sister Foxhound. ...As an F-class destroyer, I have worked hard...
Greetings, Commander. I-I'm Fortune... As an F-class destroyer, I'll do my best...
Commander, d-did I make you wait? ...I-I'm... *cries*
Commander... I worked hard but... am I still not good?
Fortune... means 'wealth' in a way...
If I'm with my sister, I can go anywhere...
Saskatchewan... a new name bestowed by God...
I... I'm causing trouble... aren't I...?
Uh... mmm.... *sobs*
T-there are... still unfinished missions...
Praise be to God for blessing us with such wealth! *gets on knees and prays*
A new mail... Is it the will of God...?
Umm... Good work! ><
Commander... Umm, it looks like the commission team is back...
Fate... is coming closer...
Bear witness to the Wrath of GOD!
Victory... is a blessing from God...
Has God... given up on me?
Uh, umm, you are all fated to be destroyed >.< !
Just as guided by fortune...
Fortune is tearing us apart...
...I-I'm nervous... Ugh...
I-I have also wanted to talk to the Commander... Umm...
Commander, I... I've always watched you-- Am I troubling you... with such a sudden remark?
I finally have the courage to can say this... The goddess of fortune has allowed us to meet each other...

To think that we've gotten to this point together, Commander... W-well, fortune has guided us... but it's also due to you guiding my hand as well. I will continue to believe in my own fortune... Thank you very much...
Commander... Thank you very much.
Come on F-class, let's do our best!
The weather is so nice and sunny, I'm sure whatever I do today will be a success. May everyone else have a good day today as well... Awauh! Little manjuu, are you okay? I can't believe I tripped...
The weather is so nice and sunny, I'm sure whatever I do today will be a success. May everyone else have a good day today as well... Awauh! Little Manjuu, are you okay? I can't believe I tripped...
The manjuus came bearing some food. Please help yourself, if you'd like...
Am I just imagining things... or... can you see through this dress...?
This garden is pretty big! Foxhound seems to be having a good time running around, too.
Being able to come to a special place like this... could be considered fortuitous in its own way...
Ooh, I think Echo would enjoy those sweets. I should ask the manjuus to set some aside for her...!
Did you need something from me...?
Eek! The drink went all over my dress! You can see through it now...
Y-you made it back without a hitch... This place is so big, I feel like I'm going to get lost...
Is this really going to help you, Commander? Ah? I doubt our destiny will change with this... Just kidding, Commander! Anything for you.
Can I really be of use with this... Eeeeh?! N-No way! I can't get off the rails! Ugh... Was that... a joke?
Fortune...means 'wealth' in a way. It would be great if I can enrich our fleet.
Ugh... Commander, please let me rest...
Oh God, is such a trial truly necessary...
G-class Destroyer - Grenville (H03)

I'm Grenville, Royal G-class Destroyer. I served as the lead ship and flagship of a destroyer squadron! However, it's a darn shame that I didn't leave behind much of a legacy because of my short service. If there's anything special I'd like you to know, um, I'm not fond of naval mines...

Heyyo~ Good morning, Commander! G-class Destroyer, Grenville, reporting for duty! Now that I'm here, you can leave everything to me and take a nap! Hehe, just kidding~ Let's get along well, all right?
Commander, welcome back! Did you sleep well? If so, let's get started with today's work!
Commander, I steeped tea according to Miss Hood's instructions. Care to try? Huh...? It's too sweet...? Ahaha... I suppose that big ol' scoop of honey was a bit overkill...
Hehe, Commander, would you like to study etiquette with me~? For example, take this fine lady's hand gracefully like this~
As a lead ship, it's only right that I become a pillar of strength! Hehe~ Because of that, I'll continue to work hard!
Even though I may be inexperienced, I have nothing to fear! What matters is the ability to overcome any adversity in the future... Hehe, sounds like I'm beginning to boast~
Ahh... If only I could become an elegant lady like Miss Hood~
Woah?! Gosh... I'm going to get angry! Commander, you have to conduct yourself appropriately!
Commander, there are a lot of tasks left still, so don't slack off~ Let's keep at it and finish up together!
Let's hurry up and claim the mission rewards~
The mail's here! Hehe~ need my help opening them?
Commander, you're finally back! Hey, come and see the results of my training- I-I mean, pardon me! You must be tired from battle! Here, have some juice! Anyway, feel better soon, okay?
Everyone's back from commissions! I sure want to be able to play with them too... Ahem, you heard me wrong~ I said, I wanted to be able to sortie with them!
With this, I'll be added to the sortie fleet more often, right~? Hehe, Commander, thank you!
Let's show our opponents how awesome we are!
Expect nothing less from a lead destroyer~♪
Ugh... are my abilities still lacking...?
You're about to bear witness to our greatness! Take this!
Don't underestimate the power of a lead ship!
Commander, if you don't perk up, I won't pay pay attention to you anymore! Juuuust kidding~ of course that's a lie! Although, you still shouldn't disappoint me~
There are a lot more interesting friends to meet around port, right? Commander, if you have the opportunity, why don't you introduce me to them? I want to learn a lot more about everyone else~
