Commander, thou hast been hard at work for so long~ Come hither and allow me to help thee unwind~
Seducing and taking care of thee are but two sides of the same coin! How does this big dummy not understand that?
I just wanted to inspect thy body a little, but turns out thou art surprisingly healthy~
Eek! I-I'm an angel in white, you know? Pervert!
Dumb Commander, stop acting all smug and come let me inspect thee for injuries!
Everyone from the commission fleet has returned! Perhaps I should check if anyone is injured.
This nurse won't be saving any enemies' lives~
If anyone is hurt, please come see me for emergency bandaging~
Commander, thou promised to go to the festival with me, right? If thou forgot, I shall have to give thee a nibble upon the neck, ehehe~
Commander, thou promised to go to the festival with me, right? If thou forgot, I shall have to give thee a nibble upon the neck, ehehe~
Commander, art thou prepared to play with me until I'm satisfied?
A Sakura-style yukata? What's that? For one like myself, only finery like this fits the occasion~
Nnh... Commander, how is this goldfish so hard to scoop? Hurry and help me!
Hmm... these "yukata" things are more interesting than I had thought. I will have to try wearing one next time.
Commander, there appears to be something interesting over there. But I can't see... lift me onto thy shoulders?
For one like myself, the night hath only begun. Thou art not allowed to be sleepy yet~
Commissions? Go forth, but do not keep me waiting too long~

Hehe, the Sakura Empire sure has a lot of interesting things. I just learned this profound phrase: "The moon is beautiful, isn't it?" But for me, thou art far more beautiful than the moon... I can't help but to want to... taste thee~
Feast thine eyes upon Vampire's idol attire... is it not exquisite? Heheh, now thy gaze shall be fixed upon my performance alone~♪
Feast thine eyes upon Vampire's idol attire... is it not exquisite? Heheh, now thy gaze shall be fixed upon my performance alone~♪
What color am I wearing today... Well, maybe there's no need to guess~? Hehe~♪
What kind of song would suit me best? ...And don't just say "rock." Give me something both cute and cool, befitting my image~♪
The key to being a good idol is motivation. That's why the most important thing is to have fun~♪ Wouldst thou not agree?
"Hey darling~♪ Vampire can be thy per~ so~ nal~ idol~♡" Ehehe~
Even Warspite is an idol now? Huh, never would've imagined...
This... counts as fanservice, right?
I got an offer! Quickly, come look~♪
Good job on thy operation~♪ I am rather tired from my lessons as well, so perhaps it's time to relax in the bath? What wert thou thinking of just now?
Commissions? Go forth. But don't keep me waiting too long, understood?
Let the performance of darkness begin!
Let's celebrate with bl— Err, with wine and song~♪
Why do thee look so astonished? Thou promised to have this Christmas dinner with me. Is it that thou would rather offer me fresh blood than a feast? I certainly wouldn't object to that!
Why do thee look so astonished? Thou promised to have this Christmas dinner with me. Is it that thou would rather offer me fresh blood than a feast? I certainly wouldn't object to that!
What present do I want most? Of course, a tithe of fresh blood from thee! ...Just kidding~♪ A glass of wine will suffice~♪
To me, Christmas is but an ordinary holiday. But, what makes it special is being able to spend it with thee~ Heehee~♪
Who do I want to spend Christmas with the most? Geez, are you seriously going to make me say it out loud...?! Hmph! You lolicon! Big dummy!
My hair ribbon is coming undone... Is this thy idea of unwrapping thy present? Teehee. Pervert~♪
Want to get even cozier? Then, I'll make some space for you by my feet~
Thou art worried if I am cold? Or, art thou just trying to find out my lucky color for the day? Peeeervert~♪
Looks like new mail is in. Maybe it's something from Santa?
This is my Christmas present to thee~♪ How dost thou find it?
Ugh... I knew it, this wretched day and thou... Curses!
Dost thou truly wish to offer thy blood so badly? Hmmmmh~♪ Then, do not allow thyself to be hurt before becoming mine in the end. Is that clear~?
Those who fall in love with vampires are bound to suffer seven times more than their infatuation. After all, love is a poison which leads to death.
Darling~ Where shall we date on this eve?
We're finally alone together~ Darling~
Cleaning is no task for a vampire! We can be lazy every once and a while!
I'm bored... Mine darling, how about a date?
Doth thou beseech the color of mine garmets today? Were thou not the one who dressed me on the morn~
Are you elevating your love for me?
Aww~ What are you doing?
Rather than missions, am I not more important?
Mission complete! Next up, dating time~
You want the mail? Then exchange sweet love letters with me~
Darling, what's the souvenir? A test? Could it be a fine wine, or maybe chocolates from a land over yonder?
Oh my darling~ Let us go and greet the maiden's upon thier return~
Come! Raise thine glass to our love!
Flowers and salute fire for my love!
I cannot possibly have enough of the time I spend with thee, Commander~ Once thou art done taking thine bath, will thou listen to what I say?
Leander-class light cruiser - Leander, Hull Number 75!
I am the Leander class light cruiser, Leander. Me and my sister Achilles had worked hard around different countries. Please tell me about the things that I need to improve on. I'll do my best.
Good day to you. I am Leander class' light cruiser, Leander. Actually, I have some differences from my sisters. Do you want to know what they are?
Oh my, Commander. Please take care of me today as well.
Mmm. I'll leave it to you then, Commander.
Commander, are you tired? Do you want to lay on my thighs?
The place I used to live in was very warm
Aiiiiiiiiieeei!!!... Oh my... it's you, Commander-- Geez, you surprised me...
Hmm? Is there anything I can do for you, Commander?
Sometimes... I have to endure things I don't like, huh...
Commander, there are still unfinished missions.
Commander, please take the rewards
Commander, you've got new mail~!
Good work, commander. Is there anything I can help with?
Commander, the commissions are done.
I'm gonna work a little harder
Let's go, everyone. Be careful not to get hurt!
This victory belongs to everyone!
I've caused you trouble...
Mmh... just the right spot!
Being unable to judge your distance with others is problematic, Commander.
Oh, Commander, you're like a child. I can't leave you alone~
I'm thinking of taking a walk, but I don't have a companion... Commander, want to take a walk with me?
We were distant sisters in the home country, so I'm happy now that we get to fight together in the same fleet. All of it is thanks to you, Commander.
Thanks to you, Commander, the others have gotten along better every day... Right. What kind of gift do you want, Commander?
Always be by your side... is it? I understand. If it's alright, I'll happily stay by your side~
Thank you. I really like this!
Greetings, Commander. I hope I can ask for your continued guidance. ... Hm? Oh dear... I'm Leander, don't you recognise me?
Greetings, Commander. I hope I can ask for your continued guidance. ... Hm? Oh dear... I'm Leander, don't you recognise me?
Mhm, Commander, it's fine to ask things of me every once in a while.
Though I miss the place where I used to live, the presence of the four seasons here makes it feel like home.
Compared to me, my sisters have much more colourful personalities... *Sigh*...
Commander?! Have I made some sort of mistake?!
Commander~! This is inappropriate behaviour!
Leander-class light cruiser - Achilles, Hull Number 70!
I'm the second ship of Leander class ships, Achilles. My name is from the war god Achilles who fought in Troy~ That~ is~ why~, I'm gonna kick my enemies' butts no matter who they are~☆
Leander class light cruiser number 2, A~chil~les~ is here~ Commander, want to buy snacks in New Zealand?
Commander, Commander, don't pronounce my name wrong again~ I'm Achilles - remember that? Remember that? It's A-chil-les~☆
Eh? Me liking potatoes... does not match with my image?!
Com~man~der! What is that delicious looking thing?
Al~right~ Then I'm eating the butter~
Oww-- I cannot move my head or body anymore~ I don't want to do anything for a month~
OK, I got it now~ Commander is an idiot!
Hey, hey, wha~t are you looking for?
No problem whatsoever! No matter how many missions there are, just bring them on!
Remember your rewards too~☆
New mails~
Commander, good job~!
A happy report~ from Peppy Achilles~! The commissions are done!
Since I've become stronger, my feet are more resilient now~
Wahaha! Let's go! It's action time!
If I'm praised by Commander, I'd be even happier~☆
Ooo... Maybe my talent has yet to bloom?
Achilles, attack!
Commander, work hard and aim to become a ☆magician☆
Did you know, men who are virgins until 30 years old become wizards!
Living a real, normal life... Aaah, I'm doomed~ (mumbling to herself)...
Say, Commander... Want to try it with me? I mean... that! Let's go out and play! I'll make a picknic for us~☆
Ehehe, I never thought that cooking for people I like would be this fun... Just leave it to me, Achilles, from here on~☆
Commander, you understand that you cannot live without me, Achilles, right? Hmm hmm~ Don't worry. I will never leave you~ It's a promise~☆
Yay! I love, love, LOVE you~☆
The cute and charming Achilles is Super☆Retro☆Fitted! Even my heel won't give me any problems now! Well, not like it really ever did before, ahaha~☆
The cute and charming Achilles is Super☆Retro☆Fitted! Even my heel won't give me any problems now! Well, not like it really ever did before, ahaha~☆
Commander, want some honey? It's heckin' yummy~!
Look, Commander! There's a gorgeous sheila in the sky! ... Really? You believed that?
Being here now, I can chat with anyone whenever! Stoked as a stove, I am!☆
You trying to hide some good chow from me? C'mon, let me have a taste!☆
Let's go and sail off into the sunset! Strewth, this is what being a teeny's all about, eh~
Target: enemy at 12 o'clock~! Shooooot!
Ajax, whaddya want me to do?
Leander-class light cruiser - Ajax, Hull Number 22!
I am Ajax of the Leander class ships. Commander, have you been to Plata river before? I have some wonderful memories there. Hehehe...

Commander, I am the 3rd ship of Leander class light cruisers, Ajax. I'm quite famous despite how I look... Commander, you'd be surprised at what I have in my closet. Would you like to take a look? Giggles
Hehe. I'll be having your care again for today, Com~man~der!
Commander, do you want to know more about my secrets...?
Do you want to have a meal first, or a bath? Or do you want... *giggles*...
I'll tell you a secret... Lend me your ear... Pfft! Did that tickle?
When I see you daydreaming, I have this insatiable urge to step on your face...
Alright. If you make me feel good, I might 'allow' you something~
When I think about perverts who touch 'that' spot, I want to step on them!
I'll give you a special reward once you finish this mission!
Reward? Of course it refers to the mission reward, doesn't it? Now take it. Or are you expecting something special?
A mail. The contents? You'll tell me, right? Com~man~der
*giggles* Little piggies that have exercised look so tasty, don't they.
Commander, I'll count to 5. If you don't greet the girls out for commissions by the time I'm done... *giggles*
*giggles* I will thank you af-ter this~
Oh my~ If you prostrate yourselves before me, I might show you mercy
Commander, good work out there. You did well...
Tsk... I'll pay you back for this next time!
*giggles* Oh cute little piggies...
So you broke... Oh well. Time to find a new toy, I guess
You have good eyes... Alright. Then you will become my new little piggy. You don't have the right to refuse.
*giggles* I'm liking you more and more. I wonder if you can amuse me further, my cute little piggy~?
Do not worry. You are the only one who made me want to abuse you this much. That's right, you are like the fated person for me, Ajax~ Aren't you happy about that~
I'm not a bad girl, you know? It's just I've never been serious before I met you. I've said this much, so now you're going to stick around, alright? You~ little~ piggy~?
This is... Looks like I have to prepare a new 'menu' of things. Please look forward to it, my lovely - little - piggy~
*giggles* Now what kind of reward would you like?
We'll beat them not with brute force, but with tactics.
I've got no interest in tying up my little piggy.
Can you have some fun while you're at it?
You've got excellent taste, Miss Formidable.

ex.line: Hehe, take good care of me today as well, my cute little piggy~
Shall I tease this little piggy today by loving it gently? Hehehe~
Just for you, my little piggy, I won't "put it back on" until you're done with work. Hehe, you know what I'm talking about, right...?
I never get tired of seeing that dumb face of yours. Hehe, you cute little piggy~♡
Perhaps that Leander is also... No, she's not like Neptune, she doesn't even understand the nature of "teasing"...
Your mail. Let's take a look... Hehe, of course I trust you, my little piggy~
Good work, my little piggy. The repairs and resupplying have already been arranged, so go ahead and rest for now.
Aren't you going to welcome back the girls in the commission fleet? I'll go with you, hehe~
Hehehe, my heel has your name on it~
I simply must reward my little piggy here. Hehe, what shall I do for you?
I mustn't let my little piggy... see me in such an unsightly state...!

lines.line: Ahaha, that slovenly expression on your face proves I made the right wardrobe choice♪ Now then, Commander, can I offer you some wine?
Ahaha, that slovenly expression on your face proves I made the right wardrobe choice♪ Now then, Commander, can I offer you some wine?
Commander, you're late. Don't you know the party already started?
You are not to stray from my side at the party. Don't tell me you forgot the rules?
Commander, have you forgotten you promised me a dance? Now watch your feet, unless you want to be punished♪
Life is like this glass of wine. One may indulge in it... or one can spill it away. Which do you choose, Commander?
Oh? Is that Exeter over there? Ahaha, I have a few words for her.
You want to see me drink? Ahaha! What an odd fetish... Here, have a goood look♪
Did I not say you were only allowed to touch my waist?
Reward...? Aha, well... How about a dance?
Of course I'm going to spill out such inferior wine.
You soiled my dress. How bold...
You've gotten so attached to me, have you, little piggy? Ahaha. Come now... Under such a lovely moon, and with such fine wine, I am your one and only Ajax, and you are my one and only piggy♪
I have some special chocolate right here, just~ for~ you. Hehe, if you want it so badly... then come and get it~
I have some special chocolate right here, just~ for~ you. Hehe, if you want it so badly... then come and get it~
Am I so petty as to say you can't accept chocolate from other girls? Rather, I'd say the more chocolate you get, the more popular you are, and the more adorable I find you... Hehehe♪
If you're so exhausted, I could always give you a massage? You need only lie down here like a good pig... Hehehe♪
The chocolate's going to melt if you don't take it soon. Or do you prefer it this way? What peculiar hobbies my piggy has~
Now, what do we do after we take chocolate from a girl? You don't need me to teach you again, do you, piggy?
You want me to feed you myself? How could I refuse? Hehehe♪
You can't wait for me to step on you...?
I have to give a special "reward" when my piggy is very, very good♡
I'll allow you to lick my feet since I'm in such a good mood today. What? I can't believe you'd turn down such a great opportunity!
I'm in a good mood today, so I'm giving you special permission to lick my feet. Come on, show sincere thanks to my reward!
Commander, how shall we 'play' today?
What? You want me to step on you that badly?
When I see you, Commander, I yearn to abuse you. Perhaps this is a form of love
Are you unable to endure that much? Yes yes, lie down over there... Hmm? You want to be stepped on... is that what you're trying to say?
Commander, are you looking for punishment again? Tonight I'll make you feel like you are in heaven and hell at the same time!
Dido-class light cruiser - Dido (HMS Dido.)
I am Dido, name ship of the Dido-class. I served as an anti-aircraft cruiser in the Mediterranean during the war. By the way, I hope Sirius hasn't given you too much trouble...?
Good day, Master. I am the light cruiser Dido. I am in your service as a Royal Maid.
Welcome home, Master. I am doing well, of course! Oh... m-my master is worried about me...
Master, you won't abandon me, will you? Can you promise not to? Can I place my faith in you, Master? You are trustworthy, are you not? Ahh... I hope it wasn't a mistake to place my faith in you...
Master never abandoned anyone else before, correct? Or have you just not done so *yet*? In other words, Master cares more about them than me? Blast it... I can do better than that!
Have you any work for me to do? Please, it can be anything, no matter how unimportant. Yes, that is my purpose in life, as Master's loyal maid.
It is a pleasure to see you, beloved Master. Please allow me to serve and soothe you with all my mind and body. After all, I am your personal maid, and that is my duty.
Uwaaa...
I did a good job, did I? Masterrrrr... Ah! It was nothing! J-j-j-just doing my job!
M-Master... I am honored to receive your affections, but... this is most unorthodox...
Thank goodness... For as long as there are unfinished missions, I have a purpose.
Congratulations, Master. The rewards from that mission look spectacular.
I have mail for you, Master. Do look it over soon.
Master, are you all right...? Phew, glad to hear it.
Master, the rewards from the commission are here. Have a look, won't you?
I cannot thank you enough, Master! But thank you very much...!
Hard work is how I'll be of use to Master! Here I come!
Victory! Brilliant, isn't it, Master!
I beg your forgiveness, Master! Please do not discard me like this broken doll...!
For the glory of the master!
I won't give up so easily...!
Ahh... I beg you, Master, spare this pitiable maid your mistreatment...
As a Royal Maid, I will serve my master with duty and conviction. Should you need anything of me, do not hesitate to ask.

There are many klutzes among the Royal Maids, yet Master looks after them and treats them with care... I, meanwhile, am just... Oh, I'm terribly sorry! No honourable maid should be openly jealous of her companions! But still... those klutzes are such cowards...
And so it's because I'm so competent that no one worries about me... B-but you worry about me, Master? I'm unworthy of such attentions from you! I just... When I think of you, I... Aaahhh...
Wh-what was that? How could you possibly love a lowly maid like me...? R-really? Truly? Honestly...? The Master likes me. The Master really likes me... Ahhh.. Help, I can't stop smiling...
My... to think you could fall in love with a worthless maid... Master, I implore you! Love me forever... forever and ever and never let go...!
Are you sure I'm deserving of a present like this?
The battlefield is the only place I need not worry about you...
It is so audacious for a lowly maid to dress herself in such finery and stand at her master's side... Still, I will go to my master and... M-M-Master...?!
It is so audacious for a lowly maid to dress herself in such finery and stand at her master's side... Still, I will go to my master and... M-M-Master...?!
Master, am I wasting your precious time...? Please forgive me! I am almost ready!
Master, what do you think of my dress....? Oh, it looks good? Does that perhaps mean I am unworthy of it? And you want to cast me out...?! But... Masterrrrrrr...
Master, might I accompany you to the party this evening...? I swear I won't be a bother! I only ask that you occasionally acknowledge me...
Rest assured, no matter how I dress, I am ever your most loyal maid! You may ask anything of me and I will do my utmost!
Serving as your bodyguard is also one of my duties, Master! Indeed, I am here to guard you with my very life!
Wha...?! You want to help me get ready? B-b-but to do something so mundane... And, and to do it for me... Aahh...
Master, m-my clothes are a mess... We, now... We can't...
I cannot believe you are here and I am still getting dressed. What a worthless maid I am. Forgive me...!

The party is about to begin and here you are, Master, standing by my side waiting for me... That can only mean you don't want to toss me away. That you care about me... Ooh... If only we could stay like this forever...
Southampton-class light cruiser - Southampton.
I am the name ship of the Southampton-class. During the war, I was the only one of my sisters to be sunk. How lucky of me... Ugh. Let's not speak of such unpleasant memories...
Good day, Mast- ahem! My name is Southampton. Let me know if there's anything I might do for you. Oh and, not to be a bother, but is there a space here where I can make tea and enjoy some music?
Oho! Commander, let us combine forces to finish the day's work as soon as possible!
Naturally, I rather enjoy being a knight more than a maid. Losing myself in this music is such a delight. Commander, you simply must try it as well!
Commander, why don't we put a nice old phonograph right there in your office?
The maids would be running ragged right about now... I am terribly unsuited to that sort of work.
Honour guard? Bite your tongue! I am a Royal Knight under the command of King George V!
Are you tired? Well then let's lie down for a nap, shall we?
I-I'm not a maid! ... Err, rather, you can't do that to a maid either!
A mission, is it...? There's still a bit of time until the deadline. I think we can worry about it later... don't you? Hehehe.
The mission rewards came in! Now there's no rush, but you'd better not forget to collect them.
Who's the letter from this time?
Commander, your office is much bigger than I expected... You know, this would be the perfect place to play hooky for a bit...
Must we go meet the commission team? Very well. Let's head straight back for a rest afterwards. Hehe~
I've grown stronger! But I do hope you won't increase my workload. Hehehe.
W-wait a tick! Don't go charging on ahead like that!
We have seized the day! Yaay!
Aieeee! L-let us beat a hasty retreat!
I do what I must!
Aieeee! Pl-please settle down!
You know, Commander, if you keep pushing me like this I'm going to break.
Commander, have you devoted yourself to the fleet once again today?
Commander, you need not work yourself so hard, you know? Why not let, say... One of my maid sisters take some of your workload... Hmm?
It's not like everything needs to be done one hundred percent perfectly all the time. Just take it easy. It's good enough for government work. You need to cut loose more often.
Commander, if you don't know how to relax, just let me be your guide. Hm? What will I do? Erm, well, wait a tick and let me think! Ehehehe~

Now, I know marriage is a solemn and serious ritual, but don't worry, I'm not going to stand on ceremony with you, Commander! Indeed, I have only one request: that whenever I wish to see you, Commander, you be there for me ♪
I'll take good care of it! Hehehe!
Newcastle! Might I trouble you for a spot of tea?
North and... South! Hah! I think we'll get along famously!

Hello there~! Royal Knight Southampton is reporting for duty in a Sakura-style outfit! Hehe, don't you have something to tell me about my new look, like how cute it is? Come on, don't be shy. Speak up~

Hello there~! Royal Knight Southampton is reporting for duty in a Sakura-style outfit! Hehe, don't you have something to tell me about my new look, like how cute it is? Come on, don't be shy. Speak up~
Commander, Happy New Year! Now it's off to the shrine for a special blessing, isn't it? Heheh, easy does it then.
Dressing up all Sakura style has me feeling like I want to listen to some Sakura music. Ehehe.
I think this here is the "Demon Breaker Arrow," isn't it? Seems to be some kind of warding charm... brilliant!
I got one of those omikuji fortunes for you at the shrine, Commander. Let's see, what does it say...?
I find myself wanting to dive into all the girls' festivals now~ What delightful holiday do we have next? I'm so excited!
Commander, come do the shrine business with me! Let's see, I think the Sakura girls did it something like this... you put your hands together, don't you?
What do you say we do a bit of New Year's rearranging in the office here, make it a little easier to faff abo... Ahem, easier to polish off those official duties. Hehe.

Good day, Comm—Err, I guess it's "Master?" Ugh, I do prefer calling you Commander though... Anyway, I've been practicing the violin to help create better atmosphere around the shop. Did you come here because you were captivated by the sound of my music?

Good day, Comm—Err, I guess it's "Master?" Ugh, I do prefer calling you Commander though... Anyway, I've been practicing the violin to help create better atmosphere around the shop. Did you come here because you were captivated by the sound of my music?
Commander, since you're here, take a seat and relax! Sip on some tea and enjoy some good music~!
Do you get how it feels to kick back and let loose to some heavenly music now? Ehehe.
I mean, this is something all the Royal Maids can do. Even I've learned most of the skills necessary for being a maid.
I thought it'd be nice if we didn't have to play music live, but Her Majesty demanded that we provide live music for her at the venue...
Commander, have any song requests? It's a special treat from me. O-oh, but... nothing too difficult, please!
An encore? Alright. Here's a special song, just for you~
Eek?! I played off pitch because of you, Commander!
Good work, Commander. Y-you want to know what I've been up to...? Well... I've been slacking off for a bit, ehehe. Please keep it a secret from the others!
The Royal Knight, Southampton, makes her grand entrance in glorious wedding garb~! Oh, Commander, you look a bit on edge. Here, c'mere for a second~ Ehehe. *rub rub* Well? Feeling a bit less stiff?
The Royal Knight, Southampton, makes her grand entrance in glorious wedding garb~! Oh, Commander, you look a bit on edge. Here, c'mere for a second~ Ehehe. *rub rub* Well? Feeling a bit less stiff?
Welcome back! Mast... Err, pardon me! Umm, Commander? That's just the same as before... Oh, how about, "Dear?" Hmm... I hope that's not too over-the-top for you.

When I spin around in this dress, don't you think the fluttering ribbons make me look kind of like a butterfly? Commander? Um, Commander, are you there? What's wrong, are you so entranced that you're totally speechless?
Commander, you look like you're drowning in work. I'll teach you this one weird trick that'll make all of your problems go away~! Ehehe.
You enjoyed my cooking? Hooray! I asked Sheffield to give me some pointers, and put my heart and soul into it. Ehehe.
Shh! Commander, come over here! Ehehe. Over here, we'll be able to slack- I mean, take a break, without Sheffield catching us.
What's wrong? I'm perfectly capable of working without slacking off if it's for your sake~♪
I-I guess it's fine... You did give me a ring...
Wait, the mission's... deadline is right in front of us?! There's no time left to procrastinate, is there... Oh no...
Excellent work as always, Commander. Please enjoy some hot and fresh tea while relaxing to the music I picked out myself~♪
It's time to greet the commission team, right? Let's stroll over leisurely, just as Newcastle does.
I'm still a member of the Royal Knights, you know!
A glorious victory, befitting a member of the Royal Knights! Ehehe~♪

That one weird trick that I told you about earlier? It's going on a date with me! Ehehe, I guess you get what I meant now? ...After you finish working? Fine, I guess I have no other choice. I'll help you out a little bit!
Sheffield-class Light Cruiser - HMS Sheffield

I am the Town-class light cruiser, Sheffield. I've basically only fought against Iron Blood, having witnessed the demise of Scharnhorst, and participated in the hunt for Bismarck and Tirpitz. However, I underwent repairs throughout the end of the Second Great War and was unable to sortie. If there's nothing else you'd like to know, I would like to head back now.
Ah... I thought you were a vermin, so I fired on instinct... You're my new Master? Excuse me. I am a member of the Royal Maids, Light Cruiser Sheffield. I am yours to command.
Please mind your step, Master... Right there... is where I just mopped.
Hmm? "Cleaning" things up with a gun falls perfectly within a maid's normal line of duty, Master.
"Master, I love you." Please believe me, I put at least 30% emotion into those words.
Master, if you wish to take a nap, please tell me ahead of time. I will make sure you don't oversleep, with this gun.
Belfast dotes on you too much, Master. At this rate, I'm afraid that you will turn into a useless lump of driftwood.
Pest- I mean, Master, what requests do you have? I beg your pardon, that was a slip of the tongue.
I do hope you have this same kind of strong spirit on the battlefield.
Please entrust all "cleaning" tasks to me.
Master, do you plan to give all the mission rewards to me?
Master, I've already sorted your mail.
Good work, Master. There is still some work for you to take care of. Please do your best.
Master, does the sound of my gun not remind you of something? Perhaps, something like the commission fleet that you've kept waiting?
Hmm... this feels a bit of all right. Thank you, Master.
"Garbage" will pile up if you don't "clean" it up...
Are you satisfied with these results, Master?
Master, please assign me to the rear...
Do you hear that? The ringing of your death knell.
So, you pests have a few tricks up your sleeves...
I see, Master, you are remarkably similar to a pest, morphologically. The world is full of mysteries.

I understand, Master. You've finally awakened to the realisation that you are an oversized lump of non-combustible rubbish, and your psyche is screaming for me to grant you the sweet release of... Just kidding, please wait while I make tea for you.
To facilitate ease of reading, I took the liberty of organising and re-categorising all the books on your shelf. Please check the results.
I should learn... from Belfast's example? A maid should serve her master wholeheartedly without asking for anything in return. In contrast, that one is quite greedy... but, I am a bit envious...
Master, are you troubled by the way I talk and act toward you? If so, you must understand that is the way I express my love, my beloved Master. Yes, it's true.

Upon the name of Virgin Mary I pledge, may the hammer of love be dropped upon those that would harm my master... Master? U-um, I wasn't doing anything in particular. You must have heard me wrong. Anyway, let's get this absolutely mortifying ceremony over with as soon as possible...
Is this for me, Master? Have you made another mess somewhere?
Surely you're not getting rusty, are you?
Do be careful with those Swordfish of yours...
I suppose this, too, is fate.
Commander, I hope this is not some perverse hobby of yours.
Let me witness your "justice."
... Did you find out about my undercover identity? You leave me no choice. Master, I cannot allow you to leave this room... Of course I'm jesting, it's merely a hobby.
... Did you find out about my undercover identity? You leave me no choice. Master, I cannot allow you to leave this room... Of course I'm jesting, it's merely a hobby.
Master, what kinds of missions are we to carry out tonight?
Maid by day, and secret agent by night? Hmm, that does fit the Royal style. Unfortunately for you, it's just your imagination.
The slumbering city, silent and dark, inexplicably makes me feel at ease...
Master, it is not incomprehensible that you would desire some excitement in your life, but please focus on the work at hand.

Do not let your guard down for even a second, and always be ready to fight. From this point, a secret agent and a maid are quite similar. Huh? Maids don't have to fight? Master, your jests are quite rich.
Master, you don't have to come all the way up to get me. It's going to be a pain to get you back down safely.
Out of respect for your bravery, I shall reserve this special bullet just for you.
Master, what do you plan to exchange for this all-important piece of mail?
Let's hurry up and get this over with. The night wanes.
The Sakura Empire's summer festivals... they're quite noisy. It will be difficult to keep things clean with so many people around... Despite that, I'm still having a good time. Is there a problem?
The Sakura Empire's summer festivals... they're quite noisy. It will be difficult to keep things clean with so many people around... Despite that, I'm still having a good time. Is there a problem?
So this is where you were, Master. I was afraid that you had gotten lost and almost mobilised the entire Maid Team. What exactly were you doing?
Swiftsure, don’t stay in your room while the festival is going on. Go out there and socialise with the others. Of course it's worth the effort...
So this is cotton candy... Mmf.. It's very sweet... Nn... What are you waiting for?
Master, what do you think about this festival? If you're enjoying it, perhaps we can go to a similar Western-style event next time.
Southampton, why did you run off to the festival when you're supposed to be on duty? Ugh... What am I going to do with you...
Do you need something?
This outfit is quite breezy. I will have to thank Ms. Victorious on behalf of the Maid Team.
I keep a gun with me at all times.

Not a bad selection of fireworks. I thought that I had nothing to see since I've had to put on so many opulent displays of pyrotechnics for Her Majesty's enjoyment, but I feel like these are pretty tasteful.
Regardless of the occasion, there is always time to take out the trash.

The fact that you're asking your own maid to be your partner at the ball shows a concerning lack of gumption as a human being... However, if you go and make a fool of yourself, it will reflect poorly upon my standing as a maid. Therefore, I have no choice but to accompany you.

The fact that you're asking your own maid to be your partner at the ball shows a concerning lack of gumption as a human being... However, if you go and make a fool of yourself, it will reflect poorly upon my standing as a maid. Therefore, I have no choice but to accompany you.
There is no need for panic, Master. I've become quite accustomed to your lack of punctuality.
Don't worry, I've hidden my gun. If anything happens, I will protect you.
Making your maid be your partner is a difficult request that falls outside normal lines of business. As fair compensation, please bring me a cake later.
As your partner, I will naturally draw plenty of unwanted attention. I must steel myself mentally.
I can see other members of the Maid Team going about their business... What a strange fetish you have, Master, to make someone who should be working behind the scenes take center stage...
You'd like to escort me? Normally, I'd decline because that'd be embarrassing, but... you'd look so wretched that I simply have no choice but to accept.
Master, please do not get carried away in your excitement.
Master, I do hope you haven't forgotten that there is still a party to attend... How hopeless you are. Allow me to tidy up your appearance.
Your enthusiasm for this party is understandable, but please do not forget about the commissions.

Allow me to warn you ahead of time, Master. I will not come to your rescue if you spring another trap, so please mind your step henceforth... Just kidding. It is a maid's duty to aid her master, after all.

Allow me to warn you ahead of time, Master. I will not come to your rescue if you spring another trap, so please mind your step henceforth... Just kidding. It is a maid's duty to aid her master, after all.
It is good to see you, Master. Please let me know when you've chosen an infiltration route.
Why am I braving this dungeon with you, you ask? Well, I don't believe any other party would take it on with a master less capable than a mere maid.
Have you truly had ample rest, Master? Considering your stamina, I sincerely cannot fathom a scenario wherein we reach the end of this dungeon together.
*sigh*... As much as I wish I could use my firearms to "take out the trash," doing so would entail wreaking havoc on the stage dressing.
To think we must crawl through ventilation shafts. How revolting... Oh, it's nothing. Please, Master, lead the way - I insist.
Please, allow me to protect you, Master. You will make this more difficult for me if you suffer an injury.
Is this how you would portray a monster?
You have received a new quest, Master. I pray it's nothing that will put you in danger.
Your quest rewards have come in. Please put them to good use.
You have received a letter. Now is the most opportune time to read it, Master.
Welcome back, Master. It surprises me to see you on the frontlines. While it's true you're helpless in a battle, your mere presence does inspire courage.
The commission team has returned. May I suggest that you contact them?
I shall defeat our foes in one fell swoop.
It pleases me to know you can be of some use during these dark times as well, Master.

(As long as we're in this dungeon, I have the Master all to myself. I would ordinarily be insubordinate to ask for this exclusivity, but if the Master so desires it...) Oh, not at all. I have no desire to remain here for as long as possible.
(Bang!) As usual, you fail to guard your back. This may just be a game, but I won't abide carelessness, Master. Let's clean this zone and hurry to the next.
(Bang!) As usual, you fail to guard your back. This may just be a game, but I won't abide carelessness, Master. Let's clean this zone and hurry to the next.
Reload complete... Now, don't get hasty and mess things up just because I happen to reload quickly. That would defeat the point. Stay calm, Master.
No matter how I'm dressed, I am your royal maid, Master... You want me to match my lines more to my current role? Please be reasonable.
Even in this virtual game, it's just too sluggish... No, Master, I'm referring to YOU.
I'll be ready to escape at a moment's notice, so don't stray too far from me. Also, please don't mess up and fall into any obvious traps.
I may be joining you in play, but this is serious maid work. ...Not to say that I'm not having fun, too.
Don't let go of my hand, Master.
...Hm. Did you fiddle with the tactile simulation settings?
Thank you for your efforts. The game can wait until after you've rested. ...You don't want to make me wait? I'd rather not hear that from you.
The commission team has returned. I'll go check on them now.
Cleanup complete. Master, let us proceed to the next combat zone.
Congratulations on clearing that level. ...It's because of me? I appreciate your feelings, but frankly, I hoped you'd work harder. Rely on me too much, and I may get a little carried away, myself...
Gloucester-class light cruiser - Manchester.

Me name's Manchester, Town-class light cruiser of the Royal Navy! I ran in convoys and helped with shipping during the war, and did loads of other missions too! Although I did make a hasty decision or two, and I didn't exactly meet a glorious end and all. Hehehe...
Pleasure meeting you. I'm Manchester, Royal Navy light cruiser. Heheh, looking forward to serving ya, Master-and-Commander!
Hey up, Master! Just got done tidying up the office. Go on then, have a seat! ♪
You can always count on me, Master! There's bound to be things ya can't do that I'm right capable of!
If your work's not coming along, how about stopping to clean a bit? Tidy workspace improves your mood, dunnit?
I've proper wanted to learn cooking and stuff, but Gloucester says bollocks to that and won't let me. I'm not too dischuffed about it, but still...
I can do me maid tasks AND fight at the same time! Problem is, there's not much maid stuff you can do mid-combat, sadly...
Bit embarrassing, this, Master...
Hey up! Need something?
Oh, Gloucester's gonna be right livid if ya keep that up, Master.
Missions, eh... Right, blimey! Gotta start looking for one you can do!
You... You've completed all of 'em? That's bloody brilliant, Master!
Letter, innit. Let's see... This how ya open it?
Welcome back, Master! Feeling a bit parched? I'll pop over to the Royal Maids, then!
Commission completed, innit, Master! Let's go say hi to the team!
Brilliant! Cheers, Master!
C'mon then, let's have a go!
Cheers for helping me achieve a graceful win, Master!
They really did us in, eh? ...Easy now, Master, I'm well alright.
It's cleaning time!
It's alright! I can keep going!
That's just not how ya do it, Master.
Being a Royal Maid, it's me duty to serve you, innit. So whenever ya need something, just hit me up!
Right, so a good maid serves her Master proactively, eh... Cheers, Gloucester! I'll give the idea a go and clean Master's room right now then!
Blimey, I should've thought this through... Can't enter Master's room without the key, obviously... Oh, hey up, Master. I was just thinking I'd clean your room...

S-sorry, just feeling a bit tense to actually be inside your room... Yeah, of course I'll do a proper job cleaning it! Also, just wondering... c-could I pop around sometimes just to... see you, you know?
I can't believe I'm getting an oath ring from you... I-I'm guessing ya won't mind me coming to your room when I feel like it? Relax, I'd never peek under your bed, 'course not!
Thank you for thinking of me, Master!

ex.line: Oh, Master! You've come so early I don't have time to clean the office... Ya know what? I'll just do it alongside me secretary duties♪
Ya want a boxed lunch? Okay, I'll try... No, I'll give it me best shot! I'm not wholly incapable of cooking or anything! Seriously!
Hm-hmm♪ What's up, Master? Heheh, looking for your pen? It's in the right drawer. I found it just earlier while cleaning.
Southampton! Moving stuff around, are ya? Lemme give you a hand!
I'd bet Gloucester would be a better maid than me in many ways... But it's alright 'cos there's also bound to be things she can't do that I'm right capable of!
Master! I can get this done proper for ya!
I guess a scolding isn't going to stop you... Ahahah... You're a dead stubborn one, Master~
Welcome ba- A gift for me? You really shouldn't have... I-is there anything I can do to repay you?
Hang on, Master! Lemme pop the champagne for you... There! Hehehe, here's to our victory!

lines.line: Master, it's time for your injection! Hmm... Nowhere to be seen, eh... Then I guess I'll keep the sickbed warm until Master comes ba- Eep! M-M-Master?!
Master, it's time for your injection! Hmm... Nowhere to be seen, eh... Then I guess I'll keep the sickbed warm until Master comes ba- Eep! M-M-Master?!
Fooound you! Come on, Master, it's time for your shot~ Heheh♪

That's good, now just stay still... Actually, don't I need to do something before giving ya the shot? It's too late to ask Sheffy by now... Eh, oh well! Besides, I'm no ordinary nurse - I'm a succubus nurse! This'll go just fine!
Hmm. A nurse's job isn't to clean rooms... but is it her job to clean her Master's body? Oh gosh, what am I even thinking...
What's up Gloucester's costume? I think she goes against her by-the-book nature to dress all fancy for special occasions... Ya think that's the case, Master?
We're in for a right bastard of a cleanup the day after Halloween, but this is all worth it for that! Plus, that'll be a chance for the Royal Maids to shine, wunnit!
Do ya want me to go slow, or do I just jab it in?
M-Master, don't move around so much!
Ahaha! Brilliant work out there, Master! Now, come here and show me your neck~ Heheh, try to hold still now~♥
Welcome to the beach, Master! Pretty hot today, innit. If you'll have me, I'm right okay with spending the day together.
Welcome to the beach, Master! Pretty hot today, innit. If you'll have me, I'm right okay with spending the day together.
I heard today is Unconditional No Work Day. That means ya have to kick back and relax, Master!
Got you a fizzy pop, Master! I can make a cocktail out of it if ya want.
Nelson's not too interested in the beach volleyball tournament... What about you, Master? I can sign ya up, no problem.
Can we talk about Ark Royal? She says she's using her camera to keep an eye on the destroyers, but we all know that's a bloody lie...
Yeah, Master? Need something?
W-was this my fault...? *blushes*
I'm done cleaning your beach house, Master. Now how 'bout reflecting on your battle over there? I'll go fetch ya a beverage!
That group has got to be... Ah! It's the commission team!
Ah, my swimsuit... Err, never you mind, Master! What matters is that we won!
So, how was today, Master? Oh, sorry if ya felt obligated to hang out with me! I'll admit, I did kind of drag ya along from place to place... You had fun nonetheless? Heehee. Happy to hear it♪
Gloucester-class light cruiser - Gloucester (HMS Gloucester.)

I participated in a number of operations as a member of the Royal Navy. And while I was prepared to face my own sinking, I never would have imagined it would come thanks to a shortage of ammunition... Master, I swear to you that such a fatal mistake will absolutely never happen again.
Gloucester, light cruiser of the Royal Maids, at your service, Master. It is my honor and my duty to assist you in becoming a most magnificent commander.
Punctuality is not a virtue, it is rather a duty. Master, do bear that in mind.
If you have the time to gape at working maids, you have the time to do your own work. Master.
More trouble from the Royal Maids today... Belfast, do look after this troop of clumsy louts.
That Fiji is always buying cosmetics, clothes and the like... You must not learn from her, Master. Life is to be lived in moderation.
A maid has a maid's work, the master has the master's. The maids serve the master, while the master serves everyone. This is the way of the world.
Do you need something of me? As your maid, Master, I will do what I can to satisfy your requests above and beyond our typical responsibilities.
Take a seat over there. I am going to educate you on the proper way to treat a lady.
You have as yet uncompleted tasks... I will continue to remind you until all of your missions have been completed.
You have uncollected mission rewards. If you would rather I collect them for you, simply direct me to do so.
Do check your mail... If you would prefer I not remind you, you need only check it sooner.
Welcome home, Master. Have some tea. Now then, I must ask, you were fully committed to your duties during the sortie, yes?
You should check on the commission team, Master. Do consider how it may affect their assessment of you.
Excellent choice. Now, if you could also strengthen some of the other girls as well, I'd be delighted.
Please check your remaining ammunition stocks.
This is but a trifling victory. Master, should you be satisfied with such triviality... I would find that rather troubling.
I beg your pardon, Master. I have failed you.
All for our master.
This is not going according... to plan!
I do not speak to things.
Everyone makes mistakes. But I will use my experience to reduce the opportunities my master has to make such mistakes. Do be aware.
Master, you must keep a healthy, balanced diet. If you find it troublesome, I can cook your meals for you. Such is a maid's duty, after all.
Master, you must be mindful of your comportment around women, particularly the way you touch and handle them... If you find this challenging, I am willing to practice with you. Ahem, now then...
Master, we must improve your daily habits if we are to raise your work efficiency... If you would like, Master, I could take care of- Rather, I would be happy to stay with you.
Master, you need not resort to such methods to keep me by your side... But if this is indeed your wish, I, Gloucester, am happy to oblige...!
Since you've blessed me with this reward, I suppose I can go a little bit easier on you.
Have faith, the master will not let that happen again.
Madam Royal Knight, do take care of yourself.

ex.line: Master, you are already the paragon of excellence, for which I am extremely proud. But worry not, Master, in order to ensure that you are not at risk of making any mistakes... please allow me to handle *all* your affairs.

lines.line: Gloucester, light cruiser of the Royal Maids, at your service for the Spring Festival... You say I look displeased? I beg your pardon, it's just... Such holidays are in fact quite busy for the Maids. We have much on our minds. It is none of your concern.

Gloucester, light cruiser of the Royal Maids, at your service for the Spring Festival... You say I look displeased? I beg your pardon, it's just... Such holidays are in fact quite busy for the Maids. We have much on our minds. It is none of your concern.
Master, how is your work coming along? Let's avoid having you at the office for the holiday.
It was a terrible mistake letting Fiji handle this festival costuming... "Spice up this bit and the Commander'll love it," and such. It's all a game to that girl...
The floor is filthy again...? Oh those girls... I told them a thousand times to wipe their dirty shoes before coming inside...
Master, you should find a bit of time to spend with the girls. Don't forget those packets of New Year money.
The Royal Maids are preparing tonight's banquet. As long as Belfast is there, I don't think they will have any issues... Actually, I think I will go take a look after all...
Master, it's impolite to stare at a lady, maid or otherwise.
We'll have to shackle the master until the end of the festival, I'm afraid...
The port is all done up for the festival. But I get a headache when I think about having to put it back as it was...

Commander, please sit properly when you're riding the carousel, and refrain from haphazardly bouncing up and down... Why am I holding a whip, you ask? Why, as a trainer, it is my duty to instruct you on the proper usage of fairgrounds equipment.

Commander, please sit properly when you're riding the carousel, and refrain from haphazardly bouncing up and down... Why am I holding a whip, you ask? Why, as a trainer, it is my duty to instruct you on the proper usage of fairgrounds equipment.
Sit up straight, butt on the seat, and face toward me. There... You may stare at me, yes. ...No need to put your hands behind your back yet.
*crack!* ...Ah, my apologies for startling you. Please continue to enjoy the ride. I'm just testing the whip... ahem, I mean, I'm simply getting a feel for this prop.
Please don't comment on my attire, Master. Learning to be unaffected by such things is part of your education...I think.
I am simply here to help you practice, Master. If you'd like to change positions, then you may manhandle me as you see fit.
Focus on looking me in the eyes. The ride is moving, yes, but I can still tell that your eyes are darting about.
Are my instructions wrong? Forgive me for my presumptuousness, but I hope you're ready to show me a correct example.
If you'd like to ride together, then I can hop over to yours... No? Okay, then.
Ah... Let's, um... revisit this later...
Welcome back, Master. You don't need to rush yourself to ride with me right away... Oh, you enjoy my commands? W-well...
We should keep this place clean so that the commission team can use it after us.

Given your excellence and earnestness, it's understandable that you aren't used to such rides. It's sure to be many times more fun with the help of a Royal Maid such as myself... Oh? It's fun... just because I'm here? I-I see...
Edinburgh-Class light cruiser ー Edinburgh, Hull number 16!

I am the lead ship of Edinburgh class of the Royal Navy. Sometimes it is stressful having an overly capable little sister... I took part in the pursuit of Bismarck and Scharnhorst, as well as many patrol missions in Atlantic, North sea and Mediterranean. In the end, I sunk with all my gold due to Ironblood torpedoes...
This is my turn, you might say! I am 'her' older sister, Edinburgh! In a sense, I am the 'most accomplished' light cruiser!
Ah! I'm not doing anything weird! I'm just transporting gold bars into the room!
I'm not going to give these to you no matter how much you stare at me.
I want to be as elegant as Hood but, well...
Eeeh! ...Bel, where are you? I forgot my keys again...
Hmhmm~ Even Scharnhorst had to turn tail and run away when she saw me!
Thanks! I'm feeling a bit more energized.
Hey!! Don't touch that! It's gonna fall!
Commander, a lady would never hide her gold bars there!
You have to finish your missions properly!
I seem to have forgotten about something... Well, whatever!
Commander, there's a new ma... Wh-What? Where's the mail? Where did I leave it... ??
I made cookies! Please have a taste... They taste the same as Bel's? Well, we're sisters, after all!
When it comes to military commissions, I'm a pro!
It seems like I've become luckier!
Wh-Wh-What to do?? First let's retre... I mean, intercept them!
Crushing the enemies with elegance... That, is the elegant Ediburgh of the royal family!
Gh... the bullion...
No matter how thick the armor is, it can't win against the power of gold!
Gh... At least let me protect the gold...!
Since it's Commander, I have to be even more careful... *stare*...
Everything goes well when 'that girl' does it, so it should be fine if I'm a little clumsy, shouldn't it?
I've been lectured by Bel again... Forgetting to lock doors when going out, and turning off the tap... What the heck! She's totally not like a little sister!
Phew... I've finally found you, Commander. Actually... Aaaah-- Who the heck! Who left the banana peel here!
Commander, want to have a walk together before it gets dark? Yes, don't worry. The lights were switched off, and the windows were shut. Everything's OK! ... W-what? ...Wh-Where did the keys go?!
Hmhm, I'm fine with sharing some of my money-luck with you. ...The gold? No! That belongs to the Belfast Foundation!
Oh, wow! This present looks so pricey!
I didn't think I'd get a chance to fight with Belfast!
Sheffy, I'm counting on you!
Newcastle, let's talk about Bel sometime!
Echo, dear, do take care!
Why doesn't she have to go to school with me...she says she’s a maid for the Queen? Well, me too! You can be a maid and school girl at the same time...tsk tsk---
Why doesn't she have to go to school with me...she says she’s a maid for the Queen? Well, me too! You can be a maid and school girl at the same time...tsk tsk---
This pendant is so cute, right?! I copied from that girl. Let's call her “Belfast”.
Hmm...this Alchemy is really mysterious, but once I mastered it, then Belfast’s trust fund will...
Belfast, wake me up before you wake up Elizabeth. Otherwise, she will criticize me for getting up late again...
Do I look like a child who’s so easily bullied? Hehe, but as elegant as I am, no wonder I am called a fairy.
Victory, let me rub your cheeks again, doing so always brings me good luck.
Commander, wanna try my snacks? Ah~~
Commander! C’mon out now will ya. I can't study this way…
Belfast, before you go to greet the girls returning from commission, could you brush my hair? It's a mess...
Tsk tsk, we don’t need her here. In any case, Belfast will always be by my side. Fleet, prepare for interception!
M-my Belfast, are you ok?!
Ahem! I made this special candy just for Halloween! Here, Commander, take some! Wooaaooah! Wh-who put this pumpkin here? It, it was me?!
Ahem! I made this special candy just for Halloween! Here, Commander, take some! Wooaaooah! Wh-who put this pumpkin here? It, it was me?!
Ah! I'm just transporting the Queen's bullion in the pumpkin! It's not what you think!
I'm a Royal Maid, I'm certainly not afraid of any- Hyaaaaah!? Wh-wh-where did that come from!? ... Phew... D- don't scare me like that now!
They're saying I've got spicy candy mixed in here...? That's odd... I hand picked them all myself... Now where did that rumor come from?
Ta-daaah! It's a special Halloween Maid uniform! Lovely, innit? Heheee, I'd say bits of me even outshine Bel!
Gneisenau's costume there, it's a bit... Um, it's something...
Halloween candy delivery! You there, Commander, how would you like a treat endorsed by the Queen herself?
Oi there! Don't be doing that when I'm busy!
Bel, are you really turning down the Halloween event because you're too busy with Head Maid duties? Gosh, you really ought to make time for your sister~
Edinburgh-Class light cruiser ー Belfast, Hull number C35!

Good day to you. I am Belfast, the second ship of the Edinburgh class. I have duties as the head maid while being the Royal Navy's greatest cruiser. I had taken part in many battles, and borne witness to lady Scharnhorst's fall... Those are but the past for a maid. Please say something should you have a need for me.
Are you my master? Pleasure to meet you. I am Belfast the maid. From now on, I dedicate myself to you.
Welcome back, master. I've prepared the tea. Furthermore, I've sorted the documents over here. Please work at your leisure.
Is something the matter, master?
In order to become an excellent master, you must start from self confidence. Please do your best to turn your will into action, master.
Do you want some tea? Ah... if you want something else, I'll prepare some coffee or whiskey.
Sunbathing on Thames river wasn't bad. But this current life of mine is better...
Aimlessly touching a lady is not a gentlemanly behaviour. Please behave yourself around others.
It's a maid's duty to dedicate her all to her master. Would you like to see, master?
A new mission has been given to us, master. Please confirm it.
Your rewards have been delivered, Master.
There's a new letter. Shall I read it for you, master?
Welcome back, master. I've readied some light snacks over here.
Master, the ladies who went off for commissions have been waiting for you to greet them.
I won't let you down.
It's a maid's duty to remove their master's obstacles.
Oh my, I didn't spend as much effort as cleaning up a stain in a tablecloth.
Please retreat first, master. I still have some matters to attend to.
Dear enemies, this is going to be a little bit painful
Everyone, the main dish has yet to come!
Correcting her master is also a maid's duty...
I'm terribly sorry... I'm still new to this fleet, so I'm somewhat unfamiliar with my duties and cannot serve you at 100% capacity... Please look forward to my continued service.
This is something I made using the connections I have to the fleet. Please have a taste -- Is the taste to your liking?

It is important to observe your intentions sensitively. Especially intentions that you yourself are not aware of, master... I'm mean, you say? Hehe. Recently I've come to enjoy your troubled look a little. By all means, please forgive me.
Are you awake? ...Hehe, your sleeping face was so cute, I couldn't bear waking you up... How did it feel, resting on my lap? You are free to enjoy it to your heart's content

Now this is a little troubling... I'm fine with simply protecting you, my master, as well as occassionally enjoying your troubled look... But with such an important bond being formed, I've become wanting to serve you even more, as well as receiving more of your attention, master...
A present from you, Commander? I do hope you look forward to how I return the favour.
Royal Maids, let us move!
Best of luck, my dear sister.
I shall protect you, Your Majesty.
With grace now, Lady Enterprise.
Be mindful of your surroundings, Miss Unicorn.
Hehe... Master, why are you so stunned from seeing me? I thought you perhaps wanted to see me in a qipao... was I mistaken?

How do you like this outfit? I had it made just for my sword dancing performance!
How do you like this stance? It's like I'm in a Wuxia movie, right?
My sister says my moves are sloppy, but this is just my style! You like me better this way anyway, don't you?
Commander~ Do you think I should add some cool jumps and flying maneuvers to the dance? I think it'd be fun! ...Huh? It's too much?
Heheh~ Can I take that as praise?
You wanna see my sword? Careful you don't poke an eye out!
Whoooa! Commander, be careful!
The swordmaster counters! Like a gust of wind, she brings mail into the Commander's waiting hands! Read at once!
Commander, nooo! It's too soon to rest! I need more advice!
Report for the Commander! The commission is complete~ But before you go see the team, check out this cool sword move! Tadaaa!
I know I'm gonna do this dance at the party, but I really wanted YOU to see it! I'm not as elegant or attractive as the other girls, so I wanted to show you my best side in the best way I could...
Admiral-class battlecruiser - Hood, Hull Number 51!

Indeed, the glory of the Royal Navy now stands before you. Being able to maintain an air of elegance at all times is the hallmark of royalty. The Denmark straits? Soldiers know of victory and defeat alike. It was no more than a temporary setback.
Are you the commander? Greetings and well met. I am the glory of the Royal Navy: Hood. Wherever I go, victory follows.
Welcome back, Commander. Care for a cup of tea?
Feel free to admire the glory of the Royal Navy to your heart's content.
An outstanding commander must have an in-depth knowledge of tea.
This word is... ah, so I read it wrong. Sorry, my eyes fail me.
Listen more, speak less. You should listen to the opinions of others, but also retain your own judgment.
Commander, might that be a special reward meant only for refined ladies? I graciously accept.
Appropriate contact is indeed essential. Shall we dance?
Commander, you should understand the consequences of disrespecting a lady... Are you prepared?
Commander, we have been entrusted with new missions. Please look through them.
With glory comes rewards. Please do not forget about the latter.
It's unopened... Commander... It would be ungentlemanly to ignore the messages of others.
Commander, may I offer you some warm tea? We can drink it as we review your battle.
Having completed numerous commissions is a sign of glory. May I suggest rewarding those girls?
Your efforts will definitely be rewarded.
May glory be with us today.
The warm sun and the cool breeze: a brilliant victory.
Victory and defeat are commonplace among those who fight, and it is we that have all the time in the world!
Elegance is not just for show.
Even I am slightly angered.
*Sigh* Seems like you must learn it the hard way.
Commander, it's such a great afternoon. Shall we have a chat? ... Hm, alright... I'll talk about the times when I was with Renown.
Though I speak of being refined at all times, you need not force yourself, Commander. Your normal self is the most charming, after all.
Hm? I'm too close? A lady must be elegant, but they must also seize the initiative towards the targets of their own affection.

"Shall I compare thee to a summer's day? Thou art more lovely and more temperate... So long as men can breathe, or eyes can see, so long lives this, and this gives life to thee." ... A beautiful verse. Commander, could you read it out loud to me?
Aha, look how nervous you are. You can't convey your feelings to a lady when you're this nervous. However, your feelings have definitely reached my heart... I would happily oblige.
To be able to pick out a present befitting a Royal Lady is the hallmark of an exceptional commander. Thank you.
Miss Renown, please mind where you're going.
Miss Repulse, mind your manners.
I shall do anything you ask of me, Your Majesty.
The glory of the royal family, advancing.

ex.line: We've enjoyed the tea together, haven't we, Commander? Hehehe. You need only to ask if you would like some more.
Wouldn't you like to know more about me, Commander? I shall gladly tell you of glory, of past regrets... and of how my days have changed since I met you.
Lately, I feel as if I'm better at understanding your tastes than I am at finding new ways to enjoy tea♪ Would you like to put my knowledge to the test, Commander? Hehe.
No matter where I am, I always cherish you above all else. Do you... feel the same way about me, Commander?
While it is important to listen to everyone's opinions, for now... I want you to hear my voice alone.
The sunshine in the port, the breeze, the warmth from your hand... It's all so wonderfully calming.
I ask that you decide what we shall dance today, Commander. Now, if you would also lead me...
Goodness, Commander. There's nothing wrong with being honest and just embracing me...
Here, a cup of tea to rejuvenate you on your return. Please enjoy it, Commander.
"Nothing may cast asunder those who have vowed their hearts to one another." I never put too much thought into that verse before I met you, Commander, but now it's one of my favourites.

lines.line: What a feast for sore eyes. I feel great~! Vacations really should be at the beach! Let's show Sara your beach ball, Cygnet!
What a feast for sore eyes. I feel great~! Vacations really should be at the beach! Let's show Sara your beach ball, Cygnet!
Good day, Commander. Let not the heat shaketh thy inner peace. Keep calm and carry on!
My brilliance is like that of the sun? I'm in a good mood so I'll accept this praise of yours.
So me and the other girls are going to play beach volleyball The player on my team that scores the least will be subjected to a small punishment game.
I can see the whole harbor from the mountain top, this is the best place to watch fireworks.
To be elegant at all times is the mannerism befitting of a lady.
The beach volleyball game is about to start. Let's find a good place to watch, Commander!
This is exactly why Wales will always be a Prince and never a King.
Thank you for inviting me on this wonderful trip. Now that I have donned this beautiful outfit, shall we partake of a Sakura Empire tea party- leisurely and elegantly?
Thank you for inviting me on this wonderful trip. Now that I have donned this beautiful outfit, shall we partake of a Sakura Empire tea party- leisurely and elegantly?
You can have some of the maid team's black tea if you'd like, but why not try some of the Sakura Empire's green tea today?
Rose patterns as well as our Royal Navy's motifs... How splendid this is! I must express my gratitude to those who dyed this kimono.
The Higashi Chaya District? ...Oh, isn't that a town famous for its teahouses? Hehe, a perfect place for enjoying the Sakura Empire's tastes and smells. I definitely hope to go there.
Add hot water to the matcha and stir gently with this bamboo whisk- The Sakura Empire has a truly profound way of appreciating tea...
Commander, why don't you take some photos as reference for Comet and the others? We might as well get as much out of this trip as possible - not just souvenirs, but also sources of inspiration.
Commander, how's my technique?
Commander, would you like to try some roasted twig tea? Do be at ease while bathing in its elegant aroma.
A gentle breeze, a soothing fragrance- An elegant victory indeed.

"As the heat retreats, harvest melons and eggplants, welcoming Autumn." ...My, what an evocative and refreshing poem. Commander, let's set aside all our worries and enjoy this trip, just the two of us.
Beauty is not always over the rainbow. Sometimes it is right in your backyard. Commander, how would you like to spend this quiet, lovely day right here with me?
Beauty is not always over the rainbow. Sometimes it is right in your backyard. Commander, how would you like to spend this quiet, lovely day right here with me?
The gentle sunlight, and a refreshing breeze - today is a fine day to venture outside.
Compared to the overly grandiose national parades, I greatly prefer the relaxing companionship of a single escort. Commander, will you be my escort?
Watch out for the stairs? Indeed, I'll do just that. Thank you for remembering that my eyesight can be troublesome.
If you don't have a destination in mind, why not simply enjoy the scenery all around us? For example... the roses in full bloom in this garden.
I can see that Bismarck is finally learning to shed the burdens placed upon her shoulders. Hehe, don't you think she should be more true to her feelings?
Commander, you'll properly fulfill your duties as my escort, yes?
Commander, when we get back, would you like another lecture on how to properly escort a lady?
Tea is of paramount importance to a leisurely outing. Naturally, I will leave that to you, Commander.
Whoa, there... There you are, Commander. You could have waited at the clubhouse... Why yes, the view is just beautiful, isn't it? Hahaha, thank you for bringing me here today.
Whoa, there... There you are, Commander. You could have waited at the clubhouse... Why yes, the view is just beautiful, isn't it? Hahaha, thank you for bringing me here today.
Commander, how will you be going back? Would you like to ride together on my horse?
Horseback riding isn't really something to be praised. It's part of raising any royal lady... You say the others were impressed? My, and you, too?
Commander, if you're willing, you should try feeding horses. I promise it's adorable to see them eating right out of your hand.
Riding a horse through vast expanses of greenery is lovely, but I think I'd like to try riding on the coast sometime. Of course, I'll need the proper equipment.
Cygnet wants to try riding, too, so I'm going to pick out clothes for her later. Want to join me, Commander? Heehee.
Riding raging waves, running through the plains on a horse—Either way, it's a piece of cake for me. Hahaha!
I hope you'll use a gentle touch with the horse, as you do with me.
Thank you for your work, Commander. The weather is lovely, so I brought this lovely little horse from the stable to greet you.
It's time I showed you the style of a royal lady.
Whether you're on the lush plains or the open seas, the winds of victory are ever so pleasant.
Commander, the invitation I received read: "A Special Event for Lady Hood." Could that "special event" include your exclusive company and this brilliant surprise on my finger?
Commander, the invitation I received read: "A Special Event for Lady Hood." Could that "special event" include your exclusive company and this brilliant surprise on my finger?
These garments are a part of my promise to you. The eternity we've spent side by side, and our vow that has weathered many a storm, are a most fitting match for the radiance of this ring.
I originally prepared these garments for a magnificent social occasion, but they are currently fulfilling a more suitable role. I am delighted that they are reserved for your eyes only, Commander.
I was lost in thought there. I couldn't help but touch the ring again unconsciously. It seems I wish to bask in this bliss for a while longer.
I value people with whom I can experience and share victory and glory alike. But this contentment, Commander, is something only between you and me. And that's more than enough.
The fragrance of today's tea seems a little different from usual. But it is certainly calming.
Could I ask you to put this ring on me, Commander?
Goodness! As elegant a lady as I am, I am still defenceless beneath this finery. I hope you will escort me to the last, Commander. Hehehe.
Welcome back, Commander. I found myself gazing at this ring while you were gone. I must have been immersed in our shared memories.
I have devoted everything to my glorious duty. However, in this moment I would like to pour all of that emotion into the vow I hold with you. This ring is the greatest proof of our connection.
If the smooth path only allows one person to travel at a time, then I’ll gladly walk the path not taken with you hand-in-hand.
Don't be so impatient, Commander. The boundless sea is rushing towards you with open arms.
Which black tea did you prepare for us, Commander? Please allow me to build up my anticipation for this tea party.
Commander, once the seven seas have returned to peace, let’s organize another “Imperial Cruise”.
Commander, let me teach you the proper etiquettes of being with a lady.
There’s no need to be in such a rush... I’ll always be by your side.
Commander, everytime I picture your face, my heart races and my spirit soars like a skylark at dawn.
Queen Elizabeth-class battleship - Queen Elizabeth, Hull Number 00!
I am the super-dreadnought of the Royal Navy. Make sure to remember my name! My military achievements? I let my subjects take care of those kind of things. I simply need to watch them do their work!
Are you the commander? You are still 100,000 years too early to command me! Well, I shall be generous and give you a chance... From this day on, you will be one of my faithful servants!
Despicable, to have me wait on you for so long!
Peasant! Who permitted you to peak?! I-I have not prepared myself yet...
Being petite is a noble characteristic, understand?
You're saying I bumped into you? That's because you didn't make way for the Queen!
Do not touch my belly, it's rude!
Please do not touch our noble body so casually
W-wait... You fool, what are you doing?! I-I'll sentence you to death!
Hurry and finish the mission! Do not skip your work!
Kneel before me and accept your mission rewards!
I have no interest in the contents of your mail... Mmh...
A fine display, I shall be benevolent and permit you to rest.
The subjects tasked with a commission have returned. Go at once and see if they brought me a tribute!
I have no need to get any stronger! But... well, if you're going through to effort of doing it, then...
Witness the might of a super-dreadnought!
Piece of cake! There are no mistakes in my actions!
How despicable! To have brought shame to the great Elizabeth! You better remember this!
Kneel before the Queen!
Why are you spacing out?! Hurry! Get them!
You useless servant! I will have you relieved of your post!
Work hard for the great Elizabeth!
I'm sitting here for just a moment because I like the mood! Don't start getting any strange ideas!

H-hmph! You have been slightly exceeding in your duty, thus I will make an exception and promote you to captain of the Royal Guard! When I call for you, you will come hither immediately! Understood? Immediately! Swiftly! At maximum speed!
Hey, can't you just leave your work to your underlings? How can you be a proper consort if you aren't always by my side?! I-I would be so lonely...

Finally you have arrived before me. Foolish servant! Just how long did you intend to make me wait?! ...But I acknowledge your endeavors. Come here, I am giving you permission to take my hand! Yes! From now on I will always be with you!
One must admit, your taste is quite satisfactory! Now be grateful for this praise! Ahem!
Warspite! Hurry up and take care of these enemies!
Now this is the fleet I've been wishing for!
Warriors of the Royal Navy, fight for glory!
The Queen orders you to move! THAT... INCLUDES... YOU!
These oversized sisters... What an eyesore! ><

Hah haah! You're a lucky servant this evening! We shall allow you to accompany us to the party! ... B-but it's not like I chose you because I like you! I just... Yes! I just sort of chose randomly! Got it?!

Hah haah! You're a lucky servant this evening! We shall allow you to accompany us to the party! ... B-but it's not like I chose you because I like you! I just... Yes! I just sort of chose randomly! Got it?!
We shall allow you to bask in our splendor! ... Now out with your praise already! Lowly servant!
So as not to embarrass me at the party, you need to practice your dancing! Y-you could practice with m-... You don't want to bother me?! B-b-but it really wouldn't be much trouble!
It is a servant's duty to clear the way for the Queen, are we clear?!
Bel! Is everything ready for the party? N-not that I'm excited about it or anything! I'm just supervising my maids!
Hm, hmph! ... Considering the lengths to which you went for this party, we shall overlook your boorishness for now. Be grateful for your queen's leniency! Lowly servant!
Aie! Warspite!! Level your fifteen-inch guns at this insolent servant! Off with its heeaaaaaad!!
Now this is a stage worthy of our majesty! You are not to leave our sight, servant! Let your passions burn for me!
Now this is a stage worthy of our majesty! You are not to leave our sight, servant! Let your passions burn for me!
Hah hah! Spread the word, servant! Let all be dazzled by our splendour!
"Grovel before me, servant!" ...Hm? It feels a bit different from usual...?
Like so...? Is this cuter? Very good then, well done, Matchless. My servant will be blown away!
A maid idol...? What is it Bel and Gloucester have been teaching you?
How improper!
Encore? Heh heh. I could give you a few more!
Watch your hands, servant! Or it's the oubliette for you!
An offer for me? W- well, it is a Queen's duty to hear out the commoners...
I've included a favour in your rewards. Show me your gratitude!
Fine work. As a reward, you may have this portrait of me. Keep it well!
This is the Queen's stage!
Valiant, spread word of our victory far and wide!
Hehe, behold the new outfit that I had Akashi make for me! Impressive, no? Prostrate yourself before the elegant charm of my school uniform, servant~♪
Hehe, behold the new outfit that I had Akashi make for me! Impressive, no? Prostrate yourself before the elegant charm of my school uniform, servant~♪
Your Queen has arrived! Do make way, my subjects!
Servant, do advise me on these "club activities." I have heard much commotion about "idols" or something like that...
Bel, where's my cake...? Servant, take Neptune with you and make yourself useful!
Warspite, how fares the tea party plans with Nagato and the others? Have George and the knights deliver the invites to them!
"Field trip?" Let us make our way to Sardegna! Have Veneto regale us with the most exquisite banquet!
Did you go buy candy from the student store? Heh, even a noble such as myself must learn the tastes of commoners.
Time to check my locker~♪ ...Hm, a note from Newcastle? Um... "Already cleaned for you." ...Oh, I see.
Mathematics, check. History, check... Physical Education? Pass! A noble like me playing basketball with commoners? Unthinkable!
Ehehe, why it's only natural, of course! Nothing like that self-proclaimed "spiritual leader!"

Did I hear that you're supposed to give out red envelopes during the Dragon Empery's New Year? This is a fine chance to display the magnanimity of the Queen of the Royal Navy! ...Don't just run off with your gift! Spread the word of my glory, my servant!

Did I hear that you're supposed to give out red envelopes during the Dragon Empery's New Year? This is a fine chance to display the magnanimity of the Queen of the Royal Navy! ...Don't just run off with your gift! Spread the word of my glory, my servant!
"Be not enchanted by dreams of silver and gold. There are yet many ways to earn your coin." ...Well said, Warspite.
Servant, bright us some of that Dragon Empery tea! We wish to compare it with Edinburgh's black brew!
Heh heh, you doubt the wealth of a queen? Just you wait for the next Royal Banquet!
It seems different places have different customs for New Year's gifts, eh? Hmph, no matter. So long as you carry on as a good servant, we may reward you at any time!
You have our permission to collect this New Year's gift!
Watch your hands, servant! I curse you to lose your wallet!
You are to check your mail at once...! And I do not mean this red envelope!
You've done well. This red envelope is your reward!
Fight for your queen!
