Warspite, what in the world is all this... The Maid Team has to sift through all this paperwork?! I'm tired already... I wish I never mentioned wanting to experience what it's like to be a maid... And you, stop staring and help me already, servant!

Warspite, what in the world is all this... The Maid Team has to sift through all this paperwork?! I'm tired already... I wish I never mentioned wanting to experience what it's like to be a maid... And you, stop staring and help me already, servant!
You're not my master! I'm your master!
Warspite, what's taking you so long? ...What do you mean you can't move around easily in a skirt?!
Being a maid is no easier than carrying out public duties... So come help me already, you lowly servant!
Bel, come clean up around the office! Heheh, any job that someone as noble as me carries out becomes a noble endeavor in turn!
Do you also do this to the girls in the Maid Team...?
Hurry up and take care of the missions, you lowly servant!
Excellent, the rewards are here! Warspite, take these over to my servant!
I shall check the mail in your stead, my servant! ...Hmm, I wonder what this says...
Nothing beats Edinburgh's hand-brewed black tea! Wouldn't you agree, my servant?
Servant, what do you think you're doing?! Instead of wasting your life working, go have some fun in the sea for once! We went out of our way to come to the beach, so do not disappoint me!
Servant, what do you think you're doing?! Instead of wasting your life working, go have some fun in the sea for once! We went out of our way to come to the beach, so do not disappoint me!
I left Valiant with all the busy work so I could take it easy today! Why don't you leave your work to someone else for once?
Hmph! A noble queen would never swim with the common folk! ...I-it's not because I can't swim! Fine. Let's race to that rock! I'll prove to you that I am a capable swimmer!
A beach party? Seattle, where is this coming from? ...Not that I mind, once my servant and Hiei arrive.
Richelieu, wait! Why are you bringing the Meowfficers?! And Jean Bart, don't just stand there and watch! Stop her!

You don't see the Royal Maids around? Well, of course not; I gave them the day off. My servant and the knights are here, and Neptune and Cheshire have always wanted to try maid work anyway! I see no cause for concern.
Wh-what are you doing?! A reward, you say? Well, this is hardly...
How kind and perceptive of you to offer to refill my tea for me! Make sure you bring sweets, too.
Th-that was an accident, right?
You still have missions? Mm, I suppose I am a little concerned about Valiant...
The rewards have arrived! Hood, go take a look with the destroyers.
My, you've really given it your all! Heheh, I hereby permit you to rest! Take it easy by your queen's side, servant!
What's that, little ones? The commission team is back? Good! I shall go and greet them!
Servant, we go together!
Heheh!♪ George, be sure to record my accomplishments! And those of my servant, too!
Grrr... Servant! We will devise a plan to get them back!
Queen Elizabeth-class battleship - Warspite, Hull Number 03!

Elizabeth-class fast battleship, Warspite, reporting in. I hold the record for the longest ranged hit on a moving target. I've come close to being defeated quite a few times, but I managed to cheat death every time. This must be my fate.
Greetings, I'm Warspite. I hold the record for the longest ranged hit on a moving target. Surprised? I'm smaller than you thought? Looks like we need to have a long talk...
As long as I'm here, we can deal with any enemy, no matter how far they are.
Don't be blinded by statistics. Victory depends on far more!
Your orders are absolute, Commander. They shall be my highest priority.
This grand old lady can run faster without a skirt. Want to race with me?
If you make fun of me one more time, you'll be eating my 15 inch shells!
Body contact...? I don't hate it...
Just so you understand, I'm definitely not that sort of, erm...
Accept your new mission and then get ready to head out, Commander!
Missions give out rewards once you complete them. Don't forget that!
You've got mail, Commander!
Whew, not a bad fight. Let's rest for a while.
Commissions? I suppose I do miss running around on errands... Let's go. We need to welcome back those hard workers!
Battlefield, I'm coming for you.
I would never let the commander's enemies escape!
Don't be confined by the so-called "limits". It is indeed possible to be unsinkable!
My damage control isn't functioning?! I've lost control of my steering wheel as well! Why now, at such a critical moment?!
Belli dura despicio!
So this is how harsh the battlefield can be.
Would you please not act like we're close...
Commander, want to hear about the history of the Royal Navy? Maybe I should tell you something about the generals who used to accompany me.
I'm not very elegant? I'm sorry that I'm not like Hood or the others... No... I'm not talking about my body...

How do I put this... I'm considered to be one of the older girls, yet my body is like this... It might be unbecoming of one my age to compete with the younger girls, but I wanted to at least be attractive to you… What is a lady meant to do…
Well, enough of that. I'm Warspite, the one who spites war. Hmph! However, whosoever tries to take the Commander away from me will first have to face my cannons!
Finally the day has come! It looks like my efforts were not in vain... Let's go, Commander, I'm prepared for this. Officers, draw swords!
I didn't expect you to know what I like... thank you.
Do you want to race this old lady?
Unmatched by any? *Sigh*...
Elegance does not belong on the battlefield.
Your Majesty, please look forward to my performance in battle.
Youngsters, follow me.
Don't overdo it, alright?
This year, I am in charge of delivering presents to the children of the Royal Navy. Let's get going once I finish decorating this Christmas tree!
This year, I am in charge of delivering presents to the children of the Royal Navy. Let's get going once I finish decorating this Christmas tree!
Even warriors need to rest. Since it's a holiday, you shouldn't be too uptight either.
The wreath that goes on Her Majesty's door... Hmm, Belfast told me that the best way to make it is with seashells! Commander, let's head out to sea to collect some!
Commander, do you want a present as well? If you really want one that badly, it's not like I can't give you one...
Hmm... what present should I pick out for Her Majesty? It can't be too expensive or too cheap, and it can't be too exotic or too ordinary. What exactly can I get her?
If I'm delivering Christmas presents, it's only natural to go through the chimney... Eh? Wouldn't that make me seem suspicious?
Commander, come help me decorate this Christmas tree - I'm not tall enough to reach... W-wait, who gave you permission to pick me up?!
Commander, while you're out delegating missions, mind helping me deliver this present to one of the kids along the way?
Good. Since you are here, I can proceed to my next battleground - the important mission of delivering these gifts!

Apologies, Commander, it seems like our Christmas together was a bit unromantic. You... enjoyed it just fine? Heh, you're always like this... Well, at least, let us enjoy the rest of the night together while the bells of the Holy Night toll.
We have the finest equipment. Now to turn in a performance worthy of Her Majesty's beauty... Behold, the Royal Stage!
We have the finest equipment. Now to turn in a performance worthy of Her Majesty's beauty... Behold, the Royal Stage!
The day's schedule is in your hands.
Don't let my name fool you. Warspite is ready to fight, whenever and wherever, even onstage.
I'm no idol... Yes, idols are nothing like me... Hm...
What do you think of this outfit? It was made with input from the Royal Knights. Should be different from the others'.
Her Majesty is certainly all in at the moment, but I'm worried she may suddenly lose interest...
Are you fixing my equipment?
Is it time to call the police?
A gig request...? Maybe you'd better give this to Illustrious...
Rewards. I never thought Cesare would be sending them.
I'm going to win, even in a skirt!
(Did I take it too far...?)
If I were just a little faster...!
Humph! Good, a perfectly halved watermelon. The Sakuran watermelon-splitting technique is surprisingly easy to master... Well met, Commander. Mind delivering these melons to the others for me?
Humph! Good, a perfectly halved watermelon. The Sakuran watermelon-splitting technique is surprisingly easy to master... Well met, Commander. Mind delivering these melons to the others for me?
I'll split one for you, too. Haaah! ...Hm? You think I look unnecessarily murderous?
What happened to the bamboo and straw posts here? I was just taking a few practice swings. A wooden sword handles very differently from my usual weapons, after all. Heheh.
Do Sakurans usually split watermelons while blindfolded? Hmm, I don't mind starting over, but I might miss the first few times... You think I should keep going as I am?
When you deliver these, make sure to give Her Majesty the one with the least seeds. Oh, and try to take them out, if you can...
How about we compete to see who can split them more evenly? Heheh, I've always wanted to see your swordsmanship.
Humph! Phew... Can you line up the next one for me?
Hm? What do you think you're doing?
Well fought. You can't go see everyone with the air of combat still on you - blow off some steam on this watermelon, and that should fix you.
This outfit is battle-ready, too. Don't underestimate me.

To be honest, I'd rather enjoy the festival with you than keep on splitting watermelons, but... this is fine, too. You're with me, and I'm with you. We're doing good work for everyone's sake. It suits our respective roles, doesn't it? Hehehe.
Warspite, retrofitting complete. Mm, I rather like this feeling of being rejuvenated... Now, Commander, let us make our way towards new battlegrounds!
Warspite, retrofitting complete. Mm, I rather like this feeling of being rejuvenated... Now, Commander, let us make our way towards new battlegrounds!
My range extends even farther. Commander, send me out to fight, won't you?
It is my duty as your secretary ship to counsel you, Commander. I won't hesitate to speak my mind if you make a poor decision.
Survival is the key to becoming a stronger person.
Battle is the fire that feeds one's growth. And so I fight with all that I have, in every conflict.
Commander, if you have something to say, just come out and say it. I'm happy to listen.
My important parts haven't grown at all...? Seems like someone wants to taste my high-angle mounts...
Nelson-class battleship - Nelson, Hull Number 28!

If you don't know who I am, go back to the naval academy and start over. I have no need of a commander who doesn't know me. ... You're calling me slow?! Huh?! That's brave of you to say... Stand still, I'll launch some knowledge into your head with my cannons!
You're the commander? You don't look very capable to me, though. I'm Nelson. I'll be following your orders, for now.
Hmph. Are you done lazing around? I sorted out your documents, so I'm hoping you'll get some things done.
What are you staring at?! Keep it up and I'll gouge your eyes out!
Experience from what's known as "failure"? Only a loser would say something like that!
I'm not just talking about you, but those who wave around empty words of "friendship" and "efforts" do not belong here.
One should only do work one is capable of. You still don't have what it takes to be entrusted with important tasks... Keep honing your skills.
Are you trying to get a taste of my cannons?!
Off to the bottom of Trafalgar with you, Com-man-der!
Why are you daydreaming if there are still missions to complete?
Are you trying to make me get the rewards for you? I'll give you 10 seconds to do it yourself! 1, 2...
I picked up your mail while I was out on my walk. Read it and be thankful.
Have you witnessed the might of the Royal Navy?
Com-man-der! Did you forget about the returning commissions again?
I suppose I should show a little appreciation for you; nice work.
I expect everyone to do their duty.
Hmph. Enemies like these aren't even worth the time.
To humiliate me like this... I'll get you back!
You're making a big mistake if you think I'm going to underestimate our enemies!
Hmph, this is nothing!
I... don't even know what to tell you anymore... *Sigh*...
They let the likes of you be a commander? What a joke. Listen up! To be a commander, you must first... (One hour later)... Got it? Then work harder.
Just with results like these you want me to... You did all this yourself? Don't laugh! I suppose I can make an exception and admit that you did well this time. Hmph!
What are you looking at? I do approve of people who take of their work seriously. Besides, in the beginning I just thought you were unreliable, I never said you weren't serious!
Go out on a date? Well... It's not as if I won't, as long as you keep on working hard then...

Stand straight and puff your chest. You are the one I have chosen to spend the rest of my life with. This is something you should be proud of! ... Of course, to be chosen by you, is my honor... I'm not arrogant anymore? ... W-why, you... Do you want me to beat you up that badly?!
Hmph! I'll admit, your tastes aren't half bad. I'll accept this.
Renown, try not to ruin my reputation!
Your Majesty, please let me take care of this for you.
Kaede's Legion, unleash your full firepower!
This costume... *Sigh*, whatever. It's Halloween, so some kind of entertainment is to be expected. But listen here: I'm not dressing up because I WANT to participate, okay?!
This costume... *Sigh*, whatever. It's Halloween, so some kind of entertainment is to be expected. But listen here: I'm not dressing up because I WANT to participate, okay?!
I'll overlook your slacking at least for Halloween. But when this day is over, you don't get to slack off any more!
I wasn't really planning on dressing up at all. I was just a little curious, so... I-it looks good on me? ... T-thanks... Hey, don't get carried away!
Stop taking pictures, Rodney! I don't want people to see me like this...!
I guess it's okay to have fun with everyone like this sometimes... What? Did I say something funny?
What are you standing around for? It's a holiday; don't you have better things to do?
If you try anything weird at all... then you'll be in a world of pain!
Do you wanna end up like this pumpkin?!
W-what are you gawking at?! What's so weird about my costume?!
Hey, are you even enjoying yourself? At least pretend to have fun when I went out of my way to invite you, or else I'm going to lose sleep over this! ...Look behind me? What are you- Oh...!
Hey, are you even enjoying yourself? At least pretend to have fun when I went out of my way to invite you, or else I'm going to lose sleep over this! ...Look behind me? What are you- Oh...!
Make this day count, you hear? Y-you should know how to celebrate a holiday. You're not THAT stupid...

Rodney's with Colorado's group - they went to the shooting gallery. We can check that out, if you want... M-me, get lost among the crowd? Like that would ever happen! Especially when, you know, we're holding hands...
Look, those girls are dancing. Heehee, they seem to be having fun. That's the "Awa Dance," if I remember right.
I will compliment the Sakura Empire on its impressive craftsmanship. Just look at their blue dyes and this tailor-made yukata.
These fireworks are gorgeous... You are looking at them, right? I don't want to stand here and watch them all alone... N-no, I don't mean that the way you think!
(Mgh... This sash feels far too tight, even compared to my regular uniform... Never thought a yukata would compress my breasts...)
That's quite a few missions. Shouldn't you entrust some of these to other people?
I tasked the manjuus with collecting those rewards because I don't want you to leave... N-no, I didn't mean it like that!
You just witnessed the might of the Royal Navy! ...Ack! Y-you did NOT just see me trip! Got it?
A commission should be completed by now? Y-yeah, I know! I don't need you to remind me!
You'll have to shape up if you want to go out with me. Firstly, you... Look, I've told you a dozen times by now! This is not a date, you're just giving me a guided tour around the festival grounds!
H-hey, are you sleeping all day, or what? My retrofit is all done. Hmph, you might've widened the gap between us, but... I'm gonna keep on pushing my limits! Got it?
H-hey, are you sleeping all day, or what? My retrofit is all done. Hmph, you might've widened the gap between us, but... I'm gonna keep on pushing my limits! Got it?
There's TONS of stuff to do today, so don't think you'll be able to do it all without my support! Get it together, Commander!
I can't believe the Commander is into this stuff... Did everyone else already know? I don't wanna ask Rodney outright... I know. If I just make a bold move on the Commander, then... Hyah?!
We use our experiences of failure to forge a path to success. You should remember that, too. (whispering) Don't push yourself too hard, though.
Do I hear... West Virginia playing her guitar? It's crazy how many talents she has... N-not that I'm jealous! Don't get it twisted!
A d-d-d-date?! Wh-where is this coming from?! As a leader, you should prioritize improving yourself! ...I know! I'll join you in doing just that!
What are you trying to pull?
D-do you really want to get stepped on?!
If you have time for this, then go do your missions, or something!
I brought your bonus. Don't expect me to do it again!
You can't just collapse out of nowhere because you're tired... Or m-maybe you want to be stepped on?! You pervert! *blushes*
We can always rely on allies who see a job done right.
For glory, we fight as one!
They were too weak for you and me. Hah!
Even with this retrofit... Ngh!
W-we may be going out, but isn't that just in a work sense? Keep doing your best, and maybe we can make it real... Don't betray my expectations, okay?
Nelson-class battleship - Rodney, Hull Number 29!

I'm Nelson's little sister, Rodney! Um... us sisters are pretty famous right?
 Erm, you've heard that my fighting style is unbefitting of my appearance? Well well, Commander, such rumors are, of course, false~
Hello, I'm Rodney. I shall be in your care from this day forward.
Ah, Commander, you're back! I was just tidying up the documents, please have a look.
Need me to explain the details?
I'm here to help you with anything you need.
If the Commander doesn't mind, please allow me to keep you company!
Commander, if you keep slacking off, even I will get angry.
What is it?
Please don't do this in the command room...
Commander, shall we complete our new mission?
Here are your mission rewards. Let's take a look!
I've brought your new mail, Commander.
Let me make a cup of tea~
Hehe, Commander. The girls are back from commission!
I hope you're looking forward to my performance from here on out!
Mmm... I'm looking forward to everyone finishing their work too~!
Hmm, I think I accidentally wasted a lot of ammunition...
I can still fight... but we should probably retreat, for now...
There's no need to be polite when dealing with enemies.
Can I increase my firepower?
Even I'm a bit disappointed...
The weather is pretty nice. Want to take a walk, Commander? Let's relax and chat for a while. What do you think?
Commander sure is gentle, always slowing down to match my pace when we're taking walks... I'm moved by details like this.
Not respecting the chain of command can mean big trouble, it has happened before……Of course it's ok for us since we're so close~

Commander, want to have dinner together tonight? I'll make your favorite dish... Hmm? it's not a holiday or something like that... I just thought of it just now... If you want, Commander, we can do it every night~.
Everyday I spend with the Commander is a special day, I hope days like these will last forever.
Wooow, thank you! Shall I cook for you tonight?
Hood, you must not waver.
You shouldn't underestimate your opponents, dear sister.
Kaede's Legion? Let's do our best together!
Although it's a gift from the Commander, it's still embarrassing to wear this....Commander, do you think you could teach me how to swim?
Even if it's the Commander's gift, wearing it is pretty embarrassing. Commander, want to teach me how to swim?
It's so hot... I can't imagine doing any work! Commander, how about we take a cold shower together??
Don't be shy, Commander~ Come on, come on over here~ How do you feel? Are my hands too cold?
Beach volleyball? But I finally got a chance to be intimate with you...I'll PASS~
I'll love whatever gifts you give me!
I'm wiped out. So much swimming! Commander... can you carry me home?
Commander, could you put some sunscreen on my back?
How's that? The feeling of a bona-fide Big Seven

Miss Akashi, shall I look at the camera next? Understood. Oh, Commander, I did not expect you to grace us with your presence here as well! Yes, the photoshoot is proceeding smoothly. By the way, is there a favorite pose you'd like to see?

Miss Akashi, shall I look at the camera next? Understood. Oh, Commander, I did not expect you to grace us with your presence here as well! Yes, the photoshoot is proceeding smoothly. By the way, is there a favorite pose you'd like to see?
I was delighted just to have you stop by, but I can't believe you even brought me refreshments... How about I pour you a cup of tea as well?
Perhaps I should hold up a fan like this? ...Like this? *click* Oh, great advice, Commander! Akashi said that changed the mood of the shoot completely, ehehe.
It's my first time wearing clothes like these, so I'm trying to figure out the perfect way to show off my legs... Commander? Hehe, have you been enchanted?
You're worried that I might be feeling cold? Well... how about you check by holding my hand?
Long photoshoots really are quite tiring... Commander, how about going for some coffee together after we wrap this up?
Thank you so much for helping me put this fur on!
We're still not done with the photoshoot~ Hehe~♪
Welcome back. What you're smelling right now is the fragrance of Dragon Empery tea... Yes, my friends here recommended it to me.
It is time for me to carry out my duties once more!
I'll have to check on our inventory of ammo when we get back.
I never imagined that this dreamlike situation would come to pass... Commander, have you also been looking forward to sharing this moment with me? Hehe~
I never imagined that this dreamlike situation would come to pass... Commander, have you also been looking forward to sharing this moment with me? Hehe~
My heart is at rest when I see you happy, Commander~
I have paperwork, practice, and dinner to see to today. The more burdens I can take off your mind, the happier it makes me~
Every day with you is a day worth celebrating... Hmm, phrases like these feel rather cheesy, so I'll keep them to a minimum. Knowing you, you already know how I feel, Commander.
Each minute you slack off is one less minute of the day we'll have together. Please try to stay focused, for both our sakes.
Commander, do you have any plans for the next naval holiday? If not... we could go on a date somewhere. What do you say?
I've read that physical intimacy deepens a relationship the more you do it~
Please, let's put this on hold until we're alone, all right?
Well strategised, Commander. Wait just a minute while I go brew some tea.
That's why you shouldn't underestimate a Big 7!
Care to have dinner with me tonight, Commander? I know all your favourite dishes~
King George V-class battleship - King George V.

The nameship of the King George V-class battleships is none other than me. I served as flagship for my country, leading the fleet into numerous battles including the fateful encounter with Bismarck. After getting a brief taste of that thrill, I have been craving to cross swords with her once again... But I digress - is there anything else you'd like to know about me?
So this is my new battlefield. Ahh, how I've long awaited this... By the way, are you my commander? You are in the presence of King George V - do use me well.
Commander, did you already partake of supper?
My standing within the Royal Family? Hmm... If I had to draw a comparison, I'd say "Knight Commander" would be the most fitting... Hahaha...
Commander, this fleet only functions because of you. Don't get sloppy on us.
Wales and Yorkie? It's a bit of a shame that they don't act more like cute little sisters, but I am glad that they have strong personalities.
In my eyes, there is no leader in this world more worthy of my loyalty than Her Majesty, Queen Elizabeth. Does that make sense to you, Commander?
The Royals' cuisine is all bland? Hogwash. That's just an unfortunate stereotype.
Why do I have a mountain of snacks before me? Isn't it obvious? One cannot move on an empty stomach.
Ohh? I wasn't aware that you possessed such audacity, Commander.
New missions, eh? It would be ideal if we got something a bit more challenging.
Supper tastes best after the day's missions are all complete. Wouldn't you agree, Commander?
A letter, huh? Now then, is this a challenge, or a love letter?
Commander, did you thoroughly enjoy the battle?
There's some commotion by the port...? Oh, it seems to just be the commission team returning.
Hmm... I suddenly feel like having a lavish feast.
Let us go forth and plant our banners!
Make no mistakes. I shall ensure both victory and the safety of all my comrades.
Do not be demoralized. Neither victory nor defeat are decided by a single battle.
The glory of the sun that never sets shall not fade!
Hmph, how interesting!
I favor those of character, and those who can cook. Commander, you are neither.
By the way, Commander, are you a good cook? Hmm? Despite my appearances, I've spent many hours honing my skills to sate my own appetite.
How's that, commander? Are you impressed by my cooking abilities? Here, have as much you desire. Seeing you enjoy my food pleases me.
Commander, so you're learning how to cook? Hmm, colour me impressed. I look forward to trying the dish that you're making for me.

My greatest hobbies in life are food and fighting. While I am more than capable of fighting alone, dining by myself is quite difficult and lonesome. To be able to find someone who can share both of these things with me is truly a joyous thing.
They say that "the quickest way to one's heart is through their stomach," but you've managed to win over both at once. Commander, shall we share all our meals together from now on?
How thoughtful.
Wales, you'd better not suddenly leave me again!
York, let us shatter our enemies together.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Commander... I don't get to wear a dress very often, so it took me a bit longer. Let's get going, then. Remember, you'll be the lead tonight. Haha~
Sorry to keep you waiting, Commander... I don't get to wear a dress very often, so it took me a bit longer. Let's get going, then. Remember, you'll be the lead tonight. Haha~
Take my hand, Commander. I'm still not used to walking around in this dress.
Hmm...? These clothes seem a bit too tight. Commander, mind helping me loosen up the zipper in the back?
Ugh... I'm expected to act more proper when I'm wearing formal attire. Can't even go around trying all the different delicacies, what a drag...
We are able to enjoy a jubilant night like this because of all the hard work we've put in. Commander, let's make the most of it.
Hmm... Yorkie and Wales are going at it again. Commander, excuse me. It's rare that the three of us get to have a sisterly reunion.
It seems... that Belfast and Hood are already attending to Her Majesty. Looks like we'll be free to enjoy ourselves, Commander.
Issuing tasks during our banquet...? Those folks sure know how to ruin the mood.
Let's use these rewards to decorate the venue.
An invitation to the ball? Hehe, want to go together, Commander?
Commander, if we don't hurry, all the food is going to get cold.
Commander, let's call it a day after this commission is finished. Everyone has a right to enjoy the banquet.
Bad luck, friends. You chose the wrong day to get in my way.
King George V-class battleship - Prince of Wales, Hull Number 53!

I'm the second ship of the King George V-class battleships, the Prince of Wales. I once escorted the Prime Minister to sign the Atlantic Charter. Making my mark in the history books of weaponry? Hmph, how dare you mention that in front of me.
You're the Commander? Very well. I, Prince of Wales, shall let you witness my true strength.
Welcome back. Shall we have tea before getting back to work?
Fate can be easily derailed, Commander.
Expensive isn't always better, but it's your job to maximize our combat capability, Commander.
I don't want to suffer the pain of losing my comrades again...
Would you like to have some tea? I have also prepared some sandwiches. By the way, I am a fan of pickles.
Let's have chat, Commander.
You know what doing this means right? *Smiles*
Commander, it's time to put you to the test.
Rewards received! You performed beautifully.
You have a new message, Commander.
Sometimes victories come down to nothing but luck. Don't get too full of yourself, Commander.
The commissions are complete, it is your duty to welcome them back.
Let's not repeat failure again...
Courage is necessary for success… All ships, fire!
The taste of victory is always sweet.
A horse may stumble even though he has four legs. Let's try again next time.
It's a showdown!
Get up! We're going to go look for a fight!
Keep your distance. You are not qualified to command me...
I heard that my current name was chosen because my original one could bring misfortune, but... judging by how things turned out... it seems I'm unable to escape my fate...
You never know how many plans, hopes, and efforts would sink into the sea with you, Commander. So try not to die too easily.
Fighting fair and square is my motto. I wish it could be the same when it comes to my own feelings. So... can you stay with me a bit longer? I have something important to tell you, Commander...
I had a dream, a dream of that time which makes me feel hopeless even now... But when I open my eyes and see you by my side, it feels like life... like life isn't so bad after all...

To me, the ritual isn't as important as the fact that you're the person that I've accepted... However, receiving something like this still makes me happy. Thank you, Commander... I'll keep this with me forever!
This is for me? ...Thank you. I shall cherish it.
To be honest, I never know what you're thinking.
It is my honor to serve you, Your Majesty.
Hehe, shall we display the elegance of the Royal Navy?
If it's about the Commander, perhaps... we can talk about it.
Little Miss Vampire, what can I do for you?
Repulse, though this might sound quaint coming from me, you should try to concentrate a little more.

ex.line: Managing the fleet is complicated and difficult. If there's anything I can help out with, let me know.
Should I prepare a snack for you? I'm not skilled enough to be able to boast to others like George does, but my cooking won't disappoint, either.
Repulse, Vampire, and Hood, and Eugen and Bismarck... It seems there'll be no risk of boredom while I'm by your side.

I'm used to taking care of Her Highness' needs, so it's perfectly fine for you to make absurd requests from time to time. On top of that, I'll flawlessly complete your request and make you fall in love with me all over again... Hehe, how does that sound?
Is it already time for the tea party?
You know exactly what this means, right? Hehe.
A toast to our victory. Never forget that you are the reason that everyone can enjoy this peace for yet another day.
Commissions have been completed. Let's go greet the girls together.
For the glory of Her Majesty and the Commander!
A light heart lives long. Don't be too hard on yourself.

Love based on pretense is a vile thing. I give myself to you as I am, and I accept you for who you are. No matter how many mistakes you make, I can overlook them all, because my eyes are cloudy with tears of happiness. That's what lovers do, after all.

lines.line: I'm not a big fan of beach volleyball, but Hood begged me... I swear, that girl! She just can't get enough of the sun! You've got to cheer for me!
Although I don't really want in on the beachball game, but it was a request from Hood....That sun-loving girl. Don't forget to cheer for me!
To  truly experience the charm of all things, first one must sincerely love them. Commander, the same goes for girls too.
Regardless of the time and situation, to ignore a fair maiden is most ungentlemanly.
How's my swimsuit, Commander? Haha, let me teach you how to compliment a girl in this kind of situation.
Commander, leave all the admin stuff to me. Everyone else is waiting for you on the beach!
Hood, you should get some sun once in a while too, you know.
Yamashiro looked pretty depressed after she lost the ball game... Commander, why don't you go and comfort her?
Do you need me to teach you how to properly treat girls?
Fear not for dangers and obstacles, leap over challenges, and charge towards your goals. This is how unprecedented accomplishments are achieved!
Good work, Commander! How about a massage? People tell me I've got the best technique.
New mail? Hood, stop staring at me. They aren't for me!
I know it's tempting to eat ice cream during the summer, Commander, but don't eat too much otherwise you'll get a stomachache!
I'll welcome the girls home from commission. Take a rest if you're really tired.
I can't die happy until I see Prinz Eugen with a true and honest smile on her face.
Love with you is like priceless treasure. I wouldn't trade even an entire kingdom for it!
I've been wearing Royal attire my whole life, so a change in pace doesn't seem bad. Oh, Commander, good timing. Can you explain to me how to celebrate the New Year here?
I've been wearing Royal attire my whole life, so a change in pace doesn't seem bad. Oh, Commander, good timing. Can you explain to me how to celebrate the New Year here?
Commander, are you cold? You can borrow my coat if you'd like. Ah, don't worry about me, I'm fine.
Learning about the customs of the other nations is quite interesting. I feel like I get along better with the Sakura girls now.
I miss my black tea a bit, but I suppose "when in Rome, do as the Romans do." I guess I should fully enjoy the culture of the Sakura Empire.
Why are you staring at me? I'm... suave? Hehe, I suppose I should take that as a compliment.
You're still hammering away at those missions even during the New Year? You sure are hard-working, Commander.
Since it's the New Year, it would be sad if there was nobody to greet the girls returning from commissions. Don't you think so, Commander?
To be able to experience a new culture like this, and spend the New Year peacefully... is like a dream come true. Commander, it's all thanks to you. As expected of the one I chose.
Oh, Commander. Worry not. Since I've been given this job, I will see through it until the end. Besides, it's been a while since I've gotten this fired up. Haha!
Oh, Commander. Worry not. Since I've been given this job, I will see through it until the end. Besides, it's been a while since I've gotten this fired up. Haha!
Oh, you're back. Did you run into any of my sisters on the way here?
While destiny tends to fly off the rails pretty often, flying off the course during a match would be a major accident. Commander, be careful while you watch the match.
The Manjuus drive these things... Sure, it's a mystery how they're able to turn the steering wheel, but I'm more curious about how they're able to step on the accelerator...

Whether in a match or in a battle, a machine's or ship's capability isn't everything. Depending on the driver's skill or the commander's directions, the course of the match or battle can be completely reversed. Hehe, that's exactly what makes betting fun.
These clothes make eating quite difficult... Oh, I give up. Commander, you can have the rest of my sandwich.
Does something about this outfit bother you?
Heh, I won't let you go any further.
Let's put on a performance to be remembered - for the sake of your victory.

I expected you sooner, Commander. I decided to practice the saxophone while I had some time alone... You shouldn't keep a lady waiting in the future. Heehee. Anyway, I suppose we could listen to a song before we set off, no?

I expected you sooner, Commander. I decided to practice the saxophone while I had some time alone... You shouldn't keep a lady waiting in the future. Heehee. Anyway, I suppose we could listen to a song before we set off, no?
Oh, Commander, are you finally awake? Listen to the knights' gentle alto tune... Heehee, it's dreamy, isn't it?

This black dress is like a dark night dotted with twinkling stars... to put it how York might describe it. Commander, it's okay to compliment people's outfits, but it just gets embarrassing if you go too far.
We may be knights, but that doesn't mean we're all about fighting. Versatility is the true mark of a Royal Knight... is what I'd like to say, but that isn't true for some of us. Heheh.
Concerts in formal clothes are great and all, but jam sessions with friends you can relax with are such fun. You should give it a try, Commander.
Eugen? How much do you intend to make the Commander drink? You don't mean to get the Commander drunk enough to help you pester your friends, do you? Hahaha!
Normally, touching the performers is strictly against the rules... But I can't deny the comfort of your gentle touch.
Commander? If I have a wardrobe malfunction, you'll help me, won't you? I certainly hope you wouldn't let me perform like that.
You look tired, Commander. Say, you should come and listen to my playing for a while. Let me soothe your ears with a solo concert just for one.
I look forward to the 21-gun salute celebrating our victory.
King George V-class battleship - HMS Duke of York.

I am King George V-class' Duke of York. Scharnhorst? An interesting one indeed, but now, thou art the one who captures my interest the most... My... if thou displays such an expression to me, I won't be able to contain myself...
I see. So the scent that has been driving me crazy... emanates from thy soul. O sinful Commander who tempts me so, engrave my name upon thine heart - Duke of York, of the Royal Navy.
O unclean snake, who is it thee lusts after today?
Dost thy heart cry restlessly in my absence?
The secret behind my battle prowess? Hehe, I sink deeply into visions of the enemy torn from limb to limb. What follows is only natural.
Wales, dost thou intend to hunt the same prey as me?
Please be at ease and close thine eyes. Sink into my embrace, and let thy thoughts flow away.
The night is both lengthy and brief. Come, blow out the light burning within thee, and accompany me into the dark.
Ahh, how beautiful... thy eyes, normally placid, burning with the fires of lust...
Such fair weather is rare indeed. 'twould be a pity to return to port so soon.
Only the moon and sweet liquor fail to disappoint. We shall share the most unforgettable of nights.
Thy visage when reading and concentrating, unbudging and focused, resembles one of Michelangelo's sculptures. I do not dislike such determination.
Oh, triumphant nightingale that has overcome death itself, what plagues thee enough to silence thy song?
O mesmerising Narcissus, do remember my warning when greeting those who return. Be misled not by the illusions swirling in the water.
Did thou hear? A sound that makes my blood boil, like wind passing through the forest in the dead of night.
Sinful roses of blood, bloom around me! Bloom!
There exists no living being that can resist the embrace of death.
Ahh... why dost thou obstinately refuse to obey me...
All ye, weep at your own demise!
Perhaps I have indulged myself too much...
It would appear... that I must get a little more violent...
What a nice gaze. Through thy pupils, I can see another world.
How thy visage tempts me so with each passing moment... I must ask of thee, just how sweet is thy blood?
How unfathomable... looking at thy sleeping visage hast made me replete with calmness... Now, pray that thou dost not wake, for I know not what I would do to thee...
O ignorant snake, hast thou only realised now, how long I have hopelessly been in love with thee? Therefore... would thou give thy everything to me?

Even the most ingenious poet cannot describe the beauty of this moment. Hehe, close thy eyes, feel my warmth, and listen to the beating of my heart. This is the one who shall be thy lifelong partner...
Heheh. One would much prefer thy lips.
Karma shall find thee one day.
Stop struggling in futility, my~ little~ kitten~

ex.line: O, Commander who hath earned my adoration, what is thy desire?
Thy existence has greatly influenced my fighting style — Yes, it resonates with thy passionate eyes, and my pupils also become stained with thy blood-red colour.
I shalt not giveth thee to Wales, George, Anson, or Howe. Thou art my trophy, and the proof of my conquest.
Pitiable Scharnhorst, who knows not the value of thy skin, thy eyes, thy very body... Yes, Commander, thou art the world to me.
Melt into one, be it thou or myself, be it anything in existence—
May these eyes sink into deep crimson...
Melt before the crimson apocalypse. Merely tearing thy husks apart is no longer enough to sate me.
O sinful serpent, thou hast chosen to entwine thyself around me. Dedicate thy love to me for all of eternity— and in return, accept my love, and the right to embrace me.

lines.line: This luscious scent... doth emanate from thee. What dost thou feel when gazing upon my new dress? Hehe... thy lips may lie, but thy eyes do not.
This luscious scent... doth emanate from thee. What dost thou feel when gazing upon my new dress? Hehe... thy lips may lie, but thy eyes do not.
Dost thou wish to try this blood... coloured fruity beverage?
Ahaha... I can hear the beating of thy heart. Yes, throb, throb... Ahh, what an enrapturing sound...
Thou need not be nervous. This attire is but a temporary one... Perhaps thou believed to have escaped from my usual self? Ahaha...
Even though a night eternal may be out of the question, dost thou not wish... to sink into the embrace of night with me?
Following thy ideals are akin to swimming endlessly against the current... However, the way thou refuseth to bow thy head before fate gives me ample reason to remain by thee. Hehe...
Dost thou intend to spend the night alone, or perhaps... wouldst thou like to partake of a drink with me?
Art thou able... to entertain me a bit longer?
Come, now... shall we commence our waltz upon the battlefield?
Become intoxicated with me. Then, giveth me thy purity, thy, devotion, and thy love. In return... I shall pledge thee an eternity of comfort within my bosom.
My beautiful Adonis, why dost thou refuseth to take refuge in the trove of everlasting love... Perhaps my outfit can finally pierce thy heart? Hehe~
My beautiful Adonis, why dost thou refuseth to take refuge in the trove of everlasting love... Perhaps my outfit can finally pierce thy heart? Hehe~
Love that can be robbed away holds no value. Only by becoming mine entirely will thou be worthy of my absolute attention.
Wales, thou shalt not take my Adonis from me... Hehehe, but out of compassion, I shall allow you to have a third of our precious time together.
Yes, thy gaze... So full of resistance, yet also ready to give in at any time... How thine eyes can keep me entertained for all eternity...
Thou canst not win, be it in the heated environment of this sport, or in the sweetness of my absolute existence...
Beautiful, is it not? This outfit thou hath bestowed upon me is perfect for inspiring thy adoration... Is that difficult to understand?
The snake devours the fruit — thy desires, thy true nature... I have grasped it all. Hehehe~
I prefer wine over champagne... But very well. We shall celebrate as thou so desires.
Thou hast come. Welcome to my Athenaeum, young Odysseus. Today, thou shalt receive Duke of York's instruction - now, come forth, take a seat, and hearken to my teachings.
Thou hast come. Welcome to my Athenaeum, young Odysseus. Today, thou shalt receive Duke of York's instruction - now, come forth, take a seat, and hearken to my teachings.
If thou thirstest, then I shall make tea for thee. Staff office or not, a Royal Navy Athenaeum mustn't want for elegance.
If pressed to say, I think thy very existence makes the students' hearts flutter and stimulates their desire. Thy eyes, words, bearing... Even if thou dost not realize it, haha.
Incidentally, if thou were to change thy career, what wouldst thou choose? Of course, becoming my servant is a perfectly adequate path.
I'm impressed that thou listened so intently to my lesson. Dost thou perhaps... enjoy being taught? Guided?
By my authority as a teacher, I am able to fail thee no matter how accurate thy answers... Heehee, if thou wishest to avoid that... need I say the rest?
Defiling the morals of not just the students, but even those of a teacher as well? How wilt thou atone for this sin? Heheh...
Dost thou expect something immoral? No matter thy position, thy lust knows no bounds♥
Forget neither thy missions nor the homework I've assigned thee.
Wealth, fame, and a kiss upon thy lips - what more reward couldst thou desire?
Palamedes of many talents, thou hast seized victory yet again. Phew... I am tired, as well. Let me just recross my legs... Heheh.
The commission team returns. Perhaps thou should fret thy own performance before that of others.
Bear witness to the glorious fighting style of the Royal Knights.
The threads of fate binding thee are many, but thy path forward is singular. Haha, must I say any more? Now that thou art in my embrace, dost thou really have any other options?
Battleship - Vanguard.

I am Vanguard, the battleship that was launched after the end of the war. My sword is yours - may it bring glory to your port. Also, if I may make a request... please do NOT call my weapons "old-fashioned."
I am Vanguard, palace guard of the Royal Knights! I hereby pledge to you my sword, and the full extent of my loyalty! May glory be yours, and God save the Queen!
The Commander has arrived! Ladies, at attention! ...Now, let's get to work, shall we?
Loyalty reverberates through my blade, glory booms through my barrels! Behold, the light of my royal sabre! ...Ugh, that's so cringeworthy! Although it does sound cool... C-Commander?!
You may rest assured, King George. If Her Majesty and the Commander so desire, I will gladly be the spearhead that sunders the enemy line.
Is that Bismarck over there? Gracious, this will be quite awkward...
The port seems to be all in order, and I can confidently say you're as well-guarded as can be!
Pardon my bluntness, but Royal cuisine is total shite. Sure, different people like different things, but something's wrong if even I as a native think it's rubbish.
Here's your programme for today, Commander! ...Damn, that's at the same time as the show I want to watch... N-no, just talking to myself!
Yes? How can I help?
My duty as a palace guard is to aid and protect you at all times.
Thank you for ceasing your inappropriate behaviour right at... *gasp*! Do you have a death wish?
Word of a new mission has come in. Have a look, Commander.
Mission complete. *sigh*... I should've checked on it sooner.
I've brought you a letter. Give it a read, Commander.
The Commander has returned! Ladies, arrange for repairs and a debriefing! Commander, get some rest - I'll take it from here.
The commission team is back. Let's head out to receive them, Commander.
My sword's purpose is to bring glory to the Royal Navy - and to you, Commander!
Come! Let's settle this, fair and square!
Hoorah! Victory is mine! May the Commander's name and mine alike go down in history! ...Oops! I didn't mean to say that aloud!
Tsk. You'll pay for this, you hear?! ...No, I'm fine. Take the others and retreat, quickly.
This is a knight's swordsmanship!
Tsk... What a persistent bunch!
*sigh*... If you're not suited for the job, just admit it so we can find a replacement. Stop acting tough, it just makes you look pathetic.
So, what's on the schedule for today? ...You'll be working overtime filing paperwork? I'm sorry to hear that. Be that as it may, you will be present during today's exercise, right?
While yes, I am a palace guard, that doesn't mean I should be stuck in port. Won't you let me sortie already? *sigh*... I'm going mad. The stress is killing me...

What? You're working overtime AGAIN? I understand it has to be done, but this is a bit ridiculous... I won't force you to order a sortie, but please, can't you make one happen somehow? ...You can? Brilliant!
Mmmmh! That was refreshing! Thanks, Commander - I really needed that! It's days like these that make serving as a palace guard worth it. Now, you who guides my sword, what is your next order?

By this ring, my sword and my life now belongs to you, 'til the end of time! ...All righty, do you mind if I tone down the formality a bit? I mean, what's the point in being super serious 'round the clock?
Mhm, I shall most graciously accept your gift.
What's that noise...?
Please be careful, Lady Hood!

ex.line: Ah, there you are. Yeah, yeah, I'm here with you. That's my duty as your secretary and guard... But truth be told, I do it just because I want to.
See? This is an unassuming flat - unlike Lady Formidable's place. A knight's residence should be orderly and free of- Don't go digging through my shelves!
A sortie is an opportunity for me to flourish! The glory is nice too, but I think we can all agree the best part is showing the world what we're made of!
Being as graceful as Lady Hood would be a huge undertaking... M-mind you, I'm not saying it would be impossible!
Royal breakfast is all right, that much I'll personally vouch for! If you're curious to try it, I'm willing to cook it myself!
If you need some enemies sent to the scrapyard, take me out of the dock and send me on a sortie! Preferably with Lady Victorious - she and I would likely get along!
What? There's a package for me? ...Look, I can explain... It's nothing noteworthy, really... Just, you know, some cute comics.
If you want to pat my head... then I guess that's fine.
Whatever you need done, give me the honour. A knight is always ready to serve.
I-I'm not some idiot who'll admit to liking this, no way...
A new mission's come- Oh god, this one's going to be a pain.
The commission team's back. Let's head out to meet them. And while we're at it, let us sortie!
Yes! YES! It's my time to shine!
Behold! My royal sabreee! ...Wait, what? They're all gone? Oh god, I can feel everyone's cringing at me!
You picked the wrong fight. Try harder next time if you don't want to make fools of yourselves.
This... This move is too cringeworthy to name, so forget it!

*sigh*... I have no idea how you've put up with this job for so long, Commander. Let me tell you a good way to vent some stress. You go out at sea for an exercise, and... A-a date?! Wh-wh-why are you bringing THAT up all of a sudden?!

lines.line: "Please let me know if you need anything, Master"... I'm starting to think you're making me wear this as a sick joke. The reason being, I am obviously NOT fit to be a Royal Maid... Even if I do adore their uniforms...

"Please let me know if you need anything, Master"... I'm starting to think you're making me wear this as a sick joke. The reason being, I am obviously NOT fit to be a Royal Maid... Even if I do adore their uniforms...
The Commander has arrived! ...I know that's not what a maid would say, but it's not like I could pull it off anyway...
Why do you insist on having me as a maid? I can hardly cook and I'm terrible at cleaning. Wait... Don't tell me maids are your kink...
While Royal Maids also participate in battle, their approach differs greatly from us knights. The only way I can put it is... they hold back too much?
Yes, Master? ..."Getting the hang of this," eh... Are you making fun of me?
I alone get to protect you, my honourable Commander. No one will take this privilege from me!
I have both secretary AND maid work to do... *sigh*... Will I ever get to sortie again?
As you say. Your wish is my command.
Compare me to any of the other maids and I'll destroy you.
You have a new mission, Master. Please review it.
A salute for the Commander's return! By the way, bring me along for the next sortie, would you?
The commission team has returned to port. I shall accompany you to them.
I beat the crap out of them with grace and elegance! Hahah!
This sucks... I told you I wasn't cut out for this.

How would you evaluate my performance as a maid? Ill-suited though I am for this job, I can still accomplish any task you can throw at me... Y-you want me to keep doing this? You know, I really feel like you just enjoy watching me suffer!
Lion-class battleship - Lion.

I am Lion, Lion-class battleship of the Royal Navy. Heheh. While this port is indeed yours, know that it is also my territory. I will aid you in protecting it, letting not a single threat slip by undetected. This I swear.
Oh? I was wondering who this new face is, and it's you! I do hope you won't disappoint me. Once again, I'm Lion - the protector of both you and this port.
Good, you're back. Okay, eyes up and don't squirm! You need to learn to hold your head high under my gaze.

I created a programme for you to follow. First up: Sorting paperwork. Then, a patrol around the port, a focused inspection of our security system, and finally... Yes, I've of course included breaks. Rest assured, I will accompany you the entire day.
My lion ornaments? Ahem... Why, they're there to intimidate enemies, and not because I'm particularly fond of them.
It is important to patrol the port. One cannot properly protect their territory without knowing every corner of it. Yes, that includes you.
Getting a sweeping view of the port bolsters my mood. Hm? Are you afraid of heights? Don't worry, I'll keep you safe.
Hm? Do you have something to tell me? Then spit it out. I hate those who beat around the bush - or should I say, I like you more when you're upfront.
...You are an audacious one. Or are you just playing up to me? Hahaha.
Hm? Is something the matter?
Are you testing me to see how much I can tolerate?
You've yet to finish your missions? It disappoints me to see this port's leader be so neglectful. Fear not, though - I will assist you.
You're progressing well on these missions. Do remember to claim your rewards, head held high as you do.
There is a new letter. I've confirmed it poses no threat.
All is as it should be around the port - I verified it myself. No threat dares approach the den of the lion, it seems. Now be at ease.
The commission team has returned. The duty of receiving them falls upon us. Come.
Good. Now I can better protect both you and this territory.
You wish to intimidate them with my presence? Good decision.
The battlefield is an untamed expanse, and the victor is its king. This victory is proof of this.
You will suffer for this next time our paths cross. Commander, for now, we retreat.
Tear them to shreds!
Heheh... There is no greater danger than a wounded lion!
You have disappointed me. Regardless, I will keep watching you until you show growth.
While I acknowledge you as this port's leader, I've yet to ascertain your ability. That said, our relationship may just improve if you put in the work.
You're far more capable than I'd anticipated. Indeed, our cooperation has improved a lot since we became part of the same "pack." Hahah - does my praise really make you that happy?
My intention was simply to protect you and the port, but before I knew it, I'd become unable to take my eyes off you. I'm not saying that's a bad thing, mind you.

Ahem... You know how it is. You are the Commander, and your duty is to lead us. That said, if you'd be willing to hear me out in private - that is, when we're all to ourselves - I could... treat you more gently, like a lion would treat its mate.

This occasion marks you fully becoming the lion's property. Yes, you are my property, and no one will take you from me. Now, about my collection of adorable lions... I'll let you see them, if you wish to.
Hmm, oh my... You truly know me quite well. Indeed, I shall treasure your sentiments as well.
Your Majesty, it is dangerous on the battlefield. I shall take care of this.
You make a great assistant.

ex.line: Good, you've returned, Commander. Shall I assume you're ready for any challenge that may come? Heheh. That's the look I wanted to see.

I bought a lion cushion a while ago, and I think it should go on your bed where- No, wait! I don't want it to represent me! I just... Oh well. You already see right through me, so maybe I should be more honest about this...
I can't resist the urge to chat with you when we go on patrols. It's less productive, yes... but nothing wrong with that, right?
Are you tired? You could have a rest. Ahem... If you want to borrow my shoulder, I won't say no.
If we get work done ahead of time, shall we go and watch the sunset? Just you and me.
Care for some tea? I bought a lion-themed tea set, and... Hm? You need to see how cute it is? Heheh. If you insist, then alright, let's put it to use.
Heheh... You are so easily pleased.
Tired, are you? I permit you to wind down.
Heheh... If you're bold enough to do this, then don't cry to me for mercy later♥
Nothing unusual to report around the port... excluding your look of fatigue. Alright, I will handle your work. Get some rest.

While I will give you preferential treatment, I'm not going to spoil you all the time. Although, when there's no one else around... Ahem. I can consider flirting with you then. Heh - knowing you, you're looking forward to that, aren't you?

lines.line: Heh. I hereby claim this beach as part of my territory. Whew... Say, Commander, since we've been afforded some time to relax, why don't we do so? Oh, and feel free to come a little closer.
Heh. I hereby claim this beach as part of my territory. Whew... Say, Commander, since we've been afforded some time to relax, why don't we do so? Oh, and feel free to come a little closer.
What's this? Have you been charmed by the lazy lion? That makes two of us. I feel... a little different from my usual self, somehow.
One needs to protect against sunburns. Commander, could you reapply the suntan lotion right here?
When the mood is comfortable and relaxed, the lion shows its soft side. Will it bring us closer together, I wonder?
This is thanks for applying the suntan lotion on me. Open your mouth and I will feed you this fruit. Naturally, refusal is not an option♪
That's quite the delectable drink you chose. Care to try mine? You're not too embarrassed to use the same straw, are you?
Since it's only us here... I'll allow you to satisfy yourself.
What? Are you checking where I applied the suntan lotion?
Heh... Making a bold move, are you?
You cannot let the missions pile up while on vacation... No, actually, stay here. I'll help you after we've had our fun.
Exemplary work with those missions. Do you want an additional reward? For instance... Ah, what do you wish to be fed this time?
You've returned. Can't handle the sun? Then consider sitting next to me for a while.
So the commission team is back. I'll allow you to step away for a while, then.

Commander, this holiday mustn't be squandered. Let us take our time and enjoy this private world of ours. Hm? You'll decide how to spend our time right now? Fine, but at night, it will be you who listens to my orders♥
Hermes-class aircraft carrier - Hermes, Hull Number 95!

I am called Hermes, I was the second aircraft carrier to be ever built. 
 The only carrier to be sunk by the Sakura Empire? Can't do much about stuff like that. But if I ever get the chance, I want to duel that first carrier.
Glory to the cards, my soul to the duel d... I mean, the flight deck! I am Hermes. Commander, give me your orders!
You're back. Now it's time to duel!
Statistics aren't important, it's how you take advantage of them.
It is my wish to duel with Houshou
In each plane and every card resides a soul.
It's my turn!Victory aside, I also want to bring happiness to everyone.
What, you want to duel?
Hmm.... If the Commander is interested, I'll properly reward you each time you win.
Missions are like challenges, Commander. Let us challenge ourselves to even greater heights.
Rewards' is a good of a word as "duel". Let's see what you've got!
You've got new mail, Commander. I wonder if it's a request for a duel!
Gotcha! Your dueling was hot out there!
Hold on! Our fleet has come back from commission. Let's see what they've earned.
The new me now can move to even greater heights with my deck!
If you believe in your fleet, we'll work our hardest to meet your expectations!
When the stars gather in one place, our bonds will illuminate a new future!
I won't surrender. My turn... Let me go!
It's my turn!
Have you fallen to the forces of darkness, Commander...? I'll have to defeat you then!
What's up, Commander? Interested in duels? Don't worry, we'll start from the beginning, I'll teach you! The most important thing is spirit!
Interests in anything besides dueling? Hmm... I've never thought about it. Will you show me something new, Commander?
Mmm... Commander, I decided to engrave your portrait on the back of my cards. That way you're always with me!

If two duelists fall in love, Commander, they can undertake more duels together! They also must truly understand each other... I think that requirement is already fulfilled for us... so... shall we try?
This feeling is……! The bonds formed between Commander and I here shall open up a brand new future, a path of brilliance! It’s our turn, draw!
Thanks. I really like it.
A fellow duelist?!
Houshou, there is infinite potential inside you!
Our glory coalesces into the bonds that forge a bright new future! Let's rev it up! Hermes, retrofit complete!
Our glory coalesces into the bonds that forge a bright new future! Let's rev it up! Hermes, retrofit complete!
I've been waiting. The cards... no... my burning soul told me you'd returned.
For a true duelist, there are no accidents, Commander.
Houshou is strong. And now I know. That strength comes from her kindness.
Your spirit is a great weapon, and an even greater weakness. No matter where you are, you must not forget that.
Centaur taught me how to make this. Try it. I'm showing you that I'm more than just a duelist.
That's the wind... Commander, follow my wake!
There is something present in the mail beyond what you can see with your eyes. That is: friendship.
Hangar, gate open!
Hatred, no matter how deep it runs, will always be weak.
No one is truly undefeatable... If you give up now, you were never worthy of being my Commander.
My path to victory does not end here!
Aircraft carrier - Unicorn, Hull Number I72!

Royal Navy's... support carrier... I am Unicorn... I was born to support my big sister Illustrious... Later, I went to support other big sisters... but everyone treated me nicely. I worked hard in lots of different ways, you know? ...It would be nice if I become a little dependable... Ehehe, I'll work harder, big brother
I... I am... The Royal Navy's... Unicorn. ...Commander, can... can I call you... big brother?
Welcome back, big brother... Are we going to sortie for today as well?
Big brother... do you want to know more about me?
Desstroy Moad'? There is no such thing...
Yuni's horn... cannot transform, you know?
'Entee'...? I have no idea what you are talking about, big brother...
Will I, Unicorn, grow up to be just like big sister Illustrious one day?
Big brother... is Unicorn a good girl...?
Ehehe... Big brother... that tickles...
If it's you, big brother... it's alright...
Don't forget about... your missions...
Don't miss... your rewards...
Shall we... check your mail?
The fleet... returned safely... Good work, big brother. My lap is... alright, you know?
The big sisters out for commission have come back... Big brother... will you greet them?
Did ...Unicorn become more mature....Onii-chan?
Leave the rear support to me... I'll... do my best...!
Was I... of great help to you, big brother?
Outside is... so scary... Can I go back...?
Unicorn... will do her best!
Big brother... that hurts...
Big brother, you're the worst...
This over here is Yuni. Yuni the Unicorn... is my friend... Ehehe
When things become dangerous, Yuni will protect me-- It won't be dangerous because you are here, big brother? Ehehe. You are like my knight...
I've been working hard, you know? ...Supporting big sister... taking on missions... transporting things... Am I a good girl? Am I a helping hand, big brother?
Big brother... can I be selfish before you? Can I have you pamper me...? I, Unicorn... am actually not a good girl... Is that alright as well?
This... precious thing... Are you really giving it to me? I, Unicorn... will work hard... That's because... I like big brother a lot!
I love it...
When it comes to supporting big sister Illustrious... I'll do it...!
Don't bully my friends!
Unicorn loves singing... but singing in front of everyone else...///
Unicorn... is now a songstress... *giggles* Unicorn's song has reached Onii-chan's heart.
I have... become a songstress~ ehehe... It would be nice if my song can reach Onii-chan...
Onii-chan, does a fancy dress like this look weird on me?
Yuni has grown up too *giggles*!
'Listen to my song!' Am I acting like a songstress? *giggles*
Sister Illustrious... do I seem more mature to you now...?
Hehe... Onii-chan, do you want to listen to my song?
Big brother... this present is for you... I hope you'll like it... Eh? Just seeing me in this outfit is the best gift? Ohh~ b-big brother...!
Big brother... this present is for you... I hope you'll like it... Eh? Just seeing me in this outfit is the best gift? Ohh~ b-big brother...!
B-big brother... please don't stare at Unicorn so much... Uuu...
These are called "Spring couplets." The big sisters from the Dragon Empery taught Unicorn how to write this, ehehe~
"Firecrackers" seem to be a specialty of the Dragon Empery... Ah, this one is just a prop. It won't go off...
Big brother... Has Unicorn grown a bit bigger?
Ah, big brother, you're here... Ehehe, I only just got here as well. Um... shall we go then? I kind of... want to go to the amusement park...
Ah, big brother, you're here... Ehehe, I only just got here as well. Um... shall we go then? I kind of... want to go to the amusement park...
Big brother, there are a lot of rides that Unicorn wants to go on, together.
Big brother, when we're riding the roller coaster, is it okay to hold your hand?
Ferris wheel... recommended for couples, eh? Ah, b-big brother! It's nothing...!
The carousel... it's so pretty... Huh? Big brother, I can... sit with you?
Big brother, being able to spend time together at an amusement park... and hold hands like this... makes it seem like we're lovers, ehehe...
B-big brother... there are a lot of people here...
Big brother, if you have some important business, you can go ahead and take care of that first... Unicorn will be waiting for big brother, always...
There's no need to be in a hurry, okay? Unicorn will always wait for you, big brother.

Before coming on this date... there was a lot I wanted to say to you, big brother... But now I don't think I need to... because I already know what you're thinking... and what you're feeling. Big brother, do you also know mine?
So this is a "kimono" from the Sakura Empire... Changing into it is difficult but... if you like it, then Unicorn is happy!
So this is a "kimono" from the Sakura Empire... Changing into it is difficult but... if you like it, then Unicorn is happy!
Happy... New Year! This year, I can spend New Years with you... Ehehe.
A grab bag? Is that Unicorn's present...? Th-Thank you! I wonder what's in it... Ehehe, this is so much fun♪
I heard that, by decorating the arrow that acts as a charm against evil spirits, even bad luck is warded off.
Yuni, you changed into New Years' clothes too? Ehehe
A decorated pineapple in front of a mirror cake? ...The Sakura Empire's New Year is really interesting...
Big brother, are you coming with me to visit the shrine?
About my hair... Big Sis Illustrious did it for me. Is it cute...? Ehehe.
So I'm... an "idol" now... I'm not sure how well I'll do... But I'll give it my all...!
So I'm... an "idol" now... I'm not sure how well I'll do... But I'll give it my all...!
You came to watch me practice, Big Brother...? I'm so glad!
It's all thanks to yours, and Illustrious's, and everyone else's support that I can get up onstage and sing!
I hope my song gets through to everyone...
I'm like... an angel? That's, a b-bit much...
Yuni will stay with me, right? Take the mic for me... Thank you, Yuni♪
You're the only audience I need, Big Brother! I'll... always sing my best for you!
I'm a little nervous, but... with you by my side, Big Brother, I know I can do it...
Oh, big brother... Unicorn is reading right now. Mm, yeah, while eating ice cream... Big brother, want to have a bite?
Oh, big brother... Unicorn is reading right now. Mm, yeah, while eating ice cream... Big brother, want to have a bite?
Big brother... are you here to read with Unicorn? Yay, I'm so happy...
Unicorn is very healthy. She won't get an upset tummy...
Mmmh~ The ice cream is so cold... but so yummy...
Big brother... what flavor of ice cream do you like better, vanilla... or strawberry?
Illustrious gave me this storybook... Mm, some of these stories are still hard to understand though...
Unicorn won't catch a cold~ She also has this blanket over here...
Noo... the ice cream's going to drip onto the pages...
Shhh... Please don't wake Yuni up, big brother...
Unicorn... is now serving as a nurse. Umm... Big brother, would you mind being Unicorn's patient...?
Unicorn... is now serving as a nurse. Umm... Big brother, would you mind being Unicorn's patient...?
Big brother, will you help me with my nurse practice today? Um, can you p-please lie down over there first...?
The "hospital food" Miss Jervis made was the most amazing thing I've ever seen... Um, if I could also cook like that... Maybe I would be able to feed big brother myself... Ahh... *blushes*
If I use this stethoscope... I'll also be able to hear big brother's pounding heart clearly...
I learned a lot about nursing from Miss Perseus, you know? She explained it to me very carefully... but there are still some things I don't quite get...
Thanks for bringing me the thermometer, Yuni... Ehehe, yes, you're a very reliable helper~
Today, I am your nurse, and yours alone, big brother. Ehehe~
Good job on your sortie... Um, now then, big brother... Are you feeling unwell anywhere...?
The big sisters in the commission fleet have come back... Oh, since you're a patient now, maybe I should go welcome them back...?
This is... an important outfit for an important ceremony... yes! Unicorn and Yuni are both ready for this! Big brother... how do I look?
This is... an important outfit for an important ceremony... yes! Unicorn and Yuni are both ready for this! Big brother... how do I look?
Big brother! Eheheh... I'll always be here waiting for you to come back.
Big brother... you truly understand me.
Um, big brother... I've been working really hard lately, so... Do you think maybe, when we have a day off... We could go out together?
Yuni and I got matching outfits... ehehehe...
I've been learning to cook from some of the older Royal Navy girls... Ehehe. I can't wait to surprise you. Oh! I guess you won't be surprised, since I just told you... Hm...
Even when I become an elegant lady like Illustrious... can I still stay with you all the time, big brother...?
Big brother, can I hold your hand a bit longer...?
A mission... Can I help with it?
Wow... that's a lot of rewards. Good job, big brother.
The mail...! Yuni got it for us~
Unicorn got to help big brother...! Ehehe...
Nng... I have to... be strong... for big brother...
I can do it... for you, big brother...!
Unicorn has finished her retrofit... Now she can do more for you and her friends!
Unicorn has finished her retrofit... Now she can do more for you and her friends!
Welcome back, big brother... Are you going out today as well? Unicorn and Yuni are ready to come with you...
Illustrious said that Unicorn grew a little bigger... Do you think that's true? Ehehe...
Yuni has become big and strong, so Unicorn has to do her best too!
Unicorn's new rigging seems... to be giving off light... Do you want to take a closer look?
Unicorn wants to be just like you, not just on the battlefield, but in all kinds of other ways as well! She will do her best!
If you get tired, you can rest in Unicorn's lap... (Ehehe, I really want to see big brother's sleeping face...)
You're also very nice, big brother... Ehehe~♪
Big brother... You can also rely more on Unicorn, you know?
Bad big brother... Ehehe, bad~♪
Can Unicorn help... with your mission?
Ehehe, there are so many rewards that not even Yuni can carry them all~
Ehehe, Yuni also wanted to tell you "Welcome back," big brother.
The friends in the commission fleet have returned... Big brother, can you take me with you?
Unicorn... can now fight alongside everyone else!
Unicorn... was able to be of help!
Unicorn... will protect everyone!
Big brother...? I was just practicing my trumpet, if you were wondering... Umm, what do you think? I hope you like my trumpeting...
Big brother...? I was just practicing my trumpet, if you were wondering... Umm, what do you think? I hope you like my trumpeting...
Big brother... Did you come to listen to me practice? It makes me a little nervous, but I'm glad you're interested...
I gotta gather my courage and invite big brother to the party today... Ah? B-big brother... Did you hear that? Oh...
Concerts are hard... I need to practice more. But if you're there, I'm sure it'll go well...
It's a good thing Yuni can hold the sheet music... Hm? You'll help too, big brother? I dunno if I can practice while I look at your face...
Big brother... What if we slacked off together? Indomitable told me about it. She says bad girls do it, heheh...
Do you mind if I... ask you for something a little greedy...?
Big brother... W-we're all alone right now... ///
No matter how busy you are, I'll always be waiting here for you.
Don't come any closer! Th-this is dangerous... Big brother?! Thank goodness... Please come save me!
Don't come any closer! Th-this is dangerous... Big brother?! Thank goodness... Please come save me!
Big brother, are we going to go dungeoneering again today...? I'll do my best to support you...!
I raised all of my support skills to their maximum levels, so I'll be your best partner ever! Yuni can help, too. Hehehe!
Why does this staff have the Charm skill, anyway... What if I used it on... N-never mind! I-I shouldn't think of such things...
Raising your weapon's level can lead to stronger healing effects... Huh? Z23, you think I shouldn't...?
Huh? You can level up just by leaving the character over there and go AFK...? Laffey, your knowledge is incredible...
Do you have enough healing items? If you don't, I still have lots on hand...
O-oh, no... Did I accidentally cast Charm on you?!
If we clear more quests, we can win more healing items...!
Big brother, don't forget your quest rewards, okay?
I'll heal you, big brother! Haaaah! ...I healed all your HP and cleared your debuffs! Phew...
The big sisters in the commission team came back! If we're lucky, they might have rare items...
Y-you can be MVP even when you play a support role? Did I really help that much? Hehe...
I-I'm out of MP... I can't use any healing magic now...
I heard forming a party with people you have high affection with makes your stats go up... And if it goes even higher, you get to... I-I'll do my best to raise our stats!
Phew... *pant*... Big brother! F-fight on! Seeing you try your very hardest reminds me... that I need to do my best to cheer you on, too!
Phew... *pant*... Big brother! F-fight on! Seeing you try your very hardest reminds me... that I need to do my best to cheer you on, too!
Big brother! Give today all you've got... Fight ooon! Mmm... I-I'm okay... I can still cheer!
Big brother, are you okay? If you're tired, tell me instead of pushing yourself. I can bring you snacks, or call others to come help... A-anything it takes to help you!
Do your best, big brother! Everyone in the stands is cheering alongside me!
Umm... B-big brother! Hehe, big sister Illustrious brought iced tea for us! U-umm, I don't have any cups, so... do you mind if we both drink from this?
Yuni's doing her best to cheer you on, too! Do you like the uniform I made for her?
My tummy looks cold? Don't worry, I feel just fine.
B-big brother, this is really embarrassing...
Good work today, big brother. Me, Yuni, big sister Illustrious - all of us were waiting for you. Hehe!
The girls who went out on commission are back! Big brother, wanna take a break before the next race starts?
I'll handle the cheering!
I'm not MVP - you are, for leading us. Ehehe, congratulations!
*pant*... Nnngh... I can still...
Eagle-class light aircraft carrier - Eagle (HMS Eagle.)

After having been converted from a battleship into an aircraft carrier, I provided much early experience for the Royal Navy's carrier forces, and my final moments were spent fighting on the battlefield. Though I met a noble warrior's end, I do wish I'd been done in by a cannon or an airstrike, rather than a submarine.
The name is Eagle. I intend to serve your fleet to the utmost of my abilities as a proud warrior of the Royal Navy.
Great to see you! Based upon your punctuality, I can already tell that you're a responsible commander.
There are many Royal Navy ships named "Eagle," and I will go great lengths to maintain its honourable reputation.
Let's see what's on the menu today... Fruits and a vegetable salad. Ideal for a low-calorie diet.
How much do I weigh? Ahem, you'd better drop this topic, or else...! Okay, I'm just exaggerating. But I hope you understand that it's a sensitive topic for me.
A band of Iron Blood submarines ran away before I could as much as say hello. Again... Guess I'll have to come up with a good way of approaching them.
What is it? An invitation to get lunch? Hmm... Sorry, but could you go in my place?
You see, this is the reason why we have to teach people proper etiquette.
There's still unfinished missions, Commander. We should get them done sooner rather than later.
Now that's the face of an accomplished commander. Good job.
There's mail for you. Don't forget to give it a look.
My body weight's still the same as it w- Oh! Commander! Didn't think you'd be back so soon. A-anyway, you'd better give our next mission plan a look!
Commission complete. Let's go and offer the returning team some biscuits. Don't worry about me, I can do without.
Enhancements, huh... I just wish they wouldn't affect my weight...
The battlefield... Heh, I'm getting all fired up!
To show compassion to your foe is to put the safety of your allies at risk.
Tsk, I've taken damage after fighting for so long... I'll need repairs when we return.
You're mine!
A warrior of the Royal Navy won't back down so easily!
You're betraying everyone's trust in you by acting like this. Pull yourself together, for god's sake!
People say I'm not great at socializing, a fact that I begrudge. But my social skills aside, I do know my manners.

I'm not a frequent attendee at Royal Navy tea parties... Which isn't to say I don't want to, it's just... they bring out snacks at tea parties... What do you think I mean, Commander?! I'd gain weight, that's the problem! ...Sorry, I lost my cool for a sec there.
