Despite my low-calorie diet and daily rigorous exercise, my weight stays the same... *sigh*, I guess my past status as a battleship defines me more than I think... But why?! How does everyone else manage to lose weight just fine?!
You are irreplaceable to me. Whatever becomes of me... Scratch that. I'll stay the way I am now, just for you. Because I think this is what made me equally irreplaceable to you. Am I right?
I once met my final obstacle in the Suez Canal... But if you ever need saving, I will overcome any obstacle to get to you, Commander. This is my promise not just as a warrior, but as your lover.
Th-thank you... very much...
Let us fight side by side!
Hrmh! Try as you wish, you won't beat me!

ex.line: Commander, if you're tired, you could've just stayed in bed, or arrived late if you wanted. All you need do is let me know about it.
Low-calorie diets are a healthy habit, Commander. You should give one a try sometime.
I don't really mind showing you my physical exam report. Just to you, Commander.
I've gotten better at talking to all the submarines. Knowing you for so long has helped me substantially improve my social skills.
An invitation for lunch, eh? With you watching over me, I think I can do it. Let's go.
Despite my weight, I have little meat on my- Wh-what are you doing?!
My body weight's still the same as it w- Oh, you're back, Commander. Yeah, it's been business as usual in here.
That really hit the spot, thank you. No matter how hard the going may get, I will always keep advancing for you.

Weight and appearances don't bother me as much anymore. We, as ships, can't physically change much anyway, and you're happy with me no matter how I look. We are both irreplaceable to one another, after all.

lines.line: This may be an exercise, but even so I will give it my all. Right now, I am not just a Royal Navy warrior, but a medical resident as well. If you ever feel ill, come see me, Commander.
This may be an exercise, but even so I will give it my all. Right now, I am not just a Royal Navy warrior, but a medical resident as well. If you ever feel ill, come see me, Commander.
Debrief me on your symptoms. Oh, that doesn't sound like what a doctor would say? Then how about... Do you feel ill?
I've come well prepared in hopes of learning the ropes of our infirmary.
I've come up with a new, healthy diet that improves your physical stamina. Care to give it a try?
Treating wounds and saving lives - being a doctor comes with great responsibility, but also great pride.
Are you scared of needles, Commander? I understand. Then as part of this training, we should give you a shot, just so- Oh, okay, maybe we shouldn't.
Let's take your temperature, just to be sure. Mind if I assist with that?
Umm... Are you feeling lightheaded, Commander? Do you need a thorough examination?
"Weight Loss and Health Care Metholody," eh... Oh, ahem! Good to see you again, Commander. I-I was just reading medical literature, that's all!
Aircraft carrier - Ark Royal, Hull Number 91!

Ark Royal, reporting in! I'm the first aircraft carrier specifically designed and built for the role in the Royal Navy, I'm proud of being a prototype to all other carriers that followed. 
 Little needs to be said about my feats against the Bismarck. Rather I must ask, are there any of those cute little destroyers in our fleet?
Ark Royal, reporting in for duty! I am confident in all manners of battle. Why, it was I who managed to destroy Bismarck's rudder!
Ready for orders, Commander. I am confident in any kind of battle!
Ark Royal, ready for inspection!
You look like you're busy, Commander. I won't bother you then. Let me know if you need anything.
Commander, umm... can you tell the destroyers to come to my room? I'd like to give them presents.
This is... So cute! *pat pat* Eh? Wh-when did you get here, Commander?!
Your warm hands keep me energized to keep fighting, Commander!
Eh... Commander... please don't... Why are you doing this?!
Commander, it's a soldier's duty to complete missions!
Commander, to leave your rewards unclaimed is disrespect to the mission.
Do you need to me read out your mail, Commander?
Is it time for a break? I'm going to see my destroyer sisters then!
Commissions have been completed, Commander. If there are any cute destroyers in the fleet, allow me to welcome them back myself.
Oh! oh! oh! Allow me to protect you, my destroyer friends!
Is that it? Hah! Swordfish squadron, prepare for battle!
An enemy who loses their ability to steer will be doomed!
Damn, trapped!
It's time for you to leave!
If only a destroyer would give me a hug!
You can't compare with the destroyers, Commander...
I... I'm going to say this in advance, but... those destroyer girls... u-um... I mean... I kind of hold them dear... I know how to mind my manners... It's not... it's not a crime!
I thought you were finally going to have me Court Martialed, Commander! I'm grateful to finally be recognized by you. It's nothing to be ashamed of? Commander, I, Ark Royal, will follow you forever!
G-good grief... If you were the same size as those destroyers, Commander, I wouldn't be so embarrassed... I was fine with doing this with the little ones... but with you...

If I were closer to you, Commander, I could get closer with the destroyers too... Of... of course, that can only happen with your approval. I'm more than happy to help you with destroyer inspections! Is that all right, commander?
I'll take care of all the destroyers from now on! No one can touch Commander or my destroyers. No one!
This is...! Your Excellency, how did you even know? Thank you so much!
I feel so strong now!
I've got to set an example for the others!

ex.line: Commander, I am ready to act. I mean ready to fight, of course! Let us show the enemy the might of a Royal Navy aircraft carrier!
Commander, I'll take care of the destroyers... Err, WE'LL take care of the destroyers! As long as we're around, no one can do them harm!
What am I thinking? Oh, just about you, and the fleet.
You want to call the destroyer girls here to your office, do you...? Commander, this is a task you must entrust to me, Ark Royal!
The outfit Glorious, Acasta, and Ardent recommended... should go like this. One must be more careful next time.
That little submarine is missing again. Heavens, she's always stealing away into other people's rooms to play hide and seek...
Commander! N-not here...!
Fulmar squadron, Swordfish squadron, prepare to launch!
It is thanks to the Commander's guidance that I reach my full potential and seize victory!

lines.line: Nothing says summer like the sun, the beach, and destroyers... Ahem! Th-that's right! Even though we're relaxing, we still have to keep an eye out for enemy destroyers! Commander, I may be in a swimsuit, but I'm ready to sortie at any time!

Nothing says summer like the sun, the beach, and destroyers... Ahem! Th-that's right! Even though we're relaxing, we still have to keep an eye out for enemy destroyers! Commander, I may be in a swimsuit, but I'm ready to sortie at any time!
Summer, huh... Commander, do you enjoy the summertime? I know I do.
It is dangerous to let the destroyers play on the beach alone... I suggest setting aside time every day to allow them to frolic together.

To be honest, Commander, I wanted to provide everyone with some toys to play with while on the beach, but don't know what would be well received. Could I go consult the destroyers to see what they think?
Commander, why have you been staring at me this whole time? Huh, I'm "quite the beauty when I'm not running my mouth"...?!
Some say that my tastes are a bit questionable, but I have complete confidence in my abilities as secretary ship. I'll take care of the work!
Destroyers frolicking around in swimsuits? Where?! ...Commander, don't mess with me like that!
One tends to let her guard down at a party like this, but worry not! Put the ball in my hands and let Ark Royal keep you safe!
One tends to let her guard down at a party like this, but worry not! Put the ball in my hands and let Ark Royal keep you safe!
Commander, status report: all quiet over here.
You need to inspect what's on my camera? Well... let's not worry about it until after the party. I promise I'll hand over every last negative!
This camera is strictly for security recording purposes. You never know what might happen. Of course, I could also use it to record some tender moments.
Are you cold, Commander? You can have my jacket.
This party is so noisy, so rowdy. It's my responsibility to take watch over those sweet, innocent, little destroyer girls!
Oh, don't worry about me. While everyone else sinks into the enrapturing atmosphere of the evening, someone has to stay sober and alert.
You want to dance with me? But, Commander, this... isn't this a little out of the ordinary?
Ooooooh! Brilliant! Perfect! - Ahem! Erm, well, that's right! This is just your average, everyday record keeping here. I'm not doing anything weird at all! No siree!
Time to get rid of some troublemakers!
Commander, Happy New Year. Oh no, I'm not going hunting. I'm patrolling the port during the New Year's celebrations. Naturally, I volunteered for the job.
Commander, Happy New Year. Oh no, I'm not going hunting. I'm patrolling the port during the New Year's celebrations. Naturally, I volunteered for the job.
The more peaceful and inviting the atmosphere, the more one wants to protect it. What do you think, Commander?
I can use this gun for ceremonial salutes, as well. I'll put her to good use at the banquet!
Oh those destroyers in their Eastern dresses... Ah, I was just thinking how captivating it all is. These New Year's celebrations really are splendid!
I have already committed everything important about the New Year's programming to memory. If you need anything, Commander, do let me know.
Wherever there is trouble, I shall be there! Such is my solemn oath as guardian of the new year!
Commander, would you like to personally carry out the gun salute? Mind the recoil.
My neckline is off? Oh, thank you... Oh my, no, it doesn't go like this, does it?!
To be able to watch over the destro- The fleet here, that's the best new year's gift anyone could give me.
This is the place, Commander. What are you going to order? Me, I think I'll have the same as you... Yeah, so what? I just felt like grabbing a coffee with you for once.
This is the place, Commander. What are you going to order? Me, I think I'll have the same as you... Yeah, so what? I just felt like grabbing a coffee with you for once.
Oh, you're back. Well, I'm not actually surprised - I saw you coming.
I've been here a few times before. They've never seated me near destroyers due to my reputation... But that's fine. I anticipated as much.
Mmm, the smell of coffee beans... Don't give me that "wasn't expecting to hear that" look! Even I can appreciate a good cup of coffee!
Wh-where'd you get that camera?! Oh god, don't tell me it's all over for me... What? That's your personal camera? Oh, I see... Phew.
I record everything that goes on in here. Let's just say it's for security reasons. That's the only reason, you hear?! My conscience is clean!
Sod off! I'm not letting anyone have my destroyer footage!
Commander, please, save it for another time. I'm trying to hear what the destroyers are talking about.
I'm relieved to see the destroyers are back safe and sound. Wish I could be with them on dangerous missions... Ah, forget I said that. I'm not going anywhere, you hear?
Commander! Here to enjoy yourself? Me, I'm working tirelessly on keeping order around the amusement park! ...That sounds fun to you? Alright, then watch how it's done!
Commander! Here to enjoy yourself? Me, I'm working tirelessly on keeping order around the amusement park! ...That sounds fun to you? Alright, then watch how it's done!
Do you have any plans today? Got any rides you want to go on? I can introduce you to some fun ones if you want.
Stay in the queue! Don't cut ahead - it's dangerous! ...How's that, Commander? I don't come off as too bossy, do I?
This height sign is meant to determine whether or not you're eligible to ride - it's not at all an excuse for me to get up close with destroyers! Want to see how you compare?
Why I volunteered for the job of maintaining order? Because my heart beats for law and order! ...I'm a terrible liar, you say? Ahem, well...
I'll let you touch me now, but do refrain from it when I need to reestablish order!
My plans after I'm done maintaining order? Hmm... Don't have any yet.
Commander... N-now's not a good time for this!
You ought to complete your missions before you spend the whole day making merry!
Oh, you're back. Came to check on the amusement park, did you? Everything is fine! Maintaining order is a piece of cake!
Here's an idea for after work is over - there's going to be a fireworks display at the park tonight. Ahem... Do you care to come with me, Commander?
I never thought a day would come when even I don such attire... Ahem. Your Excellency, I shall protect your happiness, as well as that of my destroyer sisters!
I never thought a day would come when even I don such attire... Ahem. Your Excellency, I shall protect your happiness, as well as that of my destroyer sisters!
I brandish my rigging to protect this sacred moment in time!
Interested in trying my home cooking? I've trained under the Royal Maids, and I'm 99% sure I can prepare a good meal!
Allow me to read your letter aloud, Your Excellency.
Taking a leisure break, I assume? Then won't you accompany me to check on the little destroyers, Your Excellency?

Since we've grown so intimate, I assume it's now safe to tell you that I've become... r-r-rather intimate with the little destroyers too! Of course, you are still number one in my heart, Your Excellency!
Ark Royal retrofitting complete! Now I can protect you, my friends, and of course, the little destroyers, to the very end!
Ark Royal retrofitting complete! Now I can protect you, my friends, and of course, the little destroyers, to the very end!
At last you're here, Commander! Assign me any missions you need done!
Everyone has something dear they wouldn't give up for the world. Whatever yours may be, Commander, allow me to protect it with you!
My Swordfish squadrons are in tip-top condition today! Likewise for my Fulmar squadrons!
It is customarily destroyers that protect carriers, but there's nothing wrong with reversing that. Don't you agree?
To protect what's close to you, you must always keep a watchful eye on the horizon. I trust you to do that, Commander.
As long as I have your support, I can brave the battlefield without reserve!
Commander...? Excuse me, but what's gotten into you?!
I need to go check on the destroyers! I'll be right back, Commander!
Illustrious-class aircraft carrier - Illustrious, Hull Number 87!
Greetings, Commander. I am the armored aircraft carrier Illustrious. I may seem gentle, but I have quite the temper. I single-handedly bullied the Italian fleet during the raid at Taranto.
Greetings, Commander! Aircraft carrier Illustrious reporting in! I pray that you will bring love and peace to this world. May the light be with you.
Greetings, Commander. I've tidied up a bit here. What do you think?
Could you help me pick up that handkerchief...? I'd lose my balance if I try to pick it up myself...
Have you seen where did I put my planes? Oh? Right in front of me? Sorry, something blocked my line of sight.
Commander... can you feel my heartbeat through the palm of your hand?
Commander, why are you always staring at me? Am I that pretty?
It's as though... I've received your recognition, Commander. I feel so relieved.
Seriously, Commander, you're like a little kid.
Commander, it's no good to leave missions unfinished.
Don't forget to collect your rewards, Commander!
Here's your mail, Commander! Should I open it for you?
Feeling tired? Relax for a while. How about a massage?
The light shall disperses the fog of darkness. Oh? The girls are back!
This way we can radiate our brilliance even further.
Why cause unnecessary conflict?
The light shines upon our land of triumph.
Let's retreat, lest I lose my life...
Holy light, grant me power!
Don't panic, Commander. I'm here!
Not even my light can reach the darkness within your heart?
Commander, what do you find most important in a girl? Seriously, could you look me in the eyes when we're speaking?
Commander, while I'm like this, I take a special liking towards suprise night attacks. Seriously, I didn't mean it like that, but is the Commander into things like that?
Commander... do you want to try... a soft landing?
No matter what you ask of me, Commander, I'll accept it... So, Commander, please tell me how you feel about me.
Even though light should be shared equally among us all, it's fine for you to have a bit more. After all, I've received something important from the Commander as well.
Commander, your feelings are what motivate me to work hard~
You haven't changed one bit, Miss Saratoga.
May the light illuminate Kaede's Legion!
Sun kissed skin, scrumptious snacks and delicious black tea. It’s as if both my mind and body have been rejuvenated— Commander, care to join me for some leisurely chit-chat?
Sun kissed skin, scrumptious snacks and delicious black tea. It’s as if both my mind and body have been rejuvenated— Commander, care to join me for some leisurely chit-chat?
Commander, how does it taste? Today’s scones are Edinburgh’s signature dish.
Commander, black tea is supposed to be sipped~ At the very least, pay attention not to spill your drink.
Compared to the glaring sunset, I prefer this bright and gentle sunlight, what about you Commander?
Commander, you can’t act this way… at the tea party.
An invitation to the ball? Hehe, I would be honored to go... as long as you don't decline, Commander~
An invitation to the ball? Hehe, I would be honored to go... as long as you don't decline, Commander~
Good day, Commander. Are you ready to attend the ball?
I always feel my heart racing when I wear a different outfit in front of you, Commander~
As dance partners, we should hold hands like this... Commander, can you feel my warmth?
The orchestra has started playing~ Commander, would you like to dance with me?
Did you want to talk, Commander? I'll always be here to listen to you~
Commander, being proud about doing something inappropriate doesn't make it any less inappropriate.
This is my first time wearing such exotic fashion, hehe~. Commander, if you like how I look, how about showing me off a little~?
This is my first time wearing such exotic fashion, hehe~. Commander, if you like how I look, how about showing me off a little~?
Greetings, Commander. Sorry for taking so long, but fixing my clothes took quite a bit of time... I'm not late, am I?
I look like a princess from a foreign country? Hehe, you're making me blush...
Commander, it is only because of you that we are able to experience so many different cultures. Being able to be at your side is my greatest pleasure~
Commander, can I lean against you and rest for a while? This time, I want to listen to your heartbeat~
Good work out there, Commander. I've prepared some authentic incense for you. Why don't we close our eyes for a bit and uplift our spirits~
It is my honour to get to wear another faction's garments. However... this traditional Dragon Empery dress feels rather tight around the chest area...
It is my honour to get to wear another faction's garments. However... this traditional Dragon Empery dress feels rather tight around the chest area...
How do you do, Commander? May this splendid holiday wash away all your worries.
This festival may be a foreign custom to many of us here, but I think it's delightful we get to enjoy it nonetheless. And it's all thanks to your efforts, Commander. Hehe.
All these Iris flowers are not just for showy decoration, they make for some aromatherapy as well. Hehe.
These Dragon Empery decorations all have a certain... unique charm to them, don't they?
Commander, you absolutely must try the Empyreal cuisine the Royal Maids prepared. I've heard even Her Majesty praised the flavour. Hehehe.
Is there something you would like to do with me?
Just this once, on this special day, I'll indulge your childishness~ Hehehe.
You're looking well. What good news have you brought Illustrious today?
A gentle melody for a peaceful celebration. Today, Commander, I offer this tune to you and the people of the port. May my melody please your ears♪
A gentle melody for a peaceful celebration. Today, Commander, I offer this tune to you and the people of the port. May my melody please your ears♪
Are you awake, Commander? I shall once again accompany you throughout your day.
No matter where you go, I want my melodies to follow you... As such, I've asked Formidable to record them. Just let her know whenever you'd like to hear one, Commander.
Excuse me... Would you like to take a break? Haha, then I'll play a tune to help you relax—Oh. You'd prefer if we rested together...?
So Indomitable didn't come, after all... No, I know that she and Formidable don't feel comfortable at these occasions. I told them they don't have to force themselves.
Where did I learn to play the harp? Hmm... Heehee♪ Would you believe me if I self-studied, just like with singing?
Heehee. Commander, is something wrong?
Please rest within this gentle melody, Commander.
Commander? ...Heehee, wait just a little longer.
Commander, congratulations on another well-fought battle. You... would like me to play a tune for you? Heehee, then I hope this healing song meets your expectations.
The commission team has returned, I see. Erm, then the next song I should play is...
I devote this song to peace...
This tune, and this brilliance, will commemorate our triumphant return.
I know that kindness alone is not enough to win, and yet...
Oh, Commander? It's a pleasure to see you. Umm, I'm currently going over some... "extracurricular studies." If you have some time to spare, would you mind joining me?
Oh, Commander? It's a pleasure to see you. Umm, I'm currently going over some... "extracurricular studies." If you have some time to spare, would you mind joining me?
Greetings, Commander... Heehee, your timing is impeccable. When you're ready, won't you come practice with me?
Commander... Could you keep this little private study session a secret between you and me? Heehee, I'd like it to be a special memory for just the two of us.
When you're making milk from powder, it's important to drip a few drops on your hand to check the temperature. It doesn't feel hot, so I think it's ready for drinking. Here you go, Commander~
Commander, could I try... holding you in my arms while I sing a lullaby? Heehee, I fancy myself a decent singer♪
Hm? You came here just to find me? Because you think I have a "lovely motherliness" to me...?
Phew... Heehee, you learned how to do it just like the book says, Commander.
C-Commander... Do you want to practice this, too...?
Commander, try not to get too focused on your practice. You should still have missions to complete.
Welcome back, Commander. If you're tired... I could rub your back for you?
Thank you so much for taking time out of your busy schedule to help me. I know none of this is relevant to you... Hm? You say it's actually very important to learn this? Heehee, I agree♪
The end of sorrow, the beginning of happiness, and the desire for eternity.
The end of sorrow, the beginning of happiness, and the desire for eternity.
Greetings, Commander. Did you have a good rest?
I'll always be with you no matter where you go, Commander!
When will true peace come to these waters?
Commander, my heart is beating so fast. Can you feel it?
You're always number one in my heart, Commander.
Just whisper in my ear if you have anything to say~! *giggles*
I'm not opposed to intimacy, every now and then~!
Tired, Commander? Why not take a rest? Eh, on my lap? It can't be helped I guess.
Commander, come and try this cake I made... Oh? Heehee, of course I know. That's the ring that symbolizes our eternal vow. I promise to cherish both you and the ring forever...
Commander, come and try this cake I made... Oh? Heehee, of course I know. That's the ring that symbolizes our eternal vow. I promise to cherish both you and the ring forever...
Afternoon tea is ready, Commander. Let's enjoy some alone time♪
You came just in time for the cake to finish baking. I didn't even have time to change out of my apron. Heehee, not that I'd mind at all if you... "accidentally" saw me in a state of disrobe.
See how the ring sparkles in the sun? It's just as bright as your smile, heehee.
Commander, you do love staring at me... Of course, I find your gaze reassuring.
I hope my tea and snacks are to your liking, Commander.
Hmm? Want me to feed you again?
Your hands are always so warm...
Heehee, Commander... Was cake not enough to satisfy you?
You have to take both your missions and afternoon tea seriously. I'll be cheering you on, Commander.
Good job. Just like dessert after tea, don't forget to enjoy your rewards for a job well done.
Oh, new mail...? Want some tea while you read it?
You've been working so hard. Today's cake turned out perfect, so would you like a slice? Good! Open up so I can feed you~
Go ahead and greet everyone. I'll have sweets ready and waiting for their return!

I'll never forget the ring you gave me, nor this special tea party... Heehee, not for as long as I live. Whenever I see this ring, I'll remember today's warmth and love. Let's make so many more beautiful memories together. I'll always be by your side, Commander.
Illustrious-class aircraft carrier - Victorious.
I'm Victorious, Illustrious-class aircraft carrier number two! From the Atlantic Ocean to the Indian Ocean, and even the Pacific... where the ocean breeze goes, I follow!
I am the one called Victorious, Aircraft Carrier of the Royal Navy. Yes, sing my name as you herald the coming of the symbol of victory. As long as I am here, our endeavours shall be smooth!
The quiet sea, the cool sea breeze... Even in this moment, the birth of new, beautiful things blesses us.
In both love and war, one should be brave~ So, be brave, and if you need support, I shall be there!
War is ugly. And this olive wreath is the symbol of peace and beauty.
Tirpitz, if you won't come out and have fun with me then I'll bomb your room again!
I don't like violence, but using it is often the quickest solution to many problems...
When you feel down, I also do. Come on, you have someone as beautiful as me beside you, so why not be happy?
Y-you just did "that," didn't you?! B-by "that," I mean...
Only I have the privilege of being selfish. Don't even think about pushing missions onto me.
Fine, but just this one time! I won't help you with your missions a second time!
Handwritten letters are so much better than typed ones. Don't you think it's interesting how you can deduce the author's emotions based on their handwriting, Commander?
To celebrate your victory, why not wear this olive wreath? I'm certain it'll suit you.
Stop loafing around! I promised the commission team that I'd use my planes to photograph the moment they entered the port!
Words are not needed to praise me! It's not people's words that touch the heart, it's their actions!
Sigh, all that cannons and gunpowder can do is make is war even uglier...
When my foes have been this thoroughly defeated... not even I, the symbol of victory, can truly be glad.
Remaining dignified even in defeat: this is how one should lose a battle!
O beautiful world, sing to me a song!
Oh dear, I've let my guard down.
I'm fed up~! I'll knock you out stone cold!
You know about me from the Battle of Trafalgar? Umm, aren't you thinking of somebody else? Please, Commander~ Who you're thinking of is totally unrelated to me.
My part in the pursuit of Bismarck and Operation Tungsten? I was just in the mood to help, I wasn't at all trying to earn any honours.
I'm not in such a great mood... Are you free, Commander? Great! Then let me dress you in something fabulous! Seeing beautiful things makes me feel better, you see!
I wonder what the future you will be like, Commander~ Of course, I already quite like the way you are right now. ...Goodness, you're blushing ear to ear. How utterly adorable you are~
Don't think too hard about it. Just follow my lead at your own pace. ...Come on, this is a day to celebrate, don't be so nervous~ From this day on, you'd better work hard to always please me!
Quite thoughtful of you. Thank you.
Pleasure to meet again, little Ms. Flat-As-A-Pancake.
Illustrious, y-your bust is just too busty!
Let's bring your sister along for a tea party next time.
Can you talk like normal people?
Hum~ dee dum♪~ I'm all dressed up, and my hair is perfect! Commander, I'm ready to go! Don't keep me waiting on a holiday!
Hum~ dee dum♪~ I'm all dressed up, and my hair is perfect! Commander, I'm ready to go! Don't keep me waiting on a holiday!
Way! Too! Slow! Commander, what does your schedule look like today? Hurry up and finish so you can take me shopping!
Do you need advice from the beautiful Victorious? Whether it's fashion tips or relationship trouble, you can ask me anything~!
Rest is for the sake of being able to work better! Therefore, set aside that work and come play with me~!
Tirpitz, come and play with me~ I won't do anything to you~!
Stay in tip-top condition so you can work hard and play hard! That's my motto~!
This outfit is surprisingly warm... Even in this kind of weather, I don't feel cold at all!
Phew, is the battle finally over? As I said, let's go out and have some fun!
Since you messed up the day off I was so looking forward to, I'm going to have to punish you!
Are you preparing to hold an event for the port? Hehe, sounds like you could use my help. Don't worry, with someone as beautiful as me around, anything you do will surely be blessed with success!
Are you preparing to hold an event for the port? Hehe, sounds like you could use my help. Don't worry, with someone as beautiful as me around, anything you do will surely be blessed with success!
♪~ What should we start off with today?

A few words of advice from me: Invitations should be sent early, the venue should be grandiose, the programme should be discussed with everyone, and your attire should be flamboyant — just like mine~♪
Having trouble deciding? If I was in your position, I'd just circle everything, then figure out the specifics later.
Unicorn, what kind of outfit would you like for next time? I'll make it for you~
I'll have an eye out for you, so if you need me for anything, just call~
I added a slight twist to my outfit this time. Can you spot what it is~?
Y-you put your work down just to do something like this?!
If you have any questions about your mission, you can always ask me. I'll be glad to give you my advice.
I shall guide you until the rewards are secure in your hands— so, why don't you hurry up and do that?
As a celebration of victory, why not decorate your office with this red New Year poster? Isn't it about time for a change in atmosphere?
Let's teach them a harsh lesson!
A beautiful victory — now this is elegance~ Hehe~♪

*Yaaawn*... Basking in the autumnal night's wind while gazing at the moon is the very definition of elegance, is it not? Heehee. Right now, I am not acting as a Lady of the Royal Navy, but rather as an "ojou" of the Sakura Empire elegantly enjoying her tea... Hyeep! Hot?!

*Yaaawn*... Basking in the autumnal night's wind while gazing at the moon is the very definition of elegance, is it not? Heehee. Right now, I am not acting as a Lady of the Royal Navy, but rather as an "ojou" of the Sakura Empire elegantly enjoying her tea... Hyeep! Hot?!
*huff puff*... The tea feels warmer than it should be because it's getting chilly outside... Should I just switch to iced tea instead?
A beautiful lady deserves beautiful surroundings. Oh, I'm joking♪ However beautiful the surroundings, I need you to be complete, Commander.
It's nice to for once have someone else tailor my clothes for me... I think I'll read up a little on Sakuran clothing when I return home.
Invite Indomitable to come along next time? It'd be a hard idea to sell, because she feels just wearing a kimono is a chore. Though, maybe she will agree if YOU invite her?
*Yaaawn*... Get me some dangos, Commander♪ I've heard they're a must-eat when you're gazing at the moon.
I'll have another bath when I come back♪ Would you like to join me, Commander?
H-how forthright... *blushes*
Give being selfish a try, Commander. For example, you could decide, "I'm not doing any missions day!"
So, you completed a mission. I'll let you have this piece as your reward.
To celebrate this victory... Oh, I'd better eat my watermelon now! Heehee♪
For the souvenirs... Oh! It's our turn to get souvenirs from the commission team.
This is a bit hard to move in... Though I hardly need to lift a finger to achieve victory.
Elegantly, gracefully, and beautifully - that's how I will beat you up!
Illustrious-class aircraft carrier - Formidable.

I am Formidable, third ship of the Illustrious class. I operated in the Mediterranean for a time, crossing swords with a certain Veneto. Thereafter, I found myself all across the Seven Seas. While my service record is not particularly impressive, I feel I made a small contribution to the war effort.
Good day, Commander. I am Formidable, third ship of the Illustrious class. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
Commander, you're uncharacteristically punctual today.
?! ... Ah, I was just doing a bit of tidying up. Please, come right in.
Commander, if you're not making any progress on your work, why not take a break? I've prepared tea and crumpets.
No harm in taking a rest while the Commander's dist- Heavens! Victorious! G-good day. Do you have some business with the Commander?
On the day of my launch, hmm... What a shame... though I didn't do it on purpose... Well! All water under the bridge now, isn't it?
I must admit, Tirpitz is quite the hard nut to crack.
Commander, is this the appropriate way for one to behave?
Commander, please don't forget to review the mission list I prepared for you.
Commander, please don't forget to review the list of mission rewards.
Commander, I'm leaving the mail right here. Please don't forget to review it.
Hmm~♪ Hmm~♪ C-Commander! I am p-pleased that you have returned!
Commander, the commission is complete. Shall we go to the harbour and greet the team?
Formidable shall not disappoint.
Ladies of the Royal Navy have many virtues, but mercy to enemies is not one of them!
What a magnificent victory! Let us press the advantage.
Why you miserab- Ahem! You are truly worthy adversaries, but next time victory will be mine!
The curtain falls.
You are all to redouble your efforts!
I'm afraid I've contracted a disease that gives me a dreadful headache when you're nearby. Would you mind going someplace else?
Commander, is there something required of me? If you have a moment, why not join me for a cup of tea?

My big sisters Illustrious and Victorious, like so many other ships you've gathered here, vouch for what a great commander you are. Now come, let this cake be a symbol of our new friendship. Take a bite, won't you?

Truthfully, even though I'm a Lady of the Royal Navy, I sometimes want to have a bit of fun too. A side of me that I can't normally show except to people close to me like Illustrious... Doesn't that make you want to get closer with me?

Commander, good day to you ♪ Shall we share another cake today? The maids have prepared a dreadfully sweet treat for us! Hmm...? I decided to let my hair down a bit more for you, Commander. Hehehe, I wonder if you'll find me just as captivating a Formidable as I was before?

I, Formidable, hereby dedicate my life to the love of my Commander, through good times and bad, rich times and poor... This is quite long, so I'll omit the rest~ Now then, Commander, it's your turn. I know it's a long vow but you are not to skip a single word ♪
Thank you for your kindness, Commander.
Illustrious, my dear sister, what would you say to a spot of tea after this?
Victorious, my dear sister, have I comported myself well today?

ex.line: You're late, Commander. I've been waiting for ages!
The posters on the walls are all my favourite rock stars. I don't usually let anyone see them. You're a special exception, Commander~
That Ajax, she saw straight through me right away... And yet, I think we get along rather well. I've learned a lot from her.
Haah... I'm back. Those tea parties have some delicious snacks, sure, but they're so dreadfully uptight about bearing and deportment.... Hehehe, Commander, would you mind helping me with my shoes?
Commander, which of my sisters is more your type? The sweet and gentle Illustrious, or the passionate Victorious?
Commander, don't you think Veneto looks a bit dim, cool as she might be?
Commander, should I be angry? Positively inconsolable?
Big Brother, I finished organizing your mission list ♪ ... Hehe, is that your type, Commander?
Commander, do you want your mission rewards or do you want me? You have to choose! ... Hehe, just kidding~
Commander, the mail is here. Would you mind getting it yourself?
Commander, I'm going to catch a few winks on the sofa here. Wake me up if anyone comes calling.
Ding dong ding dong ♪, incoming message from Formidable: Commission complete. Repeat. Commission complete.

lines.line: A Lady of the Royal Navy exudes elegance even when wearing her swimsuit. Huh...? Y-you're not seeing it? Really... that's weird...
A Lady of the Royal Navy exudes elegance even when wearing her swimsuit. Huh...? Y-you're not seeing it? Really... that's weird...
Are you done warming up, Commander? Right then, into the water with you♪
Don't you find the atmosphere rather dreary...? What if we put on some rock... Er, something a little more stimulating?
Hmm, that would be Hood. Even in a swimsuit she's the picture of nobility. Of course, that's nothing I'm not incapable of...
Don't fret, Warspite. I wouldn't be able to swim without the Commander's help either!
Huh? Illustrious?! Grr... You tricked me, Commander. Now you're in for it!
Okay, I see how it is. The salty sea air has gotten you all frisky, Commander. Hehehe...
I was simply waiting here for you. Don't think too much on it, Commander.
Yes, this will do wonderfully! Thank you, ladies. Phew... Getting dressed is so dreadfully time-consuming... Ahem! How silly of me. I must not whine in the presence of others.
Yes, this will do wonderfully! Thank you, ladies. Phew... Getting dressed is so dreadfully time-consuming... Ahem! How silly of me. I must not whine in the presence of others.
Ahem. I see you are as punctual as ever. Thank you for attending the party.
What do you think of my outfit? I was only able to wear it with the help of Dido and the others...
Sirius made a few errors at the beginning, but thanks to Dido, they were finally able to get me changed safely...
Commander, your collar is all crooked. Here, come have a look in the mirror.
I wonder what kind of dresses my sisters will wear... Ahem. I have no doubt that they will be splendrous indeed.
You'd like a dance? Very well, Formidable shall be your partner.
Commander?! Th-the maids are still here!
Commander, are you still busy? I appreciate the work you've put in to prepare tonight's party.

ex.line: Hehe~ I've waited for you all this time, Commander. I would've preferred it if you'd come a little sooner, though. Hehehe~
Would you please describe how gorgeous my dress is? Yes, and kindly don't stop until I feel I've heard enough ♪
Has my hair gotten entangled? How?! I'm always going to such lengths to prevent it! What if Sirius is trying to- Oh, it's all right now? Th-thank you.
Come here for a moment, Commander! Let's straighten out your uniform... There! Perfect!
Commander, I'm sure my sisters all have splendrous dresses, but do not forget about your dear Formidable.
You'd like a dance? Certainly. Allow me to be your first, and hopefully, your favourite partner.
Commander! I urge you to pat my head at once! Or else I will ignore you for the rest of the party!
Commander, are you still busy? I'm afraid I can't be of much assistance, but I can give you a wink to keep your spirits up. Best of luck ♪

lines.line: Good afternoon, Commander. Why am I still in class during lunch break? Heheh, as you can see, I'm on duty. Commander, won't you spend some time with me while I prepare for the next class?
Good afternoon, Commander. Why am I still in class during lunch break? Heheh, as you can see, I'm on duty. Commander, won't you spend some time with me while I prepare for the next class?
Nnngh... Hnnh! Phew... Who made erasing chalk so difficult?! Huh? C-Commander? How long have you been standing there?!
Heheh, I actually like the vibe of a classroom more than I expected. It feels oddly freeing.
Nnnh... This patch of chalk is beyond my reach. If I stand on a chair... What? You think it can't possibly be that strong? You're making me angry, Commander.
Commander, do you have any plans for lunch? Umm... If you don't, would you like to join me?
Today's class was nothing a royal lady such as myself cannot handle. Umm, though I did struggle to understand some of it...
Oh... Is there chalk residue on my shoulder? No? You just wanted to give me a massage? Th-thank you.
Eep?! What do you think you're doing?! You really expect me to believe you were just brushing chalk off? At least come up with a real excuse!
Oh, welcome back! ...What's this? You brought me lunch? Thank you so much!
Heheh, just call me the perfect student on duty!
Commander, do you have any plans for lunch period? Me? Not really. Of course, doing nothing is fine. One adorable academy student is right in front of you - isn't that enough to satisfy you?

ex.line: Alone in the classroom with a student... What happens next? Heehee, don't worry, I already know. Your eyes have been glued to me for so long already!
Time spent with you is so peaceful and nice... Heehee, and I don't have to carry myself with the bearing of a royal lady, either. "I love you, Commander♪"
Eep?! Commander, you'd better have a good explanation this time! ..."Sorry, honey sweetest"? Now you're just messing with me... Oh, forget it.
W-welcome back! I made a boxed lunch for you, Commander. Would you like it now?

lines.line: Phew... Finally got the scissors... Wait, C-Commander?! Why are you here already?! Close the door quickly and look away... N-no, actually, come and help me untangle this ribbon!
Phew... Finally got the scissors... Wait, C-Commander?! Why are you here already?! Close the door quickly and look away... N-no, actually, come and help me untangle this ribbon!
Goodness, Commander, how long are you going to stand there?! Hurry and... untangle this thing!
I really just wanted to decorate a little and give you a private concert, and then maybe... Umm, anyway, I didn't expect to end up like this! My plans are in tatters!
Commander, why are you still standing there? Come sit next to me. Phew, my leg is sore from being in that position for so long... Could you massage it for me?
I rehearsed these songs for you. If you'd like to make a request... Heheh, of course. They're all rock songs!
You want to try my electric guitar? Okay, hold it like this, and put your hand here... Come on, Commander. You're not the one tied up - relax a little.
My hair's going to be such a mess... What? It already is?!
How did I turn out like this, you ask? Gee, I'd like to know that, myself!
Do you not consider that taking advantage of me, Commander?!
Can you please get this cat away from me?! I'm scared I'll hit it with the scissors... Hyaaah?! Don't pull there, please!
The commission team is done. C-Commander, you'll stay with me, won't you...?

Let's begin the show. But first... I need you to forget the state you saw me in! ...Huh? You don't want to, because you found it cute? Who taught you to be so corny... If that's how you feel, then I want you to remember how cute you found it forever... But you won't tell a soul, you hear me?!

ex.line: I finished tuning, so I can finally start my solo concert♪ I prepared this just for you, so listen closely... It's not even started yet, and you're already watching so intently. Heehee, I really am your favorite, aren't I?
...That won't be enough to please me! Hmph!
Keep going, and you're in trouble! ...Apologize all you want, I'm not listening! Ahh...

lines.line: To both express my eternal love and gratitude to you and celebrate the wonderful days we've spent together, I will be joining in the port's celebration. ...Ahem, Commander? Tell me the next part!
To both express my eternal love and gratitude to you and celebrate the wonderful days we've spent together, I will be joining in the port's celebration. ...Ahem, Commander? Tell me the next part!
Welcome, Commander. Come and celebrate the big day with me. Heehee♪
My love, along with everyone else's, has been put into this dress. It's the most perfect and elegant attire for today! Well, it would be even more perfect if it had some rock-and-roll energy in it...
"Elegant and gorgeous, like a Royal lady." Hehe♪ Commander, you were just taken by the sight of me, weren't you?
Shall we go to the venue together? I'm sure to get tired if I'm left to walk alone in this dress...
(The Commander's been staring for a while... What part of me is so attention-grabbing? My legs? My chest? Hmm...)
C-Commander... I see you're doing your best, too.
Be careful not to stain the dress, please!
Th-this is how our relationship is now, after all...
If you had to choose between me and your missions... y-you WOULD choose me, right?!
Big Brother, your mission rewards are riiight here, nya♪
Your mail? Right here, of course!
Welcome home. I will elegantly take care of the rest for you, okay? Heehee♪
Our commission team is back. Mmm~ This is a good opportunity to stretch our legs...
Elegantly... and gorgeously!
I dedicate this wonderful victory to you, Commander!

Hmm... Now that I've changed into this dress, I feel a little restless for some reason. If I mess up such an important day for everyone... Oh! I know! It's because there's so much riding on my efforts today... You think I can take it easy? I-if you say so... don't blame me for anything that happens, okay?

ex.line: "Formidable has become an elegant Royal lady and an esteemed songstress of the port." Commander, what do you think of that profile? Umm, it might overlap with my sisters a little, but... Wh-what? You think it's perfect?!
What have you been staring so fixedly at? ...You just wanted to make me ask? Well, that's just naughty.
You do love affection, don't you, Commander?♪
Heehee. Commandeeer...♡

lines.line: Courageous-class aircraft carrier - Glorious, Hull Number 77.
I'm the Royal Navy's heavy crui... *ahem* ex-cruiser, now aircraft carrier, Glorious! I was just being careless when I was sunk by Scharnhorst and Gneisenau, not because they're better than me!
Royal Navy large crui- *ahem* aircraft carrier Glorious, reporting in! Commander, stand up straight, for your glory has arrived!
Today is a good day. Good weather puts you in a good mood to get work done!
Expect great things for me, for I am Glorious! Of... of course! I'll be your glory forever!
Ardent and Acasta did the best they could, but I...
I'll be more prudent in the future. Only then can I avoid meeting disaster again!
Commander, glory and courage go hand in hand. However, Courage isn't the same thing as recklessness.
Any guidance?
Commander, you're holding the glory of the Royal Navy
Rest up and then finish your missions in one go!
I won't forget this time... *ahem* Commander, collect your rewards!
I'll put the tea here... Mail? Ah, yes! There's new mail for you!
You need to always keep your guard up, Commander.
Commander, after your commissions are complete, you should... uh... hm... collect your rewards!
Thank you, but power alone is not enough to win...
Search and destroy!
A glorious triumph!
Next time, I'll scout out the enemy before we attack!
May victory and glory be ours... hopefully!
Sm- smokescreen!
Commander, you're making me feel uncomfortable.
You can't be too careful in war... That being said...
The kids in the sky have been working very hard. Can't they rest with me for a while? ... ... Commander, in times of war, is there no room for warmth?
Commander, it's quite late. Why not rest a bit? I've made some black tea... Mail? It's in your tea, of course... *Zzzzz*
Commander, if you are tired you can always rest in my embrace. Eh? Didn't you say yesterday that was the best way for you to recover?
If we face it together, there is nothing we can't overcome, Commander. Are you ready to accept your Glory?
Thank you very much. I am partial to things that shine!
This time, we fight together!
Being able to occasionally have a peaceful school life... is something I could get used to. Commander, look at the markings on this butterfly - aren't they lovely?
Being able to occasionally have a peaceful school life... is something I could get used to. Commander, look at the markings on this butterfly - aren't they lovely?
When I put on this uniform, my mood seems to lighten up compared to usual...
You're saying... that failures are just learning opportunities? Thanks, Commander, I do feel a lot better now.
Commander, Ardent told me about some fascinating places. Want to go check them out after the operation is over?
Commander, what would you consider an ideal school life?
Even though I still have much to learn... I swear to bring you true glory one day, Commander.
Hey!! Commander, you scared the butterfly away...
Commander, remember to not let your guard down on your way home.
I heard that the Sakura Empire's traditional attire was really hard to put on... but the Dragon's Empery's outfits are even more... Huh?! Commander, p-please look away!
I heard that the Sakura Empire's traditional attire was really hard to put on... but the Dragon's Empery's outfits are even more... Huh?! Commander, p-please look away!
Commander, the glory of... the glory of the Royal Navy will...! F-forget it!
I shall strive to always be your beacon of glory, Commander! ...B-but, that doesn't sound convincing at all while I'm wearing this dress, does it...?
Are you talking about Ark Royal...? Do you not think that it is appropriate for us adults to monitor the growth of our Destroyer sisters, even off the battlefield?
I bought this outfit because I thought it looked gorgeous, but... then this happened... Wh-what do you mean I can just leave it like this?
The scent of plums wafting upon the evening breeze is so calming... Oh no, I still have to finish my secretary duties!
You don't want me catching a cold, is it? I appreciate your concern.
B-but, the glory of the Royal Navy... (blushes)
The hot water is over here... Oh, the mail! Um... I'm so sorry, I could've sworn the mail was right there...
Commander, don't let your guard down... Huh? I'm the one who looks more vulnerable right now?!
To Glorious goes the victory! Commander, thank you for your support!
I must gain a better grasp of the situation on the battlefield.
Commander, if you're tired, feel free to rest in my lap. Not only is it ideal for you to replenish your energy, but it is also my duty to provide you succor.
Erebus-class monitor - Erebus, Hull Number I02!

Erebus, my name, sounds surreal?
My predecessor was a ship which carried explorers to the North Pole and never returned... like a journey into the abyss.
Please pay more attention to my sisters!
Commander, is that you? I'm Erebus. I followed your voice and have come from afar.
Commander, I'm always here, awaiting for your summons...
I am not the harbinger of death... I am just..... guiding them after their times are up
Did you just have an out-of-body experience?
I'll always protect my little sisters.
I have to say, this warmth, I don't dislike it.
Allow me to channel forth the whispers of the dead...
... ... uh... ... I'm sorry, it seems like I was having an out-of-body experience.
You'll experience an eternity of restlessness if you die with incomplete missions.
Rewards are but worldly possessions. It makes no difference to me whether you collect them or not.
Letters are what connect humans. Hold them dear.
The silence after a battle is divine. Take your time and rest.
I'm not particularly interested in embarking on commissions... The other girls always say I see weird stuff. I suppose it can't be helped... Anyway, your girls are back!
The purer the darkness, the calmer my mind.
Please remain calm. The darkness will only make the stars shine brighter.
Allow me to harvest the souls of our enemies.
Even if you manage to defeat me, you'll never escape the infinite darkness.
Want a taste of death?
The darkness is with us.
Commander, if you fall into darkness, know that it will be me hunting your soul...
It was hard to take care of my sister at the beginning, but I got used to it... used to being alone? I'm just used to the fear of it.
Whenever I'm afraid, all I have to do is think of my little sister. It gives me the strength to push on. Even though my sister can't be without me, I can't be without her either.
I'm afraid no longer. Being next to you, I'm willing to become the darkness to your light; And if that light were to swallow me... No, even if I was to be devoured, that would be fine too.

Where there's light, there's darkness. Wherever you are, I'll be near. This isn't fate but the law of this world... It's nothing, it's just something that I've wanted to say for a long time, if I ever found someone who I truly liked.
Shadows chase after light, and light embraces the shadows. I've heard of foolish lovers who erase each other, but who can judge another's love? Isn't that right, Commander?
Thanks. Never thought I'd get something like this.
Terror, stay close to me.
Vampire, please imbibe wine - I mean, blood - with moderation...
Lady Warspite, I shall support you.
Saru Legion? What a fun name!
Those who embrace the shadows will find only an illusory happiness... But for me, that much is sufficient.
Those who embrace the shadows will find only an illusory happiness... But for me, that much is sufficient.
I am still but a shadow. The only difference is, I've found a small, small thing to strive for.
Commander, there's no need to be reserved. I still have a lot of chocolate.
Commander, just being able to watch you like this, and give you chocolate, is enough to make me happy.
I'm here, as always.
Were you able to touch happiness, Commander?
Commander, would you like some sweets to replenish your energy?
No matter how long the night, the dawn will come again...
"I am the witch of Hallow's Eve, here to guide your soul into the ever darkness"... that's what the concept of the Halloween witch is about, right?
"I am the witch of Hallow's Eve, here to guide your soul into the ever darkness"... that's what the concept of the Halloween witch is about, right?
The Halloween event has started. But, I'm supposed to wait here until it's my time to come out.
Terror really wanted to go to the Halloween party with me, but... I...
Legend has it that real monsters come out on Hallow's Eve... Shall we search for them?
These festivities have diluted the ever darkness with noise and light... but it's not such a bad thing.
T-trick or treat...? Oh, right, you can have this special bewitched candy.
Commander, have you been possessed by a perverted ghost?
I can hear the wailing of souls passing through the ever darkness... You want to know what they're saying...?

Forming a contract with a witch will allow one of your wishes to come true. In return, your souls will forever be bound, unable to separate from one another... Commander, tell me... what is your wish?
Erebus-class monitor - Terror, Hull Number I03!

I'm the second ship of the Erebus-class monitors.
The Abercrombie-class ships are no match for me and my sister... We spent a lot of time in the Dardanelles strait. Bombardment missions... piece of cake.
Monitor ship... Terror... Abercrombie-class ships are no match for me and my sister... We spent a lot of time in the Dardanelles strait. Bombardment missions... piece of cake.
Commander... I've been wanting to talk... to you... about...
Your eyes look just like those weirdo' eyes, Commander...
Commander, could you put away those peas? And the lawnmower……
Is is that weird for me to have a 'heart'?
Commander……are you……a wind player?
Can you feel... my warmth?
*Stares...*
How about some missions for exercise...? Otherwise my knee may break again...
*coo, coo*~! Commander, I've got your rewards...
A letter... Would anyone write a letter to me?
Rub my head, Commander...
Commander, commissions are finished... You know, I lost my hand during a commission. It took everyone quite some time to help me find it...
I feel as if my body... is much more agile now.
Even Terror... is getting terrified...
Commander, I... I worked really hard. I didn't cause you any trouble, did I?
*Cries*... I'll try to hold out until you tow me back to port, Commander...
... Sink.
Terror... is getting terrified...
Terror is terrified of you, Commander.
Aren't you afraid of me, Commander? My body feels cold... I am always depressed... I always feel.... like a corpse.
I remember my sister being with me, ever since the very first time I opened my eyes... She's always been there for me. She's my only family...
It's warm next to my sister, it's warm next to the Commander too... I feel like I just got a new family member... I'm so happy...
Commander... please touch my heart... It has never beaten this fast... it has never been this hot... This is all... because of you, Commander...
Times like these, should I laugh, or should I cry? I'm... I'm not really sure... but Terror knows... I know I've never been this happy before...
Huh? For me? Th-thank you!
Sister, I'll do my best!
Can I jump around like a monkey too?
I have to dress up as a ghost for Halloween, but I'm not very good at making complicated costumes... Is something like this okay?
I have to dress up as a ghost for Halloween, but I'm not very good at making complicated costumes... Is something like this okay?
Boo! Scaring people... it's done like this, right?
"From the depths of Sheol, I emerge from eternal slumber to claim your soul" ... This line sounds like something my sister would say.
I wanted to spend some time with my sister, but she doesn't seem to be interested in Halloween...
Today, everyone will be dressed up as monsters and witches, so I will fit in with them...
Children will ask for candy from adults... but Terror is no longer a child- Eh? Candy, for me? Thank you...
Commander's hand... is nice and warm...
If you keep touching, the bandages are going to come lose...
Trick-or-treating? I'm a little excited...
Special type I Fubuki Destroyer Class— Fubuki

Yoohoo~ I am the destroyer who recently made the world tremble, call me Fubuki! Sorry, I’m not trying to be complacent, in fact, I was in many battles… although none of them are worth writing home about… I will continue to do better!
Yoohoo~ yours truly Fubuki class has arrived, so you’re the Commander? I'm looking forward to your guidance~
Commander, how are ya feeling today?~
Hehe, are you that lonely Commander?~
The weather today sure is beautiful, don’t you think, Commander?
Listen up Inazuma, even if the Commander is a total loser, but I am totally (probably) reliable!
Even if the Commander praises 100 times, that still won’t be too much... hmm, or perhaps 100 praises will be a bit tiresome to listen to.
Help with work? O right… Looking at the Commander being so idle, I almost forgot about work~
Wow! You scared me to death!
Commander, there are so many uncleared missions—— ahhh~!!! Were you being lazy again?
Commander, the mission rewards are here~ With me being here, perhaps there are more rewards now? Hehe.
Here’s some mail~ ah… So it’s for the Commander...
First, you do this, then this....?! C-Commander, welcome back~ Hahaha, I wasn’t up to anything!
Hey~ The Commission fleet is back, stop sleeping!
Wow?! Excellent condition!
Good weather, even better mood~ Let’s go!
Uh-huh, I’m good right~
That hurts so much… Commander, let’s run away!
Hmph, taste the power of the Special type Destroyers!
Looks like this isn’t the time to joke around...
I thought the Commander would understand me...
What’s in my hands? I think it’s called “Gohei” or something like that. It looks so pretty when swung back and forth, so I thought to grab it with me~
Not sure how my sisters are faring… Although, since they are my sisters, I’m sure they’re prospering wherever they are!
What type of girls do you like, Commander? Hmm? I’m just curious. Ha~ perhaps you’ve misunderstood me?
I was implying something before? Regardless, no matter what type of girls you like, as long as you will like me in the future, then that’ll be just fine~ Hehehe.
Even though I said that the Commander would like me “in the future”, but it seems that “future” has become unexpectedly sooner~ Were you a bit shy when I asked you?~ Hehehe.
Thanks, Commander! It's my lucky day!
Let’s give the enemy a taste of our might!
Oh no! I-I'm gonna be late for school! Y-you need to speed up too, doggy! *Pant*... *pant*... Why'd none of my sisters wake me up before they left?!
Oh no! I-I'm gonna be late for school! Y-you need to speed up too, doggy! *Pant*... *pant*... Why'd none of my sisters wake me up before they left?!
I didn't oversleep! I was just doing stuff I like and ended up losing track of time...
The Fencing Club, the Reading Society, the Economics Association, the UFO Research Organization... Dang it, I wanna join them all!
Belfast's going to hang out with Edinburgh after school... Maaan, I wish my sisters would come see me, too...
Commander, you got any more work you need help with? I've gotta go walk the doggy in 15 minutes!
Let's finish this so I can make it to school!
Fight or run away to fight another day!

"C-come on in! We've got special offers for you!" ... W-wait, is this really what a "sexy mascot" would wear? It feels pretty different from what I was expecting... And boy, is it stuffy in this thing...

"C-come on in! We've got special offers for you!" ... W-wait, is this really what a "sexy mascot" would wear? It feels pretty different from what I was expecting... And boy, is it stuffy in this thing...
C-come on in! ... Oops, I mean, welcome back, Commander!
I-I feel my consciousness... flapping away...
I did promise Akashi I'd be the mascot... but it kind of feels like she tricked me...
Could you help me pick these up, Commander? Wearing this makes them... mmrgh... impossible to reach, you see...
What? The forecast warned about high temperatures? ... That's no biggie, I've already gotten used to it being really hot...
C-Commander, don't touch me... I'm going to lose my balance...
Wh-what? What the heck are you doing, Commander?
N-nicely done!
It's so hot... Let's mop up the enemies quickly so we can go home...
Heheh! Wearing this costume... doesn't impact my performance at aaaall!
Check it out, Commander! What do you think? ... No, not my dress! I'm talking about the tuba! Want me to play a tune for you~?
Check it out, Commander! What do you think? ... No, not my dress! I'm talking about the tuba! Want me to play a tune for you~?
My marching solo will wake you up, Commander!
Didn't think an instrument could be so fun! I have to teach others about the joy of music!
Let me play you a motivational song, Commander! Tooooot! ... Wh-what? That's annoying...? Sorry!
You should learn an instrument so we can play a song together, Commander!
Oh yeah, what do you think about my dress, Commander? Does it suit me? I absolutely adore it, it's all fluffy and stuff!
Do you wanna hear a song, Commander? You got it! Manjuus, you all ready to go?
Whuah! ... Don't expect me to feel bad if I smack you with this thing, Commander!
Did my pre-sortie motivational song serve you well, Commander?
Tooooot! The commission team has come back, Commander! ... No surprise: this tuba's reminding potential is totally next-level♪
Maybe my tuba... is useful in battle after all...?
Okay, let's play a victory march to celebrate... H-hey! Wait for meeee!
If I ever perform on stage, will you be there to listen, Commander? Actually, it'd be even better if you could be my maestro~
The whole world's going to feel the tremors from my debut! I'm Fubuki, the Special-type idol!
The whole world's going to feel the tremors from my debut! I'm Fubuki, the Special-type idol!
Let's begin today's performance! 3, 2, 1, Start!
I bear the hopes and expectations of all the Special-type destroyers. I can't afford to be anything less than perfect!
Woah, look at all the sisters who came out to cheer me on! Hey, Ayanami, Inazuma, Ikazuchi! I'll do my best~!
The other girls are putting on an absolutely dazzling show, but I can't let them out-do me!
Commander, I'll give it my all out there, so don't take your eyes off me!
Ooh, water! As expected, Commander, you knew that I'd be thirsty. Thank you~
Ah, Commander, good work out there! Did you come to watch my performance? I saved a special seat for you~

Commander, to be honest, I know I don't stand out as much compared to the other girls. But as long as you're by my side, I can stay on stage and shine brighter than anyone else. So, please keep your eyes on me!
Welcome, welcome! Oh, Commander! I've actually started working here part-time, but I'm still learning— Wooah?! Phew... Th-that was a close one...
Welcome, welcome! Oh, Commander! I've actually started working here part-time, but I'm still learning— Wooah?! Phew... Th-that was a close one...
Commander... Err, I mean, welcome! What would you like to order~?
If my sisters saw me working hard... would they say something like "Fubuki's such a hard-working role model?" Ehe... ehehe... Ah, I'm so so sorry, I just spaced out for a bit!
Sigh... When will I be able to handle this job as easily as Miss Belfast does?
You want to chat with me? Sure, as soon as I get finished with all this stuff... Ughh...
Did someone call for me? Excuse me, I'll be right there! Oh hey, it's Akatsuki and the others!
Commander, this bell is just for decoration...
Eep?! It's hard to keep my balance, so stop with that already!
This Oxy-cola goes to this table, and uhh, a few more minutes on this pizza, and umm... Ahhh! This would be so much easier with a clone of me here!
C-Commander?! Aw, shoot... I, uh, can't explain this in just one sentence... Please, just help me!
C-Commander?! Aw, shoot... I, uh, can't explain this in just one sentence... Please, just help me!
Ahahaha... I can't exactly greet you when I'm tangled up like this.
I heard you'd be attending the mid-autumn festival, so I thought I'd get better at hanging up lanterns... Ahahaha... It's sooo hard!
I was gonna hang this one there, and then that one over there, but then I got caught up in the wires and fell over!
Commander! I know what you're thinking - you're gonna bully me now, aren't you? I've told you I'm super ticklish...
Weeehhh... Is this your way of cheering me up?
This is just, uh... an accident, that's all!
Not there, Commander!
New missions? Hey, wait! I'll help you, just untie me first!
Welcome back! First thing's first - help, please? We can hang up the lanterns after that.

Ugh, I'm supposed to set an example for my class and impress you, yet here I am, hopelessly tangled up... Huh? It's fine in the end because you got to see quite the sight? Uhh... It feels like you're poking fun at me here...
Special Type I-class destroyer number two - Shirayuki.
I'm Shirayuki, Fubuki-class destroyer number 2. I served Destroyer Squadron 3 during the war, and... that's pretty much all I have to say. I'll make myself useful to you and the rest of the fleet.
Fubuki-class number two, Shirayuki. I'm a bit quieter than my elder sister... Mm, pleased to meet you.
I see, so that's how your footsteps sound... I'll commit it to memory.
Why does everyone want to touch my ears? What's so special about them...?
I like the scritchy-scratchy noise paper makes when you write on it. It's relaxing.
Fubuki's always bursting with energy whenever I see her. I'm honestly impressed with her...
A carrot? Uhh, no thanks? What do you think I am? A rabbit?
Eep?! S-stop it, that tickles...
Is there something you want to talk about, Commander?
Wh-what do you think you're doing?!
More new missions... Ugh... Could I call over Fubuki for some extra help?
That noise... Sounds like our rewards are here.
Here's your letter. You should read it before it becomes old news.
*clap* *clap*... I'm glad you're back. Let's have some tea together.
Sounds like the commission team has returned to port. I heard their footsteps.
Motivation overclocked! ...Is what Fubuki would say, I bet.
I have a little experience with leading a fleet, but...
It's over? Phew... Looks like everyone's okay, too.
They beat us... I'll cover our retreat!
I'm... not afraid to bite...!
This doesn't look promising...
I, I don't want to hear your noise...
I've not heard anything suspicious today... And that's a good thing.
I don't like crowds. All the noise they make gives me headaches... I much prefer quiet places.
We could share an umbrella on a rainy day, go for a walk, and just listen to the sound of the raindrops... Hm? Did I say something out loud just now?
Can I snuggle you up for a minute? Thanks... I can hear your heart going ba-thump, ba-thump. It's really soothing~
Is your heart racing, Commander? That's okay, because mine is too. Hehehe~ So, do you promise to always, always be with me? You're not going to regret it? Great! Then we're wed now!
A gift for me? I, I guess I'll take it then?
Oh, Fubuki. So full of energy.
You're from... Planet Bunny?
Ready for your orders!
Whoa now! There's enough food for everyone, so don't fight over it! ...Commander? Don't just stand there, give me a hand, please!
Whoa now! There's enough food for everyone, so don't fight over it! ...Commander? Don't just stand there, give me a hand, please!
I recognize that sound. It's you, Commander! Heheh. I know it by heart.
Today it's my turn to look after the bunnies. No, I said "look after," not "be looked after by."
Maybe I should also bring some hay along with the carrots... No, Fubuki! You can't feed that stuff to a bunny!
I guess the ears really are the first thing people go for when they see a bunny... No, I'm talking about bunnies, not me!
Oh, to be a happy rabbit, spending my days eating, sleeping, and playing with humans...
There's a lot you have to keep in mind when playing with a bunny. For starters...
R-rally, bunnies! Bite the commander!
Come here, little bunny. There, that's a good girl... Phew. Finally got them all to settle down.
Special Type I Fubuki-class destroyer number four - Miyuki.

I am a Special Type I Destroyer from the Sakura Empire, Fubuki-class number four, Miyuki... Due to some bad luck, I was never able to be of use... B-but, Commander, please don't hate me! I, I'm sure I'll be able to do something useful for you!

Is this... my new home? C-Commander, it's an h-honor to meet you... I'm one of the Sakura Empire's special-type destroyers... Number four of the Fubuki-class, Miyuki. P-please command me as you see fit... Eep...
G-good morning, Commander... Is there anything I can help with today? I, um, would like to be more useful to you...
Oh, these bandages? They're just in case I bump into a tree branch again... B-but you don't need to worry about it! I'm already used to it...
Fubuki is as outgoing as ever... If only I could be brimming with positivity just like her... F-forget I said anything...
My tail is warm and fluffy...? Um, p-please don't go touching it all of a sudden... I'm a bit sensitive there...
Um, is the fog rolling in? Bad weather makes me feel really uneasy... I really hate bad weather...
Naka and her sisters are the ones who make my tail look pretty and nice... I can't do it all by myself...
I, I will be okay...
C-Commander, did I mess up...?
P-please, don't do that... at least not where others can see...
You've been assigned new missions...? Commander, should I go with you to check on them?
Commander, the mission rewards have arrived... Should I go bring them in for you...?
C-Commander, new mail has arrived... Sh-should I go sort through them first...?
Commander, good job on your sortie! Um... you didn't get hurt, did you? Did everything go well with the battle? Oh, sorry, I must be bothering you again...
Commander, the friends we sent out on commission have returned safely... Thank goodness they're fine...
Th-thank you very much! ...I, I'll work twice as hard!
What nice weather... That means the battle should go smoothly, right...
I hope I managed to do something useful...
You don't need a useless girl like me, right... I'm so sorry...
I don't want to have to say goodbye ever again...!
*sniffle*... I hate it when this happens...!
Commander, you're scary... P-please stay away from me...
Thank you for accepting me here...! I will do my best to repay this act of kindness! B-but first, I need to not cause trouble for you...
Commander, was I able to do something useful for the fleet today? ...I did a great job? Yay! I, I'll continue to give it my all...!
After we're done with work, is it okay if I stay with you a bit longer, Commander? I think I've become a bit more confident, all because of... I mean, all thanks to you...

C-C-Commander, th-there's something I really want to tell you! Um, uhh, I... Nevermind, s-sorry! ...*sniffle* I can't even get myself to say it in practice, how could I ever make the Commander know my feelings...

W-wow... C-Commander, I'm always down on myself, and keep causing trouble for you... But you still want to stay by my side? I, I see... Thank you very much! I also... have always, always loved you, Commander!
A g-gift for me? Thank you for your consideration! *bows*
I wish I could be a bundle of positivity like you, Fubuki...
Can I stroke your ears? Just a little bit is fine...
Please be careful, Inazuma...
If I touch your fluffy tail... will that bring me good fortune?

ex.line: *sniff* *sniff*... Ahhn... It's the Commander's scent... Commander, welcome back! I, um, I haven't been waiting that long for you, it's fine...
Commander! When you go on your next mission, c-can you take me with you? I want to stay with you... I know I'll be able to make myself useful somehow!
I'm sunnier and more positive than before...? Fubuki told me the same thing... Ehehe...
I, I don't mind if you like touching my tail... I can do anything for your sake... *blushes*
The weather looks pretty bad outside... But I'll be fine! Because, you promised to always stay by my side... and to save me even if I get hurt...

Mmgh... Ahh... Hnng?! *pant* *pant*... C-Commander? I wasn't d-d-doing anything! I was just, umm... i-imagining what it was like for you to stroke my tail... s-so I can get ready for the real thing...
It, it doesn't hurt at all... I feel warm and fuzzy inside when you pat my head...
Is it okay if... Umm, we hold hands a bit longer...?
I, um... I don't mind... *blushes*
Commander! I've been praying and praying for your safe return... *sniffle*... Thank goodness...
I did it... Finally... Ehehe!
As long as I can return to the Commander's side...

My most heartfelt wish...? Well, just getting to spend every day with you is already enough to make me happy... Um, but if I have to make a wish, I'd like to always stay here, a place I can call home, with the person I love...

lines.line: Commander, I think the goods over here are a bit cheaper... Umm, I'm doing fine on my budget still, so we can pick out some more things to buy. A-also, I'll get to spend more time shopping with you... Ah, d-disregard that please... *blushes*

Commander, I think the goods over here are a bit cheaper... Umm, I'm doing fine on my budget still, so we can pick out some more things to buy. A-also, I'll get to spend more time shopping with you... Ah, d-disregard that please... *blushes*
Commander, what are we going to go buy next?
I have to be careful not to cut myself when chopping the vegetables... Otherwise, Commander will be worried about me...
Do I like going shopping by myself? N-not really... The way people look at me is a bit scary... so I usually go with Fubuki or Shirayuki...
Eek?! My tail got caught between the shelves... Nngh... Commander, please help me! *blushes*
It's important to stock up on food, you know? Just in case we can't go shopping because of bad weather, like a typhoon or something...
Commander, are you going to stop by the Sakura pop-up café next time? I learned to cook a new dish, so... I can deliver it to the dorms too if you'd like...
Ehehe...
Eep...! What's wrong? Oh, I'm going to hurt myself if I keep rubbing the pointy part...? Oh, th-thank you...
There's a new mission... Go ahead and take a look at it. You don't need to worry about me...
The mission rewards are in... D-do you think we could go fetch them together...? *blushes*
Commander, you've got new mail... Would it be better if I read through it first...?

Commander, are you still working on the after-action report...? I'm so sorry I couldn't help you even though I'm supposed to be your secretary... Huh? I already did you a big favor when we were shopping? I see, that makes me feel better...
Our friends who were out on a commission are back. But, it'll be a while until they'll stop by to restock, right?
I want to be more useful to you, Commander...!

I wish I could still go shopping with you after the pop-up café event ends... Huh? We'll all still be together after that, so you don't mind going with me...? Ahh... Thank you... Thank you so much, Commander...
C-Commander, I'm ready any time... You think my outfit's cute...? Th-thank you... Heheh, I got it just for our date... Umm, I figured hiding my bandages might help ward off my bad luck...
C-Commander, I'm ready any time... You think my outfit's cute...? Th-thank you... Heheh, I got it just for our date... Umm, I figured hiding my bandages might help ward off my bad luck...
H-hi, Commander... Are you sure we should be going on a date right now? Your work... Oh, you finished it? Th-thank goodness!
Oh, Commander, kitties are gathering around... Do you think they're hungry? Hmm... Wait a second, okay? I can share just a little bit of my crepe...
The weather is nice, I'm not hurt... and I didn't drop my crepe... I-I'm sure your good fortune is outweighing my bad fortune, Commander! Yeah, that must be it...!
A delicious crepe, a cute little fox plushie... Say, why did you give me this plushie? It's like me? Because it's smiling...? I-I'm only smiling because I'm on a date with you...
I'm just happy to be able to go shopping with you after work, Commander... Oh, there's cream on your face. There, all clean... Oops! I didn't realize how close I was getting...
Nnh... Don't pet my ears so much, or I'll get sleepy...
C-Commander... Umm, do you want to hold hands...?
M-maybe not outside... Mm... L-let's go home first, okay...?
Commander, good work today! ...No, I haven't been waiting long. It's okay. Umm, here... This crepe's still warm.
Today's fortune is, umm... that I can always be happy by your side, Commander? ...You'll always share your fortune with me? No! I love you, so I want you to keep your fortune with you...!
Eep! Aw, I fell... All the mochi I made for you is ruined... Huh? You'll help me clean up? Th-thank you, Commander!
Eep! Aw, I fell... All the mochi I made for you is ruined... Huh? You'll help me clean up? Th-thank you, Commander!
You wanna make mochi together...? Umm, it's a little cramped... Guess we'll have to huddle close...
Commander... Do you like this outfit? U-umm, I dressed up like this to make mochi... I-if you like it, then I'll make mochi for you more often...
