Ah, Commander, you can't eat that mochi. It fell on the floor... Hm? Five-second rule...? I'm pretty sure it's been longer.
I got all flustered when I flipped the tray over, but you were so nice to me instead of getting mad... I'm really happy...
Huh? Did I get sticky rice flour on me, too? Where... Hyah?! C-Commander? Umm, don't lick it off of me, please...
Was there mochi on my head? I didn't even notice... It's a good thing you did!
You wanna see if there's any sticky rice flour on my tail? O-okay...
R-right here? Ah... Commander, you'll get sticky rice flour on yourself, too...
I'm almost done cleaning! And then... we can make mochi together. Hehe... I just know it'll be the best mochi ever.
I-I may have made a few mistakes, but I like... No... I love how you embrace me despite my clumsiness. I really love you...!
First ship of special Type II Ayanami class destroyers, Ayanami.
I am Ayanami, an improved Fubuki-class destroyer. I am not afraid of combat. Though just a destroyer, I can fight any enemy...
I'm... Ayanami. I am often called the "Demon." Pleasure to meet you.
Commander, have you eaten yet? Here's some snacks.
I've inspected the communication equipment. It won't cause any more problems...
Ayanami's ears... are they cute? I don't understand... As long as you're happy, Commander!
I've been having nightmares of all the girls getting lost... I'm certain that it's my fault, too...
Commander? No, nothing. I just wanted to see if you were here or not.
I don't really get it but... I'm a bit happy...
Uuu... it tickles...a bit.
Commander... please... don't touch there so much... It's making me feel weird...
Commander, we've been notified of new missions.
The rewards for the previous mission are here.
There's... new mail...
Commander, you're a little like me on the battlefield... That's... pretty cool.
Commander, a commission has finished.
My power is overflowing...
Want to go... to Solomon?
MVP? I don't really get it, but... thanks.
It's okay... I'll recover quickly.
Bear witness to the true power of the "Demon"
I don't want... to be alone...
I don't really want to get any closer.
Ayanami's impressions of Commander? I don't really know.
Commander, you're always saying that my ears are cute... But why won't you touch them?
If there's one thing that worries me... it would be when you are not at my side.
I don't particularly... like or dislike combat. I just do what must be done. But if it's for you, Commander... maybe I can get a bit stronger.
Rest assured... This time, no matter what happens, I'll survive and return to you... because I'll always want to see you again...
Ayanami is... really happy, yes.
I will protect you all.
Laffey, I've run out of oxy-cola again...
Long Island... don't get distracted on the battlefield.
I'm depending on you for aerial coverage.
I heard that... I need to wear a costume like this to participate in Halloween festivities. Commander... do I look cute?
I heard that... I need to wear a costume like this to participate in Halloween festivities. Commander... do I look cute?
Are these... sweets? Thank you. I will try them.
There are fun things outside of combat and training too...
If I stand on this pumpkin lantern... will I be closer to reaching the skies?
I think... I like this costume.
Tonight, I am not a demon... but a witch!
Commander, want to listen to music together? Do you like... this non-combat-oriented Ayanami?
Commander, want to listen to music together? Do you like... this non-combat-oriented Ayanami?
Commander, before work starts, want to listen to music together?
When I put on my headphones, the music flows and washes away everything in the world... except you...
Commander, Javelin asked if I could play later. Is that okay?
Commander, what kind of music do you like? I like... um, rock?
Ikazuchi said she was playing something called a "mobage." Commander, do you know what that is?
Ayanami's riggings... can also become musical instruments. Commander, do you want to hear me play?
I'm somewhat looking forward to today's rewards...
Training and commissions... there''s no time to slack off...
This song... fits the battlefield well.
"As long as you're smiling..." What does that mean?

Compared to the way we celebrate New Year in the Sakura Empire, the festivities of the Dragon Empery have a completely different atmosphere... But, I don't really mind the liveliness... Commander, do you like festivals?

Compared to the way we celebrate New Year in the Sakura Empire, the festivities of the Dragon Empery have a completely different atmosphere... But, I don't really mind the liveliness... Commander, do you like festivals?
Commander, the girls from the Dragon Empery seem to be having a banquet... Want to come with me to have a look?
This outfit feels light and easy to move in, not bad at all... Very cute? Um... thank you...
This year's zodiac animal is... Eh? Commander, did you see where the piglet ran off to?
Commander, are we under attack? I hear a lot of explosions... Eh? So those are a form of celebration? That sounds interesting, yes...
What is this "ding-a-ling" sound? It reminds me... of our New Year back home...
Commander, this dress is made with really comfortable materials... Want to feel...?
Commander, you can't... lift that part...
I wish you a happy and peaceful holiday~ Commander, I hope that we can continue being together like this forever...
"Welcome, Commander..." I should greet customers like this... yes?
"Welcome, Commander..." I should greet customers like this... yes?
Commander, what would you like to order today? The menu is right here...
Training to be a waitress is something that Ayanami has never experienced before. It's very novel, yes...
Laffey said that it's important to diversify your diet. So... today, would you like something sweet, Commander?
Javelin is always so energetic, no matter what she's doing. I'm a little jealous...
Being a waitress... is harder work than I imagined...
I should hold the serving platter... like this? Commander, are you trying to help me? It's okay, I think I can manage on my own.
Would you like a special combo meal to celebrate your safe return?
When I'm off work, I want to spend some time with you, Commander... I'll make you a special bento that I learned how to make at work... Is that okay, Commander?
Ayanami here. Successfully infiltrated Commander's office. Oh... Commander saw me. Operation failed...
Ayanami here. Successfully infiltrated Commander's office. Oh... Commander saw me. Operation failed...
Commander, want to join Ayanami in cover ops training? ...Hmm, actually, that seems futile.
Even though we were supposed to use our codenames, Kaga just went and spilled the beans. It's a bit troublesome when nobody is going to use them...
Those Cloak of Invisibility things that they have in the Royal Navy are really cool... they make me a bit jealous...
When I need help, I usually turn to Shouhou or Zed. As for Fubuki... she always hears me out on a variety of stuff. I'm very thankful.
This cloak that Yuubari developed for me... has a function that "always conceals its wearer's face." That's... probably good.
Commander's office is always protected, and it is absolutely safe. There's no need to worry.
They're ears, not horns...
Commander, want an apple? They're really good.
The mail's been... Oh, the members of the maid team responsible for protecting you have already looked it over. It's fine to open it.
This power... is for the sake of protecting my friends...!
I'll show you the power... of Ayanami and her friends!
The enemy's lookouts have been taken out succcessfully. Thank you, Commander.
The concealment function that Yuubari added was not very useful...
I guess I'm making my idol debut? Um, Javelin and the others are making their debuts, so, I also had to... Commander, what are idols supposed to do normally?
I guess I'm making my idol debut? Um, Javelin and the others are making their debuts, so, I also had to... Commander, what are idols supposed to do normally?
Commander, I'm currently practicing my dance routine. Want to watch?
Z23 is always looking out for us... Even though she has her own schedule to worry about, she always helps us manage ours.
Singing and dancing are no problem for me, but smiling is hard... Javelin said that's what makes me cute though. Is that true, Commander?
Commander, Z23 told me that rock n' roll and idols don't really go together. Do you think I could make metal cute?
Fubuki seems to also be doing idol training. We should go see her... in a little bit.
I never knew that there were so many things to do as an idol. I'm getting all fired up.
Commander, this is what I learned from my lessons today.
If I imagine performances to be like battles, and think of the audience as enemies... Err, wait, that's not going to work.
An idol's duty is to protect everyone's smiles!
Victory pose. Yeah.
I'm still... your Ayanami... though I'm not very used to this outfit... Commander, does it suit me?
I'm still... your Ayanami... though I'm not very used to this outfit... Commander, does it suit me?
No matter where you go, Ayanami shall always walk three steps behind you. Commander... shall we go?
Now, I know that I'm not alone anymore... because you're here after all, Commander...
I'm not sure... I understand the meaning of these clothes... but since you'd like me to wear them, I don't mind...
Everyone was staring at me so excitedly... I'm not used to this...
Commander, I like cuddling with you like this... It feels nice.
This feels... a bit weird after all... But, if you like it, I don't mind...
Commander... shall I rub your shoulders?
Commander, as long as you're by my side, I won't lose.
I enjoy being with everyone, but... I'd also like to spend more time alone with you, Commander...
Ayanami, retrofit complete. I feel stronger, yes... Having that said, Commander, can you pat my head? I want to be spoiled a bit...
Ayanami, retrofit complete. I feel stronger, yes... Having that said, Commander, can you pat my head? I want to be pampered a bit...
Commander, I feel like I can work a bit harder when I'm with you...
Being with everyone makes me happy... so I want to be able to stay together...
Commander, if you leave me alone... I'll be hurt...
Commander's hands... are so warm...
It will be all right, Commander... Believe in me...
If it is for everyone's sake... I am willing to become the "Demon."
Commander, Happy New Year's. In this coming year, please continue to look after me...
Commander, Happy New Year's. In this coming year, please continue to look after me...
During holidays, everyone always has lots of fun. Of course, Ayanami is also having lots of fun...
Fubuki seems to have drawn "Misfortune" at the fortune-telling shrine, but she doesn't really seem to mind... Me? "Small blessing." I'm glad.
New Year's outfits... are very pretty, but they're hard to move around in... Ayanami still isn't used to it yet...
Snowflakes are very beautiful, but, they melt as soon as they land in your palm.
This year as well... I hope to stay together with everyone, and Commander as well.
New Year's isn't complete... without ozoni. It's piping hot. Please have some if you'd like.
Ayanami... isn't cold.
Please do not mess up my clothes... Otherwise, Ayanami would not know how to fix them...
During New Year's, there are many interesting-looking events. Ayanami would like to try going to some...

What I'd like to do this year? I'd like to continue being with you as well as my friends... That doesn't count? Um... in that case, I'd like to watch the petals with you during the spring? Is that better?
Commander, thank you for coming to the party. Ayanami... has been waiting for you. ...I look a bit scary? I'm not sure I get it... I guess.
Commander, thank you for coming to the party. Ayanami... has been waiting for you. ...I look a bit scary? I'm not sure I get it... I guess.
"It is unbefitting to keep a lady waiting." —That was just a joke. Commander, welcome back.
Commander, you'd like to dance with Ayanami next? I'm not very good at dancing though... I'll try not to step on your feet, I guess...
Z23 seems to be fitting in just fine, but... I'm still a bit nervous. Commander, don't leave me alone.
To get rid of my nerves... maybe I should try releasing the †Force† like that one person taught me... Is that a bad idea?
Listening to the piano makes me a bit sleepy... Commander, you're not getting sleepy?
...Ah! Ayanami... is awake now...
Commander... you're acting a bit weird...
Let us go with grace and elegance.
"I'll become the life of the party!" ...I'm sure Fubuki would say something like that.
I can't... let it end like this...!
No, Ryuujou! Samurai builds should stay back during the boss! ...Oh, welcome, Commander. I'm busy with this game right now, so just make yourself at home or something.
No, Ryuujou! Samurai builds should stay back during the boss! ...Oh, welcome, Commander. I'm busy with this game right now, so just make yourself at home or something.
Do you want to play co-op, Commander? Okay. First, you must take this controller.
I've inspected the voicechat equipment. It won't cause any more problems...
If Ayanami dies... the fate of the villagers falls upon... the ghost gamer...
I have a feeling Little Bel is the best gamer among the Royal Maids...
Could you turn up the AC, please? If the room stays this hot, Ayanami will evaporate...
Oh no! Commander, it's a trap! Good thing we managed to avoid it.
Is this gamer fuel for me? Thank you.
Well done on that battle. Ayanami has a "battle" to return to as well.
V for victory. From Ayanami.
Rigging, activate!
I have equipped a full set of Dragon Empery Wuxia gear, yes. It may not look as cool as the in-game version, but this pleases the Ayanami. Heh.
Using qing-gong to fly into the air, or firing huge sword beams... I don't know about other people, but Ayanami can't do stuff like that...
Just changing into this outfit makes me feel like I'm much stronger at melee combat. It's just a feeling though, yes...
Ayanami's stats are well-rounded. Javelin put all her points into external kung-fu, and Z23 put all hers into internal kung-fu. Those are crappy builds.
Akatsuki seems to be observing me with great interest... I think I should explain things to her before there's some weird misunderstanding...
If this was the real deal, all the nearby flora would have turned into sharp blades... But since this is just Ayanami's rigging, that's not happening, I guess.
This is a "breach of etiquette," I guess?
Commander, there's a new mission. ...I don't mean inside the game.
Your rewards are here, yes. Don't forget to check them.
A messenger pigeon... isn't coming. It's just normal mail for you, Commander.
Commission complete. It's time to repair and resupply up.
Kurogane Greatsword: Hullbreaker-Style!
The lonesome and tragic Ayanami continues her journey, unable to find a single worthy foe.
This doesn't seem to work in IRL battles...
Welcome. Ayanami will be taking your order, yes. Will this be dine-in, or to-go? I would personally recommend the cola.
Welcome. Ayanami will be taking your order, yes. Will this be dine-in, or to-go? I would personally recommend the cola.
Come on in, Commander. We're having a special discount campaign today, so... take your pick.
Ayanami messed up the order once... I thought Zed would chew me out, but she ended up encouraging me instead...
If you're not sure what to order, Laffey's favorite Teriyaki Twisters, Zed's recommended french fries, and cola make a great combo.
I like my cola ice-cold. How about you, Commander?
Hm... Does this combo go better with ketchup or barbecue sauce... Do you know, Laffey?
Commander, care for another cup of cola?
Ayanami... is still working...
Commander, if you're tired from your mission, how about enjoying some cola? Ayanami will treat you.
I see, you're all done with your work... Ayanami has to work hard too, yes.
There's a delivery order... When I come back, I'd like to bring a portion for Javelin too.
Welcome back, Commander. Here's your large cola, ice-cold. Please enjoy, yes.
A new shipment of food has arrived. Ayanami will go help out.
Ultimate Ability: Dynamic Kick! ...Oh, I used my skill on the wrong target. Sorry, can we try that again?
Ultimate Ability: Dynamic Kick! ...Oh, I used my skill on the wrong target. Sorry, can we try that again?
Ultimate Ability: Dynamic Kick! ...Oh, good morning, Commander. I was just practicing my ultimate ability... Thankfully it didn't hit you, yes.
I've seen through this dungeon's layout, yes. I've honed my senses by training with the legendary L.I., so you can count on me.
Sorry about the dungeon repair costs... There goes all of Zed's equipment funds... *sigh*...
By the way, Commander, what kind of role do you want to play? It'd be nice if you could play some sort of healer to support us.
Look at that...! It's a Meowfficer dressed up as a monster! Can you get EXP from defeating it?
Commander, can you help me practice my ultimate ability?
Commander... *blushes*
This quest looks pretty tough, yes. But if we all do our best, I'm sure we'll be able to clear it!
The bonus rewards are in. We should set it aside for Zed's gear.
A message from Akashi? Probably should take it with a grain of salt, yes.
Welcome back, yes. First, we must cleanse Laffey's debuffs. Oh, she's just sleeping...?
...Oh. The commission team's back. I'm sure it'll be a Great Success.
When it comes to multi-hit combos, Ayanami has the upper hand, yes!
Your own body is the mightiest weapon. Javelin has yet to learn this, heh.
Taste the Demon's jump-kick!
*fidget, fidget*... Oh, how's the party? Yes, I get a little angsty when I'm without a weapon... I envy your ability to stay calm no matter what.
*fidget, fidget*... Oh, how's the party? Yes, I get a little angsty when I'm without a weapon... I envy your ability to stay calm no matter what.
Phew... I'll be meeting up with the girls later, yes. Are you also heading back to the venue, Commander?
Commander, would you like to dance? ...Mm, I'll be fine, as long as I follow the beat like a rhythm game. I can handle this, yes!
If anything happens, I will protect you with my bare hands. I have a lot of experience playing fighter classes in games.
Did Laffey already go to sleep? Speaking of which, I'm starting to feel drowsy as well... I wanna go back to my room and roll around in bed.
It's good to get my homework done? Oh, this isn't my homework. Umm, it's not like you can get any paperwork done during a party either.
Commander? What's the matter?
You're also into that... I guess?
There's still work left to do. Commander, let's hop to it after the party's over.
Huh? Mission rewards are here? Commander, did you finish work while chatting with me...?
The mail's here. I wonder who put it here?
Kyaa~ Ayanami is falling in love all over again... Huh? That kind of line doesn't suit me at all...?
Looks like the commission's done, yes. Shall we head out together?
My rigging... is ready!
Please praise me more for this splendid victory, yes...
Understood. Retreating immediately!
Type III Akatsuki-class destroyer number one - Akatsuki.

I am Akatsuki, a special-type destroyer! Destroyer Division Six consisted of me and my sisters! I was the first to be built and the first to be sunk! The Battle of Guadalcanal? I-I was trying to cast my light on the enemy! I was by no means scared of them! ... Ahem, you shall witness how strong I truly am... that you will!

I am Akatsuki, the oldest ship of Destroyer Division Six! Well met, Commander. I sincerely hope you will let me rebuild Division Six! ... Huh?! You do not permit the formation of destroyer divisions?!
My name is Akatsuki, I am the ninja who will banish all the darkness in the world! ... Whoa! Commander, w-when did you get here?!
T-the reason I sleep with the lights on is because... i-it is not because I am afraid!
Sometimes I do not understand what Ikazuchi and Inazuma are trying to say...
Can Hibiki find her way here on her own? It has me somewhat worried...
W-w-what! Anyone would be shocked from suddenly seeing a person's shadow cast in the light in the middle of the night!
Hibiki... I really miss her...
S-should you touch me there again... then I will not be able to restrain myself!
The ocean at night is a little scary... N-nay, I am not scared! B-but may I propose we do missions during daytime? You must agree, right?!
Rewards~ rewards~!
New mail for you! Uh... I will read it out loud for you!
Commander~ Did you bring back any shiny items? ... Hm?! N-not at all, I am not asking simply because I want such things!
We may use my searchlight to find our way home! Huh? ... You have no need of it? R-really...?
As the oldest of my siblings, I must work even harder!
Destroyer Division Six, embark!
This is the true power of a ninja!
Damn... I-I shall get you next time...
O darkness, be gone!
Commander, you must cheer up!
I am a little worried... about Ikazuchi and Inazuma...
Commander, do you perhaps wish to see my true right eye?
I cannot sleep well without my sisters by my side... T-that is not to say I am lonely! I-it is because I am concerned about them!
We Division Six destroyers have always been together! And... um, surely you will be together with me forever as well, Commander?
A promise that binds us for eternity... I understand! Then I shall show you my true right eye, right this mo... T-there is no need for it? All I need to do is close my eyes instead? Re... really...?
Woah! This is awesome!
Together we shall shine a light on the darkness!
We will always be together!

ex.line: Hibiki, I won't let myself get lost over something like that ever again!
Hibiki? Oh, it's just you, Commander...

lines.line: Is this the place called the Northern Parliament?! It is colder than I thought... Th-thank goodness I brought gear for extreme environments! Hibiki, please wait a bit longer! Your sister is coming to see you!

Is this the place called the Northern Parliament?! It is colder than I thought... Th-thank goodness I brought gear for extreme environments! Hibiki, please wait a bit longer! Your sister is coming to see you!
Being fully prepared is the key to going in the right direction! Say that again? The East lies *that* way?
I made friends of these bears on my journey! I suggest you try befriend them too, Commander... Er, forsooth!
I've still not found Hibiki... I really do wonder when we'll meet again.
It is thanks to my compass that I have arrived at the Northern Parliament! Huh? How long has the needle been frozen in place?!
I'm curious as to how Ikazuchi and Inazuma are faring...
Would you care to harken to one of my tales of valor?
Oooh, I feel myself warming up! I don't know why, though... Something about it feels strange.
To one day find Hibiki - that is the reason I set out upon this journey!
What do you think, Commander? I have a brand new outfit and a brand new companion! I am no longer a plain old ninja... I am now a motoninja!
What do you think, Commander? I have a brand new outfit and a brand new companion! I am no longer a plain old ninja... I am now a motoninja!
Motoninja Akatsuki, reporting in! Commander, your orders please!
My companion and I have shared so many miles together... Hm, maybe next time I should call my cohorts to take her for a spin together!
My companion's lights are strong indeed, but I still find these night roads rather difficult...
Back before I had broken her in, my companion here gave me a lot of trouble. But these days? We move as one and the same!
Inazuma and Ikazuchi are going to be impressed with my companion!
I'm afraid you can't ride her, Commander...
Wooooaaaahh!! I'm losing control!
My bond with my companion has grown even deeper!
Look out! Move, Commander! ...Phew. To explain, I am helping Santa give out Christmas presents! Now excuse me, I cannot tarry here or I'll be late... Wait, have I come to the wrong place? WHAT?!
Look out! Move, Commander! ...Phew. To explain, I am helping Santa give out Christmas presents! Now excuse me, I cannot tarry here or I'll be late... Wait, have I come to the wrong place? WHAT?!
These presents must all be delivered before the end of today... Commander, we should depart at once!
This obstacle will be child's play if I'm able to leverage my ninja skills... I-I'm going the right way this time, I'm sure of it!
I'm well acquainted with how to use a grappling hook! ...What? Oh no! The presents!
Hmgh! Oh goodness... That's a long way down. C-Commander, how did we end up ascending so high?!
Hibiki will deliver the remaining presents? Phew, that's good to know...
Umm, C-Commander... You will stop my fall, won't you?!
C-careful, lest the rope come loose!
The sp-spirits of Christmas roam the port at night? C-C-C-Commander! It takes more than that to perturb me, I'll have you know!
I could've sworn we met here just a minute ago... Wait, a-am I going in circles?!
The commission team has returned! Speaking of... Where did my presents for them go?
No ambushes! Let us fight face to face!
I m-must maintain my posture...!
Welcome, Commander, to DesDiv 6's tent of entertainment! For our first act, I shall perform for you my most stunning ninjutsu! ..."Circus"? I've never heard of this word before!
Welcome, Commander, to DesDiv 6's tent of entertainment! For our first act, I shall perform for you my most stunning ninjutsu! ..."Circus"? I've never heard of this word before!
I see... So it's called a performance, not an exhibition... Be that as it may, the show must go on!
Inazuma's elephant is quite the clever fellow. Heehee, let us see if it can catch this ball!
Ikazuchi, are you all right?! ...Phew... Don't make your sister worry like that!
Behold! Jutsu of Flame Escape! ...*cough cough*! This darned pyrotechnic device is needlessly complicated!
Don't just stand there, Hibiki - come and assist! ...Your anchor really contains a hidden camera?! ...You just made that up? Aghh! Hibikiiii!
Watch and be amazed, Commander!
H-hands off!
A mission, you say? It shall serve as a fine side act!
You've returned, Commander! Let us continue the performance! Hi-yaaah! Behold! Jutsu of Concealment!
The commission team has- Oh no, oh no! ...That was close... Thank you for breaking my fall, Commander...
I shall dance around our foes!
My ninjutsu is no mere acrobatic act, it's authentic! ...At least I'm fairly sure it is!
Type III Akatsuki-class destroyer number two - Hibiki.

I'm Hibiki, from the 6th DesDiv~♪ I fought in many battles with my friends, and even saw the end of things. That's good and all, but... having to go in for repairs at that time was a bit awkward... Ahaha...
Nihihi~ We finally meet at last, Commander! The name's Hibiki! Don't you forget it!
Commander, did you just pop in~? All righty... Let's both get some good work done today!
Everyone in the 6th DesDiv is super unique! There's Ikazuchi, Inazuma, and we even have Akatsuki the ninja! I love everyone! Ehehe~
Verniy...? It has a nostalgic ring to it...
I'm so glad that we can all be together again~♪
If you don't need me for anything, I'm going to go play with Ikazuchi and Inazuma~
Yo! Did you call me, Commander?
Ah~! Commander, I bet you did that on purpose just now!
We sure have all sorts of different missions, huh... Don't sweat it though! I'll help you out!
Missionnnn... complete! ...Hey, Commander, you should get pumped up too!
Mail? Show me as well! Show me!
Good work out there~ Well, having that said, you still have a lot of stuff that needs to be done... Ahaha...
Ah, that's right, the commission fleet seems to have returned? Should I go with you to welcome them back?
So this is that "leveling up" thing that Ikazuchi mentioned? Nihihi~
Heheh~ Hibiki is super strong~! If you don't believe me, just take a look at this~♪
Heheh~ I'll be taking that gold star~!
Awww... Looks like I'll have to go back to port for repairs...
Trust in me!
I won't let it end like this!
Commander, it seems like the only way to get you to open your eyes is to get a bit rough... *sigh*...
I've been making Akatsuki worried all this time. I have to apologize to her properly, as well as thank her.
Akatsuki, you've been pretty gung-ho about getting the 6th DesDiv back together... Well, the name's not that important as long as we're all together. That's what I think anyway~

Ah, that reminds me! Commander, have you been taking care of yourself properly? We'd be in serious trouble if you got sick and collapsed or something... Well, even if that happened to you, Hibiki would tenderly nurse you back to health~♪
Commander, why don't you tell me your story? I'm really interested! ...Why? No particular reason~ Haven't we exhausted all the other topics already? Ehehe~
I've been waiting so long for this! Ehehe~ I love you, Commander! ...Ah, look at you getting all bashful~ But my turn's not over yet. I love love love you~! Ehehe~
Woooah! Thanks a bunch, Commander!
Woah, are you a phoenix as well?
6th DesDiv, set sail!
Maybe you're a real phoenix!
Akatsuki, let's do this, together!
Ikazuchi, be careful for unseen enemies!
Inazuma, be on the lookout for unseen enemies!

New Year's finally comes to port! I, Hibiki of the 6th DesDiv, will be marking my new arrival in my New Year's attire! Commander, don't you dare change the channel - you've gotta watch my every move~!

New Year's finally comes to port! I, Hibiki of the 6th DesDiv, will be marking my new arrival in my New Year's attire! Commander, don't you dare change the channel - you've gotta watch my every move~!
Commander, you haven't started working yet?
Well, um, y'see, sorry to keep you all waiting for so long. I do feel kinda bad about it, but since we're all here, let's cheer up and put the past behind us! That's right, look forward! Ehehe~!
Akatsuki, you went all the way to the South Pole to look for me?! W-well, I certainly didn't expect that...
Just like me, Fubuki seems to also like being the center of attention. But for whatever reason, only she keeps getting herself into weird situations. Why is that?
This brisk weather is nothing compared to the cold of the Northern Parliament! Huh? I'm comparing it to the wrong thing?
Want to know more about oni horn? Or this golden badge here?
You couldn't control yourself because I looked too delicious? Commander, you beast~
Good work~ Even though it's the New Year's season, there's still a mountain of work to get through, isn't there~? Looks like I won't get to sleep the day away after all, *sniff*~
Type III Akatsuki-class destroyer number three - Akatsuki.

I'm Ikazuchi, an Akatsuki-class destroyer. I may not look like it, but I'm a Sakura Empire veteran. Even Yamato calls me... um, what was I called again? Anyways, it was something like that! You can count on me to do my job! Also, see that LIKE button? Give it a good tap and make sure to subscribe to my channel!
I am Ikazuchi…I’m simply not very talkative...I think you’ll be seeing a lot more of me in the future, Commander.
I see! You just "logged in" didn't you? Human language sure is profound...
If you bow deep and beg for it, I'll make your wishes basically come true! ... It didn't work? Um, well... that's because you haven't wished hard enough yet!
Almost as fast as Shimakaze? So, the wind is faster than thunder and lighting?
I see! So Inazuma-chan landed the "First Strike" in the World War!
I see! So if I stay in the shipyard all the time I'll become a "Phoenix"! Yep, I'd be a... "Thunder Phoenix"...?
I see! This is one of those ordinary "greeting" things, right?
Uh, umm... is this what I think it is? I know full well the meaning of w-what you did! I-I see...
You haven't finished the mission? ... That sounds about as bad as not finishing your job.
Come on! I'm the commander's secretary, but I can't claim rewards on his behalf?! What are the people in charge thinking!
I see! This is that... thingy! The thing you need to bring with you to be let into that one chocolate factory!
Times like these call for fine wine and good food! Hard work shouldn't go unnoticed and all that! Hm? Where do we get it from? From the dorm! There's plenty of it there!
If you let a completed commission just sit there, does it gain any "interest"?
I'd rather have my "ratings","likes",and "gimme" stats enhanced instead!
I see! So all we need to do is press that auto button in the top left and we'll be fine!
I see! Now this is what you should expect of someone as "prestigious" as me! Er, or was it "pretentious"...?

Umm, uhh, Commander, what kind of girls do you like...? I-I don't mean anything special by that... Nope, nothing special!
Whenever I sneak in a look at you, it always feels like you look back... I'm not just... imagining things... am I?
I'm so glad we're together, Commander... *Whimper*... I-I'm not crying! It's just that... I'm so happy that I can't hold my feelings back... I'll work even harder for you from now on!
This will make my tail even floofier!
You can do it, Hatsuharu!
Yaho~ Good morning, Commander! For a limited time only, Wakaba Claus will be delivering Christmas presents! Huh? My bag? Aaahhh! C-Commander, help me pick everything up!
Yaho~ Good morning, Commander! For a limited time only, Wakaba Claus will be delivering Christmas presents! Huh? My bag? Aaahhh! C-Commander, help me pick everything up!
Good morning, Commander! Mind helping me look for a missing Christmas present? I somehow ended up short one...
Even if I'm busy giving out presents, I have to keep my tail in good condition~
There's nothing wrong with winter. It just means that spring is right around the corner. Hehe~!
My ears are just as sharp on Christmas! Hehe, Commander, want to help me listen in on what everyone wants for their present?
Since I'm in a festive mood, I wouldn't mind letting you pet my tail~
Commander, you have to focus on your work. Just like I have to focus on delivering these presents—
Hey, don't use this as an excuse to rub my tail!
Hmmgh! Oh yeah... Ah, there you are, Commander! Care to join me? Come bask in the afternoon sunshine, it feels great!
Hmmgh! Oh yeah... Ah, there you are, Commander! Care to join me? Come bask in the afternoon sunshine, it feels great!
Heheh! My tail's smooth as a baby's bottom today!
Sunshine is so good~ I love the sun! I wish I could sleep away the whole afternoon in the sunlight!
I've heard a bunch of neat rumors around school! You curious to hear some, Commander?
Hatsuharu's starting to make new friends! I bet she'll be a social butterfly in no time~
I wonder if any nuts have fallen from this tree... Come have a look with me, Commander!
Heheh! I can handle a ton of sunshine!
No! You'll make my tail all ruffly!
*yawn*... What time is it? Wait, what?! Then I'm gonna be late for class!
Hatsuharu-class Destroyer, number 4 - Hatsushimo
I am Hatsushimo of the Hatsuharu-class destroyers. I fought in many battles alongside the 21st Destroyer Division. Although I didn't really sustain many injuries, in the end, you know how it went...
Oh my, what's with that scared expression? I won't bite~ I am Hatsushimo of the Hatsuharu class. I hope we can get along, ahaha~
Did you only just realize that you still have work to do?
Excellent. You seem to have remembered our appointment~
Are you more concerned with your popularity among the girls than with your actual work?
Yukikaze? I must admit, she is the luckier one...
Huh? Right now... could you not space out while we still have work to do?
You want to touch my tail? Well, I can't promise you what happens next~
Ehehe... Commander, such a brave soul...
Eeeh? Not even kids would leave those missions unfinished~ How lame!
Looks like nobody has noticed that the task rewards haven't been collected yet... Hehe, in that case...
There's mail for you. Shall I open it for you? Hehe, don't worry, I won't charge you a cent♪
Good work, everyone... Huh, don't get me wrong, I didn't say you~
I can't wait to see the icy faces of the girls who you stood up~
I suppose that will do~
Let's hurry up and get this done!
MVP? It's only fitting~
Ugh... I'll show you!
I'm being underestimated, whatever shall I do~?
Tsk... things didn't quite go as planned...
What a pity... You're not even worth making fun of anymore~
You wouldn't happen to have feelings for me, would you? Save your breath, there's not a chance in hell~
Oh, so you plan to "capture" me? Give up already, it's no use~
What a stubborn fellow... Fine, I suppose I can give you a little reward. Here, this is the great Hatsushimo's lap pillow. Enjoy it while you can.
Fine, fine, it's my loss~ I'll allow you to date me from now on. ... Don't tell me you don't even know how to date...?
A ring? Hmph, are you trying to get back at me for all those times I mocked you? Too bad, I won't fall for that... Eh, seriously? W-w-wait, this isn't how the script is supposed to go... *blushes*
Are you trying to butter me up? Heehee. Well, guess I'll allow it because the present was so nice.
Wakaba, be extra attentive when it's foggy.
Cheers, Commander~ C'mere, you've got to enjoy the party too! If you're thinking of doing something tactless like running off to go back to work, people are going to get upset with you~
Cheers, Commander~ C'mere, you've got to enjoy the party too! If you're thinking of doing something tactless like running off to go back to work, people are going to get upset with you~
Commander, please be mindful of the girls who tend to get lonely easily. Like Kasumi, for example... Hmm? She's perfectly fine? ...Was I misunderstanding something?
I see, I see. So this is one of Ikazuchi's "creative dishes!" ...I have no freakin' clue what this is! Hey, Salt Lake City, how about you?
I wonder what that stuff is that the Northern Parliament girls are always drinking... Feels like something I shouldn't look too deeply into.
Russian Roulette with candy? Hmm, count me in. I don't lose at this kind of stuff.
Though I don't quite stack up compared to Wakaba and Naganami, I've got plenty of confidence when it comes to the size~ of my tail, of course. Heehee~
Yeah, yeah~ Still have unfinished work~? Nothing wrong with saving it for another day~
You know that you still haven't picked up the rewards, right?
Good work, everyone~ You've also been working hard today, Commander. Accept my gratitude and be thankful! Hehe~

Hatsushimo's retrofitting is complete. You don't think I look all that different? Oh, Commander, you're still as simple as ever~ I've changed in tons of ways beyond what's just on the surface. Heheheh~

Hatsushimo's retrofitting is complete. You don't think I look all that different? Oh, Commander, you're still as simple as ever~ I've changed in tons of ways beyond what's just on the surface. Heheheh~
Oh, you're on time today.
Being able to come to this port, and now even receiving a retrofit... Looks like my luck's not too bad, hehe~
Hatsuharu doesn't seem to be as scared of strangers anymore. Heh, looks like you've been taking good care of her~
Hmm, what are you staring at? Naughty Commander~
*staaaare*... Oh, I'm just carrying out my secretary duties of observing you, Commander~ Don't let your mind wander so easily~
Interested in my tail? Well, I guess I'll let you touch it. You'd better be grateful~
Do you want to experience for yourself... the less visible parts of me that have changed? Commander~?
Good job~ But... there's still a lot of work left to do. Hehe, do your best~
Hatsuharu-class destroyer no. 5 - Ariake

I formed the 27th DesDiv along with Yuugure, Shiratsuyu, and Shigure. Since I was the eldest, I suppose that made me the big sister... We got along well and worked hard throughout various campaigns, but in the end, Shigure was the only one left... Well, that's war for you~
I'm Ariake of the Hatsuharu class. Commander, pleased to meet you... Ah right, I just remembered! Is Yuugure posted here? If so, she hasn't been causing any trouble for you, has she?
Commander, did you sleep well? We might get a bit busy today~
Though I sometimes wish Yuugure would be a little more independent, thinking about that... feels a bit lonely.
Commander, did you know that Shiratsuyu and Shigure technically are my sisters, considering that they were Ariake-class?
Commander, if you don't develop good lifestyle habits now, it'll come back to bite you in the rear later.
Commander, want a bento? I'll make your portion along with Yuugure's this evening.
Jeez, Yuugure, don't pull on my... Wh-what? I mistook Commander for Yuugure?
Jeez, Commander, you're not a child anymore, so please have some tact.
Looks like we've got new missions. Any transport operations? Those are my specialty~
Come to think about it, Yuugure always has to tell me whenever she finishes a mission...
Commander, I left your mail in a pretty visible place, so go take a look later.
Good work, Commander.
Commander, while you were spacing out, the commission has already finished~
Take care of your anti-air~!
Everyone, be on the lookout for enemy airstrikes!
MVP, huh? I'm satisifed as long as I was able to help~
I wouldn't mind resting up in the docks if not for this whole getting beat up thing...
Now's our chance.
Things are getting... a little messy...
Do all commanders go through a rebellious phase?
Ariake-class? Ah! There was something like that at some point but it was changed back later, not that I mind. What about Yuugure? Well...
Although Yuugure is sometimes a bit clingy, that's part of what makes her cute. Hey Commander, if I was to cling to you, would you be happy?
Having taken care of Yuugure, Shiratsuyu, and sometimes even Shigure for such a long time, I can't just flip the switch so easily and become clingy and dependent myself...
Hmm, hmm. Yeah, it might not be a bad idea to become Commander's little sister. What do you think? My domestic skills are of the charts, you know?
See, super-domestic little sisters are in high demand right now! But... I will admit it's a little embarrassing~♪ Hehe... From now on, you can depend on me even more. I'm very confident in my skills~
Oh, Commander. Thanks a bunch.
Hush, hush, Yuugure. The battle's about to begin.
Shigure, you look like you're up to no good again.
Shiratsuyu, follow me.
Hope everyone enjoys the oodles of balloons I made for this party! Yeah, I'm sure the little girls will love 'em!
Hope everyone enjoys the oodles of balloons I made for this party! Yeah, I'm sure the little girls will love 'em!
Commander, want a balloon? I have all kinds here!
Parties are "a world of adult pleasures...?" Hmm, who's been putting weird ideas into Yuugure's head? ...Could it be you, Commander?
Yuugure, it's not every day we get to attend a party like this, so you should show off your stuff! Besides, you look super cute in your dress. Right? See~?
If we tied a balloon to Shiratsuyu, she wouldn't get lost easily, right? After all, we'd be able to see it from anywhere.
Who's been going around telling kids that you can fly if you tie a bunch of balloons together? ...Hatsushimo, can you stop giving them strange ideas?
You want to be my dance partner? Ah, um! Sure, if you're fine with that.
Woah?! Ah, Commander, you made my balloon fly off...
Phew... Time for a little break...
As promised, I'll now be your doting little sister~ Mmhmm, take good care of me, Commander~
Ah... So this is what it feels like to be retrofitted. I'll work harder for your sake, and for everyone in the 27th Destroyer Division~
Ah... So this is what it feels like to be retrofitted. I'll work harder for your sake, and for everyone in the 27th Destroyer Division~
You seem pretty busy today too. But don't worry, I'll help you out~
Yuugure has come a long way. She's no longer the little girl constantly tugging at my sleeves asking for help.
Yuugure's all grown up now. When I stand next to her, you can't even tell who's the older sister anymore! Ehehe...

Wish I got as big an upgrade to my ability to take care of people as I did to my firepower. It's not just Yuugure, it's practically the entire 27th Destroyer Division... I just can't keep up with all of them.
Here Commander, your lunchbox. I made a portion for Yuugure as well.
Jeez, Commander, why are you tugging on my sleeve like Yuugure now?
Good work~ Here's your tea~
Sixth ship of Hatsuharu class Destroyer— Yuugure

Second ship of Ariake class Destroyer, Yuugure. A lot of people thinks that my sister and I are Hatsuharu class, but they are mistaken. My sister and I participated in many battles in the South Pacific. We helped protect the 4th and 5th Carrier Divisions. We were greatly taken care of by Akashi. This time...I will stay by my sister’s side until the very end.
Ariake class Destroyer Yuugure. I am open to your guidance, Lord Commander—— Hatsuharu? No, please do remember I'm Ariake class. This is something I won't back down from!
Lord Commander, you’ve worked hard today.
Umm... exactly what do I need to do, to be able to see my sister again?
Rumor has it that we would be able to finish our mission before the pot of tea that we brew got cold? Eh, is this wine?
Even if there is only the slimmest of hope, as long as you persevere, one day you will make it a reality.
Is Hiyou coming? She has a mischievous look about her, I’m a little worried.
Eh... yes, I’m listening.
Lord Commander, what are you doing!
Let’s brew a pot of tea first before we start our mission.
It would be great if our rewards can be confirmed as soon as the mission is completed.
Lord Commander, here is your tea, cake and the latest mail.
...Hmm? Is someone there? Sister, is that you? …Sorry, I was dreaming just now...
The commission is now complete! Lord Commander, would you like to try and build a new ship? Perhaps this time...
If only I could’ve been a little faster, perhaps Hiei sister...
Everyone, follow the battle plan!
...Victory? If only my sister is able to see it...
Hmm… I have to bother Akashi again...
For one day when we will eventually reunite...
Lord Commander, regarding tomorrow’s task— yes, I wish to confirm it all at once...
Sister Hatsuharu treats me gently, as if I'm her real little sister... but...
Ahh, it’s the Lord Commander! Why do I have smoke covered all over me? I’m not sure, I was trying to make coke pancakes.
Ahh, it’s the Lord Commander! Eh, no it’s not. I didn’t mean to disappear like that... sorry, my mind simply wandered...
A cool breeze is blowing, the whispers of the wind chimes in the gallery. Feels like a return to summer times with my sister... but, only this time it’s the Lord Commander sitting beside me.
Lord Commander... before my sister arrives, can I count on you? I can? Thank you... I will take care of the Commander and spend my entire life with you.
Thank you very much. I'm sure Ariake would like this too.
I'll do my best, I promise!

ex.line: I'm so glad we finally can be together, Ariake! All that time I spent worrying about when I'd be able to see you seems like a distant illusion now…
Ariake, did you see that?

lines.line: "I, Yuugure the maid, shall dedicate myself to Ariake, my sister, and you, Commander!"... Eek?! M-my skirt...!
"I, Yuugure the maid, shall dedicate myself to Ariake, my sister, and you, Commander!"... Eek?! M-my skirt...!
Welcome back, Commander. I've left your juice over here. As for the resources... I'm still sorting them... I'm sorry...
Commander, Belfast taught me a lot about being a maid! ... But if Ariake saw me now, she'd probably be... shocked.
Edinburgh taught me a lot as well... She seemed to make a number of mistakes, but I still appreciate her kindness!
As soon as Mikasa saw me, she yelled "Scandalous! Taisho-era servitors would never wear skirts this frilly!"... Even though I wasn't born in the Taisho-era...
Phew... I'm done sorting the resources... Now for the next task...
... Commander, please don't do such things to me!
I asked Maya to take a picture of me and send it to Ariake, and she did!
Welcome back. I was going to hide my tail and ears, but Shoukaku told me I look cuter this way... B-but saying "meow, meow~" is too embarrassing for me...
"T-this glorious victory i-is in my Master's name!" ... *Whimper*... I can't deliver lines like these...
I baked a Royal Navy-style cake! I'm certain this time it'll be a hit!
A maid's job is to provide service and relieve people. ... Commander, do you find my service to be relieving?
The Dragon Empery's New Year celebrations and new outfits are sure to lift everyone's spirits~ My sister will probably love this new dress as well. What do you think, Commander?
The Dragon Empery's New Year celebrations and new outfits are sure to lift everyone's spirits~ My sister will probably love this new dress as well. What do you think, Commander?
Welcome back, Commander. I'm about to go wish my sister a happy new year, as is customary in the Dragon Empery... Would you like to come with me?
Do they eat New Year's rice cake in the Dragon Empery as well? Perhaps they just eat whatever they feel like eating.
A red envelope from you? Please don't forget to give one to my sister as well.
Commander, our dreams will come true this year... right? N-no, I'm sure they will!
I have to tell my sister about all the customs I learned from the Dragon Empery!
I'll leave the mail that just arrived over here. I wonder if my sister sent me a greeting card?
My New Year's wish, huh? Um... if I had to say, it'd probably be to celebrate even more New Years with Commander and my sister...
I finished changing, Commander. This dress is very pretty, but... isn't it missing something up top?
I finished changing, Commander. This dress is very pretty, but... isn't it missing something up top?
I've heard parties are "a world of fun for adults." C-Commander, could you accompany me to this "world of fun for adults"...?
When a girl wears a different outfit, your impression of her changes, doesn't it? I hope they can make a different outfit for Ariake, too...
It's beautiful when flower petals flicker in the wind, but also a little sad, in a way... Do you know what I mean, Commander?
I-I'm fine with just juice! ... Ah, thank you!
I feel like maybe I should bring back some sweets for Ariake... Huh? Am I not allowed to...?
What's the matter...? "Am I nervous"? I-I'm fine... I think... It's just a bit embarrassing to show myself wearing these clothes to others...
Once I've grown a little more, I'll be able to keep my composure even in places like these.
Excellent work. I know the party is about to begin, but it's okay to rest a little... and have a snack before we head out.
Commander, thank you for keeping me company until the party... C-could you take my hand and join me for a dance, like you would with an adult...?
Woah... These stalls have all sorts of amazing things~ Commander, will you help me pick a gift out for Ariake? Hm, let's see... How about this Daruma doll?
Woah... These stalls have all sorts of amazing things~ Commander, will you help me pick a gift out for Ariake? Hm, let's see... How about this Daruma doll?
Commander, if we don't hurry up, everything will be sold out.
I hope Ariake will like this Daruma doll...
This looks pretty interesting, but so does this... Ah, but, which do you think is better, Commander?
Huh? Ariake? I'm currently looking after Shiratsuyu. After all, someone has to keep an eye on her, right?
A lucky bag lottery draw, huh? I wonder if Shigure is going to try her hand...
Eh, my tail...? I, I'll be careful!
Commander, everyone's looking at us!
Commander, want to try on this fox mask? ...Yes, it looks great on you~

I was really looking forward to playing with you at the beach, Commander, so I changed into this swimsuit. Umm... Ariake told me that I had to choose something that was easy to move around in, and cute enough to make you lose your mind... Was she pulling my leg?

I was really looking forward to playing with you at the beach, Commander, so I changed into this swimsuit. Umm... Ariake told me that I had to choose something that was easy to move around in, and cute enough to make you lose your mind... Was she pulling my leg?
The weather has been great all day. It's perfect for swimming or sunbathing.
Commander, what do you think is the proper way to play on the beach? ...You want to hear my opinion instead? Um, I... I think I like the stuff the kids do...
First, do some stretching... Okay! It's finally time for my debut match of beach volleyball, right? Ariake is watching me too, so I've got to do my best!
Wearing a fancy swimsuit like this is a little embarrassing for me. C-Commander, do you think something easier to move around in like what Wakaba is wearing would be better?
Making a sand castle is a lot harder than I expected... How did Takao and the others manage to build something like THAT...?
Shall I bring you some fruit juice?
Mmgh... The sun's making me all sweaty... Hwaah?! Commander??
Hatsuharu taught me that adding a twang of salt to watermelon brings out a completely different flavor. If you'd like to give it a try... It's great, isn't it? I'm glad you liked it!
Battle complete. This is a victory that Ariake and the others can be proud of!
Ariake-class destroyer, Yuugure, has completed retrofitting. Ehehe, from now on... Ariake and I will be in your care once more, Commander.
Ariake-class destroyer, Yuugure, has completed retrofitting. Ehehe, from now on... Ariake and I will be in your care once more, Commander.
Here you go, Commander. Um, your tea! It's Ariake's favorite kind, but I do not know if it will be to your liking or not...
I feel like I've gotten a little taller after my retrofit... and it makes Ariake seem shorter in comparison... Ugh...
(whispers) Hatsushimo, you'll trouble Commander if you do that! ...I-I wasn't saying anything!
Wakaba, Commander, I have some walnut daifuku for you. Um, huh...? You don't need the wrapping...?
Welcome back, Commander. I'm preparing tea for Ariake, so please wait a moment for me to bring you yours.
A commission has been completed. Commander, please make sure to stockpile our resources for construction.
Hiei, this time... I swear...!
Ariake, Commander, I did it! Mhm... I really won!
The gentle sea breeze, the warm sunlight, and the sound of waves upon the beach... Every day here at port is filled with happiness, because I can be together with both you and Ariake...
Kagerou-class destroyer number three - Kuroshio.

Third ship of the Kagerou-class, Kuroshio. As part of the 2nd Fleet and Destroyer Division 15, I joined in the Battle of the Java Sea, operations in the South Pacific, the Third Battle of the Solomon Islands, and other engagements until I was sunk during a transport mission. ... I will not let that happen again. I will commit all of my resources to ensure that I am of service to Your Grace.
Third ship of the Kagerou-class, Kuroshio reporting in... I am here to carry out my master's will.
Your Grace, welcome home.
Your Grace... Please don't stare at me so...
Hm...? Your Grace? Did you want me to say something?
I am not sure what to say... But I would be happy to listen to anything Your Grace wishes to impart.
The flower in my hair? It was a gift from Oyashio. Oyashio, she's... very colorful.
Kuroshio, awaiting orders.
As this body belongs to Your Grace, please do with it as you will... Nnng... Aaaah...
Your Grace, a new mission has been issued.
Your Grace, mission rewards have been issued. Inspect them at your leisure.
Your Grace, a letter has arrived.
Your Grace, are you tired? Is there any way I can be of assistance to you?
Your Grace, the fleet you dispatched on commission has returned as scheduled.
I stand ready to execute your will.
Naught but death awaits those who oppose my master.
I am Your Grace's shadow. I have no need of glory or acclaim.
Your Grace, it is time to retreat. I will cover your withdrawal.
Secret Technique - Heavenly Purification!
... Your orders?
A true ninja has no need of emotion. She needs only her master's will to execute.
While I struggle with Your Grace's concepts of "communication" and "games," still... I... can't say I dislike them.
Your Grace, I beg your pardon. Recently I find myself distracted from the mission, thinking again and again about Your Grace's "communication." Please, you must punish me...

So this is an "emotion"... before such things I had no problem keeping a clear head, but even now it seems not so wicked... Yes, this "emotion" drives a powerful need to stand by Your Grace's side, and it grows ever stronger.

I once thought that absolute devotion to the mission was all there was to being a ninja, but I have learned so much from you, Commander... I, Kuroshio, from this point forward, am no longer your shadow alone, Commander, I am now your partner. And we will stand together until the end of our days.
Did I earn this in any way?
For the master...!
Kagerou-class destroyer number four - Oyashio.

I'm the fourth ship of the Kagerou-class, Oyashio. I've always been close with Kuroshio. She can tell you everything you need to know, so just ask her~♪ Oh, unless...? You'd rather I act it out for you?
My big sister is a ninja, and I'm a puppeteer. Isn't it amazing how diverse our world is~? I'm the fourth ship of the Kagerou-class, Oyashio. And with my puppet Kuro, I will dazzle you, Commander.
Commander, how are you today? Would you care to enjoy one of my famous puppet shows? Come on! How about it?
Commander, don't I look ninja-like when I do this with my hands? Ehehe, that's because Kuro taught me~
Commander, will you come to watch my show when you have free time?
Kuro is my dear friend! Her namesake is obvious, isn't it? My oh so serious big sister!
Of course the strings are a puppetry thing. So why do I put torpedoes on them? Ahaha... Let's call it an old trade secret.
Commander, isn't it amazing how nurturing Oyashio is? ... Er! I'm talking about the ocean current!
Huh?! Grraagh! ... Oh, Commander, I'm sorry... that's just how we've been trained in this line of work...
Commander, let's go knock out one of those new missions~ I need to get some new material♪
Commander, the mission rewards are here~ Let me see if there's any props I can use in there♪
Commander, guess which torpedo has your mail in it? If you're wrong... well, it probably won't blow up♪
Kuro, why don't you give the Commander a massage? Yes, I think hopping around the shoulders should do the trick?
Commander~ The commission's done.
Oooh! I just came up with a new idea for a show!
Come one, come all!
And thus, the Commander led our fleet to another victory! That's the end of this episode!
Ugh! Commander! Quickly, take the others and run!
The fun has only just begun, right~♪
No matter what you do, Commander, Kuroshio has no problem following you... But I'm not so forgiving. For her sake, Commander, en garde!
Commander, would you like to watch my show? By all means, come on over and take a seat~ The more the merrier, after all!
As a ninja, my sister is always very serious... And since I'm a puppeteer, I always thought it would be nice to make her laugh sometimes. That's kind of a tall order though, ahaha...

Commander, you're awesome. Not only do you know what I'm thinking, but you help me get through to everyone else... One day, I'm going to make Kuroshio laugh, and I know you'll definitely be there to see it!
Commander, I thought it would be great to be as clear-headed as Kuroshio... But there's no way I could. I like Kuroshio, I like you, and I like puppet shows. That's just who I am.
And so the Commander and Oyashio lived happily ever after for all the rest of their days... Ehehe, even if the audience might get sick of it, I'm hoping the rest of our story is a long, happy comedy♪
Eheh~♪ As thanks, shall I act out a story for you?
Yuubari-class light cruiser - Yuubari.

I am Yuubari, Sakura Empire Yuubari-class light cruiser. I was developed under the constraints of a naval treaty, but this conversely allowed me to utilize a great number of new technologies. I served as the flagship of a Destroyer Squadron in the Pacific War. Hmm... I will need many oxygen torpedoes if I am to research them...
I am light cruiser Yuubari. You say we've met before, Master? Hmm... b-but that's not possible... I don't have any sisters after all...
With you by my side, Master, I have nothing to fear...!
Be they canisters or weaponry, my developments in them are the latest!
*Yawn*...
Melon bread? I'm extraordinarily curious as to how it tastes...
The Gatos are terrifying... Why are such frightening submarines named after a catshark?
Your hand is so warm and gentle, Master~
Mmh... ugh... gah... stop, or I will bite!
You have incomplete missions... Hmm, it appears the results of my research will not be of any use...
Master, I believe it is time for a nap once you've finished your missions.
Hmm, this mail seems questionable... Master, I urge you to open it!
Data collection complete. Now we shall use it to improve our gear.
A commission is done! Hmm, I wonder if they brought us gifts...
Hmm... It seems to be a bit too tight in here...
Combat trial for new equipment... begin!
Surely by now, you've begun to understand the importance of developing new gear, Master?
Dear me! ... Once I'm done developing new gear, I won't lose like this again!
Feel the power of my advanced weapons!
Oww... No issue, as long as my equipment is fine...
Master, could you just stay away from me?
Master, what's on your mind when you stare at me? Hohoho, I'm rather perceptive, I'll have you know!
I much prefer staying in the port than going on sorties. This is my home; by the blue seas, beneath the warm and dazzling sunlight... *Yawn*... Mmhh... Zzzz...
What girls are your type, Master? Someone like me? You know, my type is people like you, Master~
Do you want to nap with me, Master? Take this, it is my favorite pillow. Perhaps if you sleep on it, you will see me in your dreams. And if you do... Hehehe♪
I'm overjoyed♪ Starting today, every day when you wake up, the first thing you'll see in the morning is me~! Hehehe♪
Hawawa! I really like this~ Thank you, Master!
I've finally finished developing my new equipment! Since we still have time, let's go and try it out in live combat right now, Master!
I've finally finished developing my new equipment! Since we still have time, let's go and try it out in live combat right now, Master!
Master, are you here to help me gather data today?
Akashi is really enthusiastic about helping my research, but it feels like she has some ulterior motives...
Research always comes with failure... but with your support, Master, all these difficulties will pass!
Nnh... I'm a bit tired... Can I rest here for a while?
The way I am now, I won't be afraid even if I run into a Gato-class, probably...
Master, you have to remember to get some rest, all right?
Augh... I'm going to smack you!
Hehe, looks like the data collection went well this time too.
Master, have you realized the importance of having modernized equipment?
Hmm... Looks like I haven't upgraded my equipment enough...
First ship of the Nagara-class light cruisers, Nagara.

I'm the first ship of the Nagara-class light cruisers from the Sakura Empire. I took part in various battles in the Solomon Seas and in the center Pacific. During Midway, I took over Akagi's role as flagship after she sank and then coordinated our retreat. In the end, though, I too met the fate of being sunk by a submarine...
Eheh, I'm Nagara. Commader, have you been anticipating my arrival?
Hey, hey~ Commander, were you daydreaming again?
What kind of girl do you like, Commander? Hehe. Oh yeah?
You need to change clothes after getting soaked... Hey, do you want to borrow mine?
It's great that Abukuma is finally making friends, but...
Commander~ Your face is so~ cute~!
Have you run into any trouble, Commander?
Sometimes I really don't understand what you're trying to do, Commander...
If it's just taking a break once in a while, I think I can let that go.
Wow, finished already? Well done, Commander!
Hehe, Commander~! You've got new mail~!
It's great to see that you returned safe and sound, Commander~!
Commissions? That's part of my job too.
Oxygen Torpedoes.....I want.......
Who is the enemy this time?
I hope every battle goes as well as this one did~!
*Cries* Commander, let's retreat...
Hehe, are you ready?
Come on, Commander, cheer up~!
Hmm... What should I cook for my little sisters tonight?
Commander? Oh, nothing. I just wanted to say hi!
An escort? That's my specialty. And this time? Ah, going to port with you, undercover?!
Yesterday, I saw a side of my sisters that I hadn't seen before... Commander, do you want to see a side of me you haven't before? Hm... what should I do?
... Hey~ Commander, are you ready? Okay, I'm closing my eyes...
Ehehe~ Thanks!
Hatsuharu, be more careful this time~ Hehehe~
Good evening, Commander. This room...? Ah, it's a special Dragon Empery-themed set I bought from Akashi's. It looks pretty snazzy and was on sale, so I picked it up. Ehehe~
Good evening, Commander. This room...? Ah, it's a special Dragon Empery-themed set I bought from Akashi's. It looks pretty snazzy and was on sale, so I picked it up. Ehehe~
Commander, want some tea?
Commander, how do you plan on spending your Spring Festival? Me? ...Well, chilling in my room with a cup of tea sounds pretty good, or reading a book, or rolling around. Ehehe~
Commander, have you seen Kinu? I told her I'd clean her ears, but she sure bailed quick... Seriously, what's wrong with cleaning your sister's ears...?
Commander, you know, Abukuma started having tea with me, and will even let me clean her ears! Ehehe, th
Commander, want me to clean your ears too? Sure, come here then~ *pat* *pat*
Jeez, Commander, don't blame me if I poke a hole in your eardrum~
Look, Commander, the tea stalk is floating upright. I'm sure something good is going to happen today~

Whispering to you while cleaning your ear like this... kind of makes it seem like we're a couple, doesn't it? Hehe, forget I said anything. All right, all done. You can stay here and chat a bit more if you'd like~?
Second ship of the Nagara-class light cruisers, Isuzu.

Sakura Empire, Nagara-class light cruiser, Isuzu, reporting in! I participated in battles at the Lesser Sunda Islands, Solomon Islands, and Guadalcanal. I've fought alongside many famous ships, so you've got to work hard to try and have as good of a reputation as I do!
Woah! You... you scared me~! Oh, it's you, my Commander! I'm Isuzu... You're not here to pick on me, are you?
Aaaaaah!!! Commander! Don't scare me like that...
*Cries*... I'm so glad that you're still this gentle with me, Commander...
Torpedoes are truly frightening...
It feels creepy at night without any lights on, don't you think...?
I've seen plenty of things in this world! You won't scare me so easily.
Commander... you're so warm...
Uwa! It's touching me! It's touching me!
Commander, I think you've still got a lot of unfinished work to do.
Mission rewards delivered! I wonder if there's anything good...
Commander, you've got new mail! I hope there aren't any curses written on them...
*Cries*... Only you wouldn't pick on me, Commander...
The girls have completed their commissions! I hope they didn't bring anything strange back...
Did I... get stronger?
Nothing weird is going to pop out, right?
Vi- victory? Commander, how did I do?
*Cries* ... Are they all demons?
I... I'm not scared!
Is Commander a demon?
*Cries*... Are ghosts scary because they don't exist in this world?
Ah? A midnight adventure? That... it's not a good idea, is it? No, I'm not afraid!
*Cries*... There definitely was something strange there just now! I already said a midnight adventure was a bad idea!
You... you're going to protect me from anything that appears? You're... you're just making fun of me again, Commander... I'm not blushing! It's just a little hot...
*Cries*... I hope you aren't messing with me, Commander! I'll never feel scared again, as long as you're with me... Can I trust you, Commander?
Wow, I like this! Thank you!
There's many monsters roaming around during Halloween... B-but I'm not scared, okay?! ... Umm, err, uh... Can I hold your hand?
There's many monsters roaming around during Halloween... B-but I'm not scared, okay?! ... Umm, err, uh... Can I hold your hand?
C-C-C-Commander! Trick or... o-or... I can't do it...!
A-all those Halloween monsters are just people in costumes, right?! ... There aren't any real ones roaming around, right?!
Monsters aren't real... Monsters aren't real... M-m-monsters aren't real....!
W-w-why do they make even the pumpkins look scary?!
L-l-looks like everyone's enjoying Halloween... I-I-I-I'm not shuddering, okay?!
You make me feel safer than anyone else, Commander...
*Eeek*?! I-I'll turn you into a frog!
If only I could board the pumpkin carriage and meet the prince of my... What?! Commander, h-how long have you been here?! D-don't stare at my face! *Sob*...
Commander? I only came here to help wrap up all the presents for tomorrow, n-not because the fireplace is too cozy and I don't want to get up...
Commander? I only came here to help wrap up all the presents for tomorrow, n-not because the fireplace is too cozy and I don't want to get up...
Two people sitting in front of the fireplace like this... feels a bit like family.
My sisters wanted to dress up as Santa Claus and go around handing presents to kids... I didn't go with them because I'm not good with the dark.
It's so cozy right next to the fireplace... There are even fuzzy Manjuus to cuddle~
Um... Commander, what kind of presents should I give to everyone?
I've already done my research. There are no ghost stories or anything of the sort related to Christmas... R-right, Commander?
Are... you trying to share my body heat?
I knew it! You were trying to take advantage of me!
I was told that this outfit would be good for wearing around the house, but it's a bit too loose... S-stop staring at me already.

I'm not really sure how Christmas should be celebrated. But just sitting next to you in front of the fireplace like this... is probably fine. Commander, i-it's a bit cold... I'd like to get a little closer...
Wooah! ...I fell down again... But at least it's cooler now... Huh? A photoshoot? Noo, don't take a picture of me~
Wooah! ...I fell down again... But at least it's cooler now... Huh? A photoshoot? Noo, don't take a picture of me~
I wasn't trying to spill the juice! ...Sorry...
I had no idea donning a mascot suit was so demanding... Fubuki used to wear these all the time... That's way too insane...
Haah... I wonder if I should take a little breather... It's so nice and cool...
Card games? N-no way, that'd be way too hard...
C-Commander, thank goodness you were here this whole time...
Ugh... I knew you'd take advantage of this opportunity to tease me...
Mascot outfits are so hard to move around in... It's all dark and stuffy inside... Ugh...

W-w-woah! W-wait up! You guys are going too fast! I'm gonna fall! I'm gonna faaaaall! You're supposed to carry me in a way that doesn't give me a heart attack!! Commander, something crazy seems to have happened with my cavalry~!!
Retrofit complete! ...Umm, Commander? ...Wh-what's the matter? Do I really look that different...?!
Retrofit complete! ...Umm, Commander? ...Wh-what's the matter? Do I really look that different...?!
Gyah?! ...Commander, are you trying to scare me on purpose?!
Commander, you've always been so kind to me~ Thank you~
Y-you saw something weird?! Wh-wh-where?! ...Jeez! Don't scare me like that!
Nagara said that I looked cuter before, but I think that's just because she likes to dote on me...!
Kinu seems like the dependable type, but she sometimes gives off really scary vibes... Ugh, I just don't understand her.
Commander, did I become a bit more dependable?
I... I'm not scared!
Welcome back, Commander! I used to cuddle up to you after you got back from a sortie? D-did something like that happen? I think my memory's a bit fuzzy~ Aha...haha...
The girls in the commission fleet have come back. Hopefully they didn't bring anything weird back with them?
Leave the anti-air support to me!
I... I'm not afraid anymore!
Nagara-class light cruiser - Natori.

I'm Natori, the third Nagara-class ship! As a light cruiser of the Sakura Empire, I often tell people that I fight with single-mounted guns and water scouting craft... But that is a ruse! For I am the incarnation of a dragon! My strength shatters boulders (with cannonballs) and soars over the sea (with my rigging)! So? Impressed?

"Nuo ho ho! So this young whippersnapper here's the Commander! You don't look all that reliable to me~!" ...Argh, do not interrupt me when I am speaking! Ahem- I am the strongest light cruiser Natori, and this is my partner, Old Man Hiranuma! Nice to meet you!
♪~ I'm just so strong that I suffer from success~ Commander, join me! ...Not for work! For fun!
Hmph. Let me share some little-known information with you, Commander. These aren't oni horns; they're dragon horns! Isn't that incredible? "Yes, yes, a dragon. I say so, and that means it is fact!"
I must pass a trial to unlock my true power, no? Come with me when the time is right, Commander!
Ah, I'm hungry... Oh, Commander! Hey, treat me to a meal! "I desire pudding for dessert!"
"By the way, there are plenty of ways to raise your attributes~ For example, these stats..." Old man, would you just cut to the chase and tell me how?!
W-wait, Nagara! I-I'll clean it up, I promise, just don't throw away my manga... I know! Yura, let me hide them in your room for a little while!
Nngh, do not stroke my hair so casually!
...Mm? What? Do you need me?
What are you doing to me?!
You STILL haven't finished your missions? Ugh, you average people... I'd have them done in the blink of an eye.
Huh? The Commander's missions are finished already?! Old man, why didn't you tell me?!
If only there was some convenient feature that lets you know with an icon that you had unread mail... "You rely too much on humans. Here, I will notify the whippersnapper."
Ooh~ You've finished your work! Then the workday is over! Maybe I'll go shopping with Nagara, or...
Did you notice the commission girls are back? Heheh, you're not bad if you can keep up with my super senses.
Ooh! My power... My power is surging! My stats are going through the roof!
I could defeat you all with one pinky finger.
Did you think you could withstand a dragon's might? "I've never seen a more foolish foe!"
This is not defeat! It's strategic withdrawal!
Behold, my latent power!
Kh, I'm fine! If I use my cheat skills, I can make it out of this...!
Everything you say is a cheap lie. I don't trust you...
I'll share this with you alone, Commander. If I close one eye and push like this, I can shoot laser beams! Or so this old geezer says. I've never tried, because it's far too destructive.
I see, I see. So you finally understand my strength. That's right! I can use this ability to triple the price of toys in the port stores! ...Hm? What is that good for?
You just don't understand. If I can triple prices, then I can resell what I purchase for massive profits! Jealous? ...Y-you're not jealous?!
Hmm, my "affinity" stat has gone up too high. My old man says this is going to interfere with my daily work! Commander, what do you plan to do about this?!
Oh, I can't leave your side anymore, Commander... You always look after me, and you listen to the things I say... That's just unfair! What is this, your trap?! Is that it?!
Eh?! What? For me? Really?! Wooow! Thank you!
Alriiight! Naka, it's time to charge in!
Isuzu, can I follow behind you?
Keep your eyes forward, or you'll run into me, Abukuma!
Requesting air support, Kadekuru!

ex.line: C-Commander! You're late, I've been waiting forever, I was so bored! You're spending all day with me, got it? Our schedule is packed with plans!
Yura has a useful helper, just like me. Commander, why don't you call your favorite girl and have her do the same?! ...Me? Hmph, I'm too important to be YOUR helper, Commander.
I can use magic, you know. What kind? It's search magic that tells me wherever you are! Heheh, incredible, no?
Hrmmm... How can I do away with my old man's prying eyes when I want to be alone with the Commander? "For goodness' sake, stop trying to blind me..."
How can I draw the Commander's eye... Haruna, a hint, please?! Something that doesn't involve fists or food would be nice!!
A request, for me? Heheh, go on♪
Huh? You still have work left, you know. What's wrong, Commander?! Are you sick, or something?!
You finished your work already?! The fact that you told me before my old man could... Impressive, Commander!
Mm. I spent all my money on treats to eat with the Commander... Old man, is that get-rich-quick scheme you told me about real?! ...Whoa! Commander?
Heheh, don't even think about calling me an imposter!
"That whippersnapper's leadership was spectacular." WRONG! It was my charisma that carried the day!
No matter what, my "affinity" stat just won't stop rising. Don't these normally have some kind of cap?! ...Ah! Could it be that you have cheat abilities like me, Commander?!

lines.line: Mmfhuhu~♡ What's the matter, Commander? Enraptured by my charms? Heehee, you're frozen in place! You can't begin to think of how to compliment me, can you? "Enough staring, out with the compliments!"
Mmfhuhu~♡ What's the matter, Commander? Enraptured by my charms? Heehee, you're frozen in place! You can't begin to think of how to compliment me, can you? "Enough staring, out with the compliments!"
Mmfhuhu~♪ I'm a little different from the usual today, right? I'm sure you can figure out how, Commander♪
I've made everything up to the castle keep. At this rate, the sand castle competition is all but won... Heheh, now, time to go laugh at the others— "A giant wave is approaching! Watch ooout!"
Mhmhm... Very, very interesting! I see your passionate gaze upon me, Commander! That gaze is the essence of summer!
Even the fish are knocked cold by my charms. Now's your chance for a big catch!
I'd say my sensuality matches even Isuzu's now, no? See, old man? Even the Commander is speechless!
Mmmm... There! My special ability allowed me to sense your approach! Incredible, no?!
Grr! My skin is too fine for you to be touching it so freely!

Phew~ I am beat! Time for some juice and rest... Hey, old man! Do I have the power to create juice out of thin air? "You might be able to make fried chicken, but no juice, kiddo. Have that whippersnapper buy you some."

Heheh♪ The brightest star in the venue, she with the power to shake the earth - none other than Natori, of course! Go on, Commander, and kneel before me~ "Nuo ho ho, even the whippersnapper is amazed!"

Heheh♪ The brightest star in the venue, she with the power to shake the earth - none other than Natori, of course! Go on, Commander, and kneel before me~ "Nuo ho ho, even the whippersnapper is amazed!"
Heheh~ You've arrived, Commander! Get ready quickly and come with me! It takes two to play, of course.
Phew... Using my power indiscriminately has left me hungry. Commander~ Let's go get some food soon!
Food Protection Magic, activate! When food is about to fall on the floor, it will float for not just three seconds, but ten! Ahahaha, incredible, isn't it? "Nuo ho ho, how strong you've grown!"
Commander, I hereby declare that you have become mine - an Adherent of the Dragon! "Becoming an adherent is apparently a big deal, whippersnapper! Give her your full support!"
Whoa?! Commander, how did you... Have you awakened a new power?
Nuo ho ho~ Do you want a taste of my power, Commander?
I'm gonna faaall!
Must you constantly worry about missions even while we party? Why not just leave it all to me and the old man here?
"Whippersnapper, the mission is complete!" Aren't you glad you had us to help? Ahaha!
Commander, you're finally back! Heheh, while you were gone, I took control of this entire venue!

Heheheh~ Commander! Once the party's over, let's go raise hell somewhere else! In fact, I found a way to stop my "affection" stat from rising infinitely! So now - w-wait! No touching! You're putting all of my efforts to waste!
Nagara-class light cruiser number four - Yura.
