I am the Nagara-class light cruiser, Yura. In a certain great war, I was the flagship of the Fourth Torpedo Squadron for a short period of time. I might have taken my leave earlier than my sister ships in that war, but this time, I swear that my Self will remain until the bitter end.

Um... Would you happen to know where the Commander might be? My name is Yura, and I have just arrived here today. Are you the Commander? Um, do you have a signed note or certificate that corroborates that?
Commander, um... good job making your way over here.
Sometimes, I feel like I'm not quite myself... That must be my other Self...
Commander, if you're concerned that the tea is too hot... Um, should I blow on it for you?
Abukuma, I don't think that "only eating and sleeping" is a healthy lifestyle. I'm wrong about that? Well...
The destroyers are... well, they're always so full of energy and zipping about, that it's honestly a bit hard to keep pace with them...
Even when we can't see her, my Self is always by my side.
You want to know more about my Self? Do I think she has some kind of special connection with the meaning of my name...? I sometimes wonder myself.
Would you like to touch my horns?
Did you need something from me?
I have no choice but to become your wife now, Commander. Hehe~
Oh, Commander, I really think you shouldn't be neglecting these missions...
Oh, speaking of which... I haven't told you to receive the mission rewards yet... have I?
Shall my Self read it aloud for you?
It's good to see you, welcome back. I apologize, for I don't really know where to put these papers...
The girls are back from commissions. If you require assistance, shall my Self accompany you?
Oh, I feel something awakening inside me...
I'd like to wait a bit more and see what the situation is like...
My Self played a big role as well. I'll have to thank her for her help.
It might be better to withdraw first...
Safety first.
We should get back into formation.
I wonder if the fortune that foretold "calamity" was referring to you...
Commander, if there's nothing for me to do, I'll be heading to the shrine behind the mountain to help out.
You want to know more about my Self? Well, she's also a part of me... Mm, if I were to put it simply, she's kind of like my familiar.

Your fortune said that bad luck would follow you around, so I, along with Abukuma and the others, made a protective charm that will ward off evil. Please be careful, and always carry this around with you.
Whenever I think of you, I always worry that something bad might have happened to you. Please, stay with my Self's... no, my side. That way, I won't have to worry.
Oh, to think that I'd be able to become your betrothed, Commander. ...Is this truly alright? Hehe, I'm so happy that I lost my composure... Thank you.
Is this really for me? Thank you so much!
Well... Let's try to stay safe.
My friend? Mm, I'm not sure what you mean...
Can you see my Self?

ex.line: Commander, um... it's great to see you again!
My Self is a very good girl. I'm sure that you'll be able to get along with her just as well as you do with me. Hehe~
Were you helping Kinu out with her training? Ehe... Would you mind if I came over to watch?
If you would ever like to see my Self, please let me know. I really love having conversations with her.
If you're ever worried that you're being possessed by something, do let me know. I'm fairly confident in my ability to exorcise spirits.
I pulled a lucky fortune while at the shrine earlier today. I'm sure something good is going to happen soon!
Heehee~
Um... did you need something from me?
My, aren't you quite the prankster?
I can feel the power flowing through me...
You shouldn't underestimate my Self's power or the Commander's tactics.
I must thank my Self for protecting us... Oh, is everyone safe?
Just as my Self stays by my side and protects me, I would like to stay by your side and protect you. At your side, always... Hehehe~♪

lines.line: Uh... I think these clothes are a bit too much... Commander, I... don't look out of place in these, do I...?
Uh... I think these clothes are a bit too much... Commander, I... don't look out of place in these, do I...?
Commander, um... W-welcome...?
When I'm wearing these clothes, I feel like I'm going to be exorcised... What do you think about them, Commander?
A succubus is a being that tempts people in their dreams... I-I'd never do anything like that!
Isuzu, it's me, Yura! I'm not a ghost, you don't need to be afraid of me!
I don't know if today is a day of celebration, but everyone seems to be more lively than usual. I wonder if the Commander will be all right dealing with them...
It seems that thou are doing well. Hehe. Commander, do you perhaps prefer my Self to me?
Oh, did you need something?
Maybe you were the real succubus all along. Hehe.
The wings are slipping off... Is there a mirror somewhere...?
I'll seduce you, alright. Hehe.
Nagara-class light cruiser number five - Kinu.

I am the Nagara-class light cruiser, Kinu. My name derives from Kinugawa, meaning "furious and violent like a demon's wrath." I live up to my name, but trust me - that is not something that you would want to see.
I'm Kinu. If you want this demon to do your bidding, then you'd better show me what you're capable of!
Hurry up and make today's plans.
You're welcome to inspect the other stuff, but you'd be best off not casually touching my demonic raiments.
Somebody I can't stand? I guess that'd be Nagara. She's the- Whuah, Nagara?! W-Wait, don't get any closer! MMPH, URMMMPHHH!
A new model of oxygen torpedo...? I say, do get me one of those. I promise I'll draw out every bit of its power.
My cloak's pretty cool? Heh~ you think so too, huh? ...Hey, stop trying to slack off!
Don't go around touching my head.
You want to duel me? Don't worry, I'll give you a handicap.
Really? Are you trying to get me mad?
Don't forget about your missions. A soldier must fulfill the orders of their superiors.
Accept these rewards. You've earned this privilege.
I've already highlighted the important parts for you, Commander.
You look like you're in a good mood. Are you the type that gets motivated the more you work?
The commission team must be getting impatient from waiting.
I won't be able to test whether or not this strengthening worked outside of live combat.
Just bring it on already!
Make an enemy of me, and your defeat is already ensured.
Even I have become obsolete...?
Don't even think about running!
Ahaha! Now you shall witness the form of a true demon!
Cowards shall never control a demon.
You may look like someone who is too gentle to hurt a fly, yet you have control over this entire port. I'm a little interested in you.
I've heard that Yuubari is responsible for developing new equipment. If possible, could you ask her to upgrade my equipment? For example, starting with my torpedoes...

How about letting me treat you to a couple cups of sake tonight? Hah, don't worry, I just want to have a normal chat. Having a heart-to-heart over some fine spirits... what greater comfort in life is there?
I feel like I can entrust myself to you. Is this where the demon finally finds her home...? Commander, if I was to become the blade you wield, how would you use it?
Commander, you are the worthy one who has conquered a demon. Let us commemorate today's vow, and aim for greater strength together.
How'd you find what my favorite- ...Never mind, that isn't important. Thank you very much.
Be careful; don't let your guard down.
Hey Aoba, don't make me carry you back again.
Want to lend me your torpedo next time?
Grr! What are you here for? Speak up. ...Oh, you just wanted to take a tour of the club activities? Sorry 'bout that, I don't like getting disturbed in the middle of this kind of training.
Grr! What are you here for? Speak up. ...Oh, you just wanted to take a tour of the club activities? Sorry 'bout that, I don't like getting disturbed in the middle of this kind of training.
Just finished my daily practice swings. Time to get back to work.
What Takao is doing can't be considered a club activity... No, I didn't mean anything by it. I just do what I like.
Unless you are a genius, you can never depart from the fundamentals. Even if you are a genius, you cannot afford to neglect the fundamentals either. That is the nature of swordsmanship.
Prince of Wales and Repulse, huh? ...Hmph. I'd never call them cowards.
Isuzu clearly is also an oni, but she's somehow afraid of ghosts. Me...? Guh, I suppose I can't deny that...!
These little manjuu hardly make for good sparring partners. How about taking their place?
You've received a lot of New Year's greetings, Commander. Remember to take a look at them.
Calligraphy and swordsmanship both hone the body and the mind. Commander, how'd these words come out?
Sorry, but these riggings are the real deal.
Well? I've still got one card in my hand. If you want to win, then show me everything you've got! I will not have you disrespect me just for wearing a silly costume!
Well? I've still got one card in my hand. If you want to win, then show me everything you've got! I will not have you disrespect me just for wearing a silly costume!
Eyes on your cards, idiot. This is not a staring competition... Wh-what? Are you hoping to unnerve me or something?
Hey! Don't let any submarines near the wine! That goes for you too, Commander.
What...? No, I'm not "cute!" I don't consider that a compliment!
Cheaters can go to hell! Play fair, or don't play at all! Right, Commander?
You'd be an idiot to underestimate the demon.
S-so my costume is just that seductive, huh?
Give me a minute, I need to put on makeup... Just need to do like Isuzu showed me... There! I'm all ready now.
Come! I will determine whether your hand is good enough or not!
That's it? I've still got the demon card in my hand!
Dammit! You've ruined my tights and skirt!
Retrofit complete... Look forward to commanding the might of the demon ascended. I shall not disappoint you!
Retrofit complete... Look forward to commanding the might of the demon ascended. I shall not disappoint you!
My oni mask? Ah, it's on the other side now. With my self-evident power, there is no need to flaunt such things.
This time, I won't resign myself to obsolescence!
Darn that Aoba... With how she's always absent-mindedly flitting about, what is she going to do when she ends up in actual danger?
This mantle was specifically made for me. See, look here, and here as well... Gah! ...Ahem! Sorry, I got carried away. I just wanted to make sure you knew.
If you want to spar with me, you'd better think thrice. One slip of the hand, and it won't be just a flesh wound that we're dealing with.
Ugh... I'm still a woman, you know! Have you no sense of decency?!
This is a true oni's wrath!
Sixth ship of the Nagara-class light cruisers, Abukuma.

Nagara-class light cruiser, Abukuma. I've spent most of my time in the First Torpedo Squadron. Although I look aggressive, I actually prefer other things like fishing and just cruising around... just like when I was at Kiska. Perhaps protecting others is a more suitable job for me.
Hi, Commander... I'm Abukuma. What are you looking at? My horns? Don't mistake me for Kitakami or Ooi...
Welcome back. Want to try some fresh torpedoes?
Don't push yourself too much, Commander!
Commander, shall we go fishing? How about a game of chess?
My name seems a bit complicated, but it's actually easy to read. Why don't you try it?
Dress up? Oh... these socks are actually pretty easy to take off. Want to try yourself?
Be quiet, Commander.
Want to have a taste of my torpedoes, Commander?
We're starting a new mission. Got it?
These rewards aren't so bad...
You've got new mail!
Did everyone make it back in one piece?
Commander, shall we return to port and do some fishing? The girls seem to be back from their commission as well.
This isn't a bad feeling at all...
First Torpedo Squadron, Abukuma, Moving out!
I'm number one? Hm... I don't feel anything special...
Everyone, prepare to retreat... I'll cover the rear!
Everyone.... Gangway
Don't panic... wait for the right moment to strike!
Don't touch me...
What's wrong? If it's nothing then stay quiet, Commander.
I look trigger happy? I actually prefer being an escort more than I do engaging in combat...
Commander, should we go fishing today? Oh, there's work to do? I'll wait for you to finish then... Oh? No, it's fine! I'm more than happy to stay with you, Commander.
I'm just a normal Abukuma... no one has ever cursed me to become a demon. If someone tries to hurt you though, Commander, I might just turn right into a demon!

It's not for the other sisters in First torpedo squadron, but for me? Is that really alright? Ahh, this makes me happier than that one miraculous victory......thank you, Commander, I shall treat it as my most precious treasure.
...This means a lot to me.
Combat retrofit complete! First Torpedo Squadron flagship, Abukuma, ready to sortie any time!
Combat retrofit complete! First Torpedo Squadron flagship, Abukuma, ready to sortie any time!
Have you finally memorized my name? Just read it out. You can give it a few tries~
My expression seems a bit softer now? It's because I like the fleet and the Commander more than I did before~!
Commander, did you call for me?
Hey! Commander, you're going to be eating torpedoes if you keep this up!
I brought back the rewards, Commander!
I've prepared snacks for everyone. Commander, there's some for you too! Come dig in!
The most important thing is that everyone stays safe.
Mogami-class Heavy Cruiser no. 1 - Mogami

I am Mogami, nameship of the Mogami-class... on paper, anyway. After what happened to Mikuma and Nachi at Midway, I have no right to call myself that anymore... In any case, feel free to hand me your work, but just don't expect much.
Mogami, reporting for duty... Don't worry too much about me, just leave me be and I'll find my own place to crash.
Welcome back. Huh? You want me to say it with more emotion? Sorry, chief. Not sure I can help with that one.
Not saying anything makes you look cool? Figures... you would believe something like that.
I wonder what Mikuma is doing right now... Well, I suppose there's nothing to worry about. She's not like me, after all...
Are you sure you want me to be your secretary? Just about anybody else would be better for the job. I'm serious... I'm not just saying that to avoid work.
Perhaps I should get Nachi to teach me how to be a little more cheerful... crap, hope nobody heard that...
You don't have to remind me, I'll get the work done.
Eek!! Commander, are you seriously interested in someone like me...?
I finished organizing the task list. Even I couldn't mess something like this up... probably.
I'll go pick up the mission rewards. Commander, you can just stay put and keep working.
I picked up the mail. Can I leave it here?
Everyone made it back safely. Isn't that enough?
You're going to go greet the commission fleet? I'll just stay here, so I don't end up ramming into someone.
Thanks... What's the matter? Am I not allowed to express gratitude?
Fighting is a drag... but losing is an even bigger drag!
First place, huh. Got a problem with it?
So this is what I'm made of...
I won't fail this time!
Have I spread my misfortune to everyone...?
Well, a hapless fellow like me was bound to get stuck with a hapless commander...
You must really have some strange hobbies, to want to associate with hapless folks like me. Oh well, if it's just talking... I suppose I can entertain you...
My horn, huh... Well, I don't really mind, but... it kind of sticks out, doesn't it? I don't really like the attention... *sigh*...
I already know that Mikuma and Nachi don't hold anything against me, but I can't forgive myself... *sigh*... Huh? My horn is cute?! ...I-idiot...
Um... Commander, uh... maybe, umm, since you said you liked it... would you like to try... t-touching it?
Are you sure you won't regret choosing someone like me? If you say so... I suppose I can put in a bit more effort for our sake... A-anyway, please take care of me...
Hwuh?! Commander... you really are a weirdo...
Mikuma, I'm sorry...
Forgive me, Nachi...
Fusou, exorcism party at your place after we're done here?

Are you sure this is a retrofit and not some weird hazing ritual? I look... Well, I suppose I do feel stronger. Guess I'll try to work a bit harder. Wouldn't hurt for you to look forward to it a little.

Are you sure this is a retrofit and not some weird hazing ritual? I look... Well, I suppose I do feel stronger. Guess I'll try to work a bit harder. Wouldn't hurt for you to look forward to it a little.
Commander, you're back. Huh? I just happen to remember what your footsteps sound like.
I look even cooler now when I don't say anything? Whatever... have it your way...
Recently, Mikuma has been telling me that I have more self-esteem... Not sure about that one though, I don't think I've really changed...
Secretary ship duties? Well, I still think I'm not really cut out for it compared to the others... but if it's what you want, I'll keep doing it.
Commander, be honest. What do you think about my new outfit after the retrofit? Um... if you like it, I suppose we can keep it like this...
Maybe I should go practice using this naginata or something...
There are people waiting for me... so I refuse to lose!
Mogami-class heavy cruiser number two - Mikuma.

I am Mikuma, the second ship of the Mogami-class. I collided with my sister in Midway, but I don't resent her for it. On the contrary: she... Ah, forgive me for changing the topic so suddenly... I shall do everything I can for the fleet, so please give me your orders.
My name is Mikuma. I'm Mogami's little sister. If... if you don't mind, could you please look after her? She has a bit of an unusual personality, you see...
Welcome back. Let's try to get a lot of work done today.
My... horn? If it makes people remember me, then I believe it's not all that bad.
My sister is... probably sitting somewhere, alone, lamenting the past again. Commander, would you please excuse me for a moment?
A secretary should be the Commander's right hand. Please don't hesitate to give me orders.
I was the first heavy cruiser to sink in the war... Oh, never mind, it was nothing important.
I'm standing by. Please give me your orders.
... Commander, please be wary of accidental discharges from my cannons.
I have organized the mission rewards, Commander. Could you confirm them, please?
I have completed my inspection of the mission rewards, Commander.
Here is the letter that arrived today, Commander.
Outstanding performance, Commander.
A commission has finished, Commander. If you're occupied at the moment, please send me in your stead.
Your kindness is highly appreciated. I swear to repay it one day.
Everyone, on me!
This is nothing to get thrilled about!
*Gah*...! This will serve as a lesson...!
Loading complete! Main guns, fire!
Don't panic! We still have a chance!
I've gotta warn my sister about how untrustworthy you are...
Pardon me, Commander, I'm occupied with the task you gave me... Okay, how may I help? Communication? Yes, of course, communication is important.

All Mogami-class cruisers were part of Cruiser Division 7, but because Kumano and Suzuya were launched later than me, it was I who had to look after Mogami. And for that reason, they aren't as close to her as I am.
I'm always willing to support my sister, but owing to her somber personality... I don't think anyone but you can truly guide her, Commander...
Jealousy... you say? It's never been on my mind... As long as I have my dear sister and my dear Commander... everything will probably be okay... I think?

Sorry for taking so long, Commander. Huh? I should call you "darling"? Umm... D-darling... This feels a little awkward, but it's something I should slowly get used to. Now, I hope we will be together for many long years.
Thank you very much. I'll continue to give it my all.
Mogami, try not to stray too far from me.
Commander, may you and all our friends enjoy peace and good health... Alright, what did you think? That was a ceremonial dance I'd like to offer to everyone at the main event.
Commander, may you and all our friends enjoy peace and good health... Alright, what did you think? That was a ceremonial dance I'd like to offer to everyone at the main event.
Welcome back, Commander. Mogami should have already started heading back. Did something happen...?
The Commander was staring right at me... Of course I'd be self-conscious, but it's not like what Suzuya said...! Just thinking about it is making me even more self-conscious... *blushes*
My sister seems to be troubled... Commander, let's hear her out together!
I want to see my sister dance, but I'm better suited for an event like this.
Kumano also wants to try dancing? That could be arranged... Wait, no! What if she tears her costume because her movements are too flashy?
My horn... is cute?
Mikuma stands at attention. Please give your orders.
Umm, please mind my main battery... It might explode!
I've finished collecting the mission rewards. I think it's about to go check on my sister...
Mission complete. I'm sure my sister is also pleased by this. Heehee.
I left some drinks in the lounge area for you. Commander, please take this time to rest up.
The commission team has returned. Want to take Suzuya and Kumano with you when you head over?
I actually would've liked my sister to take these honors...

Commander, I'd like you to take better care of my sister instead. Though I don't mind seeing the two of you together, the same can't be said for her. The two of us at the same time...? Um, o-of course that would be possible...
First ship of the Furutaka-class heavy cruisers, Furutaka.

I'm the Furutaka-class heavy... Err, just call me Furutaka! I may not look it, but I participated in the First Battle of the Solomon Sea! I also helped my sister Aoba out a lot! In the end though, I rushed too far ahead and didn't make it back myself... Ehehe...
Ah! Sorry for bumping into you... Huh? You're the Commander?! F-Furutaka, first ship of the Furutaka class, reporting for duty! Can you please forget what just happened? Ehehe...
Commander, please be more careful when you open the door...
I'm a bit bored...
Commander, Kako doesn't really hate you, so don't take it too personally.
Um... because I'm not very smart, maybe Kako should take my place at meetings instead...
Ouch...! Ahh, I'm fine... I just nodded off and bumped my head.
What's up?
I never thought you'd take an interest in me, Commander... Frankly, I'm a bit happy~
A new mission, huh? Seems like it might be a bit tricky.
I bumped into something while getting the rewards... Oww...
Sorry, Commander... I tripped and fell while getting the mail and now it's all wrinkled...
Commander, I tripped again... Do you have a band-aid somewhere?
Commander! Ah... that hurts! I'm fine... I just wanted to tell you that commissions have been completed.
Thanks, Commander!
I have to do well in this battle!
Eh? I'm the MVP?
We lost... Too bad...
All right, here I come!
(Furutaka ignores you as she passes by)
Kako acts like that because she holds herself as the role model for heavy cruisers, but she's actually very gentle.
Commander~ Oww! ...Ehehe... Thanks, I almost fell again. I'm trying to pay more attention so that I don't trip as much, but I was so happy that I let my guard down.
Yeah... Being able to live with Kako and seeing my sisters from the Mikawa and 6th Fleet was always a dream of mine. Commander, you've made my dream come true. That's why... I'll do anything for you!
If you're okay with this... then I don't mind, Commander. But... I've never been in a relationship before, so I don't know what it's like. Can you teach me?
I've never felt like this in my life before... But as long as I'm with you, I'll be able to feel this way more and more, right? I can't wait!
Thanks for getting my favorite gift, Commander!
What's wrong, Commander? Why are you staring at me like that? My body? Yes, some things seem to have gotten bigger... Want to take a look?
What's wrong, Commander? Why are you staring at me like that? My body? Yes, some things seem to have gotten bigger... Want to take a look?
Commander, did you have a good rest? Me? Umm... I slept very well.
I might have changed, but I'm still the same Furutaka, Commander!
Ouch! Ah... I just bumped my head again...
My hair feels a bit messy... maybe Kako can teach me how to tie it up.
Commander~! Want to take a nap together?
Since you like me so much... I suppose it's okay~
It sure is nice weather, isn't it? I feel like taking a nap. Oh? The girls are back from commission~!
I'm much stronger than before!
Don't blame yourself, Aoba! It's fine.
Second ship of Furutaka-class heavy cruisers, Kako.

Second ship of the Furutaka-class heavy cruisers, Kako! I was perhaps the first real heavy cruiser made for my country. Despite contributing to the first Battle of the Solomon Sea, I took too many risks and ended up being sunk by a submarine... My personality? I'm only like this when I'm around you. Open your eyes and learn the advantages of a real heavy cruiser!
Second ship of the Furutaka-class, Kako, ready for orders. Why don't you show me whether you're worthy or not.
Good timing, I just finished sorting your documents. Can you actually finish these?
If you want to say something, just give it to me straight!
This fleet is quite impressive, except for their commander.
You made a mistake here. And here. Do I have to tell you how to do everything?
I wonder how Aoba is doing right now...
Are you an idiot?
Why you little... Hello? Could I speak with the Military Police?
New missions, Commander. Surely you can handle these.
So you can work hard as well, huh? Here are the rewards.
Mail's here. I'm surprised you have so many friends.
Taking a break? Well... since you put in your fair share of work, why don't you set the rest of these files aside for later?
The commission fleet has returned. Do you plan to sit here and wait for them to bring the resources to you?
I suppose I should thank you for this.
In any case, I shall set the standard for heavy cruisers!
To think that you could do this much... I suppose I can offer you a word of praise.
Tsk... Can't you work a bit harder?
Let me show my true strength!
It seems that you'll never be able to earn my respect.
I suppose I'll have to teach you how to behave in a respectable manner, Commander. Earning my acknowledgement is no easy feat, so I hope you've steeled yourself.
To make this pose, put your hands here... What? You're embarrassed by me touching you? ...I'm blushing? Wh-what nonsense!
You still have a long way to go, but I suppose you're doing well for now... Just how long do you plan to cling to me anyway? How despicable... it seems like you haven't learned anything yet.
You've been learning quickly lately... About that... hm... If you want to experiment with me, I'm ready.
You've passed, but just barely! This is only the beginning... there's still a long way to go! What about me? If you want to spend the rest of your life with me, I'm ready!
Hmm. Must've been a lucky guess.

Performance upgraded, improvements complete. This way I can finally... *cough* Oh, it's nothing, Commander. I must simply be more strict with you in the future. Are you ready for your psychological examination?

Performance upgraded, improvements complete. This way I can finally... *cough* Oh, it's nothing, Commander. I must simply be more strict with you in the future. Are you ready for your psychological examination?
You're five minutes late, Commander!
What do you want? Surely you didn't come to get lectured.
This is a step up from before, but you still messed up here. Are you doing this on purpose to get me angry?
What am I writing? Your agenda, of course. Without it, you'd just slide right back to your old habits.
I'll be here any time you have questions.
Did you see that? This is the true power of our fleet!
First ship of the Aoba-class heavy cruisers, Aoba.

Hai hai! The name's Aoba! I spent most of my days in the 6th Fleet, took part in many battles with my sisters, and did my best to survive until the end. Let's drop this boring topic, shall we? I was a writer for the Navy once, so I've picked up a thing or two. Commander, anything juicy going on around you lately?
Hmm, hmm... I can smell it. This fleet is going to make the headlines! So you're the Commander, huh? Just let me, Aoba, gather all the information without holding back!
Hehe~ Commander, I saw that~!
What's up? You know I charge for intel.
I believe that hard work pays off, you know. Eh? Why was I following you yesterday? I don't ever recall doing anything like that~
Say, Commander. If you let me interview you, I'll share some juicy gossip with you. Like... which girls might be looking your way~
It's sure hard getting a scoop... Maybe... I should make some news myself!
Ah, a good idea, finally! This will definitely make the front page!
Commander... It's not wise to mess with reporters.
Missions? I'm just here to record your heroic image, Commander. Oh? I need to go too?
Commander, stop lazing around. Go get your rewards and let me take a picture!
Commander, you're way to careless with information... Take it, it's your mail!
Commander~ of the girls out on commission right now... who's your favorite?
"Come see a magnificent view of girls hard at work!" ...Okay! Commander, let's pack some snacks and head to port to conduct some interviews!
I think I'm getting closer to my next big scoop. Thanks, Commander~!
You're far too naive if you think  you can escape Aoba's eyes!
Okay, time to get a quick word from the losing side. Eh? Leaving already?
I... Aoba... shouldn't be getting upset over this!
It's not very funny when I'm the one on the news.
Maybe I should go conduct some interviews overseas...
Commander, could you tell me how it feels to have such a large har- I mean, fleet?

It's been a while since since I've been stationed here, so I've managed to get some good information from everyone. At first they thought you were a shady person, but you seemed to have earned their trust. Good for you!

I've made my fair share of mistakes, so I thought I could help by leaving something to commemorate everyone's hard work. Sorry for saying something so unlike me... but, you made me drop my guard. Now, you have to answer my questions!
Alright, I've decided. For all my precious friends here, I will record their lives! Does that include you? Oh you, don't you already know the answer to that?
Just to be clear, I'm not good at this kind of stuff... so don't expect me to say anything romantic... ever! Well, maybe just once... Um... I... l-l-love... you!
Hmhmm? Should I write a few nice words about you?
It's over... I'm definitely going to get yelled at again...
Furutaka... I'm so sorry for what happened back then...
6th Fleet, set sail!
Let's see who has the better intuition!
Second ship of the Aoba-class heavy cruisers, Kinugasa.

Good day, I'm Kinugasa! I was in the 6th Fleet with my sister Aoba before it was disbanded. We fought together in many battles, like Wake Island, the Coral Sea, and the Solomon Islands. I'm not as lucky as her though... Anyways, Commander, try not to overwork yourself! Rest is important too!
Pleased to meet you! I'm Kinugasa. Have you been eating and sleeping well,  Commander? Don't be like my big sis... Speaking of which, is she also here by any chance?
Welcome back, Commander! Did you get enough to eat? If you're still hungry, I can cook something for you!
Health comes first!
Did you rest well, Commander? Health comes first!
I'm not sure if Aoba is getting enough rest... Please make sure to check up on her!
Work hard, play hard! That's the secret to a happy life!
Commander, did you also come to wind down with some light stretching?
Please take a seat, Commander. We're going to discuss fleet discipline.
Commander, work will only pile up if you keep putting it off!
Commander, leaving your rewards there won't make them grow.
Commander, do I have to tell you to check your mail every single time?
Commander, it's important to balance work and rest. Since you just got back, why not take a quick break?
Commander, since you didn't go yourself, you should at least welcome back the girls who worked hard on the commission!
Being wasteful is no good, Commander.
Everyone! Stay alert, protect yourself, and don't be reckless!
Everyone, don't let your guard down just because we won!
We need to call a meeting and review this performance...
Don't panic. Get into formation!
It's not like I care what you do...
Did you clean your room, Commander? Did you lock the door? Have you forgotten anything?
Don't be too hard on my sister... She actually has a lot of guilt buried in her heart.
I don't really like lecturing people... but I've gotten used to lecturing my sister, and you don't seem to mind. Eh? You actually appreciate it? Then... I guess I'll keep it up...
Aoba is always so impatient! But she's my big sis, and she's very important to me. Just like you, Commander. You're precious to me as well!
Jeez, Commander. Your sleeves and collar are messy as always, even for such an important occasion. I'll lecture you later~ let's carry on with the ceremony!
Commander? Ah... my apologies, I almost started launching into another lecture... Thank you very much.
Stop looking around, sister!
Tone-class heavy cruiser number two - Chikuma.

I'm the Tone-class heavy cruiser, Chikuma. I can carry more seaplanes than my heavy cruiser counterparts—you could say I've got plenty of eyes in the sky. I'm good at the art of knowing things, don't you think so? Hehehe.
I am Chikuma. Pleased to make your acquaintance. Well, that might be the case, but I already know a bit about you... My, are you curious? You'll find out before long, hehe.
Let's see... Well, it looks like you're right on time. Welcome back, Commander.
Knowledge is power. Not only in battle, but for everything else as well... right?
You want to know what people are saying about you? ...You know, if you're that curious, I suggest that you dig around a bit yourself.
This is some juicy info here... Hm, I bet Aoba would love to hear about this~
Just like the "eyes" on my seaplanes need maintenance, our eyes should be maintained properly as well. That way, we can make sure they work well when they need to.
Are you trying to get my ears to spring up? Hehe~
If you want some help, you should organize the information first.
Looks like I've grasped another weakness of yours, Commander♪
Commander, I don't think it's a good habit to neglect your duties.
Mission rewards... Lots of things here, so I'll leave the accounting to you♪
There's some new mail for you. Please make sure not to look over any new information.
Good work out there. Why don't you get started on the combat report? This experience will become the foundation for your next victory, after all.
Hm... According to my seaplanes, it seems like the commissions team is almost here.
My reconnaissance abilities have grown even sharper~
I've already seen through your tricks, hehe.
As long as the intel is correct, victory is guaranteed... Ehe♪
It's because I wasn't able to get enough info on them...
Knowledge is the key to victory♪
This is nothing... This won't make me fall behind...!
I'm sorry. I'm not sure I can deal with someone like you...
Let's see what my seaplanes' eyes have captured for me this time.
Oh, are you curious about the intel I've gathered? Mm, like how everyone at the port feels about you? Just kidding, of course♪

Mm... Even if there's something you really want to know, I can't just tell you... Right, how about this? You listen to one of my requests, and I'll tell you one thing you want to know in exchange. Hehehe♪
Hehe. As payment for the secret I told you, you'll be taking me out on a date♪ ...No refunds allowed, of course.
Are you disappointed that I'm not surprised at all? Don't be, I really am, you know? It's just that I'm so happy, it far exceeds any surprise I might've felt~♡ Hehehe~♪
Oh my, did you do a bit of homework on me, Commander? Thank you~
Leave reconnaissance to me!
Let's take care of this and get back in one piece.~

ex.line: Oh, it looks like you're up early today... Very praiseworthy of you, Commander.
Hm~? Are you curious about what I was doing? I was collecting info, of course. You unexpectedly have a lot of openings. Hehe~♡
Calm down, Commander. If there were rumors any floating around about you, I'd tell them off. You're even more worried now? My my...
So, about those affection points... Mm, well, I'm maxed out, but... would you like to find out about some of the other girls? Hehehe.
My, what am I going to do with you... So, what is it that you'd like~?
Your tastes... Hehehe, there's no way I wouldn't know by now, right~
Well, whatever you might be worried about, let's focus on knocking that mission out together.
Mission rewards? Well... Hehe, let's check on them together.
Good work out there. Leave the combat report to me. You... should relax for a bit. Hehe.
As long as I'm able to gather information with my seaplanes, this should be the expected result. Hehe.
Oh, are you asking me on a date? Mm~ What should I tell you in return... Hehehe, how about... the place I'd like to go today~?

lines.line: Commander, would you like to share a drink... or play a game together? If you win, I'll share some secret intel that you're sure to love.
Commander, would you like to share a drink... or play a game together? If you win, I'll share some secret intel that you're sure to love.
Welcome back. I prepared a delicious, refreshing drink for you. Partake, and perhaps we can continue our game.
Usually, I don't share what I've learned from my Eyes with anyone... But if you beat me, or if you can provide something more interesting, I'd be happy to. Hehe.
Hehe, there was one reason I won: I simply know you too well, observe you too keenly.
Hmm? You didn't know about my Eyes until now? Hehe, don't underestimate me♪
Your eyes are practically glued to my chest~ Do you want seconds? Here you go~♪
Oh, are you tired? Let's take a break.
Oh, my~ Is this how you plan to win? Try all you like♪
Thank you for your efforts. I'm ever so taken by your unyielding spirit, despite your many losses. Hehe.

*sigh*... It wounds me to keep beating you, it really does... What to do? Maybe you could trade me something I'm interested in, instead? ...Hehe, you're being even more dense than usual~ What I'm most interested in YOU, and the secret information I have to offer is... the fact that we're on a date♪
First ship of the Myoukou-class heavy cruisers, Myoukou.

I am Myoukou, of the Sakura Empire's Myoukou-class heavy cruisers. I participated in both the glorious victory of the Java Sea and the humiliating defeat at Leyte Gulf. Afterwards, I was struck by a torpedo and pursued by submarines. In the end, I could only watch from the South as my nation surrendered. It is hard to say whether that was fortune or misfortune. Anyways, Commander, you can always talk to me if something is on your mind.
I am, Myoukou, first ship of the Myoukou-class heavy cruisers. Commander, is there anything I can help you with?
Would you like some homemade pancakes, Commander?
Commander, acquiring intel is the first step to victory.
If I get another chance... I'd like to pet Hatsukaze's head again.
I've put on weight?! Commander... there are some things that even you shouldn't say.
Bergall?! Phew... you were talking about someone else.
... Please do this kind of thing to destroyers, not me...
I'm supervising the destroyers' training right now. Please save it for later if it's not an emergency.
... Commander, have some self-respect...
Commander, please don't hesitate to ask for help!
Don't call it a day after finishing just one mission!
New mail has arrived! Is this the latest training manual?
This method of relaxing is inefficient. Why not try some of my specially-made energy drink?
Commission complete! Is everyone putting forward their best effort?
I won't let such a small improvement get to my head.
Let's see the fruits of my daily training! All guns, open fire!
This victory was made possible by everyone's efforts, not just my own!
It's all because I neglected my daily training... Everyone, I'm sorry...
Burn this final sight into your memory!
Stop slacking off, Commander!

It is not unusual for a weaker force to defeat a stronger one in a naval battle. Victory or defeat is often decided by good judgment and split-second decision making. We must be thorough in our training in order to cultivate these abilities.
Commander, remember to take breaks as needed. Your efficiency will be worse if you run out of stamina... Lap... pillow? It's fine by me... but will it really help you recover faster?
I saw your light on, so I came to check on you. I had no idea you'd still be awake; even being a workaholic should have its limits! Come on, I'm not leaving until you fall asleep.
Commander, I've finished processing those files. It's the end of the day, so why don't we grab dinner together? ... ... How's it taste?
Commander, your body is no longer just yours alone. Make sure you take care of yourself properly... for me, okay?
Commander, your feelings are reaching me.
Second ship of the Myoukou-class heavy cruisers, Nachi.

I am Nachi, second ship of the Myoukou-class heavy cruisers. Though I said second ship, I am no "little sister". I fought my way all around the Pacific, and served as flagship multiple times. I am greatest heavy cruiser - bear witness to my elegance and power!
I'm Nachi, the first post-treaty heavy cruiser from the Sakura Empire. My design is the very definition of perfection! I'll be in your care from here on out!
I-I'm not training.. I'm just... being lazy and laughing at the other girls as they work up a sweat.
What is it? Do you want to be my lackey?
My sisters in the Fifth Fleet? I miss them a bit... err, just once in a blue moon!
Ghosts on the training ground? W-what are you, a kid? Who'd believe something like that?
Salt Lake City? I'm going to show her that Lady Luck doesn't bless the same person forever!
Commander, are you feeling lonely? I just happen to have more spare time than I know what to do with~
I-idiot... you're that fascinated with me? At least tell me in advance...
Only an idiot would be unable to complete such an easy mission.
Heheh, looks like you couldn't have done this mission without me!
You want your mail? Only if you beg me nicely~
Good work. However, you won't be able to catch up to me with even ten times the effort!
Mmhmm. It's important to work hard! Well, unless you're me!
I'm even more flawless than before!
Hmph. Another bunch of blind idiots.
Hehe, this is only normal, of course.
Damn it... just what went wrong?
Kneel before my cannons!
I wasn't talking to you!
Commander, you're going to be unpopular forever if you don't pay attention to your appearance.
Hard work? Not at all. A genius like me doesn't need to work hard. I get stronger just by breathing.
Huh? Commander? What are you doing at the training area so late? You were worried about me? I-I was just taking a walk because I was bored. You heard cannon fire? Th-that was...
I can't be honest with myself... because I can't stand the thought of people seeing me work hard... except for you, Commander. No matter who I become, surely you would...
I know I have a hard time being honest with myself, but... I'll try my best to make you the happiest person in the world! I swear my name on it!
This is for me? I appreciate it a lot!

Howzit? Now that my retrofit's all done, don't I look even more perfect than before? Maybe now, our ever-so-reserved Commander here will be super impressed by my new abilities~ Wh-what do you mean I've been staying up too late training with my rigging? W-we're not gonna talk about that!

Howzit? Now that my retrofit's all done, don't I look even more perfect than before? Maybe now, our ever-so-reserved Commander here will be super impressed by my new abilities~ Wh-what do you mean I've been staying up too late training with my rigging? W-we're not gonna talk about that!
The perfect Nachi put together your daily schedule for you! Now, let's get some work done!
A gift? It's not like I asked you to go and buy this for... Hahaaah, I guess you're so used to running around and getting things for me that you couldn't help yourself! Well... Sure, I'll take it!

Lately, I've been running into Haguro early in the mornings... Hm? You say I should train somewhere else? Good idea... Instead of the Sakura Empire dorm, I should come to your—no, I obviously can NOT do that!
You're feeling anxious? Hmm... Why not try working or crafting something to take your mind off of it? Like, say, origami?
Whoa, you're just openly slacking off... Heheh, then I'll just... NOT join you, obviously! C'mon, Commander! There's work to be done!
Feeling lonely, Commander? Heheh, same here... Uh, I mean, I'm just so darn bored!
Hm? What's up... Hyah?! H-hey, did you just do that on purpose?!
These missions are so simple, they could be done instantly. I know I could, but surely even you can, Commander!
You didn't even need my help! Heheh♪
Thanks for your hard work~ Oh, you brought back tons of spoils... O-of course, you are working, like, fifteen times harder than before. I know you're catching up to me... *blushes*
The commission team is really working hard. Heheh, hurry and go check out those rewards.
Get on your knees and beg, and maybe I'll forgive you♪ See how tolerant I am?
I don't know what went wrong, but... Let's run away, Commander!
Myoukou-class heavy cruiser number three - Ashigara

I am Ashigara, third ship of the Myoukou-class heavy cruisers. I had the privilege and glory of representing the Sakura Empire in the Royals' Coronation Fleet Review. My habitability? W-well... some things must be sacrificed in order to survive on the battlefield.
Ashigara, reporting for duty. Commander, my blade shall cut down all your enemies.
You're finally back... Commander, would you spare some time to spar with me?
No matter how much you stare at me, I won't get any stronger... Commander, wouldn't it be better for me to sortie?
"Let your victories not be decided by the strength of your equipment, but by your abilities." That is what Myoukou taught me.
"Let those who think of the Sakura Empire also think of your name?" Hmm... Yes, that is a goal that I indeed have been working towards.
Commander, thank you for training with me every day. I'll continue to refine myself!
I got this from Myoukou. I often record what she says, so I can listen to her words when I have free time. Eh? Is that weird?
Ack...! U-um... I need to ask Myoukou about what I should do in this situation...
There are still a lot of missions left... Commander, I don't quite understand how to do some of these. I hope I'm not dragging you down...
Mission complete! Commander, why don't you go check the rewards first?
The postman has already finished their job. Commander, why don't you go take a look?
Commander, it's fine to rest every now and then, but please don't go overboard with it.
Commander, the commission fleet has returned.
Yes! With this, I'm full of energy!
Everyone, advance! The fortunes of war are with us!
N-not bad... I suppose... *blushes*
I... I can keep fighting!
I'll cut you all down!
This is the hour of reckoning! Chaaarge!!
Commander, if I am a nuisance to you, please let me know...
Commander, you wish to survey my room? That's fine... but please give me a moment to tidy up first.
U-um.. I'm not very dexterous, but I'd like you to have this origami crane that I made... though I'm not sure you can really call it a crane. I've always wanted to do something like this...
Commander, what's the special occasion? You even brought my toiletry and wash towel to my bedside today... woooahh! It's already this late? I completely overslept!
Sorry, Commander... when you weren't here, I started feeling uneasy and... before I knew it, I had already folded a hundred paper cranes... Um, that's weird, isn't it...
Commander, sneak attacks are against the rules... There's no one else around, right? Th-then... maybe it's okay to cling a little bit. Commander, you're so warm...
Thank you very much, Commander.
Myoukou, we finally get to fight together!
Phew... I finally managed to fix my dress... but I just can't seem to get used to it. Commander, how does my dress look? It's not strange, is it?
Phew... I finally managed to fix my dress... but I just can't seem to get used to it. Commander, how does my dress look? It's not strange, is it?
You'd like to train with me? Of course! Even dressed like this, I have no intention of losing!
"There's no need to overexert yourself." That's what Myoukou told me, anyway. Commander, hopefully you're not pushing yourself too hard?
It's hard to put my hair up like this... Thanks to Myoukou's help, I was somehow able to manage...
I can't sit here doing nothing all the time... Commander, if there's anything you need help with, please give me the order!
This is how you do the lap pillow thing, right? I heard that it would help you recover from fatigue...
Commander, is something bothering you?
Umm... C-Commander, Myoukou said that you shouldn't do stuff like this...
Phew... Let's take a break, Commander.
My appearances shouldn't affect my combat performance... In any case, let's advance!

This whole "fashion coordination" concept is still a bit hard for me to wrap my head around, so I'm glad Nachi helped me pick out a swimsuit. Now, I just need to... Hey, Commander! Open your mouth! H-huh?! But this is what Nachi told me to do... is there some sort of problem?!

This whole "fashion coordination" concept is still a bit hard for me to wrap my head around, so I'm glad Nachi helped me pick out a swimsuit. Now, I just need to... Hey, Commander! Open your mouth! H-huh?! But this is what Nachi told me to do... is there some sort of problem?!
The cool, pristine waves splashing across my skin... What a comforting sensation.
I originally planned to bring headphones to listen to the soothing sound of Myoukou's... Err, I meant to say music! But, it might be more calming to just listen to the waves.
Under the azure skies, the seagulls and crabs also thrive... the summer seaside also has life of its own.
I promised to play beach volleyball with Myoukou and Nachi, but we have an odd number of people... Commander, why don't you join us?
Myoukou, I brought my training equipment. Today's regimen is... Oh, I don't need it today?
Commander, did you want to take a break? ...Ahem! H-h-how about a l-l-lap pillow?
Eep?! ...Oh, I had cream stuck on me? Th-thank you, Commander...
I heard there are lots of crabs hiding on this beach. I wonder if I can snag a couple...
Myoukou-class heavy cruiser number four - Haguro.

Myoukou-class heavy cruiser, Haguro here. As you can see, I'm just a normal heavy cruiser who made things happen during night battles and stuff in the Great War. A miracle ship...? I mean, I've been called that before, but... it's embarrassing to be called that to my face...
Guess you're the Commander, huh... Wassup? I'm part of the team now or whatever. You just mind your own biz and I'll mind mine.
Mornin'. Oh, you're already here? Aren't you the real diligent type...

So sleepy... Hm? You wanna know why...? Erm, it's none of your business... Err, I guess it's not right for me to hide stuff from you, Commander... Alright, I'll fess up! I pulled an all-nighter playing video games!
Ya need me to tidy up around here? Sure thing. Then, if you'd please leave the office for around fifteen minutes...
*Yaaaaawn* I'm beat... Having Myoukou lecture me first thing in the morning, then having Ashigara fret over me... Well, of course I know it's for my sake, but...
Hmm? Ya heading out? Then I'll—what? You don't mind if I come with you, right...?
Hmm...?
Hmhmm~ Oh, 'sup Commander?
What the...???
Here're your missions. I'm here focusing on the ones you've assigned me, so good luck on yours.
Hm? You've already finished your missions? Nice, good stuff.
You've got some letters. Yeah, yeah. I'll go get'em for you.
*Yaaawn*. Oh, you're back... Guess I'm done for now... Wait, there's more to do, isn't there...
Commissions completed. What are you staring at me like an idiot for? Let's head out and greet'em.
So as long as you put something trendy on... Don't mind me.
Give me a bit, and I'll get to it!
Piece of cake. Not much else for me to say, really.
So frickin' annoying... Ugh, we're backing off for now.
See if you can spot me!
Who cares about miracles, so long as I can protect my friends...!
...I'll take care of you right here, right now. Just kidding, I'd hate to lower everyone else's morale around here.
*Yaaaaawn*... So tired... Don't you feel tired at all? Don't force yourself too much, or ya'll set a bad example for other girls who'd follow the lead and overwork themselves.
Well, it's time to keep watch over the Commander's sleeping hours... Huh? Y-you still haven't gone to sleep?! This wasn't supposed to... I-I'm, um... looking for someone to play video games together!

Commander, I apologize for having lied to you... Truth is, I didn't pull an all-nighter playing video games, I was actually carrying out some late-night missions... D-does it matter what my excuse is? I could blame a tengu, and nobody would believe me anyway!

Ahaha, Commander, it's not good to intrude on people at this hour. But, um... if you'd like, why don't you join me in playing some video games? Not like there are any missions left to take care of, and it doesn't look like you're able to fall asleep anyhow... I-it's not a bother for you, is it?
A-a pledge ring?! This has to be some kind of joke... No way. I mean, I'm perfectly fine with it, but are you fine with me...? I-I mean... I'm a total night owl...
Real nice stuff! Thanks a bunch, Commander!
I'll get'em, Myoukou!
I really hate standing out...
Maybe I shouldn't have taught you how to fold paper cranes...

ex.line: *Yaaawn*... Commander, you're always so early. What'll we be starting off with today?

What'll you be having me do today? Eh, you don't have anything in mind? You just want me to sleep for once... Is that my mission? Or are you trying to scold me like Myoukou? E-either way, I know it's for my sake, but...
Whew... everything's sparkling clean now. Tidying up the office always lifts my spirits. Same goes for you, right?
Whenever I wake up early, I always end up bumping into Nachi, and the atmosphere always gets all awkward... Commander, you should watch out as well.
It's surprisingly a lot of work being your bodyguard. Not only do I have to watch out for your safety, but also for the other girls who try to... N-never mind what I just said...
Pfft, hahaha... No need to be nervous. I'm not the angry type like Myoukou.
You've still got some missions left. Plannin' on staying up late to finish 'em? Alright, but I'll stay here with you 'til you call it a day.
Another win under your belt, huh? Nah, I'm not annoyed or anything, it's just... I'd like to prove my mettle on the battlefield instead of housesitting back here.
Commission completed. Now we need to welcome the girls back, right? Yeah, yeah. I know.
I'm the MVP this time around~! Whew, who would've thought a proper night's sleep would make such a difference?
I'll be sure to protect you at any cost, Commander...!

lines.line: Ow! That freakin' stings... Can't believe I actually slipped on the stairs and hit my foot. Just how clumsy am I? ...Oh, Commander? Uh, welcome?
Ow! That freakin' stings... Can't believe I actually slipped on the stairs and hit my foot. Just how clumsy am I? ...Oh, Commander? Uh, welcome?
Zzz... Oh no, I almost fell asleep while sitting down... Ah, Commander! Welcome back.
My skirt? Yeah, I'm wearing a skirt today... My skirt! S-stop, don't look! ...Ugh, what am I supposed to do about this now...

Everyone's working together to clean up this pop-up café. It's designed specially to entertain you to the fullest, so everyone's working diligently... Perhaps too diligently, since that's why I slipped and hurt my foot.

Musashi dotes on people so much, she's bound to spoil a bunch of girls rotten... I've always been rotten to the core, so I'll be fine, but... What about you, Commander? Would you like to be spoiled rotten?
As our exemplar, Mikasa really is so frickin' cool... Compared to her, I'm just a clumsy brat... Ahaha...
You want to treat my injury? T-thanks a lot... *blush*
W-what are you planning on doing to me...?
You alright? Not hurt anywhere, are ya? Ehehe, I was just thinking that we could slack off together if you had happened to injure your foot as well.
Commissions completed. What are you staring at me for, let's go greet'em already. ...You don't need to worry about me, I'll be fine. Jeez.

H-hey, help me out! ...No, I didn't come in here for fun. When I finished my security duty last night, I got to thinking about how I was going to give you chocolate for Valentine's and fell asleep. When I woke up, I was stuffed in this thing...

H-hey, help me out! ...No, I didn't come in here for fun. When I finished my security duty last night, I got to thinking about how I was going to give you chocolate for Valentine's and fell asleep. When I woke up, I was stuffed in this thing...
Man, is there any way to get out of this thing... Hm? You'll stay with me until help comes, Commander? ...For real?
If I move, you're gonna see everything... No, I don't want you to see my bits! Mmrgh!
It's a little cramped in here, but eh, I'll be fine. Akashi should be here soon... She'd lose money if nobody can play it, right?
Yaaawn... My bad. I'm a little sleepy... This thing's ventilated, so don't worry about me.
I wonder if Ashigara managed to give the Commander her chocolate. Pfft, I bet she'd tell me to focus on my own problems first... Yeeeah.
M-move the claw carefully, okay? You'll crush the chocolate...
Wh-why are you going straight for THAT place?!
Really missed my chance to give out chocolate, huh? ...Hm? N-nobody said you were the one I was most excited to give chocolate to, okay, Commander?
Good! Keep it up! Almost there! Aaand, failed again. Hmm... I'd feel better if you could at least take the chocolate, but it's just not gonna work out. Ahaha! Thanks for trying, Commander.
First ship of the Takao-class heavy cruisers, Takao.

I am Takao, first ship of the Takao-class heavy cruisers. I may not look like it, but I have already crossed through countless battlefields. Please place your faith in my firepower and armor, and be at ease.
Are you the Commander? Please allow this lowly Takao to offer you what little strength she has.
Takao standing by. What are your orders?
Small strokes fell great oaks, constant drops pierce through rock. Those who train through the most humdrum of days shall seize victory in the most critical of moments. That is my belief.
Even back in port, we must not lower our guard. Danger lurks around every corner.
Commander, not even you could withstand my blade.
Daily refinement means to continually strive towards your goals. Commander, may your focus never falter.
...I-is my hair a mess? Pardon me for showing you my unsightly side... I'll clean myself up right away!
E-enemies?! Oh... It was you, Commander? Apologies - my eyesight isn't the best.
Kyaa! You scared me... how shameless!
New tasks have been assigned - would you like to confirm them?
Mission accomplished! Are we going to collect the rewards?
Commander, there's new mail. Shall I bring it for you?
I'm glad that you came back safe and sound.
Your fleet has returned from commission. Want to welcome them back?
Power... flows through my blade!
Please leave combat to me. I shall not shame my title of being "The Strongest!"
Hm... Once again, I've cut a worthless object.
I was careless... I definitely will not fail next time!
Swift death unto evil!
Be still as water...!
A sword has no eyes. It would be wise to avoid approaching me casually.
Do you need anything? If not, I'm going back to work.
It might be pretty nice to just set aside my duties and have a relaxing conversation with you every once in a while, Commander.
Recently, I haven't been able to keep my composure during training.. Just from thinking about you, my form becomes sloppy. If I am like this, would you still want to keep me by your side?
No matter how badly I'm injured, I will make sure to always return to your side. So... Commander, could you always stay with me as well?
For you to acknowledge me like this, Commander, is the greatest honor. From now on, this blade shall serve only you. Please continue to treat me kindly.
A-are you sure you want to give something this nice to me?

ex.line: It felt like someone was watching me train... So it was you, Commander. If you're so interested, stay and watch for a while longer.
Phew... Another day's training complete. If you're interested, I could show you my newest technique. Or if you'd prefer to drink tea and relax with me... that, too, is acceptable.
Shall we patrol the port together? Even the sea breeze feels more refreshing when we walk together.
Excellent. Now that I've attained such martial mastery, nobody will ever be able to hurt you.
This goes against the principles of the warrior's path, but... w-with you, once in a while... I suppose it's fine...
I knew it was you, Commander. There's no need to be so surprised. I know everything about you, down to the sound of your footsteps.
C-Commander... You're trying to get me flustered for your own entertainment, aren't you?!
I see... "Love" can make even the most invincible of warriors vulnerable, but it can also become the sharpest of blades that cuts through all hesitation... This is why a warrior mustn't fear love.

lines.line: Commander, even I’ll get embarrassed if you keep staring at me like that... Eh? Why did I bring a volleyball? Did you not order me to bring it?
Commander, even I’ll get embarrassed if you keep staring at me like that... Eh? Why did I bring a volleyball? Did you not order me to bring it?
Of course I can sympathize with the others. In this kind of heat, it is important to get some rest. However, we mustn’t neglect our training!
I may have lost to Miss Saratoga in sandcastle building, but I shall redeem myself in beach volleyball.
Miss Saratoga wants to challenge me? Fine. Swimming, volleyball... just name it. I’ll take her on.
Atago, did you bring my sunglasses?

Relax, Commander. I didn’t bring this kendo sword to hit you with. It’s because I heard that someone from the Royal Navy is going to be here. Heh, just kidding. It’s because Atago is scared of ghosts~
The younger girls are all so energetic... Commander, did you know you can tell their age by when they were launched?
Don’t touch me! I’m working on a sand castle... it has to be at least 70% bigger than Sara’s!
Good work, Commander. ...What? Miss Saratoga is going to join Team Royal during the beach volleyball tournament? I see... a chance for payback has come!
Calligraphy is also a form of self-cultivation, so I am instructing the children... Commander, would you also like to join?
Calligraphy is also a form of self-cultivation, so I am instructing the children... Commander, would you also like to join?
Commander, welcome back. Pardon me for making a mess; I'll clean it up right away.
Oh no, the ink... Commander, don't step on the paper!
Qipao? Atago picked it out, saying you like this kind of outfit. How is it?
What? "Fortune" is the only thing that needs to be written? I thought I could write whatever I wanted...
Commander, can I try writing your name next? Hm? No particular reason... I just felt like it.
It would be great if I could really bring "Fortune" to Commander and everyone else with my calligraphy.
Commander?! I-I won't be able to write like this...!
Hmm... school life, huh? It's a fairly fresh experience for me. Would it be fine to pin my hair up like this? What do you think, Commander?
Hmm... school life, huh? It's a fairly fresh experience for me. Would it be fine to pin my hair up like this? What do you think, Commander?
Woah! C-Commander? When did you get here? I-I'm sorry, I'm still not ready yet...
A balanced school life is a part of the responsibilites here. Surely, I will develop valuable and translatable skills through the process of going to school.
Commander, even if you're at school, you can't slack off too much!
What clubs am I interested in joining... I wonder if there's a kendo club...
This uniform was supposed to fit, so why is it so tight... C-Commander?! What are you staring at!?
This Woofy strap here? Atago gave it to me and said it'd help me look less uptight. Jeez, I'm not uptight at all...
I'll show you why they call me the "School's Strongest!"
Phew... I suppose that's a good warm up.
Ugh... S-such shameless attire... If not for Atago saying that it would benefit me to experience different things...! It looks good on me?! I, I see...
Ugh... S-such shameless attire... If not for Atago saying that it would benefit me to experience different things...! It looks good on me?! I, I see...
Sitting in this same pose is rather tiring, but this is also part of my training. After all, improving my flexibility should not be something that goes to waste...
I will give my all to fulfill any task I've been assigned... B-but, Commander, could you not stare at me so much? It's a bit... embarrassing...
The flashes from the camera are a bit too bright, but worry not about me. Commander, I shall face down each and every challenge before me.
I should try to maintain my smile at times like these? If you say so... then I shall do as you advised to the utmost of my ability.
Commander, would you mind holding onto my parasol for a bit? I need to fix my hair accessory...
I should change my pose to make it easier to take pictures? V-very well... Ugh... Th-this is too embarrassing after all...!
I, I'm still working right now...!
F-finally, you're back... With so many people staring at me, I was so hoping that you'd come back soon...
Calm your spirit and dedicate yourself to the task... I want to believe that this is part of my training!
My five senses are sharper than ever, perhaps even TOO sharp. No matter what trap awaits, my only way forward is to pierce through and focus on overcoming this trial... Haaah!
My five senses are sharper than ever, perhaps even TOO sharp. No matter what trap awaits, my only way forward is to pierce through and focus on overcoming this trial... Haaah!
Commander, get behind me! They may just be set pieces, but it'll still hurt if you get hit by debris.

We may be able to dart about freely here, but a battlefield isn't so unrestricted. Don't be arrogant over good results in exercises, and remember that it's important to learn from real experience. ...Say, Commander, why don't you join me for a while longer?
Miss Kirishima taught me ninja techniques, and Miss Washington instructed me in martial arts. I will flinch from no foe!
I can defeat enemies more quickly by using my rigging release technique, but that would endanger you, Commander. How can I respond if you're taken hostage? Kh...
"Tentacle demon Observer, abomination of the deep! I, shipninja Takao, will strike you down!" Hm... Will this do for my fighting stance?
Commander, watch out! Sorry... My first reaction was to hold you in my arms. Hm? Something of mine is touching you? Ah...
C-Commander...?! Are you being possessed by some evil spell... Kh?!
...I'll carry out any task you ask of me.
Mission complete. Claim your rewards, but beware of any devious traps.
A letter, hm? ...I almost sliced it by accident...
Haaaah! ...Oh, you? I just finished dispatching the enemies here. Let's explore a little longer and take a break.
The commission fleet has made their return. Commander, wouldn't now be the ideal time to greet them?
I, heavy cruiser Takao, shall be the exorcist's blade!
A little damage to my clothing won't affect me. As long as I have an arm to swing my blade, rigging to fire my cannons, and the will to fell my foes, I can fight on!
Kh... Commander... I've made a mistake!

Is this not supposed to be for the sake of self-cultivation? I've never seen training methods such as this... However, now that it's come to this, fleeing is not an option. I must lead by example by adapting to these strange circumstances!

Is this not supposed to be for the sake of self-cultivation? I've never seen training methods such as this... However, now that it's come to this, fleeing is not an option. I must lead by example by adapting to these strange circumstances!
Hmm. Commander, I am prepared. I'll strike the perfect pose to show you true mental fortitude!

Mental fortitude is all about discarding the false and embracing the true, conveying a unique message to another through one's bearing alone... Was that hard to understand? Then watch me, and you will surely understand.
I see. The more one self-cultivates, the more naturally one can face dangerous situations... Watch carefully. My performance displays true mastery, does it not?
This fabric has such a different texture from the ones I usually wear. It's light, but when I wear it... I feel oddly sensitive.
Am I cold? Don't worry about me. I can meditate under waterfalls in the winter, so this chill is nothing to me.
Am I still too tense? Apologies... I'm sure I'll be more confident once I have tried a few more outfits on.
Is this outfit really a best-seller? It doesn't leave much to the imagination...
Y-you're suddenly so forward!
Back already, Commander?! I-I was... in the middle of trying a new technique... Consider it a little sneak peek!

I try to keep my mind free of distractions, but your unwavering gaze is... perhaps a little unsettling. As I am now, if I keep eye contact with you for more than three seconds, I'll surely expose a weakness... Will you help me train my way through this, Commander?
Commander, I've been undertaking countless bride training sessions in order to prepare for this day. As your bride, I won't let you down.
Commander, I've been undertaking countless bride training sessions in order to prepare for this day. As your bride, I won't let you down.
Commander, come and try my cooking.
I brought my katana with me in this wedding dress. It's just hiding somewhere that you cannot see.
I think that each and every day we spend together is a blessing.
After today's training, I will replenish our food supply... am I... a good wife? N-nothing.
Atago said that my expressions have been softened recently, heehee, that's because now I smile whenever I think of you.
Commander, please focus on the work... or are you purposely teasing me just to see my troubled face?
C-Commander, we are still in the office...
Commander, don't get sloppy during the mission.
Mission complete... I feel so happy after seeing the Commander's efforts.
I just received a new mail.
I'm slowly getting used to waiting for your inevitable return.
Will any of you be able to stop me today?
As someone who only lives for training, I'm really happy and lucky to be able to find and bond with you, Commander.
Second ship of the Takao-class heavy cruisers, Atago.

I'm Atago, the second ship of the Takao-class heavy cruisers and flagship of the Second Fleet. Many of my sisters have followed my banner into battle. No matter the mission, just leave everything to big sister here~!
Oh my, what a cute commander! Please allow your big sister Atago to take good care of you from now on!
Welcome back! What should we do today?
You shouldn't ask about a maiden's weight so casually~ *giggles*
It seems like... my shoulders are always sore...
Commander~ I can see you ogling me in a daze, you know?
Hup! A little bug got into the room. You didn't see it? I'm confident in my good eyesight.
Oh my~ Are you going to give me a massage?
You can touch me even more if you'd like... but there's no saying what might happen next... *giggles*
Missions have been updated. Don't forget to take a look!
Mission complete! I wonder what rewards we will get~?
Ara~ new mail? I wonder who it's from.
Welcome back, Commander. Are you tired? Come bury yourself in big sister's bosom~!
The commission fleet is back! Let's go give them a warm welcome.
My whole body feels... hot... Commander, can you stay with me for a bit?
Naughty children need to be punished~
Combat operations... complete! It's all thanks to your leadership, Commander!
Oh my... this is a bit troublesome...
Oh my, how should I torment you today?
Looks like big sis needs to get a little serious.
You've been naughty, Commander. Do you want to be punished so badly? *giggles*
If you don't express your thoughts clearly, Commander, nobody will ever understand you.
Commander, would you like me to clean your ears? Come on, don't be shy. Just leave it to me~
It's all your fault, Commander... If you make such a cute face, I won't be able to keep my hands off of you...
It's no good... I can't control myself anymore! Commander, won't you become mine? You don't have to worry about anything... All you have to do is listen to me, and I'll satisfy all your needs...
Oh my, you've caught me, Commander. Or should I say, I've finally caught you? Hehe~ I'll never let you go now!
My, my~ You really understand a maiden's heart, don't you~ I really like this~
The warm breeze that gently wraps around your skin, and delicate footsteps across the white sand... isn’t this the essence of summer? Commander, what does summer mean to you?
The warm breeze that gently wraps around your skin, and delicate footsteps across the white sand... isn’t this the essence of summer? Commander, what does summer mean to you?
Phew... it sure is hot during the summer. Eh? Why is your face all red? Are you having heat stroke?
Oh my, Commander... just what are you looking at~? Would you like me to bend over a bit more~?
Kendo sword and sunglasses... Takao, did you really come here for vacation?
Commander, you can join me under my parasol if you get too hot.
Commander, want to watch me play beach volleyball?
The best type of swimsuit? Definitely a bikini. Don’t you agree, Commander?
Oh my. There may only be one Earth, but Commander certainly has two hands~.
Running commissions in this kind of heat is no easy feat. Let’s go properly reward our hardworking girls.
Oh my, it's begun to snow. Commander, should we find a nice, quiet place to enjoy the view?
Oh my, it's begun to snow. Commander, should we find a nice, quiet place to enjoy the view?
Commander, are you cold? Come and receive some warmth from your big sister~
Commander, would you like to pet the puppy? She seems to have taken a liking to you~
Commander, would you like to take a stroll with your big sister? I'd like some peace and quiet with just the two of us~
Akashi-chan? Don't fall asleep on top of the commander~
Just the two of us, enjoying the solace of winter together... doesn't it set just the right mood?
Student handbook, textbooks... twin guns, torpedoes... and what else... Huh? Commander, I'm just packing my bags for school... is there anything I'm missing?
Student handbook, textbooks... twin guns, torpedoes... and what else... Huh? Commander, I'm just packing my bags for school... is there anything I'm missing?
What should I pack in Commander's lunchbox today~?
Since I'm wearing a different outfit, it'd only feel right if you called me something different as well... Commander, why don't you try calling me "senpai?" Hehe~
Clubs, huh? There's nothing that interests me. You know, I'm much fonder of attending the "Going Home Club" with you, Commander~
Commander, learning more about you is so much more interesting than anything they teach at school~
It'd be nice if going to school could teach Takao to soften up her uptight personality...
Ehehe~ Commander, want to walk your big sister to school?
Oh my... Commander, do you really like this uniform so much? Well then, I suppose I wouldn't mind wearing it for you every day. Ehehe~
Hehe, misbehaving students will have to be punished~
So, you want big sister to be your "fleet queen"? You got it. But you'd better give it your all out there, or else I'll be upset with you!
So, you want big sister to be your "fleet queen"? You got it. But you'd better give it your all out there, or else I'll be upset with you!
Commander~ Please do your best today♡ *smooch*
I'm pretty sure it was on purpose, but these clothes are very revealing... Hehehe. Big sister thinks it's cute when you're honest like this.
Commander, are you tired? Hehehe, why don't you lay down and rest for a bit? Where, you ask? Well of course... right here~♡
Sigh, it's a pain to have to keep maintaining this pose... Commander, won't you help big sister up?
Akashi, you said you wanted to publish a lingerie photobook starring me, right? Then... Commander, would you like to see those photos?
Commander, keep at it~ Big sister is always by your side♡
Commander~ Work hard on leading the fleet, okay♡
Me being the fleet's showgirl, isn't this much to be expected~?

Commander, next time we take photos, I'm counting on you. That's right. We can spend some quality time together, just the two of us... For some reason, I get the feeling that we're going to end up with an album that's for your eyes only, hehe♡
Awooo! Tonight is a full moon, so you'll want to be extra careful so I won't eat you up! ...Just kidding. Even if I were a werewolf, I'd still protect and keep you safe.
Awooo! Tonight is a full moon, so you'll want to be extra careful so I won't eat you up! ...Just kidding. Even if I were a werewolf, I'd still protect and keep you safe.
Welcome back, Commander! Ah, interested in my ears? Sorry, but they're sensitive, so you can only touch them a little.
So cute... I'm going to pull you right toward me and then hug you suuuuper tightly- Whuh? I-I suddenly lost control of myself... Maybe it's due to the full moon.
Awooo! Heehee. Apparently, when a wolf howls, it's saying, "This is my prey, so stay away!" Well, maybe comparing you to prey is a little inappropriate.
You like how fluffy this feels? Well, what if I were to take my tail and coil it around you... or perhaps even wrap you up with it?
Heehee. I'm not a dog right now, I'm a big wolf! You, on the other hand... you can be whatever you want, heehee.
Oh my. I look like this, and still you want to fawn on me? Fine by me♡
*sigh*... You're doing something very dangerous, Commander. But you know what? Let's continue♡
Heehee. Truth be told, I've been tracking your scent for a long time so you can't get away from me.
If you make yourself any cuter than you already are, this full moon is going to make me go feral on you. I'll use my arms and legs like thiiis... and I'll "eat" you up! *smooch*♡
Commander... Ahh, from now on, shouldn't I call you "darling?" Come and hold my hand... Ah, at times like these, I just can't help but to want to eat you up, dar~ling~
Commander... Ahh, from now on, shouldn't I call you "darling?" Come and hold my hand... Ah, at times like these, I just can't help but to want to eat you up, dar~ling~
Commander, you didn't go to sleep that long ago. Did you miss big sister that badly~?
Even though I would be more than glad to allow you to feast your eyes upon me forever, you do need to get your work done~
What should I cook today... Commander, what would you like to have?
Commander, you're just too cute~ I just can't get enough of you~
My, Commander, you're as spoiled as ever~ Here, come to big sister~
Dar~ling, if you continue like this, I won't be able to hold back any more~ Hehe... just kidding~
Surely you must be tired. Come take a nap in big sister's lap~
Commander, please allow your big sister to take care of anything that stands in your way. Ehehe...
As expected of my wonderful commander~
I've calmed down compared to before? Well, that's because I know that you'd never leave my side, hehe~ Well then, come into my loving embrace~
