Third ship of the Takao-class heavy cruisers, Maya.

Maya, third ship of the Takao-class. My little sister and I are twins, but we're a good bit younger than our older sisters... Feel free to leave both the enemies in the sky and on the sea to me. You'll need to deal with those underwater yourself. And one final reminder: don't get too close to me or you might get hurt!
I'm Maya, the one who will tear open the sky. You're the Commander...? Don't get too close... You might get hurt!
Commander, you want someone like me to keep you company today as well? What a strange person...
Would you stop staring at me like that? I can't promise my sword won't come your way...
We were doomed to stray from the path of righteousness the moment we took up arms. Commander, we can never become heroes.
The South, Solomon Island, Leyte Gulf, and now this sea... Nothing ever changes...

Being by Yamato is like a warm embrace that melts away my worries... I sometimes long for that feeling... N-no, it's not Iike that! I may have said that but, not in that way! But if I put it that way...
...Seems pretty clear you weren't listening to me.
Commander, you're getting on my nerves.
Stand still over there. I want to practice my swordsmanship.
Another mission... another battle.
Mission complete... Can I go back now?
There's mail for you, Commander.
Combat operations over... Seems like we didn't encounter any worthy opponents today... again...
Looks like... the commission is finished.
Strength may breed sin, but for now, we have no other choice.
Shall I tear them apart...?
I shall slay anything that stands in my way, whether ghost or god!
... It hurts... No, don't mind me.
Perish by my blade!
Hmph. Retreat? How laughable.
If you get too close to me, I'll cut you down
Didn't I already tell you? Don't talk to me if you don't have any business.
I said don't talk to me if-... You want to know more about me? Fine... as you wish.
Commander, you sure are a strange person. I've never felt anything like this before... but it's not all that bad. Hey, care to have a little chat with me?
My dream is to one day conquer the sky and everything beneath it. When that day comes, would you still remain by my side?

I'm not very good at expressing my emotions... but despite that, you've never left my side. As long as you're willing to call for me, I will be able to continue fighting. Commander... I don't want to let go of your hand.
Mm... Thanks.

ex.line: You must swing your blade, or else your skill dulls and the many days you spent practicing are forgotten and wasted. But don't worry - come hell or high water, I'll be with you.
You want to see how I maintain my weapon? It's a very delicate thing, just like me. So, um, be careful.
We have many days ahead of us, you say? Well, guess I should start learning about things other than fighting.
Now that I've sworn to protect you, I can never leave your side.
You think I'm strong enough as it is? I'm not. Nowhere near it. I can't afford to stop now if I want to be able to hold your hand forever.
You want to talk? I'm not much of a talker, but I'll listen quietly.
Are you cold? Then come closer. You can borrow my scarf.
...I don't get this stuff, so if we could... Mmgh...
You're back unscathed. That's good.
A sword needs a scabbard... and I need you, Commander. As long as I'm here, nobody is ever going to hurt you.

lines.line: Maya, searching for mission target... Hm? What's the target doing up here? Tsk... Well, you've found me, so we'll do it this way. Fight me, Commander!
Maya, searching for mission target... Hm? What's the target doing up here? Tsk... Well, you've found me, so we'll do it this way. Fight me, Commander!
Only the winner will walk away from this. Commander, accept my challenge and draw your blade!
I'm Maya, a professional assassin. To dispose of my target is why I'm here... Is this really my role, Commander? Alright. Seems easy.
These toy blades can't even cut through a breeze... Can I bring my own weapons, Commander?
You're finished! Wha- How'd you stop my attack with just two fingers?! Such superhuman skill - able to surpass an assassin's speed!
When an assassin is discovered by their target, they have two choices - vanish, or clash. I choose the latter. Fight me with all you have, Commander.
Looks like you're ready to draw your blade. Let's see what you're made of.
You got this close without making a single sound... You're hiding your true strength, aren't you?
You... You're throwing me off!
You knew I was here as soon as you got back? Looks like that last victory didn't get to your head. Next time, I'll ambush you from a higher position... You won't spot me as easily then.
Mission failed... By law, the defeated must be thoroughly disposed of... Y-you'll take me under your wing? Well, since you're offering... I accept.
Takao-class heavy cruiser number four - Choukai.
I am the fourth ship of the Takao-class heavy cruisers, Choukai. As the former flagship of the 8th Fleet, I took part in many campaigns. Commander, you can entrust any task to me!
I'm Maya's sister, Choukai. I'm so glad to meet you. Um, by the way, we seem to have met before somewhere...
Welcome back, Commander. I've taken the liberties of preparing your documents. Um... would you also like to have some refreshments?
Um, do I ever get bored...? Not particularly. Even if I'm not really doing anything, I enjoy getting to spend time with you, Commander.
Commander, you're truly a kind person...
Commander, you should pick a day when you're not too busy to come look at the dandelions with me.
Commander, are you not well rested? As a matter of fact, I've actually been hard at work learning how to give massages, just to prepare for this moment! Here, don't be shy~
Commander, I really like it when you pat my head~♪
Shall we go for a stroll before the sun goes down?
C-Commander, if that is what you so desire, then...
Commander, I've finished sorting the list of new missions.
We've done it, Commander! That's another mission done without a hitch!
Commander, allow me to read the content of this letter to you.
Good work out there on your sortie. I'll handle the reports, so please take this time to get some rest.
Military commission, complete. Rewards, received... Aye! I've recorded everything!
Thank you very much, Commander. I shall use this power for your sake.
Fleet status confirmed... prepare to open fire!
Let's triumphantly return home in high spirits!
I can... still fight! I don't want to lose anyone ever again...!
My kindness... is reserved for my friends only!
I can... still keep going!
Commander, let's try to do our best?
Commander, why don't you rest for a bit? Um, you'd like to hear me sing? Hmm, in that case...
Commander, what would you like to have tonight? Um, you'd like me to decide? In that case, would you like vegetable cream stew or pork cutlets?
Commander, there is nothing that makes me happier than being able to satisfy you.
Commander, I'd do anything for you. Um, you'd do the same for me? Ehehe... that makes me really happy~

Um, Commander, I never dreamt that you'd reciprocate my feelings, but... if this is your sincere desire, then I shall accept it. Commander, would you please seal our vows by helping me put this ring on?
Thank you very much. I'll treasure this.
I'll be in your care again~
Let's give it our all!

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I've already planned the day's tasks. If we finish everything on time... maybe you and I could go out on a date together?
Do you think I look a little more intimidating in combat? Hehe, when I'm with you, I know I can face even the most terrifying enemies without fear!
Your meal is ready! I made all of your favorite foods. It's important to eat regular meals, so put that work aside for now!
There's a gentle wind blowing today... Commander, would you like to go sit in the courtyard with me? I made tea and snacks so we can enjoy a moment's quiet together.
Ah, Commander, don't move your head so much in my lap. I'll start cleaning your ears... How does it feel? Good?
Rub, rub, pet, pet~ Can I touch you this time, Commander?
Commander, I found a spot with a wonderful view. Let's go look at the sunset together.
C-Commander, can it wait until we're in your room...?
You must be tired from that last sortie! Would you like to rest your head on my lap for a while?
All of yesterday's memories and tomorrow's promises with you touch my heart... Hehe, I can't live without you now, Commander.

lines.line: There, that's it for the entrance... Oh welcome, Commander! I've been cleaning, so give me a moment... I'll be right with you!
There, that's it for the entrance... Oh welcome, Commander! I've been cleaning, so give me a moment... I'll be right with you!
There's no need to worry about you, just focus on what I'm doing...? Alright! Then... please watch your feet♪

Lalala~♪ I feel so motivated just from having you by my side! ...Um, I'm not really sure if the extra motivation affects the quality of my work but... it's fine as long as you're pleased with my work~♪
You're even avoiding walking on the floor that I just finished wiping... My, how courteous of you, Commander~ Huh? It's because the floor's slippery...?
Astoria's outfit's design is a bit out there... but is that the kind of outfit you prefer?
Commander, how would you like a massage? It's special service for you, on the house!
Eep?!
If you're done with work, I'll see you off to the room.
Watch out for the floor? Did something happen? ...Wah?!
The mission rewards have arrived! I wonder if I should leave them for Maya to take, but... I am a bit concerned...
Please leave your paperwork on the counter, I'll take care of it later. I'd like for you to make yourself at home, Commander.
The list of bounty we received from commissions? Sure! I'll bring it along with the menu!
Focus... Give it your all!
Maya, Takao, Atago! Look, we did it!
Hyah!? So many laser tripwires... Phew... I managed to get through them, but what could possibly be next?
Hyah!? So many laser tripwires... Phew... I managed to get through them, but what could possibly be next?
I see you've got some "surprises" in store for me... But I won't be daunted!
My target is the legendary masterpiece in your possession... Is that it right behind you? Umm... Well. I guess someone like me could never comprehend such fine art!
Umm... So if I stay still and don't touch the tripwire beams, you'll let me go? H-how much longer must I wait, then?!
(Phew... I'm a little tired. Who knew this scene would be so demanding? And this pose... Oof.)
All of the cameras are pointing at me... Does that mean I'm being observed from all angles?! O-oh, no! It's too embarrassing... Isn't one camera enough?
These cat ears are a special eavesdropping gadget. Wearing them heightens my hearing!
Th-the tail is actually a sensor shaped like a cat tail! Umm... It's for detecting your location.
Hyah?! W-wait a second! Nobody told me there was a play-fighting scene!
Found me already, huh? Things don't look good for me... But maybe if it means I'll get to play a special game with you, it's not so bad after all.
I'd rather steal your heart than any painting... Hehehe, that wasn't in the script - it's how I genuinely feel, Commander.
Kongou-class fast battleship number one - Kongou.
Nameship of the Fast Battleships, flagship of the 7th Combined Fleet, and the last Sakura capital ship to be laid down overseas - that is me, Kongou!
I am Kongou, lead ship of the Kongou-class battlecruisers. I shall illuminate the path that leads to victory!
Have you had enough rest? The fleet now awaits your orders.
The only value of war is the peace that follows it. I implore you to never forget this.
No way in hell a battleship like me is going to get taken out by some flimsy torpedo!
Come! Let's destroy our enemies, pass through that measly canal, and return to the land where I was born!
I take myself too seriously? No, you take yourself too lightly!
Horns? Oh, these things? They're just decorations on the hat. I wouldn't look much like a member of the Sakura Empire without them, right?
Wh-what is it!? An emergency!?
Hey you, don't tell me you've been subjecting my sisters to such depravity as well!?
Do I need to go do it myself?
Excellent! We're one step closer towards our ultimate victory.
Adjust your strategies in accordance with the new information.
Good work out there. Were you able to achieve your tactical goals?
Phew... time to take a break. Commander, does black tea suit you?
Phew... another trump card to add to my hand.
All units, battle formations!
To be victorious is to be elegant!
Please rest at ease. This situation can still be salvaged.
Press the attack!
Now is the time to make our comeback!
You do not deserve victory!
Commander, please be at ease, for victory shall soon come.
Will Zuikaku be fine on her own...? Mm... I'll watch her from here. From this distance, she probably won't notice me...
I've heard that people are most likely to reveal their sentiments at twilight... I wonder if you're also like this?
That Hiei, trying to throw a party again tonight... Commander, do you have time to keep me company there?
Since you've put so much effort into pursuing me so passionately, it is only fitting that I give you the proper respect. Come, you've earned my hand.
Understood. I'll accept this.
Fast battleship squadron, sortieing!
Let's pursue victory together!
W-watch out for enemy fire!
Being popular... is best saved for when you're off the battlefield.
We must fully live in the present, whether during work or during leisure - this is my mantra. Commander, shall we go for an outing together?
We must fully live in the present, whether during work or during leisure - this is my mantra. Commander, shall we go for an outing together?
Commander, are you well rested? There are still many hours to go.
Commander, a break is not a break if you're constantly thinking about work. Besides, don't you think it's rude to be so preoccupied when you're supposed to be spending time with me?
I'm used to always going out with my sisters, so to be able to spend time with you outside is rather novel for me.
Commander, when the weather gets a bit warmer, why don't we go enjoy the cherry blossoms with my sisters?
You're awestruck by my beauty? Hehe, something as obvious as that needs not even be said~
You... perhaps you're going to need a remedial course in basic etiquette.
Good work in your sorties today. If you're hungry, I don't mind splitting my dango with you.
Such a tasteless rabble!
"Celebrity Endorsement of the Port Medical Facilities"... Hehehe, you've made a wise decision picking me. Commander, I can leave the ad shoot to you, right?
"Celebrity Endorsement of the Port Medical Facilities"... Hehehe, you've made a wise decision picking me. Commander, I can leave the ad shoot to you, right?
Have you rested enough? Let's get back to work, as gracefully as always.
This operating system is the fruit of Akashi and the others' hard work. Would you like to try it out... Actually, I guess it's best if you don't. Hehehe.
This syringe filled with Manjuu plushies is an advertising prop, but isn't it quite adorable? Hehe~♪
In a way, saving lives directly like this feels more fulfilling than fighting enemies on the battlefield.
Good work completing your duties, Commander. Would you like to get checked up? After all, I am a nurse right now. Hehe~♪
Oh? Would a different pose be better?
It seems like you need some more intense treatment, Commander...
It would be a shame to pass on this lovely weather, Commander. Why have a dull commute by train when you can enjoy a leisurely bicycle ride in the sunlight, hm? Heehee♪
It would be a shame to pass on this lovely weather, Commander. Why have a dull commute by train when you can enjoy a leisurely bicycle ride in the sunlight, hm? Heehee♪
Have you had a good rest, Commander? You've got a long day of school and office work ahead of you.
Walking with you and taking in the scenery is quite pleasant, actually. Say, how about showing me that vantage point with an apparently exquisite view Hiei spoke of earlier?
This outing has reaffirmed to me the reason why we fight - to restore peace to all the world.
Kirishima made this charm in her home economics class. It's quite well-made, don't you think?
It seems the manjuus fell asleep. Heehee, seeing their adorable at-rest faces somehow makes me think of my sisters.
Oh, do I have a petal caught in my hair?
Excuse me, have you even considered how you're going to explain yourself to the Morals Committee?
The fruits of missions form the foundation of victory, as someone wise once said.
Splendid work. I'd imagine Haruna went off to see her clubmates... As for me? I suppose I'm doing the same this very moment, my fellow going-straight-home clubmate.
It appears the commission team has returned. Shall we treat them to the tea I bought from the school canteen?
I excel in both theory and practice!
Ah, the tailwind of victory. The very definition of envigorating, is it not?

There is a number of school-related romantic things I hope to try at least once. For instance, walking home with my beloved, or making a lunch box and savouring it together... Oh, silly me, I've already done those! Heehee♪
That was a big wave... I need to balance better on my board, or else... Commander, can I take your hand - Hm? What's slippery? I have no idea what you're... Hyah?! My swimsuit?!
That was a big wave... I need to balance better on my board, or else... Commander, can I take your hand - Hm? What's slippery? I have no idea what you're... Hyah?! My swimsuit?!
I'm trying to ride the board correctly, but it's really hard... C-Commander, can I lean on you for balance?

I know things can be too sudden to react to sometimes, but next time this happens, please try to help. In service of that, I'm going to have you learn to surf! Now, hold on to my hips, and... H-hey, wait a second!
You think it's too soon to practice in the ocean? Heheh, I think I understand being scared of the ocean. But I'm here with you, so don't you worry, Commander.
This board is much too small. Th-there's no way the two of us can... u-unless we stick really together...?
I've shown you such an inelegant side of me... Commander, please keep this a secret just between us! I'll do anything!
Geez, if you have a free hand to pet me with, use it to hold on to the board instead... Hyah?!
Commander, be careful you don't fall into the water.
Hyah?! Commander, now isn't the time for this...
Relaxing on the beach is nice and all, but you have a pretty big backlog of missions...
Another mission completed. With these rewards... I could buy myself a new swimsuit!
A letter... Phew! I managed to keep it from getting wet. Commander, you'd better read it quick.
Thanks for all your hard work. How about we take a break and enjoy the sea breeze?
Everyone from the commission team is back. Black tea seems a little inappropriate in this heat... Yeah, I think we should bring them ice-cold juice instead.
Ride the waves... elegantly, now!
If only I could be this elegant during practice... O-oh! Don't mind me, Commander!

I have to apologize. If not for that mishap, you and I could've been having fun surfing right now. ...You think the time we're spending together is more important than surfing? Gosh, do you have to say stuff like that out of nowhere...? *blush*
Kongou-class fast battleship number two - Hiei.

I am Hiei, the first Kongou-class battleship born in the Land of the Rising Sun. As an Imperial Ship, I witnessed the growth of our mighty fleet, and led our forces into the Battle of the Solomon Sea. Commander, have you finished your preparations? The banquet is about to begin.
I am the Imperial Ship Hiei, second of the Kongou-class, reporting for duty. Commander, where shall we go next?
There is nothing more relaxing than a banquet following a battle... By the way, Commander, I'm free after this...
Hehe~ Which do you prefer: matcha, or black tea?
*Sigh*... Whenever Kirishima comes to a banquet, all those kids that tag along with her usually end up making a mess of things...
When it comes to warfare, wisdom and courage are equally important. We can't count on another miracle if we discard proper planning and rely on blind courage.
Commander, I'll be able to protect you, no matter the situation. Hehe, I am called an "Imperial Ship" because I have that capacity after all~♪
I can take you anywhere the ocean reaches.
Hehe. Commander, have you not gotten enough sleep yet?
Let's finish while we still have the momentum!
Hehe, shall we celebrate by holding a banquet tonight?
Are all of these new letters? Thank you for your hard work.
Welcome back. The tea has just been brewed to the right temperature.
Welcome back, everyone. Hopefully, none of you encountered any suspicious people?
Today's breeze feels more pleasant than usual.
Hehe, shall we go enjoy the festivities?
It was no big deal~
Was I bested...?
Be swept away by the raging waves!
Commander... It's too early to give up just yet!
What a pity...
Ehehe~ Commander, is there something on your mind?
That Kirishima... She's actually quite the popular one...
Being able to see everyone's smiles at the banquet makes all the hard work and preparation worth it.
Commander, after tonight's banquet... will you be free? Hehe, please look forward to it~
So this means... "We'll always be forever?" Thank you very much. I'll gladly accept it - however... If anything was to happen to us, I hope that you would consider yourself first...
Hehe. Just what I like.
Are you still waiting for your sister?
Look how late it is... Commander, shall we embark on a dreamy voyage together?
Look how late it is... Commander, shall we embark on a dreamy voyage together?
Adequate rest is important for improving your performance. Commander, I've prepared your pillow. Tonight... enjoy the best sleep of your life~
Which pillow would you prefer? The soft one, the hard one, or... perhaps you'd like to use my thighs? Hehe~
Hehe, it seems like we'll be able to have a pajama party banquet. How about it, Commander? Would you like to join?
Good night, Commander. Don't worry, I'll wake you up when the time is right.
Ah, the plum blossoms shimmering under the moonlight... Commander, shall we go watch the petals together?
Commander, the moon is beautiful tonight. Wouldn't you rather take in the beauty of the night sky instead of staring at me?
Hehe~ Someone seems quite energetic tonight, Commander.

I have to admit, these qipaos from the Dragon Empery are quite elegant... I might sound arrogant saying this, but I feel like this outfit really brings out my charm. Hehe, wouldn't you agree, Commander?
