These guys are tougher than I expected!
I'm so tired of bosses that can't handle their subordinates, like you.
You okay, Commander? You've had this tired, stiff look on you for a while now... You're not getting rusty like Suruga, are you?
Thought as much. I'll help you with your training, then! Come on, out of your room and into the fresh outdoors for some jogging! And later, we'll do some sparring!

There's no fun in knocking a battle out of the park if nobody's there to witness it. Anyway, once this work is done, I'll go train with Hyuuga. After that, you, I, and Suruga will go for a drink with Ise! Sound good to you?
People say you can push yourself harder if it's to protect someone. Then for everyone's sake, I, Kii, shall become the strongest battleship... Pfft, yeah right! Hahahahah!

I mean, we don't need to go that far. We're already dearly important to one another, aren't we? ...Don't worry, I'll still accept it! And of course, I'll keep on keeping you safe, just like I always have!
Not bad! I'll take it!
You're the brains, I'm the brawn!
Don't be shy! Let's do this with flair!
Let's celebrate with a glass after we get back!

ex.line: Look who's arrived early. Now then, where are we going on a sortie today?
Say, how about a little drink after the working day is done? Although since my drinking pals are coming along, I guess we'll have more than just a little! Hahahahah!
Physical contact doesn't normally bother me, but you clearly did that on purpose!
Come here! Let's fight to the last ship sailing!
Now this is a victory I want the whole world to see! Hahahahah!

lines.line: Refreshing drinks, delicious food, warm sunshine... and a pool to beat the heat? Heh, isn't this the essence of summer?
Refreshing drinks, delicious food, warm sunshine... and a pool to beat the heat? Heh, isn't this the essence of summer?
There you are, at last. Want to get something to eat, if you're hungry? Like dumplings, or a rice ball, or something.
Hey Suruga, let's go somewhere- Come on, don't be all "I like it indoors" and "I'd rather not draw attention," just come out and enjoy the summer with us!
Akashi sure got that vending machine and stall set up quick... She's ingenious, but only when there's money to be made...
Why the hesitation? It's just a pool. Nothing wrong with just swimming together with me, is there?
Really looks like Amagi, Akagi, and all the rest are enjoying the summer. All thanks to you, Commander. You should be proud.
Want to head to that other area? I'll come with you.
Whoa, this drink is really good. Want a taste, Commander? Hehehe~
Tosa-class battleship number one - Tosa.

I am Tosa, the first Tosa-class battleship. My construction began long ago, but its completion never came... I have been an aircraft carrier, a battleship, a weapons testbed, and a target; they worked and reworked me to the bone. But now I am here, in this form, and I will not disappoint you.

I am the nameship of the Tosa-class battleships, Tosa. I only serve those who I deem worthy. As for you... Well, I do not believe in making hasty judgments. For the time being, let me first assess your abilities.
Give me an engaging task, should you find one, Commander.
I hate the phrase, "it's how it's always been done." The same mistakes will forever be repeated as long as fools keep spouting it.
Brute force - the most primitive, but also most effective approach. That said, I much prefer fighting with words over swords.
I do not shy away from using any trick required to achieve my goals. I would rather that than play by the rules and end up at the bottom of the sea.
Stay behind if you cannot fight. The weak should know their place from the strong - this is the belief my sister holds.
I am neither as forward-thinking as Amagi, nor as short-fused as my sister. What? What's incorrect? The part about my sister, or my description of myself?
Seeing as you have time to kill, why not practice your swordplay with me?
Acting on a momentary impulse can have deadly repercussions. I do hope you're not getting any outlandish ideas.
A leader chooses their mission, not the other way around. You should take this principle to heart, Commander.
A mission has been completed, has it? Then don't loiter around, go and claim the rewards at once.
A letter, eh? I would be grateful if even a third of the information in it is credible.
Did you see anything extraordinary on your expedition? You may find it inconsequential, but I am curious to know what you encountered.
You don't expect me to announce when a commission team returns, do you?
You have an eye for talent, Commander.
Hah, my rampage is soon to begin!
It's over already? Hmph, I expected more from them.
Gah, so even I overestimate my abilities at times...
Bear witness to who reigns supreme!
Hahaha... Battles fraught with suspense are always the most interesting!
Weaklings belong behind the shorelines. I have no business with someone who cannot handle even a tidal wave.
You are brave, lowering your guard around someone that could take your life at any moment. You say it's because you trust me? Hahahah. Trust. A fine word that is.
You are an odd one, remaining unfazed in the presence of the Sakura Empire's ships. Still, I do enjoy exchanging stories with you. What have you in store for me today?

When I am alone, I let no rules or regulations restrain me; I push my will through. However, when you are present, I feel compelled to follow the rules and act with prudence. You are really something else, Commander.

Your ambitions and dreams are of no concern to me, but I know that you need me. Which, I admit, is also true in reverse. Our fates are intertwined, and we cannot afford to lose one another... Hahahah, isn't that right?

Simply being given life in this world would've been enough for me, but now I've even been given a partner to spend said life with... Hmph, life is a long and arduous road, and I am happy that I get to walk it with you.
You knew... I wouldn't be able to turn down something so precious... Hehe, quite the devious one, aren't you?
Together with me now, my sister!
I am still no match for you, Amagi.

ex.line: All right, hurry up and get to work. I'll find something to do.
*Sigh*, that damn commander... If I'm not careful, then Kaga's going to... But wait, even Amagi isn't to be overlooked... Huh?! When'd you get there?!
Commander, you seem to be dealing with Amagi's bootlicker pretty well... Heh, actually, my sister's even harder to handle. Be grateful that you have me.

As ships, our purpose is to connect the hearts of mankind as well as the ocean's routes. No matter what shape we might take, that will always hold true. Even if we were born for the sake of war, that will always hold true.
Privacy...? As someone who is strong, isn't it only natural to protect someone who is weak such as you, wherever and whenever?
You want to cross swords with me? We could, but... It would be a dull match if I don't go all-out, but then you are bound to suffer grave injuries... Hmm, what to do...
Do not let your hand waver. Be more bold if you so wish. Hahaha!
Missions? Let me see them.
Oh, was that the mission completion notification? How was the payment?
Mail? If it's a reassignment request, I'd just rip it up.
Why don't you tell me about something interesting that happened out there? I like hearing about that stuff.
A commission team has returned. It would seem I've grown used to announcing this.

Lest you forget, no matter how great your ambitions may be, you are but a vulnerable human. If you are ever in danger, you must take cover and protect yourself. If misfortune befalling you strips me of my reason to move forward, I will hunt you down through the depths of hell or the pinnacles of heaven. Don't think you can escape from me, ahahaha!

lines.line: An inspection? ...You're awfully gung-ho about your work considering how hot it is outside... Surely you wouldn't have some sort of ulterior motive?
An inspection? ...You're awfully gung-ho about your work considering how hot it is outside... Surely you wouldn't have some sort of ulterior motive?
Whew... It's nice to get to play freely, but I must take heed of all the extra attention this swimsuit draws to me...
You should avoid swimming too much as you're so sickly, Amagi. How tragic it is, a ship such as you being so frail...
The shrine maiden and her sister, frolicking in the water... A rare sight to be had.
We could play a round of go if you are bored. I want a new opponent after playing against only my sister for so long.
You're in need of a snack? Sorry, I only just got these from my sister. That said... we could exchange side dishes, I suppose...
Try this with my sister instead. Actually, don't; it would likely backfire on you...
My sister is still on the way here? Hmph, then I will prepare you some food.

Commander? ...You were looking for me? Hah, you have the most atrocious luck. I've just started getting comfortable and I'm not leaving anytime soon. Besides, the banquet will be done in time even without my help... You seem to be enjoying yourself. How about you join me instead of merely staring?

Commander? ...You were looking for me? Hah, you have the most atrocious luck. I've just started getting comfortable and I'm not leaving anytime soon. Besides, the banquet will be done in time even without my help... You seem to be enjoying yourself. How about you join me instead of merely staring?
You want me to come with you and enjoy the banquet? I could, but all merrymaking and no sharpening makes any blade grow dull - even yours.
Let's join the festivities after this bath. Surprised I'm going to attend the banquet, are you? Hah, I really am. Someone has to look after you, after all.
I'd rather stay here than go to some party. That being said, I suppose I wouldn't mind going if it's with you. Nothing wrong in changing your mind sometimes, right?
The view up here is pretty good. Maybe it will even give me new insight that'll help in battle... Insight which I will need to keep you safe.
Here I thought this was a great place to wait out the banquet, yet you found me in no time. No matter. In a way, it's proof of how likeminded we are.
Tell me, did my sister put you up to this? She didn't? Alright, then let's stay here a while longer. I want to make the most of this rare opportunity to enjoy the view on this cruise ship.
Do you like the sensation of moist skin?
What is it? Unless it's really important, save it for after I've put some clothes on.
Relax. I have no reason to stop you.
I suggest finishing all your missions before the banquet commences.
Completed a mission, did you? Then don't forget to claim the rewards.
Here's a letter with your name on it. I hope it isn't from my sister, demanding you take me to the banquet.
You're back. Did anything amusing happen out there? If so, sit down and tell me about it.
Are you so distracted by my figure that you completely missed the commission that's been completed?
An effortless victory, I see. How dull. I'm going back to take a bath.
Being so exposed does you no favors in battle, it seems.

My old self would never have imagined she'd one day be unclad in a bath, flirting with you. And yet, here I am, and I'm not afraid to change again for you. Heehee. We share a destiny, you and I - therefore, everything I do for you is for myself. That only makes sense, no?
Yamato-class battleship number two - Musashi.

I am Musashi, the existence that was supposed to turn the tides in the Sakura Empire's favor during that war... But there is no point in lamenting the past, as it is not in my nature. All I know is, this time, I shall protect all that is dear to me, no matter the cost.

I am the Yamato-class battleship, Musashi. If it is my acknowledgment you seek, then quell the storms that rage across these seas with your magnificence. Hm? With a fleet as mighty as yours, even a weakling would find that task trivial.
Commander, what are your plans for the day? Should you have nothing in mind, I shall arrange your schedule in your stead.
Those with great power have a responsibility to protect those beneath them. Even you, Commander, shall find protection beneath my shade. Hehe.
It is in the cuckoo bird's nature to chirp. If it does not do so, then all you need to do is wait. Hehe... Do you understand the rationale behind my words, Commander?
Sometimes, it is more important to calm your mind and think about who your allies are than it is to exact vengeance on your enemies.
If you are weary, you should not hesitate to rest. I shall protect you and take care of your duties in your absence.
In my spare time... I enjoy foot baths. Soaking my feet in hot water seems to clear my head, despite the fact that the two cannot be farther apart. How curious...
I sometimes see Shinano sound asleep here. May the pleasant dreams you give her last forever.
A most courageous child... Hehe, I do not object...
Should you ever feel anxious or frightened, please come to me. Your safe haven is here.
How precious... If the warmth of one's touch is what you crave, then leap into my bosom. There is nothing to be ashamed of.
A new mission? Take it one step at a time, and at a comfortable pace. Haste makes waste.
The mission rewards have arrived. Our stockpiles continue to grow more and more abundant.
I brought over this letter addressed to you. Please look it over.

It is good that you have returned safely. Take your time and rest first. To be human is to trudge forward while carrying karmic burden atop your shoulders. There is no need for haste, for plenty of trials still await you in the future.
The children of the commission fleet have returned. I am unable to personally escort them back, but am nevertheless glad to see them safe and sound.
"Even the greatest trees start as small saplings." The smallest bit of effort today may one day become the weapon that shatters the enemy, the bulwark that protects what we love.
Musashi has arrived. Let us rid ourselves of haste and trepidation, for we shall advance with great solemnity.
Do not allow yourself to become drunk off the nectar of victory.
Do not overextend, and do not panic. I shall see to it that you are protected.
Your time is up!
No matter how dire things may be, I will always protect you!
If you insist on continuing down this path, I will not stop you. ...However, never forget that water can either support a ship, or capsize it.
The more magnificent the tree, the more it incurs the wind's jealousy. Remember this well - the more you rise in renown and rank, the more you should watch your words and deeds.

You've never seen me get mad? Hehe... Even the most docile of creatures know when to bare their fangs. You would do well not to judge one by their appearance. Having that said, it does take some extraordinary skill to make me angry.
Every person has a sentimental side - the same is true for you, as it is for me... Do you wish to see that side of me? Hehe... That all depends on how hard you work for it.

What's wrong? Are you still unable to find rest even within my bosom? Your anxiety and frustration are not easily set aside, you say? ...Hehe, cast your fears and doubts away and be at peace. As long as you are in Musashi's embrace, you shall be protected from all harm.

Entrust all your anxieties, doubts, and fears to me, and focus your mind only on moving forward without hesitation. Come, let me become your bedrock, your foundation. My beloved Commander, nothing in existence shall ever tear you from me.
You were able to discover exactly what I like... What a sweet child...
Thank you for everything you've done.
Stand behind me!
Let us show them the might of the Yamato class.
With you supporting me, I can unsheath even more of my might!

ex.line: Commander, I have already arranged your activities for the day. First off...
You find some of my colleagues difficult to deal with? Just bring me along next time. I shall teach them that an insult to you is an insult to me as well... Oh, that's not what you meant?
Phew... What a long day. Would you like to soak in the foot bath with me? I believe you've earned yourself a break.
My favorite food? It'd have to be sea bream. Especially freshly-fried sea bream tempura. Truly a wonderful taste not to be missed.
If you ever tire of petty formalities, allow me to handle the socializing for you. As always, I will make sure everything is done to perfection.
My lap awaits you. Hurry and come enjoy your respite.
If this sensation is to your liking, you are welcome to dive in face-first. Hehe.
You're back already? Did I not ask you to inform me beforehand so I can escort you personally...?
The children of the commission fleet have returned. If you are going to greet them, do bring me with you.
Relax and bask in the afterglow of victory. Hehe.
Fighting until the bitter end serves no purpose. Withdraw for now, and come back after regrouping your forces.

Return to my embrace after finishing today's work. What do I mean by "return," you ask? Exactly how it sounds. I wish to pamper... I mean, protect you from those who would take advantage of you in your sleep.

lines.line: "Welcome back, Master." Rather, that's what all the children at the café were saying to you when they greeted you at the door. Hehe, is this some new custom?
"Welcome back, Master." Rather, that's what all the children at the café were saying to you when they greeted you at the door. Hehe, is this some new custom?
Would you like a savory appetizer, or perhaps something sweet? Hehe, open your mouth. Allow me to feed you.
Would you also like to help out with our pop-up café? Though, I don't mind if you just stay put over there. I can't help but worry when I am unable to see you...
To celebrate this great victory, I shall see to it that our friends are served the finest refreshments. Hehe, naturally, it'll all be free of cost.
The item you ordered was never delivered? Worry not, I think I understand the situation... Sakawa, I'd like to have a word with you.

The girls have been giving it their all to make our pop-up café a success, and a few accidents are nothing we cannot overlook. If anyone feels aggrieved on this basis alone, then it is only fitting to teach them a lesson.
Is someone's service unsatisfactory? I shall go remind her then... That's not it? You just need me to handle an extra order?
Comfort and solace await you in my bosom. No one shall be allowed to disturb you.
Since you're here, put your troubles aside for now. We can worry about your mission later.
Good job on your sortie. Go ahead and take a seat anywhere you want. After I take care of the rest of my chores, I shall come serve you personally. Hehe.
Let us expurgate those who would muddy this tidy place!
I'll have to tidy this mess up first...
...Hmph. Hitting such a target is but an easy feat for me... Commander, tell me which prize you want. I'll win it, along with all the other ones I've been asked to get.
...Hmph. Hitting such a target is but an easy feat for me... Commander, tell me which prize you want. I'll win it, along with all the other ones I've been asked to get.
Well met. This bunny outfit I picked to suit your tastes, this water gun... Don't you think they're perfect for this amusement park? I suggest you simply enjoy yourself...
"The fox falls into the fortunate rabbit's trap," was it? Would you consider me the fox or the rabbit right now, I wonder? How fascinating... Heehee♥
I'm used to festival shooting games. Heehee, I know how good a shot you are. Why don't we have fun and test our skills together?
Preparing so many waterpark attractions and entertainment for your friends... I admire your efforts, Commander.
Just as you entertain us with this park, we'd like to treat your eyes with these different costumes. Of course, I'm able to offer more services...
It's not the same as thunder-clad sword swings or cannon fire, but that makes it all the more challenging. Don't worry - just point me toward my enemy, and I'll do the rest.
Missed again... This water gun's handling is poor at best. I have to wonder if Akashi made it, rather than Owari...
Are you more interested in my gun... or the fabric of my clothes? Heehee.
You know what they say about rabbits... don't you?♥
New missions. No matter how treacherous the situation is, a calm response will be more than enough to handle them.
Mission complete. May this bounty and these prizes reward your efforts.
Have you gotten a good look around? Then sit, rest, and watch as I break a new record.
The girls who went out on commission are back. Your welcome, and these prizes, will be a suitable reward for them.
Let's meet them with a threefold assault.
A satisfying victory. Your joy and peace of mind are reward enough for me.
If you're tired of games, then come and relax with me. I won't bite - in fact, I know plenty of ways to satisfy you... Heehee, good, good♥
Commander, the contract has been made according to your wishes. From now on, I will be your new refuge. Now, beloved Commander, are you prepared to live up to MY expectations?
Commander, the contract has been made according to your wishes. From now on, I will be your new refuge. Now, beloved Commander, are you prepared to live up to MY expectations?
Good morning, my beloved. Before you consider your plans for the day, please enjoy a breakfast made with love.

The road may be long and treacherous, but if you keep on marching, you'll make your way to dawn. Only by continuing on, undaunted, can we find true beauty... I will journey with you, be the rock that you can lean on and take shelter behind. It's a blessing for me to be that person to you.
In this long life, it's fun to stop and smell the flowers on the roadside once in a while... This time of year is bursting with life. Why not stop with me somewhere we can forget the 108 vices?
What do you want for dinner? Or would you prefer a taste of romance instead? Don't worry. I won't disappoint you, my dear.
Devote yourself to your ideals and the future you envision... As long as I'm by your side, you can rely on me for anything.
This white dress... It has special meaning to you, doesn't it?
Heehee... Give me all that you are, my beloved. I'm already prepared to receive you.
A letter... Hmm. From afar, it seems?
Welcome back. This time, I didn't misjudge the time of your return. Take a bath and relax yourself for now.
The commission team has returned. As you expected, they bring great spoils. Let's welcome them together.
I offer to you promised victory, my beloved. Hehe.
One mustn't be reckless in battle. Failure is but the foundation of success. Let's reform our offense and try once more.
As long as I have a reason to keep fighting...

Is something wrong? I sense hesitation... Do not be afraid of the hardships of your journey. As someone willing to give you everything, I'm happy to remove all obstacles from your path. All you must do is bravely march on to the promised future.
Hiyou-class aircraft carrier number one - Hiyou.

I'm Hiyou, Hiyou-class aircraft carrier number one. I'm a light carrier, but my damage control and loading capacity are just as good as a regular carrier's. After Midway, I was a key part of the Mobile Fleet and fought hard to my very last battle...
Light carrier Hiyou reporting in. Commander, I won't have you looking down on the Hiyou class just 'cause we're light carriers!
Heheh... Let's get some good work done today, Commander.
You gonna ask if I wanna go for lunch?
Ah, Izumo... I'd like to meet her one day.
I'm pretty sure mine are larger than Souryuu's...
I'm slow-witted? Hmph, believe it or not, I'm a girl with a lot on her mind.
I'm lightly armored, so, uh...
D-didn't I tell you I was lightly armored?!
A mission? As long as it ain't in the Marianas, I'll take it on...
If we keep earning honors, one day even I can become a full-fledged carrier...!
Doesn't matter if it's a pigeon or a plane delivering your mail, does it?
Planes, up on deck... It's time we all get ready.
I was actually designed with these types of missions in mind...
... Seems my technique's gotten more refined.
In the name of the wings of the sky: take off!
It was all thanks to my little planes.
It's pretty hard to ignore the damage done to my planes...
Planes... take off!
So filthy... What? I'm not talking about you...
Junyou is... I know I'm warning you about my own little sister, but she's really dangerous...
My eyepatch? Kinda just started wearing it on a whim. Plenty of people out there who dress like pirates, you know?
My opinion of you has improved a little bit. Just a little bit, you hear!
I've sent out all my planes. Right now... there's just us two in here.
You've been real good to me, Commander... So, how about I be your lifelong partner from this day onwards...?
Heh, you really get me.
Hiyou-class aircraft carrier number two - Junyou.

It's me, Junyou, your oldest friend! After those nasty girls tormented me so much, after all the fighting in the Aleutians, Santa Cruz, the Marianas, I finally got to see you again! I really don't know how you could have forgotten me... but please, hurry up and remember! Eheheh...
Oh, Commander, it's gotten so late. You've kept poor Junyou waiting. Let's go home together, ❀like always❀.
Commander, I will ❀always❀ be with you.
Don't you think... we're bound to be together, Commander? Ahaha.
I wonder how I can make you remember, Commander...
Ryuujou... Where have I heard that name before...?
It's not funny anymore! You have to remember, Commander! We've been together ❀since the very beginning❀!
Commander? We've known each other for so long, you can be a little more forward...
I know exactly what you're thinking, Commander.
Oh, did you want to go on a date with me ❀again❀, Commander? What can I say...
That was a rich, full day. Now how about we go on a date somewhere?
Commander? Didn't I tell you not to write so many love letters~?
I trust you brought my favorite, just ❀like always❀...?
Hmph, those girls need to learn to read the room...
My planes too...
You're trying to get between me and the Commander... I'LL KILL YOU!
Ahaha, when I feel the Commander's love for me, I can't help but go a bit overboard.
We lost? What are you saying, Commander? Don't you know Junyou ❀always❀ wins?
DIE!
Commander, don't tell me you want to break up?!
The Marianas? I really... don't like it there...
I know all your favorite things, Commander.
Our first time together? I know it was ❀back then❀, but how could you not remember...?
No! There's nothing wrong with me! I'm not sick! I'm not! It's just everyone else... why don't you remember!
Commander, you finally remembered... our ❀memories❀ and our ❀promise❀... Ahhh, I'm so touched... Hehe... Well then, just like we promised ❀back then❀...
You really remembered what I like!
Aircraft carrier, Houshou.

I guess you could say that I was the first aircraft carrier ever in the world. You could call me the eldest sister, or mother, of them all! Feel free to consult with me whenever you'd like, Commander. I'm always here for you.
Ah, it's the Commander... My name is Houshou, and I'll be in your care from now on. Please leave the children of the fleet in my care. I won't let you down!
Commander, have you eaten yet? No? Let me make something for you. You can't head to work without first preparing your body and mind!
You're like a kid sometimes, Commander... Come over here~
Having long legs isn't necessarily a good thing. A high center of mass makes it easy to tip over...
Commander, I prepared some snacks for us. Do you want to relax for a while?
It's amazing to see how much my younger sisters have accomplished, but sometimes it makes me a bit sad to see everything they've gone through...
Are you looking for me, Commander?
Ahh! ... Commander, that's naughty. You can't touch me there.
You've got new missions, Commander. Care for a challenge this time?
Commander is sure forgetful, always needing my reminder just to claim the rewards.
Commander, there's mail for you!
Good work, Commander! Would you like dinner? A bath? Or perhaps... a drink first? Hehe~!
Commander, your girls have returned from commission. I'll welcome them back now, but you should hurry over as well.
Now I can help you even more, Commander!
I'm not very skilled in real combat... but I shall not betray your expectations!
Commander, will this be enough?
I'm so sorry, Commander...
It's time for a feast!
Looks like I can't afford to take it easy just yet.
Is something the matter, Commander?
Want to take a nap, Commander?

I look a bit like a courtesan? Hehe~ Well then, mister, it seems like tonight shall be our one and only night together. Let us feel the warmth of our embrace, then let the memories fade to nothing. How does that sound?

A prominent person once praised my beauty, but to be honest, I am not so sure about myself. But if Commander was to acknowledge me, perhaps I could find my confidence. So... Commander, am I beautiful?

Commander, the moon is beautiful tonight, isn't it? I've prepared some drinks... would you like to stargaze together? I wouldn't do this for anyone else - this is a special service just for you, my dear.
My dream is to one day settle down with the person I love and open a small bar somewhere... Now, it doesn't seem like my dream is so distant anymore. Right, my dear?
My, oh my... You know exactly how to make a girl's heart quiver~

While everyone slips into sweet dreams from the night's festivities, the sound of gossamer sliding off of smooth skin reaches your ears... Hehe, would you like to spend this night under the stars with me, Master~?

While everyone slips into sweet dreams from the night's festivities, the sound of gossamer sliding off of smooth skin reaches your ears... Hehe, would you like to spend this night under the stars with me, Master~?
At least for tonight, I wish you and I to pursue the happiness of being together...
Master, what do you think of your Tanabata present? Are~ you~ satisfied~?
Hehe... Master, if your heart races, then it's my victory~
The ephemeral autumn is but a fleeting dream
Zuihou-class aircraft carrier - Zuihou.

The port here is so huge! Everywhere I go, there are friends to be made and fun things to do, but I always find myself in new and unfamiliar places without even realizing it... Hmm? You want me to tell you more? Sure thing~♪ Then, come have a seat right next to me. You can listen to my stories while you eat~!

Chirp, chirp! Here comes aircraft carrier Zuihou! I might be a carrier now, but I've also served as a tanker and submarine tender, which means I can do all sorts of useful things for you, Commander! ...Oh, right! This is for you! It's candy that'll bring you good luck!

Good morning, Commander! Huh? You didn't eat breakfast yet? Aren't you hungry? Here, I brought you some hot tofu soup and senbei crackers! I can't finish it all on my own, so have as much as you'd like!
Commander, did you find something cool just now? Show it to me, please? Nnnngh...! Aww, I can't see anything... W-would it help if I tried hopping?
The last time I went to go look for some beautiful flowers, I ended up getting lost in the fog. But then, Unzen showed up and rescued me! Blessed be the Great Sage!
If things ever get dicey, I can just dive into the water! I can totally endure something like that! ...Huh? Why don't I just swim to safety? W-well, umm... that's because I can't swim...

Commander, I had a weird dream about a gourd last night! In the dream, delicious rice kept pouring from the gourd, and no matter how much rice I ate, more would just keep coming out. You know how happy that made me? And then, the gourd was so big that when I crawled inside, I could fit easily!
Chirp, chirp! I knew I could always count on you, Commander~♪
Chirp~♪ What a warm and fuzzy feeling... Ahhhn... Ehehe~♪
Don't touch there! I'll get angry, you know!
A new mission has been posted! So, where should we go next? And what are we gonna do? In any case, let's head out together right now! Yes, now! This very instant!
Mission complete~! Today's a lucky day as well, so let me see what our rewards are~!
Your mail's here! I'm sure it's good news!
Welcome back, Commander! Where'd you go today? Did you do anything fun? Chirp, chirp! Tell me, tell me!
You all went on an adventure to a faraway place, right? So, did you bring any souvenirs back? Surely you brought back lots of shiny treasures and gold coins, right~♪
Luck smiles on me again! Thank you so much! In return, allow me to whip you up a tasty homemade meal!
Don't worry, I'm prepared for everything!
Victory! Looks like today's another lucky day!
Oh no, we've been beaten... I knew it was a mistake to let my guard down...
Fly towards the light!
I-it hurts... I, I don't think... I can move for much longer...
Commander, are you struggling with negative thoughts? Can you tell me about them? I'll try to help you figure something out!
Commander, if there's anything you'd like to do, I'll be there to support you! So, you can tell me about eeeeverything~ Okay?
I had a feeling something good was going to happen today, and then... you were standing right in front of me! Chirp, chirp~♪ Isn't that lovely?

Commander, let's play a game! Close your eyes, and open your mouth... Chirp~♪ So, do you know what I just fed you? ...Huh? It wasn't enough for you to really taste anything? Hmm, maybe the spoon I always use is too small...?

Ehehe... Being together with you, Commander, is the greatest fortune I can ask for! So, I'll share some of my luck with you! Now, you'll be able to get any treasure you want, and all your dreams will surely come true~♪

What is this? Huh? You're really giving this to me? It's so sparkly and beautiful~! Hmm? I'm supposed to wear it? Like this? What am I supposed to do with it after putting it on? Eh? As long as I have it on, I'll never get lost?! Wow, I'm so happy I'll always be able to return to your side no matter where I go!
Thank you, Commander! Want to stay for dinner? I'll make some really delicious rice for you!
If you want to get luckier, you'll have to eat more!
It's embarrassing when you call me your senior! Let's just play together instead!

ex.line: Commander, wasn't that rainbow we just saw simply beautiful? I'm sure something good's going to happen today!
Whee, Commander's picking me up! Oh, wow! I can see it now, from over your shoulder! Commander, what's that thing over there? Please tell me?
Are you heading out, Commander? Can I come with you? ...Huh? There's something you'd like me to take care of? Gladly! I'll do whatever you ask of me~♪

Commander, how could you? You went out to play while I was busy... We're not talking anymore! ...Huh? You found something shiny and sparkly outside? I wonder what it might be... Let's go check it out!
Woah, what a beautiful gemstone! ...Huh? Am I still mad at you? N-no, but next time, you have to take me with you! Promise you'll tell me if something interesting happens!
You're the bestest, Commander!
Commander's shoulder... is so cozy… Zzzz…
Nice and warm~ Soft and fuzzy~ Did you want to touch too, Commander? That's fine by me~
Commander?! You're back already? Ugh... I was going to pick you up, but then I took a wrong turn, and... Chirp, chirp...
Commander, care for some tea? Oh wow, the tea stalk's standing up straight! I'm in luck today too!
Luck isn't the only thing that matters! Hard work is just as important!
We won, Commander! I'm so happy! We're invincible as long as we're together!
I have to at least... return to the Commander's side!
No matter what happens, I won't give up on my desire to be with you, Commander! As long as we're together, anything is possible!

lines.line: Commaaaaander~! Over here, over here! I'm right here! Chirp, chirp! Commander, come hand out balloons with me! Did you know these balloons can bring you good fortune? Here you go, the first one's for you!

Commaaaaander~! Over here, over here! I'm right here! Chirp, chirp! Commander, come hand out balloons with me! Did you know these balloons can bring you good fortune? Here you go, the first one's for you!
Commander, here's your lucky balloon! I'm giving the biggest one to you!

If we give lucky balloons to everybody, then the whole world will be lucky, right? Ehehe~ just thinking about it makes me feel warm and fuzzy inside, so giving out these balloons isn't tiring at all~♪
Huh? Fweeeeeh! Th-the balloons are going to carry me awaaaaay!! Phew... Commander, thank you so much!
The balloons are shiny and smooth in the sunlight! I love bright things! Chirp, chirp~♪
Something good is going to happen today! I know because I can feel it! Chirp, chirp~♪ See? I'm holding this lucky balloon, and I get to spend the day with you! And that's a wonderful thing!
Commander~ Ahhn, Commander~ Ehehe♪ Chirp, chirp~♪
Ehehe~ I'm flyyyying! Commander, you'll make sure to catch me, right?
Jeez... Stop that already. Bad Commander.
Commander, I've been waiting for you? Chirp? Oh, umm... It's not like I chose to stay here because I'm scared of getting lost or anything! >.<
Commaaaander! Our friends are back! Maybe we'll get better rewards because of these lucky balloons~ Chirp, chirp~♪

I wonder, was I able to successfully share a portion of my luck with you, Commander? Ehehe... For some reason, whenever I'm with you, it feels like I'll be happy forever and ever! And this must be the best kind of happiness, right? Chirp, chirp~♪
First ship of the Shouhou-class aircraft carriers, Shouhou.

I'm Shouhou, first ship o' the Shouhou-class! 
The luck's a bit poor, but they ain't a thing I can do 'bout that.
Commander, Shouhou's the name. I don't have a lotta firepower or planes like those regular carriers, but there's plenty o' stuff I can do that they can't! A real pleasure to meet ya!
I'll protect ya even if it means puttin' my own life at risk, Commander!
Ahh~ the folks always tell me, I'm gonna be a real beauty when I grow up~
Ah, Commander, I'm ready to give it my all t'day as well! Let's go stick it to those bad guys!
My big sis and Kaga are always lookin' after me, but one day, I wanna be more independent!
Commander, the weather's real swell today! What's with the gloomy mug? Let's play together!
I don't really mind, but you shouldn't be doin' that to others.
Nnh... Stuff like this... is better saved for night~
Commander, there's new missions here!
I brought the mission rewards!
Commander! The mail's right above ya~
Need a rest? How 'bout I give your back a nice thumpin'?
A commission's all wrapped up~! Let's go welcome everyone back!
I'm a li'l closer to becomin' an adult!
Sisters, charge! Let's show 'em who's the star o' this show!
I've got the God o' Fortune by my side! Of course I'm gonna win!
How could I lose to those guys?
It's show time, y'all!
Commander treats me like a li'l kid too... Yer makin' me sad...
My children are all Shikigami - easy to store, but a pain to maintain! Y'all came at the right time - maintenance!
I have no regrets 'bout what happened at the Coral Sea. I read we oughta accept our failures, else we won't learn from our mistakes! Eh? You think I'm amazin'?
Commander, how do I become mature real fast? ...I'm fine as I am now? Really? But I'm always thinkin' I rely too much on you and my sisters...
Mm... I got it now. Relyin' on others ain't such a bad thing! I won't be all jittery about growin' up faster now... Havin' that said though~ Commander, can I rely on ye even more now?

Eh? Commander, are y'sure this is going to the right girl? Someone as immature as me? ... I see, I've earned yer respect and recognition... Commander, from here on out, I'll do my best, so please continue to care for me!
Wow! This is one of my favorite things! Thank you!
Waaaah! My candy! Candy is spillin’ everywhere! ...Wh-why are y’all chasin’ me? Commander, help me catch the pumpkin!
Waaaah! My candy! Candy is spillin’ everywhere! ...Wh-why are y’all chasin’ me? Commander, help me catch the pumpkin!
Trick or treat!
Hehe, I’m a real beaut, aren’t I?
All these crazy pumpkins... whose sorcery is this?
Commander, it’s Halloween! Halloween!!
Commander, don’t! Nooo!! Those pumpkins will chase after anythin’ that touches them! Ahh!!
Pumpkin Fleet, sortie!
Commander, how do I look now that I've grown up? Are ya fallin' in love with me already? Mhm, ye definitely are~
Commander, how do I look now that I've grown up? Are ya fallin' in love with me already? Mhm, ye definitely are~
Don't look so sad... I'll keep growing. I'm sure of it!
Commander, gimme a chance to prove myself!
Why does everyone treat me like a kid when I'm already all grown up?
Grown-ups need to play, too! Won't you play with me, Com~man~der?
Commander, do ye like my Shikigami? They ain't the bitin' type, I swear!
I feel like I've definitely matured some! Commander, what do ya think?
Sis... sisters...
Ryuujou-class Light Carrier - Ryuujou

I am Ryuujou of the Sakura Empire, a seasoned warrior who has served in the First through Fourth Carrier Divisions, and participated in campaigns in the Phillipines, East Indies, Aleutian Islands, and Guadalcanal. I don't look the part...? Th-that must be because of that one incident at Iwate that stunted my growth! Milord, just you wait. I'll show you the extent of my capabilities!
Milord, I am called Ryuujou, a ranger from the Land of the Rising Sun! I shall lay down my seven lives to mete out justice in your name!
A day off? Milord, my week only consists of Monday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Friday!
Milord, we cannot survive unless we fight!
Odango... these delicacies will cause my heart to waver, so... Um, I suppose I can reward myself a little.... Mmmh! So delicious!
When you're stressed out, you should go watch the fish swimming around peacefully in the aquarium. I'm not sure why, but it always calms me down.
I fight for a just cause! No matter who stands before me, I swear to give it my all!
Milord, please be careful. I am just as top-heavy as Illustrious.
Eek!!! Oh, it wasn't Saratoga after all. However, you seem to be even more mischievous than she is.
A new mission is here! Whether it's combat or training, let's knock it out at the speed of sound!
The mission rewards are here! A bagel? Is this a snack for me? Thank you, Milord. Well then, let's move out!
A telegram? Oh, it's not a combat report from Headquarters. I suppose there might be some value to reading it then.
Don't break formation even when we head back to port! The glory of the Sakura Empire is in its meticulousness!
Worldly things are of little significance! The only things that matter are spirit and resilience!
Thank you very much, Milord! Shall we go run a lap to test my new strength?
Now, count up your sins!
Despair... shall be your final destination!
Ugh... my body is all beat up...
As long as I am here, nothing shall stand in my way!
My life is burning bright!
No matter where you are, the top brass is all the same...
Milord, when it comes to war, victory is more important than good or evil!
Commander, feel free to rely on me as you please. Should you will it, I will execute any command.
Commander, did you prepare this meal for me by yourself? In that case, I'll be more than glad to dig in! Mm... thanks for the food! Eh? You'll continue to cook for me when I come back!?
Just being able to see your face before I sortie fills me to the brim with energy and makes me feel like I can't lose to anyone!
From now on, no matter what perils we might face, I will protect you with everything I have! Even if I sink to the bottom of the ocean, I will not permit any harm to come to you!
I would be grateful to receive any gift from you, Milord!
*yawn*... Finally, a good night's rest... Now, to pick up where I left off on that RPG... M-m-m-milord, why are you here?! I wasn't slacking off or anything, I w-w-was just... Ughh....
*yawn*... Finally, a good night's rest... Now, to pick up where I left off on that RPG... M-m-m-milord, why are you here?! I wasn't slacking off or anything, I w-w-was just... Ughh....
*yawn*... O-one moment! I'll get myself in order!
It's good to always be ready for battle, but this isn't... so bad either, wouldn't you agree, Milord?

I cannot believe how addictive this technological marvel of a game console can be...! B-but that's not to say it has no merits whatsoever! After all, if we could settle wars through these games, nobody would have to get hurt!
C-can we really allow foodstuffs as devilishly tempting as these deep-fried chips of potato to exist in our society?!
Zzzzz... Milord?! Are we being attacked?! ...I lowered my guard and fell asleep? Forgive me for this shameful display!
Splendid work, Milord! If you so like, come take it easy with me!
Milord! C-could you please consider rewarding me with some potato chips?
These games and snacks are a sort of trial for me! Rest assured, Milord! My devotion will not be swayed by the likes of these items!
All right! Steady! Steadyyy! Gottem! Hahahah! Now I'll- M-Milord?! I-I'm just, umm... enjoying an after-school break!
All right! Steady! Steadyyy! Gottem! Hahahah! Now I'll- M-Milord?! I-I'm just, umm... enjoying an after-school break!
You came at a time most opportune, Milord! I would like you to join me for this Master Rank quest!
The character I've created is a brave and honorable samurai, much like myself!
Yes! I dug up a rare material! Haha! It's true what they say about you bringing luck, Milord!
It's so convenient, being able to play a game anywhere you want, whenever you want... But I must have discipline! I must not let myself fall for temptation!
My homework? Rest assured, Milord, I completed it some time ago, as one should!
Do you wish to go on a hunt with me, Milord? Let me move over... There. Please, join me on the bench!
Whuah! Oh no... Milord, your action just led to my death. Why did you have to do that?
A new electronic message? Could it be an invite to a party?
I always strive to do my best, be it with video games or whatever else! My ambition is to be like the legendary L.I.!
Quest complete! And without using any continues, too!
Through this game, I've deepened my bond with my friends, and made fun memories with you, Milord... I-I won't deny it came at some cost to my discipline, but even so, I am glad I got into this game!

Milooord! *splash*... Heheh, behold the amusement park's crown jewel - the Meandering Megamanjuu Dragon Slide! If that's too long, it's also known as the Manjuu Octopus Slide. Personally, though, I think the former name is cooler!

Milooord! *splash*... Heheh, behold the amusement park's crown jewel - the Meandering Megamanjuu Dragon Slide! If that's too long, it's also known as the Manjuu Octopus Slide. Personally, though, I think the former name is cooler!
These slides are quite jumbled together, so reaching the peak without a guide is a very tall order. Milord, if you wish to take the slide again, allow me to be your guide!
Milord, let quickly us move on to the next attraction! Time waits for no one!
Go with the flow like a dragon, ride the waves like a dragon! ...Hm? Is there... not much of a difference between the two?
There are not only submarines in the pool, but also mutant manjuus, you say? Rest assured, I shall make quick work of them!
The stalls in this park sell pretty good food! If you're hungry, Milord, allow me to make a recommendation!
Th-that tickles, Milord!
Are you afraid of heights, Milord? If so, please sit behind me! I'll cover your eyes with my tail so you can't see below you!
Milord, just to be safe, hold on to me so you won't- Eek!
No! Milord! I understand you want to take the slide again, but please don't cut ahead in line! ...You don't know where the line starts since you just got back from a sortie? Oh, my apologies!
Watch! This shall be the highlight!

Once I'm done showing you around here, I can take you to another attraction and- *tummy growls*... Oh, take a break, you say? O-of course! A break it is! Ideally, let's go to a place where we can eat while playing a game!
Aircraft carrier, Akagi.

I am the glorious Akagi, the pride of the peerless First Carrier Division. With my famed air wing, I shall overcome any battle as long as you are with me. Yes, Commander, as long as we are together...
We finally meet, Commander. However, there appear be too many eyesores here. Please allow me to "clean up" a bit before we deepen our relationship. Hehehe~
Ah, welcome back... Commander, if you had taken any more of your sweet time, I would have turned this place into a sea of fire~
Commander, are you keeping Akagi in your most secret of thoughts? Mmm, how delightful~.
Commander, you’re so cute when you are hard at work. Just watching you makes me feel like I’ll overheat~
Don’t make fun of me for being slow-footed. See? I’ve~ caught~ you~
You smell like... that girl! Commander, Akagi needs to step out for a bit~
Akagi loves you so, Commander~
If you so desire, I would not mind if you partake of me in front of all the others.
A new mission... is another opportunity to deepen our bonds. *giggles*
Rewards? Being together with you, Commander, is all the reward I need.
Commander, who sent you this letter? A girl? Who is she?
Five Minutes of Fate? You mean every five minutes that we spend together?
I was hoping that they wouldn’t have come back at all... Commander, I’ve already confirmed the completion of the commission. No more than a glance should be needed from you.
Commander, your love is filling up Akagi's chest...
Are you girls also trying to get close to Commander? Ahahaha!
I will do anything for Commander’s sake, even if I must slay a god.
This wound is nothing compared to the thought of you abandoning me, Commander!
My love is invincible! Ahaha... ahahaha!
Ahahaha! I’m getting excited!
If Commander was cut up into little pieces, he would never be able to leave Akagi’s side or break her heart ever again... Ahahaha!
We were destined to meet. I knew at first sight that you were the one I’ve been looking for my whole life.
You belong to me, and me only, Commander! That's something you should never forget, even if you are in charge of an entire fleet... Or else...
Commander, why were you talking to that girl? Weren’t you coming to see Akagi? She was tempting you? Then... Akagi is going to make her disappear.
Commander... With this, nothing will get between us ever again... Your embrace, your smile, your scent... all belong to me.
I have waited an eternity for this day to come. No one shall be able to separate us ever again! My mind, body, and soul belong to you, as yours all belong to me. Haha... ahahahaha!
Oh no, what shall I do... At this rate, I shall have to surrender my heart to you~
Am I beautiful, Commander?
Look out for friendly fire~!
I'm very tolerant, you know...
Commander, are you testing Akagi's love~?
"When you gaze long into the abyss, the abyss also gazes into you". Commander, please do not forget that when you gaze at Akagi~ *giggles*
"When you gaze long into the abyss, the abyss also gazes into you." Commander, please do not forget that when you gaze at Akagi~ *giggles*
Ahh... Welcome back, my dear Commander. I wonder where you've been. Take your clothes off so I may know if the smell of vixens lingers on you~
Akagi picked this swimsuit out just for you, Commander~! Are you falling in love with me even more deeply?
Commander, it's dangerous to be separated at sea. Please hold my hand tightly~
Relax, Kaga. You're my only friend. You'll always have a place by my side.
Wait until tonight, Commander. Kaga and I shall use our planes to hold a most spectacular fireworks show for you!
Commander, what were you doing with that "Rodney" girl?
Commander, won't you come teach me how to swim? Oh? What did you just say~?
Has the commission fleet returned? If you're going, won't you take Akagi with you?
Commander will always remain by Akagi's side... Right, "Gods?" Of course... Akagi will deal with the pests.... Ahaha...
Commander will always remain by Akagi's side... Right, "Gods?" Of course... Akagi will deal with the pests.... Ahaha...
Welcome back, Commander. Would you like to have dinner, a bath or... ahh, forget about that and eat me up first~
Commander, we'll always be together, this year as well~
Commander, I've finished this batch of paperwork. Is there anything else you'd like me to attend to? Of course, if you're tired, please tell me~

Commander, you just spoke with that girl, didn't you? Just an "ordinary greeting?" Akagi understands... but if you get even an inch more "ordinary" with her, Akagi can't guarantee what will happen... Ahaha...
Ahaha... Akagi is always ready and willing~
Commander, I've been waiting for you~ What a sinful one you are, to tempt Akagi like this for so long... But at long last, nobody will ever get between us again...♡
Commander, I've been waiting for you~ What a sinful one you are, to tempt Akagi like this for so long... But at long last, nobody will ever get between us again...♡
Have you awoken, Commander? Akagi will always be at your side~
Commander, I knew you'd be busy at the party, so I waited until the very end for you. Now, your full and undivided attention shall belong to Akagi alone~ Hehe~♡
I will not do anything that would tarnish your reputation, but... if any meddlesome pests insisted on getting in your way... Ehehe...

Indeed. While you were socializing, I made sure to strengthen our bonds with the other factions. At events like these, Shinano is horribly out of place, and if I may say so, the burden may be a bit too great for Nagato.
Commander, why won't you get drunk with me already... Haah, even though Akagi has been so lonely for so long...
Ah?! Commander...?!
Commander, there's a vacant seat right next to me~ Wouldn't you like to come a bit closer~?
It's just the two of us here... Yes, Commander, feel free to do whatever your heart so desires~
A letter, huh? ...Hey, Commander? Just what kind of uncouth person would go out of their way to get between us at a time like this...?
A toast to your victorious return, Commander... Hehehe~
Who will you send to greet the commission fleet?
1st CarDiv, Akagi, sallying forth~
My love shall burn everything away~ Ahahahaha!!
At least... protect my friends and compatriots...!
This banquet is my present to you... and your attendance is the greatest reward I could hope for~ Indeed, I shall not grant you leave tonight until you pass out. Ehehe... Ahahaha~♡
This banquet is my present to you... and your attendance is the greatest reward I could hope for~ Indeed, I shall not grant you leave tonight until you pass out. Ehehe... Ahahaha~♡
Commander, are you enjoying Akagi's banquet? If it is entertainment you desire... Ehehe. You can ask me for anything, you know?
Tonight, you are not allowed to meet with anyone other than me. Exchanging pleasantries...? Oh, are you not satisfied with "exchanging pleasantries" with Akagi alone? Hehehe~
What's the matter, Commander? Hehe, worry not. Kaga will eliminate any pests that seek to squirm into our banquet tonight~
Oh, would you look who showed up... Do remember to be on your best behavior tonight, 5th~ Car~ Div~♪
Hiryuu, you're going to get tired from sitting in a kneeling position all night... As the Commander is perfectly relaxed here, you should also do likewise and enjoy yourself~
Let us partake of each other's drink, Commander~
Ah, Commander... Ahahaha~♡
This reward... shall serve as an exquisite dessert to the banquet~
A toast to your splendid victory, Commander... Hehe~
The commission team has returned...? Excellent. You may go now.
I shall burn everything away!
Nothing brings me more joy than being a cornerstone of the Commander's glory! Ahahahaha!
Commander, open up. Say ahh... Heehee, heheheheh... You're like a little baby♪ Receiving a lovely new outfit and seeing a different side of you... How blessed am I?
Commander, open up. Say ahh... Heehee, heheheheh... You're like a little baby♪ Receiving a lovely new outfit and seeing a different side of you... How blessed am I?
Commander, would you like another? Okay, open up! Say ahh♪
Shall we take a break? There's no rush; your journey is far from over. Of course, I couldn't be happier about that...♡
Commander, where are we going next? I'd love to go somewhere far away so that we can spend looots of time together~
I'll treasure these clothes you gave me for a lifetime. Thanks again, Commander~
Traveling through cities and nature, enjoying beautiful scenery... Heehee, what an elegant trip. Commander, are you having fun, too?
Heehee. What's the matter, Commander?
Oh, you'd like to feed me? Okay! Aah♪
Just be patient until we can get a room together, Commander...
A letter... Heehee, perhaps it's from a girl who's jealous of our relationship?
Would you like a cup of tea, Commander? Heehee, of course, I've already brought it—Yes, please. Drink it while it's still warm♡
I've gotten word that the commission team is back. Yes, I'll arrange for someone to meet them. We wouldn't want to busy you over that, now, would we?
I won't allow you to enter the Commander's sight...

Commander, I made a hotel reservation for us tonight! A town abundant with history, delicious foods, and a hidden hot spring to soothe your fatigue... Heehee, and we'll be sleeping in the same bed, of course!♡
We should send out even more invites... This is the best way to rid ourselves of those pesky vixens all at once!
We should send out even more invites... This is the best way to rid ourselves of those pesky vixens all at once!
Commander, why do you smell like another woman? Oh, so it was her? Hehe... Akagi understands!
Commander, we must be together at all times.You definitely cannot leave my side~
It would be great if Commander and Akagi were the only people left in the world~
Commander, stop struggling. Akagi made this special chain, just for you~
It’s human nature to want to possess something so special to you, Commander~ Ahaha~
Are you hungry, Commander? Akagi is going to cook now. Don’t even try to run away~!
Commander, you can’t resist any longer, right? Akagi feels the same way~
As long as we can be together, those commissions and tasks don’t really matter, right? You agree with me, don’t you?
Akagi knows that Commander wants to stay with her forever and ever, but the top brass will get suspicious if nothing ever gets done~
Oh my, mail has arrived. Mm... it would seem that our superiors don’t suspect a thing.
Commander, won’t you try some of Akagi’s hand-crafted tea? I added a little ingredient to make our love even sweeter~!
Looks like those troublesome nymphs have returned. Commander, Akagi will be right back~
Ahh, Commander, you’re finally awake? Hm? Akagi didn’t do anything~ except lock you in so that we can stay together forever.
Aircraft carrier, Kaga.

I am Kaga, from the First Carrier Division. I was originally designed to be a battleship, but fate had different plans or me. Enemies? I simply slaughter them, but only because it is my duty, not for fun.
Will I be able to find a worthy foe here? Very well. I’m yours. Perhaps this, too, is destiny.
Justice and righteousness are for the strong only. The weak can only weep in vain.
Commander, if you keep looking at me like that, you’ll be eaten up.
I shall conquer all, no matter who stands against me.
Our enemies may be strong, but that is what makes them worth crushing. Heheh...
The girls of the Fifth Carrier Division? They might amount to something if they work hard enough.
Is there a problem?
... Fine. If you say it helps you relax...
Commander, stop slacking around. There are still missions to complete.
Here are the rewards, the fruits of your labor.
Your mail is here. Try not to forget it next time.
A fitting reward for the ears of our enemies. Let us enjoy the spoils of war leisurely.
The girls on commission have returned. Go on ahead, I will prepare some refreshments for them.
Not bad. I’ve come up with some new combat techniques.
Entertain me with your final struggles. Hehehe...
Such is the fate of the weak. Death, nothing more.
This pain... I shall return it tenfold!
Only the strong may survive on the battlefield!
