You wanna take me out for a ride in your own car later? Sure! You don't mind taking the shotgun seat, do you? 'Cause I'm gonna be the driver! Heheh!
Yeah? Are you thirsty? I've got a drink if you need a sip.
Hey, uh... I want to conserve stamina, so let's save this for later...
Better get those unfinished missions done while you have the chance. You need all the time you can get on the race track!
You finish missions as fast as I drive my car! Hahaha! Now let's get a look at those rewards while we can!
Welcome back, Commander! Come join me for a break. Ahahah, you might think you don't need one, but people need maintenance, too!
Oh, the commission team is back! THAT was pretty darn fast.
Go for the checkered flags and let the engines roar!
Hey. This is a secret between you and me - I actually care less about my track time and more about seeing you rooting for me... Oh, and don't tell that to Shoukaku!
Taihou-class aircraft carrier - Taihou.

I'm a state-of-the-art aircraft carrier with extra reinforced armor. Just look at my flight deck and enclosed hangar. Amazing, aren't they? Hmm? What's this about carrying capacity and firefighting systems? Never mind that... Tell me, what do you think of my... body?
This heat, and this throbbing... We meet at last, my dear Commander! I am Taihou, unworthy as I am, at your service♡
Would you like to take a bath with me? Maybe you'd like to taste me? Orrr~ would you like to do it with me...? Ahahaha!
I belong to you, my Commander, body and soul...
Hehehe, I would pull the moon from the sky for you, if you wanted it, my Commander.
You like small ones, my Commander? Then I'm off to cull the big ones, hehehe...
My Commander, you know you can never EVER lie to me. Or else...
Touch me more!
If you touch any other girls like this, I might have to punish you, my Commander.
There's a new mission. Can we go?
Mission complete~ Want to go get the rewards?
My Commander, you've got mail~ I licked it very tho-rough-ly. It's safe.
Mission accomplished! And let me say how fantastic you looked on the battlefield.
Commission complete... But if you ordered it, my Commander, I would clear all of them for you... I must mean so much to my Commander.
Ahaha, now I can serve my Commander even better...
I'll tear down everything and everyone that stands between me and my Commander! AHAHAHAHA!
I dedicate this victory to my Commander!
Why aren't you dead... why won't you all just DIE?!
Now you can die happy, ahaha...
For my Commander, I have to win...!
Those insects... Just a second, my Commander, I need to do something about these impudent little insects...
I know everything, EVERYTHING there is to know about you, my Commander~ In fact, my Commander is my entire world.
... That gift she gave you? Oh, I threw that out. Why wouldn't I? Only my things belong on your desk~
You forgot your coat? Well isn't my Commander forgetful... Don't worry about it, I'll go get your coat for you. Huh? The key to your quarters? Hehehe, you can keep it. Taihou has her ways.

The bed and toiletries in your quarters? Of course they're mine. I should have thought of this before~ If you don't want me going in and out of your room all the time, we should just be sleeping together. Hehehe... please be gentle with me.

It's finally on my finger! You know, I would have thrown this ring out long ago if it didn't have my name on it. Hehehe. Oh? How did I know about it? I tollld you, I know EVERYTHING about my Commander. And from now on I'm going to love EVERYTHING about you too~
A-all I can do to show my gratitude is offer you my body! It may not be much, but please accept it!
I will NOT tolerate any talk of bad luck!
You're taking so long to dress yourself, my Commander. Are you struggling to find something to match my dress? Hehe, it doesn't matter what you wear, you're always perfect to me♡
You're taking so long to dress yourself, my Commander. Are you struggling to find something to match my dress? Hehe, it doesn't matter what you wear, you're always perfect to me♡
I've been waiting for you, my Commander.
Oh, how I envy you, kitty. If I were you, my Commander could hold me tight and never let go.
My Commander, you just stole a glance at another girl, didn't you?
My Commander, if I were to drink a little too much, do you think you could take me home?
My Commander, it's safe for you to attack me when no one's around~
My Commander, how would you like to go for a stroll somewhere private?
Yesss, that's it, my Commander, give all your love and attention to Taihou alone...
My Commander, let me clean up the few remaining insects troubling you.
Are you the ones distracting my Commander from the party?
This is what happens when you get between me and my Commander!
Come, my Commander, this party is a perfect opportunity to proclaim our love to everyone, to let them all know that we belong only to one another.

Hehehe, I let Christmas and New Year's slip right by me, that I might use the Dragon Empery's Lunar New Year to capture my Commander's attentions... Oh, My Commander, won't you please enjoy the show I've prepared for you❤

Hehehe, I let Christmas and New Year's slip right by me, that I might use the Dragon Empery's Lunar New Year to capture my Commander's attentions... Oh, My Commander, won't you please enjoy the show I've prepared for you♡
My Commander, do tell me what song I might serenade you with?
I wanted to borrow an Empyreal dress from Master Yat Sen, but it turns out we're not the same size~ So what could I do? I made it myself♡
For you, my Commander, I could face any challenge...! Oh, but that little gremlin from the Eagle Union... something must be done...
If I can only keep my Commander's gaze fixed on me for just a little bit longer, all my efforts will have paid off~
If only I could become like the women in those stories... those Empyreal romances Master Yat Sen spoke of~
Did you enjoy my performance...? Oh, my Commander~ My efforts, seeking out Master Yat Sen, the study, the practice, all that hard work... it was truly worth it~!
I offer you a song of joy ♡ my Commander ♪
Do I make a nice race queen, my Commander...? Hehe. With these proportions, and my fantastic outfit~♡ The others couldn't hope to compare with me!
Do I make a nice race queen, my Commander...? Hehe. With these proportions, and my fantastic outfit~♡ The others couldn't hope to compare with me!
My Commander, would you like a picture of me? Oh, not for promotional purposes, just for your "personal use..." Hehehe♡
Would my Commander like to race? I would be happy to take care of the other racers to make sure you win first place... Oh... But why not?
I don't care about prideful things like which carrier group I'm in. All that matters is that I'm willing to do anything for you, my Commander♡
I could wait here for you forever, my Commander. But of course I would be happier to be at your side~ If you would let me... Oh, even if you don't want me to, I could still be at your side anytime♡
Hehehe, the "race queen" is another of the Sakura Empire's great inventions~ Save your wonder, my Commander. Just keep your eyes fixed on Taihou♡
I am here just to model for you, my Commander~
Hehe♡ My Commander~
Unlucky...? We won't be hearing that again!
Ehehe~ There is no greater bliss than being with you after classes are over, my Commander~ The kitty here seems to agree♡
Ehehe~ There is no greater bliss than being with you after classes are over, my Commander~ The kitty here seems to agree♡
My Commander, would you like to go somewhere with Taihou? An after-school date, perhaps~♡
My Commander, whatever your heart desires, no matter what it is, Taihou shall grant it to you~♡
What am I writing about in my notebook...? You, of course~♡ Hehe, do you want to take a look?
A-A-A-Albacore?! ...D-don't scare me like that, my Commander. I'm telling you, that girl can pop out from just about anywhere...
Want a feel, Commander? --Then, here you go~ The little kitty, or Taihou? Take your pick, hehe~♡
Taihou belongs to you, mind, body, and soul~ Heheh... Here, put your hands on me as you please~♡
Club... activities? How could I let such insignificant matters get in the way of our precious time together, my Commander?
Anyone who would get between me and my Commander... should just disappear!
Commander, nobody will get in the way of our date anymore~♡
A beach date, just me and my Commander... I could walk by your side forever—No, I can't be satisfied by this alone. And neither can you... Right, my Commander?♥
A beach date, just me and my Commander... I could walk by your side forever—No, I can't be satisfied by this alone. And neither can you... Right, my Commander?♥
You and I, walking on the beach together... I'm so happy that you're here with me, my Commander! Do you feel the same way?♥
I rented out the whole beach for us. You know what that means... No matter where you go, you can't escape me! Hahaha, I'm just joking.
This shirt? Actually, I snuck into your room and... Hm? I didn't say a thing♪
You'd like to lie next to me and listen to the ocean? O-okay! If that's what you want, then I'll stay as long as you'd like... *blushes*
I'd love to just get washed away to a deserted island with you... No, this is your home. Even I understand that much.
Be careful not to catch a cold? Aww, my Commander, you're too sweet~♥
Come, my Commander...♥
You have new mail. Heehee, does it smell like me...?
Heehee, we're all alone again... I'm like putty in your hands right now, my Commander... Hahaha! Come right out and say anything you want to me.
Another commission is done. You don't have to lift a finger, my Commander; leave it to me.
Sleep with the fishes!
All who stand in my way are fated to oblivion♪
My Commander, I... I...!
My Commander, do you have plans? Wait... Do you mean you've set aside time for me? O-of course. We are on a date, after all... Goodness, how can I effectively optimize my time with my Commander?
Aah... I didn't think you'd agree to my offer for some extra "entertainment" together♡ Just the thought of you using your body to guide mine now... Heehee♡ I'm all yours to command.
Aah... I didn't think you'd agree to my offer for some extra "entertainment" together♡ Just the thought of you using your body to guide mine now... Heehee♡ I'm all yours to command.
Phew... You're too good at this, my Commander~ Once you've decided on your next move, call me, and I'll be there right away♡
Am I tired? Heavens, no! I've got plenty more rounds in me, and you... Um, my Commander? M-maybe you do need a break, after all...?
Where should I shoot, and how? Use your finger to guide me♡ I'm ready any time~
If you want to go for a bank shot, then you need to calculate the angle it will bounce at to hit the pocket... M-my Commander?! This is getting too detailed for me to keep up!
My Commander, you're spacing out again... Go ahead and aim. Don't mind me~ If you want, use me to balance your cue♡
My Commander~ Leave everything to me♡
Is something the matter, my Commander? Aren't you supposed to be teaching me billiards right now?♡
My Commander♡ Love me more and more and more♡
New missions are here~ Tch, what bad timing...
Missions complete~ My Commander, do you mean to say that I'm not reward enough for you?
Aah... Welcome back, my Commander~ I've been waiting here for you for so, so, sooo very long♡
The commission is done~ Heehee, you should get up first, okay?♡

My Commander~ You can have fun anytime and anywhere you want♡ But in return, tonight, you're mine alone... Heehee, and I want you tomorrow, and the day after, and... Actually, I'm never letting anyone else have you!

My Commander~ Do you like the location that I've chosen~? We have the entire evening to ourselves, free from the disturbance of anyone else...! Ahhh, my heart is throbbing even more vigorously than the ocean's waves~♡

My Commander~ Do you like the location that I've chosen~? We have the entire evening to ourselves, free from the disturbance of anyone else...! Ahhh, my heart is throbbing even more vigorously than the ocean's waves~♡
This pure white dress was crafted by yours truly. Now, my Commander, we can be together forever...! Ahhh, my Commander~♡
The defenses around your bedchamber are complete, my Commander. Nobody will be allowed to intrude on our love nest~♡
This sound... Albacore?! N-n-n-no way, it couldn't be! My Commander, tell me you're jesting!
Is something the matter, Commander? If you are unable to collect your thoughts outside, perhaps I can take you to somewhere a bit more private~
C-Commander?! Ahhn, I can't believe you'd even treat me as a child~ ...Ehehe~♡
I belong only to you, my Commander~♡
Yes, new missions. I already know all about it~♡
My Commander, I shall fetch you everything you desire~ After all, there is no way I'd possibly burden you with such menial tasks~♡
My Commander~ Are you having fun with your pest extermination? Please do enjoy yourself thoroughly, and leave the paperwork that comes after to me~♡
A commission has been completed~ There's no need to go welcome them back. After all, I already saw them back to their dorms~♪
Ahahaha! Nothing will remain of you!
My Commander, please do not leave my side...!!
My Commander~ I'll have you accompany me all day, just as you promised~♡ Is there any place you'd like to go or anything you'd like to do? As long as we're together, anything is fine~♡ Ehehehe...
Yamato-class ship number three - Shinano.

I am called Shinano, aircraft carrier of the Sakura Empire. I was to stand beside Yamato during that war, yet in the end... Alas, there is impermanence in all things, and nothing became of this one's life... May your guidance lead my fate to a different outcome...

This sensation... is that of reality... Was it you who awoke this one from her long slumber? Such is the inevitability of fate... Please allow Shinano, third ship of the Yamato-class, to guide you forward upon the right path.
Nnnh... You have returned. Long, eternal, has this one's wait been...
Mmh... True strength can shatter the chains of fate... or is this but the moon's reflection within the water... Mm...
Even the most beautiful flower is transient, to be scattered into the wind... But, 'tis better to bloom for but a moment than to wither eternally upon the vine.
Do you wish to rest within this one's bosom? ...Yes, just as the little destroyers do...
I would like to experience all this port has to offer... should it be possible...
I have left the report here... Hmm... There are many errors? ...'twould seem that hasty deadlines are not this one's strong suit...
Vrooom... Zzzzzz... Oh... Did I hit you by mistake? ...Sincerest apologies...
Aah... My ears are sensitive...
Mmmm... Hm? ...I dozed off again? ...Sincerest apologies...
You musn't... Not there... Nnh...
This task... can it be completed in time...?
As long as you are here, there is nothing that cannot be accomplished...
Dismiss not the letters bearing distant thoughts...
Nnnh... Your safe return... pleases me...
Mmmm... The girls on commission are returning now... 'twould behoove you to forget them not...
May this not end in futility...
Though fate has been written, I shall fight until my soul's duty has been fulfilled...
Is this... my power...?
Apologies... I have failed to meet your expectations...
Your fate... has been sealed...
...I shall not retreat...
From here, this one sees not any light...
To carry the burden of great expectations, yet unable to demonstrate the power to meet them... Such is fate's mockery of this one's existence...
To see destiny, yet to be unable to change it; or to be ignorant to the turning of fate... Which is the greater misfortune?

Long has this one dreamt... Tragic dreams that one wishes to never recall... Blissful dreams from which one hopes to never wake from... Even reality itself seems like just another dream.. Commander, is this truly reality, or yet another illusion?
I once lamented my inability to shift the hand of fate... But now, and forever... as long as you are here...
The memories forged at this port... have brought me great joy... Alas, from now on... I shall cherish my time with you through fates both joyful and painful... through weal and woe alike...
This one shall cherish your gift...

ex.line: Only by experiencing love can one know its sorrows... This one misses you so.
All good things are fleeting... However, every moment spent with you is as a thousand autumns...
If you grow weary, rest in this one's arms, and we may drift off to dreams together...
This one is becoming proficient at the tasks you've assigned... With you, I can overcome any difficulty.
Th-that spot is... sensitive... Mmmnh...
Mm... May this one hold you and sleep a while longer? Zzzz...
Nnh... May this sweet, gentle dream never end...
Warmth rests on this one's palm... Have you returned? This one is delighted...
Now that we have come so far, even fate cannot part us... This one can truly walk hand in hand with you. One could not ask for more...

lines.line: The moonlight dims beneath hazy clouds, and the lights of the night sky begin to shine... The moon, and this sake, are both intoxicating... Will you not enjoy this fine evening with me...?
The moonlight dims beneath hazy clouds, and the lights of the night sky begin to shine... The moon, and this sake, are both intoxicating... Will you not enjoy this fine evening with me...?
The shimmering of the countless stars, the dancing lights of the banquet... This night... has only just begin... Zzzzz...
Through the sojourn of the stars through the sky, through the waxing and waning of moons, fate remains immutable... In contrast, mortal dreams and realities alike seem like fleeting illusions...
Being able to enjoy tonight's banquet thusly... fills one with apprehension that this... may be yet another dream...
Though I have long been the plaything of fate, it still allowed me to meet you... How strange and whimsical a thing it must be...
Western spirits are a new experience for this one... Even this trifling amount... has already... gone to my head...
Beauteous is the moon tonight... Are you in agreement...?
*sigh*... Sincerest apologies for this unsightly display... The destroyer children were playing around and made a mess of my tail... How embarrassing...
Hnnh... Such clamors of merriment... Would this one be welcome amidst these festivities? Alas... If you so desire, how can this one refuse...?
Hnnh... Such clamors of merriment... Would this one be welcome amidst these festivities? Alas... If you so desire, how can this one refuse...?
Mm... Nnh... Will this do...? This one offers wholehearted support in all your struggles... I pray for your first-round triumph...
The attire you chose for this one...though beauteous, is rather revealing... This one cannot help but be embarrassed by cruel fate...
Gleaming chrome, roaring reverberations... Who emerged victorious? Alas, this one must apologize...for missing it...
Subjected thusly to the eyes of many... The heart is elated, yet its tranquility is disturbed... Do you feel the heat this one feels...?
Initially, this one wondered if you had ulterior motives...but knowing that this is to add flair to the race, I joyously accept this duty...
Alas... This one's ears are sensitive...
You want this one to change posture? Mm... If that is my destined task, then I will try...
As a reward for your valiant efforts...
Trite it may be, but your work is of vital import... See it done anon...
A prize of Western spirits... Alas, I suppose...this one must open it...?
Hopefully my form is not so burdensome as to break this... The task you have entrusted this one is difficult to bear, but I may beseech advice from Shoukaku and Taihou...

This world of pristine sand that you have envisioned, a mirage that fits only within the confines of a dream and a reverie... No matter how many times we meet here, this one finds herself drawn to this place again and again...

This world of pristine sand that you have envisioned, a mirage that fits only within the confines of a dream and a reverie... No matter how many times we meet here, this one finds herself drawn to this place again and again...
The swimsuit you requested is too small for this one... Mm... This one hopes it isn't too strange compared to the others...
While the swimsuit is beautiful... Even when tied securely, just moving makes a mess of it... It's rather mortifying...
A lover's tryst, both in reality and in our dreams... Your loving and longing warm this one so much that it makes me sweat. Sorry you have to see this one like this...
It was not this one's intent for my swimsuit to malfunction... Every time this one adjusts it, the next small motion throws it back into disarray... How can one escape this plight?
If you desire a cool breeze... M-mm... By fanning this one's tail as such... Mm... Hopefully this does not simply blow hot air at you...
You so persistently strike this one's weaknesses... Mmh...
An invitation to swim... This one will gladly join you...
This one graciously accepts your touch...
Even in your dreams, you diligently fulfill your responsibilities... It is astounding.
An ever-growing pile of rewards... May this dream of your efforts being rewarded come true...

If regarded as illusions that will eventually fade, one can even accept seas and skies that defy the laws of nature... If it is your desire, this one will make the last moments of your dreams eternal.
The commission team makes their return... This one asks that you greet them soon...
As a flickering, quivering phantasm... Welcome to the dream this one made for you, Commander. Do you like this magic, in which this one appears in an instant?
As a flickering, quivering phantasm... Welcome to the dream this one made for you, Commander. Do you like this magic, in which this one appears in an instant?
This one welcomes your arrival... If you wish, you may stay in my grotto. This one will accompany you, of course...
You wish to know why this one has woven such a dream? This one only wishes to indulge in sweet dreams with you, to seek surprise and succor together...
There wasn't much time to prepare, so this one's tail is unbrushed and messy... Please forgive me.
This glass box is rather cramped... Fortunately, it did not affect the performance...
Phantasmal, dancing lights and your passionate gaze... They make this one's self-control futile...
Supposedly, this hand gesture conveys joy... Do you see the joy this one feels in your presence?
Hmm...? In this dream realm, this one will not fall asleep...
Do you... wish to open this box?
Hmm... Your warmth reaches this one. Is this your own magic...?
Do you wish to see this one's magic again...? Whatever it takes to soothe you...
Ah, what a perfect display of magic...
All fleeting dreams must come to an end...

Even the most glorious magic must fade, in one last spectacular moment... However, if this one weaves this magic into dream, its wonder will be eternal... If you desire, come into my grotto... and we may be together forever...
Mmgh... We agreed to share this mysterious liquor together, yet this one seems to have partaken excessively... Though, a few drops still linger upon this one's lips, should you crave a taste...
Mmgh... We agreed to share this mysterious liquor together, yet this one seems to have partaken excessively... Though, a few drops still linger upon this one's lips, should you crave a taste...
By sharing this liquor, we allow our senses to mingle, our minds to meld... Ah, it is too wonderful for words...
Unprecedented ecstasy... Will you take the next step, share this bed with me, and weave new dreams together?
Phew... This one is not asleep, but savoring your soft caress...
Intoxicated, burning with affection... The bliss welling up in this one's heart belongs to the both of us...
Mmnh, do you love this place? This one feels your ecstasy...
Our feelings are joined in perfect union...
Mm... The overlap of these rich flavors is... too heady to bear... Aaah...
This one has waited for you... Oh, how the wind has carried your yearnings to my heart.
Dreamier than reality, more potent than fantasy... This one knew your feelings already, but the intimacy of this experience... is irresistibly intoxicating.

Repair ship Akashi
Can be built after unlocking
Nya! I am the one and only repair ship, Akashi. I supported the front lines until the destruction of the Truk naval base. If you get all scratched up, just leave it to me nya!
I am the only repair ship in the entire Sakura Empire, Akashi nya~! There is no injury that I cannot fix. Having that said, you should not take your life too lightly.
Commander~ good meowning~ *yawns*
Commander, want a check up?
...n...nya? Nnnh... zzzZZ...
Commander, what’s the matter? Can it be that you broke?
Commander, care for a beverage? Freshly squeezed from another ship nya~!
...n...nya? Nnnh.... zzzZZ...
Akashi isn't malfunctioning, right?
Nn? What's this feeling? It's as if I've been damaged.
Commander, Commander~! You've got a new mission!
Rewards are here~! Anything tasty... nya...?
*stares*... New mail has arrived~
If you are broken anywhere, Akashi can fix you up.
The girls from the commission fleet have returned~ Akashi will check to see if they're injured, nya~!
Nya?! What a nice and warm feeling...
Charge forward without hesitation! I’ll fix you if you break.
There’s always some nice stuff among the litter.
Nyooo~! Just wait until next time!
Nya~?! Akashi is here to rescue you, nya~!
Akashi is serious now, nya~!
Nya?! (Akashi, completely frightened, escapes and observes you from behind a wall)
Commander... do you need Akashi to repair you, nya?
Commander... Akashi is sleepy... (Akashi ignores your reaction, curls up on your lap, and falls asleep)
Hey Commander, hurry up and take off your clothes and let Akashi inspect your body in case you need repairs in the future, nya~!
You treat Akashi so well... Is Akashi your goddess, nya~?
What's this, Commander?  Does it need fixing? I don't really get it but, I'll keep it safe, nya~!
Akashi loves... rare ingredients, nya!

Commander, how does Akashi's new outfit look, nya? Isn't it cute? If you like it, then put a ring on it. I mean, everyone's gone out to play... if you don't help empty my inventory, I'll go broke, nya!

Commander, how does Akashi's new outfit look, nya? Isn't it cute? If you like it, then put a ring on it. I mean, everyone's gone out to play... if you don't help empty my inventory, I'll go broke, nya!
I have to work hard today as well to sell as much equipment as I can, nya!
Commander, you've come to buy something, nya?!
Uugh... the equipment isn't selling... Commander, buy it all, nya... just buy a little bit, nya...
Happy New Year! Want to buy something from Akashi's store?
*yawns* ... Commander, stop moving around so much... I'm still sleepy, nya...
Nya?! Akashi is not for sale, nya!
Commander, are there problems with anybody's equipment? Do you need replacements, nya?
Heheh, this is what I've been saving up for, nya~♪ A special dress that combines Gothic fashion with Sakura charm! Commander, how about those gems, nya?
Heheh, this is what I've been saving up for, nya~♪ A special dress that combines Gothic fashion with Sakura charm! Commander, how about those gems, nya?
Commander, how can I help you, nya~
Nya...aah?! This outfit... puts me way over budget! I'm going to have to think of some new promotions, nya... Commander?! H-how can I help you, nya?
There sure are a lot of people at this party, nya. Maybe I should open up a booth here, nya.
Since this celebration is such a special occasion, maybe I could afford to cut you a little discount, nya~
Commander, would you like some gems? Or maybe some wisdom cubes, nya? Or... maybe a generous bit of both, nya?
Akashi earned all these gems here through hard work! Commander, I'm just letting you see them to motivate you, nya~♪
This place is locked behind a paywall, nya! Um... fifty gems per time, nya!
While everyone was hard at work outside, Akashi helped to set up the party, nya~
Commander, Akashi wants a lap pillow, nya! ...The other way around? No way, nya! Akashi wants to curl up in your lap, nya!
Ohh, it's Commander, nya. Have you come to buy Akashi's new work, nya? Today's a holiday, so go ahead and enjoy yourself, nya~
Ohh, it's Commander, nya. Have you come to buy Akashi's new work, nya? Today's a holiday, so go ahead and enjoy yourself, nya~
I'm drawing... ack, the stylus nib is getting worn out, nya. I'll have to get Shiranui to order some new ones, nya.
Today, I'm not a shopkeeper - I'm an author! I won't accept your gems today, nya!
St. Louis is a poster girl, nya?! Arghh... Next time, I'll need to get her to sit at my booth, nya... Wait, no, the genre might be a bit too different, nya...
Nya? If I sold my art digitally, I wouldn't have to sit here all day at the booth...? H-how convenient, nya...
Nya?! This... this kind of stuff is only allowed in the thin books, nya!
Mail has arrived, nya! My booth application results... I guess it's not here yet, nya...
I'm worn out from running the booth all day, nya... The book signing will have to wait until next time, nya...
D-Don't run in the sea corridors!
Hehehe, come on in, nya! Can I help you find something, nya? Your genial and knowledgeable staff, Akashi, will gladly provide her detailed recommendations, nya!
Hehehe, come on in, nya! Can I help you find something, nya? Your genial and knowledgeable staff, Akashi, will gladly provide her detailed recommendations, nya!
Welcome, nya! Has Akashi convinced you to visit the store, nya?
Hehehe, we broke our sales record today, nya! See, I can do anything if I set my mind to it, nya! You deserve thanks too, Commander♪

Even at the beach, we cannot afford to be careless! Commander, have you adequately prepared for today's activities?
Phew... It's been a long time since I've been able to enjoy such a refreshing breeze.
Mr. Anchor has to sit out in the sun as well, or he will get moldy.
Volleyball? Or how about swimming! I won't lose, no matter what you pick!
Liven up! Don't tell me you're tired already!
It's time to let these Royals witness the tactics and teamwork of the Iron Blood! Heheh~
I'm not tired yet, there's no need for you to massage- Ooh... that feels pretty good...
S-sink!!
Commander, which girl are you staring at this time?
Königsberg class light cruiser, Königsberg.

I'm the first ship of the Königsberg-class light cruisers, Königsberg. I began serving in the Iron Blood Navy a long time ago.
I've participated in far more training and transporting missions than actual combat, so feel free to refer to me as your teacher. Understood?
So you’re the commander? You have such a cute face! Hehe... let big sister take "good care" of you from now on~
Now then, let us begin today’s training.
Remember, it’s unwise to place too much faith into the numbers.
Making an expression like that... are you after some of big sister’s rough affection?
You should never ask about a woman’s age, Commander.
Whipping doesn’t actually hurt that much once you’re used to it. Want to give it a go?
Oh? You seem fairly energetic today. Let's do some more training.
Oh my? That’s not how you do it. Should I teach you the proper way to touch a girl?
Let's see what mission is up next.
Oh? Mission complete? Well done, Commander. Don't forget to collect your rewards!
Remember to read new mail as soon as possible. It’s rude to make people wait.
Good work, Commander. Let’s quickly review the previous battle.
The girls have returned from commissions. Please welcome them back in a timely manner.
I think I get the hang of it! Commander, come with me for a second!
It's time to see what we learned from our training... and make our enemies tremble before us!
Hmph, so that’s all they amounted to.
Tsk... Do we still not have enough anti-air?
Hmm, do you want some lessons from me too?
Alright, time for me to punish you.
Hey! What were you trying to do? Don't be shy... just tell me.
And I thought you were a good child, Commander... I guess you can still be trained... Hehe...
Hmm? I do you like you very much, in many different ways... I'm going to teach you all kinds of things from now on... Hehe...
To train someone, the trainer must also give the trainee some love, otherwise... Yes, Commander, I love you. Come, let's continue. What should we try next?
Commander, you’re the best! The best what? Pet? Companion? Or maybe... lover~?
You seem to always know what a girl wants~ I shall accept this, then.
Königsberg class light cruiser, Karlsruhe.

I am the second ship of the Königsberg-class light cruisers, Karlsruhe! I participated in battles as the flagship of an Iron Blood torpedo squadron. I hate cold weather, storms, and that pesky Truant...
Hi, it's me, Karlsruhe! Please take good care of me, Commander.
Ehehe... I have a feeling something good will happen today!
Ahaha~ Are you that interested in me,  Commander?
La~ la~ la~ When is the next battle?
Is.. is there a storm coming?
Boring~ boring! How do you expect me to stay quiet?
Nyahaha! That tickles!
Nya? Why do I feel so hot where you touched me...?
Mission~ Mission~ It's time to make some money~!
Mission complete! Hurry up, let's collect those rewards!
There's new mail! I wonder who it is?
Good work, Commander~! Why not take a break... and play with me!
The girls have returned from commission! Let's go welcome back our money- I mean... the girls!
I've found the strength to continue exploring afar.
Let me show you my true power... Here I come!
Eh? I won?
Uu... I let my guard down...
I have a feeling this one's gonna hit!
I don't want to play with you anymore...
Wow~! Are you here to play with me, Commander?
I don't like being cooped up in the house, nor do I like that pesky Truant! When I look at it that way... isn't this my destiny?
My chest tightens whenever I think about you, Commander. Why is that?
I asked my sister about it, and she said that this feeling is called "love." It feels a bit painful, but it also makes me very happy.
I feel happy whenever I think about you, but I miss you whenever I can't see you. Overall, I'm still glad that I fell in love with you!
Yaaay! You're the best, Commander!
Königsberg-class light cruiser - Karlsruhe.
Commander, take a look at my new rigging! Doesn't it look all shiny and strong? Now, I feel like I can weather any storm... probably!
Commander, let's put our best foot forward and work hard today!
I'll give any storm a good thrashing! Hyaah!
Commander, are you interested in me? Ehehe, us Königsberg sisters are famous for our good looks~!
Did you call? If you want to play, I'm down any time!
Königsberg-class light cruiser, Köln.

I'm the third ship of the Königsberg-class light cruisers, Köln. Our slender bodies are something that we're all very proud of.
I once circumnavigated the world, and participated in operations in the Baltic Sea and North Sea. You can count on me for any type of operations, defense or assault!
You seem like a wise Commander. I'm Köln. Please rest assured and let me take care of your work.
Welcome back, Commander. Here is today's schedule. Please look it over.
Commander, what kind of data are you looking for?
Ah... We went over budget again this month...
Königsberg, stop teasing the Commander! Be careful or you might just awaken some weird fetish of his...
Karlsruhe, Commander is very busy right now. Can't you stop bothering him and just play by yourself?
Eh? New instructions, Commander?
Commander... You realize that harrassing one's subordinates is despicable, right?
New missions have been posted. Shall I add them to today's schedule?
Mission complete! Shall I take an inventory of the rewards?
There's new mail for you, Commander. Please take a look.
Good work, Commander. The next thing on the agenda is...
Your fleet has returned from their commission. Should I join you for the inspection?
Commander, you're a very kind person... for taking care of your subordinates.
Enemy fleet spotted! Prepare torpedoes!
Phew... This performance... should be acceptable?
Ugh... I failed again. P-please don't dismantle me...
Yes, the time is now!
Workplace harassment is a crime, Commander...
Is there anything that I can help with? Please let me know.
I'm so glad that you are an approachable superior. I can't really handle short-tempered people.
To... to prevent you from harassing my sisters... I-I will... (blushes)
J-jeez... Am I really the only one who can rein you in, Commander? Just let me handle all your affairs, private or public. Wh-what? I'm not trying to make you my property!
With this... I can get much closer to Commander! A-ahem... it's nothing! Thank you, Commander, I won't let you down.
I-is it really okay for me to accept this?
Hmm... I feel like I can work even more efficiently than before. Commander, please rest assured, I will never betray your expectations.
Hmm... I feel like I can work even more efficiently than before. Commander, please rest assured, I will never betray your expectations.
Today's task list. I've taken the liberty of sorting them in order of priority. Please review them.
Data aside, if there's anything else you'd like to know, please don't hesitate to ask.
Detailed planning ensured the efficient completion of one's work. Commander, next on the list is――
Such desk work demands a quiet and peaceful atmosphere. Well, I suppose that means I should hope my sisters don't come barging in...
Commander, what would you say to coming by the Tactical Classroom to observe some lessons in your free time?
Don't you have more important things to be doing than staring at me or chatting with me?
...From time to time, one should consider the rumors spreading around the port about oneself, Commander...

Leipzig-class light cruiser, Leipzig.
Can be built after unlocking

Um... I'm... Leipzig, the first ship of the Leipzig-class...
One time, I collided with Eugen because of some thick fog... I hope she doesn't still hate me...
Co- Commander... I'm Leipzig. I black out frequently due to malnutrition, but... I'll do my best to finish the tasks assigned to me...
Wel... welcome back, Commander. I've arranged your documents...
C-commander... Please don't stare at me...
Eek! I think I saw something...
I'll... I'll try my best!
Commander... is there anything else I can help with?
Is this training for learning how to not faint? I'll.. see what I can do...
Uuu... I really won't be able to move like this... what should I do?
Commander... you've been assigned new missions...
Ah- Wah! Commander, your rewards have arrived...
Commander, Fishy brought in some new mail...
Commander's aroma is so calming...
Ah, Commander! Fishy told me that the girls have returned from their commission...
Th-thanks for your concern, Commander!
Ahh~! I'm so nervous I could faint...
I feel stronger with Commander around...
Wah... I'll be bitten... It's scary! I'm not going!
Uu... Help me, Fishy...
Stay... stay away...!
Commander, y-you called for me? Ah... a d-d-date??! ... (faints)
I won't faint anymore after I've gotten used to it... Also, Commander, being with you... makes me really happy.
For the longest time, only Fishy would keep me company. Commander... for you to accept me... I'm so happy!
Fishy... you're on lookout duty... I've got something very important to tell Commander... Don't let anyone in...
I'm so glad that you returned my feelings, Commander. I'll do my best... not to faint in front of you anymore.
Haah~ Th-thank you so much, Commander! I'm so happy I might faint...
Commander, ah, um... We have all new items on the menu, and they're on sale for a limited time only... P-please give them a try! Phew... Th-thank goodness, I managed to not flub it...
Commander, ah, um... We have all new items on the menu, and they're on sale for a limited time only... P-please give them a try! Phew... Th-thank goodness, I managed to not flub it...
W-welcome home, Master! ...Um, w-would you like to take a look at our menu?
Commander... Um, could you look at the pamphlet instead of at me...?
What happened to Fishy? Um, I asked Miss Eugen to take care of it...
Eat well, rest well, and... then you'll never be defeated in battle, right...?
Commander, um, are you sure you're okay with me? Someone else will take over the shift soon according to the schedule...
Do you need me to get you another menu...?
...You'll be okay, Leipzig... You'll be okay!!
The mail's here. Thank you, Miss Eugen!
Commander, you must be tired from your battle! Um... Why don't you come in and relax for a bit?
Did Fishy go to welcome the commission fleet back...?
I'm still a bit nervous, but... I'll do my best!
It's all because everyone was with me... including you too, Commander!
I'm so sorry, Commander... I, I'll do better next time!
Err, umm... If you're ready, I'd be glad to take your order, Commander... I'd like to know more about your tastes, and what you like... Th-that's okay, isn't it?
I feel like Fishy is a lot more capable than before, but I don't feel much different... M-maybe Fishy was the one to get a retrofit instead of me?!
I feel like Fishy is a lot more capable than before, but I don't feel much different... M-maybe Fishy was the one to get a retrofit instead of me?!
Phew... Commander, I, I organized your files!
Fishy looks a bit intimidating, but he's really kind! ... Well... I might be the only one he's kind to... Sorry...
You're right, a nutritious diet is important... Do you have any... um, yummy recommendations...?
Despite how Fishy looks, he really does have his own thoughts and feelings. But it seems I'm the only person who understands what he says...
It's okay, Fishy. Commander is just a little busy right now...
Unghh... Get a grip, me! I can't faint now...!
Eek! I-I managed to not faint...! Thank you, Commander!
C-Commander...! Commandeeeer! Don't forget your missions!
Commander, Fishy brought us the mission rewards. Thank you, Fishy~
Commander, would you mind if I took Fishy with us on a walk to the harbor? The commission team returned, and I want to go greet them.
I'm pretty nervous... but I'll do my best!
I'm so sorry, Commander... I-I'll try harder next time!
Admiral Hipper-class Heavy Cruiser, Admiral Hipper

I am Admiral Hipper, the Iron Blood heavy cruiser named after the undefeated Admiral Franz von Hipper. I have participated in countless battles and given them my all. The Barents Sea? That only happened because Admiral Kummetz was even dumber than you.
Huh? You are the commander? Is the war effort going so poorly these days that they’re letting anyone become a commander?
Idiot, so you rolled out of bed? Haah? What are you fantasizing about? I only happened to bump into you while patrolling the port.
What are you looking at, idiot? Get out of my room!
Blücher, I will definitely protect you this time.
Hah? A novice like you wants to challenge my cruiser-commanding skills?
Hah? Are the Schweinshaxe and beer ready yet? How many servings do we need? Idiot! Is your brain just an ornament?
Huh? Did I give you permission to touch me?
Huh?! You stupid, moronic, block-headed idiot! Go die! Sink yourself in the Kiel Bay right now!
Don’t get distracted in the middle of a mission, you idiot!
Idiot! Hurry up and collect your rewards! Why are you showing it off to me?
Are you too stupid to realize that you have new mail?
Idiot! If you had already returned, why didn’t you come to see me? Hah? Who would be worried about you?
You idiot! You still haven’t remembered what you forgot about yet?
Hah? Did you think something like this would impress me?
Compared to Jutland, a battle like this is mere child’s play.
Hmph. Just today, I shall allow you to praise me a little.
C-c-c-curses! I can’t stand this, ahh!
Huh? Who gave you permission to resist?
You piece of trash! I told you to stay out of my sight!
Huh? You can’t even do something like that? Are you an idiot?
Huh? Worried about me? Having an idiot like you worry about me doesn’t make me happy at all.
Huh? Who would ever have a crush on you? I’m only tagging along because Eugen wanted to have dinner with you. Don’t get the wrong idea, idiot!
Huh? Who would ever fall in love with you? I’m only here to drop off something I found during sortie, per regulations. Huh?! A ring? Who would wear something like that?!
Huh? Why must I wear something like this? Whatever... I’m in a good mood for a change. You’re going to take care of me forever? Hmph! Isn’t that what you’re supposed to do?
Haah?! You think something like that would make me happy?!
Who are you calling flat?!
Please begin your performance, Glowworm!
W-well? Does this kimono look good on me? ...R-really? Duh, I know it looks GREAT on me! Who really cares what you think... C-can't be me... No, I didn't say anything!
W-well? Does this kimono look good on me? ...R-really? Duh, I know it looks GREAT on me! Who really cares what you think... C-can't be me... No, I didn't say anything!
Which onsen do you want to go to today? I'd like to visit as many as possible so I can tell Eugen and the others all about the fancy places we've been to.
I can feel your gaze, you know... Would you stop ogling me like a painting? ...Huh?! "You can't take your eyes off me"? You say the stupidest damn things!
I've heard this type of kimono is famous. Makes sense, considering how much skill an artisan needs to create patterns and colors this complex.
It's wonderful feeling the breeze on your skin after getting out of the hot spring. It's so soothing, so cooling. You know what I mean, right?

Hmph! Eugen can poke fun at me all she wants - this is NOT a date! She's not gonna be so smug when I gloat about how great the hot springs were. "It was sooo good! I left feeling like a new person," and so on!
Huh?! Grabbing a girl's hand without warning is a great way to startle her! At least tell me first!
Yeah, I figured you'd like the pattern of- What the-?!
I don't care what spots you want to check out, focus on your damn missions! You're keeping ME waiting too, remember?!
Whoop-de-doo, you finished a mission. Good for you. Stop dawdling and go collect the rewards!
There's a letter for you. Wow, that's a nice postcard... Never mind that, just read what it says already!
Whew, we're back. Time to dig in to some food before heading back to the onsen. You're worn out, and I'm just as worn out as you are!
Let me guess, you still haven't realized what's escaped your memory? ...Wrong! It's the commission, not which stores I want to visit!
Isn't this much to be expected?
Thanks for making me work up a sweat!
We won. Heh, I'm willing to give you the credit for the victory today.
This isn't much of a story to tell the others... Ugh...!

For the record, I never wanted to go here. This trip is for you - to reward all your hard work and give you a break... Huh? Me, enjoying my time with you? Wh-who decided it's got anything to do with you? I have the right to enjoy my visit irrespective of you!

Hmph. Don't look at me like you missed me, or something! All I did was get my retrofit and come back stronger than ever... I-I wasn't waiting around for you to come looking for me! I was just passing through, you dummy!

Hmph. Don't look at me like you missed me, or something! All I did was get my retrofit and come back stronger than ever... I-I wasn't waiting around for you to come looking for me! I was just passing through, you dummy!
What're you dawdling there for, dummy? I didn't get stronger just so you could laze around! Get up and get this battle situation sorted out! I'm not waiting any longer!
What? You wanna know if I'M ready? Don't be stupid! As if I'd ever slack off - you're the one who needs to get off your butt and keep up with me!
I left some food on your desk, so you'd better check it out! You don't get to neglect yourself just because you're busy!
Come over here, dummy. You look pale. Are you okay? Don't get any weird thoughts - I'm just worried because we need you in top condition for the next battle!
H-hey, who gave you permission to touch me?! Wh-why, you... You're going to pay for that one!
Hey, if I'm the one who got retrofitted, why are YOU the one acting overconfident? Going around touching me all willy-nilly... I'd better teach you a lesson!
Idiot! Big dummy! How dare you... I-I'm gonna feed you to the fishes!
You're FINALLY back? ...What? I-I wasn't worried about you, no, you stupid, clumsy dummy! If you come back late again, I'll give you something to REALLY worry about!
Know your place, or get out of my sight!

Only a huge idiot like you could get me to hang around... D-don't get a big head about it! I just think it's not so bad fighting alongside you! ...Aaargh, look what you've got me saying! Just wait until I get my hands on you!
Admiral Hipper-class heavy cruiser - Blücher.

Heheh☆ I'm Blücher of Iron Blood, second ship of the Admiral Hipper class~ Yup, I'm the one who got totally whooped by fortress guns in Operation Weserübung! And you, Commander, are the source of my endless happiness~
Heheh☆ It's me, Blücher, reporting in to serve my sweet, sweet Commander♪
Heheh☆ Doesn't seeing me make you all happy?
I only joined this fleet 'cause I'm so in love with you, Commander! You feel the exact same way about me, don't you~? Heheh☆
Hipper, don't you wanna cuddle with the Commander too?
Aim for the Commander's heart aaand... all-love assault!
Being able to meet you is like a dream come true! Mmhmm, I've never been happier!
It's me, the girl who's more in love with you today than she was yesterday~
Heheh☆ No comparing me to anyone else~♪
Heheh☆ It's time we started practicing the art of love, Commander!
Heheh☆ Another unforgettable memory made with you!
Heheh☆ You've got new messages... including a love letter from me! Don't forget to read it!
Heheh☆ Welcome back, Commander! Gimme a hug~! Ehehe~
The commission team is back~ Wonder if they found any goodies out there?
Heheh☆ Have you fallen even deeper in love with me?
As long as you keep your eyes on me, I'm toooootally invincible!
Heheh☆ Crushiiing victory!
Bweh... Only a kiss from my Commander can get me back on my feet...
Look what my love for my Commander can do!
Anything's possible when you have love!
Something's wrong with you... but I still love you!
Heheh☆ What a beautiful day~ Hop on my rigging and we'll go have a wild time, Commander!
Heheh☆ Every time we touch, my heart beats so fast and I swear I could fly! Oh wait, my rigging actually does take me higher♪
I need hugs from you to get the energy to do anything... Heehee~ Hold me closer~ Clooooooooser!
Heheh☆ I love you so, so, soooo much, Commander! When can we go on a date again? Next month? Next week? Tomorrow? I can't wait that long, so let's go on one in five minutes! Hehehehe~
Heheh☆ I've waited forever for this day! So, are you ready to embrace every last bit of me, Commander? Me... I'm as ready as can be♪
Heheh☆ It smells like Commander!
C'mon, Hipper! There's nothing wrong with admitting you're in love!
Heheh☆ I'm gonna make you a blondie!

ex.line: Heheh☆ Now begins another day of lovey-dovey cuddling and flirting together♪♪
Commander, I know you gave me this ring 'cause you love me! I love you super duper ultra much too! Heheh☆
You don't have to be as flirty as Eugen, buuut... Heheh☆ Just don't become as nitpicky as Hipper, Commander.
Plot a course for my Commander aaand... full speed ahead! Heheh☆ You can't escape my love!
It's me, the girl who's so in love with you it's literally impossible to love you any more than this~
Oh, Commander~ I'm gonna close my eyes for you, 'kay?
Heheh☆ Hey, Eugen~ Look who's the MVP~

lines.line: Heheheh☆ You're lagging behind, Commander! Pick up the pace or you'll be left behind! Just kidding~ I'll slow down for you so we can stick together!
Heheheh☆ You're lagging behind, Commander! Pick up the pace or you'll be left behind! Just kidding~ I'll slow down for you so we can stick together!
Heheh☆ Mountains are peak fun, aren't they, Commander?
Commandeeer! I'm heading where you are, so you'd better catch me! ...Heheh☆ Nice one! I love you!
Everyone keeps telling me to "watch where I'm going!" First, it was Hipper, now even Köln's saying it!
You'll stand in for Eugen and watch over me today, won't you? Or should I watch over you instead, sweetheart? Heheh☆
You feeling hot or cold, Commander? My outfit's all breezy, but you make my heart race and my body all warm♪
Which do I look more like - a bunny, or a mountain hare?
Hehehe-eeehh? Oh shooooot! I'm gonna fall!
Welcome back, Commander! ...Okaaay, I know I need to watch my speed and not get carried away.
Gotta take it carefully here!
Even I can't have it my way all the time. Hmph...
Heheh☆ I'm Blücher, dragon knight of the Demon King's army! ...Not riding the dragon so much as being dragged along by it? Well, I guess... Whoaaah! The dragon won't obey me! Commander, heeelp!
Heheh☆ I'm Blücher, dragon knight of the Demon King's army! ...Not riding the dragon so much as being dragged along by it? Well, I guess... Whoaaah! The dragon won't obey me! Commander, heeelp!
Heh, heheh... Commander, you ready to mount the dragon and feel the breeze?
I've wanted to soar the skies together with you before, but I never imagined we'd be doing it on a dragon. Heheh☆ Hold on to me tightly, Commander! You might fall off if you- Whoooah!
You don't think I FEEL like a soldier of the Demon King? Hmph. I do wanna learn to look like one, but- No, no, no! I'm gonna fall again!
Heheheh☆ You're safe with me, my number one sweetie! How's that? Don't you feel super duper safe around me? ...Not at all? Aww...
Dragon's breath! Did you feel the heat? Heheheh☆ My love for you burns just as bright as the dragon's- Whoa, whoooa!
Commander, do you wanna steer the dragon? I'll let you do anything you want! Well... probably!
Huh?! You wanna do it NOW? A-at least wait until my dragon has taken off smoothly...
Heh, heheh☆ Come on, get those missions done and come rescue me!
Heheh☆ We made a nice, new, and slightly chaotic memory together!
New letter for... No, no, no! Don't use your fire breath on it! My love letter to the Commander is in there!
I-I'm back, and I'm still alive...
Hmm... Being on this dragon gives me a great view of where everyone is! Let's go say hi to the girls!
Dragon knight! Los, los!
Hrmgh... Being a dragon knight is sooo hard! Commander, the only way to cure my hurt feelings is for you to kiss me!

You wanna visit all kinds of places with me,? Heheh♡ Of course we can! Where do you wanna go, my super sweet sweetheart? My dragon can take us anywhere in this vast, vast world! Whenever you're ready, let's go!

Heheh☆ I KNEW you'd come to see me, Commander! Next time, you don't need to rush to my side after getting my message, okay? I'll give you as much time as you need, because the last thing I wanna do is tire you out, my super-duper mega sweetheart!

Heheh☆ I KNEW you'd come to see me, Commander! Next time, you don't need to rush to my side after getting my message, okay? I'll give you as much time as you need, because the last thing I wanna do is tire you out, my super-duper mega sweetheart!
Heheh☆ Commandeeer! Why are you sitting all the way over there? Come closer! Closer, closer! There we go! Now I can give you a biiig hug!
Commander! I've still got time, so let's go somewhere! How about downtown? Or the arcade? Or maybe... Huh?! You're gonna go home and do homework of all things?!
Commander! Look! The sunset is so beautiful today! We can't just let something so picturesque go to waste - come here and let's take a selfie! Three, two, one - cheese!
Surprise examination! Let's see what your note on my contact profile says... Huh? You didn't write anything?! Well, in that case... Write "I love you so, so, so, sooo much, Blücher"!
Commander, lower your head for a sec. I'm gonna wipe your sweaty forehead. Hm? My hanky? I use this thing all the time, y'know! You can have it if you want it!
I won't settle with just some headpats for my reward! Okay, as punishment for you, you have to let me hug you for 10 minutes straight!
Heehee! This massage is... kinda making me feel ticklish! Ahahah! Hey, not there! Ahahahahaha!
Eek! We're still in class, you know... Heehee - if that's how you want it, then two can play at that game!
Heheh☆ Commander, I studied reeeally hard today! Take me on a date after school as a reward for my hard work!

Commander, you can always rest your head on my lap whenever you feel tired. My thighs are a VIP seat exclusively for you, my super-duper mega sweetheart! ...But it's late? Doesn't matter to me! As long you're with me, I'm fine with staying here until morning!
Admiral Hipper-class Heavy Cruiser, Prinz Eugen
I am Prinz Eugen, the miracle of the Third Reich and the third ship of the Admiral Hipper-class heavy cruisers. I will survive any battle, no matter how fierce. Luck? You sure have some guts.
Hmm... so you're the Commander? How long can you keep me amused? I'm looking forward to it.
Hmm~ What is it? How would you like me to train you today?
Hmm? Check up? Vielen Dank~
If you overwork yourself too much... you ~ will ~ die.
Lucky ship? Are you mocking me?
Operation Rheinübung? Looking back, that was how it all began for me.
Have you finished having your fun?
Now then, it's my turn to have a taste of you.
Missions... aren't there any interesting ones?
Commander, the rewards. My portion? Not interested~
There's new mail. Hehe~
Commander, won't you shower and relax with me for a while?
Commission completed? Let's see if there is anything interesting to report.
This feeling... isn't half bad.
All ships, open fire!
*Yawns* ... Battleships? Nothing but small fry.
Hehehe... now you've done it...
It's not enough. I. Want. MORE!
Ahhh... how interesting!
Mind getting out of my sight? You're a bit of an eyesore.
... I don't smile enough? Commander... care to see if you can make me?
Commander~ I love you. Just kidding. Did your heart skip a beat?
Ich liebe dich~ is this a joke or the truth? Why don't you decide for yourself~
... Why did I laugh? Because it's funny to see you look so confused, Commander... This smile is truly from the bottom of my heart!
