Scharnhorst-class battlecruiser, Gneisenau.

I'm Gneisenau. Though I'm not as bellicose as my sister, I'm still confident about my combat capabilities. As some of the best ships the Iron Blood has to offer, we hold the record of being the only battlecruisers to sink a standard aircraft carrier. Your faith in us will not be misplaced.
Hello, Commander, I'm Gneisenau. Though my big sister is a bit reckless, we're actually an invincible team. I hope I will be able to sail with her as often as possible!
Welcome back. Ready to get back to work? I've prepared everything you need, Commander.
My duty is to support my big sister who is always charging too far ahead. Admittedly, it gets a little irritating at times.
You mustn't put off until tomorrow what you can do today. Please take that to heart.
One forgets the cruelty of war after being at peace for too long. The opposite... is true as well, isn't it?
Looking back at it, it's unbelievable that I would mistake that prideful princess as an old-fashioned knight.
Isn't it amazing how different people can come to different conclusions about the same topic?
Commander, Anton is locked on, you can't escape now.
A mission? Let me do some planning for you...
Rewards distributed. Please accept them when you have a moment.
Commander, there's mail for you. I'll leave it here.
Welcome back. Please take it easy for a while.
A commission has been completed! Care to inspect the results?
It's fine as long as you haven't let power cloud your judgement...
Truth only exists within the guns' range.
Sorry, this is war. There's no room for mercy.
I let my guard down...
... Now you're in range!
All ships, remember to stay alert!
I assumed you were more intelligent, Commander...
Is it urgent? I prefer simple and effective forms of communication.
"The Ugly Sisters..." Though we were given that epithet for our achievements, it still hurts a little. Commander, do you think I'm ugly?
Without realizing it, I've come to enjoy supporting both my sister and you, Commander.
The present flies by like an arrow, but the future always arrives too late. I hope that one day, I will be able to see the future that you and I create.
A promise, huh? Long ago, I would have despised the notion of being tied down to emotions... but it doesn't seem so bad now.
Your kindness is much appreciated.
These Halloween festivities are quite interesting, in a good way. Getting dressed up in these costumes isn't such a bad experience either. Commander, what do you think of my costume?
These Halloween festivities are quite interesting, in a good way. Getting dressed up in these costumes isn't such a bad experience either. Commander, what do you think of my costume?
At first I was too embarrassed to wear something like this, but I went along with it and after wearing it for a while, I must say I'm starting to see things in a different light...
Everyone wants to be a witch for Halloween, so I chose something a little bit different. After seeing your reaction, Commander, I think I chose correctly. Hehehe...
If only my sister were here... Now if we had some sort of pumpkin-smashing gunnery competition, that would have gotten her attention.
This holiday certainly is well suited to us "Ugly Sisters," isn't it?
My tail? Oh it just came with the costume... Still, I'd prefer if you didn't touch it.
While I haven't prepared any candy, I do have a "treat" for you to enjoy. Would you like to try? I'm afraid there may be some pain involved... Hehehe...
Eek?! Commander, does someone want to be "punished?"
You say you see ghosts and goblins all around me? ... I think you need a break. Getting into the Halloween spirit is all well and good, but you can't overdo it.
Bismarck-class battleship - Bismarck.
I am the Iron Blood battleship entrusted with the name Bismarck. Allow me to prove that Iron Blood engineering is the finest in the world, no matter the battlefield. Eager to see for yourself?
Guten Tag, I am Bismarck. I have fought many foes on many fronts. You may call upon me whenever there is a problem.
I look forward to working with you.
Is there something on my face?
Is there a problem? Perhaps my combat experience could prove useful?
"Operation Rheinübung?" I don't have fond memories of it...
Such a slovenly expression, Commander. Now! Lift your chin, puff out your chest, and let me see those eyes! Hut!
Keep your hands to yourself.
I... am not good at expressing myself. Please do not tease me on purpose...
Those who cannot finish their missions have no right to stand on the battleground.
I'm leaving the mission rewards over here...
Be diligent about checking your mail.
You've done well. You've earned your rest.
... The commission team has returned. I'll go greet them first.
Danke.
Follow me, not Eugen. Come - we shall face our opponents, no matter how numerous they may be!
Such honors may please a weakling, but I am strong.
For tarnishing my pride... next time, you will pay with your lives.
Truth can only be found within our range!
Everyone, get behind me.
Stay out of my sight.
I am not so easily impressed.
You're not a bad commander... What? Is it so strange for me to give compliments? ... You're simply overreacting.
Why are you staring at me? Do I have something on my face? I'm pretty, you say...? Um, thank you...
I... know that I'm not the best with words, but.. I want you to know that... I enjoy being at your side...
... Commander, what kind of expression should I have at a time like this? I should... just smile?
Why, this is...! Danke schön!
Tirpitz... forgive me...
Eugen, don't go overboard with your games.
No one can stop the march of the Iron Blood.

My sincerest apologies for the delay, Commander. Ah, excuse me... as the fleet leader of the Iron Blood, I'm expected to wear this outfit to various formal occasions. Just putting it on seems to make me inadvertently change the way I speak...

My sincerest apologies for the delay, Commander. Ah, excuse me... as the fleet leader of the Iron Blood, I'm expected to wear this outfit to various formal occasions. Just putting it on seems to make me inadvertently change the way I speak...
How's your work coming along, Commander?
Apologies, Commander. Am I acting differently from usual? At times, I don't even know which is the real me...
Commander, would you invite Tirpitz for me? Apologies, I'm... still not sure how to ask her myself.
I can keep a lot of people satisfied merely by sitting here with a smile... but only because of my status as the fleet leader of the Iron Blood.
As a leader, I must sometimes say and do things that I do not believe in. Commander, I hope you never lose sight of who you are.
A dance...? Oh, no, I wouldn't turn one down, I just haven't been asked until now...
C-Commander... don't tease me like that...
Having unfinished work will turn even the finest wine into vinegar. Isn't that right, Commander?
A decoration for the banquet? Splendid work.
Even at the most lavish banquet, it is your responsibility as commander to be well-informed should the situation change.
Let us raise our glasses to the heroes who have returned from battle.
Once the commission fleet has finished dropping off their supplies, let's invite them to the banquet as well.

In front of my compatriots, I always had to be adamant, solemnly spearheading the march of the Iron Blood. To be the leader of the Iron Blood's indomitable fleet, I had to lock away the Bismarck that struggled to express herself... But when I'm with you, Commander, I can set aside that burden, just for a little bit...
Welcome, what would you like to order? ...If you want, we can drop this charade. I'm not used to being a waiter anyway, so I prefer it this way. Hehe.
Welcome, what would you like to order? ...If you want, we can drop this charade. I'm not used to being a waiter anyway, so I prefer it this way. Hehe.
Oops, I almost wrote down "the usual" for your order... Ahem, what would you like?
I feel far more at ease here than when I'm busy with research or the Iron Blood. I really hope that you feel the same way that I do.
Truthfully speaking, this outfit feels more like that of a waitress than that of a maid... Though, I've been told there's not really much of a difference...
Tirpitz, compile today's sales data and send it to Friedrich. Figuring out what to do with the data we've collected is her specialty.
Eugen did tell me she wanted me to try this "physical contact" thing with you.
A new mission... I wonder who would be the best fit for it.
The remunerations for the missions we've completed are here. I'm sure Graf and the others will be ecstatic to hear.
Here's your mail. I... hope it's not an order of coffee from Mainz...
This cup is a prize for the hero who has graciously returned from the battlefield.
Looks like the fleet has returned from their commissions... Thiele, I'll leave them to you.
I can take on any number of them!
Data collection is complete. Take solace in the fact that you'll be useful after your demise.

I never thought I'd be standing in front of you in this outfit like this. Still, whether it was fated or not, I'm glad that you were able to see a different side of me... Hm. This cup's on me. Please, enjoy yourself, hehe.
C-Commander? Well, as you see, I was wrapping your Christmas present, but now the surprise has been spoiled. I suppose this moment calls for a "Merry Christmas," hmm?
C-Commander? Well, as you see, I was wrapping your Christmas present, but now the surprise has been spoiled. I suppose this moment calls for a "Merry Christmas," hmm?
Wrapping myself up right in front of you... It's rather odd, don't you think?
Why I chose this? Because of Eugen's advice - "If you're bad at expressing your feelings with words, do it with actions instead." I simply did what she suggested.
I'll admit, I've had a little to drink. It's my first time doing something like this, and a bit of alcohol helps me feel more natural and empowered, I suppose?
This was my chance to give you a surprise... If only I hadn't made that noise, this would've gone very differently.
Do you like this outfit? As long as you like it, it has done its job as a present.
Consider this a thank-you for tying up my hair.
Do you want my help with the unwrapping?
Although my present turned out half-baked, as long as you're happy with it...
Share the burden of your unfinished missions with me. The sooner they're done, the longer we can enjoy this holiday.
Is it just me, or are our rewards better than usual?
Did your letter come with a seasonal greeting card?
Outstanding work, Commander. Take a break, then once you're done, could you help me here?
Please receive the commission team on my behalf. Dressed like this, well...

Even with Eugen's advice, I had to rack my brains to come up with a way to express my love through actions. Unfortunately, it also ended in failure... Close your eyes, will you? *smooch*... Now it's all good. Frohe Weihnachten.

You've arrived, Commander - or rather, my sweetheart in eternal vow. I know I can't wear a stiff expression forever, but when I think about the days to come under your guidance, I feel so needy all of a sudden. Yes, it's like you say... just keep smiling.

You've arrived, Commander - or rather, my sweetheart in eternal vow. I know I can't wear a stiff expression forever, but when I think about the days to come under your guidance, I feel so needy all of a sudden. Yes, it's like you say... just keep smiling.
There doesn't need to be only one leader. The position of assistant to you is very important. So am I, you say? Yes, you're right.
Have you decided where we'll go on our honeymoon? Oh, I'm not trying to rush you, I just thought I'd offer some advice if you couldn't decide. Maybe that's being too... proactive of me.
Being the leader of Iron Blood, I'm used to walking the red carpet. This occasion, however, is a first for me. I am wholly reliant on your help for this entire day. Heehee.
Don't rush yourself - follow the path of your ideals at a steady pace. There is plenty time for both of us.

It's incredible that there's always something we can both talk about. Not just fighting or leadership, but also music, hobbies, and daily life. It's embarrassing to admit, but there aren't many people I can have such profound conversations with.
The ring you gave me is right here. Do you want to... touch it?
Bride dresses really do make you... No, never mind. Um, continue... *blushes*
Read your new letter. It no doubt contains equally important information to me.
You okay? Didn't push yourself too hard? ...I'm only imitating the way you show concern for me. I suppose I failed to pull it off at all. Heehee.
Let's speak to the commission te- Wait, no, I can't go out looking like this. They'll be shocked.
Gather under our banner!
I offer you this brilliant victory - to decorate our journey of glory.

I thought getting wed would make it easier for me to make expressions - as it turns out, that's not the case. That said, I feel more true to myself, and I've gotten more feelings I want to express... Fine just the way I am? That's good... because I like you this way, too... *blushes*
Bismarck-class battleship, Tirpitz.

It's a bit hot... Ah, sorry. I am Tirpitz. Because I was stuck in the north by myself for so long, people suddenly started calling me the "Lonely Queen of the North." If you think it's a good nickname, then you do not fully understand... how soulless those words are.
I was imprisoned in the north for so long, unable to return home, and now you want me to follow you? ...Very well. It is up to you to show me the world.
Once you get used to waiting, you lose sight of what you were waiting for.
Choose your enemies carefully, Commander.
Big sister... Now that you mention it, I think I might actually have one... Ah... I've already started to forget.
Can you comprehend how it feels to watch the battlefield from afar, unable to do anything but lament the cruelty of war?
Strategic reasons? I was installed with cannons... but they were never meant to be fired. Ironic, isn't it?
Are you cold?
I'll think of how to deal with you later.
Finish your missions properly. Perhaps you will one day realize the joy of having any purpose at all.
Mission rewards... how nice.
More mail for you... Ah, I'm envious.
Commander, you should show your face on the battlefield more often. If you stay behind your desk for too long, you may one day forget the meaning of life.
The commission seems to be complete... Next time, why don't you let me go? I'm a little curious.
If you have no opponents, all the might in the world is meaningless.
Commander, I shall fight for your sake.
So this... is the taste of victory.
So this is... the frustration that comes from failure and fear.
Checkmate.
No one would protect those who asked for their own destruction.
In the end... are you just another incompetent fool, unable to command me?
I have already grown used to the cold solitude of the North. At this point, it's natural for me to have no expectations.
Those who have nothing to lose also have nothing to fear... But is this kind of bravery really anything to be proud of?
The worst feeling in the world is not knowing whether to continue waiting or to give up hope. Commander, are you someone worth waiting for?
Ahh... I see. I thought I was used to the cold and embraced it, but that was just because I had forgotten the joy of human interaction and the warmth of being with someone... But now I remember...
Ahh... so this is the warmth of one's beating heart... It's melting the cold and despair remaining within me. Danke sehr, Commander. The "Queen of the North" is no longer alone.
This feeling of joy is... Thank you.
Sorrow is a mask unbefitting your countenance, sister.

ex.line: You're finally here, Commander... My waiting was worth it.
It used to be so easy to bear with the loneliness... Now that I have you, even a single second of it feels unbelievably long.
Sometimes, when I leave home, I can't help but think that someone is waiting for me... It makes the passage of time suddenly feel so much faster.
You are my morning sun that melts the winter ice... Let me stay with you, if only for a little longer.
Your body is... delightfully warm.
...Can you not wait even a moment longer? Well, I feel the same way...

In my endless waiting, I've looked forward to the end of the bitter cold thousands of times, hoping for the moment when all the despair, anguish, and loneliness will disappear. Now, my wish has finally come true, because I have you by my side.

lines.line: Summer... In the past, it was always just a hot and stifling season... But now...? Doesn't my outfit tell the whole story? Let's get going, there's bound to be a lot of people on the beach.
In the past, I never saw summer as more than a hot and humid slog... But now? My outfit probably says it all... Let's go, everyone's already waiting for us at the beach.
Commander, there's no need to rush yourself. There is meaning in simply waiting for you.
Commander, enjoy yourself to the fullest. Our hard-fought battles are for the sake of peaceful moments like these... and our hard-earned breaks provide us with will to keep fighting.
As long as you're by my side, even looking off into the horizon is meaningful.
Some of my colleagues seem to mistake me for some unapproachable ice queen... Perhaps playing beach volleyball with them would help...
The sunset and the beach at night are wonderful views. When you're done with work, want to accompany me for a walk along the shore?
It's a bit stuffy... Commander, would you mind turning up the air conditioner?
Even though it's summer... there are still some things you shouldn't do...
Even I can't get fired up about doing missions during the summer... because it's too hot...
I bet Bismarck must've been thinking about how to invite me to the party, but ended up asking you to do it, Commander. Hehe... Let's get going soon. It's best not to keep her waiting.
I bet Bismarck must've been thinking about how to invite me to the party, but ended up asking you to do it, Commander. Hehe... Let's get going soon. It's best not to keep her waiting.
So you've come, Commander. Don't be anxious, the night is still young.
Truthfully, I still have a hard time conversing with Bismarck... But at least now, time is on our side. There will be plenty of things for us to talk about in the future, wouldn't you agree?
In the past, the word "sister" meant nothing to me. But the moment I laid eyes on her, I knew in my heart... Yes, she is indeed my sister.

Behold, she basks in everyone's adoring gaze as they orbit around her upon the resplendent firmament of the stage, as if she is the center of the universe... But you and I both know, that is not where she wants to be.
Waiting for her to find us instead of taking the initiative to find her might be a bit of my nasty streak showing, but I'm still the little sister here. I have that right, don't I?
Do we have new missions? Don't worry, Bismarck won't mind waiting a bit longer.
Commander, we don't have too many of these banquets, so don't get too anxious about work. Let's have something to eat first.
We're getting all these requests to dance with you, Commander. Maybe I should put in one as well?
Commander, do you wish to know how I feel about Bismarck?
Commander, it seems like another commission has been completed. Go ahead and take care of it; I'll be waiting for you right here.
If she was here... how would she have fought this battle?

They have a peculiar way of wishing a happy New Year in the Sakura Empire. In line with their traditions, I've put on this new outfit. I hope it doesn't... look strange on me. ...You like it? I see... That being the case, I'll keep wearing it for the time

They have a peculiar way of wishing a happy New Year in the Sakura Empire. In line with their traditions, I've put on this new outfit. I hope it doesn't... look strange on me. ...You like it? I see... That being the case, I'll keep wearing it for the time
I waited for you, Commander. Now let us go and wish everyone a happy New Year, before aircraft come chasing after us.
My Sakura Empire friends told me that the pine tree is like an anchor point for the gods. Much like what you are to me, Commander... Oh, just talking to myself. Hahah.
I must give my regards to my sister... But how I should face her, I do not know. Could you come with me, Commander?
Alabama proposed playing a type of badminton enjoyed around New Year's. I suppose that could be fun. ...The loser will have ink rubbed on their face? On second thought, I will pass.
I've long been used to the cold, but sometimes, I find myself reaching out towards the warmth... Commander, can I... come a little closer?
It feels warm... A nice change of pace.
*sigh*... Could you please mind your manners in public?
It's all right, I just got here myself. I will say, it's strangely reassuring to know I'm not the only one nervous on this day.
It's all right, I just got here myself. I will say, it's strangely reassuring to know I'm not the only one nervous on this day.
No need to rush, Commander - we have plenty of time. If there's one thing I'm used to, it's waiting.
I cannot picture Bismarck going out on a date... I know I'm the one who asked you to come, but I didn't foresee she and I both would be so lacking in social grace.
Having you all to myself fills my heart with joy, even when we're simply killing time.
I used to envy Hipper's and Eugen's closeness. Now Bismarck and I get along better than ever, thanks to you.
Indeed, this is a happy reunion. Having something to look forward to can warm the heart on even the most frigid winter nights.
You should sit down if your feet ache. It's true Bismarck overexerts herself, but that's no reason for you to do the same.
Welcome back, Commander. While I'm used to being kept waiting, being kept in suspense is something I can scarcely put up with.
This ends now.
Congratulations on your new record, Commander. This glory alone has given meaning to my time spent waiting. Now, rest assured while I do maintenance on your car.
Congratulations on your new record, Commander. This glory alone has given meaning to my time spent waiting. Now, rest assured while I do maintenance on your car.
Park your car here, Commander. Your next tires are ready, so let's get them swapped out.
I will become your biggest supporter so you may run with all you have.
A change of tires will let you exhibit your fullest potential. Give me a minute... I'll be done before you know it.
Your invitation to enter the race together thawed the frost inside my heart... Ah, this brings back memories.
Whew... This is a bit tricky... Hm? You'll give me a hand? Okay, then give me your hands. Don't let go... until I tell you to.
Don't worry. It's just moving a tire. I can do it.
At least save it for after the training...
Your lap time is getting better and better... I need to pick up the pace as well.
Heehee. This glory belongs to you who gave it your all. I merely did what was expected of me.
It's almost showtime. Whether you will earn new glory or face setbacks, I'll be here, waiting for the start of your next journey.
Aircraft carrier, Graf Zeppelin.

I am Graf Zeppelin. Though this name is worth little, you may call me by it if you wish. My only desire? To end the world. I shall not ask for your help though... as you are already a part of my plans.
You're my Commander? I am Graf Zeppelin. Since it appears that all the conditions have been met, let the final movement begin.
The black goat's horn has already sounded. Quell your anxiety and wait at ease.
If gods truly exist in this world, let us begin our slaughter with them.
I prefer the high ground, because I can see everything... everything that shall be destroyed...
Easy come, easy go... Aren't things like that better off not existing in the first place?
Life is akin to playing cards with a stacked deck. Doesn't it make you want to smash the entire table?
What is the meaning of this action?
I despise everything.
Quite brave, aren't you? As expected of the one I chose.
Is the person who gave you this mission really who you want to fight for?
Rewards... take them away.
Treasure the time you have to speak with your loved ones, for that time is about to draw to an end.
All your fights, all your struggles, are nothing more than fodder for the End.
Ah, so they have returned... Just seeing those faces filled with joy...
Ah, if only strength alone was enough to determine everything.
Let us begin our symphony of destruction.
My enemies belong in their graves.
Next time, I shall grant you despair even worse than death.
Die... Funebre!
The smell of steel and blood...
You again...?
Ahh, so sweet. Sweet things cannot last for long. The only thing that endures forever is ice-cold hatred.
Does prayer really work? Will God ever respond? Nein. Gods are called as such because they are merciless.

I have never been one to believe in fate, but if meeting you was also predestined... Hmm... How ironic. For the gods to have given me the worst past but also the best future... what purpose does my hatred then serve?

As long as you are here, the world does not feel so insipid and detestable. Rest easy; even if the world was to become your enemy, I would happily fight by your side. As a matter of fact, I eagerly await this day.
Oh? Have you finally decided to make the entire world your enemy? What? You just want to be with me? Hmph, very well. Eradicating everything that stands in our way doesn't sound bad either.
You knew all along... Thank you.

ex.line: Listen - the bell's peal heralds the coming of the End. If you wish to close your eyes and hide in my arms, then I will allow it.
If you, too, harbor the ambition to slay gods... then let me accompany you. Divine though they may be, they're no match for us.
You and I both occupy high stations. Do you enjoy looking down at things from above like I do? Heh, that's another thing we agree on.
Sometimes, what's lost is gone forever. We must treasure what we still have.
This world is only another chessboard waiting for the end of its game. But if you're the one moving the pieces, then I will gladly face the End alongside you.
Are you trying to offer me comfort? Very well... It is better than nothing.
The darkest night comes before the brightest dawn.
Your audaciousness always exceeds my expectations... not that I mind that.
Though we're ever beneath the shadow of the End, never forget... that all you do has meaning.

You once told me that the End would lead to new beginnings. To be honest, I still don't understand what these new beginnings may be. But if you are by my side, then I am ready to witness them... and to lend a hand.

lines.line: So the Second Movement is a Lento of the summer and the sea? So be it... Since we will arrive at the Finale eventually, I suppose I can enjoy this moment of fleeting peace with you.
So the Second Movement is a Lento of the summer and the sea? So be it... Since we will arrive at the Finale eventually, I suppose I can enjoy this moment of fleeting peace with you.
Didn't we agree to go to the beach? Where were you?
Now that I think about it, other than forcing me to wear this skimpy bit of fabric, what else is this summer season even for?
Is there a nice vantage point on the beach to sit at? ...There isn't? Oh well...
I only wore this... "clothing" because you told me to. If you didn't come to the beach with me, I'd be... rather upset.
Eugen, don't rush me, the commander is still working. What am I going to do on the beach by myself...
Is it time to depart? Wait a moment, these shoes are a bit hard to put on... Come help me out for a second...
Hmph... Commander, do you also wish to become food for this child here?
Finally, you've come. Even if it meant dying tomorrow, it's a worthy trade to enjoy this moment with you.
Finally, you've come. Even if it meant dying tomorrow, it's a worthy trade to enjoy this moment with you.
The view outside is wonderful. If you miss it, I suppose I'll be forced to invite you over again.
Hmm. You think I'll catch a cold if I don't put more clothes on? Do you consider this lightly dressed? Then what do you call what everyone else is wearing?
Why are you staying so far away? Do you not want to be next to me? Is my bed too small? I'm sure you can squeeze in... Come over here already.
Emperian wine hits so different... The intense, straightforward spiciness of it only makes me more thirsty.
Nnh... Again, I'm not drunk. This heat is just... a natural physiological reaction...
Maybe YOU'RE the drunk one. I could drink hundreds of glasses, and I would still be able to face the end with the clearest mind of all.
Nnh... Close the window first.
I saved some wine for you. Come and drink with me. When you're tipsy, you can lie down and rest... with me, of course.
Once upon a time, I hoped that annihilation would come to this dull world. Somehow, I feel as if I've found my home amidst these lights... Maybe your existence is the glimmer of hope I needed.
An Shan-class destroyer, No. 1 - Anshan (101)

I am the nameship of the An Shan-class destroyers, and one of the Dragon Empery's first-generation "Four Unbreakables." As the flagship, I participated in many naval exercises, carried out surveillance, and engaged in confrontations, leaving behind lasting achievements that I can be proud of. Though I never participated in live combat, I am the destroyer with the most miles under her belt in the entire world!
Destroyer, An Shan, reporting for duty! I shall protect my sisters and you, Commander!
Wow! Today's schedule looks packed. Let's work hard today!
Commander, what would you like to know?
Woah, this is my first time seeing a battleship!
Where did Fu Shun run off to? Would it really kill her to do as I say every now and then?
My sisters - Fu Shun, Chang Chun, and Tai Yuan - are all my pride and joy!
Commander... Hehe~ doing this occasionally is not all that bad.
Hey-! My sisters are going to see us...
Protecting the peace isn't just about fighting - you'll have to do these missions too.
Keep up the effort, don't slack off just yet!
Commander, you have new mail. Should I unseal it for you?
Why don't you take a break? It's not good to be too stressed out.
Great, everyone returned home safely!
Now I'll be better equipped to deal with ruffians like De Haven...
What are you all fighting for?
Commander, being able to help you out is the greatest!
Everyone, regroup. We can't retreat like this!
Let the protection of heaven surround the brave!
Commander, concentrate and be extra careful!
Commander, it's bloomring season for the hawthorne I grew around the Bohai Gulf. Can we go back and take a look?
Commander, we have to fight to protect the things we care about. This isn't really a question of personal preference.
Even if the day comes when I am no longer needed on the battlefield, I still want to watch over the Bohai Sea. I want to always be able to see the waters, dyed a shimmering vermillion in the sunset.
Commander, rest assured that wherever you go, I will be there to protect you. Huh? Isn't it obvious, you're mine after all...

I'm so blessed to have met you, Commander. I've made so many friends and so many memories... Hey, Commander, once I complete my duty as one of the "Four Unbreakables," let's go travel around the world together!
Commander, my body and soul, all of my life, belongs to you from now on. Make sure to take responsibility properly.
Thank you, Commander. I wanted something just like this.
Stop running around, and stay by my side!
Remember, you can never be too careful on the battlefield.
Let's see those guts! Great! Just like that!
