Awaiting the return of a loved one... is a warm feeling.
As long as you're with me, there's nothing that Yat Sen cannot do.
Even if we are to be separated, our hearts will always beat as one. Do you feel the same way about me, my dear? Hehe~
There's no need to worry, Commander. I will be fine now. Please allow me to serve you once more in this new form.
There's no need to worry, Commander. I will be fine now. Please allow me to serve you once more in this new form.
Commander, welcome back. I am by your side, just as always. May all your endeavors proceed smoothly today.
If I told you that there's much I still want to learn about you... Would you entertain my request? Heehee~
Ying Swei and Chao Ho... To outsiders, those two girls might seem like they don't get along very well. But, people who understand them will find their antics delightful and amusing. Heehee.

We cannot rely on the same old set of experiences when facing the challenges of a brand new era. I believe that with your keen judgment, Commander, you will be able to distinguish between right and wrong, and arrive at your own conclusions.

In the past, I used to pray that I would become stronger. Now, I pray that I may understand both the warmth and coldness of this world. Naturally, I would like to experience those things to better accompany you and my other friends, heehee.
Did you need me? I am willing to hear you out at any time.
All inappropriate conduct will be held to account.
Indeed, home is the place that truly makes your heart feel at ease.
Ning Hai-class Light Cruiser, Ning Hai

I'm Ning Hai, the first ship of the Ning Hai-class! In order to revive our nation's navy, we have been living as frugally as possible. If you waste our efforts, Commander, I'm going to be very angry with you!
You're the Commander? Well, from this day forward, I'll take the duty of supervising the fleet. I hope you'll coopera... Buns? Thank you, I'll help myself.
Where were you? Lazing around again?! Did you bring me any food...? Hmph. Let's get to work.
What is it? You want to watch a martial arts performance?
Even if you put a giant plate of steamed buns on the table in front of me, I won't relax...
Commander, I would rather see you and the fleet become stronger instead of just myself.
You cannot protect your loved ones if you neglect your training.
What, you want to have a go with me?
*sigh* I won't forgive you, even if you beg God for forgiveness and bribe me with a lifetime supply of steamed buns.
Missions won't complete themselves if you are daydreaming. Let's get going!
Rewards have been counted. We could buy a huge stack of steamed buns... *ahem* The list is here, Commander.
Reading the mail in a timely manner is a common courtesy. Make sure to properly respond as well!
I just finished steaming these buns. Why not relax and have a quick snack?
Commander, the prior commission should be finished just about now.
I've got to work even harder to balance the fleet's income and expenses.
I'll never hold back against our enemies!
Everyone must aspire to outperform me!
My abilities... are inadequate...
I'll show you the power of kung fu!
Persevere!
As if I'd eat your buns!
Come on! What's going on with this month's expenses?! Why are these buns here... Have I eaten? Not yet... Fine, let's eat together.
Don't always try to change the subject to buns when we're discussing serious business, Commander! Do I look like I can be bought that easily? Ooo... mmm.... So delicious!
You won't trick me this time! I'm telling you... Eh? You like me? Wait, th-this must be your new way of tricking me! Uu...

There's an old saying in our nation: "It's easy to go from a life of frugality to one of extravagance, but not the other way around." I hope that the one I like would not turn me into a frivolous... wh-wh-why would I say that I like you? You must have heard me wrong.
... Since you trust me so much, Commander, why don't we plan ahead? The next focus of our fleet is... cost cutting! We've got to maintain the fleet by minimizing expenses, and... Hey! Don't run away!
Don't think this means you get to slack off! Tch... O-okay, you get ten minutes!
Ping Hai! Stop eating my buns!
Summer's all about the beach! And the beach is all about good food! Let's find something good to eat, Commander.
Summer's all about the beach! And the beach is all about good food! Let's find something good to eat, Commander.
*panting*... S-sorry, Commander... I wound up on some weird uninhabited island... *panting*... I swam away for dear life and finally made it back... *panting*...
How'd I even get lost...? My map of the local sea should be perfectly accurate...
I wanna geh closer to tha firrwurks... Lemme wide on your shouldersh, Commander~! Err... N-no! I'm not drunk!
Come here, Ping Hai. Let me take care of that stain on your lips.
Ping Hai! You can't get careless just because we're not in batt- Blurph!
I'm tired and my muscles hurt... But it was all worth it for that awesome beachside barbeque!
Calm down, Commander, I'm trying to watch the fireworks... Your shoulders hurt? Come on, I'm not that heavy!
My summer appetite empowers me!
You're not taking my fried noodles from me!
I want another helping of seafood with fried noodles!
Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! By the way, I heard that if you prayed to the moon today, you'll become as pretty as the Goddess of the Moon! ...Eh, you're really doing it?!
Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! By the way, I heard that if you prayed to the moon today, you'll become as pretty as the Goddess of the Moon! ...Eh, you're really doing it?!
Oh gosh, mooncake! Yes! Om nom nom nom!
It's a holiday, so nobody will mind if I drink a little... right? *gulp*, *gulp*... Ahahaha... Something here smells like sweet osmanthus~!
Da Bao, Baobao, do you want some mooncake too? Here you go.
The whole family's all gathered for the Mid-Autumn Festival! Happy holidays, Commander!
For the last time! I'm not a bunny girl, I'm a moon rabbit! Got it?!

We haven't had to worry as much about things like food since we joined the fleet, but that doesn't mean we can just throw money around...! Anyway, I'm the older of the "Dragon Sisters," Ning Hai! Great to be here!

We haven't had to worry as much about things like food since we joined the fleet, but that doesn't mean we can just throw money around...! Anyway, I'm the older of the "Dragon Sisters," Ning Hai! Great to be here!
Thank you very m-! It's you, Commander.
Look, all this idol stuff is just work, okay! Don't start thinking I actually enjoy it!
C- Commander... "Jia you! ☆" Was that cute enough...? Don't look at me like that! This is serious business right here!
After studying all that kung fu, Idol dancing is a piece of cake for me and Ping Hai! Hah hah!
Oh, right! Commander, next time me and Ping Hai put out a single, we'll definitely save you one.
Don't worry, I'm wearing shorts underneath. And anyway if somebody tried something gross, I've got a roundhouse kick with their name on it!
Roundhouse kick!
A new offer...? Heh, hehehehe... Sure, I'll keep packing in as much work as my schedule can take!
The fans make me really happy, sure, but next time I'll have to teach them how to save money!
There's so many fan letters...! Being an idol is so exhausting...
Nice work out there, got a request you want me to sing?
The commission's done? Okay then, take five. Commander, you should probably go out and meet them.
Is making me sing during a battle some kind of weird fetish thing?!
It feels... even better than I expected.
Oh, my outfit...
Sigh... turns out the more idol stuff I have to do, the less time I get to spend with the Commander... Commander, um, say...? Do you think you could be our manager...?
Commander, what are you spacing out for? Over here! They say that you'll have good fortune if you give this thing a shake!
Commander, what are you spacing out for? Over here! They say that you'll have good fortune if you give this thing a shake!
Where should we go next?
Ping Hai can get away with it, but I can't believe YOU don't have a clear schedule for this vacation, Commander... Forget it, I'll make you one!
Hmph. Sure, we got this vacation for free, but we can't squander our money... Ping Hai! Don't go off ordering food! You too, Commander!
I've vaguely felt it since way back, but the Sakura Empire and Dragon Empery are similar in a lot of ways. But also dissimilar in many ways, obviously. Those are what feel fresh.
It's so crowded over here... Listen, um, could you hold my hand? ... I mean, with me.
We have to visit *all* the places I've outlined in my schedule, Commander. And don't you think about giving up already!
This one's really expensive... But we do need a souvenir to take back home... Fine, we'll buy it!
You're late! We're going to the next tourist attraction right now!
Stop interfering with our vacation, you scrapheaps!
You're willing to go *any* lengths to anger me, aren't you?

H-Huh? Hey! Why do *you* have my tourist magazine, Commander? The red circle on the shrine that "makes lovers get married"? L-Look, I only marked it because I wanted to check it out while we're here, that's all!
Yat Sen said this look would be best for a party, but, is it really okay? I'm not used to having my hair down like this...
Yat Sen said this look would be best for a party, but, is it really okay? I'm not used to having my hair down like this...
This cake is for you, Commander! T-take it!

Yat Sen, Ping Hai, and I made this cake for the party, with the help of some other girls. It had to be big enough to feed everyone... But a big baozi probably would have been better than a big cake... Ahem! N-never mind.
Da Bao! Bring the next slice over here! Pay attention!
I told her not to, but I'm still worried Ping Hai is going to gobble up the cake before she finishes passing it out... I better go keep an eye on her!
While handing out all this cake I realized just how many friends Ping Hai and I have made lately... Heh heh.
Passing out the cake...? That's not a job for a commander! Leave it to me and Ping Hai, and of course Da Bao and Baobao!
Waaah! C-Commander! What if I drop the cake?!
A party this fancy must have cost a lot... Hm... Fine! The money's spent, so we might as well enjoy ourselves!
You're not getting this cake!

Good boy. Chew thoroughly before you swallow. I never thought I'd help with a charity event for nature, but Da Bao's made a lot of new friends because of it. Keep up the good work, Commander and Ping!

Good boy. Chew thoroughly before you swallow. I never thought I'd help with a charity event for nature, but Da Bao's made a lot of new friends because of it. Keep up the good work, Commander and Ping!
Commander! Good timing! Could you go get some bamboo?
I never knew pandas are omnivores. I'd always thought they only ate bamboo...
Have some bamboo too, Da Bao. Eat it slowly now, so you don't choke!
These cubs might not look all that heavy, but they weigh a lot for their size.
You can't just play all day, Ping! There are charity missions to do, don't forget that! Same for you, Commander!
A baozi? You're not supposed to feed pandas with stuff you'd feed Ping! ...It's for me? In that case, th-thanks...
The mommy panda is pretty wary of letting people near her babies... What would her caretakers do in this situation?

Woah! Da Bao, lend me a hand here! Don't let that octopus get away! ...Oh, Commander, Happy Lunar New Year! Uhh, the kitchen prep's going fine... Huh? You're gonna help? Heheh~ don't worry about us! Just leave everything here to me 'n Ping!

Woah! Da Bao, lend me a hand here! Don't let that octopus get away! ...Oh, Commander, Happy Lunar New Year! Uhh, the kitchen prep's going fine... Huh? You're gonna help? Heheh~ don't worry about us! Just leave everything here to me 'n Ping!
Oh, a customer! ...Uhh, I mean, welcome back, Commander! Got work today? Well, let's get it taken care of so we can enjoy our New Year's banquet!
Today's main dish is drunken octopus! Here's the Shaoxing wine, but... Drunken octopus, drunken octopus... Woah! The octopus is jetting away?!

Do you like how my outfit looks? Heehee~ This was the New Year's present that everyone picked out for me, and I gave it a little unique touch! I'm still missing a stocking? Th-this modification is just to make it easier to record the orders!

Hmm? I made too much food? ...Nonsense! I might encourage being thrifty every other day of the year, but I'm going all-out today! It's the New Year after all, and you don't mess around with the New Year's banquet. So, I'm going all out!
Commander, look forward to the lavish banquet I'm going to prepare for you! ...Don't worry, I've got things under control. S-seriously, I said I can handle this!
Hyeep?! H-hold on, the bowls are gonna fall! ...Jeez, this isn't the time to start clinging to me!
...H-hey, mind the time and place, okay? Ping Hai is here, you know?!
Hmm? New mission? So, what's the plan, Commander? Gonna take care of it now?
Mission rewards, collected and accounted for! Hmm... What's this... I think I can incorporate this into my banquet menu?
Commander, you've got mail. At this time of year, it's probably New Year's well-wishes, right? It'd be rude of you not to reply~
You couldn't have picked a better time to get back~! The baozi are fresh off the stove, so if you're hungry, grab a basket!
The commission team is back. Perfect, just in time for a get-together meal!
Ping Hai, you'd better not let that crab get away!
Yes! … this feels good. Thank you, Commander. In order to live up to your expectations, from now on, I will be more serious around you, Commander. Hey, don't run!
Yes! … this feels good. Thank you, Commander. In order to live up to your expectations, from now on, I will be more serious around you, Commander. Hey, don't run!
In order to save money, I'll have to cook with the most affordable ingredients I can get... Commander, come taste test this for me~
Commander, if I catch you slacking off, you'll get a taste of my new karate chops.
If I don't cheer up a bit, who is Commander and Pinghai going to depend on- Ah, I didn't mean it like that!
Commander, don't just sit there all day, come here and do some aerobics with me to loosen up!
Where in the world did Bunbun get these fancy glasses... I hope he's not trying to become a pandit.
I'll be everyone's role model!
Ning Hai-class Light Cruser, Ping Hai

I'm Ning Hai, the first ship of the Ning Hai-class. Big sister told me to say this when I was introducing myself. Ah? I'm Ping Hai? That's right! Then... I'm Ping Hai, the first ship of the Ning Hai-class... I'm wrong again? This is so confusing...
Commander? Big sister told me that commanders who can’t even put food on the table are no good. Can you support yourself? ...Then, how about me?
Commander, have you eaten yet? You can’t work on an empty stomach.
What are you looking at, Commander?
Socks? Big sister said we should spend less money, so we share one pair together...
Kung Fu? Big sister said we could earn some Coins by performing on the street, so I learned that too...
Pandas? On our heads? They're also sisters!
Commander, do you also want a hug? I hug my big sister all the time.
Big sister told me to beat up any bad guys that I come across. But what is a bad guy?
Big sister says that missions won’t complete themselves if I’m daydreaming. Does that mean they will if I practice kung fu?
So many rewards, Commander! Can we trade them for buns?
Big sister says that checking the mail in a timely manner is a common courtesy! Commander, want to read these?
Whenever big sister is tired, the only way to make her happy is by giving her steamed buns. Do you want some, Commander?
Commander, Commander! Big sister said that I have to tell you whenever a commission is finished.
I'm... hungry!
Do I get any tasty food for winning?
Number one? Does that taste good?
Big sister, where are you?
Hi-ya! Kung fu!
I'm hungry...
Commander... are you one of those "bad guys" that big sister talks about?
Big sister always says that we are too poor to have food in the pot, but every time I open the lid, there’s always food in there! What’s the deal with that?
Big sister said I shouldn’t be alone with Commander... is it because she wants the buns all for herself? Then, I shall come visit Commander more often from now on!
Big sister told me that finding someone who can feed me is more important than finding someone I like. Since I like Commander and get plenty of food, there shouldn’t be any problems.
I will be satisfied as long as I can be with Commander all the time, and just see my sister every now and then. Hmm? Big Sister would cry? Why?
Does this mean that I should only listen to Commander from now on instead of my big sister? ...Make my own decision? Hm... then, I shall listen to both of you.
My sister says I shouldn't accept gifts, but we can make an exception for you, can't we?
Big sister! Do you want some buns?
Shaved ice is better than steamed buns, fireworks are prettier than shaved ice, and more precious than fireworks is...
Shaved ice is better than steamed buns, fireworks are prettier than shaved ice, and more precious than fireworks is...
B-big sister, where are we...? And where is everyone...? Eek! I-I think I just heard something... Oh, right, this place is uninhabited.
Big sister and I got lost on on this strange island and saw some weird stuff... What was weird about it? Look, it was really weird, that's all!
Liquor chocolates? Wait, no, big sister! You shouldn't eat those...!
Big sister told me the dining table is a battlefield of its own, so I'm gonna stay on my guard!
Aww... I wanna ride on the Commander's shoulders too...
D-don't stare at me like that... Fine, I'll give you a third of my ice cream... Ugh, okay, half! But no more than that!
Fried noodles! Grilled fish! Ice cream!
Will you give me food if we win this? Pretty please?
Hey Commander, I wanna have croquettes today!
Commander, happy Mid-Autumn Festival! I have mooncakes, pomegranates, and osmanthus cakes... Mm... This holiday is the best!
Commander, happy Mid-Autumn Festival! I have mooncakes, pomegranates, and osmanthus cakes... Mm... This holiday is the best!
Om nom... Hey, Commander, what flavor of mooncake do you like?
Just so you know, Commander, I'm an unrivaled champion at hammering mooncake!
The sweet osmanthus cakes my sister made smell delicious. You want one, Commander?
Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! Do you wanna make a traditional lantern, Commander?
I feel like I could hop all the way up to the moon in this outfit...

Big sister says that even though we have some money now, we still have to save as much as we can. Um... Anyway, I'm the younger "Dragon Sister," Ping Hai. Erm... I'm kind of hungry. Do you maybe have something to eat?

Big sister says that even though we have some money now, we still have to save as much as we can. Um... Anyway, I'm the younger "Dragon Sister," Ping Hai. Erm... I'm kind of hungry. Do you maybe have something to eat?
Commander, are you here for my show?
I think big sister really likes her idol outfit.
Big sister says all I need to do is be myself up on stage, but the truth is I don't know how to be myself unless she tells me...
Commander, do you think I should try doing kung fu up on stage? Like this.. hiyaa!
I think everybody really likes Baobao. Let me do a show with Baobao next time!
Commander, you want to get up on stage with me?
I think I'm wearing it right?
Big sister says more offers means more money...
They gave me so much good stuff to eat. I love it!
Commander, can you help me reply to all this fan mail? I can't do it all by myself...
Commander, can I go with you to welcome everyone home?
Big sister, my clothes ripped... sew them for me...
Being an idol with my big sister is so much fun. And it's been a really long time since I've seen her so happy... but I'd be even happier with you, Commander.
The Sakura Empire has lots of delicious food that I've never tried before! Yeah! It's a great place!
The Sakura Empire has lots of delicious food that I've never tried before! Yeah! It's a great place!
Commander, I wanna try the Sakura Empire's take on ramen!
Big sister made a stupidly jam-packed schedule. Just looking at it makes me sleepy... But there's apparently lots of tasty food by the tourist attractions, so I'm coming along!
Big sister said this is a prize vacation, so we can't try out all the local restaurants... What even is a "prize vacation"?
Big sister looks thrilled to get to enjoy a vacation! Seeing her smile, and getting to eat so much good food, has me feeling thrilled too!
Let go of my jacket, big sister~! I've not finished my food yet! Give it a try you too, it's really yummy!
The goal of our vacation? Mine is to try *all* of the Sakura Empire's yummiest food!
There's so much tasty food I want to try!
Commander, I wanna eat some tempura!
There's always a lot of delicious food at these parties! But, my sister said I'm not allowed to have any cake until everyone's gotten their slice... Baobao, let's be on our best behavior!
There's always a lot of delicious food at these parties! But, my sister said I'm not allowed to have any cake until everyone's gotten their slice... Baobao, let's be on our best behavior!
Here's your cake. Eat up. Ning Hai is passing out blueberry cake, but I've got strawberry.
Just like Ning Hai's, me and the girls made my cake with love. It's a chao ji da strawberry cake... I wonder how many days it would take for me to eat by myself...? Hehehe.
Baobao, where do I bring the next slice...?
There's going to be so much good stuff at the party... Commander, they have to have some baozi, don't they?!
Ning Hai always says I need to make more friends... But really I have so many friends already!
Ning Hai told me to pass out my cake without bothering the Commander!
Mm. I've known for a long time, my sister and I are very different in that department.
I'm... so hungry... Maybe just a little bite... No! Ning Hai told me not to!
Cheese! That came out looking good! Hehehe~ I'm really glad to be a part of this charity event for nature, along with you and my sister! Baobao is really glad too!
Cheese! That came out looking good! Hehehe~ I'm really glad to be a part of this charity event for nature, along with you and my sister! Baobao is really glad too!
Big sister told me to look after these pandas! Does that mean I should play with them?
Commander, let's take these pandas back to port! ...We're not allowed? Aww...
Look at the camera! I'm gonna take a group photo!
Do you wanna pet the pandas too, Commander?
Eat lots, Baobao! Then you'll grow up to be as big as your buddy!
I'm not allowed to feed them baozi? Okay, I'll keep that in mind...
I'm gonna take a bunch of pics of these cute pandas and show them to people around the port!

You can't have a hearty banquet without crab meat! Which is why... I'm not letting you get away! Oh, Commander, did you want to lend a hand? It's okay though, my sister and I have got things under wrap here.

You can't have a hearty banquet without crab meat! Which is why... I'm not letting you get away! Oh, Commander, did you want to lend a hand? It's okay though, my sister and I have got things under wrap here.
For our ingredients, we've got crab, octopus, and fish... Commander, got a dish you're interested in?
My sis said today is a huge opportunity to show off our culinary skills. So, what would you like to eat? As long as you can imagine it, we can whip it up for you~

My new outfit? My sister and Chi An picked it out for me. Look at this~ Hiyaah~! Look how easy it is to move around! ...Hm? It looks good on me, but I should refrain from doing any kung fu? Why's that?

Baobao, the hammer's dangerous, so put it down right now! Huh? The crab's making a beeline towards the Commander? Oh no, it's too late... Your hand's all red... *huff, huff*... Pain, pain, go away~! All better now?
Hmm? How am I supposed to chop the veggies like this? ...Oh, Commander, you should probably keep your fingers away from the kitchen knife.
You ARE hungry, aren't you? I'll have food ready in a moment... Umm, sorry, but I can't exactly go give you a hug right now.
...Hm? I don't mind. But... I can't guarantee that my sister won't give you a walloping~
Commander, new rewards have come in! Do you think there might be some handy cooking ingredients inside?
Commander, you've got new mail. I can't help you right now, so you'll have to remember to check it yourself.
Commander, are you hungry? If you want a snack, I've got some baozi. Want one?
Commission complete, Commander! You should go take some dim sum out to our friends! Let's see... Does baozi sound good?
Sis, your octopus is getting away!
Hi~ya! Hmm... this feels... nothing special. Baobao looks happy though... Never mind, Commander, Ping Hai is hungry!
Hi~ya! Hmm... this feels... nothing special. Baobao looks happy though... Never mind, Commander, Ping Hai is hungry!
My sister bought another pair of socks again, but then gave them to me... Could it be that she actually wants to wear them?
Baobao, stop jumping onto Commander's head to practice shadowboxing...
You want me to stop doing high kicks? Why though?
Commander, why are you putting my sister and I on opposite sides of the door? Huh? Exorcism?
Commander, I want to eat something yummy when I get back!
Pallada-class Light Cruiser, Avrora

I am Avrora, a light cruiser. I started a famous revolution, but I cannot understand what happened to the world after that...|I'm no more than just another soldier in your fleet. Please utilize my abilities to their fullest, and I'll make sure to ring victory to the fleet.
Здравствуйте! Avrora, reporting in. Along with the light of dawn, I shall bring you victory.
Ah, Commander, you're back! Would you like some borscht?
For combat to be the sole purpose of my existence is a strange and novel feeling.
I have a big heart? Thanks for the compliment.
As the herald of dawn, I shall bring light to everyone.
Bears? They're pretty cute. I used to raise one.
Do you like my ushanka, Commander? Heehee. You can try it on if you'd like~
I'm not cold though~
You should express your feelings in a more passionate manner.
A new mission! I'm more excited than I should be.
Here are your well-deserved rewards.
This mail has traveled a long way to get here. Please read it.
Good work, Commander. Would you like a bottle of vodka to warm you up?
Commander, a commission has been completed. Let's bring some vodka to the girls to warm them up.
I feel like I could lift an entire bear! Hehe...
Victory lies ahead!
We must remember the sacrifices that made this victory possible...
The Revolution shall not cease its march.
Within the light of dawn are spilled blood and raging flames...
Even I am unable to shed a light into the darkness of your heart, Commander?
Commander, care for a drink? Whether you can get me to do strange things afterwards... depends entirely on your ability~
My hometown? It's very beautiful. Although if you want to go there, you would need to be prepared for the cold. Me? I'll be fine, even without clothes. Hehe... want proof?
Commander, everyone from my hometown is straightforward, and I'm no exception... If you can finish this drink, you can do anything you'd like with me...
Я люблю тебя, Commander. If you want to know what it means, you'll have to learn my mother tongue... and come to my hometown.
Commander, are you all geared up? The journey is going to be cold. Don't worry! I've brought plenty of vodka to keep us warm...
You really remembered! Спасибо~
Gangut, don't bully the commander too much, okay?
Kuku? I'm not sure I want to call you that... Ahaha...
Forward, comrades of the Northern Parliament!

ex.line: I made fruit pelmeni today. Which would you like first, strawberry or cherry? Heehee, why the strange face? No being picky, Commander~
Commander, can you hold my hand? Mmm... You're very warm.
Has the sun already set? Don't worry. Darkness may always exist, but the dawn always follows.
Sometimes, when we're together, I find myself thinking... The days used to feel so long, but now they pass in the blink of an eye. Why is that, I wonder?
That feels nice... just like sitting by the fireplace.
Ready to go drinking?
You're as passionate as ever. I hope you're ready for me to repay that passion.
Welcome back, Commander. If I can help with anything, please don't hesitate to ask.
Wherever you are is my home. I'll always be by your side, just like the inevitable break of dawn every day.

lines.line: I am Avrora, the princess bound within this tower by a cruel fate... My beloved, please come for me soon...
I am Avrora, the princess bound within this tower by a cruel fate... My beloved, please come for me soon...
Ah, Commander, welcome back. Did you come to save me? Here, I'm all yours~
Roleplaying as a damsel in distress is rather new and exciting. Hehe~
This building's ambience and lighting are just right. Heehee~
I won't surrender myself to fate. I pray that the light of dawn will reach even this dark place.
Even if my knight in shining armor was to come, they probably wouldn't be able to get past the bears... Just kidding~♪
I'm not particularly cold, you know? I'm actually pretty used to it. Commander, make sure you stay warm though.
"The captured princess was toyed with by her tormentors..." Something like that won't happen to me, right?
Commander, my apologies. I'll go compile the reports, so please let me out of these for a bit.
May freedom soon dawn upon this land...
The coming of dawn... is yet deferred...
"Muahaha... Now, these streets belong to me..." Sorry, I bit my tongue... Hmm, getting into this role is quite difficult for me after all.
"Muahaha... Now, these streets belong to me..." Sorry, I bit my tongue... Hmm, getting into this role is quite difficult for me after all.
Who's on the hit list today...? Umm, give me a moment... I have to go over the script again...
You think I... make a pretty good mafia boss? Mikasa and Gangut were laughing their heads off saying I wasn't cut out for the role...
I'll bring revolution to these streets with a single shot! ...Umm, wait, right now I'm supposed to be... Right, I'm a bad girl now.
Who's that over there... Kronshtadt? I-is she okay?!
"Those who stand in my way... will face unbearable punishment!" Come here, Pirožkí, I'm going to give you a biiiig hug~
Commander? Fweh?
We've got a new job. How exciting~ Ah, let's see what we have here this time... Heh heh. That's how I should be responding, right?
The rewards are in. Here, you've earned it. Heh heh~
News from our top-secret contact? Let's hurry up and check.
"Muahaha... Today, I'll have you and Pamiat' do my legwork!" ...All right, Commander, be careful on your way there~
Muahaha... Get 'em, girls!
"You won't get to see the sun rise tomorrow, kid. Muahaha!" ...Hmm, don't you think not letting someone see the beautiful sunrise is a bit too cruel, Commander?
Looks like we got busted...
The party's already over? Nuh uh~ Come on, have another drink, Commander! Just finish this glass, and all your troubles... will... Zzzzz...
The party's already over? Nuh uh~ Come on, have another drink, Commander! Just finish this glass, and all your troubles... will... Zzzzz...
Huh? Oh, Commander. Heehee, don't even think about running away~ We still have a lot of drinking to do... Come on, raise your glass~♪
Commander, let's have a toast! As long as our glasses remain lifted, the party shall never end!
Com~man~der~♪ Are you not going to drink? Really? I've already tasted it for you. It's honey-sweet, and... has a hint of "me"~
*yawn*... This mellow sunlight is making me sleepy... Commander, why don't we take a nap together? I'd love to share a bit of this sunshine with you~
I'm totally not drunk. My face isn't even red yet... Huh? It is?
Don't get in my way, you hear? I can drink another ten glasses... another ten glasses, I say!
Are you drunk already, Commander? We haven't even started drinking for real though...
Oh, Commander. You're back? ...Heehee, I left you a cup of the finest wine~
My dress looks wonderful, doesn't it? Heehee... all the time I spent preparing for this special moment was well worth it~ ...What special moment? Well, that would be... Zzzzz...
Benson-class Destroyer - Bailey, Hull Number DD-492!
I'm from Planet Bunny. I'm a bunny, just like my sisters! I'm super good at giving providing fire support. I've even earned awards for it, believe it or not! Hehe, I'm super strong!
I'm Bailey, a Benson-cla... Wait, no, I'm a bunny! Commander, have you seen any of my sisters?
Are you feeling good today, Commander? Let me inject some bunny power into you!
Giiiy... Kiiie... Uh... Bwuuuh...? It's hard to speak like a bunny...
The most delish carrot is always going to be the next one!
I've received a transmission from Planet Bunny telling me to help you with your work. No need to thank me, just leave it to me!
I'm going to become a superstar one day! The most popular in the universe!
Your hands are so warm, Commander~!
What a... strange feeling...
You should definitely stock up on carrots, but you shouldn't stock up on unfinished missions!
Look, Commander! I brought the rewards we got! Aren't I great~?
Commander, new mail arrived! Is it from Planet Bunny?
Good work, Commander! Want to try some of my handmade cookies?
Commander, the girls who were out on a commission have returned! Let's give them a warm welcome! If we don't have regular exercise then we'll start to rust!
My bunny level has gone up even higher! Yeah!
I'm not afraid of you!
Haha! Bunnies are just super strong!
*Sob*... Planet Bunny won't let you off so easily!
Here I go! Bunny Boosted Bane Blaster!
Bunnies bite when they're angry...!
You're the enemy of the bunnies, Commander!
I'll do my best, even though I'm just a bunny!
Benson told me that I'm from Planet Bunny... Does she think I'm still a kid or something? But... but... I know for a fact that Santa is real!
C'mon, Commander, play with me~! Busy with work? Hehe, look again, Commander. No need to thank me!
My sister told me that bunnies die if they get too lonely! That's why I came to see you~! Do you... not want to visit me, Commander?
Pro...mise? Promise what? I don't really get it. Do you wanna become a bunny too? ... Great! That means we can be together forever!
Whoa! I wanted this! Thanks, Commander!
Can you see the ghost next to me? Hehehe— the black witch from Planet Bunny is none other than me, Bailey!
Can you see the ghost next to me? Hehehe— the black witch from Planet Bunny is none other than me, Bailey!
Trick or treat! If you don't hand over the candy, Baily and the Bunnykin will play a trick on you!
Cutie, Lucky, listen closely! Today's mission is to extract a whole bunch of candy from the commander!
Commander, your candy contribution will be distributed among the residents of Planet Bunny! Ehehe~☆
Don't you have any carrot candy? Bailey craves carrot candy!
Bailey's a black bunny today. Don't mistake it for a regular ol' white bunny!
Candy given away can never be reclaimed~!
This strange sensation... Could it be EM waves from Planet Bunny...?
Bailey doesn't do pumpkin pie, but you can have this delicious carrot cake instead!
Cutie, Lucky, hold on tight~!
Your Bunny Santa has arrived! That's right - not regular ol' Santa, but Bunny Santa! The real Santa's busy, so Bailey from Planet Bunny is here to help out!
Your Bunny Santa has arrived! That's right - not regular ol' Santa, but Bunny Santa! The real Santa's busy, so Bailey from Planet Bunny is here to help out!
There you are, Commander. Get over here and help me out! There are way too many presents here for one bunny to carry...
Commander, why don't you be a Bunny Santa, too? It's really fun to give out gifts to all the good boys and girls!
Santa is real! Planet Bunny has Santa, so this planet has to have one, too! Heehee!
Kalk, you can't give people chili peppers for Christmas! And Hobby, the Commander's helping me out right now, so you can play reindeer later!
Cutie and Lucky, did you deliver the presents like I asked? Aww, thank you!
Can you carry the heavy stuff for me? Thank you! Bunny Santa rates you nice this year!
Brr, that's chilly... Uh, but that isn't the only problem here!
Now that you're back, it's time to get back to delivering presents! Don't worry; the cold is nothing to Bunny Santa!
This long-awaited day has finally come. My bunnies, are you all ready? Bailey's debut shall now begin! Commander, my sisters, let's all come see Bailey's bunny magic!
This day has finally arrived~ Are you ready, Rabbits? Bailey’s new debut is about to begin. Commander, sisters, come and witness Bailey’s rabbit magic!
Cutie, Lucky, I'm leaving the equipment to you two~!
Bailey will always be shining brighter in the next moment~!
Commander, Commander! Is Bailey cute? Ehehe... you can praise Bailey some more~!
Commander, there's mail! Is there any fanmail for Bailey?
Good work! Bailey shall use her brighest smile to soothe Commander's heart!
Bunny magic is suuuuper strong!
It's Bailey from Planet Bunny! Everyone, please give me your support~
Type 1936 destroyer - Z19 Hermann Künne.

I am the Iron Blood Navy's Z-class 1936-Type destroyer, Hermann Künne. I participated in Operation Weserübung, and met my end during the fierce engagements at Narvik. Things will be different this time around!
Z19 Hermann Künne, reporting for duty! Commander, I'm prepared to fight until the very end!
Commander, skipping breakfast is bad for your body. I've prepared some cereal and toast for you; if you don't mind, would you like to eat together?
Any inquiries, Commander?
I must be more strict with myself now that I'm your secretary.
Commander, if you're free, would you like to play with me?
Commander, I prepared some watermelon for you. Open your mouth~ aah~
Commander, your orders?
Please don't pick me up... I'm way too old for that...
Ah, it's already time to get back to work. Commander, let's go complete some missions.
Commander, the missions were done perfectly this time! Full marks!
There's new mail, Commander. Surely there's a commendation from the higher-ups!
Could you play with me for a while, Commander? Oh.. you're tired? I guess rest is pretty important too...
Is it finally time for you to play with me?
Am I one step closer to being an adult?
All ships, at the ready! Aim for the enemy fleet ahead! Feuer!
Z23! This time, I got a perfect score!
Ugh... Mission... failed. Commander, I'm terribly sorry.
This is the result of all my hard work!
Zero points for you, Commander!
No matter what skill you have, I'm sure there's a place for it.
Commander, if I get MVP in the next battle, would you take me to a water park on your next day off?
Commander, as long as I can see you, my mind is at ease even if you aren't doing anything in particular. Is this what it means to be reliant?

*yawns* Commander, why haven't you gone back to your room yet? You're sorry for waking me up? No, it's okay... but I only have this single bed here... You want to measure my finger size? Why not turn on the lights... Fuehhh?!
Can I really have this? Thank you very much... I'll do my best to be a worthy partner!
This present gets a full 100 points!
Type 1936 destroyer - Z20 Karl Galster.

I am Z20 Karl Galster, Iron Blood Z-class 1936-Type destroyer, the sole survivor of the Z17 type destroyers. After being handed over to the Northern Parliament, I was renamed "прочный." Being separated from my sisters and living alone sure was rough...
Z20, Karl Galster, reporting in! Where's my welcoming party?
Commander, up for a jog?
I'll make all your concerns go "poof!" How's that, Commander? Feel better?
Commander, let me teach you the right way to breathe while running. It's good for both attacking and retreating!
As long as I'm in a good mood, I can enjoy any scenery!
Protschny? Don't call me by that name!
Hmm? You want to go on a run with me?
Hehe, how do you like my curves?
Let's prepare for the celebrations before we start~
Marathon, marathon! I'll definitely take first place this time.
A letter for you, eh? I don't think I should be the one to open your mail.
Good job! Let's go find some place to relax.
Ah, our friends have returned! Let's go welcome them back!
Ahaha, I'm feeling even better!
I'm the flagship? Fine by me! Everyone, follow me!
Hahaa! Piece of cake!
Oof... even I mess up sometimes... just sometimes~
Gotta smile during battle as well!
The moment I saw you, all the fatigue from running kicked in at once. I'm out, time to rest!
As long as you keep running, you'll leave behind all your hardship and anxiety. Commander, come find me any time you're feeling down.
What's wrong? Something bugging you? I promise you'll feel better if we go run a marathon together!
If you never tell others how you feel about them, they'll never understand. You get that, right?
You idiot... All right, stop blushing and stammering. I like you. So, do you feel the same way about me?
Say, I heard there's a tradition in the East where couples will drink with their arms intertwined. Haha, come on, Commander! Don't be shy!
Ahaha, you sure picked out something nice!
Type 1936 destroyer - Z21 Wilheim Heidkamp.
I am Z21, Iron Blood Navy Z-class 1936-Type destroyer. I was the flagship during Operation Weserübung, but was sunk by HMS Courageous. I won't lose next time!
I am Z21, the Z-class destroyer flagship in the Battles of Narvik, Wilheim Heidkamp! Since you worked so hard to find me, I suppose I'll have to follow you home.
Commander, you're back! Eh...? It's... it's not like I actually care!
Is there something on my face? Stop staring at me!
You should be more careful if you want me to be your flagship... Don't misunderstand, I'm not actually worried about you.
I'm staying beside you, but only because its my duty as secretary ship!
If you're really tired, I suppose you could rest on my lap for a while...
Didn't we agree that you'd give me a heads up before poking me?
Ah! What... what are you doing? One more time and I'll really get mad!
You're still not going to work? ...You prefer staying with me? You... you're doing this on purpose, aren't you?
I-I suppose you deserve a little bit of praise... but only for your hard work.
There's mail for... help you open it? I... I guess I can do that, reluctantly of course...
G-good work. Hmph!
Good work, everyone! Except the one who's always goofing off in port... *ahem*
Thanks... for nothing! I didn't say anything!
Come on everyone, let's give it our all!
Well, I suppose you did contribute a little bit...
Ugh... I... I'll remember this!
Combat will be no problem, as long as we put in a little effort.
I'm having a bad day... Just stay away from me!
I'll fight to protect my sisters... Not you!
What kind of stuff do I like? Why should I tell you? Well, I guess those macaroons we had yesterday were pretty good.
I'm not following you! We just happened to be going in the same direction! Where am I going...? Why... why should I tell you?!
Is there anything you'd like to tell me, Commander? Eh... nothing? I-i-idiot!
Since you're being so sincere, I'll... accept... reluctantly! But that doesn't... it doesn't mean that I've agreed to anything yet... Ah, alright, don't leave. Yes, I agree!
Like this would be enough to make me happy! ...(whispers) I guess it makes me a little happy...
Type 1936C destroyer - Z46.

Iron Blood Z-class destroyer, 1936-C Type. Four other sister ships were planned for construction, but only Z47 and I were built. I wasn’t even completed by the end of the war, and was scrapped without ever being finished. One day, I hope to be called not as Z46, but by a true name.
Are you the one who summoned me? I am... unfortunately, still without a name. You may call me Z46 for now though.
This world is so different that from what I was expecting. How interesting!
Z46 is but a codename, not my actual name. For a ship, something like a name should be unimportant, but...
I have experienced neither failure nor suffering. Consequently, I have accomplished nothing.
A name is not merely a label. It is also proof that one exists in this world.
The things I have yet to experience and understand are as numerous as the countless stars in the night sky.
Being able to be touched is proof of one’s existence.
If your desire is righteous, then why do your hands tremble?
Unknown beings and new acquaintances... let us sally forth to meet them!
Freedom and fortune only favor the hardworking.
Receiving mail is proof of the expectations and trust that people have in you.
Is the battle over, or has it just begun?
Waiting at the harbor for dispatched ships to return... is something I’ve ever experienced before.
Though this is but a trivial thing, I'll return the favor for your consideration.
For not fleeing upon seeing my visage, I applaud both your courage and your stupidity.
Am I too strong? Or are you all too weak?
Go and boast to the world. Be proud that you have bested me even once.
The unworthy are fated to drown in this world.
What doesn't kill you only makes you stronger.
Perhaps what I seek... cannot be found here.
The journey to find a name has lead me to this place.
Friendship, enmity, love, hate... these are things that I have never experienced prior to coming here.

The sea breeze caressing my cheeks, the crashing of waves resounding in my ear. The laughter echoing on the beach, the footprints left in the sand. The rays of summer shimmering overhead, the fluttering sails of ships about to return... What an unforgettable scenery.
To be needed, yearned for, trusted, and loved... "I" am a cloth dyed by your color. My beloved, please bestow a name upon me.
My beloved, I have long awaited this day. What name have you decided to bestow upon me?
With utmost sincerity, I accept your kind wishes.
After this battle ends, please teach me to make today's lunch.
Ill suited as I am for an idol's name... Please do not try to call me something cutesy.
Do remember, trying too hard can sometimes backfire.
The bustling beach, clamoring with waves of joyfulness... experiencing this kind of summer is a first for me, but I don't dislike it...
The bustling beach, clamoring with waves of joyfulness... experiencing this kind of summer is a first for me, but I don't dislike it...
The midsummer seaside is full of the unknown... Let's go explore it together!
The tide ebbs and flows, leaving behind an unforgettable summer experience.
The hot summer and the refreshing ice... what a wonderful contradiction.
Trust your instincts and your courage. They will guide you forward.
No matter how many times, I will always believe in your words. I can always trust that you will guide me down the right path.
I truly do exist, and am needed by everyone...
Why... is there hesitation in your eyes?
Have you prepared yourself? Then let us proceed to our next battlefield. This battle shall thusly be dubbed: "Soaking in the Shallows!"
Through the sweat and tears, striving for your goals. Rejoice in victory, sink within defeat... How fascinating, this "sports meet" may be.
Through the sweat and tears, striving for your goals. Rejoice in victory, sink within defeat... How fascinating, this "sports meet" may be.
I wish to run as fast as a leopard, and fly to great heights like a soaring bird.
To compete with others and prove your worth, through different means than fighting battles... To be crowned "champion," 'tis a great feeling.
Even in this little academy, there are so many things to do and see...
Whether your sweat is falling on the track, or your words are encouraging others, all of this is an unforgettable experience.
Just a small piece of paper... can create such a profound tie between people... this "scavenger hunt" is more interesting than I thought.
Where are your fingers... Is there really anything worth exploring right there?
Steel yourselves for this upcoming battle! Intense fights await, at our next sports meet!
Whatever color you may wish to bestow upon my existence - be it black, red, or blue, I shall accept it all. My beloved, please bestow upon me my name, the identity you choose to bless me with.
Dancing beams of light, shimmering on-stage; uplifted voices, joined as one by song... Upon this unknown stage, my heart doth flutter... Yet this sensation, is quite refreshing.
Dancing beams of light, shimmering on-stage; uplifted voices, joined as one by song... Upon this unknown stage, my heart doth flutter... Yet this sensation, is quite refreshing.
As long as your eyes are fixed upon me; Upon this stage I shall sing bravely.
Countless days and nights of hard work congeal into a single flash of brilliance onstage. Like a shooting star, leaving only a fleeting trail of light—
The star-lit stage is another world of its own, an ajar door to the unknown that now beckons me...
My dear friend, there is no reason to worry about me. All of this was made possible by Z23, Z35, Graf Spee, Admiral Hipper... We are all connected by the bonds of the Iron Blood.
Take heed of where the other performers and your audience are looking? ...I see. I understand why such a thing is important, but can you explain to me why it is called the "Evil Eye?"
My singing voice... is proof of my existence.
The stage is yet another battlefield, where wars are fought not with steel and fire, but with our charm and earnest desire.
A commission fleet has returned to port. I wish for them to see me as I am now, as a beloved idol.
In front of tens and thousands of adoring fans... I must do my very best.
Let us sing this song of celebration; For our friends' displays of dedication.
Have my lessons been so insufficient; or are my emotions simply deficient?
Anxiety and nervousness gather along with the light upon this stage, and the colors of my heart cannot be concealed... O you who I love, are these feelings reaching you?

"Jianzhi," the art of breathing life into works of cut paper... is a world beyond my imagination. If these decorations are said to usher in blessings... are they akin to a coat-of-arms or a holy seal?

"Jianzhi," the art of breathing life into works of cut paper... is a world beyond my imagination. If these decorations are said to usher in blessings... are they akin to a coat-of-arms or a holy seal?
I eagerly await the completion of this next piece... It's as if my soul resonates with this craft.
The festival to herald the arrival of spring is sanguine, filled with joy, fanfare, and deliciousness. None may resist its delights.
Sister of my friend, please wait a bit longer. The preparation process is difficult to control.
After this piece is complete, will you mount it? The more delicate the art, the more strict the protection must be...
Allow me to complete this seal, and it may be of great use to you.
Are you trying to stick something onto me?
I have no desire to be a burden upon my peers... Before devoting myself to this craft, I shall continue to observe.
Cast your eyes upon this bit of dust. As I was entrusted with the cleaning, I shall not allow this dust to remain. Will you also join me in this battle?
Cast your eyes upon this bit of dust. As I was entrusted with the cleaning, I shall not allow this dust to remain. Will you also join me in this battle?
Upon my pride, this dust shall know no succor. Hm? Did I say something weird just now?
Even Lord Bismarck's statue cannot be cleaned satisfactorily... Too ashamed am I to face my Iron Blood friends, but this war against dust, I shall not suspend.
How does one eradicate something as infinitesimal yet as innumerable as dust? ...It's impossible? That, I cannot accept. To do so would invalidate my very existence.
The process of making things beautiful and pure through cleaning is wonderful indeed. Call upon me if there is some place you want cleaned.

"If dust is allowed to remain, it will eventually become a mountain." Does this not mean that all the dust I sweep will also become a mountain? I cannot allow that, and that is why I must eradicate it all.
The manjuus are doing their best to help out. I would appreciate it if you could do the same.
Oh, thank you. I was just thinking I needed a lift to reach that high spot.
Hrmm... The more I clean, the more the dust grows. Will this battle never cease because dust yet remains on my tool's fleece?
Hm? You are following us because you're drawn to the sound of my flute? Ah... Then in exchange for accompanying you on this journey, tell me your story.
Shimakaze-class destroyer - Shimakaze.

I'm Shimakaze, the sole Shimakaze-class destroyer! I boast the highest speed and best torpedo capabilities of all fleet destroyers - a pivotal part of any torpedo squadron! No type of operation is beyond my capabilities! Ha-hah!
I am Shimakaze, the world's one and only Shimakaze-class destroyer! You must be the commander! Let us join forces and work towards our goals, together!
Commander, you're not the type to dilly-dally around, are you? That makes two of us! We'd better begin our work for the day!
Houshou's carrot cake is just divine! I hope to taste it again sometime.
My rigging calibration checks out. I'm fully prepared to sortie at your command!
My shoes? They're quite special. In fact, these shoes are what allow me to go faster than everyone else! Ha-hah!
The Sakura Empire is home to many sword-wielding shipgirls... If I ever get the chance, I'd love to borrow and swing someone else's sword for myself.
Any two people can come to an understanding as long they're both willing to listen! That's what I've always believed!
Mweeehhh... Please, d-don't touch my ears! It makes me shooo weak... Aaaahh...
Huh? Have I done something incorrectly?
Eek! What has gotten into you?! If I didn't know any better, I'd think... Well, just this once, I'll turn a blind eye to it.
Aha! I spy with my little eye incomplete missions! Full speed ahead for those rewards! Right, Commander?
Mission completed! Quick, let's check what rewards we've earned!
Apropos of nothing, I think you should check your latest mail.
W-welcome back, Commander! ...No, it's nothing, really! I was just wondering when you'd return...
Hmm... Commission teams don't run into ambushes out at sea, do they...?
I can become even faster... even stronger!
Shall I assume command? Understood! I won't disappoint you!
All right! Another first-place finish!
I-I'll reflect upon my errors...
Maybe I should turn this into one of my secret moves!
Don't die on me now, engines... Please hang in there!
If you manage to right all your wrongs, then maybe you'll earn my forgiveness!
I am THE strongest destroyer! Or, so I'd like to think. But to truly become the strongest, I'll have to hone myself through my training and sorties!
People often say I'm too hasty, but isn't swift decision-making supposed to be a good thing? Plus, if you don't fight with all you've got, it could come back to haunt you! Hehehe!

Commander, what things motivate you to keep fighting? I'm just asking out of curiosity. Whatever they are, I will fight for them alongside you! ...Yes, I know, I swear not to get ahead of myself this time!

Could we go somewhere together after finishing our work today? B-because, well, we hardly get any time for ourselves during office hours... Okay, look! I'm saying I want some alone time with you, Commander! Would you... oblige?

What is THIS?! Wasn't this meant to be an emergency mission briefing?! Wait, what's this ring...? I fell for it, hook, line, and sinker! But why trick me into coming? I would've agreed to it if you'd just told the truth!
This is exactly what I wanted! You're such a nice person, Commander!
You can go faster than me?Really?!
Let's rush them down!
Is Planet Bunny a real place?! I must know!
I'll scout ahead, Suruga!
I'm... a starter ship, too? That's weird, because I don't really feel like one...
Takao! Do you think better of me now?
L-Lady Nagato?! I-i-it's an honor fighting alongside you!

ex.line: Good morning, my sweetheart! Hehehe♡ Time for your morning kiss, just... Oh, sorry, we're at work! As you were, Commander!
To protect what's dear, what matters isn't the weapon in your hands, but the will in your heart. Wouldn't you say that's true?
My rigging is in tip-top condition! I feel like I could take on the world today!
I'm not THE fastest - I just happen to be the fastest ship! After all, one should not ever outrun humility.
Long-range torpedo strikes are my specialty, but... I don't suppose there is any way this fleet can leverage that.
Mweeehhh...
How can I be of assistance, Commander?
At least you didn't touch my ears. The outcome wouldn't have been worksafe... Ugh...
Mission completed! I went ahead and brought you the rewards!
W-welcome back, Commander! I was wondering when you'd return.
I've confirmed the commission team's safe return to port! A peaceful journey is always best!
In the event we lose, please don't take it out on me!
The Shimakaze Fleet can make even the impossible happen!

Sweetheart? I'd love to have dinner with you after work, then go shopping together. I wish we'd have more time for ourselves, even if I'd always want more of it. Hehehe~ Got to make the most of what we can get, though, right?

lines.line: Hippity hoppity! Grab a glass and have a sippity! Whew, I must say, this outfit was tricky to get into. Still, you made an exquisite pick, Commander!
Hippity hoppity! Grab a glass and have a sippity! Whew, I must say, this outfit was tricky to get into. Still, you made an exquisite pick, Commander!
I'm positively brimming with energy! Tonight, let us "party hard," Commander!
Commander! Why not play a round of Shipgirl Bounty Hunter? There are many nice prizes you can win!
Abukuma invited me to go fishing with her! So, I'm going out to meet- Y-you think it's best if I change clothes first?
Suruga! You should try a bunny girl costume too! ...Y-you wouldn't be caught dead in one? Isn't that a little extreme, even for an aversion?!
These frills fit around my ears perfectly! Which is good, because I'd become lethargic if they were too tight...
Would you like a refill, Commander?
There being no danger of skirt-flipping doesn't make this tolerable behavior!
Outstanding work! I will provide tonight's entertainment act! As soon as I come up with something entertaining... Hmm...
I'm truly in my element in this outfit!
I'm the fastest, strongest destroyer... And that's a fact!
Whoa-whoa-whoa! Why'd I end up here again?! Even though I've been running for a whole hour! ...Commander?! Waaaah, I'm so glad to see you! Please, help me get out of heeeeeeere!
Whoa-whoa-whoa! Why'd I end up here again?! Even though I've been running for a whole hour! ...Commander?! Waaaah, I'm so glad to see you! Please, help me get out of heeeeeeere!
After much thinking, I've realized that I'm not Alice, but rather the White Rabbit! So isn't it weird that I'm lost in here?
The sheer scale of this set is staggering! I've run around all over the place and still found no sign of the exit... What?! I've been going in circles all this time?!
Whoa! There's cake over there! Heehee... No, Commander! Finding the exit comes first, like I told you before!
If Suruga was here, how would she... Wait, COULD Suruga even find a way out of this place? Because I am completely out of ideas!
There's the exit! Watch, I'm going to make a mad dash for- Owie! Th-this is just a dang mirror!
Mhm! Allow me to show you the right path to your destination!
At least it's not my... No, ears or not, it's embarrassing when you touch me like that!
Laffey could find a way out if she were here... Whoa! Word of a new mission just came in!
Ah, Commander! Heehee~ I stumbled across this delicious tea just earlier! Join me on a break and we'll drink it together!
The commission team has come back! But as it stands now, we can't meet them!
Hippity hoppity! That's what happens when you underestimate me!
