Wow, these rewards are "fenomennel"! ... Huh?! I'm not getting any?!
Heeheehee~ Your mail is gonna be gone one day if you don't empty your mailbox!
Hi, Commander! Where's my strawberry ice cream? Wha-? But didn't I tell you to get some?!
Commissions look fun! I wanna do one too!
I'm feeling super excited!
St-stay back! My Peepsy's made to keep you meanies in check!
W-we won...? Myahahah! You see that? Nagatsuki is all-powerful!
Waahhh...! Peepsy's nothing more than an alarm...!
Show them what you're made of, Peepsy!
Oh nooo! I hope they didn't bruise me!
*Yawn*... I'm bored... Commandeeer! I'm gonna set off Peepsy if you don't do something fun with me!
Heeheehee~ You're not a dangerous stranger, so don't worry about Peepsy, Commander! ... You AREN'T dangerous, right...?
The story of the boy who cried wolf...? Teehee, maybe I should set off Peepsy's alarm to show you that I'm not just all bark and no bite~!
Waaahhh! I'm sorryyy... But you won't get angry at me since you're a nice and caring commander, right...?
I shouldn't play around with my Peepsy? Hmm... I'll think about it, if you play with me instead! Teehee~
Is this shiny ring... for me? ... You'll take over Peepsy's role and protect me? Wow, that makes me feel super duper happy! Can I set off Peepsy to celebrate this?
Woah! Commander really isn't a bad person after all!
Nagatsuki and her nice friends, let's go!
Nagatsuki the kitty maid is at your service~ Do your best to not fall madly in love with my cute looks~! Hehe~
Nagatsuki the kitty maid is at your service~ Do your best to not fall madly in love with my cute looks~! Hehe~
Welcome back, Master♪ Oh, you wanna hear that again? Sure, but first I want strawberry ice cream!
Sure I'm wearing a maid costume, but I can't do any maid work with these kitty paw gloves on! Sooorry♪
I still have Peepsy with me~! I've just hidden it somewhere!
What do maids even do...? Oh, I know! Commander, I'm thirsty! I want some tea! Hehehe!
My kitty paws are really nice and soft. Don't you wanna feel them? Here you go! Kitty paws to the face!
You really like maids, huh~ But just so you know, Peepsy's gonna go off if you keep poking me!
I totally forgot I can't set off Peepsy with these kitty paw gloves oooon!
Grr, that Royal Navy maid Belfast is always working... I'm gonna quit being a maid. Hehehe!
Mutsuki-class destroyer number ten - Mikazuki.
I'm Mikazuki. I've got a lot of little and big sisters. We're all friends. I'm really good at escort and transport missions! Oh, and I love taiyaki! Do you want some too, Commander?
Aahh... Hm? Hmm? Co... main... der? I'm Mikazuki. Want some taiyaki? You can have half of mine.
Commander? Wel~co~me back~! *Nom*... Delicious!
Commander, I still have lots of taiyaki, so I'm fine.
I'm full... and sleepy... Commander, gimme a hug~
I like taiyaki filled with bean paste even in their tail fins.
Taiyaki looks like a fish... Fish live in the sea! Hm... the sea is on Earth! Earth is in space! Mm... so tasty!
Commander, want some? I don't mind sharing.
Oh, I dropped my taiyaki...
Commander, new missions!
Commander, does the reward include any taiyaki?
Commander, what's this package for? Can I pack up my taiyaki?
Ah... Commander, want some too? I've got more.
Commander, I'm heading out to welcome back the commission team! They promised they'd buy me some taiyaki!
I ate... too much taiyaki... I'm stuffed...
That's the enemy... can we eat them?
Isn't it about time for a snack?
I'm hungry...
You're not getting any of my taiyaki!
Ahh~ *Nom* (Mikazuki doesn't seem to notice you.)
Commander, want to eat some taiyaki with me?
Clothes are so annoying... I hate getting dressed... I just want to eat taiyaki...
Always telling me to wear my clothes... you're just like my mom... But I still like you, Commander. Almost as much as I like taiyaki... Okay, Commander, help me get dressed.
"Only really close people should help each other get dressed"? Are we not close, Commander? I love you, Commander. Do you not like me?

A promise...? Does that mean you'll help me get dressed? I don't really get it... I should really do it on my own...? Commander, you're weird... I'm fine with you helping me get dressed, I told you before...
That looks really tasty!
Mikazuki is supposed to be... a jiangshi? Um... hip... hop... Commander, trick or treaaaaat~
Mikazuki is supposed to be... a zombie? Um... hip... hop... Commander, trick or treaaaaat~
Commander? If you don't give me taiyaki, I'll summon Minazuki~
Getting changed is a pain, but since everyone wanted to see me in a costume, I did it... Hip, hop.
Bouncing around is exhausting. Commander, your lap please.
Halloween is all about witches, pumpkins, and... delicious taiyaki! Ommfh!
If the seal on my head gets removed, I'll turn into a real zombie... That's what Minazuki said, anyway.
Commander, are you scared of zombies?
My outfit is all messed up now... even though it took so long to put on...
I got so much candy... Mutsuki seems to really like them, so I'll give it all to her later.
Shiratsuyu-class destroyer number seven - Umikaze.
"Revised Shiratsuyu-class"... Yes, my sisters and I were called that. During that war, the four of us formed the 24th DesDiv... My memories from back then weren't all rainbows and sunshine though...
I am the revised Shiratsuyu-class destroyer, Umikaze. Commander, I hope I will be able to support you and your fleet to the fullest of my abilities... I d-do hope we'll get along!
Good morning, Commander. I hope that I was able to adequately prepare today's schedule. Is there anything else I can help you with...?
Commander... Um, I'm afraid I'm not very good with physical contact...
Commander, shall I open the window? You'll feel a lot fresher if it's nice and breezy, right?
Please don't interrupt Yamakaze and Kawakaze's work... Um, if you want someone to play with, use me instead...
I wonder if any seagulls will show up if we put some crumbs out by the window... Ehehe...
Eek?! P-please stop that...
Um, excuse me...! You're getting... a bit too touchy-feely...
*sniffle* ...Commander...
Commander, um... Might there be anything I can help with?
Mission complete! I'm so glad that I was able to be of help to you, Commander...!
Commander, I left the new mail on your desk.
Commander... Ehehe, to tell the truth, I was really wondering when you would come back...
The commission fleet seems to have brought back a lot of rewards. Shall I help you bring them in?
Thank you for always looking after me...!
Fair winds, good visibility... Mhm!
Ehehe... It was only made possible by everyone else's hard work...
Don't worry about me... More importantly, are the others safe...?
I'll try to be helpful!
I can... hold on a bit longer...!
Commander, I'm so sorry I wasn't able to help you...
I don't mind feeding seagulls, or petting cute little animals... So why can I not handle being touched by the commander... *sigh*...
Commander, um... would you like to go feed the seagulls with me? ...Yay! Here, let me give you some bread... Uh oh, I'm sorry! It fell...
Commander, if it's not too much to ask, could you please take my hand? I'd like to try to get used to being touched, so... please don't let go no matter what! I, I'll endure it all!!
Thanks to your help, I've become a lot better at the touchy-feely stuff... Um, if it's not too much to ask, could you continue to "practice" it with me...?
Um, it's terribly embarrassing still, but... I finally managed to put the ring on...! Um... Commander... please allow me to stay at your side forever...!
Huh? I-is it okay for me to accept something so extravagant...?
I hope I don't cause you any trouble this time...
Thank you for your instruction, Jintsuu!
L-let's all be careful here, okay?

ex.line: Good morning, Commander. I hope that I will be able to be of use to you today!
Um, Commander, I think... I can handle a bit more of the touchy-feely stuff...!
Commander, could you open the window? Ahh... The sea breeze is just right, refreshing but not blowing the documents away...
Yamakaze, if you want to play with Commander, please wait a bit... H-huh? I'm not trying to monopolize Commander...!
Ah, um... it's okay to do more of that head-patting thing...
Ah, um, it's alright! I'm already used to your touch...!
Ermm... Is this also a part of my training"...?
Commander, welcome back. Here are your documents, as well as some light snacks and drinks for you to enjoy... If there is anything else you need, please call for me right away.
Even one such as myself was able to obtain victory!
Commander, I hope you'll allow me to hug you... H-hup! Umm... Somehow, I thin k I'm getting too sleepy to... get any practice out of this... Zzz...

lines.line: What's the matter, Commander? Oh, this outfit? ...Um, I heard that this outfit would bring you therapeutic benefits and hoped to try it on... Wh-what do you think? Does it feel therapeutic to you?
What's the matter, Commander? Oh, this outfit? ...Um, I heard that this outfit would bring you therapeutic benefits and hoped to try it on... Wh-what do you think? Does it feel therapeutic to you?
Commander, today's your day off, so you don't have to work so hard, alright?
Was I able to bring you even the slightest bit of therapeutic benefit, Commander?
Um... The socks are on a bit tight...
Yamakaze gave me some sweets. Would you like some, Commander?
A lot more of these bunnies look just like me, clad in black... Why is that, Commander?
I, I'm not sure I can handle this kind of touching...
P-please don't bully me...
Commander, would you like a shoulder massage? Ah, um, this level of contact is fine! I appreciate the courtesy!
Commander, it is my pleasure to accompany you today. Umm... What do you think? I decided to go for a different outfit this time... D-do you think it's cute?
Commander, it is my pleasure to accompany you today. Umm... What do you think? I decided to go for a different outfit this time... D-do you think it's cute?
Commander, I hear seaside strolls are great for blue-skies days like today. I can show you around, if you'd like!
Wooow... Look at all the seagulls gathering around that bread! They're so cute... Wonder if I could pet them... Ah! I-I'm sorry, I was having a little too much fun...
The sunlight's a little harsh in the afternoons... Commander, w-would you like to come under my parasol with me? I-it may be useful practice for... physical affection, too.
I was so excited and busy planning last night that I didn't get much sleep. When I relax, I get so sleepy... No, Umikaze, you have to try harder... Zzz...
Yamakaze gets a plushie, but what souvenir would Kawakaze like? Commander, do you have any advice?
C'mon, Umikaze! You're brave enough to hold hands by now!
Eep! C-Commander...
Mission complete! Ehehe... The seagulls seem happy, too.
If you're tired from walking, we could take a break at that bench up there. Erm, I took the liberty of bringing some light handmade foods...
The girls out on the commission are back. I'll join you in going to greet them!
Did I manage to help? Thank goodness!
Shiratsuyu-class destroyer number eight - Yamakaze.
I was the flagship of DesDiv 24 during the war! Impressive, right? Oh, and don't get me confused for Arashi!
Roooaar! Shiratsuyu-class destroyer Yamakaze is here! ...So, um, I'm looking for this "Commander" person. Any idea where they might be? ...Oh! That's you, huh?
Woooo! I'm pumped and ready to do some work!
Hehe~ You wanna play with me, Commander?
If you don't play with me right now, I'm gonna roar at you! Fine... Rooooar!
Hey, Kawakaze! Have some fun for once and come play with me and Umikaze!
Being lazy is super lame, Commander! Come on, you've gotta work!
Rooooar!
Do you wanna play knock-out boxing?
Argh! I'll turn you into red paste!
New missions have come in! Let me at 'em!
Mission complete! Do I get a share of the loot?
I've got your mail right here, Commander!
You're back? Here, the seat's all yours!
Commander! Our commission buddies brought back heaps of good stuff!
Woohoo!
Woo! Follow my lead!
We won! Hip, hip! Hooray!
Bwaahh! Get me outta here!
Onwards! Go! Go!
Owwieee...
Grrrrr! (Yamakaze is wary of you.)
When those mean Meowfficers gang up on me, I scare them off with a roar!
Commander, Commander! I wanna play with you! We could call over Umikaze and Kawakaze, too!
Could we please go to the zoo, Commander? I wanna listen to the cries seagulls, and bears, and dolphins!
You're always so nice to me, so I'm gonna be nice back! If any baddies show up, I'll send them scurrying back to mama! ...Huh? You'll protect ME instead? But... why?
Woohooooo! I feel I could explode with how happy I am! Not literally, obviously~ Commander, I love you so much!
Eheheh! Love you lots, Commander!
I'm rooting for you~!
Fighting now, questions later, Lady Mutsu!

ex.line: My motivation tanks are at max! Gimme a "let's go," Commander!
Heehee~ I love playing games with you, Commander~
I'll promise to stop scaring you, but in exchange I wanna play with you more often!
Umikaze! I've got a bag full of breadcrumbs! Wanna go feed some seagulls?
What are we gonna do this time? More knock-out boxing? Sumo wrestling?
I caught youuuu~♪
Welcome back, Commander! Wanna sit? Heehee... You'll have to play with me first if you wanna take this spot!
Commander! Our commission buddies brought back more goodies! I'll go give 'em a hand!
Commander! I'm here to play another game! Hehehe~ Whatever we do together, it's always so much fun! Oh, here, Umikaze shared some snacks with me! You can have aaaall of them!

lines.line: Voilà! Don't go anywhere, Commander! My magic show will start in just a sec! To start with, let's hear a roar! Roooaar!
Voilà! Don't go anywhere, Commander! My magic show will start in just a sec! To start with, let's hear a roar! Roooaar!
I'm prepped and ready for my big trick! Woo!
I'm gonna surprise everyone with a jaw-dropping trick at the banquet venue! But first I need to come up with a total jaw-dropper... Hmm...
White doves should be part of any good magician's act!
Watch closely! I'm now going to make this flower dis- What the?! Why'd it turn into a handkerchief?!
Heehee! This trick's definitely going to stun Umikaze and Kawakaze... Stop it, Commander! No peeking!
Come over here, Commander! I'm gonna show you my coin trick~
Woah! Stop trying to figure out my tricks!
Presto! I've magically retrieved your mail!
Commander! Can I borrow your seat for a sec again? Just one second, I promise!
Shiratsuyu-class destroyer number nine - Kawakaze.

I'm Kawakaze, 3rd ship of the improved Shiratsuyu class, or simply the Umikaze class. Destroyer Division 24 comprised of my sisters and me during the war. Ah, Solomon... True, it is a place of many memories. The Iron Bottom Sound, Northampton, and the last thing I remember...
The name's Kawakaze of the Shiratsuyu class. I have no intention of becoming your friend. Spare me your introduction.
Just another uneventful day.
I like fishing. When fishing, you can just clear your mind and not think about anything.
Shells are weapons to silence one's enemies with. That's all they are, no matter how you sugarcoat it.
If there's something you're wondering, ask Jintsuu. I'm... if I must say, I'd say I'm more like Sendai.
Pretty cheerful gang you've got going with this fleet...
How I feel about secretary work? Work is work, I don't have any preferences. Secretary or not, I don't care.
... Now you've really done it...
New mission's appeared. ... What? Do I have to make small talk with you?
Mission rewards are here. Let's see if they were worth the time. But first, accept them.
Mail for you. Me? Not a fan of the stuff...
What happens when the battle ends? The next one begins, that's all.
A commission's done. Don't forget to read the report.
Getting stronger... feels okay.
War... war never changes.
The Solomon Islands... they call for me...
I'm still... afloat. If that's good or bad, who can say...
Relax. I will end this in an instant.
This pain... isn't enough to distract me!
In the end, you're just someone who can't exceed my expectations, Commander.
In war, there is no right or wrong, no beauty or ugliness. This is true for both ally and enemy.
Have you not experienced war, too? Then why do you still believe in fairy tales like justice, love, or harmony...?
I abhor the stupidity and naïveté of those who refuse to face reality and continue shouting about their hopes and dreams. But you're not like that... are you?
"Your dreams will come true if you don't give up on them"... Hmph, what a trite answer. But, if that's what you say...
I'm astonished that I'm doing this with you... We've been together so long that your wishful thinking has rubbed off on me... And for doing so, you'll take responsibility, won't you...?
...Thank you. I don't receive gifts often, so... this is quite a quaint feeling.
And now, we're allies? ... Fine.
Lady Nagato, please be careful.
Let us work with each other's strengths!
Mhm. Lightweight clothing makes it easier to fight. Thanks, Commander... "It looks cute on me"? W-well, thanks...
Mhm. Lightweight clothing makes it easier to fight. Thanks, Commander... "It looks cute on me"? W-well, thanks...
Today might actually be an eventful day.
On the battlefield, you swing your weapon and defeat the enemy, no more. Thinking about other things comes after the battle.
Sendai, how about we have a match? As for our spectators... I suppose we could ask Jintsuu and the Commander.
Seems having some cheerful people by your side might not be so bad.
Do you like kendo, too? I'll work you to the bone to make you good at it. ... Huh? You don't wanna do it?
Phew... I was considering chopping off your hand, had you gone any further.
...Oh, it's you. This is a forbidden area, so even you can't... Okay, and you're coming in anyway. Hmm. Not sure what to do about this...
...Oh, it's you. This is a forbidden area, so even you can't... Okay, and you're coming in anyway. Hmm. Not sure what to do about this...
No matter where I am or the role I am given, my duty remains. I'll always endeavor for your sake.
I may be a ninja and a guard, but I still get bored waiting for visitors all the time... What? You want me to take a nap and let you handle it? Are you being serious right now?
You brought me food? Thank you... Or is this just a bribe?
I have to keep an eye on festival security as part of my duties, too. Wouldn't want you to burden yourself with that job when you're trying to have fun... not to mention the mental effort.
I don't remember trying to seduce you...
New missions. Let's return to our respective duties for now, Commander.
The combat report is right here. I've been checking behind you ever since you got back. Hmm... I guess this outfit is for espionage, now that you mention it.
Commission complete. Ugh, I know I'm just going with you to check on them, but I worry about leaving my post...
Ready for battle! Awaiting orders, Commander!
Trying to make an enemy of me? Naïve!
Is everyone enjoying their ideal version of the world? I guess I am. How it looks depends on the person, but in the end, we all love being in a world with you. Yes, that includes me.
This must be the dream you've awaited so eagerly... Of course, I vowed to be with you to the end of our days. I shall take my rightful place beside you and your wishful thinking. We are... together.
This must be the dream you've awaited so eagerly... Of course, I vowed to be with you until the end of our days. I shall take my rightful place beside you and your ideals. We are... together.
Today is another day devoid of change. But nothing needs to change if I can happily remain by your side.
I want you to pay Lady Nagato a visit from time to time. There's little I can do to ease her loneliness, but I believe that you can. Don't you worry, I know you'll still come to see me as well.
The same sword that takes lives can also save them. It is my goal to become that: a sword that protects.
You must not fixate on only either brains or brawn. The ideal leader is both wise and strong. Ahahah, here I am, paraphrasing Naka.
You've got a cheerful gang going with this fleet. And you are a part of it, Commander.
What is it?
How I feel about secretary work? Work is work, that is all. I will gladly do anything for you.
It's humiliating to watch the other girls get ahead of me...
You have new missions. Shall we have a casual discourse while you review them?
Mission rewards are here. Hopefully, they'll have been worth our efforts.
When the fighting ends, I will always be here waiting for you. Put your mind at rest.
I fight... for the one I love!
The Commander, Lady Nagato, and all my friends depend on me. I cannot afford to lose now.
"Your dreams will come true if you don't give up on them." They will, so let us make them real. I swear it to you upon all my being.
Yuugumo-class destroyer number eight - Kiyonami.

I'm Kiyonami, the eighth Yuugumo-class destroyer... I had improved anti-air capabilities, but neither Yuugure nor I could really deal with things in the air... Ugh... If only I'd done a better job back then... B-but even so, I did achieve a couple of things! Wh-what I'm getting at is that I'll do the best job I can...!
Yuugumo-class destroyer Kiyonami, r-reporting for duty... And this is my friend, Hoppy... I-it's nice to meet you! ... Ugh...
Welcome back, Commander... Come on, Hoppy, say hi to the Commander.
Ugh... C-could you please not stare so much...?
I feel safe around Yuugure. I enjoy playing and having sleepovers with her. I wish I had more friends like her...
Oh no, a-another air raid?! ... Commander, please don't scare me like that!
I'm always doing my best, trying to catch up to everyone... S-so please, don't ever leave me behind, okay...?
Hoppy is cute, isn't he? Ehehe~ He's always there with me when I go to bed.
I-I'm not sure why you're doing this... B-but please stop, it tickles, Commander...!
We still have quite a few missions to complete... Commander, can you do it...?
A mission... Yes, it seems a mission has been completed! You're quite the go-getter, Commander...
Your mail has arrived! Let's take a look at it, Commander!
Well done on the last sortie, Commander... W-would you like to pet Hoppy? I-it's really comforting to stroke his fluffy fur...
The commission team just returned to port. Umm... I think we should go check on them...
Hoppy and I think we got a little stronger...
I-I'm supposed to give orders?! ... Whuah?! C-come on, everyone!
I-I got... first place? Y-you're... not just joking, right...?
Ugh... S-stay away...!
W-we will do this together, Hoppy!
I-I'm not going to give up!
Everyone's been saying the Commander is a mean person... Commander, is that really true...?
Why do I like to hide behind you...? Umm, that's because... I feel more comfortable with you leading the way, Commander...
Ugh... It's so scary at night... Commander, w-when it gets late, could you pretty please lead me to the dorm...?
I have many more fluffy friends than just Hoppy... Commander, would you like to come visit my House of Fluffs sometime later...?
I'm not scared of the dark or planes when I'm with you, Commander... W-would you mind if, from now on, I walked ahead of you, rather than behind you...?

Will we really be able to be together forever from now on...? That's great...! N-now, I learned from Yuugure that... the next thing I should do is close my eyes and wait for you to do something, right? O-okay!
Th-thank you very much, Commander! I, umm... how should I even return the favor... Nngh...
Yuugure, d-do you mind if I stay behind you...?
S-sorry to keep you waiting... Yuugure and I picked out this outfit together. She said it "looked very Christmassy," but it doesn't look weird, right? ... Ugh...
S-sorry to keep you waiting... Yuugure and I picked out this outfit together. She said it "looked very Christmassy," but it doesn't look weird, right? ... Ugh...
M-Merry Christmas, Commander! Phew... I think I said that right!
I'm not sure what wrapping paper to use for my presents... Ummhh... Could you help me pick out a good one, Commander...?
I'm spending Christmas with Yuugure and some friends. D-do you want to be there with us too, Commander...?
I've gotten presents for everyone I know. Th-that includes you, of course, Commander!
All these warm lights at Christmas make me feel at ease... I wish it was Christmas all year round...
Sometimes... Hoppy is on his own, but we always go to bed together at night.
Y-you'll make my hood come undone... Ugh...
Well done on the last sortie. W-would you like a snack? I have gingerbread cookies and Christmas cake...
Akizuki-class destroyer number five - Niizuki.
I'm Niizuki, I'm the fifth ship of the Akizuki-class, I was constructed as part of the Circle Four Plan. But... I might be the least useful ship ever constructed... *Sob*...
I'm Niizuki, the fifth ship of the Akizuki-class. I-I sincerely hope I can be of servish to... *Whimper*... I've made another mistake... Even though I practiced on it so much...
Commander, I've sorted all your documents... You wanted your documents sorted... right?
C-Commander, I haven't, um... disappointed you... have I?
I want to be useful to you, Commander, but if I cause you trouble instead... Then what will I do...
If I cause you any trouble, I'll let you touch my ears and my tail, so please don't get mad at me...
For this one you do this, then here you do... this... I think? I-I hope this will work...
Commander? I'm worrying if I did something wrong today... I-I don't think... I have...
Eek?! C-Commander... you're seriously going to make me cry...
Commander, we have new missions. I'm certain it is a new one. I confirmed it myself...
Commander, I brought the mission rewards. I didn't make another mistake, did I...?
Commander, you have mail... Here... oh, wait, is it this one?
Commander... you're not hurt, are you...?
Commander... a commission's been completed... I didn't get the time wrong... did I?
Commander, whenever I think about failing to meet your expectations... it almost makes me start crying... *Sob*...
A real battle... I'll give it my all...!
I hope I didn't cause any trouble for anyone...
I've failed yet again...
I-I'm not mistaken here, am I?!
I knew I probably wouldn't be of any use to you...
Commander, is there something you wish me to do? I-is it possible I might have caused you trouble without realizing it?
I'm trying my best not to cause trouble for people, but I don't know how... So instead I ended up making a lot of mistakes...

Ever since I came to your base, I've started making considerably fewer mistakes... But even when I do, you don't get mad at me, so I've slowly but surely been able to get better... Also, when you encourage me by stroking my ears, your hand feels so warm...
I'm timid and I often make mistakes, so I doubt I'll ever be very helpful to you, Commander... But I'm okay with that. Because what matters is...

Even if they're a coward, even if they often make mistakes, what matters is telling your partner that you love them from the bottom of your heart, right...? This is the one thing I've believed ever since I was born... Okay, from now on I swear I'll always be with you, Commander...
Akizuki-class destroyer number nine - Harutsuki.
I am the ninth ship of the Akizuki-class destroyers, Harutsuki. Due to various circumstances, I wasn't able to do much, but... I'll make up for it this time, Commander!
I was guided here by the gods... Ah! M-My name is Harutsuki! Pleased to meet you!
Commander, w-welcome back!
Hyaa! C-Commander, when did you get here?
O gods, please bless this port so that everyone may come home safely.
Yoizuki may seem cold, but she's very nice and is always thinking of everyone else!
Good luck! I'll... be supporting you!
Commander? Would you like to try the sakura mochi that I made?
C-Commander! P-Please stop doing that... *sniffles*
C-Commander, umm... there are still missions left...
Commander, I've received the rewards!
Commander, h-here... your letters...
Commander, you're safe! Thank goodness... my prayers were heard...
Commander! E-Everyone has come home safely!
C-Can I truly become stronger like this?
My s-skirt is gonna get blown away!
Surely this must have been the gods' blessings.
O gods, please save us!
O gods, please watch over us!
O gods, please give me guidance...!
Commander, I wonder if you've been cursed...

Stupid Louis... She just went "I'd rather not be kicked by a horse" and walked off... Let's just forget about her... Commander, do you want... some fried squid?
Y-you saw how flustered I was just now, didn't you... I don't hate you or anything like that, you know...
Goldfish scooping is pretty hard... Could you lend me a hand, Commander? I want one to give to Helena...!
Seems there'll be a fireworks display by the harbor... Commander, how about we go there on our walk?
Don't make excuses... I know you did that on purpose...!
Do you want this...? Here, take it...
Let's get this over with quick, I wanna go back to the festival...!
Can we go back now, Commander?
After all that trouble putting this on... This sucks...
*Sigh*, why can't I ever keep my composure in front of you... "What am I murmuring about"...? N-nothing! I didn't say a word...! Dummy...!
Louis... if you make me look dumb again then I really will get mad...
Rest easy, Helena! I'll assist you!
Brooklyn-class Light Cruiser - St. Louis, Hull Number CL-49!

I'm St. Louis, Helena's big sister. I got my nickname, Lucky Lou, from getting through the attack on Pearl Harbor unscathed. After that, however, my missions didn't go all that well. I guess luck really does come and go after all...
Hello, I'm St. Louis, but I'm called Lucky Lou. Hey, Commander, don't you think it's your lucky day, finding me like this?
Luck never stays with one person for too long, Commander. We should make the best use of it while we still have it.
Unlike those Sakura Empire ships, I don't bring any misfortune to my allies. Probably… I hope…
What are you looking at, Commander?
Helena, your SG radar can't detect underwater threats.
Arizona, even if you'll never forget what happened that day, you shouldn't let it wear you down so much.
You get good luck if you touch me? I've never heard of that before.
This isn't something you should do outside, Co-man-der~
Hey, Commander, you should prepare yourself for a real surprise.
Hehe... You're so spoiled, Commander... Okay, before you go and collect those rewards, you can stay here for a while and rest if you want.
New mail? It must be good news!
Always remember: "the feud chair is unpredictable"… Hmm, I heard that from someone, but who…?
Hmm... Okay, I'll go greet the returning commission team with these clothes.
Luck comes and goes. You can't depend on in it forever.
Did you hear that? That was the sound of the Winds of Fortune!
Hehe~ That wasn't all thanks to luck.
Today is not my lucky day…
Lucky Lou!
Hehe... my luck is second to none!
At least spare Helena...
Things might have gone differently at Kolombangara, had Helena been there...
Want me to help you clean your office, Commander? ... You don't!?
Hehe~ I know about all the secret things you have hidden in your room, Commander~!
Whew… Cleaning is always such a pain… Hey, why don't we go on a date somewhere, Commander?
Oh dear, why are you giving me a present all of a sudden... Ah, I see, it's one of these... Okay, could I ask you to put it on my finger for me, Commander?
Thanks~ In exchange, I'll share some of my luck with you.
Helena, don't focus purely on victory or defeat this time!
I suppose you could call us the Lucky Unit!
What do you think of this foreign dress, Commander? *Giggle* ...Perhaps it's rekindled something within you?
What do you think of this foreign dress, Commander? *Giggle* ...Perhaps it's rekindled something within you?
How I wish I could bring this chair with me on sorties... Helena, could you help upgrade my rigging?
I am Lucky Lou. I may not look like it, but I actually have experience with fortune-telling.
Brr... It's actually a bit cold... Commander, could you come a little closer and... share your body heat with me?
Oh, do you mean I've put it on wrong? Have I really...?
The Sakura Empire's clothes are just so refined. Ahaha... Aren't you cold standing out there, Commander? Sit down with me and have a drink.
The Sakura Empire's clothes are just so refined. Ahaha... Aren't you cold standing out there, Commander? Sit down with me and have a drink.
You should drink a little something to warm yourself up before getting to work.
A "hatsumode," huh... Do you have any wishes to make, Commander? It so happens I don't, so you can have my wish.
Not to say the Eagle Union's new year celebrations are lonesome, but the Sakura Empire's and Dragon Empery definitely celebrate New Year's with more festivity. And I like festivities.
Oh, Commander, if you're hoping to get me drunk... well, it depends on how much you yourself can drink. Ahahah~
Are we heading out? Ahah, then let me get out my umbrella. Hey, come closer, otherwise you'll get snow on your clothes.
Welcome back. I've put on the heater for you. Oh, me? I'd like to stay here and enjoy the snow a little longer.
Hmm... seems it'll keep snowing for a while. Why don't you stay for the night, Commander? ...Oh? I was thinking we could share some drinks, but perhaps you had something else in mind? Ahahah♡
Oh my, what a good little commander you've been, waiting here all this time for me. Hop in~ Did you think you would be driving? Hehe, you shouldn't underestimate me~
Oh my, what a good little commander you've been, waiting here all this time for me. Hop in~ Did you think you would be driving? Hehe, you shouldn't underestimate me~
The view here is lovely~ Let's pull over for a moment to take in the winds of good luck.
Hehehe, you thought I'd drive in these high heels? It's certainly not impossible, but I'd rather use the other pair of shoes I have inside.
Oh dear, was that... Jamaica? Hehehe... Fasten your seatbelt, Commander. This'll be a bit of a wild ride.
You want to use my car? You can, of course, but promise me one thing in return: take Honolulu on a nice trip.
Whew... Finally we've arrived at the party. Now, Commander, wait here for thirty minutes while I reapply my makeup. Relax, I'm just joking! Hehehe~
Let's see here... Ah, thanks, Commander. Hehehe, you're getting quite good at this.
You have an urgent mission? I'll wait another five minutes for you, then.
Oh, you went and claimed those mission rewards? You could've taken your time if you wanted. Hehehe~
Helena messaged me, saying the party's starting soon. Check your mail, then let's hurry on back to the venue.
Do you have everything, Commander? We're not driving back if you forgot to bring something.
As much as I like parties, I like being alone with you even more, Commander... Maybe we could sneak out and go for a drive together? But probably not~ Hehehe~
Commander, I've been waiting for you. Lazing about and enjoying the sights here does sound nice, but... Heheh, it just isn't the same without you by my side♪
Commander, I've been waiting for you. Lazing about and enjoying the sights here does sound nice, but... Heheh, it just isn't the same without you by my side♪
Welcome back. Heheh, I think my sunscreen is starting to wear off. Commander, it's time for you to make up for making me wait♪
I've been waiting for you so long that I'm all hot and flushed now. Hm? A cold drink is nowhere near enough. Heheheh... You'll have to think of other methods.
...Mmh, this swimsuit's a little tight. Geez... Commander, can't you help me out a little? Yeah, that's the spot.
Wanna lie down on my floatie with me, Commander? We can probably fit together. Or do you wanna snuggle in closer?♪
Going on this cruise with you was a great idea. Watching the sea together is refreshing.
Do you think traveling with Lucky Lou herself might bring you good luck? Heheh, I know eeeven better ways for you to... get lucky♥
Heehee. Is that enough to satisfy you, Commander?
You'll put my sunscreen on for me? Okay. Then I'm all yours, Commander. Heehee.
Geez, you're impatient, Commander... You can't bear to wait anymore, can you?♥
I wanted you all to myself for a little longer, but it looks like you still have missions left.
Mission complete! As a reward, I'll put your sunscreen on for you. Mind if I touch you, Commander?♪
You've got mail. Wanna check it after we relax a little longer?
Welcome back, Commander. Want a drink? Unfortunately, I only have one straw...
You want to go greet the commission team? Oh, fine... I'll help you change clothes♥
Shall we go on a Lucky Cruise Trip~?
Now I can go back to enjoying my voyage with the Commander.
Your fingers heat up my skin even more than the sun itself. I wish I could stay in your arms and listen to the waves with you forever... Heehee.
J-class destroyer - Jupiter, Hull Number F85.
I am the J class destroyer with improved torpedo equipment, Jupiter... "Juno"? We're just sisters. I-60? I think I sank her, but...
I am the Royal Navy J-class destroyer, Jupiter... "Jue-know"? Erm, which one are you referring to?
Ju-Juno, you don't need to be concerned about me... I've been in this longer than you...
I sank I-60? That's not...
My name is "Jupiter"... not "Cupider"...
It's fun to be with you, Commander...
I hope I'll... get to come home some day...
Commander... my hands... are they warm...?
Huh...?! It wasn't Juno, but you, Commander?!
Do we really have to do this...
Don't worry, Juno. The mission has been completed.
Commander, here's your mail...
Commander, is there anything you need me to... Got... I'll just sit down...
Our resources have increased...
I feel like something's changed...
This is God's judgement... Hehehe...
I wasn't expecting this...
A-are we retreating...?
P-please don't dodge this...
Commander... do you hate me?
I'll be fine on my own...
J-Juno... the Commander's fine being alone with me, so you don't have to be here...
Commander, about that toast I made for you... hehehe... did you like it?
Commander, do you think I'm cute? ... Hehehe... Then, as a reward for you...
D-does this mean we'll always be together? Th-then... Commander, close your eyes and I'll give you a present...
Hehehe... A great present!
P-please, cheer up!
Sh-shouldn't it be my turn to care for you...?
Good evening, Commander. There's a new show on the telly. You want to watch with me?
Good evening, Commander. There's a new show on the telly. You want to watch with me?
That new show is about to start. Hehe. I've been looking forward to it. Are you interested, Commander?
Huh? Where's my slipper...? Oh, it's behind me? Thanks, Commander...
My torpedo pillow...? Hugging it... makes me feel very safe...
I do wish Juno was here. But having you with me, Commander, that makes me very happy too. Hehe~
I heard a rumor that a certain Ghost of the Eagle Union and a Demon from the Sakura Empire are interested in this show too.
Commander, can you please not tell my sisters... how I spend all night watching TV?
Eek! You, you scared me...
You're just in time. The show hasn't started yet...
J-class destroyer - Jersey (F72.)

I'm Jersey, of the J class. While I have neither noble blood nor a particularly outstanding combat record, my personality is what it is, so spare me your complaints. What happened in Malta was just a slipup. But, admittedly, mistakes are mistakes. That much I know.
Are you the Commander? My name is Jersey, and don't you forget it.
Do you know how long you've kept me waiting, Commander? What's the meaning of this?
Do you need anything? Or are you just here to chat?
I hate it when others underestimate me because of my size!
No one knows what's on a person's mind if they don't say it aloud. I do not like people who are roundabout.
I wish you would compliment me for being honest, rather than for being "cute." Not that I mind compliments like that.
What, you want to nuzzle against my lap? You can keep your fantasies in your dreams where they belong.
C-Commander?! I-I-I appreciate your straightforwardness, but now isn't the time...
Stop pretending like you haven't seen the new missions and get them done already.
Commander, our rewards have arrived. Well done, I say.
Your mail, Commander. Don't forget to read it.
Don't overexert yourself after returning from the battlefield. Relax.
Commander, a commission is done. You haven't forgotten about it, have you?
I will not let your efforts go to waste.
We must face our enemies seriously, no matter who they are.
This is the might of the J class! Regret your own carelessness!
Ugh... You will pay dearly for staining my dress! Know this!
Now's not the time to be taking it easy!
You are a halfhearted and lousy individual.
Commander, while we're not that familiar with each other, I wouldn't take issue with having tea and chatting with you.
There is one thing I want to set straight with you; I'm not foul-mouthed, I simply say what's on my mind. For instance... do you have a thing for little children?
But that's all right. You may fancy me if you like, but if you don't, then it's... not *not* a problem...
Commander, I'm a straightforward person, and I'd like my partner to be as well. So be open-hearted and simply say what's on your mind. In return, I will be sincere with you as well.

Now that I think about it, we've been so straightforward that we've not even done anything romantic... But now at least we know each other better than anyone else. I say we let romance into our lives starting today.
I have been wanting one of these. I'm very grateful.
Everyone, try to keep up!
Sendai-class light cruiser number one - Sendai.

I'm Sendai, the first ship of the Sendai-class. Although my service record isn't as impressive as my little sisters', I served as the flagship of Destroyer Squadron 3 and fought in tons of battles. I bit the dust at Bougainville, but I did so as a warrior with no regrets.
You're a commander? I don't need one... But maybe we were fated to meet, or something. Guess you've got me to look after too, now. The name's Sendai. Don't forget it.
I'm done warmin' up. Time to sortie, or what?
These bandages? They're not for when I get hurt, they're for wrapping around my fists... You'll struggle to find anyone who can actually injure me.
I dream of justice, justice for... Never mind. Let's write off that one as a joke.
All I have are my principles and my fists. Even so, I'll always keep moving forward.
Commander, who do you think is our worst enemy? The Sirens? I think it's our own minds.
Commander, you'll end up gettin' hurt if you approach me without warning.
You got a damn death wish? You askin' me to knock some sense into that skull of yours? Izzat it, huh?!
A mission... That's my kinda deal.
You sure you wanna ignore those mission rewards, Commander? Not that I really care.
Here, your letter.
When's the next sortie? I've still got a ton of spare bandages.
Yo, commission's done. Don't tell me you're really considering just keeping those hardworking girls waiting.
I'll become stronger, then I'll...!
You're going up against me!
Heh. Won't even need to replace my bandages.
Owwww... Ahaha... Guess this is it...
I'll wreck you!
Think it's about time we say goodbye.
I'm not much of a people person, so I'd rather you'd just leave me alone... Hey, relax. You're my boss, so I'll still do my job.
I can't settle until I've made right out of wrong with my fists. That's my way of life. It's why I try not to get involved in anyone's business; I just don't wanna cause any trouble.
Feels like I've been here a long time... I know I'm the one saying that, but still, it really has been a long time...

People like you are pretty amazing. You do everything I want to, but just a bit better... When I'm with you, I even lose track of time... As long as you don't lose sight of who you are, I'll follow you to ends of the earth.

Commander, before you gave me this, I'd just have left you if you'd forgotten your principles... But now that you've given me this... Forget your principles, and you'll taste my fists of love and rage. *Giggle*
Need my help whoopin' somebody's ass?
Let's go, 5th CruDiv!
Kako, stay close to me.
Jintsuu, what should I do?
Hmh. Guess I won't be needin' these bandages anymore. Commander, how about we find out how strong I've gotten... by having you take one of my punches?
Hmh. Guess I won't be needin' these bandages anymore. Commander, how about we find out how strong I've gotten... by having you take one of my punches?
You're back, huh? Focus on your work. Gimme a shout when it's time to sortie.
Yeah? Oh, I'm working on my sortie pose. When goin' to war, you need a war pose, y'know?
Violence is the only solution I know of for my problems. That's why I envy you and Jintsuu sometimes.
Whenever I try to be like Jintsuu and use logic to solve problems, I usually end up using my fists anyway. I dunno why, either...
Hardships don't get under my skin, but I'm scared that I'll one day lose my way...
Hold still, Commander. We're pals, so I'll only hit you with 80% of my full strength!
Nice work. Want some sweets? You can have some of mine. They're all stuff I personally like, though.
Sorry to say, but this is where you'll all die!
Where'd I put my bandages... Oh, right, don't need 'em anymore... Totally forgot.
Sorry to say... but I can't afford to be defeated here!
Sendai-class No. 2 light cruiser, Jintsuu.

I'm Sendaii-class ship No. 2, Flagship of the Second Torpedo Squadron, Jintsuu. People have criticized me for being a coward, but I proved myself in the Battle of Kolombangara. Let me show you the glory of the Second Torpedo Squadron once more.

The battlefield can change at any second. Think rationally and act cautiously so that you may never be defeated in battle. Commander, have you been able to achieve this? Flagship of the Second Torpedo Squadron, Jintsuu, reporting for duty.
Commander, how you spend your time off-duty is no business of mine. Once you arrive, however, please do your work properly.
For the next operation, we need to allocate resources, and... Yes? Ah, help yourself, Commander.
If being cautious is considered cowardice, then shouldn't being brave also be considered recklessness?
There is no single solution for everything. Only through comparison, practice, and even failure, can one find their own correct answer.
Even if others don't understand my actions, I'll always do what I think is right... Even if you don't understand, Commander.
What's the matter? I'm just thinking about how to manage the fleet.
You've got more guts than I expected, Commander. Do you have the heart to face the consequences, though?
Your new missions have been sorted. Please take a look.
Rewards are here... Hmm? Don't worry. I'm just thinking about how to make our fleet more efficient.
Commander! It's important to respond to messages promptly!
Books cannot teach you everything. Some things can only be picked up through live combat. What do you think, Commander?
Stop daydreaming! Commissions have returned!
Should we consider advancing deeper into enemy territory?
All ships, charge forward!
Is that it?
All ships, retreat! Do not make meaningless sacrifices.
I've been waiting for this moment!
You might as well just leave the fleet management to me.
I was a flagship before, but now I'm just a common warrior. Please treat me the same as you would the others.
Commander, it's okay to respect my opinions, but please have confidence in your own judgment. I wouldn't be standing by your side if I didn't believe in you.

Commander, why do you think those famous generals of the past were willing to bow to their superiors? Was it the limit of their abilities, or was it devotion to their leaders? In my case, perhaps a bit of both.
Real leaders will always stick to their guns, no matter who opposes them. You can tell if their methods are correct by seeing who is willing to follow them. For example... me...
Deciding on the best course of action before acting cautiously has always been my creed. I can now say with confidence that choosing you, Commander, was the correct decision.
Thank you very much.
Hmm? Is it unusual? Hah. Even I require a change of pace to clear my mind every so often. Commander, why don't you come out and get some fresh air as well?
Hmm? Is it unusual? Hah. Even I require a change of pace to clear my mind every so often. Commander, why don't you come out and get some fresh air as well?
After we finish work today, how about taking a break on the beach?
I said I was taking a vacation, but even out here on the beach, I'm still thinking about the affairs of the fleet... I really am a workaholic, aren't I?
If you relax too much, you'll become undisciplined. If you're too uptight, you'll only find yourself out of breath.
Every year when it is swimsuit season, I can't help but to be envious of Sendai... Commander, I'm not being negligent in my exercise, am I?
Commander, your mind has wandered off onto the beach, hasn't it? It’s written all over your face.
Commander, you're concerned about it too, right? My tail is so conspicuous in this swimsuit...
You can't concentrate on your work when I'm wearing a swimsuit, right? Hehe, just consider this a test of will then.
Here, iced coconut water. Please have some.

"Where do you think you're going so early in the morning, Little Red Riding Hood?" ...Oh, if it isn't the Commander. This might be my own little whim, but I often find myself thinking the same way as this character... If you don't mind, I'd like to hear your feedback about my acting.

"Where do you think you're going so early in the morning, Little Red Riding Hood?" ...Oh, if it isn't the Commander. This might be my own little whim, but I often find myself thinking the same way as this character... If you don't mind, I'd like to hear your feedback about my acting.
Even in fairytale-esque stories, there are hints of deception and trickery hidden throughout. Basically, make sure to stay on guard as you usually do...Hehehe♪
If you think about it, the Big Bad Wolf's plan has so many holes in it. For example, he could have left the grandmother alive and used her as bait... Ehehe, I'm just playing around.
The moment you plan on striking down your prey is the moment you should be most alert. One can never know when a hunter might try to use the opportunity for their own benefit.
Speaking of hunters, none are better suited for the role than Sendai. I really wouldn't want to make an enemy out of her, even if it's just an act.
Hmm... I know I have it down in my head, but when I start to act it out, I keep running into trouble. Do you have any advice for me, Commander?
This outfit? ...Oh, it's what I have on before I turn into the grandmother.
And, checkmate. Hehehe~
Well done. I'll evaluate your battle plans for you, just like you evaluated my acting skills for me.
Maybe I should gobble you right up.
Since I've gotten used to living with you, Commander, I've decided to be more laid-back after receiving my remodel. My dance? Hehe... I can't show that to just anyone so easily.
Since I've gotten used to living with you, Commander, I've decided to be more laid-back after receiving my remodel. My dance? Hehe... I can't show that to just anyone so easily.
Did you sleep well, Commander? Do you need any help with fleet administration?
Commander, do you have any tactics you'd like to discuss with me? If you'd like... we can also just sit down and have a chat.
Sometimes it's hard to prove to others that what you believe is right. Commander, let's do our best together!
Every now and then, I get a bit jealous of Sendai and how straightforward she is...
Even though some people may think that cautiousness is a sign of weakness, I'll be happy as long as our fleet truly understands me...
There's nothing wrong with wanting to see me dance... I'll show you, but only if you work seriously first!
Commander, please do not mistake my cautiousness for tolerance.
Rewards have been issued! Want to see something interesting now that we can take it easy?
I can always work harder for the fleet!
Everyone, get ready! ... Press forward!
I only gave the orders, the real credit goes to the fleet!
Sendai-class light cruiser number three - Naka.

I'm Naka, Sendai-class light cruiser number three! Due to certain circumstances, my construction was delayed, I was redeployed to place after place, and my service record as the flagship of Desron 4 isn't much to brag about... but that's okay! I'll still work my butt off to try to surpass my sisters!
Nice to meet you, Commander! I'm the light cruiser Naka! My sisters are better known than me, but I swear that one day I'll be even more famous than them!
Welcome back, Commander! I'll try to be the best secretary you've ever had!
Commander, would you like to study together with me?
If it looks like there's nothing for me to do, would you mind if I did a little training on my own? I won't get in the way of your work!
Jintsuu is wise, Sendai is strong... but I'll work my way towards both brains and brawn! ...Ahahah, though I'm not sure if I can actually do it.
If you're tired, would you like me to give you a good relaxation tip? I actually know quite a lot about it~
Hum hum~♪ Oh, sorry, am I disturbing you in the middle of work...?
Eek! ...Please, Commander, try to stay focused on your work while in the office!
I reorganized the mission list for you! Here, please choose one!
You've cleared another mission! You're so brilliant, Commander! I'll need to work just as hard!
Commander, I have mail for you. I picked it up on the way back from my training.
There's nothing better than getting to come back home. Wouldn't you agree, Commander?
I think a commission has been completed. We should go and say thanks to the returning team!
With your support I can work even harder!
My sisters, please look forward to my performance in battle!
Compared to my goal of surpassing my sisters, this is no big deal at all!
Oh no! Commander, we should retreat immediately! Jintsuu said we shouldn't make meaningless sacrifices!
I'm really powerful, you know!
Everyone, stay calm! Let's change our strategy!
My sisters chose you because you just let them mess around without being scolded? How strange...

What I do on my days off? Well, I get up and do morning training, I read for an hour, I do target practice for 2 hours, and then... Basically, I make full use of my vacation days! I have to work really hard to become stronger, you know?
What are my hobbies? ...I don't really have one in particular. But I enjoy reading and training... Oh, would you like to train together with me? Heheheh~
Hmm, I feel a little guilty over always making you come with me... Is there anything you'd like to do? We'll do it together, of course!
Huh? Are you saying you've been waiting for a chance to go on a date too? Heheh, in that case~ Why don't we do it, Commander?
You can stare as much as you'd like. Hehehe~ From now on I will use my brains and brawn to serve you, my sweetheart whom I love so much!
Thaaanks! I really appreciate it!
I want to shine as gloriously as you, my sisters!

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander! Today, let's continue to pursue excellence in the ways of the pen and the sword!
Commander, if there's nothing I can help you with, why don't we divide and conquer? It'll be easier that way!
Commander, if you're feeling tired, I'll help you relax and feel good! That's not what you taught me? Ehehe... just sit back and enjoy it!
Hum hum~♪ What do you think, Commander? I have a natural talent for singing, don't I?
I'll always be waiting for you right here, Commander!
Commander, look forward to my success!
Am I one step closer to catching up to my sisters?
Heheh~ Commander, have you decided where to go for today's date? If you haven't made up your mind, I'll make the decision for you~

lines.line: Ahaha! Another big one's coming~! Phew~ that felt amazing~! Ah, Commander, let's hit the waves together, shall we?
Ahaha! Another big one's coming~! Phew~ that felt amazing~! Ah, Commander, let's hit the waves together, shall we?
We've gotta warm up before hitting the waves! C'mon, Commander, don't keep me waiting!
I heard that surfing is a great way to sharpen your motor skills, especially your sense of balance! C'mon, let's give it a try!
Sendai, how'd you split that watermelon blindfolded...?! Th-that was so cool...!
I'm sure Jintsuu will be writing some report like "The Status of the Waves and Water in this Sea Region" after our vacation is over. Hahaha!
It sure feels nice to just float around and let the waves sweep you away~
Hehe, Commander~ Did you just offer to give me a massage~?
Commander... if you do this kind of stuff on the beach, all the girls will hate you, you know?
Eh? Jintsuu, you even brought the mission documents along?
C-Commander?! We just got a message in a bottle!
There's no way to keep this tail from getting in the way when I'm swimming, huh... Wait! I'm sure Sendai knows a way around it!
Surfing is pretty fun once you get the hang of it, right? What do you think, Commander? Wanna go on a surf date with me?
The 11th Destroyer of Kagerou class — Urakaze

The 17th Destroyer fleet have been together for most of the time, and we participated in all sorts of sorties and operations for almost the entirety of the war. In the end I was with Kongou-sama as we both made our last stand… to the end. So I don’t care about those little things.
So it turns out to be you, are you the Commander of the 17th Destroyer fleet from today onwards? You seem so ordinary. I am Kagerou class Urakaze, show me what you got, Commander.
So slow, are you like a turtle who’s stumbled onto the battlefield?
O you mean this family emblem? I designed this myself, plus the clothes. I won’t accept any other comments except for “its cute”.
That Hamakaze girl, as my little sister she always acts superior to Tanikaze, even more than I do, darn…
If only we discovered Tusk, then Kongou-sama would not… sigh, forget it, what’s important is the present
Official documents? Let me see… hmm… ahh I see I see...
Don’t poke me unstoppingly, are you a monkey?
This type of things should not be tolerated, right? In that case, die...
I’ve organized all the missions… say what, you want me to clear them as well?!
The mission rewards have been confirmed, I’ll leave the labor work of transporting it here to you.
You’ve got mail… hmm? You read it, I didn’t really focus on what was written, don’t mind me.
You’ve worked hard today, please get some rest.
The commission fleet has returned, did you forget?
Thank you… my ears are twitching? Impossible, I’m not that happy at all.
Muahaha, all ships… set sail!

Let's give it everything we have.
Did you witness my performance?
How careless of me... I will undergo special training when we've returned. *Giggle*.
They don't call me "state of the art" for nothing~
Dear me, it seems things have gotten rather serious.
Even breathing the same air as you do is unpleasant, Commander~
I wonder what will happen today... *Giggle*, I'm looking forward to finding out.
Commander, why don't we have a chat? Yes, I'm curious as to what kind of person you are.
Me? I'm fond of interesting things. Such as... the act of toying with you, Commander... *Giggle*, you'll have to excuse me for that~
Someone who toys with the person they like... Are you familiar with anyone like that, Commander? *Giggle*, perhaps it's me~

You have feelings for me, Commander? You wish to be with me forever? ... Why am I asking the questions here? *Giggle*, because, even for someone like me, wouldn't it be humiliating to have someone else take the initiative at moments like these...?
Oh my... Thank you~
If you want to mess with Nagara, first you must get through me~
Noshiro, you'll have to develop a better relationship with the Commander.
Even though I'm not really into this whole "Christmas" thing, if it means I get to toy around with your heart by wearing this cute outfit of mine, then I suppose I would be interested. Hehe~
Even though I'm not really into this whole "Christmas" thing, if it means I get to toy around with your heart by wearing this cute outfit of mine, then I suppose I would be interested. Hehe~
Oh, aren't you back early? May I suggest starting with a review of today's schedule?
Is this a satisfactory pose for the occasion, Commander? Or would it suit you better if I stuck out my chest slightly more?
Commander, would you please stand over there for a moment? I need an accurate reference for the snow sculpture I'm making~
You've done well, Commander. Please get yourself some hard-earned sleep tonight. Ah, you thought I was teasing you with that request? *Giggle*~
Commander, what are you wishing for this Christmas? Ah, you don't need to consider your options at length. I picked out your present long ago, you see♪
*Giggle*, while I do enjoy a bit of teasing, being on good terms with you is more important. Commander, how about we set some time aside to watch the snowfall later?
Oh my, it appears my costume has caused an unintended development♪
I'd like to offer you a reward for working so diligently, even on a day as special as this.
"Oh my, you're also out for a stroll? Hehe, my name's Agano. And what might yours be?" ...Jeez, Commander, take this more seriously. According to the setting, we just met for the first time.
"Oh my, you're also out for a stroll? Hehe, my name's Agano. And what might yours be?" ...Jeez, Commander, take this more seriously. According to the setting, we just met for the first time.
Hey, are you here by yourself? Hehe. Why don't we... have a little chat, then?
This super-cute girl was sitting on a bench all by herself while looking a little lonely~ But too bad this scaredy-Commander won't even pounce on the opportunity~
You haven't had anything to eat? If you'd like, you can have some of my crepe~
"Um... do you mind if I shift a bit closer to you? It's a bit chilly out here..." What am I after? Jeez, way to spoil the mood...
"Would you mind telling me more about yourself? I feel like... we have a lot in common~" ...Hehe, in other words, I want to learn a lot more about you!
"Want to take a stroll with me?" *sigh*... It took me five minutes just to get you to ask me out. Commander, you have to take the initiative next time, got it?
Manhandling a girl who you barely just met... Heeh~ Commander, I didn't know you were that kind of person~
All done with the mission? Did you also pick up a crepe for me? Thanks a lot~♪
More mail, huh... You're quite the popular one. Hmph~
You must be tired, right? Here, if you'd like, you can come lie down over here.
Commander, it's more fun to play around this way~

Why'd I ask you to play a dating game? Well, if I teased you too much, wouldn't that only make you dislike me? But since I can't help it, I decided to make it up to you this way~ Do you think better of me now, Commander?

The blunt approach is not my style, but I cannot have Noshiro think I only inch my way to success... Oh, I was just talking to myself, Commander. Hehe, so anyway, would you mind being my partner for tonight's party?

The blunt approach is not my style, but I cannot have Noshiro think I only inch my way to success... Oh, I was just talking to myself, Commander. Hehe, so anyway, would you mind being my partner for tonight's party?
Well, well. Were you hoping to fluster your lady by arriving late on purpose, Commander?

The competition tonight is considerably fiercer than I anticipated... This calls for a counterattack... Oh, it was nothing important. I was just thinking out loud about how, uh... fabulous that chandelier is.
Come to think of it, I haven't seen Noshiro around... Knowing her, she may be off on her own somewhere...
Say, Commander, would you care for a drink? Me? Well, I can hold my liquor at least as well as you. Heheh.
Please, Commander, you need not look so on-edge. I may enjoy teasing you, but I'm not so brash as to do it on this special occasion.
You certainly are greeting many people tonight, Commander.
My, Commander, you look simply resplendent when you return from battle... I'm once again head over heels for you. I mean it.
I am an... enigma to you? Why, I would say that you're the enigmatic individual between us, Commander. And yet, that makes one want to get to know you better, the sinful person that you are. Hehehe~
Agano-class light cruiser number two - Noshiro.

Just as Agano says, the great war in which we were born may have been an era of misfortune. ...No. As a member of the improved Agano-class, I should be able to make you satisfied with my work, if only there was just a place I could display my true strength.
I'm the new arrival, Noshiro, second ship of the Agano-class, reporting for duty. Let's do our utmost to prove our worth to each other, shall we?
My, you're quite early today. For starters, how about checking today's schedule?
Regardless of the situation, you should first calm down, think of a way forward, and only then act. That's how I tackle things.
...Let's try thinking of some recipes for tomorrow's meals...
Keeping everything neat and tidy shortens the time it takes to search for documents. Why don't we start by organizing the documents on your desk?
Agano's exp... Yes, it's truly impossible to tell what's behind that fearless smile... She always ends up leading me around by the nose.
If you're stuck, why not stop what you're doing, and instead, think of a different way to proceed?
R-Regarding your conduct right now, I demand that you apologize and reflect upon your actions!
If you feel overwhelmed by the number of missions, why not try sorting them based on priority?
I've received the mission rewards. Please double check that nothing has been left out.
Mail? I'll check to make sure there's nothing suspicious inside.
Hm... Ah, sorry. I was lost in thought. So you've returned. Let's start by reviewing this past battle.
Please form the next commission team, okay?
Please, strengthen my combat ability.
Please look over the battle plans, just to double check.
If you lead with careful analysis and accurate decision-making, your victory is ensured.
We have no choice but to pull back...
Now's the time!
An enemy trap?!
You seem to be in quite the hurry. For once, why don't you try calming down and reflecting upon your actions?
I am currently contemplating over the last practice exercise. Do you not also have things you should be doing right now?

An invitation to a joint practice session together from Agano... How troubling. It's full of intent to bully. Even though I want to refuse, I can't think of an excuse. Instead, would you be willing to assign some official duties to me around that time?

Ahem. I'm only asking this because I keep hearing my friends use the term over and over, but... out of curiosity, what exactly is this concept called `a woman's intuition'...? "I have absolutely no clue," you say? I see. I guess it's an enigma to you, too.

So this is what it feels like to have your heart throb. While I used to be just as inexperienced with this feeling as I was experienced with being perceptive and relying on my instincts... Yes, it's all clear to me now. My feelings, as well as yours.

In order to not just accept your feelings, but to reciprocate them as well... Umm, let's see... I'll need to prepare meals, go on dates on days off, but I also need to make sure I don't lose motivation for my regular duties, like practice... Eh? Ah, sorry, I got lost in my train of thought. Huh? I-I should keep going?
I... I'll cherish this!
Agano, please be careful.
Um... mind keeping a safe distance?
Just as I thought, this is the perfect place for watching fireworks. You came here thinking that too, didn't yo8u?
Just as I thought, this is the perfect place for watching fireworks. You came here thinking that too, didn't you?
It'll be a bit of a walk, but won't you come along with me?
I only found this place by pure chance. Thinking back on it, I wonder how I was feeling when I stumbled upon this back alleyway instead of following the main road...
Please, watch your step. The road is very narrow.
If we're talking about dressing up properly for the festival, this is definitely the getup. However, I struggled a bit while changing into this. I even got laughed at by Agano. ...*sigh*
Hm... Ah, I'll be fine even if you don't prop me up like that. ...Um, thank you very much.
Apologize and reflect upon your actions. Don't think that you're going to get away with it just because we're at a festival!
Where were you all this time? Don't tell me... you got lost?
Now, let's put on a dazzling show!
Commander, what are you standing around for? Did you also need a change of pace? That makes two of us— Come, there's nothing to be afraid of here.
Commander, what are you standing around for? Did you also need a change of pace? That makes two of us— Come, there's nothing to be afraid of here.
Phew... Go on, fly away, little ones. Mind the cage on your way out, now... I've been taking care of these guys. What have you been up to?

Don't worry. There's nothing for you to worry about. All the preparations for the party and the related formalities have all been taken care of. All that's left for you to do is to enjoy the evening while savoring this beautiful scenery.
Wah! ...Sorry. I can't believe I almost fell... Um... T-Thank you for catching me...

It's a given that I love the atmosphere here, but another reason I like this place is that I feel like I can finally get away from Agano's endless teasing here... Though, I'd rather she just stop worrying about me in the first place...

This is yet another massive set built right in the Port. Yes, it's incredibly gorgeous... Honestly, when I saw it for the first time, I forgot I was in still in the Port for a moment. Speaking of which, didn't you also stand and stare in awe when you first came here?
Hehe. I think even Agano would take a liking to this place, too.
Excuse me... How about I give you a massage... with this?
Once you've rested up, why don't we go and make our appearance at the party together?
Though it might not seem that way, we're actually pretty close to the Port. Shall we go and greet the Commissions Team?
Freeze, and turn to ice... Your time is up.
In the face of well-crafted plans, resistance is futile. Accept your defeat.
Hmm, I wonder what kind of scene this set is supposed to depict. A birdcage, crows, the sea, blue roses, and... you beside me... Um... Don't you think this is quite picturesque?
Whew... Oh, are you cold by any chance? I have some hot tea for you if you'd like. If you want someone to chat with, I'd be glad to keep you company.
Whew... Oh, are you cold by any chance? I have some hot tea for you if you'd like. If you want someone to chat with, I'd be glad to keep you company.
It's good to see you. How should we start the day off?

I like staying in places that are quiet and peaceful. They make me feel relaxed. The whisperings of the wind, the sound of flowing water, the harbingers of spring, and Commander's... Ehem, I-I didn't mean anything by that.
You still haven't taken a sip yet. Is it too hot? ...Are you perhaps bad with hot things?
It's not like I'm opposed to going into battle as a warship, but... I'd really like to save people as well. Much like Hamakaze's always done.
The Manjuus' teapot is astonishingly authentic. I don't see any problems with adding one to the Office for daily use, either. Hehe.
There's really no reason to push yourself to get some work done today. It's a precious day off, so why don't you enjoy it for a change?
Sigh... Of course you would do that.
Welcome back. Oh... I know you're thirsty, but the tea's a bit hot. Take care not to burn yourself.

Though the snow has piled up this much, it'll all melt with the coming of spring—becoming water that will nourish nascent life. I don't think I can remain cold like this for much longer, either. After all, before I was able to notice... spring has managed to start creeping into my life, too.
Why don't you unwind for a bit before you start reflecting on the day's happenings? I'm sure it'll be far more efficient that way.
Why don't you unwind for a bit before you start reflecting on the day's happenings? I'm sure it'll be far more efficient that way.
Phew... Now then, let's prepare ourselves for the work ahead of us.
The snacks Agano asked for... Commander's documents... and then there's Jintsuu's... Phew... Things ended up real busy...
What is there to drink... Maybe some tea or coffee? ...No, I mustn't. Too much caffeine will interfere with my sleep.
Even on my off days, I always end up working anyway... Maybe I'm also a workaholic, just like the Commander...
This feels just like tutoring the little destroyers. Hehe~
What's the matter?
Hm? Oh, my apologies. I didn't realize you were calling for me.
Why don't we focus on work for now?
2nd DesRon, sallying forth!
Welcom...?! What are you doing here? Wait, don't leave—I was just surprised, that's all... Well, what would you like to order?
Welcom...?! What are you doing here? Wait, don't leave—I was just surprised, that's all... Well, what would you like to order?
Did you want me to call you "Master?" Understood... Master.
If you're lost on what to order, how about I surprise you?
I guess pigtails really do make you look considerably younger... I hate to admit it, but it's just like Agano said.
Personally prepared meals aren't part of the service provided by the café, so I leave the cooking to the manjuus, but... if you insist, I wouldn't mind doing it for you.
Please, take your time.
R-reflect on your conduct...!
Welcome back. Sometimes, I don't really get how I should be treating you while in this outfit... Oh, it's the same for you? That's a relief.
The fleet's back from completing commissions. Make sure you greet them properly before coming back here, Commander.
Ahem. "How's your order, Master?" ...Too emotionless? Then, how about, "How's your order, Master~♪"? ...Hey! Are you taking me for a fool?!

...Take that! Heehee... Ahaha! Phew... I know you don't like admitting defeat, but I got you pretty good there. I might have tried a bit too hard, but I'm pretty sure you were the one who told me to give it my all.

...Take that! Heehee... Ahaha! Phew... I know you don't like admitting defeat, but I got you pretty good there. I might have tried a bit too hard, but I'm pretty sure you were the one who told me to give it my all.
You should enjoy yourself at the beach, just like you ordered me to. Hehe.
I like being able to unwind and have some fun in my swimsuit, but long strolls along the beach are nice too. Um, if you don't mind... Maybe next time, the two of us could...
If you're stuck trying to think about what fun things to do next, why don't you ask the others? I'm sure they'd love to join you for anything you'd like.
Sakawa... I have an inkling of where she might be. Wouldn't surprise me if she's at a beachside hut somewhere, stuffing her face with sweets. Sigh...
I picked this swimsuit because you told me we were going to play on the beach, but instead... No, never mind. But did you perhaps... want to see me in something more risqué?
Want another go?
Wh-where are you touching... *blushes*
Welcome back. Care for refreshments? Heehee, make sure to finish the soda before it goes flat.
I've received word that the commission team has returned. Why don't you take a quick break from work and go welcome them back?
When it's time to fight, my mind is solely on the battle. Playtime's over; it's time to focus.
Commander, what do you have planned next...? You want to just relax and enjoy the date? Understood. Umm, let me just try and get a feel for it... Hmm...
Commander, what do you have planned next...? You want to just relax and enjoy the date? Understood. Umm, let me just try and get a feel for it... Hmm...

Ah... Commander, what are you in such a hurry over? You rushed here so you wouldn't be late for our date...? I don't think you need to worry about it that much. I'm already plenty happy that we got to do this.
Commander, you've bought me so many things lately... How about you let me pick a few gifts out for you next time?
You look sweaty from rushing here. I have a handkerchief. Just lean forward so I can wipe it off for you, okay? Heehee.
Your eyes are wandering a lot today. ...Hm? My outfit's "too dazzling"? I see... If you like it so much, maybe I should wear it more often.
Commander, this perfume's all the rage lately. How about we buy each other matching ones? Then, we can smell the same!
You want a lollipop? But this is my only one... Wait, are you saying... I-I mean, I don't mind, but...
Umm... My hat is cute? Oh, is it because there are holes for my horns?
Do you want to hold hands? It's a little embarrassing, but I don't mind...
Eep... W-we're in public...
Do you still have missions left over? Don't worry. I'll wait here, so go finish them up.
Mission complete. I'll help you count the rewards.
Got news to share? I'm glad phones make it so convenient to learn things.
Welcome back, Commander. I haven't been waiting long. In fact, I'm still happy from when we got to walk around town together.
The commission team just got back. I know, we're in the middle of our date, but don't you think we should go welcome them back?
I felt something rise. I guess you could call it... girliness?
Interrupt our date, and you will pay.

I had so much fun with you today. Are you? ...Hm? I looked too calm all day? You're misunderstanding. I might not express my emotions very well, but... when I'm with you, I'm always excited. Listen... Do you hear my heart pounding?

Receiving everyone's blessings is truly a deeply moving experience. But for now, let's set everything else aside and partake of our sweet bliss. After all, you're not just a spectator anymore - we're in this ride together, hehe~

Receiving everyone's blessings is truly a deeply moving experience. But for now, let's set everything else aside and partake of our sweet bliss. After all, you're not just a spectator anymore - we're in this ride together, hehe~
You said you'd be the one to escort me today, did you not? Here, take my hand... Mhm.
Agano did say that it's important to have a certain degree of flashiness, but... isn't this carriage just overkill? Well, if you think it's apropos, I'm fine with it too. Hehe.
I'm pretty thirsty... Maybe some tea or coffee... Wait, I shouldn't. I won't be able to sleep if I drink too much. ...Oh, the same is true for you?
What should we start off with today? ...Don't always make it about work. Isn't it about time you let me do something nice for you?
You look like you're having a hard time... If there's anything bothering me, I can hear you out, you know? If I made a face like that, Agano wouldn't let me hear the end of it... Hehe.
What's up?
Hm? Oh, sorry. I didn't realize you called...
Still getting overwhelmed by work, huh? ...Hmph, you're as clumsy as ever. Guess I'll come help too.
Mission accomplished. Why don't you leave the rest to me and take a break?
Here's the mail. You know, I was thinking it'd be nice if you'd write me some... Err, n-nevermind...
Welcome back. Hehe. To be honest, my feet are a bit sore. Do you think it was bad for me to wait here for you like a princess?
Next up is welcoming back everyone from the commission team, right? Let's get going.
Second Torpedo Squadron, heading out...!
I'm perfectly calm. Aren't you the one excited over the victory?
My face... is all red? That's probably... because of how tightly you're holding me. Don't you ever get tired of me? ...I love you, hehe~
Basking in the summer night's air and chatting with someone I love, all under the moonlight... Now this is a nice bath. By the way... did you know you dropped your towel?
Commander, there's no need to force yourself. Staying in a hot bath for too long can be bad for you. Me? No, I'm fine... Probably...
You feel embarrassed? That's okay... I've embarrassed myself in front of you countless times... No, it's nothing.
