If you want your towel back, then tell me you love me ten times! ...Sakawa would say something like that. She's a little bit of a tease.
It's not that I'm being straightforward because we're alone - I just think it's hard to cover up my feelings when I'm so physically exposed. Gotta let it all hang out in the bath... right?

If you like hot spring baths, then how about we go on a hot spring tour some time? The Sakura Empire would be good for it... I think visiting all of the world's famous hot springs would also make for a great vacation.
That's enough mischief from you. Heheh.
You want me to take my towel off too so that we're even? G-goodness...
Do you have missions to do? Go take care of them. I'll wait for you here.
Mission completed. Don't you think it's weird that I'm the one telling you this?
Your letters... Ah, be careful not to get them wet.
Phew. The wind is blowing hard, but I don't feel chilly at all. I guess I won't have to worry about you catching a cold here, heheh.
Our commission team is back. Er... Should we get out already?
We'll wash away our fatigue in the hot spring later. We're almost done here.

I think you're right - I have gotten more expressive these days. I can even say that I love you with ease... But even in this state of undress, I feel awfully hot. Maybe I've been in the bath too long...
Agano-class light cruiser number four - Sakawa.

I'm the Agano-class light cruiser, Sakawa! I wasn't able to do a whole lot during that war, but... I'm so grateful to you and all my friends here at the port for giving me another chance to fight! Mhm!
I'm Sakawa, Agano-class light cruiser♪ And you're the Commander? I see~ I get why Noshiro is so into you. I am, too!
Gooood morning! ...Oh, am I supposed to be all graceful and say "well met" or something?
Look who's here to see me again! Heehee, I know you would, since you really like me. Likewise, there's a lot about you I like - and dislike.
Oh my, were you just sneaking a peek at me? I don't blame you, since I'm just soooo cute~ You'll never get tired of staring at me, right? Heehee♪
I can handle anything you throw at me. I'll breeze through anything, whether it's a sortie or a bunch of paperwork.
Not to be a glutton, but, since I've been working hard, can't you spare me an itty bitty treat? Haha, how about something sweet?
We patting people's heads now?
You were staring at me just now, weren't you? I bet you were~
An accident, huh... I never said you had to apologize!
You sure have a lot of work to get through... Even if I lend you a hand, it'll probably still take a while, huh~
That's it for the paperwork! Let's see if you left anything out... Ah, found a spot! Gimme a sec to look everything through!
Your mail's here. Mind if I read it?
Welcome back! You won, right? I mean, obviously, you did. Otherwise it'd be tactless of me to greet you like this~♪
You can stop staring at me already~ After all, we have to go welcome the commission fleet back, don't we?
Now that's a power boost. Best way to test it would be with a real battle, no?
Improvisation, expertise, and execution - that's what it's all about!
Victoryyy! Now's a good time to congratulate me, no? I'd say it is. Heehee.
They actually beat us? How's that even possible?!
I'll show you what I'm made of!
I won't have the wind taken out of my sails here!
Didn't I tell you to leave me alone already? I don't like people who don't listen to what I say.

Wow, we meet again! By the way, doesn't it feel like we've been bumping into each other every day since I arrived at the port? Well, you're the Commander, so I suppose there's nothing strange about that. Ehehe~♪

Oh my~♪ Did you come to see me again? Ehehe, Noshiro's gonna be so jealous if she finds out. Well, sit down already. I'll go bring out the tea and snacks - these are some of my favorites from the Sakura Islands!

Of course I know why you come to see me every day~ But isn't it a bit boring if I steal your thunder? At times like these... you're supposed to proclaim your passionate love for me at the top of your lungs, right~?
W-wow, you really went and did it... Hearing it up-close like that is actually a bit embarrassing. Or, were you just teasing me? Did you know, I've been serious about you this whooole time?
Ehehe, did you steal another glance at me just before you put the ring on my finger? ...Y-you didn't? Geez, and here I am trying to show you what a maiden in love looks like...
Ehehe~ You really, really love me, don't you~♪
Keep your eyes on me!

ex.line: Good day, my dearest~♪ You look more energetic than usual today~
Wow, you came to see me again today! Oh, it was just a coincidence? Heehee, what a prankster you are~ You totally knew I'd be waiting right here for you~
Ehehe, you're going to make me blush if you do that while we're still at work... Huh? I haven't been working for quite some time now? I, I totally knew that!
Want me to whip up a light snack for you? Hey, just because I like eating doesn't mean I don't know how to cook~♪
Noshiro is totally head-over-heels in love with you, but she just won't admit it... I don't get her at all. Heehee.
Alright, alright. Heehee~♡
Please pay more attention to me... Okay?
You let missions pile up just so you can spend more time working with me, didn't you~♪
And that's all of 'em! See, everything's fine when we take things slow and steady~
Welcome back! Let's finish reviewing the mission, and then you'll have some Sakura confections waiting for you!
If we're going to go greet the commission team, how about bringing Noshiro along?
I'm calling the shots~!
You're the best, Sakawa. You're amazing, Sakawa. I'm proud of you, Sakawa- What's wrong? Haven't decided what to say yet~?

Aren't you dying to tell me how much you love me? Ehehe, I'm going to steal those words right from your lips, so you'd better think carefully about how to return my feelings. The longer you spend agonizing over it, the more my love for you deepens~

lines.line: Welcome! Heehee, you came because you were just so keen to see me, am I right? Then I've got to make you feel real welcome♪
Welcome! Heehee, you came because you were just so keen to see me, am I right? Then I've got to make you feel real welcome♪
Come get your delicious and fluffy dango~ One for you, one for me, and we can share the last one~♪ Ehehe, goood morning~!
Happiness is a mouthful of sweets from the Sakura Islands~ Don't you also want to share a bit of this happiness with Sakawa? Here you go then~♪
Dangos are sooo good~ I could eat them for three days straight! But after that... I'd probably get sick of them and want some yatsuhashi instead~♪
The stuff you ordered? ...Oh! I think I ate it by accident! Oh, silly me!
Since we're trying to make our pop-up café the best it can be, I have to memorize the entire menu~ Heehee, I'll be making a whole lot of goodies later~
I feel like I'm on top of the world~
Alright, what would you like to order?
Well, um... I suppose you just couldn't help it because of how cute I am, right...?
Sorry to keep you waiting~ I've brought you your piping-hot tea! ...Oh my, I seem to have forgotten the teacups! Oh, um, what should I do...?
We're giving Sakura confections to the commission team as a thank-you reward, right?

M-my lips...? Even I'll get embarrassed if you suddenly try to kiss me, you know...? But, maybe we can go somewhere else later and-- Huh? There's something stuck to the corner of my lips?! Wh-what about the kiss...???
Wow, look how far you pursued me. You must have really, reeeally wanted to see me, huh, Commander~? Heheh, want a popsicle?
Wow, look how far you pursued me. You must have really, reeeally wanted to see me, huh, Commander~? Heheh, want a popsicle?
A cool summer's day in the forest~ One for me, one for you, and halfsies for the bears~ Ehehe, welcome back!♪
Aww, you came to see me again! Are you sure you want to spend time with me, and not Noshiro? Heheh, do you feel guilty? It's okay~ We can always make it up to Noshiro after we have fun together♪
Whoa! Commander, you're soaked. Oh, I know; were you and Noshiro shooting water guns? Ahaha!♪ She never holds back when it comes to play.
Swimsuits aren't just for the beach. They work great for swimming in rivers, too. Hm? You aren't going to swim, Commander?
There's going to be a big fireworks show later, right? I'll save room for the feast later♪
Would you like one?
I-is this because I'm in a swimsuit...?
Have a nice, cool popsicle after that heated battle! Heheh, was someone looking forward to an indirect kiss?
Ooh, you were just looking at me, weren't you? I was juuust about to let you know that the commission team's probably back by now♪
I'm strong, aren't I? Ahaha, a swimsuit won't get in the way of my fighting!

Isn't it easier to tell someone how much you love, love, love them when you're alone together? Ehehe, of course it is~ You've been trying to say it for a while now, right, Commander? I'll let you go first. Say it loud enough for me to hear, now♪
Laaa la-laaa♪ Oh, Commander. Here to see me again? I know you're madly in love and want to watch me practice, but people will think you're weird if you keep coming and going constantly. Heehee♪
Laaa la-laaa♪ Oh, Commander. Here to see me again? I know you're madly in love and want to watch me practice, but people will think you're weird if you keep coming and going constantly. Heehee♪
What am I practicing right now? Heheh, just guess, Commander♪
Doesn't it make people really nervous to sing and perform in these huge venues? I'm not, though, since I'm with you~
Agano's dress is so mature, isn't it? ...Mine, too? Well, I doubt it's like hers~
Just between you and me, I've been practicing my piano instead of singing. Heheh, did I trick you?
Ah! You were just staring at me!♪ Could it be... You brought me treats? Woohoo!
Do you know a lot about music, Commander?
Are you doing that because I look a little more... mature today?
Party prep, strategy meetings, exercises... You're so busy, Commander. Should you reeeally spend so much time watching me practice?♪
After I finish my jaw-dropping performance... should I bow for the crowd, you think?
You come to watch every day 'cause you love me so much, right? Heheh, we're all alone right now, so you can say it as loud as you want. ...Whoa?! I-impressive... *blushes*
M-class destroyer - Matchless (G52.)

I'm Matchless, a Royal Navy M-class destroyer! After my escort missions in the Arctic, I was in the Battle of the North Cape, and then I helped escort Queen Mary! My name makes me sound powerful, but in reality, I'm totally helpless!
We meet at last, Commander! I am Matchless, an M-class Destroyer! Ah, although my name is "Matchless," I'm actually very weak. Ehe~ Commander, will you protect me?
You look sad, Commander... Let's try this... Hehe~ Feel better?
Everyone has someone they want to protect... So don't protect just me, okay, Commander?
You know flattery won't get you anywhere with me, right?
Oh dear, it's getting cold again... Commander, can you lend me your coat when we leave port?
I hope I can just stay as your secretary forever... Hm? What? I didn't say anything!
Can I just stay with you forever, Commander?
Because of that... I'm subtracting a few points off your record~!
I-I'm scared... I want to stay with you...
You look so awesome from behind, Commander!
I'll go and get your mail~!
I like it better when you're here, it makes me feel at ease...
I hope I can go on a safe transport mission together with you, Commander...
Maybe you got stronger too, Commander?
I-I'll try to stay where the Commander can protect me!
Time for a photo~! C'mon, let's take a picture!
S-someone, help meeee!
Okay! Now close your eyes~!
I should've known... You can't possibly protect me...
My name might make me seem invincible, but that's not true at all. Don't mistake me for a Main Fleet ship just because of my name!
Duke of York is tough, cool, and... Hehe~ She must make you jealous, too~
The feelings I have for you, and the feelings you have for me... Which of the two is more passionate?
Physical scars heal over time, but mental scars never go away. So, please, don't make my heart ache!
Aww... I'm so happy... Thank you... Commander, I may not be able to protect you, but I'll do everything I can to protect your smile and warm your heart! Please, Commander, be happy!
So warm...
Ah, Commander, over here! Hm, you're going to take care of all the plans for today's date? In that case, I look forward to seeing just how suave you can be! Hehe~
Ah, Commander, over here! Hm, you're going to take care of all the plans for today's date? In that case, I look forward to seeing just how suave you can be! Hehe~
Oh you, Commander, you're going to lose points for keeping a girl waiting! Hehe, just kidding! I arrived a bit too early~
Commander, the super-luxurious ice cream crepes you bought are soooo good! Thanks! ...That's right, you should try some too. Come on, don't be shy, open up~
If some questionable individuals suddenly showed up, you'd be there to protect me, right?
Hmm... it feels like someone is always staring at me... is it just my imagination?
Haven't decided on where to go yet? That's totally fine, I'm happy to just have you here.
Commander, you're in charge of all the bags! Do your best for me, all right~?
Commander, I'm going to give you a big fat zero on today's performance.
Commander, today, you're going to be escorting me full-time. You'll lose points if you let your attention wander~
Commander, stick out your arms~ Yeah, just like that! Huuug! Hehe~ ...Hm? It's hard to hold that posture? None of my business~ You should be able to endure it for my sake, right~?
M-class destroyer - Musketeer (G86.)
I'm the Royal Navy M-class destroyer Musketeer! I was in the Battle of the North Cape! Commander, little Musketeer is gonna shoot straight through your dreary heart with a bang bang!
I am the M-class Destroyer, Musketeer! Hehe... I knew something good was going to happen today~ Commander, can you point me to where the port is? Here? Or over here?!
Morning, Commander! Nice weather today! Click, click... bang! I'm not sure why, but I'm always brimming with energy!
Is it fun to hang out with me, Commander? ...Ah, sorry, never mind that.
Something nice is gonna happen today~ That's what I'm feeling!
Why am I always smiling? Hehehe, because I've been having so much fun ever since I came here!
The injuries I've sustained from combat? Hehehe, they don't hurt at all.
Hehehe~! You've reloaded me with energy!
It's not like I *dislike* it, but... Yeah, I actually don't dislike it!
Finish them all in one go!
Hehehe~ It's just human instinct to smile at the sight of money! Yeah, that's it! Smile, Commander~!
Heehee~! See? I told you something nice would happen today!
Take a gander at my new marching act, Commander! Relax, I'm only using blanks this time!
Wooow! Look at those mission rewards! We could fill a bathtub with all this oil!
Take aim~! Fire! Bang!
How-dee-doooo! I'm gonna shoot yooou!
I'm gonna punch a hole straight through your heart~! Heheh, I've always wanted to say that!
Time to make a sneaky exit~♫
Locked and loaded~! Ready to fire!
Come on... Return to your former self, Commander...
No matter what life throws at you, always be optimistic, happy, and positive! You just gotta be!
I always have tons of fun hanging out with you!
We should all forget our worries and live to have fun! Don't you think so too, Commander?
So much has happened since we first met... But I haven't changed a bit!
Thank you, Commander! This is the best thing I've ever gotten! Hey, tell me: have I given you some good memories, too?
That's cheered me right up!
Fiji-class light cruiser - Fiji.

Name's Fiji, I'm pretty much the nameship of my class. Things I fancy include... What? Spare the details? Then, if you're asking about my service record, all I did was fight in the Battle of Crete. Pretty rubbish record, innit... ahaha. Just gonna have to live with it and work on it, you know?
Heeey! Fiji's here~! Are you the Commander? Hmmm...? Pfft... Hahaha! You don't look too shabby! Nice seeing you, Com~man~der~♪
Had supper yet, Commander? If not, I could cook you something up.
What's up, Commander? Missed me, have you? Hah, alright, have a seat and I'll get you some tea.
Jamaica? Ah, yeah, proper oddball, that girl~ But it's all good as long as she's having fun, innit?
What's up? You look knackered... Fancy a nap in my lap, maybe?
Hey, take a gander at this, Commander! Fancy what I've done with my hair? How about my nails?
Feeling lonely, Commander? I'm always here for you.
If you wanna know my three sizes, can't you just ask? I mean, if you do, I'll tell you~ Hahaha~♪
You can't just go leaving missions unfinished, Commander~ Let's go finish them. Remember: I'm right with you.
Mission rewards, hooray~! Done your job proper, I'd say, Commander.
Mail's here, Commander. I'll leave it here, so check it when you've got the time.
What're you staring into space for? Is that your way of saying "I want a hug"?
Commission team's come back. Don't forget to go greet them! Or else you'll hurt their feelings.
I'll do my part on the battlefield all proper like, so you can rest easy, Commander.
Battle time! Eyes ahead, everyone!
Just doing my part on the battlefield, really!
Commander, take everyone with you and retreat! Leg it...!
I'm in the groove!
It's like back in Crete... Sod that! I'm not letting that happen again!
You need something, Commander? I'm kind of unavailable, really.
All combat, all makeup, all the time, that's me!
Oh yeah, anyone in the fleet you fancy? Want me to assist you with them? Come on now, don't get your knickers in a twist~ I can keep a secret~
Oh, hey, Commander. I was just about to head out. Getting dressed right now, you see~ Ah, don't be shy, you can look~ Later, I wanna get a look at you, too~

Slow to catch on, aren't you~ Right, question! Could you believe there's a girl out there who's always talking about love with you, isn't afraid to undress before your eyes, and has grown quite fond of you?
Hey, is my makeup looking decent? What about my outfit? Reckon I look as pretty as it gets? ...Good~ I've never dressed for this occasion before, so I want to look as good as possible~
Hey, this is a right wicked present!
Did I keep you waiting, Commander? Ahaha... A girl's gotta take her time before stepping out onto the streets, remember? Come on, take my hand, and let's get going! Hehe~
Did I keep you waiting, Commander? Ahaha... A girl's gotta take her time before stepping out onto the streets, remember? Come on, take my hand, and let's get going! Hehe~
Commander, we've talked about the importance of being punctual before, right...? As compensation for making me wait, we're gonna shop 'til we drop! Ahaha!
Hehe, what do you think about my outfit, Commander? Pretty nice, isn't it? ...You don't know where you should be looking? Haha, you cheeky little...
The joy of going shopping is knowing that every time you go out, there's something new to be discovered. Commander, I'll let you handle the "spoils" of our shopping trip.
You've gotta try on some new clothes during your downtime every now and then! Hehe, want me to help you pick out some clothes, Commander?
Girls need to do a lot of preparation before going out, you know? Hair, makeup, clothes, you name it... So, if you want to see us at our cutest, you've got to be patient~
When we're on a date, it's only natural to lock arms and lean against you like this~ Ahaha, are you embarrassed, Commander?
Welcome back! Hmm, how are we gonna celebrate your hard work? Ahaha, what do you think about a candle-lit dinner?
Fiji-class light cruiser - Jamaica.

It is I. I, Jamaica, who sabotaged Iron Blood's operation in the Barents Sea; I, who sealed Scharnhorst to her fate: to sink in the Battle of the North Cape. Operation Tungsten? Of course I was there. As was I during the subsequent civil war... As long as Evil continues its march, I will keep fighting... Yes, all my choices were made by Justice itself...
Ugh... my eye is throbbing again... So you're the Boss, huh? The name's Jamaica. All is in the name of Justice...
Boss, my Eye has seen it... Your necktie is slightly loose.
Boss, can you check if these chains are covering my left eye? I'll reposition my arm.
Boss, is the "you" that my Eye sees really "you"?
Boss, care to race with me? I will show you what real Lighting looks like.
I feel it. Somewhere in the world, the darkness of night is enveloping something...
...Boss, keep your hands to yourself. Otherwise you'll startle me when I'm concentrating.
...Boss, t-this isn't the place for this...
Boss, are there any Missions for me to tackle?
Boss, we've received mission rewards. Me? No need. I'm satisfied with Standing here and basking in my sense of accomplishment.
Boss, you have mail from one of your partners.
I feel Evil wriggling within the depths of my heart... Boss, let's enjoy this Peace while it lasts.
Boss, the commission team has returned... "Stop posing on the veranda"? U-understood...
It's not enough... I need more power...!
My heart is utterly unclouded...!
Eradicating you fiends is the meaning of Justice.
It's not pain I fear... it's being completely helpless... Ugh!
The eulogy of life... is the eulogy of Courage!
Victory comes to those who are determined! Stand Proud!
Unfortunately, Boss, it seems your Goals differ from mine...
Boss, care for a chat? There seems to be a need for us to Know one another.
An age of justice? That is not what I want. Where there is light, there is dark. Evil cannot be eradicated so easily, Boss.
You end up on the path of Evil if you only focus on your own justice, your own desires. Never let the Darkness out of sight. I'm here with you, Boss.
One needs a Heart of Justice. As long as we have it, no matter what struggles we face, we will surely see our journey to the end. We are Just, therefore... you are never alone, Boss.
Boss, what we are doing is carving a path through the Wilderness. And being here to walk beside you is the greatest blessing of my life.
You would guide me to the path of justice? I'm grateful, Boss.
Let's go, partner!
Sheffy, have you awakened to your Heart of Justice?
Hey Boss, you talkin' about my sweet bike? Heh, I made it myself by scrounging up parts from Akashi's place. Pretty cool, huh?
Hey Boss, you talkin' about my sweet bike? Heh, I made it myself by scrounging up parts from Akashi's place. Pretty cool, huh?
Boss, the weather be fine today. Wanna go for a ride?
Boss, if you have time, wanna help me upgrade my bike? I got some sick ideas.
When somethin' is on my mind, I just keep on riding until my troubles are left far, far behind... However, it's really easy to get lost.
Boss, when I drive, I like to go fast. When you're sitting behind me, make sure to hold on tight!
Boss, what if I named this bad boy here "Dark Bolt?"
Boss, do you wanna try riding too? Be careful, this guy's got some serious horsepower.
Boss... even though I told you to hold on to me tight, I didn't mean right there...
Boss, come take a seat. We're gonna forget all about the the smoke of the battlefield, and feel the wind at our side.
I used to consider myself a drifter, a vagabond with no home and no destination. But I learned that I was wrong, Boss. No matter what happens, I'll always come back... to home.
Look, Boss, this is the new bike that Akashi sent me. She said she wanted me to be her brand ambassador... Doesn't that job sound badass?
Look, Boss, this is the new bike that Akashi sent me. She said she wanted me to be her brand ambassador... Doesn't that job sound badass?
Akashi said she'd give me this bike in exchange for some "marketing." Sooo... Boss, what do you think? Wanna buy one?
This baby's got more horsepower than the other one, even if it's less reliable. She's still a good bike.
Worried about your hair? Well, safety's the most important thing on the road, so you'd better hang on to this helmet.
Boss, would you like to learn about motorcycles? I thought you might. Let's begin with starting the engine. First...
Do you hear it, boss? The rumbling of her engine? She thirsts for the open road. What are you waiting for? Hop on! But don't forget your helmet.
Boss, the mountains are lovely this time of year. How about it?
I once thought myself a traveler, with nothing to tie me down, with no real destination... Turns out I was wrong, Boss. I'll always come back to you, no matter what happens.
Cleveland-class light cruiser - Montpelier, hull number CL-57.

Listen, the Cleveland-class were the most powerful cruisers the Eagle Union had in the war. You should show more respect for my big sis. ... Me? I was in the battles of Midway, Augusta Bay, and a few others. I guess I did okay.
You're a commander? You don't... look reliable. But my big sis works for you... I've no choice, then. Montpelier, reporting for duty. I don't really care whether you give me orders or not.
So, you're back. I'll take my leave, then. It's too crowded in here for me.
Big sis! ... Oh, it's you. Need something?
How can I be more like Cleveland... "Smile"? ... That might not be possible...
I don't get along with anyone but my sisters. As for you, Commander... I'll try.
Commander, I'm curious: when my sister's doing secretary work, what's she like?
... Huh? If you've no need of me, don't call for me.
G-gotta put up with it... This is obviously a test of the trust I have for my big sis...!
Commander, we've got a mission. Time's money... get going already.
Rewards, eh... Guess this is part of my job. I'll go get them.
I left your mail over here.
Well done. You should get some rest.
A commission's done. Aren't you gonna welcome the team back?
I'm one step closer to my big sis...!
Knights of the Sea, onwards!
This is how victory feels... Not bad.
Big sis... I'm sorry... I've stained the reputation of the Knights of the Sea...
You're an eyesore. Disappear!
Big sis told me... to never give up!
Guess my big sis can't tell good and bad people apart...
I don't get why my big sis chose you. But I trust her intuition.
My big sis is... strong, cool, has a golden smile, and she could probably beat anyone in a fight... I want to be like her one day.
I used to think commanding was just about giving orders from a comfy room while sounding like a bigshot... But after seeing it for myself, now I understand. You have a tough job, Commander.
I don't just blindly listen to everything my big sis says. I listen because she's always right... And I finally get why she chose you. It's because you're outstanding.
Big sis told me to follow my heart. Which is why I'm here: to follow my heart. Are you following yours, Commander?
...Thanks. I'll give you something in return later.
... I won't embarrass you, big sis!
Night battles? Two can play at that game!
Let us become fine warriors who will not disappoint our sister!
So this is Sakura-style New Year's attire... If Cleve was also interested in this... Hm? Commander, were you watching? Um, well, Happy New Year's.
So this is Sakura-style New Year's attire... If Cleve was also interested in this... Hm? Commander, were you watching? Um, well, Happy New Year's.
The Sakura Empire's New Year's celebration is... a bit different from my expectations.
The sleeves on this outfit are long and heavy... and this, uh... dress? It's really hard to move around in. Don't they find this cumbersome?
If Cleve was to wear this outfit... Hmm, I can't picture it after all.
My New Year's wish...? I'd like to get a bit closer with Cleve, I suppose...
...You'd like to see me dance in this outfit? Commander, you're as prone to flights of fancy as always.
Everyone is hard at work preparing for New Year's... but what in the world is going on inside that head of yours?

Spending the end of the year with you isn't so bad... You really still want to see me dance in this outfit? Hmm... I'm probably a bit rusty, but let's just consider it a rehearsal for when I'm doing this for Cleve.
As unreliable as you are, I didn't think you'd be too scared to approach a movie prop... You're just "admiring it from a distance?" ...Fair enough.
As unreliable as you are, I didn't think you'd be too scared to approach a movie prop... You're just "admiring it from a distance?" ...Fair enough.
"Welcome back, darling." ...This feels wrong. Doesn't fit the scene.
This set really is expertly made. It shocked me when I first laid eyes on it.
I'm only wearing this dress because big sis told me to. It's the total opposite of the clothes I'm used to wearing... Hm? That's not the point of this all?
Change my pose? Okay. How's this? ...I have no clue what you think is so funny about this. Guess it doesn't matter as long as big sis is enjoying herself...
Wanna sit next to me? This thing is built to handle several people.
No thanks. I can get down on my own. The set isn't a hard climb or anything, I'm just not used to wearing this dress.
Are you that keen to taste the power of darkness?
Time to go back to the party? All right. Give me a moment to come down.
"Kneel to the power of darkness!" ...Is it cooler to recite this line from the script?
Ugh... It's so humid... And this water tastes weird... Commander? Did you just finish bathing? Alright, we could hang out if... No, you see, I've got this weird fever right now...
Ugh... It's so humid... And this water tastes weird... Commander? Did you just finish bathing? Alright, we could hang out if... No, you see, I've got this weird fever right now...
Don't you feel hot with all those clothes on, Commander? Hmm... I'm the only hot one here? No way that's true...
I don't get it, Commander... Why am I the only one feeling weak after my sisters and I all went into the hot spring?
Something wrong with my yukata, Commander? Ah, well, there weren't any Sakurans around, so I had to figure it out myself... The sash? I loosened it because it was too hot otherwise...
Hm? You're telling me that was alcohol I drank? No wonder I'm dizzy... I couldn't figure out why... Ugh. Gotta sober up somehow...
Ugh... This heat just won't go away... Commander... give me something to cool down with...
Mmh... Feels surprisingly... comfortable... Zzz...
Ohh... Your hand's nice and cold... Hey, wait! Don't move it away...
Mh... Aahh... Feels weird how... hot I feel... Wh-what do I do, Commander?
New missions? Right after getting out, too... Actually, if anything, I guess we might get it done more efficiently now...
Ah, rewards... I'd love to go fetch 'em for you, but, well...
I left your letters... over there...
You're back. Man, my head's spinning... Why are you wearing those thick clothes? Just looking at you makes me feel hot... Come here and I'll help you change into something else.
Time is money... Get out there and... welcome them back...
Ugh... Commander... It's so hot I can't sleep... This heat just won't let go of me... N-no, I'm not saying it's your fault necessarily... Still—think you could... help me cool down a little?
Cleveland-class light cruiser - Denver (CL-58)

I am Denver, fourth ship of the Cleveland-class light cruisers. I fought hard alongside my sisters in the Battle of Empress Augusta Bay. Though I still lack experience, I won't let you down, Commander!
Hello! I'm Denver, 4th Cleveland-class cruiser and Knight of the sea! Before I officially start working for you, I've got one question: what is the future you want to see?
Welcome back, Commander! Today's a fine day to sortie!
Commander, what do you do for your own training? Why don't you come join us down here every now and then?
I want to fight alongside my sisters again, just like at Augusta Bay.
I want to be able to dominate the battlefield with swagger, just like Cleveland.
Even though many of my younger sisters were converted into light aircraft carriers, I'm not jealous of them at all. After all, it's best to be yourself.
How strange, Commander, you're also a fan of the "bro fist?" I thought we were the only ones who used that greeting.
Commander, what are you trying to feel for?
Rain or shine, hell or high water, I'm always ready to sortie!
We were able to complete our mission without a hitch because of everyone's superb teamwork!
Commander, check your mail!
Welcome back! I prepared some refreshments, but... Sorry, this isn't exactly my forte.
Let's load up some extra supplies. In a battle of attrition, we can't let supplies run out before our spirits do.
I'll make sure to put this power to good use!
All the stars in the sky are our enemies! Everyone, fiiiiire!
Let's seize the day! And the next!
I'm still not... mature enough?
Your weak point... is here!
Scars are the only battle honors I need!
Commander, where's your dignity!?
Before I met you, Commander, I felt like I was always trapped within Cleveland's shadow.
I've relentlessly honed my skills in order to defeat all our enemies, but... is that really all there is to life?
Even though I don't think I can ever truly grasp the kind of future that you are envisioning, if it is something that you can stand by firmly, it must be very dazzling and beautiful.
Commander, you are the one who I admire and look up to the most... so if one day, you ever decide to turn your back on the person you are now, I will make sure... to drag you back!

Commander, your ideals and morals are loftier and purer than anyone else's... From now on, can I have the privilege of being your sword so that I may cut aside everything barring you from your future?
I'll cherish it!
Cleve, you're always kickin' ass!
Aahhh... This is heaven! Hm? Commander, wanna join me? Oh, the bath just felt so good I couldn't help but moan! There's no funny business going on!
Aahhh... This is heaven! Hm? Commander, wanna join me? Oh, the bath just felt so good I couldn't help but moan! There's no funny business going on!
Fwaaah... Soaking in the hot springs is sooo relaxing~ Oh, Commander, work's been doing a number on you, right? Come right in, then!
Cleve always told me that laziness is an enemy that we must all defeat... but right now, I wanna be buddy-buddy with it... for just a bit longer... Haah... feels so good...
Commander, these dango are soft yet chewy, a perfect mouthfeel! Add in this matcha... and you've got a complete hot springs experience!
Huh? I shouldn't drink while soaking in the bath? Of course I know! ...Hmm, what am I pouring right now? It's water, of course!

Wondering why I have a private indoor bath when there's also an outdoor bath I could go to? Heheh~ it's because I wanted to relax and have some time to myself... Oh, but, it's a different story if you're here, Commander! Being with you is always best, wherever that is!
H-hwuh?! Did you just find my weak point?!
Whoa, a surprise attack from the Commander! Well, take this - Denver Splash! H-huh? Why didn't you dodge? I-it's not like I was trying to get you wet on purpose...
Wooooah! ...That was close! I almost flipped the tray over...
Welcome back, Commander! The tea's still warm, so go ahead and drink up!

Ever hear that saying that you should share the best things with those you love most... W-well, umm, that's why I wanna share this bath with you, Commander! So, umm... wanna come in? I just... want to be a bit closer to you!
Asashio-class destroyer number one - Asashio.

Asashio-class nameship, Asashio. Arashio and I, along with our friends, formed the 8th DesDiv. Though we were disbanded in the end, I strongly believe that we'll be able to be together again one day. Commander... do you want to help me find them?
I am Asashio. I've come to join this fleet in order to search for my missing comrade. Commander, do you also have someone who you could not give up on?
Welcome back, Commander. If you don't want to set sail right away, why don't you rest first?
I'd like to stay here forever... But at this rate, I won't be able to find Arashio.
Dampier Strait? I don't really want to think about that place anymore... More importantly, Commander, can you install another anti-air gun?
Happiness is a full belly and a good night's sleep.
*Yawns* ...It's already so late, but Commander is still at it... Please make sure to take care of yourself.
Don't worry, I... am not afraid anymore!
What a weird feeling...
Commander, your missions... Please show some motivation once in a while.
The mission rewards... can I use them to buy something to eat?
Shall I go through the email for you? Maybe there's a letter from Arashio...
There is nothing more reassuring than being here. Commander, don't you think so too?
Isn't it about time to welcome the others back?
I think... it'd be better to mount another anti-air gun.
Anti-air preparations... is everything in place?
It seems that I accidentally did something awesome...
If only I had upgraded my anti-air equipment a bit more...
This time... I won't fail again!
The situation... seems to not be ideal.
Arashio... Where are you?
Every time I look out into the horizon, memories of that time come flooding back to me...
I had another nightmare yesterday. Commander, would you please stay with me tonight? That black abyss, not being able to see anything... I'm scared...
Commander, I'm at ease when I'm with you... But every time I think about Arashio, I get anxious again...
Commander, you're somehow always able to put my heart at ease. But recently, I've discovered something else that scares me... Commander, you'll always stay by my side... right?
If there's one good thing that's happened to me, it's that I was able to meet you, Commander. Will you stay by my side until I fall asleep? Tonight... and tomorrow... and every night...
How'd you even know what I like? Commander, could it be... that you're a mind-reader?!
This time... let's go home, together.
I also like cute girls. Hm? It's not the same?
I love to sing as well~

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Let's take things nice and slow.
Michishio is here at this port, and you are too, Commander. I want to stay here forever.
Did you sleep well and have enough to eat? Good, good, that's what I want to hear. Pat, pat...
Zzzzz... Commander...? Can I stay like this a little longer...? Good night, Commander... Zzzzz...
Would you like to have a tea party with Michishio and the others? ...Commander, I want us to go together.
I'll protect you, Commander.
Commander, there's a new mission... Let's do our best, together.
The mission rewards... Let's bring some along for Ooshio.
New mail... Should I try singing it aloud like Michishio does?
I feel safest when I'm with you and the others. Don't you think so too, Commander?

lines.line: My name is Asashio, and I just transferred here today. Pleased to meet you... Even though I might not be able to get caught up with the course work, Mr. Kitty and I will do our best.
My name is Asashio, and I just transferred here today. Pleased to meet you... Even though I might not be able to get caught up with the course work, Mr. Kitty and I will do our best.
It's time to go to school again... Commander, want to walk with me?
I wonder if I can find Arashio here at school...?
How nice it'd be to go to school with Arashio...
Mr. Kitty always likes to rub against peoples' legs.
*yawn*...It feels nice to take a nap during class, but... I probably shouldn't, right?
Commander... do you also want Mr. Kitty to rub against you?
Happy New Year, Commander. I am here to spend the New Year with you. Would you be so kind as to first help me down from here?
Happy New Year, Commander. I am here to spend the New Year with you. Would you be so kind as to first help me down from here?
Commander, would you like some hot tea and a mikan orange?
So warm... Commander, would you like some? Here, you should enjoy hot tea like this... Fwoo, fwoo... Then just let the warmth spread over you.
Are you cold, Commander? ...That's no good. Mm, you'll warm up if I give you a hug like this.
I can't finish all the food that everyone brought... Commander, if you don't mind, could you help finish mine?
Even though we can't have a tea party during the winter, it's fun to sit around and chat with everyone inside the kotatsu.
Hold hands...? Okay.
There are still letters coming in even though it's New Year's day.
For your sake, Commander, I shall do my best.
Commander, thank you for coming to see me. I'm currently rehearsing my program for the Spring Festival performance. I do hope it is to your liking.
Commander, thank you for coming to see me. I'm currently rehearsing my program for the Spring Festival performance. I do hope it is to your liking.
Flutter, flutter... I've been trying my best to learn these dance steps. How do I look, Commander?
*Bum* *Bum* *Bum*... The drums' sound makes me feel all fluttery... Oh, Commander, are you okay? I'm... not too heavy, am I?
Shall I give you a shoulder massage since you've been working so hard? Rub, rub... Does that feel good?
Um, Michishio chose this outfit, Arashio picked out this hair accessory, and Ooshio chose this anklet... Do you think they look good on me?
The fact that all of us used to be separated... but can all come together to prepare for a show like this... is a dream come true...
The long and fluttery sleeves are beautiful, aren't they?
It's hard to dance like this...
Everyone's been bringing me gifts. These snacks from the Dragon Empery smell so good... Commander, do you want some as well?
If it's for you, Commander, I know I can win.
Asashio-class destroyer number two - Ooshio.

I'm Ooshio, Asashio-class ship number two~ I served as the flagship of Destroyer Division 8 and did all kindsa things with Asashio, Michishio, 'n Arashio, 'n I was even awarded a few medals~ Then I took some damage 'n Asashio was put in charge, but that's all in the past now. Anyhow, why don'tcha tell me a bit 'bout this fleet?
Oh, I found me a talented-lookin' Commander~ "How so"? Cause I saw all them talented-lookin' girls ya got followin' ya~ I'm Ooshio. I'll be countin' on ya'll from now on~
Commander, let's stay focused 'n work hard to make everyone happy~
Who's yer favorite girl, Commander? Reckon ya could tell me?
Yer makin' me jealous of how yer surrounded 'round the clock by such talented girls~
Asashio's a real cutie~ Hehehe~
Commander, if yer bored, why don'tcha call some folks over 'n we can have a tea party?
Wonder what I oughta make for desert... Ah, ya want some too, Commander? Aw heck, yer puttin' me in a tight spot~
Oh my, I better tell the others that yer a dangerous one, Commander~
It's mission time, Commander.
The mission rewards done arrived, Commander~
Got a letter for ya, Commander~ *Giggle*, ain't this a... luve letter?
Ya made it back in one piece~ Ya ain't injured, are ya...?
Ah, the commission team's back? ...Ain't that nice~ Wish you'd let me go on one too~
Thanks much~
Take care now so ya'll don't get hurt~
I done saw how fine ya'll fought~
Ya can't let a small setback getcha feelin' blue~
For the sake of the fleet~
We don't gotta force ourselves~
I reckoned we'd never be able to understand each other...
Girls are just the cutest darn thing~ And who on earth doesn't like cute things?
Whether they're boys or girls, if they're talented 'n cute, I love 'em all the same~ It's not yer gender that matters, it's what's inside~
Yer a good person, Commander~ Now I get why the fleet believes in ya~ I'll letcha in on a li'l secret: I done fallen for a certain someone... Hehehe~
Hehehe~ Yer the talented and cute person I fell for~ How 'bout you, Commander? Do ya love me too?
I love you, 'n you love me too, ain't that just the darndest thing~ Don'tcha agree, Com-man-der? ♡
Oh my. Heehee~ Thank you, Commander.
Yuudachi, I'm over here~
Set sail, Destroyer Division 8~
Merry Christmas~ Commander, we gotta go hand out presents to them destroyers~ You be Santa, I'll be yer reindeer~
Merry Christmas~ Commander, we gotta go hand out presents to them destroyers~ You be Santa, I'll be yer reindeer~
This costume here's a bit too tight... I oughta get a new one next year...
Oh yeah, whaddya want for Christmas, Commander? I can get it for ya, even if it takes some lookin' 'round.
Christmas is more fun when ya get everyone together 'n throw a big party~
By the end of the year, everyone'll be smilin'~♪ Hehe, it makes me happy, too~
You wonderin' why I wanna be the one handin' out presents? Cause I wanna see those cute smiles on everyone's faces, ya silly~
Well, fine... Think of it as my Christmas gift to you~♡
Ain't it more fun if we treat these mission rewards as presents from headquarters?
Letter for ya, Commander~ Hehe, wouldn't it be nice if it's a thank-you letter from a good girl to Santa?
I got presents for all you girls who made it back safely~ There's one for you too, Commander~
Commander, ya got time once we're done handin' out presents? Heheh, cause I've got a special present for you, my sweetheart~ Just don't be too surprised when I show it to ya~
Happy anniversary~ Today's a day to enjoy to yer heart's content, ya know? I'm just havin' fun in my own way, checkin' out cute girls from afar~ I appreciate yer concern though, Commander~
Happy anniversary~ Today's a day to enjoy to yer heart's content, ya know? I'm just havin' fun in my own way, checkin' out cute girls from afar~ I appreciate yer concern though, Commander~
Fancy a drink, Commander? It's pretty darn nice stuff~ Hehehe, don't be shy now! I might be heckin' drunk, but I won't bite~
Wonder if Asashio's here yet... Not done been abducted by some criminal, has she... Am I just worryin' over nothin', Commander?
Albacore, don't go causin' mischief durin' the party, all right? Commander, I reckon you oughta tell her too.
Michishio 'n Arashio almost love Asashio as much as I do~ That's why we all love havin' tea parties with her. You too, Commander, go become buddy buds with her~
Commander, it ain't nice of ya to check out other girls while yer talkin' to me~! Where are yer manners?
Commander? What're ya starin' at me for...?
Gawsh... Girl has a sip of wine 'n this happens... Yer lucky it's me ya did it to~!
The world is all spinny~ I guess I am pretty drunk... Commander~ What do I oughta do to sober up...?
C'mon, ya'll, follow my lead~
Hm...? I've might've fallen for ya again, Commander... You look even more charmin' than usual... What about me? Ya think I'm cuter than usual?
Should I hang this "fortune" poster here...? Oh, Commander, did ya also want a Spring Festival present from Ooshio here? Just kiddin'~ Hehe, anyway, happy Lunar New Year~
Should I hang this "fortune" poster here...? Oh, Commander, did ya also want a Spring Festival present from Ooshio here? Just kiddin'~ Hehe, anyway, happy Lunar New Year~
Are ya fixin' for some tea, Commander? Then have some brewed usin' tea leaves I got from Yat Sen~
It's nice wearin' a cute dress 'n minglin' with a bunch of cuties~ I don't mind you oglin' me if ya want, Commander.
Ain't family get-togethers a tradition 'round this time of year? I'll call over my sisters for a little tea time... No wait, we'll have tangyuan instead! Wanna join us, Commander?
Kasumi, how's about joinin' us for a night out? You can bring Foo and yer friends too, if ya want~
If everyone's happy, then I'm happy too~ You feelin' happy, Commander?
My hair ornament's slid out of place? Aw, thanks, Commander~
Commander, this ain't the place or place for lewdin', all right~?
Go on, spend some time with all the cuties 'n have a relaxin' holiday!
Finally we're through with them mornin' classes~ Commander, would ya fancy havin' lunch with me? Heheh, yer wonderin' what I done made? You'll see for yerself soon 'nuff~
Finally we're through with them mornin' classes~ Commander, would ya fancy havin' lunch with me? Heheh, yer wonderin' what I done made? You'll see for yerself soon 'nuff~
How'd ya like my home cookin'? ...Heheh, glad to hear it~ Ya can have as much as ya want.
These special-made uniforms're real nice - everyone looks so cute in 'em~ Whole school's a feast for the eyes, ain't it, Commander?
I done made a lunch box for my li'l Asashio too. Stay right here while I go 'n give it to her.
These kitties got such squishy li'l bellies~ Have a feel for yerself, Commander!
What do ya say we invite Michishio 'n Kasumi over for a tea party after our club activities're over?
Do ya wanna feed these li'l kitties, Commander? Heheh~
You tryin' to come on to me, Commander? Ain't you a real skirt chaser~
Ya got a letter, Commander! Heh, do ya want me to leave it in yer shoe locker?
Oh! I was just wonderin' where ya went. Is that a can of green tea? Much obliged~
The commission team done returned. Give them hardworkin' girls a treat for their efforts~
Just goes to show what teamwork can accomplish~
For dessert, we'll be havin' some schoolgirl eye candy~ Aww, why ya lookin' bummed out? I know you've always got room for sweeties, hon. Hehehe♪
Third ship of Asashio class destroyers, Michishio.

I'm the third ship of the Asashio-class, Michishio. I was part of the 8th and 24th Destroyer Squadrons, until finally I was assigned to the 4th Destroyer Squadron. That's when I joined the Battle of Leyte Gulf... Hmm, even though I'm pretty unlucky, I'm hoping everyone here will still be my friend!
Petaaals of the saaaakuuuraaa... Oh, hello, Commander. Nice to meet you. I'm Michishio. It's a pleasure.
Oh, hello. Do we have everything we'll need today? Better make sure.
Commander? If there's anything you want me to do, please let me know. I love helping out.
Laa laa laa ♪ It's another beautiful day today, Commander!
What should I make for the girls today... Any ideas, Commander?
It's great seeing all the happy faces here every day. I truly love it here♪
What's wrong, Commander? Are you tired? Thirsty? Hungry? Aaanything you need, I'll take care of it.
Aie! Commander... You're dirty...
Commander, I'm putting the new mission documents right here, okay?
Commander? The mission rewards have been delivered!
Commander, you've got mail.
You came back. Thank goodness.
Commander, shouldn't we go out to meet the girls you sent out on commission? It's about time for them to be getting back.
Now I'll be able to protect everyone.
I don't want to lose any friends today!
B-but everyone pitched in... Um, I'm... I just, everyone's looking at meee!
Wait! Please don't leave me heeere!
Everyone... just a little bit longer...!
I don't think I can be friends with you, Commander...
Commander, can I give you a hand with anything? Any little old thing? Really, I can do aaaaaanything♪
I've lost a lot of friends over the years... Asashio and them, Suzukaze, Umikaze... I'm so afraid to lose any more... I'll do anything for my friends...
Helping people makes me happy. Hm? You don't want me to overdo it? You're worried about me after all, Commander~

I'm not taking care of myself...? Commander, you're such a worrywart... Since you're so concerned about me, can I ask you for a favor? Commander, I want you to promise me you'll aaalways be with me, forever and ever...
I've never been so happy before... But I know today is just the start of an even happier life, isn't it? It definitely is, isn't it, Commander♪
My, my. Are you sure you want to give me such an expensive present?
Hello, Commander. Oh, you think I look good in this fluttery dress~? Thank you very much!
Hello, Commander. Oh, you think I look good in this fluttery dress~? Thank you very much!
Commander, would you like to take a stroll? There are cute little butterflies in this garden~
The butterflies go fluttering by~♪ Oh, the Manjuus are also chasing after the butterflies.
Ooshio looks very mature in her dress, doesn't she~ It's a bit too soon for me still, right?
These balloons? I got them from Ariake. She brought a bunch just for the occasion; isn't that amaaazing?
It's so nice throwing a party in nice and warm weather! Commander, do you prefer this, or a fancy banquet?
You want to see me spin around? Spiiiin, spiiiin~♪
Eep! Commander, my tail's all tickly~
I'm glad I came along with my sisters~
Asashio-class destroyer number four - Arashio.
I am Arashio, the fourth Asashio-class destroyer. I was part of Destroyer Division 8 along with Ooshio, Michishio, and of course Asashio. Lastly... I hope I can stay with everyone this time around.
Destroyer Arashio, here to join your fleet. I'll provide everyone with the support they need~
You don't find my appearance odd? I feel the best way to greet someone is with a smile!
I feel a little sad when I see planes in the air... But it's okay, that's all in the past. What's more important is keeping my chin up and smiling. Right, Commander?
Asashio and I have always been together. Yup, we even sleep in the same bed. She's so quiet when she's sleeping.
We might not always be able to stick together, but we'd never leave anyone behind... That's why this place feels like home to me.
I've made you some tea. Take your time to savor it. By the way, is my tea-making ability to your liking?
Mmh... I try not to think about why we all got separated. Besides, we got to reunite here, so let's instead live our lives happily ever after.
Eeeeek! ... Is this truly necessary to become an adult?
New missions have appeared. I'll gladly help you with them, Commander.
A mission has been completed. You did a great job, Commander!
You've received mail. Shall we go see what it is, Commander?
Stellar work, Commander. Would you like to rest your head in my lap?
Commander, I believe the commission team has returned. Let us head over to receive them.
Now it'll be easier for me to avoid getting hurt. Thank you, Commander.
Everyone, try to avoid getting hurt if you can...
Why, I'm the MVP...? Hmm, this might not be so bad.
There's no need to worry, we'll win the next time!
I'll keep everyone out of harm's way.
You must remain calm in the face of danger. Don't worry about me.
Oh, Asashio? There there, there's nothing to be afraid of... You'll have to excuse me, I need to stay with Asashio.
I'd like to get to know you, Commander. *Giggle*, what should we start with?
Did you have another nightmare? Aww, relax, Commander, everything will be okay.
It's gotten quite late... But I really enjoyed chatting with you! Say, don't your shoulders get stiff from sitting down all day? Would you like a massage?
We're all to ourselves now. My heart's been thumping for some time now... Commander, could we huddle up next to each other, just for a little while?
Commander, I won't say anything indecent, but there's one thing I want to tell you... Umm... I'll always be there to support you. Your side is the place where I truly belong.
Heehee. You really get me, don't you? I'd be honored to receive such a wonderful present!
Destroyer Division 8, let's all stick together now.
Asashio, I'm right by your side. Don't be scared.
Looks like you found me, Commander. Hehe, want to light some fireworks with me? Spending time together should be more fun than being alone, right?
Looks like you found me, Commander. Hehe, want to light some fireworks with me? Spending time together should be more fun than being alone, right?
Commander, do you like fireworks? In that case, I'll help you light some~
The shimmering of fireworks reflected across the water's surface... How enchanting and ephemeral...
Sparklers might not be as gorgeous as the fireworks that blossom in the sky, but it's nice to be able to have something you can enjoy at your own pace.
Asashio, will you be able to remember this place? Try not to get lost, okay?
It's so quiet along the river bank... You can even hear the soft crackling of fireworks.
Commander, I'm really glad I get to enjoy fireworks with you and the others~
Eek... Are you doing this because there are no people nearby...?
Is this... a new sparkler? Thanks, Commander~
Edinburgh-class light cruiser - Belfast.

I am Belfast, born in Harland and Wolff. Yes, the same place as the Titanic. I actually have an older sister. She hasn't taken care of me very much, however... Umm, that's all I was going to say. Master, what type of person are you?

My Master is also a commander... Umm, so the commander is a captain of a ship? I don't quite understand, but... I will stay here for a while if you don't mind. I am Belfast, maid-in-training. It is a pleasure to serve you.
Master, would you like some tea?
To perform a curtsy, a lady puts her feet across each other like— Forgive me, I failed to do it...
You'd like whiskey and coffee... Umm, d-do you not drink tea...?
Master, is there anything you would like me to do?
Master, neglecting your commander duties is a big no-no!
Master, you'll end up a failure if you rely on others too often. Sometimes, you must— Mmh, you leave me no choice. I-I won't help you next time, okay...?
Don't worry, Master. Even if you go to prison, I will still bring you your meals.
Master, should you really let all these mission documents pile up...?
The mission rewards are here. If I prove to be of service to you, will I receive rewards too?
Master, would you like me to leave this letter here...?
Are you hungry, Master? I'm feeling quite peckish. Shall we eat together?
Master, the ladies have returned from their commission and are waiting for you.
I'm not quite used to fighting, but please have faith in me.
It's a maid's duty to remove her Master's obstacles!
This isn't... anything to brag about. Isn't that right, Master?
A lady must be elegant, even in defeat... *Sob*...
Dear enemies, this is going to be a liiiittle bit painful.
Master, perhaps it would be a good idea to retreat...?
You are more troublesome than a kitchen stain, Master.
There are so many ships here... Master, does "commander" refer to an incredibly wealthy person who owns a shipyard?
Do I feel nervous? Well, Master is a nice person, and none of the ladies here are merchant ships, so I have nothing to be nervous about.
I now completely understand how you think, Master... Umm, is this what's known as "empathy"? No, perhaps it's just overly easy to understand you, Master...
Master, do you think I will be a lady worthy of you, when I grow up?
Does this mean you "approve of me"? Thank you, Master. However... if I wear this ring, people may get the wrong idea about you... P-perhaps you should think this through more thoroughly?
How should I return this favour...
Roberts-class monitor - Abercrombie.
I'm the Monitor Abercrombie. My sister and I used to help with shore bombardment around the Mediterranean Sea. Tee hee~ It's way more fun to shoot stationary targets~
Take THIS! - Oh, Commander? Tee hee~ I'm Abercrombie! Lovely weather today, eh~?
That loud bang? Tee hee~ You were gone for so long I was getting bored, so I let a shot loose~
It's so much fun to fire my gun~!
My hobby's collecting shell casings~! Hey, don't you think shell casings are super cool?
Top of the mornin', granny Hood!
Whuaah! Hey, Wales! Granny Hood is giving me creepy looks~!
Commander, want some crisps? Here you go! ... Roberts, come here! I found the crook who ate your crisps!
Whuaaah!
Commander, there are new missions! Tee hee~ What'll we be sinking this time? I can't wait~
Commander, is the next mission gonna be as fun as the last one?
Oh, have I hidden your mail~? Want it back? Then get some snacks and bar-ter for it! Bar-ter for it!
Hey, Commander~ Brought back anything gander-worthy? Like a piece of wreckage or parts from a crashed aircraft or something?
Target spotted, calculating trajectory... Bugger, it's just the commission team. Laaaame...
Tee hee~ I might be loading a teensy bit too much gunpowder~
Tee hee, what should I knock out first? Their bow? Turret? Engine?
Kaboom! Ahaha~ You can't beat the Mark I!
Tsk. Lame.
Be torn to shreds by my shells!
Whuaaah! My armour!
Tee hee~ Commander, did you know you can use the Mark I as a blunt weapon? I'll show you! (Pow!)
Tee hee~ How do you like my habanero curry? - Huh...? W-wait, Nelson! I didn't know that one was yours! - Don't hurt meeee!
Oh, Commander~! Com-man-der! Coooommaaaandeeeer! What? It was nothing. I just wanted to see your face~ Tee hee~
Feeling stressed out? Then try out my Mark I! Fire a shot for every worry you have to make them disappear with a bang! You'll get hooked on it!
I wonder if I can combine you and my Mark I... Commander, for the next sortie, how about you sit atop it while issuing commands?
W-wow! Thanks! I'll never take it off! I-in exchange, take my Mark I! Roberts told me you're supposed to give your partner your dearest possession at times like these!
This is... wicked sick!
Auntie Hood, I'm here to help!
Nobody does pranks better than me!
Kabooom! You thought it was a pumpkin, but it was me, Abercrombie, with my Mark I! Commander, did I scare you senseless? Muahaha!
Kabooom! You thought it was a pumpkin, but it was me, Abercrombie, with my Mark I! Commander, did I scare you senseless? Muahaha!
Tee hee~ Who knows where I've planted my pumpkin surprise~
Trick or treat! Give me candy, or you'll taste one of my pranks! Although, even if you give me some... well, you'll see for yourself! Tee hee~
Take a gander at my Halloween Mark I! Looks cracking, doesn't it!
Nelson's wearing a Halloween costume?! Really?! Let me have a look at it, Commander!
If only we had more holidays where you could cause mischief and get away with it scot-free~
Shake hands with my Halloween Mark I! Come on, Mark I, show the Commander your special trick~!
Taste the retribution of my Mark I! (Pow!)
I wonder how people would react if they got my custom-made horseradish candy~ Tee hee~!
Now for a ghost pepper while nobody's looking... Tee hee! Perfect! I wonder who'll be the lucky one to sip- C-Commander?! You didn't see anything suspicious... Right? Tee hee~
Now for a ghost pepper while nobody's looking... Tee hee! Perfect! I wonder who'll be the lucky one to sip- C-Commander?! You didn't see anything suspicious... Right? Tee hee~
ello there! How about a glass of delicious and nutritious carrot juice? ...Wait, stop, not that one! THIS one's for you! Phew... Disaster averted...
Carrot juice has just the perfect consistency. You can put anything you like in the glass, and nobody'll know!
Shaking the bottle? Pfft, that's the oldest trick in the book. I'll teach you a newer one, Commander!
Oh bollocks! It's Nelson! Quick, Commander, I need a place to hide!
You're silly, Erebus. All I asked for was a little inspiration, not the full recipe for some kind of magic potion!
Bottoms up, like adults do! Drink up, Mark I!
Bring our customers their drinks, Manjuus! And be careful so you don't drop them!

Found you! No criminals are escaping on my watch! You have the right to remain silent! Everything you say can and will be used against you in a court of law! Tee hee, now surrender peacefully, Commander!

Found you! No criminals are escaping on my watch! You have the right to remain silent! Everything you say can and will be used against you in a court of law! Tee hee, now surrender peacefully, Commander!
Tee hee! You willingly went back into your cell? Looks like life on the outside wasn't what it used to be!
Commander, have a gander at this! My Mark I got an original makeover! Isn't that lovely? This will surely be handy for the upcoming shoot when... Dangerous? Not at all! It's not loaded, see?

Let's play a game of naval cat and mouse! You'll run away while we try to catch you. By the way, what do you think happens to the mouse when the cat catches it? ...How's that? Pretty strong acting, right?
Escapees always end up cornered! Inmate 001, give up and surrender peacefully!
How bold, patting the warden's head like this! I do like it... but I'm still arresting you! Tee hee! Don't give me lip about how it's "cowardly"!
Hm? You can bribe me with candy, but I'm still going to arrest you!
Whuaah! Wait, what are you doing?! We're still filming!
Oh? A new mission? Did an inmate escape? Got it! Mark I Search Team, find them!
We caught the escaped inmate! Mission complete!
Welcome back, Commander! The shooting starts in a minute! But first, tell me about all the cool stuff you saw today!
Tee hee! There's no criminal who can escape ME!
La-la-la, I can't hear you!
Let's cuff you up! Tee hee, you're not going anywhere! Now you're a prisoner to me and me alone! I get to choose which ward you're going to. We'll never be apart again!
London-class heavy cruiser - Sussex.

Other than the coastal defence battle in the Mediterranean Sea and that one naval battle up north, I pretty much carried out all my missions normally... Well, there was that one time I needed serious repairs... b-but anyway! Since I'm here, I'll continue to put my best foot forward. Commander, I expect the same from you!
So you're the Commander? Hmph! Let's make one thing clear: I'm not easygoing like my sister, London. I'll expect you to have your act together!
Are you ready to begin working? Don't come running to me if you find out later that you're missing something.
Shropshire can be quite a handful to deal with... But, I suppose since she's the type of person who won't ever let herself draw the short straw, you should just let her be.
Excessive kindness can become poison. One must be strict when the situation calls for it.
If you have time to gawk at me, you should get your work done first. After you finish, then you can, um...
... If you're tired, get some rest. I'm not saying this for your sake - it's simply better if you're ready to give it your all when the situation calls for it.
Commander, your collar is messed up. And your hair too... Hold still, I'll fix it for you.
Commander, sit right there! Good grief... I'll have to re-teach you some basic manners...!
Before acting, one must first consider the most efficient way of getting things done - you haven't forgotten, right?
So these are the mission rewards! Commander, you're quite the capable one~
Please do not forget to check your mail.
There's a lot to report still, but for now, good work.
And that should be time... Commander, the commission team should be returning any moment now.
Thank you. I'll continue to work hard on the next mission.
For the sake of not bringing shame upon the fleet, let us fight!
Don't think that winning is the only thing that matters. There are still many things I could have done better.
This was due to my failure as a leader. Don't blame yourselves, everyone.
Let's make this shot count!
Everyone, tighten the formation!
London is too much of a people-pleaser, and all her coddling seems to have turned you into mush.
The way London always has that smile plastered on her face no matter who she's around just rubs me the wrong way.
London is the type of person who would easily be deceived by a bad person, but still continue to smile despite knowing that... Jeez, just why does she have to have that kind of personality...

*sigh*... What's more, when I went to bring this up with her, she just gave me a pat on the head and said, "Thanks, Sussex, but it'll be alright." So, nothing changed at all... Good grief, why do people have to be so difficult...?
At least I'll feel at ease leaving London in your care... No, you'll have to become even more distinguished, to the point that I won't be able to look away from you... huh? What did I just say...?
