Commander, did you bring anything for me?
Commander, a commission's been completed~ I'll go check if they found anything neato♪
Bien joué, Commander!
They're just slightly bigger targets! On y va!
*Yawn*... Winning makes me sleepy, somehow... Mmh...
Oops, we lost... Commander, think we should flee?
*Giggle* Think you can dodge this?
I promised the Commander I'd fight and give it all I've got!
Oh, Commander, could you get back to work? I have more fun when you're not around.
So apparently, I'm named after a big-shot pirate! Some say that's pretty cool, but I'm not a fan of those guys, so I don't really care.
Salut~! Wanna go have some fun, Commander? Let's take a walk around town, go shopping, then fall asleep in a grass field~
Commander, I've found a fantastic napping place, and I'll tell you where it is. Oh, and don't tell anyone else, okay? Let's keep it a secret between just the two of us♪
*Giggle* Aren't we practically made for each other? It's not every day you find people as closely in synch as we are~ Say, isn't it time we become a couple now?
So, you wanna chain Surcouf to your side with this ring? Jeez, aren't you greedy~ But, since it's you... I might be fine with it♪
Ooh. Nice one, Commander!
Hmm? Commander, are you shopping as well? If so, why don't you come along and take a look around? ... Huh? Of course you can't climb on. That'd be illegal.
Hmm? Commander, are you shopping as well? If so, why don't you come along and take a look around? ... Huh? Of course you can't climb on. That'd be illegal.
Commander, are you ready? Then we're off to the next stop~
This scooter really is fantastic! A good buy for a good price~ Lucky me♪
Commander, you can give me puppy-dog eyes all you want, but I won't share my ice cream... F-fine, just one lick, got it?
My twin-gun turrets are also on vacation today! Gotta work hard and play hard!
Uhh, I don't think I'll bring the puppy with me next time... He's way too jumpy and almost even fell off the scooter once...
Oh, you finally noticed, Commander! That's right, I put my hair up just for today's ride! This is your only chance to see it like this.
I can't believe you. You almost made me drop my ice cream!
Here, Commander. You drive and I'll hold onto you from behind like this~ Mmm, now it feels like we're a real couple~ I've always wanted to try it out myself♪
Mmmh~ Bonjour, Commander~ Nothing feels better than the waves lapping at your skin~ Oh, Commander, why don't you come lie down and experience it for yourself?
Mmmh~ Bonjour, Commander~ Nothing feels better than the waves lapping at your skin~ Oh, Commander, why don't you come lie down and experience it for yourself?
Hey, Commander, done anything fun lately? I wanna know!
Sure, I go in the water all the time since I'm a submarine, but it's nice to just relax by the beach every now and then! *yaaaawn*... A girl needs her vacation time, you know~
Hey, Commander! Just lie on your back and I'll cover you with sand~
Go get the camera, Commander! I wanna take a photo of this.
Passepartout, could you get me some sunscreen? Oh, and Commander, would you mind rubbing it on for me?
You're head over heels for my gorgeous body, aren't you? Heheh, stare all you want, because I don't mind♡
Welcome back, Comma- Whuah! Geesh, that last wave was huge! You could've warned me that it was coming! Hmph!
L'Adroit-class destroyer - Le Mars.
Back then, I wasn't able to fulfill my duties, but... Commander, this time, I'll show you what I'm capable of!
Eh? Who are you... Ah! Right, you're the Commander! I'm the L'Adroit-class destroyer, Le Mars! A pleasure meetin' you!
Commander, you finally made it! What's on the training regimen today?
To be honest, I'm a little jealous of Forbin. Back then, we both weren't able to move, but she made more of the situation than me...
Commander, I'll teach you some stretches for those long days!
Being a commander sure is tough, isn't it? Having to micromanage this and that... My head would start spinning...
Studying just isn't my strong suit... I obviously can read all these words, but they just don't make any sense to me when put together...
My shoulders were starting to get stiff too... Thanks a ton, Commander!
Th-this place also needs a massage? Um... it feels a little strange...
We're not done with the missions quite yet. Let me handle the errands!
Mission complete! Huh...? I still have to tally the rewards?
Mail's here~! I already brought it all with me, ehehe~
Commander, you've gotta sweat to burn off fat!
Everyone's back! I'm gonna run down to greet them! Be right back!
I grow stronger yet again! Thanks, Commander!
Warm-up exercises are all done! I'm setting out~!
I'm in first place...? Très bien! Ehehe~!
Merdé! Time to retreat!
Time to do this~!
It's just a flesh wound! I'll tough it out!
Woah, Commander... I, I think I'll be training solo today!
To be an outstanding knight, it's not enough to just have the strength to protect others. You must also become wise through learning! But... I always start dozing off when I'm studying... *yawn*
Commander, you'll help me study? Yay! Thank you so much! I'll be sure to... Huuhh? Wait, I have to memorize all this?! S-sorry, I have a stomachache!
I think I'm starting to get it, but maybe not... But, I'm so glad that you're patient enough to teach a dummy like me. Thank you, Commander!
Even though I still don't quite understand this stuff, there is one thing that's certain - when it comes to learning things about you, Commander, I function twice as well!
Um... I haven't learned what I'm supposed to do at a place like this yet... Ah, um! In any case, p-please continue to take good care of me in the future!
Ah! I've always wanted one of these!
Forbin, shall I take the lead?
It's summer~! Summer is here, Commander! Let's head down to the beach to play! I'll show you why I'm feared in water gun fights!
It's summer~! Summer is here, Commander! Let's head down to the beach to play! I'll show you why I'm feared in water gun fights!
Commander, summer is finally here, so why such a long face~? Let's enjoy some fun in the sun on the beach~♪
This is no simple inner tube, Commander. It also doubles as "ammunition storage" for my water gun! How 'bout it? Wanna taste my waterpower~?
Commander, wanna share a watermelon?
Just because it's hot doesn't mean you should stay cooped up underneath the air conditioner all day. Let's play outside~!
Commander, you should also get a tan! That way, we'll match~♪ Ehehe~!
Sunscreen? I don't need that~!
C-Commander... that place doesn't need any sunscreen...
Ehehe, Commander, are you done with work for the day? Let's get going then! ...Huh? Where to? The beach, of course!
If you underestimate me just because I'm lightly equipped, I'll gladly teach you a lesson~!
Hey! Over here! Hehe. I didn't expect to run into you at school, Commander. What are you doing here?
Hey! Over here! Hehe. I didn't expect to run into you at school, Commander. What are you doing here?
I'll be bringing the heat at school today!
School life is all about running track under the warm sun, am I right!?
Commander, you should get us some more phys ed classes! I mean... exercise is really important!
Listening to music is a real good way to calm your mind when you wanna relax! Let's listen together, Commander.
Huh? Forbin's heading this way with a pile of notebooks? Um, is there a good hiding place around here—
The wind doesn't scare me!
I don't need a massage right now...
Uh oh... I can't get anything in this book to stick in my head...
Commander, thanks for coming to pick me up! I don't often get the chance to wear formal clothes, though it is a little hard to move around... Oh, but I can deal with it!
Commander, thanks for coming to pick me up! I don't often get the chance to wear formal clothes, though it is a little hard to move around... Oh, but I can deal with it!
Good morning, Commander! What kind of work will we start with today?
They do these crazy flips and spins in the movies, right? ...So what'd you think, Commander? I sure wish mine could look that good...
I can't do this... Reading books about etiquette puts me right to sleep... Huh? You're willing to be my practice partner? That'd be a huge help!
By the way, Commander, have you seen Forbin? ...Even though she's a total lightweight, she keeps trying to push herself... Ugh, I'm getting a bad feeling about this...
Phew... I finally managed to finish making my rounds... I was so nervous my body was stiff as a rock, but you looked like you were totally in your element... That's amazing, I tell you!
Um, this is how you're supposed to hold the champagne, right?
Um, is this also a part of my training...?
You seem pretty worn-out, Commander. Let's do some cool-down stretches! Maybe some mild exercise will make you feel better!
It's probably because I got a good warm-up in. Hehe~
Retro~ fit~ com~ plete! The new and improved Le Mars is at your service~!
Retro~ fit~ com~ plete! The new and improved Le Mars is at your service~!
My torpedoes and cannons are locked and loaded! Commander, I'm ready to sortie at any time!
Commander, are you that desperate to see my gallant form as I unload all my cannons and torpedo tubes? Ehehe, what am I going to do with you~
Hehe! Commander, is this victory pose cool? I saw it in an anime!
Commission or sortie, I'm ready to do anything! With how strong I am now, I won't let you down, Commander!
Is there something that needs doing? I'll be happy to shoulder even a little bit of your burdens.
Hehe, how about I be the one to give you a shoulder massage this time?
Welcome back, Commander! Shall we plan our next sortie?
Now, for a victory pose! ...Hey! Wait for meeee!
Dunkerque-class battlecruiser - Dunkerque.

I am Dunkerque, 1st Division of the Line of the Vichya Dominion. As you already know, there is no glory in my service history - there is no hiding this fact. However, if you are still willing to use me, I will not let you down.
The day when we can all stand together has come at last... It's an honor to be here, Commander. I am Dunkerque - please allow me to become a part of this magnificent fleet.
Commander, did you get enough rest?
What should I make... Macarons, or Mont-Blanc? Oh my, Commander, you came at just the right time. Why don't you help me decide what confection to make?
There are things in this world that you might never be able to accomplish, but that is no reason to give up hope.

It's not nice to sit around idly in port, but... Strasbourg, who took my place in leading the fleet, must feel even worse about what happened... if only the Army was able to hold out a little longer... *sigh*
Ahh~ Sweets can really take a girl to heaven... C-Commander?! How long have you been here?!
Commander, shall we make some confections together? My home country is world-famous for our sweets, you know?
What am I going to do with you...
There's no shortage of new missions for us to get through... Hard work is important and all, but let's not overwork ourselves.
Hm? I see, the mission rewards are here. Commander, I'll go get them.
Commander, I've finished sorting your mail, so don't forget to take a look.
Commander, would you like to try my freshly baked gâteau?
Oh my, it looks like the commission fleet has returned. Perfect timing - I'll invite them to try my new confections.
Every little bit matters.
Apologies. I have no mercy to spare for my enemies.
Let's keep up this pace.
T'en fais pas... a defeat here is not the end.
Let's do it just like we practiced...!
I'm only getting warmed up...
Ça faisait longtemps, Commander. There's no need to worry about me; I've been doing fine.
Glad you could make it, Commander. One moment please - the dessert is ready, I just have to make tea. Today, let's unwind and chat a little.
Back then, none of us had a choice... so I don't blame the Royal Navy for what happened. Quite the contrary - if it wasn't for them, we might not be fighting together now.
Commander, you're quite the conversationist. Do you find me interesting to talk to? Hehe, I make sure to remember all your preferences. Sit tight for a moment, and I'll bring some cake out for you.

True strength is not measured by our capacity to suffer in silence, but by our courage to open up to others. Commander, that's why... if you ever feel like crying, my bosom is always available for you.

If I only was able to meet you in the present because of my suffering in the past, I won't say things like "I wish I had met you sooner." However, I do hope that in the future, I will always be able to find solace in your embrace. Commander, can I stay by your side forever?
Merci beaucoup~
I've been waiting so long for summer... and it's so worth it - the sun, the sand, the waves, and everyone's laughter. Commander, why don't we take this opportunity to enjoy some crullers together?
I've been waiting so long for summer... and it's so worth it - the sun, the sand, the waves, and everyone's laughter. Commander, why don't we take this opportunity to enjoy some crullers together?
Commander, are you done changing into your swimwear~?
Everyone looks like they're having so much fun... I couldn't ask for anything more.
Ice-cream based desserts are delicious, but they melt too easily... I might have to bring a cooler with me next time...
It's been a long time since I last was able to enjoy scenery like this without any worries...
Commander, are you done changing? The others are calling for us, let's go play with them!
Want to try gazing into the ocean horizon together? It always puts my mind at ease.
Commander, would you like some ice cream? I brought several different flavors of syrup.
Enemies...? Way to spoil the scenery...
Who wants to have some crullers? I made more than enough for everyone~
Don't you simply adore the atmosphere in this place? It's one of my favorites. The desserts here are to die for. Would you like a taste?
Don't you simply adore the atmosphere in this place? It's one of my favorites. The desserts here are to die for. Would you like a taste?
Here you are, Commander. Oh? Don't worry, I've only just arrived myself.
What's your favorite dessert? I can make it for you, Commander.
......der, Commander! Look at you, staring at me and spacing out again, am I really so captivating? Did the ice in your drink melt?
Commander, shall we go for a stroll? How often do we get to go out on a date? Let's not waste this one sitting around chatting.
When I sit here like this, I sometimes forget I'm a warship... But, to fight for these little moments, that's not such a bad motivation, is it, Commander?
Just relax, Commander, we still have plenty of time.
Is it a very important mission? Well then, I'll go with you.
Commander, some mission rewards are available. Shall we head back to the office?
We have new intelligence? Well, don't worry about me. Please, check it at once.
No need to rush, Commander, I don't mind waiting for you.
Commander, the commission is complete... Hehe, no matter the time or place, I suppose I'm still your secretary ship.
The warm sunlight, the peaceful atmosphere, the soothing music, all embracing me as I relax and chat with one so dear to me. If this is a dream, I hope to never wake up...
Richelieu-class battleship - Jean Bart.
I'm Jean Bart, the battleship. I was named after a certain "renowned" privateer... You what? Never heard of privateers? They're pirates with legal permission to pillage, fighting for a just cause.
I'm Jean Bart, the Vichya Dominion's last cutting-edge battleship. Guessing you'll be plotting my course from now on... Hmph, I'll see for myself how good a job you'll do.
Go figure... you're busier than I expected. If ya need a hand with something, just gimme a shout.
If some dumbass sticks their nose where it doesn't belong, they got only themselves to blame when they're hanging from my cannons.
The era of battleships is over? Hah, the hell you mean? MY era is just getting started!
Insincere preaching about faith and beliefs is no different from idle sleeptalk.
Idiots just don't ever wisen up, do they... What drives 'em to pray to a made-up being that won't even respond?
Stop trying to hit on me.
... You better not regret this later.
A job's a job. Whining won't make it go away.
... Pish, them's some shabby rewards.
Got some mail for ya. Picked it up on the way here.
You finished plundering? Coulda gotten it done in no time if you'd brought me.
Guess your rackety team's come back.
Feeling great. Wanna give it a shot?
Don't bother with courtesy! Just bunch up and come at me!
Your endeavors were touching... but when you pick the wrong fight, that's all they'll ever be.
My payback comes with interest... Before long, you'll know how much!
Playtime's over!
That all ya got?
Seems you've mistaken a wolf for a dog... Hmph, don't start crying if you get bit cause of it.
Your smile makes me think of her... She's someone I wanna hate, but can't bring myself to.
Stop looking so intimidated. Long as you won't betray me, I won't betray you.
I can't stand hearing those babies cry when you get hurt... So use me as a shield. I don't mind.
It's like the mood eases up when you're with me... I'mma get some rest right here... And don't you leave me...

The path I walk is an unforgiving, dirt-ridden path where you can't even see the future lying ahead of you. But ya still wanna go with me? ... Hmph, your stupidity amazes me. And for your foolishness, I offer you the rest of my days.
Hmm? Give something to a pirate like myself, and you'll never get it back. Are you sure you want to give this to me?
That's enough praying. Prepare to fight!
You're not gettin' ahead of me a second time!

ex.line: Gimme that, I'm gonna help ya out... Of course I'm gonna assist, I'm your secretary.
I'm not the kinda girl who goes shopping with Dunkerque and Algérie. But you knew that already, being the person who knows me best, right? On the other hand, I wouldn't mind doing that with you.
I ain't letting any new talent outshine me. I am Jean Bart, the Vichya Dominion's most powerful ship and bearer of the sacred Iris' name. This title is my pride, and I will never surrender it.
If you wanna go talk to Richelieu then I could come with ya. We believe in different things, but we're still sisters.
Praying isn't my thing, but wishing is fine by me. 'Cause wishing for the wellbeing of the one you love is what it means to be human.
Look, just don't get too flirty with me...
You're really that keen on my body?
This loot ain't nearly good enough. Not for me, nor for you.
I mighta once had a big role to play, but with you in command, I just never get to truly act.
Guess that merrymaking team's come back.
All hail the Vichya Dominion!
...Oh, crap, guess I dozed off. How 'bout you take a quick nap too? You could use my lap for a headrest. Take it easy. You and I, we're always by each other's side.

lines.line: The guest of honor shouldn't be wandering around looking for girls drinking alone... Hmph, might as well have a drink while you're here anyway.
The guest of honor shouldn't be wandering around looking for girls drinking alone... Hmph, might as well have a drink while you're here anyway.
You... look awfully bored, Commander. Hmph, what a coincidence. That makes two of us.
I'm more willing to listen to Dunkerque than a lot of others. She's a lot more in touch with the masses.
Letting go of everything and losing yourself to the merriment of song and dance... that is what a banquet should be about. Not this pompous farce that makes even wine taste bad.
The one thing that this banquet has going for it is the fact that everyone's smiles are genuine and heartfelt... Look, I'm praising you, can't you tell?
Commander, I'm not going to exchange pleasantries with you. C'mon, it's not like we just met for the first time, right?
Cheers... Hmph. I never asked for the "blessing" of being someone's sister, but I've already gotten used to what that entails.
You still have missions to do even now? ... Need my help?
C'mon, put all that stuff aside and have a drink with me.
Did you just come back from battle? Here, cheers.
A commission fleet has returned? Let's head down to greet them together then. I needed some fresh air anyway.
Mmm... the wind on the battlefield... now that's what I'm used to.
Hmph. Still better than going to that banquet...

I loathe red tape, nor do I have any desire to stand here like a flower vase for people to stare at... But I'm doing all of this for you, because you make me feel like it's all worth it. You've committed quite the serious offense, mon amour...
You damn scalawag... You don't just sneak into someone's hideaway without consequences, ya know. Though, I found this place by pure chance too. Don't go tellin' anyone else about it!
You damn scalawag... You don't just sneak into someone's hideaway without consequences, ya know. Though, I found this place by pure chance too. Don't go tellin' anyone else about it!
Don't you go touchin' my stuff without permission! I'll knock ya out cold.
You wanna go lookin' for treasure? There's no damn treasure 'round here. But one day... Hmph, one day, when we've achieved a boring peace, I'll give you a taste of what a real treasure hunt is like.
Sorry, but this hammock's only big enough for one of us. Ya wanna relax, get your own. I ain't your personal servant.
Just how much damn work do you have if you're even bringin' it up here...? You just like being with me...? Tsk...
Wha-? Is... Is that Surcouf? The hell... How'd she end up dozing off in here? That girl's a real piece of work.
Ack! Don't put your damn ice-cold soda on me! You're on thin ice, buddy...
You're not the only one who can do whatever ya want just 'cause nobody else will come here. I can, too. Understand?
Would you stop comin' here right after returning to port? Don't want people catching wind of this place and turning it into a playground.
Man... The sun's crazy bright out today... What, you're still here? How long are ya gonna hang around? Hmph, you're real good, both at making me happy AND making me mad, you know that?
Bonne année... Or rather, I should say "Happy New Year" here, yes? A year of peace and prosperity passes, and we are here to welcome another... and I must thank you for making that possible.
Bonne année... Or rather, I should say "Happy New Year" here, yes? A year of peace and prosperity passes, and we are here to welcome another... and I must thank you for making that possible.
Work, same as always, huh? Tell me if there's anything I oughta know.
Aid with getting dressed? This is nothing compared to a ceremonial Iris dress. Not to mention it suits me better. Don't ya agree?
Sakura Empire-style badminton? Sounds fun. I'll knock that shuttlecock beyond the horizon!
I hate it when people approach me to either give or get a hug. Never asked for their damn compassion.
Wagashi, for me? Thanks. Dunkerque sure is considerate as always.
Hmh...
What, you wanna see me brandish one of these?
Umph! What now?!
You're back? Seems you've got girls queuein' up to meet you. Me, not so much...
Forward! Quarter them!
I'm not the type to underestimate anyone.
Not to say I've grown soft, but I have gotten too used to you bein' around. I don't mind it - hell, I like it. I'm all but dependent on you, that's just how important you are to me.

What're you starin' daggers through me for? Are ya that excited about this new outfit? Alright, then feast your eyes on my fashion sense. Yeah, I didn't put it together just for your sake this time - more like to demonstrate my tastes.

What're you starin' daggers through me for? Are ya that excited about this new outfit? Alright, then feast your eyes on my fashion sense. Yeah, I didn't put it together just for your sake this time - more like to demonstrate my tastes.
You're here. Well? Does this attire meet your standard? ...No, just asking out of curiosity.
While I do like this holiday spirit, don't expect me to dress up every single year... You'll help take photos next time around? Hah. You sure know how to get someone's hopes up.
Sure, this is more fun than I thought, but I can't go 'round cheering like a little kid... You wouldn't mind it if I let my inner kid out? Well, I'll be the one to decide what I do.
A red envelope? Oh, is that how you give blessings to someone? Heheh. Alright, then how 'bout showing me how sincere you are?
A new year and a new beginning... So they say, but every day's new to me. What makes it different from the past ones is the fact that I have you now.
I swear, people like you... Ugh. It's a holiday. I'll pretend you didn't do that.
Don't get too ahead of yourself, now...
You sure you ain't getting carried away? It being the New Year isn't an excuse to... Actually, do whatever you want.
Remember, you've got work waitin' for ya. It being a holiday ain't an excuse to slack off.
Looks like your rewards're ready. You're not gonna tell me to go and fetch 'em, are ya?
Got a letter for you here... No, I didn't go looking for it. I just happened to find it.
Look who's back. So, what should I do? It's not that I DON'T want your approval, I just want to do my best.
That rowdy bunch is back. Heheh. They're right at home with this holiday spirit.

It's a new year... As long as you'll be here, I'll have something to look forward to. Is this what those Empery girls're talking about when they wish for "peace in the years to come"? Although, I'd hate it if I started becomin' reliant on you for... Nah, forget it. What matters is - I'm counting on you for another year, Commander.
South Dakota-class battleship - Massachusetts, Hull Number BB-59.

I guess I'm the most normal ship in my class. I earned 11 battle stars, which is less than South Dakota did. "I hardly suffered any damage"? That's cause I never fought anyone strong enough... Here's hoping that I'll get to fight as hard as my sister did back then.
Hm? Ah... my turn to speak. I'm Massachusetts. I'm just a regular old South Dakota-class you can find anywhere... So, yeah, I hope we can... get along.
For lunch, I'll make... Oh, Commander, are you going for a stroll?
Tell me when you're done inspecting.
... You know, I actually like this hair color. It's like that of a bald eagle, isn't it?
You think my jacket is strange? This way I can feel the breeze hit my skin when out at sea, though... I love it.
People that impressed me? Umm... when I was in Casablanca, I fought a battleship who held out a long time even with just a single turret... I'd like to fight her again in her finished state.
You want someone to pamper you? ... You want ME to?
... If you'd move your body more, you'd have fewer weird thoughts.
So many missions waiting on us...
Ah, the rewards have arrived... Seems we can afford beef for dinner tonight.
I'll leave your letter here. Check it later.
You're back... Did you get hurt? If anyone pokes fun at you, we can talk about it.
... Oh, look. They've brought so much back. I'll go help them out.
I feel a bit different...
Pretty tough, aren't you? You won't cry if I hit you, will you?
It's over already? But I was just warming up... Aren't there any other enemies left?
Sorry, I got distracted...
This one's really heavy.
... So you want me to get serious?
Your body is weak, Commander. Are you eating properly?
How to get stronger? Uhh, do some push-ups? ... Not working for you?
Seeing you challenging yourself with things you can't do is... interesting. It makes me want to explore my own limits, too.
I like how cool you look when you're pushing yourself hard... but overdoing it isn't good. I'll force you to rest if I have to.
I don't have any dreams. But I have the power to grant them. Commander, do you have a dream for me to grant one day?
Umm, yeah... I already know what you want to do and want to say... Because I love you too, Commander.
For me, huh? Yeah, good job. I'm happy with it.
The way you are now... I like it. This is good.
I envy your defense, sis...
Hey... Is this outfit that strange to you? Thought it looks just like what my sister's wearing... so what are you staring at? I don't get you at all...
Hey... Is this outfit that strange to you? Thought it looks just like what my sister's wearing... so what are you staring at? I don't get you at all...
My... plans for the party? We could go listen to Dakota play the piano.
Tell me what you think when you're done looking. Else I'm not letting you leave.
Where's Jean Bart gone? I wanted to show her how I look.
Seems everyone's enjoying the party. Hope Dakota and Alabama are too. Me? I'm having tons of fun.
You want something, Commander? I'm gonna go get a drink. I could get one for you too if you want.
I shouldn't lift this flap? Why not?
Are you getting more weird thoughts because of my outfit?
Oh, rewards have come in. Good stuff.
Makeup is tricky stuff... I don't know how everyone else does it.
Fighting while trying not to get my dress dirty... Kinda fun.
Fletcher-class destroyer - Bush, Hull Number DD-529.
I'm the Fletcher-class destroyer Bush. Like my sisters, I fought in the Pacific Ocean and took on tons of missions! ... Planes? I-I don't wanna talk about those scary things!
I'm Bush, from the Fletcher class! I'll be staying here from now on!
Umm... What are we doing today, again?
What is it? Do you want something from me?
If I stay out of sight, the Commander probably won't notice I'm neglecting my work...
Uughh... Following a schedule is so boooring! I say we do stuff when we see it needs doing! ... What? That's not gonna fly?
I've got a bunch of sisters, both younger and older than me! I forget their names all the time, though...
Yep, what is it?
It's not okay to touch me like that!
You've got some missions left to do. Commander, you're not... slacking off again, are you?
Mission complete! ... Did I do it right?
I've brought your mail along! What does it say?
Whoa! Everyone's back home!
Oh, it's time to go welcome the commission team back!
Huh? Will this make me stronger?
I'll fight with all I've got!
Hehehe! That was super easy!
Nooo! Get those planes away from meee!
Where is the enemy at?
I-I'm not giving up yet!
You need to learn to smile, Commander...
Whuah! A-a plane came flying towards me! ... What? Th-that was just a beetle...?
You know, I'm actually quite athletic! Check it out, I could hop side to side all day! ... *Pant*, *pant*... This is exhausting... I can't hop anymore...
Gotcha! ... Well, how do you like the prank Thatcher taught me, Commander? ... Huh? But I thought you liked pranks, or at least Thatcher said that you do...
For whatever reason, I don't feel that scared of planes anymore. It's got to be because we love each other, Commander! ... At least that's what Thatcher told me. She's not wrong, is she?
Does this mean you love me more than anyone else? If so, will you do anything I ask you to? Okay! I want some snacks from that store that just opened, so let's go there right now!
Whee, it's my favorite!
Tadaaah! All done! How does it look? I think I'm pretty talented as an artist!
Tadaaah! All done! How does it look? I think I'm pretty talented as an artist!
Aww, do we really have to work? I'm not done painting yet...
North Carolina asked me to paint a portrait of Washington smiling, but Washington didn't really wanna do it... I think I know why! Maybe smiling is embarrassing for her?
Just give me a minute! I'm just finishing up my painting!
This is my sketchbook I use for drawing practice! And no looking inside, okay?
I'm gonna draw portraits of everyone at the port! Heehee!
Hm? Do you want me to paint something for you, Commander?
Oh no! I got paint on my clothes because of that!
*gasp*! You spooked me... You almost made my hand slip and mess up my painting!
Centaur-class light aircraft carrier - Centaur.

I am called Centaur, name ship of the Centaur-class aircraft carriers. As I was constructed only after the Second Great War, I lived a peaceful life, in spite of it all. And so to me, all the ships of the fleet, even the little destroyer girls, are my Elders. I am at your disposal.
So this is the place where all my Elders who fought in the Second Great War gather... Greetings, Commander, I am Centaur, at your service.
Commander, I swear to follow the examples of my Elders and strive for greatness once more today!
My... appearance? Right, well, my name derives from a mythological creature, so that's why I look rather... fantastical?
By the way, supposing I really was a "Centaur," like a half-man, half-horse? Wouldn't that be funny...? What do you think, Commander?
Peaceful, carefree days certainly are lovely, and yet I can't help but wonder from time to time, why was I even born?
Serving as your secretary ship gives me so many chances to interact with the Elders. I can learn so much from them. Thank you, Commander!
You want to try pulling my bowstring? Hehe, it's harder than it looks, huh?
Commander, you're embarrassing me...
Commander, shouldn't you head out to complete this mission? I'll accompany you.
Commander, how should we handle the mission rewards?
Commander, some new mail has come in. I'll go fetch it for you.
I'm learning a lot from how you and the Elders fight, Commander.
I can hear it. A whisper on the wind... Hehe, just kidding. Huh? The commission team has returned.
Thank you, Commander. I continue to strive toward the examples of my Elders.
Elders, let us strive together for victory!
Commander, I think I'm catching up to the Elders, maybe, just a bit...?
Forgive me, Elders...
I've learnt from the Elders, I'll show you their courage!
Just as the Elders do, I shall hold fast!
How could my beloved fleet turn out like this...
Commander, would you mind introducing me to some of the fleet Elders? I don't much like being alone...
It, it isn't really that shocking that I use polite language with the destroyer Elders... is it? B- but to me, those girls are also my Elders, worthy of respect!

Spending so much time with the Commander and my Elders has shown me a side of you I never expected to see. For example... Admirable person though you are, Commander, you do sneak away from your duties from time to time. Hehehe.
I understand now that the others are ordinary people, just like me. But it's still not wrong to treat them with respect. ...Not only as their Childe, but also as their sister-in-arms.
Having been born into a world of peace, I certainly can't say I am glad to fight... But to meet you, Commander, and to be assigned to your fleet, these are the things that truly make me glad.
I am most grateful for your kindness. I'll be sure to work even harder!
Elder One, it is an honour to fight by your side!
Even though I see the ocean every day, changing into this swimsuit gives me a totally new outlook on it. How about you, Commander? Don't you feel at ease?
Even though I see the ocean every day, changing into this swimsuit gives me a totally new outlook on it. How about you, Commander? Don't you feel at ease?
Commander, what would you say to a stroll on the beach?
The Elders haven't been shy about complimenting my figure, though I can't help but feel a little bit embarrassed...
Taking in the ocean, feeling the sea breeze, letting the sounds of the waves lap against my ears... I feel completely at peace here.
Coming to the beach with my Elders, and of course with the Commander, to spend a day off is so delightful.
Commander, Elder Hermes has been talking about this "Summer Duel Tournament" that's about to begin. Why don't we go watch together?
Commander, is this pose okay? How about my expression? Hehe, all right then, make sure you get my good side.
Commander, let's go to the beach together after sunset and watch the stars. I'll show you my constellation. And then we'll have... a chat.... sound good?
I never imagined you would give me such a splendid dress, Commander... I think it's called a "qipao..." is it? I'll try it, revealing though it is. Wh-what do you think...? Do I look... nice?
I never imagined you would give me such a splendid dress, Commander... I think it's called a "qipao..." is it? I'll try it, revealing though it is. Wh-what do you think...? Do I look... nice?
Looks like everyone from the Dragon Empery is in the midst of preparing their Spring Festival celebrations, but I'm not sure there's anything I could help with...
You want to see me dance...? W-well, I'm not very practiced, but if that's what my Commander wants...
In the coming year, I'll be trying even harder to learn from my Elders!
I learned a special dance from the Elders of the Dragon Empery, I do hope it pleases the Commander and the other Elders.
Commander, if you're feeling stressed, I could massage your back for you, help you relax a little?
These fans and my shawl are so soft to the touch~ Commander, would you like to feel?
Th-the Elders are all watching...
It really looks like the whole fleet is having a good time and getting along so well... This season is truly delightful.
Essex-class aircraft carrier - Essex, Hull Number CV-9.
I am the nameship of the Essex-class carriers. Although I was built with great expectations, I was always overshadowed by Enterprise's success. If only I could have been deployed sooner...
So this is where Enterprise is... A-ahem! I am Essex, one of the Union's state-of-the-art aircraft carriers. Commander, you can expect great things from me! I swear that I won't disappoint you!
There you are. I've already finished preparing everything. Commander, give us your orders!
What would you like to know, Commander? I'll answer to the best of my abilities.
Everyone knows that the Essex class is strong, but still, Enterprise is all they ever talk about... *sigh*...
There are a lot of ships in my class. As the nameship, I have to do everything I can to be a good role model...
Musashi and Yamato? They were... yes, formidable rivals worthy of respect. I hope I can meet them again one day.
Mm... Nnh... Ah! I-I'm not moaning, I swear!
Time to sortie?! Just leave it to me! Oh... you just wanted to chat...?
Wh-what is this?! I, I...
There are still unfinished missions? Mind letting me handle things this time...?
The mission rewards have arrived. Are you sure you don't need me to go get it?
There's new mail for you. Here you go.
The fleet has safely returned. Commander, I've prepared the battle report for you. Time is of the essence, so please review it right away.
The birth of the Essex-class would not have been possible without the hard work of the logistics teams. I have to show my gratitude to everyone.
When will I be able to get jets...
All carrier-based aircraft in position, anti-air defense preparations complete. All forces, full speed ahead!
Enterprise, did you see my feat?
I won't let it end like this... I swear it!
Spread your wings and soar!
The battle... has just started!
I wonder how Enterprise puts up with someone like you...
I witnessed the end of the era of battleships with my own eyes. Will carriers share the same fate some day...?
Jealousy? No, that's not the case. Enterprise is a true hero worthy of all the respect she gets. However, compared to her dazzling aura, I'm just...
I won't lose to anyone, not even to Enterprise. But how do I get everyone to acknowledge this? Commander, if you were in my shoes, what would you do?
I might never be able to become a hero like Enterprise... But when I'm with you, I feel like I can do so much more than just that...

Once you've experienced the happiness of two people supporting each other, it becomes something you can't live without. Thank you, Commander. I no longer have to walk alone in my quest to prove my worth. I promise to always be at your side, wherever you go.
You're giving this to me? (whispers) ...How did the Commander learn about my tastes? A-ahem. I didn't say anything. Thank you.
Just you watch, Enterprise! I won't lose to you so easily!
The era of carriers is upon us!

ex.line: Hello and welcome back to port, Commander! ...Hmm? There I go being formal again. I-it's just that, since you came home, I wanted to be as polite as possible...
If I ever become the kind of person who my juniors admire... then I think it'll be because you gave me the courage to become that person.
Peaceful afternoons with you are so nice... Heehee, mind if I bring you a cup of coffee?
Ah... I looked at your last combat report. No, I wasn't analyzing your tactics - I just saw you in the video, and... I couldn't take my eyes off of you.
Stay with me a little longer, would you?
Hm? You wanna chat? I'd love to! Oh... Another sortie, huh?
A-an ambush?!
I feel your love and trust in me, Commander... I promise, I'll prove that you made the right choice even if it takes my whole life to do it - because I'm your one and only Essex!

lines.line: I'm not trying to go anywhere in particular; I just want to enjoy the scenery along the way. Commander, let's go experience the thrills of the road together.
I'm not trying to go anywhere in particular; I just want to enjoy the scenery along the way. Commander, let's go experience the thrills of the road together.
Commander, have you put on your helmet yet? We're about to get going!
Even being able to see a small portion of these 2448 miles has been an eye-opening experience. Though I wasn't able to ride from sea to shining sea, what an unforgettable journey it's been!
Enterprise advised me to pursue some hobbies that aren't related to combat... This should count as one of those.
Combat is something that must be done at full throttle. It'd be dangerous to do that while riding though...
You followed us the entire way? What an incredible eagle!
Phew... Hm? This bottle of water is for me? Thank you very much! I'll help myself then.
Commander, could you be... too tired to know what you're doing? I knew we should have stopped to rest...
Did you want to rest for a bit? That's fine, take your time.
Commander?! Ah, um, no, I'm not drunk! ...I, uh, just had a bit too much to drink... just a bit! Please don't tell the others though!
Commander?! Ah, um, no, I'm not drunk! ...I, uh, just had a bit too much to drink... just a bit! Please don't tell the others though!
Sorry, Commander, but could you give me a hand? ...Ugh, why is the hem of this dress so long...

By the way, Commander, there's nobody else around, right? *sigh*... Thank god... If Enterprise or Shangri-La saw me like this, I'd die of— ...Eh?! Shangri-La?! Wait, no, stop! Please, no photossssss!!
I even got Mr. Eagle here all decked out~ Looks pretty sharp and spiffy, right?

Hey... Commander, um... Yeah, so... have you ever seen Enterprise get drunk before? Ah, no, I was just asking out of curiosity... I mean, it's almost impossible to picture that happening to her, right?
Commander, don't worry about me. Don't you think you should head back to the venue before the others start to wonder where you went?
One more cup... Just one more! Commander, here! Cheers! Thanks for everything you're always doing for us. This is... a token of gratitude from me... *hic*!
Commander! Jeez, what are you doing... Did you also have a bit too much to drink? What am I going to do...
We've got new work? Um, I really hope my head clears up soon... Ugh, everything's still spinning...
Did the mission rewards already get here? Th-thank god...
Everyone was greeting me one after another at the party, and there I was basking in their attention, so... I started toasting everyone, and... Ugh! Why am I so childish...?!
Wh-why is a commission fleet coming back now of all times? ...Commander, I'll— *hic*...! I don't think I should go like this after all...

The princess and the prince snuggled up to one another and sailed into the sea of stars above the castle~ ...Did you hear that?! Ah, forget it... Just write it off as me being drunk... and let me cling to you already! Hehe, ehehehe...

The Dragon Empery's attire and tools of calligraphy... I see, just wearing this outfit makes me feel more scholarly and artistic! I shall put forth my best effort to prepare for the port's Spring Festival!

The Dragon Empery's attire and tools of calligraphy... I see, just wearing this outfit makes me feel more scholarly and artistic! I shall put forth my best effort to prepare for the port's Spring Festival!
Happy Lunar New Year! I'll be waiting for your orders!
One, don't be blinded by the pursuit of perfection; two, seek harmony in the spacing between ink and paper... Hmm... Does this look right? No, there's something off still... Man, this is hard...
This is a special technique to maneuver the flight deck... Fantastic! At this rate, I'll catch up to Enterprise in no time!
What are those girls doing... Eh? Is that how big brushes normally are?!
Intrepid, see that star right there? That's Mercury, but the Dragon Empery used to call it the "Chenxing." Heheh~
Am I supposed to add another stroke here? I understand. Um... right... here?
Am I supposed to add another stroke here? ...Eek?! Commander?!
The longer the transport distance, the greater the logistical difficulty. I must extend my gratitude to everyone who works so hard to maintain our supply lines.
Attack squadron, ready to scramble! Just like an eagle soaring through the sky!
How'd you like that! Commander, Enterprise, see that?

My eagle has gone missing... Just as Enterprise said, there's something strange going on in this port-- Wait, I definitely smell a case in the making! Commander, let's get to the bottom of this together!

My eagle has gone missing... Just as Enterprise said, there's something strange going on in this port-- Wait, I definitely smell a case in the making! Commander, let's get to the bottom of this together!
I hope my eagle didn't get eaten... But now's not the time to worry about that. Gotta focus on the investigation first!
"I am Detective-Carrier Essex, unraveller of mysteries, revealer of truths!" ...Alright, that's a good-enough catchphrase... Gotta look cool in front of Intrepid and all.
This piece of evidence is... the drink Enterprise left behind? And there's... a lemon here too? Oh, uhh, forget I said anything!
This piece of evidence is... the witness's photograph, but I have to glue it back together - speaking of which, where'd the glue go?

This piece of evidence is... The Manjuus that interrogated Cheshire seemed to mention something about an organization called the "Republic of Essex"... How strange, I'll have to look into this the next time I catch her.
This piece of evidence is... Wait, isn't this Bunker Hill?! Why were you so fired up to get a shot like THIS?
Let's go over the evidence we have... What?! You already managed to get conclusive proof? I knew I could count on you, Commander!
Let's let Shangri-La analyze the photographs. We're more cut out for field work!
Y-you're trying to pass down the WHAT...?
It's a great day for an investigation, Commander!
I just picked up the mission rewards. What the heck is up with this Matryoshka doll...? Pfft, ahaha, what a weird face~♪
Don't let your guard down when toasting in celebration. Remember your limits, and act accordingly...
The commission team is back! Jamaica, sorry, but I'm going to borrow your bike for a sec! I need to greet- err, talk to the eyewitnesses!
Open up! Detective-Carrier Essex is on the case!
"Don't assume someone's literally irrelevant just because of how they really look" ...So that's what it means!
"Anchors aweigh! Arr, pirate aircraft carrier Essex be ready for battle! Nothing in the seven seas will escape my grasp!" Hic... Hehehe... I wanna be a piraaate...
"Anchors aweigh! Arr, pirate aircraft carrier Essex be ready for battle! Nothing in the seven seas will escape my grasp!" Hic... Hehehe... I wanna be a piraaate...
Commandeeer? Pssh, no, I'm not drunk! I just had two, MAYBE three beers during my break~
Uuurgh, my head hurts... I feel like I did something crazy yesterday... Do you have any idea, Commander?
Mmm, the acidity of lemon works just right. I feel great! Now, let me get Enterprise to... Ah. You heard nothing!
Endless office work... So this is your everyday struggle, Commander. I underestimated you...!
Did you see that?! I, aircraft carrier Essex, have obtained the greatest treasure of all! I've overcome my elders—Shangri-La?! Hold it, hold it, hold it! I'll apologize! I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
Commander, wanna ride my ship? Huh? That'd make you the captain, wouldn't it? Then I'd be...?
Hey, Commander?!
New missions... That means there's more office work to go with them... Ack!
Mission rewards... Now this is what I need to motivate myself to work!
The new mail? Where did I leave it, again...?
Commander! Welcome baaack~
Shangri-La, please, put that down! Huh? You're just using it to let me know the commission team is back...?
Eagle Union's own Tempesta... Ack, that's not what I meant!
I'm better at fighting than I am at office work!
Just imagining all the paperwork that's going to come from this defeat... Uuurgh!
You've got it rough, Commander... If I was gonna be stuck doing this every day, I'd run away and become a pirate... I'm kidding! If it means reducing your burden, I can handle it! Heheh.
Cooldown lap completed! Did you see me on the racetrack, Commander? Heehee. Thanks for everything, from setting up the race to assigning racers and supporters!
Cooldown lap completed! Did you see me on the racetrack, Commander? Heehee. Thanks for everything, from setting up the race to assigning racers and supporters!
Everyone performed great on the track today. Maybe it was because you were watching, Commander? Ahahahah.

It's so hot... Just like the heated support from everyone. However, I must remain sharp at all times during a race. Heehee, then again, I've fought many battles before, so this is nothing I can't handle.
Enterprise is rooting for me?! From where? It's really motivating, but at the same time, I feel a ton of pressure on me now...
I won't go easy on someone just because they're a friend! I'm going for the gold in my next race!
You don't want me drinking too much during the victory party? Of course I won't! ...(Weird. Why am I the only one being told that?)
Can't this get a little lower? Damn... Hm? Commander?! Oh, I was just... I didn't mean it the way you think!
Wh-whoa! Uhh...
New missions! Is there any way I can help with them? I've got time while my bike is being worked on!
Mission rewards have arrived! Maybe there are some replacement parts in there?
Ty brought us this new letter. Are you going to read it?
Excellent work! Shall we go to the pit after a quick break? Everyone from the R&D department is there.
I'm sweaty all of a sudden... Oh, the commission team is back? Okay! Let's give them a warm welcome after the race is over!
Essex, taking off!
I managed to keep the lead by some miracle... Next!
Don't worry, Commander. I'm making sure your ride is squeaky clean before the race! Check it out - I bet your car is the most dazzling one on the track now.
Don't worry, Commander. I'm making sure your ride is squeaky clean before the race! Check it out - I bet your car is the most dazzling one on the track now.
Commandeeer! I'm over here! Me and your car are both ready and raring to go!
It's almost time for the race... Are you nervous at all? I could rinse your car again... It might make things cooler inside.
Whoa, the hood is HOT! Commander, can you turn on the water for me? I need to cool this baby down!
I'll do everything I can for your victory! As your partner, I promise I'll be with you 'til the end!
Boy, it's hot... Hey, do you think it's okay if I cool down using the hose? Whoa?! H-hey, that's too much water pressure!
The race is about to start! Hurry and get in, Commander!
Commander?! You'll get your racing suit wet!
Wow... Another new record! Great work, Commander! Do you need a bottle of water?
This victory is thanks to all of our combined efforts, Commander!
Do you feel this raw energy between us? I think we might just be the perfect duo! But, umm... It's kind of hot, isn't it? Should we go cool off in the shower together?
Essex's retrofitting has finished! Now Enterprise will be- No, YOU will be 120% satisfied with me, Commander! Anyway, I, Essex-class aircraft carrier Essex, am at your command!
Essex's retrofitting has finished! Now Enterprise will be- No, YOU will be 120% satisfied with me, Commander! Anyway, I, Essex-class aircraft carrier Essex, am at your command!
I'm ready for anything! Be it a sortie, clerical work, patrolling the area, or even drafting an operation, just give me the word!

Would you care to join me for lunch, Commander? Ah, um, I'm not particularly hungry, it's just that this is the time you usually eat at, so... Huh? You were actually going to take me out to lunch, too?
It's just as you said, Commander. It's fine to want acknowledgment from someone, but fighting for said acknowledgment is dangerous.

I'm planning on doing some optional drills in the exercise area on our next holiday. Would you like to come with me, Commander? Oh, um, not to do the drills with me, but rather to guide me - that's what I meant.

While it's true that I have grown, I can't let it get to my head. There's no such thing as a perfect person, and I still have to keep learning from my peers. Hm? You think you could learn to be as modest as me? No, no, I'm afraid I have nothing to teach you, Commander.
Never hesitate to rely on me, Commander!
M-me?! Well, um... if it's me you want, then very well...
A new mission... Understood! Allow me to take care of it!
Mission rewards have arrived. I'll go ahead and sort them so you'll have an easier time reviewing them.
Well done out there. Now, the report should... Oh, you already finished it? Well, in that case... I'll proofread it to make sure there are no mistakes!
The team that went on a commission should be back soon. I'll head out early to receive them. In the meantime, Commander, you should come up with some words of gratitude for them!
This is par for the course, really!

I must go above and beyond what's expected of me now that I have this new strength. I need to set an example for others, catch up to Enterprise, and above all else, make myself worth your trust and love, Commander. Gosh, it's unbelievably embarrassing to say it out loud like that...
Gato-class submarine - Albacore, Hull Number SS-218.
My achievements? Let's see... Oh, right! I sank Taihou! She shouldn't have sunk so easily, though... Actually, why DID she sink?
Tadaaah! I'm Albacore, from the Eagle Union! Oh, did I jump out and scare you? Sorry 'bout that~! I'll be a member of the fleet from now on, so let's get along!
The Commander's back? Sweet, today's gonna be jam-packed with mischie... Err, I mean, time for work!
Hohoh, I must've caught your attention~ Let me guess... you like 'em young, don't you, Commander?
So, who are you into, Commander? Come on, tell me~ It'll be a secret between us... At least for a while!
I'm SOOOOOO tireeeeed~! Lemme sit on your lap, Commander! ... Sweet! Thanks, friendo!
This? This is how I've always looked. Do ya like it? Let me guess... you're having naughty thoughts, aren'tcha~?
Oh, my! Not even submarines are safe from the Commander's evil clutches!
I wonder what'd happen to you if I were to scream for help right now... Wanna find out? Heheheh~
Give me a massage and I'll keep quiet about that time you slacked off~
Sweet mission rewards! So, when am I getting my share?
You've got mail! Say "pretty please" and I'll give it to you~
Weeelcome back! ... Why's the paperwork been stacked into a pyramid? Gee, a strong wind must've done it~!
Commission complete! C'mon, let's go! We can't just sit here and keep 'em waiting forever!
Ooh! That's good!
Who's it gonna be next~? Teehee♪
Hah hah! Easy peasy!
Time to get outta heeeere!
Surpriiiiiiiise!
Huh? Have they spotted me or something?
Jeeeeeeerk!
You wonder what'd happen if you tick me off? I'd host something like a public exhibit of your greatest blunders!
My shoulders are so stiff after a long day of swimming... Oh, I have an idea! If a certain someone gives me a massage, I might just forget that really embarrassing thing they did!
It's mean to mess with you all the time, so today, you'll get a nice, relaxing massage! ... *Phew*... Hey, you feeling something inside your ears? It's your fault for blindly trusting me like that!
H-hey, listen... If some day I don't come back from the battlefield, would you... Ahahaha! Like that's ever happening! C'mere! I'm gonna tickle you senseless!

Just claiming my ring. If that's all then I'm gonna get going now... What? You're not gonna stop me? I-I'm telling ya, I really will walk outta here! ... Fiiiine, you win! I admit it, I just can't be without you anymore!
Oooh! Yeah, I'm taking that!
Ahaha... C'mon, let bygones be bygones, okay~?
Catshark attack!
Oopsie! I totally just dropped something by mistake~! I'd better pick it up quick! Hmm? Saw something you shouldn't have, Commander? Hehehe~ That makes you my partner in crime now!
Oopsie! I totally just dropped something by mistake~! I'd better pick it up quick! Hmm? Saw something you shouldn't have, Commander? Hehehe~ That makes you my partner in crime now!
How about a... KAPOW! Gave you a real scare, didn't I? Teehee~ Turned out pretty good, if I say so myself~

You wanna warn people about my firecrackers? Hehehe~ By all means, go ahead~ But how exactly are you gonna explain knowing that I had 'em hidden under my dress~? You get where I'm going with this, don'tcha? Hehehe~
Commander, you seen Taihou anywhere? I've got an explosive surprise for her!
Which do you like more: this dress, or my ordinary getup? Why do I even ask? Hehehe~ C'mon, don't be shy and answer the question~
Over here, Commander! You agreed to be my accomplice right when you caught wind of my plan, so you've gotta follow me around the whole day~
You're gonna dig up location info under the guise of dancing with someone? Hey, pretty good idea! Huh? You just wanna dance? With me?
I wonder how people would look at you if I set off a firecracker right now... Wanna find out? Heheheh~
Time to spice up Cavalla's drink with a little... Darnit, you caught me in the act, Commander... All I wanted to do was give it a more mature but alcohol-free taste!

L-listen, I'm really grateful that you hang out and let me mess around with you! I've got something important to say... Come here so I can whisper... C'mon, a little closer... *smooch*♡ Hah, got 'em! Expect much more teasing to come~
Surpriiiise! I was in the box all along! ...Did I really freak you out that much? Heehee~ Here, have this voucher as an apology. Come see me later to use it~♪
Surpriiiise! I was in the box all along! ...Did I really freak you out that much? Heehee~ Here, have this voucher as an apology. Come see me later to use it~♪
C'meown in! What can I get mew? The meows and mews are part of the theme, mew see!
Maybe I'll get Archerfish to hop in a box too. We can handle the wait, but can you handle that many surprises~? Hehehe~
Soooo~ Among all the kitties here, who's your favorite, Commander~?
I don't prank people while I'm on duty~ That is, unless they're someone I like~♪
The reason I'm just lounging around right meow is 'cause I've already taken everyone's orders~♪
For every prank you fall for, you get a minute of one-on-one chat time with me! Pretty sweet deal, am I right?
I wonder what'd happen if you touched other girls like you touch me... Wanna find out? Heheheh~
You like me so much you'll skip work just to see me? Heehee~ Golly, look how these missions are piling up~♪
Meow nice to see you! Teehee~ Popping outta the box never fails to get a reaction from you~♪
The commission team is back? The next time you visit me, bring some friends along!

By the way! I've got a secret discount menu. If you wanna know the code phrase for it, come closer so I can whisper it to you. Closeeer... Mwah!♡ That was all a lie! Thanks for being so easy to trick~
Le Hardi-class destroyer - Le Téméraire.
I am the Le Hardi-class destroyer, Le Téméraire! I was never completed during that war, but I'm really happy that I can be with all of you now!
