You wanna go on a hunt again, Commander? Or a sortie, that's fine too!
Oww! Son of a...! Learning how to cook sucks! Can't believe Vincennes told me to do this when all she does is microwave her food... But I'll keep trying! Just for the Commander!
You serious?! Now that we're married, we're gonna be cleaning the office together?!
I'll be here the whole day if you need me, Commander!
Anything I could help out with, Commander? Like, c'mon, we're wed and I'm your secretary. Put me to work doing more stuff if you want.
...Huh? Wh-what was that for?
Yeah? What is i- Huh?! S-seriously, I've told you not to randomly go "I love you" around me! I'm so embarrassed I could die!
S-s-s-so this kinda thing's fine now, huh?
"Welcome home, Honey♪" - Urgh! Stupid Astoria, forcing me to say this cheesy crap... It's not my style, for crying out loud... Huh?! C-Commander?!
Walk right into my trap, you scrapheaps!
Hahahah! Check out these results!
Sorry for this, Commander. But I'll get 'em next time!
Fletcher-class destroyer - Hazelwood, Hull Number DD-531.

I have a lot of experience on the battlefield, so I guess I'm a bit of a veteran! Oh right, I also served as a "reserve aviation command ship" for a while! What's that, you ask? Well, that'd be a ship that helps carriers guide their planes! Something like that~
Gotcha! Hehe, I'm Hazelwood, from the Fletcher class! Pleased to meet you!
Right on time~! I just finished warming up~ Let's get going!
Phew! That feels great! The warm sunshine feels amazing today!
These sunburns are battle scars from my active lifestyle!
Hey Bush, stop loafing around and come jog with me!
If only we could host a port-wide sports meet... I know I'd be the fastest one out of all my sisters!
How about it? I've got a super healthy tan, right? Commander, show me ours~
Eek! Don't go peeking under there!
Don't back down, no matter how intimidating your pile of work looks!
Woo! That's one more checked off the list! Way to go, Commander!
Whaddya think? Nobody gets the mail faster than me, right!
Are you tired? Should I help you get comfortable?
A commission has finished? I'll be right back!
Faster, stronger!
All righty! Let's set sail, everyone!
I'm number one? Now that's what I call unexpected, ehehe...
I can't hold out any longer!
Take aim...!
I... I'm not scared!
Everyone's saying to stay away from the commander... I wonder why?
There are lots of girls here who like to run fast. That's why I'd like to race them!
There's nothing more relaxing than soaking in the sunlight! Commander, you come with me too~!
The sun isn't coming out today... But no matter, hehe! As long as I stick with you, I won't get mopey at all~!
I see you, Commander! Heheh~♪ Are you gonna get in trouble if I cling to you too much? But it feels so good... so can I keep doing it a bit more? Yaay~!
From now on, I'll cling to you even more, Commander! ...Hehe, Commander, you're nice and warm... rub against me more~
Ah, I love this! Thanks, Commander!
Omaha-class light cruiser— Concord, hull number CL-10.
I am an Omaha-class light Cruiser, Concord, of the Eagle Union~ After many weapon modifications, you can certainly count on me~ probably? Hehe.
Light cruiser Concord, reporting in. Do I like lollipops and ice cream—— huh? Does the Commander always like to gaze at people’s feet? Hehe.
It’s nice to see you again, Commander~ Did you bring me any yummy candy?
Do your best, Commander, if you perform well then there’ll be lollipops waiting for you~
Hmm, I’m getting tired from all this walking… it seems you got time on your hands, come and give me a feet rub~?
I always want to go to the town of my namesake~ If we get a chance can we go?
I am a very helpful individual~ Can’t you tell? Hehe, looks like we’ll need more time to understand one another~
Do you also like candy? If you ask me nicely, perhaps I’ll share some of mine? Teehee.
Commander, if you touch me here again, then I’ll have to send you flying with a high kick~
There’s still missions to do? Don’t just stand there daydreaming while looking at my feet, c’mon~
If you don’t hurry up and collect your rewards, then I’ll do it for you~ And then all these rewards will belong to me!
There’s new mail~ Not sure if it's notification for new desserts?
You’re finally back~ Do you want to taste the new flavored ice cream cone in my hand?
The commission fleet has returned~ I hope they brought back new flavored ice cream with them.
This feels awesome~
Heeheehee, how exactly should I “love” you?~
Oh, getting MVP isn’t such a difficult feat~
A total loss… I can’t lift myself up…
Don’t underestimate me!
Hmm~... Isn’t it too risky always rushing towards the front lines...
I’m not tired, don’t touch my feet. Touch it again and I’ll kick you!
Help me grab these desserts! Then follow me around and help carry these things for me~
Just stay beside me like this, ok? Take a good look at me, and don’t doze off!
Since I’m on sugar crash, how are you going to sway me over? What, you’re going to reward me with dark chocolate? I certainly can’t wait!~
My whole body is on a sugar rush, would you like me to show you? Hehe~ Give me your face… (pinch) How does it feel? Sweet, huh~
Wow, we’re finally at this step Commander~ From today onwards, you’ll rub my feet. Of course, I’ll also share with you all my candy~ I simply cannot wait!
Good stuff~ You're making me fall for you all over again♪
Oh wow, what a treat to finally be in combat together. Let’s do it!
Apple candy, Taiyaki, and fried noodles~ The Sakura Empire’s Temple Fair really is something~ Hehe Commander, do you also want to take a bite of my apple candy? Here you go~
Apple candy, Taiyaki, and fried noodles~ The Sakura Empire’s Temple Fair really is something~ Hehe Commander, do you also want to take a bite of my apple candy? Here you go~
The night-time events at the Temple Fair is starting soon, shall we go take a look?
Hmm… with my hair up like this, I can’t properly wear my headphones~ Commander, do you want to give it a try~? Perhaps it’ll be very suitable on you.
Hmm… walking around this temple is very tiring, hehe, can you give me a piggyback ride Commander?~
On occasion, it’s nice to try out more exotic dresses. What do you think Commander, does this suit me?
Even though lollipops are a must-have, but apple candy also have a distinct apple flavor. Sigh… it’s so hard to choose~
Commander~? You can either be kicked or stepped on by me, please choose?
Merry Sweetsmas, Commander! Today, I get to eat as many sweets as I want without anyone saying things about it~♪ Hmm, I already eat this much every day? I guess so~
Merry Sweetsmas, Commander! Today, I get to eat as many sweets as I want without anyone saying things about it~♪ Hmm, I already eat this much every day? I guess so~
Commander~ let's sweeten things up together!

It's really cold here during the winter~ In times like these, you gotta give yourself the extra calories to make it through! I've been give the gift of not being able to gain weight, so I have to put it to use~!
I'm not tired of Dunkerque's desserts at all, but I'm equal opportunity when it comes to sugar. Premium or bargain, I want it all as long as it's sweet~
Memphis really has it rough... I want to help her, but what should I do...?
That's gingerbread, huh...? You can even make it look like that...?
Amazing~ ♪  Commander, you should try a bite too!
Hehe~ Did you think I wouldn't be able to punt you across the room from this position~?
You'd better give all the Christmas sweets to me~!
1st Ship of the Amagi-class Battlecruisers, Amagi

I am the nameship of the Amagi-class battlecruisers, Amagi. Along with Akagi, I was originally supposed to be converted into an aircraft carrier, but that plan was scrapped after a certain natural disaster. *cough* *cough* ... As you can see, my body is not in a great condition, but please do not worry about me too much.
*cough* *cough* Battlecruiser Amagi, reporting in. It looks like I should be able to fully utilize my abilities here. Commander, would you please brief me on our enemies?
Commander, I've left today's combat operation plans on the table. Please take a look.
Don't let anyone get injured? Commander, that's quite the tall order, but I'm up for the challenge.
The road ahead of us is perilous, but I believe that is also what makes the journey worthwhile.
Commander, there is no need to fear failure. As long as I am here, all setbacks are but fodder for our victories.
Akagi turned out... a bit differently from what I expected.
Ehehe... Oh, Commander, I was just thinking about what snacks I'd like to eat.
Oh, Commander... I was contemplating some other things...
The next mission is...
Mission rewards... we should think of the most efficient way to utilize them.
Commander, you have new mail. Might it be new intel?
Commander, were you able to make use of my strategic plans?
Commander, a commission has been completed. Also, I have some suggestions for potential candidates to send on the next-
My health... seems to have improved a bit.
All right, let's proceed as planned.
Now then, how can we make further use of this victory?
Did I... make a miscalculation...?
Ahahaha...
Perhaps a change of plans is in order...
Swineherds like you are quite hard to find these days.
Information is a tactician's most valuable asset. Knowing more than your enemy is already half the battle.
Superior tactics can only make up for differences in strength to a limited extent... *cough* *cough* ...That is why becoming stronger is still of paramount importance, Commander.
*cough* *cough*... Commander, you've already earned my acknowledgment. Why not have a little more confidence in yourself?
Commander, if you truly care about me, *cough* then please keep moving forward with all your might. Your gallant victories and smiling face are the best medicine for me.
Commander... so you've chosen me, then? Hehe... From the beginning, I was prepared to lay my life down for your ambitions. But with this being the case, perhaps I should take better care of my body.
I wonder if something good happened to you, Commander? Heehee...
Akagi...? Oh my, I have the wrong person...
Akagi, follow the commander's orders, okay?

ex.line: Commander, I've prepared today's operational itinerary. Please take a look, heehee~
Commander, please enjoy these snacks that Houshou brought over. Heehee, don't you think they're... a bit too cute?
Plan carefully before taking action, and know what your limits are. I do wonder, Commander—what sort of decisions will you ultimately make?
Commander, if you do this, my body will...
Commander... is still waiting for news of our victory!
When I see your face, it feels as if even illness cannot knock me down. *cough* *cough*... Heh... Heehee~ For your sake, Commander, I will do everything in my power to live on.

lines.line: Commander, are you here to pay me a visit? ...Ah, there is no need to be concerned about me. I made a promise to both you and Akagi that I would be mindful of my health.
Commander, are you here to pay me a visit? ...Ah, there is no need to be concerned about me. I made a promise to both you and Akagi that I would be mindful of my health.
Commander, are you not going to head down to the ocean? There is no need to worry about me, so please enjoy your time with the others.

Is there anything I would like to tell Akagi? Of course, I have many things I would like to impart with her, but perhaps it would be more appropriate that she hears those words from you, Commander. And perhaps, that would be the more interesting way of doing things... Don't you agree? Hehe~
Kaga's younger sister is quite skilled at drawing... As for my sister, well... Akagi has her own charming points~
I'm sorry for the trouble I've caused you due to my less than ideal health, but I would like to say... Commander, you have my deepest gratitude for looking after me all this time.
Would a light meal be to your liking, Commander? Kaga, Akagi, and I worked together to make this. We chose our dishes assuming that you would also be here to partake in our cooking. Hehe~
Oh my, what's this...?
I'm not going anywhere, Commander. That's what you and Akagi wished for, after all.
Commander, I would advise you to pay closer attention to your surroundings before doing things like this...
Please entrust this assignment to Amagi.
The mission rewards have arrived. Please look over them.
New mail has arrived — yes, it's good news. You need not be concerned.
Thank goodness you're back. Everyone here at port was waiting for your safe return, Commander.
Commander, a commission has been completed. Shall I summon the returnees here once they are finished with their preparations?
First, let us assemble our formation.
*cough* *cough*... I wonder if I am coming down with a cold...

*munch*... Ah. Commander, the banquet isn't over yet. What brings you here? When a host sneaks out, that causes trouble for the person cleaning up after them... Heehee, I didn't say NOT to, now, did I?

*munch*... Ah. Commander, the banquet isn't over yet. What brings you here? When a host sneaks out, that causes trouble for the person cleaning up after them... Heehee, I didn't say NOT to, now, did I?
Care for some Sakura confections, Commander? Hiei and the others made a whole bunch, and I just can't stop myself... Heehee, I'm sure Akagi will be worried about me again.

Have you already seen Akagi? Heehee, good. She can never settle down unless you're around... No, it's not that she overthinks. I think she's a lot like Nagato, in that she tries to carry all of Sakura Empire on her back. Commander... Make sure you correct her course when she does.
I've heard that in Sardegna, they have banquets where you eat lying down. Why don't you try it out, Commander? Heehee!
Katsuragi, prattling on for too long will only bother the Commander. At least divide your monologue into two... No, four or five segments would be better...
Commander, I know the feast is bountiful, but try not to eat too much, okay? Call it... advice from an expert. Hahaha!
Mm... I already know what you're thinking and feeling, Commander. Heehee!
Commander, may I accompany you on your next mission?
Your mission rewards are here. Yes, I think the fruits of our efforts ought to be reflected in the coming banquet.
You returned right on time. How punctual of you, Commander. Hahaha, I'm just happy that my strategies could help.
The commission is complete. Take it easy and relax, Commander.
I'd love to hold a banquet to celebrate everyone's victory. Your thoughts, Commander?
*cough* *cough*... Ah. Commander, I'm just fine. It's not what you think—Oh, thank you. That you've given me tea rather than medicine is proof that you know me well, hehehe.
Tosa-class battleship number two - Kaga.

I'm Kaga, second ship of the Tosa-class battleships. Built as an improvement to the Nagato-class, I was to serve as part of the Eight-Eight Fleet Program. Amagi... I would like to fight alongside her someday.
Hmm... is this the next place for me to flex my might? Very well. I am Kaga - Battleship Kaga. Make no mistake of it.
Commander, why don't you warm up a bit before starting work?
Getting stronger isn't a spectator sport. Let me at 'em already!
Those puny carrier aircraft are "strong?" Nonsense. What's more, isn't it utterly insipid to fight without your own two hands?
As a secretary, the most frustrating thing is not having anything to do. Commander, don't you have anything you need me to take care of?
Amagi is a worthy rival, and the one who I respect the most. Even if you asked me to be her support, I would have no objections.
Commander, don't you ever get tired of being in that cramped office all day? Why not come out with me for some fresh air?
... Let me get a shot in first if you're going to do that!
Missions? If it's not combat-related, don't come looking for me.
Mission rewards are here, huh? I'll go grab 'em. I could use a bit of exercise.
Catch, it's your mail.
Nothing is more exciting than defeating a strong enemy, don't you think?
A commission has been completed. Speaking of commissions, are they any fun? I'd like to give 'em a try.
Ahaha! I won't disappoint you!
A strong enemy? I'm looking forward to it. Don't let me down!
Too weak! Come back and face me again once you've had some more training.
Kuh! I'll remember your face...
Only the strong have the right to stand on the battlefield!
Not bad! You are worthy of facing my full power!
You aren't one of the strong that I seek.
Realize your weakness is nothing to be ashamed of, as long as you work hard to become stronger.
Why do I wish to become stronger? Does that really require a reason? If I had to choose... it would be to defeat Amagi.
Commander, what should I do to become stronger? At first, I thought what I was doing was fine. But after seeing you and Amagi, I realized that it isn't enough.
I sometimes feel like I can only become stronger through following your commands... Hehe, it's not a bad feeling though.
To be able to trust someone who always has my back, to be able to fight without reservation... this has always been my dream! And for that someone to be you, what more could I ask for?
How'd you wind up like this?
Amagi, please don't go off to a distant place by yourself again
Kamikaze-class destroyer number five - Hatakaze.

I'm Hatakaze, a Kamikaze-class destroyer. Oh, also, though my class might make me seem experienced, not only did I mainly engage in escort missions and achieve nothing spectacular, my story ends with my wish to fight the bitter end, like Kamikaze did, going unfulfilled. For someone like me, that's rather deplorable.
You must be the Commander. I see... No, I'm not looking disgruntled. I'm Hatakaze of Destroyer Division 5. Oh, also, be ready. I will watch over you as your superior from now on.
A commander should at the very least be on time. But considering your achievements up till now, you at least deserve some praise.
Oh, also, did you know my original name was "Destroyer No. 9"? ... I suppose it's a good thing they decided to change it.
I think Matsukaze feels compelled to worry about us so much, and sometimes we don't even know how we should respond...
If you want to slack off all day, just resign. Oh, also, you have much work left to do.
Kamikaze, could you stop teasing the Commander?
Anti-air is crucial. Oh, also, the price one pays for negligence is much higher than you think.
... Now if you'd just use that bravery for something else, my view of you might actually change.
Those with talent work a lot. Do not leave missions incomplete.
Well... I wasn't expecting this big of a reward.
Check the new mail you received. Oh, also, I have a copy of it as well.
Admirable work out there. Have some tea and reflect on your tactics.
Before you go collect those mission rewards, remember to give thanks to those who worked so hard for them.
You needn't go so far for the likes of me... But I'm still grateful.
Don't think too hard, just do your part and we'll win. Let's go!
A victory is merely a victory. Garishness and applause are needless.
It seems I have not kept up with the times...
It seems to be my turn.
Agh... So this is why they say you can't flee from pain...
Could you acknowledge the error of your ways before other girls start thinking poorly of you?
If you'd like, perhaps I could give you a wise lady's advice on how to interact with others?
Different people must be treated in their own unique way. This is no secret to social success, but it will help make you more sociable.
Ah, you should also take this amulet. It will make you more sociable. But beware: if you use it to hurt someone, you will be too.
If something's on your mind, tell me. I may be old, but my experience has been useful for solving many problems. Besides, why would you hide anything from your partner? Ahah.

It's me you want? But I'm not attractive, I'm just a bother who likes nagging about you... You're really not joking? I-if so... *Ahem*, then till the oceans of the world dry up, I will remain by your side.
Oh my. You're pretty considerate, aren't you? Thanks a lot.
Let's show them how veterans fight!
Shigure, don't get caught off guard.
Yuugumo-class destroyer number five - Makinami.

I'm Makinami, I belonged to Destroyer Division 31. Serving as Kongou-san's and Haruna-san's escort, I helped in tons of battles in the Pacific! ...Hehehe~ I gave the Eagle Union a real beating in the Battle of Tassafaronga!
I'm Makinami, the Yuugumo-class destroyer! I surfed the waves to come here! I'll be counting on you, Commander!
C'mon, stop being so blue and be positively positive!
You've heard I've only been on transport missions? No, I-I've totally fought before too!
Kongou-san and Haruna-san were so nice to me... You should be too, Commander!
Doing Tokyo Express runs... wasn't any fun at all...
Night battles are what Desron 2 do better than anyone else!
Do you want to do my hair...?
Umm, Commander... I'm not slacking off on pur... Eeek?!
Commander, why are you suddenly glomping me?!
Oh, we've got another mission...
Heeey! A commission's done!
Hey, Commander... Can you read what's written in this letter for me...?
The team has returned! Hehehe~ Welcome back, everyone~
If you don't take commissions seriously then you'll be in serious trouble!
Heh heh~ I feel stronger!
Hehehe~ Now it's my turn to take command!
I'm just the best ship ever~
All we can do is place our hopes on the next one...
Here's a present from me~!
C-could we retreat?!
Hmph. ...Leave me alone.
It'd be a shame to not go out and play on a sunny day like this! Right? Let's head out~
Oww... I tripped again... Can you give me a piggyback ride back home, Commander...?
Fine... I'll start looking where I'm going and not run and jump so much... Doesn't it get boring for you, always walking like that...?
I-is this a bride carry?! H-hehehe... But I still think I prefer your piggyback rides...
If you ever get hurt, I promise I'll carry YOU back home! So can you give me a piggyback ride now? Hehehe~
Woah! I really like this!
All right, everything looks good! I'm super excited and my batteries are fully charged! I'm heading out~!
All right, everything looks good! I'm super excited and my batteries are fully charged! I'm heading out~!
Hey, listen! I've heard there are these cool legendary things at school! Let's go check if they're true or not!
I was running earlier and tripped on something... But Hamakaze helped me back up, and now I feel fine!
Oh, it's Haruna! Hey, Harunaaaaa! Let's head to the classroom together~
Hey, I know! We can trade snacks with each other, Commander! Lemme see what you brought for lunch~!
Huh? You don't have any evening plans? In that case... Let's come up with something to do!
You're gonna give me extra lessons, Commander? Hehe~ That sounds like fun!
W-wait, is this... Th-that "student and teacher" thing...?!
Oh right, it's almost time for class! I'm gonna need my notepad... Wait, huh? Where'd it go?
Dido-class light cruiser - Sirius.

I am Sirius, the 5th ship in the 2nd group of the Royal Navy's Dido-class of light cruisers. I participated in Operation Pedestal in the past, but now I serve as a Royal Maid and have the privilege of fighting for my honourable Master.
It is an honour to meet you. I am Sirius of the Royal Maids, here to assume the position. Henceforth, Master, I shall serve you to protect your glory and your beliefs.
It is good to see you return, my honourable Master.

My honourable Master, what would you like to learn more about today? Literature and culture? Logistics and strategy? The fine arts? Or, perhaps, you are more interested in more... carnal knowledge...?
"Cleaning"...? If it is combat you are referring to, then I vow to meet all expectations you set for me, my honourable Master.
Regardless of what may ever happen, I shall always accompany you, my honourable Master.
Achieving a balanced diet is essential for one's health. Therefore, although my cooking skill may be unsatisfactory to you, please do not forgo the meals I prepare, my honourable Master.
My beloved Master... Touch me as you please.
Please refrain from intimate contact while others can see us, my honourable Master.
If you wish for me to service you tonight, then... M-my apologies! I made a rather careless assumption...
A mission of this magnitude is inconsequential. Isn't that correct, my honourable Master?
My honourable Master, the mission rewards have arrived.
My honourable Master, the mail is here.
It is good to see you return. There is tea and a light meal prepared for you. And, if you'll pardon my initiative, I have also prepared a creep... a crêpe. Would you like to have it now?
My honourable Master, I have information regarding the results of a commission, so please relocate to the sofa and get in a relaxing position.
My honourable Master, I shall become even more gorgeous for you.
Let us bring victory and glory to our honourable Master!
My honourable Master, I have cleared the path so that you may move forward.
How shameful... My honourable Master, it seems I have made a mess of myself. Please give this naughty maid her due punishment.
My honourable Master, please grant me strength!
As the Masters maid, I shall not be defeated!
...I implore you to be more honourable, my slightly disappointing Master.
I take honour in my service to you, Master. However, should you find my service unsatisfactory in any way compared to the Head Maid, I kindly ask of you to tell me.
To me, there is nothing more honourable than to have the privilege of serving you, my honourable Master.
If you find my embrace to be relieving, then I would gladly do so again at your command, my honourable Master.
I ask of you to stand proud and illuminate all the world with your glorious image, my honourable Master...!
Oh, the bliss of getting to make this wondrous vow... Please, close your eyes for this unseemly maid and permit her to feel your warmth... My honourable Master...
Thank you very much, my honourable Master.

ex.line: Welcome home, my honourable Master. Your tea is ready. Please allow me to stay by your side again today.
Will we plan out strategies together today? Or discuss some other matters? Or... Is my presence all you want? Please share whatever your heart desires, my honourable Master.
The Royal Maids' daily lessons have ended, so the rest of my day belongs to you, Master. I humbly await your command.
I noticed you rubbing your shoulder... If I'm not mistaken, may I give you a massage?
My one and only reason for being... is to be by your side now and forever, my honourable Master.
If you like how I feel... then please continue.
Pay no heed to the eyes of others. All that I am belongs to you, my honourable Master.
Master? Is this your way of requesting my service? I-I'm sorry... Was that too forward of me?
Honourable Master, the missions are complete. Your praise brings me more joy than any mission reward ever could.
Welcome back, my honourable Master. I have prepared black tea and sweets. May I also... try my hand at making crepes for you today?
There is no greater joy and honour than being able to indulge in your warmth... my one and only beloved Master.

lines.line: My dear, I changed into the new outfit as per your request. I would be most grateful were you to offer me words of praise, Master.
My dear, I changed into the new outfit as per your request. I would be most grateful were you to offer me words of praise, Master.
No matter what clothing I wear, I am still your maid and live only to fulfill your expectations, my honourable Master.
Every single maid dreams of being able to stand beside her master in such a dress... Please forgive me for my presumptuousness...
This dress seems ill-suited for combat... but since it is your wish, Master, I shall humbly carry out your will.
This necklaces suits me well...? Thank you for praising this unworthy maid, my honourable Master.
Oh, my Master who has intoxicated me with passions so, it is an honour to have been chosen as your dance partner.
There is no greater happiness than your safe return, Master. Would you like to gather everyone to have tea?

Whether it's under the swirling lights of the ballroom stage, or in the smoke and explosions of the battlefield, there will never be anything more radiant than you in my eyes. My honourable Master, please allow me to gaze upon you and be at your side, always...
I've received ample advice from my colleagues in the Maid Team regarding swimwear etiquette. My honourable Master, are you pleased with my appearance?
I've received ample advice from my colleagues in the Maid Team regarding swimwear etiquette. My honourable Master, are you pleased with my appearance?
No matter where we are, I shall do my utmost to keep you safe. My honourable Master, simply enjoy yourself, however you please.

Worry not, for I have come prepared for every occasion. Food, drinks, magazines, sunscreen, contingency combat armaments, life-saving equipment, and... a cat? Why are you here? ...Oh, umm, I was just talking to myself!
My honourable Master, why are you staring at me so intently? Did this humble maid err somewhere?! ...I'm overthinking things...?
Swimming? If... if you wouldn't mind teaching me... Um, sorry, a lowly maid has no right to request your valuable time...
My honourable Master, are you tired? Something to rest on...? ...Um, if you wouldn't mind, then... feel free to use my body...!
My honourable Master, allow me to protect you from the sun.
Understood. If you would like to see me in a bikini, then... Is, is that so? I'm terribly sorry... I prematurely jumped to conclusions yet again.
I have heard it is part of a maid's duties to dress to her honourable Master's liking over the holidays. Would this outfit happen to... satisfy the honourable Master's wishes?
I have heard it is part of a maid's duties to dress to her honourable Master's liking over the holidays. Would this outfit happen to... satisfy the honourable Master's wishes?
Happy Lunar New Year, honourable Master. I have made a cup of tea for you.
I made some Dragon Empery dishes, however they turned out quite... Pl-Please, do not be concerned! *This* year, I vow to make delectable food that shall suit the honourable Master's palate!
My honourable Master, if you'll forgive my asking, have you eaten any unusually shaped, unstuffed gyoza? ...P-Pardon me, I was merely wondering...
This naughty maid is deeply obliged to have the privilege of spending the holidays with her honourable Master.

There are a lot of really stunning goods here, but the price tags on some of these are also very "stunning"... Wh-why don't we start by looking through the more cost-effective stuff first...
Forcing you to help me make all these decisions is a little embarrassing... but thanks for bearing with me. You've been a great help.
I also chose a getup for my partner here... Hehe, doesn't it give off "gentlemanly" vibes?
Ahaha, seems like this store also sells wigs. Commander, want to try some on?
Makeup? Uh, I'm not well-versed in that stuff, so I guess I'll pick up a little bit of everything. I'll try asking around for help after we get back!
You want me to try these shoes on? Um, s-sure. Just give me a moment.
Oh, Commander, did you pick something out for tonight's ball yet? If not, why don't we stop by one of the shops en route?
Whew... A bit of stretching helps keep the body flexible. Hm? I'm in loungewear, what about it? I'd appreciate it if you wouldn't stare too much, though...
Whew... A bit of stretching helps keep the body flexible. Hm? I'm in loungewear, what about it? I'd appreciate it if you wouldn't stare too much, though...
Your health suffers if you don't move your muscles enough. Keep an eye on your posture in the office so you don't develop a hunchback, Commander.
Saratoga and Lexington do stretches on the regular, giving them great dexterity for aircraft carriers. They really live up to their rep as idols. Good examples of hard work paying off, too.
Who's the most dexterous among the Cleveland class? If I had to guess... Columbia. She does ballet, you know.
Even the most basic of stretches qualify as exercise. Though I'll admit, it's not very rigorous exercise.
Long Island claims mastering yoga gives you the power to breathe fire and extend your arms. I don't buy that idea, though.
Yeah, that's it. Push on my back and hold it like that.
I appreciate your help with the pushes, but now you're just pushing your luck.
Feel like doing some stretches with me? I could use a hand with a couple of moves, like the forward bend for instance.
Just need to feed it a coin, then operate the crane with the joystick... Oh! I got one! That was easier than I expected.
Just need to feed it a coin, then operate the crane with the joystick... Oh! I got one! That was easier than I expected.
Commander, do you want to take a shot at this manjuu crane game?
Who put this crane game here? "Supplied by Akashi, nya"...? That's what it says on the back?
By the way, have you seen my pet eagle? Do you think he flew off somewhere? ...Wait, he's not in the crane game, is he?!
Apparently, if you bang on a machine hard enough, you might get lucky and get a prize for free. Though it's more likely to get you in trouble than anything else.
I've heard there's a café run by the Sakura Empire nearby. Why don't we stop by there later for a drink?
Here, have some coins. Good luck, Commander!
You ought to get some fresh air to cool that hot head of yours...

I got a prize on my first try, so I tried it a few more times... but the crane wouldn't move like I wanted it to, and loosened up as soon as it grabbed something. What a failure. I thought I'd try again, only to find out I was all out of coins.
Oh, Commander. You also came to the beach? What a coincidence... I just finished with my swim. Got a bit too enthusiastic when I got in the water though...
Oh, Commander. You also came to the beach? What a coincidence... I just finished with my swim. Got a bit too enthusiastic when I got in the water though...
So, uh... I guess I didn't warm up enough before I started swimming, because my right leg is cramping pretty badly. Could you, umm... massage it for me?

You're really good at giving massages... I thought you were just supposed to press down on the sore spot, but now that you're doing this, I can tell - location, pressure, and what order you do things in all matter.
Phew... Right there... I think it's starting to loosen up a bit. Wow... You're really good at this, Commander.
(Urk... The Commander's been staring at my feet for a while. This is embarrassing... Are the soles really that hard to work out?)
Is this hard part what you call a knot? So you cup it in your palm and slowly work it out along the muscle... Hey, it does feel a little better. It works!
My hair is wet? Oh, don't worry about it. The breeze will take care of it. Might mess up my styling a little, though...
Pfft... Hahahaha! Wh-why does... Haha, why does it tickle, hahaha, instead of hurt?! I-I'll do the soles myself... C-Commander, stop, hahaha!
I-is this part of the massage?!
Great work out there, Commander. Hm? I see you brought a towel and... massage oil, huh? Is that for my legs? Oh, and my soles, too...? I-I see.
I know I ought to solve my own problems, but being with you makes me feel like I can be vulnerable... Is this what it means to trust your beloved?
Light carrier Independence reporting. Retrofitting complete. I'm ready to take on harder, more vital missions. Leave anything like that to me.
Light carrier Independence reporting. Retrofitting complete. I'm ready to take on harder, more vital missions. Leave anything like that to me.
I'm in top condition and ready as always, Commander. Rest easy.
I am fully accustomed to my new weaponry. My next battles will be legendary in naval history. Okay, maybe not to that extent.
I should probably hang out with my own sisters as much as I hang out with Cleveland...
I've finished all the work you assigned me. Proofread it at your leisure.
Even I, someone who's terrible at inferring people's feelings, can clearly see how passionately Princeton is about her goals.
Are we sortieing? Or is there administrative work to do around the port? Either way, leave it to me.
What the-?!
You conducted that battle masterfully, Commander. Let's take a moment to roost, then get to work on the post-battle report.
Commission goods have arrived. I'll help transport them, of course.
Nothing can stand between my wings and the skies!
Essex-class aircraft carrier - Shangri-La, Hull Number CV-38.

My name, Shangri-La, has its origins in a famous operation from the war. Being an Essex-class, I've been all over the world and got to record a myriad of things and events in my notebook. This, to me, is my source of pride.
CV-38, Shangri-La, has arrived. I'd like to share the stories in this notebook with you someday... but first, let's concentrate on the task at hand.
Welcome back, Commander. I recorded all the noteworthy events that took place while you were gone. Would you care to read about them?
I strictly follow the principle of divulging nothing to outsiders, but giving full disclosure to my superior officers.
Are you curious about these butterflies? Bugwatching is one of my hobbies, actually. I brought these darlings with me from Panama.
Anti-sub warfare? I'd love to try my hand at it, should the opportunity arise. Who knows, I may be surprisingly talented!
Ensuring you stay in good health is part of my job, Commander. I sincerely urge you to be careful so as to not overwork yourself.
My hair ornaments? They're a gift from Yat Sen; she said they go well with my name.
Which story would you like to hear, Commander? The one about the undiscovered haven, or the wonderland beyond the horizon?
Did you just perform a health examination on me?
We've received a mission from headquarters. I made note of it in our task list.
A mission has been completed. I wonder what our reward will be. Perhaps an unmanned recon aircraft?
You've received new mail. If you're short on time, you could consider having me read it out for you.
The fleet has returned to port. Let us hold a tactical debriefing once everyone has had some time to rest.
A commission has been completed. Shall go and we receive the returning team?
Thank you. I will repay your generosity with greater glory in battle.
Turn bow to the wind! We shall teach them the importance of freedom!
Shangri-La will forever be out of reach to the likes of you.
This wasn't... supposed to happen!
Weather the storm and fight with all your might!
Put out the fire! Please, hurry!
You've been added to my confidential informee blacklist, Commander. Do keep that in mind.
Starting today, I will take notes on everything related to you, Commander.
Commander, no matter how pressed for time you may be, eating junk food will only impact your health negatively. Please, I urge you to have this more healthy sandwich I made.
*sigh*, I've asked you time and time again to be more health-conscious... Please, have this cup of saffron tea. It's good for you.
Did you know that the saffron flower symbolizes joy in floriography? To me, writing your biography, fighting by your side, and personally looking after you... That is the greatest joy of my life.

I'd love to write down my feelings without a moment's delay, but a more important task is at hand: holding you in a close embrace. I, Shangri-La, will forever be with you, following you to the mystical land at the end of your journey.
Oh, could I ask you to hold it for me, Commander? I'd like to take a photograph of your gift as a memento.
Don't worry too much, I'm sure we will one day surpass Enterprise.
Would you mind lending me some aircraft, Miss... Umm, "Miss Cowgirl"?
Commander, welcome to my "Utopia." Here, you can find my prized collection. Now, where should we start our detailed tour?
Commander, welcome to my "Utopia." Here, you can find my prized collection. Now, where should we start our detailed tour?
Welcome back, Commander. Let's warm you up with a nice, hot drink. Would you like coffee or hot cocoa?
This shawl you gave me is really cozy. Hehe, let's huddle up like this... There, now we share the warmth.
If the opportunity presents itself, I might just host my own exhibit. Perhaps I could call it... "Caracal"?
I wouldn't mind sharing some of my prized specimens with you, Commander. You'd take good care of them, wouldn't you?
*click*! Nice, a fine new addition to my photo collection. I name it... "Fleet Commander, in Profile." Hehehe~
Would you like to learn how to pin a specimen, Commander?
Both specimens and girls alike must be treated delicately. Understood, Commander?
Did you come across a new specimen I could add to my collection, Commander? Hehehe~
*yawn*... Oh, was I dozing off just now? Sorry for that, Commander. I just feel so relaxed when I'm with you... But thanks for lending me your shoulder to rest on. Hehehe~
This specimen looks to be fairly ancient... You could watch from behind me, or you could join me for an up-close examination; we can enjoy our time here however you wish.
This specimen looks to be fairly ancient... You could watch from behind me, or you could join me for an up-close examination; we can enjoy our time here however you wish.
One needs knowledge to write a story. Knowledge on ships, on people, and on the world as a whole. Say, Commander, has anyone ever told you, "Read a book or two"? Hehehe~
It seems I can only make notes and sketches as there's no photography allowed here... I'm a little annoyed by that.
Wait, Intrepid! Don't run around recklessly! Good grief... Could you please go help her out, Commander?

Though not as old as these fossils, there have been relics found that indicate saffron was being cultivated during the Bronze Age. Incidentally, would you care for some tea if you're thirsty, Commander?
Ah, I believe a theory recently surfaced, claiming that dinosaurs were feathery, not scaly. But what do you think, Commander?
Should I respond like a dinosaur and go, "Graaawr!" for you? Hehehe~
What are your thoughts on this specimen, Commander? Hehe, would you say it befits your glory?
Type 1934 destroyer - Z2 Georg Thiele.

I am Georg Thiele, otherwise known as Z2, a Type 1934 destroyer built as an experiment. I was to make quick work of adversaries using my excellent mobility, or at least that was the plan... I'd rather not elaborate. Please forget I said that.
I am Z2, Georg Thiele, awaiting your orders. However, if your orders are flawed, please allow me to reconsider them. May our relationship be productive.
Commander, I have a question: why do you always arrive later than me?
Commander, I have a question, do you have a thing for making others dress up in fancy clothes?
Commander, please try not to be as reckless as Lebe. It would be annoying to have to knock you out, and I don't particularly like getting physical with a superior officer.
I'll bring you a fresh batch of paperwork if you have nothing better to do. I hope you're ready.
This little one is Lebe. Yes, you heard that correctly; this is Lebe. Isn't she cute?
Oh, absolutely, I agree wholeheartedly. Now, what's our next task?
Among all actions that take bravery, this would, in my honest opinion, be the worst kind.
We've received new missions. I organized them to give you a solid overview. You're welcome.
I'll obey if you order me to claim the mission rewards, but my opinion of you will worsen. Is that an acceptable tradeoff to you?
You have mail. I propose that you open and read it as soon as possible. You are prone to forgetting about it, otherwise.
I've put together an after-action report, as you ordered. Please have a look.
The commission team has returned. Naturally, we should greet and praise them for their hard work. I can accompany you, if need be.
Won't I develop some sort of flaw if I get even stronger?
Be wary of ambushes and try not to overextend yourselves.
There are countless examples of seizing defeat from the jaws of victory. Let us not underestimate our foes.
I'll cover everyone. I'm quite good at these things, owing to Lebe's help. You may rest easy.
I can still go faster. Just a bit more.
My magazine is flooding... which is quite bad.
I don't mind being near you, but I'm afraid that Lebe does.
Is there anything you wish to know about Lebe, Commander? Oh, you're more interested in me? You're quite the curious one. Please give me a minute to think.
You want to make small talk again? Why? You should know that the only answers I ever offer are nods and affirmations. Could it be that you actually like canned responses like that?
You are a commander with many strange ideas, but that may just be the perfect fit for a person with Lebe for an arm like me.
Commander, if you wish to take our relationship to the next level, simply keep being yourself; say what you want to, and do what you want to. That is all I need from you.

So this is marriage. I never thought I'd form an unbreakable bond with someone... What was that? I'm blushing? Umm... could you please take a photo of me right now? I've never seen myself red in the face before.
A gift? I don't remember doing anything to warrant that from you, Commander...
Please don't take it too far, Lebe. The cleanup would be annoying.
Ride the waves and sail the... Never mind I said anything.
Commander, I do wonder if your order to "come dressed in new clothes" was simply your way of saying "I want to see you in a casual outfit." No matter the case, I'm happy to oblige.
Commander, I do wonder if your order to "come dressed in new clothes" was simply your way of saying "I want to see you in a casual outfit." No matter the case, I'm happy to oblige.
You'd like to know how I spend my free time? Your inquisitiveness truly boggles the mind, Commander.
Hm? Are you staring at me in hopes of making me initiate conversation? Apologies, but I'm afraid that won't happen.
Do I have any other expressions? A better question is: do you deserve a different expression? ...I'm joking, of course. I'm just too lazy to make any other face. That is all.
Take this opportunity to go outside and take a breather, Commander. I mean, you won't be completing all this work any time soon anyway.
A stroll through the city? I fear we'd be mistaken for a couple, so I must kindly decline.
Allow me to reiterate: Lebe does bite if provoked.
Welcome back. Please forgive me for greeting you with such an inhospitable look. It is not acceptable behavior on my part. Wait just a moment, please. I will massage my face into a better expression.
Are you having trouble breaking the ice, Commander? Then allow me to ask the question on your mind. Would you like to go somewhere with me?

Being able to see you all flabbergasted makes changing into this outfit worth it. Are you going to keep standing there like a scarecrow? Come over here~ Who knows, we might even be able to see the fireworks from this spot.

Being able to see you all flabbergasted makes changing into this outfit worth it. Are you going to keep standing there like a scarecrow? Come over here~ Who knows, we might even be able to see the fireworks from this spot.
Commander, keeping young maidens waiting isn't something you should be proud of.
When we're together like this... Yes, it does undeniably look like a "date."
Lebe, I know festivals are fun, but I think you're having a bit too much fun...
"A carp becoming a dragon?" ...Lebe, do you want me to teach you what that means?
Festivals, delicious food, and wondrous scenery... Yes, I finally understand the miraculous "summer" that my Sakura Empire friends spoke of.
If you wanted to talk to me, wouldn't it be better if you at least had a topic in mind? Heh.
Commander, I'm not going to accept an excuse as flimsy as "I needed to fix your clothes."
Good work on your sortie. Would you like to recharge with some sweets? For the time being, I set these aside for your enjoyment.
Essex-class aircraft carrier - Bunker Hill, Hull Number CV-17.

Essex-class, Bunker Hill. My name comes from a battlefield in the Revolutionary War. I've seen my fair share of battles... and know that war brings nothing but sorrow and pain. Let's not talk about it any more.
Bunker Hill, one of the Essex-class carriers, is joining the fleet under your command. Don't worry, you'll see the extent of my abilities soon enough.
We're in a state of emergency. Be prepared to run the Holiday Express, even if it's a holiday.
Commander, why are you staring at me...?
Right now, another place out there is being engulfed by the flames of war...
Eldridge's ability? I'm not exactly sure, but... I feel like I've seen it somewhere...
All resistance is meaningless before the Essex-class's attack formation.
...Don't think I'm upset just because I have little to say. Just let me know if you need anything.
By the looks of things, you won't learn your lesson without some harder-hitting "experience."
Missions... should best be completed in a timely manner.
There are a ton of rewards? Of course.
The mail's here... Wonder if there's any new intel?
You've returned? ...Very well. Why don't we prepare for the next sortie?
Pardon, but I'll go greet the girls who are coming back from their commission. Just wait here until I report back.
I grow stronger... yet again...
Why did they choose to become our enemy...?!
So this is the end that you all chose...
Their power... surpasses even the "Dragon's Jaws"...?
Resistance is futile!
Why now of all times...?!
I'd rather not talk to you right now.
There is no beauty in warfare. There is only ugliness in the suffering and loss of life we inflict upon each other.
Don't think I'm upset just because I have little to say. If anything, I'm probably thinking about something, or about how to express myself.
Something strange has been going on with my thoughts recently. Whenever I start thinking about things, your face pops up in my head and makes it hard for me to stay calm...
We were born as weapons of warfare, and I thought that is all we would ever be. But having spent time with you, I'm beginning to think... that there's more to our lives than war.
Sorry... My mind has gone completely blank... I'm lost for words... Oh, that's right! "I pledge loyalty and love to you until the end of time." ...How does that sound?
I never thought I'd be getting a present from you. Thanks.
You are nothing before the Essex class.
Project Rainbow? ...It has a nice ring to it...
Mission complete. Next up, a new recommendation from Long Island... Oh, Commander? Come make yourself comfortable.
Mission complete. Next up, a new recommendation from Long Island... Oh, Commander? Come make yourself comfortable.
Relax, Commander. The Holiday Express is always ready to depart, no matter the time or occasion.
Just completed another game. Might be time to go ask the ghost for more recommendations.
Calm down, Intrepid! You'll break the controller!
Ugh, so many achievements left... This game has too many damn things to do!
Nothing complements a gaming session like a refreshing Oxy-cola. Georgia was right all along.
You wanna play? The other controller's over there. You go first, and if you can't beat the boss, I'll help.
Dammit... I'd better wrap this up...
The commission team's back? I'll see to them in a minute. I need to get to a save point first.
This is the end you yourselves chose...
Type A Mod. 2 cruiser submarine - I-13.

I'm I-13, formally known as the Type A Mod. 2 cruiser submarine model thirteen. Some people call me the fifth of the Type A model, but I was really just an upgraded model that could store Seirans. Sounds cool, doesn't it? Well, sadly, I didn't achieve much of note...
Hi, Commander. I'm the aviation submarine I-13. My hobbies include aircraft and gazing up at the sky! Also, this is my friend, my Seiran. I'm glad to meet you.
Welcome back, Commander. The skies are ever blue!
There's only so many things a regular submarine can do. To turn the war around, we need more wings in the air.
Don't get the wrong idea about me, Commander. I do love aircraft, but that doesn't mean I hate myself for being a submarine.
The sea is the color of the sky. And the sky is the same color as me!
There's the Type 97 and Type 99, the Suisei, Tenzan, Ryuusei, Saiun, and of course, my Seiran. I know everything there is to know about aircraft!
Mmh... If you're gonna headpat me, just a little is fine…
I'm okay with lending you my Seiran, but it's veeeeery expensive! Break it, and I'll be really angry, okay?
Don't make me pepper you with my Seiran's machine guns.
Remember to give those missions a look, okay, Commander?
Commander, my Seiran just came back with the mission rewards.
Commander, my Seiran has arrived with mail.
Nice job on that last mission, Commander.
Hey, Commander, a commission should be done by now.
Maybe I can fit a few more Seirans once I get stronger?
Let's give it our best shot.
This victory will be a great help to our other fleets.
It's not good enough to be an ordinary submarine...
Here it comes... Everything I'm capable of!
I guess this is all a submarine can do...
You just don't understand me either, do you, Commander?
Welcome to my room, Commander. I've got books on aircraft lying around if you want to read those. Oh, and please be careful around the model plane on the shelf over there.
You think I'm weird, do you? Heheh, maybe I am... Just remember: there are only so many things a regular submarine can do. That's something I learned during my short time in service.
I've gotten closer to the carrier's aircraft now, and it's all thanks to you. I've never been this happy before in my life. Thank you, Commander!
I want to repay you somehow for everything you've done for me, Commander. I'll do anything you want! If I can help you, you can then help me back.
A... Hellcat? An Avenger? Even a Hurricane, and all these other planes?! You... went out and borrowed them all just for me? Oh, Commander... I love you so much I can't even think straight...!
Thanks a bunch~

ex.line: The skies are ever blue and beautiful, Commander! I'd love to take you for a sky ride with my Seiran.
When we visited the aircraft exhibit, I was spouting off facts and trivia the whole time... That didn't bore you, did it? ...Oh, you liked it? R-really? Heehee...
I'm used to looking at the sky from the sea. I wonder what it's like to look at the sea from the sky... Don't you think it'd be a breathtaking view?
What's your favorite color, Commander? ...Huh? The color I am? Oh, well, that's just... Heehee♪
Fighters hide in the clouds, and submarines hide under the water. Both are fantastic for launching a surprise attack!
Heehee - headpat me all you want!
Up we... go! You're curious about my horns, aren't you, Commander? Touch them if you want!
Whuah?! C-Commander! No surprises, please!
Welcome back, Commander! I got tickets for the aircraft exhibition. We should go there if you have the time!
No matter how little strength one person has, you find surprising ways to leverage it, Commander! Being with you and doing my best at everything makes me so happy.

lines.line: So high up... But it's okay, Commander - I have a good sense of balance. Anyway, wanna see what's down there?
So high up... But it's okay, Commander - I have a good sense of balance. Anyway, wanna see what's down there?

Are you heading home, too, Commander? Heehee - alright, then come to me. The view here is mindblowing. You can see all kinds of stuff from up high. Heehee... I took my shoes off so I won't slip, so don't worry about me.
Commander, have you ever done animal observation reports? I swim with fish in the sea all the time, but I've never observed an animal up close like this before... It's really fascinating!
The roundy-head's an octopus♪ The longy-head, yes, that's a squid♪ Let's find out what friends we'll meet today♪
Be careful of poisonous fish, Commander. Like the pufferfish, and the striped eel catfish, and the manta ray... Luckily, we don't have to worry about them here!
Can't even find one with my Seiran... Oh, I was talking about clams. I used to do clam-digging at the beach long ago. I remember my feet getting stuck in the mud, which wasn't nice...
Hrmph... I'm standing higher up, so why am I the one getting headpatted?!
What is it, Commander? Do you wanna observe with me?
C-Commander! You'll make me lose my balance... It'll really hurt if I fall from here!
You should come up here. You can really feel the breeze up here. It'll blow all your fatigue away! Come on, I'll help you take off your jacket.
The sky and the sea come together into one up here. Everything's dyed blue. Heehee - I wish we could look at this view forever and ever.
Mogami-class heavy cruiser number three - Suzuya.

I am Suzuya, third ship of the Mogami class. During that war, I fought alongside Mogami as a member of CruDiv 7. My last battle left me with a bit of regret... but I've been given a new beginning on this battlefield, and I'll fight alongside my new companions with a fresh outlook. I look forward to working with you.
I am Suzuya, Mogami-class heavy cruiser. I place myself under your command from this day forward.
Welcome back, Commander. Which job should we take on first?
Commander? Oh, I'm just preparing for the next lecture at the auditorium. Please don't worry about me, and continue your work as normal.
Commander is looking at... N-nothing, don't worry about it!
Kumano, please don't make trouble for Mogami, all right? She's going to get a stomachache again...
We're sometimes called the Suzuya class, but I still prefer being called the Mogami class. We all fought together during that war after all..
Commander... where do you think you're looking? Don't think I wouldn't notice... I could feel your gaze boring into me... Am I right?
Nnh... So this is what you were after from the very beginning... I knew it all along. I've always known, this entire time... Ehehehe~♡
I've arranged the status of our current missions. Please look over them.
The mission rewards have arrived. That is good news.
The mail has arrived. There's something for you, Commander... Ah...
We must apply what we've learned to future battles. Shall I prioritize writing the report first?
The commission team has returned to port. What's next? Shall I go with you to greet them?
My abilities have been enhanced. Well done.
I won't run away again... I swear it!
Congratulations. Eh, I'm the MVP...? Th-thank you very much...
Ugh... I guess that's it...
It's time to get serious...!
As if this... would be enough to make me turn back!
Mogami may often fail to recognize her own worth, but more and more people are starting to see how little you're worth.
Would you like to learn more about the Mogami class? Very well, I'll be glad to explain everything from the top. Which one of us would you like to hear about first?
You're... most interested in Suzuya? Of course, I'd be glad to give you the details... but just explaining things wouldn't be enough, right...?
...There's no point hiding it. I already know how you feel about me. Just shut up and... give in to your feelings already!
Ahh... Commander, your gaze is so passionate... so I can finally tell you... I've always admired you... Huh?! What's this? I feel all fluttery...!
(whispers) Commander, when this ritual is over... you know what's next, right? Don't worry. I'll treat you better than anyone else. Isn't that right, darling~♡
Commander, thanks a bunch. I'll keep this safe!
I can understand your pain.
Did I also...? No, I would never.
Suzuya, the Mogami-class heavy cruiser, will be the nurse taking care of you today. Heehee, let's have fun with this nighttime examination, shall we?
Suzuya, the Mogami-class heavy cruiser, will be the nurse taking care of you today. Heehee, let's have fun with this nighttime examination, shall we?
Commander, it's time for your examination. I'll check your body temperature, blood pressure, and so much more... Where would you like to start?
Hmm? Oh, I'm just organizing your medical records. Keep on resting there, and I'll take care of you soon.
It's so hard to take my eyes off you when you're sleeping... Yes, I know you're awake. I'm telling you that you should go to sleep, silly.
Listening to your breath in a quiet hospital bed at night is so very relaxing... I wish I could take care of you forever...
*pant*... Your eyes... are ever guided by the syringe in my hand...
Huh? S-such sudden touch... N-no, as your nurse, this level of touch should be alright, I'm sure!
Ever since I became a nurse, your gaze has gotten more and more lascivious... Heheh, don't worry, I get it...
Mm... Let's wait until we're done and the door is locked, okay?
You have unfinished missions... Let me help. You won't recover until you get your bed rest.
Well done, Commander. You've finished both your missions and your physical therapy. As a reward, I made a nutritious meal for you.
Commander, new mail just arrived for you. It might be your examination results, heehee... Allow me to nestle in and read it to you.
Heehee, you're a little late. Come and lie down, now. It's not good for a patient to leave the nurse's side for so long.
Has your commission team returned? Then I'll stop for now... I'll be back after I've welcomed them home.
Aah... Just the two of us alone in a hospital room... Yes, I'll care for you more earnestly than anyone else ever would. After all, you're my one and only, my most beloved patient...
Fast Battleship, second ship of the Kongou-class Hiei.
Once my big sister Kongou comes back, we're going to shock the world! Until then, I need to work hard to become a leader worthy of her! But.... courtly etiquette is really hard.....
