Awright! It's my turn to be it! One, two, skip a few... Ninety-nine, a hundred! Here I come, Commander!
Commander, you jerk!
I'm gonna finish up all these missions in one fell swoop!
Sooooo many rewards! Well? I'm pretty helpful, aren't I?
Commander, you always get so much mail... Next time, I'll write you a letter too!
Commander, were you trying to play hide-and-seek with me?
...?! Commander, my Sandy Senses are tingling! There's someone waiting at the port!
Eehhh? Is this stuff really going to be useful?
We're headed for the ocean! Chaaaaarge!!
Did you see that? Just now?! I'm freakin' awesome!
Huhhh? Isn't that the way back home?
Got it! It's about time we get serious~!
Hey, guys, why so serious??
Don't feel bad, Commander, it's not your fault that you're dumber than San Diego.
The key to happiness is to not worry about the stuff you don't get. Isn't that right, Commander?
What should I do if there's stuff that I can't stop worrying about though...? Ah! Got it! That's what Commander is there for!
No matter what kind of stuff I ask you, you always have an answer... Commander, are you actually pretty smart?!
As long as you're here, Commander, I'll know where to turn to whenever I have any problems! Hehe, I love how you know everything, Commander!
What's this shiny, loopy thing? I'm supposed to put it on my finger? Ooh, it's so pretty! Hehe, I guess I'll keep it on then!
For me? You're the best, Commander!
Hey, Atl-auntie, look over here! Here!
Together, we're ☆invincible☆!
I am Swiftsure, a light cruiser of the Royal Navy... If it is not too much for one such as myself to ask, I would like to support your fleet in whatever way I can.

I am Swiftsure, of the Royal Navy. I joined towards the end of the war, but with it winding down and fate taking some odd twists and turns, I wasn't able to perform as expected. If it pleases you, I will serve the fleet with everything I have. Oh, but if it doesn't, you need not worry about me...
I am Swiftsure, a light cruiser of the Royal Navy... If it is not too much for one such as myself to ask, I would like to support your fleet in whatever way I can.
Good morning. Here is your work for the day... *Sigh*...
Um, sorry I made such a mess... Sheffield tried to teach me how to clean, but I'm a lot worse at it than I expected... Ahaha...
Commander, let's work as hard as we ever do, eh?
Commander, do you think a Lady of the Royal Navy should be more elegant? Not like the maids, I mean Fiji and Jamaica... They stand out quite a bit... is that alright?
I envy the Knight Commander. If only I could comport myself so... Sorry about that. Forget I said anything.
As your secretary ship, I am responsibile for everything in all of the reports.
Commander, um... I think fleet regulations call this kind of thing "inappropriate..."
Commander, I've finished sorting out these tasks. Do look them over.
Commander, I've finished tallying up the mission rewards. Do look them over.
Commander, you have new mail. Oh, I've been checking about once per hour. So I don't think I've... no, I haven't missed any.
Excellent work. I've prepared a report for you. Take a moment to look it over.
Commander, the commission is nearly complete. If you head out now, you should be able to meet them as they return.
Swiftsure, swiftly and surely, everyone is counting on you...!
All ships, forward...! Form up on me!
Um, I... really tried...
Sorry. If only I had tried harder...
Get the timing right... I should be able to do this!
I have to get the others to safety, at least...!
Someone like me deserves a Commander like this...
Commander, do you have something for me? I can handle anything... Oh, but only if you're okay with me...
Fiji is always telling me to smile more. Is she right? Oh... Sorry, I must be boring you with this...
The Commander told me to help Jamaica fix up her bike. Hehehe, it turned out to be a lot more fun than I thought... Oh, Commander, sorry... about that... just now...

I think I'd probably be better off being all cool like Sheffield than trying to smile all the time like Fiji... Right? If I every so often let slip a smile that could catch the Commander's eye... Oh, um, forget everything I said just now!
I'm really sorry about all this. Are you honestly okay with someone like me...? The way I am...? Umm, if you're alright with me, then I'll gladly be your partner! Commander, thank you so much!
My apologies... Did I do something worthy of this reward?
Right! Here I go... swiftly!
Commander, why are you here...? Me? Yes, as you can see, I'm still studying... I figured that acquiring knowledge would be the best way to make up for my lack of experience on the actual battlefield.
Commander, why are you here...? Me? Yes, as you can see, I'm still studying... I figured that acquiring knowledge would be the best way to make up for my lack of experience on the actual battlefield.
Good morning. Here is the outline for today's course. Please make sure to review it.
Unicorn, this is how you do this problem... Oh sorry, Commander, I'm currently helping the others study. Please make yourself feel at home.
Fiji, don't you know that studying is good for you? Come on, Commander, care to back me up on this one?
While I have served as a flagship before, that has nothing to do with what's going on now. I have to be humble and learn from everyone.
I often see Edinburgh in the library. She's always grumbling about what's going on in the maid team or something...
I look cute when wearing glasses...? Err... Um, that wasn't my intention...
Commander, I d-don't think you should be doing this at school... Ahh!
Commander, you have new mail. I've instructed the Manjuus to help fetch the mail for me even when I can't do it myself, so worry not.

I agreed to try on this outfit, but... I know these fancy outfits don't suit me... H-huh, I look gorgeous?! ...Thank you very much. Even if you're just trying to make me feel better, I appreciate it...

I agreed to try on this outfit, but... I know these fancy outfits don't suit me... H-huh, I look gorgeous?! ...Thank you very much. Even if you're just trying to make me feel better, I appreciate it...
Happy Lunar New Year, Commander. Why don't you set aside your work today and take some time off?
Hmm, what should we do next? Why don't we see if there's anyone who needs help...? Just sitting here idly somehow doesn't feel quite right...
Um, are you redecorating the office? Do you need me to help?
I got some red envelopes as gifts from my seniors in the fleet. Ahaha... I'm not sure how I feel about this...
Commander, the more free time everyone else has, the less free time you seem to― Um, oh my...
If you're cold, p-please... feel free to use my shawl.
C-Commander... What if someone sees us...?!

I just made a snowman with the others... Huh? Did you want to see it, Commander? Um, in that case... Oh, right! That snowman already got knocked down and remade into something else! You shouldn't look at the one I made...
W-welcome! ...Ugh, I'm still way too nervous... Ah, um! H-how may I serve you today, Commander...?
W-welcome! ...Ugh, I'm still way too nervous... Ah, um! H-how may I serve you today, Commander...?
Commander, what will your first order be?
So I need to put this headband on... I wonder what kind of hairstyle would be good? Um, let's tie my hair up like this... Actually, maybe twintails would be better instead?
Commander, is something wrong? ...Is this outfit really too stimulating, like Sheffield said it was...? Or... is it actually too conservative, like Fiji said it was...?
Everyone acts much more freely when they're at the beach. Do you think I should do the same? A-Alright, I'll give it a try... Y-Yo!
When I'm helping Neptune, I feel like a completely different person. ...Oh. What would you like to have, Commander?
Um... This outfit really is quite embarrassing...
...Eek! C-Commander...!
Commander, there's new mail for you. I apologize, but I didn't have the time to check its contents beforehand. If it's alright with you, I'd like to check the contents with you, right now...!
Welcome back, Commander. If... If you'd like, please enjoy this refreshing beverage...
Take a deep breath, Swiftsure... Everyone, please commence attack on the enemy!
Le Fantasque-class destroyer - Le Malin.

I am Le Malin, Le Fantasque-class destroyer of the Vichya Dominion. I once fought alongside my friends of the 8th Light Division in Brest. After that, Le Triomphant went down a different path... Well, we don't hold it against each other.
I am the mirage that chases the waves, the poisoned blade that protects the Vichya Dominion. Super Destroyer, Le Malin, is yours to command.
Destroyer, Le Malin, is ready to take your orders at any time... *yaawnn*...
*Yawn*... Sleepy... I wanna go roll around in bed... Zzzzz... Geh?! Wh-what is it?!
Without firepower, speed alone is not enough to defeat the enemy. That goes without saying.
So bored... maybe it's time to quit... Gah! I didn't say anything!
Dunkerque's handmade sweets... Guhehe... Ah, I mustn't! I'm still at work...!
Being elegant... isn't worth the effort... Geh?! Wh-what do you want?!
Hyah?! Wh-what are you doing?!
We have new orders, Commander.
Commander, rewards incoming from above.
This letter's for you, Commander... Is there nothing for me?
I steeped this tea just the way Triomphant taught me. ...So you knew, huh? Indeed, it's just a normal cup of tea. Please enjoy it.
The others have returned. Let's hurry and greet them.
It wouldn't be right if I didn't work even harder.
The blade that protects the Vichya Dominion advances!
I've eliminated those who would stand in our way.
I won't admit defeat... I haven't lost yet!!
Begone!!
So strong...!
...... (Le Malin seems to have fallen asleep)
Destroyer Le Malin is both your secretary and the blade that protects the Vichya Dominion. Please give me your orders.
I, I did say that I was ready to take your orders at any time, but... there's just too much work after all...... Tired... Can't work anymore... Please let me go on leave...
I, I can go home early today because I did such a good job...? Woah... Woohoo! Now I can head back and go to sleep! ...S-sorry, I got a bit excited there...
Commander, t-today, can we leave work a bit earlier? ...It's not because I'm tired! Um, I was thinking... if you wanted to go on a date or something...
As the blade that protects the Vichya Dominion, I, Le Malin, swear to defend you and offer you my eternal love. Um... this is really tiring... Commander, let's head back already...
Thank you very much... I'll take good care of it!
Welcome back... Le Triomphant.

ex.line: Destroyer, Le Malin... *yawn*... ready to sortie at... *yaawn*... Can't do this... Too sleepy...
Roll, roll, rolling around... Commander, wanna join me?
I didn't really do anything, but I still worked hard anyway... Yeah, go me~!
Hungry... Wanna eat Dunkerque's sweets... If I push through this, I'll be able to slack off later...Wh-what a pain...
We have new orders. They're addressed to you, Commander.
Commander, the mission rewards are here!
Le Triomphant taught me how to make this tea... Look, I did it normally this time. No idea if it tastes any good though...
The others have come back. Let's hurry up and welcome them back. Come on~!
The heart of the Iris continues through me!
The elegant arts of the Le Fantasque class... knows no equal!
Le Triomphant... Commander... I'm sorry!
I do want... to go on a date, but I always get tired when we go to some faraway place... W-we should just go on a date at the dorms! Right?

lines.line: Morning, Commander~ Mm, the Sabbath is the day of rest, so I shall not budge from my sacred charge even if you were to call Triomphant over. I solemnly swear to do absolutely nothing today.
Morning, Commander~ Mm, the Sabbath is the day of rest, so I shall not budge from my sacred charge even if you were to call Triomphant over. I solemnly swear to do absolutely nothing today.
Tired... Don't wanna work... Commander, don't call for me even if you have something that needs doing...
Ahem! Commander, I brought coffee! N-no way! How'd you figure out that I slipped cold medication into it...?!
I don't wanna do any more work todayyy... Commander, let's hurry up and take a break already~! Right! Now!
Hyah?! ...Jeez, what are you doing! Just when I was about to fall asleep...
Witness the power of the Le Fantasque class!
Extermination complete...... Wait, didn't I say I wasn't going to do anything today?!
I really can't get any work done today after all... I just want to head back and relax already...
I must commend you for being able to find my secret base, Commander... but unfortunately for you, I refuse to return to the office today. Just... *yawn*...let me spend the whole day sleeping here...
I must commend you for being able to find my secret base, Commander... but unfortunately for you, I refuse to return to the office today. Just... *yawn*...let me spend the whole day sleeping here...
Commander... Ice creammm...
This hammock feels pretty nice, but I can't roll around... A tactical failure...
Too bad you can't turn into an air conditioner, Commander... Otherwise, I'd cling to you all day... Zzzzzz...
In any case, Le Malin will now go take a most elegant nap. Don't bother me even if there's something that needs doing... and save me some Cola and snacks... Zzzzzz...
Who's that over there? ...Le Terrible?! C-c-c-commander! Hide me! If that girl finds me, I'm not gonna be able to sleep the day away!
Swim? Hehehe, not to brag or anything, but I'll show you the most elegant way to float!
I'm too slovenly...? Meh, haven't you already known that for ages~?
A new mission? Don't wanna... Th-there's ice cream in it for me? F-fine, I'll do it!
The commander's out there working hard, but here I am... Zzz...
Commander... Let's hurry back and turn on the air conditioning...
So hot...... Why must we sortie in this kind of weather?!
Eh? It's already time to go home...? Geh! It's already evening! Hmm?! I can't move my legs because I overslept... Commander, help me...
Zzz... zzz... Huh? Commander? I was in the middle of a nap... Oh, this outfit? It's cool, comfy, and cute. If you don't need anything from me, I'm going back to sleep...
Zzz... zzz... Huh? Commander? I was in the middle of a nap... Oh, this outfit? It's cool, comfy, and cute. If you don't need anything from me, I'm going back to sleep...
Welcome back. Sure, let's keep it casual... I don't care either way, hehe...
This outfit is nice and smooth... Perfect for rolling around, right?
Le Triomphant is looking for me? Y-you're just trying to scare me! I d-don't believe that at all!
This outfit is great for rolling around on the comfy couch... It'd be a waste to not take a nap... Zzzzz...
It's time for a lunch break! ...What do you mean there's still more work to do? Let's just push it back to tomorrow...
Huh...? Do you need something...?
Gwaaah?! Wh-where do you think you're touching! That scared me...
Today's "scheduled break time" is still in effect for a few more hours. In other words... Please do it yourself.
The commission fleet's back? Y'know, I don't think I should be going outside, looking like this and all... So, you can go by yourself, Commander!
We won? ...Let's head back and go to sleep~
I wouldn't have signed up if I knew this was going to happen...
Le Hardi-class destroyer - L'Opiniâtre.

I saw many things during the war, though my construction never finished. But now I get to lead a new life as a part of this fleet... This is a gift from the magic realm... or rather, a gift from destiny.
I'm the destroyer L'Opiniâtre, a so-called "magician" from Iris Libre. It's a pleasure meeting you. Umm, actually, please forget the "magician" part.
I knew you'd be back right about now, Commander. Hm? Oh, well... I made that prediction based on your day-to-day activity.
This book lists hundreds upon hundreds of powerful spells... In my imagination, that is. It's just a regular old book of fairy-tales. No, really, that's all.
Let me tell you... Miss Dunkerque's sweets are truly magical.
Poke. Hm? Oh, don't mind me. I just got a sudden urge to poke you with my wand. Pokey-poke.
If someone told you they'd grant you one wish, what would you ask for, Commander?
Feeling tired, Commander? Then would you like me to cast an awakening "spell" over your head with my wand?
Please stay where you are. I must go look for a spell that'll turn you into a rabbit.
Do I have a spell that automatically completes missions...? Sadly, I don't. Please do your best, Commander~
I wonder if there's a way to increase our mission rewards...
I present to you this mail brought by hand; no levitation spell used. Here you go.
Well done, Commander. Would you like a soft drink, rather than a spell, to reinvigorate with?
Our commission teams sure make magic happen.
It would be nice to have a spell that does my training on my behalf.
Keep it together, me! I can pull through with just my own powers...!
Hm? We won? I'm happy to know that my efforts led to this victory.
If only I had a spell that could protect us all...!
Attaque!
I refuse to admit defeat so soon! B-but how am I going to win?!
I wonder if there's a chant that'll turn you invisible...
Do you believe in magic, Commander?
Watch this coin closely, Commander. Left... right... left... right... Yes, you're feeling veeery sleepy... Oh. I suppose my hypnosis didn't quite work on you...
Please give me your hand, Commander. Okay, now put it over mine, like this... Wait, why isn't this working? The book said I'd be able to see into your mind if I do this...
You know, I always get so worked-up and feel my heart race just by being near you, Commander... Have you cast a sort of spell on me?
I had never even dreamed of partaking in a ceremony as sacred as this... Commander, I promise to treasure this feeling and remain beside you, forever and ever.
Wow. Are you a mind-reader, Commander?
You're overextending yourself, Tem!

ex.line: Now that I think about it, whenever I'm around you, Commander, my heart always feels fluttery and I can't calm down... Wait, could this be... the Magic of Love?!

lines.line: It is said that the summertime sea holds an extraordinary enchantment over people... but the only supernatural thing I'm feeling is this accursed heat... Am I missing something?
It is said that the summertime sea holds an extraordinary enchantment over people... but the only supernatural thing I'm feeling is this accursed heat... Am I missing something?
Jeez, how'd my glasses end up in the sand... Um, where's my handkerchief... ah, there it is! Oh, Commander, when did you get here?
It is undignified to stare so much at a maiden's swimsuit. B-besides, it's really embarrassing...
If only there was a spell to make it cool down... maybe something to blot out the sun? Hehe, just kidding. A cold drink will suffice. Commander, what would you like?
The sheer number of people gathered here... is this the mystical allure of the summertime beach?
Commander, have you seen Temeraire? ...She's playing beach volleyball with the others? Hehe, I see she's as full of energy as ever.
Commander... you didn't get heatstroke, did you?
Do you want to be turned into a starfish?
Everyone was saying how they wanted to head to the beach because of how hot it is, but it doesn't seem any cooler out here... Ugh...
Type B1 cruiser submarine - I-25.

I'm the Type-B class cruiser submarine, I-25. I'm at my best when it comes to reconnaissance and disrupting shipping routes. I've also been in some... pretty daring operations. Hehe~ Commander, you can count on me.
Phew... I finally found you! Commander, I'm I-25. I hope that I can be a big help to you. Anyway, it's nice meeting you~
Mmh... Welcome back, Commander. While you were gone, I finished compiling all the reports. Here you go~
Sorry to bother you when you're busy, Commander, but could you please help me test the capabilities of my seaplane?
Where I'm from, we always offer our respects for the food in front of us before each meal. It's a custom that helps us be at ease.
I hope my sister hasn't been causing too much trouble for you. She's a little ball of energy... there's no way I can keep up with her...
Commander... Commander...? Are you still asleep? I'm getting a bit worried...
Haah... I'm being filled to the brim with your energy, Commander...
Commander, do you... like this kind of sensation...?
There are still some missions that need to be completed. Commander, let's finish them together.
These are the fruits of everyone's efforts. Make sure to receive them with pride.
New mail keeps piling up... Commander, you should hurry up and start getting through these...
Judging by your grin, Commander, you must've had a resounding victory. Hehe, why don't you come here and let me massage your shoulders?
Everyone in the commission fleet has returned safely. Hmm... should I reward them with some homemade chocolate?
Hehe... Thank you for helping me become even more reliable, Commander~
Sometimes, you've got to stand out!
Heehee, from now on, just leave it to me~
Is everyone safe?
Now's our time to attack!
Now, this is a bit of a sticky situation...
Though I am very sorry that it has come to this, I must once again remind you that your poor work ethic has already affected the fleet.
Commander, thank you for coming to see me today. Because of you, I'll have some extra spring in my step. Hehe~
...Is Commander really not coming today..? I'm going to die of loneliness... ... C-Commander?! Did you hear me just now??

Commander, sorry to call you out all of a sudden, but I've just been so lonely... I'm quite bold, you say? Ehehe... Well, you know, I did have a bit of experience getting... tangled up with the enemy back then. Want to hear more about it?
Ahhn... Commander, you've come to see me again... Today... today, you won't leave my side this time, right? Commander, if you stay with me, I'll never be lonely ever again!
This is the proof of our oath to each other, Commander... Thank you so much! Finally, I've found my happiness! I'm so glad... we'll get to spend all our days together like this from now on! Ehehe~♪
I-is this a gift from Commander? Thank you! This makes me really happy!
Try not to get lost, all right?
Hi there, Commander. Oh, this outfit? I'll be wearing it to school today. By the way, did you want to come sit in on my class?
Hi there, Commander. Oh, this outfit? I'll be wearing it to school today. By the way, did you want to come sit in on my class?
D-deep sea fish, attack! Umm, uh... that's not how it works...? I don't seem to be very good at this...
Which subjects am I good at? I'd say I'm pretty decent at all of them. Ehehe, I did say you can leave everything to me.
Coral reefs are breathtakingly beautiful, Commander. If you ever want to see for yourself, just let me know.
This might sound strange coming from me, but forest fires are a very serious matter. There will be dire consequences if you don't take that to heart. Just ask the girls of the Eagle Union.
There's nothing wrong with I-19, right... The next time I-26 calls everyone to play, I'll go check on her.
Haah... as long as you're by my side, I feel safe and sound.
Woahh... Commander...
Uuhh... the whole time during class, I was thinking about when you'd come back, Commander... Looks like I-26 is going to make fun of me again...
Commander, Happy Lunar New Year. Would you like some sweet wine to celebrate? Oh, be careful not to drink too much~
Commander, Happy Lunar New Year. Would you like some sweet wine to celebrate? Oh, be careful not to drink too much~
Uhh... C-Commander, are you done making your rounds yet? ...Haah... thanks for filling me up with your energy today...
"S-Secret Technique: Dragon Dance!" ...Ungh, I can't do this after all... Commander, could you please have my sister do this instead...?
Thank you, everyone, for preparing all this Spring Festival food. Right, time to dig in... Ah, um, is it okay to start eating?
The Manjuus and Meowfficers are also busy preparing for the Spring Festival... Thanks for all the hard work~♪
If it's going to take a while to make your rounds, go get my sister instead... Actually, wait, can I come with you?
Please... rub my ears as well...
Commander, I've gotten enough of your energy... Hm, you want to load me up in advance? Mm... Okay!
M-my sister's going to get jealous...
Haah... haah... Here, this is for you~ I let the wine get to my head a little. Hehe~
I need to be a bit more graceful... both in celebration and in combat...!
Type B3 Mod. 2 cruiser submarine - I-56.
I am the 2nd ship of the Type-B Mod. 2 cruiser submarines, I-56. The most noteworthy thing about me... is that I did nothing noteworthy... But there wasn't much I could do at that point anyway...
I've been found... I... I'm I-56... Um, if there are any missions I can do by myself, could I get those?
Eep?! C-Commander... it's fine to not greet me...
Eep?! Oh, C-Commander... did you need something?
Commander, you're always dealing with so many people every day... Amazing... I-I'd never be able to do that...
Commander, being together with you is peaceful and quiet... I can calm down and think about lots of things...
Being athletic like 58 and 19.... err, I mean, 26... would be nice... Eek?! C-Commander? I-I didn't say anything!!
Commander, what's the matter? Ah, umm... was I muttering something weird to myself again?!
Eek?! C-Commander... this is just like in that book...?! Ah, um, forget I said that! Sorry...
Commander, these... these are mission delegations, right...?
*gasp*! Oh no... I spaced out while tallying the mission rewards...
Make sure to go through your mail carefully...
Today's sortie... went well then?
What's the commission of the composition team... Umm, I mean, the composition of the...
Um... th-thanks...
They didn't find me, right...?
Next time... I hope I don't get MVP...
Time to slink away quietly...
Y-you leave me no choice...!
L-Looks like I've drawn too much attention...
Leave... Leave me alone...
If you don't want to get caught up in bothersome things, it's probably better to be like thin air and not stand out...
Everyone in the fleet gets along so well... Ehe... hehehe... Um, it's nothing... l-leave me alone...
From time to time, my thoughts slip out when I'm muttering to myself... D-don't read too much into it...
Commander, sorry I haven't come to see you recently... It's just that... I've been thinking about you like crazy, and I can't stop it... It's so embarrassing...
Am... am I still fantasizing? Mmhm... probably, yup... Commander, give my cheeks a good pinch...!
I, I never thought I'd get something like this...
Who works best with 58...
School... is pretty nice. I can quietly stay in this corner and mind my own business...
School... is pretty nice. I can quietly stay in this corner and mind my own business...
The other kids often post all kinds of pictures onto social media from their phones... Commander, you can also take a look.
At school, you can see a completely different side of people. It can be pretty interesting...
I've received invitations from several clubs before... but I still prefer to watch others from a distance.
Don't worry, Commander. I'm enjoying my time at school.
... What's the matter, Commander? Oh, I was just watching that couple over there walking to school together...
New text message...? Um, Commander, new missions have been posted.
Commander, I just got out of school... Um, want to head back together?
I hope this doesn't get in the way of my school attendance...
Kaidai Type VIa submarine - I-168.
I am the submarine I-168. In the war, I avenged Hiryuu by taking out Yorktown and Hammann. Besides that... well... I really tried... but wasn't able to sink any other ships...
I'm I-168, but do call me Iroha. I expect you to know how to handle an extraordinary and decorated vessel such as myself!
You're very late! ... A submarine such as myself is extremely patient, but that doesn't mean you can keep me waiting for this long...
You want something from me, don't you? ... Well, even if you don't...
I'm bored... Entertain me, Commander!
I'm tired... I like it better in the ocean...
Hammann? If she wants to berate me then she can go ahead and try! I'll turn the tables on her!
W-what the hell?!
Don't touch me for no reason! ... It's a massage? O-okay... Continue...
Eeek?! W-what do you want?!
A mission...? Hmph! I'll show you how it's done! Now listen veeery carefully♪
You've done well! Here's your reward.
A letter for you. Do check it later! ... I wonder if there are any for me...
Nicely done. Now sit down and relax.
Marvelous work, everybody! ... Wonder if they found any rare stuff...
All right! I've become even stronger!
Let's go! We're hunting big game!
I DID IT! You see that? Did you see it?!
(Blub blub blub...)
Sink for me!
I hate scum like you. Don't come near me ever again.
Hmph! Doubt me all you want, but I'm THE Sakura Empire submarine that sank an important carrier. Now, get on your knees and worship me.
Tooru! I told you to quit tickling me with your Type A! ... Wait a sec, you're not Tooru!
Ever since I sank Yorktown in the war, I've been getting occasional angry glances from Hammann... B-but aren't we all friends now? I mean hey, even Yorktown herself says she's let go of it!
Hmph! If you prefer girls who are honest about their feelings, why not hook up with someone more honest than me? ... WHAT?! Hammann is NOT more honest with her feelings than me!
F-finally you decided to open up to me... You did right to choose me... Ehehe... W-what's that mean?! YOU'RE the one not being honest here!
Appreciate it~♪
Hammann, we're all friends now, you know!
I look different from usual? That's obvious, isn't it... All right, all right, I was just giving you a hard time. We're at a festival, so we might as well enjoy ourselves!
I look different from usual? That's obvious, isn't it... All right, all right, I was just giving you a hard time. We're at a festival, so we might as well enjoy ourselves!
Fried squid! Dango! Candied apples! Om nom nom... *Cough cough*! N-need water...!
I just love festivals! You have my permission to take a break today♪ ... It's the other way around?
G-going around town every now and then isn't so bad, I guess...
Hammann can't tie her yukata's sash on her own either... W-what's so funny?! Hardly anyone can tie that thing on their own!
I'm in a good mood, so I'll sink you with just a single shot!
W-woohoo?
Iron Blood Type VIIC submarine - U-101.

I'm U-101, one of the Iron Blood's 7th U-Boat Flotilla. I took part in four wolfpack operations. You could say that disrupting the enemy supply lines is my specialty - I even received a Knight's Cross! My hobby is going on long rides with Great Shark. Commander, wanna come with me?
Hey! You! That commander over there! How 'bout coming for a ride on my Great Shark? I'll show you a real thrillin' time!
Commander, just hit me up next time and I'll give you a ride, okay?
You know about those Union girls who call themselves "Solomon Knights" or something? Well, it has a nice ring to it... All righty, Commander, I'm an "Undersea Knight" from now on, got it?
Ah, Commander, wait just a sec. I've gotta finish fine-tuning Great Shark. We can go afterwards.
Great Shark is land-capable, you know. Well, just not as fast. Don't ask why it works that way!
What kind of music do you like to listen to on trips, Commander? Have any recommendations?
Hop on, Commander, and make sure to hold on to my waist tight! It won't be my fault if you fall off~
...Commander?! Sic 'em, Great Shark!
You have a new task? Want me to take you to where you need to go?
Commander, I've brought the rewards!
Hello! Your local courier U-101 has new mail for you~ Hahaha!
Commander, want me to drop you off at the dorm so you can get some rest?
The commission fleet is back? All righty, I'll go pick 'em up!
I feel the need for speed!
My boat torpedoes are ready!
Booyah! Number one!
Couldn't get out of the way in time...
All boat torpedoes, launch!
Looks like I've gotta pick up the pace...!
I'm going for a ride! Tschüss~
When I put in my headphones and rev the engines, I can outrun all my worries. Lemme tell you, Commander, it's one hell of a feeling.
Y'know, I really want to have an all-out race with the other factions' subs. I just know it's gonna get my blood pumping! How about it, Commander, wanna do me a favor?
Commander, hurry up and hop on! There's a school of incredibly rare and beautiful fish passing by today! Who knows how long we'd have to wait if we missed this opportunity!
Commander, look who's back! Hehe, seems like you've fallen in love with Great Shark, huh? All right, get on. Today, I'm going to show you a real special place!
Don't worry, Commander. As long as you're somewhere Great Shark can get to, call me any time. I swear I'll come for you!
Woow... You're a nice person, Commander!
Commander, welcome to the school band! Why'd I join the band? The reason's simple - there's no Motorbike Club at school, haha! Just kidding~! Actually, I'm quite fond of music as well, heh.
Commander, welcome to the school band! Why'd I join the band? The reason's simple - there's no Motorbike Club at school, haha! Just kidding~! Actually, I'm quite fond of music as well, heh.
Commander, let's put on some music!
It feels nice to kick back and enjoy some good music!
Commander, I recently started learning the trombone, hehe. I'm not very good at it, but it's still pretty interesting. Wanna listen~?
If I was able to play this thing underwater, I'd be able to perform for the fishes! Too bad, though... Guess I'll have to settle for the fish in the aquarium!
Even though we U-boats hang out together regularly, studying together at school feels rather special!
Commander, how about becoming the band conductor?
Woah! I almost smashed this over your head...
Commander, there's a ton of homework today.
Commander, I'm all done with my homework. Let's go for a ride!
Good work out there, Commander. Let's put on something chill~
It's pretty far from here to the piers. Commander, how about we take Great Shark out for a spin?
I don't know why, but when it's just the two of us in the band room, my chest starts fluttering like I'm sick... but I'm so glad... Aghh!! I'm gonna go take Great Shark out for a spin!
Iron Blood Type IXC submarine - U-522.

I'm U-522, Type IXC sub, from the glorious 2nd U-boat Flotilla. You need long-distance commerce raiding, I'm your girl. Anti-sub escorts do put me in one helluva pickle, though. Anyways, keep those eyes peeled for my combat performance~
Hmm... you're the commander 'round here, eh? I'm U-522, Iron Blood submarine, reporting for duty. Anyhoo, heard this here port's like a party. I'm eager to join in on it. Heheheh~
Always happy to see ya, Commander. Today's lookin' like it'll be fun.
Hehe, been oglin' me for some time, haven'tcha, Commander? I noticed ages ago!
This tail connector's not just for show. When plugged into my rigging: bam, gives me perfect control.
When I'm fighting, you can stare at me to your heart's content, y'know? Hehehe~
I just LOVE seeing my enemies squirming about, trying to get away from my attacks~ Ahahahah~!
You feelin' like some hide and seek? I'm game. I always win, y'see.
Tail - no touch! Bad Commander! That's my sensitive spot!
Ya figure we got any new missions, possibly involving hunting?
Commander, check out this mound of rewards we got~!
Commander, got news for ya from headquarters~
Mumph... Oh, you're back? Want some corned beef?
Commission team's back safe and sound~ Let's go check out those rewards.
Sehr gut!
Oh boy, here we go! Listen up, folks! It's lunchtime!
That's all? Laaaame. I wanna have more fun~
Oopsie... Guess I messed up a calculation...
Victory blitz!
You're not half-bad...
Sure can't count on you, huh, Commander. Guess that's cute in a way, though?
You want a fun hunt, ya need good chums, else it's not happening~
Hey, you're pretty chill~ I'm feelin' like this is the start of a good relationship~
Commander, your cunning plans won't work on me. Cause 9 times outta 10, I know just what you're thinking.
I think we oughta get to know each other more intimately~ Whaddya say, Com-man-der? Ahahahah! Look at you, blushing! Oh, that's hilarious!
I'm kinda worried about your future, what with how dang easy it is to read you, Commander~ But it's cool, I'll always be with you, so do keep counting on me, 'kay? Ahahahah~
Oh, wow. You really do know what I'm into! You deserve a little reward~
South Dakota-class battleship - Alabama, Hull Number BB-60.

I'm Alabama, fourth ship of the South Dakota-class, also known as Lucky A... What else? Uhh... I received some honors while fighting in Norway, the Marshall Islands, and the Marianas. Then, there was Leyte and the trip to the Sakura Empire... Since then, I've just been taking it easy in the Mobile Bay.
I'm Alabama. You need somethin'? ... Prepare for duty? Oh, sure. Got nothin' better to do, so might as well. Let's go!
Oh, it's you, Commander. I almost mistook you for a shady person and sent you flyin'.
Commander, I'm hungry. Think you could get me a roast turkey?
Commander. Com-man-der. Commanderrrr~ Oh, I didn't need anythin'. Just felt like callin' for you.
I'd like to have a Turkey Shoot. Makes me wish I could fly...
Sure is nice outside. Commander, wanna go lie in the grass under the sun? I could stay like that all day...
You're interested in my abs? Go ahead and feel 'em.
Huh......? Commander, the hell are you doing?
Commander, what's this big ol' stack of papers? Oh, I see... so those are the missions...
Commander, I'll go fetch the mission rewards. I'm big and strong, after all!
What's up, Commander? Oh, the mail? Ah, um, I forgot to bring it over. Give me a sec.
Commander, come sit in my lap. Huh? Isn't everyone doing this nowadays?
I can see the commission fleet comin' back over the horizon. Mhm, I'm real proud of my eyesight!
I feel like I could beat someone up right now... Mmh!
I won't let y'all leave until I've had my fun!
Kickin' the enemy's ass is all in a day's work for me. What are you praisin' me for?
Time to retreat? Fine...
Don't die on me just yet!
Well well, aren't you the frisky bunch... Ahaha!
......Who the hell are you?
Commander, can you call Tirpitz out here? I've always wanted to see which one of us is stronger, but she always ignores me.
I've been gettin' along pretty well with the Sakura Empire girls. I thought they'd hold a grudge against me, but turns out that wasn't the case at all. Mhm, they're an interestin' bunch!
Commander, let me give you a hug... This feels really nice and puts my mind at ease. Mhm, I like it.
Commander, can you come to my room tonight? Um, I've always hugged a stuffed animal to help me sleep, but I was thinkin'... maybe you'd be even better...
Is this a promise to become my personal hugging' pillow? Will you let me cling to you as I fall asleep every night? Mm... that makes me happy. Commander, can I start huggin' you now?
That's mighty good of you, Commander.
Sis, I'll be the one to beat them to a pulp, okay?
I challenge you, Tirpitz!

ex.line: There you are, Commander. Did you come to see me? Me too.
Doin' work, eatin' food, and just spacin' out together... It all feels mighty special.
Ain't my hands warmer than yours, Commander? You wanna just hold hands forever?
Feels like my heart's beatin' faster than usual... Maybe that's 'cause you're here with me?
Your scent is so relaxing... Hold me a little longer.
Whew... What a unique feeling...
Your hug is warmer than a bedsheet left to dry in the sun... Just keep holdin' me like this. You like it too, don't you?

lines.line: Hrmm... Lotta orders to work through... Runnin' a Dragon Empery restaurant ain't easy. Hmm? You here for some chow too, Commander? Then how about... I put you ahead in line?
Hrmm... Lotta orders to work through... Runnin' a Dragon Empery restaurant ain't easy. Hmm? You here for some chow too, Commander? Then how about... I put you ahead in line?
Oh. Commander. Happy New Year, now give me a red envelope... is what everyone's been sayin'. Speakin' of, do you have one for me?
These girls are rackin' up a long, looooong tab... *sigh*...
Havin' snowball fights, lightin' firecrackers, eatin' baozi... It's all a ton of fun. Especially with friends.
Heard Massachusetts and Jean Bart are gonna have a snowball fight. Curious to see who'll win... By the way, are riggings fair game?
Two beef baozi, one veggie baozi, and some shaomai... Comin' right up. Manjuus, bring this note to the kitchen.
You'll take the bill? Gotcha. I'll get back to my work.
Uh, Commander? What kind of Lunar New Year tradition is this?
Welcome back. You wanna order somethin'? We got steamin' hot baozi, if you're interested.
Mmh... I reckon it'll be more excitin' if I show more skin... Commander? Great timing. Could you help me press the shutter?
Mmh... I reckon it'll be more excitin' if I show more skin... Commander? Great timing. Could you help me press the shutter?
Commander, I just snapped these photos. Out of all the poses I picked, are there any that get you goin'?
Commander, come here. Directly show me what pose I should do next. Oh, you reckon this one makes my figure pop better? Alright. Just gotta figure out where to exert myself...
You want me to get closer to the camera so I'm more exposed to the light? Alright. This spotlight sure is warm... I feel like ice cream in the sun...
Hmm... These clothes are so thin, but they completely "swallow" me... It's a pretty comfy fit. Could you help me lift this, Commander?
We ready to start yet, Commander? Oh, hang on, let me change my pose... Current one's fine, you say? Nah, I need to find a pose so good, it'll make you forget to press the shutter.
This is comin' along swimmingly. It's great havin' your help.
Right now? Is this, like, a part of the shoot?
Commander, you've got unfinished missions. Let's save the rest of the shoot for after you come back.
Snappin' pictures with you... It's a whole load of fun. More fun than anythin' else. Next time, and the time after that... um, take some more photos of me.
Gato-class submarine - Cavalla, Hull Number SS-244.

I was given a golden opportunity during my maiden voyage and sank a carrier! ... It was a pretty risky move, and it wasn't easy! But in the end, I came out on top! If you wanna hear the whole story, just ask!
I'm Cavalla, the Eagle Union submarine! I'll make this fleet famous through glorious victories, so just you wait, Commander!
Morning! You're right on time today!
I'm no fish out of water that can't fight on the surface! It's no problem for me!
Could we make submarines stronger? By, for example... giving them stronger, better weapons or something?
It's so boring to just sit here and twiddle my thumbs... Give me something to do, Commander!
Whew! The breeze feels almost as good on land as it does at sea!
Ahahaha~! Stop! Ahahah~! That tickles- ahahaha!
I-I'll have you arrested!
Do we get a boatload of rewards if we do these missions?
Ooh! A boatload of rewards! Let's treat ourselves, Commander!
A new message has arrived! Wonder if it's from one of my submarine friends!
Commander, if you need the expertise of a submarine, just call on Cavalla!
The commission team has returned safely!
I feel stronger! Heheh!
Give me strength, my friends!
You can thank Cavalla for this victory! Hehehe~
Bah... This happened just cause the sea is so salty...
I've been waiting for this chance!
I won't give up, no matter how bad it gets!
I hate you!
Fear of failure can be overcome by showing your courage!
Sometimes, courage alone isn't enough... And that's when I need your strength, Commander! With your instructions, we can overcome anything!
I've been feeling sick lately... I can't fight with the same flair as I used to when I think about you... That's it, it's gotta be your fault, Commander! ... Actually, I'm not so sure...
I had a dream where you carried me and walked around the port... It was really weird! But for some strange reason, it makes me feel happy... I wonder why...
Whuah! Hold on a sec! Why are you hugging me out of the blue?! What are you doing?! You call this "weight training"? A-are you kidding me?! Everyone's staring at us, so let go already!
I love this!
Let's see who of us is the strongest!

ex.line: I-I wasn't expecting you to actually carry me around the port... I'm stunned... Listen, I don't mind being with you, but stop treating me like baby!

lines.line: You're late, Commander! ... What's all this? Heheh, it's loot I got from the stop n' rob's bargain bin! Here, have some bread!
You're late, Commander! ... What's all this? Heheh, it's loot I got from the stop n' rob's bargain bin! Here, have some bread!
I've been waiting for you, Commander!
Some snacks for Albacore and a torpedo model kit for Dace... These convenience stores really have everything, don't they!
IT'S A SUPER RARE! Holy mackerel! Commander, look! Hehehe~ See what I just got?!
I snagged myself a limited-edition Sara plushie! Aren't you jealous~? ... Y-you already own one? D-did they scam me?!
School life is a lot more fun than I expected! I might just be a natural scholar!
No, Commander! You can't have my precious discounted chips!
I bet you waited for me to leave school just to do that!
A mission? Is that my homework?
Commander, hotdogs are 50% off today!
A-are they the fabled Fantastic Forty Percent Off?! ... Oh, it's just the commission team.
Look at all the cute balloons and flowers, and the delicious food as well! Hehe! Parties are the best!
Look at all the cute balloons and flowers, and the delicious food as well! Hehe! Parties are the best!
Oh! I've been waiting for you, Commander! I was seriously worried that you'd gotten yourself lost!
Here, Commander! A bouquet for you! I heard from Shoukaku that you like these!
I'll gather up tons of balloons then take off into the sky! Yeah, as if! Hehehe~
Hrrmm, still not old enough to drink, huh... I'm not a kid anymore, so what's the big deal?!
Teach me how to dance, Commander! I wanna do it with you like everyone else does!
A toast to the party! Hehehe~ That's how you do it, right?
I'm gonna tell on you for that!
Hey Gridley, come take a pic of me and the Commander! Thanksies!
Independence-class light aircraft carrier - Bataan, Hull Number CVL-29.

I am the Independence-class light aircraft carrier Bataan of the Eagle Union. I participated in numerous battles during the world war. I will resolutely provide all necessary aid and support to all the ships of this fleet, as is my duty.

Bataan of the Eagle Union's Independence-class, at your service. If you don't mind, when forming a fleet for a sortie... please consider including me! I may not be flawless, but I should be able to handle a combat mission or two!
At last, you've made your return, Commander. Now, let us begin the day's labors, shall we?
Commander, such perfect timing. I was just performing some maintenance on this little one. Would you mind lending a hand?
To make a beautiful plan and then watch it come together - is there any better way to get one's work done? Commander, why not give my way a try?
This little one is a Hellcat, endlessly useful in so many battles. Hehe.
Maybe there's nothing really special about me, I'm not the type to stand out in a crowd, but I... as long as I can do things my way, and be helpful to everyone, that's good enough for me. Hehehe.
I have a lovely smile? Um, well... ehehe... I'm glad my smile cheers you up, Commander.
My, Commander, you can be such a child sometimes...
If you don't complete your missions, you won't get any stronger. Come, Commander, just a little bit more effort and we'll clear those missions off the board.
Mission rewards. How delightful. Hehe.
The mail is here. Take a look, please, Commander.
Welcome back, Commander. You certainly fought hard. If you have need of me, I would be happy to accompany you on the next sortie.
The ships you sent out on commission have returned. Shall we go greet them?
Now I can be so much more useful to everyone. Thank you very much, Commander.
Onward without fear! For I stand behind you with all my might!
Am I... the MVP? Ahahaha... this victory belongs to all of us together.
Hm... I must carry this lesson on to the next battle...
Now it's your turn, little planes. Be sa~fe!
We mustn't... retreat yet!
No one respects a worthless commander. You need to shape up! Come, I'll help you.
Perfect. Our work goes exactly according to plan... Yes, now on to next month's plan...
How will I spend my day off? I suppose I'll just lounge around by myself. That's how I like to relax, after all. It's not like I have any particular hobbies or anything... Aha, ahaha...

It seems we've been spending a lot more alone time together lately, Commander... It's okay if we get even more intimate... is it? Well, then... If I sit a little closer... even cuddle up a bit... is that... okay too?
Whether I'm happy or sad, you're always here with me, Commander... I, why I might just be the luckiest girl in the world... Hehehe.

To be here with you, Commander, celebrating a day like this... I can't fathom how lucky I am. I can't even begin to know what to say... Commander, umm, do you think you could close your eyes for me for a second...?
Um, th-thank you! I wonder what I should do to pay you back...
Yaaaaawn... Huh!? Commander!? You scared me... I was just going to lie down and... Um, yes, with little Hellcat here... Goodnight...
Yaaaaawn... Huh!? Commander!? You scared me... I was just going to lie down and... Um, yes, with little Hellcat here... Goodnight...
Good morning... Sorry, Commander, do you mind if I wash my face first...?
It's a little embarrassing, but I do always sleep with this little one here...
Good sleep is very important to your work. Commander, do make sure you're getting enough rest.
Sorry, Commander, I'm fading again... Zzz...
A pajama party...? I want to go... I wonder if Independence would be interested...
These are my favorite pajamas... They aren't too childish? ... They suit me? Ahahaha... Th-thanks...
Welcome back, Commander... Why don't you take a rest? I can lend you my pillow...
Whether I'm hard at work or resting comfortably, you're always here, Commander... And I wouldn't trade it for the world. Hehe. Commander, would you like to hold the little one?
Atlanta-class light cruiser - San Juan, Hull Number CL-54.

I am San Juan, Atlanta-class anti-aircraft cruiser number four. I escorted many carrier groups: Enterprise, Saratoga, several of the Essex-class. I fought alongside them all. Let's just say I have a lot of experience in aircraft carrier support combat!

I am San Juan, Atlanta-class anti-aircraft cruiser number four. I've served as a support unit for the Eagle Union's carrier fleets. You seem like a person up to your ears in work, Commander... so I now offer to support you!
Clock's ticking! We gotta get to work— Oh, come on! Here, let me straighten your collar. You're a mess!
I set the trap just like the book said, but why haven't I caught anything yet? That's strange...
Commander... are you daydreaming again?
Supporting a carrier group is just watching the skies all day. I wish supporting you was as easy...
My sisters haven't been causing you any trouble, have they? Oh, thank goodness...
I know you're tired, Commander, but you don't have to whine about it. ... Okay, once you finish your work, how about I give you a massage?
W-w-w-watch your hands!!
How do you still have unfinished missions? Well, since you're hopeless without me, I suppose I can help you out...
Mission complete! Feels pretty nice to be done, huh?
I got your mail for you. Don't forget to check it.
Welcome back, Commander! ... D-did it go okay?
The resources from the commission have been delivered. Commander, why don't you... Umm, I'll go check on them.
Now I can escort those carriers even better!
I'll keep the skies clear for you! Everyone, forward!
Victory is just a result of the effort we put into the fight. It's nothing to be especially proud of.
Agh...! Go! I'll cover your retreat!
You've entered a no-fly zone!
I-it's just a scratch! I can keep going...!
I thought this might happen, but... I won't give up!
The fleet is gonna lose faith in you if you keep spacing out like that. Commander, get your head in the game!
Um, I know I can be a little hard on you, Commander. But you get what I mean, don't you? ... Commander?

Commander, I always thought you wouldn't like me... and I'm glad that isn't true! B-but, how do we take our relationship to the next level? Wh-what are we supposed to do? I... I don't know about these things...

Um, I was thinking, if you have time, could we go out on a da... date? I know it's my fault for being so hard on you all the time, so I'm trying to make it up to you... Whatever I need to do to take us to the next level, I'll do it... Okay!?

L-look, Commander... I'm only doing this because you're easier to deal with than my sisters. I only have enough patience to take care of one more person, so thank your lucky stars that it's you! I wouldn't do this for anyone else, got it?!
Giving me a present out of nowhere... I-I hope you're not thinking anything weird!
You don't always have to put so much emphasis on the "sister" thing!
San Diego, quit screwing around already!
Juneau, you don't have to push yourself if it gets too scary out there...
All right, dress looking good. Now just to check my makeup... Need to be thorough, so I don't embarrass myself in front of- What?! C-Commander?!
All right, dress looking good. Now just to check my makeup... Need to be thorough, so I don't embarrass myself in front of- What?! C-Commander?!
Hmm... Hope my lipstick looks fine... Commander? You're here already? O-okay, I'm coming!
That's right! My sisters can take care of themselves for once! My only focus today will be enjoying myself at the party! ...Oh, who am I kidding, they can't go without supervision...
Commander? If you wanna slack off, now's the time to do it! ...Oh god, I can't believe I just said that!
Whew... Remember, Commander: overworking is bad for you. Though having that said, we're both guilty of that...
I'm beat. Saying hi to everyone isn't as easy as I expected... Oh right, makeup... Do I look okay, Commander?
Aah! Wh-what was that?!
I left your mail where I always do. Give it a read sometime later.
The goods have come in from the last commission. Commander, mind if I take a peek?
I'll send 'em packing, you know it!
I can get away with showing off just for today... I-I am number 1!
S-so, what do you think of my dress? It's definitely different from the rest of my wardrobe, a-and I just hope you don't think it's a letdown... Y-you don't? Th-that's great then! Really great!
Cleveland-class light cruiser - Birmingham, Hull Number CL-62.

I am Birmingham, the eighth Cleveland-class light cruiser. Born during the war, I fought to its end alongside my many sisters and earned 9 battle stars. As a Knight of the Sea, my duty continues, and I will now fight for the sea's future.
Starting today, Cleveland-class light cruiser Birmingham is on active duty. I will not rest until the future of the sea is secure. Commander, grant me your guidance and support.
Sortie preparations complete. Your orders, Commander?
Someday I hope to see the sea return to its peaceful former state...
Princeton... please be okay. If I had fought harder back then, things wouldn't have...
Sometimes people ridicule me for being unlucky, but having survived that hellish battle, I feel quite lucky.
I feel at ease when I'm with Cleve and my sisters. I believe this is what's known as a "bond."
What is it, Commander? Was that your sortie order?
Is this amusing to you?
New mission from HQ. Let's complete it right at once, Commander.
Mission rewards have arrived. Perhaps there is ice cream in... Oh, um, never mind that.
Mail for you. My intuition tells me it's good news. If it's bad news, I will help you digest it.
It is good to see you unscathed. I suggest taking a break.
Every little bit counts in the end. The worth of this commission will become clear one day.
This enhancement was necessary for me to keep advancing.
Time is money, so let's strike quickly! I will lead the way!
The next battleground awaits. I will stay on my guard.
What could I have done differently...
Full speed ahead!
They have superior firepower! This may be bad...!
Commander, you should reflect on your actions thoroughly.
Being a light cruiser, I can't markedly affect the war... However, I firmly believe that the power to protect the sea rests within me.
You think I'm overly stoic...? True, but I must be in order to repel the darkness that envelops the sea.
Commander, it feels as though you have the peculiar power of calming people. Just like a peaceful sea would...
A smile? Like this? That is an unusual order to issue. That is not to say I dislike it... *Giggle*

This must be an oath... Have we already spent this much time together, Commander...? No, I'm not displeased at all. It's just... in this case, it's... *Ahem*! Now, then... Commander, will you watch the sunrise over the horizon of the sea together with me?
Commander, did you do research on what I like?
Sis! I will cover your flanks!
Good morning, Commander. Unfortunately, this bicycle only seats one person, but I could dismount and lead it along as we walk together.
Good morning, Commander. Unfortunately, this bicycle only seats one person, but I could dismount and lead it along as we walk together.
Is it time to sortie? Please wait. I must park my ride somewhere first.
A bicycle must be maintained regularly, so I asked U-47 for advice and help. One day I need to offer her a favor in return.
It seems the academy has no bicycling club... Perhaps I should petition to create one... Hmm...
A new dessert shop opened, and their specialty is ice cream...? ... C-Commander, do you mind if I leave for a moment?
U-47, how about we go on a bicycling trip the next time you're off duty?
Bicycling is an excellent way to train the body. Prepare your bicycle and we can go for a ride, Commander.

Happy Lunar New Year, Commander. I'm trying out Dragon Empery fashion for a change, though this dress will some getting used to. Hey, uh, do you want to join me under the umbrella? For cover against the snowfall, I mean.

Happy Lunar New Year, Commander. I'm trying out Dragon Empery fashion for a change, though this dress will some getting used to. Hey, uh, do you want to join me under the umbrella? For cover against the snowfall, I mean.
Welcome back, Commander. There's snow on my umbrella? Oh, darn it. I got so absorbed in the wintry landscape that I forgot to shake the snow off.

When snow falls over the farmlands, it kills off crop-eating insects and keeps the soil at a stable temperature. Then when the snow melts, it waters the earth... Now I can see why they call it "fruitful snow."
Princeton, I'm pretty sure that aerial maneuver you learned from Saratoga is only good for pranking people...
Ice cream doesn't melt so easily when the temperature drops. Is it weird to talk about ice cream in the middle of winter? ...Oh. Now I know...

Hmm? Tired, are we, Commander? A bath in the thermae would rejuvenate you splendidly. I could go for one myself, in fact.
Veneto is a tad too formal, wouldn't you agree? She really ought to do like me and take time to unwind more often.
My cardigan is made of woven silk. You can appreciate its quality just from touching it, no?
When put before a stunning treasure, few could be satisfied with only watching from afar.
Look who's back. Hang up your coat and make yourself at home. Then I can get comfortable too.
Talk about bad luck, we're caught in a rainstorm right now. Unfortunately, it seems we'll have to wait it out here, Commander.
Talk about bad luck, we're caught in a rainstorm right now. Unfortunately, it seems we'll have to wait it out here, Commander.
Going somewhere, even though it's still raining? You could simply stay with me instead. Hahaha!
Should've brought an umbrella, you say? ...Let's forget how that wouldn't help in a massive downpour and focus on enjoying this providential quiet time we have, shall we? Hahaha!
What is it? ...I'm soaked through and through? Well, look who's talking. We're both dripping down to our ankles.
Knowing Impero, she'd run outside barefoot without a care in the world about getting wet if she was caught in the rain. She wouldn't let anyone stop her, either.
You could go to work in the rain, or kick back and relax while you wait for it to stop. When the weather gives you a free pass, why not seize the day, after all?
Oh? Feasting your eyes on the rare sight that is me in rain-soaked clothes, are you?
To be frank with you, I WOULD say this isn't the time for this, buuut...
Once the rain's stopped, I'm going to take a nice, long bath. What about you, Commander? You could join me in the thermae if you'd like.
Conte di Cavour-class battleship - Conte di Cavour.
I witnessed the ascendancy of the Imperial Fleet as well as its decay into powerlessness. Commander, I pray that you, as the leader of the fleet, will never repeat the tragedies of the past.
I am the dreadnought, Conte di Cavour. There is much that I can do for you, Commander, but that depends on whether or not you are trustworthy.
Save your breath. Let's begin today's work.
Leonardo da Vinci... had that tragedy not occurred, she surely would've fought to the last breath for the glory of the Sardegna Empire, just like Cesare.
A gown? I have no interest in things like that. Nor will I ever.
Commander, if I ever get invited to one of those Royal tea parties, please tell them that I am too busy with secretary work.
Some people used to hold me to lofty expectations, but it feels natural to see the next generation surpass me.
Allow me to say this: judging people by their appearance will be your downfall.
Just how little do you think of me?
Hmm... The number of missions you've completed seems to be lower than the number of missions you were given. Commander, may I ask why?
One more name off my list... Oh, I was talking about the list of unfinished missions.
New mail has arrived... I'm not your butler, and you're perfectly capable of getting it yourself. Look, it's by your right hand.
A hard fought battle. Next, there are many missions that you must attend to... Oh my, it would appear that I've accidentally finished everything. Do have some tea and rest for a while.
The commission squad has returned to port. Were you sending this bunch to a parade or something?
Thanks for your consideration.
It is time to clad yourselves in courage and wisdom!
One will never tire of victory.
Ngh... Must I also bow my head to the passage of time...?
This volley... shall not be my last!
Everyone, stay vigilant!
You will eventually pay the price for your arrogance.
As one of Sardegna's veterans, I have ample experience ranging from communication to fleet management. If you need any advice, feel free to ask me.
Commander, what do you think about when you gaze up into the night sky? I always think back to that night... when the skies were ablaze with what looked like countless meteors.
Long live the glory of the Sardegna Empire... Forget it, it's all in the past now. I'm getting used to being in this fleet, so let's look ahead.
I said "let's look ahead," right? In that case, I'll cover your back. That way, no matter what happens, you can always keep your eyes ahead of you and leave the rest to me.

You're giving such an important thing to me...? I... this is... ahh! I'm sorry, I can't keep my composure, but I'll try my best to say it... "I do!" How's that? P-please let this embarrassing ritual be over already...
You put more thought into this than I'd expect.
A Royal Knight, huh? I never expected to fight alongside someone like you.
Cesare, follow me!
The glory of Sardegna... yes, it used to shine brighter.
Commander, take this. Good, for the time being, you are a now a disciple under my command. It is time for us to mete out punishment to the unruly.
Commander, take this. Good, for the time being, you are a now a disciple under my command. It is time for us to mete out punishment to the unruly.
Curses... I can't believe people are seeing me in this soggy, ugly mess... What, I'm cute? Wh-what kind of sick joke is that? Come help me already!
It's always the normally quiet types that end up making the boldest statements at the beach...
Huh?! Where'd that sneak attack come from? I've gotta answer back...!
Cesare, this is the only time we'll be fighting on the same front. Let's do this!
Not as much as a damn molehill on this beach... Where's a soldier supposed to hide herself...?
You've helped me a lot. Thank you.
Y-you traitor...!
My "ammo" is about to run out... Commander, fetch me more water!
Conte di Cavour-class battleship - Giulio Cesare.

Memories that haunt me? None but that dreaded battle. I had to retreat from the Battle of Punto Stilo after taking a single hit... Things would've gone differently, had I only gotten to strike first...!
I'm Giulio Cesare, battleship of the Sardegna Empire. Prove to me your talent in commanding a fleet!
You're right on time... Naturally. I'll admit your timeliness is the one thing I could learn from.
At last I can have a rematch with Warspite on equal terms. I've been waiting for this!
Office work? Cavour is better at it than me... but I'll still do it. As any secretary should.
Commander, be decisive. Hesitation wastes time, and wasted time is gone forever.
A good leader doesn't micromanage or mediate, they issue clear orders and make firm decisions. Isn't that right, Commander?
Cavour, don't be so overly formal around the Commander! No one wants to be treated like an old-timer!
Mh... Mm? Sorry, I zoned out for a bit... Were you worried about me, Commander?
If you plan on toying around with me, don't blame me when you get burned.
You can honestly skip missions you'd rather not take on.
On the topic of completing missions, does it even affect the war situation?
There's a letter for you. Assuming it's no private matter, you don't mind if I open it, do you?
Triumphant once again, yes? It's written all over your face.
Isn't that the commission team? Why not go say hello to them, Commander?
I've yet to hit my own limits!
As per the Commander's orders, we depart for the front!
Veni, vidi, vici.
Am I out of my depth...?!
All shall bow before my might!
You won't break my spirit so easily!
Seems you lack the mindset to be a worthy commander.
Cavour always stresses the importance of courtesy and diplomatic discourse, but I believe in simply speaking one's mind. Doesn't it sound dreadful to obsess over some idea of formality?
A little bit of harsh discipline is the right medicine for slouches who can't obey orders. "It's not that simple"? Well, I thought I was making a good suggestion...
A little bird told me you're free, and I've got two tickets to the opera, so what do you say? I'd say you're due for something you haven't experienced before.
You can rest easy, Commander. For as long as I have your back, you can keep your eyes on the path ahead and continue moving forward. I'll take care of everything else for you!

*Sigh*... The romantic vacation I booked was all for nothing... "With who"? With you, shouldn't that be obvious?! ... "Just ask me next time"? But I booked it just for you in the first place... F-fine, I will...
Is this for me? Th-thanks...
Our battle isn't over yet!
Cavour, worry about yourself instead!
Both exercise and war are at their core about willpower! Now, get ready, Commander! We're not finished until you're dripping with sweat!
Both exercise and war are at their core about willpower! Now, get ready, Commander! We're not finished until you're dripping with sweat!
The treadmill is free right now. Do use it if you plan to work out.
Want me to make a training plan for you? ... "Cesare's training methods send nutrients to your muscles and away from the brain"? Did Cavour really say that?!
"Inaction saps the vigor of the mind"... Who said that, again?
Jogging courses, fat-burning courses, rolling hills courses... Is it really this complicated? I'll just start with whichever seems the toughest.
If you feel stressed out, just let it all out on that sandbag over there. I can attest that it does wonders for the mood.
Are you out of breath already? You've still got a long way to go, Commander.
What was that for?! Don't ignore me, answer!
Here, take this! Don't forget to rehydrate.
Tired already? For goodness' sake, I thought you'd be more reliable than this. Don't go burning all your energy at once, we still have a whole day of recreation ahead of us.
Tired already? For goodness' sake, I thought you'd be more reliable than this. Don't go burning all your energy at once, we still have a whole day of recreation ahead of us.
Hey, Commander. I hope you're not tired already, or else you'll be branded as unreliable.
Warspite's taking part in the beach volleyball tournament? You should've told me so sooner!
Trento and Pola are out for you, so you came here to lie low, didn't you? ...No?
This is not a playground, Cavour! Take your watergun fight elsewhere! ...I'll be right back, Commander. I'm going to have a word with that wannabe commando!
I do like this bikini, though it doesn't quite match up to Veneto's.
Surely you know what consequences await you for doing that.
Want some ice with your Sardegnian liqueur? It's best downed in one gulp when it's this cold.
Are you charmed by my prowess in battle, or just me? Haha~
Zara-class heavy cruiser - Zara.

I am the first ship of the Zara class of heavy cruisers, Zara. I was born to be a marine battery, with my magnificent guns and armor plating. I served as the flagship of my squadron, at least until that fateful night...
Ciao. It's a pleasure to meet you, Commander. I'm the heavy cruiser, Zara, and I look forward to bringing victory and glory to your fleet.
Welcome back. I've gathered everyone up and we're awaiting your inspection.
Now, Pola and I are often praised for our beauty, but aren't you worried that all this ogling might cause some unsavory rumors?
Tenacemente, that is, fighting to the bitter end, no matter the odds, is my personal motto.
Looking up at the night sky, admiring the countless glimmering stars, it's really nice, actually. But it's better enjoyed from inside... don't you think?
By the way, I've actually got kind of an eye for fashion. How about I help dress you next time, Commander?
You like my sword, Commander? Or could it be... something else you're interested in?
Eeek?! ... Ahem! There is more to me than my armor plating, you know? Maybe you would like a taste of my guns as well?
Is this mission giving you trouble? Here, let me take a look.
Mission complete! My my, that's quite a big reward there, isn't it? Well done, Commander~
Commander? The mail is here. If you don't get to it soon, I could always read it out loud for you? I wonder if there are any love letters, hehehe...
An exhausting mission, was it? Why not relax with a glass of wine?
Commander, you must profusely thank all these girls for ensuring the safe delivery of these supplies.
Grazie! Now my main guns are an even greater threat to the enemy.
I'm used to being flagship. All ships, get into formation! Tiro!
I've brought you victory and glory, just as I promised.
Ugh... Don't make me recall the humiliation I endured that night...!
Don't think you can pierce my armor so easily!
My armor... will hold!
Terrible... There's absolutely nothing about this commander anyone could ever find appealing...
Is there something bothering you, Commander? Let's hear it then.
Despite her appearances, Pola is a really sensitive girl, you know? And anyone who dares to hurt her... even you, Commander, would not be easily forgiven.

Now that we're finally alone together, was there something you wanted to do, Commander? ... You want me to clean your ears? Well, all right... Come, put your head right here~ And please, try to relax, okay? I'm going to very gently, very slowly, clean your ears♪

Commander, after all this time together, you should already know what I'm thinking before I even open my mouth. Hehe, so who am I thinking about right now? Of course it's you, Commander, that's too easy. Hehehe♪

You really think you can bind me to you with nothing but a cheap little ring? This isn't nearly enough~ ... Hehe, don't give me that face... Haha, I'm only joking~ Don't worry, Commander. I'll be with you forever.
Did you prepare this just for me? Grazie! I'll keep it well cared for.
We're allies now, huh... I'm counting on your fire support then!
Phew... It's a perfect day for swimming. Oh my, Commander, did you come to swim too? Or... perhaps you had something else in mind? Ehehe~♪
Phew... It's a perfect day for swimming. Oh my, Commander, did you come to swim too? Or... perhaps you had something else in mind? Ehehe~♪
Commander, please be careful swimming in the deep end, okay?
Did you do your stretches? You don't want your legs cramping up in the water.
Hey, no horseplay in the pool!
I really like swimming, but the submarines and destroyers are always faster... Why is that, Commander...?
Speed is one thing, but I'm quite confident in my stamina. How about it, Commander? Want to try me?
Your eyes are wandering. Hehe, what's on your mind? You can tell me.
Really now, Commander? I understand your eagerness, but there's a time and place, no?
Legs straight, calves stretched- Ah, welcome back, Commander. I suppose you can tell I've been teaching the others to swim. Would you like me to teach you as well?
Trento-class heavy cruiser - Trento.

I am the nameship of the Trento class, but if you count the days since our launches, Trieste has a longer service record. Speaking of which, I had a little incident on my launch day... but I still carried out my missions as a member of the Sardegnian fleet~
I am Trento, first heavy cruiser of the Sardegna Empire, here to help out. I'll support everyone in my own special little way, so please do look forward to that, Commander♪
Right on time~ Way to go, Commander~!
Umm... What was I doing just now? Do you have any ideas, Commander...?
You've already finished all the paperwork? That's great~!
Tea blends, let's see... Hmm, would any Royal girls take issue with this mix? Yeah, they might...
Looks like I'll get to enjoy both the Dragon Empery's AND the Sakura Empire's cuisine at this port~ That's wonderful~
I've heard that hugs help people relax~ Shall we test that theory, Commander?
That's naughty, Commander! You'll be unpopular with the girls if you keep doing stuff like this.
If we push on just a little more, we can take on a new mission!
Yup, yup, mission complete! Keep it up, Commander~!
Please don't forget to check your new mail!
You're amazing, Commander! Bringing home another victory for the team~
The commission team is back, safe and sound. May I head out to receive them?
Please take good care of the others as well, okay?
Come on, everyone! We are born winners!
Very well done, everyone! I'm so glad we won~!
It's okay, it's okay! This isn't anybody's fault!
Let's go, everyone!
This doesn't look very promising...
Don't give up, Commander! If you just make amends for your mistakes, nobody's going to abandon you!
I much prefer complimenting and congratulating people over scolding and blaming them~
Please have some of this stamina-recovering coffee! ... Oh, does it taste bad? Let me try... Eww?! I might have mistook salt for sugar...
Are you having troubles of any kind? Could you share them with me? Telling others what's on your mind can be a great help~
As long as you need me, I accept you for who you are, Commander. No matter what happens, I'll always be here for you~ See? Everything's all right~

I thought I was prepared for this, but now with the ring on my finger, I feel so unbelievably happy~ With all my heart, thank you, Commander. Ehehe, we'll always be with each other now, so if anything ever happens, please let me know!
You prepared this for me? Well, it's perfect~

ex.line: You've clocked in right on time again! Way to go, Commander~ I'll shower you in more love and support after you finish your job~
I was just about to go buy the ingredients for tonight's dinner. I'm impressed you remembered, Commander! Heheh, I should work on remembering things better myself~
You've already finished all the paperwork? That's great~! Then I say we go have lunch with Trieste~
Ah, you're going for a stroll around the pier in a while? Do you want me to come with you?
How about taking a little break and doing something fun? We can doodle with crayons, play with toy blocks, or maybe even do a round of musical chairs... Hehehe~
Here you go~ And don't forget: you're doing a great job, Commander~
Okey-dokey, let's cuddle all you want! ...Wait, this isn't exactly what I had in mind...
You have new mail~ Just be careful not to fold the envelope, okay?
Awesome work bringing everyone back safe and sound~ Keep it up, sweetie!
The commission team has returned. Remember to check the rewards list!
We all believe in you, Commander!
Great job, everyone! Including you of course, Commander! You're my superstar~
You've shown how much you need me, so as promised, I wholly accept you for who you are~ Hehehe~ You have nothing to worry about, sweetie. You're doing really, really good~

lines.line: The summer's scorching heat is alleviated by the ocean~ Commander, why don't you set aside your worries and... cut loose a bit~?
The summer's scorching heat is alleviated by the ocean~ Commander, why don't you set aside your worries and... cut loose a bit~?
Commander? Did you doze off to the sound of the waves just now? Ahah, don't worry~ There's plenty of time, so you should enjoy your nap~
I might get sunburnt? Ah, you're right, I should be more careful... Commander, would you mind helping me apply the sunscreen?
Commander, would you like to try this sundae? Here, say "ahh~" Very good, very good~
Playing in the water seems like a lot of fun. Commander, shall we join them as well?
The rhythm of the waves is quite hypnotic... Commander, if you want to take a nap, just come lie down over here and let me take good care of you~
If there's anything you want me to do, just speak up~ Don't be shy~
Being at the beach always makes people more easygoing... I suppose I'll forgive you today~
It must have been difficult fighting in this heat~ Mmhmm, good job out there~
Soldati-class destroyer - Carabiniere.

As a member of the Soldati-class destroyers, I served as the leader of the 12th Destroyer Squadron and led my compatriots through many battles. No matter when or where, I shall give it my all to complete any mission!
Flagship Veneto's escort, Carabiniere of the Sardegna Empire, reporting for duty! As your subordinate, I will carry out your orders and complete any mission!
Salutations! Carabiniere welcomes you, Commander!
Commander, I'm currently on patrol. Do you have any new instructions for me?
Royal submarines have always been elusive and mercurial. They've gotten the better of me in the past...
My gun? I'm telling you, it's real! I just don't have it loaded.
"Don't disturb during work hours." I put this sign up so you can have your peace of mind!
Sì!
P-please don't tease your subordinates like that!
Commander, there are still tasks that need to be finished. Do you require anything of me?
The missions are done, and we have quite the rewards to show for it. If there were some non-material rewards though...
Commander, the mailbox seems to be filling up.
Commander, an inquiry arrived while you were gone. Do you want to look it over?
The commission team has returned! I'm so glad that everyone came back safely.
I shall definitely become a better subordinate!
In Commander's name, I sortie!
Victory is ours!
Ugh... th-this subordinate will accept any punishment!
Locked on!
This isn't how it was supposed to be...
Commander, I don't think that... Nevermind, your subordinate shall follow your order.
