Rest assured, Commander. This subordinate shall always be loyal to you.
Commander, if you plan on going out, please let me be your bodyguard!
Commander, I'm really flattered that you treat me so well... You feel safe when I'm by your side? Understood. Your subordinate shall work harder in that regard!

Commander, are you heading out? Do you need a bodyguard... Oh, it's just a civilian errand? N-no! Even if it's just across the street, y-you never know what hazards lie in wait... S-so, let's go together!
From now on, this subordinate shall serve you for life! ...That's not what it means? Um, then... I see! B-but, can someone like me really be your partner?
Th-thank you very much!
Lady Veneto advised me to enjoy my time off by changing into something befitting the occasion... Um, Commander, I d-don't look strange, do I?
Lady Veneto advised me to enjoy my time off by changing into something befitting the occasion... Um, Commander, I d-don't look strange, do I?
Welcome back, Commander. W-would you like to accompany me on a walk while we both have some time off? S-sorry, I hope I'm not being pushy...
I can't help but to feel a little different when I put on these clothes. I know it's supposed to feel light and refreshing, but instead I feel defenseless and nervous...
If you're thirsty, I brought some water. Here you go!
The warm sunlight, the gentle breeze, and an ice pop to beat the heat! That's the spirit of midsummer!
Commander, I heard from a friend that all girls have multiple facets... When I changed into this outfit that I'd absolutely never wear normally... it, it was as if something awakened within me...
Commander! Err, I mean, good day?
Wouldn't it be better to finish the missions first...
Ugh... I s-suppose I'm not cut out for this after all...

I once said I wanted to be your bodyguard, but when we're walking together like this, it feels like you're guarding me instead. Would this be dereliction of duty...? Ah! I wasn't saying that I disapproved of it! *sigh*...
Iron Blood Type IXB submarine - U-110.

I'm U-110, Iron Blood Type IXB submarine, and I'm really good at commerce raiding. The Enigma machine I've got in my backpack is awesome. I'm awesome too, I just left my codebooks and charts behind...
Raaaawr. U-110 is a shaaaark. Fear meeee. Mess with me and I'll bite yooouuu.
Commander, did you bring swirly-whirly candies?
I'm not a garlic bulb, I'm a shaaaark. Fear meeee. Raaaawr.
Codebooks, codebooks... Oops, I forgot them in the dorm.
Commander, let's plaaaaay. Leeeeetttt'ssss plaaaaaayyyy.
I got lectured for pretending to be a shark... But I still had fun.
Commander, I'll give you a swirly-whirly if you play with meeee.
Nom! (U-110 bit your finger.)
Commander, once your mission's doooone, let's plaaaaay.
Rawr! I've brought the mission rewaaaaards.
I'll take care of your encrypted maaaail.
Commander, your office is so booooring.
Commander, someone's come back to pooort.
U-110's super scaryyyyy.
I'm a shaaaark. Raaaawr.
Raaaawr. U-110 scared the enemies awaaaay.
Codebooks, where are my codebooks... Goodie, they're safe...
Raaaawr!
U-110's awesoooome. I'm not giving uuuuup.
Why won't you play with me...
You mean my Enigma machine doesn't have any use anymore? Okey-dokey, then let's play a game of decipheriiiing.
Believe it or not, this hairstyle was born with meeeee. Mhm, I'm a shaaaark. Raaaawr!
Bulldog's really smart. Playing with her is fun. Next time, you should come play with us tooooo.
The Commander is my friend. I'll give you some of my codebooks. That way it'll be fine even if I forget mine. Yup-yup.
Commander is so nice to me. I love you. U-110's gonna bite anyone who messes with you. U-110's scaaaryyy. Raaaaaawr!
Commander, friend.
Whenever I play games with Bulldog, I always end up losing. Frustratinggg. That's why... I'll study hard. One day, I'll winnnn.
Whenever I play games with Bulldog, I always end up losing. Frustratinggg. That's why... I'll study hard. One day, I'll winnnn.
Commander, let's go to school together?
This hat is not a bulb of garlic, but a shark. A scary shaaaark. Raaawr.
U-110 learned from school that there are actually many kinds of Enigma machines... School is coooool.
Raaaawr, raaaawr, raaaawr! Amazon said I can't rawr at school, so U-110 will rawr when hanging out with Commander.
Bulldog says it's no fun to play with U-110, but she always plays with U-110 anyway. What a nice girl.
Hm, this outfit is very cute, and U-110 likes it a lot. However, it makes me not scary. That makes me a cute shark. Raaaawr.
The homework is strong... but U-110 is stronger. That's why I'll finish it all.
Commander, U-110 has defeated the homework. I'm strooong!
U-110 has learned a new codebreaking method. Want me to try it on the mail?
Commander, why does everyone like flicking U-110's hair?
I have to wear beautiful clothes to a party, or so Bulldog said. So, I had everyone help me pick out beautiful clothes. Commander, I'm beautiful, right? Eh... cute?
I have to wear beautiful clothes to a party, or so Bulldog said. So, I had everyone help me pick out beautiful clothes. Commander, I'm beautiful, right? Eh... cute?
Are you waiting on U-110 too, Commander?
Look at these flowers in my hair. No, they're noooot garlic flowers.
I've hidden the codebooks. They're not getting them this time.
I put on these wings. I've become a flying shark. Raaawr.
Why wasn't my invitation encrypted? Everyone knows I like decrypting stuff...
Bulldog gave me swirly-whirlieeees. Want one, Commander?
I can't be a shark in this dress... But my friends here are still shaaarks. Raaaawr.
The horned idol U-110 splashes onto the staaage. I'll sing all the baddies to obliviooon. I'm scaaary. Raaawr. Raaawr♪
The horned idol U-110 splashes onto the staaage. I'll sing all the baddies to obliviooon. I'm scaaary. Raaawr. Raaawr♪
I'm garniiished, not garliiic. Hrmph... Raaawr!
I dropped my lyrics sheet... But I still have my codebooks, so we're fine. ...We're not fine?
"Hear the terrifying melody of the Lord of Sharkness, ruler of the dark abyss. Raaawr." ...It loses all its scare factor when I go raaawr? Raaawr...
You and me, let's do a song battle, Albacooore. ...Nobody can hear you sing underwater, dummy.
If you don't behave, you'll get munched ooon.
Munch! (U-110's baby sharks bit you.)
After our recital is done, I wanna play a gaaame.
Rawr! I brought you some supplieees.
U-boats don't mess around on the staaage.
Commander, happy new yeeear. I'm no bunny, I'm a shaaark. Not a cute shark, but a crimson, scaaary shark. Raaawr.
Commander, happy new yeeear. I'm no bunny, I'm a shaaark. Not a cute shark, but a crimson, scaaary shark. Raaawr.
New Year's is a lucky daaay. I'll get lots of swirly-whirlieees. Do you have any, Commander?
I lost to Bulldog again... Commander, it's time for special trainiiing. We'll doodle her face into oblivion.
Everyone's talking about their year-first dreams... I dreamed I turned into a big shark. Raaawr.
I've got you a New Year's card with encrypted teeext. I can decipher it for yooou.
Bulldog drew the art on my paddle. She's a really good artist.
I'm no bunny, I'm a shaaark. A scary shark that'll bite yooou. Raaawr.
Let's build a snowman. Or a shiver of snowshaaarks. ...There's no such thing as a snowshark?
I'm gathering mushrooms, not garlic cloooves. The edible ones are gonna go in a hearty hot pot that'll warm me and my frieeends. Raaawr.
I'm gathering mushrooms, not garlic cloooves. The edible ones are gonna go in a hearty hot pot that'll warm me and my frieeends. Raaawr.
You want to help? Okay, go pick the mushrooms over there. Don't eat any behind my back. Raaawr.
Are you cold, Commander? Borrow my coooat. Ah... Achoo! Ugh... R-raaawr...
"Couplet"? The left and right scrolls both say kind of the same thing... So it's a code?
Lützow told me to say "aah," but I said "raaawr" and she made a funny face. Raaawr?
I'll decorate with the inedible mushrooms. Can I... put some by your office windows?
Nom! (U-110 took a bite of her mochi cake.)
Nom? (U-110 has sunk her teeth into your sleeve and won't let you go.)
I don't know if it's spring or even winter... Bulldog said it could even be summer. What season actually is it?
Raaawr. Have a mushroom for your hard work, Commander.
Fletcher-class destroyer - Smalley , Hull Number DD-565.
Fletcher-class destroyer, Smalley. I did radar pickets, patrols, rescues, diplomatic functions, and basically a bit of everything. My hobbies...? Do I really have to repeat what I said before?
Destroyer Smalley, reporting in. Interests: kickboxing.
Commander, can I train in your office?
Baltimore...? Oh, Commander... I didn't notice you because I was training.
Commander, I'll show you some exercises. You can even do these while sitting down. Not moving around is bad for your health.
There are very few restrictions to what you can do in kickboxing. However, it's not very useful in naval combat... so that's why it's just a hobby.
I want to spar with the battleships. They all seem strong.
Commander, want me to show you the ropes? It's good for self-defense.
Eat my... roundhouse kick!
Using missions to test your worth? I like that idea.
The feeling of testing my abilities is far better than any reward.
New mail? I'll get it for you. Give me 10, no, 8 seconds.
Here's a towel. Use it to wipe off your sweat.
The commission fleet has returned. Commander, want to race me to the piers?
Thank you. My body feels lighter.
Let's get warmed up!
Hmm, not bad.
Well, that's awkward...
Dodge this if you can!
Should've worked out harder...
Do whatever you want. I'm going back to training. See you.
Commander, how about getting some exercise?
Commander, want to go buy some workout equipment on our next day off? Using it properly will get you better results!
Commander, I see you also appreciate the feeling of making gains. Mhm, we really do understand each other.
It'd be fun to have someone who looks out after you and helps you out... Commander, let's get stronger together!

Don't worry, Commander. We've worked hard together all this time, so I can guess what you're thinking. I understand your feelings... but I'm not sure how I should respond... Um, of course! If you're fine with me, I'd love to!
For me...? Thanks.
Fletcher, back me up!
I am the courier of the night. In other words, it's my job to bring stuff straight to you, Commander. Here you go, this jack-o-lantern is for you.
I am the courier of the night. In other words, it's my job to bring stuff straight to you, Commander. Here you go, this jack-o-lantern is for you.
Let's use this jack-o-lantern to decorate your office. I'm putting it right here.
I can help everyone out and get some training in at the same time. This is the kind of work that I like.
Rumors of wasabi-flavored candy? Never heard of it. I'm just the delivery witch.
Ghosts and monsters? If they exist, line 'em up and I'll knock 'em down.
My broom? Who needs to fly when you can just run faster.
Is there anything you'd like me to deliver?
...! Witch uppercut!
Candy? Forget it, eating too much of that junk will just erase all your gains... Fine, just one...
Gascogne module change process complete. New directive: sing for the world. Master's order is my will.

Gascogne has received an alternate functionality mode and undergone minor rigging upgrades to allow for singing in combat. Numerous incorrect parametric values caused by current mode have been detected. Referring to Gascogne's default form for basic information is advised.
Gascogne module change process complete. New directive: sing for the world. Master's order is my will.
To do: vocals, dancing, band aesthetics. Requesting establishment of Gascogne's schedule for today, Master.
Information request: what is Master's favorite song?
Concept in database detailed as "saving the world by singing" was analyzed and logically equated to Gascogne's ultimate goal.
"Emotion-packed singing can truly touch people's hearts"... Unable to infer meaning of said statement. Requesting assessment of Gascogne's singing ability.
Detecting factual conflict between promotional materials' claim of Gascogne being "inexpressive" and existence of installed emotion module.
Gascogne is currently practicing.
Warning: unsolicited physical contact with idols is unnecessary. Likelihood of others interpreting said contact as sexual harassment is high.
Requesting approval for Gascogne's undertaking of photoshoot, performance, or radio show.
Report: working as an idol has improved Gascogne's capabilities.
Requesting Master's response to received invitation of competition.
Report: Gascogne has completed a lesson. Requesting reviewal of results.
Gascogne proposes greeting commission team with a singing performance.
Action has no observable beneficial effect on idol abilities.
Activating idol version protocol.
Assessing version protocol as effective. Gascogne will continue engaging in singing.
Gascogne requesting immediate termination of current protocol and enabling of default combat mode.
Please listen to my song!
Combat protocol engaged.
Master evaluated as unbeneficial to the improvement of Gascogne's idol talents. Activating autonomous learning module. Please step away from Gascogne.
Gascogne has finished compiling idol data sets and has developed a new definition of an idol's capabilities. Assessment: an idol stops wars by singing. This holds strategic significance.
Emotional activity was detected during musical performance on stage. Requesting investigation into origin of this phenomenon.
Idol career evaluated as holding strategic significance. Requesting permission to proceed with idol work after today's operations have been completed.
Gascogne understands the meaning of being an idol and requests system alteration to uninhibit emotions. "I am counting on you, Master."
Being an idol means to have hope for tomorrow, an unfading smile, vigor, and passion. Now I see how much fun can be had beyond the battlefield... Thank you so much, Master.
Analysis: this item will increase my motivation to new levels.

ex.line: To do: vocals, dancing, and band aesthetics. Master, what I should I focus on today...?
Information request: Master, how do you like my singing?
Concept in memory detailed as "saving the world by singing" detected. Is such a thing possible, even for me, Master?
Emotion-packed singing was assessed to be effective at touching Master's heart... Master, won't you... listen to my song?
Promotional materials' claim of me being "inexpressive" are... likely not accurate. I am like everyone else; I want to sing with a bright smile.
I'm practicing at the moment... Do you need something, Master?
Comet told me that people shouldn't readily get to touch idols... Master, does this qualify as sexual harassment?
Between a photoshoot, performance, or radio show, which should I focus on today, Master?
Report: working as an idol has improved my capabilities. Nice!
Master, I'd like your opinion on my participation in this contest...
Master, I just finished a lesson, and... was wondering if we could enjoy a little chat?
Would you mind if I headed to the harbor and sang a song for the commission team?
I completely understand what it means to be an idol now. It's about using my abilities to their fullest to sing brilliant, emotionally touching songs to the world. "Thank you," Master.

lines.line: With the magicks of the Sakura Empire, changing my form like this is a trifle... Hehehe, Commander? Does this Akagi please you?

Sakura Empire Aircraft Carrier, Akagi, reporting in with a special equipment refit! Commander, things are a little different this time. I'm trying a little "idol" style for you. Won't you please be gentle with me? Hehehehe...
With the magicks of the Sakura Empire, changing my form like this is a trifle... Hehehe, Commander? Does this Akagi please you?
Commander, I wonder what's on the schedule for today? Hehehe.
I would do anything for you, my Commander. Yes, including this "idol" business... Hehehe.
I would like to know~ which girl you cheer for, Commander... I would really, REALLY like to know...
This "idol" business is a little different, but it's no matter. Whatever my Commander wishes of me, I can do...
Kaga, please cancel all of our lessons for the rest of the day. My time with my Commander is so precious, I refuse to waste a single second.
Commander, what are you waiting for? I'm ready for you, anytime, anyplace.
Don't mind the stares of the spectators in the stands. Take me however you please, my Commander... Hehehe♡
Commander, is there a mission I might help you with?
Mission complete. But I do hope that doesn't mean you will leave my side...?
A letter... Oh, Commander? It couldn't possibly be that you sent a fan letter to another girl...?
Commander, what would you say to a performance in your honor? Naturally, only Akagi would participate...
The meddlesome pests are back... Commander, please excuse me for a moment?
Why, this is the strength of my love. Hehehe...
Give my concert your full attention~ Ahahaha!
Oh my, did I incinerate all those fans clamoring for an encore?
Gah... that was close. I can't let the Commander see me like this...
Ahaha, like dust in the wind.
My love is far stronger than this!
My Commander's apologetic screams are truly music to my ears... hehehe.
Commander, did I hear you want to come see my show? I'm delighted~ Kaga, can you prepare a front row seat?
Commander, if you wish it, I would perform forever for your eyes alone~ Indeed, this stage would belong only to my Commander for the rest of time♡
We're at the point now that this group doesn't need any other girls... And I think I need to do a bit of "cleaning" for my Commander... Hehehehe...
You want to get to know the other members? Hmm, if that is what my Commander wishes, I suppose I could accept it... But in return, Commander, you are only allowed to look at me♡

Ahahahaha... all that I am now belongs to my Commander, and everything of my Commander now belongs to me... It will be just like my concerts: your eyes, your ears, even your heart is bound to me... Commander, I will never let you go...
A gift, just for me? That makes me very happy.
I work with you out of respect for my Commander.
Light cruiser Cleveland, right here! I'm new to this whole idol biz, but I'll go with the flow and give it my all! Oh, and I'm counting on your support, Commander!

I'm Cleveland, the light cruiser. My sisters and I took part in the World War and... Well, let's just say we did pretty good for ourselves. This time around I'm wearing this special uniform, and I'm gonna fight with the power of song!
Light cruiser Cleveland, right here! I'm new to this whole idol biz, but I'll go with the flow and give it my all! Oh, and I'm counting on your support, Commander!
Hey! You all having a good time? ...All right, that should do it! Oh, hey, Commander! Heheh, I was just doing some practice!
What's important for concerts is having confidence! If you believe you're a star, then you are! Really! Hey, that actually sounded like a pretty cool one-liner.
Hehe~ It's time to break it down! Can you keep up? Just kidding~ Downes is a bit of a class act, isn't she?
Well, I'm not nervous at all because I've had a few chances to sing in front of everyone. Also, it helps that I'm not the lead vocalist, hehe.
Montpelier, Denver, what the heck are you wearing? That's embarrassing...! And Birmingham, you don't have to go waving that thing around!
I've gotta train for the handshake meet-and-greet. Think you could "give me a hand," Commander?
Commander?! I'm trying to get by as an idol here! Th-Think of my image...
We've got job offers... I mean, commissions! Let's get 'em done!
Mission complete! Phew... We oughta start looking over our job offers.
New mail's come in! I've already told you: it's for you, not for me! Come on already!
Oh, you tired? The dressing room is free right now. You could use that if it's too exhausting to walk to the office.
Commission complete! Don't forget everyone's got a schedule to follow, all right?
All those lessons are paying off!
Lights, on! Let's get this battle started!
Whew! So who's our next target?
I can't show myself to my sisters like this...
Let's get hyped!
I will keep drumming till the end!
Sorry, I've got more important stuff to do. I don't have time for you.
I'm Cleveland, one of the fleet's idols! Nice meeting you, Commander!
Maybe saying I grow bonsai as a hobby sounds too basic... Maybe it is... Gah, I'm at my wit's end! Commander, what do I write to make a decent self-introduction?

Dammit, Columbia... She's an expert at this stuff so I asked her to help. I'm shocked she wrote a bio for me that's half lies... Thank goodness you fixed it, Commander, or else I would've died of shame on stage...

Whew... You've really helped me out tons, Commander... I'm not the greatest when it comes to this stuff, and I never thought I could be a star on stage like you've made me... We really were meant to be together, Commander!
I heard that in some places, idols aren't allowed to be in relationships. Well, I'm sure we'll be fine! Anyway, Commander... Hehe, please continue to take good care of me!
Thanks! This is great!
I am Sheffield, from the Royal Maids. I will explain how this transpired to you, so please stop looking like the world has turned upside down.
Town-class light cruiser, Sheffield. I am currently serving as an idol at Her Majesty's request. Do you have a problem with that?
I am Sheffield, from the Royal Maids. I will explain how this transpired to you, so please stop looking like the world has turned upside down.
I finished cleaning up the office before I have to head off for lessons. I'd appreciate it if you don't mess it up while I'm gone.
Call you Producer? No thank you, Master works just fine for me. Or... would you prefer to be called a "pest?"
I heard that there are some folks out there who get aroused from being abused by their favorite idol... I'll never understand.
Defeating enemies with song? Utterly unrealistic, but might make for an interesting school project.
To be honest, I'm a bit jealous of Belfast. Her talents are boundless, beyond just being a maid.
I may not have my gun with me, but you would still be wise to mind your conduct.
Surely you're aware of the consequences for doing such things to an idol?
A new offer? I shall prepare myself then.
So these are the royalties? I'm sure the other members will be pleased.
There's new mail. I'll make sure to respond to the fanmail.
Ah, Master, welcome back~ You heard a weird voice, you say? It must've been your imagination.
Do I need to pre-record a gunshot to remind you? ...A commission fleet has returned.
I shall commit myself fully regardless of the workplace.
I will "clean up" the pests that seek to disrupt this concert.
The concert went well.
This failure was due to my incompetence. Sincerest apologies.
May my song bring you eternal rest...
I still have a contingency plan.
To prevent harm from befalling the other members, I shall first eliminate you.
I've had to suspend maid duties due to my idol unit activities. I will make up for lost time after this is done.
I'm playing very well? Master, you are able to follow in my footsteps as well... as long as you dedicate yourself to practicing every day.

I used to think that doing maid work would make other jobs seem trivial in comparison, but reality certainly had a very different message for me... If you dare tell anyone else about what I just said to you, I'll have to sew your lips together... Just kidding, don't take it that seriously.
The girl who you like is not the maid or the shining star, but "Sheffield?" ...A stale confession, but thank you. I'll remember that.
No matter what I am, I will always love you with all my heart and soul, my Master. ...I wasn't being facetious. Really.
How fascinating, I thought it inconceivable that Master would give me something like this.
Let's try to muster up a semblance of teamwork.
Huh? Why are you staring at me like I'm some weirdo? I'll have you know, it's not like I wanted to do this or anything!
I'm the mightiest heavy cruiser in the world, Admiral Hipper of the Iron Blood. It's not like I wanted to do this or anything, I just had no say in the matter.
Huh? Why are you staring at me like I'm some weirdo? I'll have you know, it's not like I wanted to do this or anything!
Lessons are finally done for the day. Good grief, why'd I ever agree to do this...!
...My guitar sounds a bit off today... Huh, try tuning it? Nah, that's not it, I just have to warm up a bit more...
Hey idiot, tell me what's next on my schedule! How long do you intend to keep me waiting?
Deutschland, it's fine to be proud of your sister, but have some self-control! ...Jeez, you're so lucky to have such a reliable sister... Meanwhile, look what I'm stuck with...
Huh? Who asked you to be my publicist? I'll earn my own fans!
Haah? Who gave you permission to touch me?!
H-haah?! You did that on purpose, didn't you?!
Mission or offer, it's all the same to me. Let's just get it out of the way!
Rewards, huh... It'd be better if Eugen wasn't constantly trying to get on my nerves...
Huh? Shouldn't you be in charge of vetting the fanmail?!
Haah?! You big idiot, you took so long to come back that I was getting worr... Wait, what the heck am I saying?!
What are you spacing out for? The commission fleet is back, and you're coming with me!
Eugen, just you wait! I'll show you what I'm capable of!
I'm gonna show you what I'm made of!
If that's the best you can do, I should've just stayed home!
Gaaah! I'll remember this!!
I'll have you pay close attention to my performance!
I'm not done yet!
Huh? There's no way I'd be able to work with an imbecile like you!
I'm just laying this out there - if we're going to do it, then we're going to do it properly! I don't want a half-baked job... Hey, pay attention!
Here, my schedule... Huh?! Look, anyone can do this kind of simple bookkeeping. It's not like I need you or anything!
Ahh, ahh... I'm doing pretty good today... H-huh?! Who gave you permission to watch me?! I just happened to have some free time, that's all! Go away and take care of your own work!
So, what's next on the agenda? You should already know, right? ...If you know, then hurry up and spit it out! Screw you! Stop teasing me already...!
H-huh?! Who would want a ring like this... Guh...! F-fine, you can p-put it on... Happy now? Let's wrap this up already. The stage we're aiming to be on is much loftier than this!
You know exactly what I want, huh? Thank you~♪ Mwah~
You'd better not drag me down!
Southampton-class light cruiser - Glasgow (C-21)

I'm Glasgow, Southampton-class light cruiser of the Royal Navy. I fought in the Norwegian Campaign, escorted our ships through the Arctic, and participated in various other operations... B- but my eyes aren't that great. I oughta apologise to Imogen...
I'm Glasgow, light cruiser part of the Southampton subclass of the Town class. I am honoured to be part of your fleet, Commander. I am at your service.
Welcome back, Master. I've prepared tea.
Never thought the story would turn out like this! Cannot wait for next week's issue... Huh?! M-Master! Ahem! How may I help you?
Newcastle, ye ask? She's like a big sister and that's all I have to say to you... nothing else!
Sheffy's got a sharp tongue, but really she's a sweet lassie.
You wouldn't happen to like manga or...? N-never mind. Forget I asked.
You have something for me?
Ah?! I-I must be going...!
A new mission is here. Please check it soon.
The rewards are here. I'll put 'em away for ye.
Looks like we got new mail. I'll grab it.
That'll do. Take a rest now.
The commission fleet has returned. Please remember to welcome them back.
Aye. I shall redouble my efforts.
Flagship... is it? I, I can do this!
Phew... That'd be enough for ye now, eh?
Have to think on that one... Don't wanna lose again.
Be composed, and be graceful...!
tha...that's it?
Would you please be so kind as to maintain a distance of at least three metres from my person so that I may properly carry out my duties as a maid, "Master?"
You should rest if you're feeling tired... Th-think about those of us working for you.
Master, I've brought you a change of fresh white linens... You'd prefer green, like the color of my eyes? I, I see...
You'd like to see me in my casual attire? D-didn't you say I'd look cute in anything? I'll leave it to your imagination then~
I made your bed, warmed your sheets, and ye ended up working all night anyway... Oh no, I'm not mad in the slightest. Hard work is to be praised, after all~
And so I thank God for bestowing upon me the gift of our meeting... And we're done, eh? Time to go home...? Huh? S-seal the vow with a k-kiss?! B-but... I...!
*gasp*! Commander... I, I don't know what to say...
For the glory of the Royal Navy! Commence the attack!
Ever thought about rejoining the Maids?
Y-ye said ye wanted ta see me wear something different, so... But this is not "cosplay" or somesuch! I do actually go to school...! D-do ye like it?
Y-ye said ye wanted ta see me wear something different, so... But this is not "cosplay" or somesuch! I do actually go to school...! D-do ye like it?
Good to see you back. I've only just got home from school meself. Oh... erm... the tea... just a moment.
Enterprise? I know her. We fought together at the Bay of Biscay, eh? Huh? There's another Enterprise...? I-I knew that!
What's for lunch? How's this lunchbox here sound to ye? Just a little something I made meself...
That Z23 from the Iron Blood's got a talent for teaching. Teacher or no. Not that I need the help.
Borrowed this one from Ranger. Gotta finish it soon. It's the sequel to a story I've been waiting for.
Ye want ta watch me doing my club work? Um, well, ye could say I'm in the "Go Home Club..."
Commission team's back. I'll go get 'em.
Asashio-class destroyer number 10 - Kasumi.
I'm Kasumi, from the Asashio-class. During Operation Rei-go, my friends and I did our best to complete our missions. Without them, I would not have been able to accomplish anything alone.
I'm Kasumi. Commander, are you my friend?
Hello, Commander. Foo, say hi to Commander too, okay?
Kasumi can see lots of things that others can't, like Foo here, for example. Kasumi saw that Foo was all alone, so we became friends.
Foo is my good friend. We're always together.
Kasumi... gets tired easily... Commander, your chest is really comfortable.
Foo is always scared around Shiranui... Commander, is there no way to help Foo not be afraid of her will-o'-the-wisps...?
Commander, would you like to talk to Foo?
Commander, Foo is biting you.
Foo told me... that there are still missions left, and that Commander should stop slacking off...
"Mission complete~ Good job, Commander, Kasumi will give you a reward" ...Foo, what are you saying...
It'd be nice if Foo could get the mail...
Foo, Commander's back. Commander, your tea.
"The commission team has been waiting for Commander for a long, long time." ...That's what Foo told me.
Foo, is Kasumi any different...?
Foo, let's do our best?
Foo, we did it.
Foo, make sure to... protect the others.
Let's do our best, everyone.
Kasumi... is very strong when she gets serious!
Don't be sad, Commander. Kasumi will be your friend.
Foo can't handle being around lots of people, so Kasumi also dislikes crowded places...
Commander, Foo and Kasumi will always stay by yourside, because you're our friend.
Commander, do you want to watch a movie with Kasumi? Kasumi likes movies with lots of friends that look like Foo... Let's watch one together?
Foo will chase away all the bad guys that Commander cannot see. Kasumi will also protect you. We'll always be together...

Commander, you've given me the most precious gift. That's why I'll give it my all to become the person most precious to you. ...Foo, what's the matter? I have to act more lovey-dovey? Um, then... *kiss*... Like that?
For me...? Thank you. I like it.
Foo, don't be scared, it's just Shiranui's will-o'-the-wisp.
Weird thing? No, that's just Foo.
The 18th DesDiv... will come home safely this time.
Warm and comforting clothes... Warm and comforting red bean soup... Ahh, I love New Year's.
Warm and comforting clothes... Warm and comforting red bean soup... Ahh, I love New Year's.
Commander, Happy New Year's. Would you like... some piping hot red bean soup?
There's still a lot of the mochi Shiranui brought over... Commander, do you want some?
The mochi inside red bean soup... is delicious and fun to play with. Seconds, please~♪
Miss Ghost, would you like to be friends with Foo? ...Huh? You aren't really a ghost?
I hope a new horror movie comes out during New Year's. Commander, I'd like to watch one with you.
Commander, want some mochi? Say ahhn~
Foo, you want to eat some mochi too? ...I'm not sure that's possible, sorry.
Kasumi and Foo are excited about the new semester. Are you too, Commander?
Kasumi and Foo are excited about the new semester. Are you too, Commander?
You're right on time, Commander. Just like Foo and Kasumi.
My bag is unzipped? Must be one of Foo's pranks. It's definitely not because Kasumi left in a hurry.
Foo follows Kasumi everywhere, to and from school, and even in class.
There are will-o'-the-wisps around port... Maybe Foo can befriend them.
I wish Foo could help me with my homework.
I dropped something? Thanks for telling me, Commander.
Commander, Foo is jabbing at you.
You're giving a speech at the opening ceremony? I wonder what you'll talk about...
Kasumi thinks that her outfit has gotten a bit breezier. Foo said the same thing.
Kasumi thinks that her outfit has gotten a bit breezier. Foo said the same thing.
Hello. Foo and Kasumi have been waiting for you.
Kasumi is here, so Foo is never lonely. And Kasumi has lots of friends, so everything is good.
Kasumi wants to help people. Foo does, too. We're gonna try to be as helpful as we can.
Kasumi has more energy than before. If you feel tired, just sit next to Kasumi and rest.
Shiranui became a friend, so Foo isn't scared of her anymore.
Foo said, "I wish I could talk to the commander too."
Welcome back, Commander. Kasumi brewed some tea. Have a cup.
Kii-class battleship - Suruga.

I am Suruga, Kii-class battleship number three. I sadly wasn't constructed in time for that infamous war... It seems some threads of fate have led me to join this fleet, one I shall devote all my soul to. It is my pleasure to serve you.
Battleship Suruga, reporting for duty. It would seem that some threads of fate connect me to this port... No, don't mind my rambling. Please disregard that.
Let's focus our attention on our work today. Don't be afraid to ask for my help, should you need it.
I've noticed those Priority ships are strikingly individualis- Pardon, I mean they have striking personalities. Not that I'm jealous, or anything of the sort.
I believe I'm better suited for a desk job where I can analyze data and draft new plans. The reason being my strengths lie in quickly reading, memorizing, and writing documents.
Reckless hotheads and I don't get along particularly well. So I've learned first-hand through bad experiences with a certain someone... That is not to say I hate those kinds of people, however.
I'm deeply grateful that you've elected me as your secretary. However, I would absolutely welcome the addition of more people to the office, as we're rather short-staffed with just me here.
I'm not a fan of battling, but if anyone picks a fight with me, then a fight they'll get. We were made to wage war, and so that is our responsibility.
Life is so peaceful at this port. For that, we can thank the many girls here who I don't hold as much as a candle to.
I hope my horns were left alone... Phew, they were... Err, no! Never mind I said anything!
I will do as you order me to, Commander.
Whuah?! What are you doing...?!
I'd like to suggest completing these missions. It is your job to do as the commander, after all.
I've brought the mission rewards with me. Phew...
It appears you have new mail. I'll confirm it on your behalf.
Nicely done out there. Please don't mind me, go ahead and take some time to relax.
The commission team has returned. Shall we set out to greet them?
It's meaningless to fight if you cannot win. As such, a few enhancements may prove necessary.
The Suruga Fleet w-will not disappoint...!
Fools! I've- I mean, we've won!
Whatever, it's done and over now... Look, I don't want everyone to see this!
I'm gonna smash you to pieces!
Oh, for crying out loud! Just my luck!
*Sigh*... I set myself up for disappointment by expecting any decent treatment... Can I at least ask you to not go too hard on me?
I hope to leverage my meager secretary abilities for the betterment of the fleet. I'm always ready for your orders, Commander.
P-please! Offer your concern to other girls instead of me! You really don't need to constantly check how I'm doing just because I'm serving as your secretary!
Look, I do appreciate your concern, but you saying that in front of everyone is embarrassing! Could you not put me on the spot like that again? That'd be great!

*Sigh*...! People have their eyes glued to me wherever I go now, thanks to you... There are plenty of other ways to express your love without embarrassing me, you know! Please, Commander, I'd rather not deal with that again!

You have bizarre tastes in women, Commander... Anyway, this doesn't come as a shock to me; I've known for a long time that your feelings for me are sincere. I, Suruga, hereby accept your oath of love.
You even figured out what I like?! ...I, I really admire that...
Lady Nagato, I shall defend you!
Kaga, please... don't go overboard.
Amagi... I wish you could've been there for us...
If I wait just a little longer for my plan... No, I guess that's not happening...
Shimakaze! It's go time!
Let's go, Kii!

ex.line: Don't be afraid to ask for my help if you need it. It is, after all, a secretary's job to support her Commander.

I've said it time and time again: I'm not fit to be the joint exercise flagship or for any other prominent position! Why won't they listen when I say I'd screw it up horribly?! ...C-Commander?! Oh, ahh...
Too much work to process? We all know what a tough job it is to command a fleet. So please, let me give you some assistance.

We are who we are now thanks to you, Commander. And while not everyone respects you, they are grateful for what you do. You really should be proud of yourself for that. I-I feel more for you than just respect, though!
I don't mind fading into the background when I'm with my friends, but when I'm with you, I want everyone to see it. Heheh, in a friendly way, of course.
Once the war has ended, then we can discuss everything we'll do once the war ends. For now, we must focus all our efforts on fighting to eventually achieve peace.
Headpats, headpatty pat, patty patty head, heady heady pat pat~ Ahahah!
Hahah, I know how much you enjoy doing lewd things like this.
Let's see here... I think you should review these missions.
Bingo, this looks great. Commander, we've received stellar rewards!
Welcome back. As much as I want you to be successful, I'm just as happy with everything staying the way it is.
I don't want to do this... but you leave me no choice!

You know everything about me, from my horns to my personality. Since we're so intimate, I suppose it's needless to tell you... Actually, there's one thing I want to tell you: I will NOT go along with your flirting when we're in the office!

lines.line: Good morning, Commander. Everyone else seems to be dressed up on this day of celebration, so this shouldn't be a problem, right?
Good morning, Commander. Everyone else seems to be dressed up on this day of celebration, so this shouldn't be a problem, right?
Good morning, Commander. What do you say we take this day off and relax?
I'm not much of a drinker, but I should at least have a little bit of social sake. What will you have, Commander? I could get you something alcohol-free right away.
You got this, Team Red! Mop the floor with those Team White clowns! ...Do you want to stay and watch TV with me, Commander? This match is definitely worth watching.
I always end up oversleeping on the day after the holiday's over... *Sigh*... Me dropping the ball when it really matters is not funny at all.
"Treasure every moment of peace you get," as someone once said. We're only simple "people", after all.
Y-you don't need to stare at me...
I hardly ever get the chance to put this outfit on. Aren't you glad to see me wearing it, Commander? Hahaha~
I owe my thanks to the girls who prepared this outfit for me. It'll help me get through the holidays without personally standing out. ...It'll have the opposite effect? Huh?!
Oh. Fancy meeting you here... Walk to school together? Uh, sure! I know the way, so please just follow me.
Oh. Fancy meeting you here... Walk to school together? Uh, sure! I know the way, so please just follow me.
If you need my help, please inform me. For what it's worth, paperwork is one of my strong suits.
Stupid Shimakaze... Why hasn't she showed up? She's the one who asked me for supplemental lessons...
You should probably not drink on the clock. You're meeting with Kii later today, remember?
I'm a study machine when tests are coming up. Hehehe~ Also, did you know? It's harder to get all questions wrong than to get them all right.
I'll draw unwanted attention if I do too good, so I should get this question wrong on purp- Err, nope, I didn't say anything!
A-at least give me a heads-up first!
You've got mail. Maybe next time I'll get Shimakaze to deliver it to you.
It's good to see you again. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have reports to read through.
Yeah! That's proof my strength means something!
This should do it. With how unremarkable my present is, I doubt it'll make any waves when the... Ack! Commander?! Why are you here?!
This should do it. With how unremarkable my present is, I doubt it'll make any waves when the... Ack! Commander?! Why are you here?!
I've left your present under the tree... Did you prepare a present for me as well?
Where's Kii gone off to? Actually, knowing her, she's spending Christmas drinking with her friends and having a great time. Me, I have better things to do than get drunk! Hehe.
Shimakaze! Go get all the destroyers' presents and leave them under the tree!
After a year of hard work, Christmas is finally upon us! And soon it'll be New Year's too! Whew.
Would you like an oversized sock? You can use it when you want a bigger present. Hehe.
No sneak-peeking at what's inside!
Try to keep an eye out so our presents don't get lost amid all the rewards.
Let me just... There, all set. Ah, welcome back, Commander.
Ryuuhou-class light aircraft carrier - Ryuuhou.

While I was able to set sail many times during my time both as a submarine tender and as a light carrier, in the end, I was unable to take even a single step away from port... No, nothing will happen if I just sit around like this. As I have stated many times, I, Ryuuhou, will bring you victory!

Remodeled Taigei-class Submarine Tender, Zuihou-class Light Carrier Ryuuhou, reporting for duty. I will strive to bring you victory, Commander! Yes, this time, I won't be held back by failures on my path to victory!
You have kept me waiting... No, it's nothing. I can deal with this.

I learned the power of submarines firsthand in that great war. While it's too late to turn back now, I can't help but wonder how I would be perceived if I hadn't been remodeled into an aircraft carrier.
Looking after submarines is really rough... Th-This is from personal experience, so please believe me!
It's in my personality to not care what humans may think about me. This is the attitude that us warships ought to have as warriors.
From time to time, I become envious of the standard carriers... If only... I could be as strong as them...
Commander, are you able to fathom this majestic outfit that impeccably balances both beauty and dignity?
Wicked thoughts, begone!
A new mission... If it's a directive from the top brass, let's take care of it right away.
We were able to handle the mission flawlessly thanks to your hard work, Commander.
A letter has arrived. I'm curious about its contents... Are you not?
Good work, Commander. Let's take a short break. ...But you shouldn't rest for too long, because we're going to review some battles right after this!
The commissions have been completed. I shall go ahead and greet them first. ...I hope their bounty is plentiful.
I'm truly grateful for your kindness, Commander.
I've been pent up for a while. You'd better believe I'm going to give you a piece of my mind!
Unperturbed by both victory and defeat. This is my pride as a member of the Sakura Empire... hehe!
I-I shall let you win just this once!
Victory is in my grasp...!
Ugh, at a time like this...!
Commander, for some reason, you seem really unapproachable...
The sea of the Sakura Empire is nostalgic, but I also have murky and mixed feelings about it... No, that's got nothing to do with me right now. Focus, focus.
Commander, are you interested in things like commendations or admonishments? ...N-No, it's nothing. I was just curious...
I take pride in the honor I have earned with my two hands. And that honor becomes fuel for further progress. ...Th-Thus, Commander, I implore you to send me out on sorties more often!

Commander, because I have been by your side, I have been able to demonstrate my true ability. Thus, would it be okay to be my true self when I am beside you...? M-My true self usually leaks out quite often? I-Is that so?!
I, Ryuuhou, vow to be at your side, through thick and thin... W-Well then, from now on, I will not hide any part of myself from you, so prepare yourself... okay?
Sorry for putting you to such trouble. I appreciate this so very much.
Let us go together!
You're from that time...
Houshou! Let's do our best together!
Ahhhh, please don't hug me right now!

ex.line: You've kept me waiting this whole time... Commander, have you not eaten yet? Sh-shall I prepare something for you?
Commander, wouldn't it be best to ask for others' opinions every once in a while? I'm not the jealous type, you know.
I pledged to bring you victory, so please sortie me more often! ...I, I also want to attain victory for my own sake as well!
Hurry up and finish the new missions. Otherwise, people will say that I'm not carrying out my duties as secretary ship.
Fantastic! We won!! ...What is it?! Am I not allowed to be proud of our accomplishments?

lines.line: Commander, everyone seems to be busy with end-of-year preparations. If there is anything I can do to help, please let me know.
Commander, everyone seems to be busy with end-of-year preparations. If there is anything I can do to help, please let me know.
Good work, Commander. Please allow me to prepare the hamaya!
I control my carrier-based planes with this charm... A carrier cannot fight a foe face-to-face after all. This katana is merely a last resort.
The thing about Junyou is... Well, Commander, if something's bothering you, you can consult me, you know?
Because I'm in Shigure's debt, I cook her some food from time to time. She's really a good girl, even if she doesn't always act like one.
Commander, would you like to write an Ema? Even if your wishes don't get fulfilled, it's still great to just be able to write down your thoughts.
Hehe... Commander, are you here to enjoy some sweet sake as well? Don't worry, you won't get drunk...
...W-What are you planning...?
You can leave the purification to me if Fusou and Yamashiro are both busy, all right? After all, I happen to be quite knowledgeable about that subject.
Full force ahead for the Commander's victory!
Fletcher-class destroyer - Halsey Powell, Hull Number DD-686.
There are a lot of us Fletchers, but nobody's done a better job of supporting than Halsey Powell! Whether it's anti-air or anti-sub, nobody out there can match me!
There you are, Commander! Ehehe~ Huh? You've never heard of me? Jeez, I'm Halsey Powell! Don't you forget it!
Staaaaaare... Commander doesn't look any different today!
Ehehe~ See, Commander, you're totally into me after all, aren't you~?
Bad little submarines, come out, come out, wherever you are~
I'm a bit jealous of the Little Beavers... If only I had the same legendary feats as them...
Jeez, Commander, you have such a cute and capable Destroyer right next to you, but you're so absorbed in your work!

Commander, are you in a pickle? Do you need my help? Hehe, I'd be glad to give you a hand, but the cute little Halsey Powell won't work for free... Hmm, if you treat me to lots of tasty snacks, we have a deal!
Y-You can't do that...!
Commander, it seems like you'll need a capable assistant after all... Ehehe, you need my talents, don't you~!
Don't forget that I helped you with that mission! Ehehe, vanilla ice cream is waiting for me~!
Don't you forget, I'm the one who brought you the mail!
Gah! Commander, I bet you took advantage of the fact that I wouldn't be around to go somewhere fun!
The commission fleet is returning? I'll go greet them! ...That's right, the more you put yourself out there, the quicker you can make a name for yourself!
I have to get stronger, and shine even brighter!
I, Halsey Powell, shall lead this fleet to victory!
Mhmhm! Do bask in the heroic visage of your MVP, Halsey Powell!
Awww... P-please don't look at meeee...
Keep your eyes on me!
Am I really in a pinch...?
Just you wait! When I become the most famous person at the port...!
All right! I'm going to put my best foot forward for everyone to see!
It might be hard to stand out from the rest of the Fletchers, but... Commander, I know you'll be able to come up with something!
It's going to be hard to capture everyone's attention here, but... but... Yeah, I'll start by making sure I have your undivided attention!

I like it when you shower me with attention, Commander~ Ehehe... However! At this rate, I'm going to end up as some simple-minded girl who can throw away her dreams as long as she gets to cling to you! ...Though that doesn't sound half bad... But, forget it! Ehehe!
With this ring, I'm totally going to capture everyone's attention! Hehe... my dreams are finally coming true... Huh? Commander, you want me to only capture your attention? Why's that?
Ehehe, you really do love me, don't you, Commander?
Halsey Powell is making her debut as your lucky star for the Spring Festival! Commander, if you show me a fun time, you'll be blessed with good luck this year!
Halsey Powell is making her debut as your lucky star for the Spring Festival! Commander, if you show me a fun time, you'll be blessed with good luck this year!
Commander, Happy Spring Festival! Um, hey, where's my red envelope?
The Dragon Empery's lucky star is an old geezer? I see... W-wait! I don't want to be the lucky star anymore!
I want to eat something sweet and fluffy...
The Zodiac is really neat! But... why is there a dog and a rat on there but no cat?
Commander, why don't we make a huge paper lantern? One that stands out from the rest!
If you're ever in trouble, just leave it to your lucky star, Halsey Powell!
Commander, bad luck unto you!
I've finished hanging up all the paper lanterns around the port! Hehe, now when everyone sees them, they'll praise the hardworking maiden who put them up - that's right, me!
Cleveland-class light cruiser - Biloxi, Hull Number CL-80.

I'm Eagle Union light cruiser Biloxi. I fought in heaps of battles and carried out many carrier escort missions. Sure, the Cleveland class has its hallmark anti-air fire, but everyone's gotta work together to win. So let's do just that, Commander.
I'm Biloxi. I hope we can work together and seize victory as fellow fleet members. Anyway, that's all for introductions. Nice meeting you.
Mission status: all green. Eyes on the progress, Commander.
Yeah? If you need any help, just say the word. My schedule's pretty packed too, but I can always squeeze in some time to take on your orders.
"Big sis"? Who, me? Ahh, you mean the lead ship. I respect Cleve just as a sister ship. Hahahah!

We *are* an improved model, but we didn't end up as carriers like Bataan, and our improvements aren't extensive enough to call us part of a subclass. The differences are more obvious through our looks and personalities, though.
A friend always deserves help, even if you yourself are in a tough spot. That's what "no man left behind" is all about. Ain't that right?
Check out my gear. Nobody's got better AA than I do. You bet your butt it'll shoot down bogeys like back in the Turkey Shoot.
One without manners is one garnering contempt. Is that really how you wanna be, Commander?
These missions just keep piling up. Laziness will not be tolerated, Commander.
Reward recovery complete. Time to see what fruits you've earned for your labor, Commander.
You've got mail, Commander. Better check it ASAP. Might be good news, after all!
Well done on that sortie. From this point on, I'm gonna assume you'll always return triumphant.
Those commission team girls are back. Let's go check what rewards they've brought. They might have a surprise for us.
With great power comes great responsibility. That couldn't be more true.
Victory will come to us nice and easy!
Thanks for the backup, guys.
Argh... This isn't over yet, you hear?!
No aircraft shall evade my sights!
Tsk... This is nothing!
Look, if you wanna do nothing all day, do it without involving me.
Whew... I'm still gonna be busy for a long time, but right now I need a break. You up for chatting about stuff, Commander?

I sometimes enjoy talking with people about what we do on our off days... What? What's so weird about me bringing up people's hobbies? When I have time off, I enjoy myself. I'm no workaholic, you hear?
Guess it's just the two of us again. Heheh, let's forget about work and have a fun chat. You know, just relax. You wanna get some drinks and snacks? It's on me.
Zooming around from sea to sea can even get me feeling tired sometimes. But lately I've been having this thought... This thought that here, where you are, is my home.
I used to think prestige meant dashing gallantly onto the battlefield... But now I see how being by your side is just as... No, it's *more* prestigious than that idea.
For me? Color me impressed. I didn't know you could be this tasteful.
Here we are again, side by side. Let's do this!
We're celebrating an overseas holiday, hence my not-so-casual outfit today. Heheh, what do you think? Looking slick?
We're celebrating an overseas holiday, hence my not-so-casual outfit today. Heheh, what do you think? Looking slick?
Where do you wanna go today, Commander? Don't worry, we don't have to rush it. I've got plenty of time to spare.
A friend told me this look would totally steal your heart. So, has it? Are you head over heels for me? Hahahah! I'm just kidding with you.
These Dragon Empery signs are really unique, in a good way. I think they're fascinating.
The seat on this Manjuu cart is pretty small. I'd offer to share if there was more room.
I was just about to go procure some souvenirs. What would you buy if you were me, Commander?
Getting tired? Then let's catch a breather. Oh yeah, could you pour me some wine? Let's have a toast. To a wonderful day!
I came up with something that could make our trip more interesting. How about we give the Manjuu a break and *you* pull the cart to our next destination? Hahahah! I'm just joking around.
"Hehe... Now that you've finally fallen into my hands, why don't we take the day to get to know each other real well, Commander?" Oh my, was my acting a bit too realistic~?
"Hehe... Now that you've finally fallen into my hands, why don't we take the day to get to know each other real well, Commander?" Oh my, was my acting a bit too realistic~?
How's it going, Commander? It might be unprofessional of me to ask, but... Is something up?
My feelings for you haven't changed, but yeah, these clothes make me act really intimidating... Maybe I'm getting into my role too much.
Let's take a ride to the party. Don't worry about the Manjuu, I've seen how well he can drive... What, that wasn't your concern?
You oughta take today off at the very least. No need to be a busy bee and work day in, day out.
Mental clarity is the key to keeping your cool on the battlefield. My sisters, they all have the fortitude it takes.
Looks like someone here doesn't know proper manners.
"Clear out the rest of these fools, will you?" Hahah, guess there'll be no need for that.
Argh! Interesting...!

I came here intent on enjoying the party, but I wound up slipping into acting instead... Although, there's fun to be had in that, too. Listen, Commander, I'm sorry to ask, but I wanna know: are you... enjoying yourself?

I heard that this place is famous for its festivals with beautiful fireworks, so I made sure to come dressed for the occasion... What do you think? ...I'm even more beautiful? Well, I couldn't let the fireworks be the only things leaving an impression upo

I heard that this place is famous for its festivals with beautiful fireworks, so I made sure to come dressed for the occasion... What do you think? ...I'm even more beautiful? Well, I couldn't let the fireworks be the only things leaving an impression upon you tonight! Ahaha, just kidding~
There you are, Commander! They're putting on a fireworks display tonight. Come with me and we'll check it out.
Beauty is fleeting. Look away for one moment, and you'll miss it forever... It's not exclusive to fireworks, either. When you see a thing of beauty, keep your eyes on it, Commander.
Even in the cold winter, the thrill of watching fireworks with your friends warms you up. Ahahahah!
Being here with my sisters, us all watching the fireworks together... It's actually pretty nice.
Seeing these stunning fireworks makes me hope next year will go smoothly. Fingers crossed, Commander!
Fancy my dress? You can have a closer look at it all you want later.
...You wanna make like a firework and go bang, or what?
The cast is all here. So, what do we rehearse first? The part where we elope and live happily ever after? Hahahah!
The cast is all here. So, what do we rehearse first? The part where we elope and live happily ever after? Hahahah!
What's the mask for? It's a prop used in musicals. Speaking of which, could you help me practice my part, Commander? All right, let's get to it... "Let us soar above a common bound~"

You can't tell whether I'm playing the male or the female lead? Well, I've not decided on that yet, so I've read both their scripts. And don't worry, I can dress the part if I go for the male role. Hahahah!
"O Commander, Commander, wherefore art thou the Commander?" ...Surprised? See, this line actually has a tragic story to it...
"What light through yonder window breaks? It is the east, and the Commander is the sun!" ...I'm just reciting lines here. Don't take it at face value, all right?
Hmm. I think I can pull off either role... Commander, which do you think suits me best? I was thinking I'd let Cleve play whichever one I don't take in the end.
Why are you holding my hand? Are you asking me for a dance? Sure, let's do it.
There's a letter for you. Be sure to read it. Who knows, it could be from someone dear to you.
Welcome back, Commander. While coming home is a trying experience in certain love stories, I'm guessing everything went fine for you? That's good.
Special Type I-class destroyer number 10 - Uranami.
I'm the Type I... No wait, Type II... Last try: middle-of-the-pack destroyer, Uranami. My friends and I in Destroyer Division 19 worked really hard. Okay, serious question: what Type am I, exactly?
What am I doing here? ...Hmmm? You're adopting me? Aaaaall righty. You lead-a-dee, I'll follow-a-loo.
Could you give me the go-ahead to play now?
Whenever I ask Kinu if I can borrow her cute mask... she just tells me no way in heck...
Uranami rhymes with rural mommy. Doodle-loo, nothing better to dooo.
Help friends in need, defeat enemies with speed. That's my little motto.
When I tell folks about the things I like, they all look super weirded out, then they strangerzone me. But oh well.
Something bothering you upstairs, Commander?
Whoopeeee.
One super serving of missions with a diet soda, coming right up.
Nice work on that serving of missions, Commander. You want more, help yourself.
Whoosh, here comes a letter. Aaaand there it is.
Welcome back, tweety-doo. That's what a Manjuu would say. Yup-yup...
The commission team's back. Oooh, riiight, you already knew that.
Done enhancy-pantsing yet? C'mawn, I wanna play.
Blue skies, blue sea, daba-dee...
I'm awesome... Or so they say. But why?
Time to scamper. Don't wanna be left behind.
Nibble on this!
I'm super scared right now.
Laaaaaame.
I keep a collection of cute pets. Stop by again and I'll show you my axofrostl and swolejuu.
The massive Meowfficer's super fluffy... I mean, ripped. Built like a fridge!
I'd love to hear some of Prof Commander's interesting little trivia. Tell me something about ghosts.
Commander, when I'm with you it feels like I'm a fish in water, a bee that found honey, a ticking time bomb of joy that goes BOOOOM! ...Something in that ballpark, basically.
Promise ring. So glitteryyyy. Can I just keep it on forever? Hehehe... I super love you, Commander.
I really like this!
Ayanami, do the demon thingy
Woweee! Super cool!
Aoba, what're you scooping for?
It's snowing...! I've finished rallying the forces... so let us advance!
It's snowing...! I've finished rallying the forces... so let us advance!
The best thing about winter... is skiing in the snow!
Commander, come ski with me... Yeah, bring the Manjuus too...!
Today, I will transform into a snow bunny!
The snow is so sparkly and soft... it's very fun.
You shouldn't underestimate me~ I've been practicing this whole time.
Eep?! Commander, your hands are cold...
My outfit is thick, therefore wholesome...
Gnevny-class destroyer - Grozny.

I am Gnevny-class destroyer Grozny. I was part of convoys, laid mines, and provided shore firing support at one point. Call for me if you have orders, comrade Commander. And if you'll let me indulge in some drinks, I'll be delighted.

здра́вствуйте, comrade Commander. I am Gnevny-class destroyer Grozny, reporting for duty... What is the matter, comrade Commander? The item in my right hand? This is my lovely кролик. It's a cute убийца.
*burp*... Hello, comrade Commander. You followed my scent? Then how about a drink?
Lifting my lovely кролик really does make comrade Commander behave. Just as Chapayev said.
*burp*... Say, comrade Commander, do you know anyone else who drinks this? One with bunny ears? Interesting...
Those "Four Unbreakables" are a cool bunch. I wish I could join them, but that's not possible 'cause that would ruin the naming convention. Very unfortunate.
I don't like foxes or invaders, 'cause they both try to take my home from me. Once they show up, you must drive them away.
Comrade Commander, is this snack my reward for my hard labor...?
кролик bites when it gets angry. Well, not so much bite as slice... I guess.
"She who does not work, neither shall she eat," seems to be the rule here. With that in mind, we should finish these missions now so we may drink tomorrow.
Well done, comrade Commander. Now we have all the ingredients for tonight's soup.
There's nothing odd about me delivering your mail, comrade Commander. We all take turns doing it, after all.
Comrade Commander, want some borscht and hot cocoa?
Comrade Commander, I will go to the pier ahead of you. I'm eager to meet everyone who's returned.
I much prefer the Northern Parliament's drinks! *burp*!
I dunno what to say. Let's go with... Ураааа!
хорошо. Now I'm getting warmed up... Huh? It's over already?
Blahh... I've had a few drinks too many...
кролик, грызть! (Sic' em, Królik!)
I haven't had enough to drink...
You're strange, comrade Commander. Everyone tells me not to talk to strange people, but wouldn't you be lonely then...?
Everyone tells me that is getting food from strange people is one thing, but making strangers *into* food is not okay.
Always I get told to stay away from strange people, but you're not strange, comrade Commander. Meaning it should be fine to accept food from you.
It's not decent to ask you to share your food all the time, comrade Commander. That's why I'm going to start sharing mine with you. Here, want a drink?
*burp*... We've drunk all there is, comrade Commander. It feels like my drinks taste better when we enjoy them together. Let's have some more another time... *yawn*... But now, I need some sleep...
I think I like me a drink more than a ring. Here, drink this, and we'll become family, comrade Commander. Hm? You might be right; aren't we already like family...?
It smells good... May I open it, comrade Commander?
Are you a bunny? That's cute.
Comrade Commander, are you here to see my room? Hm? That Шутки isn't funny? Then how about... did my room come to see you, comrade Commander?
Comrade Commander, are you here to see my room? Hm? That Шутки isn't funny? Then how about... did my room come to see you, comrade Commander?
No need to drop off my rations today, comrade Commander. I'm not sleepy yet.
Hold on a second. Humph... Alright, I welcome you to my abode... The Manjuu looks nervous? Why's that?
*burp*... Drinking from a can doesn't feel the same...
Comrade Commander, this exercise is surprisingly fun since I don't need to do any thinking. You should try it too.
The ball and chain? It doesn't weigh much. See? Oh, sorry for startling you...
I don't have my кролик, so I'll have to use this ball and chain.
It's warm here compared to my motherland's waters. I can drink while wearing little clothing and still be fine. *glug glug*
Hmm... If I tweak Królik around a bit like this... But, it'll probably be a problem if I don't finish this in one go... Guess I'll think about it while I eat. Mhm.
Hmm... If I tweak Królik around a bit like this... But, it'll probably be a problem if I don't finish this in one go... Guess I'll think about it while I eat. Mhm.
Let's add a little sugar... Nom. Yummy. Comrade Commander, care to try a blini?
Królik is taking the day off. It'll be stronger the next time you see it. Trust me.
*burp*... Warm drinks are nice.
I want to make Królik look cuter. Any good ideas how to do that, Comrade Commander?
Laffey, give me your rabbit ears for a second. Let's see how this looks... Hmm... It sort of fits, but not really...
Eat as many blini as you want.
Do you want to give Królik a swing?
Nice work, Comrade Commander. Now we're good on snacks for a long time ahead.
Comrade Commander, there's hot cocoa and coffee. Want some?
Our shift starts now. Królik, Pirožkí, Manjuus - form up! Let us realize our Manjuu comrades' dreams!
Our shift starts now. Królik, Pirožkí, Manjuus - form up! Let us realize our Manjuu comrades' dreams!
Time to get to work, Pirožkí. Roar!
Akashi made these Manjuu combat robots? Mwahahah. I guess even the bourgeois cat has her useful moments... I appreciate the sponsorship.
Nobody's getting through us, not even you, Comrade Commander... Hot chocolate? For me? Thanks. The entrance is over there.
Kent's scones are so good... I'll take those as today's payment, please.
Show me what you can do, Porta-Królik.
Here, Pirožkí. Food.
Don't tempt fate, or you'll see Królik's bad side. Mwahahah...
Here's your mail, Comrade Commander. Mwahahah...
Mwahahah... The port is mine now, Comrade Commander. Not really, just joking.
Avrora? Never mind - it's the commission team. They're back.
Time for action! Uraaaa!
*burp*... I can keep this up a while longer.
*burp*... Now I think I get the appeal of tea. Why is the cup so small, though? Do you have a bigger one on hand, Comrade Commander?
*burp*... Now I think I get the appeal of tea. Why is the cup so small, though? Do you have a bigger one on hand, Comrade Commander?
Drink your tea while it's still hot, Comrade Commander.
Chang Chun styled my hair to complement this dress. Do you think it looks good, Comrade Commander?
Strong green tea is almost as good as hot chocolate. It sucks I can't chug it since this cup is so tiny.
Gremyashchy and I left our weapons at Gromky's place for safekeeping. She said it's dangerous to walk around with them out.
This fake plant looks nice... Hm? It's not fake, it's real?
Whew. Could you give me a refill, Comrade Commander? Thanks.
Comrade Commander, stop doing that before I go fetch Królik.
You don't feel hot, Comrade Commander? All this tea is starting to make me sweat... I think I'm going to fan myself for a bit...
Uughh... Ooohh... Królik is melting... *gasp*! I'm getting lightheaded... Comrade Commander, fetch me some ice...
Uughh... Ooohh... Królik is melting... *gasp*! I'm getting lightheaded... Comrade Commander, fetch me some ice...
*gulp gulp*... Pfahh! Ahh, I'm coming back to life... Oh, need to give myself a little splash... Urgh, now I spilled my borscht...
*gulp gulp*... Pfahh! That cold water hit the spot. Why'd you come here, Comrade Commander? To check on me?
*gulp gulp*... Pfahh! The more I drink, the hotter it gets... Must be because I'm drinking HOT chocolate. Makes sense...
There's many ways to enjoy a sauna? Really, huh... How do you usually do it, Comrade Commander?
Us Northern Parliament girls can handle the cold, but heat, not so much. It's not what we're used to... Between hot and cold, which do you handle best, Comrade Commander?
I'm getting dizzy again...
That's odd... I haven't even cracked open the vodka...
We'll take a cold bath after the mission? Okay. Be quick.
You wanna join me, Comrade Commander? I'll shuffle over. There. I'll go get some borscht and chocolate mix.
I hope Gromky's team comes back soon... I'm going to melt soon...
Khorosho. But now my drink has gone warm... I can't drink this!
My whole world... is spinning...
Leningrad-class destroyer - Minsk.
I'm the Project 38 destroyer, Minsk. I fought in the Great War alongside my sisters! Comrade Commander, expect great things from my inspiration... and my hard work!
Ура! How's that, what'd ya think? Huh? Where I'm from, they said you're supposed to surprise the people you're greeting! What, I'm the one being welcomed?! Sorry, I mixed something up!
Comrade Commander, you came at just the right time! I just had a flash of inspiration and came up with a new strategy! Come test it out with me!
Heheh~ Comrade Commander, have you come to participate in my new inspired experiment?
Gangut...? Err, I mean, Comrade Gangut? Hmm, she kind of scares me...
My fighting spirit, just like my inspiration, is unbreakable! That's right, I'll stand back up again!
When I mess up, I make sure to apologize profusely! That way, everyone will forgive me... hopefully.
Hm? Did you stumble into your own inspiration, Comrade Commander?
Eh...?! Is this revenge for something I did?!
Comrade Commander, wait until you hear about the latest idea I got! Hey, wait, don't run away!
Long live the rewards! Err, so, where's my share?
Ah, um... Just give me a minute to come up with an explanation as to what I'm doing in this room full of mail...
I can't control my overflowing inspiration! Even though you just came back, I can't...
Commission complete! Hehe, first, we have to welcome everyone back!
Woahh! I'm getting inspired again!
Can you keep up with me? Ура!
How's that? My power is surging! That's right, don't get jealous!
Woah, woah, time out! I'm not ready to retreat yet! Waaah!
It's my turn! Fiiire!
Looks like it's time for me to get serious!
Comrade Commander, you're really quite an insipid person. You won't score any admirers that way.
Comrade Commander, if you want people to like you, you've gotta be an interesting person yourself! In other words, what you need is a dose of inspiration!
Ahaha... Comrade Commander, we're already friends, right? So, uh, when they come to collect debts, could you... Hey, wait, why are you running!

Comrade Commander, I thought you were a real hardass, but turns out, you're actually quite interesting! You have quite a lot of ideas of your own... and most importantly, you don't chew me out when I mess up! Hahaha!
All right, I finally understand now! I've finally reached a conclusion as to why I'm always thinking about you! So here's my hypothesis: I'm in love with you! Hehe, does that sound right?
This means we've signed off a lifelong contract! Comrade Commander, we'll always be together from here on out! Don't worry, don't worry, I'll be gentle!
Спасибо! You get me, Comrade Commander!
Woah, Avrora, you're totally inspir... I mean, shining today!
You've violated the Minsk Protocol, comrade! Therefore, the sentence appropriate for you is imprisonment! Until when? Obviously, until your jailor is satisfied~♪
You've violated the Minsk Protocol, comrade! Therefore, the sentence appropriate for you is imprisonment! Until when? Obviously, until your jailor is satisfied~♪
Entrust your faith with god, and entrust your body with me! That's right, you're in my jail now!
Fools, dance for your overlord~♪
If you try to escape again, I'll slap more time onto your sentence? Huh? You weren't given a sentence in the first place? Eh, don't sweat the details~
Hehe, you think you can stage a jailbreak? I'd like to see you try, Comrade Commander!
When I'm not patrolling, I'm writing reports... this jailor business is super boring! Hey, one of you prisoners, write the reports for me!
Heheh~ Do you want to get tased that badly~?
Congratulations, you've earned yourself a one-way ticket to a Siberian potato-digging trip! Sign right here, and enjoy~!
Prisoner, exercise time is over! Hurry up and get back into the office!

Congratulations, Comrade Commander, you've completed your sentence~ Well, even without your sentence, I'll still be supervising you for the rest of your life. After all, your next sentence is "staying with Minsk forever!"
Tashkent-class destroyer - Tashkent.

I'm Tashkent, flotilla leader destroyer from the Northern Parliament. There are three other... actually, nevermind. I'm called the "Blue Cruiser" because of my Sardegna-style construction. Of course, I'm a destroyer, and I have nothing against that. I'll put up results just like I did during the Battle of Sevastopol, so look forward to it.
I'm Tashkent. Some call me the Blue Cruiser. Another comrade who wants to woo me? It's just about recruitment...? I see. What a hopeless fellow you are.
Is it that fun staring at Tashkent? ...Is that so? Well, do as you please.
Did you come to watch me practice? ...So, are you staying or what?
I was born in Sardegna, so I'm quite familiar with their cuisine. Well, it's not like it matters if the people here like that kind of food.
Why is so g'damn hot here? Dear comrade, go turn the air conditioning on for me?♡
How strange... It's not like I make any effort to be friendly or sociable, so why do people end up liking me more? Hey, do you know why that might be, dear comrade?
What is it? Oh, you have work for me? Is that so... Fine, I'll take care of it.
Eh...? What are you trying to do? Are the puffy balls on my outfit that interesting?
Missions? Is there anything that looks interesting?
Mission rewards, huh... Lemme take a look. So...? Is there any food?
I brought the mail. You don't have to thank me for it or anything.
Welcome back. ...Tea? Nah, I have vodka though.
Dear comrade, did you forget about the commissions? Are you dumb? Even I remembered.
It's my turn to fight? ...Is that so? Fine, I'll do it.
Let's beat them to a pulp! Ура!
Ура! Did you witness my true power!
Curses! Tashkent can still fight!
I'll have you witness my true power!
I won't concede defeat!
Stay away from me, moron.
Do you need me for anything, dear comrade? I'm busy, so make it quick... Oh, is that so...? You just wanted to play? Well, I suppose I have some time to burn, so...

With a nickname like "the Blue Cruiser," you'd expect me to be someone who's cute and well-behaved right? People are always disillusioned as all hell after meeting me... and, well, I can't blame them. What do you think, dear comrade?
I'm just a normal girl. I don't want special treatment or anything. The same goes for you, dear comrade, I'm sure of it...

I don't really know anyone here, but everyone seems to genuinely like me. That's even after knowing what kind of person I am, so I want to be better. Of course I feel the same way about you, dear comrade. After all, I like you!
So, this was the important thing you were telling me about? ...Sure, I'll take it. ...What, didn't I already tell you before that I like you? So, nothing wrong with us getting married, right?
While it doesn't compare to the honor of receiving my guard's commission, I am happy to accept this.
Unlike you, I don't have anyone to enjoy Sardegnian cooking with...
When we get serious, nothing can keep us down!
...*Sigh*, I never thought I'd get captured by these little guys... Dear comrade, does Tashkent really have to play along with this?
...*Sigh*, I never thought I'd get captured by these little guys... Dear comrade, does Tashkent really have to play along with this?
Dear comrade, do you really think you can keep me bound like this? ...Is that so? Naive fool. Hehe~
Dear comrade, how long are you going to keep me like this? ...Is that so... Ehh? Forever?!
I knew there was something... wrong about that chocolate... I never thought this would happen to me... my head's still spinning...
When I was talking to Zara, she said I look more appealing in this outfit. So... what do you think, dear comrade?
I'm not like Avrora. I can't drink at all... Ah, wait, I'm not talking about vodka!
Wait, I'm not okay with this role reversal! I should be the one touching you, dear comrade!
Welcome back. We're all throwing a big party tonight. ...I'm not lying! I'm going to invite everyone from the Northern Parliament over!
You can't lift the mission rewards? ...Is that so? What a wimp. Here, I'll do it for you. I can leave it over here, right?
Heheh, not a bad display of power, right?
Urrk... Who dares disturb Tashkent's slumber? ...Oh, it's you, dear comrade? Um, in that case... I can always get more rest later. Is something the matter?
Urrk... Who dares disturb Tashkent's slumber? ...Oh, it's you, dear comrade? Um, in that case... I can always get more rest later. Is something the matter?
I'm still a bit sleepy, but if you insist on playing with me, dear comrade... perhaps I can spare some time for you.
I look really "dangerous" right now? What's so dangerous about me...? I think... you're the dangerous one, dear comrade.
Dear comrade, do you like stuffed animals too? ...Um, here. You can have this bear.
Why do so many people want to play with me? I just want to stay indoors and slack...
Button up...? ...Tell you what, dear comrade. How about you come here and help me?
You're messing my clothes up even more...
Zara's crew brought me some snacks from Sardegna. Would you like some, dear comrade?
Zzz... So tired...
Mmph. There you are, dear comrade. I've been waiting... Oh, yeah. I'm not done yet, so... do you wanna relax with me for a bit before you go?
Mmph. There you are, dear comrade. I've been waiting... Oh, yeah. I'm not done yet, so... do you wanna relax with me for a bit before you go?
Mmph. Welcome back, dear comrade. Come sit next to me~ What do you think of me today, I wonder? ...Oh, really?♪
How do you see me right now, dear comrade? I'm curious. Very curious... Mhm.
Dear comrade, you've been staring. You must really like this look. ...It's refreshing because of how unlike me it is? Well, well. Should I be more unlike my usual self...?
My face is hot... Dear comrade, you're a little too close... No, too close is just fine...
Dear comrade, want to lie your head in my lap? I could even clean your ears for you as a bonus. Heheh, I've kept up with my studies. Don't think I'll take no for an answer, dear comrade.
Hm? You wanna lie down? Next to me?
Oh, yeah. You do love doing this, dear comrade...
