Dear comrade... Even if you get a little lightheaded like me... Mmph. You gotta do those missions~
Your mission rewards are here? Mmh, I wonder if they gave you anything that can clear my head...
Good work, dear comrade. Here... A relaxing hug.
This getup just doesn't work with me...
Mmph. Where should we continue, dear comrade? Continue what? Our time alone together, obviously. I love you, dear comrade, so... isn't it normal for me to try and be alone with you?
Bogatyr-class protected cruiser - Pamiat Merkuria.

I'm Pamiat Merkuria, protected cruiser. I was a bigshot in the Black Sea Fleet during the great war, beating up baddies left and right, and I even fought alongside Avrora in a world war! I'm charismatic, experienced, and cute - all the things YOU aren't!
Yoohoo, Commander! I'm *the* Pamiat Merkuria, light cruiser from the Northern Parliament! Nice meeting you! Do your thing and work your butt off for me♪
Yoohoo, Commander! What task are we starting today with?
Believe it or not, but I'm from the same era as Avrora and Mikasa! So, you know what you oughta do as the commander here, don'tcha?
Avrora, could you go buy me a new game? Hmm, fine... Then how about the Commander instead? What do you say to that, Commander~?
Secretary work, eh... Like, I'm happy to work hard for you and all, but wouldn't it make you even happier to work hard for me?
It's embarrassing how I'm staring at you constantly? Well, I don't feel embarrassed, so who cares~ Hahah!
What are you doing? Didn't Mikasa teach you to respect girls with rich histories?
Ah, "getting personal," are we? Hehehe~ Where do you wanna touch me, huh~?
You really like 'em... *big*, huh? You creep♡
You've got missions. Get 'em done. Me? I've got my hands full with this game.
Mission complete! Haha! I did my share of work, so I'm gonna claim my reward!
I'm on letter-giving duty today. You'd *better* appreciate my work♪
You're back, huh? Then get me something to eat, now! I want some of that "ramen" the Sakura Empire's got!
A commission's been completed! Now gimme your thanks for notifying you!
I have design limitations, so don't work me like an ox, alright?
I'm ready to ram! Let's gooooo!
Loooosers! Are you that much weaker than me? Or am I just really strong?
Сожаление... And here I thought this fleet was stronger than this...
Let's smack 'em down!
Oww... Show some dang decency!
Scumbag...
This isn't a naval cabin, so why is my room so plain? If I'm to actually live here, you'll need to get some much better interior decor!
*yaaawn*... What's this? Bedsheets and a soft pillow? Wow, how thoughtful of you! Now I can get myself a good nap! Right then... *yawn*... Zzz...
I toss like crazy in my sleep?! Wh-wh-what're you saying?! Were you watching the whole time?! Oh geez, now I'll never be able to get hitched... Now it's your responsibility, Commander♪
Sadly for you, I don't belong to anyone, so you don't get to have me♪ But, if you really, *really* insist, theeen... Hehehe, you get what I'm trying to say, don'tcha?
Hahaha♪ You're giving me a ring, just like that? Just how thirsty are you, Commander? Next time, think it through first. Whatevs, I'm not gonna make you regret your choice♡
Woohoo! This is really in style right now! ...O-of course I knew that!
What do you mean "nothing's changed"? Hmph!

ex.line: So, what are we starting the day with, darling? ♪
You wanna know more about the war I fought so hard in, darling? Heheh! Maybe I should brief you then~ Not that I have to, someone else can tell you of my exploits.
Secretary work, huh... I'll do it if you can beat me at a game. Although you have any chance of winning anyway♪
Mh...! I think I just strained my back... N-no, I didn't say anything!
You love it when they're big, don'tcha? And I love you

I may look young, but I've got a rich history and a vast repertoire of knowledge, which is how I know your mind like the back of my hand, darling♪ "Wisdom really comes with age"... We're not touching that topic! Ever! That has nothing to do with it, stupid!

lines.line: What kinda exercise is this?! Nobody said I'd become a dang showpiece! Come on, get this thing off me, *now*!
What kinda exercise is this?! Nobody said I'd become a dang showpiece! Come on, get this thing off me, NOW!
Ughh... Why am I here, just to suffer...?
Umm... Is it just me, or are these mockup cell bars way too strong? Dangit, I just hope Gangut comes and rescues me soon...
I have a big backlog of games to play... I'd really like to go home and work on it! Please? Please!
Something smells gooood... So what if I had snacks merely 30 minutes ago? I have a needy stomach!
Grrr... I'm on my last dang legs here... Grrrr...
Urgh...! Don't go touching wherever you want just 'cause I can't move...!
Eep! Wh-whaddya think you're doing?!
You have new missions! Do them, quick! Trade the rewards for food to fill my stomach!
You've got mail. See, I can do work even with just my torpedo boats!
Commander, I know I did wrong, and I'm sorry, so come on... Give me some of that fooood...!
Mmmh~ I sure could get used to this life~ Oh, Commander, thanks for being my gofer~♪ Ah, you can leave the cherries right over here!
Mmmh~ I sure could get used to this life~ Oh, Commander, thanks for being my gofer~♪ Ah, you can leave the cherries right over here!
I don't ever wanna get up from this Manjuu cushion~ Sitting's bad for your health? Well, good thing I have you around to take care of your elderly~♪
Zzz... Fried rice... Garlicky goodness... Hot dogs... Fries... More please... Zzz...
*Rero rero rero rero*... Mmmh! Sour, sweet, and totally delish! Got any more?
Whoa, I got a rare drop! Maybe having you in the room raises my luck stat! Hahaha♡
You want a cherry too, Commander~? Too bad, I'm not gonna share~
What do you think you're doing? Gee, what a perv~♡
A letter came in earlier. "Where'd I put it"? Hmm, good question...
Oh, you're back. Avrora dropped by and gave me a snack. Want a bite~?
You thought an old ship couldn't whoop your asses? Loooosers~♪
My ramen noodles have gotten all soggy! Ugh!
Aaand send DM to Rossiya... Finally you showed up, Commander! So, where are you taking me, hmm?
Aaand send DM to Rossiya... Finally you showed up, Commander! So, where are you taking me, hmm?
Lemme just reply with a manjuu sticker~ Don't wanna be that girl who leaves someone on read! Hahaha~
Oh, didn't think you'd notice the tail! It's a gift from Murmansk♪ Looks cute on me, doesn't it?
You really can't carry anymore? You seriously need to start working out! Oh, and don't try to make me carry this stuff!
This manjuu plushie? It's a present for Snezhok. You know, Stremitelny! She's a sucker for stuffed animals~
What, do you wanna know who I'm texting~?
A little bit of cleavage gotten you all worked up? You creep♥
Happy Valentine's Day~♪ Did you come here to enjoy my chocolate? Then, try guessing where I hid my chocolate - if you get it right, I'll give it to you~♪ Is it here... or maybe over here? Ahahaha~♡
Happy Valentine's Day~♪ Did you come here to enjoy my chocolate? Then, try guessing where I hid my chocolate - if you get it right, I'll give it to you~♪ Is it here... or maybe over here? Ahahaha~♡
Yoohoo, Commander~ Have you gotten your Valentine's chocolate? Oh, I was the first? Sweet♪
Eating sweets makes you sleepy, doesn't it? Come here and we'll cuddle together! ...What, you still wanna eat more?
A quiz? I'm bored, so why not♪ ...You have to promise you'll give me the right answers!
I did NOT strain my back while making chocolate! This is just my come-hither pose!
Eep! Oh... The fountain got chocolate fondue over me... Heehee♪ Commander, come here and clean it off~
Open wide, Commander♪ Say "ahh"!
You've got missions! Meanwhile, MY mission is to relax from all that chocolate-making~
Your mail? Where did I put it again...
Stretchy stretch... *yawn*... I'm getting sleepy... Commander, fetch me a soda, will ya~
A commission's been completed! I'll hold on to your chocolate if you want.
Owwwie... Shouldn't have put all my effort into my chocolate...
Over here! So, Commander, which outfit do you think looks cuter - the left or the right one? Heehee - you better choose carefully, 'cause I'm gonna wear it!
Over here! So, Commander, which outfit do you think looks cuter - the left or the right one? Heehee - you better choose carefully, 'cause I'm gonna wear it!
Yoohoo, Commander! Finally, you're here. You're gonna help me get ready for our next outing, so perk up!
Check it out! The white one's pure and adorable, but the black one's alluring too... Hm? Commander, that look in your eyes... Don't tell me you were imagining me wearing these, weren't you?
This outfit you picked, it's... uhh, not exactly my number one favorite, but since you chose it, I'll wear it anyway♪
Hey, Commander, what should you pack when going to the beach? For starters, sunscreen, a beach parasol... Oh, and little old me, the most important thing of all!
Heheh. I've actually got another, more revealing outfit around here! If you really, really wanna see it, I'll give you a little preview♡
This is no time to mess around!
Oh, you're gonna help adjust my fit? Thanks!
Eek?! H-hey, I'm still trying these on... Clearly, you just can't resist my charm♡
Ugh. Forget about your missions and help me decide on an outfit!
Mission complete! Your rewards or whatever can wait - for now, could you bring me some more clothes?
A letter? But you have more important things to do now, like keeping your eyes on me♡
Whew... You're back, Commander. Didn't think trying on clothes could be this tiring. Get me some juice in a bit so I can get my energy back! This is your obligation - got it?
Commander, I think a commission just got done! Not that it matters, because you're supposed to be helping me pick out clothes!

To be honest with you, I've already tried almost everything in this place. I just wanna know which one you'd choose for me! 'Cause, you know, we're going to the beach, and I wanna wear the outfit you like best! Shhh, don't tell anyone that - it's our little secret♡
My retrofitting is done! Look forward to seeing how both my cuteness and combat potential has been upgraded!
My retrofitting is done! Look forward to seeing how both my cuteness and combat potential have been upgraded!
Yoohoo~♪ Remember to keep your nose to the grindstone for adorable old me~
Now with my modernization upgrades, I can give other ships a run for their money! Don'tcha think I deserve a lot more respect for all my potential, experience, and charm~?
Oof, my shoulders feel so stiff~! Let me just give my arms a good stretch and shake my butt to get my circulation going~ Oh~? What're you eyeing me for~?
Listen, darling, I could really go for some Dragon Empery-style fried rice! Yeah, you guessed right— go buy me some takeout~♪
I keep it fairly tight, if you know what I mean~
Cannons locked and loaded! Fireee!
You thought an old ship couldn't whoop your asses? Loooosers~♪
Owww, my back... That proves it, I'm not fit for these exhausting battles!
Kirov-Class cruiser—Kirov

Salutations, Comrade Commander. I am Kirov. My appearance, rigging, and class are all unimportant in the greater scheme of our ambitions. What matters is that we work together to achieve a future of red glory.
I am the child of a union between our unprecedented country and a free spirit! Now, Comrade Commander, let us achieve great things together!
Good to see you again, Comrade Commander! Let us once more set out to teach our enemy the meaning of unity and solidarity.
Neither fate nor evil can hamper our ambitions!
The strong must always march onward. Holding the line is what the weak do.
Glory is what sustains and strengthens us, and is what will leave our mark on history.
I march onward in the name of a tomorrow where everyone is safe and smiling.
Lead the way, Comrade Commander.
This is no time for this sort of depravity, Comrade Commander.
It is time to embark on a mission, Comrade Commander.
I knew you would pull through for us, Comrade Commander! Here are the rewards.
You have mail. Read it through at once. The more comrades, the better. Always.
Well fought, Comrade Commander! Your valor warrants the front page spot in the port's newspaper!
A commission has been completed. We must head out and greet the returnees. Our comrades deserve recognition for their efforts.
This strength will further our cause!
To arms, comrades!
Our advance will stop for nothing and nobody!
Gah...! I cannot and will not succumb until our ambitions have been realized!
Hear me! I am Kirov!
No! I am far, far from finished!
It pains me to say, but I no longer consider you my comrade.
Never let but's or if's misguide you, Comrade Commander. You alone decide what is right and true.
Splendid, Comrade Commander. You've chosen a path of your own. Now follow it and see where it takes you!
I will always watch over you. Should you ever lose your way, I will be the hand that shoves you back on the right path. Only look ahead, never stop advancing!

To fight not just for your motherland but also for your soulmate, that is what love is... I understand it now. Passion is the fuel of my fighting spirit. And as long as I have you, nothing is impossible!

Only a fool chooses between protecting either the world or their lover. There is but one correct answer: protecting them both. We have both the will and the means to do just that. Come, Comrade Commander, let us march onwards!
Oho! Thank you, Comrade Commander.
Onwards, Northern Parliament comrades!
I have your back,Tallinn!
You may be bourgeois swine... but today, we fight together!

ex.line: What's on the itinerary today? If there's anything that requires me to uplift the spirits of our comrades, I'm all in!
...Having that said, it isn't inconceivable that war devolves into attrition. In such cases, we must be able to adapt to changes...
Let me tell you this— never underestimate the eyes and ears of the Northern Parliament!
Hmm... I would like you to be a bit more mindful of the rules.
One's individual leadership abilities are hardly as important as the will to stand side-by-side with one's comrades. In this regard, you have excelled without a doubt.

lines.line: Comrade Commander, you've come at a good time. I've recently taken a liking to this blend of coffee. Want some as well? No need to be shy.
Comrade Commander, you've come at a good time. I've recently taken a liking to this blend of coffee. Want some as well? No need to be shy.
Don't be nervous. Make yourself at home and relax.
We relax only so we can march even further. Do not get too comfortable now, Comrade Commander.
Hmm, I should find a way to improve my special blend somehow...
Drinking coffee in tandem with listening to music is the most effective way to combat drowsiness. Let us start with a song that kindles your fighting spirit!
The weather is splendid today. Perfect for some outdoor exercise. ...Change my outfit? All I need put on is a pair of shoes.
You want to talk about coffee? I know countless facts and trivia about it. Go on, ask me something.
Use your energy for more productive things, Comrade Commander.
Here, taste my signature blend of coffee. It has a dash of vodka to keep you on your toes.
Halt! You have nowhere left to run!! ...Well done, Comrade Commander, what a thrilling chase we had on our hands! What, you think I'm well-suited for this job? You tease too much, bahaha!
Halt! You have nowhere left to run!! ...Well done, Comrade Commander, what a thrilling chase we had on our hands! What, you think I'm well-suited for this job? You tease too much, bahaha!
Bystreye! Yet more enemies of the Revolution lurk in the shadows!
How should I punish these naughty fellas... What, I'm just having them help me out a little. How 'bout coming by to get some exercise as well, Commander?
Wanna take this thing out for a spin, Comrade Commander? Oh, but not right now though. Gotta make some special adjustments first before you can ride it.
Tallinn, Kirov reporting. I'll be there shortly. Now, Comrade Commander, come with us.
Did Kronshtadt flank our mark already? She sure loves doing the flashy stuff...
Come on, hold on tight! We're about to blow this joint!
Comrade Commander, a new mission has arrived. I'll let you decide when to start.
Comrade Commander, you've done well in leading our efforts. Our streets are much safer as a result.
Drop your weapons!
Keep your eyes on the greater goal! Do not let our comrades' sacrifices blind you with rage!
...Hmph! Just short of a new personal best, huh? But make no mistake, Comrade Commander. Keep watching me and your patience WILL be rewarded with a breathtaking record!
...Hmph! Just short of a new personal best, huh? But make no mistake, Comrade Commander. Keep watching me and your patience WILL be rewarded with a breathtaking record!
Are you ready to challenge yourself, Comrade Commander? Then watch my maneuvers closely!
Alright, all appears in order. Comrade Commander, give me the order - then watch as I push the boundary of what is humanly possible!
Never overestimate your physical ability. That is a skill - one that has been built on the learnings of countless people over centuries.
Why not try this yourself, Allen? Same for you there - yes, the Sakura Empire girl. I'll reposition the bar for you so don't be scared.
This feat is the product of routine practice. You can do it too if you set your mind to it, Comrade Commander... You think it's impossible? Don't give up before you even try!
Hah! Be awed at the sight of my athletic skill!
Look out! ...Phew. Be careful - a collision from this height seriously hurts.
I can hardly believe my new record made it next to your victory in the port newspaper... Actually, that is something of an affront to you...
Chapayev-class cruiser - Chapayev.

I am the name ship of Project 68-K, also known as the Chapayev-class. I was meant to participate in the war, but due to a series of delays, I was not completed in time. I didn't really do anything. Too bad. Hehehe.
So you're the Commander? Hehe, I like what I see... Ah, excuse me. I'm Chapayev, a light cruiser from the Northern Parliament. Let's get along~
Welcome, Commander. So this is your office...? Aha, of course, it's OUR office, isn't it?
Commander, let's chat a bit? It's important that we get to know each other... don't you think?
Are you jealous of my little friend here, Commander...? Oh, you're not? Hmm.
I'm actually very strong... Or at least, I was designed to be. I guess I would need you to check and make sure I actually turned out that way, Commander.
If you're worried those you trust will betray you, you just have to keep them close. Either rope or chains will do the trick... right?
You want to feel? Ah, not this little guy. I mean me. Hehehe.
Hehehe... Commander, naughty naughty~
All these unfinished tasks... Wouldn't it be better if I helped you take care of them?
Wow, you completed that mission all by yourself! Hehe, were you hoping I'd give you a reward?
I sorted the mail for you. Don't forget to look it over.
What do you think of my food? Is this the kind of thing you like to eat?
Commander, the girls you sent out on commission are back. Are you ready?
Keep strengthening my equipment. I know you can do it.
I can handle these girls just fine! Hiyah!
Hah... that seems about right.
Hah... I can do better.
Scorched earth!
Gah... was I unprepared...?
You may need some stricter training. Hm. Worrying...
Commander, did you have something to talk about? Or are you just here for a little chat? With this fleet, we could go on and on. Hehehe.

Fraternizing with subordinates...? Yes, these among comrades who put our lives in each other's hands, trust is the most important thing. I hope you trust in me, Commander, the same way I trust in you.
A pet? I wonder... I've never had one before. The one I love and cherish is always right here with me, after all. Say, Commander... Do you need more affection?
Oh my... that looks serious. You really do need someone you love and cherish by your side... Commander, let me be here for you. I'll take care of all your worries for you.

To get such a ring... such a beautiful gift, it's wonderful. So let me give you this bridle in return... Hehe, it fits perfectly. Now it's like we're always connected, wherever we might be... Don't you love it?
This is such a sweet gift. That's my good Commander~

ex.line: Welcome, Commander. Time for another day of hard work. By the way... Have you been wearing your bridle like we talked about?
Commander, are you hungry? Well, you'll just have to wait. Once I say 'okay,' then you can eat.
Commander, what's wrong? I'm here, and I'm not going anywhere.
It's a big responsibility to have someone trust you so much. But don't worry, I'm holding your reins tightly.
Just let me know when you'd like to talk to another girl. You'd be very embarrassed to be seen like this, hm? Hehe, I think it's fine if somebody sees, actually.
Hehe, I think I want to touch you too, Commander.
Hehe, I'll join you in a minute, okay?
You did so well on that sortie... Now you just let me take care of everything.
Полный ход!
Hehehe, I'm happy if you are.

Still feeling a little uneasy? Just wait a bit longer. You need to stay bound to me like this for now, but sooner or later you won't have to think anymore, you won't have to worry, and you can forget all that pain.

lines.line: Commander, what's going on? Did I... do something wrong...? This was all just... meant to be an exercise, right?
Commander, what's going on? Did I... do something wrong...? This was all just... meant to be an exercise, right?
*Pant*... *pant*... Commander, what should we start with today?
I could leave whenever I want, so why do I stay... Commander? N- nothing, it's nothing...
You know, this room might rub some people the wrong way...
Commander, are you okay? Please answer me if you're okay. You can't keep me waiting...
If I'm here too long, you know Tashkent will start to worry...
I- I have to keep this around my neck?
Hyah?! Commander, that's not what I meant...!
There's an unfinished mission. I have all the details here.
Mission complete. What should we do now...?
Mail's here... I think you should read it...
I really wish there was a kitchen in here. Are you going to feed me, Commander...?
The commission girls just got back. You have to get out there and bring them in...
I have to try harder, right?
I fight with all my heart!
I guess I can relax a little...
Commander, I'm sorry...
I think you need some training in this area, Commander...
I get that you wanted to be alone with me, and that's fine, but I just think we're missing something... If only we could... hold each other's hands tightly or... Ahhn?! D- don't pull on that!
Phew... Oh my, Commander, I'm sorry I didn't welcome you at the door. You don't have to be so tense - I already know not to try doing anything weird with you. Hehe~
Phew... Oh my, Commander, I'm sorry I didn't welcome you at the door. You don't have to be so tense - I already know not to try doing anything weird with you. Hehe~
Welcome, Commander. Working today, like always? Well, keep at it.
Mmmgh~ You ought to stretch a little, Commander. Sitting down all the time leads to back and shoulder problems, and all other sorts of bad things.
This book? I picked it up on Belorussiya's recommendation. It might be a bit too hard for you, though. ...Unlikely, you say? Read me a few pages, then.
There we go... This lotion is sticky, but it's good for the skin. You should get into the habit of using skincare products too, Commander.
Do you want me to oil you up?
Heehee, I might have used too much lotion.
You must be tired. How about a sweet refreshment to clear away the fatigue? Here you are, sweetheart. Just don't have too much, now.
I'll disrupt the enemy line!
You've been looking for me? Heehee, sorry if I made you worry, I just had to feel the night breeze in my hair for a bit. Why don't you stay and enjoy it with me?
You've been looking for me? Heehee, sorry if I made you worry, I just had to feel the night breeze in my hair for a bit. Why don't you stay and enjoy it with me?
Ooh, this water is nice and cold... Heehee. Perfect for cooling off in.
I hope Soyuz will pay this place a visit someday. Lord knows she deserves a good refresher.
This yukata feels lovely on my skin. It's like I'm dressed tip to toe in silk.
Doesn't vacationing make you feel like the leash has come off? ...You don't get the analogy? Hmm, well, fair enough...
We can hold hands if you're scared of getting separated. Unless... you'd rather be led along by a pair of reins?
Heehee. Doesn't that feel nice?
Hey, great job on that mission. Heehee, how does a hot bath sound for a reward?
Why don't we go watch how artisans dye clothes blue?
I suppose this is one way to de-stress.

You've no reason to worry. The bond between us is so strong that no matter which of us pulls the reins, our feelings are clear to us both. Like this - if I just pull your hand towards me... you can hear the beating of my heart, no?

Why are you here... Oh, that was rude of me to ask. Maybe you just wanted a change of scenery, or you were drawn by the music. Or maybe my feelings have reached you... I think I like the sound of that one the most. Hehehe.

Why are you here... Oh, that was rude of me to ask. Maybe you just wanted a change of scenery, or you were drawn by the music. Or maybe my feelings have reached you... I think I like the sound of that one the most. Hehehe.
Commander, what do you want to do? Would you like to hear a song? Or practice dancing with me, maybe? Don't hold back; just say the word.
Conductors are people who must hold the reins of the performers. What of you, Commander? Will you accompany our movement until the end?
Do you know what song was just playing at the party? Hahaha, you're very knowledgeable, Commander. Then... What was I just playing?
I'm amazed that Kuybyshev learned such a complex piece... That would be one of her strengths, I suppose.
Relax as much as you want. See? I'm relaxing here, too. No confining others, or letting them confine you, until the party's over.
Would you like to play, too?
What exactly are you asking me to play with? This, or...?
You have a letter. Make sure you check it later, okay?
I thought you'd be coming soon. What do you think happens next...? Hahaha, not like that. I'm asking if you'd like to go back to the party, or if you'd like to rest here for a moment.
Kursk? ...Oh, so the commission team has returned. Come and enjoy the party for a while, would you?
For an improv performance, I think I did pretty well!♪
Gangut-class battleship - Gangut.

I am Gangut, a dreadnought from the Northern Parliament. My equipment may be outdated, but don't underestimate me. Both humans and ships are alike in their quest for greater power, to protect what they otherwise would not be able to. That is революция, the revolution I strive for! From the Bering Sea to Leningrad, only by rising up in the face of humiliation was I able to become a beacon for the light of glory!
Hahaha! Not bad, comrade! Come, let us fight for the safety of these azure lanes! Fight until your last breath!
Comrade, what sort of strong enemy will we face today? I, Gangut, shall stand with you!

Know this, comrade. Even if I am battered and bruised, muddied by defeat, I will rise each time to reclaim the glory of mankind! Yes, that is the революция I desire, the only heaven that exists for me!
Comrade, how about a few drinks? ...What? Don't tell me you can't even handle a swig of vodka!
O comrade, aren't those stories about the exploits of sailors absolutely riveting? You see, that is the very spirit of revolution, humanity in all its glory!
An easy victory? What a stupid thing to say, comrade! How are you supposed to draw out your full power if you have nothing worthwhile to fight? Send me to a more dangerous battle next time!
What about my rigging? Isn't fully utilizing everything at your disposal a wonderful and pragmatic ideal? Why would I consign myself to weakness for the sake of showmanship?
What are you doing, comrade? Are you not aware of how we handle lawbreakers in the Northern Parliament?
Missions exist for the sake of preserving the order. We should complete them as soon as possible.
Excellently done! This reward will help pave the next step of our revolution!
You have a letter, comrade. It would be best to open it soon.
O comrade, do you return bearing news of glorious victory? Ah, but it matters not, for the thing that matters most is that you fought with all your strength!
Hopefully our comrades will return bearing good news, unlike that bitter Ice Cruise. Come on, let's go welcome them back.
Comrades! You are also strong! Let our souls shine out brilliantly!
Show me your mettle!!
Rejoice, for we have earned this privilege! May this celebration become the bread that sustains us until our next victory!
Comrade, consider this not a defeat, but rather a warning. A sign that we are losing sight of our revolutionary spirit.
The revolution blesses you!
Ahahahaha! At last, this is a battlefield that I am meant for!
There is no future for those who mistake recklessness with courage, comrade.
I am Battleship Gangut, also known as Oktyabrskaya Revolyutsiya. However, my name is less important the what I've achieved. Don't dwell too much on it and just call me what you want.
I hope you don't take this the wrong way, comrade, but this fight is not just for all of us. It's also yours. Never settle with the status quo, and always seek to keep improving.

Ahahahaha! Well done, comrade! No matter how strong the enemies we may face, we now join each other courageously, prepared to give everything in pursuit of greater challenges! What could be more revolutionary than that?
Let's get to the point! Comrade, I was struck by your brilliance, and thus I fell for you! And now, I face the challenge of how to express my feelings for you! Here, comrade, accept my embrace!
A pledge, huh? While this act is symbolic in nature, it is also undeniable proof of the bonds we've formed. A toast, comrade. Please continue to guide me in the future.
Hahahaha! Are you testing me? Very well! Then I will just have to give YOU a gift of equal value! Just you wait, Comrade!
Ahahaha! Finally, I have the privilege of fighting by your side, Mikasa!
For the light of revolution!

ex.line: Comrade~ have a bit more to drink~ That Marat can't keep up with me~ C'mon, keep me company until dawn.
No strong enemies around? I feel your frustration, comrade... Well then, come at me. Let's make life worth living!
I see, I see, so you want to fully grasp the extent of my rigging. Very well! I have no objections, for your courage is commendable as well!
You are forgiven, comrade! Such courage deserves to be rewarded! Come, put your hands all over me until you've had your fill!

lines.line: You have my thanks for this exercise, comrade! I shall gladly carry out the important duty of judge, jury, and rehabilitator!
You have my thanks for this exercise, comrade! I shall gladly carry out the important duty of judge, jury, and rehabilitator!
Commander, did you come to inspect the exercise? Hahaha! Feel free to ask away!
Comrade, it is too soon to confess to your sins! Struggle for your freedom, and resist until you are about to break! That is the true path to growth!
This outfit resembles something that you'd wear in the Eagle Union or Iron Blood, right? If I chose something more imposing, I'd scare off the kids!
This is Gangut... Everything's fine over here, so stay on patrol.
Care for a drink, comrade? Come on, it's good stuff. I just happen to have a little bit of free time.
Are you curious about this medal? You can make as many replicas as you'd like!
Having trouble with your missions? If you need to conduct an investigation, I'll help you out.
...Bwahaah! I've had all kinds of liquor, but nothing beats the stuff back home! Comrade, let's have a toast to the coming off-duty days!
...Bwahaah! I've had all kinds of liquor, but nothing beats the stuff back home! Comrade, let's have a toast to the coming off-duty days!
I take it you've come to share a drink with me, comrade? Ahahaha! What a coincidence, I just received this bottle of vodka from Avrora. Two shots, coming right up!
Have you read the article in this magazine, comrade? It's a great piece on how the working class is the reason for our ever-improving quality of life.
Comrade, you must always be ready to fight, even in times of peace. If you get complacent with the status quo, then who else will stand up in the event of a crisis?
The Sakura Empire is home to a few drinkers too, I've learned. Ise and Hyuuga, I think their names were? I'll invite them over the next time I'm enjoying some liquor!
Ugh! I've had enough of this! Get up, comrade! We'll round up some more comrades and go for some target practice!
Drink, comrade! Have another shot! You'll have to do much better than that to get me plastered!
You're drunk out of your mind, aren't you, comrade? No worries, you may use the couch! Go on, lie down!
My room is a total mess, you say? I suppose it is, yes. If I am to clean it, the question becomes, where do I start? The bottles? The magazines?
Sovetsky Soyuz-class battleship - Sovetsky Soyuz.

I am the first ship of Project 23, Sovetsky Soyuz. Like my sisters, I was a centerpiece of the Northern Parliament's naval strategy. Now my strength is all yours to wield, Comrade Commander. Your decisions have my support, as always, because I have full confidence in your ability.

I am Sovetsky Soyuz, flagbearer of the Northern Parliament's will. I hope extending a simple greeting doesn't make you too anxious, Comrade Commander. Let us henceforth work together and fight side by side.
I take it you're ready, Comrade Commander. It's time to get started on today's tasks.

Why I'm fond of Arctic hares, you ask? Don't you think they look adorable when they stand up, Comrade Commander? ...You really don't see it? Their bodies are so round, yet their little arms and legs get so long when they stretch! Isn't the contrast just so shockingly cute?

Planning and efficiency. The two things you need to make it in the world... No, I believe they are important, but I wouldn't go as far as saying that they are everything. Rest assured, there is more to life.
You feel I'm more like a reliable colleague than a serious manager? No one else has described me like that before. Most of my comrades view me as one of the latter.

Not much to talk about outside of work and combat, you say? Yes, there aren't very many situations where I can offer input. All the more reason why I should focus on listening to what others say rather than speak myself.
Rossiya, Belorussiya... Or should I say, my sisters. They're doing so well. One day, they will surely surpass me.
Well... This is unexpected, coming from you. Still, I'll allow it. This contact is a morale booster for your troops, after all.
Yes? Do you have a new production adjustment proposal?
Comrade Commander, if you want to deepen our relationship... it will take a toll on your spirit, and especially your body.
Here is the mission list... Let's focus on efficiency. I'll handle the logistics while you concentrate on the missions themselves.
Mission rewards have arrived. They have been reviewed already.
This letter is for you, Comrade Commander. Here, use this letter opener.
You're back, Comrade Commander. I put new wood in the fireplace. It should dispel the chills you're feeling from the weather out there.
The commission team has returned. You should go speak to them, Comrade Commander. I... Seeing me may stress them out, so I'll stay here.
Thank you, Comrade Commander. This concludes my maintenance.
Onward. No turning back.
Great. This is going just as expected.
How unfortunate. Our plans will need to be revised.
United as one!
Where did my plan go awry?
It seems I have no choice but to show you my strictest side, Comrade Commander.
...A solemn ruler, or a curt decision-maker? What I want to be is a listener, a person whom others confide in. Changing people's views of me in that direction is quite difficult, however.

I won't become closer with people merely by listening to them. I know that, but I'm terrible when it comes to talking about personal matters. Comrade Commander, please, give me a hand. You have the tools to help develop my interpersonal skills.

The relationship with you I seek is something deeper than an acquaintanceship or alliance... but I feel like it's selfish of me to want it. Why is that? Because becoming friends with me carries much, much more weight than you think.

We've reached the point where I can call you a close friend, Comrade Commander. I'd like to take our relationship even further, though... Don't be so surprised. Knowing you, I'm sure you understand what I mean.

At last, this time has come. I know I specifically asked to deepen our relationship, but... to be frank, I always feared I wasn't returning your feelings properly. I've felt this the whole time, but now, there is no longer any doubt in my heart, heehee. Yes, this is the future I wished and hoped for. From this day onward, we walk together.
This is very thoughtful. How could I say no?
Onwards we march, together.

ex.line: Mh... Looks like you're in good shape as well, Comrade Commander.
Our path is one towards a bright future. It doesn't matter how rugged or long the journey is, because the many sights we'll see along the way will become wonderful memories.
...You think I should smile when speaking to someone to not make them anxious? Not a bad idea... Like this, then?
I'd like to thank you once more, Comrade Commander. I've never felt better than I do when I'm by your side... Hm? You liked my smile just now? I... see...
I make endearing faces when I look at Arctic hares? You really think so? Oh, dear...
You like doing it here, do you? Mmh... I don't mind it at all. Heehee.
Good, you're back, Comrade Commander. Now let's have a break. A healthy body leads to improved productivity.
The commission team has returned. Let's go bid them welcome back, shall we? I'll... try, for their sake.
Follow the plan and seize victory!
Oh, dear... Looking back at it, "deepen our relationship" was an outrageous thing to say. Then you said all those things and even threw a wedding... Thinking about it now... it makes my cheeks warm.

lines.line: This is Agent Sovetsky Soyuz, codename Polyarnaya Zayats, commencing infiltration. I'd hate to spend long on breaking through the security, so please just surrender now. It's not too late.
This is Agent Sovetsky Soyuz, codename Polyarnaya Zayats, commencing infiltration. I'd hate to spend long on breaking through the security, so please just surrender now. It's not too late.
Perfect timing, Comrade Commander. Everything is prepped and ready. Give the order to sortie.
Did you think you could escape justice by hiding in a fortified skyscraper? You banked on a naive hope - which I'm now going to crush.

That was a pretty visually stunning take, wasn't it? ...Hm? You're worried your performance as my rival won't be that good? I understand. Once we're done filming, let's go find a place for you to rehearse.
Changing careers and trying a different life... It's more fun than I expected. I'd love to do this again if I ever get the chance.
My way in is... Rappel down from the roof, then break directly into the room with the objective. A plan full of highlights, it seems.
So you like roleplay, do you, Comrade Commander?
Excellent work. How's the stage-setting going? ...Oh, the camera was rolling. Please send that take to the cutting room floor.
Ah, yes, agents creating a family does sound like an interesting theme. Would you like to... give it a try, Comrade Commander?
This is very thoughtful. How could I say no?

Curses... To think I'd fall for such an elementary trap... I take it you're going to "interrogate" me now, Comrade Comander? Oh, no, it's just... if you don't know the proper technique, I could assist you.

Curses... To think I'd fall for such an elementary trap... I take it you're going to "interrogate" me now, Comrade Comander? Oh, no, it's just... if you don't know the proper technique, I could assist you.
Comrade Commander?! Ahem! How shameful of me to be caught... No, actually, this may very well be a blessing in disguise.

A little chat to start with? Yes, let's. Although I'm fine, I imagine it's hard for you to stay calm in this situation. Let's talk about how cute Arctic hares are when- Oh, save that topic for another time, you say?
There's no need to worry about me. My only issue... mmh... is that it's hard to see you in this position.
Any further delays will negatively impact the plan. Using force to extract information is an option at your disposal, Comrade Commander.
My outfit being as flexible as it is has backfired. I'm tied up in such a way that... I can't free myself with my own strength...
When viewed another way, this is a chance for us to share secrets and deepen our relationship... Ah, no, I didn't say anything.
Comrade Commander, that's my- Ah! No, I'm fine...
Ahh... Apologies, my body has gone numb, impairing my tactile sensitivity...
To ensure you can begin your mission as soon as possible, I'll- Mmh!
Mission rewards have arrived. One of our comrades will surely claim them for us.
There's a letter for you, Comrade Commander. You should be able to easily open it if you make adept use of these strings.
Mgh... Are you going to disable the trap already, Comrade Commander? You don't need to, as I can maintain this pose without trouble.
The commission team has returned on time. Find a suitable time to meet them to ensure the plan doesn't fall through.

Despite being in a pinch, I strangely feel as though I can be open with you, Comrade Commander. Come to think of it, I've never been in a situation where I'm entirely at someone else's mercy, unable to do anything... You're free to do with me as you please. I trust in your strength and our bond.
So here you are, Comrade Commander. You're usually so well-guarded, yet now you're all by yourself - something I can only describe as careless. I, Sovetsky Soyuz, shall take you on.
So here you are, Comrade Commander. You're usually so well-guarded, yet now you're all by yourself - something I can only describe as careless. I, Sovetsky Soyuz, shall take you on.
There is nowhere left to run, Comrade Commander. Now, as planned... I mean, as fate dictates, allow me to attack you one time.

While improvising is easy, playing the role of your assailant is hard. Oh, no, I don't mean that attacking you is hard, but rather that it's hard for someone like me to seize the initiative and... well...
Cease your futile resistance and give me the rest of your time - how does that sound? A good deal, wouldn't you think?
No matter how well one person prepares, the collective wisdom and efforts of the many will easily trump the few. You lose, Comrade Commander.
Hmm - you're approaching me? Instead of running away, you're coming right to me? Are you, too, perhaps actually well-versed in swordsmanship?
Even should you make a choice with many irrational aspects, I will still gladly accept it since it's your choice, Comrade Commander. Heehee - the same goes for this outfit.
Come at me whenever you're ready, Comrade Commander.
What you just did... was it due to my outfit?
You need only surrender and I'll take on your missions for the day... Is that not enough?
Mission rewards have arrived. We should examine them in just a bit.
There's a letter for you, Comrade Commander. This is an excellent chance to test the precision of my cuts.
Excellent work, Comrade Commander. The night is still young, and I will be making good use of your body until morning.
The commission team is back on time. I should... Actually, no, you're better suited to receive them than I am currently.

I can do whatever I like to you if I get you to surrender... Heehee. I'm sure you can imagine what a tempting proposition that is. Even so, you're still willing to cooperate - is that because you trust me? Or is it, perhaps, because deep in your heart, you want me to be dominant with you?
Sovestsky Soyuz-class battleship - Sovetskaya Belorussiya.

My sisters and I were devised as part of Project 23, but we never saw the light of day, much less fought in the war... But on the other hand, it would've been ludicrous to sail into battle equipped with second-rate armaments. Now though, I would be content with just getting to perform at full capacity under your command, Comrade.
Comrade, are you sure you're ready to have me under your command? Very well! Let us join hands and lay waste to our enemies — using my methods, of course!
Aha! I knew you'd be back right at this hour, Comrade! Rossiya doubted my intuition.
If excellency is what you seek from the Sovetsky Soyuz class, I am your best and only true option!
It's much more entertaining to lure your foes into a trap one at a time than to crush them all at once. Am I right?
Seems it's all quiet on the western front... Don't you have any palpitating news?
There is no greater pleasure than decimating your enemy with minimal losses. Wouldn't you agree?
Your little hand gestures have no effect on me.
Let me guess, you are simply poking me for your own amusement, and not because you need something done. Am I wrong?
You chose the most depraved of ways to prove you have guts, Comrade.
Comrade, sure we should not allow the glorious advance of our fleet to be delayed by such trifling missions.
Fantastic. With HQ's missions complete, we can finally continue with our own plan.
A letter? I welcome correspondence, assuming it is an enthralling read.
Do not be so lenient with the enemy next time, Comrade.
Interested in a bet, Comrade? Do you think the commission team has returned with bountiful rewards, or few at all?
We will curb the enemy with our superior firepower! Hahaha!
Crush the enemy! Break their spirits, then their bones!
This comes as no surprise. All I did was nudge those fools toward the annihilation they so desired.
Everyone makes mistakes, I suppose...
Cease your pointless struggling!
The battle is still under our control!
I don't care. You are absolutely nothing to me. Just stay out of my way.
How about a bet, Comrade? Do you think your job will only be accomplished thanks to my help, or regardless of it?

Oh, so you don't mind losing a bet if it means you get my help? I see. Well, regardless, it doesn't matter who wins a bet made on the spur of the moment. Now, what do you need assistance with, Comrade?

If you ever tire of managing the fleet and planning battles, I will take over for you. You can rest easy, knowing I will bring you good reports on the daily. Although, knowing your devotion to your job, I doubt you'd ever delegate it to get some rest.

You don't mince your words, do you? I will say I do prefer a forthright confession of love over beating around the bush. Standing at the top of the world, gazing at the horizon, with you by my side - I like the sound of that. Ahahaha!

You hope this ring will forever connect me with you, do you? Then I believe it will, because I believe in you. Only you are capable of standing at the top of the world together with me. Do not let me down, Comrade.
You've figured out my taste with perfect precision, Comrade Commander!
Dropped some screws? I'll gather them up for you!

ex.line: You've come, Comrade. As punctual as always.
That's checkmate. Hey hey, throwing in the towel already? What, you're making it seem like I'm bullying you or something~
The port sure is peaceful... just as it should be. Violence should have no place outside the battlefield.
Hey, hey... I didn't call you here to make you all hot and bothered.
All right. After we finish these missions, you should go back to pursuing your own ambitions.
Letters, huh? Let's take a look... Wouldn't want to miss out on anything juicy.
There is no harm in prolonging the suffering of our foes, but do not forget the reason why we are here, Comrade.
What, you wanna bet on whether or not our commission fleet is bringing back a big haul? Nah, no need for that. We pretty much know the outcome already.

lines.line: To pass the time by proactively reading, or by passively enjoying the company of others... Ah, good morning, Comrade, I've been expecting you. Hahaha!
To pass the time by proactively reading, or by passively enjoying the company of others... Ah, good morning, Comrade, I've been expecting you. Hahaha!
Take it easy. There are many ways to kill time. Just pick one which feels sound.
What's your favorite book, Comrade? I'm asking out of curiosity, and to have something to recommend to Soyuz and Rossiya.
Anyone's life can be enriched by having many diverse interests. Even I enjoy the odd girly hobby or two.
Oh please, don't toot your own horn, Comrade. I know several destroyers who read advanced literature too.
I need to get up and move around a bit. My joints start aching if I sit down for too long.
What, did my revealing outfit cause you a lapse of judgment?
I see you've all returned in one piece. Your reputation has further improved as a result.
There's no point in betting on a sure outcome! Onwards!

Haha! Did you not expect this to be our rendezvous spot? Oh please, even I wish to unwind in the sand sometimes. Since you're here, accepting my invitation, won't you keep me company to kill some time, Comrade?

Haha! Did you not expect this to be our rendezvous spot? Oh please, even I wish to unwind in the sand sometimes. Since you're here, accepting my invitation, won't you keep me company to kill some time, Comrade?
Your time of arrival is nearly precisely what I estimated, Comrade. The winds are fair, so let us feel the breeze.
The fact that my prominence is unrivaled remains true even in leisurely settings. Now, let this beach serve as a new stage for you and me.
This breeze really is lovely. Ah, I know - care to make a wager? If you're able to grab hold of this veil, I'll treat you to a reward, Comrade.
It's nice, just staring at the sea with you. It makes even me want to stay here forever.
Wouldn't you agree I look pretty sexy, Comrade? ...Haha! You can't fool me with those halfhearted words. I picked out this swimsuit carefully. Stare as much as you like.
Are you asking to be tied up in my veil?
Oh? You thought I'd lowered my guard? You were in over your head if you believed that.
I'll need to bind you with this veil and punish you for this, Comrade.
Finish your missions so we can stroll along the beach and enjoy the weather. I'm raring to feel the breeze.
See? Do as I told you, and even missions will become no more than a way to kill time. Now help yourself to the rewards.
Hm? A letter? I hope it's nothing that will ruin the moment...
Welcome back. Wish to spend your break time with me, do you? Hahaha! Then you should cherish this moment we have to ourselves.
The commission team has come back? I have a feeling that the spoils will far exceed your expectations. Hahaha!
It wasn't the sea breeze that loosened me up - my feelings for you did. I promise you, Comrade, that you will not forget this profession of love for the rest of your life.
Sovetsky Soyuz-class battleship - Sovetskaya Rossiya.

I am Sovetskaya Rossiya, of Project 23. I was part of a strategic plan during the war, but for several reasons never came to be. I see though that I can prove my value here in this fleet with a series of decisive victories.

I am called "Sovetskaya Rossiya," and as the mightiest of all the Northern Parliament's battleships, I am her ultimate weapon. I will press onward to eliminate all obstacles that stand between you and the Revolution.
Comrade Commander, you are late. You must not forget your proletarian values.
Is that you, Comrade Commander...? I'm afraid the office is a bit messy. But we must make sacrifices to achieve our goals.
A report I submitted went missing? Pardon my negligence. I'll make it up, so... please don't tell the others about this matter.
I hope that you can command from a global perspective. After all, the responsibility on your shoulders is much greater than just that of an individual.
When I was inspecting my rigging, I noticed a few more screws than last time... Hm, an unexpected "increase in resource allocation?" That's a good thing, right?
Your tactics are too conservative! As long as it has not been sunk, it can repaired, learned from, strengthened, and optimized... Continuing this cycle is the best way of fighting.
You want to deepen our camaraderie? Very good, let us start by making a firm handshake part of our regular routine.
This is not polite behavior.
We have a mission. I will handle the clerical work. You must be clear to focus on your duties as a commander.
Hm? Something missing from the reward manifest...? It should be generally correct...
Mail. Comrade Commander, you must read it quickly before the next one comes bringing another letter.
Rest. And tell me now of what glorious victory you have won, or how you turn defeat to our advantage.
Military commissions? They are part of the logistical aspect of proper fleet management.
An excellent strengthening. The next one should be so good.
Commence bombardment! We will bury them!
Kill confirmed. You cannot stop the Northern Parliament... You cannot stop our righteous liberation!
Gah, how humiliating... to think a material defect would surface at a time like this...!
Blow them away!
It's not fatal damage...!
This negative attitude is unacceptable. You must be forcibly reeducated.
Your fleet must be an iron curtain... Hm, it's a metaphorical expression... My meaning is that I hope to see this fleet stand united, just like our Northern Parliament.
Comrade Commander, what is this? You wish to deepen your relationship with me as an individual, not a representative of the Northern Parliament? Well, such subjective decisions are acceptable.

Mm, this food is well made... Comrade Commander, thank you for serving me this meal, but I have to wonder, is this more than simple social etiquette? C- could you have some ulterior motive for this charm offensive?

Gah, well done...! I have no choice but to place the pride of the Northern Parliament on the line and face defeat at the hands of Comrade Commander's charm offensive! Now then, Comrade Commander, you face the full power of my love offensive!

So long as I draw breath, I labor to carry out my mission. Not only as a member of this fleet, but also in service of the bonds you have forged... This is not a product of rational thinking alone, but also a decision born of my subjective opinion.
Oho. Should I take this as a simple token of your goodwill?
This is no time to ponder the meaning of life. Just show us your strength!
Kirov, aid me!

ex.line: This port has such abundance. That leaves me one core duty. I must bring emotional enrichment to your life.
I need only focus my attentions on battle? That is a reasonable decision... But does it mean my clerical skills did not pass muster?
Comrade Commander, today's handshake. Mmm. Let us properly follow proper protocols today.
Is this what the Iris would call a "breach of etiquette?"
Comrade Commander, please eat this. Think nothing of it. Call it a personal supplement.

lines.line: "Situation normal in all sectors of the facility..." Oh, it is you. I was just giving Minsk the daily report. Do you have something?
"Situation normal in all sectors of the facility..." Oh, it is you. I was just giving Minsk the daily report. Do you have something?
Facility inspection, watch patrol, and observations conducted in accordance with regulations. Everything running smoothly.
What is the most efficient way to dispose of... Ooh? I mean the refuse. Spare me that look of concern.
You find me more reliable than Gangut...? I am glad you see my value, but I find that a very low bar to clear.
This is all in service of a greater cause. The girls have fully committed their labor. You need not trouble yourself.
Document classification protocols...? I was trying to find the required materials, but seem to have created a bit of a mess in the process...
Now, your hand... For today's handshake. I am not going to clap you in irons. Relax.
Hmph. Do you want to be handcuffed?
Freeze! Comply!
Essex-class aircraft carrier - Intrepid, Hull Number CV-11.

I'm the third ship of the Essex class, Intrepid! Although my poor luck during the war earned me quite a few unflattering nicknames... Heheh, that's all behind me now! Commander, under your command, I'll show you just how powerful I am!
"The Fighting I" of the Essex-class, Intrepid, is here! Commander, leave the combat missions to me! I'll bring home victory and glory!
Am I slated to sortie today? If not, hurry up and fix that!
One should always go all out, no matter the enemy... Having that said, there are various practical reasons why that isn't always possible...
Commander, do you like stargazing? Ahaha, it's fine if you aren't really into astronomy. If you're ever interested, just let me know.
Submarines are... quite strong. But I think I might be able to go toe-to-toe with them.

Despite the fact that there are many Essex-class carriers, we all have our good spots, you say? ...Uhh, you're not talking about our ship performance? I've never given much thought to those bothersome things...
Wooahh?! You're messing up my hair?!
Want something to drink? Then, how about a martini - shaken, not stirred? Just kidding!
You... *sigh*...I'm way more inclined to beat you to a pulp than to praise you for your bravery.
Having trouble with your missions? If you're stumped, why don't you let me try my hand?
Mission accomplished! See, there's nothing you can't do if you put your mind to it!
There's new mail... do we have new orders?
Phew, I'm back! Oh, you need a battle report, repair and resupply overviews, and a mission debriefing? Sure, five minutes should be enough, right? After that, send me back out there!
Commission completed, resources received~! Hehe, way to go, Commander. You know exactly how important logistics are to our fleet operations!
I feel like I can always keep improving! For example, how 'bout giving me a dozen jets?
Flight preparations complete! Attack squadrons, roll out!
The crown of victory goes to me, the one who knows no fear!
I have to go to the docks again...? Damnit, why is it always me... Y-you didn't hear anything!
Let's get this done!
Crap, I didn't think there'd be so many of them...
Commander, the way you're acting now makes you no different from a coward!
The great symbol of fearlessness is none other than I - Intrepid! Don't you forget that!

Oh, Commander! This- yeowwwch! Who decided it was a good idea to leave a trolley here?! Jeez, why does this always happen to me...Ah, um, nevermind, I'm fine! More importantly, when do I get to sortie?
During my free time, I like to read, watch movies, or stargaze. Oh, by the way, I got a movie ticket from Casablanca. Why don't we go watch it?

The stars in the night sky are distant. So distant that even with all the courage in the world, the effort it would take to reach them is unfathomable... However, all it takes to catch the commander in front of me is.... this! Hehe, isn't that right?

I didn't expect you to be the one to take the initiative... but I suppose that's fine too. Commander, guess I'll continue to be in your care then! As long as I am with you, I want you to push forward and face the future fearlessly!
Appreciate it, Commander! I'll pay you back on the battlefield!
Task Force 38, let's rock and roll!

ex.line: Commander, who do you plan on sortieing today? Why don't I offer you some suggestions?
No matter how strong the enemy, I have absolute confidence that you will be able to draw out my full power! Come on, add me to the next sortie roster!
If you ever fall into the ocean, I'll come to save you, Commander. Just send me your general location, and I'll find you as quick as Mercury and Gemini in the night sky.
Essex is always working hard, but she seems obsessed with how people commend Enterprise's achievements... What do you think of others' assessments, Commander?
Aaahh... I need to stretch... Hey, Commander, is there anything over there that looks like it could get in the way?
I-I won't give in, no matter how many times you attack!
Having trouble with your missions? Well, let's work on 'em together!
Mission accomplished! See, two heads are better than one!
Good work out there, Commander! ...Oww, sorry, I bumped into my own rigging... After all, I always get stoked when I see you! Ahaha...

Gotcha, Commander! Heheh, even if these hands will never be able to hold the stars in the sky, at least I can have you~ Just kidding. In any case, wanna go watch a movie? Naturally, we'll be holding hands, hehe~

lines.line: There's been a lot of inter-port meets recently... But before I can join a team with my other Eagle Union colleagues, I've got to up my game first! So, Commander, mind training with me?
There's been a lot of inter-port meets recently... But before I can join a team with my other Eagle Union colleagues, I've got to up my game first! So, Commander, mind training with me?
It's not enough to just be a pitcher. I've gotta be a good batter as well! Oh, Bluegill's also out there training. Let's grab her for our practice!
Nice catch! You've got skill! How about becoming my catcher?
A ponytail really does get in the way, huh... Next time, maybe I'll try putting it up...
Gah! I threw the ball full power and lost control of it... My bad, my bad!
All righty! This one's headed towards the ends of the universe! Wait, how's the catcher gonna get it then...
Woah! I just thought of a new kind of pitch! Commander, let's go try it out!
Even if you brought protection, getting hit by my fastball is gonna hurt like hell~
Phew, time for a break! Commander, thanks for coming out with me! Feel free to use the equipment however you'd like!
Nobody can return one of my pitches!
Gah, I gave up a run...
Baltimore-class heavy cruiser - Bremerton, Hull Number CA-130.

We Baltimore-class girls, me included, hardly got any chances to shine in combat since we were built near the end of the war. This time 'round, though, we're always on standby! You need somethin' done, hit me up!
Here! I! Am! I'm Bremerton, the Eagle Union heavy cruiser! The pleasure's mine! Oh, by the way, mind telling me your name, birthday, and favorite thing?
Nice seeing ya, Commander! I'll list off today's mission objectives... but first, I've gotta make a post to my Juustagram!

One sec, gotta finish this message... There we go! You see, I offer this like, counseling service thing, so sometimes I get people messaging me like this. You need any counseling, Commander? Typing all the time's a chore, so just hit me up in-person.
You look kinda moody... Wait, is that my cue to like, go buy you a drink?
What are you like when you're not working, Commander? Maybe you're one of those serious-on-the-outside, klutz-on-the-inside people?
Is my outfit tickling your fancy, Commander? Heheh, if you wanna get a closer look, go ahead.
Oof... My shoulders are killing me! Yo, Commander, mind giving me a massage?
Do that again and you'll regret it real bad, you hear?
Are these missions tough stuff? Hmm... Maybe I'll take a look, see if there's anything I can help with.
Mission's been completed. We haven't claimed the rewards yet, though. Come on, head out and get 'em!
Got a letter for you here. If it's nothing important, I could read it for ya.
Phew... Hey, Commander, you're thinking about skippin' work, aren't you? Hah, I'm fine with that. It'll just be you and me taking a short break, nobody'll notice.
That commission team's come back! This is your chance to charm 'em, Commander!
Hooray! It feels like I've grown in some way! Or somewhere, but I dunno where that'd be...
All right! Let's do this!
Heheh! Lookit or not, I'm a Baltimore-class, so these chumps were easy-peasy!
Oops... Uhh, I think I messed up somewhere...
Say goodnight!
I mighta been a bit too careless...
Come back to your normal self already, Commander... If you really need it, you can cry into my chest and let it all out.
Welcome to Bremerton's counseling corner! So, whatcha got on your mind? ...Hang on, what? You just wanna chat? So... you want counseling on how to find a chat buddy, basically?

Things I like besides fighting? I chat people up all the time and give counseling over social media, sooo... I guess I like hanging out with people? Oh, hang on, gotta check this Juustagram message. One sec...
I know you're used to listening to everyone else's troubles, but you can talk to me about whatever's on your mind. Oh, if you wanna talk through text instead, you can always DM me over Juustagram.

Did you read my DM, Commander? Don't go ghosting me; it says you've seen it~ I'm waiting for your reply with, like... Butterflies in my stomach, I guess? You know how to write a good reply, don't you? Hehehe~
Okay, now keep your eyes closed, Commander. "Why"? Come on, I'm not gonna mess with you, so just relax and do it~ I wanna remember this feeling every morning I wake up for the rest of my life♪
Mighty thanks, Commander!
You ready to kick some butt, Baltimore?

ex.line: Mornin', Commander. Let's see what's new on Juustagram... Wait, no. First, it's time to hear your orders!
Oh, you here to help out with my counseling corner, Commander? Sorry, but you can't. I appreciate the thought, but girly problems require girly solutions.
Here ya go! A drink, a small packed lunch, and some snacks from a bunch of peeps. Might be a bit much all in all, but think of it as proof of how much people love you!
I see Baltimore's out there being a hero, like always... She should take a break sometime to focus more on fashion and other stuff girls do.
Hohoh! You like that, huh~ You wanted to feel it for youself, am I right?

*sigh*... I always ask myself if you have to go into battle every time I see you leave, but at the same time, I wish I could be styling with you on the battlefield... Guess my feelings are pretty mixed on this.
Commander, you wanna go hang after we're done with work? Where? You decide♪ Hehehe~ Don't let me down now. Pick a good place and take me there~

lines.line: *pant*... *pant*... Man, it's so sunny today... Commander, or should I say, "Coach," could ya lend me your parasol? I'm starting to feel my brains melting away...
*pant*... *pant*... Man, it's so sunny today... Commander, or should I say, "Coach," could ya lend me your parasol? I'm starting to feel my brains melting away...
*gulp* *gulp* Phew... I'm coming back to life! Coach, thanks for practicing with me all this time!
Gah, it's freakin' hot... I just wanna hit the showers and then flop around in bed until it's time to sleep... Oh, gotta update my Juustagram... Ehh, forget it, I'm not gonna bother today.
Coach, if you're thirsty, you can take a sip from my water bottle. Don't sweat the small stuff, go for it!
Seems like Cooper is having a match with some Sakura Empire girls over on the next court. Coach, wanna go take some sports drinks over to them in a bit?
Wanna have a friendly match? Er, actually, scrap that. There's no way I'd be able to beat you, Coach.
Now that I'm all sweaty and gross, I can't just ask to lean on your shoulder, can I? Ahaha...
I was an idiot for thinkin' you wouldn't try something when my guard is down...
Got a letter for you, Coach. If it's nothing important, I could read it for ya.
*pant* *pant*...Unlike Baltimore, I guess I'm really not built for this kind of exercise...
That commission team's come back! This is your chance to charm 'em, Coach!
"Stop right there, evildoers! You've managed to evade justice all this time, but the hour of judgment is finally upon you!" ...Hmm, making the perfect flashy debut is pretty tough, isn't it?
"Stop right there, evildoers! You've managed to evade justice all this time, but the hour of judgment is finally upon you!" ...Hmm, making the perfect flashy debut is pretty tough, isn't it?
Hoo! Hi-yaaah! Whew... 'sup, Commander? Came to watch? Cool, cool. Never mind me though, check out this ballin' backdrop Akashi hooked me up with!
Bremerton's counseling corner's still open, like always! Got somethin' you wanna talk about, Commander?
Have you seen Ning and Ping's mad acrobatic skills? The stuff they can do legit blows my mind...
Hi-yaaah! Oh yeah, frickin' nailed it! Aw, hang on, Juustagram DM just came in!
"My final move! Spinning Bird: Thunder Whip!" ...Ow, ow, ow! Lesson learned: this move's too advanced for my lacking motor skills...
I know hairbuns are cliché, but I wanted to change up my style, y'know?
Ooh, that's good... Your muscles get real stiff after so much action.
Heheh, you really wanna taste my kung-fu fury that badly?
Mission donezo! Got another scene coming up, so we'd better go get those rewards now.
Commission team just got back. You know what that means: we gotta give 'em a true kung-fu hero welcome!
C'mon, show me what ya got!
I reckon we've done enough shopping for the moment. Let's stop and chill here for a bit, then have another look around~♪
I reckon we've done enough shopping for the moment. Let's stop and chill here for a bit, then have another look around~♪
Hey Commander, on a scale from 1 to 10, how do I look today? And no wishy-washy answers like saying I look "cute" or "pretty," got it?
You're worried about my counseling service? Don't worry, I put up a sign saying it's closed for the day. Hehe, now that you know, focus on our date~
Affection's somethin' that goes up bit by bit, so don't underestimate the power of dates!
You want a taste? Ah... No need to get all flustered about it, go ahead! Take a sip!
Obviously we're gonna walk all around town when we're on a date! Let's head over to that store next!
You wanna rest up a bit more? Haha, I guess I am the one who invited you out~ Hmm, all right. Let's stay here for a bit longer.
What's your endgame here?
One boba milk tea, no ice and half the sugar please! Oh wait, let me get one more for the poor Commander who's carrying my luggage!
What a fun day~ Should probably write about it in my diary later... Hmm, since this was just our first date, I wonder what we should do for the second and third ones... Got any ideas, Commander?
Welcome to Bremerton's counseling corner! Actually, I came up with this idea just for you, since you're always working so hard... Tadaaah~! I've prepared us some matching sleepwear~♪
Welcome to Bremerton's counseling corner! Actually, I came up with this idea just for you, since you're always working so hard... Tadaaah~! I've prepared us some matching sleepwear~♪
Oh man, I feel like a million bucks in these PJs! C'mon, Commander, let's get you into some sleepwear!
Ah, I see. I think I've got the perfect solution for your problem... Hey, was that...? A Juustagram notif! Wait, no, helping you with your problem comes first!
I call this a counseling corner, but it's really just a repurposed section of my own room. Hey, stop surveying the place!
You're welcome! I can't do athletic stuff like Baltimore, but counseling is a piece of cake!
Hmm... I can't decide on the last photo to post to my Juustagram... Which do ya think looks the be- Wait, that album is off limit!
Heheh, pretty comfy rug, right? Whaddya say we lie down?
Hey, uh... Sorry, but I'm in counselor mode right now♪
Hang on, I'mma go fetch the aroma lamp! Lemme know if you want a particular scent.
Yo, commission team is back. Let's go talk to 'em - we'll continue your consultation sesh after!

Hold still, Commander! You gotta relax in this position or else I can't do my thing. Take it easy and let me handle them weary bones. Alright, from your hands to your arms, then to your neck and shoulders, time to press down!

Hold still, Commander! You gotta relax in this position or else I can't do my thing. Take it easy and let me handle them weary bones. Alright, from your hands to your arms, then to your neck and shoulders, time to press down!
Morning, Commander! Kinda rude of you to fall asleep in the middle of my massage... Heheheh, guessing you want something a little more "stimulating," eh?

We finally got some time to spend together - ain't nothing wrong with doing one or two things that're off-brand for me, right? Besides, it's too late to quit now, so you might as well accept me takin' the lead here!

Couldn't find me earlier today? Well, I was at the amusement park, I was thinking about how to approach you, and I had a lotta consultation work to do. Heheh, I got off to a late start, but this is where I make my comeback!

Before you hit the hay and sleep like a log, you gotta treat your body right to actually get rid of your exhaustion. That means taking a bath in a big tub and getting a hottie to massage you before anything else!
Man, you're real reckless, Commander - opening the door to the room before even checking who it is. You're bound to get pounced like that.
Here we GO! Hm? Did I use too much force?
C'mon, Commander, just let me do my thing♪
Wow, talking 'bout missions while getting a massage... Fine. If I can help, just lemme know!
Mission complete! Whew... Don't move, just lie on your back now!
This letter's for you? Oh, you shoulda said so! I was 'bout to throw it away!
Aahh, that was divine! I've drained the bath and gotten the sauna fired up. You ready for the next round of soothing, Commander?
The commission team is... How did you know that? You hiding your phone in that pillow or something?
That was refreshing for the both of us! Heheh!
Oops, I guess I got too cocky...

Ahh... A little late, but I'm really sorry for barging in! I just saw you hangin' out with other girls at the amusement park, and... Nah, it didn't make me jealous. I just got anxious, wondering when it'd be my turn...
Three, two, one, go! Did you get a pic of me tossing the bouquet, Commander? Ahahah! I'm postin' this to Juustagram later, so you should do the same! It'll be like... retaking our pledge of love♪
Three, two, one, go! Did you get a pic of me tossing the bouquet, Commander? Ahahah! I'm postin' this to Juustagram later, so you should do the same! It'll be like... retaking our pledge of love♪
Welcome back, Commander! Just gonna update my Juustagram status to "With the Commander"...
I'm surprised how easy to wear this is. Maybe I'll do something physical while wearing it... like playing tennis. Ahahah! Just kidding♪
The bouquet toss represents sharing the joy. I really wish this happiness and hope reaches many, many people.
*click!* You look so cute in this pic! I'm so saving this... You're wondering if I'll post it to Juustagram? Heheh, nah, this one's for me to look back on fondly. My followers don't get to see it♪
Hm? Do ya wanna hold the bouquet too? I mean, I guess you can...
So, do you like what you see? Oh, and whisper me your answer♪
Welcome back, Commander! Gimme a big hug before I update my Juustagram~ Ahaha♪
My Juustagram feed is going wild about you... I wanna share my happiness, but I also want you all to myself... What do ya think I should do, Commander~?
Allen M. Sumner-class destroyer - Cooper, Hull Number DD-695.

I'm an Allen M. Sumner-class destroyer, Cooper! I fought alongside Allen M. Sumner and Moale at Ormoc Bay, but I guess I didn't try hard enough... Nnng, damn it! How was I supposed to pick out anything like those oxygen torpedoes!
Hey Commander, I'm Cooper! Let's join forces and fight for the future of the world! Booyah!
It's nice to see your smiling face, Commander! Heh heh!
I have an incredible power inside me that will burst forth to save everyone at that critical moment... Yeah! That would be badass!
Paperwork? How does that help in a fight?
Aaahhh~ I just lose it whenever I see a kitty cat. Commander, let's keep one in the office, a black one!
Hey... how long are we gonna stay in the office? I'm so bored...
Hey! Ready to move anytime!
Commander, do you understand what you're doing here?
We won't be able to help anyone if you leave your missions unfinished!
Mission accomplished! We're definitely making a difference!
A new message? Could it be a distress signal...? My Danger Antenna is tingling!
Commander, I took care of a whole bunch of things while you were gone! See these reports? I wrote them all wrong? What the...
Go greet the team coming back from commission? Easy peasy! Just watch me~
Getting stronger is how I help more people!
Cast off! Let's go!
Phew... What a nice feeling. Feels like victory.
One little setback won't get me down!
CYCLONE SMASHER!
I won't be afraid! Now more than ever, they need me!
Even if Commander is my enemy, I won't go soft!
Whenever you're in trouble, just call my name! Then you can bet Cooper will be there to bail you out, Commander!
Commander! Did I hear my name? Hah hah hah, just point me at the enemy and... You need me to deliver these documents? I'm not your errand girl!
Sorry, Commander. I know you were looking for me, but I got held up with this black kitty cat. I hope you didn't worry about me... B-but, like, who could resist playing with a kitty cat...?

Commander! From now on I'm staying here with you, whether you call for me or not. So you won't have to worry about a thing...! Huh? You think I'm the one who's gonna get in trouble? Nng, yeah, maybe... But that still means I gotta stay with you, Commander!
Commander, who knew I was so important to you... I'm so happy! As long as I'm with you, then tomorrow... and the next day, and the day after that, I know I'll be able to do anything!
Thanks, Commander!
Break point!
30 to 15... Next match will be mine, you hear! Oh, Commander, are you here to play a round of tennis?
Watch me beat this Sakura girl... then it's you and me, Commander!
I never thought a game of afternoon tennis would be so exhausting... Huh? What's up, Commander?
Ace shot! Yaaaaaah!
This is for me? Alright...! Glug glug... Haah!
A black kitty cat! Where is it...?! Hey now, don't distract me!
Y-you probably shouldn't touch me. I'm all sweaty right now.
Wait up! Hold on! Gotta catch my breath...! Phew, whew...
Deuce! This ain't over!
Hm? I'm just wrapping up some presents! Can't just present them as-is, and all that. Hehe~ I could sure use a little help, Commander!
Hm? I'm just wrapping up some presents! Can't just present them as-is, and all that. Hehe~ I could sure use a little help, Commander!
I get excited thinking about what kind of presents I might get! What stuff did you wish for, Commander?
Whew! It's freezing cold outside, but warm and cozy in here! Nothing beats an open fireplace in the winter~
You'd be surprised how easy wrapping presents is! You just put it like this... take some wrapping paper... then a ribbon... aaand done!
Man, I wish I could ride anywhere in a cool snowmobile like Minneapolis. "It's too dangerous for a kid to ride"? Hey! It's not like I'm a little baby or anything!
I'm getting kinda bored... Hey, Commander, wanna play word association? With a Christmas theme, obviously!
Are you feeling chilly? Come a little closer if you wanna warm up, then~
Hrmph... You're not fooling me with any "just wanted to warm my hands up" excuses!
New mail, huh? You think it might be someone's Christmas wishlist?
I'm not sure who'll end up getting this snowglobe, but I am sure they'll love it!
I think the commission team's back. Let's invite them in here and we can all have a cozy Christmas together!
Atlanta-class light cruiser - Reno, Hull Number CL-96.

I'm Reno, an Atlanta-class cruiser of the later Oakland subclass. We've got souped up anti-air power compared to the regular Atlanta-class. We only saw the last bits of the war, but we still fought hard. But I feel really bad about Princeton... Nnng, it's fine! We can do it!
