You're the Commander? Ahh, I've always wanted to meet you! I mean, aren't people like you basically heroes trying to save the world? Which kind of makes me your sidekick, right? Oh, I'm Reno, part of the Oakland class! It's a pleasure!
Commander, today we do our best to save the world. like always!
Commander, I'm in a bit of a pickle... I can't get any of the parts for my costume at Akashi's shop... I guess I'll just have to make them myself... Hrm...
You looking at my gear, Commander? If you press this here, it shoots out a light like bzzzzew! And if you press this one, it goes like kshaw ksshhew. And then this one's like...
Commander, I'm in a bind... Well, I guess it's not really that big a deal. It's just, I wasn't able to get this premium figure I've been wanting...
Woooww.... Hm? Oh, was I bothering you? I was just basking in the amazing feeling of a sidekick watching her hero work up close~
I'm doing good work...? Oooh! My hero complimented me! Of course my face is gonna turn bright red!
You think they're big too? They really get in the way...
We got a lot to do... But I'm sure you can knock it out easy peasy, Commander!
That's my Commander! You always get the best rewards!
Mail for you, Commander. Is it a fan letter?
Good fight out there, Commander. Here's a towel and a drink... Hm? Isn't this what a sidekick does?
The commission came back. You want to go out and see them?
Hah ha! I'm the Commander's sidekick!
Just leave the planes to me!
Yeah! The good guys always win!
They say it's always darkest before the dawn... Mm. We'll try harder next time.
I am Reno!
I could do this all day!
They say you should never meet your heroes. Now I know why... Sigh...
Commander, you're looking at my superhero gadgets! This is my Ibranium shield, this is my Chiropterang, and this here's my Worpher Belt... Cool, huh? You name it, I've got it, Commander.
There was a time when I was training really hard to become a superhero... But these huge things got in the way of my dreams... the flat girls don't know how good they have it...

I may have given up my training, but I still love watching sports. Oh, but even more than sports, I love watching superhero shows...! But now that my real hero is here, Commander, maybe I'm good on that front.

They say "with great power comes great responsibility," but superheroes need some downtime too, just like warships. Sometimes I just gotta be a regular girl, and you're no different. Let's do something fun sometime.

So like, from now on I'm more than just your sidekick. I gotta learn how to be a partner to you too, for the rest of your life... I don't really know how to do that ♪ so you'll just have to speak up and tell me what to do~
Wait, is this the limited edition one?! Oh, I love you, Commander!
Let's get 'em all fired up!
San Diego, you've been playing with my collectibles again, haven't you?!
Don't give up, keep fighting for your dreams, and so will I!
This really is a huge clash of all the biggest names from all the factions. It's one exciting match after another! I gotta cheer my hardest too. Eagle Union, go get 'em!
This really is a huge clash of all the biggest names from all the factions. It's one exciting match after another! I gotta cheer my hardest too. Eagle Union, go get 'em!
Commander, I got a great view of the games from here. Come watch with me~
Craven was supposed to be cheer squad leader on account of she's older, but she ended up asking me to do it... I can't let her down. I gotta cheer hard!
Ah, it's half time. That means we better get out there and cheer! Everybody ready? Let's get their blood pumping!
None of the other factions have serious cheerleaders like me or Craven. But I won't underestimate the ones they came up with either... I can't let them beat me~
Look at them out there on the field, shining like superheroes as they fight for victory... being a cheerleader sure is amazing!
Huh, you brought me water, Commander? Woaaahhh, no way...! Nng, my hero brought me water... I couldn't be happier...
Commander, people can see...
Commander, it's time to get your rewards, everyone's waiting for you to attend the ceremony~
Commander, you're just in time. The next match is about to start~

"Superhero spin-off! The superhero who saved the world is enjoying a hard-earned vacation on the afternoon beach with the sidekick!" ... Hehe, Commander, a tagline like that sounds pretty cool, doesn't it?

"Superhero spin-off! The superhero who saved the world is enjoying a hard-earned vacation on the afternoon beach with the sidekick!" ... Hehe, Commander, a tagline like that sounds pretty cool, doesn't it?
*Click!* Welcome back, Commander! Heehee~ I couldn't stop myself from taking a picture of my beloved hero enjoying the beach!
It was really hard to find a swimsuit that would fit my bust... Luckily, I was able to find this swimsuit at the last minute! It fits my chest perfectly, but... my poor hips are chafing... Ow...
Looks like everyone's pumped up for the beach volleyball tournament! If only my... weren't so big. They make it hard to move around...
Oh yeah. How dashing does My Hero look when swimming? Do you zoom by others while going at 100 miles per hour? Hehehe~
If you compete in the tournament, I'll cheer you on with all I've got! Go! Go! Come on! You can do it! M-Y-H-E-R-O!
If it isn't coconut milk! Is it okay to accept such a precious gift? ...Hehe. I'm absolutely elated to receive a precious present from my hero!
Woah?! I-If you touch it like that, it's going to snap!!
Commander, are you in Sleep Mode? Then please, rest well! ...You don't have to worry about me. I've already rested for a bit, and I was thinking about heading out to make my rounds anyway!
Come on in, Commander! Don't you recognize me? I'm Reno Bunnino - cutesy bunny girl by day, villain-vanquishing superhero by night! Pretty neat concept, am I right?
Come on in, Commander! Don't you recognize me? I'm Reno Bunnino - cutesy bunny girl by day, villain-vanquishing superhero by night! Pretty neat concept, am I right?
What can I get you, Commander?
Reno, tired of seeing her commander fighting all alone, assumed an alter ego and joined the commander in the battle against the forces of evil! Pretty cool origin story, wouldn't you say?
So I was telling everyone about Reno Bunnino, and for whatever reason, North Carolina was super keen to hear it... Not like that's a bad thing. More friends is always good!
Hungry, Commander? Vestal taught me a handful of recipes. I could cook something up for you.
Y'know, I think this Reno Bunnino's thing really gonna take off. I'm counting on you to facilitate that, Commander.
This gauntlet I'm always wearing? Oh, uh, I've not made my Reno Bunnino tool belt just yet, so I'm making do with this for now.
If you're doing what I think you are... Yeah, sorry, there aren't many clothes my size.
When Reno Bunnino's beloved commander comes home to roost, that's her time to shine.
Check this out, Commander! Hehehe, I added a little firework launcher to my superhero gadgets. Cool, huh? ...Your interest lies more in my new look? But... the firework...
Check this out, Commander! Hehehe, I added a little firework launcher to my superhero gadgets. Cool, huh? ...Your interest lies more in my new look? But... the firework...
Happy Spring Festival, Commander! The port looks great with all these paper lanterns decorating it! They give it this novel, cultured vibe. You know what I mean?

"An unforeseen accident causes panic at the festival! That's when our plain-clothed superhero rises up to the task!" That'd be such a fun scenario! Although, obviously we'd all much prefer to have a peaceful holiday.
Hehe, check this out! Doesn't this outfit... kinda make me look like one of the Dragon Empery's wandering recluses?
Want me to show you my micro-firework again? Hehe, I'd be right happy to♪
Sorry, Ayanami. All my gadgets can do is shoot these little sparks. They can't fire real fireworks, lasers, or anything like that.
You wanna hold hands? Sure thing! Ah, wait, this one's still a bit hot! The other one!
Whaaa?! You're not supposed to lift this flap!
I've got a red envelope for you, Commander! Here you are! ...Hm? This is backwards? Usually you're the one giving these out?
Gato-class submarine - Bluegill, Hull Number SS-242.
I'm Bluegill, Gato-class submarine. I saw action all over the sea and gave my enemies a real scare. Hehe, I'll shine on at this port, too!
I've finally found one! My own commander! ...Hehehe, from now on, you're Bluegill's commander!
Welcome back, Commander! Let's part these curtains, like... This! Hehe, now the sun's gleam reaches in here too!
I wonder if there's a way to become friends with Yuubari, that girl cooped up in the science department...
Sunny days are always good swimming days!
Hey, that's not a blank sheet, that's Bluegill's personal file on the back! Look! I wrote the whole thing myself!
How long are you gonna have a staredown with your desk, Commander? C'mon, let's catch a break!
You want a fight with me? You asked for it! Take *this*! Blue knockout punch!
Whoa, whoa! Commander! You've kinda crossed a line here!
Commander, if you're heading out for a patrol, why not take Bluegill with you? It might be good to have me!
Mission complete! Now it's time for a swim! ...Huh? Too early for a swim? But why?
Is this mail for Bluegill? Oh, it's addressed to the Commander...
Good job, Commander! Come here!
Commander, the rewards from that commission have arrived!
Wooo! Wow, I've really gotten nimbler!
Bluegill, setting out!
I hereby name this victory "The Battle of Bluegill"!
They nearly got us... But it won't go the same way next time!
Bluegill, comin' at ya!
Oh dang, oh shoot!
It's okay! You just need to bask in the sunshine for a bit, and your troubles will surely all go away!
Bluegills are, in fact, a type of sunfish! ...You knew that? Welp, and here I was hoping to tell you a surprising fact.
There you are, Commander! Come here! ...What's wrong with me hugging you? Am I holding you too tight? That's not it? Then what is it?
I figured out why my hugs bother you! It's because it feels embarrassing, right? Well, don't worry about that! I asked around, and nobody thinks less of you for it! ...W-was I wrong?

So my hugs really put you in a pickle, huh, Commander... I'm sorry for that! I can't help it, I just feel super, *super* happy when I hug you! Hey, what if I wait with my hugs until you say you're ready? Okey-dokey! Just tell me whenever you want one!
Can I hug you now, Commander?! Yay! Sharing a hug with you just feels like total bliss~ Hehehe~ Stay put, I wanna enjoy our embrace a little longer!
Heheh, this belongs to Bluegill now!
Whoa, is that a new piece of gear?!
Gato-class, let's go!
Look out for Bluegill's ultra-reliable defense, Intrepid! Hehehe, Commander, stay here and see the results of Bluegill's special training!
Look out for Bluegill's ultra-reliable defense, Intrepid! Hehehe, Commander, stay here and see the results of Bluegill's special training!
I wish baseball was as easy as diving... I'll still give it my best shot, though! Bluegill's a go-getter!
I've heard I can throw the ball faster if I have my feet raised, like a pitcher! ...It doesn't work like that?
With you and Coach Bogue helping me, I'm destined to become a pro player!
I'll stun everyone with my skills when the next baseball league rolls around!
Intrepid! Bluegill's by your back! Don't forget that!
Is... this the proper throwing stance? I'll memorize it!
Stop playing dirty!
Bluegill catches, Bluegill throws! Oh no! Look out! Sorry, Commander, I didn't mean to throw it at you! Hehehe...
Casablanca-class escort carrier - Casablanca, Hull Number CVE-55.

Back then, roughly fifty other Casablanca-class sisters entered service over the course of just over a year. Although most of us saw our missions come to an end shortly after the war, I will do my best to fulfill my duties to this fleet, whether as an escort, air support, or a transport. It's a pleasure to work with you, Commander.
Good morning to you. Escort carrier Casablanca, reporting in. I shall support the fleet to the best of my abilities, so you may rest assured.
Time is of the essence. Let us quickly begin the day's work.
Although fighting on the front lines is not my specialty, I'll give it my all if needed!
Commander, shall I help assess the state of the fleet's logistics?
Commander, where would you rather be, the thrilling, constantly-shifting front lines, or the humble, but critically important rear lines?
If possible, I'd like to hear about what happened at the Battle of Casablanca from Massachusetts.
Commander, what's the matter... Oh, is my necktie crooked?
Eek?! I... I've never read about stuff like this in my books before...!
You will surely be rewarded for your hard work. Please do your best, Commander!
Mission complete! All right, with these supplies, your fleet operations should be even smoother.
I wonder if this message is from the Naval Headquarters... Commander, I think it'd be wise to check just in case.
Welcome back, Commander. The combat report is... Wh-what book?! *cough* *cough*... It's nothing, forget you saw anything.
I've finished checking the resources from the commission. Please confirm.
Thank you very much, Commander!
A head-on battle, huh... All right, leave the air support to me!
First place... me? Hmph. Fighting on the front lines might be easier than I expected.
There's only so much I can do on the front lines as an escort carrier...
I will do everything in my power to protect everyone!
Gah... This is starting to look impossible...
So... you were the greatest obstacle to the development of the fleet...
First Ameer, then Alazon Bay, and finally Casablanca. Isn't it nice when your name bodes good fortune? Hehe~
I like movies and books. I adore stories with high and low points and emotionally touching scenes. As for my favorite genre, that would be... Umm, it's a secret!
Oh, Ilsa... You poor thing, you can only choose one person... I wouldn't be able to do that... I am so happy that I don't have to face such a dilemma on m- C-Commander?! When did you get here?!
Would you like to go watch a movie with me, Commander? My favorite kind, of course... A story of love and romance. Together with you...

Although love stories, with all their twists and turns, have a unique appeal, I personally would rather live a life of simple happiness. Do you think the same way, Commander? Then let us join in an embrace after you put the ring on my finger.
Oh, I really like this! Thank you!
I am glad to have you by my side, Long Island!
A dash of flair is nice every now and then!
When do you propose we host the next group reading?

ex.line: This is Casablanca. Proceeding to aid the Commander. Hehe~ Let's give it our all today.
A bar located in a town on the border between the desert and the sea; the nostalgic Iris Libre countryside; memories passing by as the time flows. A beautiful scene, wouldn't you agree, Commander?
Commander, have you made sure that our supply lines are secure?
Commander, what do you say we spectate Bogue's next baseball game?
"The Port's Carrier Weekly"? It's featuring one of my sister ships? Th-that's a little embarrassing for me...
Commander, your tie is loose. Hehe~ This time, I noticed it before you did.
C-Commander... Things of this nature are inappropriate here. We should relocate to somewhere else, like... Ahh, I can't believe what I'm saying!
Welcome back, Commander. I returned the movie we finished the other day. Hehe~ It's okay if you forget; I always remember it.
If the Commander wants a victory... then I won't allow defeat!

lines.line: Phew... Can't train hard if you don't stay hydrated! Oh, Commander, good day! Did you come to watch us practice?
Phew... Can't train hard if you don't stay hydrated! Oh, Commander, good day! Did you come to watch us practice?
Cheerleaders raise the morale of the players. It doesn't seem much different from the role of an escort carrier, supporting those who are working hard on the battlefield.
Getting the choreography down isn't the hard part. It's being able to cheer so enthusiastically like Reno... It's a bit too embarrassing if you ask me...
Captain Reno, I think your enthusiasm is nothing but commendable, but wouldn't it be better to take a break now to conserve our energy?
Commander, I brought some water and sports drinks. Feel free to take whatever you want.
Even though this squad was thrown together last minute, thanks to the support of you and Craven, I don't want to lose to the other factions!
Is this towel for me? Ah, thank you very much, Commander.
Commander, you seem to be quite good at taking advantage of these situations...
The actual meet is coming up... I've got to practice even harder!
Omaha-class light cruiser - Marblehead, Hull Number CL-12.
I'm Marblehead, your average Omaha-class girl. I went like, all over the globe during the war, and stuff like that. Anyhoo, let's be buds and just chill, 'kay?
Sup. Name's Marblehead. Are you the Commander? Ahah☆ I dig your style. Hehehe, let's hang out sometime!
Libra's horoscope for today promises... super good luck.
Why follow the stupidly serial boss-and-subordinate template, am I right? Hehehe, let's just hang out and be friends!
Yo, Commander, I promised Memphis I'd color her nails in 2 hours! That's gonna take about an hour to do, so if you've got work for me then you might wanna give it now.
Let's see... Hey, Commander~ See this? I don't really get what this part says, but somethin' about it looks off.
Put the seal there, check the numbers, make a report... Hm? Oh, I'm not up to anything special! You're just imagining things, probably!
Commander, I'm trying to take a selfie here, so could you move?
Whuah?! Commander, that's *really* creepy, okay?
Once this mission's done, could you go get the milk tea I ordered? And not too much sugar, thanks.
You, uh, one of those super-achievers, Commander? I'm... I-I'm kinda sorta into people like that.
Guess this is new mail or something... Right, I'll just pretend I never saw it.
Commander, you feelin' hungry? I got some cake, fresh outta the oven.
Commander, I figure a commission should be done by now. Hm? Nah, I've just got a good mental clock~
Huh. You fancy a girl like me?
Tiiiime to get serial!
Smile for the camera, Commander~ I need a selfie to preserve this moment~
I have to investigate into what went wrong this battle... Oh, uh, never mind I said anything!
Try *this* on for size!
Guess I've gotta crank up the serial factor...!
You're uncool as heck, Commander. I'mma hit up Concord and hang with her instead...
This here picture I've got? Ah, that average-looking girl used to be me. Whatevs, let's put that aside and go have some fun~!
I'm not really shy about my past as an ordinary girl. What's then is then, what's now is now, y'know? I think my new look better expresses who I am~ So anyway, as I was saying...
I guess it's like, you lose sight of what's fun when you go super-serial all-work-and-no-play, you get me? I'm having tons of fun now, and wouldn't go back to my dorky self even if you told me to.
I dunno if you're into girls like me, but *I'm* into commanders like *you*, so~ What do you say we get closer each other? Let's get the ball rolling with a date~
I totally knew it, we're like, made for each other~ I looked into your personal preferences ages ago, so yeah~ All right, you wanna come with me and have some fun again today?
This is really cool! I love it, Commander!
Omaha-class, moooovin' out!
You girls wanna get together later?

ex.line: Your horoscope for today promises... mega good luck!
Commander, you've *gotta* read this great book... It's on administration and philosophy, what about it?
Yo, Commander, the port's 7 mysteries are some seriously interesting stuff. Let's go check one out the next time you're off duty~
Maybe I'm a bit garish, but don't underestimate my smarts! Lemme see what part you're stuck on~
Come a little closer, Commander. I'mma take a picture of you~
Smokin' bod I've got, am I right? Heehee!

lines.line: After trying out a whole bunch of activities, I settled on joinin' the boxing club in the end. Everyone wants to exercise now and then, right? Come along, Commander, and we'll have a fun workout together~

After trying out a whole bunch of activities, I settled on joinin' the boxing club in the end. Everyone wants to exercise now and then, right? Come along, Commander, and we'll have a fun workout together~
All right, Commander, let's start with some warmups~
I started reading up on building muscle for future reference, and man there's a lot to learn~
Let's leave our boring work and social troubles behind and focus only on workin' out~
I need a break... All right, time to check out the MME tournament on TV~
Commander, you seen Omaha 'round here? I bet she's off gorging herself on snacks in secret. Don't let her get away with it~!
Sooo, Commander, when we're working out... who're your eyes on~?
Using the fat around your chest for softening impacts... kinda actually works?!
Good going out there. You want a sip of my electrolyte-rich sports drink?
We could have a workout date someday~ Like a "let your fists do the talking" kinda thing, or something like that~ Be a darling, Commander, and take my loving blows~
Whoa! Talk about a stunning view! You like, totally all the best spots in the city, Commander~ Hehe, okay, so... Merry Christmas!
Whoa! Talk about a stunning view! You like, totally know all the best spots in the city, Commander~ Hehe, okay, so... Merry Christmas!
Hey Commander, you ready to get? "To get what"? To get to work, man! Hehehe~
Hmm... The snow's falling at a rate of 3cm per second, so assuming no wind, tomorrow's forecast should be something like... Oh, Commander? Just talkin' to myself!
You think Santa Claus is real, Commander? Me, I think he's like, basically real. Because, y'know, there's all these people wearing legit Santa costumes in stores and stuff. Hahaha.
If Miss Raleigh were in my shoes here, she'd totes be blushing to her ears.
Wanna draw something with me, Commander? Y'know, like, exhaling on the window and making shapes with your finger~
Feeling chilly? You can come closer if you wanna~
Winter makes you wanna snuggle up, doesn't it~?
Sup, Commander. Oof, real chilly out there, huh? Then c'mere and I'll warm you up~
The commission gals are back~ You wanna go out and meet up with 'em, or...?
This victory's almost as lit as this view!
The annual moon gazing festival's upon us again~ Ah, so you know a thing or two about the Mid-Autumn Festival, Commander? Then I reckon you know what we're doing tonight, right~? ♡
The annual moon gazing festival's upon us again~ Ah, so you know a thing or two about the Mid-Autumn Festival, Commander? Then I reckon you know what we're doing tonight, right~? ♡
Let's see the prediction for Leos born today... Hmm, clearly something's wrong with my calculations here...
Why am I wearing Dragon Empery clothes? Because there's a Dragon Empery celebration today, duh~ Now if you don't mind, I'm gonna have myself a mooncake.
Yo, this mooncake bussin'! Concord would love this little sugar bomb! I'll grab one and bring- Hm? This one's extra salty?
You know the myth about rabbits on the moon? Bet those rabbits can jump, like, a mile up in zero-gravity.
I don't mind you gawkin' at me, but you'll wanna gawk at the sky too. Full moons only come once a month, you know!
Man, this view is awesome~
Whoa! Careful, or I might fall, Commander!
Thanks for this sweet gift you brought back~ I'm gonna go show it to Memphis~
Phew... Should be in the clear now. Oh, hey, Commander. Whatcha doing here? Waiting for a cutie to show up or something? Surely it can't be a coincidence... right?
Phew... Should be in the clear now. Oh, hey, Commander. Whatcha doing here? Waiting for a cutie to show up or something? Surely it can't be a coincidence... right?
Maaan, it's raining cats and dogs! My uniform's soaked through... Haha♡ D'ya like it that way, Commander?
The shirt and sweater I can deal with, but my tights are like glue... Dunno where to put 'em after I take 'em off. Got any ideas, Commander?
Be your personal teacher? I'm down~ Which subjects, and for how long are we talkin'? Need to know for return-favor purposes♪
Memphis?! Crap, my bad... Wouldn't've gotten THIS drenched if I'd warned ya ten seconds sooner... Err, forget I said anything!
If you wanna check me out, n-now's the time... You can't ogle me once I've gotten changed... So yeah.
A towel? Aww, you're too nice... Huh? Err, if you wanna dry me off, sure I guess...
Whoa! You don't want me to get changed first?
Missions? ...Dang, I'll try again when the Commander's free...
Mission complete~ You wanna get something warm to drink? It's on me.
Whoa, we got a message. Think it's a letter for you, Commander.
Weren't we gonna do the umbrella-sharing thing on our walk back to your office? ...Hahaha! I'm just messing with you~
Crap, I'm all wet again... This wasn't part of the plan.
High school romance is like, pretty done to death~ You wanna shake things up a bit? 'Kay, then how about... There's something I wanna tell ya. Can we go... to an empty classroom?
Akizuki-class destroyer number thirteen - Hanazuki.

I entered service during the tail end of the War as an Akizuki-class specialized for anti-air and anti-submarine capabilities... Err, I guess it was the Fuyutsuki-class... Or was it the Michitsuki-class... Err... S-sorry, I still have a lot to learn, so I'd greatly appreciate your guidance!

I, destroyer Hanazuki from the Sakura Empire, would like to extend my humble greetings to you. As a member of the Akizuki class, I specialize in anti-air and anti-sub warfare, but please do not hesitate to call upon me where I am needed.
Welcome back, Commander. Shall we continue our work? Should you have any concerns, please feel free to consult me. I shall do all I can to assist you.

I love the way countless flowers bloom vividly during the spring, but even so, I wouldn't want it to be spring all year long - that would be unfair to the flowers that only bloom in other seasons. Mhm, I'm sure the four seasons exist so that all flowers have a chance to bloom. Hehe~
Commander, do you prefer herbal tea, or black tea?
Commander, Harutsuki seems to have gotten herself in some trouble. I'd like to check on her, so would you mind if I left you for a bit?
"The sun in the west, the moon in the east, canola blossoms inbetween." I'd love to see this scenery myself.
Anything you need me to do, as long as it is within my abilities, I would gladly do for you.
Eek?! Um, if I may be so bold... this sort of behavior is... It would be best not to do this to the other girls...
So many unfinished tasks... Commander, wh-where should we start?
Congratulations! As expected Commander, you've completed our missions with flying colors!
New mail seems to have arrived. If you need me to sort it for you, please let me know.
Welcome back, Commander. The port is like our home now, nothing is more reassuring than being back here, right?
The commission fleet has returned. Commander, should I bring some herbal tea with me to welcome them back?
I see, I see. That was quite educational.
Be careful, everyone. Watch out for the submarines...!
It's only right that I offer my gratitude to everyone who fought alongside me.
I see, because of my indecisiveness... I am terribly sorry for dragging everyone down...
Hanazuki is here to offer support!
Ngh... As long as the others are safe...
Commander, I do not wish to see you ostracized by anyone... But at this rate, I may not be able to do anything for you...
The sun is shining brightly, and it's another beautiful day outside. Commander, if you aren't busy, would you like to view the flowers with me?

It's embarrassing to admit it, but... I tried to pick up gardening several times but kept getting stuck because I couldn't decide what I wanted to grow... Commander, do you have any flowers that you're partial towards? I want to make up my mind this time!

Some flowers bloom all year long while others are fleeting and ephemeral. Some are purely ornamental, while others have therapeutic uses... Commander, do you like flowers that bloom dazzlingly, or those that bloom silently and out of view? ...Ah, sorry, I'm not making any sense...

Commander, I hope this is not too presumptuous of me, but may I decorate your office with some fresh flowers? I want to give you something that reminds you of me, even when I am absent... It's just a little selfish whim of mine, hehe~

I see that while my heart was still wavering, you've already made up yours. Then, I won't hesitate to reciprocate your feelings either... Hanazuki will gladly accept this ring. I'm so glad that I can be someone who is important to you...
Thank you very much! This means so much to me!
Anti-sub, anti-air patrol, be careful!
How does your garden fare today?

ex.line: You've been working hard, Commander. The next thing I should be doing is... Ah, um, first, let's start by organizing the resources!

This month's flower... and to combine that with some seasonal picks... but I can't just slap them all together like this. I'll have to narrow it down a bit more... Commander, wh-what do you think about this?
Commander, I prepared something special for you today... Umm, it's jasmine tea! I chose it because it's supposed to bring good luck, but...
Niizuki is fun to talk to, but... why does she act that way when around people who aren't her relatives...?
Ah...! Commander, um... It's not that you can't, but... at least give me some time to mentally prepare myself...
Commander, the next task is... H-how about this one?
Welcome back, Commander. I followed Oyashio's advice and changed my ornamental flowers around a little. Is it to your liking?
Commander, have you been watering the flowers in the office? ...It's important to me, because it gives me something to remember you by when you aren't here.

lines.line: I've heard some say that summer is the season of cherry blossoms, lotus petals, and sunflowers, but... If you ask me, being able to leisurely enjoy the breeze with you feels pretty good too. Hehe~
I've heard some say that summer is the season of cherry blossoms, lotus petals, and sunflowers, but... If you ask me, being able to leisurely enjoy the breeze with you feels pretty good too. Hehe~
Today may be my day off, but if there is anything I can do for you, please do not hesitate to call upon me.
Even though it's the same sea as always, watching the clouds with you while wearing this unusual outfit is filling me with novel sensations I've never felt before...
Look, Commander, that coral reef... Hehehe, the "flowers" in the sea are quite beautiful as well, aren't they?
This swimsuit... took a lot of agonizing over, but I eventually made my decision... Commander, what do you think? Does it look good on me?
Gah...! ...Ah, s-sorry! I was just looking at the ocean... and suddenly shifted into anti-submarine mode... I know I shouldn't be so uptight during time off!
Do you need me to lend you a swim ring?
Eek?! Ehh?! S-sorry! Ah, um, Commander, the strap is...
Are you weary, Commander? If so, why not try some of my lavender honey tea? It's great for recovering from fatigue.
What kinds of flowers should I decorate the office with for the Lunar New Year...? Ugh, I just can't decide! Um, Commander, will you be inspecting the interior? I'll show you around! Phew...
What kinds of flowers should I decorate the office with for the Lunar New Year...? Ugh, I just can't decide! Um, Commander, will you be inspecting the interior? I'll show you around! Phew...
Please tell me which tasks you'd like to start with, and which events you'd like to attend.
The floral patterns on the Dragon Empery's dresses are so pretty... How should I thank Miss Aurora for picking out such a wonderful selection?
The entire port is filled with the gentle aroma of fresh flowers~ Even though it's not quite spring yet, doesn't this holiday carry a bit of that longing for the early arrival of spring?
Hibiki, and Kasumi? Wh-what's the matter...? Recommended events? Um, um... errr... C-Commander, help me...
Commander... *blushes*
Commander, um... N-nevermind! It's nothing...!
Zzz... Nnh... Hwah?! C-Commander? I'm so sorry, I must've fallen asleep while waiting for you...
Everyone in the commission fleet has returned. I've prepared some gifts for them... Oh, should I set off some firerackers first?
Let us ring in the new year with a splendid victory!
Yuugumo-class destroyer number four - Naganami.

I'm Naganami, fourth ship of the Yuugumo class. During the War, I was primarily involved in transport operations, but I did participate in some large-scale operations and even served as flagship. Any hardship on the battlefield can be overcome as long as you believe in one another... I just know it!

So this place is the port? Huh... Oh, Commander! I'm the fourth ship of the Yuugumo class, Naganami. It's a pleasure to finally meet you! Um... what's my selling point... Love! I love you, and everyone else as well!
Welcome back, Commander! Um, Naganami will always be waiting for you right here! That's because, well... I'm happiest when I'm by your side!
I give off warm and fuzzy vibes? Ehehe, I've heard that from the others as well~ It's a little embarrassing... Nuh uh, I don't mind at all. I'm really glad to hear it!
Jintsuu is always so knowledgeable and reliable... I wish I could be just like her...
Commander, can you let me be flagship next time? I'll work even harder, for the sake of everyone's happiness!

Lately, everyone has been circulating rumors that hugging me or cuddling my tail has healing properties, like coming out of a bath. They're even saying that it can cure colds... There's no way that's true, right?!
I'm more than just a ball of fluff, you know? Look, it's my smile and my ability to bring warmth to others that counts~
C-Commander, it's still work hoursss...
I can probably help out with transport missions, but as for other tasks... By the way, Commander, I see you tackling all sorts of different missions every day! That's really amazing!
Mission complete! Great work today! Come, come, don't be shy - come rest on this big fluffy pillow!
Commander, new mail has arrived. Here, I brought it for you. Maybe someone brought good tidings!
Commander, good job in battle! Hurry, come sit over here~ I'm going to give your shoulders a nice rub!
Commander, everyone in the commission fleet has come home. I'm sure they're all tired, so I'll go give them a warm hug!
The feeling of warmth and safety... this is what it feels like to get stronger... Commander, thank you very much!
I'm the flagship? All right, just leave it to me!
I didn't even realize I got MVP... But, this was only possible because of everyone's hard work!
I'll have to work much harder if I want to become an ideal flagship...
Try this torpedo strike on for size!
My friends are still fighting, so I can't afford to go down here!
Commander, if there's anything bothering you, please let me know. I'll be waiting for you... as long as it takes...
Everyone in the Mutsuki class is super fluffy and cute! Being at this port makes me so happy~!
My tail is warm and fluffy, but Wakaba's is shinier in comparison... Hatsushimo's is slender, and Shimakaze's is tiny... Um, there are all different sorts!

Oyashio taught me a little trick! If I remember properly, it goes a little like... this! This circle on your forehead is supposed to make you luckier when it comes to your love life, and also helps you become happier!
Still not enough good fortune in your life? ...You leave me no other choice then! Even if you have bad luck, there's a way to compensate for it! I just have to pass it to you directly... Mmwah~

Um... Commander, I thought we had grown a lot closer, but this still feels a bit awkward... Wh-what should I do? ...Ah! Commander, try hugging my tail! I'm sure its warmth and fluffiness will help you loosen up! Mhm!
You're giving something this wonderful to me...? Thank you so much, Commander!
When we work together, the 2nd Torpedo Squadron will never lose!
It's an honor to fight at your side!
Akashi pushed me into getting this outfit, saying that it would surely make you happy, but... What do you think...?
Akashi pushed me into getting this outfit, saying that it would surely make you happy, but... What do you think...?
I'll do my best to bring happiness to everyone at port, Commander! Just believe that one day, this place will be filled with happiness!
I want to be a maid who can bring happiness to everyone! ...I'm going to have to work even harder to make that happen...
This is the first time I've made sweets by hand. Commander, how are they? You'd like to have some more? Of course! I'll make them for you right away!
Let's emulate the Royal Maids and form the Maids of the 2nd Torpedo Squadron! What do you think, commander?
"Just spotting Naganami immediately causes one's mood to improve?" ...More weird rumors are circulating again... But if you believe that, Commander... Hehehe, I guess I'll believe it too!
Being able to go about business as usual in this kind of outfit is no easy feat... Real maids are truly something...
Commander, at least let me set the tray down first! Eek! It's going to fall!
Commander... Um, I mean, Master! Welcome back! Whether you want to enjoy some refreshments, or take a nap on my tail... either way is fine!
Commander, your entire body is radiating happiness - I can smell it! Huh? You want to try smelling my happiness? Um, in that case, come a bit closer... Even closer...
There's still some time before the banquet begins, and I'm afraid I'm feeling a little sleepy... W-would you mind if I took a nap? Thank you...
There's still some time before the banquet begins, and I'm afraid I'm feeling a little sleepy... W-would you mind if I took a nap? Thank you...
Commander, did you come just to see me...? Ohh, for the first thing I see when I wake up to be you... I must be dreaming...!
You feel a sense of relief when you see me? I'm not quite sure what you mean by that, but I'm glad that you're happy...
My tail is fluffy and warm, and you can even use it as a blanket... At least, that's what Oyashio and the others keep saying. Would you like to give it a try, Commander?
Commander, whenever I gaze at you, whenever I talk to you, I feel so at ease that I could go to sleep... Hm? You feel the same way about me?
This outfit feels a bit tight around the chest... Um, Commander, p-please don't stare at me so much...
It's not time for the party yet...? Then, um, let's stay like this for a bit longer...
*pant* *pant*...
Commander, your missions are of utmost importance... Mm, so I'll wait for you right here...
Great job on finishing your mission, Commander! Um, ahem! Don't you want to cuddle up with my big, fluffy tail...?
We've got new mail. I'm sure it's good news.
Do you like it when I massage your back with my feet like this, Commander? ...Not in that sense? I see... I don't really get it though...
Commander, our friends have returned from their commission. Sh-should we head down to welcome them back?
I, I'll do my best...!
Commander, are you happy? ...I don't mean like in general, but... like, when we're together... Um... As for me, when it's just the two of us, I feel amazingly happy...♡
I wanted to help you relieve some stress, so I thought I would read some folk tales to you... When I mentioned that, Akashi suggested these clothes to me... Wh-what do you think?
I wanted to help you relieve some stress, so I thought I would read some folk tales to you... When I mentioned that, Akashi suggested these clothes to me... Wh-what do you think?
Tonight, I'll be putting all my heart into reading, all for your sake!
The sound of my voice puts you at ease? Th-that's great... it was worth practicing ahead of time!
...The end. Commander, for the next story, should I try speaking in a softer voice... Huh? Commander? Looks like you've already fallen asleep, hehe.
I wanted to surprise you, so I'll be reading one of my personal favorites to you today. If there's something you want to listen to next time, please let me know, and I'll have it ready!
You want me to read the next story? S-sure, I'd love to!
I-I'm going to lose my place...!
No more~ No matter how much you want to keep listening to the story, you need to prioritize your missions first!
You've finished your missions! Good job with them. Since you held tight and worked hard to complete them, I've prepared lots of rewards for you~
Oh, there's some new mail for us! ...I wonder if it's the storybooks I had ordered.
Commander, good work! I'm ready for you as well. Well then, um, let's get started. Ahem... A long, long time ago...
Commander, the girls are back from their commissions! I'll head out to greet them!
It's time for me to get serious...!
Commander? You stopped eating. Does it taste too bitter...? Oh no, if you don't like the chocolate I made, I... I-I can still make you happy in other ways!
Commander? You stopped eating. Does it taste too bitter...? Oh no, if you don't like the chocolate I made, I... I-I can still make you happy in other ways!
Fluffy, fluffy... D-does my tail feel good? Does it make you happy?
Why am I dressed like this? Well, I can already make you all mine by wrapping you up with my tail, so I thought I should give myself to you in return...
Commander, umm, can you breathe okay? You've been wrapped up in there for a while now, so if you can't... Y-you're fine? Okay!
Ah. Are you not eating your chocolate because of my smell... Hm? It's more of a visual problem?
After you touch my tail, can I have another hug? I-I'm nice and warm, so you'll be as comfy as can be!
Fluff to your heart's content...
Do you feel so warm and fuzzy that you might... melt in my arms?
Good work today, Commander! Before you taste your chocolate, taste me first! Umm... I-I just meant I wanted a hug...
Whether it's chocolates or my tail, I'll use anything to make you happy! No, not just things - if using my own body and soul will do the trick, then I'll do it... I love you, Commander♡
Now that the big day is here, I'm awfully nervous... I-I'll be in your care now and forever, okay?
Now that the big day is here, I'm awfully nervous... I-I'll be in your care now and forever, okay?
It's amazing how happy I am just to be with you forever. Commander, let's enjoy another blissful day together!
I'm by your side. Always have been, always will be. Your happiness is my happiness, Commander.
I've never done the san san kudo ceremony before. I hope I don't mess it up...
My white kimono looks lovely? Why, thank you. I'll cherish the memory of it for all my life.
Moving is rather difficult when I have to worry about my tail and the train... Heehee! That's another fond memory to look back on.
You want to hold hands, don't you? I'd be happy to!
If you want to cuddle up with me and my tail, then...I don't mind. Indulge yourself.
It's time for a mission. I will naturally assist you. After all, finishing it early means more quality time with you!
Well done on another completed mission! Now we can spend some time together, just the two of us.
Welcome home...d-dear! Calling you that now is still a little embarrassing!
For the happiness of those we love!
In sickness and in health... No! You are already happy now, Commander, so... Healthy times aside, I don't know about... I-I'm sorry! Forget it, umm... Let's just be together forever!
Renown-Class Battlecruiser - HMS Renown

I am the battlecruiser Renown, and I was training in Govan before coming here! Being able to weigh anchor ahead of schedule is a testament to my strength... Indeed! I will do my utmost to live up to everyone's expectations!
The Renown-class battlecruiser Renown has come to join your ranks! My stature may be small, but my desire to succeed is great!
Commander, Renown is awaiting your orders! Please issue today's commands!
There are many things that I do not understand in the Codex of the Royal Knights! Commander, can you offer me any guidance?
As long as Renown is here, no harm shall befall you, Commander!
The serious and dedicated Little Renown is cute? I see, I'll be sure to pass on the message to... wait, what?
It's not just you. Everyone here at port is truly amazing... I must redouble my efforts...!
Myahh?! Wh-what are you doing?!
Candy? I'll have you know, Commander... Renown has no use for such things!
Commander! That's in violation of Royal etiquette!
Commander, please allow Renown to handle the missions! H-huh? Commander, you're doing them all yourself?!
Heave-ho... C-Commander, the m-mission rewards are... wooooahhhh!!
This one's for you, Commander. This one's also for you... and this one too...
You're not too bad, Commander... If Renown also works harder, will she be able to... be like you one day?
Commander! The commission fleet will return to port in ten minutes! Please... Wait, did I get the time wrong...?
For the Commander's sake, I'm ready... to become stronger!
Royal Navy, search and destroy!
I've done it...! Wait, no! The books clearly teach that it is foolish to gloat over a single victory! Self control... self control...!
My apologies, Commander...
The enemy shall never see my back turned!
Renown shall break your lines!
Commander, please get your act together! Renown shall not abandon you!
I mustn't neglect my training or my studies... I'll do my utmost each day so that I may become a proper knight. Commander, do you want to follow this path as well?
Work is important, but taking breaks is also important! Coming from a Royal Knight, you're overworking yourself! After you finish this, please make sure to get some rest!
Commander, why did the knights in that book betray their own king? Renown is nothing like those knights! I would never betray you even if it cost me my life!
So, Commander, is it fine for Renown to always stay here? Being close to you gives me strength, and above else, my love for you is absolute! ...Huh? Did I say something weird...?

A promise ring? I know about this! Um, "I pledge to defend the weak and act with valor..." Oh, all I have to do is read this? Well then... "through thick and thin, we shall share our pain and willingly give love eternal." ...Commander, does that sound right?
Thank you very much, Commander! I shall treasure this!

ex.line: Commander, Renown has free time today and is standing by! Please give me your orders! ...Something other than "go play," please!
Commander, today's reading is not on the Royal Knights? Aww... Well, if you recommend it, I'll gladly read it!
I'm not... sleepy... at all... Commander, I'll... protect you... Zzz... My eyes...
I'm really cute? ...Um, Commander, I'm glad to receive your praise, but I'd rather be complimented on my abilities rather than my looks!
Renown has no need for a sugar rush at this time... B-but, maybe just one piece of candy...!
Leave the preparations to Belfast, and the combat reports to me! Such are the duties of the maid and the knight, yes!

lines.line: Vauquelin-class destroyer - Tartu.

I am Tartu of the Vichya Dominion. During the war, I was assigned to the Mediterranean and joined the fight against the Royal Navy. At Toulon, the others and I were... No, I can't get caught up about the past. The important thing is what's now in front of us! That's what Vauquelin would say, hehe.
Good day, Commander. I'm Tartu of the Vauquelin-class. ...Huh? Oh, I'm so sorry, I got caught up in thinking about how large the port is...
Commander, good day...... Oh, I was deep in thought about why you hadn't shown up yet...
The motherly Dunkerque, the elegant Algérie, and Lady Richelieu... They all represent the pinnacles of womanhood. I must strive to be more like them.
Commander, do you think I can grow up to become a mature, caring woman like Dunkerque?
Vauquelin, about the donuts last time... Oh, you already heard about that? ...Sorry, I must have gotten lost in my thoughts again...
Vauquelin is really athletic. Getting tired from exercising, resting, and getting hungry... Oh, sorry, I started thinking about Dunkerque's sweets...
Commander, regarding what you asked me earlier... Eh? You've already taken care of it? I, I see...
According to the book Vauquelin recommended me, what I should do in this situation is... gather the evidence, and... detain the offender?
How should we spend the rewards from last time... Oh, we have new missions?
Mission complete. Should I arrange the report based upon priority, completion time, payout, or... Mmm...
Ah, um... Right, Commander, I came to bring you the mail.
Hmm... What would be the optimal way to welcome back the Commander...
The commission has been completed. Sorry, Commander, I forgot to tell you...
I feel like... I've become stronger.
Focus, focus...!
......Oh, sorry, who got MVP again? Oh, it was me?
Hmm... I knew I should have aimed a bit more to the left on that last shot... Oh, I'm sorry... I should be retreating right now...!
The right thing to do in this situation is... this!
...Eep! I've got to stay focused...
Commander, please be quiet. I can't even hear my own thoughts over your ruckus...

Ow...! Ugh, where did that tree branch come from... Oh, Commander, good morning. I'm... Mm, I'm fine. I just got lost in my thoughts while I was walking. Don't worry, this kind of stuff happens all the time.
Listen up, me, if I keep overthinking everything, I won't notice what's going on around me... and then won't be able to become a mature and compassionate woman...

Commander, you're always trying to follow my pace during conversations... Thank you. However, if I end talking to myself, feel free to snap me out of it. I won't get angry or embarrassed if it's you...
Nowadays, when I think about you, I end up even deeper in thought than ever... Ah! I'm so sorry... Just now, I...
Commander, do you like me as I am now? I also... like you a lot, but it feels like you're always looking after me... I'll do my best to grow up into someone who can look after you, Commander...!
How did you know... Did I end up talking out loud while thinking about this at some point?
Vauquelin, don't push yourself too hard.
Miss Dunkerque is with us... I-I'll have to do my best!

ex.line: Hello, Commander. Ah, um... I was just thinking about what to make for you to eat...
Commander, about that donut from earlier... Oh, I already asked you about it? ...Sorry, I was caught up thinking about other things and forgot...
Commander, would you like to read as well? I have lots of recommendations for you.
...Eek! Ah, I'm sorry, I got too absorbed into thinking about you...
Welcome back, Commander. Would you like me to give you a massage?
Who's the MVP? Um... Why's everyone looking at me...?
It's fine to always be thinking about you? In that case....... Huh? Didn't you just say it was fine...? I sometimes feel like I could just daydream about you forever...

lines.line: Commander, you're not going to get into the water? ...Ah, I'm fine right here. To tell you the truth, I once got washed away by the waves, and then got laughed at by Vauquelin... so I'm perfectly fine right here.
Oh, Commander, good day. Would you like some ice cream?
The book I last read took place on the beach, if I remember properly... It was a murder mystery on the beach, right?
McCall from the Eagle Union and Suffolk from the Royal Navy seem to get along really well. The two of them are pretty funny, hehe.
Vauquelin, I'm not going into the water. I'll just spend a nice, peaceful day on the beach like this.
Commander, aren't you going to change into a swimsuit? ...Um, I'm slightly curious, just a little...
Commander, what's wrong? The ice cream? ...Hyaa?!
Oh, speaking of letters... I'm so sorry, Commander, I got engrossed in our conversation and totally forgot...
I won't get washed away...!
I could really go for one of Dunkerque's donuts right about now...
Richelieu-class battleship - Richelieu.

I am Richelieu, the lead ship of the Richelieu class. During my history as a ship, I lived through good times and bad times, and I also witnessed the rise and fall of my homeland... This time, I hope to protect all that is dear to me up until the end. Together with this fleet, I strive for liberty and peace...
I am Richelieu, Cardinal of Iris Libre. If you too will fight for freedom and faith, then I shall bring you victory, Commander.
Bonjour, Commander. Please relax and drink this tea while I carry out my morning prayers.
Place your faith in me. Follow my lead. Offer up your prayers. Seek the Lord. Only then will the path of God be opened...
I believe that any obstacle can be overcome with fervent faith and untiring efforts.
Those round little creatures... If I recall correctly, Algérie told me they're called "Meowfficers."
Have I met the Royal Navy yet? Yes. I hope to deepen our bond, so I'm bringing some wine to the next tea party.
Please make use of my precious allies, the Iris Templar Knights, at your discretion. After all, one of their missions is to fight for peace.
The relationship between those from the Eagle Union and those from the Iris Libre is a bit... Well, I get the feeling that Jean Bart would get along with them just fine, though.
May Heaven confer upon you its blessings.
Please listen to our prayers closely, Commander.
If nothing else, your audacity is commendable.
Missions may be called a kind of trial. If you take them on with the proper attitude, there is no need to worry.
The reward for those who work hard is Heaven's grace. Let us accept it gratefully.
Letters are blessings from other people.
Mission complete. The fleet has safely returned to the port. Good work, Commander.
I'd like to report that the commissions have been safely completed, and that fleet operations are running smoothly. You've done a good job, Commander.
At times, might is needed to guide others on the right path. I give you my thanks.
All ships, prepare for combat! For liberty and glory! Aux armes, marchons!
May the wandering souls drifting about the battlefield find eternal peace and salvation... Amen...
Is this... also a trial from Heaven...?
Accept your divine judgment!
There is... still hope...!
Those who refuse to stop marching shall face the path of ruin... Make sure you keep that in mind.

The one you are talking to was once despisingly called many things: the calamity that brought on war, the fearsome Cardinal, and the maniac possessed by religious fervor. I ask of you: when you look at me, what do you see in me?

Commander, please have a seat. What would you like to drink? ...There's no need to be on guard. Even someone like me lives an ordinary life when not on duty or performing religious rites. A person cannot live on faith alone. Sometimes, you just need a drink or two. Hehe.
You've come by again. Haven't you been getting too friendly with me? ...Just kidding. I'm truly grateful to have another person that I can chat casually with. I hope that you feel the same way, too.

The feeling of distance between people is an interesting thing indeed. A superior officer and their subordinate. The leader of a fleet and the highest post of the organization. A warship and... Hehe. For the time being, let's let the others continue misunderstanding our relationship, okay?
As the one who guides Iris Libre, I cannot make an oath solely to you. However, I vow to protect and support you for as long as I live. This, I vow, on the holy name of Iris...
This is for ME? Merci beaucoup, hehe.
As long as we have Heaven's divine protection, we have nothing to fear!
It seems that we fight together once again.
Please fight to your heart's content. I have your back.
Brethren! Assemble under the banner of righteousness!
Bring down judgment upon the nonbelievers.

ex.line: Bonjour, Commander. Please relax and enjoy this tea while I finish my morning prayers.

I meet with Jean Bart every once in a while. We don't talk much, and simply focus on whatever we're doing at the moment. Even so, I feel like we understand each other very well. It's something to be happy about.
The practice of faith is not an easy path to walk. Discipline is required for enlightenment, and the path is sometimes accompanied by suffering and even self-sacrifice.
Commander, I have a question. Is there a way to get these "Meowfficers" to like me as much as they like being cuddled by you?
Please, do not forget. The warriors from Vichya are also Iris Libre's brethren.
It's time for worship. Please wait here patiently.
If you would like to touch me, I would prefer it if you took a different approach.
Welcome back. Thanks to you, everyone's safe and sound. I'm truly grateful.
Whether you or I care more for the other is inconsequential. I feel more than happy enough just feeling our close bond together like this. Thank you for always being by my side.

lines.line: This swimsuit... Yes, the one Émile picked out for me, seems a bit skimpy... I didn't think she'd be the type to trick me into wearing something like this, but... Commander, where are you looking?
This swimsuit... Yes, the one Émile picked out for me, seems a bit skimpy... I didn't think she'd be the type to trick me into wearing something like this, but... Commander, where are you looking?
Scenery that calms the heart... Commander, you've got good taste.

Iris' teachings do not go as far as to forbid its followers from spreading their wings. Let us enjoy today with everyone to our heart's content. Consider this as yet another of Heaven's many blessings.
Commander, I'll be heading to the beach for a bit. ... Hehe. Indeed, this is a bit different from how I am usually. Would you like to come along with me?
Frozen treats are most effective against hot and humid weather like this... Shall we ask Dunkerque to prepare some more next time?
Jean Bart... Perhaps it's better to spend some more time with her... Sigh...
My... Where are you taking me, Commander?
If you know what's good for you, I wouldn't assume that a girl is defenseless just because she's in a swimsuit.
I don't wish for my absence to become a burden on you, Commander. If there's anything I can help with, please let me know.
We have a really good view from up here. I can even see a commission group starting to return out there.

Walking together on the beach like this while basking our ears in the sounds of the sea... Agréable. Hehehe, this is quite a rare experience. Commander ... Thanks for being with me. I'll cherish this moment.

Commander, I wish you a Happy New Year. May you avail yourself of the period of repose that follows the culmination of the year's duties. I pray that you and everyone else may receive the blessing of the Heavens.

Commander, I wish you a Happy New Year. May you avail yourself of the period of repose that follows the culmination of the year's duties. I pray that you and everyone else may receive the blessing of the Heavens.
It looks like you went out to take a glimpse of the morning sun. I look forward to being in your company today, Commander.
Believe, atone, and pray. Seek a new day... that you may grasp hold of your happiness, and the road to the light.
What these fortunes tell may be your fate. Even so, is it not mankind's strength to overcome fate?
Shh. Lower your voice. I'm trying to get this one to warm up to Jean Bart.
Béarn, is it already time? ...Yes, I made a promise earlier to visit the shrine with everyone else. How would you like to come with us?
You'd like to sit by my side? Up we go... Good kitty... Alright, here you go, Commander.
Is this a greeting... for the New Year?
So this is what the Sakura Empire's New Year's greeting cards look like... How interesting. Hehehe.
Please calm down and ponder what we should do. I'll be waiting right over here.
It seems the commissions team made it back safely. This counts as good fortune, doesn't it?

Settle down. Let us pray together. If I listen to your prayers and you listen to mine, you will come to understand that we are heading toward the same goal. Let us walk toward the light. You and I, together...
Light cruiser - Jeanne d'Arc.

Even though I had previously been a training cruiser in charge of raising excellent warriors, I am now standing at the front lines for my country with sword in hand. I pledge my all for my beloved homeland!
If you are familiar with the name I have been entrusted with, then you should also understand my noble calling. Jeanne d'Arc of Iris Libre is now under your command.
May the port be ever blessed with our Lord's grace.
Jeanne d'Arc... While this name imparts a heavy responsibility, I refuse to run away from it. After all, bearing that burden is my duty.
Saint Michael, I beseech you - please tell me what I should do next...
My name, my weapons, and my rigging. All are testament to my conviction.
If you're tired, you should rest. Battles should not compose your entire existence.
Is there something bothering you?
I-is this what you're into, Commander?
Commander, there must still be some unfinished business you need to attend to.
There is more value to mission than just the rewards.
Commander, you've received some mail. Please look through it.
The flames of war have yet to be extinguished. It's time to redouble our efforts.
Everyone's returned safely. Praise be to the Lord!
My burning spirit, become my strength!
Brave soldiers, follow my lead!
This still isn't enough to fulfill our duty... No. Everyone, you've all done great!
No, I can't stop here...
The Lord's blessings upon the Iris Libre!
The situation is dire... Everyone, stay in formation!
...If you are a demon, I will not hesitate to cut you down with my sword... If if is just that you have strayed from the righteous path, then repent, now!
If thorns block my path, I will clear a way. If flames obstruct my path, I will overcome them. I will not let any obstacle keep me from walking the path of God!
This blade does not exist to be wielded for my sake. I wield this blade for you, my homeland of Iris Libre, and for all in the fleet...
My dream is to lead everyone to victory while bearing a banner. However, victory is something that cannot be achieved alone. For that purpose, I need the help of my allies, and you, Commander.
Commander... The more burdens I bear, the more I cannot allow myself to rest. That's why, for a little bit... just for a little bit... would you lend me your shoulder?

This is... how you feel...? I'm so happy. I also treasure you the most, Commander. Um, you see... I'm not really sure what we're supposed to do together, but... first, would you like to try being pampered by me, Commander?
I'd almost forgotten something that I once loved so dearly... Thank you, Commander.
My comrade, may you also receive our Lord's blessings!

ex.line: Commander, may God's blessings be upon you.
In comparison to someone like me, Cardinal Richelieu... is a true saintess. N-no, I'm not jealous at all.
As you always have done, please, continue to protect everyone in the Iris Libre, the port, and the Commander...!
...E-eh? Commander's documents... Oh no... How could I make such a mistake!

If you're tired, you should get some rest. If you don't rest, then I can't rest peacefully, either... After all, it'd be inconceivable for the secretary ship to rest before the Commander! A-anyway, please get some rest first.
I-it sparkles, so please don't touch it too much.
D-don't touch me there!
One who is bestowed the Iris' power must always be humble. We must take care to not let ourselves be swayed by the outcome of a single battle, Commander.

lines.line: "O chosen hero, I bestow this sword upon you so that you may clear any obstacles in your path..." Commander, how did that sound?
"O chosen hero, I bestow this sword upon you so that you may clear any obstacles in your path..." Commander, how did that sound?
Commander, shall we get started? I'm all ready.
To think that there was such a wonderful movie set at the port... What a surprise.
I know you told me to rest when we take breaks, but... my, how should I put it... I'm really enjoying this work!
There's a dream I have from time to time... I dream of what it would be like to cruise freely about the sea, using only my divine powers to do so, though I as a ship do not deserve such freedom.
Com...mander. Commander. Is something the matter? You've been zoning out while looking at me. By the way, I require your assistance. Would you please come over here?
When we wrap up this job, do I want to go to the beach? Yes! I'd love to go to the beach with you!
Oh, Commander, would you like to release a lantern? I hear they're a way to send wishes into the heavens above... May our Lord bless our companions and bring peace and joy to all.
Oh, Commander, would you like to release a lantern? I hear they're a way to send wishes into the heavens above... May our Lord bless our companions and bring peace and joy to all.
Pray that our wishes and blessings become eternal and protect everything we hold dear...
You want to know what I wrote on my lantern? Heehee, they say that wishes don't come true if you tell others what they are. For now, it stays a secret.
May the fireworks and lanterns above carry my wishes to protect everyone... and to protect you.
Goodness, it's that late? I didn't notice. It's practically as bright as daytime, after all.
I can put down my sword for today...? "As long as you don't forget your duty, occasional rest is perfectly fine," you say? Hmm... I understand. Thank you, Commander.
I know I don't normally dress like this... Is it too different?
The petals are falling on you. U-umm, would you like to come under my umbrella?
H-here, of all places?!
You mustn't forget your duty, even on days of celebration. I'll help you.
Your missions are all complete. Now we can relax a little.
Commander, you return. Did your mission go smoothly? Good... Glory to the Holy Spirit for answering my prayers.
I put up all of these lanterns, each bearing a different wish of mine. Yes, I know that I must be on my guard against all kinds of greed, but... What is a wish, if not something I want to be granted?
Algérie-class heavy cruiser - Algérie.

I'm the flagship of the Vichya's First Cruiser Fleet, Algérie of the Templar Knights. In my history as a ship... I was called the best-designed treaty cruiser. Accordingly, I've been through plenty of interesting escapades... Hehehe. How do you feel about me, Commander?
Bonjour. From today, this heavy cruiser of the Vichya Dominion shall now be serving at this port. It's a pleasure to meet you, hehe. If it's not too much to ask, I hope that we can get along well.
We're on great terms after all. I would've been fine waiting a bit longer.
When it comes to history, relying on second-hand accounts is not enough to sift fact from fiction. You must conduct your own research.
Even if I don’t have any honors or decorations, my strength can speak for itself.
Oh, Commander. How about enjoying some wine with me later? Hehe, only after you finish up the rest of your work though, alright?
Gold...? Oh, were you interested in that story? Hehehe. At that time, the Iris were...
My hobby is touring cat cafés, but this port doesn't... Oh, that's right. Even at this port, there are plenty of adorable creatures... Yes, how lovely!
The Royal Navy are now allies who fight together with us. Furthermore... even yesterday's enemies are today's allies. What an interesting life this has been... Hehehe.
Are you trying to see if I have a fever...?
Oh my, did you want to slack off for a bit? Hehe, I won't tell anyone else, so take some time off, okay?
Commander~? No matter how nice the other person may be, you shouldn't get too carried away. Hehe.
We've just received a new directive from the higher-ups. Oh? It seems that you're just as busy as always... As much as I'd like to do some of this work in your stead, I suppose I wouldn't be able to?
Have you finished the mission? Good work. Please leave the report to me and go get some rest.
Reading a letter allows you to peek into the hidden heart of the person who sent it... Hehehe, how exciting! Here, Commander, some new mail's come in for you.
Good work planning out the operation, Commander. How would you like some freshly brewed coffee?
The girls from the commission team have come back. I wonder if I can guess which girl's carrying the most important goods?
Shattering the confines of the treaty... is rather pleasurable. Hehehe~
It'd be nice if the battle goes the way we want it to.
If only you realized the situation you were in a little sooner, you might've been able to avoid this outcome... but what can you do at this point?
It seems that I lost... But don't worry, Commander. Let's prepare carefully and try again.
It's too late to run~
I'm telling you, the constraints of the treaty are still too suffocatingly restrictive...
Oh, Commander. I've been looking into the documents that need to be prepared for your formal retirement. Are you ready to start the process?
Are you a bit scared of me? Hehe, don't worry, Commander. I wouldn't harm an ally.

Commander, won't you drink a little with me? Are you perhaps bad at holding your alcohol? That's alright. Just take a little sip, like this... and try slowly tasting it with your throat... That's it... Don't you taste it?... The cool, rich flavor of maturity.
You know, I actually really, really like cute things. Those trinkets, those squishy furballs, making sweets... Hehe, don't you think it's nice for an adult to enjoy cute things?

Commander... would you like to rely on me? ...If it's you, I'd be happy to let you rely on me, and I'd always be supporting you from your side. Hehe, in exchange... I hope you'll show me just how much you can achieve, with me by your side.
Thank you. Henceforth, I vow to dedicate my whole heart and body to you. Together, let us enjoy - slowly and surely - just how sweet our future will be. My partner, my beloved...
Thank you for this gift. I love it, hehehe.
There's nothing to fear. The Vichya Dominion rises up to face any crisis.
We've finally got a chance to compete, Zara. Wanna see who's better?
Hehe, what a nice smell. Will you let me tag along for a bit?

ex.line: Welcome back, dear. What will you start working on first?
Oh, Commander. ...Next time I'm off duty, I'm planning on checking out a sushi train with Dunkerque. Of course, you're welcome to join me. Hehehe.
Commander, is there anything you'd like for dinner today? Something other than dinner...? Oh my, how bold~ ...That's something you can look forward to later♪
Whether it's during work or in your daily life, it's no good to be too strict on yourself. Make sure you rest properly when you have the time, alright?
Hmm~ How is this one thiiiis cute... That's right. I'll have to show this to Miss Richelieu next time. Hehehe~.
My my, do you want to be pampered like a child today?
There's no reason to be so impatient, right? Hehehe♡
We've just received a new directive from the higher-ups. Oh? It seems that you're just as busy as always... As much as I'd like to do some of this work in your stead, I suppose I wouldn't be able to?
Dear, you've got some new mail. I wonder if I should try my hand at writing some love letters myself. Hehehe.
You look really tired... Darling, you shouldn't push yourself too hard. Please, leave this to me and go lie down for a bit.
Oh no, I lost... I'm sorry for letting you down...

Love, how are the plans for our next date looking? Oh, I know that the destination's basically decided upon. More than that, I was thinking things like... where we'll eat dinner, or where we'll stay. We have to plan out everything carefully so we can enjoy the date that much more!

lines.line: Oh my, hehe... Are you enjoying the warmth of the sunlight here? I'm glad that you're finding some time to relax here, but wouldn't you rather come play with everyone else?
Oh my, hehe... Are you enjoying the warmth of the sunlight here? I'm glad that you're finding some time to relax here, but wouldn't you rather come play with everyone else?
Even if you've already applied some sunscreen, you still need to take care to not get sunburns.
Hehehe. Commander, it seemed like you enjoyed being surrounded by so many cute girls. Who caught your attention the most?
Here, a sun cap. If you want to play out on the beach, please make the proper preparations against the sun's rays first.
A beach volleyball match between the Vichya and Royal Navy... Sounds fun. How about watching it together?
Writing words on the beach and waiting for the waves to wash them away... Hehe, seems like it'd be fun~ What shall we write?
Sigh... It's seriously quite hot... Commander, don't push yourself, you hear? Please let me know if you start to feel worse.
You want some coconut juice...? Alright, wait there for now. I'll bring some over.
Huh?! I wonder, do these clothes make the Commander more impertinent...?
Wine... would be a little bit out of place here. Hehe. Commander, will some tropical juice suffice?
Commander, if I buried you in the sand neck-down, you wouldn't be able to move, and I'd be able to do whatever I want to you~ Hehehe, I'm joking. Or, would you like to do that to me? Hehehehe.

Oh my, it seems that the one who ended up coming wasn't little Alice, but you instead... Do you plan to defy me as well, Commander? If so, I'll have to put you on trial for your sins... How was my acting just now? Hehe~

Oh my, it seems that the one who ended up coming wasn't little Alice, but you instead... Do you plan to defy me as well, Commander? If so, I'll have to put you on trial for your sins... How was my acting just now? Hehe~
You're finally here, Commander. Have you decided how you'll continue the plot?
The Cheshire Cat? A bit foul-mouthed, but still a good kitten nevertheless. Oh, considering my current role, maybe I should be more annoyed?
It's quite troubling playing the role of a villain. Should I act in a way that people will like me, or in a way that people will hate me...?
The rabbit who's supposed to lead the way in the story ended up getting lost in the set... Commander, shouldn't you go help that little'un?
Good triumphs over evil... In fairy-tale stories like this, there's no better ending than that. Like a storytale for pure, innocent children.
If you'd like to try your hand at being the "Evil Ruler," I'm perfectly willing to hand over the throne to you, hehehe.
Shall I call the soldiers? ...Just kidding, hehe.
Feeling tired? If you'd like a drink, I'll have one of the "little attendants" bring it over.
La Galissonnière-class light cruiser - La Galissonnière.

I was assigned to Vichya's "High Seas Force" back during the war, I think? Don't think I ever set sail though, due to fuel shortages... Y'know what? You're probably gonna get a quicker rundown if you just ask Dunkerque.
Vichya, Sardegna, Iron Blood... and now this place? Ah well, doesn't matter to me 'long as I get to have a good time. Anyway, I'm La Galissonnière from the Vichya Dominion. Nice meetin' you!
Finally! You're back! I thought I was gonna rust up from boredom while you were gone. Gimme a task, any task, and I'll do it.
You lookin' to have some fun? You mean with me, or my weapon?
Just sitting in the office, boooored out of my mind while the Commander goes ham on a ton of paperwork. *siiigh*...
If the goal's to beat the enemy, then what's wrong with me bashing them with my rigging? I swear, you fuss over the strangest stuff, Commander.
Can't say I'm keen on planning stuff... It's like, you make a plan, but it always changes, y'know?
Touch me all you want! As long as you don't mind getting hurt.
Listen, unlike a certain someone from the Templar Knights, "dirty work" is my specialty... Wanna know more?
These missions are a pain? Well, sorry to hear that? I can't exactly do 'em for you, y'know.
You finished a mission? Cool, that's quicker than I expected. Maybe I underestimated you, Commander.
Here, letter for you. Better read it now, 'cause it's not my problem if you lose it.
Sorry, nobody's permitted to enter the office while the Commander is out... Oh, hey, Commander! Obviously you can come on in!
Commission team's back, eh? Cool, then I'll go say hi since I've got nothing better to do.
Makes me look back on my days in Brest...
I'm lookin' for a fun time... Gimme one!
Ahaha! Now that was a lot of fun!
Oops, I've been beaten... Just let me fight another time!
Disappear!
Hell yeah! More of that! This is getting fun!
If you wanna quit being a commander, I could refer you to a decent new job.
Lookin' to be a boring day like any other...
I've got some of Dunkerque's handmade mousse cake! Here, have a slice. Nah, nah, don't thank me, thank the girl who made it!
Sure, we ships fire our guns and torpedoes all day, but it's fun to just have a chat about weapons now and then. Hit me up for that sometime, Commander! You seem like a cool person!
My opinion on you? Hmm, to tell you the truth, I kinda like you. You wanna hang out and do something fun sometime? I mean, we already have fun every day, but still!
You're just the kind of person I love, Commander! Hahahah! From now on, if anyone tries to mess with you, I'm gonna deal with 'em!
Oh, wow! How did you know I loved this?
Could you make me another mousse cake when we get back?
Cardinal, I march into battle beneath your banner.

ex.line: What are we doing today? Why don't you gimme something to do before I turn to rust?
You wanna know about "that" work? How do I say this... Let's just call it the "Inquisition?" What it means is... Hmm, I really can't tell you after all~♪
♪~Hey Commander, can you help me check if I sharpened this enough? I'm always afraid that I missed a spot or something...
Gotta say, I still prefer working under Jean Bart rather than Algérie. Y'know, it's that whole "don't worry about anything other than slaughtering your enemies" kind of feeling...
Hm? Hmmmmm? ...Mmm... Well, whatever~♪
There's not too much of "that" kind of work to do at this port, huh... Well, as long as the Iris girls are safe and sound here, then I can have fun without worrying about anything! Hehehe!

lines.line: Summertime means pool time! Oh, hey, Commander. What are you waiting for? Come over and let's have fun!
Summertime means pool time! Oh, hey, Commander. What are you waiting for? Come over and let's have fun!
I'm not gonna swim all day, so I'll just skip the warm-ups. Should be no biggie!
I'll throw the swim ring at you if you get close to drowning. Relax, knowin' you, I'm sure you'll catch it!
We don't really NEED to swim just 'cause we've got a pool, do we? Nothing wrong with just dipping our toes, you know.
Over here, Commander! Ka-splash! Ahahahah! Feelin' refreshed now?
Hmm... Feels a little weird, not having my hands full with something...
Whoa there, trying to startle me? Sadly for you, I saw that coming from miles away~
Ahahah. So you wanna practice holding your breath, is that it, Commander?
Could you throw me that ball, Commander? Merci~
Happy New Year, again! So, you wanna try sharing this "cross-cupped wine?" What, it's not a drinking game? Welp, I guess I've still got a whole ton to learn about the Dragon Empery's customs~
Happy New Year, again! So, you wanna try sharing this "cross-cupped wine?" What, it's not a drinking game? Welp, I guess I've still got a whole ton to learn about the Dragon Empery's customs~
You're leaving me out in the dust here, Commander! I'll die from sheer boredom if you won't hang out with me!
I dig the design of this Dragon Empery outfit. Uh, that's NOT an invitation for you to ogle me all you want, okay?
Got any red envelopes for me, Commander? Talk about lame, there's just money inside... I expected something that's like, more novel, and now I'm disappointed!
Get together with the extended family over New Year's, hang up fai chun decorations, aaand... what's left? Courtesy calls? Take me along, Commander! I won't embarrass you, pinky promise!
I know! Let's meet up and do festive stuff with Dunkerque!
