What's up? You thinkin' about finally introducing me to your family?
Watch it, or you'll make it come off!
You can feel the festival spirit everywhere you look! Isn't that nice?
If you ignore me, I'll use my black cat magic to turn you into a pumpkin! Is that Halloweeny enough? Ahahaha! I'm just messing! C'mon, let's go do somethin' fun tonight, Commander!
If you ignore me, I'll use my black cat magic to turn you into a pumpkin! Is that Halloweeny enough? Ahahaha! I'm just messing! C'mon, let's go do somethin' fun tonight, Commander!
You're back? Thought up a good spooky trick yet?
Sure are a lot of cat lovers around here. Algérie, Richelieu... Are you one too, Commander?
Uhh, Commander? If you're just gonna sit around, then I'll find someone else to hang out with.
Let's see what candy we're giving out! Hmm... You mind settin' this, this, and some of this aside just for me?
Putting on a costume and scaring people sounds pretty fun... So that's what Halloween's all about, huh? Makes my costume choice seem kinda out-of-place though...
Am I supposed to go "meeoow?"
This lingerie won't stop me from gettin' my hands dirty if I need to, y'know.
Trick or treat! ...Only kids go trick-or-treating? Who cares! Shut up and gimme candy!
Vauquelin-class destroyer - Vauquelin.

(I wanna give a cool self-introduction, but I don't have many exploits to my name... I did escort Dunkerque and Algérie, though that's not much...) Long story short: I'm Vauquelin from the Vichya Dominion! I've got more potential than you can imagine! C-cool, am I right?
Tadaah! Nameship of the Vauquelin-class large destroyers, Vauquelin, has arrived in style! Hey, what's so funny? I may not look strong, but I am! Um, probably!
So, Commander, didn't you promise you'd return with snacks for me? Uhh, what? We never made any promise like that?
Oh gosh! D-don't just appear outta nowhere, Commander... You'll scare people.
You look bored and in need of some relief, Commander. Perchance you would fancy a showcase of my lancing skill- Oh gosh, careful! You'll get hurt!
Can I ask you a favor, Commander? Well, I was hoping you could, uhh... leave out the bell peppers from my dinner tonight...
Aah, so it's like that, huh. I understand everything now. Let me take it on... NOT!
Ahehehehehehe~
What's up? Need me to do you a favor?
You're making me a bit uncomfortable, Commander...
A mission, you say? Hehehe! Finally, it's my time to shine!
Holy cow! Look, Commander! We got a huge bounty for that mission! O-oh, it's nothing out of the ordinary?
Mail? Oh, I'll go get it then!
For all your hard work, you deserve a headpat... Whuah! Spare me that expression of yours!
A commission's complete! Just F-Y-I! So yeah, let's go receive the returning team.
You're not gonna... dump additional work on me now, are you?
Witness the true might of a LARGE destroyer!
MVP! This calls for a celebratory cool pose... Uhh, why's everyone giving me funny looks?
Huh? You're asking for my opinion on what went wrong? Dunno, that's your job to find out, Commander!
I'm strong as heck! Probably!
Stay calm and wait for the right time...!
You know, I've learned something, Commander. People who can't introspect probably won't make many friends...
I got one of Miss Dunkerque's cakes! Oh boy, which one is it today? Think you could guess, Commander?

Something that's bothered me lately? Well, Tartu asked me for advice on becoming more ladylike, so I thoughtlessly recommended this detective novel I've been reading, and she apparently got hooked on reading it... It feels like that was a mistake, you know?

Whether I'm actually dumb or not doesn't matter, but sometimes I like pretending to be stupid. Then when I do something smart, people are gonna be like, "Whoa, you're a genius, Vauquelin!" That's how it goes! I mean... it does, right?

Plus, when you're playing dumb, you don't need to use your brain! It's refreshing to just not think about anything! Thus, when you enjoy yourself, others will, too! You should give it a try sometime, Commander!

Holy smokes... You really meant that thing the other day about getting married?! Well, not to say I took it as a joke, or didn't believe you, or anything... Uhh, I mean... Y-you get what I'm trying to say, right...?
Ooh. Did you strike it rich, Commander?
So Tartu, did you finish that book I lent you the other day?

ex.line: Hmm... So this is the commanderly feeling of sitting atop the commander's throne... Woahh?! When'd you get here?!
Let me show you the spear dance that puts even the knights to shame! ...Commander, do you really have to hide under the desk? I won't hurt you... Ah! Look out!
Let's throw out all those yucky vegetables! Yeah, all of them! Including yours too!
Th-this is a bit embarrassing...
Commander, we've got a boatload of rewards... No, an entire mountainload! Way more than usual!
Commander, as a reward, I'll give you a headpat! ...Ahaha, you don't need to act all bashful!
Commission... commmmplete! Yaayyy!! Commander, you don't have to follow along!
Number one! Clap, clap, everyone! Heheh, I'm super strong, after all!

Allll righty, what carefree adventures are we going to have today? ...Woahh?! Commander, why are you hugging me so suddenly? I, I don't mind if you want to fool around, but what if someone sees us... Ahhn?!

lines.line: Commandeeer! What are you doing? It's our day off! Turn the work part of your brain off and just have fun! C'mon, let's enjoy ourselves on the beach!
Commandeeer! What are you doing? It's our day off! Turn the work part of your brain off and just have fun! C'mon, let's enjoy ourselves on the beach!
Tartu's not gonna get washed away by a stray wave, I hope... Yeah, figured as much...
Everyone's looking so cute~! Woo~! Hm? I'M looking cute too...? W-woo~!
Isn't it great to just forget about work and have a good time~? But, uh, what's up with that Royal Knight over there? She's casually playing around too, even though she's still on duty...
Beach barbeque! Heck yeah! I'd love to grill some vegetables, but I'd rather someone else does the bell peppers!
Teehee~ Well? How do you like my swimsuit~? Yeah, I know, I'm flat in a few places...
I know I don't hold a candle to Tartu, but... Wait, what do you think you're doing?!
Yes, the strings... I can hear the celebratory melody... Now, follow my lead and we'll take this song to greater- Oh, Commander? What's all this, you ask? Uhh... You know... Ahahaha...
Yes, the strings... I can hear the celebratory melody... Now, follow my lead and we'll take this song to greater- Oh, Commander? What's all this, you ask? Uhh... You know... Ahahaha...
Check it out! Your favorite Vauquelin, now in a fancy dress! Also, good luck at work, Commander!
Wow, rude much, Commander and Tartu? Way to fall asleep during my performance! ...I mean, technically I wasn't personally performing... But still!
Gotta swing in rhythm to the music, like... Oh, Commander! Guess what? I've been getting tons of compliments on my conducting skills! Hehehe~!
Right-o! Now'd be a good time for a relaxing song! ...Wake up, Commander! You're sleeping on the job!
Got any requests? Like a song, or food, or even a thrilling chat with yours truly? Hehehe~
Bet you were imagining these were Tartu's knockers. Hmph.
Let us play a requiem! ...Hang on, that sounds familiar...
First place! Let's hear a victory song for me! Wait a sec... Where'd my orchestra go?
So yeah, I'm thinking it's time for me to scoot! Phew... Good thing I picked a non-cumbersome dress...
*crash*! Found another coin! Check it out, Commander! I got all these from smashing pots! ...Breaking the law? Heheh! The one law among thieves is that there are no laws♪
*crash*! Found another coin! Check it out, Commander! I got all these from smashing pots! ...Breaking the law? Heheh! The one law among thieves is that there are no laws♪
Oh, you barged in, just like me? Sounds like you've learned the rules of this world!
As I've found out, everyone in this crazy world thinks it's okay to waltz into someone's home, go through their drawers, and break their pots. That's video game logic for you. Ahahah.
I've moved up the thief skill tree! Now I'll probably get more item drops! Heheh♪
That enemy had a stealable item you can't get anywhere else?! You should've said so! There's no way to load saves here!
My new Silent Steps skill makes me undetectable. I can steal anything if I want to now... Heheh.
You're naive if you think you can grab me!
Whoa! That's not part of a thief's skillset!
Welcome back! What drops did you get? Hero's gonna mock you if you didn't find anything.
Bet they dropped some loot! Better grab everything we can!
Crap! Time for the escape QTE!
Aircraft carrier - Béarn.

My name is Béarn, I am the Iris Libre's first aircraft carrier, converted from the unfinished 5th Normandie-class dreadnought. I lived to see the end of the strife between Iris and Vichya... A tragedy I pray will never happen again.
Béarn, Iris Libre's very first aircraft carrier, reporting for duty. It is an honor to fight by your side. I eagerly await your orders, Commander.
Here is today's schedule, Commander. Read it at your leisure.
An improvement in operational code and tactical variables... This sequence should be useful. I shall write this down in my notebook.
If I may be so blunt, Commander, it would be very unwise of you to read my book. I am not exaggerating or joking about this.
Are you daydreaming, Commander? You may continue to fantasize if you so wish; we have enough free time in today's schedule to accommodate for it.
I shall attend to our official business and schedule management. You need only focus on the work on your desk, Commander.
I am right here, Commander. Do not hesitate to give me your orders.
Do you lack the knowledge of what being a decent person entails, or are you simply unable to control yourself, Commander?
Commander, I have received word of new mission directives from headquarters. I shall go and make some arrangements.
A mission has been completed. That's one burden off our minds.
Reporting in. I have a newly arrived letter for you, Commander.
You would like something sugary in preparation for your mental labor? It so happens I have a list of our stock of confectionaries. Please have a look.
Transport commissions and cargo escorts are vital, of course, but let's not forget the important safety of our docks.
Your kindness will not go unrewarded, Commander.
Now, as outlined in our briefing, prepare for combat!
How would you say I did? Was my performance satisfactory?
I sincerely apologize, Commander. I take full responsibility for this defeat.
Let's proceed as planned.
I have sustained damage, but it is under control...
"You are the most outstanding, exceptional commander I have ever met." - You can only hope to hear me say these words in your most outlandish dreams.
Are you curious about this book? It is just a notepad, more or less. Rest assured, there is nothing remarkable about it. And it is certainly not something you need look at.
A "grimoire"? Hmm... And you say L'Opiniâtre told you this? It's certainly an amusing allegory. Now, I'm afraid I must take my leave for a while, as I have business to attend to.

This "grimoire" topic again? I do not appreciate your insistence on it. "A sacrament from the Iris Libre can perform all sorts of miracles"... Assuming that were even true, how would you utilize such great power, Commander?
Commander, all of today's clerical tasks have been completed right on schedule. This is a good opportunity to... Indeed, as you've requested, I will teach you about the so-called "sacrament of love."

If there are sacraments that can emotionally move and unite people, then this so-called "marriage" must be the most powerful of its kind. Ah, this bliss, this feeling of butterflies in my stomach... Now I understand how it feels to take an oath. It's quite enjoyable, actually. Hehehe~
Commander, do you ever feel as if you're putting too much thought into me? It's okay to be more relaxed around me.
I'd love to transport fascinating items with you.
I am profoundly honored to fight by your side.
Allow me to show you an Iris sacrament.
Are you perhaps feeling unwell, Commander? Oh, I see, you're just looking for a shaded place to rest? Acknowledged. In that case, you may sit here if you'd like.
Are you perhaps feeling unwell, Commander? Oh, I see, you're just looking for a shaded place to rest? Acknowledged. In that case, you may sit here if you'd like.
Would you like a swim ring, Commander? It could be useful if you plan on playing with the girls by the beach.
Everyone seems to be enjoying themselves at the beach. What do you say about playing beach volleyball, or building a sandcastle, Commander? Me, I would rather remain here and observe.
One can seek cover from the sun, but cannot escape the heat. As I'm on lifeguard duty, perhaps I should've brought an electric fan with me.
This ice cream is going to melt if nobody eats it. Say, Commander, would you like a taste?
Both Vichya and Iris girls enjoying the summer on the same beach... A lovely sight, in my opinion.
Your praise honors me, but I can easily imagine that you praise everyone here for their swimsuits.
I suspected you would engage in obscene behavior as soon as you distanced yourself from onlookers, Commander...
You were out at sea? Here, have a towel.
Illustrious-class aircraft carrier - Illustrious, Hull Number 87.
I am the world's first armoured aircraft carrier, ehehe. One day, I'll do my best for the glory of the Royal Navy!
Good day to you, Commander. I am Illustrious of the Royal Navy. We'll spread the holy light of love and peace all across the ocean, right~♪
Good day, Commander. I helped organize a little bit based upon how you had things before. How does everything look?
Illustrious is steady in her steps!
My planes? They're right here. Ehehe, everyone's so well-behaved.
Commander, I'll be there for you any time you're feeling lonely.
What an even more wonderful world it would be if everyone could understand each other.
Commander's hand is so big... much bigger than mine...
Is this some sort of new game...?
Commander, are you worried about the unfinished missions? Is there anything I can help you with?
Mission complete! Thanks to your efforts, we'll be able to further spread the light of love and peace!
Commander, there's mail for you. Umm, where did I put it... Oh, there it is! Here!
Good job, Commander. Would you like Illustrious to give you a back massage?
Everyone has come back from their commission. I'll have to hurry to bring the refreshments out to them!
With this, I'll be able to further spread the light of love and peace...
Bad guys that disturb the peace will be dealt with, like this!
We're one step closer to a world of love and peace.
For the sake of a world of love and peace, next time... you won't get away!
Holy light, pummel our enemies in the name of love and peace!
For the sake of love and peace, I must not be scared!
Were my prayers for love and peace not even enough to reach the person closest by my side...?
Commander, for the sake of love and peace, you mustn't quarrel with others, all right?
Ah, Commander, wait a second... Here, use my handkerchief... Ehehe, there are some cake crumbs stuck on the corner of your mouth~
I heard that sitting down to talk with someone can help relieve your worries. Commander, if there's anything bothering you, I'd be glad to hear you out.

Commander, you seem to not be feeling well... Are you tired from working too much? Hm... Ah, Commander, here... *pat pat* What a sweet child~ I heard this will help you not be tired... right? Ehehe, don't you feel better already?

S-so this is a promise ring... such an important thing, for me...? Ehehe, thank you so much! I may still be immature, but I will work hard to become the person of your dreams. No, I'm sure I'll be able to do it~♪
You're always taking such good care of me, Commander~
We'll mess them up in the name of love and peace! Understood!
If you're bored, why don't we play a game...?
Miss Sara, could you teach me a song?
Let us bring love and peace to this battlefield!
Tribal-class destroyer - Eskimo.

I'm Tribal-class Destroyer Eskimo! During the war, I mostly served in the Home Fleet. I defeated Z19 at the Battle of Narvik, but then Z2 struck back at me... After that, I did good work in the Mediterranean.
Eskimo, Tribal-class Destroyer, is here! Oi, this fleet's not half bad! Nice to meet you, Commander!
Commander, you kept me waiting so long I got mad and took apart your chair! Wh-what if I can't put it back together...?
I was just looking for you, Commander! Let's do something fun.
Commander, let's build an igloo when it snows! I'm pretty good at those!
Yippeeee! Yahoooo! Ah, Commander, errr~ Why am I horsing around like this? Just bored, I guess.
All right, target acquired: daydreaming Commander. Eskimo head smasher! GO!
What's up, Commander? Time I get to work? All right, time I get to work!
Oh? Something on my coat?
A new mission? All right, a new mission!
Commander, here's all the mission rewards. Take a look at them already!
Commander, I got the mail for you~ Heh heh. It was nothing. Don't mention it.
I finished all the work you left here for me.
The commission team's back? I'll go get them!
Yes! Now I'm feeling it!
Lemme at 'em!
Yes! I'm the MVP! Now cheer for me!
Oh noes... Sorry, Commander...
All right! Have a taste of this!
It's not time to retreat yet!
You're no fun at all, Commander...
My outfit? It's different because I served in some pretty frigid waters back in the day~ Heheh, it's pretty cool though, huh? What do you think?
Y-you saw my room? Well, when I get too bored, I end up taking apart the furniture... and then I don't know how to put it back together. But why, though?
Too noisy? Hmm, well, I'm just trying to get your attention. Everyone's really... Oh no, could I be bothering someone? I'd better go apologize!
I've been good? Eheheh, that's all thanks to you, Commander. Since you've been giving me so much attention, I don't need to bother anyone else. I can just wait until you have time for me. Riiight?
All right, I promise, Commander. I'll work hard, and be good. I won't cause any more trouble! Just keep on giving me more attention! Eheheh!
What's this for? Thanks!
Hey! Z2, you'd better make Z1 behave!

ex.line: Patience, patience... Ah, Commander, it's about time! I've missed you!
Commander, wanna go adventuring in the Northern Parliament's tundras when we get some time off? Don't worry about it, you'll be fine with me at your side!
Commander, is there anything I can help you with? All right, I'll just wait in this corner here and not bother you...
Target acquired: Commander's lap! Commencing tactical dive bombing!
Commander, I've actually been waiting for you to call me! So, what do you need done?

....... Why am I not saying anything? Oh, did you want me to? I was trying to keep quiet so I wouldn't bother you, Commander. Buuut, if you insist... I'll flirt with you all I want~! Ehehe, remember, you were the one who asked~!

lines.line: Oh woe, nobody wants to play with me because they're all too busy~ ...Oh, hello little Manjuu... Heheh, maybe I'll play a prank on you instead!
Oh woe, nobody wants to play with me because they're all too busy~ ...Oh, hello little Manjuu... Heheh, maybe I'll play a prank on you instead!
Commander, shhhh!
Ehehe... You have no choice but to play with me! ...Commander! Oh, it's nothing!
Miss Belfast and Dunkerque? You brought ice cream for me? Thanks a ton! Ah, got any for the Manjuu? Huh, what do you mean you're not falling for that?
Commander, you done with work yet? You're not? Aw, I wanted to play...
Oww! All right, please stop bonking me... I just got bored because you wouldn't play with me... Okay, okay, I won't bully the Manjuu anymore...
Woohoo, Commander's back! All right, let's go swim or something!
King George V-class battleship - Howe (HMS Howe.)

Prior to my being sent to the Pacific, I always worked side by side with George. But aside from the one time we escorted our Sardegnian friends, I suppose I don't have too many notable feats to my name.
It's a pleasure meeting you, Commander. I'm Howe of the King George V-class. I hope we can build a healthy relationship.
How nice to see you. Now, let's get to work on today's tasks.
To your friends, show no cowardice; to your foes, show no mercy - that is my creed. Hehehe~
Wales and York are lovely ladies. At times, however, I struggle to keep up with their thought processes.
George has always been good to me. She often treats me to a cookie or two... But I wish she'd stop treating me like I'm still a child.
If you have a hard time making friends with an eccentric person, my advice is this: bake some cookies, and offer to share with them.
Do save the massage for later. I'm not tired yet.
Umm... What are you doing?
Oh, missions? Are there any I can help with?
A mission's done. I can take care of claiming the rewards, no problem.
We've received what looks to be mail addressed to you.
Nicely done out there. If you've got the energy to spare, perhaps you could write an after-battle report?
Do you need someone to escort the commission team home? I'm quite the experienced escort, I'll have you know.
Phew... I'll return your gesture with valour on the battlefield, Commander.
Heheh, there'll be no mercy for you!
Heheh, I'm in top shape today!
Next time... victory will be ours.
My aim shall not waver!
I can't... falter now!
A kind deed to others is a kind deed to yourself - or so I was naive enough to believe...
"Shape the world into God's vision" - if there is a God, what is his ideal world? It can't be one of perpetual war, that's for sure.
Are you tired, Commander? Under the weather, perhaps? Heh, well, a nice cookie can fix that. Just eat one of these and you'll be right back to normal.
Come visit the dorm next time we're having cookies, Commander. We'd all love to have you, and I especially want to spend some quality time with you.
Bah, being indirect is just not like me. I adore you, Commander. Both as the leader of the fleet, and as my beloved special someone. I wish to know... do you adore me as well?

Thank you for your sincerity, Commander. I will gladly be yours. I won't ask of you to share all your joys and sorrows with me, as I'm more than happy with just being by your side. Ah, that didn't sound like what I would say, did it? Well, hehehe~
A present for me? Heehee, thank you.
Allow me to witness your true might.
Let us show the world what we're made of.
Cookies are great, don't you know? Do you really not want one?

ex.line: Welcome back. Can I keep you company until the night arrives, love?
My sisters can be rather headstrong at times. If they give you any trouble, you can turn to me, love.
It seems my cookies were adored, but my performance failed to garner any reactions...
You'd like a massage? It would be my pleasure.
I can see why you'd do that. Hehehe~
Splendid work, love. Have a cookie and get some rest, then we'll start on the after-battle report.
Hehehe, let's plan for our next date, love. Speaking of which, I've heard of a place with famously delicious cookies. How does that sound?

lines.line: Sorry to keep you waiting, but now I'm ready to- Commander? What's the matter? It'll get dark soon if you keep standing around like that.
Sorry to keep you waiting, but now I'm ready to- Commander? What's the matter? It'll get dark soon if you keep standing around like that.
Glad you could make it, love. Now, as for our plan today... Oh, should I not have made a plan ahead of time?
Is this the place with the famously delicious cookies? Could we order some right away? I must taste them for myself!
Wales taught me the dos and don'ts of dating. Though enlightening, her advice seemed purposed for winning an ordinary girl's hand... So perhaps it's better intended for you, Commander?
Peckish, are you? Then you can have this cookie George gave me.
This dress is quite comfortable, actually. It's no trouble for me to walk a little longer.
Have a seat if you need to rest, love.
Hm? Is there something on my dress?
Well done on that sortie. Let's proceed with our plan, shall we?
I hope misfortune befalls you.
"Please, Master, save meee." ...Ugh, I can't get into the role. What sort of tone should I be aiming for, love?
"Please, Master, save meee." ...Ugh, I can't get into the role. What sort of tone should I be aiming for, love?
"Masteeer, please untie meeee"... Hmm...
Oh, who will come to my rescue? George? Or perhaps... you, love?
Goodness... These cookie props are so enticing they're distracting me...
How do you think Belfast would respond if I walked up to her and said, "I'm joining the Royal Maids starting today"?
Memorising my lines is simple enough. Reciting them is another matter, though... How does Wales do it so effortlessly?
I'll bake you your favourite pastry later, love.
...Master?
Splendid work. I would offer you a treat, but as you can see, my hands are tied...
Swift and graceful, I advance!
I'm curious what the Royal Maids mean when they say they "service" you... Heheh. Would you mind enlightening me after this rehearsal, love?

Thanks for your patience, love. I've looked forward to this evening's party for a long, long time. Hopefully George, York, and company won't laugh at me after how much effort I've put into this ensemble... What do you think of it, Commander?

Thanks for your patience, love. I've looked forward to this evening's party for a long, long time. Hopefully George, York, and company won't laugh at me after how much effort I've put into this ensemble... What do you think of it, Commander?
I'm right here, Commander. Seeing as we still have time, why don't you try this new flavour of cookie I made? ...Now's not the time?
What, you think my dress is ludicrously posh? It should be, considering what an important day this is... What about it is so important, you ask? Hm... That is an excellent question.
Monarch has me a tad bit concerned... Ah, no, she fits in just fine, I just wonder if she likes the food on offer.
All these foreign dresses have me mesmerised. I'd love to try some on for myself someday.
I don't want to stand out TOO much - you're the star of the show tonight, after all.
I can't walk all that fast in this outfit, so be a sweetheart and escort me.
Please, mind your manners...
Welcome back, love. Go on and take a minute to rest. Let me know if you'd like to order anything.
The commission team is back. Heehee, I suppose we have to wait with the champagne for a bit.
A Royal Knight is not to be trifled with!
That is what I call an elegant victory. Phew... This will hopefully put George at ease.
Colossus-class light aircraft carrier - Perseus (HMS Perseus.)

I'm Perseus, the Colossus-class light aircraft carrier. Sadly, I didn't enter service until the war had ended. Don't have much in the way of a reputation or experience as a result. Still, I'll try to do a good job. All right, is that good enough? *sigh*...
I'm Perseus, from the Royal Navy. You can pronounce it "Per-see-us" if you want though... Well, whatever. Are we done here? Great. Nice meeting you.
There's some saying that goes, "the early bird catches the worm." ...If that's true, I guess you'd starve, Commander.
The big mirror in my room? What about it? If I told you, "I just like mirrors," would that satisfy your curiosity?
If you need my help with something, just say it. You do need to try and accomplish it on your own first, though.
Work is like food, in a way; leave it sitting for too long and it goes bad. Just so you know.
I heard Yuubari and Akashi get up to fun experiments in the lab. I kind of wanna see one. Kind of.
...Yeah?
Maybe try finishing your work before you "chat me up" or "interview me" or however you wanna sugarcoat it?
You must really want a seat at the naval jailhouse dinner table, huh?
What kind of lazy cat are you, just lounging around all day instead of doing missions?
Those mission rewards will expire if you don't claim them. Maybe.
You've got mail. Nope, didn't bring it with me. Next time, ask, and I'll consider it.
One quick battle, and you're knackered already, Commander? You have the stamina of a beached whale.
Look, Commander... No, I'm not angry, I was just going to tell you a commission is done.
Thanks a bunch... Well, yeah, didn't you want a thank-you?
Careful, now. The battlefield is no place to worry about fuel economy.
Looks like the enemy will have to, uh, try harder next time.
Damn, we lost... Sorry.
I've got this.
...I can't afford to mess around, huh.
You really are like a can of rancid surströmming.
I can hear just fine, Commander, so don't go yelling in my ear, thanks...
If you ask me, people should be able to say whatever they want... Oh, hello there, Commander. Just talking to myself.
I'm a total moron... Why am I so rude to the Commander when I just want to be friends... I'm so, so stupid...
How would I describe you? I dunno, I guess like a storm in the middle of a peaceful voyage... No, no, I didn't mean it like that... Sorry, what I meant to say is, um...
Obviously I don't hate you, Commander. How could I, when I adore talking to you and being patted on the head? L-look, I'm trying to say... I love you. I mean it...
You seem to know what I like, huh... Thank you.
Time for a new experiment?

ex.line: There's that saying that goes, "the early bird catches the worm"... Uh, just try not to starve to death, Commander.
Okay, fine. I use my mirror for conversation practice... Stop giggling, it's not funny.
If you need my help with something, just say it. But first, try to accomplish it on your own. Or don't, that's fine.
Work is like food, they both have an expiry date. So, need any help finishing your food, so to speak?
Intrepid, can you see Perseus? No, I mean, the constellation.
So, are you up for a chat?
The commission team is back, Commander.
Thanks a bunch... Well, yeah, didn't you want a thank-you?
I've become able to just, you know, talk. Like a normal person. With you and other people, I mean. I owe you thanks for helping me come this far. I love you, Commander. I really do.

lines.line: I'm Perseus, I will be your nurse today. Use this button to call for me if you need anything... Yes? Did you need something?
I'm Perseus, I will be your nurse today. Use this button to call for me if you need anything... Yes? Did you need something?
Honestly, I have no idea what sort of face to put on when pretending to be a nurse.
I'm still learning, but I know how to give injections and stop a haemorrhage in theory. Can I practice my knowledge on you, Commander?
It's noble to help those in need, but don't go overboard with it. What I'm trying to say is: unless you NEED my help, just make do on your own, Commander.
Now to practice turning a gravely injured person over... You, I'm gonna need you to lie on your back.
Nice new med tech. Commander, I want you to be my guinea pig- Excuse me, I mean, experiment assistant.
You have a healthy look in your eyes, Commander.
You belong in the bed of a jail cell, not of a hospital.
Your health is seriously concerning, Commander. Want me to get you some vitamins?
Whew. Lunar New Year... Easy to grasp in various ways. Both the holiday and your tastes, I mean. Heehee.
Whew. Lunar New Year... Easy to grasp in various ways. Both the holiday and your tastes, I mean. Heehee.
Hm? Did you give up on being the early bird? ...Me? I'm the spring worm that sleeps in.
...Lunar New Year's greetings? Right, those are a thing. Whew. Okay... Happy New Year, Commander. Keep on being the early bird, all right?
Whew... Lunar New Year's a nice holiday. You can just lie down and someone will feed you... Hm? They won't?
Looks like Theseus is into the hustle and bustle of the season. Though, I guess I'm the same when it comes down to it... *yaaawn*...
A cannon to inaugurate the new year with? That's a neat idea... Crap, now I'm interested...
...Oh. Now it's your responsibility to comb my hair.
...Do you wanna lie down with me? Knock yourself out. Like they say, Lunar New Year is a holiday for resting.
...Baozi... or rice cakes? C-Commander... *blushes*
There's a Lunar New Year card with your name on it, Commander.
Back at long last. Whew... You have more stamina than any person has any right to.
A commission's been completed. Oh well, nothing too important to our sleepy bird here.
Yup, I got my red envelope. Here, this one's for you.
...Time to set off some firecrackers!
Dido-class light cruiser - Hermione (HMS Hermione.)

I'm Hermione, a Dido-class ship belonging to the Royal Navy. In the past... I chased after Bismarck and participated in anti-submarine warfare in Sardegna... Besides that, there's nothing worth mentioning. Commander, do you have any questions?
Good day. I am Hermione, from the Royal Maids. I'm delighted to make your acquaintance, Commander.
Good morning, Commander. Did you sleep well?
I really admire the head of the Royal Maid, Miss Belfast... She can do anything and has a strong will to boot... I hope I can become like her one day.
It's not good to strain yourself by overworking. How about splashing some water on your face to refresh yourself?
It seems like the price for this ingredient has gone up... Commander, from now on, we'll have fewer dishes that use this.
Commander, watching you easily handle your work makes me feel happy... I wonder why?
A fizzy drink? ...What am I going to do with you? I suppose you can have just one bottle, all right?
Commander, it's good to pay attention to the time and place when doing something like this, you know?
Commander, the more you don't deal with your work now, the more you'll have to deal with later.
This mission's reward is quite sizeable. Congratulations, Commander!
Is this mail for you, Commander...? I apologize. I'll leave it here.
Commander. For the time being, you're forbidden from doing more work, okay? You need to make sure to take a break from now and then.
Commander, let's put our work on hold and go to greet the team that's just returned from commissions.
My, have I gotten stronger?
The enemy's been detected~
I'm sure Commander will be elated~
Oh my, what a failure...
I hope this hits~
It seems I let my guard down...
Commander, why are you so stubborn...
Doesn't Dido worry a bit... too much? She works so hard, and I know you don't hate her, but... please, watch over her some more, Commander.
Commander, are you working overtime today? Then I'll bring over some coffee. ...Um, it's not a bother, you know? After all, being by your side no matter what is a Royal Maid's duty.

Commander, if it doesn't bother you, would you mind leaving your laundry to me? Washing our clothes together saves time, but more than that, I want you to personally feel how great your clothes feel after being hand-washed by the Royal Maids♪
Whew... I've finished cleaning the room. Next... Oh, welcome back. I'll prepare your meal right now, so please wait a moment, Commander.

You'd like for me to stay by your side, forever...? Of course, Commander. Taking care of you is my job, after all. Ah, would this be what's called a "confession"...? Yes, of course. Commander, I'll be in your care, from now, 'til the end of time.
Thank you very much. I'll put this to good use.
Dido, it's not good to worry so much
Miss Belfast, please allow me to watch and learn!

ex.line: Good morning, Commander. Hehe, you were sleeping so soundly, I couldn't bear to wake you up. Let's do our best today~
Commander, please come over here and lie on your side. I'll give you a wonderful Royal Navy-style massage~ Hehe.
This feeling of doing work with you, by your side... It feels really great. Yep~♪
A fizzy drink? ...I guess it can't be helped. Just one more, alright?
Good grief, you never change...
Hmhm~♪ The room's all cleaned, time for... Oh, welcome back, Commander. I'll prepare your meal right away, so please wait a bit longer~

lines.line: My, what brings you here, Commander? Are you feeling unwell? That's no good... Why don't you come sit over here first? I'll start by taking your temperature...
My, what brings you here, Commander? Are you feeling unwell? That's no good... Why don't you come sit over here first? I'll start by taking your temperature...
Hm? Commander, what brings you back here...? Umm, are you here to be... inspected?
Commander... Even ships can get sick. Please, make sure to take care of yourself, alright?
Gosh, Commander... If you pretend to be sick, even I'm going to get mad at you!
Commander, don't you think this dress is a bit too small for me...? Um... I just feel like it doesn't fit me...
Commander, please make sure that you pay attention to your own health. After all, I can't attend to you around the clock.
Commander, let me perform an examination on you. Please come here and lie down on your side.
Are we... playing doctor?
Commander, please wait there for a moment. I'm examining someone else right now...
Commander, I've brought the chair. If you don't want to get in the water, feel free to sit here. ...Hm, me? Of course, I will remain by your side.
Commander, I've brought the chair. If you don't want to get in the water, feel free to sit here. ...Hm, me? Of course, I will remain by your side.
Commander, please leave work at the office, and relax to your heart's content today.
Actually... I bought this swimsuit back when it was on sale. I'm relieved that you like it...
These waves feel so nice~ Why don't you dip your feet in too, Commander? ...Hm? A big wave is... Eek!
Overexposure to the sun isn't good for your skin. Why don't we move somewhere else in a little bit?
A nap? Y-yes! Please take your time and relax to your heart's content. If something happens, hm... don't worry, I'll make sure you wake up when that happens.
Wow, the sea is so pretty~ ...Hmm? I'm even prettier than the sea...? Jeez, Commander... Don't get all sappy on me now.
I've prepared a cool, refreshing drink for you. Please enjoy.
Would you care for some afternoon tea, Commander? Heehee~ This is one of my little hobbies when I'm not performing my maid duties.
Would you care for some afternoon tea, Commander? Heehee~ This is one of my little hobbies when I'm not performing my maid duties.
I've finished brewing the tea. Commander, do be careful, as it is very hot.
I changed into slightly more formal attire in preparation for us having afternoon tea together. Do you think... it doesn't suit me well...?
A while ago, Miss Belfast recommended these delicious and economical snacks. Commander, are they to your liking?
The first thing that comes to mind when one speaks of "elegance" must surely be Miss Illustrious or Miss Hood. Oh, you'd include me as well? Hehe, I'm honoured~
Commander, I see you've finally managed to relax a bit. I suppose inviting you for afternoon tea turned out to be very fruitful after all~
Hm? You'd like another serving of tea? Sure, here you go~ Please let me know if there's anything you want~
Before you continue with your work, please enjoy a delicious slice of cake and unwind a little~
How are you feeling, Commander? Hehe, I'm not wearing my usual nurse's gown right now, but I suppose this isn't much different~
How are you feeling, Commander? Hehe, I'm not wearing my usual nurse's gown right now, but I suppose this isn't much different~
My fellow Royal Maids drew inspiration from the Dragon Empery's traditional attire when crafting these clothes. I do hope you like them.
It is often said that the best medicine is bitter, but I tried to make mine as sweet as possible to suit your tastes.
I wonder what kinds of effects these herbs have... I should ask Dido later.
I am quite proficient at following recipes and preparing ingredients. They're skills I often use as part of my work with the Royal Maids.
Might you be... checking my pulse?
Commander...
New mail has arrived. Did they procure the ingredients I asked for?
Breathing in these herbal fragrances is quite good for you. Commander, please feel free to relax.
The commission team has brought back some quality herbs! I propose that we have some herb tea to celebrate.
There has to be a cure for you out there somewhere... You're not beyond saving yet, I know it!

Commander, how are you feeling today? I won't be giving you any medicine, but since food and medicine have the same root, I'll make sure to prepare some nutritious meals that you're sure to enjoy. Please leave it to me~♪
Commander, umm... Happy Valentine's Day! What do you think of my outfit? Hehe, it's perfect for a date, isn't it?
Commander, umm... Happy Valentine's Day! What do you think of my outfit? Hehe, it's perfect for a date, isn't it?
Commander, over here! Oh, it's okay. I just arrived, myself. Let's forget all the stuffy formalities and have a fun Valentine's together.
What do you think of when you hear Valentine's? Chocolate, of course. What chocolate do you like, Commander? All kinds? Heehee, that is a relief, but it makes things a little hard for me♪
Am I blushing? Umm, I'm probably a little nervous... We're on a date, after all. How can you blame me for a bit of anxiety?
At this time of year, shops that sell gift wrapping are busier than ever. Heehee, I'm sure you know why. ...Now that we're dating, maybe I have reason to go myself~
Here you go! Valentine's chocolate. ...You're surprised that I just gave it to you instead of picking the perfect moment? Please. Every moment with you is plenty romantic, so there was no need to.
Today... Heehee, well, it is a special day.
Thanks for all your hard work, Commander. Shall we see a movie? Rest a moment at a café? At the least, we should find somewhere we can take things slow.
Interrupting a lady's date... How extremely senseless!
Someone needs a lecture on manners.

♪~ Commander, how did you enjoy our date? Me... Yes, I'm plenty satisfied. I hate to be selfish now, but part of me can't help but think... If only I could go on such lovely dates with you every day. Hahaha!
I'm so happy to have come this far with you, Commander. May this gorgeous sunrise watch over us for all time... I love you, Commander.
I'm so happy to have come this far with you, Commander. May this gorgeous sunrise watch over us for all time... I love you, Commander.
Commander, you look well. Is there anything at all I can help you with?
I never dreamed that I'd get to meet you as I wear this dress, Commander. I'm so, so very happy...
Caring for your health, treasuring our life together... It doesn't feel like things have changed much, does it? I guess we've been the perfect team for a long time now.
I've heard that spoiling people too much can make them lazy... But you'd never be lazy, Commander! Umm, so... It's okay to let me pamper you once in a while, okay?
Commander, take it easy whenever you want to. I like you most when you're smiling without a care in the world♪
Are you tired? You may rest your head in my lap, Commander.
M-may I seek your warmth, too...?
Thank you for your hard work, Commander. Make sure to monitor your work-life balance. Otherwise, I may find a way to force you to rest... Hehehe♪
Hmhm~? The room's all cleaned, time for... Oh, welcome back, Commander. I'll prepare your meal right away, so please wait a bit longer~
Queen Elizabeth-class battleship - Valiant (HMS Valiant.)

Queen Elizabeth-class battleship, Valiant. Hehe, this fleet is known from Jutland to the Far East for its heroic majesty, and I am the reason for that! Now, Commander, you shall become my assistant so that you may prove your worth as a subordinate.
To be Valiant is to be me. Remember this face, for it is the face of a fleet leader! ...Speaking of faces, who are you? The Commander? Very well! I shall treat you as my personal servant!
It's about time! Now, show me today's itinerary!

Look, isn't Elizabeth acting a bit too spoiled? And Warspite and the others are totally enabling that. I knew I should have been the one in charge... Huhh? I'm more or less the same...? Wh-what did you say?!
So thirsty... Ahem. My attendant, do tell the Maid Team to brew me some black tea. Hmm, on second thought... that'd take too long. You can do it for me, can't you?
Charisma is the most important facet of a leader! To be charismatic is to command dignity, to imbue your every word with gravitas! Ahem... did you get all that?
Snack time?! ...Ahem! A proper leader must know how to balance their work with their life. Please do not forget that.
Wh-what are you doing?!
Speak your mind, my attendant. You have my ear.
What's the meaning of this?! Grrr... As a charismatic, generous, and VERY patient person, I will forgive you just this once!
I'll leave this these trifling quests to you.
Even the most trivial quests at least deserve some rewards.
Tsk... Why is all the mail for you...
My attendant, how fares the combat situation? Do tell me in detail.
Heheh, it seems that the commission team has been doing well. Do send them my best regards in my stead.
Not bad, my attendant~ Do you want a reward?
Heed my command! Forward!
A heroic battle commanded elegantly by the Commander— now this is the kind of flawless victory that befits me.
Ugh... H-how is this possible...
Everything dances within the palm of my hand!
H-hey, hurry up and do something about this...!
I had great expectations for you...
Good, you came. If you have no other work to do, play me in a game of chess.
Y-you're better than I expected... F-fine, I won't go easy on you next time...!
H-hold up! Chess is like a real-world exercise, so you have to consider all the various external factors! Th-that's right! That last match was a fake! A fluke! Doesn't count! Cancelled! Got it?!

As my subordinate, you should be considerate of your superior... I mean, sh-shouldn't you let me win at least once? I've lost to you so many times that I barely even have the confidence to play chess anymore... A-anyway! Lose to me! Just once! It can even be on purpose! This is an order, got it?

Well done! You've gained my recognition as my trustiest spear in the arsenal! To reward you for your continued loyalty, I shall allow you to stay at my side and bask in my charisma! May this ring be a symbol of our bond~♪
This is...! Heh heh. I hereby accept your sentiments!
Feast your eyes upon the might of the noble Queen Elizabeth-class!
M-make sure you observe my every move!

ex.line: You're here! Good timing, let's go over today's itinerary!
Hey, what's taking so long? ...The black tea still isn't ready? I'm already used to the flavor of your tea, so don't keep me waiting too long...
Charisma might be important, but what people truly flock to is your talent and sincerity.
Huh? What is it? Are you even listening to me?
My assistant, how fares the war situation? N-nothing out of the ordinary, hopefully?
I don't care if I win or lose... A-after all, what's more important is that I get to be with you, right...? You agree?! ...W-well then, let's have a rematch!

lines.line: Hehe~ As this medical facility training is crucially important, a charismatic leader such as myself would be best suited to instruct everyone on- Wait a moment, what's with this outfit?! You there, explain the meaning of this at once!

Hehe~ As this medical facility training is crucially important, a charismatic leader such as myself would be best suited to instruct everyone on- Wait a moment, what's with this outfit?! You there, explain the meaning of this at once!
It's about time! ...Wait, just kidding! You're supposed to be the patient, right? How about you stop walking around so much? Get back in bed this instant!
Hey you, don't tell me you're actually enjoying being taken care of like this?! Grr... How unfair! How about this, next time, I'll be the patient, and you'll attend to my every whim!
Don't get any weird ideas. I'm only pouring tea for you because you're the patient!
When we're not training for this exercise, how about a game of chess? I already brought the board. I'll set it up, so just wait in bed!
As a patient, so you're supposed to listen to the nurse! Mm... Besides, shouldn't you already be heeding my every instruction? You're my attendant after all...

You're my patient today! Heheh, be grateful that you're now under the care of the charismatic nurse, Valiant, and heed my every command! ...It, it's not like I'm into this or anything, so don't expect me to do this every single time!
It's time to get your blood drawn, so stick your arm out! ...Geh... I can't handle this stuff like Vampire does...
What's the matter? Are you going to die if I don't take care of you~?
...I, I'm only overlooking this because you're the patient!
I brought water for you. Make sure you drink plenty if you want to stay healthy... That's right, eight cups a day!
Why the astonished look on your face? You heard me correctly! On this day, I am not merely Valiant, I am the regal and royal Queen Valiant!
Why the astonished look on your face? You heard me correctly! On this day, I am not merely Valiant, I am the regal and royal Queen Valiant!
Do you remember how you are to address me today? Yes, "Your Majesty, Queen Valiant!" Make sure you do not forget this!
O~ho~ho! With my regal display of wisdom and fortune, I have finally secured the Crown from Elizabeth's grasp! Heheh~ before you is the victor of the War of the Roses!
Elizabeth lost a bet with me. Now, she has to surrender the Crown to me for a day, and do whatever I tell her to~♪
See to it that I, Queen Valiant, am the center of all attention at tonight's party! Huh? Don't overdo it...? I, I know that!
Are you well-versed in ballroom dancing? Hrmm... It's decided! You shall be my dance partner tonight!
H-how dare you lay your hands on Queen Valiant!
Hwah?! ...Ahem! I'm feeling extra charismatic today, so I will forgive your transgression for today!
Today, I feel like the world is mine~ Oh, you're back, my attendant? You may enjoy my cooking as a reward!
I-class destroyer - Icarus.

My history as a ship...? I escorted Hood and Warspite, and also participated in anti-submarine missions... Basically, I've been here and there and done this and that. I guess you could say I have quite a bit of experience? That being the case, feel free to call upon me, whether in battle or otherwise!
Well met, Commander. I am Icarus, I-class destroyer from the Royal Navy. I specialize in escort and anti-submarine operations. I look forward to working with you.
Commander, did you just arrive? Hehe. There are documents on your desk. I'll have your tea ready in just a moment, so please get started on your work.
A change of clothes for the commander, the menus for tomorrow's meals... Oh, Commander. When did you get here? ...Don't mind me, I'm just doing some daily preparations~♪
Commander, please let me know when you head out! Whether it's an umbrella or a coat, I'll be sure to have it ready for you.
Eskimo looks like she wants some attention... Commander, I'll do something about her, so please focus on your work. ...That's right, I can call Abercrombie over!
I guess destroyers really have their limits... If only I had bigger guns or torpedoes... Oh, I was just talking to myself. Please don't mind me!
Hehehe. You know, this feels kind of nice.
Was there something you wanted me to do?
I-I'm not sure if we should be doing this...
There's a new mission. Let's do our best!
The mission's been completed! How wonderful!
I've finished sorting out the new mail! Should I bring it over?
Welcome back, Commander. I cleaned up the room while you were away. ...N-no, there's no need to praise me. It really wasn't a big deal!
Commander, would you like me to go greet the commissions team in your stead?
Mmh~ One step closer to achieving overwhelming firepower... Err, I mean, I'll be more useful to the commander!
Alright...! Let's go all-out!
We won! It's all thanks to you, Commander!
If only I could have shot another volley of torpedoes...
Loading complete... Let's go!
My torpedoes still aren't ready... I can hold out for a bit longer...!
...If you keep this up, I'll be the only one left who's willing to keep looking after you, Commander...
Commander, I've sworn to protect you and everyone else at the port. I'll use all my might to destroy anything that dares to hurt you!

Commander, haven't you been working a bit too hard recently? You need to make sure to get some rest when you can... If you fly too close to the sun, your wings will melt, and you'll fall down, you know? ...Huh? What am I saying...?
Mm... The more I stay by your side, the more I want to do your work in your stead... Do you think I'm getting a bit too attached to you...?
"You, who are like the sun, make me feel your warmth just by being there. You, who are like the sun, make me afraid of being swallowed by your warmth." Commander, can I come... a bit closer to you?
Just as I've become unable to part with you, have you come to feel the same way about me? I'm so happy! From now on, I'll be sure... to ask you for lots of things♪
You went out of your way to prepare this for me? I'm so incredibly grateful, Commander!
Miss Hood, this time, I'll defend you properly!
It seems we're heading out together again!

ex.line: Oh, Commander. Did you just get here? I've prepared the schedule and documents on your desk, along with a glass of lemon water. It's got plenty of vitamins in it, so I hope you'll do your best!
Here Commander, your lunch! Ah, but you can't be a picky eater!
Wow, Hood is gorgeous as always... Hey Commander, you should follow her example too and act more gracefully!
Whenever I play hide-and-seek, I usually find everyone intuitively... Perhaps I'm better at it than I thought?
Hehe~ Commander, your kindness puts me at ease.
I'm right over here~ Please let me know if you need anything!
If you're g-going to do something like this, shouldn't we go elsewhere...?

"You, who are like the sun..." No, that's not quite it. If I were to say what you are really like... Maybe a space heater? Warm to be around, without the danger of being burned... Look, even if I'm sticking to you this closely, I'm still not burned! Hehe~

lines.line: This is a special exercise for our on-site medical facilities! Well, that's what they said anyway, but isn't this kind of weird...? I feel like I'd rather be taking care of others, not the other way around...

This is a special exercise for our on-site medical facilities! Well, that's what they said anyway, but isn't this kind of weird...? I feel like I'd rather be taking care of others, not the other way around...
Commander, did you come by to check up on me? Though I might look like a patient, I'm actually perfectly fine~
I've already prepared your changes of clothing and daily necessities in advance. Make sure you don't neglect your health while I'm away participating in this exercise, alright?
Looking out the window of this hospital room at the scenery is making me oddly emotional...
These bandages and this IV are just here for practice. They're not the real deal, you know?
It's hard to move around properly in this... I'm sure there will be an impact on my firepower, too...
Even in this situation, I'm sure there is something that I can do for you, Commander.
C-Commander? We're in the medical facility, you know...
I wonder if... I should just let the Royal Maids clean your room instead...
"Let's go explore the ocean together! What special things will we be able to find today~?" Hehe, how's that, Commander?
"Let's go explore the ocean together! What special things will we be able to find today~?" Hehe, how's that, Commander?
The manjuus and I are all ready to go! You can start taking pictures whenever you're ready.
No matter how many times I see it, it never gets old... It's simply amazing that we're able to create amazing sets like this at the Port.
So this is what the submarine girls see while they battle... Hehe, the scenery down here is amazing.
This swimsuit fits me nice and tight. It's so easy to move around in it!
Oh, I caught you spacing out, Commander. I had the manjuus take a picture as proof, too. Why don't you take a look? Heehee~
W-We're still in the middle of the shoot, Commander!
Commander, how would you like to join me in the shoot? I think I'd get more fired up if we're in the same shot... Hehe~
I hope your work's going well, Commander! I've been here playing with these kitties since finishing my duties. Here, I brewed some fresh tea to help you recharge~
I hope your work's going well, Commander! I've been here playing with these kitties since finishing my duties. Here, I brewed some fresh tea to help you recharge~
What a good little kitty cat you are~ Hold still, let me get that itch for you~ Same goes for you, Commander. Let me know if you've ever got an itch, I'll take care of it for you~
I cleaned your room earlier, and was pleasantly surprised to see that it was well-organized. Great work not leaving documents strewn about, Commander~
Commander, it's time to eat. I put my all into the preparations! I... went too overboard? E-Err...
Comparing me to the Royal Maids is like comparing night and day. There's no way I'd be able to measure up to true professionals.
I think I understand your daily schedule now, Commander. These are part of the duties of a maid, aren't they?
Commander? It seems you really enjoy touching people. Let's go tell everyone about this interest of yours!
Is this... also part of the duties of a maid?
Welcome back, Commander. How about a break? I've prepared some cake for you. I do hope it's to your liking.
Type 1936A "Narvik-class" destroyer - Z26.

So you want to hear about my history? Absolutely! As the Iron Blood Type 1936A destroyer, Z26, I escorted Hipper and Scheer, and disrupted shipping with Z25 and the others. While doing so, I was defeated... and that's that!
I'm the Iron Blood destroyer, Z26! I look forward to working with you! ...All right, that should do just fine as an introduction...!
Sorry, but only authorized personnel are allowed into the office... Oh, I guess you're authorized to enter. Welcome back! Let's give it our all!
I hate snowstorms. One was the reason I got separated from my allies and captured by the enemy...
Commander, slacking off is absolutely prohibited! ...You've already finished your work? I-in that case... Well done!
Zed's good at studying, and Lebe's good at sports... so I should aim to... study while playing sports? W-will I manage?
I wonder if Z25's Mr. Anchor is actually alive... I mean, she's always talking to it, so...
If you need assistance, just give me the order! ...Err, I mean, please let me know!
No lewdness allowed! Ever! Full stop!
New damn missions have co- Err, I mean! Commander, please hurry up and check out the new missions!
A mission has been completed! If Zed were here, she'd say... "Commander, you've done well!"
Here's the latest intel! Please give it a look, Commander!
Commander, here's some coffee! ...S-sugar? Hmm... I wonder if 10 cubes will be enough...
The commission team is back! They've really done it this time... Nono, I mean, they've done a good job!
I'm very grabbed! ...No, I mean, I'm very grateful!
All ships, follow the vanguard's lead! Oh, I guess that means follow me!
Continue making your best endeavors! ...Um, I mean, well done, everyone!
We ended up losing... I'm really sorry, everyone!
I'm all ready to go!
I wonder where Z25 and the others went...
Commander, you're a failure!
What I do when a foe's aiming at me? Well... I pray that they fire at someone else by accident! If they don't, I pray again that their torpedoes don't hit me!
Commander, you did a great job, like always! Continue to do your best tomorrow as well! ...You can tell that I'm complimenting you right now, no?
Maintaining a good work-life balance is very important! That's why I'll be watching you on your days off to make sure you don't do any work! This is me telling you to get enough rest.
Commander! I was observing your work, and it looks like you can do just fine without my supervision! What a good job you've done. You're stellar! I'm very proud of you.

"I take you, to have and to hold, from this day forward, for better, for worse, for richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health, until death do us part." ...I was able to recite it from memory! Now it's your turn... right?
Well done, Commander! I mean, uhh, thank you!
Please don't stray too far from me!
Commander, welcome to my pad! Ah, give me a sec, let me go grab all the snacks and drinks and games!
Commander, welcome to my pad! Ah, give me a sec, let me go grab all the snacks and drinks and games!
Sorry to keep you waiting! These are all my belongings! ...I mean, uhh, these are all my snacks and games!
Spee really likes these bugle crunches a whole lot. Do you like them too, Commander? Then, open up, I'll chuck a few in for you!
U96 pwned me again! Maybe I should practice more with Ryuujou before challenging her... Oh, Commander, I'm talking about a fighting game I've been playing with U96 and the others!
If you're tired, you should try hugging Sharky and taking a nap! ...Ah, I meant that Sharky pillow on the bed!
My sisters are always telling me not to spend too much time gaming. But since it's my day off, does it reallly matter how much I play?
Press this button to start a new game! ...Um, Commander, weren't you asking about where the start button is?
You thirsty, Commander? I've got Cola, milk, and even the fizzy stuff Hipper and Eugen drink when they come over to play. They're all in that mini-fridge over there, so take whatever you want!
Iron Blood Type VIIC submarine - U-96.

The name's U-96, Iron Blood Type VIIC U-boat, part of the 7th U-boat Flotilla. I made some real juicy contributions over my 11 patrols in the war. Never did fare well against aircraft, though... But don't let that worry ya, Commander. I'm still an ace, and I ain't never gonna let ya down.
Sup. I'm U-96, Type VIIC U-boat and member of the famous Vorwärts wolfpack. Hehe, I'll have you drowning in reports of my success soon enough.
Look who's early. Here I was hoping to see you panicking over being late.
Yeah, what? You fancy how a U-boat in her off time looks?
It's not the foes you can see that you should fear, it's the ones you can't see. Like us U-boats, for instance...
Step one: dive. Step two: wait. While we U-boats can hold our breaths for ages, sometimes I just like goin' for a leisurely swim.
"The Oak-Leaves Patrol"... Heheh, that's got a nice ring to it. Still, all we really did was make a pack and go huntin' for targets.
Did ya need something, or?
What? You seriously like touching me here?
What's this? Still got unfinished missions, do we?
So, what is it? Need someone to fetch ya those rewards?
That mailbox is gonna get full sooner or later. And don't say I didn't warn ya.
Lemme see that map, Commander... All right, cool... 'Kay, so the spot I marked would be perfect for an ambush next sortie. If ya need it done, just hit me up.
The commission team's back. Good thing those sheep didn't get eaten by wolves, eh.
Oh man, I can't wait for the next sortie.
Time to get huntin'!
Now do ya see what an ace is capable of?
Whatever. Next time's gonna be much better.
Jetzt!
Should probably retreat while I still can, I guess!
You know where you belong? In a shark's stomach. Meh, whatever.
During most my missions I'm honestly just bored out of my mind and pray I find somethin' worth my time. If you ever feel bored, go hit up some of the U-boats at port.

If ya think U-boat combat is that fascinating, you could always come with me on the next sortie. Oh wait, you can't stay underwater all that long, can ya? Then how's about I teach you how to dive like a pro?
You can get onto my rigging while I'm surfaced, can'tcha? Don't worry, I ain't gonna just dump ya in the middle of the ocean. So, how's that sound? Wanna ride with me?

Someday I wanna take you with me on a trip across the sea, just the two of us. We could write a journal as we go and make a book or even movie out of it... Actually, that'd be weird, so let's not. But as long as we make some fond memories, I'm happy.
You got me, I'll give ya that much... But I've still got the chance to strike back. Close your eyes! ...Mwah! Heheh, hit ya right in the heart with that one, didn't I?
Hey, this is awesome!
There ain't no escaping the wolfpack!

ex.line: Oh, there you are. You're the only person who's capable of making me clock in this early, ya know that?
Hm-hmm-hm♪... What? This is how I always look. The hell are ya getting all prude for?
Foes you can't see aren't so scary if ya got friends to watch your back. Yeah, like those surface ship buddies of yours.
Ahahaha, Lebe's getting schooled by Thiele again! Ah, and if ya ever want me to school you, I could do that.
Mix together some lemon juice, coffee, and rum, and ya get... Hold up, are you seriously considering drinking this? It ain't really meant for consumption, though...
Ya need somethin'? Let's hear it then.
Mgh... Ohh...
Mission rewards, comin' through. Nah, I fetched 'em just 'cause I felt like doing it.
If ya don't wanna dig through your mailbox, I could do it for ya.
You got the map, Commander? No, not that, THIS one. You don't get it? It's the route we'll be taking for our date.
I'm goin' straight for the kill!
I told you, remember? "Swimming in reports of my success," and I delivered. Mwah!

lines.line: Nice timing. I just finished an intense battle. The result...? Of course I won. What? Did you want to have a match against me?
Nice timing. I just finished an intense battle. The result...? Of course I won. What? Did you want to have a match against me?
The snacks and drinks are on the side. Go ahead, help yourself to whatever you want. No need to be polite.
This getup's real comfy and easy to move around in. Plus, I'm in my own room, and it's not like it matters if you see.
If you wanna beat me, go practice for a few years and then come back, Warrior from the Land of the Rising Sun. Ahaha~
Um... wait a sec, I think I heard some weird noise. Don't tell me U-81's bunch snuck into my room again while playing hide-and-seek...
I'm a pretty big fan of the Dragon Sisters, y'know? How should I put it... They work hard, and you can't ever hate 'em. Isn't that right?
How about another match? All right! There's gonna be a punishment for the loser~
A new notification?! Oh, it's just your mail. I thought I was getting a challenge from L.I. or something.
Right, so, I just read up on this new strat. You should help me practice it!
Mmgh... Guh... Ahhh! These things are heavier than they look... Oh, there you are. You work out too, do ya? Feel free to join me if you've not just come to tease me.
Mmgh... Guh... Ahhh! These things are heavier than they look... Oh, there you are. You work out too, do ya? Feel free to join me if you've not just come to tease me.
I'm gonna get it this- Ah! Whew... Always showing up at just the wrong time... To hell with it. Let's get started on our workout.
Yeah, what? You fancy how an exercising U-boat looks?
Is that Northern Parliament girl using just one hand...? I'm frickin' speechless. What kinda crazy workout routine has she been doing?
Hey, you'll get outta shape if ya sit on your ass all day. Want me to show ya how it's done?
Grit is the name of the submarine game. I can work out here every day, no problem. I can coach you every day too, if ya want.
I'll remember that... You're getting what's coming to ya later!
Try to lift somethin' too heavy and it'll only hurt ya. Not like I'm worried you'll do literally that - choose your enemy, is all I'm saying... Hah, guess I am worrying after all...
Commission team's back. Guess we'd better go get into gear.
Victory iiis... mine!

Sup. If it isn't our Commander. Got bored already because you shattered all your previous records? Or, did you run into some mechanical issues? ...Huh, you're here to ask for my support? Did the butterscotch get to your brain or what? Despite the way I look, I've been on the sidelines cheering you on this whole time.

Sup. If it isn't our Commander. Got bored already because you shattered all your previous records? Or, did you run into some mechanical issues? ...Huh, you're here to ask for my support? Did the butterscotch get to your brain or what? Despite the way I look, I've been on the sidelines cheering you on this whole time.
Yo. Here for an inspection? Or to spectate? Or maybe you wanna cheer on the gals with me? Do whatever you wanna.
I'm no shut-in or nothing, but standing all day in the blazin' sun is gonna be the death of me... You feel the same? Then do me a solid and gimme a massage in a bit.
I'm not worried 'cause I know you're gonna win. But, if you were to lose, don't worry - I'll win in your stead. Hahah!
I can root for you anywhere and everywhere. On the stage, on the track, even on this bad boy - so, got a particular place in mind?
Should I be cool, or just do like usual and be tough... Hm? Nah, it's nothin', I'm just thinking about what kind of cheering on will make ya the happiest.
No boots? Yeah, 'cause it'd get hot as hell, standin' around in those. You oughta take that suit of yours off if you're sweating, too.
I swear, people like you... Huh? Oh, you went for THOSE... *blushes*
Hm? You tryna reward me? Hang on, why should I be rewarded when YOU just got back from a sortie? Should be the other way 'round, no?
Heh. Open another bottle of champagne for me when we get back, will ya?

What, you want me to root for you to pump you up? Is that why you made me wear all this? Fine. C'mon, you can do it. You're the best Commander there ever was. Now get out there! Pedal to the metal from start to finish!
Akizuki-class destroyer number three - Suzutsuki.

I'm Suzutsuki, Akizuki-class destroyer. I was a member of the 61st DesDiv along with Akizuki and Hatsuzuki, and escorted Musashi and participated in Noshiro's rescue mission! Not a shabby record, right? I had a close call at the Battle of Bou-no-Misaki when I got hit by two torpedoes, but I managed to survive until the end!
Ahaha, Pooky, listen up, we're gonna live here from now on! Uhh... Third ship of the Akizuki-class, Suzutsuki, reporting in! I'll be the one to protect my comrades and you, Commander! Just kidding~♪
Welcome back! ...Got any new jobs? I'm down for anything!
When my friends are counting on me, I can feel power surging within me that makes me feel like I can do anything!
"The invincible Suzutsuki is here! Your attacks shall not put a scratch on me!" How'd that sound? Hya hah!
Ahaha! You'd rather sit atop Commander's head instead of mine? Very well, go forth! Oh, but no pranks though!
Commander, you sure have a lot of work, don't you~ Look, Isokaze, Urakaze, being a warlord or a general is a lot of hard work. A better job would be to become Commander's retainers!
Look, fluffy and super pattable, right? ...Hey, I'm talking about Pooky, not my ears!
This marking on my right cheek? You haven't heard of it, Commander? It's the latest fashion trend! Here, I'll draw one on for you!
C-Commander! Jeez, there are some things that you shouldn't be doing!
A tough mission, huh? Lemme take a look, maybe I can help out!
Mission complete! Commander, don't forget about the rewards!
Huh? The envelope got torn? ...Ahaha... Sorry 'bout that, must've been Pooky...
Team A is directly under my command. Teams B and C will follow the plan, and then... Oh, Commander, when'd you get back?
The commission fleet has returned! Lemme take home the extras!
Give me more power, so that I may protect everyone!
May the odds ever be in your favor! Go forth!
The enemy general’s head is mine~! Just kidding, ahaha~♪
Guh... No matter what, we all have to make it back safely...!
Suzutsuki, defending her friends!
The real fight's only getting started!
Commander, you're gonna make me hate you...
I may come across as a braggart, but that's because I'm pretty reliable! "Oh, Suzutsuki, you saved me! I don't know what I would've done without you!" Yeah, I get that a lot~
Commander, you can rely on me as well! ...What?! You think you can one-up me...?!
Hmm... What would I like the commander to do for me? ...Make tea? Pack my lunch? Carry me back to the dorms after I fall asleep? ...Th-th-that's way too embarrassing!
Commander, get over here! Hup~ ...Mmhmm, that's much cozier. Now it feels more like I'm relying on you, doesn't it? See, you'll also have to take good care of me from now on~ Just kidding~♪ Ahaha!
Ahahaha... Being in a situation like this is quite nerve-racking, isn't it? ...I thought I had mentally prepared myself... Commander, you c-can handle the rest... right...?
Ooh! Can I really have this?
Be careful out there!
I will be the one to protect my friends!
Isokaze, back me up!

ex.line: Welcome back! Wanna make out instead of doing work today? Haha, just kidding~ ......Eh, you serious?!
Thanks, Commander! You were a great help! ...What's the matter? Are you the kind of person that gets really hyped up after being complimented?
Lady Mutsu, this is what you do with the sword... and this is how you wave the flag... Got it? Now you have everything you need for our mock Sengoku battles!
Pooky, what do you want to eat today? ...Ah! Jeez, now Pooky's attached to you now because you keep feeding him, Commander!
Commander, you can rub my ears if you want~
Mission complete! As for my payment, just let me to lie in your lap for a bit!
Suzutsuki is unsinkable, and therefore, Commander is also undefeatable! ...Anyway, I know you'll come back safely no matter where you go! Welcome home~!
I love being in your arms, Commander~ Ahh, I could roll around forever~ ...Wh-who's there?! ...D-d-do you need something from Suzutsuki?! ......Forget what you just saw, all right?! Seriously!

lines.line: Commander, over here! We're about to start without you! Ahaha, what would you like to do, Commander? Beach volleyball? Sandcastle building? We can also go relax in the water if you'd like!
Commander, over here! We're about to start without you! Ahaha, what would you like to do, Commander? Beach volleyball? Sandcastle building? We can also go relax in the water if you'd like!
Commander, time out! Look, the others have already started playing without you~ Fine, fine... I shall be the one to accompany you then!
I'm pretty refreshing and cool, right? Just like my name suggests~
Do we have enough people to build a sand castle? Great, count me in as well! Wait, Commander, hold on!
Pooky likes coming to the sea as well, isn't that right~? Ah, careful not to fall into the water!
Agano's not here? That's too bad, I was looking forward to playing with her... Commander, why do you look so relieved? Hm? It's just my imagination?
Woah?! ...Oh, it's you, Commander, you surprised me... Hibiki shoved a crab in my face earlier and it gave me a nasty pinch...
Jeez, Commander! What are you doing in front of this many people?!
Not enough people for a game of beach volleyball? All right! I'll go play some watermelon splitting with Georgia first!
Phew... Playing by the beach is super fun, but after all the commotion, I could use some relaxation... Yup, I'm gonna lie down right here! Mm... Yeah, just stay put like that. Hehe~
I, Akizuki-class destroyer, Suzutsuki, shall not allow you to pass through these arches! Hwuh?! I missed the return again...!
I, Akizuki-class destroyer, Suzutsuki, shall not allow you to pass through these arches! Hwuh?! I missed the return again...!
Happy New Year, Commander!
These markings are the proof of my battle scars as a warrior... they're not just doodles! Ugh... I swear, I'll be back for revenge after I train some more!
Aaahhhhh!! Jean Bart, you don't have to shank every shuttlecock out of existence!
Pooky, I got some sunflower seeds from Hanazuki! Here, come and eat your fill~ Grow big and strong and scare the heck out of the commander~ Ahaha!
I can't sit still during the New Year! After all, there are so many things going on that only happen during this time of year!
Commander, make sure the matches continue smoothly!
Suzutsuki, now reading the contents of your mail out loud!
The girls from the commission fleet are back! Darn it, I wish Hatsushimo could come with me!
You ready, Pooky? Let's— go!
Mogami-class heavy cruiser number four - Kumano.

Name's Kumano, Mogami-class heavy cruiser! Back in the war, I was Cruiser Division 7, workin' my ass off! Shame about what happened at the island in you-know-where, though... Welp, no point crying over spilt milk. Just gotta do better this time.
Bam! Heavy cruiser, Kumano, ready for action~! Commander, pleased to meetcha~!
There you are, Commander! Nice, nice! So, what's up today? We hangin' out together? Just work? Figures...
Yo, Commander! Hang out with me, now! Oh, is that a lollipop for me? 'Kay, some other time then! Nom!
Huh? Me takin' the battle seriously surprised you? Well, yeah, I get serious when the situation demands it.
So, Commander, what kinda girls do ya like? Wait, lemme guess, I'm your type, aren't I? Ahah!
Soooo bored... Hey, could ya get Suzuya up in this place? I wanna chat with her about my next shopping trip.
Well, well! Caught you admirin', Commander! Hehehe, you don't gotta act innocent. If you wanna stare, stare all ya want!
Weeeell, someone's feeling frisky, huh? Totes fine with me. Go on, touch me 'till you're content~♡
Ugh, missions? You're probs better off hittin' up Suzuya...
Sooo tireeed... Oh, crap! Hey, unclaimed mission rewards! C'mon, man!
You've got a new DM- Err, I mean, new mail! And don't go ghosting whoever sent it!
You gonna review that last battle? Aight, cool, go ahead. Wait, I'm the one who's gotta do it?
Commission team's back, yo. Don't got time for rhymes, but let's go!
Sweet! This'll get me more time in the limelight, yeah?
Enemies spotted! Guess we're rollin' up our sleeves and squarin' off!
MVP, baybee! Hell yeah! Give it up for Kumano!
Payback's-a comin', ya hear?!
It's ass-whoopin' time!
I'll return to port if it's the last thing I do!
You're lame, you know that? Not tryin' to be mean, or anything, just saying. Listen, I've got a couple ideas for how to unlamify you.
Commandeeeeer, I'm boooored, let's do somethiiiing. Yeah, it's candy, so what? Not like I'll turn into a lardo from a single- Hey, oww!
Commandeeeer, I'm lonelyyyy. We can do whatever, just hang out with meeee. "Find someone else?" Wow, rude much? I wanna hang with you! C'mooon!
You'll finally hang with me? Hell yeah! Wish you would've just said so from the beginning! Anyway, where we goin'? Y'know, just the two of us~♡
Y-you really like me?! Really, huh... Thing is, I actually love you, Commander... Seriously, though! I do!

Uhh, "I take you, to have and to hold, from this day forward"... How'd the rest go? Agh, screw it, it's too long and I'm makin' a fool of myself in front of everyone! You don't mind if we bail and go straight to our room, right, darling?
Ooh! Found something nice! Oh, it's for me? Woohoo!
Yo, Mogami, let's hang out later!
Suzuya, you take that one!
Hot damn, your makeup game is on point!
It's time for Kumano's sexy swimsuit debut~! Just kidding~☆ Hey Commander, just where~ are~ you~ staring~? Ahaha~♡
It's time for Kumano's sexy swimsuit debut~! Just kidding~☆ Hey Commander, just where~ are~ you~ staring~? Ahaha~♡
This is too revealing? Meh, not really~? I've seen submarines wearing more risqué stuff than this.
Commandeeeer, what're you up to? Get over here already, c'mooon!
I wanna see Mogami in a bikini! Don't you? I do, at least! And you? Same, right?
Phew, I'm tired! Commandeeeer, massage my feet and shoulders! ...Err, I didn't ask you to massage THOSE!
Candy? Nuh-uh, this is mine, and I ain't givin' it away! Hahahah!
Hah, I knew this would catch your eye! You're like a little kid~
Yo, Commandeeer, how'd ya like my bikini? Come closer if ya need a better look~ Yeah, you bet I'm tryin' to hit on you.
Now it's your turn, Commander! Which one's it gonna be~? You suuuure you wanna pick this card? ...I hear you, Suzuya! Stop tellin' the Commander what the cards are!
