Now it's your turn, Commander! Which one's it gonna be~? You suuuure you wanna pick this card? ...I hear you, Suzuya! Stop tellin' the Commander what the cards are!
Psst, Suzuya! Commander's here! Hahah! Let's see you try to beat me this time, man!
Aw, for real?! You lucked out and chose the best possible card! Hrmm... Hang on, are you cheating, Commander? You ALWAYS pick out the good cards!
Hungry, Suzuya? Wanna order home delivery?
Whatcha lookin' at, Commander? You more interested in me than the cards, or what?
Taking your sweet time, huh. Mmh... Meh... *yaaawn*...
Ahah! Is that your final answer?
You jelly, Suzuya? 'Cause you sure look it! Haha~
Ahah~ Back where we left off, Commander! So, which card are you gonna pick?
Now I'm PISSED! I'm gonna beat the crap outta you!
Tadah! Get a load of my... dancer outfit! So, whaddya think? Ahaha~♡ Hey, Commander, where are those eyes wandering? Did ya see something ya like?
Tadah! Get a load of my... dancer outfit! So, whaddya think? Ahaha~♡ Hey, Commander, where are those eyes wandering? Did ya see something ya like?
Welcome to my unveiling! Now let's see how many songs you can last before you fall for me~ Hahahah♡
Who else are ya excited to see, besides me? Ahahah☆ Hey, I'm not jelly in the slightest. I know you, Commander. Just name like, 20 or 30 other people~
That's... Mikuma? When'd she become so damn hot and stylish? Sheeeesh... Even I'm swooning over here!
Wanna see a rough rehearsal, Commander? Or are you gonna wait 'til the real deal?
This dance is like, murder on your back. I'm gonna be recovering in bed tomorrow, so go easy on me~ "What're we gonna do then?" Hang out, duh! Ahah☆
Ahah♡ Wait 'til I start shakin' it around~
Commander... Where's that hand of yours wanderin'...? ♡
We've got mission rewards~ Anything catch your eye?
Aw crap, got an e-mail! Commander, pass me the phone!
C'mon, take a seat~ I'mma give those weary bones a nice massage! Heheh, where should I start? Your shoulders, or your feet? Tickle tickle tickle♪
I'm gonna evade all their attacks and dance around the- Oww!
Zuihou-class aircraft carrier - Chitose.

Though Chiyoda and I were originally designed as seaplane tenders, during a certain war, we were remodeled into aircraft carriers. Whether it's due to my lack of skill or my inability to oppose the passing of time... I wasn't able to be of much use until the end.
I am Chitose, light carrier of the Sakura Empire. Commander, I look forward to receiving your guidance. By the way, is it true that Chiyoda is also here? ...Don't worry, I was merely inquiring.
Oh, you're here. There's some red bean jelly from Chiyoda on your desk. Feel free to take some.
Chiyoda and I are partners in carrying out shrine duties. Even though Chiyoda can be pretty annoying at times, there are still times she's fun to be around.
Isuzu... is quite a scaredy cat, but she's a good girl. But even that side of her is cute.
Chiyoda always insists on doing my hair this way, so I let her. However, I always feel a bit apologetic for making her do so much...
I'm at least confident in my Kagura dancing skills. If you get the chance, please come and watch.
Do you like touching my bangs like Chiyoda does?
Who?! ... Oh, it's you. I thought it was a prank from that pink-haired Union girl.
Hah?! Wait, no...!
Here are some more missions. Isn't it bad to let them pile up like this?
The mission is... complete. That's good.
There's a letter addressed to you. Please check it out.
I'm glad you're safe... I made a protective charm for you, and also one for Chiyoda. Please keep it safely inside your clothes.
The commission team has returned safely. What a relief.
For the time being, thanks, Commander.
I have to make sure to be careful...
I'm glad... that I was able to be a help to everyone else.
We're pulling back. Chiyoda, please be safe...
Attack force, surround them...!
This is bad... I hope Chiyoda... is alright...
Commander. Get away from Chiyoda. As far as you possibly can.
The one thing I hope I never have to see again is the formation of a "decoy fleet"...
I don't dislike having to pamper Chiyoda... If anything, I might actually find it quite endearing...
Cooking, cleaning, even taking care of my things... Chiyoda takes care of it all. ... Basically, it's not that I can't do these tasks. If I put my mind to it, I can do it... I totally can...
Commander, won't you rely on me some more? I'm actually pretty good at spoiling people, you know... Oh I know... would you like me to give you a lap pillow, or something...?

If that's how you feel about me, I'll gladly accept your feelings... I'll pray for your safety every day, and be your refuge from your daily hardships. I hope... you'll come look for me whenever you're feeling troubled, because I want to pamper you like I do with Chiyoda...
This is really nice. ...Thank you.
Alright, alright... We'll go together.
D-Don't call out to me so endearingly...
I'm here. There's nothing to fear.
An order of coconut milk... and grilled sausage. Mm, that should do it. ...Hm? Commander? Are you here to place an order, or to get away from the heat?
An order of coconut milk... and grilled sausage. Mm, that should do it. ...Hm? Commander? Are you here to place an order, or to get away from the heat?
The sun's rays are so harsh... I should go look for some awning to hide under...
Everyone becomes so rowdy when they get to the beach... I hope nothing bad happens today. Please, may enemy aircraft and volleyballs not come flying our way...
Isuzu, who told you that...? There aren't any ghosts here, don't worry. Go out and play.

Chiyoda's quite the sore loser... She's like that even when it comes to building sand castles, so I can't even imagine how worked up she'd get over beach volleyball... If that pink-haired union girl is our opponent, I think I'll just sit out...
The weather forecast says... it'll be clear until the evening... Mmn...
That shaved ice looks really good... I guess there's a good reason cold treats are popular in the summer.
Commander, you're sweating so profusely. Are you okay? ...Here's a towel. Let me wipe you down.
I had this outfit custom-made just for today... Do you like it, Commander? Um, that's good then... (*whispers*) Booyah.
I had this outfit custom-made just for today... Do you like it, Commander? Um, that's good then... (*whispers*) Booyah.
Did I keep you waiting? It took me an awfully long time to get ready... This always happens when Chiyoda isn't around...
I'm so looking forward to seeing what Chiyoda's going to wear... I wanna take a picture with her... Yeah, we're definitely going to do that.
Are you busy, Commander? Ph-photo. I really want to take a photo with you...
Up at the shrine, I use a fan to help out with Yamashiro and Fusou. With enough practice, you can do stuff... like this! H-how'd that look?
Flying cranes are a symbol of good luck... Yeah, I'm sure that's true! Zuikaku said the same thing.
Phew... It's sure hard to walk around with these long hems.
D-did you want to take a photo...?
Are you tired? We still have a banquet to go to tonight, so you should rest while you still can... Oh, don't worry about me, I can get some rest right here... (*blushes*)
Even if I'm alone... No, Chiyoda and the Commander are waiting for me...!
When I get free time, I like to come to this lotus pond to unwind... Commander, shall we cleanse ourselves with tea together?
When I get free time, I like to come to this lotus pond to unwind... Commander, shall we cleanse ourselves with tea together?
Oh, you're here. I'm just cleansing myself with tea... Come and enjoy the peace and quiet with me.
Washing yourself with tea should calm the body and mind, I'm told. How do I feel? Hmm... Yes, I think I'm relaxed. What about you?
Commander, is there anything you'd like to do after this cleansing? U-umm, you could... include me...
Chiyoda told me that cleansing with tea will infuse you with its fragrance... Do you like this scent, Commander?
Watching the ripples in the water, smelling the aroma of tea... and being with you. Nothing could be more relaxing.
Are you fixing my hair? Mm... That feels nice.
Was it the scent of tea that attracted you? Or was it... me?
Do you want to cleanse me...?
All of your work is done. If you're tired, then come drink tea and relax alongside me...
Welcome back. Come over and sit... I'll whisk away your fatigue with the aroma of tea.

The delicate fragrance of tea has bound us together. From now on, whenever you smell it, will you remember what happened in this pond today? I'll always be here... waiting to share this tranquility with you.
Zuihou-class aircraft carrier - Chiyoda.

Even though Chitose and I were seaplane tenders, after a loss in a certain battle, we were both remodeled into aircraft carriers. ...Even so, neither of us were able to be of much use until the end... Ahahaha....
Hehe, looks like I've kept you waiting! I am the renowned seaplane carrier- err, I mean, aircraft carrier, Chiyoda! In any case, I'll be staying here! Right, right, is my sister Chitose here as well?
Today's another great day to show off my amazing prowess! Commander, let's get pumped!
I help Chitose out with her Shinto duties sometimes. You know, as a shrine maiden. ...Huh? You think I'd be more of a hindrance...?
Taaake that! ...Hmm? No reaction... Commander, sometimes you're so much like Chitose, it's honestly quite a letdown...
Doesn't Chitose have really silky hair that smells just divine? Actually, I'm the one who takes care of it everyday.
Whenever we rehearse the dance with Yamashiro and Fusou, some kind of trouble always occurs... Like something falling, or flying off somewhere. But really? I find it all to be pretty funny!
Hehehe~ Commander, do you prefer them long or short?
Am I so beautiful that I caught your eye? I'm flattered, but you should focus on your work for now~
Yikes?! If you had done this to Chitose instead, she'd have turned bright red from embarrassment!
You know, I think it's better to take care of missions as they come in. Yes?
You took care of the missions? Alright. While you take a break, I'm going to go check up on how Chitose's doing.
There's a letter addressed to you, Commander.
Looks like you didn't run into any trouble while I was gone. Hehe, it must be thanks to the protective charm I slipped inside your clothes~
Commander, the Commissions Team is back.
Oooh~ I really want to show the new and improved Chiyoda off to Chitose♡
Let's kick some fine enemy butt on this wonderful day!
Did you see that? Did you see how amazing I was?
Ugh... I want to bury my face in Chitose's jugs...
It's my grand entrance!
Chitose, save me...
Commander. Get away from Chitose. As far as you possibly can.
I went to give Chitose some red bean jellies, but I ended up getting spoiled senseless by her instead... Oh, here's some for you. Please go ahead and try some.
Commander, don't you want to try touching Chitose's hair too? Even though she prefers to keep her distance from others, if you ask, she absolutely won't be able to turn you down.

Oh, the things I'd do for a lap pillow from Chitose right now♡. Seeing she isn't around right now, I guess I'll need a temporary replacement... Hm, maybe the Commander who's slacking off right now. Hey, if you don't want the others to find out you're slacking off, give up your lap to me~ Hehehe... Mmn~

Y-yeah, I, I guess I've gotten pretty close to you... What would Chitose say if she saw you pampering me like this? Hm... If she saw us like this, she'd probably say, "I love both of you, so it's fine." or something. Yeah, she'd definitely say something like that! Hahaha!
Now that you've given me this, you're going to be stuck pampering me senseless! You already are? I-I guess that's true... Well, feel free to request whatever you want from me in exchange!
Isn't this the awesomest thing?! Thanks, Commander!
Big sis♪ Let's kick some fine enemy butt on this wonderful day☆
Hehe~ If you don't have any other plans, then your only task... is to enjoy a holiday by the sea! Commander, have you switched into vacation mode yet?
Hehe~ If you don't have any other plans, then your only task... is to enjoy a holiday by the sea! Commander, have you switched into vacation mode yet?
Since we're here anyway, we've gotta enjoy the day to the fullest! We can start by playing with some balls. Catch, Commander!
Heehee... Commander, take this! A direct hit from my water gun! Oh, you got some saltwater in your mouth? I'm terribly sorry... So, Commander... tell me, how did it taste? Hahaha~
Hmm, beach volleyball? ... I'll use my powers to turn Saratoga into a holey woman! Ain't that right, Chitose?
The summer sun, the sparkling sea... Stop lazing around and come play with me already, Chitose~
Oh, Yamashiro and her sister came too. Wouldn't it be a good idea to team up with them? Well?
The glamorous Chiyoda in a swimsuit~! No matter how breathtaking I might look, don't just stand there and stare like an idiot. C'mon, let's go and play~
If you're looking for something nice and round, I can throw this ball at your face, you know...?

It's not like I was aiming for your face, you know? My hand just happened to slip, and the ball just happened to make contact with your face... C'mon, get over it. It's just an inflatable ball anyway!
Oh, Commander! You finally found me! Hehe, I found this super-cool rest spot all on my own! Wanna drink with me?
Oh, Commander! You finally found me! Hehe, I found this super-cool rest spot all on my own! Wanna drink with me?
THERE you are, Commander! This time, I'm not taking no for an answer. Get over here and have a drink.
Ahh... I'm getting a little hot. Is it the wine, or is it because you're so close...?
Drinking warm wine in cool water... Gosh, it's such an awesome contrast! Come join me, Commander.
This wine is just waiting for the perfect person to be shared with... Come on, you know I mean you, Commander! Hehe.
Hehehe, I like it when you pet me... You really love my hair, don't you?
Hmm? You're really staring... You want me more than the wine, don't you, Commander?
Heheh, got you, Commander! I'm not letting go 'til you reek of wine~
Missions complete! Cheers!
Welcome back! Need a cup? It'll warm you up and chase off your fatigue~
I'm stronger now! Gotta celebrate this one with a drink!
The scent and warmth of this wine are just like the hot passion between us... Commander, come a little closer so you can really feel it.
Munition ship - Kashino.

My name is Kashino. My favorite hobby is relaxing in the hot springs, and my weight and height are... Ack, that's not what I'm supposed to be saying! Excuse me... Um, I was the ship that was created to transport the Yamato-class's 40cm Type 94 gun, but I also participated in various transport missions before finally being sunk by a submarine... Hmm, is that good enough...?

Well met, Commander. I am Kashino, munition ship of the Sakura Empire. Hmm... I may be a rather peculiar ship, but... if there's anything I can help with, please entrust it to me... is that acceptable?
Welcome back, Commander. Is there anything I can transport... Err, I mean, is there anything I can help you with...?
My weapon? ...Hyah! Eh? I look really cool? D-don't say that, I barely know how to use it...
1, 2, 3... Commander, the supplies you've given me to transport are all accounted for. Hm? It's all right, you don't have to get everyone to help me carry it. It's not very heavy...
♪~ Commander, I brought you your tea. Adding a bit of milk will give it a Royal Navy flair... how about it?
Commander, how about decorating your window with a windchime? Enjoying a refreshing breeze while enjoying this delicate sound will surely make you feel better~
Oh...! S-sorry, did I hit you with my tail...?
Am I carrying main guns again? ...Ah, sorry, I spaced out a bit...
Eek?! Commander?!
Do you still have missions to complete? Please be mindful of the deadlines.
Mission complete~ That's one fewer thing to worry about.
There's a letter on this pile of supplies...? Oh, it's addressed to you, Commander. Here you go.
Phew... Oh, Commander, welcome back. I just finished stashing the supplies that the others brought back into the warehouse. The inventory? Um... please give me a moment.
The commission team has returned safely. Let's go greet them. Having that said, I'm used to being in their position though, not the other way around~
Hmm... Was I supposed to feel different...?
Anti-air combat... commencing!
This sense of elation is rather mysterious... Mm...
Ugh... It's hard for me to keep up with the actual warships...
I've brought the supplies!
It's just a scratch... Don't worry, I can keep going!
I can bring you all the supplies in the world, but you don't seem to be capable of using them well...
My rigging is a bit different from that of the other girls. Want to learn more...? Mm, why don't you come take a seat on my deck then?
I often play with the little destroyers. Like this... I put one on each shoulder and pretend like I'm some giant monster or robot... Yes, it's quite fun~♪
Commander, if you're tired, why not take a bath? Afterwards, if you enjoy some fresh milk, you'll be sure to feel— C-Commander?? What's wrong? Should I take you to the infirmary...?
Phew... Ah, Commander, are you feeling better now? I've brought iced milk, sweets, and everyone's well-wishes. Ehehe~ If you'd like me to wash your back again, just let me know.
As a munition ship, I may not be very useful in combat. However, as long as you believe in me and cherish me... I'll try to be as useful as I can in other ways...! Mhm!
This is... for me? Thank you very much!
I've brought your armaments!

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Is there something I can help you with today?
♪~Commander, do you like Western-style Sakura confections? I'll currently deciding on what to pack you for lunch, ehehe~
You want to take me to the hot springs on our next day off? Really?! I'm so happy to hear that!
Milky Manjuu...? Are you talking about that drink that used to be popular? I can make it if you'd like.
...Mm... Nnh... S-sorry, this sometimes happen when I listen to the windchimes... Zzz...
Oh my... C-Commander...
I'll help bring back the supplies from the commission fleet! Commander, please look after our hardworking girls!
The munitions I brought paid off~♪
Ahh~ That feels so good... Commander, thank you so much. I really appreciate the massage... Now, it's my turn to do all sorts of things for you, right? Ehehe~♪

lines.line: Ack... Owww... My apologies, Commander, I seem to have slipped on something... At times, it's hard to notice things I'm about to step on... Ugh...
Ack... Owww... My apologies, Commander, I seem to have slipped on something... At times, it's hard to notice things I'm about to step on... Ugh...
Commander, are you enjoying the water? Yes, I love the hot springs here~
If there's anything lacking about these hot springs, it's the fact that this place is too small... If you're not careful, it's easy to slip or to bump into various things...
Phew... That feels so good... My shoulders aren't stiff anymore~ Commander, thank you for telling me about this place~
M-my swimsuit, um... Commander's going to see... Erm, please disregard that!
A nice bottle of milk after a refreshing soak really hits the spot~ Let's get another bottle later~♪ ...Um, I knocked the first one over when I slipped earlier...
Shall I... wash your back for you?
Th-they're pretty heavy, right...?
By the way, Commander, there was a letter for you... Sorry, I forgot to report it earlier...
I've kept the fresh milk in the fridge back there. After you've finished bathing, please feel free to help yourself~
Oww... My luck isn't so good today...
Hyah?! U-Umm, I can't get out... Oh, Commander?! I'm sorry! I tripped while I was cleaning, and I ended up stuck in here! Umm... What do I do now...
Hyah?! U-Umm, I can't get out... Oh, Commander?! I'm sorry! I tripped while I was cleaning, and I ended up stuck in here! Umm... What do I do now...
Commander, if there's anything I can help you with—Oh. Erm, maybe I'm the one who needs help...
Being a maid is a lot harder than I thought... I can do physical labor and simple chores just fine, but deep cleaning never goes well.
How did this happen, you say? Well, um... I'm not too sure, myself. You say this doesn't normally happen? Ooh...
The ingredients are on the shelves, and the snacks are in the fridge. There's cold milk in there, too, so feel free to help yourself.
Honestly, it's really hard to maintain this posture. Umm, b-because they're really heavy... *blush*
Oh, I... c-can't get out this way, either...
Commander?! P-please don't pull on the door right now, or... Hyah?!
Ah, watch your step... (BANG!) Hyah?! C-Commander?!
W-we've been issued a new mission! Commander, let us check at once!
Hnnngh... Mail's here! I had to struggle to pick that one up!
Nnngh! Haah, haah... I just can't get out. They said this store was built well, but this isn't especially reassuring, is it...?
The commission team is back! Uh, umm... I can't exactly greet them like this, can I...?
Want to see how a maid fights? Get ready!
Phew... I'm glad I took extra-special care to avoid messing anything up.
Honestly, this outfit is more suited to service than combat...

♪~ Commander, how'd that sound? Hmm... I just started learning last minute, so I guess things aren't coming together after all... But, why do I sound off-pitch even though I'm playing everything exactly the way I was taught...?

♪~ Commander, how'd that sound? Hmm... I just started learning last minute, so I guess things aren't coming together after all... But, why do I sound off-pitch even though I'm playing everything exactly the way I was taught...?
♪~ How did you like my performance, Commander? Hehehe, I somehow feel like I'm both making progress and hitting a plateau... What exactly am I doing wrong?
I'm glad you know so much about instruments, Commander~ I didn't know the correct playing posture, so I could never play just right... Y-you say it's not a posture problem?
*inhale*... *exhale*... Don't think too much, just do as you practiced... You'll do just fine, Kashino...!
By the way, I call this set the geisha party! Hehehe, I put more effort into the name since I was going to invite you♪
You say it's a little hot...? I-I didn't turn up the heat... Maybe it's just because of the lighting and atmosphere...?
Ah... *blushes*
You'll show me how to do it right? Thank you, Commander...
F-forgive me... *blushes*
There's a letter among the gifts...? Oh, it's addressed to you, Commander.
♪~ Sit the body in my lap, hold the neck with my left hand, the bachi in my right... Hm? Commander? Is something about me bothering you?
It looks like the commission team has returned. Umm... May I call them over for a rehearsal...?
Commander, wasn't that perfect?! ...O-only my fighting was?
Hwah?! I-I accidentally stepped on my kimono...
W-welcome... A bottle of milk is just as good after swimming in the pool as it is after bathing in a hot spring... Umm, should I really be wearing this? You seem to be blushing, Commander...
W-welcome... A bottle of milk is just as good after swimming in the pool as it is after bathing in a hot spring... Umm, should I really be wearing this? You seem to be blushing, Commander...
W-would you like a bottle of milk? Thanks for your patronage! Oh, don't worry about paying - this one's free, as thanks for all you do, Commander.
There are lots of stalls here, so I'll probably fill up pretty quickly if I try the food at just a few... Just exercise and it'll be fine? Well, I suppose so...
Commander, what would you like to drink after a tour around the park? ...Hm? Anything served by me will be fine? O-oh gosh...
Th-thanks for your order! That's one cold milk, one gomme syrup, and a sprinkle of my love... Wait, what?!

*pant*... *pant*... Standing like this all day is actually pretty hard... No, not because I'm embarrassed or because it's hot, but because the sign is pretty heavy, and so are my... N-never mind, forget it!
Whew... That helped me calm down a little.
C-can I take your order?
Wh-what should I do?
Umm, Commander... You have unfinished missions.
Mission complete. As for the rewards... I-I think I'll wait here while you do it...
A new letter? *sigh*... I can't be expected to transport things while dressed like this...
Welcome back, Commander. Can I interest you in some milk? It was squeezed and bottled just this morning.
The commission team is back! Oh gosh... I can't face them dressed like this...
Th-this feels so inappropriate!
How about another bottle to celebrate this victory? Although, it's milk and not champagne, so...

Have fun at the amusement park with everyone else? No, no, I promise I'm already having a lot of fun, entertaining you and the other guests! Also, since I'm dressed like this... at least wait until we're alone, okay?
Independence-class light aircraft carrier - Princeton (CVL-23.)

Second ship of the Independence class, Princeton, at your service. I was originally laid down as the seventh ship in the Cleveland class, Tallahassee. I fought a lot alongside Saratoga in the war, and though I was able to learn much from her, I wasn't able to make it through the Battle of Leyte Gulf... It'd be an honor to fight by her side once again.
I'm Princeton, Independence class. Tallahassee? I don't mind if you want to call me that.
You're finally here. Did you rest well?
Did you need something? Oh, it's fine. I wasn't doing anything special, just sorta letting my mind wander.
Sara? ...S-Saratoga is someone I admire very much. I wouldn't dare call her by her nickname.
Montpelier is a close friend of mine. It's not because we were both members of the Cleveland class, but because we both have someone we really look up to in our lives.
Feel free to give me as much work as you need. It's part of a secretary ship's duties, so don't fret it.
What, do you think I'm too inexpressive? I was wondering if that's why it's like you're always trying to make me laugh.
Have you never tried a knuckle sandwich before? How about a taste of mine... Hyah!
We've been assigned new missions? Let's give them a look.
Mission rewards... My heart's dancing with glee.
Your mail? I'll go get it, so just stay there and focus on your work.
You look pretty tired. Here's a towel.
Heading out to greet the commission team? I'll go with you.
Not bad at all. Appreciate it, Commander.
Go forth... No. Let's put the lessons we've learned into practice!
Looking good. Let's press on.
Still out of Saratoga's league...
Just like Saratoga would!
I won't let history repeat itself!
Honestly, I'd rather have Saratoga be the one giving me directions.
You wanted to have a chat over some tea? Pl-please, just a moment... Umm, I need to tidy up the room a bit, so I'd appreciate it if you could give me half an hour or so...

Ahem! So you were asking about my hobbies? I like to read books and... study Saratoga's battle style. In terms of combat prowess, I sincerely believe that Saratoga is in a class of her own, and wouldn't lose even to Enterprise herself.

Do you understand what I mean? Even though Saratoga's usually a perky, high-spirited kind of girl, she's always looking out for others, even in battle. I've personally been saved by her many times. There's also how... Commander? Oh no, you fell asleep...

Commander, why do you have a picture of Saratoga? You picked it up from the floor?! Nooo! I can't believe I've screwed up so royally... You see, this is from my collection... Please keep this a secret from everyone else, I beg you!

I'm so lackluster compared to Saratoga, so why would you...? Err, not that I'm turning you down! If anything, I'd be willing to go through thick and thin with you, as long as you're fine with someone like me... Yes, let's be together!
Thanks. Is there anything I can do for you in return?
Saratoga, I've got your back!
I'll do my best to get it done.
You don't need to worry about me!

ex.line: I'm so happy to see you again. Let's get stuff done!
Commander, did you watch Saratoga's exercise? Not that it's any different from the usual, but it's always truly amazing how creative she can get!
Wow... I can't believe Saratoga called me Princey... Today must be my lucky day.
Montpelier's sister, Cleveland, is truly... a fascinating person. There are plenty of things I can learn from her as well.
Feel free to entrust me with as much work as you need me to. After all, we've both sworn to work hard to become like Saratoga... no?
I don't mind you trying to get me to laugh, but these pranks are a bit... W-wait, was this Saratoga's idea all along?!
Geez, that was very naughty of you. *pat pat*
You look exhausted... Hold still, I'll wipe that sweat off your brow.

All right, we'll now start our meeting to review and discuss Saratoga's battle style! There will be another one right after to appreciate her newest single! Commander, make sure to keep me company until the end!

lines.line: Commander, are you also here to swim? ...Ah, this here? I brought it with me to the ocean to get some practice in.
Commander, are you also here to swim? ...Ah, this here? I brought it with me to the ocean to get some practice in.
Have you done your stretches yet? You don't want to get cramps because you rushed into the ocean unprepared.
I got this collector's edition of "Saratoga: Beautiful Summer Days" from Gridley. Looking at Saratoga enjoying the summer with everyone else makes me wish I could join her...
Hehehe. With this, I'll be able to improve my sense of balance and my physical strength at the same time. Would you like to give this a try as well?
...It really will be a problem if my hair gets all messy from this. Um, Commander... do you think you could tie it down for me?
Independence and the others are calling for me? ...All right, I'll go.
You want to get on? I-it's not that I don't want you to, but...
W-wait a second! If you move too suddenly, it'll capsize... Wah?!
If you stay out while the sun's blazing... you're going to get heatstroke. Make sure not to let the sun cook you for too long.
You're finally here? ...Ah, well, I only just got here as well, so don't worry about it. Anyway, shall we get going?
You're finally here? ...Ah, well, I only just got here as well, so don't worry about it. Anyway, shall we get going?
I heard there's a famous candy store around these parts. W-Why don't we stop by there first?
According to Saratoga, what I should be doing in this situation is... Wah?! Commander?!! I wasn't up to anything at all!
Commander, what's your favorite flavor of ice cream? ...Oh, umm, it's just for reference...
Saratoga told me this outfit looks fine on me, but I wonder I really do look presentable in such cute clothing...
A shooting game? Alright, I'll show you how much I've improved thanks to Saratoga's special training sessions! Oh... it's a bit embarrassing to get all pumped up by myself...
You want... to hold hands? ...W-Well, that's not a bad idea... Even though this isn't a big deal, why is my heart pounding so furiously...
Y-You did that on purpose, didn't you?!
Commander, where have you been all this... a premium Saratoga plushie?! W-Where in the world did you find this masterpiece!!!
I'm done changing... Is this supposed to be a "reindeer" costume? It feels a bit too risqué... Oh, Commander, since you're already here, come get your Christmas present.
I'm done changing... Is this supposed to be a "reindeer" costume? It feels a bit too risqué... Oh, Commander, since you're already here, come get your Christmas present.
Merry Christmas, Commander. Let us enjoy a joyful Christmas together.
Of course I've prepared a present for Saratoga, I do so every year. Saratoga didn't seem all too pleased though... What could be the issue?
I heard someone at the port accidentally tied herself up while making some ribbons. I have to learn from those mistakes.
You want me to tell some Santa stories to the destroyer girls... I did promise Saratoga I would help her out, but I'm not much of a storyteller...
Commander, I've finished wrapping up my presents. Would you help me carry them over to the Christmas tree?
If you love my smile so much... I-I suppose I could smile a bit longer for you.
H-hold up! The ribbon's going to come loose-!
Check the mailbox? I'll do that when I go send out the presents.
W-wait, Commander, watch out! I-I'm sorry, Commander... I wanted to try flying my presents over with my planes like Saratoga does... But you arrived just as I was about to test it out...
With these clothes, and upon this stage... Ahaha... Ahahaha... Fate has ordained that my Commander shall fall for me here... Commander, please listen to the song of my love until the very end~♡
Sakura Empire armored carrier Taihou, reporting in to test the experimental "Muse System..." hehehe♡ My Commander need only ask and I will give anything, even my very life~
With these clothes, and upon this stage... Ahaha... Ahahaha... Fate has ordained that my Commander shall fall for me here... Commander, please listen to the song of my love until the very end~♡
Commander~ What would you like me to do today?
I would rather have been a solo act, but I still need to learn more about idols, and my Commander asked me to join the group... So for now, I bide my time... Hehehe♡
Hmph! This dance has some very difficult moves... I'll have to practice a lot more to give my best performance to my Commander!
That Iron Blood girl's "healing" business that's all over her promotional materials... that's all fake, isn't it?
My Commander♡ suddenly came to watch me practice... I feel like I could take on the world~!
C- Commander?! Ooh, you're treating me like a child now... hehehehe♡
Hehehe♪ It seems this pose is powerful enough to draw my Commander's eye♡
Hehehe, it may be a scandal, but I don't care♡
For the sake of my Commander, I can endure... no, I will gladly take any offer!
Hehehe, I've grown even more powerful from this job...!
A fan letter...? Who else should I talk to but my Commander?
My Commander♡ Are you here to watch me practice?
Commander, won't you go pick up the commission team...? I have a feeling that little Union girl is going to jump out and scare me if I go...
I can't wait to show my Commander the results of my special training~
Surrender to my charms!
Ahahahaha! Bow down before the power of my love!
Grrgh, miserable insects...!
We'll have to get rid of these pests♪
My Commander is watching...!
Are you telling me I can't be an idol...?!
To sing and dance for someone other than my Commander is...No, I just need to think of it another way. The idols are all for my Commander, only for my Commander. It's perfect...!
Commander♡ My shoulders are sore from all my training~ Could you take me back to my room...? Actually, I think I'd rather rest in your room for a while, my Commander.
Commander♡ I brought you my official idol merch. Of course, it's not something you could buy in a store, it's "special," just for you... Are you wondering what's "special" about it? Hehehe♪
I have no interest in dazzling the people with my performance. But if my Commander wants to see me like that... Hehehehe♪ I'll do anything for you~
Commander♡ What do you think of my new stage? And my outfit...? I will dazzle you over and over and over again with my beauty until you can't stand it anymore~ Ahahahahahaa!
Aahh... a present, from your heart to mine... Just as you have always cherished me, I shall keep your gift close to me at all times~
Aren't you a little bit too close to my Commander...?
Dear comrade, what do you think about this outfit? Is that so... I went out of my way to become an idol and that's your reaction? Hmph, I'll rock your socks off soon enough.
I'm Tashkent, destroyer from the Northern Parliament, and now an idol participating in the experimental Muse System. I'll show you the tenacity of the Northern Parliament.
How do you like my outfit, dear comrade? ...Is that so? After all of Tashkent's work to become an idol, that's how you react? Hmph. Just you wait. My next concert will rock your socks off.
Dear comrade, please go over our daily itinerary with us.
I've always been good at dancing, and I trust that my vocal skills won't disappoint either... Still worried about me, dear comrade? ...So, you're too much of a worrywart. I can handle this.
The other experimental ships all have instruments? Is that so? I don't plan on losing to anyone, no matter who they might be.
That Albacore really is something... She's got ideas for everything from costumes to choreography.
It's hard to keep your dance steps in sync... If you're just singing, you can pretty much hear how things are going. But if you're focused on dancing, you can't always be looking at the others.
Are you seriously giving me the kiddie treatment? Hmph!
Chocolate for me? Is that so... Thanks for the support, dear comrade.
D-dear comrade?!
Dear comrade, there's work to do. Come on, let's get to it.
That should wrap things up! You did pretty well!
Looks like work from the agency. Dear comrade, let's look it over before showing it to Baltimore's group?
Cola and tea, chocolate milk, juice, and vodka... Everyone's back all right... Dear comrade, what would you like?
The commission has been completed. Even if I'm an idol, I can't neglect my normal line of duty.
Guess it's time to get serious. Hehe.
Ура! Let's get this show on the road!
This victory is a testament to my abilities, not just that of the Muse System!
Were we out of step? But why...?
Don't even think about looking away!
My dear comrade is watching me...!
I can do this by myself... I don't need your help.
Are you looking forward to my idol debut? Is that so... Well, considering this is an armament test and whatnot, I guess I can put in a little effort.
Dear comrade, are you concerned about our teamwork? Heh, there's no need for concern. This kind of cooperation is second nature to us girls from the Northern Parliament.
It really is hard to express our individuality while performing as a group... Even though my dear comrade was concerned, I still... Oh, what is it? Did you come to help me...?
Dear comrade, what do you think of me now? ...Is that so. Look, I've taken lessons with the others and performed on stage. You don't need to worry about me anymore, for real this time. Hehe~♪

Heheh~ You're still too naive, dear comrade. There's no way I'd be satisfied with just being one star in a constellation. I'll shine the brightest of them all! That's why you shouldn't take your eyes off me even for a second~♪
Big thankies, comrade! *cough* *cough*... F-forget what you just heard!
That girl... is it even possible to dance like that?!

I am the light cruiser, Dido, currently taking part in idol activities as part of the experimental Muse System. I learned more or less what idols are supposed to do from the others, so p-please... keep a close eye on me!
I'm Dido, Royal Navy Light Cruiser. I'm but a lowly maid, and I never expected to be chosen to be an idol... But I'll do what I can!

I am the light cruiser, Dido, currently taking part in idol activities as part of the experimental Muse System. I learned more or less what idols are supposed to do from the others, so p-please... keep a close eye on me!
Master, what would you have me do today? Idol things or maid things, I'll do anything you want!
Between my idol lessons and shows, training and my maid duties, all to be useful to you, Master... It's a lot of work? You want to reduce my workload...? P- please don't throw me away...!
Singing is more about conveying one's feelings than it is skill... So I will keep singing for you, Master...
Madam Illustrious focuses so much on her footwork during dance practice... is it because of the mirror?
My fellow maids, and the girls from the different camps come together to make a proper idol unit. It's truly amazing that you can bring all of us together, Master.
You need only ask and I'll be happy to shake your hand, or whatever you may want!
Nnng...
We have a gig offer, Master. Won't you take a look?
Master, here are the rewards. It's all thanks to their hard work.
Looks like some important mail, Master.
Master, are you hurt? Do you feel okay? I may be an idol for now, but if you need me, I can still service you anytime...
Tashkent tells me the commission team is back.
I wonder if Albacore's idea could actually work...
Now, to steal Master's heart... with my dance!
I know I can do it if I work hard. I'll become an idol you can be proud of!
I can't sing as well as the Head Maid...
As an idol, for the Master...!
I can't let the Master throw me away...!
Did I let you down, Master? What a despicable maid I am...
No longer a maid serving her master, I'm now an idol.I've learned so much from the other maids, but I'm still not sure if I can do this right...
I look good in my idol outfit? Thank you so much, Master...! Oh, does that mean I'm not a maid anymore?! Master, you aren't going to abandon me, are you...?!
You mean you're excited to see me as a maid, and as an idol...? Sorry, I misunderstood...
I'm doing well as a maid, and as an idol...? I'm honoured by your praise! I'll keep working hard as an idol... No, I'll keep working hard in everything I do for you, Master!
It's unthinkable that a lowly maid could shine onstage with all of you... But I will redouble my efforts to be worthy of the honour! All for the sake of my dearest Master!
I never thought I would receive a present from Master... I am simply overjoyed!
It's okay to show off from time to time...!
If only I could present myself to the Master like that!
Lights! Camera! Albacore! Ahaha, don't worry about it, I'm just getting fired up over here! Oh, did you come up with a better idea? Tell me, tell me~
Here comes Albacore, submarine-slash-idol! I'm unique, I'm in the groove, so make some noise as I perform for you! Vocals, dancing, you name it, I can do it!
Lights! Camera! Albacore! Ahaha, don't worry about it, I'm just getting fired up over here! Oh, did you come up with a better idea? Tell me, tell me~
Morning there, P! Let's make the most of today!
My new gig must leave me with little time to play pranks? Haha, my friend, a true idol can perform AND play pranks, too! If you want an example, look no further than Sara!
Surprise! How's my new stage prop look?
Most of the stuff we're wearing was brilliantly handmade by Dido! Curious about that doll she's got, though. What's it represent?
I wanna see Taihou's concern in person! We should totally set some time aside for that!
I wouldn't be here without your support!
I wonder what'd happen to you if I were to scream "I'm being molested!" right now... Wanna find out? Heheheh~
We've got new job offerinos!
Job donesy-done! Whew, I'm pooped.
Uh, Tashkent, where's the Commander's mail? ...Oh, hi, Commander! No, just talking to myself!
Your next line is, "Why is Albacore prompting me to speak?"
Teehee! I get this feeling like the commission team is about to enjoy a surprise concert!
My idol rank has gone up!
Trap set! Let's goooo!
Encore! Encore until our next encounter!
Welp... I've got one final ace up my sleeve!
Let's make some noooooise!
Oh shoot, I screwed up!
You're really ruining it for the other members, you know that?
Being an idol's pretty good! I get to sing, dance, and smile for a massive audience! ...That sounds nothing like what I'd enjoy? Really, huh?
Hey, is that for me, Commander? Aww, how nice of you~ In return, I'll keep quiet about how you were ogling us while we practiced~

Oh, Commander! Morniiing! Did you see the note I left about a date? It's your job as the producer to see to our personal needs, y'know~ I'll write down whoever else wants one, so be sure to give it a look~
I want to be your center-stage idol that dazzles the audience, Commander! Heh, just kidding! Our WHOLE unit has to reach stardom together, after all. Hehehe~
Say what? Idols aren't allowed to be in relationships? Yeah, well, I was a shipgirl before I became an idol, so it's all fine! This pretty little ring is mine now~ As are you, Commander~
Yippee and yahoo! Guess I'm just overjoyed!
Yo, Taihou! How about a duo performance?

The name's Baltimore, Eagle Union heavy cruiser. Whoops, right, I'm not just a soldier anymore, but an idol as well. I agreed to do it, and I'm gonna do it as best I can. We'll be counting on your support, Commander.
Heavy cruiser Baltimore, currently serving as an idol to test the Muse System. I'm giving it my all to put on the best performance you'll ever see.

The name's Baltimore, Eagle Union heavy cruiser. Whoops, right, I'm not just a soldier anymore, but an idol as well. I agreed to do it, and I'm gonna do it as best I can. We'll be counting on your support, Commander.
What's on our schedule today, Commander? Same as always, I'm counting on you.
A spin there... backstep there! Whew... Yeah, I'm just working out the choreography for our new single. Gotta come up with something everyone in the troop can dance, not just me.
There's tons of idol business to tend to, so I've not had much time to help people. Think you pick up the mantle for a while, Commander? Thanks, you're a hero! Hahahah!
These moves might be too hard for the Royal Navy girls... What do you think, Commander?
Th-this whole "cute" thing isn't exactly my thing... N-not that I hate it, and YOU seem to like it, I guess... Ughh...
How's this for a signature pose? Good?
Eep! What was that for?!
Mission time, eh... You're really not in an enviable position, having to keep doing those while we work as idols.
Got some mission rewards here. Oh, and I got rid of that trap Albacore set.
Thanks, Dido, I really appreciate it. Got a letter for you here, Commander.
Oh, you're back. Hope everyone else made it safe and sound too. An idol needs an audience, after all.
Commission complete! What do you say we welcome them back with a small performance?
Thanks a bunch. Guess I should say: look forward to our next performance!
Just an idol, passing by... Nah, that just sounds off. Anyway, let's do this!
Picking me was the right choice, am I right? I'm never gonna let you down.
Looks like we need to rehearse it from the top...
Far and near! Hear our song loud and clear!
A small screwup isn't gonna stop me!
A control freak like you isn't fit to instruct us. Loosen up a bit, then try again.
Your job is to plan our schedule, and our job is to follow it. So business as usual, I guess, huh? Hahahah!
How do I look, Commander? This outfit's more revealing than what I'm used to... D-does it really make me look cuter?
"Thanks for supporting me!" ...Yeah, Bremerton's right, my delivery is just a bit off... Hey, Commander, do I fit in with the other members? Am I really... cute?

You think I am cute? Especially when my eyes are on you? A-alright then... Now I know not to give up! This might be selfish to ask, but do you think we could do some special training together, so I can truly shine on stage?
This I promise you, Commander: we'll all work together to bring you the best performance ever! In return I ask for one thing: that you witness it, and witness me, at my cutest.
Very nice, thank you.
Together now! In formation, on standby!
Heavy cruiser Roon, reporting for idol activities and associated experimental equipment testing. Today, we fight not with fire and sword, but with the power of song.

I am Iron Blood Cruiser Roon. I'm currently equipped with special "Muse System" rather than my usual loadout. It's definitely "special," but it is combat ready, and I can't wait to tear something apart with it. Thank you for this, Commander.
Heavy cruiser Roon, reporting for idol activities and associated experimental equipment testing. Today, we fight not with fire and sword, but with the power of song.
Commander, what am I doing today? Orders please.
Everyone is enjoying these idol activities, but aren't you forgetting about our weapons? I shouldn't worry about them...?
First I heal everyone with my soothing song, then I shred them with its power. Hehehe, I know how it works.
That Sakura girl, she's fragile; she can't take many hits... What can I do to help her?
I must pour my heart into my song... I may not be very good, but I'll try my best.
Headpats, is it~?
You want a hug? Sure, any time~
Let's enjoy some "intimacy" a little later~
A combat mission? Yes! I'd love to join~
You've been working just as hard as me. Good job, Commander~
You've got mail~ I wonder what's inside?
Well fought. I got you a little something to eat, just as a way of saying thanks for all the training~
The commission girls are back. Would you like to try, Commander? Line up for hugs, everyone~
There is something intruiging about using sound as a weapon~
You stand in our way...? Then you will suffer!
Oooh this feeling... when I tear them to pieces...!
Hm... I still think we should be fighting with conventional weapons.
Get out of my way...!
You're in the way... and you will pay!
Would you like to be my "enemy," Commander...? Hehehe... hehehehehehe...!!!
Everyone is working so hard at this idol business, for your sake~ Me? Of course I am~ My smile and my joy, it's all for you, Commander... Hehehe♪
I feel a certain emptiness after working at this idol thing for a while... Maybe it's the combat... could it be because I can't sink as many as I used to...?
Knowing that the Commander is watching me sing brings some fulfillment to my empty heart. Maybe... as you give me your time, you also give me your life... is that the feeling?
I thought slaughtering my enemies was the only way to make me feel better, but you taught me another way, Commander. I never thought you'd be able to change me. You really must... pay for that♡

"Something too perfect and beautiful to destroy."――I never knew my concert could be so great. I want to perform more, to shine more, to take more and more of your time, Commander... until it runs out♪ Hehehe...
Wooow! Thank you so much!
I am the newest addition to the Muse System, Illustrious. Through my songs, I shall spread the light of love and peace— Don't you think that's a wonderful thing?
I am the name ship of the Illustrious-class armored carriers... Oh, should I call myself "Idol Illustrious" now? I lack experience, but I will do what I must for the sake of peace.
I am the newest addition to the Muse System, Illustrious. Through my songs, I shall spread the light of love and peace— Don't you think that's a wonderful thing?
Good day, Commander. What will we be practicing today?
One, two, one two, Ah... Thank you, Commander. I'm not sure why I just can't keep my balance...
What if we had a little tea party after our next practice?
When one watches Tashkent and the girls dance so vivaciously, it makes one's heart pound. Hehehe.
The theme of my costume is "the starry cosmos," isn't that romantic? How delightful. Hehe.
Are we practicing for handshake events? All right, thank you very much, Commander.
Commander, do remember to maintain decorum when touching an idol.
Dido prepared this list of tasks for us. Do take a look at them, Commander.
Mission accomplisheed. Look over the rewards and... what's next on the schedule?
Reading fan letters is so delightful. What about your mail, Commander?
♪~Ooh, welcome back, Commander. Can you give our new song a listen?
It seems the commission team has returned. I wonder if they have the material for Victorious's clothes...?
It's not just about the shining image, it's also about conveying one's voice.
And now, a song of peace――
Our stage is brilliant and dazzling. Hehe~
It seems the power of song alone was not enough...
I will bring the light to you in song.
We can't let the light go out...!
I do hope my song can return you to normal, Commander...

To prepare for my idol activities, I borrowed some selections from Formidable's music collection. I find it rather noisy, but powerful, in a way that shakes my ears and in fact my whole body... Is that not right?
At the Commander's request, I referenced a song by Comet and the girls. The gentle melody and soothing voices made me truly understand how idols can make people smile.
I've been practicing with the other girls. I find I can sing gently, or energetically, and even smoothly... and it's all thanks to you, Commander. Hehehe.
May my radiance touch you, Commander, and carry from the stage my song and dance of peace and love.
I can feel your support, and your hope for me... And I see your eyes full of happiness as you look upon the stage, and upon me, Commander. Hehehe.
You've gone to such great lengths to get this for me... Thank you very much, Commander.
You like hugs...?
I am the Iris's shining sword, Le Malin. As the shimmering idol who chases the waves, may your souls be healed by my songs of prayer.
I am the Le Fantasque-class destroyer, Le Malin, reporting for duty. Heheh... Just watch, I'll do an amazing job on this idol mission. J-just to be clear, it's not like I was looking forward to this!
I am the Iris's shining sword, Le Malin. As the shimmering idol who chases the waves, may your souls be healed by my songs of prayer.
Good morning. What will today's lesson be?
I didn't really want to do this, but I'll see this idol mission through. I will bring the elegance of the Iris to the world stage.
An "idol" is something that people worship and exalt. As the word suggests, we mustn't do anything that would shorten that distance.
Jean Bart told me to just enjoy myself, but... the expectant gazes of Le Triomphant and Richelieu... it burns!
That little girl from the Royal Navy.. . Not only does she act all innocent, she also sings about "prayer." Hehe, as if I'd let her steal my thunder~
Huh...? What is it?
Thanks for always cheering me on~
Hwuh?! Wh-what are you doing?!
We got a job offer... Hopefully we can take care of it quickly and efficiently...
F-finally, that's taken care of... Now all that remains is the collect the reward, elegantly...
It's work-related. Look it over please.
Good work out there. Would you like to enjoy a most elegant cup of tea?
The commission fleet has returned... Phew! That means I get to chill!
The Iris's miracle manifests here!
Harken! Hear my prayer!
Long live the glory of the Iris! Rejoice! Weep!
There's no time for regrets...!
Light, heed me!
There's no way I could dance like Émile...!
This... must be carte blanche to loaf around as much as I want...
I am the dazzling Iris idol, Le Malin— Now, provide me the most elegant of instructions!

Lessons, offers, training, and rehearsals... There's too much stuff to do... I can't deal with this anymore! I'm gonna pass out at this rate... Just looking at the schedule is making me want to crawl back into bed... Maybe I should do just that today~

Haah, haah... How's that? My performance was pretty on-spot, wasn't it? If you think so, let me take a break already! All right, I'll be heading off! Or, uhh, if you could prepare some tasty snacks for me...
Commander, on my day off, promise you'll take me on a date? I mean, uhh, sorry, I'll just head back to... Huh? Really?! Yaay! I can't wait to loaf around together— Ah, ahem... First, this concert...!

The fact that I'm standing upon this shining stage right now is due to all the support from you and my friends. Now, place that ring upon my finger, and may our vow preserve this radiance forevermore!
I-is that...
Please make the lyrics easier to understand!
Let's do our best onstage!
You know... it really does feel better to just enjoy myself!

ex.line: Good morning. Um, today... there are no lessons planned, right...?
At times like these, you gotta throw your hands in the air like you don't care, and turn around... Zzzzzz... Wh-wh-wh-what is it?! Eh? I fell asleep?
Idols shouldn't get too close to their fans, right? So that means I don't have to do these autograph events either. Sweet~♪
If I just stay awake through this lesson, I'll get to enjoy Dunkerque's sweets afterwards... Focus, focus!
Graf Spee wants to rehearse with me? Uh... O-of course I have no issues with that?
Ahh~ Yeah, yeah, that's the spot. Keep massaging right there~
Too tired... I'm gonna die... Ahhh... Waaah...
Uh, so today's offers are... Ah, wait, nobody said you had to go and accept ALL of them!
Too tired... can't do this anymore... Lemme go to sleep after you look over the rewards!
... (Am I imagining things, or is the work piling up the more I do it...?)
Tired... Why are performances so draining... I just wanna go to sleep today...
The commission fleet has returned. Uh, yeah, that's what Béarn told me.
Long live the glory of the Iris! Rejoice! Weep! ...Wait, I don't need an encore!

lines.line: Graf Zeppelin-class aircraft carrier - Peter Strasser.

I am Aircraft Carrier B, one of the Graf Zeppelin-class carriers that suffered an unfortunate fate, having had my construction halted without ever getting to set sail. But... doesn't the name "Peter Strasser" have a much nicer ring to it than "Aircraft Carrier B"...?
It is I, the never-completed Graf Zeppelin-class "Aircraft Carrier B," otherwise known as Peter Strasser. There is much for us to do and little time to do it... No time to waste. Let's begin.
Did you just get here? Heheh. Make sure you work efficiently on your duties today, as always.
The expression of the passage of time as the hands of a clock ticking—don't you think it's just fascinating?
The more precise your plan is, the less time you'll have to waste hesitating on what you need to do. Why not give it a try, Officer?
Heinrich, your documents for your training program are here. Make sure not to forget them next time.
It's so nice to see all of the tasks be completed, just as planned. Hehehe.
What is it? You've still got time left until your break ends.
Officer, if this helps raise your efficiency, I don't consider it time wasted.
Here are the new missions. Instead of rushing to finish everything at once, use your time wisely and plan out your endeavors properly.
I'm glad the rewards for the missions correspond to the amount of time it took to complete them. Hehehe.
Officer, there's mail for you. Make sure to check it at your earliest convenience.
The more complex the machine, the more time it takes to maintain it. All the more for humans. Make sure you don't forget to rest up.
The commissions have been completed. Yes, I'll have to praise them for their efficiency considering their station as your subordinates.
Strengthening complete. Yes, it seems as if I've spent my time wisely.
Let me test this tactic on you.
Hah! Took care of them faster than I thought.
Time is far better spent contemplating how to avoid being destroyed, rather than foolhardily charging into destruction again and again.
Your time is up!
Everything... is still under control.
Officer, you're not worth my time.
Time is a precious commodity. State what you need me to do as concisely as possible.
Officer, the clock in your bedroom was off by two minutes. ...Oh, there's nothing for you to worry about, I've already taken care of it. You can't use the excuse that your clock is off anymore
Devoting your time to one person is a waste of time. That is, unless you get something worth it in return... Don't you think so too, Officer?
Officer, you'll pay me back for all of the time I've spent for you...? Interesting. Let me check the details first, hehe.

A ceremony to ensure the time I've spent doesn't go to waste... well, since you've said this much, I'll take your words as proof of your vow, Officer. We still haven't spent as much time and emotions on each other we want to after all, right...? Hehehe.
Oh my, how considerate you are~
Before you go and destroy the world, destroy the enemy in front of you first.
Don't just rush in. ...H-hey!
Gently now. Hehehe.
Ehem... Time is not on your side.

ex.line: Focus solely on your work. I don't want to see my time nor your time squandered.
I don't meant to disturb your train of thought, but do keep an eye on the clock. The next thing on our schedule is less than a minute away.
Kaga fights very much like a beast. I quite like how she looks when doing it.
I consider not just Graf Zeppelin to be my ally, but you as well, Officer. Do you think I would give you my precious time if I didn't?
Oh, what a thrill it is to do this with you, Officer. Heheh.

lines.line: Eugen, you said that this was is a ceremonial outfit from the Sakura Empire? Surprisingly, it does seem to suit me rather well. Oh, I'm supposed to offer my well-wishes for the New Year at this time, yes?

Eugen, you said that this was is a ceremonial outfit from the Sakura Empire? Surprisingly, it does seem to suit me rather well. Oh, I'm supposed to offer my well-wishes for the New Year at this time, yes?
So you're working over the holidays. How commendable of you.
The sands of time pile up to become a mountain; The passing of time eventually becomes history. Hehehe, how interesting.
I hear this is the time of year when New Year's gifts are handed out. Officer, would you rather be the one handing out the gifts or receiving them?
Eugen, Heinrich, there's a limit to how much rucku... teasing you should do.
Graf Zeppelin, why don't you try studying the Sakura Empire's shrines? Even if you don't pay your respects to their gods, the Sakura Empire's amazake seems quite interesting.
The plan already takes the holidays into account. There won't be a problem even if you take some time off to rest, Officer.
Officer, are you telling me that this much is enough for you to not be able to hold back?
Go take a break, and leave the deliberation to me. It's not yet time for you to make your appearance, Officer.
The commissions have been completed. Please leave their reception to me. There's no need for you to waste your time, Officer.
You already know, don't you? Since I spent so much of my precious time changing into a dress for your sake... Heh, I'll be taking plenty of your time in return. Hehehe.
You already know, don't you? Since I spent so much of my precious time changing into a dress for your sake... Heh, I'll be taking plenty of your time in return. Hehehe.
I'll have you escort me tonight. Quickly now, come take my hand.
If you have nothing else to do, go read a book. Much can be learned from the experiences of people past—in essence, earning time.
The "Unhulde," you say? ...Officer, keep your eyes on me. I shan't let her steal your attention or your time.
Viersechs, Zeppelin is over there. Hehe, how cute. Don't you think so, too?
I'll bring some drinks over. ...Are you trying to show off? Go make your rounds with the others first.
...Phew. (whispers) Umm, drinking beer at a party is a bit out of place, isn't it...
How very like you. Hehe♪
You have new missions. Hurry up and take care of them.
Hehe. These rewards... Well worth the time spent, right?
You need some rejuvenation? Hmm... Should I lend you my lap? Or would you prefer my chest, instead?
The commissions are complete. I sent Heinrich to go welcome them back. After all, she'd be out of place here.
Come-- The time of our destruction is nigh.
Time waits for no one. Not even for you.

Heheheh, it may be a new year, but don't forget to be punctual. Just as you've refurnished this study into a Dragon Empery style, I've changed clothes to match. This little book club is just for the two of us, and I mean to suit the mood.

Heheheh, it may be a new year, but don't forget to be punctual. Just as you've refurnished this study into a Dragon Empery style, I've changed clothes to match. This little book club is just for the two of us, and I mean to suit the mood.
You're finally here. Come, let's begin today's reading - now, you don't have to be so impatient. Nobody's going to come and bother us today.
What's so important that you have to come and whisper to me about it? ...Oh? I think I can satisfy this little request of yours.
I've been reading up on New Year traditions, and they're all so complex... In my opinion, all that matters is that you have fun.
Do you listen to music when you read? ...Heheh, I'm okay with anything. Pop, jazz, rock, you name it.
After we finish reading... We could talk about life, or something. Or if you'd like, there are ways to make better use of our time together♡
All you have to do is touch Dragon Empery clothes, and you can tell how comfortable they are.
You want to do something more "productive." Heehee♪ I totally understand.
Look at you, working your butt off during a festival. I don't mind lending you my lap, you know. I'll even throw in a relaxing massage.
Am I ready to greet our comrades? Of course. As long as I consider it time with you, it's hardly any effort.
The bells and drums of the new year ring. Begin the attack!

Invest time, reap companionship... I spent so much of this festival with you, so will I receive something worthy of my time? Heheh, while I do appreciate your companionship, there's something more that only you can give me...
P-class armored ship - Prinz Heinrich.
An introduction? You got it! My name's Prinz Heinrich, I'm a P-class armored ship. What else is there... Hmmmm... Eisen! Hey, Eisen, any ideas what to tell the Commander?

Hello there, Commander~! I'm the P-class armored ship, Prinz Heinrich. My little friend here is called Eisen... Hey, Eisen! Introduce yourself to the commander normally... Wait, how many times have I told you not to chew on others' clothes?!
Welcome back! Let's get fired up and do this thing! Hahahah!
What's a good way to make Eisen look less threatening... Hmm, maybe some cute stickers would do the trick?
My gut tells me the papers you're looking for are right here! ...Aww, I was wrong?
There's plenty girls in other factions who don't have a history, huh! I thought it was just an Iron Blood thing.
Sure, Peter gives me a lot of flak, but honestly, I dunno how I'd manage to get anything done! Hahahah!
Woo!
Mmmhh! Aahhh... Don't you ever get restless, working as much as you do, Commander? Get up and we'll take a jog down the hall!
Stop RIGHT there! This is where I draw the line!
A new mission? Say no more! I'll kerpow all the enemies to kingdom come!
So much paperwork and signing-off just for finishing one mission... My soul's boutta leave my body... Anyway, here's the rewards...
Bad Eisen! Stop munching on the mail! The Commander will get in trouble!
Sortieing sounds a heck of a lot more fun than rusting away in port, don'tcha think? Take me out on the next one, come on!
The commission team's back! Put me on the next one, please? Come on, coach!
I feel the powah!
Let 'em have it, girls! Los! Los!
Sweet victory! Not to mention MVP! Hahahah!
Wait, we lost? How the heck?!
My intuition tells me to just do it!
I'm not done for just yet!
I don't know what made you this way, but if nobody else is gonna fix you, then I will! Just shut up and grab hold of my hand!
A past free of regrets paves the way for the future! Wow, that makes me sound super sophisticated! Hahahah! Am I right, Eisen? Right, Commander?
I just love listening to people talk about their history. Wish I had one... If I did, what'd it be like? I'm having fun just imagining it!
Tell me more about yourself, Commander! Tell me what it's like to lead a fleet, or some funny mistake you've made! Come on, tell me, I wanna know!
You down to go on another date today? When? Sometime later, I guess? Where? We'll cross that bridge when we get to it! No point in planning everything in advance! C'mon, with me!
Hmm, I think you're supposed to follow the ring up with something else... Oh, now I remember what! *kiss*... Hahahah! I'm so glad to be with you, Commander!
Woah, I've always wanted this! Thanks a bunch!
Bad Eisen! Stop trying to scare people!
Team Armored Ships, comin' at ya!

ex.line: Welcome back! Let's get this show on the road, Commander!
Whoa, whoa, you need to hold still, Eisen! Otherwise I'll mess up the sticker placement! Hey, Commander, gimme a hand here~!
What have we here? The paperwork you're looking for? Hahahah, see? I told you you could count on my intuition!
Whoa, it's like a party in here! What're you all chatting about? "What if I'd actually been built"? Hey, as long as I could still come see you, I'm fine with any kind of past~
Come at me then, Miss Spiritual Leader! Let's see if you're hot stuff or not! ...Oh, it's a video game rivalry thing.
I see you yawning there, Commander. What do you say to taking a refreshing little stroll outside?
Whuah?! Geesh, Commander, I know who you are, okay?
You're a meanie, making me do this office work which I'm no good at! ...We'll go claim the rewards together in just a bit? Fine, I'll hang in there for now...
All right, so, you either have to send me on a sortie, or hang out with me! Time to choose, Commander!
I sent the commission team off to the dorm! You said I could I do that, remember?

lines.line: Phew... Changing into these clothes took quite a long time~ So, how does it look? A fine mixing of different cultures, wouldn't you agree? Ahaha, Happy New Year, Commander!
Phew... Changing into these clothes took quite a long time~ So, how does it look? A fine mixing of different cultures, wouldn't you agree? Ahaha, Happy New Year, Commander!
I've heard the Sakura Empire has loads of fun New Year customs! We've got to check 'em out together, Commander!
Where Eisen's gone? It's New Year's after all, so I let him out to play. He's a good boy! He won't harm anyone.
Strasser gave me an envelope with cash inside! She said it's a Sakura Empire and Dragon Empery tradition! Commander, you gimme one too~
Let's crank it up to eleven for New Year's! Even Spee's out there having fun with the gang!
Can't we leave all the office work for later and get dressed for a snowball fight? I promised Lebe I'd come!
You in the mood for an outdoor stroll? Hahahah, I'll be just fine in the cold, don't worry.
Hey! Hold it right there! I'm gonna doodle on your face as payback for that!
Apparently, you're meant to yell "tamaya" when they launch the fireworks! Dunno why that is, but sounds fun! ...What? That's only in the summer?
*ptwee*! Remember: safety first! Commander, you've got to do your stretches before going in the pool! Be thorough, or I'll get mad at you!
*ptwee*! Remember: safety first! Commander, you've got to do your stretches before going in the pool! Be thorough, or I'll get mad at you!
Morning, Commander! You here today for a swim, or to check girls out? Hahaha!
Commander, I will save you if start drowning, but that doesn't mean you shouldn't try to save yourself first! Listen, I'll teach you all you'll need to know!
Can rabbits swim, or can they not? I wonder if... Wait, why am I letting this question distract me?
Eisen, stop it! That's my swimsuit lace, you can't pull on... Oh gosh! Don't look, Commander!
Thanks for keeping an eye on everyone, Béarn! You're doing good work!
You want me to swim with you? Hahaha~ Sure thing!
Listen up, Commander! I'm the one in charge of this school's seedy underbelly here at this port, so you'd better do what I tell you to! In return, I'll offer you my protection! Ahaha~♪
Listen up, Commander! I'm the one in charge of this school's seedy underbelly here at this port, so you'd better do what I tell you to! In return, I'll offer you my protection! Ahaha~♪
Morning! ...Come on, Commander, say it like you mean it! Lemme hear you put some diaphragm into it!
The stage set's taken a real beating, but that's not entirely my fault. You could kinda say Eisen threw a fit, and... yeah.
The banners say, "Undefeatable - The world is mine." Basically, I'm as tough as they come, 'cause I rule this school!
Aw, crap! It's Strasser... No, wait, it's the Morals Committee! Please, no more catch-up lessons!
If I find any juvies, I'll whoop their butts! Hey, wait a sec... Aren't we juvies, too? Hiryuu! Explain this to me!
Hm? You got me bread from the canteen? Thanks~
Commander?! Hrmh, you picked the wrong girl to mess with!
There's a letter for you. Do you think it's a love letter, or a challenge to a brawl?
How's the school doing? If you see anyone trying to pick a fight, tell me, Commander. Heh!
Now do you get who owns this place?
Alrighty, I'm gonna sing a song for you now! Surprised by how jazzy and womanly I can be, are you? Ahahah!
Alrighty, I'm gonna sing a song for you now! Surprised by how jazzy and womanly I can be, are you? Ahahah!
Welcome, Commander. The party's already started. Quick, grab a chair and sit down! You too, Eisen!
The idol girls sing before a crowd all the time, which takes serious guts! Do you think I've got what it takes to be an idol, Commander? Not quite? Why the heck not?!
No one told me I'd sing for THIS big a crowd! Strasser, bail me out!
What?! Bismarck and Tirpitz are in the crowd?! Oh shoot, this is nerve-racking! Commander, do you know any quick ways to calm down?!
Where'd Ulrich go? She's supposed to provide accompaniment! ...Hm? What'd you say? Our genres don't mesh?
Has my dress got you bewitched? Heheh~ You'll make the other girls jealous if you keep ogling me~
Whoa! You're dead drunk, aren'tcha? Eisen, fetch the bouncer!
Great timing, Commander. I was just about to start singing! Since you're already here, stick around and listen♪
The commission team's back? Eisen, go with the Commander and give 'em a warm welcome!
Iron Blood Type IXA submarine - U-37.

Difference between us Type IX's and the Type VII's is that we're bigger and can go farther! We hide where they'll least expect us... then BAM! Torpedo 'em to smithereens! ...The what in Hudson Bay? They just made that up for that movie! The real me was still alive and kickin'!
I'm the hunter that prances across the open seas, U-37! ...Huh? Is the commander here always this spaced out? Well, I've given you my name already, so catch ya later~!
Oh, hey! I'm going out, so call if ya need somethin'! Gonna go for a dive!
My rigging's got bits that'll hurt ya, so watch yourself if ya wanna feel it.
Can't I get a free pass if just say the paperwork's up and vanished? No? Figures.
They say teamwork makes the dream work! So let's round up some more peeps to do this paperwork!
Touch my tail without warning, and I'll whip your ass with the tail end of my rigging! ...Hey, I'm kidding! Hahahahah!
How d'ya like my glossy, wet skin~?
You got a kink for submarines or somethin', Commander? Well, well...
New mission, huh? I'm on it! ...What? We're not disruptin' cargo lanes?
Mission's been completed! Guess I didn't have much to do with it though... Lame.
Look at that, new mail! Wonder if it's from across the pond.
The deep sea hunter's back, baby! Didn't score any prey, but I just caught me an slacking commander! Heheh!
Commission team's back? I'll go greet 'em! Better that than be bored to death in this office!
Now that's a nice boost to my swimming skills!
Wanna hazard a guess where I'll appear from~?
We are so throwin' a party when we get back!
Well damn. Better luck next hunt, huh...
You ain't gettin' through me!
Oh crap! Might be time to dive back down and hide...
Miss me with your lame ass! Laterrr!
So here's the dorm, here's the academy, and here's the office... Gotcha. Now I've got a pretty good idea of where everything is!
Check out my massive rigging, it's big enough for two people! Hop on and I'll take ya some place far away!
When ya go on missions in remote oceans, ya gotta live with being alone for days in a row... But I've got this photo of you in your sleep to help stave off the loneliness! Heheh~

Sometimes I just wanna be right beside you, sometimes I just wanna hide and watch ya struggle to find me. Y'know, I think I'm in love! You made me feel this way, and you'll own up to it, won'tcha? Hehehe~
I knew this day was comin', but I'm still feeling all giddy! Thank you for this, my lazy but adorable Commander! I'll always be with you from this day onward!
Huh? Is this for me?! No givesies backsies, alright?!
Wolfpack, let's mess 'em up!

ex.line: Heehee, you're under arrest! I've been lyin' here in wait for you! Whaddya think? The deep sea hunter really caught ya off guard, eh?
Did ya know that when someone's partner is a loose cannon, that means said person's pretty dangerous, too?
I sure as hell ain't raring to do any work, but since you're bustin' your ass, I gotta put in some effort, too! And as thanks, you gotta gimme all your break time!
You wouldn't believe what's out there under the sea! Sometimes you even run into glowy deep-sea creatures! Wanna see some? Alright, you and me, let's go!
We've known each other for ages now, and you're still fascinated by my tail? C'mon, don'tcha wanna touch my nice, warm skin instead of my cold tail?
Heh, you can ruffle it up if ya want. Feels chummy, and I like that!
You checkin' my body temp? Heh, I'm not one to get sick easily... Ah-ah-achoo!
Well, if you love it that much... Heh. Be ready for some payback.
Ya know what I look forward to the most while out at sea? Returning to the port and getting my hands on you! Heehee!

Commander, y'know what gets me more excited than anything else? It's workin' out the perfect ambush with you and catchin' the baddies with their pants down! But, before we set out, we'll need to do a "strategy briefing" first. Get what I mean?

lines.line: Now then, please lend your ears to this song I shall offer you... Wait, Commander, are you spacing out again? Even though I went through all this trouble to learn this song from my friends in the Sakura fleet... Please pay attention, okay? I'm starting ov

Now then, please lend your ears to this song I shall offer you... Wait, Commander, are you spacing out again? Even though I went through all this trouble to learn this song from my friends in the Sakura fleet... Please pay attention, okay? I'm starting over...
Hey! Happy New Year, Commander! Lessee here... Just tryin' to think of a fitting New Year's song...
Now then, my dear visitor, I would like to play for you a little song... Heheh, go figure, I'm good at this whole mimicry thing!
These clothes keep slippin' off... Annoying for me, but just the way you like it, am I right~? Heheh~
My U-boat buds agreed to play this thing called "hanetsuki"! U-110 sure seems excited about it... Hang on, can I even play in these tight clothes?
An electric guitar would really be more my style, y'know? Would kinda clash with this getup, though. Ahah.
Hehehe~ I've got pretty slick skin if I do say so myself.
Whoa there, lost all self-control, have ya, Commander~?
All right, I'm goin' out to- Oh crap, oh no! ...Phew, thanks, Commander. Nearly tripped right there... Mad respect to the Sakura Empire girls who can walk around in this stuff like it's nothing...
Playing music's a way for you to express your feelings... I, uh, might still only be able to play beginner songs, but... you feel the emotion in 'em, right?

There ya are, Partner! I'm tellin' ya, these punks running around the port are getting bolder and bolder. It's time someone cracked down on 'em! Anyway, I'll handle this stuff like usual - you go and do your thing, Partner.

There ya are, Partner! I'm tellin' ya, these punks running around the port are getting bolder and bolder. It's time someone cracked down on 'em! Anyway, I'll handle this stuff like usual - you go and do your thing, Partner.
You're here early, Commander! Let's go for a ride before the shooting starts. Remember to hold on tight to me, and don't let the high speeds freak ya out.

Partner, our top-priority mission for the near future is to keep a real close look on some punks: The Spark Speeders, and the... the Loosey Boozers... Pfft. Their races have been gettin' wilder and wilder, and it's time we did somethin' about it. Heheh, that name tickled my funny bone...
Take these gloves, Partner. The two of us'll bring back peace to the port's streets! ...Heh, me talkin' all seriously for once must be a nice change of pace for ya.
I'm not 'boutta lose in a race to some punks off the street! C'mon, get on, Partner! We're gonna show 'em how committed we are to maintaining road safety!
All streets bow to the king that is road safety! Whenever you're chasin' down thugs, remember to stay safe, Partner!
