Hey, take it easy. I'll take off my hat so ya can pat my head all ya want.
Pretty tight fit, ain't it? Makes me look like a real true and blue cop.
Heehee, real bold - you askin' to be put in cuffs?
Nice, nice! You did some damn good work today. Hop on and I'll drive ya back home. And don't worry - it's a movie prop, sure, but I AM licensed to drive it!

Hell yeah, Partner, gimme five! Bangin' job on completing the mission! ...Click! Heh! You can't get away from me now that we're cuffed together! ...Huh? We don't have the key? Heehee, well, then we'll just spend the rest of our lives chained together!
Aircraft carrier - Weser.

Whether as the 4th ship of the Admiral Hipper class, Seydlitz, or as the escort carrier, Weser, I was never completed over the entirety of that war. ...Over here, I should have more than enough time to do everything I've always wanted to do. That way, I'll be able to bury my regrets, one by one.
Heavy cruiser, Seydlitz... Rather, escort carrier Weser, has arrived. You're wondering why I have two names? Don't be in such a rush... I'll be sure to teach you later, slowly.
Before you hurry off to do your work, why not first take a seat and enjoy a cup of coffee?
Commander, are you free? Do you have time to help me practice with my planes?
The Iron Blood doesn't have as many aircraft carriers as the other factions, so I can't help but worry that we'll be at a disadvantage during practice exercises.
The Unsinkable Battleship...? Oh, I know who you're talking about. I wonder if I'll ever be able to meet my renowned predecessor, Seydlitz, at some point?
Hipper, Eugen... I can't believe I'm able to fight by their side like this. It's all thanks to you, Commander.
If you're tired, just set everything else aside and get some rest. I'll wake you up if somebody comes around.
Your spirited enthusiasm... You might want to change the way you convey it.
New missions? There's no need to hurry. We can check them after you finish whatever you're doing right now.
Mission complete. Don't worry, it's not like the rewards will run off somewhere. You just need to make sure to collect them later.
There's some mail for you. If it's nothing urgent, just read them later.
Being a commander truly takes a surprising amount of work... How about taking a quick breather right about now?
The commissions team is back? We shouldn't leave them waiting there like that... Should I go ahead and greet them first?
It looks like I'll get to use some more powerful equipment. Thanks, Commander.
Keep calm and persevere. Victory will surely come to us.
Victory, just as I expected.
Ugh... I wonder if I'm still not used to my planes...
The time has come!
It's not yet time to panic.
Commander, I've got one word of advice for you. If your condition isn't great, make sure to take a break and sleep soundly. It won't do to have everyone else see you in bad shape.
The battlefield is a place where the unexpected occurs. If you simply insist on following the orders given to you by the higher-ups, you'll never be able to achieve victory.
Peter is quite brilliant, but she can also be quite dreary. I wish she'd loosen up about time and planning and all, and learn to just have fun sometimes.
I believe that the way we live isn't influenced by our environment, but rather the choices we've made. That's why I've always lived by my own tempo. What do you think about the way I live my life?
Have you matched your stride to my tempo, or have I matched mine to meet yours? Putting all that aside, you know, having you by my side makes me feel comfortable and relaxed. Hehe.

This ceremony... Surely you didn't have to be in such a rush? It's not like I'll run off somewhere or forget our promises together. Or... is it that you don't have any faith in me? Hehe, I'm just messing with you. For the future everlasting, I'll be yours, Commander.
Thank you. I'm rather fond of this.
I wonder what your plan might be?
Head forth without worry, we've got you covered.

I've been waiting for you, Comander. As per my sister's recommendation, I've put on this Sakura Empire kimono. It was very tricky to get into, I might add... That aside, how do I look? ...Good enough, I hope?

I've been waiting for you, Comander. As per my sister's recommendation, I've put on this Sakura Empire kimono. It was very tricky to get into, I might add... That aside, how do I look? ...Good enough, I hope?
Have you already decided what we'll do today? If not, take your time. The goddess of time is a patient one.
Sit down and relax. Have some rich tea, or read a nice book to ease off.
The Sakura Empire's New Year's banquet? I'd love to go, but... Eugen, can you promise you won't get drunk out of your mind again?
Cozy winter sunsets really make you drowsy... I just take a short nap... Zzz...
On New Year's Eve, you're meant to put work on hold, relax, and take in the start of a new year. You should do exactly that, Commander.
Oh, we're going to a Sakura Empire shrine for New Year's? Heheh. I'm looking forward to the memories we'll make today.
Okay, you've proven just how tenacious you are. Now, could you stop it already?
Welcome back. Give me a moment to put in a bookmark.
Ah, I've kept you waiting. I do apologize that it took so long to get changed into this outfit. Now, Commander, won't you come show me your chivalry and escort me down these stairs?
Ah, I've kept you waiting. I do apologize that it took so long to get changed into this outfit. Now, Commander, won't you come show me your chivalry and escort me down these stairs?
There's still plenty of time until the party ends. If there's anything you wanted to do with me, then go ahead, Commander.
This dress took just about forever to pick out. Judging from your reaction though, I can see that it wasn't time wasted, hehe.
Even though we've toasted over so many drinks already, I can't believe that you're still so lively. I might have underestimated you a bit, Commander.
As my lovely knight in shining armor, Commander, don't you think you should be asking your princess for a dance?
The girls of the Iron Blood are calling for me. Come greet them with me, Commander.
Are you getting bored? Want to head out to enjoy the breeze together?
That is not a chivalrous way to conduct yourself.
How about doing something else for a change of pace? Just let me know if you want to spend some time together, whether it's inside the banquet hall or outside.
I've been waiting forever for this season to arrive. It's a perfect time, the waves wait for nobody, so I'm off for now. I'll make sure to teach you how to surf later, so look forward to it.
I've been waiting forever for this season to arrive. It's a perfect time, the waves wait for nobody, so I'm off for now. I'll make sure to teach you how to surf later, so look forward to it.
You can already ride the waves? Then how about coming along for some practice?

The surfing lesson is about to begin, so put on these casts. I had Akashi make these "surfboard posture correction casts" for you. Once you put these on your feet, you'll be able to understand how to ride the waves instinctively.
Surfing is fun to me because, unlike cruising on the ocean's surface while using my rigging, it feels like I'm gliding through the water.
Don't head over there—you'll be washed out into the open sea. Never underestimate the power of Mother Nature.
Haven't you skateboarded with Minneapolis before? It's not exactly the same as surfing, but try to remember the feeling you had while skateboarding.
Looks like you fell off of your board. You're a beginner, so you shouldn't feel too bad about it.
If you're having such an easy time that you can mess around, maybe I should raise the intensity of your training?
That was a fantastic wave. Now that you've cooled off, go take a shower and chill out for a bit.
Oh, welcome, Commander. As you can see, I'm just taking a break. Nobody thought you'd come right now. So... How would you like to be served?
Oh, welcome, Commander. As you can see, I'm just taking a break. Nobody thought you'd come right now. So... How would you like to be served?
You think we're unusually serious for a pop-up? I'll take that as a compliment. Heheh... Yes, I know that's how it was intended.
How am I so relaxed when we're about to open? Well, being anxious is the real danger. Anxiety makes it more likely you'll flub things when it gets busy, so I just relax.
Carbonated coffee, huh? I'm not sure Odin and the other Iron Blood girls would like that... but do you like it, Commander?
I guess it does make us feel more popular if we get a long line before the place opens, but you're just one person... Heheh.
We're holding a vote to decide what music we play. Why don't you cast your vote? ...Ah, maybe not. If you told us what to do, there'd be no reason to hold a vote...
So? Have you decided on an order? I'm ready to provide.
We haven't opened yet, so nobody will interrupt the two of us... Heheh, very clever of you.
Good work today. How about a break? I can get you some coffee right away.
Black tea, beer, Iron Blood coffee... Which one do you prefer after a battle?

Today is different, I know, but you don't have to push yourself to keep pace with me. I'll just feel bad if you have to go out of your way for my sake, and it'd be awful if it affected the coffee I made for you... Hehe, do you get what I mean?
Leipzig-class light cruiser - Nürnberg.

Though I received many modifications during the war, I never was able to put any of it to good use... But, there aren't many ships in the Iron Blood with longer service histories than me? I, I can't even believe it myself...
I am the second ship of the Leipzig-class, Nürnberg. Starting today, I shall serve you to the best of my abilities... Is that acceptable?
It is time to begin working. C-Commander, please give it your all...!
Why are you here by yourself, Commander? ...W-were you perhaps waiting for everyone else to leave...?! Oh, you weren't?
Commander, do you like Brötchen? I see... Th-then, if work goes well, I... I'll make some for you!
I wonder if there's anything that can be done about Leipzig always collapsing... Ph-physical exercises, you say? Commander, are you planning to do something weird to Leipzig?!
Am I being too hard on you? What should I do... If I was to make you upset with me... W-well, I'm sure it's fine, since you're probably thinking up all kinds of weird things right now...!
Eek?! Suddenly touching my head like that... Commander, you're thinking of doing something weird, aren't you...?! Am, am I wrong?
Are... are you trying to condition me to be less cautious by touching me...?!
Aaah?! Wh-what are you doing all of a sudden, Commander?!
There's a new mission, Commander. Did you get the previous one sorted out yet?
Did you finish all your missions? As expected of the commander...
You have new mail, Commander. I hope it's not a glitter bomb...
I know you're tired from your sortie, Commander, but please hang in there a bit longer for everyone else's sake... I mean, if you could...
A commission has been completed. You should know what to do without me reminding you, right?
I hope all this hard work pays off...
Everyone, p-please exercise your own judgment...?
Huh? I'm number one? That's rather... unexpected, isn't it?
How could this happen... It surely must've been my fault... I'm so sorry...
P-please don't get back up!
Ah... Oww...
You... really are an eyesore...
I wonder if Leipzig fell down somewhere... Commander, let's go look for her... I mean, would you like to come with me?
You want me to teach you how to make Brötchen? I don't mind, but I must warn you that I have high standards... Wait, are you perhaps using this as an excuse to get closer to me...?!
Commander, we've been spending more and more time together recently... Ugh, you really were planning something weird after all... At this rate, I... I'll be... Fine with it...?

Now that I think about it more, Commander, you haven't tried doing anything weird to me. If anything, you've treated me really nicely and it's somehow reassuring to be with you... Even if you tried to have your way with me, I don't think I'd... Wh-wh-wh-what am I saying?! P-please forget I ever said anything...!
I, I know already... I'll do whatever you say... so please don't look at me! It's embarrassing... So embarrassing that it's driving me crazy... I, I wish this would end already! ...Hauu...
It looks so expensive... Are you really giving this to me?
Let's focus on the fight!

ex.line: Come on, Commander, let's do our best in service of the fleet today! I'll be right there at your side!
The brötchen...? No, it's not ready yet! I don't care who it is, you'll have to wait two more minutes!
Slacking off again? Looks like I'll have to give you some p-punishment... Hauu...
Hyah?! H-how many times have I told you not to suddenly pat my head! You're going to give me weird ideas... Hwaaah?! I, I didn't say anything!!
Ngh... This is just... accidental contact... There's no deeper meaning to this...!
Commander, your orders please...!
I'm number one! Ehehe... Wh-what's wrong with gloating every now and then?!

lines.line: Since you so readily accepted my invitation to go on a vacation together, you must be planning to... Ahh, what I meant is, we can leave at any time if you're ready...!
Since you so readily accepted my invitation to go on a vacation together, you must be planning to... Ahh, what I meant is, we can leave at any time if you're ready...!
Commander, let's head out if you've already finished getting ready? There are lots of places I'd like to go today.
Hmm... Commander, can you come help me pick out a good souvenir for everyone back in the Iron Blood?
I wish Leipzig was here as well... Well, she's never been good with crowded places though...
I never knew the Sakura Empire's food was this delicious... Yeah, I'll have to ask my friends how to make these.
The Sakura Empire's traditional outfits are so beautiful... Eek?! Commander?! Where were you staring at just now?!
Y-you want to hold my hand?! ...Are you sure it's just so we don't get separated...?
Commander, why don't we write a postcard as well?
Commander, please hang in there a bit longer. Let's take a break after we get to the next destination.
Type 1936A "Narvik-class" destroyer - Z24.
After Z23, the 1936-class destroyers no longer were given actual names... Why?! Why can't I have a cool and easy-to-remember name like Lebe or Thiele...?!
Tremble, mortal! Before you is the Fiend of the Crimson Darkness, the Avatar of Fear, the Iron Blood destroyer, Z24! All you need to do is grovel at my feet!
Do you have any idea what time it is? This is why I can't stand you lazy mortals... Get back to work already!
A mortal that does not tremble before my visage? How strange... I thought I did my best to look absolutely hellish... I wonder why...
Black is the mark of my infernal nobility— yes, black coffee, dark chocolate, and black forest cake... are all things within my domain! Surely even human scum such as you recognizes this~♪
Aaaahhhhh... I'm sooooo booooored... Shall I teach the next person who walks through these doors the meaning of true fear? ...No good? Tsk...
The ways of the mortal realm have no bearing upon me! Therefore, Zed, I have no need for this "homework" stuff. Oww! F-fine, I get it, so stop chewing me out!
You... forgot to bring the offerings? ...Looks like I will have to teach you about the fragility of human life.
Impudent mortal, how dare you wantonly touch my head... W-wait, don't stop, please~
These massive claws suit my status as an Archfiend, both in terms of appearance and destructive power! Ahahaha!
Surely you already know the fate of those who dare to disrespect me? Foolish mortal...
Missions? Hurry up and get those unsightly things out of my sight, mortal.
The time of reaping seems to have come once more. Isn't that right, human~?
Insight from the Abyss itself... Guhuhu...
It's about damn time, human. Tired, so I'm gonna rest. Don't bother me unless it's urgent, or you have dark chocolate.
Commission rewards? I have no interest in mortal trinkets... But oh! If there's any black chocolate or black forest cake, you must bring it to me, mortal!
Not bad, human scum! My power grows ever greater!
Let us begin the festival of blood and iron!
Ahahahaha! Fresh blood and steel, blossom into magnificent fireworks!
*pant*... *pant*... I don't have to hold back anymore, right? I'll destroy everything... every last bit of it...!!!
Kneel before me! Ahahaha!
Can I destroy everything yet...?!
Do you know the fate of mortals who have fallen to such depths of depravity?
Hrmm... Those planes circling overhead are like flies... annoying and won't go away... Don't you agree?
Nothing in existence can stand before me without succumbing to abject terror... or so I thought. Why aren't you afraid of me!
Are you offering this black forest cake to me? Ehe... Ehehehe... Very well, human. Here, ahhhn... What are you spacing out for? Hurry up and feed me already!
Now that you've learned to fear and respect me, mortal, I shall give you the privilege of forming a physical pact with me! Come! ......Hug! It's a hug! Do I have to spell it for you, you fool?!
You seek to form a contract with me, mortal? Ehehehe... very well! I shall reward you for your bravery! From now on, you shall serve me!
Your taste is pretty decent, for a mere mortal. Be grateful for my praise!
Let's tear them to shreds!
I look forward to seeing your dark arts!
You will no longer face the storms alone!
Devil, heed my call and destroy our enemies!
H-hey, stop lecturing me!

ex.line: You've got some guts to keep me waiting, foolish mortal! I have been toiling away at being an excellent secretary ship!
...Hmph! (Strikes pose) Ahahaha! How's this? Terrifying, yeah? Does it make your knees weak? ...Hmm, I see. Judging from reaction, it still needs some work...
Hurry up and finish your work already, you fool! Stop... slacking... off... or I'll scratch you!
Studying...? Wh-why do I have to stoop to doing the same stuff as Z25 and the others? Don't wanna! Stop throwing homework at me!
Good, human, you've returned. I'm tired... Hey, don't run away! Come hither and give me a back rub!
Ehehehe... Ahahahahaha!

lines.line: Come, human! The rite of festivities is upon us! Come hither, and let us revel in this foreign holiday together!
Come, human! The rite of festivities is upon us! Come hither, and let us revel in this foreign holiday together!
Are you all rested up? I'll give you the privilege of keeping me entertained today! Consider this your greatest honor, mortal!
Even off duty, I cannot remove this claw, as it is a symbol of my dignity! ...What do I do if I need to pick something up? Th-that's your job, you foolish mortal!
I shall reward you with a taste of this black fruit! Open your mouth, foolish mortal!
Do you want to stay by my side tht badly? Heheh~
Th-there are some things you just shouldn't do! I hope you're ready for some punishment, foolish mortal!
Heh heh... As expected, you couldn't even last for a second! Winning too easily takes all the fun out of it... You, the mortal over there, I'll give you the honor of being my next opponent!
Heh heh... As expected, you couldn't even last for a second! Winning too easily takes all the fun out of it... You, the mortal over there, I'll give you the honor of being my next opponent!
Tell me what plans you have for the day, mortal. I've decided - you shall bear witness to my dominion over this stadium, and burn those memories into your eyes!

When facing human opponents, it would hardly be a fair contest if I didn't convert my claws into bandages... It definitely had nothing to do with me breaking a whole bunch of racquets or anything like that.
Not half bad, for a human. It appears that the time has come to unleash my sealed power--
Picking up balls is beneath someone as exalted as me! ...Oww! Fine, fine, I get it! Stop chewing me out already, Zed!
As a r-reward for defeating me, I shall grant you the privilege of giving me directions for the day! Bask in this glory, foolish mortal!
Heh heh... Excellent!
I, I did not mean THIS kind of reward...!
Whether on the battlefield or inside the stadium, the fruit of victory is sweet indeed! Even a foolish mortal such as you is privy to that knowledge, right? ♪
Bow down before my might!

"Sing your praises to the Fiend of Crimson Darkness, Z24!" ... Hmm, maybe I should go with "Bow down in astonishment!"... Ah, yes! Mortal, you've come at a most opportune time! Hurry and tell me what you think of my new catchphrase! ...Actually, get me down from here first!

"Sing your praises to the Fiend of Crimson Darkness, Z24!" ... Hmm, maybe I should go with "Bow down in astonishment!"... Ah, yes! Mortal, you've come at a most opportune time! Hurry and tell me what you think of my new catchphrase! ...Actually, get me down from here first!
Behold, mortal! I got this special costume and these ornaments just for this day! The black and red are befitting of the night of demons... What do you mean I "hardly look different"?!

Come the night of a thousand demons, the ashen red queen shall rise from the underworld! She will lead an army of lost souls and bring chaos to the world! ...That's the idea, anyway. Well? Do you think it's cool?
Give me tribute if you don't want to get cursed! As for what that entails... I desire whipped cream or a chocolate cream cake!
Dammit, this binding spell holds the Force of my retainers who sleep in the abyss... Never mind. I should avoid using the term "Force"...
(If I had my claws, the Commander would point out I could break free on my own... Anyway, it's fine like this! Just need to wait for the mortal to get close before I perform my trick...)
Human, would you have preferred a more witchy design? ...N-no, I'm absolutely not asking about your personal tastes! *blushes*
Whuh?! Th-there's nothing hidden... I-I-I never said I'd play any tricks!
You can't do this mission yourself, pathetic human? Hmph. Fine, I shall do it my- Grrrr...
Oh, you're back, mortal... Hm? Tired, are you? Very well, I permit you to rest at my mansion. Worry not, the beds are surprisingly snug.
Ah, the commission rewards... Hmph. What I want is a dark chocolate treat of- There is none? Then you will get me one, mortal! ...I don't care if you buy it from Akashi's store!
I did the tricking. You, mortal, should prepare the treat!
Type 1936A "Narvik-class" destroyer - Z28.
As a lead ship, I may not be as qualified as my sisters due to my armament... As a result, I've come to value problem-solving in other ways rather than directly fighting.
Pleased to meet you, Commander! I'm the one in the exact middle of the Type 1936A destroyers, Z28! My mission is to support you to the best of my abilities!
Ah... Commander, I'm sure you had your reasons for being late! Anyway, it's fine, don't worry about it! Let's just work hard starting right now!
Commander, look at this torpedo! I drew a funny face on it! Cute, isn't it?
I want to play with cute animals all day long~
This big old office feels a bit empty, but it's also refreshing and helps me focus on work!
If you finish all your work on time, I'll make some delicious sweets for you~
Ehehe, let me pat your head too~
Please go to sleep already! You can wait until later to finish the work!
All the girls will hate you if you do stuff like this, you know?
Looks like we have some new missions... Any tasks to go play with Meowfficers?
Another mission completed flawlessly! As a reward, I'll give you a hug~♪
The little birdies brought me a letter~ Should I read it aloud for you?
Good work, Commander! Here's a hug for your safe return!
Commission complete! Commander, if you're busy, I'll go welcome back the commission team!
Mmm... if only they could make my rigging a little cuter as well...
Everyone, please follow my lead!
We won! Commander, you're really awesome!
There's no need to feel down. Since we managed to retreat safely, there will always be a next time!
I'm going all-out! Hyah!
A fearsome foe... Everyone, be careful!
I'll continue to support you until you reflect on your behavior and regain everyone's trust. Don't give up!
I wonder what the little birdies are talking about from their tree branch up there... I've always wanted to know...
Did you want to take it easy for a bit? Sure, I don't mind covering for you. But, there's no replacement for the work you do... so please take care of it later~
Did you finish your work today? Mmhmm! As a reward, I'll give you a hug~♪ Good job, good job~
Are you tired, Commander? Here, come put your head in my lap. Please lie down and have a pleasant dream, until all your fatigue and worries melt away one by one~
I never thought I'd get something like this from you, Commander... I'm overjoyed! Please dote on me as much as you'd like from now on! No matter what, I'll always be there for you!
Are you giving this to me? ...Wow, thank you so much, Commander!
Sis, you're way too strict with Commander~
Z24, I have no idea what you're talking about...
Z25, shall we go take a look at Mr. Anchor?
Let's calm down and take things one step at a time!
Scharnhorst, you look so cool when you're out there fighting!
Commander, Happy New Year! Is there anything you'd like to do on New Year's Day? Say, why don't we try doing all of that stuff, all at once~?
Commander, Happy New Year! Is there anything you'd like to do on New Year's Day? Say, why don't we try doing all of that stuff, all at once~?
Hello, Commander. I thought you were still hiding inside the kotatsu. Ehehe~
Should I make offerings at the shrine first, or play hanetsuki with my friends...? Ugh, there are just so many things I want to do!
Commander, look at this lifelike tail! Doesn't this make me look like one of those girls from the Sakura Empire?
Hmm, why does this lion have a scary face? ...Wouldn't it be better if he's cute...?
Commander, want to try some New Year dango? ...Here, open your mouth, say ahhn~
All tuckered out from playing? Let's take a break then! I'll wake you up if there's an exciting event going on!
Promise me you won't do this any more, okay?
I'm going to give this daruma doll a cuter expression! Um... the brush... where'd the brush go...
Prosit, Commander! I think these wild animals were attracted by the champagne's aroma. But they're well-behaved and like being petted. Do you want to be petted too, Commander?
Prosit, Commander! I think these wild animals were attracted by the champagne's aroma. But they're well-behaved and like being petted. Do you want to be petted too, Commander?
Salutations, Commander. The party's just getting started, so get out there and have some fun~
Doesn't being surrounded by animals just make you want more to come? Why, I'd call it... Critter Crossing!
Commander, don't worry about your own outfit just because I'm wearing a dress. Be comfy!
We don't need a dress code. If you come to the party, what you wear is the dress code! Wear whatever you like, everyone.
Wow... Missus Deer, Mister Squirrel, the birdies, and Mister Raccoon... Even guests not from the fleet are here to party!
Did you want to pet me instead of the animals? I guess that's fine~
Huh? A little birdie brought us a letter. Let's see what's inside!
Commander, welcome back. You'd better hurry up, or you'll be too late for food! Even the animals are gunning for whatever they can eat...
Zara-class heavy cruiser - Pola.

I'm the fourth ship of the Zara-class heavy cruisers, Pola. My sisters and I have stronger armor rarely seen on heavy cruisers, which gives us an advantage in artillery battles. In terms of my abilities to serve as flagship... I might be a bit more suitable than Zara?
I'm Pola, heavy cruiser from Sardegna. And you're the commander of this fleet? I see. Well, don't let me down, okay? Hehe~
Hehe, you sure took your sweet time. The fleet exercises are about to start without you~
My Zara is always so gentle and lovely, I just can't take my eyes off her.
All these "conventions" and "treaties"... Things that do not consider the feelings of actual people should disappear from this world.
A true fighter does not fear any danger. I won't back down even in the face of a heavy storm.
The feeling of being enveloped by a searchlight... makes me a bit uneasy.
My rapier is not simply for show, you know.
You surely didn't do the same kind of stuff to Zara, right?
You've got to stay motivated and finish your work... Or, were you expecting me to give you some "motivation?"
All done with the missions, huh? That's what I want to see. ...I haven't forgotten about the reward. Mind waiting there for a bit? Hehe~
Commander, there's mail for you from the Naval HQ. You might miss some important information if you drag your feet~
Welcome back, Commander. Bring back any juicy gossip for me?
The commission fleet has returned. All your girls are such hard workers.
Oh? Some interesting developments.
The small fry never seem to learn their place.
MVP? Why, that's only natural. Enemies of this caliber aren't even worthy of staining my mantle.
My mantle's all dirty now. What a shame...
Let's have a little bit of fun~
My turret won't move? Why... at a time like this...?
A commander that acts in this manner is in need of some "re-education."
My gentle and compassionate Zara simply doesn't know how to say no to others. I wonder, what should I do...
Commander, focus on what you need to do. I'll take care of any annoying little obstacles in your way.
So, between Zara and me, who do you like better? Well... you wouldn't know the answer to that unless you tried, right~? Hehe~♡
Because you're so kind, I worry about you too, just like with Zara. But... because of your kindness, we also know that we can entrust you with our futures.
Commander, once you've become my chosen partner, you must be prepared to be bound with me for a lifetime. Are you willing to sign this "contract" with me?
Grazie. You have good taste - I'd be happy to take this off your hands.
Zara, your hands are so warm...
Zara, how dastardly of you to spike the ball at such a time- Eek?! Commander?! Why are you in a place like that?
Zara, how dastardly of you to spike the ball at such a time- Eek?! Commander?! Why are you in a place like that?
I do say, if you want to watch the game from over there, don't come crying to me when you get hit by a stray ball. Got it?
Commander, you're not satisfied with this game being for your eyes only, right? Hehe~ In that case... You can be the referee as well. Any objections, Zara?
...Isn't this swimsuit... a bit too tight...?
This obstinate starfish... C-Commander, come give me a hand here... Eek?!
Littorio, how about a 2v2? Heheh, though having Veneto on your team would be too much of a handicap, so how about I lend you the commander?
What are you staring at? Hehe, spit it out already... Just what were you thinking about?
Jeez, Commander... I know you're the impatient type, but are you sure you want to suffer the same fate as this manjuu?
Commander, don't expect me to save your life even if you're drowning~ ...Oh, Zara already taught you to swim? Hmph... Lucky you.
Much easier than a match against Zara. Heheh~
Damn it... I'll remember this!
Alfredo Oriani-class destroyer - Vincenzo Gioberti.

I'm Vincenzo Gioberti, the second Alfredo Oriani-class destroyer. I stood shoulder-to-shoulder with valiant cruisers in many battles across- Huh? That's not quite right? Okay, my completion was a bit behind, but I was second to be launched among my siblings, so I do qualify as a bona fide big sister!
I am Vincenzo Gioberti of Sardegna! ...Eh, my name's hard to remember? ...Hmm, how about just "GB" then? That's a bit easier, right?
It's the start of a lively day! Keep at it, Commander! I-I'd better get ready for work too!
Anything GB can help you with? I'm the oldest among my siblings and can do absolutely anything! Go on, let's hear it!
S-Simoom isn't around here, is she? Ahem! Not to imply I'm afraid of her, my question simply stems from a sincere desire for amity and courtliness.
Oh goodness! Seriously, could you not pull weird faces while I'm trying to work?
Commander, would you care for a delectable dessert? I personally recommend tiramisu!
H-hey! I've grown out of headpats! They don't work on me, nuh-uh!
Huh? I've not done anything weird, have I?
Whuah?! You're a real creep, Commander...
Hm? New mission directives? But I'm not ready yet... Oh, they're not for me?
Mission completed. Now where's the rewards report?
Here, I brought your mail, Commander.
How about a victory hug for everyone? Would that make me seem more mature?
The commission team has returned!
One step closer to blooming into a gorgeous signorina!
Rest easy knowing I won't let you down, Commander!
Hehe, easy as pizza pie! Err, I mean... Of course, just as expected! Nothing to get excited over!
Dangit... You won't discourage me so easily!
I'm going all-out!
Oh no! Deploy smokescreens!
Sadly, there's no cure for your chronic hopelessness, Commander.
Hmm... I wonder how long it'll be before I become a fine lady like Veneto...
I was born in the historic port of Livorno, a dreamy city on the gorgeous Sardegnian west coast! You should visit it with me if you ever get the chance, Commander!
You only find my floundering endearing and cute because you make me flounder so much! ...Th-th-that said, I'm perfectly fine with being called c-cute...
If you and I had met under different circumstances, like as classmates... then maybe we'd be in a typical romantic relationship... J-just thinking out loud, that's all!

You want to... get engaged with me?! B-b-b-but I...! Calm down, GB! Don't get too excited, be cool and graceful like a big sister and respond with grazia! Okay, now... I say, Commander, would you be a darling and put the ring on my finger?
Ooh! This is... Ahem! Thank you, Commander!
You don't need to be so formal with me, you know.
*gasp*! W-we're on the same side now, right...?
"To refuse a fair signorina's invitation would be most uncouth"... Hehe~ Now, Commander, would you like to partake in some refreshments? Rest assured, they're all non-alcoholic♪
"To refuse a fair signorina's invitation would be most uncouth"... Hehe~ Now, Commander, would you like to partake in some refreshments? Rest assured, they're all non-alcoholic♪
A refill, if you would, Manjuu waiter! Likewise for the Commander's glass, please! Now let me just... Hup... Ugh, these bar stools are sure are tall...
You may drink to your heart's content today! Worry not, just put it on my tab! ...Huh? The drinks were free to begin with?
This "for adults only" drink has gott my attention... Could I at least have a taste?
Commander, as this is an informal gathering, you are free to say whatever you please! I am a grown lady, and I can handle it!
We have some lovely tiramisu resting on the counter, Libeccio! Call over Maestrale and we'll all savor it together!
Fare un brindisi! Indeed, this is how a signorina raises a toast.
You'll never receive another party invitation from me again!
I'm a signorina - I do of course understand if you're too busy for pleasantries, Commander. Having said that... You should at least tell me before you go out, all right?
Gnevny-class destroyer - Stremitelny.
So, I'm Stremitelny of the Gnevny class. My friends and I did some escort missions as well as coastal support operations! Commander, if there's anything I can help with, just say the word!

Way! Too! Slow! Why'd it take you so long to find me?! That's right! I'm Stremitelny of the Gnevny class, but you can also call me by my nickname, Snezhok! Anyway, here's a snowball to commemorate our meeting, catch~!
Hurry up and come play in the snow with me!
Everyone in the Northern Parliament likes calling each other "comrade." Comrade Commander! I'm Comrade Stremitelny! ...Buuuut, that's a heck of a mouthful, so I'm just gonna call you Commander!
Chang Chun and I were looking into a way to retrofit our naval guns into snowball launchers. Eh, that's not allowed..?
Why am I called Snezhok? Well, it means "Little Snowball," and I'm a little cutie who likes snowballs.
During the winter, you can have snowball fights, build snowmen, and wear fuzzy clothing! Winter's the best!
Geh, you meanie! You're gonna make my hat come off!
Do you like playing with snowballs too?
Now I'm angry! Take this! And this! And this!
Commander, are you letting your missions pile up like snow on the branches?
Mission complete! Wooooohoo~!
Your mail's here! Catch~! ...Eh, I'm not allowed to throw it...?
My sisters said that I'm not allowed to drink vodka because that stuff melts snowballs or something... Uhh, somehow that doesn't sound quite right...
I'll go greet the friends coming back from their commission! ...I'm not going to throw snowballs at them!
Snowball fight or gunfight, I feel like I can't lose!
Stremitelny, setting sail!
Hehe, victory! Commander, I want a prize!
Ehhhhh?! How could I lose?!
Behold my might!
I hate airplanes! Shoo, go away!
I hate you! Stay away! One step closer and I'm gonna pummel you with snowballs!
My snowballs are gentle! There are no rocks or bits of ice inside, only softness!
Secret technique! Snow down the back of your neck! That oughta freshen you back up, or so Minsk said! ...Um, Commander... You're not upset, are you?
Are you cold, Commander? C'mere! Come stick your hands here where it's nice and fluffy! ...Hehe, aren't I super nice?
Come build snowmen with me, Commander! You'll make one, I'll make one, and then we can have them hold hands, just like we're doing now! Ehehe~
Hauuu... My face is burning hot, like I'm gonna melt for real! But... if I can melt right into your heart like this... that wouldn't be half bad. Ehehe~
I want it!
C'mon, just give me a little taste!
It sucks not being able to play in the snow... Oh well! I'll play some games instead! Commander, let's play something fun together!
It sucks not being able to play in the snow... Oh well! I'll play some games instead! Commander, let's play something fun together!
Whoa! When'd you come in here, Commander? Never mind, let's just play video games!
Pamiat Merkuria is way above my skill level... Oh, I know! Commander, practice with me so I can get better!
Whew, I'm tired! I'm gonna put on my sleep mask and catch some z's! ...Dang, not happening?
Rekordny! An Shan! I know you've got games in your room! You can try to hide your power level, but you're also a gamer, aren't you?
I learned a ton of gaming trivia from Pamiat Merkuria!
O-one more round! If you win this one, then I'll get up and do work!
*yaaawn*... Hm? What time is it? Eh, guess I'll boot up the console and play something... Wait, no! I've gotta get eady for work!
The commission team's back. Uh-huh... Okay, okay! I'll do it next time, I promise, just go and greet them this time for me! Please!
Huh?! Commander, why did you walk here?! If you're feeling bad, just press the call button... Ugh, you can't walk around at night when you're sick! Grrr!
Huh?! Commander, why did you walk here?! If you're feeling bad, just press the call button... Ugh, you can't walk around at night when you're sick! Grrr!
Sit down already! I'll get you painkillers! Uhh, let's see... Here! I got water, too, so take them.
Wait a minute~ I'm double-checking your condition to ensure there won't be any negative drug interactions! You gotta be careful with medicine!
Take your medicine exactly when it says to, or else I'll throw a snowball at you... Just kidding! You're sick, so it's my job to take good care of you!
Is it boring working night shifts? Nope. This is my job, so don't you worry about me. Take your meds and rest~
If your head still hurts, how about trying this new painkiller? I hear it works great! ...No? Heheh, are you scared of syringes, Commander? I'm not! Heheheh!
I'm a qualified nurse, I'll have you know! I studied everything I need to know!
You're going back to your room? I'll walk you there!
You still have the energy for this stuff?! Say, are you faking being sick...?
You've still got so many missions even though you're sick... Being a Commander is rough! But I'll help!
Does your head still hurt? Hmm... I hear massages are good for headaches. Lie down, Commander! I'll massage you! ...Huh?! You wanna lie in my lap?!

Take your medicine and get well soon! When you feel better, let's build a snowman! Heheh, I've already thought of what kind, too! We'll build two snowmen hugging each other! As for how to make them hug, uhh... Let's figure that out when you're better!
Iron Blood Type VIIC submarine - U-410.

For an Iron Blood "wolf," I don't have much to boast about. I went on a few patrols and the odd rescue mission, but that's about it... I just wish my career would've ended out at sea instead of docked at port.
Formally, I'm the Type VIIC submarine U-410. But you, Commander, can call me whatever resonates with your heart. You heard that right: just let your heart decide. Hehehe~
Oh, you're back. Ready to start chipping away at this mountain of paperwork?
I think it's good for a submarine to act a bit more mysterious. Wouldn't you agree, Commander?
Sauerkraut juice is a great pick-me-up. Give it a try and see for yourself.
Penelope? Oh right, she works here too. Take good care of her, you hear?
You can't figure out what that report says? Let me see... What, I'm too close to you? Hmm... Well, my bad~
Just give me the signal when you wanna slack off. Hehehe~
Are you saying you find my body "too good to pass up?"
Do you find it thrilling to put off your missions until the last minute?
Accomplishing a mission can be the reward in and of itself. Receiving tangible things is a nice bonus, though.
Letting your mail pile up just to read through it all at once might feel rewarding, but it's not very productive.
Haste makes waste. Take it easy, yeah?
The commission team has come back in one piece. That's nice to see.
Bolstering your combat abilities is always a good move.
There's nothing to worry about. Just take it easy.
You'll need to do better than that, my surface ship friends.
There's no turning this battle around... We should probably retreat.
Watch your back~
No more playing nice...!
I just don't know what to do with inconsiderate jerks like you.
A submarine must be slippery, elusive. You know, an unknown threat lurking beneath the surface. Hehehe...
Patience is the most valuable trait a submarine can have. What lengths would you go, how long would you wait for someone dear to you, Commander? Hehehe~
I've got someone on the hook. What do I mean by that? You'll have to wait to find out. That's part of what being patient is about.
Why don't we start dating, Commander? ...What's this out of the blue? I've taken my sweet time preparing, and this is the time to strike! Hehehe, now give yourself to me~♡
Ooh, I see you've been preparing something of your own. So, have you made your mind? You'll live the rest of your days happily with me? ...Great, then we're all set♪
I'm a little curious how long you agonized over this gift.
There's no escaping the wolfpack!
Yeah, that's it! Draw the enemy closer!

Happy Lunar New Year. Have you cooked up a scheme for this year's festival? Hehehe~ I'm of course talking about giving out New Year's gifts and hanging up decorations. I've devised a master plan of my own.

Happy Lunar New Year. Have you cooked up a scheme for this year's festival? Hehehe~ I'm of course talking about giving out New Year's gifts and hanging up decorations. I've devised a master plan of my own.
While there's no huge stack of paperwork awaiting you, there's no shortage of other things we need to do.
Can't think of a good present? Hmm. Might I suggest a handwritten letter? I think that gets your feelings across pretty well.
We were playing hide-and-seek earlier, and get this: U-81 hid herself inside a snowman. That girl is on a completely different level.
I wonder what Penelope's up to... I might just go and check.
It's really hard to hang these up on my own. Would you let me ride your shoulders, Commander?
Is this your idea of a New Year's gift?
Whoa there. A little too excited from all the festivities, aren't we?
Take it nice and easy. No point stressing out on a holiday.
And for my finishing move... maybe something like this? Heehee. What do your eyes think, Commander?
And for my finishing move... maybe something like this? Heehee. What do your eyes think, Commander?
Welcome back, Commander. Are you ready to practice with me?
As long as you know someone is rooting for you, be it through cheerleading or whatever, you'll perform better than you would otherwise.
Keep it up! Keep it up! Coooommander! Heheh! How was that? Do you at least feel a little supported? ...You don't want it look like you're staring? Oh, sorry about that♡
You want me to do a peppy holler and hoot? I... Yeah, I dunno about that...
Thanks for the backing, Commander.
Oh, so my cheerleading is "distracting" you, is it?
Did my cheerleading before the sortie do its job?
Aren't I supposed to be cheerleading, not taking the lead? Heehee.
Chao Ho-class protected cruiser - Ying Swei.

I am the second ship of the Chao Ho-class protected cruisers, Ying Swei. I'm also Chao Ho's sister. By the way, if you see the two of us bickering, don't be alarmed. It's nothing more than our way of expressing affection for one another. Hehe~♪
It is a pleasure to meet you, Commander. I am the elder of the Chao Ho sisters, Ying Swei. Hmm, Chao Ho said that she's the big sister? Hmm, I guess you're not as gullible as she is. Hehe~♪
The ever-industrious commander, right on time today. Hey... have you seriously never thought about playing hooky?

Going by launch date, one could say that I am actually Chao Ho's older sister... But alas, since she wants that role so badly, she can have it. Besides, being the "little sister" comes with perks of its own. Hehe~♪
Chao Ho, if you want to be seen as the big sister, you're going to have to do things yourself instead of relying on the commander. Heehee~♪
Reminder from Ying Swei~ You've had your head in the clouds for a while~
Are you interested in the Four Treasures of the Study? I'd be glad to instruct you. Hehe, not to boast, but I'm quite confident in my abilities.
If you mess up my hair, I'll have you style it for me for a week starting tomorrow, you hear?
If you're tired, you should go ahead and rest. Collapsing due to overwork is inefficient.
Wouldn't it be a great time for me to tell everyone how much of a pervert you are? If you want me to reconsider, you'll have to make me a little promise first. Hehe~
Commander, we've got new missions. If Chao Ho was here, I'm sure she'd be nagging you to kingdom come. Hehe~
Mission complete. Now, if I could just enjoy a meal, soak in the bath, and then get into bed... that would be the life. Hehe~
You've got new mail... You know, stone-cold printed text doesn't have that same human touch as something handwritten.
I'm sure there are a lot of things you're dying to tell me. But that can wait until after you've rested up.
The expedition fleet is back. Don't forget to reward all our hardworking friends.
Indeed. You must be strong if you wish to protect what is dear to you.
Purge all evil. Become as a stalwart blade.
I'll wait until I get back before declaring victory.
Do I not have enough power... to stop the enemy's advance?
We shall never fade away...!
We will not, cannot, back down here...!
...I have nothing to say to you.
Chao Ho should be doing her usual training just about now. Commander, why don't we go take a little field trip? Hehe~

Chao Ho has been complaining to you that I've been pushing my chores onto her, hasn't she? Don't listen to her. I've just been instructing my little sister, who has stubbornly been running away from her responsibilities, about the realities of being an adult. Hehe~
"Whenever I'm with the commander, I get all excited and can't figure out why... but, but..." Oh, ahem... I'd appreciate it if you could act like I was just talking to myself.

There are a lot of things I'd like to say to you, but whenever I'm in front of you, it's like the words just won't come out... I'm afraid I'll have to write my feelings out for you, so please don't laugh.
Ink does not fade with the passage of time... I wrote my feelings down with the hope that they also may never fade. I now offer these words to you, along with myself.
One good turn deserves another. Allow me to reciprocate this generous gift.
Sister, don't let the enemy get away with underestimating us.
Let's do this, together!

ex.line: We've got a lot of work to do today. Thanks in advance for your cooperation. ...Hehe, don't even think about slacking off~
Commander, in your times of need, please also call upon Chao Ho, not just me.
I've brought you a most sophisticated cup of lapsang souchong tea, hehe~
I like the way you stroke my hair, ehehe~♡ ...Ah, no, I didn't say anything.
Though I no longer communicate with you through writing, I feel like we understand each other much better now. Please continue to share your feelings with me, be they amorous or anxious.

lines.line: Happy New Year, Commander. I've come to deliver you blessings for this coming year... Next, you're going to ask for a red envelope, right? Hehe, just teasing~
Happy New Year, Commander. I've come to deliver you blessings for this coming year... Next, you're going to ask for a red envelope, right? Hehe, just teasing~
The warmth of spring often lulls many into oversleeping... But, Commander, it seems like you're accustomed to waking up early?

Chao Ho thinks up the couplets, and I write them down. Don't you think we make a good team? Besides, seeing Chao Ho's brows furrow in thought is super cute... Anyway, let's think up some lines together later.
Miss Yat Sen, I'll help you prepare the food for tonight's reunion dinner. What about the fish? I'll start it up if you'd like.
I never thought I'd be able to enjoy the company of my sister and all our friends like this... Yes, it's all thanks to you, Commander.
Fu Shun, if you throw any more firecrackers into the pond... I'll change your seat to be right next to that lotus~♪
Since it's the Spring Festival, how about taking a break?
The excitement of the festival seems to have gone to your head. Hehe~
In the warm spring breeze, snow melts and life blooms anew. Spring is the season of life.
A~ job~ well~ done~♪ ...Hehe, did you like that?

Commander, Happy New Year! Chao Ho and I are preparing for this year's Spring Festival, and as you can see... we're in the middle of a little "intermission." Hehe, don't worry, there's nothing you need to help out with. Just take a seat over there and enjoy the show~

Commander, Happy New Year! Chao Ho and I are preparing for this year's Spring Festival, and as you can see... we're in the middle of a little "intermission." Hehe, don't worry, there's nothing you need to help out with. Just take a seat over there and enjoy the show~

An old saying goes, "it's better to be lucky than it is to be punctual." Since you've come at quite the fortuitous moment, why not come sit next to me and enjoy the show? As for what's going on over here, don't sweat the small details~♪

This year, Hai Tien is in charge of coming up with the Spring Festival couplets, I'll be doing the calligraphy, and Chao Ho is handling the decorations. An all brawn, no brain job like that is perfect for my sister, isn't it? Heehee~♪
What's the matter, Chao Ho? Still haven't been able to get your stuff back? ...I tricked you? What could you possibly be talking about?
We're almost completely out of ink for our Spring Festival couplets. Commander, mind helping me grind up the inkstick? I'm a bit busy right now, but I'll make a cup of tea for you later.

The goods Akashi sent over sure are convenient. There's the mechanical errand-running Manjuus, the automatic fireworks launchers, and the lion dancers as well... I'm sure Fu Shun and her gals would have an absolute blast with these.
You also want to try playing a prank on Chao Ho? Sure, but don't go too overboard~
Commander, are you sure you want to do this with Chao Ho watching? I never knew you had kinks like that...
Got some mail for you, Commander, but it's not easy for me to move right now. I'll just leave it on the table for you.
Nngh~ My legs sure are sore... Oh, Commander, you're back. Say... would you mind helping me out a little?

I already apologized to Chao Ho about what happened today. Oh right, Commander, do you have some time to spare after the evening banquet? I have some things to tell you, but only if we're alone! Because, it's a little embarrassing... Ah, but I'll have to apologize to her again for making a move behind her back, heehee~♪
Heehee, if it isn't the Commander. Your timing is perfect~ I was thinking I might take a break here... While you're here, why don't you rest in the pool with me?
Heehee, if it isn't the Commander. Your timing is perfect~ I was thinking I might take a break here... While you're here, why don't you rest in the pool with me?
Welcome back, Commander. Do you have any plans? Heehee, if you've got the time... come join me for a game in the pool!
Chao Ho and I picked out this swimsuit together. It shows off my curves... Ahem, forget I said that. Anyway, do you like it?
Isn't this swan float just adorable? If you like it... then come and sit next to me♪
Hm? Commander... Your eyes are practically glued to me. Do you prefer this outfit?
Sunshine, a pool, and you... I wish every day could be this relaxed. If only I could keep you... Ahem... How am I supposed to express my feelings without pen and paper?
Ah... Commander, you got my hair wet...
Heehee... I could lose hours watching the ripples with you.
Keep doing that with me, and you'll face serious consequences... Oh, I mean falling into the pool, of course♡
Phew... You're back. You look tired, so sit down with me and just feel the water on your skin for a while.
Commander, we're reflected in the pool. Heehee, can you try coming a little closer? I want to see your reflection snuggling close to me. And... I want to see if you only have eyes for me♪
My retrofitting is complete! Don't I look a little stronger than before? Regardless, I hope you'll guide me as you always have, Commander.
My retrofitting is complete! Don't I look a little stronger than before? Regardless, I hope you'll guide me as you always have, Commander.
You're very punctual, as usual. If you're in the mood to play hooky at all... I could help you get your work done early?
Don't you think I've become even more reliable? Hehe, there's no need to say it. I can already tell from the look in your eyes.
It's not as if your work will ever end. Put down your pen for a moment and try the tea I made, would you?
I'd be happy to teach you about the Four Treasures of the Study. My brushwork is much steadier now, and I've gotten better at teaching!
Chao Ho is secretly practicing her dance steps again. Wanna go watch with me? Heehee!
You want to pat my head? That's fine by me, but in return, you'll have to brush my hair for the next two weeks.
Hehe, is that all you've got? Personally... I'm willing to go much further~
Well, well. I've caught you red-handed again. Hehe, if you want me to keep quiet... then you'll have to spend the entire weekend with me.
Let's get these missions done before Chao Ho finds out. Otherwise, she'll start nagging you like a mom again.
Missions complete! All that's left to make the perfect day is to eat together, take a bath, and go right to sleep... What do you think, Commander? Heehee.
You have mail. I suppose your period of rest is coming to a quick end... Would you like me to sort them out first?
Welcome back, Commander. If you have any entertaining thoughts today, I'll be your best listener. Hehe, but first, take a break... Tell me all about it after.
There are so many things I want to say that I'll probably take up all of your free time... Hehe, anyway, where should I begin?
Chao Ho-class protected cruiser - Chao Ho.
I'm the name ship of the Chao Ho-class protected cruisers, Chao Ho! As for my history... who the heck knows! Specs? Dunno about that either! Stop asking about this stuff already!
I'm Chao Ho, lead ship of the Chao Ho-class cruisers! Don't you forget it! Oh, and no matter what Ying Swei says, don't let her trick you into thinking I'm the little sister!
H-hey, you're late! I was worried about you, darn it!
Why do people think Ying Swei is the big sister?! ...Am I that immature in comparison?! Commander, what's your take on this?
Let Ying Swei handle the public side of things! I, uh, I'll support her from the sidelines! ...Wait, wouldn't that make me seem like the little sister then?!

H-how long are you going to keep dawdling around in front of me? Can you just sit down and get your work done?! Eh? ...What the heck are you saying?! It's not like I really care what you're doing or anything...!
Only through perseverance can we reach our desired outcome! ...Th-those are Ying Swei's words, not mine!
Ahhhh!! You're gonna mess it up, so stop touching already!
...What are you trying to do?!
Eeek?! Y-y-y-y-you pervert! Degenerate!
We've got new missions! Hurry up and take a look! Otherwise, Ying Swei is going to complain about me nagging again!
That mission was a piece of cake! ...W-well, I suppose your efforts helped!
Commander, hurry up and check your mail before it starts growing moss!
All right, nobody's here, right? Maybe I'll practice my dance steps a little... Ehh?! Huh... Wh-when'd you get back?!
The commission fleet's back? Y-yeah, we did send one out earlier, huh... Wh-what, I didn't forget about that!
H-hey, I look a bit more reliable now, don't I?
P-purge all evil... Ah, screw it, will you die already?!
Hmph! I'll say this again! Don't you dare violate our oceans!
Guh... Am I still not strong enough yet...?
Be captivated by my song and dance!
It's time to get serious! I'll make them pay for underestimating me!
Don't talk to me like you know me!
I still haven't practiced my dance today... Commander?! I, I won't let you peek!
Commander! Ying Swei... Ying Swei... she threatened to not share Ning Hai's steamed buns with me! And said I have to clean the room today! H-hurry up and do something about her!
Um, Ying Swei said you don't like short-tempered girls, so I'll try to act a bit mellower! So, um, please don't hate me... Hey, wh-what are you laughing for?! Don't get all uppity with me!

About my new dance, um... I want you to name it, since you'll be the first person who gets to see it. So... how about it? Y-you don't have to come if you don't want to! ...Ugh! I mean, you have to come! No matter what! Even if you don't want to! Jeez!

At a time like this, I'm supposed to say "may we hold hands and hope to live forever with one another" or something like that, right... Ahh, I can't remember this stuff! A-anyway, you have to take good care of me from now on! Got it?!
It's mine now! I'm not giving it back!
Let's do this thing!
I'm glad we have such stalwart companions!

ex.line: What took you so long?! Are you trying to make me worry on purpose, you dolt...
Who's the big sister of the Chao Ho class? That's right! I'm Ying Swei's big sister~♪ I'm glad you understand now!
You're leaving this assignment to me? G-got it! I'll show you what a capable big sis I am!
.........You haven't moved a muscle for quite some time now! S-say something to me every now and then! ...O-otherwise, I'll get worried...
Mm, fish and chips~♪ Even the Royal Navy has some pretty good food~
Hmph. Fine, I'll let you touch me, but you better be grateful.
Hyah?! I-I know you and I do this stuff all the time, but it's still so embarrassing!
H-hey, you're not comparing me to Ying Swei, are you...
We've got new missions! ...Wh-what is it? Are you not gonna do anything unless I nag like your mother?
That mission was a piece of cake, wouldn't you agree?
That mission was a piece of cake, wouldn't you agree?
H-hey, you're not comparing me to Ying Swei, are you...
Commander, um, I'm not just your partner, but I'm also your big sister... or, at least I want to be! S-so, if I want to be pampered a bit... Yeah, pamper me! J-j-just a little!

lines.line: Happy New Year, Commander! This red envelope is my gift to you... after all, that's my responsibility as a big sister! Anyway, hurry up and take it!
Happy New Year, Commander! This red envelope is my gift to you... after all, that's my responsibility as a big sister! Anyway, hurry up and take it!
You're late, Commander! Jeez, we're all supposed to get together for the New Year, so stop running around!

That Ying Swei... Even though she knows I'm not good with the literary stuff, she still made me think up spring couplets... If it wasn't for her sake... Commander, come here and help me think of lines as well!
My performance for the Spring Festival banquet? ...I-i-it's not like I'm nervous or anything! I've practiced over and over!
I wish my sister was as demure and well-behaved as Tai Yuan... Yeah, Ying Swei, I'm talking about you! Stop laughing!
Commander, it's really cold tonight around the time of the banquet. If you catch a cold, um, I'm going to have to take care of you, and that would be a hassle... So, um, yeah!
...D-don't scare me like that!
Y-you're gonna get eaten up by the Nian beast!
Don't worry, this tree is real sturdy and won't break with just one person on it... Hey, wait, are you calling me fat?!

Happy... New Year... Commander... Gah, this isn't the time for pleasantries! And you, help me catch the dumb fluffball that ran off with our ornaments! Jeez, why is this happening when I'm in the middle of getting ready for the Spring Festival?!

Happy... New Year... Commander... Gah, this isn't the time for pleasantries! And you, help me catch the dumb fluffball that ran off with our ornaments! Jeez, why is this happening when I'm in the middle of getting ready for the Spring Festival?!
Almost got it... Huh? Commander, what are you doing here all of a sudden? Hey, get back here, you dumb bird! Now look what you did! It got away because of you! Ughhh, why is this even happening?!

Ahhhhh jeez, what's wrong with these pipsqueaks?! I swear they're running from me on purpose... I knew it! This is all Ying Swei's fault! I knew she had an ulterior motive for assigning an "easy" job like decorating to me...!
Ying! Swei! I know you're behind all this, so get these little guys to knock it off already!
Commander, um... Can you try to make things less awkward? You know, the two of us hiding under a table like this, umm... might cause some serious misunderstandings...
I wonder how the decorations for the other parts of the port are coming along... Huh? You've already taken care of everything? W-wow, you're pretty reliable, huh...
I, I didn't touch you on purpose, okay? I'm sorry! It's all because this little bugger here made me do it...
Y-y-y-y-y-you pervert! I can't believe you'd take advantage of another person's misery like this...!
Why's there a letter addressed to you in a place like this? Did you misplace it or something?
Ugh, my back and legs are all sore... Commander, hang in there a bit longer for my sake, alright? I'm done for... I need to rest first...

Umm, you don't need to be that worried about me. I'm used to Ying Swei playing pranks on me by now, and besides, she already said she's sorry... Well, if you insist on apologizing on her behalf, um... then, go on a date with me after this! ...You're fine with that? Heehee, I'm gonna make Ying Swei soooo jealous for what she did to me today~♪
H-hey, you, warn me before you come in next time! I was just looking for my swimsuit... F-forget it, okay? I'm not trying to chase you out! If you're coming in, then come in already!
H-hey, you, warn me before you come in next time! I was just looking for my swimsuit... F-forget it, okay? I'm not trying to chase you out! If you're coming in, then come in already!
You're back? Then relax here for a while, if you want. ...You want to play with me? Sure... Huh? My swimsuit! N-no, now isn't a good time!
Where on earth did it go... Ahem. We can play later, okay? I'm in the middle of something important... Geez! I'm not going anywhere, and my swimsuit DEFINITELY won't disappear into thin air!
My swan float? I mean, it's cute, isn't it? If you want to sit... Promise you won't turn toward me, and I'll let you!
(You've been staring for a while... Do you know? What do I do if you know? This is way too embarrassing!)
The pool is nice, the sunshine is pleasant, and I have you... I should be so happy right now. Why did this have to happen right now?!
(Wh-what do you think you're doing? That almost blew my cover!)
Oh, man... Ack! I was just looking at the ripples in the water!
Mmh?! Don't touch me out of nowhere... What if I fall?!
Phew... Finally back? That must have been a rough battle. I'll make room for you, so get some rest in.
You're right next to me, but I can't bring myself to do anything... Huh? You noticed it right away?! Y-you didn't have to politely look away every time, then... You can look at me all you want...
Chao Ho's back, and she's better than ever! Hmph! Now my strength and my authority as the older sister are unquestionable!
Chao Ho's back, and she's better than ever! Hmph! Now my strength and my authority as the older sister are unquestionable!
Hmm, right on time. Very nice. As the older sister, I have to commend your punctuality.
Do I look more like an older sister now, Commander? Hmph! Now nobody will think Ying Swei is the older one! H-hey, quit laughing!
Why are you looking at me like that? Don't tell me... Heheh, you've finally realized how awesome of an older sister I am?
Hey... If anything is bothering you, you could... you could talk to me about it... I-I'm not worried about you. I just don't want it to affect your work!
Your documents are a mess! Yeah, yeah, I'll clean it up for you. But I'm not doing it for your sake!
H-honestly, you're too much... Okay, but just a little.
Hyah?! Wh-why are you getting so close to me?!
Hyah?! Wh-wh-what are you doing, dummy?! Now isn't the time to be doing that!
You have new missions! I'll keep an eye on everything. Get them done quickly so you can get some rest!
Easy-peasy! I was totally reliable, wasn't I? O-of course, you deserve most of the credit...
Oh? You're back? ...No, I was NOT waiting for you! I just happened to finish my drills!

New clothes, new steps, and it's all for you... That's why I staked my pride on making it all perfect! I mean, you know that, don't you?! If you tease me and act like it's not perfect... I'll never forgive you!
Arethusa-class light cruiser - Penelope.

I am Penelope of the Royal Navy, Arethusa-class light cruiser. I participated in a transport mission with Aurora and her companions in the K Fleet. There were difficult times, but I managed to pull through. If only I had noticed her back then...
Arethusa-class light cruiser... Penelope, is my name. From now on, I will be your subordinate. I hope that you... can at least remember my name.
Commander, are you going on a sortie? I shall stay here and await your return.
Hmm... You're staring at me so much... Did you happen to want these gloves?
Paperwork, paperwork... Where did I put it again? On that shelf? I can't seem to remember...
Pepperpot? ...Why yes, I do think that food generally tastes better with a healthy pinch of pepper.
I want to get along with U-410. ...Mm, with you here, Commander, I'm sure it will be fine.
Nnh... Are you treating me like a child?
...Hm? Is something amiss? I do believe I've been doing everything to your specifications...
Hm...? Commander, what are you doing?
"Remind the commander if there are any unfinished missions." ...Got it. Commander, you have unfinished missions. What are they about? Umm...
"Remind the commander to collect the rewards for completed missions." ...Got it. Commander, please remember to collect your rewards. What rewards? Umm...
Hmm... Ah, I knew I was forgetting something... Um... Right. The mail. Commander, I brought you the mail.
I am glad that you have returned safely, Commander.
The commission has been completed, and now I'm supposed to welcome the fleet back... But what comes after that?
Have I become stronger than before?
Shall we go together?
Commander, I followed your instructions and emerged victorious.
I have been defeated. My sincerest apologies...
Is this good enough?
I... can still do this!
Commander... aren't you acting a bit weird?
I shall wait for you here tomorrow as well, just as you instructed, Commander.
If I leave the uncompleted work here, I wonder if eventually, I won't have to do it anymore.
Would you like some of the rosehip tea that Aurora taught me to make? ...It's too sour? Hmm... Maybe I accidentally added vinegar...
No matter how much time passes, I will continue to wait for you here, Commander. No matter what, I'll always wait for you to come back.
A promise ring... proof that you always want to stay with me? Mm... But, even without this, as long as you think of me, sometimes call for me, and look at me... that's all I need.
I'll cherish this. Thank you.
I'm counting on you.
Aurora, we're together again.
Neptune... Um, sorry...
Did you say something...?

ex.line: Commander, are you going on a sortie? ...Mm, I'll always be waiting for you.
Paperwork, paperwork... Mm, as you suggested, I put somewhere prominent, so I'll find it soon enough.
Mm, I'm getting along well with U-410. Commander, you should try to befriend her as well... Oh, you already have? I'm glad to hear that.
Galatea said that today's lucky colour is blue. ...Don't worry about it? Okay, I won't then. I believe you.
I will do anything you tell me to. It can be anything.
Commander, if this is what you desire, then...
I will do anything you tell me to. It can be anything.
Commander, if this is what you desire, then...

lines.line: Aurora chose this outfit for me because... the Spring Festival represents a time of celebration in the Dragon Empery, and red is the color that best symbolizes that. What do you think? Does this outfit... make you feel more festive?

Aurora chose this outfit for me because... the Spring Festival represents a time of celebration in the Dragon Empery, and red is the color that best symbolizes that. What do you think? Does this outfit... make you feel more festive?
Happy Lunar New Year. I'm glad I can see you today.
Aurora also gave me this incense burner. It's supposed to be good for recovering from fatigue, so shall we give it a try together?
Haah... Commander, I'm sorry... At this rate, this incense... is going to make me fall asleep... Zzzzz
The broth in the hotpot was as red as my clothes... It was a bit scary at first, but the food ended up being really delicious.

The pattern on this fan was embroidered. I learned how to do it from Yat Sen and the others a while back, but my hands were trembling so much I made a mess of things... Ugh, I wonder how everyone does this so well.
...Hm? Already tired? You can lie down here if you'd like.
...Um, Commander, I don't think... this is any way to conduct yourself.
Commander, do you know about the Spring Festival? There are all kinds of interesting stories, and I'd like to hear more about that from you.
Welcome, welcome. I've been working here as a maid, just as you told me to. Umm... Call for me only when you're ready to order.
Welcome, welcome. I've been working here as a maid, just as you told me to. Umm... Call for me only when you're ready to order.
Did you call? Well, what do you want? ...You still need some more time? Call for me when you've decided.
Here, I brought you your order. It's still frozen? Of course...? I never heated it up. Why...? You... never told me to...?
Here's the menu. Call me if you need me.
No, that's not it? ...What do you mean by that? There's no way for me to know unless you show me...
Sure, here's the pepper mill. How much do you want? ...Oops, I spilled it all...
Did you want some headpats? Sure. Good job, Commander. *pat pat*
Commander, it's fine if you're banned from the store for this, right?
"Welcome back, Master. How are Mew today?" What do you think about my greeting...? 'Kay, I'll see you later then.
Heavy cruiser - Tallinn.

I'm Tallinn, Northern Parliament heavy cruiser, formerly known as Lützow under the Iron Blood. I fought in the war under the name of Petropavlovsk as well. In the end, I never did get to unleash my full potential, but I trust your commanding to make good use of me.

The name's Tallinn, heavy cruiser from the Northern Parliament. Don't expect me to blindly take orders from you just because you're the commander. Use that head of yours to think things through first, then we'll talk.
You're astonishingly late. Did you want me to discipline you that badly?

No matter how many of my cannons are disabled, even should I get turned into a floating turret, as long as I am still able to fight, I shall fight until my last breath. That is my duty and my obligation.
Focus on your work. ...What, you need a break? If you've got the energy to complain, you've got the energy to work.
How do Tashkent and Murmansk manage to fit in with the others so well... What? Nothing important. Focus on your work.
I think I'll have a beer after work. Vodka? No thanks. I'll pass.
Wha...?! Keep your hands off my head!
What do you need? Don't even think about making me do grunt work just because I'm your secretary.
Ngh...?! Now you've done it...
It is imperative that missions be completed. This was true during my time in the Iron Blood, and is still true now.
Hello? Confirm the mission rewards. Don't keep us waiting forever.
A letter has come in. I wonder who sent it...
Good work out there. Keep it up.
Your job now is to go and show your gratitude to the returning commission team. Do it well and in a timely fashion.
Just as it should be.
Imbeciles! Stop the pointless struggling and surrender!
Look at that, we won. Victory comes naturally if you just follow what you trained for.
...Tsk, all because of some small mistakes...
Fire all cannons! Don't stop shooting!
Urgh... What kind of monsters are they?!
Use your head before ordering me around. If you can't even do that much, then I won't lift a finger for you.
If you want me to follow your orders, then prove yourself a capable commander first. I can handle myself if you can't.
Don't like my scoldings? Then do better! You're not about to tell me you actually ENJOY being scolded, I hope.
I'm surprised you've actually taken my scoldings to heart. Hehe, hahaha... Since you like it when I tell you what to do, I'll be more exact from now on.

Are you sure you're fit to be a commander, considering how you take orders from your secretary? Don't worry, I'll keep telling you what to do so you can keep your job. I've started enjoying it, actually. Hehehe~
All you need to do is sign this document, and I'll take care of everything else. Now to put on the ring and make it official with a kiss... So, how did my lips feel? Hehe~♪
Sure, I'll take it off your hands. You're pretty thoughtful.
Kirov, I'm counting on you!
Hehe, things are looking pretty good~
I've always thought your name was a little funny.

ex.line: Hats off to you for clocking in on time. See? You can do it if you just try. Hehehe.
Have you checked out that report yet? ...If you've got time to make excuses, you've got time to do your job.
Maybe I should put a collar on you, like Chapayev suggested... What? Nothing important. Focus on your work.
Do your job well, and you'll be rewarded. Use your head and think up something good, then I'll see what I can do. Hehehe~
You're in need of some guidance, aren't you?
Hehehe. You know what? I'll let you have your fun for once.
Do you really think this is all it takes to satisfy everyone? Exactly. Let that annoyance motivate you to do better.

lines.line: What, you've never seen the inside of a shipgirl's room? It's not like you're here on official business, so stop standing around already. Find a place to sit and relax.
What, you've never seen the inside of a shipgirl's room? It's not like you're here on official business, so stop standing around already. Find a place to sit and relax.
Make yourself at home. I don't like being uptight all the time.
Commanding the fleet isn't your only job. You've also got to live up to everyone's expectations, and keep going no matter how tough things get. I'll be there to make sure you do.
Hipper and I surprisingly have much in common. I like talking about food and guitars with her.
Kirov has a thing for barging into my room and ask me to go drinking with her... Still, I'll take that over the antics of Gangut and the rest.
Care for a hot beer? If you want a little spice added to it, let me know.
I suppose now's a good time for a nap... *yawn*...
Hnngh?! You're pushing your luck...!
Good work out there. Get some rest, you've earned it.
You've reached the Bureau of Investigation... Oh boy, another case. Commander, finish up your paperwork ASAP. We've got witnesses to interview.
You've reached the Bureau of Investigation... Oh boy, another case. Commander, finish up your paperwork ASAP. We've got witnesses to interview.
You're cutting it very close here. Five minutes early to everything - that's something you should practice.
Always work at flank speed - the momentum you build up will keep you going. If you ever forget that, I'll remind you as many times as it takes.
This case is going to be a pain... It may be time to ask Chapayev for assistance.
Look, little Manjuu, I can't understand you through your sobbing. Take a deep breath, calm yourself, and then speak.
Well done, Commander. Care to go for a drink? I know a place that specializes in mulled beer.
What is it? I already told you - you're not ready to be a phone operator.
Huh...?! Now you're really asking for it...
Missions and inquiries alike deserve our undivided attention. Wherever you are, this still rings true.
You've completed a mission, now go claim your rewards. Chop-chop, we're on the clock here.
Wow, you solved that one quick. Keep it up.
It's your duty as the Commander to show your gratitude to a returning commission team. Go on, don't keep them waiting.
Hmph. I'll just have to teach you how pointless it is to struggle.
We won. Given enough training, victory is par for the course.
...Tsk. You little rats!

I'm not letting my guard down, even when dressed like this. Take your eyes off me for just a moment and I'll escape to the moon. With you, of course, heheh. Someone has to keep pushing you forward, after all.

I'm not letting my guard down, even when dressed like this. Take your eyes off me for just a moment and I'll escape to the moon. With you, of course, heheh. Someone has to keep pushing you forward, after all.
Ready to go to the moon, Commander? Hold on tightly to me so you don't fall... What, you thought I was serious? Heheh. You're a funny one.

Ah, I got so caught up in looking for the best moongazing spot that I completely forgot how chilly this place is... Commander, could you come a little closer? Relax, I'm not going to take off your clothes. Not yet, at least.
As if putting on this bunny ear hairband wasn't enough, now you want me to hop around... You've got some nerve to ask for that!

Crap, I forgot to bring the beer... Luckily, we still have plenty of the osmanthus wine I got for you. Say, how about we exchange drinks? I'll take the osmanthus wine, and you'll drink the beer I forgot. I think that'll go perfectly with this outfit of mine. Heehee.
What, do you like my rabbit ears that much? I can give you them, but what will I get in return? A kiss, maybe?
Ah! Whew... Yes, it obviously makes me jump when you touch me in this outfit! Ugh, fine, just pick up my shoes! Do that, and I'll overlook your little bold move.
Now you're pushing it... I can still teach you a lesson even in these clothes!
Looks like the moon welcomes you. Just for tonight, take it easy. Oh, and don't think about anyone but me tonight♪
