What was going through the mind of that fairy who journeyed to the moon on her own? I suppose I just wouldn't get it. I'm firmly tied to you, after all. Heehee.
Gnevny-class destroyer - Gremyashchy

I'm Gremyashchy, Grozny-class destroyer. I didn't just do escort missions, I squared off with enemy destroyers and rescued allies too. I've done almost everything, save for dealing with aircraft carriers, so I'm fit for pretty much any mission. Mm, that's all.
Gremyashchy, Northern Parliament destroyer. I'll do what I need to do, so don't bother me for the other stuff. Mm, that's all.
You've got lots of work to do. Like, that huge stack of papers on your desk.
What are you ogling me for? Are you some sort of creep?
One whack with this thing dispatches any and all bugs and creeps. Mm, that's all.
Bad things happen to people who anger Gromky. Watch yourself, Commander.
Slacking on the job, huh... Maybe I'll tell Gromky about this.
Cut it out. My hat's gonna fall off.
...You need something?
Th-that confirms it, you're a creep...
That's a whole lot of unfinished missions...
Mission complete. You know the drill, claim the rewards. Mm, that's all.
Check your mail, yadda yadda. If you don't, I'll just throw it away. Mm, that's all.
Here, some cookies Gromky made. As your reward for a job well done.
Commission team's come back. I kind of expected that you knew that already.
Thanks for making me stronger. Yeah, that's all.
I'm good on fuel. Only thing left to do is dispatch the enemy!
That takes care of the enemies. I guess that's all.
Ugh... That was a pretty garbage battle...
...Out of my way.
I've been hurt. Mm, that's all...
...Why exactly are you still here?
I've always got my eyes on you. Mm, that's all.
You might fool Gromky, but you can't fool me. If I catch you doing anything questionable, I won't hesitate to whack you with this thing. Mm, that'll be all.
You're awfully good at putting on faces. Unless... you're actually an honest, decent person after all? I guess I'll give you the benefit of the doubt for now. Mm, that'll be all.
All right, you're a decent person, I'll give you that. Huh? You want me to... be with you, forever? Ummmm... I-I need to think about, that's all...
I've sailed through bad weather and finished countless tough escort missions. If I can do that, then I can promise to follow you anywhere you go, Commander. Mm, that'll be all.
Thank you. I'll take it.
I'll protect you.
Don't be reckless, huh... You too.
Friends...
C-can I have some of that?

ex.line: You've got all this work to do before the end of the day? ...I guess we just have to make a miracle happen...
What are you ogling me for? I don't see what you get out of this...
Hmh. Just so you know, Gromky, the Commander isn't slacking on the job. Mhm, that's all.
You always drink tea with me, so why do you leave all the cookies to me? ...You'd rather I eat all I want? Huh, I see...
Uhh, woaaaahhhhh...
Are you ignoring all these missions, hoping they'll go away? Yikes...
You've earned three cookies for today's sorties. Mm, that'll be all. Now say "aah."
Next time, do your job and command properly.

lines.line: Wh-who gave you the right to just barge in? ...I did? Huh. Well, seeing as you're here, I guess we could read a book together. Mm, that's all.
Wh-who gave you the right to just barge in? ...I did? Huh. Well, seeing as you're here, I guess we could read a book together. Mm, that's all.
I got up to this part just the other day. Time to read the rest. Mm, that's all.
Gromky's looking for me? Ugh... I don't wanna go outside. But I'd feel bad about telling her to buzz off, and pretending to be sick would worry her... Hrmmm...
If you wanna lounge around, do it over there. Mm, that's all.
Mmmh... *yaaaaawn*... Huh?! Oh no, don't tell me I dozed off... You didn't see anything, got it? I mean, of course you didn't!
Retivy... I mean, Tai Yuan, and I shared our recommended book lists. It turns out we've got pretty similar tastes. Heheh.
Want me to read aloud for you, or...?
I-I knew it! You are a creep...!
You could fill a whole book with all these unfinished mission drafts...
There's a letter for you. Can I keep the stamp? Mm, thanks.
So many books lying around... Oh, Commander, I could use your help returning these books to the shelf when you come back.
Wanna read this book with me, Commander? This one. It's called "The Happy Lovebirds." If we read it together, I might just be able to figure out what it's about. Mm, that's all.
Omaha-class light cruiser - Murmansk

I'm the light cruiser Murmansk. In terms of my history, I used to be an Omaha-class cruiser, doing rescue and escort missions. Then after becoming part of the Northern Parliament, I took part in some training missions~

Zdravstuvuyte, Comrade~ I'm the Omaha-class light cruiser, Milwaukee, reporting for duty~ Oh, did I slip up? ...Ahaha, sure did. I'm Murmansk, from the Northern Parliament. It's a pleasure to meet you~
Good morning. Sorry that I'm late, I ran into a friend along the way and stopped to have a chat.
How do you like my tails? They're super fluffy and feel nice in your hands~ By the way, I made them myself♪
Are we going on a rescue mission today? I really love helping people~
Pirouette and a spin~ To my right is a fox, and a bunny to the left~♪
Whew... Hmm~♪ Staaare... Aha!
Hmmhm~♪ Oh, do you want to chat? Why, sure thing!
Ummm, I've got just a teensy qualm about you touching me this way...
You've still got missions~ Would you like me to pester you about them the next time you forget?
Mission complete~ Now let's tackle another job while we're in high spirits~
You have new mail~
Good to see you back~ I've left a refreshing drink and a juicy tangerine on your desk~
The team has come back~ Should we offer them a few warming shots of vodka?
I've gotten stronger~
I'll open fire on the enemy~
We won~! Fighting comes naturally to me~
We lost the battle... I'm sorry for messing up...
Vperod~!
Aww, these tails took a lot of work to make...
Is there something wrong? I'm worried about you...
I might not have many special skills to boast about, but I'll do my best to live up to your hopes~
Oops, sorry, I lost track of time while chatting with a friend, and I forgot I was meeting with you today... Did I make you feel sad? I'm really sorry.
Hmmhm~♪ Once I start chatting with you, it's really hard to stop~ Is that a problem for you, in regards to work? Aww, that's a shame...
Today is my watch-only day, but tomorrow we can chat to our heart's content. This should fix our little time-schedule problem~ ...It doesn't make much difference in the end? Oh, I see...
Taking this oath means we will share an eternal bond, right~? Wonderful! Then from this day forward, I promise I will see you every day, without it causing you any trouble~
I'm so happy~

ex.line: Good morning! I managed to make it on time today. Teehee~♪
A friend told me a while ago that being around me feels warming sometimes, and chilling other times... Umm, that's not really a good thing, is it?
Staaare... Hey~♡ You're really good-looking, Commander~♪
Gosh, your hand feels so warm~

lines.line: ...Achoo! Uhh, good morning... Snow? Yeah, it is snowing today... Woah, it's really coming down hard... Ahaha~
...Achoo! Uhh, good morning... Snow? Yeah, it is snowing today... Woah, it's really coming down hard... Ahaha~
Mrmm... *yaaawn*... Good morning... Sho shleepy...
I'm spending the whole day lazing around indoors, so I don't really need to get dressed~ You can change into loungewear too if you want, Commander~
Have you seen my favorite pillow? It's "just down pillow"...?
Apparently, Pamiat Merkuria likes lazing around too~ I find that surprising, but also kind of unsurprising at the same time...
Whew... I can't help but admire how well everyone's holding up in this snowy weather~
You won't find any tails down there today~
Welcome back~! A warm beverage would be perfect right now~ Like vodka, perhaps?
Easy as porridge in the morning~
Oh gosh! Silly me, I need to focus...!
Hello there, Comrade Commander~ Come take a deeeep breath of this. Sniiiff... Can you smell this room's fragrance? Hm? You can't tell? Oh. Uh, my incense may have stopped burning.
Hello there, Comrade Commander~ Come take a deeeep breath of this. Sniiiff... Can you smell this room's fragrance? Hm? You can't tell? Oh. Uh, my incense may have stopped burning.
I can't exactly run around in this outfit, but as you can see, I made it on time. Heehee♪
I wonder. Should I drape my tails over my shoulders, or should I keep them fixed at my back? What do you think?
You've been staaaaring for a while now♪ I take that to mean you love the dress?
"One, two, three, four, five, foxes love potatoes~" That's an old Dragon Empery nursery rhyme, you know! Hmm? Isn't it? Maybe I'm remembering wrong~
Staaare... Oh, nothing~ Just observing you, that's all. Heehee.
My hair accessories and outfit match perfectly, don't you think?
Huh? My tails are on the floor? It's okay~ I can just wash them later~
I don't think this room is designed for that...
Even the mail smells good... *sniff*... Very nice~
Welcome baaack~ This incense has calming aromatherapeutic effects, so come and rest your weary bones.
*yaaawn*... The incense smells so good that... I'm getting sleepy. Come to think of it, one of the Empery girls said it had a soporific effect... Heehee, wanna sleep together~?
Gnevny-class destroyer—Gromky.

Just so you know, I've done missions with ships from both the Northern Parliament and the Royal Navy! I've also escorted icebreaker ships, and rescued ships along with Gremyashchy! Yep, may we always have fair winds and following seas!
Goooood morning, Comrade! I'm the Northern Parliament destroyer, Gromky! It's an honor to serve alongside everyone in this fleet!
Woah! Comrade, you sure are early today! You know, you can get a bit more rest if you'd like...
Eh? What's wrong, Comrade? Why are you staring at me like that... Did I do something weird?
Comrade Commander, you musn't slack off! I swear, I'll get mad at you!
For troublesome issues, let us all gather to face it together! That's the way we do it at the Northern Parliament, after all!
Comrade Commander, if your hands are cold, feel free to use my sleeves! They're nice and warm, aren't they~
Hehe, Comrade, did you also want to play with my little buddy?
There there, what a good commander you are~ Hmm? Isn't this what you wanted?
I swear, I'll get mad at you, Comrade Commander!
Let's start with the easier missions! Here, I'll help out too!
Mission complete! Unity is strength!
Here are some letters! Is there anything you were looking forward to?
Nothing's better than some blini to fill up your weary and hungry belly! Which would you like, honey or jam?
They're coming back with some precious supplies over there!
As long as I can be of more use to everyone...!
All our powers, combined into one!
It's all thanks to everyone's hard work!
Owww... I didn't think the enemy would be this organized...
Take this! Unity is strength!
T-There's a crack in the rigging?!
Comrade Commander... Are you a bad person...?
Comrade Commander, how were you able to build such a cohesive fleet? Please teach me your ways!

Have you been getting along with Gremyashchy? She's a bit rough to get along with at first, but if you're patient enough with her, I'm sure you'll be able to get along with her just fine in the future! I believe in you, Comrade Commander!

Comrade Commander! Do you prefer food when it has a deeper taste, or do you prefer it if it's lighter? Mmn, alright. I'll try to make sure the borscht I make next time is just to your tastes, Comrade Commander!
Comrade Commander, great work today! Here's a piping hot drink... along with some bliny... and... hehe, a warm hug from me!
I can feel the warmth of happiness radiating from the ring...! Ehehe~ Comrade Commander, thank you very much! I'll continue to be by your side from here on out!
Thanks, Comrade Commander!
Hey, Snezhok! Let's get this snowball fight started!
How nostalgic!
Calm down! ...That goes for me, too!
Is that borscht on the inside?

ex.line: Heyy! You can't get up yet! Didn't I tell you to get more rest?
Why are you staring at me like that? ...Ah! Did you want me to pat your head! ...Huh? That's not it?
Comrade Commander, you mustn't slack off! ...Huh? You want me to come relax with you? I, I guess I can't get mad at that... Wait, hey! Get back to work!
Comrade Commander, your reward for today's battle is... you can have as many blini as you'd like! Ehehe~
You've worked real hard, haven't you? Good job, good job~!

lines.line: Comrade! The morning is already here! Look how high the sun is in the sky!! C'mon, a wonderful day is calling to us~!!
Comrade! The morning is already here! Look how high the sun is in the sky!! C'mon, a wonderful day is calling to us~!!
Good morning, Comrade Commander! Hehe, my little friend here is greeting you too!
Comrade Commander, what did you do to make the paper airplane go so fast? That's so cool!
Hey, Snezhok! Don't just sit there in the room and play games all day! Come on, get a move on it, will you?
This paper crane is supposed to be Reshitelny... Chang Chun was the one who taught me how to make these! Hehe~
When I'm standing here, I can reach your head, Commander! Good job, Comrade Commander! Ehehe~
I don't hate it when you stroke my hair so... Hold on, you're doing it too roughly!
You want to know if I'm cold right now? I'm totally fine! Look, the weather's so nice right now!
Comrade Commander~ Take a seat! Don't you dare try to run away! Stay still, right over there, until I finish talking to you!
Comrade Commander, let's do our best to take care of these missions! Yay!
Here are some letters! Comrade Commander, hurry up and take a look at them!
Comrade Commander! You musn't fall back asleep! Don't. Fall. Back. Asleep. You. Stupid. Commander!!!
Vittorio Veneto-class battleship - Vittorio Veneto.

Expectations of me were high already at my birth, when I inherited the flag following a horrific night. Ultimately, I failed to lead my loyal friends to victory... My past isn't all that bright, is it? But that is why I have high hopes in you, Commander.
It's a pleasure to meet you, Commander. I am Vittorio Veneto, Eternal Flagship of the Sardegna Empire. Forgive me if I sound discourteous, but are you confident in your ability to command me?
May I offer you some succulent tea and a biscuit before you start your work for the day?
This may be unbecoming for me to say, but nevertheless... It would delight me if you used one of our baths. It would let you fully appreciate the splendor of our Empire.
The power of a cannon cannot be gauged by its caliber alone. Any who underestimate my 15-inch battery will pay dearly for their misjudgment.
I joined this fleet for two reasons - to achieve world peace, of course, and to further the Empire's influence. The latter of which I would like your assistance with, Commander.
Allow me to be curt, Commander. If you had the power to crush your opposition, would you still choose the path of passive deterrence? Would you choose a fleet in being?
Even I - the flagship of the Empire's fleet - enjoy leisure breaks from time to time. There will always come some downtime, no matter how tirelessly one works.
Let it be known that this sort of behavior is abjectly inappropriate, no matter your motive for it.
Allow me to give you a reminder, Commander. You are in your right to delegate missions to me, your secretary.
Heehee. I think I know what you're thinking, Commander. "These missions are a cakewalk."
May I offer a bit of advice? Choose your friends carefully.
I have lunch planned later with ladies from the Royal Navy. Are you interested in joining us, Commander?
Were my tortellini to your tastes? I must make more to give to the returning commission team, you see.
A most wise decision, Commander.
Eternal Flagship Vittorio Veneto, sallying forth!
Sardegna's hope, faith, and love shall be felt all across the world's seas, with our fleet as its emissaries.
The enemy overpowering you by sheer force is the most easily acceptable reason for a defeat...
Witness the Empire's prowess!
You hope to defeat me? With attacks this lackluster?
It seems I must reassess the Empire's future...
I never would've thought one day I'd sit down for teatime with Illustrious of all people. Fate is truly a strange thing, I suppose.
Strenuous efforts on everyone's part will be necessary to spread the Empire's splendor across the world. That includes you, of course, Commander. Heehee~
I see not only my Sardegnian friends, but all members of the fleet, beaming with joy. How you managed this feat, I don't know, but it fascinates me to no end.
I have gained many things in our time together - power, allies, and peace of mind. Please, Commander, I'm dying to know - what is it you desire from me in return? I can offer anything you seek...
Do you comprehend the significance of this vow? Our futures are henceforth interconnected. I would normally not have accepted your proposal so easily, but your sheer passion won me over. Heehee.
Oh, my. Have you been looking into my favorite things behind my back?
It is reassuring to have the backing of such capable allies.
Bow to the Empire's splendor!
May your battle go fortuitously.

ex.line: Oh, I suppose it's time for work. Allow me just a moment to tidy things up.
Self-care is important. When you're out on a sortie, don't you wish you could come back to a warm bath every day? ...Not exactly?
You and Littorio are similar in a certain way. Namely, your tendency to rely on me for help~
I'm able to use my abilities to their fullest thanks to all my reliable friends around me. Please, send me out on more missions, Commander.
You really should take occasional breaks and empty your mind instead of working tirelessly all the time, Commander. You'll lead a fuller life if you do. Heehee~
I do not condone this, but since you're so insistent... Ohoho.
Is this letter from your friend? Ah. Heehee. I'm sure your friends are all lovely people.
I have dinner planned for later this evening. I hope you'll join me at the table, Commander.
Could you give this a taste? ...Oh dear, I might have used too much salt. I thought the commission team might prefer stronger seasoning.
Now, let us proceed according to the commander's plans.
Now they know the Empire's splendor, and the firmness of our resolves. And you made it possible, Commander.

lines.line: Nngh, haah... It's awfully sunny today... How long was I asleep, Commander? Oh, it's already lunchtime? In that case, I'll get started on some food. Would you like something as well?
Nngh, haah... It's awfully sunny today... How long was I asleep, Commander? Oh, it's already lunchtime? In that case, I'll get started on some food. Would you like something as well?
Basking in the sunlight, feeling the sea breeze, and listening to the sound of the waves... Ahh, it's wonderful to have a relaxing day off.
A shipgirl gazing out at the sea from atop a ship... It sounds almost like the setup for a joke! I'll have to tell Littorio about it later. Hehehe~
Only when you take the time to recline can you truly take in the beauty of the vast, blue sea. One day, we will have finally reclaimed it in its entirety. Won't we, Commander?
Are you going fishing, Commander? I see, then if you don't mind, I will take my leave for a while. I'd like to finish building my sand Colosseum.
Please do come and spectate our beach volleyball game later in the evening, Commander. If luck is on our side, you may get to see us go up against the Royal Navy's team.
Littorio said I am terrible at photography and now she prohibits me from using the camera. Why, I've never heard something so rude before... Commander, would you ask her to let me take a picture?
Commander? I'm still awake, for your information.
Would you care to sunbathe with me? It's delightfully pleasant, I assure you.
Duca degli Abruzzi-class light cruiser - Luigi di Savoia Duca degli Abruzzi.

I am the Condottieri-class light cruiser Luigi di Savoia Duca degli Abruzzi, from the Sardegna Empire. I fought valiantly alongside my esteemed allies during the war. My ambition now is to achieve lustrous feats as the Empire's splendorous flagbearer!
I am light cruiser Luigi di Savoia Duca degli Abruzzi, Sardegna's splendorous dignitary. I've waited for the day to fight under your banner, Commander.
Greetings, Commander. The Empire's splendor radiates as brightly as ever.
I am the final development from a class of treaty cruiser. With the performance enhancements I received, victory is but guaranteed in any battle I partake in.
How can you sit idly like this, Commander? We dignitaries must set an example for others to follow.
It matters not how strong your adversary is as long as you are stronger. That is what war boils down to.
Hmm. Climb Mount Niitaka? I see I'm not alone in the desire to mountaineer... What? That's not what the message means?
What do you need, Commander? I can perform some of your duties in an official capacity.
What has gotten into you?!
Say the word, and I will complete these missions for you.
Mission complete. It's time you looked over the rewards.
You have a letter. Whoever wrote it is brutishly uncourteous... It's what? From Naval HQ? I see.
If you need rest, now is the time to get it, Commander. We will have much to do afterwards.
The commission team has returned to port. It is part of your job to acknowledge their efforts, is it not, Commander?
Now the question is, how to make the best use of my new abilities?
To battle! My splendor shall be proven!
I am the Empire's splendor - Duca degli Abruzzi! Etch this name into your memories!
Alas, we must shamefully turn our backs on our foes...
Witness my full potential!
As long as I can still fight, I will!
You've proven yourself a spineless imbecile. Get out of my sight!
My name is Luigi di Savoia Duca degli Abruzzi. You find that too hard to memorize? Then you may shorten it to Duca degli Abruzzi, but no less than that. My dignity won't allow it.
Don't fret over each and every obstacle you face, Commander. Your subordinates will do all in their power to help.
I am not just a soldier at your disposal, Commander. I am someone with a desire to understand and support you to my utmost. This desire has nothing to do with rank or status.

What do you want to discuss today, Commander? One cannot do much without the aid of loyal supporters, and I strive to be your biggest one. Hahah. It's the least I can do to return the recognition you've given me.
This ring could only mean one thing. You want my support till death do us apart, no? Then I will oblige. After all, there is no greater joy than knowing you want me by your side forever. Hahaha.
I accept. You have my gratitude, Commander.

ex.line: Care for some tea before work? I'll put the kettle on.
I truly do hope to see you at Le Triomphant's tea party. Feel free to ask if you want suggestions on what gifts you should bring.
You're not procrastinating, but rather taking a break? I wish you would've said so sooner. Forgive me if I've been excessively strict. Let us both work on our undesirable quirks.
Your presence has lifted a great burden from my shoulders. The energy it has freed up I will use to better myself.
Yes, Commander? Whatever it is you need done, just say the word, and I'll see to it.
I don't blame you for losing control, but you must consider the impact on your public image.
You have been defeated by the one and only Luigi di Savoia Duca degli Abruzzi! Remember this fact!

lines.line: Good evening, Commander. Here to unwind after a day's work, I take it? Even dignitaries desire a bit of luxury sometimes. Hahaha.
Good evening, Commander. Here to unwind after a day's work, I take it? Even dignitaries desire a bit of luxury sometimes. Hahaha.
Fixated on my younger sister, hmm? You lend credibility to the adage that heroism breeds virility. Hahah!
What do you think of this neon-lit cityscape? It doesn't start to compare to the idyllic vistas of Sardegna, but it has its own merits.
You truly are dependable to the utmost, obliging my younger sister with your company like this.
Valiant? I'm not sure where she is. Which is concerning, as I don't believe she's a good swimmer...
Enjoy your time here. Let others take care of any bothersome chores in the meantime.
Is the water temperature satisfactory? You must not come here much, so make the most of your visit. If you want something, just ask for it.
Aircraft carrier - Aquila.

My "history"...? Hmm... I do feel a longing for something like that. If only I had been finished a little sooner during that war... My Commander, don't you think I would've had an enviable service history?
Good day to you, my Commander. I'm Aquila, aircraft carrier from the Sardegna Empire. Our meeting today is no mere coincidence. No, it must be a gift from Fortuna herself, I'm sure of it.
We're going to have a busy day. Thanks in advance, my Commander.
So this is how you're supposed to launch carrier-based planes... I think I've got the hang of it... Hyah! ...Oh no, I guess it really is nothing like launching seaplanes...
Sleeping on the job is not something that an excellent commander would do. My Commander... *poke* *poke*... Care to wake up?
My Commander, you should try using gentle words to get an emphatic point across. You'll find the results quite remarkable.
My Commander, will you allow me to organize the warehouse with the help of my planes? ...The previous accident? Well, that was just a one-off thing~ Ahaha...
My Commander, did you need me for something?
My Commander, I do apologize, but... may I refuse this kind of behavior...?
We've got a mission direct from the Naval HQ... It might be pretty tough...
My Commander, I just knew you'd complete your missions without a hitch! Thank goodness~
There's new mail, my Commander. Please choose your words carefully when replying.
My Commander, should I assist you in turning down any troublesome requests?
A commission has been successfully completed! Good work, everyone! My Commander, make sure to offer them words of praise as well!
I feel more experienced now... As long as I do as I practiced in battle, I'm sure everything will be fine!
Mm, hmm! Yes, this is how it's supposed to be... Fly, my aircraft, fly!
Oh my, I won! Hehe, was this victory to your satisfaction, my Commander?
Ugh... Did I make a mistake somewhere...?
I do believe it is time to say goodbye~
I'm not some frail young miss who'll go down in a single blow...!
My Commander, are you still alive? ...Well, if I keep doing this, I'm sure you will come back to your senses...! *thwack*!
My Commander, have you already completed today's missions? And did you finish checking off the documents? This is just a friendly reminder from Aquila~ Mhm, no need to thank me~
Miss Graf Zeppelin? In terms of our history, I'm quite similar to her, right? In that case, "I shall hope that we may forge the bonds of camaraderie"... Eheh~
My Commander, look out! ...Phew, thank goodness. By the way, why did you come visit me in the middle of my aircraft training? Did you... perhaps want to see me at my most vulnerable?!
There's been something on my mind recently... "Just how should I make myself more appealing to you, My Commander?" ...What do you think? Please, teach me all sorts of things~♪
I've prepared many, many words for today's occasion, but first, I'd like to hear your words of love, my Commander~♪ After all, you're the one who proposed to me. Hehe, what do you think I should do?
I graciously accept this.
I do hope we can get along, Miss Graf Zeppelin.
Well met, fair ladies of the Royal Navy~
Wow, as dashing as ever today~
Have a nice trip~ Uh... Did I get something mixed up?

ex.line: Please look after me today as well, my Commander~
Let's give this another try... Are you sure it's supposed to work like this? ...Hyah! ...Ohmygosh! It worked! My Commander, Miss Illustrious!
Zzzzz... Ahhn, you mustn't~ Hwuh? My Commander? Hehe~ I wonder why you didn't directly wake me up?
This is your favorite food, isn't it~ ...Oh, it's not? But that's what Miss Junyou told me. She's your childhood friend, isn't she...?
Oh my... Just what am I going to do with you, my Commander...
Let me handle this task... Oh, are you worried that I won't be able to handle it, my Commander...?
Thank you very much, my Commander! I did a good job, didn't I?
My Commander, if you receive any troublesome requests, will you delegate them to me?
Friends, heed my call - Begin our advance!

lines.line: Good day, my Commander. We have the day off to enjoy the sea breeze and the ocean waves~ Hehe, would you like to help yourself to some fruit?
Good day, my Commander. We have the day off to enjoy the sea breeze and the ocean waves~ Hehe, would you like to help yourself to some fruit?
My Commander, would you like a floaty ring or a life jacket? ...You don't need either? I'll be taking them then~
Oh my, Commander~ If you stare so much at a young signorina's swimsuit, you're going to give others a bad impression~
A swimsuit contest? My my, that sounds like one of Littorio's concoctions~ Don't worry, I'm not interested in entering.
Graf Zeppelin, huh... I don't think we have much in common after all...
I'd like to fly my planes around, but... No, I've got to practice some self-restraint...!
My Commander, would you like some fruit?
My Commander, after we get back, I'll need to lecture you on how to treat a signorina.
I've already tidied up your schedule. Hehe, though it's your day off, I can still handle these small details~
Oh, my Commander? I didn't expect to meet you here! Fortune smiles upon me today. Hehe~ If you have a minute to spare, would you care to join me for a cup of tea?
Oh, my Commander? I didn't expect to meet you here! Fortune smiles upon me today. Hehe~ If you have a minute to spare, would you care to join me for a cup of tea?
Mm, yes, that's just perfect... Oh my, Commander, how are you doing today? -Hmm, I added too much sugar...?
Did you enjoy my black tea? I've worked very, very hard so that I may meet your every demand~♪
Yummy treat~ Become sweet and replete~♪ Commander, I've prepared a little magic spell to make your tea that much tastier~♪
Shall we invite Carabiniere as well next time? I'm sure she'll be quite surprised~♪
Nngh-- Commander, I think this might be a little too naughty?
Commander, would you like some Amaretti? I thought some sugar would be nice to help you replenish after leading a battle~♪
Take flight, with great elegance!
Brin-class submarine - Torricelli.

I'm Brin-class submarine Torricelli... Just remember my name, and I'll be happy... My battle with the Royal Navy? It taught me a lesson about what happens when you underestimate your enemies... Hehehehe...
You've gotta be the commander... My name is T-Torricelli, here to claim this room for myself... Don't worry about me, I'll just be sitting in some quiet corner... Hehe, hehehehe...
Ehh?! C-could you not pop in out of the blue like that... It scares me...
Wh-why are you looking at me...?
You're awful busy today, Commander... You want my help? Umm... I-I'll think about it...
It's safe and quiet under the surface... I'd love to have you down there with me... Hehe, hehehehe...
Could you... c-close the curtains, please? The sunlight... it burns...
Ooohh... Ahh, hehehe... M-more...
Mine don't hold a candle to the massive mounds of some other girls... Hehe, hehehe... Sorry if that disappoints you, Commander...
I guess this means I've c-caught your interest...
Missions? Ugh, I hate missions... Could we just pretend they don't exist...
Leave the mission rewards alone for too long and shrooms might start growing on them... Hehe, hehehehe...
There's mail for you. I've made sure nobody's read it but me... Hehe, hehehe...
I know this scent... When I smell it, it means you've come b-back... Hehe, hehehehe...
The commission team's back? I couldn't care less... You're gonna go see them? I-I'll tag along then...
My guns could use an upgrade too...
Do whatever, it doesn't matter, I just wanna get this over with quick...
Can I come up now? Okay, I-I'm heading back now... Hehe, hehehehe...
I-I'm resurfacing and going back...
Stealthily...
I wanna get out of the water...
You're even edgier than I am... Hehehe...
Like I said, don't worry about me... I'm right here, out of sight, out of mind... Hehehehe...
Yuubari said thanks? I just gave her an idea for a c-cannon modification, that's all... Now she wants my help with it, too? Uhh, I'm gonna pass...
Commander, can I come a step c-closer? Hehe, hehehehe... Your hand feels so nice and warm... Hehe...
I'm glad I have somone as d-diligent and charitable like you to count on... Hehehe... Y-you want me to give you a hand sometimes? I-I'll try...
Hehe, hehehe... Now you're obliged to provide for me forever... That was j-just a joke... So, what comes next...?
Is this for me? Heh, hehehe... I-I accept.
Your personality is my k-kryptonite...
I'm not sure we're on the same wavelength...

ex.line: I sorted all your paperwork, Commander... Hehehe... C-could I get a "thank you," please...?
I love the dark... Hehehe... It hides you from people who'd judge you...
Could I c-come with you on mission briefings? I am your secretary, after all... Hehehe...♡
Helping out with prototype equipment is such a chore... Ugh...
Oh, Commander... Hehe, hehehe...♡
Another mission? O-okay...
Hehe, hehehehe... S-say something good about me...
Thanks for everything you do, Commander... Hehehehe... Tell you what, I-I'll make you dinner today... Mushroom marinade, mushroom risotto, and my own mushroom special... Hehehehe....

lines.line: Hehe, hehehehe... We have this little c-corner of the beach all to ourselves... Now, what should we do first... Hehehehe...
Hehe, hehehehe... We have this little c-corner of the beach all to ourselves... Now, what should we do first... Hehehehe...
Eep! H-how do you keep appearing out of nowhere...
I'll trade you this shell for a coconut, Commander... Hehe, hehehehe... You have only to g-gain from this deal, don't you see? Hehehe...
Don't be scared, little turtle... I won't hurt you, I just wanna watch... Hehe, hehehehe...
I need this straw hat to protect me, or else the sunlight would melt me...
A letter in a bottle? The ocean currents must've brought it here... Hehe, it's the plight of a poor girl who'll never be real... Hehe, hehehehe...
You're not p-planning something, are you...? Hehehe...
Good thing it's j-just us two here... Hehe, hehehehe...
Back already? Hehe... I'm not alone in being a bad swimmer... Hehehehe...
Maestrale-class destroyer - Maestrale.

I am the name ship of the Maestrale-class destroyers, Maestrale. During that war, I remember hitting a naval mine and having to return to port for repairs... The rest of my history? Umm, I, I don't think there's anything else...
Now lift the rim of your skirt and bow... Ahem! I'm Maestrale, d-destroyer from the Sardegna Empire. Greetings to you and your fleet, Commander. I hope I did that right...
Greetings, greetings... G-good morning to you, Commander...
If only Libeccio was here... I wouldn't have to agonize over how to talk to the commander...
What do I think of Libeccio? ...She's my precious little sister. She can be a bit of a klutz at times though, ehehe...

The documents I was just working on are over here, and the already-finished ones are here... Ah, it's not that I couldn't find them, I just thought it'd be more efficient to remind myself out loud... S-sorry... *blushes*
Commander, you must be tired... Ahh, just thinking about it makes me nervous...
Wh-what's going on...?
D-did I say something inappropriate?
...Wh-what is the meaning of this?!
Are you going to... continue working on your high-priority missions? Err, I mean... let, let me help you!
Mission complete. Umm, should I go help you confirm the rewards after all...?
The mail, where'd I put the mail...? Phew, I almost forgot it after all the time I spent organizing it...
How to make tea... Um, take the teabag and steep it in hot water... Commander, p-please let it sit for a few minutes...
A commission has been completed. The dockhead is looking rather crowded...
Shelling, torpedoes, and reloading... I must become stronger in all aspects...
As the flagship... I've got to boost everyone's morale... Roar...!
My thoughts about getting MVP? ......Uh, umm, it's nice...?
I've been defeated... What should I be saying...?
N-now it's my turn!
What should I do...? What should I do?!
Keep your distance from me! Shoo, shoo...!!
Libeccio, please don't bother the commander in the middle of work hours... Here, I'll make a syllabus of the times when the commander is available. Mm, that should be right... hopefully.
Commander... Please look over this. It's a table of our recent mission earnings... I hope it can be of help to you...
...Commander? Why'd you come all the way... t-to talk to me? Um, right now, I'm a bit... err, I mean, yes, I'm available! I'm available, but I can't... Sorry...!
Um, Commander, please take this...! Libeccio told me that if there ever was something I'd never be able to say... to put it down in a picture book! P-please take a look...!
Wh-what should I be saying during a wedding ceremony? ...Um, I don't need to say anything at all? Well then... *kiss* Th-that's fine too, right...?
Goodness... Th-thank you! Oh, I don't even know what to say...
Libeccio, w-w-wait for me...!

ex.line: Good day... Th-there's no need to be so formal? I, I see... th-thanks then...
I really l-like talking to you, Commander... Even though I'm usually the one answering questions, but... I'd actually like to get to know more about you......
L-Libeccio isn't here today, so... Commander, how about we go somewhere t-together?!
The mission supplies are over here, the reward list is over here, and the ring box that Commander gave me is... Oh... *blushes*
Commander, need a hand?
Ehehe... Commander...
Welcome back. I've been studying how to make tea from the Royal Maids. Oh, but keep it a secret from Libeccio, okay...?
Everyone, p-please do your best...!
We did it! Commander, thank you very much! *nods*

lines.line: It's way too crowded on the beach... I'd much rather be- Oh, Commander? Are you not good with crowded places either...?
It's way too crowded on the beach... I'd much rather be- Oh, Commander? Are you not good with crowded places either...?
Greetings, greetings... Err, umm, Commander, w-want to sit down?
Though I'm not able to build the Colosseum like Lady Veneto can, when it comes to the Leaning Tower, a cathedral, or a basilica... Um, I can kind of get the rough shape down!
Veneto's Colosseum is truly spectacular... I wish I could fill in the other half...
Libeccio, stop trying to drag me around.. You can go hang out with the commander instead.
The letters I etch into the sand are immediately washed away by the waves. I see, this is what they mean when they say "write your worries on the beach"...
Commander, did you want to get buried in the sand just like these manjuu? I'll see what I can do then...
P-please stop that...!
Commander, did you come all the way here to see me? Th-thanks for your concern...
Maestrale-class destroyer - Libeccio.
During that war, I was the pride and joy of the Sardegna Empire, Libeccio! ...Eh, I was the first of my sisters to retire? Booo! Commander, why do you have to rub salt in the wound!
Ciao! The name's Libeccio! It's a pleasure to meet you, Commander! Let's be real good friends from here on out!
Ciao! Commander, let's give it our all today as well!
Now that I'm here, Maestrale's gonna make a whole lotta friends! ...Oh, right, Commander! Are you getting along with my sis?
Maestrale's super good at organizing documents, isn't she? When I try to do it, they just end up messier and messier~
My hair's silver on the outside and blue on the inside! Beautiful, isn't it?
Commander, look over here! Kapow! Whew, a direct hit~! Ahaha!
Hold your horsies, Commander! Lemme take my hat off first... Now, pat me!
Hey, what's the matter? Did something happen~?
Smooth and flat, huh? Just like my big sis!
It's mission time! All I have to do is check off the box next to 'em, right... Of course that was a joke!
The mission rewards huh... I may or may not have helped myself to a little when Maestrale wasn't looking... Ehehe~
Mail time! Mail time! Whooooo~!
Commander, look! Lookie lookie at what I found! It's the teabags that my sis always uses to make you tea! I wanna try it too!
Commission complete! Duuuuude, look at the loot!
Such powerrrr! Time to show off to Maestrale!
I'm the flagship! Everyone, lesgooooo~!
The MVP is all mine! Commander, gimme a reward!
Starting emergency rescue procedures! Commander, make sure you keep me safe!
Let's have some fun over here~!
Woah! An enemy ambush!
Knock knock! Yeah, I'm gonna keep thwacking you around until you behave!
I wish I could get Maestrale some more friends! Commander, got any ideas?
Commander, I'm here to play! You're not busy right now, right? Ehehe, after all, Maestrale made this... silly-bus for me? In any case, it seems right!
Ehhh... Spend more time with me, Commander! What do I even want to do...? I don't care! Anything!
Commander! I'm here to play again! I don't care what you're doing! I'm gonna cling to you today no matter what! Heh~ heh~!
What a beautiful ring! If I put this on, it means that I'll be able to cling to you as much as I want, right? It's a promise!
Ooh, yeah, I love this! Thanks!
Sis, follow my lead!

ex.line: Ciao! Commander, let's dial it up to 11 today as well! Woohoo~!
My sister and I both like you a lot, Commander! We love you! Ehehe~ Commander, do you love us as well?
I did my best to help you organize your documents! Ehehe! Commander, what should I do next?
Behold the Eternal Light of Sardegna! ...Uhh, what color is an eternal light, and how do you hold it? ...I wonder if Veneto will tell me...
Commander, throw the ball over here! Woohoo! Let's continue our anti-air exercises!
Commander, is my sister doing alright?
Welcome back, Commander! Hey, teach me something! Maestrale told me I should learn something that can help you out!

lines.line: Libeccio's heading towards the sea! Commander, let's go to where all the excitement is!
Libeccio's heading towards the sea! Commander, let's go to where all the excitement is!
One, two three, four... All righty, I'm all done warming up! Time to head down into the water~!
How the heck do you make a sand castle? Like this? Or maybe... like this...? Gaaaah! I give up!
Sailor Libeccio, ready to head out! Captain da Recco, when do we begin the timber-shivering?
How can I get Maestrale to join us in the fun and games? ...Hmm, take some beautiful conch shells over to her?
Commander, look at that! So many footprints in the sand along the beach... Huuuh?! Th-they got washed away just like that...
Yes, pat me to your heart's content!
Get on, Commander! We're going on a field trip!
Commander, what kind of game is this~?
Glub... Blub...! Blehhh, it's so salty... My kickboard flipped over in the blink of an eye... I guess I really shouldn't head out until the waves calm down a little!
Navigatori-class destroyer - Nicoloso da Recco.

I'm a navigator, and let me tell you, I'm phenomenal! I fought hard alongside lots of my friends, and even made it through the war in one piece. My run-in with Force Q though, that was just blind luck!
The port's newest arrival, that's-a me! Fun-sized navigator Nicoloso da Recco salutes you, Commander! Andiamo, towards uncharted waters!
Ahoy! Good to see you again, Commander! Let's have a look at today's cruising plans!
This course is a no-go because there's no resupply point along it? Okay, then how about this one? ...Also a no-go; ocean currents are too strong? Stop being such a darn naysayer, Commander!
Commander, got any maps lying around? I'm not gonna mess with them, I just wanna draw some lines, plot a few courses, that sorta stuff!
Hey, could I have a look at your medal collection? I'm just curious which and how many you have!
Why does everyone just take the same exact route over and over? There's so, so much ocean to see out there!
Ow! Don't pull on my hairband!
Will you check out the course I plotted after I finish this work? Sweet! I'll have it done in no time!
I may be short, but I'm stacked! Bada bing!
Get those missions done, on the double! I'll be stuck idling in port forever otherwise!
Mission complete! Can we go on a voyage now? What do you mean?! I thought we had a deal!
New mail's come in! Maybe it's got info on the latest course developments?
Let's see, where should I plot a course to next...
A commission's been completed! What do you say we try a different course for the next one?
To the horizon and beyond!
Captain da Recco, setting sail!
That's that annoying bunch dealt with! Now we can explore in peace!
Err, what? Did I take us on the wrong course?
Wind direction accounted for! Fireeee!
Oops!
I'm going on a voyage! Without you! Buh-bye!
Ahoy, Commander! Today's a perfect day to go on a voyage! First, we just have to plot a course!
By Neptune's name! Look, Commander, there's an uncharted area on our map! Who knows what secrets it holds! We should go there on our next voyage!
"If you help me out enough, I'll consider taking that route"? Whoa, you mean it?! Sign me up as your assistant!

We've got a date coming up, you and I! Since I am the veteran navigator here, I'll do the course plotting... I mean, itinerary planning! ...You wanna do that yourself? Hmm... All right, I'll leave it to you!
What's it mean to "link our hearts"? Will I know where you are when I'm out at sea, without even using a compass? Ahaha! If only it were so easy, am I right?
Bravo! Thank you, thank you!
Eep! You again...
Andiamo, to uncharted waters!

ex.line: Ahoy-ahoy, Commander! Did you know? It's a perfect day for a voyage! Let's go on one right now!
This course will get us caught in a storm? And this one will get us shipwrecked? Dangit, why?! I thought I had it all planned out...
I bought a new map! ...No, I paid for it myself, out of my own pocket. Making maps is what I do for a hobby!
Nice medal collection, Commander! I've gotta show these to my Sardegnian friends!
Hmm, where should I plot a course to next... Any suggestions, Commander?
A commission's been completed! It ain't easy, plotting new courses all the time.
I've worked out a course for our date! It goes to a nice, kinda remote little corner of the sea! Now it's your job to find some souvenirs for everyone!

lines.line: I know this one! It's that Sakura Empire watermelon-smashing game! Just put the melon over there, Commander! ...Relax, it'll be fine! Have some faith in my navigator's intuition! Ready? Then let's go!

I know this one! It's that Sakura Empire watermelon-smashing game! Just put the melon over there, Commander! ...Relax, it'll be fine! Have some faith in my navigator's intuition! Ready? Then let's go!
The weather's perfect for a voyage, but Captain da Recco's seaside funtime takes precedence! Come on over and we'll play a game, Commander!
Be sure to stop by later, Commander! We'll split a melon and each have a slice!
Oh, I've gotta put on a blindfold too? No problem! I'll still nail that watermelon! Just make sure it stays in place!
I remember hearing the Dragon Empery's got something similar to this, just with a rock instead of a melon!
Remember to stay hydrated! Just because you're near the ocean doesn't mean you won't get thirsty!
Wanna pick up a bat and try for yourself?
Oh shoot! Watch out - airborne bat!
Ahoy! Wanna join my sister here under the sand?
Woohoo! Good thing I smashed that melon! ...Huh? What do you mean it's not a ceremony to boost your luck?
Kamikaze-class destroyer number six - Oite.
I served as flagship of Destroyer Division 29 within Destroyer Squadron 6. I performed various escort and transport missions. Leave any tasks of this nature to me. End of report.
I am Kamikaze-class destroyer Oite, assuming my post starting today. I will perform my duties, and anything beyond that I will decide on a case-by-case basis. End of report.
You came of your own accord. How fortunate... Never you mind. Get to work.
All you do is loaf around in here... Are you a commander, or a deadbeat?
How, I wonder, would one go about making Agano stop touching my ears...
Urgh... Reading so much fine print text has given me a headache. Commander, requesting permission to rest...
I like the quiet of the office, free from the jarring hum of propeller aircraft.
What the-?! K-k-keep your hands off my ears!
Whuah! Would you STOP tickling me?
Whuah?! Wh-wh-wha-what has gotten into you, fool?!
To think a trivial task would have you up-ended like this... If you so insist it's impossible, then I will set an example.
Mission complete. Will you get a move on already and process the rewards?
Correspondence has arrived. Don't come nagging later, saying I didn't inform you.
No unauthorized persons entered the office in your absence. End of report.
The commission team has returned. I will see to the transport of the goods, and you to its inspection.
You have my gratitude.
Enough talk! Have at you!
All I did was perform my duty, as I said I would.
We must start anew at boot camp...
Let us finish this!
When push comes to shove, retaliate...!
I expect no betterment from you. Go on, let your name be irreversibly tarnished.
What do you need from me? Make it quick.
You need an attendant for your outing? Understoo- Wait, why would you need an attendant for a tour of your own port? ...You want to "hang out" with me? What does that mean?

I cannot wrap my head around your need for an attendant when there are no hostiles at the port... Nor do I grasp this "hang out" business! Although I did enjoy our friendly exchange! E-e-end of report!
All your talk of attendants and "hanging out" was just an attempt to seduce me, was it not? N-no, I mean nothing bad by it! Oh, forget it! You toyed with my heart, and now you must o-own up to it!
I don't know what to do at this ceremony! You insisted on it, so it's your responsibility to g-guide me through it! E-end of report...
You're more perceptive than I thought~
I have you covered!
Commander, have you also come to play on the beach? You're telling me to be careful? Hmph, what misfortune could possibly befall me from a game of watermelon splitting... Gwaah?!
Commander, have you also come to play on the beach? You're telling me to be careful? Hmph, what misfortune could possibly befall me from a game of watermelon splitting... Gwaah?!
Oh, to hell with it! I will practice until I can effortlessly split this watermlon!
Watch closely, Commander. You are about to witness what unyielding focus looks like... What?! I missed again?!
Are we ready to start yet? ...Commander? Where are you? G-give me the signal, I'm waiting!
Matsukaze made fried noodles! Oh, how mouthwateringly good they are! You ought to taste them for yourself, Commander.
I'm much obliged for the help, Hatakaze! Now watch - I will cleave this watermelon in twain!
Whuah! What are you doing?!
Wh-what is it?
What in the name of-?! What is the matter with you?!
Truly, Kamikaze? You're certain I will become proficient faster if I wear a blindfold?
Happy New Year to you, Commander. To celebrate the season, I had these garments tailor-made for me, using traditional Dragon Empery clothes as a basis. I don't look... childish, do I?
Happy New Year to you, Commander. To celebrate the season, I had these garments tailor-made for me, using traditional Dragon Empery clothes as a basis. I don't look... childish, do I?

A New Year's poem... "Many riches will grace you soon - I want my new year's gift by noon"... No, this is backwards! I'm at the age where I'm the one who should give the young'uns gifts... Oh, Commander? When did you get back?
The essence of the plum tree is best captured with erratic brush strokes... This is quite the elegant ink painting.
"In the ninth year of Yonghe, and the year of the Water Ox..." Bah! The rest of the text is unintelligible to me...
Writing a poem in seven steps? Is there a person on this earth capable of such a feat?
Kamikaze, what should one offer the young'uns as a new year's gift, other than money?
Whuaah?! I've told you countless times! St-st-stop touching my ears!
Eep! Y-y-you're doing this on purpose, aren't you?!
Eek?! Y-y-you reprobate! What's the matter with you?!
Should you think of any good ideas for verses, tell me. I will write them down.
Allen M. Sumner-class destroyer - Allen M. Sumner, Hull Number DD-692.

I'm Allen M. Sumner, nameship of the class that succeeded the Fletcher class. We may not be as numerous as the Fletchers, but we've got a teensy edge over 'em in firepower and AA! Hell, I think it's no exaggeration to say we were the Eagle Union's strongest destroyers back in the war!
I'm Eagle Union destroyer Allen M. Sumner! Just call me Allen! It's a pleasure, Commander! Anyway, I've heard you've got yummy food and cushy work here at this port. That true?
You're still in dreamland, huh? Hm... *blows*... Oh, hey! So you are awake!
So Commander, do you like being the one cuddling, or the one being cuddled? Just wonderin'!
Okay, hear me out! Why don't we spruce up the office with some stickers? These here would look great on the walls and your desk!
Man, it's crazy how much Fletcher cares for her sisters. Who, me? I, uhh, prefer a hands-off approach with my sisters!
So this is what you do all day... You don't think I could become a commander too if I studied enough? Yeeeah, me neither. Heheh. Feel a little less tense now?
You just yawned, didn't you, Commander? Just be honest and admit it~
Hmm?
What's that? You cuddle with me? Go on, try it!
Hahaahh! Too slippery for you! Can't catch me!
Beep boop, this is an automated deadpan mission reminder. Uncompleted missions detected. Do your job. Beep boop.
Mission completed! ...Wait a sec, this thing says I had zero involvement in it!
New mail's come in! Gonna read it later? Gotcha, I'll put a sticker on it then.
Whoa! Hel-looo! The couch is all yours if you want it.
Commission completezo! Check it out, I categorized the rewards with some stickers!
Sweet! Burst of energy like this make me wanna do stretches!
Let's do this thing!
Easy-breezy! That's another star on my record!
Oh crap, I really whiffed this one... Thank god for that near miss back there... Umm, I'll do better next time.
Welp, time to go ham!
Owch! I'm not outta the game yet, though!
Okay, okay, calm yourself and I'll indulge you with a nice, heartwarming hug.
My rigging's in tip-top condition! Counting on you to keep it that way, Commander! Hehe!

I've finished all my combat drills, so I'm gonna use my break time to run down to the store! Oh, before I forget, here's a special sticker for you! It's all good if you wanna trade it with someone later.
So, you doing anything special on your next day off? No? Perfect! Then mark that date your calendar. I'll bring the vidya and we can game all day!
Zzz... Hmm? Commander? *yawn*... Guess I dozed off, whoops. Could you gimme a ride to the couch? ...No? Aww, why not?! We're buds, so what's the big deal? Zzz...
One mystery remains: did I charm you, or did you charm me? Meh, don't really matter... All that's important is now we'll live happily ever after! Hehe~ I love you so much, Commander♡
Oooh! I'll take this!
Hey look, Black Cats! Pfft! Just messing with you~
Is that you, sis? Never mind, wrong Laffey!
Oh man, those new stickers you've got? They're so cute!
If it ain't the ghost that popularized oversized sleeves!

ex.line: Hwuh?! Wait, did I fall asleep? *yawn*... I might just call in sick today. Too lazy.
You could go for some cuddling? Don't mind if I do! We're gonna cuddle 'till dawn breaks!
What do you mean "please help"? I'm your secretary, just tell me "get this done" like a commander would! ...Right, I'm on it.
A new mission? I could help, if you want. I'll get it done in a jiffy!
Beep boop, this is an automated deadpan mission reminder. Mission rewards detected. Go claim them. Beep boop.
I'm givin' it one-hundo percent!
This victory's for me and you, Commander! Ahaha!

lines.line: Welcome, Commander! I would fetch you our menu, but I've had a teensy accident here... Don't worry, I'll fix this somehow!
Welcome, Commander! I would fetch you our menu, but I've had a teensy accident here... Don't worry, I'll fix this somehow!
Welcome, Commander! Uh, watch your step!
Thanks for popping in! By the way... I'll pay you back for the OJ later.
Turns out North Carolina is like, a bunny girl expert! I never knew that.
No, Cooper! No adult drinks, got it? Ask the commander to order you some juice instead! Hehehe~
Sooo... You like bunny girls, Commander? Asking for a friend.
You know what, it's comfier to sit and take it easy, so I'm gonna stay put for now.
Hey! You can't grope a staff member!
Hey, Commander, order a glass of OJ! ...No, it's for me! Staff can't just order drinks for themselves, y'know? That's weird.

Heheh! Policewoman who protects the city's order by day, vigilante who takes from the rich and gives to the poor by night! She is phantom thief Miss Terious, or PhantoM for short! Your riches are now mine! Your dumb little traps wouldn't catch me in a hundred years!

Heheh! Policewoman who protects the city's order by day, vigilante who takes from the rich and gives to the poor by night! She is phantom thief Miss Terious, or PhantoM for short! Your riches are now mine! Your dumb little traps wouldn't catch me in a hundred years!
PhantoM has come! The treasure I'll be stealing today is your heart! How's that for giving you palpitations?

Ahah! It's pretty fun to play a double-agent thief! Cracking down on crime in daylight, then thieving for the good of the people in moonlight... The two sides contrast nicely with each other and it's surprisingly invigorating!
"The world-renowned phantom thief has come. The treasures I called out are now mine!" ...Yeah! I referenced some other movies and came up with this line. I'd say I nailed it!
Leaving a calling card and putting your target on edge, then stealing their treasure with ease despite the high security... Now THAT'S a challenge worth taking on, heehee.
A police officer and a phantom thief think and operate completely differently, but I'm the flexible type, so I can switch between the two like it's the most natural thing ever!
You can change costumes from police to thief in an instant with just one easy trick. Wanna know it? I'll tell you if you're interested!
Is there any treasure only I could steal? Shh, it's daytime, and I'm still a police officer! Let's save this convo for Miss Terious to answer later tonight! Heehee♪
Sheesh, it's not easy playing your role, Commander. Do you need script revisions or direction? Don't be shy to ask for anything you need!
Heheh. Who's your favorite between policewoman Allen and phantom thief Allen?
You've got a letter, Commander! ...Come to think of it, I should send out some calling cards, too.
Hey! Welcome back, Commander! Quick, swap personas! We've got a case to do, partner!
Ahahah! Another huge haul and another star on my treasure list!

Ahah! I just got a great idea! Next time we get the chance, we should form, like, a super legendary phantom thief team. Think about it - we're as close as close gets, so our acting and teamwork would be smooth as butter! Give it some thought!
Fletcher-class destroyer - Stephen Potter, Hull Number DD-538.

My record's got the usual destroyer stuff. You know, did anti-air duty, hunted a submarine, and went on the odd rescue mission. So basically, I can do anything a destroyer should be able to, just don't expect me to singlehandedly save the day like some superhero.
Fletcher-class Stephen Potter here. You've probably met a million of my sisters already, so I'll spare you my life story. See you around.
Welcome to the circle of hell known as "the office." Relax, I'll lend a hand if the cauldron gets too hot for you.
Here to chillax and hang out, eh, Commander?
Dang, you caught me spacing out at work. ...Oh? Maybe you didn't after all? Cool. I'll just get back to doing it then.
Hey, how about a bit of jazz? Chill, I'm just getting up to put a song on. I'm not gonna bail on you or anything.
Mind if I borrow your coat, Commander? Thanks. This will work great as a blanket.
Okay, now I think I get why some girls have headpat addictions.
You want some gum? 'Kay. Mint or orange flavor?
Whoa! Talk about a blunt-ass approach...
Hey, a new mission! Oh, whoops... I guess we've both gotta actually do work now that I've said that.
Finished a mission, huh? Cool, then let's take ten to veg out.
Kind of curious who sent that unread letter on your desk.
Hum-hmmhm~♪ Oh, welcome back.
A commission's been completed. Just throwing that out there before I forget.
Welp, guess the Slacker Council has to disband for the day.
All right, since I've gotta take this flagship thing seriously... Let 'em have it, girls!
Cool beans. I wasn't trying to style on 'em, but I'll take any commendations I'll get.
Crap. I went too easy on 'em...
Let's get this over with.
All right, no more messing around...
Yeah, no, I'll find someplace less boring to hang out. Hit me up only if you've got business with me.
You need help with something? I've got a bazillion sisters, why not try asking them first?

Hm? Why do I always just sit and stare when you take me in as the secretary? Becaaaause... you never explicitly ask for help? If you need something done, just like, tell me? I'm not the most attentive person in the universe, so sorry for that.

It's getting harder and harder to tune you out of my mind... No, I don't mean that in reference to like, work, my free time, or whatever... I mean you, Commander. I'll just keep my eyes on you for now.

Well yeah, I've thought about love before? It's not alien to me. Although thinking about it drains too much brainpower and just makes me sleepy in the end. I'd rather just be with you, Commander, and figure it out over time.
It's gonna be so tiring, dealing with the responsibilities that come with getting hitched... Just saying, that's all. Hehe, I can handle a bit of fatigue as long as I've got you, sweetheart.
Whoa, getting exactly what you wanted all of a sudden's kinda scary! I'm super happy, though! Thank you♪
I'm gonna chill for just like, a little bit. Don't rat me out, 'kay?
Want some gum?

ex.line: Welcome back to the little bit o' heaven known as "the office." Of course, heaven is wherever I am, right?
Got something you need from me? Sure, just say the word and you got it. Not a whole lot going on anyway, so maybe I'll do you a little favor~
Listening to music really puts you in that efficient state. Oh, I was talking about gaming. I'm fallin' asleep over here at work anyway, so what's the harm in enjoying some beats?
Commander's jacket... *sniff, sniff*... Great, nice and clean. Go, me!
We've got new missions! Gotta do this stuff sooner or later, so why not get it outta the way now?
Meh. Can't afford to let you down, and all that jazz.

lines.line: Welcome to my private retreat, where you can skip work and veg out all you want. And by "skip work" I mean "enjoy your regularly scheduled day off." Anyway, make yourself at home, Commander.
Welcome to my private retreat, where you can skip work and veg out all you want. And by "skip work" I mean "enjoy your regularly scheduled day off." Anyway, make yourself at home, Commander.
Heya. Wanna play a game? Mobile, console, or tabletop?
I've got bunny pajamas on top of a bunny girl costume. That's double the bunny right there.
Meowfficer plushes, Manjuu hand puppets... I never realized how much weird stuff I've amassed over the years.
I invited Laffey over, thinking she'd be fun to chill with. Turns out she's just a sleep junkie, like Nicholas.
Yeah, the place is a mess, but I'm used to it. It's way too much work to tidy up, so let's not.
It's only human to want to touch the bun, I guess.
You want a bubblegum kiss? Sure. I've got plenty of flavors you can choose from.
I'm starting to think this outfit is a bit too inviting...
Oh, new mail. Let's see here... Figures. This one's for you, Commander.
Oh, there's that collector's edition I ordered. What to do with these stickers... Guess I'll put 'em somewhere.
1st Ship of the Amagi-class Battlecruisers, Amagi

I am Amagi, battlecruiser from the Sakura Empire. Commander, I hope to grow up big and strong here at this port so that I may protect you and Akagi. In other words... I'll do my best to eat properly and sleep properly.
Battlecruiser Amagi offers you her humble greetings, Commander. *cough* *cough* ...Ah, I'm fine, I just seem to have caught a little cold... *achoo!* Aww...
Commander, I've put today's itinerary here as well as all the documents that need to be looked over. Hm...? I'm perfectly capable of handling this kind of workload by myself.
*cough*... *sniffle*... Ugh... I, I'm okay... I just ate too many sweets, and now I'm not feeling so good... *cough* *cough*... *sniffle*...
As expected of the head of the Royal Maids... Even I must stop to admire such an excellent cup of black tea... Mm~ hmm~
Akagi, Commander is your superior, not your subordinate. ...Jeez, if you end up causing even more trouble, you're going to get an earful!
Oops, I mistook the manjuus for dango again... It must be because I'm so hungry...
Nngh... Commander, p-please stop...
It's not that my clothes are slipping off, but... Oh, you don't want me catching a cold? Yes, I shall be mindful of that.
Hm? Commander, I am currently busy thinking.
Unfinished missions still remain. We must make efficient use of our earnings...
Mission complete, Commander. When can I confirm our next mission?
I wonder if there's any candy inside... Oh, it's just a regular letter...
Welcome back, Commander. Would you like to try some of our traditional sweets? ...If you'd like, I could also eat them with you.
Commander, a commission has been completed. Should you be willing, may I propose a suggestion for our next task?
I must also become stronger, so that I can protect Akagi.
Let's proceed as planned.
Now then... how shall we press the advantage? Hehehe...
*cough* *cough*... I can't show something so unsightly to Akagi and the others...
Heh heh...
Was there an error in my calculations...?
Commander, are you going insane because of my recent poor health...?
I shall do anything to protect Akagi, the Sakura Empire, and my friends here at this port. Commander, please give me your orders.
You want to see me grow up healthy and strong? Umm... I understand the importance of this as your subordinate and ship, but... should I be doing anything special?
*Nom*... Shoooo yummy... Oh, Commander, my apologies, I was just eating this bit of mochi... Hm, it's okay to finish it first? If, if you say so...
Commander, it's time to take a break. Though you're always looking out for my health, your words wouldn't be persuasive if you didn't also take care of yourself. Here, I've prepared the bed for you~

You musn't, Commander... If you give this ring to me, then Akagi will... Huh, she's fine with it? ...I see, Akagi is all grown up as well... Wait, sorry, I should be focusing on giving you an answer first... But yes, it'd be an honor to accept this!
A direct attack on my heart... Quite the strategy. I'm impressed. Ehehe~
Akagi, don't cause any trouble for the commander.
I'd better not catch you trying to intimidate the commander.

ex.line: Commander, I've put today's itinerary on your desk. Please look over it when you have time.
Commander, say "ahhn"~ Now, it's my turn. Mm, delicious! Now it's your turn again~
Commander, can you play Go with Kaga? She keeps saying "I'll beat you next time"...
I'm not good at physical activities, but a little bit of light exercise... Yes, if you'll be accompanying me, I'll also put forward my best effort.
Do you like rubbing Akagi's tails the same way...?
Should I call Akagi here as well? Hehehe~
Commander, Hiei taught me how to make three-colored mochi. Would you like to try some? Akagi and her friends all said it was delicious~
It would appear that my tactics proved successful once again... Hehehe...
Commander, would you like to rest on my lap? Thanks to you, I've been able to hold on for a lot longer~ Ehehe... Please make sure to go sleep in your regular bed before Akagi gets mad~

lines.line: Essex-class aircraft carrier - Ticonderoga, Hull Number CV-14.

The sixth ship in the Essex-class, and the first in the class to have a long hull. I was once called "Hancock," but in the end, I was renamed to "Ticonderoga" in commemoration of the great war. That's about it.
Hi there~ I'm Ticonderoga, the newest arrival at your port. Hmm, you look just as friendly as they said you'd be~ Thank goodness. So, how about a hug to start us off on the right foot? Hehe~
Oh my, you don't look that great... How about I do something special for you? What, you ask? Hehe, why don't you try imagining what it might be?
Sigh... The last exercise revealed a lot of problems... Commander?! Please, could you please knock before entering a lady's room?
What's on the moon, you wonder? A rabbit? Aliens? Hehe. Whatever it is, I'd like to see it for myself one day.
If you're tired, you can snuggle up to me and rest for a bit. Oh, would you rather have a lap pillow instead? Well, if someone walks in on us, I'll leave the explanations to you~ Hehe.
The files are organized, and the Commander's schedule is ready... Phew... I should be fine.
You shouldn't slack off, Commander. Oh my, am I the distracting you from your work? Heheh, just kidding~♪
My, are you sure you want to be doing this? I think I saw Aoba or someone passing by with a camera earlier.
You still haven't completed the new missions? Hmm... Well, it's fine for now. Just take care of them at your own pace.
Great job completing those missions! You're quite something, Commander!
There's some mail for you, Commander. You should check them as soon as possible. After all, it'd be a disaster if you overlooked something.
Good work on the operation, Commander. Give me your arm... Good, there we go. Hehe, doesn't it feel nice? Let all the fatigue dissipate, just like that!
The commissions team is back. We should go and greet them right away.
I've gotten even stronger... Great!
Stick to the plan!
Oh, we won. It's because you were by our side, Commander.
Where did we go wrong...
Let's show off the fruits of our labor!
Hard to port! Watch out for fire!
It seems I won't be able to save the Commander with my efforts alone...
You're going to head out on patrol? Then... wrap your arm around mine, just like this~ Oh, do you dislike me, Commander? Or... are you worried about the other girls' reactions?
There are many excellent allies here at the port. I... I'll have to work hard, won't I~♪
For some reason, it seems there are some strange rumors about the two of us floating about... Just as planned? ...Commander!
I'm not particularly noteworthy as a warship, and it might be a while until I can truly stand by your side as your equal... Even so, are you really fine with me? Can I really stay at your side?

Huh?! Uh, umm... What am I supposed to say in response to your proposal...? Uhh... You're really giving this to me? Ahh, I'm sorry, I'm just so happy that my heart is about to explode and I don't know what to do and ahh...
You really are great at choosing presents, Commander.
Shall we show them our Essex-class synergy? Hehe~
Let's calm down and take this slowly!

ex.line: Commander, you seem to be in perfect condition today~ Want me to do "something nice" for you? O-okay, okay.
Commander? I'll get the door for you... Oh, it's already unlocked? Uhh, I see...
I love going stargazing with Intrepid. Really, it's surprising how much our interests align.
There there, Commander~ You've done such a good job, haven''t you~ Of course, I have too~♪
Commander, are those documents good to go? Oh, I mean the ones I gave you earlier. I was worried I might have made a mistake or two.
Good job out there, Commander. Huhh, you want to see my arm? Sure-ahhn?! Th-that felt amazing...!

Good work, Commander. Did you need anything? A date...? Why yes, of course! As long as you're fine with me... Err, no, I'll be taking the lead today, so come with me... H-huh? You don't mean right now?

lines.line: It's showtime! The stage is all set for the performance! Let's enjoy this perfect evening together, Commander~!
It's showtime! The stage is all set for the performance! Let's enjoy this perfect evening together, Commander~!
Are you down in the dumps? Well, how about I cheer you up with a little show? ...A magic trick, perhaps?
No matter how many times I practice, when it comes time for the performance, I can't help but get nervous... Maybe I'm not really cut out for this...
Forget about work for the time being and keep your eyes on the excitement, Commander~♪
And the lucky volunteer is... the Commander! Here, no need to feel embarrassed! Come up onstage and join in on the fun~♪
Next up, the Essex's air show! Feast your eyes on the performance!
Commander, did you want to come up on stage as well?
Oh? Commander, everyone's looking at us, you know?
I hope you'll all come back for more! ...Hehe, just kidding~♪
I guess we didn't rehearse enough...
Hi! Thoughts on my swimsuit, Commander? Does it suit your tastes? Heheh, thanks! If you had to leave a comment, what would you say? ...Where did you learn how to tease people so well?
Hi! Thoughts on my swimsuit, Commander? Does it suit your tastes? Heheh, thanks! If you had to leave a comment, what would you say? ...Where did you learn how to tease people so well?
Commander, you're late. I was about to melt out here waiting for you. What's that? You didn't promise to meet me here? Then why are you here, exactly? Heheh♪
The sun is strong on the beach, so sunglasses are a must... But y'know, Commander, you might be even more dazzling. Heheh, was that smooth, or what?
I was thinking of riding some waves for a while later. Wanna come, Commander? I bet you'll have fun.
Hm? You're interested in Saratoga's swimsuit? I see... Probably suits Bunker Hill or Essex more than me...
Georgia, the lace on your rash guard is so pretty. Huh? Seattle picked it for you? That's a surprise...
Essex and I don't really burn much. It's a shame we never get a good excuse to wear tanning oil.
What? You wanna put suntan lotion on me? Heheh, then how about we take things behind that tree over there...?
Oh, Commander, you look tired. Wanna take a break here with me? The ice cream and fruits here are cold and tasty.
The commission team is back. Let's go out to the beach to greet them with gifts!
Phew... Cheers to victory! Right?

Eye candy or not, it's pretty easy to get shy surrounded by so many people in bathing suits... Makes you wanna go on a little faux-date, just the two of us... Geez, what am I saying? It could be a real date, right...?
New Orleans-class heavy cruiser - San Francisco, Hull Number CA-38.

I'm San Francisco, the legendary New Orleans-class heavy cruiser! I made it through the war alive by clobberin' suckers left and right! Now I just wanna do my own thing, chilling, kickin' it, that kind of stuff!
Sup, Commander! The name's San Francisco! ...Huh, joining the fleet's supposed to be fun? Anything in it for me? Just askin' for curiosity's sake~ Oh, by the way, I'm calling ya Puddin' from now on~
ello, Puddin'! Gimme a smile! Now a high five! I see you're kicking ass at work today, so... hasta la vista baybay~!
♪ Bat outta hell~ Gets another roll~ Mess with San Fran~ Get a hole in your skull~ ♪
Someone been bullyin' you, Juneau? Just tell me who, and me and my bat will go teach 'em a hard lesson!
Man, the dorm's exterior is hella drab. I could fix it up with a splash of paint, y'know.
You busy, Puddin'? Busyyyy? Helloooo? Damn, guess you're hella in the zone. Don't you get bored sittin' in here all day?
Why do I call you Puddin'? 'Cause it's fun, so why not? Haha~
What, you trying to spook me? Really, huh? Then you better watch for surprises from now on when you're out walkin' at night, Puddin'~
Sup? Something goin' on? Or is that your way of saying "let's hang out"? ...You wouldn't deadass poke a girl for no reason, would ya?
All right then, let's clobber some decency into you! ...Just messin', but don't do that again, 'kay?
This mission? Looks like a cakewalk to me. It's all yours, Puddin'.
Rewards, eh? They're all yours, Puddin'! Rewards are a crutch, I don't need 'em!
Seems you've got new mail. I'm hella beat right now, so fetch it yourself.
A wild Puddin' appeared! Now let's see if you're gonna work hard or hardly work!
Welcome the commission team back? Naw, that's outta my pay grade. Now, if I get to meet some chill people, then we're talkin'!
Whew... It's a start~
On my command!
Dusted and done! Those chumps never stood a chance, Puddin'.
Don't get bummed out~ I'll win twice as hard for you next time!
Let's make some noise! Hahahaha!
Aw crap! They're targetting me!
Maybe you'll regret your jackassery if I tie you up and throw ya into the sea, eh, Puddin'?
Puddin' is a hella cute name, don'tcha think? Feels way more legit than just callin' you "commander" like everyone else.
Oh boy, what to do today~? Maybe I'll get up to some fun hijinks before Puddin' catches on to what I'm doing~

Right, time to have a taste of this little puddin'~ Mm-mmh, where should I start with you? So many options! ...What? I'm just talkin' about this serving of strawberry puddin'. Get your mind outta the gutter! Hahaha~
Good goin' today~ Let's grab something to eat and hang out! Ahahah, c'mon, don't be scared! Grab my hand and let's go!
Ugh, I hate ceremonies... I'll do what you say just this once. But after that, you'll be takin' orders from me, got it? Also, FYI, when I get the Puddin' munchies, it'll take a lot to calm my hunger~
This is super nice! Ahaha!
No friendly fire this time, I promise!
Bring me the next time you go hunting!
Let's do this, fluffball!
If you need a gaming buddy, I'm your gal!
Eagle Union, roll out!

ex.line: 'ello, Puddin'! Gimme a smile! Now a high five! And just to get your engines revving early... a kiss! Ahaha~
Someone been bullyin' you too, Puddin'? Gimme their name, now! Nobody gets to bully you but me! JK, JK~
I'll do some work after I'm done painting. If you see me not workin', that means I'm still busy.
Whoever touched my puddin' will have hell to pay! Nah, not you, I mean my literal puddin'!
Mail for you, with a little extra something from me to go with it, Puddin'~
Good going, Puddin'! C'mere and chew the fat with me! Kick back now, worry about the consequences later!
Welcome back, commission team! Puddin' is just over there, waitin' for you all!
Hey, Puddin', what do you say we retake our vows? ...Hahaha! Look at you, gettin' all flustered! Why so serious? Ahaha~

lines.line: Music! Lights! Refreshments! We're all set! Welcome to San Francisco's party! Enjoy yourself!
Music! Lights! Refreshments! We're all set! Welcome to San Francisco's party! Come and enjoy yourself!
Welcome to my place, Puddin'! Don't be shy now, get hella jiggy with it!
Jazz, rock 'n' roll, or whatever else, you name it and we'll play it!
C'mon, Minneapolis! Forget about hunting for a minute and just drink!
Have yourself some snacks before I decide to eat 'em all, Puddin'.
Listen, Puddin', I need party activity ideas! Do we play a game, or put something on?
ello, Puddin'~
You already wasted, Puddin'? Tsk, tsk. That's not gonna fly~
Okay, you've had WAY too much to drink.
You didn't bail on me to go have fun on your own... right? No? All good then~
Now that's a clean victory! Lemme see a big smile, c'mon! Ahaha!
Good evening, Puddin'! Welcome to my pole dancing show! You aren't going home tonight 'til you're head over heels for me♪
Good evening, Puddin'! Welcome to my pole dancing show! You aren't going home tonight 'til you're head over heels for me♪
