Ahahah! You should see how hard you're blushing, Puddin'! Need my help to take a load off? Just kidding~
What's this pose called? Uhh, what was it again... Eh, who cares! Don't sweat the deets and just enjoy the show!
Puddiiin'! Over here! Keep your eyes peeled, 'cause I'm dedicating this boo-ty-li-cious number to you♪
My bat's not bad at all, but I'm thinking this pole is more user-friendly, if you catch my drift... *smirk*
What's good, Puddin'? You having a hella good time? Sweet, then you gotta hit me up next time we're doin' something fun! Then, it's a date~
It feels HELLA good when I nail my moves! Hahahah!
Fallen for me, haven'tcha~?
Nuh-uh. Come hell or mail, anyone who takes their eyes off me's gonna regret it♪
As a thank-you for coming to see me, feel free to order whatever drinks and snacks you want - it's on the house~
Goodie! I'm like, totally kicking ass today!
Balao-class submarine - Archerfish, Hull Number SS-311.
I'm part of the Balao class, plus I hold the record for the biggest ship ever sunk by a submarine! I doubt anyone's ever gonna beat it.
Mm hmm~ So you're the Commander? Teehee. You're a total hottie, so wanna go out with me? Like right now? ...Heh, just kidding~ You should see how red your face is~ Ahaha, you're a funny one~!
Wake up, Commander! It's time to get to work! If you slack off, that's gonna be a paddling~
A submarine's gotta take care of her skin if she goes diving a lot. Not much you can do about the tan, though!
You've gotta focus when you're working, Commander! ...Let me guess, you can't focus with me around, right? Hahaha~
Start paying attention to me, or I'll leave to take a trip around the world. Okay, I'm exaggerating. I'd just go gather data on the areas around the port.
Y'know, Commander... A voyage is a lot more fun with a hot girl within arm's reach.
All I get is a headpat? I was expecting something more... Hehehe~
Hm? What's up? Did something neat happen? Come on, tell me!
Nuh-uh, you have to earn it~ No more groping like this, got it? Hahaha~
Skilled and sexy commanders don't keep girls waiting... for mission results, that is~
Mission complete! Aren't you glad I have both brains and good looks~?
New mail? Could I have a look at it? I'll have to get real, real close to do it~
Welcome back home, daaaarlin'~ Ahah! Look at you blushing again! Hahahaha!
Commission goodies, coming in! If I bring them to you, will you gimme YOUR goodies? Ahaha~♪
Don't you think I'm even hotter now? Hahaha~
Heh-heh! Prepare to get served!
This is just par for the course when you sortie me~
They beat me once, so what? I'll get 'em next time!
Once you commit, there's no pulling out~ Ahaha~!
What a pain in the ass...
There are tons of reasons nobody thinks you're hot. Cough up some dough, and I'll give you a crash course on why~ Ahaha~
Got plans to go anywhere today? I might tag along and keep you company.
It feels soooo good to sneak between that sleeping fox's tails and floof them~ Though I'll admit, it's not cool to disturb someone's sleep like that. Ahaha~
Here's some yummy soup for you, made with lots of love! Teehee~ Wanna taste test it? All righty, but what do you say we skip the spoon... and have you lick it from my finger instead~?
Well, well, finally able to keep up with me, huh? But now's where the real fun begins! Grab my hand and let's go on a date!
I knew this was coming when you called for me outta nowhere~ Don't be nervous now, just hold still and close your eyes. We're gonna do some hot stuff, you and I ♡
I've seen more unique gifts than this, but thanks anyway!
Get in position, you all!
Come oooon! Wake uuuup!
You're our lucky guest today, Commander~ You get a taste of my secret concoction... Excuse me, I meant to say "cocktail!" Relax, it won't do anything weird to you~ Probably. Ahaha~
You're our lucky guest today, Commander~ You get a taste of my secret concoction... Excuse me, I meant to say "cocktail!" Relax, it won't do anything weird to you~ Probably. Ahaha~
Welcome to a paradise of relaxation and recreation! Where you can get skip a little work and nobody'll find out~
Albacore's been teasing you? Give me specifics, so I know what to do for future reference... Err, so we can work out a way to deny her, I mean! Yeah, that's it!
What happens when you give a Meowfficer bunny ears? It gets promoted to a hare admiral! Hahaha~
Shinano's not coming? That sucks. I already mixed a special cocktail for her and everything!
You deserve a super special reward for all your hard work, Commander~ What kind of reward? Hahaha~ Well, what do you want?
Hm? Got something on your mind? Just say it, I promise I won't poke fun of you for it~
Don't you start making excuses now! The drinks I served you were alcohol-free!
What's this drink... "Bluest Blue?" Ah. The name alone makes it obvious Bluegill came up with it. It's just carbonated water on the rocks.
Would you look at that - we're sat next to each other in class. Looking forward to doing some "extracurricular activities" with you this term. Hehehe~
Would you look at that - we're sat next to each other in class. Looking forward to doing some "extracurricular activities" with you this term. Hehehe~
Morning, Commander! Finished with your homework? If not, I'll let you copy mine. Not for free though - you gotta give me something in return~
What, you think my tail sticks out too much? I can just hide it, like I usually do♪
I wonder what that sleepy fox is up to. Snoozing in the Napping Club's secret spot, maybe? I think I'll pay her a little visit.
Being surrounded by cute girls day in and day out is no excuse for not paying attention in class. Your grades are gonna plummet if you don't focus~
What to do after school's out... How 'bout we go around port holding hands? I bet the other girls would flip their lids if they saw that. Hehehe~
Hm? Have I done anything to earn a headpat? Oh well, do it all you want~
Anything I can do for or to you? Us adjacent classmates gotta help each other, you know~
This, in the classroom of all places? I dig your boldness~
There's mail for you in your desk drawer. Imagine if it's a love letter! Hahaha!
So, did you get the soda I asked for? Nah, I'm just messing~ Wait, you actually bought it? Heheh, then don't mind if I do!
Brooklyn-class light cruiser - Boise, Hull Number CL-47.

You'd like to learn more about what I did during that war? Well, I provided support for many landing invasions... The most memorable one? That'd be the one at Cape Esperance... Helena saved me back then.
Huff... Puff... I'm Boise of the Brooklyn class... Umm... Is there something I can help you with?
Huff... Puff... It's time for work.
I can go underwater, but... I'm no submarine. I can't stay submerged for long...
July 9th... It's an important date for me.
Huff... Puff... Huff... Puff... Yes, let's try to relax...
Phoenix is a really hot-blooded girl, isn't she...? Compared to her... I might be pretty cold...
You want to know more... about my mask...?
Mm... I'm listening.
What exactly... is this...?
Commander, there are still missions to finish. It'd be best to not forget about them...
Umm, Commander, I reminded you earlier, but... please collect the mission rewards at some point.
Commander, there's new mail waiting for you. Please don't forget to read it...
I'll look after the place while you're gone, so... don't worry.
Here are the results from the commission... Please look over them.
Strengthening complete. Preliminary inspection in progress...
Take a deep breath. The battle is starting...!
Battle completed. Safely.
We've no choice but to retreat... I'm sorry, Commander!
Pick out the biggest one... Mhm!
Minimize... the damage...!
Commander, I don't get you at all...
There's nothing in particular that needs doing right now. Commander... why don't you relax for a bit...?
When life knocks you down, get back up on your feet. These are words I try to live by... Commander, why don't you give it a try as well?
I'm not as straightforward as someone like Phoenix, but... Commander, I want to look after you more... E-even if I have to start with the finer details.
Even if you can't see my face directly, I want you to know that as long as I'm by your side, I'll always be smiling from the bottom of my heart.
Whether through my battles or my everyday duties, I always want to do something extra for you... If y-you're fine with that side of me, then... Huff... Puff... Y-yes! Commander, I'll be in your care!
I'll cherish it... Thank you...
I'll leave the recon to you and your SG, Helena.
What are you talking about...?

ex.line: Huff... Puff... Huff... Puff... Welcome back, Commander.
They're antennas, not rabbit ears... Would rabbit ears have been better...?
I don't really mind showing you my face, but, umm, that means...
San Francisco, it's best if you don't tease the Commander too much... I-I'll get mad at you, you know...?
Huff... Puff... Huff... Puff... Breathe in, breathe out... That feels nice... Phew...
Umm, is there anything you need from me...?
(Deep breaths... Deep breaths...!!!)
"I bet you haven't read the mail from last time yet." That's what I wrote in my log last time...
Oh, there's some paper stuck on your clothes. Let me wipe it off... It should be okay now... I think?
Huff... another smooth victory... Commander, thank you for your guidance.

lines.line: Huff... Puff... Deep breaths... I, I'll never get used to wearing this outfit in front of others... I think...
Huff... Puff... Deep breaths... I'll never get used to wearing this outfit in front of others... I think...
Huff... I guess I'll be able to relax for the time being-- Huh? C-Commander?!
Huff...... Puff...... (It looks like Boise has fallen asleep)
Honolulu, you don't like standing out either...? T-then, how about relaxing over here with me?
I'm not very good at singing... sorry, Commander...
The music is a bit too loud for me...
Is something wrong... with my rabbit ears...?
My handkerchief? Ah, umm, thank you...
I, I don't think you should be doing this... *blush*
Commander, there are still missions to finish. It'd be best to not forget about them...
Umm, Commander, I reminded you earlier, but... please collect the mission rewards at some point.
Commander, there's new mail waiting for you. Please don't forget to read it...
Commander, would you like something to drink...? If you don't want something alcoholic, how about some of the juice that New Jersey recommended...?
Here are the results from the commission... Please look over them.
Um, I decided to try on a costume, since it's Halloween and all... Do you think I got that witchy look down...?
Um, I decided to try on a costume, since it's Halloween and all... Do you think I got that witchy look down...?
Huff... Puff... Commander, these pumpkin lanterns are so nice and warm... Would you like to come sit by me...?
A long, long time ago, in a castle far away from here, there once was a witch who could grant people's wishes... Um, I'll tell you the rest of the story later. It's quite a long story.
Witches won't stand out much compared to zombies and Frankenstein's monsters... or so I thought.
Phoenix, um... I'm planning on watching the parade from here, so I can't really participate in it with you...
Commander, why don't you try putting on this pumpkin mask? Pfft... I-I'm sorry... I just couldn't hold it in...
What do you think... about this witch's hat...?
Commander, would you like to try trick-or-treating? I've still got a fair bit of candy left, if you'd like...
(Huff... Puff... Huff... Puff...) Y-You scared me...!
W-was that a will-o'-wisp just now...?
Huff... Puff... These Dragon Empery clothes look good on me? It's rather revealing and breezy, and makes me feel self-conscious... but if you like it, I suppose it's fine...

You'd like to learn more about what I did during that war? Well, I provided support for many landing invasions... The most memorable one? That'd be the one at Cape Esperance... Helena saved me back then.
Huff... Puff... These Dragon Empery clothes look good on me? It's rather revealing and breezy, and makes me feel self-conscious... but if you like it, I suppose it's fine...
Huff... Puff... The fragrance of herbs makes me feel great... Maybe they really do have healing properties...
Huff... Puff... (Boise seems to be fanning herself with her hands to try to cool down.)
Hiding one's face behind a fan is an established custom here... Huff...
I didn't expect Marblehead to be so familiar with Dragon Empery customs... She really knows her stuff... H-huh, she's just trying to sound smart?
Huff... Puff... The food sure smells amazing... Man, I'm totally starving... Oh, um, it's n-nothing!
You want to know more... about my mask...?
Commander, are you also running a bit hot...?
Nn... Mmgh...
Commander, there are still missions to finish. It'd be best to not forget about them...
Umm, Commander, I reminded you earlier, but... please collect the mission rewards at some point.
Commander, there's new mail waiting for you. Please don't forget to read it...
Commander, are you comfortable with crowded places? I can't really handle stuff like parties or festivals...
Here are the results from the commission... Please look over them.
Strengthening complete. Preliminary inspection in progress...
Take a deep breath. The battle is starting...!
Phew... I-is the battle over now...?
We'll be fine... Commander, we'll be able to withdraw soon.
Pick out the biggest one... Mhm!
Minimize... the damage...!
Commander, I don't get you at all...
There's nothing in particular that needs doing right now. Commander... why don't you relax for a bit...?
When life knocks you down, get back up on your feet. These are words I try to live by... Commander, why don't you give it a try as well?
I'm not as straightforward as someone like Phoenix, but... Commander, I want to look after you more... E-even if I have to start with the finer details.
Even if you can't see my face directly, I want you to know that as long as I'm by your side, I'll always be smiling from the bottom of my heart.
Whether through my battles or my everyday duties, I always want to do something extra for you... If y-you're fine with that side of me, then... Huff... Puff... Y-yes! Commander, I'll be in your care!
Commander, did I get ketchup on you? Sorry... Huff, puff... Th-this is the first time I'm letting you see me in a maid outfit, so I'm a little nervous...
Commander, did I get ketchup on you? Sorry... Huff, puff... Th-this is the first time I'm letting you see me in a maid outfit, so I'm a little nervous...
Ah... Welcome back. I wanted to cast a spell to make your food taste better, but as you can see, it didn't go well... I'm sorry...
Huff, puff... My ears, um, hit the bottom of the table and broke... You think they're cuter this way? Th-thanks...
Commander... I-I'll clean up right away, okay? If you want, I can clean your clothes, too...
You want more omurice...? Huff, puff... Okay! I'll remake it right away! This time, I'll make my love spell work...
I-I'm sorry... I'm just not skilled at this... You say I can take it slow? Okay... Thank you...
Are you going to help me clean...?
U-under the table...?
Commander, you have missions. If you finish them soon, I-I could... give you a massage, if you'd like?
Good work on your missions. As promised, your massage... U-umm, first things first, relax those legs...
There's mail for you, Commander... Yep, I brought it for you.
W-welcome back, Master... Huff, puff... *blush*... I-I finally managed to say it...
Huff puff, Commander. It's about time to greet the commission team, isn't it? I need to clean up here, so I can't go with you...
I wanted to do more for you, help you more, so I learned how to work as a maid... I'd do anything for you, Commander... Yeah, anything. I'd be happy to.
Fletcher-class destroyer - Morrison, Hull Number DD-560.
I'm the Fletcher-class destroyer, Morrison. I participated in anti-submarine warfare and rescue missions with my allies... If there's anything you want me to do... I-I should be able to do it.
Phew... Finally got here in one piece... Ah, um, are you the commander? My name is Morrison. Yes, the Fletcher-class Morrison with way too many sisters...
Commander, ah, um, n-never mind...
This little guy is my friend, Mr. Bear. Umm... he's equipped with a lot of equipment. Take this right hand, for example... Wait, you can't aim at the Commander!
I'd really like to get my hands on a few sets of the Iron Blood's rigging... Heh, hehehe...
Y-yes, you called? ...You didn't...? I'm sorry...
It's sunny out today... Though, it's not like sunny days are always good either.
Mr. Bear...? Oh, Commander... I don't think Mr. Bear meant to hit you, Commander...
Mr. Bear, why don't you greet the Commander? Yes, normally, just like this... P-please keep your paws to yourself!
M-Mr. Bear is on a rampage?!
Commander, if you need any help completing the missions, I don't mind...
You completed the missions? That means that I'm free for the time being, right?
Mr. Bear, bring the mail over to the Commander.
Commander, umm... I don't know if these will be of any use, but... (Morrison hands you some files)
A commission has been completed. Umm, if you need any help, I don't mind...
I really don't think you need to go that far for someone like me...
N-not another battle...
Whew... That should give me a bit of leeway...
Oww... Ugh, I want to go back to port...
Does anyone need any help?
Mr. Bear, save me...!
Just like I thought, things are better without me around...
Commander, umm... to tell the truth, there's something I... i-it's nothing... forget I said anything...
Commander, are you curious about Mr. Bear? T-Then, I'll introduce him to you.
Commander, um, could I have a bit of your time...? I wanted to get your input on what kinds of things I could do to improve upon Mr. Bear's specs...
Commander, am I helpful to you? I'm not a bother, am I? ...Mm, every time I hear your words of reassurance, I can relax a bit... Thank you very much, Commander.

Phew... I've worked hard to prepare myself for this moment, so it's okay. Commander, if it's you, I'm okay with it...! Breathe in... Breathe out... C-C-Commander, u-u-um, I-I-I've finished preparing my heart! I-I'll be in your care!
Wh-why are you so nice to me...?
P-please allow me... to escort you!

ex.line: Commander, um, would it be okay for me to stay by your side today?
With this gel applied, Mr. Bear should be able to move just fine at sea as well... No way, he's nowhere near fast enough... Commander, what do you think I should do...?
D-Did you call for me...? Yes! Leave whatever it is to me...!
It's sunny today. Sunny days are nice, aren't they? ...Yes!
In this operation, I can't let myself be a burden to either Mr. Bear or the Commander... Isn't that right, Birmingham?
Um, if there's anything I can help with... J-just let me know... okay?
Ah, um, I'm so sorry... Mr. Bear is very sensitive to sudden movements, and he'll spring up to defend me...
All done with the missions? Let's take a little break then...
Great work, Commander! Please let me handle the reports...!
The commissions have been completed. Umm, Commander, let's go and greet everyone together...!
Mr. Bear, charge!
I should use this chance to perform some maintenance on Mr. Bear... Alright, done!

lines.line: Zzz... Commander? S-sorry, I fell asleep for a bit... Uh, umm, what would you like me to do...?
Zzz... Commander? S-sorry, I fell asleep for a bit... Uh, umm, what would you like me to do...?
It's a bit embarrassing, but... it's surprisingly comfortable...
Benson told me all about the ins and outs of Planet Bunny... Huh? Is something amiss?
I wonder if I should take Stanly's advice and turn Mr. Bear into "Rabbit Mode"...
I'm so jealous of all the people that get to wear cute clothes... Y-you think I'm cute, too...?
I-it's spicy? Was it Thatcher? No, it could have been Kalk...
M-my ears are going to fall off...
C-can I take a nap yet...?
Commander, um, please show some self-restraint...
Mr. Bear, take the mail to the Commander... Oh, Mr. Bear isn't here right now...
Commander, would you like some tea...?
This looks like the perfect place to film a ninja training scene... Ahem! Allow me to demonstrate my ninjutsu to you, Commander! Pl-please keep your eyes peeled! Transformation ninjutsu! Hiyah!
This looks like the perfect place to film a ninja training scene... Ahem! Allow me to demonstrate my ninjutsu to you, Commander! Pl-please keep your eyes peeled! Transformation ninjutsu! Hiyah!
My mind follows my will, and my shadow follows my form... Uhh, now I'll... change forms and become someone else...? Wait, why isn't it working? Oh, the drone's run out of battery!

"After much excruciating training, Morrison the Ninja turned the tables in battle to much awe, proving her own worth..." Oh, Commander. I was just reading the script. Want me to... demonstrate my ninjutsu?
Mr. Bear's hologram isn't finished yet, so... he's not here for now.
Shapeshifting ninjutsu, summoning ninjutsu, water hiding ninjutsu, earth hiding ninjutsu... Why do I need to use voice control when I can just press a button?
This outfit? Ikazuchi and Inazuma suggested it - it's a professional ninja's attire. It's a bit embarrassing to wear, but... doesn't it make me look like a real ninja?
Whew... This feeling of inner peace... Yes, this is perfect for when you're training.
Soobrazitelny developed this ninja simulator, while Fargo provided me with the drone. We really have... so many talented people here.
Eek! Th-that's not part of my ninjutsu!
"Welcome back, Milord. Your ninja servant Morrison awaits your orders"... Ugh, this is so embarrassing...

It was actually me who... came up with the idea of my shapeshifting ninjutsu turning me into a slightly different version of myself. I've heard that kind of contrast is exciting to people, so... Umm... Wh-what do you think, Commander?
Yorktown-class aircraft carrier - Enterprise, Hull Number CV-6.

No matter how strong the enemy is, no matter how bad things get, fight with everything you have, and seize victory - that's the motto I strive for! As long as I keep working to get stronger, I know I'll be able to do it!
Hello, Commander. I am Enterprise, aircraft carrier from the Eagle Union. I want to learn as much as I can here to be a stronger warrior... Commander, will you help me?
Commander, what will you teach me today?
Vestal gets way too worked up when I get even the tiniest of scratches... It's really not that big of a deal...
"Grey Ghost?" ...That's supposed to be me...? That sounds pretty awesome!
Yorktown, Hornet, and me... I just know we'll become great carriers for the Eagle Union!
I'm working hard in all sorts of things outside of battle! ...B-but lemons are out of the question!
Okay, that's enough! If you pat my head any more, I'm not going to grow any taller!
D-did you have advice for me? Ah, please share it with me!
Huh...? I'm not sure I understand this order, Commander...
A new mission? Yes, let's get ready... Huh? It's just for you?
Mission complete! It's an honor to be of help to you, Commander!
Commander, I brought the mail!
Commander, how was my performance just now? Is there anything, anything I could do better?
Commission complete! If we get enough supplies, the fight on the front lines will get that much easier!
One step closer to becoming the strongest!
Enterprise, engaging! ...Woah! My hat...!
Yay, I got number one again!
I lost... S-so frustrating...!
You're finished!
This... is nothing I can't handle!
Perhaps... You're the one who requires more learning, Commander...?
Commander, please help me train today as well! Remember what I said last time, no going easy on me!
Why do I want to become the strongest shipgirl? So that I can protect my friends, defeat our enemies, and put an end to this war. That's why!
Yorktown, Vestal, and Saratoga are all very nice to me... Wait, that's no good! What am I going to do if everyone tries to coddle me? Commander, you alone have to be strict with me!

The hero in the story who protected everyone... ended up lonely and forgotten, right? But I have you, Commander, so everything will be okay! Someday... even if my mission has come to an end, will you still be there by my side? Will we still be able to play together?
Does this mean... you're proud of my achievements? ...But, I still have so much to learn... Until I become a true hero, you have to stay by my side!
Th-thank you!
Come at me all you want; I'll always win!
Such unexpected power... but I won't lose to you!
You won't surpass me so easily!
Take a good look at how far I've come!
Seriously, I told you, it's just a tiny scratch!
What is it like to become a true hero? ...I need to know!

ex.line: All right, today's another day to be the best that I can be! Commander, I'll be counting on you as well!
Calm down, Enterprise... Keep steady and don't let the pot explode... Commander? Umm, I'm trying to learn how to cook like Vestal... Woooahh?!
I have to grow up faster just like Grimmy... so I can become "Big E" sooner... Wait, what do you mean that's not how it works?
Managing the fleet is super hard! Commander, can you show me how it's done?
Commander, your advice has been super helpful! Um, do you also teach stuff to the other girls as well...?

The stars shining in the night sky... Is that the place we're aiming to go to one day? I just know that the two of us can make that dream come true! Even if we have to defeat as many enemies as stars in the sky, we'll overcome anything!

lines.line: Yuugumo-class destroyer number three - Kazagumo.

Kazagumo, Yuugumo-class destroyer number 3. I served the 10th Destroyer Squadron, mostly running transport missions and naval evacuations. These little birdies are my friends. My hobbies? I'm not telling you.

Kazagumo, Yuugumo-class, reporting for duty. I hope I'll be able to get along well with everyone else here... Commander, you're not cooking up some dastardly plan, are you? You look rather questionable...
*Yawn*... Oh. You scared away the birdies, Commander.
I like being alone in my own room. What exactly do I do in my free time? ...I'm not telling you.
Could you not stare at me like that, Commander? I can't focus like this...
You're on duty, so no chit-chatting with me allowed, okay? ...I mean, if you feel really lonely, then maybe...
I like the satisfying toot-toot noise that recorders make... Do you wanna hear it? It'll have to be later, not now...
I'm not a pet, so don't treat me like one...
Commander... What are you up to? (Kazagumo throws you a suspicious look.)
You'll be cursed for this...
Look at all these unfinished missions... You should really do something about them.
Mission complete. Wonder if I'll get a reward for my efforts...
Mail for the commander? Okay birdies, go fetch... No, please don't fight over who gets to do it.
Good going, Commander... You heard a strange noise just now? Uhh... I'm sure it was just your imagination.
The commission team's back. Don't forget to say hi to them... Me? Uhh, I think I'll stay right here.
Thanks, Commander.
We can win this... Right?
It'd be great if we could keep winning...
Ugh. I'm really out of it today...
I wanna get this over with...
Watch beneath the waves...
I guess we're all fated to be alone. You, me, and everyone else...
You want to be friends with me? Okay, but if I find out you're planning something bad... then I'll never talk to you again.
You're not a bad person, so we can be friends... Do I wish I had more friends? I'm... not gonna tell you.

There have been rumors of this girl with long hair and skin as pale as a ghost's who appears out of nowhere at port... In fact, I think she's right behind you, Commander... What do you mean that's not gonna fool you? Well, I thought I'd just spook you a little...
You're fun to be with, Commander. A lot of fun. In fact, you're my best friend... Hehehe~ I wanna always be with you. Always.
I think... this is when you promise to never leave me. First you say it, then it's my turn... Hehehe~ Thank you. I love you.
That looks pretty neat. ...Oh, it's for me? Thanks...
I'll keep you safe, Hiryuu.
Watch beneath the waves, Makinami.

ex.line: Hello, Commander. Let's have a good day today.
First, close the door... Thanks. Now please listen, Commander. I've been practicing a lot.
Try to focus on your work. Unlike me, you can concentrate even when someone's staring at you, right? Hehehe~
Are you feeling a little lonely? Hehehe~
Oh right, I have to go give Kinugasa her lunch box. I'll be back in a minute, Commander.
Commander... What are you up to? (Kazagumo throws you a considerate look.)
You still wanna hear me play, even if I'm not good at it? But I'd rather not. Not when others are around...

lines.line: Toot~♪ Oh, Commander, did you hear me practicing my recorder? Umm, I'd appreciate it if you didn't tell the others.
Toot~♪ Oh, Commander, did you hear me practicing my recorder? Umm, I'd appreciate it if you didn't tell the others.
Zzz... What is it, Commander...? Me? The breeze was just too nice and I fell asleep...
I've practiced some more. I'll play you a song, if you'll listen... On second thought, maybe I won't.
Weird... I played pretty well just a moment ago, but now I can't do it...
The name of the song I just played? I'm not gonna tell you right now. After I've mastered it, all right?
You're so nice, hanging out with me even after school... I'm not taking up your time, am I?
Ugh... I lost track of the tempo because of that... Thanks, meanie.
Oh... Seriously, Commander? You're messing up my melody.
Welcome back, Commander. You didn't bring company... did you? Okay, good. I don't want others to hear how not-good I am at the recorder...
I'm glad we won. Hehehe.
I'll make you proud, Commander!
*lick*... Oh, Commander, y-you're here for the fireworks? ...Want to watch them with me, then? I've got drinks. My ice cream? Umm... You can't have it.
*lick*... Oh, Commander, y-you're here for the fireworks? ...Want to watch them with me, then? I've got drinks. My ice cream? Umm... You can't have it.
Who is that launching fireworks over there, I wonder? Watching from directly below seems dangerous, but I bet they look prettiest from there...
Why am I out here all by myself? Because I get to be alone with... Oops, ignore that. I can't tell you...
You're tired from swimming? Take a break here with me. I'll watch over you, so you can even take a nap... if you want.
Umm, actually, I've been practicing a new song. Want me to play—Ack, the fireworks! Maybe another time...!
I wonder where Shimakaze went... How can she not be tired after playing on the beach all day?
Does my swimsuit... look weird?
Huh...? Oh... *blushes*
You finished a mission. Is there a reward for me, too...?
If you really want some ice cream... Wait, you had it delivered with the mail? A-aww...
*blows* I'd better eat this ice cream before it melts... Would I get brain freeze if I just bit into it?
The commission team came back. Go and meet them, Commander. I'll watch your things.
I'm doing lots of training. Gardening, making tea, stuff like that. Here's an example... Umm, do you want dinner, or a bath, or... Hm? I shouldn't practice that one?
I'm doing lots of training. Gardening, making tea, stuff like that. Here's an example... Umm, do you want dinner, or a bath, or... Hm? I shouldn't practice that one?
Welcome back, Master. I brought you hot tea. ...You saw pretty flowers in the garden? I-I raised them in my spare time, so... I'm glad you like them.
Yep. I've been waiting here. ...For whom? Come on, you know... Don't tease me!
Master, sit down. Here's your tea! ...You feel warm and happy after drinking it? Th-thank you...
Play a song alongside the wind chimes...? Th-that may be hard... But if you want to hear it, then I'll try. D-don't make fun of me, though!
Master, if you ever get lonely, just let me know. I know just what to do about it... Heehee, I think you and I are thinking the same thing.
Master, t-today is a good day, if you know... what I mean...
Missions... We'll do them together, Master!
I put your mail right here, Master.
Master, welcome back. You may choose: piping-hot tea, or a shoulder massage? ...You don't need anything? O-okay, well, we could always just chat...
The commission team is back. Hmm... I wonder what they brought.
Thank you, Master.
I don't understand... It feels like I'm still yearning for more. My Master is by my side already... But I think I want you here with me forever. I just wish you could be...
Allen M. Sumner-class destroyer - Ingraham, Hull Number DD-694.

Thought about it some more, but I really don't have much else to tell you. On another note, wanna see the Allen M. Sumner-class miniature I made? Main battery, AA guns, even depth charges, it's all there. See?
I'm Ingraham, Eagle Union destroyer. Not much else to tell you, honestly... Anyhoo, good to meet you.
You're late, Commander. I oughta build you an alarm clock that keeps ringing no matter what you do.
Breaking stuff is easy. Making stuff is not.
Yo, Commander, you mind if I do some tinkering in here? Don't wanna disturb you, is all... All righty, I'll take that as a "yes."
Why am I wearing just one stocking? Uhh, because I forgot to put the other one on. What does it matter, anyway? Clothes are just a bother.
There's a loose screw under the bookcase... No biggie, I'll get it myself. And don't you dare try to sneak a dirty peek in while I'm doing it.
This hairpin? It's made from a repurposed binder clip. Is that so weird?
Keep the touching to a minimum, thanks.
This is your dirty-deeds-hand, huh? I'm gonna keep you armlocked until you say you're sorry.
New missions, huh? Ugh. I don't wanna get off my butt...
Need a pen to write the mission complete papers? Here, you can borrow mine.
Mail, eh... I could give your mailbox a makeover, if you want.
My hunch was right - this thing really is a millimeter off... Oh, hey there, Commander. Just who I was looking for. Could you have a look at this?
Commission complete. Any parts you don't need? Send 'em my way.
Rigging upgrades, huh? Keep them coming, thanks.
Full module calibration complete. I'm loaded and ready for battle!
Sweet! My rigging's perfectly tuned!
I've gotta do thorough rigging maintenance when I get back!
Nothing personal!
Oh, crap! That's gonna be a pain to repair!
I'd love to unscrew your thick skull and have a look at what's inside.
Even minor flaws impact the quality of a product. You want high-end equipment? Make sure it's perfectly calibrated.
Hey, Cooper, I finished that "morph item" you asked about... No, Allen! Stop plastering stickers all over my stuff!
Yo, Commander, I scrounged up some spare parts and made you this steel medal on my day off. C'mere, I'll attach it to your uniform... Pfft! Looks pretty good on you!
Listen, if you ever need something, just hit me up. Scratch that, uhh... You can hit me up anytime, for any reason. I just feel kinda lonely without you, you know? Ahem... Anyway!

Here I thought you were dense, but I guess I was wrong. Oh yeah, I made this ring for you. It's no promise ring, but I still want you to have it... This thing's special to me, so don't even think about having me remake it for you.
Mm... Well, it's okay?
Try not to get too sloppy, Allen.
That's some cutting-edge tech you've got...
Got any pro tips for me about repairing?

Hmm... Could use a little more sweetness, and a splash of the secret ingredient... Oh, you're here? Great. I appoint you as my first dedicated taste-tester, Commander. We're gonna come up with some novel and fresh drinks, you and I!

Hmm... Could use a little more sweetness, and a splash of the secret ingredient... Oh, you're here? Great. I appoint you as my first dedicated taste-tester, Commander. We're gonna come up with some novel and fresh drinks, you and I!
You're on time for once! That means you're due for a reward. I'll make your drink doubly sweet.
Your job's simple. All you need to do is drink what I serve you and give feedback on the taste, mouthfeel, et cetera.
All I asked Allen for was some label paper, and instead she dumped a billion different stickers on me...
No, Cooper, that stuff's got alcohol in it. Put it back where you found it.
Yeah, Allen made me wear this getup when she found out I'll be handling the bar counter... That said, I guess I don't really mind it.
Hey! Wow... Hope you like your lemonade with 30 times more lemon juice.
Once I've perfected this recipe, I'll give you a gold taste-tester medal for your efforts.
Commission complete. Let's see if they brought back anything I can use...
Narwhal-class submarine-Nautilus, Hull number SS-168.

I'm Nautilus, Narwhal-class submarine - Ah, um, not that "Captain Nemo." During that war, my friends shot at me by mistake, and I managed to do something incredible without realizing it... Overall, I think ended up being quite useful to everyone...
Nice to meet you, Commander. I'm Nautilus from the Eagle Union... Um, did I scare you? A-actually, I've been following you this whole time, so I thought you already noticed me...
Good morning, Commander. I popped out of nowhere again? Actually, I've been behind you this whole time.
Submarines were born in an attempt to imitate the nautilus. When you look at things that way, the ideas for a lot of inventions were derived from animals.
I wish I could dive deeper and get to know the secrets of the sea...
Commander, want to try writing a message-in-a-bottle? Someone across the ocean might read it one day.
Commander? Oh, um, it's nothing. I was just wondering if you noticed me or not...
Nautilus is not a small animal...
Th-that tickles...
Y-you're acting awfully suspicious...
Commander, you seem to have quite a few missions still. I'd like to be of use to you in some way...
We're all done with the mission... Huh? I was a great help to you?
Commander, did you get the new mail? Phew, thank goodness...
Hauu! ...Commander, it's not your fault, so please don't apologize. I wasn't standing behind the door on purpose...
Hehe, I took a little sneak peek, and there's a lot of goodies.
I hope... my torpedo doesn't end up being a dud again...
I, I've found the enemy!
Huh? I'm the MVP? How'd that happen?
What should I do if everyone mistakes me for an enemy...?
Mm, now's my chance!
W-woah! Crash dive!
Commander, you're going to become even more of a loner at this rate...
Ugh... I'm so sorry, Commander. I didn't do it on purpose... I was just trying to follow you for a little longer...
Umm, I'm not a stalker. I'm not trying to make a hobby out of sneaking up on people either... It's just that, I like being with you, Commander... so I end up following you around... Ehehe.
Commander, are you, um, going on a walk right now? You always go around this time to catch a breather. I know this from experience, hehe.
Commander, you're taking a different route than normal today... Oh, um, you wanted to go somewhere a bit more private for the two of us? I, I see! O-of course I'd be glad to accompany you! Hehe~
Ehehe, Commander, if you like me that much... O-of course I'd be glad to remain with you forever~♪
Woah, this is so nice... Are you sure I can have it?

ex.line: I'm so glad for all the things I've learned in my time with you, Commander.
I'm sure there's lots of things waiting to be discovered under the sea. Right, Commander?
The aquarium was so much fun! ...Huh? You'd like to visit it again? Sure, I'd love to go with you!
Um, Commander... I'm right here, in case you didn't notice... Oh, you did?
Thank you for the headpat. Hehehe~
Hehehe... What is it, Commander?
This doesn't feel right, Commander... Y-you didn't mean to do that?
Th-thank you for always being so considerate, but I've stopped standing behind the door now. You don't have to worry about that anymore.
Commander! I've spotted enemies!

lines.line: Phew~ Standing for a long time really wears you out... Hwah?! Commander, when'd you get there? Um, if you'd like, would you like to come exercise with me?
Phew~ Standing for a long time really wears you out... Hwah?! Commander, when'd you get there? Um, if you'd like, would you like to come exercise with me?
Commander, I'm over here. (*whispers*) I, I was noticed, right...
Bunny suits are made to imitate bunnies. If you like bunny girls, that means you also like bunnies, right? Um, it doesn't work like that?
Commander, your coffee's already gone cold. Huh, I forgot to remind you earlier....?
The Almanac of Marine Life was really interesting. I really want to see all those mysterious creatures in person.
I'm really good at hide-and-seek. When I was playing with Dace, I managed to stay hidden 'til the very end! Teehee~
Huh? My earrings are on crooked?
Um, Commander, I'm not standing behind the door, so you don't have to be that careful.

Commander~ Ehehe, can I introduce you to some of my new friends? Here's Miss Tropical Fish, and Mister Manta Ray... Oh, and Mister Dolphin too! Oh, umm, this friend here can be a bit mischievous at times, and often causes quite a bit of trouble...

Commander~ Ehehe, can I introduce you to some of my new friends? Here's Miss Tropical Fish, and Mister Manta Ray... Oh, and Mister Dolphin too! Oh, umm, this friend here can be a bit mischievous at times, and often causes quite a bit of trouble...
H-hey, Commander, what do you think of my big ribbon? See how it floats up in the water? Isn't it cute and soothing?
It's so quiet underwater... But there are such colorful fish and coral all over the place. Lively, but peaceful... Isn't the contrast wonderful?
I love diving, but it does get a little lonely when the fish don't notice me...
Mister Dolphin, do you want to swim together? Did you come just to invite me? ...Hey, don't pull there~!
I wonder why... Even when I'm swimming underwater, I always end up wandering to you, Commander...
We're having a barbecue later after our swim? O-okay! Is it alright if I join in?
Oh, Commander, no sneaking any peeks...
Geez! You're just as mischievous as Mister Dolphin...
I'm right here, Commander. Hehehe, even underwater, I know I'd never lose sight of you!
I took a peek outside, and I saw our friends making gifts for the commission team~
Commander, this way!
I'm the MVP...? Well, I did get to fight with the Commander... Okay, sure!
Unryuu-class aircraft carrier - Katsuragi.

Let's give you some tips for how to get along with a cute and cheerful girl: First, you'd better not find any of her conversations boring! Second, don't make her do any lame chores like carrying stuff around! Finally, ask nicely, don't try to boss her around! All right, that's it for the first lesson, but there will be more in the future... Hey, are you listening?!

Hello there, Commander! I'm the Unryuu-class aircraft carrier, Katsuragi. I'm not just a carrier, I'm a full-fledged aircraft carrier, meaning that I can do everything that an aircraft carrier is supposed to do! I'm not telling ya what I don't like, but as for hobbies, I've got a whole buncha those~ For example... (1 minute later) ...So yeah! Hey, Commander, are you still listening?
Hello there, Commander! Today's workload is looking a bit heavy and I wonder if we might have to do some overtime but I'm sure if we get right down to business we'll be able to finish- Commander??
If you want to keep me company so badly... Well, I just happened to not have anyone to talk to, so you'll have to make do! In any case, let me start by telling you about my favorite kind of azalea--
Skip bombing? I must admit, it was quite an imaginative tactic. The Eagle Union was even able to give one as cute and strong as me a headache! Ahahaha!
If you're tired, just let me handle the paperwork. Nobody would notice the difference if I forged your signature... Ah, uh, that was obviously just a joke!
I left half a cake for you on your desk. Why only half, you ask? Well, that's because... I already ate the other half! Ahahaha!
You think you can mess with my heart just by patting my head? How naive! ...If you remember to keep it up 365 days of the year, maybe you'll have a shot.
What's the matter? Oh, you need me for something? Well, seeing how earnestly you're beseeching my aid, I have no choice but to at least consider it~
Heheh, I know you don't have the gumption to-- W-wait, stop that! Y-y-y-you're going to have to take responsibility at this rate, don't you know?!
Hrrrrmm... Don't tell me you still have unfinished missions lying around?

Quite satisfactory! With such abundant rewards, you'll be able to further expand your scope of work and have even more missions assigned to you! But... Hehe, are you able to shoulder that immense workload?
New mail has arrived! Now then, is it something important? Perhaps, a mission notice? Or maybe...? Darn it, hurry up and open it up already~

Ohh, you're back! So like, something totally weird happened while you were gone. A little bird got lost inside the office and it was really hard for us to guide it back out~ Your place seems to be really popular with the birdies-- Hey, are you listening?
The commission rewards are in~ I'm only responsible for informing you though, you'll have to carry the goods yourself~♪
Mhm, that's more like it! I'll offer you some words of praise for recognizing my worth!
Harrumph! With me at helm, victory is already assured!
Oh~hohoho~ How could you absolute nobodies hope to win against the might of a true aircraft carrier such as myself~
We lost?! Even though I did everything I could?! Ugh... How could things have gone so wrong??
Pay close attention to this!
Are you really going to let your all-important aircraft carrier get hit like this?!
This simply won't do, Commander... I had no idea that the esteemed leader, the shining beacon of the fleet... would be such a decadent individual!
How many times have I had to explain this to you before? I can do everything that an aircraft carrier is supposed to do, but I can't do anything outside of that because that's just what I used to be!

Oh, Commander, what are you trying to do? Checking on that packed warehouse? Or just heading out for a stroll? Ah! Don't tell me... you're going on date with someone?! ...Hey, are you listening to me?

Commander! I happened to discover something amazing! Tomorrow is a holiday, and there aren't many days like it, and by pure "coincidence," neither you or I have anything to do! So basically, I was thinking, what could the two of us do on such a rare and special day when we have nothing else to do? Haah, there are too many possibilities~!

You know how in those books, if there's someone on your mind, it normally goes something like "your face gets all red and you can't find the words to say?" But, like, in my case, I just can't stop talking at all... Ah! I get it now! I'm not the one who's nervous, you are! ...Hey, are you listening to me?

You keep squirming away from me but today I'll make sure you absolutely listen to every single word. Got it? Good! Ahem! I, Katsuragi, am bound by oath to you, and swear to always be at your side through joy or hardship! ...Mm, excellent. Now, it's your turn to repeat that back to me!
What a flatterer you are... Hmph! But, I shall accept your gift anyway~♪
No, no... I wasn't trying to say that you're wrong, but...!
There's no need to rush. The stream of time will carry victory to us!

ex.line: Good mooorning, Commander! So, I have good news and bad news for you today. The bad news is, you've got a ton of work lined up. The good news is, I'm willing to help out! Do you understand the importance of this?
One document, two documents, three documents... What am I doing? Seeing how there's nothing for me to do at the moment, I thought I'd count your files to pass the time!
Commander, I brought two different flavors of cake this time! You choose the one you want first, and I'll take the other one! Of course, we could also share them half-and-half!
Uhhh... So, how far are we into those 365 days? Well, seeing how I can't remember, let's start over from day one.
So tell me, what is this super important, ultra difficult mission that you cannot entrust to anyone but Katsuragi?
Hwaah?! D-don't you know that you need to give me time to prepare myself before doing stuff like that? *blush*
Oh~ho~ho! With you commanding from the rear, victory was all but assured!

Commander, how has work been recently? Are you doing well? And how did you like that cake? Oh, and do you know where you want to go for next weekend's date? ...Hehe, every time I see you, I just can't stop myself~ But first of all, I'll have you answer each and every one of my questions~♪

lines.line: It's- summer- festival- time-!! Uhh, well, maybe it's a bit too late for a "summer" festival, so maybe a regular festival is fine? Well, the important thing is that you have lots of fun, Commander! Because I sure as heck will!

It's- summer- festival- time-!! Uhh, well, maybe it's a bit too late for a "summer" festival, so maybe a regular festival is fine? Well, the important thing is that you have lots of fun, Commander! Because I sure as heck will!

Hellooooo, Commander! Are we starting work today with some of that festive spirit? I didn't just bring my festive spirit with me today, I came ready with the whole package, outfit and all! I'll be happy as long as you can feel that holiday cheer~!

You came here looking for someone to talk to, right? I suppose I can keep you company then, but you should make sure you go around and deepen your bonds with everyone else too! ...Except Junyou, watch out for that one!
When the fireworks climb high into the sky and go "kaboom," I can feel my excitement doing the very same thing! Ahahaha!
Commander, are you totally into my getup? You are, aren't you! Aha, I totally knew it! Come and feast your eyes all you want then~♪
Missions? Can't you let it rest for a day and just enjoy the day off??

Excellent! With these earnings, we'll be able to eat as much as we want... Well yeah, I know that! We need to share with everyone else too! ...B-but, I'd be really happy if you treated me to a little something... Please?
Woohoo, you're back, Commander! Bring any goodies back for me and the girls? I'm already so excited I can't calm down!
Victory is mine! That's how a real carrier does things, duh!

Mmmh~ When it gets real hot, whether you're a shipgirl or an ordinary person, the place to go to cool down is always either the mountains or the beach, right? But what if I told you, that when you're at a rooftop pool, you not only get the great views of climbing up a mountain, but also the refreshing coolness of splashing around in the water? Am I right or am I right, Commander? ...Heeeey, are you even listening?!

Mmmh~ When it gets real hot, whether you're a shipgirl or an ordinary person, the place to go to cool down is always either the mountains or the beach, right? But what if I told you, that when you're at a rooftop pool, you not only get the great views of climbing up a mountain, but also the refreshing coolness of splashing around in the water? Am I right or am I right, Commander? ...Heeeey, are you even listening?!

Hello hello, Commander! Boy, it's hot~ Or so I WOULD say, but we're already dressed for the heat. The only cooler places we could go would be your air-conditioned office or a restaurant freezer. So I'm gonna try a different approach! Okay, c'mon in and cool off with me!
Nobody else is around, so I guess you gotta talk to me, Commander! ...Hm? You don't want to take the lead? If I lead the conversation, I might never stop talking, y'know.
Fire! Drive them back! ...There's no point sitting around in the water all day, so I decided to have the shikigami and manjuu do a mock battle. Wanna join in, Commander?
Want a cold one? Or like a chilly, icy, brain-freezy one? The choice is yours, Commander!

Don't you love this view? You can actually see the beach—and all the other girls in swimsuits—from here, so it's easy to see all the girls looking for you, Commander... Hey, what's wrong?! Did you see something scary?
Aha☆ Fascinated by me and my swimsuit?
Yeah, I might be a little lacking compared to the other girls... What do you want me to do about it, though?
You STILL have missions left? ...Are you even listening?
Nice! With all these rewards, we can rebuild the swimming pool until everyone can fit in! ...Shame we can't make it a rooftop pool~
New mail? I'll go get it... Whoa, whoa, whoa, ack, bad, bad, bad! ...Phew... I slipped and almost dropped the mail in the pool...
Hey, you're back! So you're hot, right? Right? Of course you are! It's a little weird to get in the pool right after coming back from the sea, but forget that! Jump right in☆
Ooh! The commission team came home! I'd love to let you go and greet them by yourself, but they might think something's up if you go alone dressed like that, so I'll join you♪
I might be in a swimsuit, but I'm just as strong as ever!
Aircraft carrier Katsuragi wins again! ...Ahahaha, my victories are your victories, too, Commander.
Heavy cruiser New Orleans, reporting in. Hehe, you'll be sure to receive a medal for finding me. Anyway... Do you have any urgent tasks for me?

I'm New Orleans, nameship of my class. I used to fight for the Eagle Union. I had a frighteningly close call once in a battle, but fortunately, I lived to see another day. But the past is the past - treat me no different from how you would anyone else in the fleet.
Heavy cruiser New Orleans, reporting in. Hehe, you'll be sure to receive a medal for finding me. Anyway... Do you have any urgent tasks for me?
Welcome back, Commander. I'm counting on you today.
A rigging inspection? Hehe, go ahead, Commander.
Being focused is a good thing, but overworking yourself will only burn you out in the end.
I suppose rigging rocket boosters are still a way's off... Oh, just talking to myself.
My sisters are all very eccentric. Hehe, rest assured, they're good people all the same.
Even my sisters haven't touched me like that. Hehehe~
Whether you want close contact, or hand-to-hand combat, I'll oblige.
Hehehe. You wouldn't stand a chance against me in a real fight.
You've still not finished these missions, Commander. Do you need my assistance?
I compiled a list of all the mission rewards. Have a look.
You've got new mail. I've added "check the mailbox" to today's task list.
I held the fort while you were away on your sortie. Here's a list of things you should review.
The commission girls are back. Have you decided on what to give them yet?
You think I can handle this power? Thank you. I'll trust you.
I'll bring victory to you, Commander!
War is about always thinking two or three steps ahead of the enemy.
Neither will alone... nor strength alone... is enough.
Lock on... Fire!
I can't go down as long as they can't hit me...!
You're like a little kid, Commander.
Weapons are extensions of our own bodies. They need regular care, too.
What do I do off-duty? Hmm. I hang out with my sisters, I go fishing, I take naps... Things like that.
I like it when you ask me for help. It's... soothing, in a way. Hehehe, maybe that's a strange thing to say.
If you ever need help, or want someone to talk to, just say my name. I'll always be there to support you, Commander.
Is this your proposal? Or are you asking for more help than ever? Hehe, whichever it is, I'll oblige. As long as you want to be with me, I'll do everything you ask of me, Commander.
You went this far for me? Thank you.
We've both got to set examples for our little sisters.
I'm here. No need to push yourself too far.
Stay sharp, Vincennes!
Be careful so the hunter doesn't become the hunted.
Don't take it too easy now, okay?
To your prestige, and to your continued victories, Commander. Hehe, I do find myself in the mood for rum tonight. Care to keep me company for a while?
To your prestige, and to your continued victories, Commander. Hehe, I do find myself in the mood for rum tonight. Care to keep me company for a while?
I could've sworn that stuffed toy's eyes flashed red just now... Hmm... Maybe I've had too much.
Thank you, Javelin. Deliver this bottle to Wichita. It's very valuable. Hehe~
On a random note, why does San Francisco call you "pudding"? Is it because you're so sweet, perhaps? Hehehe~
Lexington is indeed a very good friend to me, though her sister can be a piece of work... Ahahaha.
Don't worry, I would never spike your drink~
Commander... You're unexpectedly needy, aren't you?
Ah, welcome back. I was just drinking and watching TV while you were out. I might get more than just tipsy tonight... Hehehe~
Hehe, a victory sweetens the taste.
Le Fantasque-class large destroyer - Le Terrible.

As a part of the 10th Scout Division of the Brest Fleet, I carried out escort missions as well as participated in the withdrawal from Strasbourg. As one who served the Iris Orthodoxy, I was finally shown the light of victory. Ah, how blessed I must be.
I am Le Terrible, the elegant large destroyer who protects the teachings of Iris Libre. I have come in pursuit of your ideals. Commander, please show me the reason for which you fight.
My, you seem to be in high spirits today, Commander. Do you have any orders for me?

I have no interest in fighting pointless battles, but there seem to be some individuals here who place excessive pride in their speed... Of course, I was more than glad to put them in their place. More importantly, I made quite a few friends in the process. Not too bad, right?
That little incident I had with Le Malin? Yes, I've already apologized to her, but her mind seemed to be on something else...
My, Commander, look at you over there with that derpy face-- Ahem, what I meant was, it's not good to slack off. You should try to learn a thing or two from Le Triomphant.
Those who seek to spread the wings of hope are too often shackled by trivial matters. Commander, do you have the ambition to break your chains?
Please refrain from touching my hat.
You may pray to the Holy Iris, or offer me a confession in person. Speak your piece.
I do say, Commander, how generous of you to reveal your weaknesses to me one after another~

Commander, have you come across a mission so difficult that it's even making you furrow your brow? ...My my, I see~♪ Ahem, I mean, I would be more than glad to lend my assistance, should you desire it--
Are you sure you're able to sort out all these rewards yourself, Commander? Heh heh... Perhaps you could look for another person to work with you~?
Commander, if you're unable to locate your mail... it's because I've already brought it over here. Heh heh~♪
Here are the materials you've requested, as well as the tea and light meal. Please note that the tea may be a bit hot. Hmm? It's cooled down?
Coins, oil, and supplies... I wonder if the rewards for this commission will also be abundant.
To claim to be the strongest... is not something that should be stated haphazardly. Don't you agree, Commander?
What is it that you are fighting for?
Do not deny yourself the pride that you righteously deserve. The path to victory has been paved by God, but it is you who shall lead us down that path, Commander.
The warriors of Iris Libre must not falter.
Bloom forth, hallowed Iris!
The Holy Iris will protect us!
If you wish to make a confession, better to turn to the Cardinal rather than to me.
You're here neither for prayers nor confessions? I see. In that case, I'll also have to find something else to do to pass the time... Hmm, hmm...

You'd like to have a chat? Let's see then... Between life, freedom, and love, which is most important to you, Commander? Hehe, don't be alarmed that I suddenly sprang that question on you. I simply wanted to see how you'd react~
Now then, moving on to the next question. Commander, do you prefer to be bound by someone else, or would you rather be the one doing the binding? Hehe, assume there are no other options~

If I was to cross the threshold of death's door one day, would you pull me back-- Hmm, I suppose that question's a bit too easy. I'm not trying to toy around with you, I simply wanted to hear how you feel. Heheh~

Sorry to make you buy a ring for me, but I can't deny these feelings any longer-- Heh, heheh... Ahahaha~♪ Yes, with this sacred ritual, no longer will I be teasing you. Indeed, from now on, I pledge myself to you, fully and forever.
Commander... I'm not worthy of such a gift!
If you keep slacking off... I'll have to inform Le Triomphant~ Heh heh.
Let us do battle together, my beloved sister!
Your orders, Cardinal?

ex.line: You look to be in high spirits today. So, what do you need me to do next?
A tea party with my sisters? ...I don't know about that... H-hey, it's not that I don't want to go... But what if the tea is too hot...
If you have a mission that requires speed, just leave it to me. That's one of my fortes, after all.
Want to head to somewhere high up after you're done with work? I'd like to understand... what it feels like to be a bird, soaring freely through the skies.
If you could talk to me about your concerns, Commander, I'd be really happy~♪
This... is also one of my weaknesses.
The mission rewards are right here. Heh heh~ I love the way you look when you're pushing yourself to the limit~♪
Ahaha! Thanks to you, Commander, I feel even stronger.
Accept your divine punishment!
How's that? Look what I, in all my grace and elegance, have done in your name.

Commander, have some spare time to have a chat? No no, I didn't have anything special in mind. You know, I get anxious if I don't get to see your face for even a day. Whether you're having a good day or a not-so-good day, I just want to see more of you~

lines.line: Zzz... Commander...? Sorry... for showing you this unsightly side of mine... I'm just, not a morning person... Zzzzz...
Zzz... Commander...? Sorry... for showing you this unsightly side of mine... I'm just, not a morning person... Zzzzz...
Le Malin... It's time to get to work... Make sure you don't drag the Commander down... Zzzzz...
Le Malin, Le Triomphant... We'll be together forever...... Zzzzz...
Le Triomphant... You're not the most photogenic sleeper...
Commander... Give me another couple hours... And then...
Nooo, I'm going to get pranked... Ehehe... I won't hold it against you though, so please...
But if you could stop at scribbling on my face... that'd be nice...
Nngh... Mmh...
The missions... We haven't finished them all yet...
We have mission rewards... waiting for us...
Please remember... to check your mail...
Zzzz... Black tea... should be left until it's a bit cooler than room temperature...
Our commission went wonderfully... I saw that in my dream...
It'd be nice... if I could get stronger after waking up...
Well then... I guess I'll fight...
*Yawn*... I'm still a bit sleepy... I can't even properly savor the aftertaste of victory like this... Zzzzz...
I knew it, I'm just not good enough... Unlike some of those Eagle Union destroyers...
Zzzzz
Zzzzz
Zzzzz
Zzzzz
Commander's derpy face... Ehehe... I've always wanted to see this... Just let me rest a while... at your side... Zzzzz...
How goes your day, Commander? Hehe, are you looking for my clever sister, Le Malin? If so, you would do well to search somewhere less... popular~♪
How goes your day, Commander? Hehe, are you looking for my clever sister, Le Malin? If so, you would do well to search somewhere less... popular~♪
Is the sun a bit too oppressive for your liking, Commander? If so, you would do well to find some shade, as my clever sister has done.
For someone not accustomed to strenuous exercise such as myself, I prefer to let the ocean's waves rock me back and forth.
Miss Ark Royal? Hmm, you're asking if she comes across as helpful or troublesome? Perhaps a bit of both, I must say...
The Cardinal plans to go surfing? Commander, I think you should keep an eye on her.
If a big wave comes... Hmm... Uhh... That's probably not going to bode well for me...
If you find it too hot, why not take off another layer~? Hehe~♪
My, oh my~♪
Commander, if you're talking about the mail, I think Le Malin has it... Hehe~♪
Splendidly done. Would you like to hold a tea party by the beachside, Commander? Indeed, something with ice would be nice~♪
Oh, it appears the commission fleet has returned.
Vauquelin-class destroyer - Maillé Brézé.
I am Maillé Brézé, Vauquelin-class destroyer! I am renowned for my ability to escort, patrol, transport, and to fight off submarines! ...Ultimately, though, it didn't save me from sinking... Aww...

Destroyer Maillé Brézé, Templar Knight of the Iris Libre, has arrived! Thou there, plebeian, thou may now sleep soundly knowing I'll defend thy lanes! ...What? Y-you're the Lord Commander?! F-f-forgive my grave disrespect just now!
Sound the trumpets, for I am here! ...Ah, morning salutations, Lord Commander!
Do you understand, Lord Commander? The Cardinal herself is with us in this war. Therefore, it's a holy war! You should feel honored to be part of it!
Our next battle is important, and I will not neglect my training in preparation for it!
Vauquelin! Thou must eat thy veggies! ...G-green peppers, however... Yes, it's a bad vegetable! Thou may pass on that one!
The Cardinal herself will be spectating our next exercise?! Oh goodness, oh dear... I must practice more!
Stunning hair ornament, am I right?
It won't be long before I'm dubbed a full-fledged Templar Knight!
Are you that enamored by my sheer magnificence?
What about these unfinished missions? You'd better do them before the Cardinal scoldeth you.
Mission complete! It's time to reap the rewards, Lord Commander!
New mail... The information inside is sure to be of paramount significance!
Exemplary work, Lord Commander! Although I guess it would have been a cakewalk for the Cardinal!
The commission team hath returned! Heheh. The rewards would've been greater if you'd entrusted the job to a Templar Knight like me...
Another step on my journey to full knighthood!
Onwards, girls! Holy is the war that we wage!
There you have it! That was a display of a Templar Knight's might!
Th-thou may crush my body, but my spirit will live on...! Wait, that doesn't sound right...
Feel my holy might!
I cannot and will not succumb...!
We both have goals to work towards! I'll strive to be a full Templar Knight, and thou should strive to be a half-decent commander!
I may still be a way's off from full knighthood, but I would still give my life for our holy crusade! Give me orders, and I will execute them, Lord Commander!
Lord Commander, if you ever feel anxious before a battle, simply put your hands together and pray, like... "Iris, watch over our souls," and you'll be fine!

It's not enough to protect just my Iris comrades. I must fight for all my friends here at port too... Oh, the burden on my shoulders doth grow ever bigger... Cardinal, Lord Commander, how will I carry this weight...?
If we share the burden of protecting everyone, then we can manage this feat together! The Cardinal told me that! On my sword, I vow to work harder than ever!
To whom do I deliver this ring, Lord Commander? ...I-it's for me?! You're serious?! I-I accept. I just worried for a bit whether you truly wanted me...
Oooh! Thank you, Commandeeer!
On me, Vauquelin!
Why, it's you, Algérie!
I-it's an unimaginable honor fighting alongside you, Cardinal!
Wouldst thou try and take this seriously, Foch?!

ex.line: Good morning, Lord Commander! Early as always, I see! Hehehe~
You went shopping with Algérie?! N-no, I'm not envious in the slightest, not at all! ...Though I wish you'd have taken me along...
I will protect you with my life, as your sworn knight, Lord Commander! Hehehe~
Mayhaps I should ask Émile for dancing lessons... N-nothing! Just thinking out loud!
Anything you require, I can do no problem! Simply give the order, Lord Commander!
Is this... what falling in love feels like?!
Outstanding performance, Lord Commander! If you brought gifts for the Cardinal, I may deliver them for you!
We did it! We are victorious, Lord Commander! Hehehe! The Cardinal will surely honor me for this!
Lord Commander! When is the next sortie? I must know so I can prepare for our holy battle, and also to relax and repose! Most of all, I'd love to spend a day off together with you~

lines.line: H-h-halt, intruder! Thou art intruding in the domain of an Iris Libre Templar Knight, a crime punishable by... Eek! I'm begging you, spare my life! ...It's you, Lord Commander?!
H-h-halt, intruder! Thou art intruding in the domain of an Iris Libre Templar Knight, a crime punishable by... Eek! I'm begging you, spare my life! ...It's you, Lord Commander?!
Wh-what is it, Lord Commander? As you see, I'm simply guarding my room...
Those things in the dark were just... Manjuus? N-n-no, impossible! Those little creatures could never frighten me so!
Why am I afraid of monsters under the bed...? I-I-I'm not!
Eek! I heard a weird noise coming from outside! I'm sure of it! Help meeee, Lord Commander!
It's times like these when I envy Tartu so much...!
I can't t-take this anymore!
I-I was merely pretending to be spooked!
Could you stay here until I fall asleep...?
G-g-go check your mail, right now!
You're back! You're finally back! I was sooooo scared, Lord Commandeeeer...!
S-see?! No monster can scare me as long as I have the Iris' protection!
Enjoying sweet pastries in a lovely dress - heehee, such bliss! ...I care not how unbecoming this is of a knight! I saved these desserts for my holiday! Let me enjoy myself, would you!
Enjoying sweet pastries in a lovely dress - heehee, such bliss! ...I care not how unbecoming this is of a knight! I saved these desserts for my holiday! Let me enjoy myself, would you!
Won't you join me for teatime, Lord Commander? This is too much to eat alone. I... I am not asking for your help at all! Partake only if you wish! Be grateful for my magnanimity!
It's blissful to have such many desserts just within arm's reach! More blissful yet is that they art a gift from the Cardinal herself! Heheh♪
This pastry is for thee, Vauquelin! Savor it thoroughly as it's a gift from the Cardinal! Thou must eat it with dignity!
C-Cardinal?! Thank you dearly for these gifts - such lavish treats are much more than I deserve!
I do not have any donuts, Tartu. However, I do have macarons, the next best thing.
You would touch my unarmored body?! A cowardly attack, I say!
You will have NO desserts if you're going to be like that!
Outstanding! You are permitted to treat yourself to my desserts!
There is nothing as sweet as a celebratory dessert!
Suffren-class Heavy Cruiser—Foch

I'm the third ship of the Suffren class, Foch. My design was different enough from those of my sister ships that I've even been called a member of the Foch class. As for what I'm good at... Nothing in particular, because I'm good at just about everything!
Hey there~ So you're the Commander? I'm Foch, from the Suffren class. I consider myself quite an experienced strategist, so I hope you'll find me useful~ Ahaha, anyway, it's a pleasure to meet you~
Commander, I've placed your work for the day on your desk. ...Don't look at me like that, I'm here for you too!
Commander, mind playing along with one of my whims? Stay still while I put this apple on top of your head... Wait, I'm just messing with you~ You don't have to run away♪
It's important to keep your guard up while doing work. To put it as a strategist would, "This is not peace. It is an armistice for a long while."
Maintaining a regular schedule is the key to efficiency, so no pulling all-nighters, okay?
How to get along with Algérie...? Well, for starters, she'll open up to you naturally if you have a cat with you.
My hair's ruined now! ...Just kidding, I'm not angry at all~♪
Is there something you're concerned about? Aha, well, if you don't mind opening up to me, an extra head can't hurt.
Eek?! ...Jeez, I didn't know you were into this kind of thing.
An indicator of a commander's capability is being able to take care of things in a timely manner. You should try a bit harder in that regard.
Commander, I've collected the mission rewards for you. I guess you owe me one now~
You've got some mail... Would you like me to cut the seal off for you, Commander?
Oh Commander, welcome back! Now now, don't focus so hard on your work that you forget to eat! I can even whip something up for you if you'd like!
We've gotten a new shipment of supplies. Are you going to check on them yourself?
Feel free to make me even stronger~♪
Victory can only be attained with the will to conquer! Foch, heading out!
How was that! The true power of the Foch class! Ahaha, feel free to depend on me as much as you'd like~♪
Even with these enhancements, I'm still not strong enough...
You're not getting away! Main guns, fire!
There's nothing to fear! I'm still here!
If you're truly planning on leading everyone to victory, you'll need to put more heart into it, instead of being this tepid.
The knife-thrower who never misses, Foch! ...at least, I wish I were that skilled.
Don't tense up like that, Commander, relax! ...And quietly accept your fate... Letting yourself be taken care of is for your own benefit, you know~♪
Commander... did you stay up all night again? It doesn't look like you've been eating properly, either... This is unacceptable... I guess it's time for me to look after you!

Commander, you did remember our dinner date tonight, right? You know, back when I told you I would look after you? I mean, I won't force you, but... you're not cruel enough to refuse me, right? Ahaha...
Well, of course I'm nervous, but... when I look at your face, all of my worries just melt away~ Ahaha, well, I guess I'll reveal my true feelings to you... "Sure, I'd love to♪"
Is this for me? Hahaha, glad to know you're so considerate, Commander!
We'll be fine, just follow the plan.
Ease up, we're on the same side now.
You look a bit like me... but not quite?

ex.line: Commander, the documents for you to take care of today are on your desk. ...No need to look so down, Commander~ I'll help you with anything!
Algérie invited you to a cat café? Haha, then let's go there after we're done with work.
I'll help you out so you don't need to work extra hours.
If someone wants to disturb the peace that we've built... Well, it's our job to stop them, isn't it?
If you want me to pamper you, just say the word~♪
Commander? What might you be thinking about?
I've gone and collected the mission rewards for you. This favor's on the house~♪
Do you need some help with the reports? Leave them to me, and go take a break. I'll find you if I need anything from you.
Our supplies have arrived. Don't worry, I've already checked up on them myself!
Yep~ Feel free to keep relying on me~♪
What a miscalculation... I'm sorry, Commander...

Commander, did you have any plans for the evening? Ahaha, it's nothing special. I was just thinking that I'd like to eat dinner with you tonight. The reason is... Well, isn't wanting to spend more time with you reason enough? Haha~♪

lines.line: Yo, Commander, did I keep you waiting? Sorry 'bout that. You know how it goes, sometimes it's really hard for a girl to pick out the right thing to wear. Anyway, let's get going~♪
Yo, Commander, did I keep you waiting? Sorry 'bout that. You know how it goes, sometimes it's really hard for a girl to pick out the right thing to wear. Anyway, let's get going~♪
You're letting me plan out our date? ...What a mistake on my part... I was hoping you would escort me to your heart's content...
Of course I like to dress up in pretty clothes. Did you never see me as a lady? Hmph. ...Ahaha, don't be down on yourself, I was just toying with you♪
In exchange for having made you wait, I promise that today will be a super fun day, Commander~♪
I had Algérie tell me what stores to go to, so I'll lead the way! I guarantee that you'll have a good time as well!
I've got one for self-defense. Hehe, sorry about that! Guess you won't have a chance to look cool in front of me.
Hmm... What do you think about the scenery over here?
Aren't... you in too much of a rush...?
You've kept me waiting for a while, Commander! Just kidding~ good work on your mission♪ Do you want to take a short break somewhere before we head out?
What are you planning on presenting me with as a reward?
How are you today, Master? Your humble butler Foch patiently awaits your orders... Hahah! I sure look the part, don't I?
How are you today, Master? Your humble butler Foch patiently awaits your orders... Hahah! I sure look the part, don't I?
I'm ready to give my all for you, as always. Dunno why, but this outfit always makes me feel motivated!
May I interest you in attending today's tea party today with the young ladies? Don't be shy - just go there if you want to, Commander.
I should ask Dunkerque to make a couple of pastries...
Lady Algérie, could I interest you in some tea? ...How's that? Pretty on-point, right?
Now I want to try on a maid uniform too... I should float the idea to the Royal Navy.
Ahaha... I thought I didn't stand out more than usual...
Your orders, Commander? ...Oops, I mean... Master, please tell me whatever it is you need.
You will be a glorious stepping stone for the Iris and my Commander. Heehee.
M-class light cruiser - Magdeburg

I'm Magdeburg, Iron Blood light cruiser. Don't got much of a record to boast about, but meh, what matters is the fact I'm here right now. If you need a problem fixed or someone's ass kicked, hit me up!
Yo! Iron Blood light cruiser Magdeburg here! Gimme a fistbump to celebrate us becomin' homies! Wait, uhh... Got these metal gauntlets on, so go easy for your own sake.
Aw yeah, I'm feelin' it today! Let's knock out all the paperwork in one go!
Why do I run like that? Ah, well, I was inspired by a comic I read. Makes me look pretty badass, doesn't it?
Hooh! Hah! And just for good measure... Whupah! Suddenly felt like doing a backflip, that's all. Hope I didn't startle ya there.
If I catch you slackin', your forehead's getting a whackin'. Relaaaax, I'll be gentle.
I just want the next chapter of this comic I'm reading to come out! But it's a weekly release, so all I can do is wait...
Huh? The hell are you doin'?
You wanna bump fists? Aight! Bam!
I'll choose to believe that was just an accident...
Guess what - new missions just dropped. We doin' 'em, or?
Mission complete! You gonna do the math for my share of the rewards next? Hahah.
New mail, yo! You really oughta make it a habit to check your mailbox.
Sweet, you're back. Run into any tough foes out there?
Heads up, Commander! Commish team's back, so you know what that means!
Send me into battle and we'll find out if I really got stronger or not!
Go get 'em! Follow my lead!
Hell yeah! This calls for a victory somersault!
Welp, guess this one's fubared. My bad...
Open up for a knuckle sandwich! ...Err, I mean a cannon volley!
I take hits like this for breakfast! Try harder!
You're pissin' me off to no end. Either sort yourself out, or leave me the hell alone!
Swamped with work, I'm guessin'? Need a hand? Fighting's not all I'm good for - I can do simple paperwork too, y'know.
To what do I owe this cuppa joe? ...The paperwork I did earlier? Ahahah, thanks! I'll have just a dash of milk.
Let's not think in terms of favors-for-favors and just help each other out when we need it, like homies do! Nice and simple that way, too!
Nobody matches my wavelength better than you. You and I, we're the OTP... Oh, guess that also makes us the port's number one power couple!

Honestly, I didn't plan for this at all... I doubt I've even got the kind of charm you deserve. No, no, I'm not turnin' you down! I absolutely love you, it's just... Well... Ahh, to hell with it! I can't find the right words!
Woah, you're giving me something real amazing! I'll have to think of some way to return the favor.
Gauntlet gang, represent!
You know ninjutsu? The real deal?

ex.line: Oh yeah, I'm in the zone! So, what are we doin' today, buddy?
Too slow, Commander! Hahaha! To be fair, keepin' up with my pace ain't easy. I can teach you a way to run faster, if you're interested.
