Commander, why don't ya try a somersault for yourself? Don't be scared now, I'll catch you to make sure you don't get hurt.
You slackin' again? Heheh, well, that's a forehead-flicking right there! ...Oh, crap, did I overdo it? Sorry, buddy. I'll go easy on ya next time.
Huh? Uhh... Guess I don't mind...
Brofist coming at you! Intercept! Hahahaha!
Hm? Whuh...? I can't put my finger on what I'm feeling here...
Every new mission's a new challenge! C'mon, let's get it done!
Good, you're back! I won't even have to lift a finger if you keep this performance up! Ahahaha!

Now that we've gone from homies to like, hand-holding homies, I don't know where to take things from here... "Don't worry about it?" Yeah, guess you're right! We got to this point by just going with the flow, so let's stick to that!

lines.line: You little...! Look what a damn mess you made! And I'm the one who's gotta clean it up now! ...Oh. Perfect timing, Commander. Could use a hand with the floor here, after what this little turd did.
You little...! Look what a damn mess you made! And I'm the one who's gotta clean it up now! ...Oh. Perfect timing, Commander. Could use a hand with the floor here, after what this little turd did.
Wish I could say "I'll be right with you!" but I've got this mess to deal with... Ugh, this sucks ass.
You being a cute li'l cat doesn't change the fact you've been naughty. Learned your lesson yet? Good, then don't let that happen again.
Okay, cats can be kinda cute when they're behaving... But that's how they getcha! You let your guard down, and that's when they strike!
Ulrich, come gimme a hand here... Whaddya mean no way?! Just 'cause they refuse to play with you?!
I don't mind helping 'round the café, but I never signed up to clean messes like this... I figured cats would be, y'know, cute and docile...
I'm trying to clean here, dammit!
You're gonna help me out? Great, thanks!
What, you trying to get me to grab you by the neck like this cat here?
Commander and I are leavin' to take care of a new mission. You cats better behave while we're out!
Whew... That's that mission done. Now to focus on this again...
Left your mail on the desk. Don't forget to read it.
Your battle's already over, while there's no end in sight to mine... *sigh*...
Commish team has returned? Ah, crap! I'd better put on some coffee, quick!
First thing's first - these meddlesome assholes have got to go!
Victory is meowrs! ...N-no! Slip of the tongue, that's all...
Aw damn. I blew it...

First these li'l cats make a mess of the place, then I'm forced to lecture 'em on it. Pain in my ass... Ahem. Listen... If I ever end up doing something similar to these guys... would you try to... N-nah, never mind I said anything!
Here's an idea - how 'bout putting down the camera and actually enjoyin' the open sea? I'll move the swim ring so you can chill in the breeze with me!
Here's an idea - how 'bout putting down the camera and actually enjoyin' the open sea? I'll move the swim ring so you can chill in the breeze with me!
Our goal today is just to have a real good time! Got it? Ya can't go thinkin' 'bout work all day long.
Seagulls in the sky, salty breezes down below. I've seen 'em tons of times in comics before, and I guess the real deal's just what you'd expect... Hey, let's climb a mountain on our next vacay!
Look at this dope view... Ya tend to overlook Mother Nature if ya don't stop and smell the roses! I'mma invite Bismarck and company here sometime.
Why you checkin' out my hands? ...Hm? Guess it is your first time seein' 'em without gauntlets on! Ahahahah!
Much as I love sunbathing, ya gotta wear sunscreen if ya don't want a nasty sunburn. Hold still for a sec and I'll put some on your back.
You gonna rub sunscreen on me? Thanks, homie!
Wow, you sure got some nerve...
New missions just arrived. Time to change gears and get 'em done!
Mission accomplished! The fruits of our labor are waitin', homie.
Good work, homie! C'mere and recharge those batteries with an ice-cold soda!
Commish team's back in port. Enough cloudgazin', Commander, let's go see 'em!
On me!
Aww yeah! Gimme a victory brofist!
I messed up bigtime... Sorry...
Jade-class aircraft carrier - Elbe

I'm the Iron Blood's remodeled aircraft carrier, Elbe! Just like my sister who fought for the Sakura Empire during a certain war, I was converted into an aircraft carrier and performed many great feats... or at least, that's how it should've been! Sorry, I shouldn't be telling lies...
I am the Jade-class carrier, Elbe. And you're the Commander of this fleet? Hmm, you must be quite sure of yourself to make the one who will bring you victory come to you♪
Good morning, Commander. Where are we headed to today? Come on, tell me already~♪
Hmph. It upsets me that you're a boorish Commander with no knowledge of common etiquette. Y-you think I'm well-bred? ...You're sorely mistaken! I'm a bad girl! Bad to the bone!
Commander~ Might you be looking for your pen? Hehehe, I hid it right over here! T-Thanks for finding it for you, you've been looking for it for days...?
I should invite Hiyou and Junyou over for tea sometime... Huh, I can't? Why not?
Y-You inferior creature, prostrate thyself in front of the great Elbe... Ahaha, there's no way I would actually say that to you, Commander!
Y-you little...
You can't just touch me as you please~♪ Come on, beg for my permission!
Wh-wh-wh-whaaaaa?!
Look what we have here~ A form for you to reflect on your inability to complete your missions on time♪ Think long and hard about how you want to write it~
The rewards for the missions you completed are here! ...I-it's not like I was trying to report them late on purpose... You'll fill the reflection form out? You're the best!
Here's a letter for you. When are you going to read it?
You're finally back! Yep, these should suffice as your refreshments! How are they? ...Ah, no comments on how it tastes though!
The girls have come back from their commissions. It almost feels like I'm not the only one being worked to the bone by you.
Heehee~! I'm even stronger now!
I'm coming to beat you up!
Kneel in front of me! Pretty please♪
Grr, how frustrating! Commander, Commander~!
It's time for your punishment!
I, I haven't even gotten serious yet...!
It turns out you really were an inferior creature, all along...
Hehe, how should I toy with the Commander today... It's fun, how am I supposed to hold myself back? I'll show you how we do it in the Iron Blood!
If I give this kind of work to you, you'll surely be... very troubled! I-it's fine for me to trouble you...?
I'm a very bad girl, so I'll keep finding new ways to trouble you more and more! Now, brace yourself~♪ Y-you're busy today, so I shouldn't? Oh... Okay then...

Today is finally the day I'll trouble you to my heart's content! Will I trouble you to my heart's content or will you...? N-no, bad Commander! I'll be the one troubling you! Because I really want to be with you!

Wow... So this is the fabled promise ring?! N-no way, the Commander really confessed to me...??? W-wait, don't hang your head, I'm not turning you down, really! I truly love you, from the bottom of my heart! Commander, I love you, so, so much~!
My, my. Don't you think you're going a bit overboard trying to butter me up? Heehee~♪
Good day, how do you do...?
I'm the main act here!
Isn't she the good girl here?!

ex.line: Good morning, Commander. Where shall we head to today? Hehehe.

I've been thinking... Isn't it pretty unusual for you to be the one who always makes coffee for me? I mean, even if I'm a bad girl, you're still my superior, and... you can't leave out my sugar on purpose like that!
Hehehe, I went and swapped around some of the forms you're supposed to work on. Will you finally admit that I'm a bad girl now?
Once this war is over, maybe I can go back to being a good girl... B-but, that's only if you promise that you'll always stay with me!
As your secretary ship, I'll make sure that I work myself to the bone! Now now, leave all of your work to me, and wallow in your pangs of guilt~♪
My gorgeous body can even withstand battles! Hehe, you can keep admiring me♪
A-aren't you too enthusiastic about this?!
If they make you fill out a reflection form for not completing your missions on time, leave it to me! Ehehe♪
Here are the mission rewards. Your beaming face is enough to make it worthwhile.
Great work out there, Commander. Hehe, did you expect to come back to a nice meal? Too bad for you, I left one of the side dishes out today♪ Ahahaha~
We did it, Commander! ...A-aren't you going to praise me?!
I always thought that being a bad girl would keep you interested in me, but... sometimes, I just want to be a good girl who clings to your side... O-only every once in a while though, got it...?

lines.line: Thank you all for waiting! Large mugs of Iron Blood beer, just as ord-- W-waaah?! Nnngh...! Phew, somehow managed to not spill anything... Wh-what's your deal?!
Thank you all for waiting! Large mugs of Iron Blood beer, just as ord-- W-waaah?! Nnngh...! Phew, somehow managed to not spill anything... Wh-what's your deal?!
Master, what would you like to order today? Hehehe.
You can't find your steak knife...? He, hehe... that's right! It was all me! Now you're going to make me get on my knees before scolding me, right? Wait... you're just going to leave me here?!
Let's change the Commander's order up a bit... Huh, Bismarck?! I-I'm terribly sorry!
It's not good for you to drink so much... A-After all, I don't know what kind of wild things you might do to me when you're inebriated...
I can't seem to find a chance to talk to the Commander because I'm too busy taking everyone's orders... What should I do...
Eeeeek?!
You want to bring the girls some refreshments? Sure, hold on for a moment then♪
We won! My time to shine is here!
Still not here yet...? Geez, I'll give the Commander what-for for coming later than me... Huh? C-Commander? N-no, I happened to come an hour early, is all...
Still not here yet...? Geez, I'll give the Commander what-for for coming later than me... Huh? C-Commander? N-no, I happened to come an hour early, is all...
I-it's about time we went on a... date, isn't it, Commander?
Heheh, how do you like my outfit today? ...Y-you say it's cute, and it looks good on me? Th-thank... you...
I-I don't mind if you sit here! Today, you have special permission to be next to me!
Heheh, I will gladly let you carry my things! Where should we go next? Or...do you need a minute to rest?
(Things have been so awkward for a while now... I have to scoot a little bit closer...) B-Bwuh?! Did you hear that?!
I-is this a massage?
...Hwaah?!
Why don't we forget about all the missions for a day? Come and be bad with me!
Here are your rewards. Allow me to hold your things for you.
Thank you for your continued efforts. Um... Wh-why are you looking at me so expectantly?
We won! I'm really on fire today!
My slogan today is "Neglect the Commander!" Heheh, no matter what you say to me, I won't reply one bit! ...Commander? S-say something, please... Are you okay? I'm right here...
P-class armored ship - Prinz Adalbert

Heya, I'm P-class armored cruiser Prinz Adalbert. All P-class ships are a force to be reckoned with, at least according to Heinrich. So yeah, if you need some nasties taken care of, just gimme a call~
Made it safely to port! Time to have a look around. Question is, where to start... Hm? Are you the Commander? All right. 'ello, nice to meet you, and all that jazz. See you around~
Come on. Time to get motivated, Commander.
Why're you always staring off in the distance, Commander? Got something on your mind? Maybe I can help you with it.
This hourglass is real neat. Let's reset it and watch the sand go again. And again... Welp, that got old fast. Now 'scuse me while I go rummage through your desk for other cool gadgets.
Sheesh, that's a crazy amount of paperwork on your desk. Wait, can't we just feed 'em to the shredder and be done with it? ...No? Fine, I won't do it then.
Don't you ever feel fed up, doing the same task for hours at a time? I'd give up after like, thirty minutes.
You know how Heinrich nicknamed her rigging "Eisen"? I'm thinking about naming mine too.
Huh? I don't recall doing anything to earn a headpat, but okay.
Mind helping out with my training, Commander?
You can't go 'round doing this to girls, Commander.
The mission list grows ever longer... I say we just put it through the paper shredder, honestly.
Hey, Commander, the mission rewards are piling up at the pier.
Yo, your mailbox is full. Want me to empty it for you?
Ever thought about setting up an outdoors office space, Commander? The warm sunshine and fresh air's waiting for you outside!
Hello? A commission's done. The girls brought back a ton of stuff, so I helped them out with it.
Woo! Yeah! Feeling stronger already!
Ho-kay! Warm-ups done, now let's do this thing!
K.O.! The enemies are all down for the count!
Retreating already? Guess I'll do the same...
Adalbert, coming at ya!
My comeback is-a coming in round two!
You're such a lame-ass... I'm gonna go hang with someone else.
Let's start by checking out the depot. There's bound to be peeps there who need a hand or just wanna hang out.

Heya, Commander, I got those documents you asked for... Took longer than you expected? Yeah, uhh... I ran into Magdeburg and went jogging with her, then Heinrich and I played with Eisen, and after that... Yeah, I kinda lost track of time...

Seeing other people happy makes me happy too~ That's why I love both helping people and hanging out with 'em equally. Other girls have said we're the same in that regard, you and I. You just love seeing people happy too, right?
Sooo, how 'bout say we look around for people in need of a helping hand? There ain't no problem we can't solve together. And if nobody needs help, we can just hang out instead.
Does this mean we're like, super duper besties? ...Even more than that? Huh... Super duper ultra mega besties then? Let's go with that, and promise each other we'll always be together~
Woahhh, it's lovely! Thank you, Commander~
Smash through 'em, Heinrich!

ex.line: Howdy. Finished charging your batteries? I can help if you still need more energy.
Yeah, hey... Hmm... Huh? Me? I'm as carefree as can be. What about you? Something you wanna get off your chest?
Man, your desk is just loaded with neat stuff. Hehehe, ain't never a dull moment in your office~
I'm like a human shredder, tearing paperwork you don't wanna do into ribbons... Hmm. You sure you can still manage with this amount?
It's not so bad doing the same task all day when you've got someone to vibe with~
Heard Strasser sat Heinrich down and made her read a book for once. Maybe I should find something to read before bedtime.
Huh? This is praise, right? Thanks.
I was thinking I'd do something fun with you before today's training. Yeah, THAT kinda fun.
You've really got a, uh, keen interest in women's bodies.
I'm gonna open the window and get some fresh air in here. C'mon! Breathe in, breathe out!
You down to hang out with me today? Ah, right, you've got work... Tell you what, I'll help you with it. First order of business: putting a smile on your face~

lines.line: Zzz... Huh? Did I doze off? I just meant to rest my eyes for a sec after closing up, but look how long I slept... Hang on, why are you still here, Commander?
Zzz... Huh? Did I doze off? I just meant to rest my eyes for a sec after closing up, but look how long I slept... Hang on, why are you still here, Commander?
Welcome, Commander! It's kind of odd saying "welcome" when I'm lying down, but hey.
How'd I end up here, lying down on the counter...? Think I closed up shop then got all sleepy... *yawn*... Truth be told... I'm still pretty sleepy.
Taking orders, moving dishes, and cleaning tables, that's this job in a nutshell. Never gets boring as long as you do 'em in rotation!
Honestly, not a fan of the liquor menu. All the drinks on there make my head spin...
Earlier today, I was caught gawking at my coworkers while they were mixing drinks. I was so distracted that Bismarck herself called me out for it.
I'm no marionette, ya hear!
This stuff won't fly during open hours, ya hear?
We've still got missions to do! See? You do need my help~
Finished a mission, huh? I say you've earned yourself a drink.
Mail always finds its way to you wherever you go, huh?
We're meant to be closed for the day, but I'm all ears if you've got any requests~
Those girls you sent out are back? I'll whip up some drinks for them later.
Oh, good timing. Pass me the shampoo bottle over- Whooooaaaa! Ow, oww... Hey, uh, Commander, could you help me get back up on my feet?
Oh, good timing. Pass me the shampoo bottle over- Whooooaaaa! Ow, oww... Hey, uh, Commander, could you help me get back up on my feet?
Boy, am I glad you're here, Commander... even if I definitely won't trip again. For sure.
I tripped 'cause I was playing with bubbles. I got so engrossed that I covered the whole bathroom in the stuff, and you know the rest. I've learned my lesson now!
Mgh! Hngh! This soap is so bubbly! I'm gonna need your help to wash them away.
You can stop it with that concerned look already. My rear don't hurt anymore. Also, sitting to wash is pretty comfy - you should give it a try.
What's the rush, Commander? Take it easy. If you start to trip, I'll catch you.
Hm? You wanna wash my hair? Cool. Go right ahead!
You'll scrub my back? Go on.
Is this the kind of scenario that gets you fired up?
The mission list? Oh, I almost forgot. What can I say? It got too wet to read.
It's fine 'cause you finished that mission? Oh. Then someone's gotta go claim the rewards!
Huh? What's a letter for you doing in here? Aw crap! It's gonna get soaked!
Hey, don't rush your way into the tub. Take it slow so you won't slip like I did.
A commission's been completed? So that's why they brought a new basket. Anyhow, check this out, Commander!
Wow! Doubt I'll be tripping again now!

Man, it's good you were here! I always knew we could overcome any adversity as long as we were together. Well, maybe calling falling over "an adversity" is a bit much... Hey, uh, why are you staring daggers through me?
Huh? Damn... You made it to the magician's training hall. Alright. I'll let ya be the first to see my new trick.
Huh? Damn... You made it to the magician's training hall. Alright. I'll let ya be the first to see my new trick.
I'm gonna give this performance my all, seeing as I got you to come watch. But d'you mind helping me track down my escaped rabbit first?
(The Commander's too smart to get fooled by this trick... Wait, that expression... I've been seen through already? Huh...)
Watch closely... You see this coin here? ...Poof! Which hand do you think it's in now? Oops, you got it wrong. You're not gonna see through my trick that easily!
Huh? The fireworks machine went off? Don't tell me you found the machine hidden behind the curtain? Ah, shoot! I said too much...
What're you looking at, Commander? My hat, the stage... No, you're staring at my bunny ears and tail, right? That's not where I'm hiding my magical secrets!
Hmm. I can't move too much before the show starts. If the critters under my hat get spooked... there's not gonna be anything I can do.
What's that? You wanna check my hat? Sure, go ahead... Be careful, though. If you stick your hand in there, you might not be able to get it back out.
You wanna search for the secrets behind my magic? Sure thing - Take it nice and slow.

Mind you're not wasting your energy, Commander. No one knows how to open that exit 'cept me! Mmh, though I guess I could escort you out if you figure out the trick I'm about to show you. How does it sound?
Your eyes are moving away from my hat... and onto my face... Y'know, Commander, are you really looking to get outta here? Or... Or have you been after me this whole time?!
Iron Blood Type VIIC submarine - U-1206

You've heard about Iron Blood's wolfpacks, right? Guess what: I'm a wolf, too! Or I was, until the day I had a little accident... Wait, no, forget I even said that! I'm still a deadly predator! Keep your expectations high for me!
Commander! Yeah, you! Get back here! You're supposed to greet me! Listen up, I'm the Iron Blood submarine U-1206, and I'll be serving here starting today! And don't forget next time!
Hi, Commander! What are we doing today? I'm fired up and ready to do some work!
The manual for this industrial-grade AC says... Hmm. Let's just skip to pushing this big red button... Oh no, what's happening?! How do I turn it off?!
Can I push this button? ...No? What about this one? Also no? Laaame...
Oh, someone's at the door! Hello? Who is it? ...Huh? There's nobody here? Maybe I was just hearing things...
Your documents are printed and good to go! ...The cover and back are swapped around? Oops, uh... I'll go look for the manual...
There's no button on my forehead, so stop that!
Out of things to do, Commander? Then it's time to have fun with me!
Huh? Are you having dirty thoughts right now?
Oh geez, so many missions... I'll help you with them so we have more time to play later! Let's go!
I heard you finished a mission! That means more time for us to hang out, right? Hehehe~
You've got new mail! I'll open it for y- Oh... I guess should've asked you for permission first...
Welcome back, Commander! Hmm... Wouldn't it be nice if we could just push a button to open your office door remotely?
The commission team is back! I'll go say hi!
My intuition just got keener!
Now's my time to shine!
We did it! Wait, shouldn't I get some sort of prize for being the MVP?
Oh fudge! I'm gonna push the emergency resurface button! They're not watching me, are they?!
Fire torpedoes! ...Oops, wrong button! There!
Ow, ow, ow! Stop hitting me!
You'll have to become a saint if you want my forgiveness! To start with... Lemme think... Okay, first of all, you've gotta get on everyone's good side.
I don't understand this instruction manual! But that's okay, I'll just go with my gut until I figure it out!
If only I had a button that autocompleted one day's work. If I did, I'd press it for you every single day... No, don't be greedy, Commander! One press a day is all you'd get!
Remember how you said we'd do something together next time you're free? You don't? Hrmph... You definitely did, though! Whatever, we're doing it now! We're going surfing!
Commander, would you mind if we did... everything together? You know, working, eating, swimming, napping... Everything! Please? ...Wahoo!
Hehehe~ I'm so happy right now I can't even think straight! I could just fall right into your arms! You make me feel like the happiest girl in the world! Hehehehe~
Whoa! This looks really fun!
The wolfpack rides into battle on their riggings!

ex.line: Hey, Commander! We're gonna hang out again after work is over, remember that!
Okay, so... I'm meant to press this blue button instead of the red one on the AC... Achoo! Aww, dang it... I pressed the red one without even thinking about it!
I've got an idea! Hehehe, lemme just push this button... There we go! Fan's on now! Enjoy that cool air!
Your documents are printed and good to go! I made sure to read the instructions this time! ...Agh, the text is on both sides of the paper! How'd this happen?!
I've got an idea! Hehehe, lemme just push this button... There we go! Fan's on now! Enjoy that cool air!
Your documents are printed and good to go! I made sure to read the instructions this time! ...Agh, the text is on both sides of the paper! How'd this happen?!
Hehehe, I like this!
It's always you touching me! Let me touch you for once!
Hehehe~ Don't be shy~
You've got new mail! I'll open it for y- Phew. I nearly did it again... Here you are! Your unopened mail!
Open sesame! Kidding~ I'll just open the door like normal for you!
Victory! Hehehe! We did it, Commander!
Commander! Do you have time right now? Then come play with me! I remember you saying you would! Oh, we're gonna have so, sooo much fun later!

lines.line: Welcome! Oh, Hey, Commander! Heheh, so how do you like my maid getup? Looks pretty nice, if I do say so myself!
Welcome! Oh, Hey, Commander! Heheh, so how do you like my maid getup? Looks pretty nice, if I do say so myself!
Welcome inside, Commander! Will it be coffee or milk tea? Or maybe... a little pick-me-up?
Is this a soda fountain? Guess I just press the button to make drinks come out! Clickity! ...Oh shoot! I forgot to put a cup down first!
Elbe! Need a hand with serving all these drinks? I'll help!
We're offering a special deal: one-on-one chat time with a maid! Completely free of charge!
The service button? Sure, I'll press it right- Wait, I'm dumb! That means a customer's calling for me!
I hope you're not trying to ogle me like a perv!
It's NOT okay to wanna do p-pervy stuff to maids!
Hehehe~ Wouldn't you say I deserve a tip for my top-tier service?
The commission girls are back in port! I'll start prepping some drinks!
H-class battleship - Ulrich von Hutten
My name is Ulrich von Hutten. So long as you call me that, that is who I am. A name is nothing more than that.
I am Ulrich von Hutten, the symbol of the Iron Blood's hopes and regrets. Whether my arrival is a cause for celebration or for despair is up to you to decide. I shall respond in kind.
You're here. See that massive pile of paperwork on your desk? The two of us will be spending lots of quality time here until that's taken care of.
If you want peace of mind, just don't bother worrying about anyone else. We may be born into this world, but our keels and souls aren't at the mercy of others.
You want to know more about my rigging? Sure, I can move it like I want to, but there are times when it's pretty troublesome.
The Mysteries of the Port? Just leave it as it is. That's the only way it'll continue to keep your curiosity piqued, isn't it.
Think for yourself... Though you can't live selfishly, you need to live for the sake of something you really desire. That way, even if you die, it won't be in vain.
It might be a surprise for you, but I do have hobbies I enjoy. And it's not like I become a different person when I do.
Hmph. You don't make any damn sense.
If you've got something to say, spit it out. I'll hear you out.
I'm not sure whether I should praise you or teach you your place...
Missions, huh? Whether we do them or not is up to you. That is your freedom.
The rewards have arrived. Kick back and enjoy the moment. You're going to miss out on it if you don't, and all that'll be left is emptiness.
There's some mail. Looks like it contains confidential information... I see.
Everyone made it back, huh? Not bad.
The fleet's returned from their commissions. Hurry up and decide whether you or I go and greet them.
In order to create a peaceful world where power is not needed, what you need is power. How paradoxical... Oh, don't mind me.
...Tsk. This ammo is wasted on you lot!
...Piss off, weaklings. Just thinking about the amount of ammo I've wasted on you sorry lot makes me want to vomit.
I'll back off since we lost, but don't count on it happening again.
Get lost, you're in the way.
If you don't plan on dying here, then focus up!
You sowed these seeds yourself. It's your mess to clean up, not mine.
Trust is like a poison—once it enters your body, it destroys you. The only way to protect yourself is to be wary of others.
Working for you is not the same as trusting you. The fact that you can command so many people... Or rather, be adored by so many, means you of all people should understand.
You spineless fool who doesn't even know how to doubt others... I've come to realize that you've spread deeper and deeper through me, just like a poison. Tsk... I'll return the favor, mark my words.

I told you I'd return the favor. Yep, I'll suck the poison out of you before it has a chance to spread throughout your body. This is my duty... my responsibility, for the person who did the same for me. But maybe I'm already too late? Hehehe...

Embrace it, drown in it... Just as you put the curse of trust on me, I'll place it on you. Trust... Let the poison called affection consume you. Become just like me. Don't you know? You and I are already one.
Turning this down would be a terrible waste. Hmph.
Looks like you and I are dancing to different tunes.
If you're interested in something, just face it head-on, young lady.

ex.line: You finally showed up... but you're not needed anymore. Hehehe. Don't just stand there in shock, guess what I did for you.
What's wrong? Did something happen? You're not acting like yourself... Trust in others like you trust in me, that's how you'll put those girls at ease. Of course, the same goes for me.
Even though you do so well when I pamper you, you refuse to be pampered when you're not doing well... Hmph. You're just like those little kitties in the most peculiar ways...
If you're really dying to find out what's behind the Mysteries of the Port, I won't stop you. I'll even accompany you. It'll be a good way of spending time with you.
Focus more on myself? It seems like you don't understand. It's because I'm focusing on myself that I do all these things for you.
When you neglect your health, think about the people who would be sad if you collapsed. I, for one, don't want to feel sad.
Does being pampered like this irritate you?
This is how our relationship together is. I don't know why you're getting all flustered about it at this point...
Do you want to find out which of us has less self-restraint?
There's a new mission. I did the parts I could help out with. I'll leave the rest to you.
Mission complete. Feeling a bit tired? Let's take a break until you've recovered enough energy.
Here's some mail for you. I broke the seals for you, is that alright?
Are you alright? ...I don't doubt my ability to take care of my subordinates' safety, but I can't help but worry about you... Tell me, are you really alright?
Looks like the fleet is back after their commissions. Don't you want to look at their beaming smiles?
I'll mow all of you down!
I want you to tell me whether you're satisfied with my performance or not.
I was able to bring everyone back... safely.
Stay still. Don't wander away. I can't leave the one I absolutely adore alone. If someone actually tried to tear the two of us apart... Hehehe... Let's just say, I'd tell them to eat shit.

lines.line: *sigh* Do you really have to bother me during my break? ...It's a joke, no need to take it so seriously. I was looking for someone to kill some time with anyway.
*sigh* Do you really have to bother me during my break? ...It's a joke, no need to take it so seriously. I was looking for someone to kill some time with anyway.
What's going on with you today? Spill it.
I really need to head back, but the little'un just... *sigh* what a pain in the ass.
The fan outside is so frickin' loud, but I really need my alone time... Huh? Who put these damn stickers here...?
You already know what I'll do to people who start shit inside, don't you? ...Yep. I'll give them their one warning.
I'm not really worried about Elbe causing trouble. Surprisingly, she knows when to stop. ...Well, at least she's not my main source of worry.
The little'uns really like when you do this to them.
"Welcome back, Master. May I take your order?" ...You happy with that?
Tsk... Again with that shit just 'cuz we're here? What a pain in the ass...
So, you accept a mission and then immediately begin procrastinating...? What a piece of work you are. Want me to do the same thing to you?
*Glug, glug* ...Ahh, that hits the spot. Tsk, it's already empty... Sorry, mind grabbing me another can?
Looks like things worked out just fine.
Tsk, they got me...
That was a pretty good race - reckon you'll get first place next time, though? ...Hmh. Easier said than done. You know they won't settle for second place - and hopefully neither will you, Commander.
That was a pretty good race - reckon you'll get first place next time, though? ...Hmh. Easier said than done. You know they won't settle for second place - and hopefully neither will you, Commander.
Make it clear - do you want support, or a scolding? Standing around doing nothing isn't my style.
Listen. Don't let other people distract you when you're on the track. Forget about overtaking others and just focus on driving the best you can drive. You'll finish with fewer regrets that way.
Seeing as you've got nothing better to do, go give the girls some refreshments. It'll cheer 'em up, knowing that you're here.
Maintaining hardware is one thing we Iron Blood excel at. We're expert tamers, both of machinery and riggings.
Wonder when we're gonna rehearse for the victory party performance... I should go talk to Hipper and Eugen after my shift's over.
Are you gonna race, too? Then I'll at least give you some pointers and support.
Hmph. You're a hopeless case.
A letter... Just go check it and don't mind me.
You look like you're in good shape. Hmph, so I worried for nothing.
The commission team is back. Now go talk to them. Cheering them on is your job.
Hope this will be a good morale boost.
Just hope the girls rooting for us won't be disappointed by this... Tsk. I hate putting up appearances.
Hm? You look like you've seen a ghost... Oh, you thought I'd have gone home by now? Heh... Who cares? It's not like I've got anything better to do.
Hm? You look like you've seen a ghost... Oh, you thought I'd have gone home by now? Heh... Who cares? It's not like I've got anything better to do.
Got any plans today? You don't have to answer right away - we'll have time to talk on the way home.
Yeah, I got your message. "I'm busy, so I'll be late." The "go home without me" part was unnecessary.
I found a few shops you might like. If you want, we could take a detour... Not that you'd ever refuse.
You must be tired, but if I let you lie in my lap right now, we'll get home even later... Or was that what you wanted all along?
I'm not mad. I just waited a little... but if you'll treat me to something to make up for it, I won't say no.
Doing whatever you want just because you're my senior, huh... Pfft, heheh.
Is this how seniors are supposed to treat younger students?
Just because nobody's here... Is this what you were after all along?
Hm? Another reminder? Did an urgent mission come up, or something?
Looks like you're being rewarded after being worked so hard.
You look tired. Did you run into trouble out there? I'm happy to listen, if you'd like to talk.
Go check on the commission first. Don't worry, I won't leave.
Living a simple life, going home with you every day and staying by your side... Heh. If this is a dream, I never want to wake up. Guess I'm addicted to you now.
Hmph, so the day has finally come... I'm not surprised. I knew from the day we met that this would happen. After all... the poison called love is both a blessing and a curse.
Hmph, so the day has finally come... I'm not surprised. I knew from the day we met that this would happen. After all... the poison called love is both a blessing and a curse.
Oh, you're here? You're all mine today. Work? Leave it for once. Nothing is more important than you and me right now.
Now you want to escape? It's too late. Once caught in a web, a butterfly has no escape. You've poisoned me, and now, it's time I return the favor.
Are you taken by the sight of me? Heh... Seeing that look on your face made all this effort worthwhile.
Got a problem? Let me know, and I'll get rid of whatever obstacles are in your way.
Want to know where I put my rigging? Heh, I don't really need it right now. Or else... is there something you want to try with it?
Fate tied us together long ago. Call it the red string, the silver string, whatever - it binds us forever now.
Want to feel more? Just watch out for these hairpins.
Take my hand and fall into this web with me.
Hmph... Why do you still test me? Or is this just the kind of foreplay you like?
Doing okay? Even in this attire, I can always rush to your aid... What? You want a cup of coffee first? Fine. Come to my room, and you can have it... It's just instant coffee, though.
Tch... Causing trouble for the Commander, are you?

It all started out with simple eye contact. We went from there to trust, to acceptance, and finally, to unstoppable free-fall. Before I knew it, I'd already swallowed the poison called love. Now, even the closest intimacy is just a temporary fix for me. But I must have it... All we can do now is keep indulging in it.
Dido-class light cruiser - Charybdis.

I am the Dido-class anti-aircraft cruiser, Charybdis. With the motto, "Any task - anywhere," I performed my duties in different oceans across the world during the war. Master, whenever or wherever you need anything, just leave it to me!
Dido-class light cruiser, Charybdis at your service. 'tis an honour to meet you in person, Master. May your everyday life be bathed in the warm sunlight, in the peaceful days that come.
Good morning to you, Master. Will you be starting off the day with some work?
Master, is there anything new you'd like to wear when you head out on missions? ...If that's what you'd like, please leave it to me! It so happens sewing is one of my specialties♪
Fair winds and a following sea~ Master, if it's fine with you, please take me along in your next mission as well.
There's nothing for me to do right now...? N-no way... Master, how could you do this to me...
Master~ If you'd please change into- Y-you can't see the documents you're working on...? Ahh, I'm sorry!
Just leave it to me~♪
Master, is something wrong?
Master, there's a new mission for you! Y-you already knew about it? Oh...
Here are your rewards. Please check on them.
I'm here to deliver this mail to you, Master.
Welcome back, Master! Let's make sure you don't overdo things and take a short break first~
A commission has been completed. I wonder how it went?
Behold my true power! Heehee.
Anti-air combat, commence! Master, please lower your head!
An elegant victory, the way us Royal Maids do it... Ow! A-an undetonated shell...?
Redouble our rescue efforts! Master, please retreat and leave the others to me!
Stay calm, it's time for our counterattack!
Wh-where's the enemy?
I... Master, do you throw everyone to the wolves like this...?
Hm-hmm~♪ Whenever, wherever, I'll be there to serve you as your maid. A-and please don't remind me of how I mess up sometimes...
It may be an exaggeration to say "whenever, wherever," but... I simply wish to be there to serve you whenever you might need me... I'm sorry...
If I do everything for you, you'll become incapable of doing anything for yourself? Am I that powerful of an existence...?
I-I'll do everything for you, but in moderation... Wait! I'll just do my best to relieve some of your fatigue~ Roger! I'll make sure to exercise restraint!

What's this, Master...? Y-you really weren't satisfied just having your fatigue relieved?! *sigh*... I-I mean, even without this ring... Oh! Is this a symbol of your permission for me to pamper you lots and lots more~? Heehee, my dear Master, of course I love you lots~
Um, Master? Huh? This gift is for me?

ex.line: Heehee, it's adorable how devoted you are to your job, Master~ Sorry, I'll go and prepare the documents right away.
Master, does it feel good~? Heehee, since we're fine on time, I'll keep on pampering you more and more~
May your mission today be successful, and may you return safe and sound... All right, Master. Everything is bound to go swimmingly!
I-is there really nothing I can do to help...? I can't believe you'd just leave me with nothing to do like this... There's no way this should be allowed... Masterrrr...
Master, let's check on this report together... You can't see the report because my chest is in the way? Oh goodness... I'm sorry...
Master? Whenever, wherever, please leave everything to me~!
Oh Master, you~ Heehee♡
Master, I've received word that there's a new mission for you. Though, it looks like you were already aware of it... I-it was Dido who informed you about it?!
Master, allow me to take your coat~ Here's a towel, a warm cup of coffee, and a hug from me~
I'll say it once again. Ahem... An elegant victory, just the way your maid does it!
I won't let you be swallowed up by the sea! Grab my hand!

Thank you for waiting, my dear Master. Heehee, you seem pretty tired... Hah! I'll pet you on the head today. Good work, good work~ I'm not going anywhere, so just sit tight and let my affection warm you up~!

lines.line: *Pats thighs* Master, you poor thing~ Look how hard you've been working~ Hehe, hurry and come here so that I can pamper you~
*Pats thighs* Master, you poor thing~ Look how hard you've been working~ Hehe, hurry and come here so that I can pamper you~
Goodness, what a troublesome master you are. Where have you been? I've been waiting to continue cleaning your ears~
This room is brimming with Dragon Empery style. Hmm... I'm not exactly sure how to explain it, but it sure is nice and relaxing.
Umm... Hmm... Oh no, I still haven't finished sewing the outfit Aurora requested... Dear me...
My, someone is at the door... Oh, Master?! Please don't move, I'm not done working on your ears yet...
Alright, Master~ I'll be cleaning your other ear now, so please turn around... Eek?!
Ah, Master, please don't move around so much.
Ahhn...♡
The rewards have arrived without any issues. That's a relief~
Your mail's here~ Please make sure you check it afterwards~♪
*Pats thighs* Master, I'm right over here~ Heehee, you must be exhausted, right~
There's no pampering in store for you bunch, only punishment!
Now, please allow me to continue pampering you once we return~
Tis a pleasure to see you, Master. I am delighted to be your partner for today. ...Oh, I was just trying to sound prim and proper! You don't need to look at me with such pity in your eyes!
Tis a pleasure to see you, Master. I am delighted to be your partner for today. ...Oh, I was just trying to sound prim and proper! You don't need to look at me with such pity in your eyes!
Master, why don't you take the lead tonight? Heehee~

Ugh... We haven't even done that much walking, but my feet are already sore... Changing into an outfit you're not used to isn't the easiest thing in the world. I wonder if Sirius and Black Prince are hanging in there...
By the way, Master, who did you invite today? Umm, it doesn't particularly concern me, but Dido absolutely wanted to know.
I wonder why Eagle is holding back so much? We went through the trouble of making all this delicious food, so...
Isn't Sirius absolutely breathtaking in that dress? I know you've been staring at her too, Commander. Heehee~
Did you want to shake your feet out as well?
This outfit makes me pretty irresistible, doesn't it?
The letter is right~ over~ here~! You don't see it?
The commission team is back, Commander. Ehehe.

As you can see, today's theme... is a seaside pampering, or something like that~ Heehee. I know you're no stranger to the sea, Commander, but today, we're here to play, not work. Just take it easy, and unwind~♪

As you can see, today's theme... is a seaside pampering, or something like that~ Heehee. I know you're no stranger to the sea, Commander, but today, we're here to play, not work. Just take it easy, and unwind~♪
Master~ Ahaha, that's right~♪ I'm always ecstatic to come to the beach~
Phew... This salty sea breeze feels wonderful, Master. Next time, I should bring the other ladies here to... Hmm... Do you have any ideas for what we should do? Maybe light a bonfire?
Eskimo, don't go overboard with your pranks...
Master, it's shallow over here~ ...Hwaah?! T-that was a huge wave just now...
Clear skies and a refreshing breeze... The perfect weather for pampering you, Master. Wouldn't you agree~?
I'd love to come back here every year with you, Master.
The girls of the commissions team have been swallowed by a whirlpool, you know... Just kidding~♪ Look, they've returned already.
For the safety and continued victory of my Master, I'll head out!
I'll have you know, I'm not actually bad at fighting. Heehee~
Hai Tien-class protected cruiser - Hai Tien.
I am Hai Tien, a Hai Tien-class protected cruiser from the Dragon Empery. There's not much to say about my past except perhaps... that fate was unkind to me.
Pleased to meet you, Commander. I am Hai Tien of the Dragon Empery. As a newcomer who knows not the customs of this place, please bear with me should I make any blunders.
"Time is worth its measure in gold." Commander, if you don't start your work by now, you'll end up wasting the entire day.
"It is easier to relate with the despair of a wilting flower than the beauty of a blooming flower." ...Do you think I'm being too sentimental?
Looks like Hai Chi is just as energetic as always. Oh... Is she a bother to you, Commander?
I left a manuscript of poetry on your desk, Commander. If you would please peruse it when you have the time.
What shall we do for dinner? Hmm... How about some mapo tofu?
Hm? I feel perfectly fine though?
Oh, my apologies... I was thinking about the book of poems I was reading earlier. What can I do for you?
H-how shameless of you...!
Commander, please make sure you remember to complete all your missions today.
Good work completing your missions. I'm sure the rewards will be great as well.
Every word and letter written on this paper is a deep thought from far away...
Commander, good work in your operation. I have prepared some nutritious tremella lotus soup for you. Please dig in... Um, did I make it too sweet...?
It looks like the girls have returned from their commissions. Make sure you show them your gratitude.
"To do a good job, a craftman must first have the right tools." Thank you very much, Commander.
Is the only way to end war... through more war?
"War stains the land for a thousand miles, bullets salting the earth in its wake." ...When will the flames of war finally be snuffed out?
I see... "Even horses can stumble."
Even mountains will move before an unbreakable spirit!
The fog's rolling in...?!
Please do not talk to me. I wish to be alone.
The beautiful part about poems is not only their rhymes and coupling, but also the many thoughts hidden between the lines... Do you have an interest in the path of poetry, Commander?
There are many forms of poetry, including the bold and uninhibited "Boundless Waves" style, as well as the gentle and reserved "Country Jade" style. Which do you prefer, Commander?
*Sigh*... Oh, my apologies, Commander. I'm perfectly fine. It's just that... I recently read some excellently-composed poems about "reminiscence." I suppose I found them to be... extremely relatable.
As a commander, the winds of war may one day take you far, far away... But no matter where you are, please remember -- we will always be together under the same night sky.

"Being able to find one's soulmate in the flowing river of time is the greatest blessing in life." Wait, um, that means we're more than just good friends.... Err, umm, I'm okay with that too... I mean, wait, give me a second to sort out my thoughts... P-please, just a moment!
I swear, I will repay this kindness someday!
Don't worry, I'll be fine.

ex.line: Let what should be done today not burden you tomorrow. Commander, let's both strive to reject procrastination.

The Dragon Empery has produced countless beautiful works that evoke the imagery of love, such as red beans symbolizing fidelity, and the ever-famous mandarin ducks... Hehe, maybe we should recite some love poem together, Commander?
Hmph... I'm not a child anymore...
Whether you'd like to discuss some poetry or simply chat for a bit, I'd love to spend some time with you.
Ah, um, at least let me prepare myself...
It would appear that the winds of fortune favor us today. Hehe~

It is quite natural for me to be in high spirits. After all, my beloved is by my side, your warmth imbuing me with a happiness that overflows without cessation. What cause could I possibly have to be displeased? And just like me, I hope that as long as I remain by your side, your precious smile will never fade away~♪

lines.line: What a serendipitous meeting this is, Commander. I was simply searching for a place where I could leisurely enjoy my poetry manuscript. Since fate has brought both of us here, why don't we accompany each other for a while?

What a serendipitous meeting this is, Commander. I was simply searching for a place where I could leisurely enjoy my poetry manuscript. Since fate has brought both of us here, why don't we accompany each other for a while?
Good morning, Commander. It's still early in the morning; why not rest a bit more?
Just looking at all the carp in the pool, full of vigor and vitality, seems to uplift my spirit as well.
I finished writing my couplet for the Lunar New Year, and Ying Swei is preparing to transcribe it. She even said, "We made it through without relying on Chao Ho." Looks like the two get along well.
I've prepared some splendid dishes for the upcoming Spring Festival banquet. Sweet and sour fish, braised pork feet, and dongpo pork... Yep, they all look good!
You'll hold this for me? Why, thank you very much.
My, it looks like this drunkard has set their sights on something other than alcohol.

"Lotus flowers blooming in a clear pond, clouds flowing through the air, a sage descends from their dwelling, playing music and dancing about." ...Hehe, Hai Chi's dance is something worth appreciating. If that sounds interesting to you, why don't we go watch her together?

Through dance of gossamer silk, the apsaras' grace soars... Oh, I'm simply reciting something I just happened to pick up on. What do you think, Commander? If I've captured your attention, I suppose this was worth our while~

Through dance of gossamer silk, the apsaras' grace soars... Oh, I'm simply reciting something I just happened to pick up on. What do you think, Commander? If I've captured your attention, I suppose this was worth our while~
Commander, umm... Next, I would like to humbly offer you a dance... Sorry, but, umm... I'm still a bit nervous about this...
I know a thing or two about playing the pipa, but holding this position is rather difficult... not to mention, embarrassing...
Huh? Y-you want me to try making this pose as well? Um, Hai Chi, I'm not sure about that... Can't we go with something a bit easier?
If only I were a real apsaras who could fly freely through the skies... Hmm, maybe those are the kinds of wishes that gave birth to airplanes.
Eep! Why'd the wind pick up all of a sudden?! ...Come to think of it, this apsaras outfit is rather... breezy... *blushes*
I put quite a bit of time and effort into making these hair ornaments. They're pretty, aren't they?
Umm, I'll be alright. I can endure this. If you agree that I'm not a weak little girl, please put up with my wilfulness a bit longer.
I-it's not very courteous of you to take advantage of another's vulnerability...
Hai Chi's special dance lessons should've helped out a little bit... What do you think, Commander?

Sorry to keep you waiting. It took quite some time to prepare my dress as well as this lantern... Yes, when you said we would go on a "night stroll," I made some preparations in accordance to what my ancestors once did. Now then, shall we set off?

Sorry to keep you waiting. It took quite some time to prepare my dress as well as this lantern... Yes, when you said we would go on a "night stroll," I made some preparations in accordance to what my ancestors once did. Now then, shall we set off?
The scenery tonight is wonderful, is it not? The two of us sneaking off under the hustle and bustle of the festivities to enjoy some alone time... Doesn't it feel a bit like a tryst?
Strange rumors seem to have surfaced that "a ghostly woman has appeared in the forest, floating upon a strange-sounding wind"... Um, Commander, why are you staring at me like that...?

"Upon the water's surface, algae intersects with shadows of bamboo and cypress." Gods and ghosts aside, an outing during a night like this is certainly an experience to remember. And what's more, you're here too...
Vampires, Frankenstein, and witches... No matter where you go, there will always be so many legends of oddities and monsters. Isn't that interesting?
So basically, if the kids say "trick or treat" to me, I have to give them candy? I see... Do you think these shaobing will suffice?
H-hold hands...?
S-so this is what you were after the entire time, Commander?!
Today is a day to rest our weary wings, so why don't we set aside work for the time being?
Commander, need a little pick-me-up? I happened to make some extra shaobing earlier-- Oh, they're too sweet?
Welcome back, Commander. I made some tasty pastries for you. ...Huh? You want the one in my chest? Th-that doesn't count.
Welcome back, Commander. I made some tasty pastries for you. ...Huh? You want the one in my chest? Th-that doesn't count.
Today's afternoon tea time will combine crispy pastries and sencha-brewed green tea... Phew, I'm already excited for it.
The old philosophers tell us to eat finely ground grain and finely chopped meat. In other words, all foods - including pastries - should be healthy and intricate.
Did you know that being "not TOO sweet" is one of the highest praises for sweets? Heehee, do my pastries suit your palate, Commander?
"Even if your teeth fall out, eat pastries without reserve." Never be ashamed to enjoy what you like, Commander.
Umm, you're not supposed to knead me like I'm dough...
Oh... Are you still hungry?
Th-that isn't mochi...
You have unfinished missions, you know. Do your best to finish them, and I'll give you a reward.
Heehee, you did your missions! How about I feed you my newest pastry in return?♪
Thanks for your hard work today, Commander. I brought pastries. ...Oh? The sweetness level is perfect? I'm glad to hear that♪
"Delicious foods are common, but a true friend is rare. Even more, a lover you can spend the good times with..." Hm? That look on your face... Heehee, it looks like you understand how I feel.

"Dragon-shaped jade comb in hand, tied is her hair with gold ribbons and phoenix's hairpin" ...Thank you for waiting for me, Commander. Long have I dreamt for this moment to come true... Please allow me to remain by your side forevermore. N-now then, I believe the next thing for us to do is... c-consumate... *blushes*

"Dragon-shaped jade comb in hand, tied is her hair with gold ribbons and phoenix's hairpin" ...Thank you for waiting for me, Commander. Long have I dreamt for this moment to come true... Please allow me to remain by your side forevermore. N-now then, I believe the next thing for us to do is... c-consumate... *blushes*
You're here, Commander. To commemorate this auspicious day, I've brought some mutual-joy cakes. I hope you find them to your liking.

At some point, I started to find myself filled with happiness whenever I was around you. Perhaps this is the true essence of "sharing drinks, holding hands, growing old together, so that the years flow by harmoniously."
Commander, is there anything you'd like for dinner? ...Hm? You'll go with my recommendation? Well, umm... How about something nourishing, like oysters, or mutton?
Umm... I r-recently wrote a short story, and the main characters are the two of us... W-would you like to give it a read?

"At dawn I gaze at the sky and at dusk, the clouds. Whether in motion or at rest, I find your countenance on my mind." ...Huh? A t-translation? Oh, umm... it means, that I, umm... that I'm thinking about you at all times! *blushes*
Hmm... Commander, I wonder why you look so brave and gallant today... P-perhaps it is because I am at your side?
You want to hold hands with me? Then, umm... Please do so, firmly.
C-Commander, I, I'm ready for this...!
Commander, don't forget to finish your work. I'll be right here to help you.
Have you finished your missions? I'll help you record down the rewards.
Welcome back, Commander. I've prepared a nutritious medicinal decoction of mountain yam and goji berries for you... but this time, I made it sweet enough to suit your tastes!
"A war to end all wars" ...Even if this idea is futile, it is all I can do to protect the people I love!
"An end to all wars, when peace prevails over the seas." The future you desire will come to pass, and I shall witness it with you.
I already promised... to never give up.

"Pity unto the mandarin ducks, cherished are the years. The earth aged, the skies desolate. Yet nevertheless, life after life, together they come, to fly as a pair." ...Commander, do you understand the meaning of my words?
Hai Tien-class protected cruiser - Hai Chi.

I'm Hai Chi, Hai Tien-class protected cruiser number two. With how different we are, you almost wouldn't believe Hai Tien and I are sisters. She likes staying indoors and reading, while I prefer getting out and going places! "Wiser is she who travels ten thousand miles than she who reads ten thousand books," after all!

You're the Commander? Hahah, I've heard all about you! Oh right, I forgot to introduce myself! I'm Hai Chi, Hai Tien-class cruiser. My two favorite things are traditional opera and going on trips! ...But, let's cut the chit-chat. You'll learn more about me soon enough anyway!
"A sharp mind is honed through diligence and dulled by indolence." Commander, you'd better get ready to give it your all today!
Are you a cat person, Commander? Cats are actually quite clever. If you're ever struggling to choose between two things, just let a cat decide. The results may surprise you!
Do you have any interest in Dragon Empery's traditional opera? In that case, I'd be glad to show you an example. What sort of piece would you want me to perform?
My sister's pretty reserved, but I don't shy away from speaking my mind. Comes as naturally to me as breathing!

The Dragon Empery has a proverb that goes, "it is never too late for the noble to take revenge," but personally, I disagree! If you don't set wrongdoers straight right away, they'll only be emboldened!
You like my hair ornament? Thanks, but no touching, please.
Commander, if there's anything on your mind, just say it to me straight away!
Oh, you are so gonna get an earful from my sister for this!
You've got new missions! I'll do the navigating!
Mission complete! Might I interest you in a dramatic performance during breaktime?
Commander! A horseback messenger brought this - a letter for you!
Welcome back, Commander! Did the sortie take you far from home? Did anything interesting happen? Come on, I wanna know!
Those girls you sent out have returned! I've readied a small meal for them. An army can't march on an empty stomach, you know!
"Spare no expense. Even a dull blade can shine bright," right?
Forward in formation! "Let not a single scrap of armor remain of our enemies!"
When I take the reins, none may stand before me!
Bweh... I'll get you for this!
Hi-yah! We'll scatter you like petals in the current!
Gah... Don't you dare underestimate me!
Hmph. Everything you've done and said, I'll hold against you forever!
I wonder what gift I should buy for Hai Tien on my next trip... Wait, I've got it! The same as usual - a yummy snack!
If I'll ever have to make a tough life decision, I'll face it with solemn courage and thrust forward, like a river current cleaving through land! ....Hoo! Haah!

We have a saying in the Dragon Empery, "the time spent sharpening your axe is made back multifold on the job." In other words, taking some time to rest makes you more productive in the end! So, with that in mind... How about we go on a journey right now?
If I've put you off with my habit to say whatever pops into my mind, then... sorry! Then again, you've known me for so long you must be used to it by now. Right? Hehehe~

Oh my gosh! Is this for me? Hehehe~ Know that you're in safe hands with me. I promise you're not gonna regret this decision! If you didn't know, I'm the world's best housewife, bar none! Now, with our vows made, let's get started packing our belongings and go on a productivity-boosting honeymoon!
Commander, thank you for the gift! Hmm... I wonder how I can return the favor...
Stay focused, sis!

ex.line: Let's get to work, Commander! The faster we get it done, the sooner we can do other stuff! It's as easy as that!
Commander! You should definitely come watch my next spear dance performance! I guarantee your jaw will drop when you see it! Hehehe~

"Reward the righteous and punish the wicked, and you will live neither indebted nor in regret." That's my motto! You can't go easy on wrongdoers - they'll only keep pushing the boundary of what they can get away with!
Being upfront about your feelings is good, b-but I'd appreciate at least a little restraint!
Where'd you go this time, Commander? The stories about your journeys are as interesting to me as dramatic operas!

lines.line: Look, Commander! I've become a goddess from the Dragon Empery's folklore! Hehehe! Let me perform for you a song and dance number I just learned!
Look, Commander! I've become a goddess from the Dragon Empery's folklore! Hehehe! Let me perform for you a song and dance number I just learned!
Welcome, Commander! I'll be performing a Dragon Empery dance at the port later today. Wanna come watch?
For this part, I guess I should pose like... this? Ah, you're back, Commander? Perfect! Could you watch for a sec and tell me if my moves are on-point?
This act - known as the "behind-back pipa" - takes serious skill. You can't pull it off with half-baked effort!
Allow me to play you a song on my pipa! Full disclosure though: I only started learning it a while ago. If something sounds off, don't be afraid to point it out!
Struggling with poetic rhymes? Ask my sis, she can produce ten verses without even thinking about it! No, seriously!
You've fallen for my goddess-like looks, haven't you~? Hehehe, it's okay to come out and admit it~
Ugh, Commander! This is NOT how you treat a goddess!
"Clouds of fog sail the air as pond lotuses bloom. The mountain recluse descends from the sky to play a melody." My sis composed this little poem on the spur of the moment and I wrote it down!
Allen M. Sumner-class destroyer - Bristol, Hull Number DD-857.

My history? Eh, it's honestly pretty unremarkable... Anyway, lemme tell you a story! Deep under the sea, there once lived a legendary monster that was as long as several school buses. When a ship sailed over it, the monster would open its jaws and swallow it whole...
The name is Bristol, Eagle Union destroyer! Well met, Commander! This port must be home to many mysteries... I will make it my duty to solve each and every one! Heheheh!
Weapons check complete - I'm ready to go on an adventure! Get your mystery-solving gear on, Commander!
Curious about my little helper? Hehehe. Well, Ingraham built it to assist me in exploration. Its name is Data 857!
Show the Commander what an awesome robot you are, Data 857! Let's start with your best feature - replay mode! List the results of our last investigation!
I was told your desk can transform and your bookshelf has a secret mechanism... I'm disappointed neither of those are true.
The forecast saaays... Awesome! It'll be sunny tomorrow! Can't go mystery-solving in the rain, you know!
Sure, praise me for my investigator skills all you want~
My uniform looks pretty, doesn't it?
Are you possessed by an evil entity?! Then I have no choice... I've got to subdue you for everyone's safety!
New missions are in, Commander! Maybe one of them involves investigating something!
Mission complete! I'll write up a report of my findings right away!
New mail? Could it be... a request to look into a paranormal case?
Now's the perfect opportunity to look into the Commander, one of the port's many myster- Oh! Welcome back! Err, I'm not up to anything at all! Not yet, at least!
A commission's been completed! Data 857, go see if the girls brought back any strange goodies. And watch out for k-kelp!
Firepower upgrade complete! New depths to explore are now within my reach!
Bristol Investigation Team, setting off!
Crushing victory! Heheh! Now we can keep investigating in peace!
Fiddlesticks! Agghh... No regrets...
Your biggest mistake was underestimating this investigator!
Zoinks! Don't put out my light!
Hmph... Our adventure went so badly all because you went and got the kelp curse put on you!
The Dragon Empery's a land teeming with folklore and myths... Next time I see my Empery friends, I wanna hear all about them!
If that'll be all, do you mind if I go for a stroll around port? ...Awesome! Come along, Data 857!
Are you scared of the dark, Commander? Then just stick close to me, and my lantern will shoo the dark away! You've nothing to fear - I've trained for this!
There are more mysteries in the world than Data 857 and I can ever hope to solve... It's a good thing I have you, Commander! We might never solve EVERY mystery, but together, we can solve a lot more!
Hehehe! Now we're mystery-solving partners! We'll go wherever there are clues to be found, be they at sea, in the skies, or on land!
With this, my investigations will be a breeze! Thanks!
Hehehe! Run a trial on this new gear, pretty please!
The next point of interest is where our adventure starts!

ex.line: Investigation complete! Nothing seems out of order in the office. Welcome back, Commander!
Kelp is really gross to me... Never mind eating it, I can't even touch the stuff!
Data 857 and I are ready to go, just give us the word! ...It's not time just yet? Fine... I'll check my gear again in the meanwhile!
Feels like you just charged me up with energy! Your touch is like magic, Commander~
My tie's all crooked? Thanks for telling me!
S-so that's your favorite part of me, huh...
Nice going out there, Commander! Did you come across any places warranting an investigation?
There's... kelp on my head... Agghh... No regrets...

lines.line: Happy Lunar New Year, Commander! The time's finally come to look into the age-old legends from the Dragon Empery! The truth behind these legends is bound to be as fascinating as the legends themselves!

Happy Lunar New Year, Commander! The time's finally come to look into the age-old legends from the Dragon Empery! The truth behind these legends is bound to be as fascinating as the legends themselves!
Investigator task for today: gather anecdotes about Dragon Empery legends and folklore! But that's for after I've enjoyed the festivities.
Sorry for dropping in unannounced, Tai Yuan. I was just wondering, could I borrow some books from you again? Cool, thanks a bunch!
Assuming a legend is a story embellished by people from many generations ago, then what is the kernel of truth that inspired it all?
Where's Data 857? Ingraham's doing maintenance on it. The little bot deserves a break too once in a while.
If the legends are true, then that makes this fish - the Kun - the biggest aquatic monster to ever exist!
Allen picked these clothes out for me! Hehehe~ How do I look in them?
Whoa! Hey! Don't startle me like that!
Cooper, I could use more soap liquid! ...Thanks! Come blow bubbles with me! Hehehe~
Heheh! You're finally here, Commander! My current investigation is into this thing in my... Correction - into that thing that's chasing me! We gotta run, like, now!
Heheh! You're finally here, Commander! My current investigation is into this thing in my... Correction - into that thing that's chasing me! We gotta run, like, now!
You done warming up yet, Commander?! Then we gotta pick up the pace and run!
We could shake the horseman off easily, but the fun lies in staying just close enough to preserve the tension! Come on, Commander!
They say the horseman goes away if you give him a pumpkin in place of a head... but where are we gonna find a pumpkin? We're better off just running!
Commander, I'll give you this... head once we're back safely! If you want it, pick up the pace!
What? Is my hat coming off?
You want to hold this for me? It's a lot heavier than it looks.
Sorry, but my hands are full so we'll have to do this later!
What? A new mission? This is NOT the time or place for that!
A mission's been completed? Heehee! I just got done refueling my lantern, too!
A new letter? Data 857, keep the horseman busy for a bit!
*pant*... *pant*... Out of the frying pan and into the fire... You okay, Commander?
A commission's done? Alright, then I'll distract the horseman and buy you some time!
Aw yeah! My DEX leveled up!

You can have this head once we're back safely! Also, Data 857 and I are gonna write a memoir to commemorate this magnificent investigation, then... Hm? Don't jinx it by saying that? Heh! I've done this long enough to know how to survive!
Seaplane carrier - Chen Hai.

I am the Dragon Empery's first seaplane carrier, Chen Hai. I've received many other "firsts," but those aren't exactly honors. I still have a long way to go before I can match up to real aircraft carriers.

So you're the brains behind the operation here, huh? ...Hehe, I finally get to meet the legendary Commander face-to-face. It's an honor to be able to work with you. I trust you'll live up to your lofty expectations?
How's the port supposed to run when the decisionmaker's seat is vacant? C'mon, sit down already.
If you're not busy, then... come here, let's play a match of Go? No need to have a turn timer or keep track of winners and losers. Let's just kill some time, hehe.
Are you deep in thought about something? Or... just spacing out? Oh, I see. You're trying to look cute, hehe.
My eyes look a bit scary when I'm thinking about something? ...How do you know that isn't just one of my many faces?
Feign strength if you must, feign weakness if you must. Whatever the case, do not ever let your enemy see through your trump card.
I must say... this behavior is rather unexpected.
What's the matter? ...You're not here just to have a little chat, are you?
You certainly have guts.
Don't forget to finish up your missions. When it comes back to bite you in the ass, it'll already be too late.
Mission complete. Now that you've removed another obstacle in front of you, what will your next move be?
A competent commander should never neglect potentially important information.
Good job on making it back in one piece. I went over your last battle, and while it was excellent overall, there are many areas that can still be improved... So let's review those right now?
The commission fleet is back, huh... Increasing our stockpiles, replenishing our forces, adding another card to our hand. A good play indeed.
I prefer being the one pulling the strings, but fine.
The moment the enemies let their guard down-- is the moment you strike!
The enemy has lost their will to fight. Heh, guess that's all they had to show.
Ugh, just one move behind... While I hate conceding defeat, there won't be a next time. Hehe...
Exploit their weaknesses, and catch them by surprise!
Nothing ventured, nothing gained...!
Seems like I set the bar too high for you.
The more you win, the harder it'll be for you to review your own moves objectively. Even if you're winning, never forget to continue studying your past experiences.
War isn't fair. Backstab your enemy. Think two or three steps ahead of them, read their every move. Then... BAM! Victory comes just like that. Hehe.
I'm starting to get bored of our regular old sessions of Go. Let's spice things up a little bit... I know just the thing. How about, if you can take a game off me, I'll grant you one wish.
Oh my, how could a seasoned strategist like me make such a silly blunder... Hehe, in any case, congratulations on your win. As promised, I'll grant you your one wish. Anything goes. Hehehe...

What's this? ...Hehe, I didn't expect this sneak attack from you... Or rather, you're the only person who could pull something like this off. Looking at it that way, maybe I had predicted this all along... right?
This gift comes from the heart, doesn't it? I shall graciously accept it.
My, some familiar faces.

ex.line: Oh my, you seem to be quite energetic today. I was hoping to be able to bemuse myself with your sleepy expression, but alas, it was not to be. Hehe~
The game of Go has already spread far beyond the Dragon Empery. It is a pity, however, that regional variations in rules make it difficult to thoroughly enjoy a session.
Not all surprise attacks must be executed from behind. For example, if I suddenly get right up to your face like this -- doesn't that get your heart racing? Hehe~
Even if we're just making small talk, the most mundane of moments can become splashed with brilliant colors.
It appears you are in need of some "special discipline."
Even divine beings are not omnipotent... For example, look, you've forgotten to finish a mission.

You'd like to challenge me to another match today? Very well, but let's up the ante this time. The loser is responsible for deciding how the two of us will spend our time together after the match. I also would like to take my hands off the reins every now and then, so I'll try my best to win. Hehe~

lines.line: You're here, Commander, just as promised. How do you like the atmosphere in here? Hehe, take a seat and enjoy the tea slowly. After all, we have plenty of time~
You're here, Commander, just as promised. How do you like the atmosphere in here? Hehe, take a seat and enjoy the tea slowly. After all, we have plenty of time~
Now that you're here, please make yourself at home. Don't worry, Commander, this one's on me.
Did my collection catch your eye? Hehe, very well, there's a lot more of that in the back room. I wouldn't mind showing you around if you'd like~
I already have a worthy opponent in front of me, but too bad we don't have a Go board and some pieces to play with... Ah, but worry not, I'll fetch them later.
Commander, what's your favorite collection here? Porcelain? Jade? Calligraphy? Or perhaps... this entire estate? Hehe~

Hai Chi's flower spear and Chao Ho's solo dance... Tonight's performance will be spectacular indeed. It would be nice to have someone accompanying me who has a fine eye for the arts... Do you understand what I'm getting at, Commander?
Do be mindful of who the host is, and who the guest is~
Would you like to try this rotary dial phone? You might not be used to operating something like it, so try to be careful not to make mistakes.
It would appear that you need a reminder as to who the host is here.
Commander, you're currently my guest. The fact that you're still preoccupied with work does not impress me.
Oh my, when did you complete your missions? Not too shabby, Commander.
A letter arriving at a time like this? Talk about spoiling the mood...
"Yes, excellent. Just stick to the plan, just as I told you." Oh, welcome back. That phone call...? It's a secret~
Do you know what I value most of everything inside this room? It's not the luxurious interior or my opulent collections - Indeed, it is none other than you, Commander~♪
Oh my, if it isn't the Commander... Have you also come to escape the heat? What a serendipitous meeting... Or, did you perhaps have some other goal in mind? Heehee...
Oh my, if it isn't the Commander... Have you also come to escape the heat? What a serendipitous meeting... Or, did you perhaps have some other goal in mind? Heehee...
During this moment of respite, set aside all your plans and calculations. Once you've rested sufficiently, you can always pick up where you left off.
Few things are more blissful than a refreshing soak on a sweltering day. Your clothes might get wet, but... don't you think it's well worth it?
Come with an open heart, and leave fulfilled. Now that you've freed yourself from the shackles of the daily grind, clear your mind and enjoy this occasion to the fullest~
Hai Chi? I'm sure she's playing in the water with some friends she just met. Did you want to go look for her?
Ripples in the water, the glow of the autumnal sun, and the flickering of rainbows... If Hai Tien were here, I'm sure I would be hearing one of her poems.
What's the matter? If it's about work, let's save it for later, alright?
Oh my, Commander. You're a bit lacking in self-control~
You're completely soaked with sweat... I see, the sweltering heat outside must've taken its toll on you. Come in, and cool off.

...So, do you have any plans today? No games, no bartering. Just the two of us - alone on a day off. You have all the initiative in your hands, Commander. You're not going to let it go to waste, are you? Hehe...

Oh, Commander, have you come to see me? Yes, as you can see, I've been studying the art of embroidery- Just like Go, it helps me organize my thoughts and see things from a broader perspective. Why don't you give it a try as well, Commander? Heehee~

Oh, Commander, have you come to see me? Yes, as you can see, I've been studying the art of embroidery- Just like Go, it helps me organize my thoughts and see things from a broader perspective. Why don't you give it a try as well, Commander? Heehee~
Welcome back, Commander. Hm? What kind of embroidery am I working on right now? Pardon me for keeping it a secret. You'll see as soon as I'm done.
Maybe playing Go in a serene place like this will allow me to hone my skills even further... Commander, if you have time later, would you mind having a match with me?
"Beautiful embroidery draws the orioles from their willowy perches" ...How profound. I still have a long way to go when it comes to this art.
The art of embroidery requires the patience to make precise stitches, just as strategizing requires the patience to make precise decisions...
You haven't changed one bit...
Hmm? Are you interested in my Three-Azures embroidery?
You still require some work when it comes to self-discipline.
Looks like you've completed your mission with no issues. Please rest here for a moment. I'll have your gift ready shortly.
Good work, Commander. Once I'm done with my handiwork here, I will play for you a song of victory.

The embroidery I hold here is my "gift" to you. I'm not good at expressing my emotions, so I'd like to take the opportunity to do so using this handkerchief... Hm? You'll carry it with you at all times? Heehee. I'm overjoyed to hear that.

With the red veil lifted, join me and let us sip of this nuptial wine to celebrate our union. As for how we are to spend the rest of this day... I leave that to your discretion, Commander. What say you?

With the red veil lifted, join me and let us sip of this nuptial wine to celebrate our union. As for how we are to spend the rest of this day... I leave that to your discretion, Commander. What say you?
I have been expecting you, Commander... This is a touch different from how I usually carry myself... Heheh, I am glad you like it.
"May I be your star, and you be my moon, our lights shining bright together every night..." Have my feelings gotten through to you, Commander?
I have simulated many possible futures with you by my side, Commander... But the way my heart is racing now defies all of my calculations.
I once thought myself an unrivaled strategist. Yet I now realize my most brilliant scheme of all... was making your heart throb for me alone...
You are allowed to lift this red veil only once... Because what comes after that is what truly matters.
My only wish is for us to grow old together, hand in hand...
A strategist such as I must never be taken off guard... But this time, it's my turn to be on the offensive.

Welcome back, Commander... A strategist such as I ought to act with moderation, but I could not hold back the desire to see what face you would make when you lay eyes on me... And yes, I saw just what I expected I would. Heehee.

They say the wise must never allow themselves to be held captive by love. I used to agree... but now, nothing brings me greater joy than planning the rest of my life by your side. I look forward to our future together, my Commander... My beloved.
Just as promised, I present myself before you in a brand new form. Heehee... Since we have plenty of time, why don't you come take a seat, enjoy the fragrance of tea with me, and envision our future?
