Just as promised, I present myself before you in a brand new form. Heehee... Since we have plenty of time, why don't you come take a seat, enjoy the fragrance of tea with me, and envision our future?
Hmm...? My, it looks like I've finally caught you dozing off, Commander. Heehee. So, how was it? Did you have sweet dreams? If you don't mind, I'd love it if you could share what you saw with me~
Heehee... With so many reliable allies here, victory or defeat start to seem less important to me than the contents of tonight's menu.
In retrospect, triumphing over others and triumphing over yourself are two completely different things... Simply scratching the surface of my "self's" limits was enough to give me an awakening.
I would like to see with my own eyes what kind of world the peaceful paradise you envision is like.

A world in turmoil calls for a schemer with a number of tricks up her sleeve. A world at peace, however, calls for honest, hardworking builders. When that day comes, I will take my leave and retire to the mountains. Such a life suits me better. Haha...
Commander, care for a round of Go? Just treat it as some light entertainment on the board game known as "life," okay? Heehee.
Ahaha... I can't believe I'm being manhandled in such a frivolous manner... Commander, I'll have to extract some "compensation" from you in return~
A triumphant return. Your commanding back there was simply unparalleled. Now then, Commander, please unwind while enjoying this tea.
Phew... Finally, peace and quiet can return once more.
Haha... You may have bested me fair and square this time... But next time, your luck won't last.

You know, I've been thinking... If I really went to live in the mountains, I'd like the two of us to find a nice place with beautiful scenery, build a home of our own, and grow old together in a peaceful world. We'd enjoy tea between rounds of Go, spending our time leisurely without a worry in sight... It might be a bit early to contemplate these things, but I look forward to that day with all my heart.
Project 48-class destroyer - Kiev
My name is Kiev. I was to be a Project 48-class destroyer, but I was never born for a number of reasons... I'm glad to have you as my first-ever Commander.
I'm Kiev, Project 48-class destroyer of the Northern Parliament. From now on, I'll be assisting you with all manner of things, Commander... W-was that, umm, a good enough introduction?
Commander, umm... Is it fine if I wait for you outside the office next time, too?
Are you free, Commander? Do you wanna... hang out?
Huff, puff... There... Ah, I just thought I'd write something on the window.
I'll show no mercy to anyone that tries to harm you. Assisting you and protecting you are one and the same to me.
Growing flowers are way beyond me. The only plants I can be trusted with are cacti... They can survive even if you neglect them.
I love it when you pet me. I need more... Please?
I wanna come closer... Is that fine?
My chest feels... so warm...
This mission sounds tough... Can you handle it, Commander?
Someone should claim these mission rewards... Is it fine if I do it?
There's mail for you. I think it's important. Are you fine with me fetching it?
Commander! Oh, uhh... I know you're safe and sound, I just wanted to see you again as soon as possible... That's fine, right?
Our commission comrades are back. Seeing all their smiling faces makes me envious...
We can't forego routine maintenance and upgrades. Right?
There's no ice I cannot break through!
All foes are down. Commander, did I, um... do alright?
Abandoning my comrades to save myself... I refuse to do that!
We're fighting on MY terms now!
I'll stop at nothing for the Commander...!
Am I the cause of your sadness? Would you cheer up if I simply... disappeared?
Do you think I'm cold? Or unapproachable? That's something I want to change about myself, but I don't know how...
More people are willing to talk to me than before... I think that's thanks to you, Commander. Thank you.
I've made many new friends with your help... But you're my first, and still closest friend. I want to get even closer to you. Are you fine with that?
Whenever we're apart, or whenever you're about to leave, my heart aches like it's being torn in two... I want to always, always be with you. Will you stay with me?
To think I'm taking an oath with the one I love... I'm overjoyed, blissful, warm inside, thawing like snow under the sun into a puddle... Commander, is it fine if I... melt in your arms?
I've always wanted this... Can I really have it?
We fight together, for the Commander.

ex.line: I will always be right here, waiting for you, Commander. You're fine with that, I hope?
Are you free, Commander? I could... kill some time. Are you fine with hanging out?
Huff, puff... There... I wrote your name and mine in the fog on the window. This looks fine, right?
I never wanna become a cactus. If I could grow in spite of neglect, then I worry people would actually abandon me...
Umm... (*blushes*)
New missions... They're not so tough when I have you.
Are you... gonna go claim the mission rewards? Would it be fine if I went with you?
You're back by my side again... Phew. Now I feel fine.
Our commission comrades are back. They told me about some interesting things they saw... Do you wanna know, Commander?
Just have to fight... Everything will go fine!
Please never leave me behind. I promise I will keep you safe.
I want to be the only one for you. Of all the girls close to you, I want to be your most faithful one. When you look at all of us, I want to be the only one you really see... That's fine, right?

lines.line: Seeing you here puts me at ease. I know this stakeout will go smoothly as long as you're here. Mhm, all is fine.
Seeing you here puts me at ease. I know this stakeout will go smoothly as long as you're here. Mhm, all is fine.
Everything is in order. Ready to set off, Commander?
My black clothes let me blend in, but my silver hair does the opposite... The net result is that I stand out.
There's no one suspicious in sight... But we must keep our eyes peeled.
I feel safe when I'm with you, and I don't wanna leave your side... It's fine if we stick together, right?
Wonder how it's going for the others. Kronshtadt said to maintain radio silence, which... I'm fine with, since you're here.
Hold hands? Okay. Is this fine?
Commander... Not in public, please...
Commander! Where've you been? We should stick together, since it's easy to get lost in here. Is that fine with you?
...They've caught on to us? Then I'll fight head-on!
All foes are down. Nobody spotted me. Job well done, right?

Since you're a beginner at this, Commander, let me show you the ropes. Somehow... it feels like I skate better than usual when you're around. I'm pretty good at ice skating, aren't I? This... should be fine, right?

Since you're a beginner at this, Commander, let me show you the ropes. Somehow... it feels like I skate better than usual when you're around. I'm pretty good at ice skating, aren't I? This... should be fine, right?
While you were practicing, I organized your documents for you. Only if you have no work left to do, it's fine if I take a moment of your time for myself... right?

It's supposed to be cold today, but when you're here by my side, everything seems so much warmer. ..."This is the Commander's power? Ah, is that so..." Um, how was that? Did I sound like Tashkent at all?
Commander, the way you're skating looks really dangerous, and I'm getting worried just watching you... How about we practice while holding hands? Is that fine?
Even if you get better, make sure to invite me again next time, okay? I want to always be able to do this with you... Is that fine?
The air outside is so nice and crisp, it feels so great... Commander, are you cold? Are you going to be fine if we stay outside?
Are you still scared? Here, hold on to my hand.
Oh no! ...Phew, Commander, please be more careful, okay?
You want to go ice skating with me? ...You should get some rest first, since you're tired... Mm, you're fine with that, right?
Our friends in the commission fleet have returned. Commander, once you're done greeting them... Yes, I'll be waiting right here for you.
Everything I do is for you, Commander, now and always!
All the enemies have been defeated. I fought just the way you told me too... Mhm, just the way it should be.
R-class battleship - Arkhangelsk

I'm Arkhangelsk, Northern Parliament battleship. I began life in the Royal Navy, taking part in convoy escorts and engagements with the Sardegna Empire. I did also have a period of, let's say, diminished strategic usefulness. But that is in the past - I stand here now to deliver you the victories befitting a capital ship!
I am battleship Arkhangelsk. Hehe, being plainspoken with me is exactly what I like. I see quite a bit of potential within you.
To your desk! Chop-chop! Let's get through today's tasks quickly!

You can lead the fleet as a whole, but in the field, I'll take command. By covering for each other, victory will be certain. Having said that... I wouldn't mind being the one to make decisions around the port every now and then~
It's delightful to see you're still excelling, Lady Warspite. You live up to your name as a royal knight.
While I'm far from the only Northern Parliament battleship at this port, I strive to be the best. Those aren't empty words - I mean it!
Have you finished your work? Ready to start on the next task? ...That's the spirit. Once that's done, we're onto the next, and then the next after that!
Being excessively polite is no different from simply being rude. Speak to me as you would any other.
Wh-what are you doing-?!
Attention: we've received new missions! Give them a look, Commander!
Attention: the mission has been completed! Spasíbo! I'm pleased you did them before I had to.
Attention: a letter has arrived! It's for you. Do give it a read.
So you've returned. Now you must reflect on your battle, review your results, and inspect your ships for damage... But first, have some tea while it's still warm.
Attention: the commission team has returned! Now, to pour something that warms the body - not tea, but vodka.
How about a complete modernization and retrofit next time, hmm?
The battlefield knows only one sovereign - me!
Victory is mine. Heh, not that I ever had any doubts about the outcome.
All ships, withdraw! ...You haven't seen the last of us!
Brace for some revolutionary swordsmanship!
My maintenance is lacking? Impossible...!
You're a disgrace to your position! Apply yourself!
While I appreciate your courtesy, do remember that I'm not some noble lady, I'm a soldier. Likewise, you're my Commander, so try to act like it!
Ugh... I'm dog-tired... Ah, Commander. Haven't you been working yourself into the ground too? Just don't go completely overboard, okay?
(Hehehe, what impeccable concentration. I knew you had potential. If you weren't so reliable, I wouldn't be ready to entrust my future to...) Oh, you heard that?
Well, the cat is out of the bag! Commander, I'm going to leave my future in your capable hands. To that end, you must learn how to issue me orders without my input! Understood?

Hoho. This is what I wanted to see. An occasion this special calls for more ladylike behavior... Or rather, that I return your affection. Of course I gladly accept! I trust you with my future - take good care of it!
Very nice! So this is how a real gentleman chooses gifts, eh?
If you want to surpass Warspite, you must first beat me!
Teamwork, everyone! Teamwork!

ex.line: Attention: the Commander is back! Now then, what's our first task of the day?
With you commanding even in the field, and me offering advice on the fleet's course - yes, the port has a bright future ahead of it. Hehehe~
That's hardly a drink suited for a tea party, Belorussiya... And Rossiya! That's not the right way to use that! Sorry, Commander, my hands are a bit tied for the moment!
How my abilities are put to use is for you to determine. I have no doubt you'll make the right call.
Need advice? I can offer mine only if you'll rely on me!
I'm not sure what to say about this...
Attention: new missions have come in. I suggest taking a gander at them.
Mission complete! That's created some time for us to go on a date.
Results look good, same with the after-action report... And you, Commander? Good to hear! ...Mmm, this tea came out excellent, even by my high standards.

Would you please tell me ahead of time when you want me to switch from soldier to lady mode? It's hard to dote on you at the drop of a hat - I'm not used to that. As an aside, would you like to go on a date? ...Hehehe. Expect me to make the first move for as long as I'm not used to doting on you.

lines.line: Your choice treasure now belongs to master thief Arkhangelsk! Think you can arrest me? Then stop gawking and come get me!
Your choice treasure now belongs to master thief Arkhangelsk! Think you can arrest me? Then stop gawking and come get me!
We're taking off in just a moment, Commander! Get over here, quick!
I'll be taking this treasure, if you don't mind! Heheh! Royal Navy grace with Northern Parliament dexterity is not a combination to be trifled with.
The right way to spend a vacation is to maximize your moment-to-moment fun. That's the reason I've brought you along, Commander.
Our next objective is to... Ah, we have to bring this over to Kiev to finish our mission. Nice and easy.

Despite my appearance, the fact is that I am a soldier with knowledge of everything from avoiding security to moving stealthily. Shipgirls usually aren't proficient in those? I mean... Doesn't it vary from person to person?
You're coming in loud and clear! What do you need?
Eek!
I'd kill for some tea after work. Say, would you have the time for a tea party, Commander?
Attention: the commission team has returned! You'd best go out and greet them, Commander!

I am Arkhangelsk, the royal sorceress who resides in the tower to the north. So, you wish to study magic to defeat the Demon King? Very admirable... You're deserving of the title of "Hero." I will be equally sincere and impart my teachings to you sternly.

I am Arkhangelsk, the royal sorceress who resides in the tower to the north. So, you wish to study magic to defeat the Demon King? Very admirable... You're deserving of the title of "Hero." I will be equally sincere and impart my teachings to you sternly.
Alright, time to start today's training! The pursuit of magic does not allow even a moment of idleness!

The fun of studying magic lies in taking the knowledge of previous generations and using it in new, innovative ways. You've done this well. Soon, perhaps you'll mature into someone who can pursue the very roots of magic with me.
You must learn the foundation of magic before you can pursue its greater mysteries. Start off by studying every last book in my library!
The thing floating above me? Heehee, it's just a decorative spell I stumbled upon. It has no practical use... but then again, vanities are inevitable on the road to new things.

Today, we are going to test the limits of your mana! You're going to create water, freeze it, and fire off ice shards a thousand times in a row... What's that? Out of motivation before we've even started?
Go to the tavern after the studying is done? Sure thing. But no vodka! I'm not like Poltava or her sisters!
Oh, do you want to study a new spell?
W-wait... Are you serious about this?! I'm playing your TEACHER right now!
You've received a new mission from the Mages' Guild. This is the perfect time to prove the fruits of your training.
I see you've collected your mission rewards. Good. You're on the right path.
I picked up this letter addressed to the hero. You should really read it.
Welcome back. You control your mana better than I expected. I'll have to revise my estimates... Don't be anxious. Settle down and have a cup of tea.
The commission team has returned! ..."A spell that can warp you to the harbor"? No such thing exists.
Are you really sure Revenge wouldn't play the sorceress better than me? It doesn't take much stamina, you know.

Join your party to kill the Demon King? And that's not a request, it's an order? What a bold way to ask your teacher for help. Heehee, that's why you're my disciple. I will join, just don't expect to always be the party leader.
Project 7U-class destroyer - Soobrazitelny

I am Storozhevoy-class destroyer Soobrazitelny, present mechanical mastermind and former member of the Black Sea Fleet! I've survived battles against numerous relentless adversaries, all through my sheer ingenuity and just a hint of luck!
Ahh-ha-ha-haah! Comrade! I am Soobrazitelny, the Northern Parliament's genius mechanic! Look no further than me for all matters related to machinery!
Splendid - you're back, Comrade! ...What's that noise you're hearing? Oh, it's nothing! I'm just giving your office machinery some ingenious upgrades!
Dust is a mechanic's mortal enemy! But, I have managed to prevent its spread by cleaning every nook and cranny of my workshop daily! My foresight is impeccable! Mwah-ha-ha-haah!
Strain your ears and listen closely! The rotations of the bearings, the tension in the levers, the rigging's rhythmic ticking! The beat of an enchanting machine!
Plastic? Absolutely NOT! Who in their right mind would make components out of a material with zero reliability compared to metal?!
Clean though your office may seem at a glance, I can tell there is dust hidden all over! It's time to do some cleaning, Comrade!
Being a genius mechanic, I of course made these safety goggles myself! They provide flawless eye protection while I'm building!
Don't be shy! Pet it to your heart's content! ...What? You weren't talking about my rigging?
Th-this is no way to treat a girl...!
We've received new missions! Listen, Comrade - they may look hard, but that's no excuse to put them off!
Whew! That's that mission completed! All thanks to my peerless genius! Hah-ha-haah!
New mail has arrived! ...WHAAAT?! The parts I ordered are STILL in transit?!
Exemplary work, everyone! Is anyone in need of rigging repairs, by any chance? I'll fix and improve it so it works as good as new - guaranteed!
Commission supplies! Let's see what we have... Hmm, this steel container looks strong... I could find some use for it! Hah-ha-haah!
Rigging upgrade: complete! My genius knows no bounds! Hah-hah-haah!
Now we shall all find out whose equipment is superior!
Ahh-ha-ha-haah! Dispatching you cretins was as easy as tightening a screw!
How come I've stopped moving?! Come on, rigging! Why aren't you working?!
Prepare to be blown away!
Th-th-this is mechanically impossible!
Others can fix your machines when they break, but only you can make up for the mistakes you've made, Comrade!

In contrast to the beauty of Mother Nature, the beauty of machinery lies in its unique status as the culmination of millennia of humanity's technological development! That is why I'm so in love with it all!
Hmgh! Hurmph! ...What am I up to? Working on my rigging, obviously. Don't worry about the parts rough around the edges - I'll just sandpaper those down later! Ahh-ha-ha-haah!

Would you be interested in building a small device, Comrade? I don't mean rigging repair tools, I mean something practical you yourself could use! Of course, you'll have a genius to teach you every step of the process!

It's true I talk about machinery all day, and yes, I build and tinker day in and day out, but that doesn't mean I'm a mechaphile or that I want to date a robot... Y-you see what I'm getting at, right?!

My prediction was spot-on - I knew you'd make the first move! Heheheh! I love you too, Comrade! One might say... My love for you is as strong as the hardest steel! ...Maybe that analogy doesn't make sense, but you know what I'm trying to say! Hahahah!
This is incredible! I'll repay you, Comrade, mark my words!
What do you say we build something together?
Whoa! A spark of ingenuity!

ex.line: Welcome back, Comrade! Oh, mind your step around the components on the floor! Without really thinking, I turned your office into a second workshop. Hah-ha-ha-haah!
WHAT?! Dust is upon us! Comrade, open the window at once! Or else your screens will be ruined!
The grinding of gears, the whizzing of a propeller, the ringing that tickles my heart... Whuh?! Hey! What are you touching me for, Comrade?!
Another one of plastic's shortcomings is the difficulty in fixing it. How so? Well, if I were to WHACK it, it would simply break - unlike metal.
Comrade! What are your thoughts on the Soobrazitelny-brand Automatic Door Closer? Now you'll never need to close the door manually again! I'll fix the frame damage caused during installation later!
Whereas metal is tough and sleek, your touch is soft and calming.
Fweh?!
We have new missions! Comrade! With me by your side, you have nothing to fear!
With your commanding and my ingenuity, we could finish these missions with our eyes closed!
Allow me to fix up your escort ship, Comrade! While I'm at it, do you want any new additions? Like a massage chair, for instance.
Brutes like you deserve brutish answers - punches!
Success! Hoh-ha-ha-hah! Victory for the galaxy-brained mechanic!

You needn't worry, Comrade! I may be obsessed with machinery, but I could never forget about you, my dear lover! On that note, why don't we go on a date to that toy store which opened just today? It supposedly has tons of mechanical toys on offer!

lines.line: Yes, these data and results are quite interesting... Though they mean nothing to me! I am a genius mechanic, not an analyst! Ahh-ha-ha-haah!
Yes, these data and results are quite interesting... Though they mean nothing to me! I am a genius mechanic, not an analyst! Ahh-ha-ha-haah!
What is it, Mechajuu? ...Ah, Commander! I've been waiting for your arrival!
Nuoooo! I spilled your cup of coffee, Comrade! This is bad! Terrible, even!
Quite the useful fish tank we have here... Or, is it technically an aquarium? I confuse the two sometimes...
This outfit makes me look both intelligent and sexy at the same time. What an ingenious combination! Mwah-ha-ha-haah!
The screen went black again! So be it... Hurmph! Owwww! I forgot I'm not wearing my regular gloves!
Has anything got you stumped? I can give you a lesson - assuming it's within my sphere!
Mhaahh♡ I-I told you, I won't do anything crazy!
Welcome back, hun~♡ Could you give me a hand with this experiment? ......That cold stare of yours is hurting my feelings.
Go forth, my Mechajuu minions!
Time to gather data! ...Um, what exactly am I meant to do?
Project 72-class aircraft carrier - Volga

I'm here, I'm here! My introduction, right? I'm Volga, Northern Parliament aircraft carrier. Named after our homeland's life-giving river, I'll do everything I can to support our friends, from sea or sky! Just make sure to be extra nice to me, Commander~♪

You don't look so good... Have you been eating properly lately? And how about your sleep? Hmm... Maybe it has something to do with emotional stress, or relationship problems? ...Oh. My name's Volga, Volga of the Northern Parliament. Oh my, did I really forget to introduce myself until now?
I'll do my best today as well~ Hehe, Commander, that goes for you and the other girls too. Let's all work hard together~♪
In case of an emergency... Um, I mean, you can always rely on me, emergency or not!
Arkhangelsk, can I bring vodka to the next tea party? Ehh, I can't? Aww...
Hum hum~♪ It's fun thinking about what I want for dinner while cleaning your office~ Oh right, Commander, do you have any recipes you'd like to share with me?
Heh heh~ I might not look it, but I sure pack a punch on the battlefield! ...Huh? The "might not look it" part is unnecessary?
W-wait, I'm supposed to be the big sister here, right? I, I'm sure of it!
I'm coming~ Did you need something from me?
If that's how you feel about me, then... Huh? It was an accident??
We've got new missions, huh? Try to pace yourself and not overdo it, Commander.
Owwie... I tripped while bringing the mission rewards over... Commander, would you mind lending me a hand? Ehehe, thank you very much~
You've got a letter~ Wouldn't it be nice if your friends are inviting you to do something fun?
Commander, thanks for your hard work~ Operation debriefing? Let's leave that for later and have some food with the others first?
The commission fleet has returned! I'll go take lunchboxes out to them~
I'm a REAL aircraft carrier, after all~
I'll do my best to offer air support!
Our march forward is unstoppable! We shall endure, no matter what, until the final victory is ours!
So this is defeat... But, the final victory will eventually be ours!
Now's the time to give it our all!
The final victory... will be ours!
A nice person doesn't cause trouble for their friends, got it?
You can't have an unhealthy lifestyle, okay? I know you're busy, but nothing is more important than your health.
Commander~ Want some vodka? Oh, you can't drink during work hours, huh... Well, just let me know when you're done here~♪
Hey, why don't you treat yourself to something nice today? Hmm, if I had to pick out a reward for my hardworking Commander... What do you think it'd be? Hehe~
So you want me to reward you with a headpat? Sure, I can do that~ Yes, yes, who's a good Commander? Now, come lie down over here~ You can fall right asleep if you want~♪
I'm here, Commander! What's wrong? ...Huh? Umm, this ring... It's for me? Really? W-won't the other girls be jealous though? ...Ehehe, this makes me so happy, it really does... *sniffles*
A gift for me? Really? Hehe, you're gonna make me blush~
Let's do our best, everyone~
Wow, so you're also real carriers...?

ex.line: *Yawn*... Commander, did you sleep well? I was having a nice nap just now as well... Zzz...
My greatest contribution to this fleet isn't on the battlefield - but rather, through courage, companionship, and love! Heh heh, sounds pretty cool, doesn't it?
Kiev said the lunch I made for her was funny-tasting... But how could that be? Ugh... Commander, what did you think?
Having a proper outlet for stress is a trick that'll go a long way, whether in work, leisure, or life itself... Well, assuming you want a long life, that is~
If you're heading out for battle, you can call on me! Heh heh, after all, I have a great reputation for being reliable, right?
I'm here, Commander! What do you need~?
Ehehe, if you're really that into me, then what can I say~
Good, good, you sure did a great job out there~ I'll bring the rewards over to the depot... Huh? It's dangerous, so it's better to stick together...?
Back from the operation already? *nom*... Mmhmm, sho, who'sh the MVP this time?
Commander, what would you like for din- Huh, it's already done? No way, I spent all day coming up with a special recipe... *nom*... Woah, delicious! Um, Commander, c-could I please have some more?

lines.line: Volga here. I'm currently tracking an important witness. *gurgle* ...Is my stomach rumbling because this AR game requires so much stamina? Ugh, lost track of the witness just now...
Volga here. I'm currently tracking an important witness. *gurgle* ...Is my stomach rumbling because this AR game requires so much stamina? Ugh, lost track of the witness just now...
Do I turn left or right at this next juncture... Oh, hey there, Commander! If you haven't eaten yet, take this- ...Uhh, oh! Right, I've got to focus!
All right, I've got myself some conclusive evidence this time. Please loop around that way. After that... Oh, before I forget, take this in case you get hungry~
Belorussiya told me that the bar there serves really good drinks... Oh, yeah, focus, focus!
The time it takes to get from here to the next stakeout point is... Commander, hold on tight!
Kirov should be lying in ambush on the other side... All right, this is where I show you what I'm made of!
Shh, I'm in the middle of a mission!
Now we wait... Ugh, my cover's been blown... There goes the mission...
Ahhhn?! W-wait, now's not a very good time...
(*grumble*) You heard something just now? Uh... I'm sure it was just your imagination! Yeah, nothing at all!
Project 69-class cruiser - Kronshtadt

I'm Kronshtadt of the Project 69 cruiser designation. Bravery alone does not win battles - gathering intel while denying your enemy it does. And, just as your fleet's power is not to be underestimated, neither is mine. Understood?
I'm Kronshtadt, Northern Parliament cruiser. Firepower isn't my only merit - I have many more than that. I'm sure you'll discover them for yourself as we clash with our enemies, Comrade.
Morning, Comrade. I always warmly welcome one who practices punctuality. Hmm? The workday hasn't begun yet?
My comrades should be contacting me soon. Let me open my- Huh? Don't move! ...Comrade?! Don't you know to knock before you enter? ...You already knocked? Oh. I see...
I left a note on your desk with a summary of all of today's tasks, Comrade. What? You can't read my handwriting? Fine, then I'll read it out for you. Let's see... This says...
Who am I making such frequent calls to, you ask? Be patient - you'll learn in due time.
I never repeat something I've explained before. The more information is repeated, the greater the risk of leaks... Hmm? You didn't catch that? Okay, as I was saying...
Strange... My transceiver isn't working. How am I supposed to contact my comrades now? Screw it, brute force it is... Gah! It burst into smoke!

What's essential during stealth missions is that you leave no trace. What this means is: before you go in, cannons booming, you should first create an even bigger boom to distract from- Huh? That's not how you do it?
Comrade, what are you... "Returning my efforts with intimacy?" I, I see... You've quite the straightforward methodology. I'll be doing the same the next time.
If you need my assistance, just come forth and ask for it, Comrade.
I will not tolerate you - or anyone else - mistreating me... Stop that, right now!
I've compiled a list of all available missions. Strike them through one by one as you complete them, Comrade.
Your efficiency in completing missions is quite admirable, Comrade... Goodness, you completed another just as I said that!
You have a new message. Read it, and I'll dispose of the letter aftewards, if it's of a confidential nature. I'll ensure there's no trace left of it.
Huh?! ...Oh, it's just you. You put yourself in great danger by suddenly approaching me from behind. At least call out to me first... Don't be ridiculous! You didn't startle me!
So, the commission team has returned. Exactly when the report said they would.
Who could pass on more firepower, am I right?
Comrades! We march towards victory, heads held high!
Hahah! Victory is determined not by random chance, but by a cascade of certainties.
It's all my fault this happened! Dammit... I apologize for my poor judgment!
I've found your weakness!
Do not panic! Focus! Focus!
If you hope to gain my trust, you're putting in quite a lackluster effort, Comrade.

So, I did some research into your past before coming here, Comrade... Oh, please. You can infer what I found based on the fact I'm conversing with you right now and addressing you with the word "Comrade."
One person can only do so much alone. I have my comrades to thank for having made it this far. Likewise, Comrade, if you need my assistance, I'm absolutely willing to give it.

I have no issue giving something greater than intel to those I consider as trustworthy as you, Comrade. But, by accepting it, you may be inviting danger into your life. Are you prepared for that, hmm?

Our relationship goes beyond mere "trust," as I'm sure you know, Comrade. So, ahem... Allow me to give you something purer, more intense, and unquestionably greater than my trust - my love! ...Wh-why are you laughing?!
Oaths and ceremonies? I've no need for such grand wastes of time. We have but one thing to do once you've slid on this ring. Close your eyes, Comrade, and forever memorize what I am about to do!
Wait, how'd you know what I... I've never told anybody that I wanted this, so if YOU knew, then... Gah! An information leak?!
Your firepower still does not trump mine!
Covert missions are my forte!

ex.line: Good to see you, Comrade. I've been waiting for you. Th-the reason I waited here was, uh... so nobody would spy on me. That's it.
I just received a call from my comrades. It was all good news. I'll send you the important details later, Comrade.
You struggle to read my handwriting? Well, if even you can't parse it, that means it's a well-encrypted message. Ahahahah!
Thanks, Rossiya. I'll put this screw back where it... Wait, where did you find this?
My peers? Hmh, it pains me to admit, but this port is home to a number of people one cut above me when it comes to espionage.
Y-your boldness is a league above even mine...
I've compiled all the pertinent mission info. Get out there and knock them out of the park!
Mission complete. It delights me to see you giving it your all.
Ah, Comrade? There's no reason to fear for your safety just over saying hello. By now I've grown used to you approaching me from behind. Ahahah!
Our victory wasn't a stroke of luck - it was a certainty, thanks to Comrade Commander.
Dammit, I must've gone overboard...

Take this transceiver. It connects to a highly secure channel no one but you and me knows about. Use it whenever I'm not around and you need help, have something on your mind, want to go on a date, or just have a chat. I'll be there for you anytime, anywhere!

lines.line: Listen up, assholes! We have you surrounded! I'm Kronshtadt, squad leader of the Northern Parliament Special Forces! You have only one option: come out with your hands in the air and surrender!
Listen up, assholes! We have you surrounded! I'm Kronshtadt, squad leader of the Northern Parliament Special Forces! You have only one option: come out with your hands in the air and surrender!
The perimeter has been secured, Comrade. Should I brief you on the situation, or do you want to see for yourself?
They've taken Manjuu hostages? God dammit, then we've no other choice... Squad, prepare to storm the building!
What's wrong with using indiscreet methods as means to an end? I quite like how much simpler this job is than information warfare.
It was a smart move to set up a barricade. This way, Kirov's squad can catch any suspects that try to flee the scene.
Copy that... Arkhangelsk is on the move. It won't be long before this is over.
You turn the megaphone on with this button. Want to try it, Comrade?
Well, well. Time to test how sturdy these handcuffs are... by trying them on you. Heehee...
Arrest the suspects! Move!

When you said "special animal costume," I was expecting some sort of mascot costume... not whatever this is! B-but don't worry, Comrade Commander! This is no big deal for an agent of the Northern Parliament!

When you said "special animal costume," I was expecting some sort of mascot costume... not whatever this is! B-but don't worry, Comrade Commander! This is no big deal for an agent of the Northern Parliament!
I-I've been waiting for you, Comrade Commander. Uh, no, this outfit is not meant to tempt you or any such... Look, in short, it's not about that!
Ah, seems it's almost time for my regular check-in with my comrades. Today's message and topic are... Huh. "Preparing for the Upcoming Event" and... "Costume Verification"?
Wh-what? Intelligence work is inherently risky, so if I must dress like this for the job, then that's... Ugh! No, this is way too much!
Of all things, it had to be this animal... Say, Comrade Commander, do you also like to have milk in the morning? ...N-never mind.
"Why not recommend this outfit to others"? A good point. If we all wear it, I'll blend in with the crowd compared to... Wait, what?!
Comrade Commander, wh-what are you doing?
I feel a little numb... or a little anxious... *blushes*
Eek! G-greeting from behind would've been dangerous, you say? Well, this and that are completely different situations!

While I do trust you, I just can't keep a cool head in this situation. If I could at least distract myself with... I've got it! Since I can't help but be conscious about this outfit, I might as well lean into it... Comrade Commander, could you assist me?
Aircraft carrier - Impero.
I'm Impero, fourth ship of the Vittorio Veneto class. Kneel and pledge your loyalty to me, now. Why? Because I'm brilliant, so I deserve special treatment.
I'm Impero of the Vittorio Veneto class. Introduction over - now back to sleep... By the way, I'm brilliant. So you don't need to boss me around... Just give me my space and we'll be good. Night.
Evening. *yawn*... I'm going to sleep. Wake me when it's sortie o'clock.
Need something? Come back in 3 hours after I've had my bath. But, if it's urgent, join me in the bathtub and we'll discuss it.
Is Veneto still up? She has this splendrous aura when she's awake. It's dazzling, genuinely.
The only things I need in life are bread and my smartphone. Wait, Oxy-cola too. Oh, and warm baths...
You could build a slide outside the office window that leads to my dorm room for quick access. Great idea, right?
...You really like playing with my hair, huh?
Ready to kneel before me yet?
...Sleazebag.
Missions, hmm? Completing them is key to furthering Sardegna's splendor.
Mission complete, at the cost of nearly all my precious energy... Take it from here.
Seems the wind brought this letter straight to your desk. Oh, you saw me bring it in? Welp.
You've returned. Now where's my thank-you for getting up to bid you welcome back?
The commission team's back. Go give them my regards.
*yawn*...
Gaze upon Sardegna's splendor - MY splendor!
Daring to pick a fight with the brilliant Impero isn't heroic. It's just foolish.
They caught wind of my spaghetti planes? I see... Sorry. This is my fault.
Kneel before me!
If I must exercise my brilliance, so be it...!
Get out of my sight. I've no need for a snake like you.
There needn't be a reason why I'm brilliant. Brilliance is inherent, self-apparent, and unmistakable for anything else. Veneto said that, so yeah.
Have you finally decided to pledge your loyalty to me? ...Hm? I suppose you are a brilliant Commander, but I am also brilliant. How about we swear an oath of mutual loyalty, then?
I could do nothing - not even lift a finger - and I'd still contribute to Sardegna. To serve you, however, I have to put in real work.
I did a task for you. It was sloppy, but I'm not used to doing work, so cut me some slack. Nobody's born knowing how to work, are they? My point is... Exactly. I appreciate the compliment.

Hm? Is this a ring? You want to marry me? I should probably tell Veneto about this first... Oh, I can do that later? All right, good. I love being free of responsibility because I'm so brilliant. I'll leave the formalities to you, Commander.
Hmm. Not bad at all.
You awake, sleepyhead?
I've got the skies covered, Veneto.

ex.line: Evening... You're not tired right before work? Darn, I was hoping we could nap together.
Whew, nothing beats a good bath... Huh? What do you mean "what's with the towel"? I just got out of the bath, that's what?
Littorio! Is dinner ready yet? Don't forget I'm brilliant. I'll starve to death if you take too long.
Need some help with that? ...You can do it on your own? Geesh, soon there'll be nothing left for me to do.
It's nice being a carrier. I don't need to get my hands dirty, all I have to do is pilot my planes. I'm so brilliant for being able to fight on my own.
Mhh... That's nice. Do it again.
Is dinner ready?! ...Not yet, huh...
...I love when you do this♡
Missions, hmm? Completing them is key to promoting your brilliance and Sardegna's splendor.
Brought you the mission rewards...! Oof! They're a lot heavier than I expected.
A carrier pigeon... I wish I could fly like a bird. A rigging upgrade might make that possible.
You've returned. I got you something to snack on. How nice of me, right? You may thank me with a headpat.
The commission team's back. I'll go bid them a splendrous ret- Eh, forget it. You're up, Commander.
I'm brilliant, aren't I? Yeah, I am... Hehehe.
I can't let the Commander see me like this... I'm supposed to be brilliant...
We don't have to do anything today. You heard me - you can be like me and just not do anything productive. And if you do something wild, I'll let it slide.

lines.line: Seems school uniforms are all the hype. Veneto picked this one out for me. What are you dressed as, Commander? A teacher? A classmate?
Seems school uniforms are all the hype. Veneto picked this one out for me. What are you dressed as, Commander? A teacher? A classmate?
Evening. Here's what I'm doing to further Sardegna's splendor today... Zzz...
Do you like reading too, Commander? ...Yeah, I do, 'cause I dream of the comfy stories I read. Do you?
Bookmarks are a genius invention. They save me the effort of remembering how far into a book I am.
Zzz... Oops, I nodded off. If you wanna borrow a book, go ahead. Anyway... *yawn*... Hang on, what page was I on again?
It's practically impossible to stay awake in class. But you manage, Commander. Keep on being a brilliant student.
You here to return a book, or...?
...Mgh. Hm? Huh?
These mission rewards let me read a few minutes more. Brilliant.
Ah, you're back. You hungry? I'm kind of famished, so let's hit the cafeteria in a few.
Now I can read another three pages. Awesome.
Ugh... I don't wanna work... I don't wanna work... I don't wanna work... Commander? Finished your overtime shift? Great timing... Come and drink with me!
Ugh... I don't wanna work... I don't wanna work... I don't wanna work... Commander? Finished your overtime shift? Great timing... Come and drink with me!
My job is so exhausting... I don't wanna work ever again... You do the heavy lifting, Commander - I'll be sleeping...
Listen, Commander, I was so brilliant today... I worked a bunch, I went to observe the thermae, then I went to observe the public bath... I'm running on fumes...
I'm hungry, but I don't wanna move... Feed me, Commander. Nom...
I'm thirsty, but I don't wanna move... Pour a drink into my mouth, Commander. Mmh...
My uniform's too tight... Who the hell came up with this cumbersome design? I'm requesting permission to come to work in a dressing gown... Zzz...
That's good... Keep going... Stroke me more...
Drink up, Commander. The day only really starts after you've clocked out...
Mmh... Oh yeah... I want more...
The skewers at this bar are pretty delish. Have a li'l bite, Commander! ...Huh? Why do you have two heads?

Whew... I'm just so glad to forget about work. I feel like I'm floating on a cloud... Commander, I want every day to be like this - carefree, no need to work... Pretty please... From now on, you're in charge of my happiness... Zzz...
Capitani Romani-class ship - Pompeo Magno.

I'm Pompeo Magno of the Capitani Romani-class from the Sardegna Empire! My speed and firepower make me suited for any kind of mission, and what I lack in protection I more than make up for with agility!

Captain Pompey the Great has arrived at port! ...Err! Ahem! Good day to you, Commander! I am Pompeo Magno of the Sardegna Empire! Assign any and all work to me and I'll have it done in the blink of an eye!
Welcome back, Commander! I am ready to begin my secretarial duties and take on work from you!
Look, I know most people would panic if they were suddenly told to manage every last facet of a fleet, but I'm one of those few who have what it takes... Right?
Hmm, how should I process these documents... It's okay, I know what I'm doing, Commander! Seriously, just let me handle it!
I'm going out for a while, Commander! When you've got a schedule as packed as Captain Pompey's, you can't afford to sit around on your butt all day!
If I do a bad job here, the Commander's gonna make me resign and then ostracize me... Uh, I didn't say anything! Just dealing with a minor problem here! Y-yeah, that's all!
My cap is NOT just for show!
When you need my help, just grab my hand and hold it tight!
I-I-I am NOT some easy girl!
I'll take care of all these new missions, Commander! ...Wh-what's with that look? Wait... You're signaling that you doubt my ability, aren't you?!
Mission complete! ...And unsurprisingly, I could've never accomplished it alone... Ahaha...
Your trusty secretary brings you new mail, right on schedule!
Dammit... I've barely gotten anything done while the Commander was out... This is gonna reflect so badly on me... Ahem! Commander! Welcome back!
Commission supplies have arrived! Allow me the honor of processing them!
The greater your ability, the more responsibilities you deserve!
Have faith in my orders! They will lead you to victory!
Captain Pompey the Great has once more led her allies to a spectacular victory!
We're defeated... My dignity has been destroyed and the fleet's reputation will plummet, dooming it to fade into obscurity... Oh, err, I didn't say anything!
Nothing is impossible for Captain Pompey!
No big deal! I can keep going!
You're a terrible Commander, but if I can produce results in spite of you, people will think I'm really talented! There's always a silver lining, I tell you!

I've accepted a plethora of errands and consultations with other girls today. Soon I will be the talk of the port, and every- What do you mean this schedule is infeasible? Don't you know? Nothing is impossible for me!

You came at just the right time, Commander! You see, um... Thing is, I could use a lot of help. I simply don't have enough time to run all those errands I promised to... I know, I know, but you'd be helping everyone out, not just me!

Phew... Without your help, I would've fled the port out of sheer shame before nightfall, fated to forever roam some cold corner of the ocean... Truly, I thank you from the bottom of my heart, Commander!

Now I get it! I can earn more recognition if I focus on you, plus then I won't have to worry about breaking promises. So with that in mind, will you let me take care of all your problems whenever they arise? ...I'm begging on my knees here, please don't turn me down.

Just as the capital wasn't built in one day, it takes time for people to form close bonds. Okay, I know that's an odd example! Basically, what I'm saying is: I'll make a concentrated effort to spend quality time with you so we'll become better acquainted! Otherwise I'll feel like you wasted this ring on me!
Thank you, Commander! Heheh, it's good to see my hard work being recognized for once~
You don't have a monopoly on speed, you know!

ex.line: Welcome back to the office, Commander! Your secretary and sweetheart is ready to take on any work you can throw at her!

As you know, I have a laundry list of errands I must run for my friends, so I'll be unable to give you my attention for some time... Please, I just messing with you! I'd never leave you out in the cold!
Hey, Commander, some girls were asking for help earlier. Should we go see what's up? ...N-no, I'm definitely not craving more recognition! Helping people benefits us both!

...Wait a sec! If the Commander stays this immersed in work, I'll soon be cast aside and deprived of affection... Uh, it's nothing! I was just thinking we should go on a date! To, you know, deepen our bonds and stuff! Please?!
When you need comforting, just hold my hand! Heheh!
Wait, I'm still not ready for this! ...No, I mean, I'm just saying... I've never done it before, but I'll figure it out somehow!
Captain Pompey the Great - and her great Commander - have once more led their allies to victory!
We're defeated... My dignity has been crushed... Commander, take me someplace far away where we can be alone...

Hey! You know that place popular with couples I brought up the other day? Don't say the name, it's on the tip of my tongue! It's... Hrmmm... Sigh, I can't remember... But you know what? You can make the first move and decide where we'll go for once. Hehehe~

lines.line: *yawn*... Nothing's impossible when you've got Captain Pompey... Hmm? Commander? Wait, I fell asleep? Seems I did... Drat, I forgot what I even came here for...
*yawn*... Nothing's impossible when you've got Captain Pompey... Hmm? Commander? Wait, I fell asleep? Seems I did... Drat, I forgot what I even came here for...
Hi, Commander! I'm fully rested, as you can see. So, it's time to go looking for people who need a hand and do them some favors!
If I'd known the Commander would find me like this, I would've hid under the piano top before I dozed off... Err, nothing! Just talking to myself!
Remember to get the literature Impero asked for... and the picture books for Maestrale and Libeccio... and to buy soda for Archerfish... Zzz...
Do you know how to play the piano, Commander? Err, this is just a model piano. The keys don't work.
I remember now! Someone asked me to reorganize this place! And since you're already here, you should help me- I mean, help all of us by tidying up with me!
What's with the kiddy treatment?!
Wait, stop! There's not enough room for both of us!
For the last time, there's not enough room for both of us! PLEASE get it into your head!
There are new missions? Okay, I'll note that down and sort those out later!
Mission complete! ...And I've not even gotten started on them yet... Wait, did you finish ALL the missions before I could attempt them?!
New mail? Might be our performance evaluation... C-come here and let me have a look at it!
Zzz... I've gotta finish all the errands I took on before the Commander gets back... Zzz...
The commission team brought back new components, and there are way too many to sort through... But that's okay! I like a challenge!
Victory! ...Wait, I just realized, we played for fun and still won!
I'm dead tired... Commander, lower the top for me... I need a break from real life right now...
Trento-class heavy cruiser - Trieste.
I'm Trieste, second ship of the Trento class. I saw action in the Mediterranean and was to become a carrier, but... Never mind. Forget what I just said.
I am Trieste, Trento-class heavy cruiser number two. My job is to help you with your work. Now, would you stop gawking and get back to it?
Right on time. It's good to know you're punctual. Try to be here the same time tomorrow.
Why are you here and not in your office, working? Shoo with you. You're still on duty.
I'll schedule the resupply shipment. Better I do it than trust an underachiever to produce good results.
You made an error in this paragraph. Fix it yourself - it's tiring enough just pointing out mistakes. Don't make me dump more assignments on you.
People put pineapple on pizza?! That's disgusting! That's a war crime against Sardegnian cuisine!
Need a break, do you? Fair enough. I suggest doing some stretches.
Keep your nose to the grindstone. These missions won't finish themselves. Do a good job and I'll treat you to a home-cooked meal.
You've done well. Here you are, as promised. It's a good thing I wrote that down.
Best to read your mail now before you forget about it.
I'll check through the after-action report. In the meantime, reflect on your battle with the girls. Go on, get to it.
The commission team has come back. Phew... I'm glad they're okay.
A smart move on your part.
Everyone do your part, or else I'm giving you detention!
Now do you get why I'm so strict, Commander? It's because discipline begets victory.
This is all on me for being too damn lenient!
Keep an eye on your surroundings!
Well, this is a conundrum...
Are you happy now? Sigh... I'm going to fix you. You WILL learn some damn discipline.
No time to rest, Commander. You've done your job, but not the assignment I gave you. Start on it now, or you'll fall behind.
Done with your job? Okay. Have a nice dinner, then treat yourself to a bath. You'll feel as good as new after a hard day's work, trust me.
That sortie sure took its toll on you. You should probably take some time to rest. Rework today's timetable as needed and I'll relay the changes to the others... Huh? You want me to rest with you?
I don't need to rest, though. Why do you want me to stick around? I suppose I could monitor to ensure you are getting enough rest... Okay, hang on, I'll be there in a moment!

I figured you were dying to tell me something... Huh? Did you arrange all this to propose to me? You're sure this isn't some mistake? S-s-so this ring is for ME?! Have you had these feelings for me all along? That... makes me so happy! I just...
Your motives are impure... but fine, I accept.
Show some restraint with the teasing.

ex.line: Finished your morning preparations? I sure hope so. Please don't make the others shoulder your burdens.
I'm fine with giving you a lap pillow, but I won't pamper you like Trento does... Y-you meant I'D rest on YOUR lap? Well, I suppose I... No, never mind! Come on, here you go!
How's our food supply looking... Wait, what? We're nearly out of food?! Commander, remedy this at once before we have a famine on our hands!
This paragraph is... error-free, it seems. Nicely done. It's things like this which prove that you're capable of running this place.
Since you'll be spectating tomorrow's exercise, is there something you'd like for a boxed lunch? Let me know before the end of today.
Do I need a hand? Not at all, I'm plenty capable of handling this.
Oh my. Go on...♡
Pick a mission to do first, then set out to complete it. Do a good job and I'll... Hmm, well, I'll set aside a day for a date with you.
Well, well... You did it. So, how about that date? I did say I would, didn't I?
The girls are waiting for you. This isn't the time to chit-chat with me - go talk to them. Yes, of course, I'll spend some quality time with you later.
I want to claim some credit for this victory... but no, this one's all thanks to you, Commander. Well done.
You've got food on your face. I thought you could at least eat properly, but I suppose you're a child, hmm? Remember to drink your water, too... Clean it with a kiss? I-I suppose I could...

lines.line: Oh my, are you done with your errands already? Surely, you didn't skip work just to eat lunch with... Ah, sorry for doubting you. Alright, let's go. Trento is waiting for us.
Oh my, are you done with your errands already? Surely, you didn't skip work just to eat lunch with... Ah, sorry for doubting you. Alright, let's go. Trento is waiting for us.
It's perfectly normal to wear uniforms at school... Can you handle it though, Commander? You look worked up for some reason.
I don't know how to approach you when I wear this uniform. Do I treat you as an upperclassman? Should I address you differently, or like normal?
What's for lunch today? You'll have to see for yourself. I'll tell you this: it's a dish both you and Trento like.
How do you hope to spend the prime of your life, Commander? Making great memories to look back on, and the like?
You're THAT eager to have lunch with me? What am I to do with you...
Yup, I really don't know how to approach you...
Don't neglect your missions. You're keeping me and Trento waiting.
This selection of dishes should work for half a year without feeling too samey. Tomorrow I think I'll... Oh, welcome back, Commander. I was just thinking out loud about our boxed lunches.
I think the commission team is back. Down there - isn't that them?
Whew... I'm getting dizzy... I'll rest in the breeze for a moment. You okay, Commander? Step out if it's too hot. See, someone will worry about you...
Whew... I'm getting dizzy... I'll rest in the breeze for a moment. You okay, Commander? Step out if it's too hot. See, someone will worry about you...
*pant*... *pant*... This is much too hot for my liking. Can you handle it, Commander? Are you sure?
I know I'm strict with you... Mmh... I just want to say, thank you. Like Veneto always says, it's a good time to be frank with people when you're bathing with them.
Didn't I tell you to focus on relaxing today? Come into the water - your work can wait. Whew... That's more like it.
Excited about dinner after this bath? So am I. I'll very eager to see what sort of food they serve here.
Mmph... I'm feeling a bit dizzy... I might have caught a fever, because I feel hot all over... Mmh...
Whew... This cool breeze is just what I needed.
Whew... Wh-what's gotten into you?
In a bit... Okay. Missions first, then I'll go back in.
Can't you ask someone else to get the mission rewards? Or would you rather do it yourself first, and continue your bath later?
You've received a letter. Better check it after this bath.
Don't let yourself get cold. Keep your shoulders below the water. There, that's great... D-did I sound like Trento just now?
Is the commission team bathing after us? Hmm... I can't quite remember...
The sea breeze is so refreshing... Thank goodness.
Oh no... My head's going completely blank...

Ugh... I'm sorry for making you worry when this was supposed to be a relaxing vacation for you... Can I make it up to you somehow? We're alone out here, so you can fawn on me all you want... Y-yeah, well, Trento lets you do it all the time!
Commander? As you can see, I'm putting into practice the calligraphy knowledge you taught me before. The problem is, I can't seem to nail it... Could you watch for a bit and guide me?
Commander? As you can see, I'm putting into practice the calligraphy knowledge you taught me before. The problem is, I can't seem to nail it... Could you watch for a bit and guide me?
Umm, mh... Good timing. Could you have a look at this, Commander? I don't feel like the strokes are as smooth as they should be.
These clothes? Ah, yes, it's relaxing to put them on and practice calligraphy. If you like how they look, then that makes me even happier.
Something feels different about me? You're right - I'm facing this challenge with a new mindset. It's made me ease up, just like you said.
What am I writing? Oh, it's a list of materials needed for the party. It'll be quite luxurious, so look forward to it.
I'm usually the one supervising you, but today you're the one doing it... It feels a little strange. Oh, I don't mean that in a bad way.
Huh? You're ruining my concentration.
Hm? What did I get wrong?
Is this... one way to wield the brush?
You haven't finished your missions yet, have you? Should I focus on helping you with those first?
You finished your missions? Great work. Ahem... Being strict with you has paid off. Now keep it up.
You have a new letter, so read that first. You can, umm, teach me about calligraphy after that.
Welcome back. I just wrapped up and I'm going to take a break... Huh? No, I'm not tired. I just want a change of pace.
The commission team is back? I'm starting to get the hang of this, so could you check this first before you go and receive them?

Once I've learned to write well, do you want me to compose a message for you? Not just as thanks for guiding me, but also as a wish for us to support one another into this year... That doesn't mean I'm going to coddle you, though! Understood?
Battlecruiser - Seydlitz.
I am Seydlitz, Iron Blood battlecruiser! My tenacity is my pride, my conquests are my glory, and executing your orders is my mission! I await your orders, Commandant!
Salute, Commandant! Iron Blood battlecruiser Seydlitz reporting in! Inexperienced though I may be, as of today I am proud to serve this port in the pursuit of honor and glory!
Salute! I put my faith in your guidance as always, Commandant!
Commandant, I do understand our mission at this port, but I hope to one day move up and fight for humanity's- Forgive me, I should have held my tongue.
Lützow! Stop that before you distract the Commandant! ...Well, Commandant, I do believe getting distracted is a bad thing...
I've no grand ambitions of being hailed as a hero. My heart's only desire is to serve you faithfully, Commandant.
People who doubt their comrades deserve to be shunned. If they must doubt anyone, it should be themselves.
Salute! What are your orders?
Salute! Your orders, Commandant!
C-Commandant?!
You have unfinished missions, Commandant! It may be wisest to do the newest ones first.
You have received mission rewards! Whew... I'm glad it went off without a hitch. Outstanding work, Commandant.
Salute! I've brought your newly-arrived letter!
A salute to your return, Commandant! Phew... I take it your battle was an honorable one, as always?
The commission team has returned to port! Commandant, please have a look!
You've made me stronger, Commandant! You have my thanks!
Achtung! Reduce them to scrap!
Commandant, your in-person commanding was a thing to behold! Frankly, however, I don't believe I can say the same of my own performance...
I failed by not following my orders... What a disgrace!
You will not sink me! I won't allow it!
Miladies! Take cover behind me!
This is all because I'm a worthless maggot... Commandant, I beg for your forgiveness!
If you'll forgive my audacity, I have a request. Commandant, please give me more orders! I will do anything you require of me!
I have complete faith in your decisions. Except... the worry that my service isn't all you hoped for lingers in the back of my mind. But, rest assured, it will not hinder me in combat!
Spend my day off however I want...? While that does sound nice, I'm not sure what I want to do is good in your eyes, Commandant... But if that's your order, I will follow it!
Y-you wish to go on a date? With me, of all people? ...Forgive me, I should not question an order from you, Commandant! I will make every step towards ensuring a thoroughly enjoyable date!

While I am overjoyed by your offer of marriage, I'm worried if my answer won't be to your- No! Of course I'm not turning you down! What I mean is, I don't know whether to say "gladly," or "I love you." You may decide if you'd like, Commandant!
Commandant?! Wh-why are you giving me something so precious out of the blue...
Miladies! Allow me to protect you!

ex.line: As always, I aim to please you today, Commandant! ...I-if I inconvenience you in any way, please do inform me.
Commandant, you need not be concerned about me. I am being myself, as one is obliged to be.
Please assign me a task, Commandant! ...Y-you've already finished all your work? Oh, I see...
Commandant, suppose I were to behave less like a soldier and more like a regular woman... Would you prefer that?
You're very kind, Commandant, being willing to give ear to my opinions. Meanwhile, I feel I don't even deserve to have opinions...
Look, you don't- Ahem. Commandant, I'd rather you treated me as a soldier, not as a lady!
I'll gladly listen if you wish to confide in me!
W-well, if I'm your type, then I suppose... Pardon, it's nothing, Commandant!
Commandant! Please advise which mission I should start with!
I sensed you may be thirsty, so I went ahead and made tea! W-would you like a cup?
Thank you for this high honor! This victory goes to my comrades and the Commandant!
Commandant! Miladies! Please make your escape while I hold the line!
Good lord... I should've prepared better before asking you on a date... Oh, no, nothing's wrong! I-it's just... Your immediate "yes" made my heart flutter in surprise, Commandant!

lines.line: There it is - Dracula's Castle, brought into this world by chaos itself... On my honor, I swear I will put an end to the divine bloodline!
There it is - Dracula's Castle, brought into this world by chaos itself... On my honor, I swear I will put an end to the divine bloodline!
It's time to breach the castle, Commandant. I shall lead the way!
Once the fighting ends, so does the role of a vampire hunter... Is that truly what I, or rather, the power within me, wants?
I've got you now, Lützow! Say your prayers, for it's time you paid for the Commandant's lost productivity!
I'm more than just a shipgirl, I'm now the blade that cuts down all evil. This duty, granted unto me, shall be carried out!
You'd like meat for dinner today? Certainly. The question is, how do we procure meat out here...
We know not what beasts lurk in the shadows... Mgh...
Such frightening armor... Eek!
I have your new letter right here, Commandant.
A castle of this size must have numerous ways in and out. Commandant, we should take this route if you're in a hurry.
Die, monsters! You don't belong in this world!
Salute! Oh, dammit, I dropped the bounty... Apologies. I will clearly need to practice my posing...
How do I look, Commandant? I thought you may like seeing me in a dress, however I don't know if this is what you desired or not...
How do I look, Commandant? I thought you may like seeing me in a dress, however I don't know if this is what you desired or not...
Let us begin, Commandant. Your work for today has started.
My banquet attire pales in comparison to everyone else's... If you could create my ideal look, what would it be like, Commandant?
On my name and pride, I promise to find us a place to relax while you mingle with the other guests!
Commandant, suppose I were to behave less like a soldier and more like a regular woman... Would you prefer that?
This way, my fair ladies... I'll be leaving your side momentarily to accustom myself to this place, Commandant. Excuse me for a while.
A-at your service, Commandant!
I feel I'm ill-suited to be your partner this evening... Do you desire me, regardless?
Exemplary work, Commandant. Have you tried the food on offer this evening yet? I'm sure you're going to love it!
Victory can be seized even in a dress... I'm now confident this is what you desired, Commandant!

Salutations, Commandant! ...You think I look like a totally different person? Haha! You're right - I decided to change up my look for once. Oh, today looks like a hot day, so I brought drinks. Take one!

Salutations, Commandant! ...You think I look like a totally different person? Haha! You're right - I decided to change up my look for once. Oh, today looks like a hot day, so I brought drinks. Take one!
Just a moment... There, I've struck my pose! Awaiting your next orders, Commandant!
Whew... Wearing clothes like this is quite new to me. Oh, but rest assured, Commandant - I will strive to become one with the streetwear! ...Just be myself, you say? Understood!
In case you're wondering... I did indeed pick out this streetwear by myself. Now that you have this information, what do you make of it, Commandant?
The graffiti, you ask? I thought I'd opt for a backdrop that complemented my outfit! You asked to see me in a fresh look, and I answered to the best of my abilities.
Commandant, please have a drink. The last bottle was much too cold, but this one is just the right temperature... I thought of everything, you say? Th-thank you!
Commandant, won't you take a picture with me? This feels like a great occasion for it!
Th-this isn't exactly how I pictured our day off...
Ah, you've received a letter, Commander.
Welcome back from your patrol, Commandant! Allow me to pour you a drink!
Time to exert all my strength and individualism!
Streetwear is not only comfortable, but visually striking as well. Whew... Do you share my view, Commandant?

Go on a date wearing this? Heehee, I will take that to mean you like seeing me in such a novel outfit. Then please, go ahead and ask me on a date! I will do all I can to live up to your hopes and give you an unforgettable experience!
You're the person the Organization sent to extract me, Commandant? Great. The plan went smoothly and I got the goods. We can evac using the planned route.
You're the person the Organization sent to extract me, Commandant? Great. The plan went smoothly and I got the goods. We can evac using the planned route.
You've come. Allow me to verify the code phrase. "Mission impossible" - what comes next? ...Okay, your code is correct. I can lower my guard, then. Whew... Here I thought the police had shown up.
(*sigh*... Why did I have to get the role of a villain? It's so cruel to have me be betrayed by the Commandant...)
Once this matter is done with, I'm going to leave the Organization and return to a normal life. Would you like to come with me, Commandant?
Commandant, I know missions always come to an end, but the bond we've forged will never break... right?!
...And that concludes my contingency plans for everything that may happen. Have I lived up to your expectations, Commandant?
My sunglasses? Oh, they're not for hiding from the police, I just wear them because I think they're stylish... They make me look really reliable?! Ahaha, that's good to know...
I modified this motorcycle myself. It can even catch up to a carrier's aircraft if I go full throttle!
Mgh... A strip-search does not need to be THIS thorough...
Commandant, where were you?! We need to escape now, before the- Police sirens?! Oh no... Were you an undercover officer this whole time?!
Hold on tightly! I'm turning the speed up to the max!
We've got a rat! The deal's off!
You want me to abandon my mission? Because it's "not too late to change my ways"? Thank you, Commandant... I'll place my trust in you.
Derfflinger-class battlecruiser - Lützow.
Hey, I'm Iron Blood battlecruiser Lützow. I was part of the High Seas Fleet, and... I forgot what I was gonna say. Eh, whatever, I'll probably remember after I've had a nap.

*yawn*... Hm? Who are you? Can you point me to the Commander? ...YOU'RE the Commander? Heehee, all right, saves me the effort of looking for you. I'm Lützow, Iron Blood battlecruiser. Since we're done here, I'm gonna take my leave~
G'morning. Hey, can I sit down a li'l longer? This chair is just too comfy.
Could you NOT call me without a reason? ...You know what, on second thought... If you're bored, chat with me.
Why won't you let me sleep in the office? Because that interferes with your work? Huh... And that's a bad thing?
Hey, show me what you're working on... It's just a bunch of random charts and numbers. 'Kay, have it back.
If you can't find me in the office, I'm likely out and about somewhere. Don't worry, I'll be back before you know it. Probably.
I'm not sleepy. That was just a li'l yawn... *yaaawn*...
You wanna hug this fella? Go ahead. Only a quickie though, okay?
Geesh, you're more daring than I took you for. Imagine that.
A mission? Miss me with that. You'll be fine on your own anyway.
Mission complete. Why're you giving me that look? You're the one who got it done, not me.
Here's your mail. No need to thank me, I just picked it up on the way.
You're back! It's kinda boring when you're not around.
The commission team is back. We don't have to go out and meet them, do we?
Hm? Am I stronger now? Doesn't feel like it, honestly.
Ugh... What did I do to deserve this big-ass responsibility...
Zzz... Ahh, I'm so sleepy. Is the battle over yet?
Welp, we lost... This blows. I'm heading home.
I guess maybe I'll try.
Nuh-uh, I don't feel a thing!
Ugh... I hate this place. I hate this place so much.
Don't feel like doing a dang thing today... Hey, Commander, what do you do to get through the day when you've got no energy?
You follow a schedule? It's all about getting into habits, huh... I getcha. Can you show me what yours is like?
Can't you, you know, ignore a schedule if there's a ton of work on it? ...No? A schedule sounds pretty awful then. Just do like me and do whatever you want~
Hey, Commander, how about we run away together? ...I'm just kidding with you. Don't get all worked up. All I want is for you to forget all your troubles when we're alone together~
Carefree as I am, we're stuck together now~ Stuck together by means of this ring, anyway. You're the only person I'll take orders from, and I expect you to do me a few favors in return~
Hm? What's this? ...If you're giving this to me, then don't expect to get it back. Is that alright with you?
Queen of the Royal Navy? Uh-huh, I see...
You know the drill - safety first!
Who cares what your name is anyway?
I'm a good girl. Unlike you.

ex.line: G'morning. What I'm putting in the paper shredder? Just your schedule for today. We're gonna have a good time instead♪
Need something? Wait... Now's a bad time. I've got urgent business. By that I mean: chat with me!
Since I can't sleep in your office, I'll do it in your private quarters instead. Or is that also a no-go? Heheh, if it is, just say it♪
Need a hand there? All right. I could help you with... not much, it seems. I'll just take a nap instead.
What I'm doing? Looking 'round for places we can go to on a date. Ooh, this looks promising! Let's go there the next time you're free.
Mrmh, mmh... Heehee, payback!
This is my chance to shine! ...But I don't need to take it.
*yaaawn*... We're finished here, Commander. Let's move on.

lines.line: "Have you come to accept your fate, human? Heehee~" ...Don't just stand there, Commander. Say something!
"Have you come to accept your fate, human? Heehee~" ...Don't just stand there, Commander. Say something!
Welcome back, Commander. Now where's my crimson elixir? As in, my daily glass of wine~
This looks kinda like a ball dress, doesn't it? So make like at a ball and ask me for a dance. Whether I accept or not hinges on your ability to persuade, though~
Garlic? Crosses? Those don't work on me... Those are meant to repel a vampire? Well then, I'm throwing those weaknesses right out the window.
Seydlitz, the key to acting is to fully immerse yourself in your role. You don't have to think about it too hard.
Hrmph. I'm trying my absolute best here, and you're not even looking, Commander... I'll just have to MAKE you pay attention!
Aww, come ooon. I'm comfy right where I am - don't make me get up.
When a human feels bliss, that's when their blood tastes sweetest♪
You're under my complete control, and will always come back to me... Heehee, I call this plot device "the curse of Dracula's Castle."
You brought this upon yourselves, opponents. Why must you make me spill blood?
Gaze into my eyes, Commander... Yeah, the script says I have you under my spell, so just keep gazing~ By the way, vampires drink blood through the neck, right? 'Cause I want a taste~ Nom♪
Om, nom... Hmm. Hey! This is pretty good! I mean, of course it's good - it's Empery cuisine! Commander, open wide and I'll give you a dumpling alley oop. Say "aah"!
Om, nom... Hmm. Hey! This is pretty good! I mean, of course it's good - it's Empery cuisine! Commander, open wide and I'll give you a dumpling alley oop. Say "aah"!
*yaaawn*... Yeah, what? Eating makes me sleepy. You're not seriously gonna do paperwork today, are you?
Invite Seydlitz and the gang next time? I mean, if you want their company, do it yourself. You're the only person I wanna invite. Heehee.
Eww, you're gonna drink coffee with that, Tallinn? Here, lemme educate you a little. See, you're meant to have this with a cold glass of beer. Heehee♪
I'm eating, so save the work talk for later. No food for you until your job is done, okay?
Ahahahah! Deutschland seriously can't handle hot food? C'mon, Commander, go blow on it for her. Meanwhile, I'll keep your food safe and secure in my belly♪
You want seconds? I'll order some in a bit.
Sooo~ You saying you wanna eat me, too?
Your food's gone cold. You gonna heat it up, or end up burning it? Either way, it's your move♪
One more to recharge my batteries! Nom!
*yawn*, finally, I get to lie down. Tell you what, I'm gonna have a nap... Hm? The ceremony's still not over? Hrmh... Look, it's not important. You should just come lie next to me, Commander!
*yawn*, finally, I get to lie down. Tell you what, I'm gonna have a nap... Hm? The ceremony's still not over? Hrmh... Look, it's not important. You should just come lie next to me, Commander!
Good luck with your work today. Me? I'm just gonna lie here and relax. Bride's privilege, you know? Hehehe~
Geesh, the schedule looks packed. If you ask little ol' me politely I might give you a hand... Huh? O-okay, let's start with this document... Bleh, I feel like I just dug my own grave.
It's weird. I'm just watching you go through your paperwork... and yet I don't feel bored in the slightest...
*yawn*, I may not be bored, but I'm so tired I can't move a muscle. I want the princess treatment, Commander.
Oh. You knew I was just pretending to sleep?
My dress has come loose~ Fix it please~
I'm... I'm sleeping, so I don't mind... *murmur*...
Welcome back. Come here and I'll take good care of you♪
Helgoland-class battleship - Thüringen.

Didn't I tell you I was the Iron Blood battleship Thüringen when we first met each other? You want to know more about me? Everything, even? Ahaha, then let's look for a nice place where we can sit and talk. I'll tell you everything, starting from my time in the High Seas Fleet.

It is a pleasure, Commander. I'm Thüringen, battleship of the Iron Blood. Before I formally sign on, there's one thing I want to ask - what role, exactly, do you have in mind for me? Hahah! No, I'm not testing you, I simply want a grasp of your moral compass.
Hm, I'm glad to see that you're as chipper as ever. Keep it up.
All troubles that occur either have a reason or a trigger. Unless there are innocents tangled up in the problem, it's best to lay low and wait.
Be more confident with your opinions and openly state your opinions. If anyone dares to boo you down, I'll teach them something about manners.
Mm... I'll have to disagree on this. Of course, your word goes, but would you mind hearing my thoughts out first?
What's wrong? Got something against being watched? Ahaha, you don't have to be all tense. I wasn't keeping watch over you, I just wanted to observe your response.
The things I tell you are merely suggestions to you. Ultimately, you call the shots here.
Hmph! This is payback for your insolent behavior. There's no need for me to continue being a doormat for you.
A new mission? I think it's a good idea to get started on it right now, but you're the Commander. I'll follow your plans.
Mission complete. I'll let you decide who you want to send to pick up the rewards.
Here's some mail. I'd like you to check on them as soon as possible... Later, you say? Well, I don't think there's anything urgent here, so that sounds fine with me.
Good work out there. Will you take a break? Or are you planning on getting right back to another mission? Either way, I'll be here for you.
The girls have returned from their commissions. I'm sure the morale of the girls at the port will go up if you go out and greet them personally.
Hmm. Much obliged.
Adequate preparation is half the battle.
Seems we've taken far less damage than I'd anticipated. How fortuitous.
I'll be back with some payback. Nobody likes to stay a loser.
This is it!
You're quite skilled, but I won't fall that easily!
I'll serve my duties as your subordinate, but don't expect me to be all smiles while doing so.

Nobody, not even I, can meddle with your thoughts. Of course, due to our differences in standing, values, and information, I may disagree with you from time to time. But I will never disparage your authority over me.
I might not approve of all of your decisions, but I do admire your resolution. You are exactly as a commander should be.
Commander, how are your plans looking today? ...Ah, I'm not talking about work, but about your personal matters. Frankly, I simply wished to invite you to tea if we both happened to be free.

Maybe because we have good chemistry together, but I feel very comfortable being around you, whether for work or for personal matters. Even if we disagree on something, we come to understand each other's positions very quickly. I hope we can continue getting along just as well as we have.

This kind of proposal works best when our feelings are reciprocal—basically, we accept each other as partners. When we have differing opinions, as long as we work together, hand-in-hand, we can overcome any obstacle that stands in our path! Ahaha!
For me personally, this is a most wonderful gift indeed.

ex.line: Hm, I'm glad to see that you're as chipper as ever. You look like you're ready to take on the world today.
