I don't make any pointless remarks when you're making decisions. Previously, it was because of my respect for you, but now... it's because my heart can't help but trust in all you do.

I've collected a list of good locations for the two of us, just as you directed me to... While I'm aware that this isn't a date and that you just wanted to make your rounds, I'm... not opposed to it being a date as well.
You consider my opinions very important? Thank you very much for trusting in me. But the same goes for me.
I'll let you off this once. Make sure to hold yourself back next time.
Good work out there. Will you take a break, or are you planning on getting back to work? Either way, I've made arrangements for whatever you choose.

lines.line: You, mop the floor. You, take care of the windows. Once that's done... Ah, Commander. Excuse us, we're in the middle of cleaning the area. If you have need of me, I must ask you to wait.
You, mop the floor. You, take care of the windows. Once that's done... Ah, Commander. Excuse us, we're in the middle of cleaning the area. If you have need of me, I must ask you to wait.
Welcome back, Commander. I'd like to warn you—the floor is wet, so please be careful.
This set is unbelievably big... Ahaha, there's no way I'd have any complaints. However, I definitely want the girl who prepared this set to experience what cleaning this humongous space feels like.
Speaking of which, what is this set even used for... well, I guess it's fine. It's not something for me to worry about.
That poor-looking Royal Maid taught me how to clean things up... Ahaha, it's not the kind of cleaning that you're thinking about, just regular cleaning.
Lützow, I'm not telling you not to play with the manjuu, but make sure you carry those things to Akashi once you're done, you hear?
Though you shouldn't be helping me clean... if you insist, there's no way I'd turn you down.
Nice work. I was just about to take a break myself. Would you like me to help you with anything?
Roon-class armored cruiser - Yorck.
I'm Yorck, Iron Blood cruiser. While I've hardly a single feat to boast about, I have many strengths I can offer you. It's your choice whether or not to accept them, though♪
The name's Yorck - I'm a cruiser. As of today, I'm in your hands. State your orders, and I will make my goals and desires one and the same as your directives. A wonderful arrangement, no? Heehee.
Excuse me for being so early, heehee. Now, show me that leadership of yours and make me happy.
You're free to regard me as a tool - a means to exert your power. Heehee. I don't mind.
Spee, if it's friends you want, I can be yours. We'll have so much fun together. Heehee♪
That I serve someone is all that matters, not whom I serve. It could just as well be Emden as it could be you. Though admittedly, very few are able to command me.
You look strapped for work, which I'm quite happy about. The more things I do for you, the easier your job becomes. Isn't that the best arrangement one could want?
Hmm? Are you trying to chat me up, or issue an order?
Oh, I see... You want the same done to you, hmm♥
It's of no concern to me if some missions sit and gather dust, but what's your plan for them, Commander?
Letting the mission rewards pile up to collect them all in one fell swoop once is more satisfying, don't you agree?
There's a letter for you. The most I can do is hand it to you, sadly. Heehee.
Welcome back. Next time you bring me on a sortie, please make it as good as the one just now was.
Those girls have returned from their commission. You commanded them wisely. Heehee.
Why, you... I must say, I'm pleasantly surprised. Heehee.
Time to earn your paycheck, Commander.
What will you do next? Keep advancing, or call it quits and pull back?
How unfortunate... If only we had more backbone.
Hope you like being chopped to pieces. Heehee♪
Seems like covering our rear is my only strong suit.
Heehee. You may be a worthless, hopeless imbecile, but I still have use for you.
Kindly tell me if there's something you want me to do. Likewise, I'll suggest new things I can do as I come up with them.
There are certain things only you can do, so try not to become too dependent on me. Having said that... I wouldn't refuse if you offered to become my puppet.
You really have a charismatic aura that draws people in. It's why you're deserving of my loyalty... or should I say, my love. Heehee.

Isn't it high time you picked the location of our next date? You are the Commander, your job is to lead us shipgirls. Or would you rather I gave you a list of candidate locations, as per usual? ...W-well? Which will it be?

From planning the ceremony to sending out invitations, you left it all to me. Do I take that to mean you're ready to be mine? Say it, then. "I take Yorck to have and to hold from this day forward." Let me hear that resolve, that desire of yours♥
Were you perhaps influenced by my preferences, or...

ex.line: Ah, you're right on time, as you said you would be. I do fancy a person true to their word. Heehee.
Before you state your business, I'd like to ask a question. Are you here to speak with Yorck, the subordinate, or me, your wife in marriage?
You want me to call you something else? I'm fine with either "Commander" or "Leader." "Master" is on the table too, if that's your thing.
You're requesting my aid without even realizing it, aren't you? Heehee.
You know, I think I like it when you somewhat force yourself onto me. Heehee♥
Tenacious and brave in the face of incoming attacks... I see. There's always so much to learn from your strategies.
After all the faith you've put in me, this is the least I can do.

lines.line: "Foolish, pitiable creature. Kneel before your Goddess!" Heehee! Hahahah, ahahahaha♥ You're the Commander, silly. You don't need to play along unless you want to.
"Foolish, pitiable creature. Kneel before your Goddess!" Heehee! Hahahah, ahahahaha♥ You're the Commander, silly. You don't need to play along unless you want to.
Your office chair pales in comparison to my throne. Don't you want to sit on it for yourself?
Acting as though I control you is surprisingly enjoyable. Thank you for this one night of indulgence, Commander.
Let's put Deutschland to the test and see who compels the most people... No, I meant between her and you, Commander.
A vampire hunter, you say? I wonder whether Seydlitz could make it all the way here without your aid.
Should it not be you who decides what to do, not me?
Oh. Oh my...
Oh my. You've returned with a small navy's worth of glory. That's my Commander.
There shall be left no trace of your existence.
You expected anything different? Victory is par for the course when you're a Goddess.

This is armored cruiser Yorck, and I'm ready for a night with you, Commander. My "armor" today - my outfit, if you'd prefer - is made to be enticingly light AND stimulate your desire... Heehee, don't expect to get away from me easily tonight♥

This is armored cruiser Yorck, and I'm ready for a night with you, Commander. My "armor" today - my outfit, if you'd prefer - is made to be enticingly light AND stimulate your desire... Heehee, don't expect to get away from me easily tonight♥
Oh, there you are, Commander. Nobody else is around, you know. What comes next, I wonder...? I can't wait to find out, heehee.
Waiting and watching for your next move is a new experience for me. Of course, I'm more than happy to let you give me commands, too♥
Wow, what a nice view. Is there anything you... want me to do for you? And I don't mean just for tonight♥
Heheh, it's time to take it easy, okay? Empty that little brain of yours and just stare at me.
"Honey." "Darling." "My dearly beloved Commander." Which do you prefer? Or do you like them all? Heheheh, I'm game for anything. I'll just follow your orders♥
Heehee, did you think of any fun ideas? I'll gladly do whatever you'd like!
Do whatever you want. Heehee♥
Oh? You changed clothes... I see you have "armor" for our little contest, too, Commander♪
What a satisfying victory. Shall we continue, or should we go somewhere a little more private?

Heehee, it's about time for tonight's main event, isn't it? As Commander, you can't afford to back down... Oh, have you decided to obey someone else's commands for once? ...Make your decision now, okay? It's not nice to keep a woman in suspense.
Dresden-class light cruiser - Emden.
I am the Swan of the East, also known as Emden, the Dresden-class light cruiser. "And I am Emden of the Königsberg class - member of the High Seas Fleet. We are Emden. Remember our name."
Heehee, it is you that summoned Emden, isn't it, my darling human? I shall make real your every desire if only you surrender yourself. "Heehee. Submit to Emden. Submit to us."
Welcome home, my darling human. Where shall your conquest take you today, and what foes shall you smite?
"Don't assume I'm fond of you, pitiable human." You have the sweet scent of a bud that wishes to blossom, dear human. The kind of scent that Emden adores.
Trying to make a human submit through force only gains you its resentment. Only by breaking the human's spirit can you make its whole being your own.
"When you're at a loss, how about you get up and move instead of just sitting in your chair?" Emden cannot bear to see you rack your brains all day, dear human. Heehee.

You, my dear hardworking human, deserve a reward. You are hereby granted the privilege of massaging Emden's shoulders. Use neither too little nor too much force, and henceforth, kindly do it without me telling you to first.
Why do you stroke my head? That is something a master does to her pet. Perhaps what you did was the inverse of this idea?
You would use force to subjugate a defenseless girl? Heehee, unfortunately for you, Emden stands on top, and you crawl down below, dear human. This is an unchangeable fact.
Is this your way of saying that you long to be put in a cage? "Do you wish to be flayed 'til your skin gives way to bone?"
New orders from your superiors. Supposing that someday no one is left to give you orders, where will you go then, dear human?
Ah, mission rewards. Emden need not tell you how best to use them, right, my darling human?
You have a letter, dear human. Would you be good and read it aloud to Emden?
You've returned to safety, now won't you close your eyes and rest? It's important that you get your beauty sleep, my darling human.
New supplies have arrived. A traveling swan needs sustenance - when her stomach growls, she has little choice but to "borrow" food from a passerby.
Thank you for this strength, my darling human. "You make good decisions sometimes! Heeheehee♪"
An entertaining battle awaits us♡
The battle is over. All you who are out of Emden's range may now take your leave.
One can hardly call this a desired outcome, dear human. "I get the impression you ordered a sortie without a moment of preparation."
Heeheehee♪
If you wish to defeat Emden, you must use your every drop of strength♪
Oh dear. It seems Emden got carried away. Such a pity... Her only darling human, broken by her own hands.
A lovable pet should not be unwaveringly obedient, but rather a source of continued delight to its master. "Fawn on me in a way I enjoy, my sweet human♪"
Insistent on being a disobedient little human, aren't you? "I like seeing a sweet human struggle so. Heehee."
"In truth, Emden has wanted to shackle you down from the outset, human." Obedience gained by force is worthless. I shall patiently wait for you to submit to me of your own accord, my darling human.

One finds the world's greatest comfort not in a cage of steel, but in a cradle of love and submission. Have no fear, my darling human. Give your body and soul to Emden, and your woes and troubles will all disappear in due time♡

Have you at long last learned your place? Heehee, as much as I enjoy seeing your cute struggling, you're more lovely when you submit♡ Now, lie in my cradle of love and embrace an eternal slumber. "Emden will cuddle you forever and ever. You won't want to leave♥"
You certainly know how to work for my affection now, my darling human~

ex.line: "You're late, human. How are you going to make it up to Emden, hmm?" Emden hopes for an apology through your words and actions, darling. Heehee♡
Yees? What does my beloved, darling human need of Emden? Based on that lonely look... I assume you yearn for my lips♡ "Or maybe what you want is to be held in Emden's embrace? Heehee~"
The smell of guilt is in the air... Emden can read your mind like an open book, human." Emden graciously accepts the fact that you're procrastinating, darling♡
Come hither, my darling human. Heehee♪ I see you're still reluctant to receive a headpatting♡
Hard at work, I see. You must be dying to experience Emden's punishment. Heehee~ You do find such joy in it, after all♥
You're starting to like your own subordinacy, aren't you? Heehee~
Have you forgotten, my dear human? The use of force will not change your standing in relation to Emden. "Or are you implying you've come to enjoy this arrangement?"
"You're just begging to be spoiled, human♥" Emden shall caress you until you're whisked away to sleep♡
Nobody can impede your progress... but Emden is a different case. Now go and finish your missions, wretched human♥
Oh, I wonder how I shall nurse my dear tired human♡ "Only Emden may decide - you have no say in this matter, human♥"
"Nothing beats reducing an eyesore of an opponent to dust♥" Your sinking shall further my dear human's and my glory♡
I had high hopes for you... Alas, it seems your charm is your only merit, my dear human.

lines.line: Raise your head, my darling human. O lost soul, you have three options - become Emden's meal, become Emden's prisoner... "Or become Emden's vassal. Our vassal♥"
Raise your head, my darling human. O lost soul, you have three options - become Emden's meal, become Emden's prisoner... "Or become Emden's vassal. Our vassal♥"
"You're late, human." How will you make recompense for the time you kept Emden waiting, hmm? My darling human♡
What you see is not theatrics, my darling human. Emden has merely adopted a more suitable form for handling a vassal. Vampirism has nothing to do with it. Heehee♡
Vampire hunters... A rather barbarous kind, aren't they? "They will learn who truly rules the night."
You may borrow my human if you wish, Yorck. Please do keep in mind, though, that you are only BORROWING my human.
By all means, use your holy artifacts as a means of meager resistance. "I will savor every moment as I slowly crush your rebellious spirit♥"
"You have some gall, human." Emden can tolerate a dash of self-indulgence♡
Embrace the night, and the night shall embrace you. "Now, are you ready to offer yourself?"
Close your eyes and let Emden show you a dream. A rapturous dream wherein all is possible. "A paradise of perpetual night."
A new mission has come in. Have no fear, my darling human. The night shall show you the way.
Mission completed. You have done well, my darling human. You are hereby given the privilege of sharing a toast with Emden.
There is a letter for you. Emden shall read it first, then you may take it after, my darling human.
It matters not whither you flee, for you will inevitably return hither, my dear human♡ "After all, a human that's wholeheartedly submitted to Emden can never truly escape. Heehee♥"
The errand girls have returned. Let us see what they've brought... "Well, well. These aren't half-bad spoils."
Welcome, my darling human. Are you looking for something? If it is Emden you seek, you have already found her. "We, Emden, are before your very eyes."
Welcome, my darling human. Are you looking for something? If it is Emden you seek, you have already found her. "We, Emden, are before your very eyes."
Welcome, my darling human♡ Have you come, hoping to see Emden? "Or have you come to answer Emden's summons? Heehee♥"
The scent you exude smells sweeter and richer than all the flowers here, my dear human. Your fragrance is one I adore so much.
Emden aches with eagerness when you let your indecision show, my dear human. "How I wish I could grab and drag you under the water♥"
"You've earned a reward, my sweet human." Open your mouth and savor Emden's nectarous taste♡
Look down and inspect your reflection closely, my dear human. Much unlike Emden, you must carve out your own path if you're to survive. Heehee.
You're so endearing when you're scared, my darling human.
Much like attempting to top me, grasping for the moon within a lake's reflection is a futile endeavor. Heehee.
You seem to believe you're in control of Emden... "When in fact it's Emden who controls you♥"
You've received new missions. Accept your fate and carry them out. You may defy your superiors, but you cannot defy Emden.
What a well-behaved pet you are. Have yourself a reward, my darling human.
My darling human♡ Why don't you have a peaceful slumber beneath the moonlight? "Sleep, and we will cosset you in your dreams♥"
Those commission girls have returned. "Rejoice, human, for Emden is content with this alone."
"You really thought the likes of you could best Emden?" Neither you nor my dear human could dream of overcoming Emden. Heehee♡

Welcome, my darling human. We are Emden, the receptionists that shall guide your way. You can go anywhere you'd like... as long as you give us an offering♡ "Even to an unsullied paradise that is not of this world"♥

Welcome, my darling human. We are Emden, the receptionists that shall guide your way. You can go anywhere you'd like... as long as you give us an offering♡ "Even to an unsullied paradise that is not of this world"♥
We are ready for you now, my darling human. Would you like to a whole new world today? "Or perhaps you want to search for the end of the known world?"
You give off a scent of curiosity and expectation, dear human. "Such a sweet and delectable smell. Heehee. It gladdens me."
You look lost, my darling human. Do you really find my schedule table that interesting? "Or are you simply engrossed in the service that Emden provides?"
Are you unsure where to go, dear human? Emden shall assist you. "Know that this is a kindness done unto you, human."
You must beg Emden if you want to know when and where this cruise will change course. If Emden finds your appeal satisfactory, I'll consider telling you. Heehee♥
Heehee, has our change in standing perhaps emboldened you? "Or do you actually think this will curry favor with Emden?"
Emden stands on top of you even whilst serving as receptionists, dear human. "And still, you boldly try to take a step further."
"Come with Emden♥" Clear your mind completely and relish in the paradise Emden has created♡
Welcome back, my darling human♡ "Emden shall give you a peaceful dream♥"
Supplies have arrived, dear human. I urge you to claim them at once. "You will need them on your voyage. Use them carefully."
A victory just as planned. Heehee. You're very talented. "Do you seek to pursue all-out war next?"

Emden arranged this cruise just for you, my darling human. Let Emden guide you and feel the joy of letting Emden take care of everything♡ "Don't resist it. Revel in the ultimate bliss that Emden provides♥"
Were you drawn here by the seaspray and my alluring figure, my darling human? Heehee... From now on, your lens and your gaze belong to Emden only~♡ "Revel in this great honor, human~♥"
Were you drawn here by the seaspray and my alluring figure, my darling human? Heehee... From now on, your lens and your gaze belong to Emden only~♡ "Revel in this great honor, human~♥"
Which Emden would you prefer to take a picture of right now, my darling human? "Make sure your photos do Emden's beauty justice."
The dusklight's glow on the water's surface, the way your eyes are fixed on Emden alone... "'Tis the picture of undeniable perfection."
The light is growing dimmer... Now is the time, my darling human. Use your lens to drape this golden veil over Emden.
Try for a slightly lower angle... Yes, like you're looking up at Emden... "Only by following Emden's advice shall you snap the perfect masterpiece."

"Your attention is drifting again..." Are you charmed by Emden's beauty? Or perhaps thinking about how to take the photo that would please Emden the most? Heehee, you need not say it. Your eyes tell me everything~♡
"Is this some attempt at flattery, or your way of comforting me?" Either way, Emden will gladly accept it~♪
You wish to direct which pose I'll take? How bold of you, my darling human~♡ "Show Emden what pose you have in mind...♥"
Such an audacious pose... You're looking for an angle that brings out both light and shadow, are you? "Heheh... Emden will grant you that which you desire~♥"
There's a new mission. Shall we handle it now, or finish this photoshoot first? "The choice is yours, but be sure to make a decision that will please Emden."
Mission complete. But, forget the rewards. Emden is more curious about the photos you took.
To reward you for a triumphant return, Emden will spend some quality time with you~♡ "But be sure to stretch and warm up before you go into the water~♥"
From now on, my darling human, Emden shall be all you ever see. You are fated to stay by Emden's side, forever... "Fated to be enthralled by Emden's presence, forever~♥"

Human? My precious, sweet human? What is on your mind right now?
"You stand before Emden, staring blankly..."
Seeing you like this...
Makes me absolutely salivate♡ "Absolutely salivate♥"

Breathe in... Breathe out... Inhale, exhale... Inhale, exhale...
"You need to relax before we start warming up."
Shall Emden help you? My sweet human, heheh♡

Embrace Emden tightly, darling human. This is a very important trust exercise we have to do before we dip into the water.
"Face Emden head on, and embrace lovingly♥"
Heheh... Hold Emden tight... Hard and firm enough to mess Emden up.

Let my embrace slowly... gradually... guide your body...
"Being embraced by Emden... Feels amazing, does it not?"
Look at me now... Do you see who holds you in her arms now?
That's right, it's Emden... "Pay it no mind... Emden is right here on this side, too."

Next, I'll reward you for all your hard work, my diligent, darling human.
"Bask in the sweet delights only Emden can offer you."
Emden will thoroughly pamper you...♡ "Emden will utterly pamper you...♥"

Heheh, let us begin, then...
"A special lesson only a good, hardworking Commander gets to experience..."
Are you ready? "Is your heart racing?♥"

Heheheh... Commendable work, my darling human.
Heheheh, allow us to cheer you on.
Keep it up...♡ Keep it up...♡ "Expect a generous reward from Emden♥"

Can you feel Emden's hands...? I feel your racing heart, darling human.
"It thumps and throbs... Is it excitement for what's to come, or perhaps...?"
Are you relishing in anticipation of what Emden is about to do with you?
Darling human♡ "Darling human♥"

Let us swim together, dear human... But before we begin, Emden will warm you with her body.
Come closer, a little closer... Share your desires with Emden...
"And then join Emden..."
Let yourself go and fall...♡ "Let it all go and fall...♥"

That should be enough preparation. Won't you show Emden the fruits of your training...?
"Now, are you prepared to entrust yourself to Emden?"
Are you ready to devote everything to Emden?
Make your choice, little human♡ "Emden leaves the choice in your hands, little human♥"
Pillau-class light cruiser - Elbing.

I'm Elbing, Pillau-class cruiser of the Iron Blood. I'm on the small side for a cruiser, and my service history is a disappointment. My armor is paper and my firepower is pathetic. My only redeeming traits are my speed and range...

I'm Elbing, Iron Blood cruiser. I know you're going to shun me since I'm worthless in a battle... You're not going to do that? Ah, right... The only thing I have going for me is how disposable I am...
No rain today, I assume? I see... So there was no point in me bringing an umbrella.
Commander? Are you hurt? Not even a scratch? I just got worried you might have h-had an accident on the way here...
It could rain today. You see, when I say it's going to rain, the weather always turns sunny...
My rigging is so intimidating... Strong though it may be, it's no good in the hands of someone helpless like me.
After all my efforts, there's no less work than when I started... But if I give up, your workload might increase instead... Ughhh...
Ahh...
Maybe I could help with... No, I'm good for absolutely nothing.
Y-you flatter me...
Commander, here is the mission list. Whew...
Mission rewards have come in. You should verify them, Commander. Making me do it is a bad idea...
I hope this letter has good news for you, and bad news for me...
Welcome back. You came home safe and sound because I wished that you'd get battered and bruised. My wishes never, ever come true, you see...
The commission team is back. I'd better not retrieve the rewards, or some will magically disappear...
Why strengthen me of all people...?
I'll take care to stay out of collision range!
I... I'm the MVP? You don't have to hold back for my sake... I just don't have what it takes to be the MVP...
Sure enough, all battles I partake in end in defeat...
It won't matter if I can't hit them...!
W-we're gonna collide!
This is all my fault for wishing for a good Commander...
I'll state this upfront: I'm feeble, clumsy, cursed with terrible luck, and I doubt I'll be much of any use to you...
None of my shells ever land. Even when I take another shot, it just misses. All I do is waste ammunition... *sigh*...
You've been kind to me this whole time not because I'm useful, but because you pity me, isn't that right? I only wish I could do anything in return...
Nothing I've sincerely wished for has ever come true. All I can do for you is this... I wish to be miserable! I wish to go through sorrows with you, Commander! ...This should bring you happiness.

A promise ring?! B-but that'd make us both happy, when I explicitly... I see now. The wish must've come true because I wished for your happiness, not my own. Thank goodness... *sniffle*... I'm so glad it came true!
F-for me? Are you sure?

ex.line: You think it's going to rain today? I see... I brought my umbrella, hoping the weather would clear up. H-hopefully this will be a sunny day.
Oh gosh! I'm so sorry! I shouldn't have thrown the door open! I thought there's no way you're in here, but lo and behold, you were standing right at the entrance...
We should go on a date since it's sunny? Um, sure! I'll bring my umbrella to ensure this nice weather sticks around for the whole day!
Destroyers usually have cute little riggings... Something like what they have would suit me better. Heehee.
Is there any way I can help? As long as it's something I can handle and will make your job easier...
If there's any way I can help, I'll try.
Ahh...
New mission rewards! I wonder wh-what we've received.

Of course your wellbeing is important to me, but I try not to think about it. I mean, wishing for your safety only puts you in danger. Simply not worrying about you is the best way to ensure nothing bad happens...
Are you sure you want me to fetch the commission rewards? Items on the list might get lost somehow if I do it...
You really don't need to work so hard to make me the MVP, Commander. Because if I'm the top performer, that's a bad sign...

I'm going to have an awful day today. It's going to rain, the restaurant I booked a table at will close early, same for the movie theater after that, and you'll receive urgent work that keeps you busy all night... That should do it! Thanks for waiting while I recited all that.

lines.line: As the mistress of this manor, I c-command thee to kneel... No, of course. I mean, what authority do I have to issue commands? I'm better suited to be a maid than a mistress...
As the mistress of this manor, I c-command thee to kneel... No, of course. I mean, what authority do I have to issue commands? I'm better suited to be a maid than a mistress...
You should be on this throne, not me, Commander. Let me get up so we can swap- Aahh!
I'm better suited for a role like... a messenger of misfortune who puts a curse on you. Don't you think so too, Commander?
This is what happens when you stretch your clothes past their limit... It's not my fault? Yes it is, because I'm a bad fit for this role...
I'd be helpless even in the role of a maid. All I would do is mess up constantly and be a burden to you...
At the risk of sounding rude... Emden should be doing this, not a trainwreck like me.
What is your bidding, Commander?
Mmh... Ahh...
Eek! Oww... I tore my pantyhose again... Sorry for how terrible I look, Commander. You hate to see this, don't you...?
Are you also having trouble sleeping, Commander? I-I thought so... It must be because I was praying for you to have sweet dreams... Look what I've done - now, neither of us can fall asleep... Urgh...
Are you also having trouble sleeping, Commander? I-I thought so... It must be because I was praying for you to have sweet dreams... Look what I've done - now, neither of us can fall asleep... Urgh...
Since we can't fall asleep, we could always cuddle together... or not... I know you'd say no if I... Oh, we can?

I'm worried I might wish for something that negatively affects you in my dreams... You doubt my curse extends to my dreams? Maybe not, but I'll have forgotten what I wished for once I wake up, so you can never be sure...
Mmh... Ahh... Ohh... Hahh... S-Sorry... Am I too close?
I guess I should try to stay still... I don't want to bump into you by accident... You can change positions if you want. I-I can handle a bump or two...
If you really can't sleep, should I whisper into your ear like Emden did? Alright, let me just turn over to... Eep!
What is it, Commander?
Mmh! Ahh... Hahh... Ohh... Hah...
Whew... I made a wish that you'd come back dead tired, which is why you're full of energy. Although... that'll only make it harder for you to fall asleep, won't it?
The commission team is back? Right, yeah... I'd forgotten. It's not their bedtime yet.
This is either a fluke... or I'm dreaming.
G-good day, Commander. I'm ready to be your model... Ugh, there's probably going to be an accident if I wish that you'll take cute photos... Better clear my head just to be sure.
G-good day, Commander. I'm ready to be your model... Ugh, there's probably going to be an accident if I wish that you'll take cute photos... Better clear my head just to be sure.
Have we already started, Commander? ...You're looking for an angle to get a cute shot of me? M-me... cute... Oh, gosh... *blushes*
Lunar New Year is a day that brings good luck, because even a girl like me gets to be with you... Huh? It's nothing to do with luck, and entirely because I worked so hard for it? T-true... *blushes*
(The Commander's staring so much... No, probably at the camera moreso than me... So it's okay... Oh gosh...)
What about me do you think is so cute? I-I'm not saying I AM cute... Whew... I-if you want to take pictures, just go ahead...
You'll share your Lunar New Year luck with me? Th-thanks... I'll do my best to live up to your hopes this year!
Look into the camera with a confident smile? L-like this?
Th-this angle might be a liiittle bit... *blushes*
Hey, mission rewards have arrived. I'm fine staying like this, but are you?
Did you get the photos printed? Oh, you don't need to show me! They'll stop being cute if I get too excited about them...
(The commission team is back. So I'll have to stay like this while the Commander goes and greets them... Oh, gosh...)
As long as I'm fighting I won't have to have weird thoughts!

This lantern wards off evil spirits, so I should make a wish? Oh... I won't, because my good and bad luck will probably just offset each other, so wish on my behalf... No, don't tell me your wish or it won't come true. Just wish for what your heart wants... *blushes*
Admiral Hipper-class heavy cruiser - Prinz Eugen
I'm Prinz Eugen, third ship of the Admiral Hipper class. I like to read books all day since I'm still too young to go outdoors much. Uhh, I don't like beer... Is there anything else you wanna know?
Are you the Commander? I'm Prinz Eugen, Iron Blood heavy cruiser. Let's shake hands and be friends~ I'm looking forward to having a lot of fun. Heehee~
Good morning. Good luck with your work. I'll be here reading a book until you finish.
When I look at Hipper, I tend to get the feeling that I'm more mature than she is... Is it just me? Look, Hipper's getting all sulky again♪
Alright, all that's left to do is put my finger on my lips like this... Tehehe, seeing your expression made putting this pose on completely worth it.
I can't wait until the day I can set sail with my friends... I mean, it's boring, spending all day stuck in here...
I don't get what people find tasty about alcohol. Even smelling the stuff makes me feel all dizzy.
Treating me like a child... I see. Then come at me with all you've got.
Whew... That shower left me feeling super refreshed... Yawn... Commander? Did you want to take a nap together?
This is what people mean when they say, "You can't judge a book by its cover." Hehehe~
Here's a new mission. Let me know when you want some help.
You're sharing the reward with me? Thank you.
There's some new mail. Make sure to check on it before you end up forgetting.
Commander, don't you think it's about time for snack time? Hehehe, keep it coming.
Looks like they're done with commissions. I wonder if they'll take me with them if I ask nicely...
That felt nice. I'll expect more from you next time.
I'm giving it my all!
This doesn't feel half bad. Teehee☆
So this is what defeat tastes like... Don't expect this to happen next time...!
Hehe, seems like a good time to use this.
It's not over yet...!
Sigh... what an absolute disappointment.
Commander, got anything to spill about the recent mission? I mean, it's been pretty boring only reading books these days. So, has anything interesting happened?
The Commander was still working when I got up from my nap. I wonder if they're getting enough rest... Well, it doesn't look that bad at least.
If nobody told you to stop working, you'd just keep working without rest, so I'll let you know when it's snack time. Got it? I want you to take a break, and I also want to eat some snacks.

Thank you for telling me all these interesting stories. One day, I want to head out to the huge ocean, and see all kinds of sights. Of course, you'll be with me when I do, won't you? ...Hehehe, I'm looking forward to it.

Do you really need to ask me about my response when you should know what it is already? "The promised future I'd like to fulfill with you..." ...I can't hear you. Come on, speak louder! Even louder than that!
Did my sister tell you? Thank you very much. It means a lot to me.

ex.line: Oh, already done with work? Then how about you play with me instead of reading a book?
I was out to console Hipper, but now you're jealous of her? Hehe, you're both so high maintenance.
Mein Schatz... My Darling~ I felt it was fitting to use grown-up words for my dear grown-up Commander. Hehe, what are you blushing so much for.
It's not boring at all being in this place when I'm together with you... That's how I've come to feel.
What do you mean, I should get over it and force it down, Hipper you dummy. It's over... my head is spinning...
Mmn, isn't it a bit early... Let me sleep in a bit longer... Zzz
So is this how adults play together? Hehehe~
I was free, so I took care of part of the mission for you.
What is it? You look ravenous, as if you want something more than just a snack. What, I'm just making fun of you♪
It wasn't a big deal for me.

lines.line: J-class destroyer - Jervis.

I am Jervis, J-class destroyer. I participated in several operations with the Royal Navy. If you are inclined to sum up my service as "lucky"... I suppose I don't mind. It's normal for people to become fixated on what stands out most to them, no?

I am Jervis, J-class destroyer of the Royal Navy, and my duty is to assist the injured. You seem to be in pretty good shape, Commander, so my services probably aren't needed? I'll be taking my leave for now.
I wonder if it is an acceptable thing to keep your secretary waiting like this.
I don't want any harm to come to Janus. Please take good care of her, and don't try to take advantage of her kindness.
Your nose is practically buried in your paperwork. If you don't want to live in a blurry world, I'd advise you to be mindful of your posture.

When treating people, the emphasis should always be on the "people" part. Administering the port operates on the same principle. Though it's fine to be absorbed in your work, try not to neglect the people around you.
Did Janus say anything weird to you lately? ...Nevermind. She's a kind-hearted girl, but sometimes acts without thinking. It can be a bit of a pain sometimes...
What are you doing, may I ask?
...Let me see your hand. Good, there's nothing wrong with it.
Surely you're not going to say that was an "accident," are you?
Leaving work unfinished is like allowing an illness to go untreated. By the time things get unmanageable, it may already be too late. *sigh*... Why do people choose to be so irresponsible anyway?
Mission complete. Don't forget to look back on your work to see if there's room for improvement.
New mail has arrived. If you miss any response deadlines, I can't help you with that.
Welcome back-- Oh my, you have some scratches on you. You shouldn't be so careless as to put yourself in danger... I'll treat you right now, so please stay still.
The commission's done. Make sure to wash your hands after carrying things, or else our next meeting might be in the infirmary.
I do wonder if you're improving yourself while everyone else is getting stronger.
Remember to mind your safety, even when you're fighting.
Is anyone injured? Please allow me to administer some basic treatment.
Let's withdraw. Phew... I'm glad we were able to rescue everyone in time.
Careful now.
Nothing some emergency treatment can't fix!
I cannot comprehend people who do bad things yet act like all is right with the world... Yes, people such as you, Commander.
Mhm, that should do it. Please be more careful next time. Oh, Commander? As you can see, I've just finished my treatment. Are you feeling unwell, or... just slacking off again?
Try not to get yourself hurt when you're out on sortie. It's going to be a huge headache for me if you end up bedridden.

Of course, it falls upon me to look after you should you get injured... And while that's rather troublesome, for some reason, I do find that prospect quite appealing... I wonder if I'm coming down with some weird illness myself...
I wonder if there's a cure for my selfishness... Hey, Commander, what reason might one have to develop feelings for her patient? Hm? You want me to tell you? ...As if, you prat.

Seeing as how you aren't a complete plank, I suppose I can give you an answer. Taking care of you isn't something I can't handle... Huh? You want me to say "I love you?" Y-you idiot... Maybe we can save that for next time...
Well. I don't dislike it.
Do you need some assistance?

ex.line: Making a girl wait for you isn't good manners, Commander.

Commander, do you keep a diary by any chance? See, I was thinking I'd do like Janus and record my day-to-day thoughts, and... No, you may absolutely not read it. You'll just have to live with that, I'm afraid.
Please try to curb your bad habits for the sake of your health. I'll keep an eye on you for however long it takes until all traces of them are gone.
You just can't resist doing perverted things, can you?
You idiot...
You have a bunch of unfinished missions. Remember what I... *sigh*... Reminding you about everything has become a habit of mine.
Oh, you completed a mission? Nicely done. You've proven your ability to commit to your duties.
You've received a new letter. Unless you have more urgent business, I advise you read it now.
Look at you - you got hurt again! I'll have to use antiseptic. It's going to sting, but you have only yourself to blame for that.
Is that all of the commission supplies? All right, now it's time to wash your hands. Go on - put them forth and I'll show you how it's done.
The best type of victory is one without casualties.

Could you come see me again later today? ...No, not for a checkup, but rather for a d-da- Look, you already know what I'm talking about. If you're interested, then just say it, please... Y-you idiot...

lines.line: Phew... That about does it. Next on the agenda is... Huh, Commander? What are you doing here?
Phew... That about does it. Next on the agenda is... Huh, Commander? What are you doing here?
I thought a certain someone came here to slack off, but turns out they had spare time and wanted to help out, huh... I guess there's nothing stopping you.
I'm helping out because the Maid Team is somewhat understaffed right now. What about my outfit...? Is there something wrong about wearing maid attire while performing maid duties?
Janus went to participate in the "Maid Experience Day." A real hard worker, I tell you. If she runs into any problems, won't you quietly lend her a hand? ...But, don't bring me up at all.
Are you seriously going to stay here until lunch? I'm telling you now, I only cook for my patients. If you're fine with that, you're free to do as you please.
Huh?! Why'd the wind suddenly kick up...?! Phew, that was a close one... Maybe I should just have you keep an eye on this for me? Just in case~
I'll be fine. I can still reach. More importantly, where have your eyes been wandering?
Seems like the sheets aren't the only things that need cleaning. Let's put that dirty mind of yours through the wash too.
Since you have nothing better to do, why don't you lend a hand and help me hang up the rest of these sheets? Surely you didn't come here just to watch me work?

As a maid, I am able to take care of you even when you are not ill, yes? ...Not that I care though. I'm not interested in becoming your maid; it was merely a thought experiment... Yes, nothing more than that.
Bellona-class light cruiser - Bellona.

I am Bellona, a member of the improved Dido-class, the Bellona-class. As a member of the Royal Knights, I participated as an escort during transport missions as well as participating in the raid on Tirpitz. After that war, various things happened... Anyway, please feel free to entrust me with any mission you see fit.

I am Bellona, improved Dido-class light cruiser of the Royal Navy. If I am not mistaken, you are the Lord-Commander? I have stated my name and title as per our code. I hope you will do so as well, my liege.
My liege, I've been waiting for you. Have you prepared to face your toughest enemy today - your work?

My liege, would you like to have a bout with me? Of course, not a serious match, but just something to deepen our bonds... Next time, since you've got other work to focus on, you say? Understood. Whenever you're ready, please let me know.
I much prefer fighting one-on-one compared to the disorder of a melee. There's a huge difference between focusing on one enemy versus taking stock of the big picture, after all.
Hm? There are marks of wear on these gloves? How careless of me. I shall prepare a new set right away.
My liege, your expression... Did something bad happen? If you need someone to give you a push, I'd love to be of assistance.
Is this how you show your gratitude toward your subordinates? Duly noted.
Well then, I shall accept this duel... Oh, um, you were just giving me some work to do?
Shall I take this as a provocation?
If you think of your missions as a duel with an invisible enemy, your efficiency will go up.
These are the rewards for your completed missions. Please accept them as the spoils of the victor.
Mail? Is it a challenge to a duel? Please prepare... Huh? That's not the case?
My liege, good work out there... Um, your cuff and collar are all ragged... How about changing out first?
The commission team has returned. To be rewarded for one's toils is precious indeed.
The stronger I get, the greater my odds of victory.
A one-on-one battle shall have to wait for another day.
I present this victory to you with pleasure, my liege. Of course, it shan't be my last victory either.
While we may look past our failures, we must not ignore what led to them...
Come, we'll settle this with a duel!
Purge all distractions. I'll fight with a level head!
Only those with pride have the privilege to wield a sword in a duel. My liege, you still have much work to do to earn it.
Though I was christened after a goddess of war, I'm not particularly fond of it. The only value I find in wielding a sword is in the pure enjoyment of the world of duels.
Once I grasp my blade, the only thing in my sight is my enemy. In that moment, the sole thought in my head is to devote my all to defeating them.

It's unfair to judge victory or defeat based solely on swordsmanship unless those involved are experienced. What I'm saying is, what is your area of expertise, my liege? Of course I'm curious, but I was also wanting to try something that doesn't involve a sword.

If you're interested in learning more about me, how about we spar for a bit to our hearts' content? There's nothing that brings closer than that. Hehe, I'll show up on time, but I'll leave the time and place to you. I'm sure you wouldn't play dirty with me, my liege. Would you?

It is the destiny of man to wither away with the passage of time. ...However, even if my passions wither with the passing of time, I find that my emotions only mellow and become more robust, as if a fine vintage. You are the first person I've desired something more than swinging swords with, so... Please, don't let me down.
Thanks for this gift. I shall treasure it.
Hmm... This is a way to duel as well.

ex.line: Welcome back. While I do not enjoy being outnumbered, it would be quite boorish of me to mouth off when there is a mountain of work to take care of. Let us do our best together.

You don't have to put in so much effort into maintaining your appearance to look nice, but... putting in some effort to straighten things out makes you look much cooler. Alright, I feel great standing here by your side. Hehe.
If you are planning on going far away, please allow me to escort you, my liege. Hm? No need to ask for permission, you say?
Quite a strange way of asking someone on a date, if you ask me.
My liege, good work out there. Here you go. I brought you a change of clothes so you can continue to maintain your appearance while you work on your documents.
Even this victory shan't be my last. I've already told you, haven't I? Hehe.

lines.line: My liege... No, excuse me, I should be calling you Master, right? Bellona of the Royal Maids, reporting in. My, you seem quite lost for words... I'll explain the situation to you later, so don't worry about it.

My liege... No, excuse me, I should be calling you Master, right? Bellona of the Royal Maids, reporting in. My, you seem quite lost for words... I'll explain the situation to you later, so don't worry about it.
Good day to you, dear Master. Please give me your orders, whatever they may be. I am always ready to use my blade... Ahem, I am at your beck and call.

I have always been curious about the kinds of work that Dido and the others always do. I had always thought that the work the maids did was not very difficult, but actually, it's quite comparable to fighting in a melee.
When I think of the dust as my enemy in a duel... it's like fighting a phantom enemy that refuses to fight you face-to-face. I can only hope that there aren't that many.
Hmm... These windows with bump marks are hard to remove, so they should be dealt with as an emergency... As for the furniture, let's just replace them.
Looking at a room after a deep cleaning makes you feel a sense of accomplishment. The feeling of not even seeing a speck of dust feels as good as beating a very strong enemy in a duel.
Were you encouraging me? Please do not fret. My studies regarding the duties of a maid have been going quite swimmingly.
Let us clean up any unnecessary trash there might be.
You shouldn't underestimate the power of the Royal Maids.
Welcome back, dear Master. Please take a nice rest until our next battle begins. Allow me to take your soiled clothes from you.
Heavy cruiser - Cheshire.
I'm Cheshire, the heavy cruiser! I'll do my best to be helpful to mew, Owner! I dunno exactly what I'm gonna do, but I'll do it well! Whee~♡
Owneeeeer! Meeeow! Squeeze! Cuddle! Sniff! Heehee~ Here, you can have this as thanks for letting me give you the lovey-dovey cuddly-wuddly!
Owneeeeer! Mrreow~ Mmhh, you're so warm♪
Owner! Squeeeeze! Giving you huggles makes me all sleepy... *yawn*... Zzzzz...
Hey, Bel! Show me how to make good sweets!
You think I'm cute as a kitten? Heehee, you're making me blush, Owner♪
Drake! Please buy me a gift on your next trip! Something sweet would be nice!
Try on this kitty ear headband, Owner! Come on, have a go!
What do you have for me, Owner?
Here's another one for you, Owner!
You're amazing, Owner! You can do all these missions that are too much for me!
Don't stop meow, Owner! Go get your rewards, then it's time for the next mission!
There's mail for you! I wish I could read it, but I don't know most of these words...
Owner! It's fine if you forget to bring me a gift, but you can't forget to give me huggles!
The commission team has come back, Owner!
Thanks, Owner♪ Have this in return!
This is for you!
Look, Owner! I won♪
Do we fight back meow, before they catch on? No?
Have some cannon fire, too!
I'm not giving up!
I loved you, Owner, I really did...
I'm gonna make lots of yummy sweets for mew, Owner♪ ...Wait, what was step one again? I forgot...
Do I start with the salt or the sugar? Or do I mix the batter? Oh, and then there's the juicy fruits Drake gave me! What do mew think, Owner?
Aww... You were right, Owner. You can't make good sweets by mixing random stuff together... But I'm not gonna give up! I'll make something yummy eventually, you'll see!
Lookie, Owner! I made this cookie with the help of my friends! ...Huh? Why is it moving? Oh, oopsie! This isn't a cookie, it's a manjuu! Sorry I got them mixed up, Owner!
Wowie, a present! ...It's a ring? Ah, I get it, you wanna trade with me! Okey-dokey! In return, you geeet... Yup, you get me! Huggles♪
I wuv you, Owner! Eheheh~ *rub* *rub*~♪

ex.line: Owneeeeer! Mrreow~ Mmhh~ Owner? Wakey wakey, Owner! Your favourite kitten is here!
Owner! Squeeeeze! Are you free right meow? I could make some yummy sweets for you!
Now time for the whipped cream... Oh nooo! Help, Owner! I spilled cream on the floor!
When you get busy with work, I do as well! ...Wait, how does that work?
I've got a pack of orange juice for you, Owner! Give it a taste - it's great! I got it from the vending machine outside Akashi's store!
Owner...?
Huh? What is it, Owner?
Owner! Mew came back early just to see me! It's good I left the office early to see mew too!

lines.line: Illustrious-class aircraft carrier - Indomitable.
As the fourth member of the Illustrious class, of course I'd be somewhat different from my sisters... Hey, I'm talking about hangar capacity here, not service history or repair length.
I am the fourth ship of the Illustrious class, armored carrier Indomitable. *Yawn*... I seem to be getting a bit drowsy... Would you mind if we continued this later?
Good morning, Commander. Ehh? You're going to start working already? Why not get into the zone first by, say, opening up the window and basking in the breeze?
My Illustrious-class sisters are all outstanding. Should you run into any problems, they would be more than glad to help... Me? Um, well, I suppose I wouldn't mind offering you some advice...
Oh my, an invitation to a tea party? ...Though, I think I'll pass. Keeping up airs is soooo tiring.
Sleep revitalizes the body, daydreaming revitalizes the mind, and strolling refreshes one's mood. I'll have you know, all forms of relaxation serve a purpose, and are DEFINITELY not slacking off.
*Yaaawn*... Can't get motivated right now... Huh, work? I've already finished all of it.
Hyah?! Gosh, how rude of you to interrupt my daydreaming!
Did you need something? Though, it'd be great if you didn't...
Double my vacation time, buy me some sweets, and I'll keep this a secret. Hehe, not such a bad deal, right?
New missions, huh... Should be no problem at all for someone as experienced as you, right?
That's another mission taken care of! Hehe, you're pretty good at this, Commander.
New mail? Are we being told to go on vacation? Huh, what do you mean that's not possible?
Commander, congratulations on a most excellent sortie. Of course I wasn't doing nothing. I was praying for your success with all my might.
The commission team has returned. I shall await your return, so you should go greet them soon.
I've gotten stronger, but... maybe I shouldn't let anyone know that.
M-me, flagship? Sounds like a pain in the... Err, it's nothing! I'll do it!
I'm the MVP? I wonder if I shouldn't have tried so hard...
Seems like I'll be in the docks for a good while... Well, don't threaten me with a good time, I suppose.
Maybe I should start to get serious...
If this drags on, I'll seriously be in trouble...
*sigh*... I knew I shouldn't have gotten my hopes up...
Commander, are you busy right now? Oh, wow... You look totally lost in your work... Ahem, well then, I suppose I should leave you to it.
My hobbies? Hmm... Honestly, I haven't given it much thought up until this point. Let's see... what I like isn't so much finding things to do, but rather finding ways of not doing anything.

You should learn how to relax every once in a while precisely because you're always working so hard. Learning how to clear your mind and let go isn't as easy as it sounds. But don't worry if you can't do it right away, Commander. Hehe, I'll show you exactly how to do it next time~

Hehe, I see you're also slack- Err, I mean, nourishing your body and soul. That pleases me greatly. Alright, let's continue practicing the art of clearing our minds on a regular basis! As for where to conduct the lessons... how about in my room?

An oath ceremony? That sounds like something that could turn into a real pain in the ass... I'm not saying there's anything wrong with you, Commander. I mean, a ceremony is just for show, so it shouldn't matter if... Wh-why are you making me say something so embarrassing anyway?! Anyway, we're done here, so I'll be heading back!
Oh, this seems like a pretty nifty way to pass the time. Thanks.
Sisters, let's do our best~
I swear to stand with you this time!

ex.line: Good day, Commander. Umm, uhh... M-maybe there's something I can help you out with?
Should you run into any problems... You should come to me first, not my sisters... Y-yeah, I think I'm fine with that...
Commander, did you want to go to the tea party? Um, in that case... Ugh, why is this so hard...
Did you sleep well yesterday? If you're tired, you might want to take a little nap or go on a stroll outside first. I'll accompany you~

Formidable won't let any of our other sisters see her cheeky side, but she's a lot more open around me for whatever reason... Well, there's not a whole lot we have in common anyway. Her taste in music is a bit... too noisy for my tastes.
I'm serious. Y-you can come see me even if you don't have any problems...
You're such a bully...
I pray for the Commander's safe return... Ow, ow, ow... Who thought prayer could be such a painful thing... Oh my, is that you, Commander?
The commission fleet seems to have come back. Hurry up and go- Err, I mean, let's go greet them together.
If it's for your sake, I suppose I can put in a bit more effort...
MVP, huh... Darn it, now I'm going to have to rest up to get my motivation back!
Don't worry, I'm the type of girl who can bounce right back after a little nap.

Let's see, the next things to do on our date are... chilling together indoors, leisurely enjoying some tea, then quietly arrange some flowers. Hm? You want to go outside? I, I think our schedule's already pretty packed. Look, every time we go outside on a date, my legs get all puffy the next day...

lines.line: *Sigh*... I thought changing into maid attire would break up the monotony, but just getting into these clothes has tired me out... Oh, Commander? You came at a good time. Shall we slack off together?
*Sigh*... I thought changing into maid attire would break up the monotony, but just getting into these clothes has tired me out... Oh, Commander? You came at a good time. Shall we slack off together?
Welcome back, Master~♪ All righty, that's all my maid-motivation used up...
Knowing how to brew tea is one of the essentials for the Royal Maids, no? Well, that's something even I can do. Though only once a day, no more than that.
What jobs am I capable of doing? Let's see... Oh, I can warm up the bed for you before you go to sleep?

Now that I think about it, considering how capable you are as a commander, doing a maid's job should hardly be considered work, right? Maybe I'll have you take over the rest of my maid duties... Ahaha, well, it was worth a shot...
I'm sure someone with THIS many maids would live an absolutely blessed lifestyle... Ugh, it's making me jealous the more I think about it...
Are you trying to give me a massage? My shoulders were just starting to feel a bit stiff, so massage away~
I'm going to tell my sisters, you know?
The Royal Maids are always carrying all sorts of yummy snacks back and forth... I wonder how they can control themselves.
R-class battleship - Revenge.

I am Revenge, lead ship of the Royal Navy's Revenge-class battleships. I partook in the Jutland campaign, but since I participated mostly in escort missions afterward, I wasn't able to see too much action in that great war... I'm sorry... you must be disappointed to hear this.
...Woah?! S-sincerest apologies, I wasn't watching where I was going... Oh, you're the Commander? S-splendid! Battleship Revenge of the Royal Navy, at your service!
Good morning, Your Excellency. Is there anything I can help out with today?
You're not looking all too great... Is something on your mind? If there's something troubling you, please feel free to open up to me. It's not good to bottle things up inside...
Eek?! I apologize, I didn't notice the papers on the table... I'll get to them right away!
Not so long ago, I accidentally bumped into a destroyer while hurrying along... I'm glad that neither of us were hurt, but...
If you spend too long working, your neck and shoulders are bound to become stiff. H-how about I give you a nice massage to help you loosen up?
Um, excuse me...
Did something urgent come up? Then, put it over there... Y-you just want to chat for a bit...? I'm sorry for jumping to conclusions...
That's a discourteous thing to do to a lady. Don't you agree, Your Excellency?
Is there a new mission? Please let me know any time if you would like my assistance.
Allow me to retrieve our rewards for the missions we've completed! ...Oh, I need to check the list first...?
There is mail addressed to you, Your Excellency! Should I bring it to you right now?
I'm relieved that you were able to make it back safely. For now, please get some rest.
The girls are back from their commissions. Shall we go greet them together, Your Excellency?
Thank you very much. I'll make sure to live up to your expectations.
Everyone, follow my lead!
Alright, let's keep this up!
I guess I shouldn't have forced things so hard...
I shall protect the Commander and my allies!
I won't back down... Hah!
Please, don't give in to despair! If you just reform yourself, there will surely be a day when you are accepted by everyone!
U-umm... Your Excellency, regarding the time I bumped into you when we first met... Are you truly alright? ...Should we get your body checked?

Protecting the weak is the duty of us Royal Knights—Uhh, I'm not saying that you're weak, Your Excellency. Though, when we're on the battlefield, you're definitely on the side of "having to be protected"...

Your Excellency, you always work so tirelessly for our sake... You really should try to make some time for yourself. When you do, I'll stroke your hair, and cheer you up, telling you things like, "Good work, Commander, you've done such a good job~"

Your Excellency, not only are you the most important person in this port, but you are also the most important person in my life. That's why your safety is paramount to me—whether here, or on the battlefield... I'll make sure to protect you with all I've got.

*pant* *pant*... I heard you needed something from me, so I ran here as fast as I could... Wait—this is... a ring? N-no way, I-I-I-I'm sorry! This is so sudden, I don't know what to say... B-but, gladly! Of course!
Are you sure... I can have something this valuable?
The Royal Knights are here to defend you, Your Majesty!
I-I won't bump into you!

ex.line: Welcome back, Your Excellency. Hehehe, after seeing your face, I can't help but feel like today's going to be a great day.
That battleship from the Northern Parliament... is truly knowledgeable of the etiquettes of the Royal Navy. I am truly impressed.
If you're feeling tired, how about taking a rest for a bit? I shall be protecting Your Excellency by your side, so you need not worry.
So you want to chat? ...I-I apologize! You need something done immediately, don't you?
At least w-wait until we get somewhere else to do that...
Whew... I brought the mail over, Your Excellency.
I'm so relieved that you're alright... Thank goodness... I really wanted to be out there to make sure you were safe, you know? Ehe♪
I bear no grudges against you, but... Let the battle begin!
I don't enjoy fighting, but... I'm doing this to protect those I care about!

Your Excellency, I do not consider you to be weak—and as such, I don't protect you as a member of the Royal Knights, but as a woman who loves you. That is my simple wish, that which makes me happiest... O-of course, I plan on protecting you as a subordinate as well...

lines.line: Hrmm... *sigh*... Looks like I bungled this one too... I sure hope the Commander doesn't see me like th- Hwuh?! C-Commander? P-please give me a moment! I'll straighten this out right away... Waaah!!
Hrmm... *sigh*... Looks like I bungled this one too... I sure hope the Commander doesn't see me like th- Hwuh?! C-Commander? P-please give me a moment! I'll straighten this out right away... Waaah!!
Welcome back, Your Excellency. As you can see, I'm currently in the middle of cleaning...
The Royal Maids and the Royal Knights both work hard to protect our allies. Volunteering like this renews my sense of purpose.
Leave this to me... Eek! Your Excellency, I apologize... It wasn't on purpose, I swear!
The office is all tied up, the documents are organized as well... Alright! Both the Commander and Her Highness should be pleased with the results!
Your Excellency, I've learned how to brew proper black tea and make cookies from the Royal Maids... I-if there's a chance in the future, I'd like to...
I, I'm fine. Something like this is nothing a maid can't handle... Especially for a Maid-Knight like me!
H-how should I serve you at a time like this...
*pant* *pant*... Phew... I can't believe I'm getting this tired from just cleaning... Your Excellency... Why don't you also take a short break?
Fighting on the battlefield is so much easier than being a maid...
I can't believe I failed again... Waah...
Joffre-class aircraft carrier - Joffre.

I am the aircraft carrier, Joffre. I was constructed to face off against Iron Blood carriers during the great war, but due to various misfortunes, I was fated to a life of continually being laid down and halted again, never getting to see the light of day. I have no doubt that was yet another of my many trials.
By the power vested in me by the Holy Iris, I am aircraft carrier Joffre. I see that you are the Commander of this port. Hehehe, may you also receive the Iris's blessings.
Done with your morning prayers already? ...My apologies. Asking that of you is rather inappropriate on my part.
Bringing down punishment upon sinners—that is the sole reason for my existence. As for whether you will need to be judged or not, it is still too early to tell.
Because I am one who judges sinners, in a sense, I hate everyone. All humans are born sinners, after all.
Why did you stop working? If I'm not mistaken, you still have missions to take care of...?
I am not here to judge whether your actions are good or evil. Rather, I am here to judge your existence itself.
Is something the matter?
...Accept my judgment.
Your missions have arrived. Whether or not I pass judgment upon you depends on your progress.
The rewards for your missions are here. Take them without succumbing to greed.
It seems there's some new mail for you. Let's go check on it.
I shall judge the results of your battles on behalf of the Holy Iris. ...Well done. That was a magnificent victory.
The commission fleet has returned. Such is the Holy Iris's will.
As the Holy Iris wills.
In the name of the Vichya, I shall bring down punishment upon thee.
It is time for you to repent. Your life shall continue no longer. Soon, your remains shall become the foundations for our victory.
This is merely a trial under the guise of defeat...
I deem thee... Guilty!
So long as my wings don't break...!
Please don't force me to carry out my "duties" upon you. That would only make everyone sad.
My duty here is to "battle," not to judge, right? Do not worry. I shan't do anything that causes you worry.
My duty here isn't solely to battle, but also to get along with the others at the port? Understood. If those are your orders as the leader of this port, then I shall see them done.
Don't just try to get along with the others, but also try to have fun...? But for me, having fun means doing my "other" job... Heh, just kidding. I had fun watching your reaction just now. Ehehe.

I don't like to mince words, so I will tell you this. On your next day off, how about going on a date with me? If you turn me down, I guess I'll have to—Hehehe, I see. I'll be looking forward to it then, Commander.

I swear upon the name of the Holy Iris that our vows shall hold us together evermore. ...And with that, I am no longer fit to pass judgment upon you, but that's just fine with me. I'll just have to make good use of my newly-acquired qualification to love you instead. Hehehe.
Thank you very much. I'd be happy to have this.
Let us show them the power of our sacraments.
Please ascertain if I have the right to be your rival.

ex.line: Commander, let us pray together. I got up two hours late just to match you.
Are you curious about the Sacrament of Love? Of course, I don't mind sharing with you—In order to make it easier for you to understand, why don't we go on a date?
The Independence-class... I don't think those girls understand the Holy Iris's will, but they sure fight well.
While I may no longer hold the qualification to pass judgment upon you, I am still qualified to continue observing your actions. That's the duty of a secretary ship, after all. Hehehe.
What is it? Did you need something from me?
Hehehe...
Whether or not I pass judgment upon you depends on your progress... Just kidding, of course. Let's work at a reasonable pace.
There is no need to fret. I am very well aware that all your battles are magnificent. What need is there for me to pass judgment?
Accept this divine punishment.

lines.line: Were you planning on freeing me from this spell? Then I suppose you're prepared to lock lips with me. Even though I'm already awake, um... that's just part of the ritual.
Were you planning on freeing me from this spell? Then I suppose you're prepared to lock lips with me. Even though I'm already awake, um... that's just part of the ritual.
Welcome back. What role will you be playing today? A dwarf? Or are you... my prince in shining armor?
If I end up being hunted down, I'll fight back with all I've got. That's the best way of ensuring my survival.
I won't drop dead from eating a poisoned apple or two. Unlike you, I'm built pretty tough.
"Seven dwarves"...Hmm. Why don't we ask the Manjuus to play that part?
You know, I never expected Algérie to play a part like that. Though, I didn't expect to be playing the role of a princess either.
You want to be my prince? That's fine with me.
You're acting just like a famished wolf right now, hehehe.
We've received a new mission. How should we proceed?
My little mirror told me that you'd be arriving shortly. ...Hehe, that's a joke of course.
Do you feel refreshed? Even without a holy ritual, the Iris would be happy to know that I've managed to soothe you with this bath. Was it not enough? Then... Shall we go back in?
Do you feel refreshed? Even without a holy ritual, the Iris would be happy to know that I've managed to soothe you with this bath. Was it not enough? Then... Shall we go back in?
Welcome back. Why don't you cleanse yourself before going to your office?
Am I having fun? Yes, I'm quite enjoying this relaxation and the thought of crushing our enemies. What about you? Are you enjoying yourself?
Don't fret over my wings. The sacred symbols made manifest by the Sacraments are cleansed not with water, but with one's faithful heart.
As long as I am here, you won't commit the great sin of peeping. Though I wish it was thanks to your own restraint instead of my surveillance...
I hear that a hot spring amidst the extreme cold elicits more gratitude than one amidst heat. Perhaps pleasure that takes advantage of one's weaknesses is the most terrifying of all.
Phew... Praise unto the Iris for leading me to this wonderful bath.
Heehee. Is a steamy bath not enough to satisfy you?
La Galissonnière was kind enough to deliver your new mail. Would you like me to hold on to it for now?
Loath though I am, I shall bare my skin, too. Just as with the Holy See's edicts, the rules of the bathhouse must also be upheld.
The commission team has returned. Shall we take hot springs souvenirs to them as thanks?
Things seem to have warmed up a bit. Good.
Commander, have you prepared yourself adequately for this race? I hope your machine is able to perform to its full potential... and of course, the same goes for you too.
Commander, have you prepared yourself adequately for this race? I hope your machine is able to perform to its full potential... and of course, the same goes for you too.
Welcome back, Commander. Would you like to check on your vehicle before the next race? I'm happy to assist.
Know that if you violate the rules, you'll receive my judgment from the windshield just like this... Heehee. Did that startle you?
Looks like you set a new record. Congratulations. I'm certain it was the blessing of the Iris that guided you.
*blow*... Okay, that's enough fogging up your windshield. Yes... May this give you the blessing of love.
I find it commendable how you liven up the competitive mood, but please remember to be safe... I should, too? Heehee, thanks for your concern.
Forgetting that there's glass between us, I see?
..Hmm. I don't think you need to clean me, really...
Your missions... Yes, they can be put off for now. That's the judgment I've given, after all.
I suggest making a pitstop for quick maintenance. Continuous overuse can lead to misfortune - for people, and for machines.
I hear the commission team is back. I'll tell them to give you a few minutes.
May these seas be cleansed of injustice.
May this victory serve as the foundation for your next, Commander.
You look as if you want to say, "I can't drive with you in the way, fighting angel." Heehee.

Does my "support" make it harder for you to focus on the race? Don't worry. As a fighting angel, I will take responsibility and free you of the sin that ruins your concentration. Come to me, Commander...
Le Fantasque-class destroyer - L'Indomptable.
I am Templar Knight L'Indomptable, Le Fantasque-class large destroyer. As my name states, this proud knight shall neither cede a single step, nor back down before any foe!

L'Indomptable - Le Fantasque-class large destroyer and Templar Knight of the Vichya Dominion - has arrived! Have you the honor befitting someone of your status? ...Hmph, save your breath! I shall judge you through your conduct, not your words.
You're late! One in command of the whole fleet must always be first to arrive at the office!
My black lance? Hmph! As if a pleb like you would understand the majesty and power of this rigging that befits me!
I strive to always conduct myself with confidence and elegance, like my role model, Le Malin! ...What are you grinning for, pleb?
A reward for a job well done, you say? I'll have some macaro- Ahem! No, a proud Templar Knight needs no rewards!
The Le Fantasque class is renowned for its speed. And any who think it comes at the cost of firepower is in for a world of pain!
Hmph! You think your pleb tricks will work on- Hehehehe... Oohh...
Hahah! Revere my lance 'til you've had your fill! It is my weapon and my badge of honor!
Y-y-you vile barbarian!
I am a Templar Knight with honor! I do not let missions gather dust unlike you, pleb!
Mission completed. Let's see the rewards... This is all...? N-no, I said nothing!
A letter for you. Well, well, this is an exquisite wax seal.
Magnificent commanding, pleb! Keep it up if you hope to earn my recognition!
I've finished inspecting the commission goods. Grateful for my help, hmm? Hah! It's par for the course!
The greatest equipment belongs only in the hands of the greatest wielder!
I'll teach you what painful things happen to those who cross the line!
MVP? Woohoo! ...Ahem! My wish is to see hard work be duly rewarded.
Grrr... My knightly pride has been tarnished...
You will be judged in the Vichya's name!
You underestimate this proud Templar Knight!
Hmph. A donkey like you would flee like a coward once we encounter real danger anyway.
Prove your honor and sense of duty to me, then I will treat you fairly! A proud Templar Knight is true to her word!
You follow the example set by my sisters Le Triomphant and Le Malin... What of Le Terrible? She is wise, yes! But do not be like her and go around asking people impossible questions!

I, I must admit, you have quite some elegance for a pleb... Hm? You appreciate my efforts in observing you? It's hardly worthy of praise. In fact, I'm enjoying mys- No, I mean...! Flattery won't get you anywhere with me!
Hmph. You've earned my recognition, pleb! I will be your knight. You have my loyalty, and my heart! ...What about it? What I just said is completely ordinary coming from a Templar Knight!

Is a ritual like this required for me to become yours? And I even have to wear this ring too? ...Very well. Then let us move on to exchanging vows! ...Hold hands? Then go on a date? Wh-wh-what are you talking about? Y-y-you've tricked me, haven't you?!
I-I guess I could accept a gift from you... once in a while.
Le Malin, join me in battle!
Noblesse oblige indeed!
I'm not keen to have you along...
Heheh! I am the chivalrous one between us!

ex.line: Get your act together and learn to clock in early like me! I w-worry about you when you're not around, you know!
Rest assured! If you're approached by any miscreants intent on disrespect, I will scare them off with my lance! Hahaha!
Resting to regain one's strength is crucial, you say... Ah! Now I see the profound reason for why Le Malin is always doing that!
Whew... Huff... Puff... Your proud Templar Knight has put in a lot of work today! T-tell me you appreciate me already!
Your sword is always at your side! Give me your orders, and I shall carry them out!
Well, um... Do as you please. Ooohhh... H-h-hey! I didn't tell you to stop!
St-st-stop it with this caprice!
Hahah! In times when missions have you overwhelmed, what you should do is call upon your sword - that is to say, me!
Mission complete! Don't forget to hand down a few rewards in accordance with who worked hardest!
With one as elegant and excellent as you at the helm, I assume your battle went well! I expect no less from the one who guides my sword!
We shall efface all that stands in the Commander's path!
Hmph! See? I am your most commendable champion!

My creed says I "must be ready to sacrifice everything for love, even my life." I would never betray you, but I don't know how to martyr myself for love... I needn't do anything so extreme, you say? Hmph, then I implore you to tell me what I SHOULD do! ...A-a date, for starters?!

lines.line: What a farce, making a proud Templar Knight portray a helpless little girl... Why am I lying here, you ask? Hmph. Because Le Malin asserted this is the best way to get in touch with my "vulnerable side"...

What a farce, making a proud Templar Knight portray a helpless little girl... Why am I lying here, you ask? Hmph. Because Le Malin asserted this is the best way to get in touch with my "vulnerable side"...
So soft and cushy... Mmh, this is the dream... *yawn*... *gasp*! Rats! I got dangerously close to dozing off...!
Am I really meant to lie here and do nothing, Le Malin? ...It's part of getting into the role? I see. Then lie I will!
I'm infinitely more suited to play a gallant knight than a defenseless little girl... But, I'm sure Le Malin has her reasons for promoting this role to me.
How should I act to appear helpless? ...Hm? When I encounter evildoers, my first instinct is always to send them packing with my lance.
Sleeping Beauty is apparently the role Le Malin most wants to play. Fitting, seeing as she's skilled at feigning sleep!
C-careful with my hair!
Do you want this sweet, juicy apple? ...No, it's not poisoned, it's merely a tasty apple!
Y-y-you're making me mad!
New missions have come in. I'd rather be doing those than playing this role that ill suits me.
You finished the mission? H-here I thought I could assist you after my rehearsal...
Are you my Grandmamma?" - Hah, Little Red Riding Hood is a fool! If I were her, I'd say "I saw through your disguise with one glance, Big Bad Wolf! Prepare to meet your maker!
The commission team has returned. Don't keep them waiting over at the pier.
I feel ever so slightly stronger...
It's your funeral if you think my helplessness is any more than an act!
You reaped what you sowed by scoffing at a Templar Knight!
Urgh. Playing a feeble character must've turned me genuinely feeble...

If I were to ever lose my strength and become a helpless little girl... would you stay with me, even if I'd be a hindrance to you? ...If it comes to that, you'll become MY sword?! Th-th-th-that doesn't exactly delight me, not at all...!
Hmm... Traveling by foot from here would be quickest. Ah... It's snowing. Hmph! A little snow and wind can scarcely faze a noble Templar Knight! I'll be back shortly!
Hmm... Traveling by foot from here would be quickest. Ah... It's snowing. Hmph! A little snow and wind can scarcely faze a noble Templar Knight! I'll be back shortly!
Haa... Haa... Ahem! You made it to the office ahead of schedule! Eat up while it's still warm!
Ah... Achoo! ...Why do I wear such light clothing when it's snowing? Le Terrible recommended it, and, well... I-I have no reason whatsoever to doubt her wisdom!
The elegant Le Fantasque class performs stunningly in all manners of missions! Yes, even including food delivery!
You're willing to assist? I-I'll be fine! I'm still perfectly capable of handling a delivery! ...I will call for your help when I truly need it!
This is the third time Le Malin has ordered food just today... Granted, it is an Empery holiday. Elegance is a luxury ill-afforded in hectic times...
A positive review, you say? I gladly accept a commendation that speaks to my honor as a Templar Knight, if... You're simply referring to your delivery experience?!
Stop that lest you make me drop the food, pleb!
A mission, much like Dragon Empery cuisine, is best to take in hand posthaste.
