I have brought your mission rewards. Inspect them before they turn cold.
A note of correspondence... Oh. It's addressed to you.
It's faster to take that route? Thank you! Your guidance serves me well both in the port and on the battlefield!
Behold! L'Indomptable, the black lancer of Vichya, shall cater the victory banquet!
A masquerading-and-eavesdropping mission is a walk in the park for a Knight of the Dominion! Finding evidence of my target's crimes will take no time at all!
A masquerading-and-eavesdropping mission is a walk in the park for a Knight of the Dominion! Finding evidence of my target's crimes will take no time at all!
Oh, Commander. Have you also come to enjoy a sip of- No, wait! I am not L'Indomptable! I have no recollection of your identity!
There is cream stuck to my lips? Hmph - I was told by Le Malin that this would greatly better my disguise. Although it may itch a tad, she is a professional, and her advice cannot be wrong!
How delectable and sweet it smells... *gasp*! Curses! I licked up the cream! Damn it... My disguise will surely fail now!
Comma- Ahem! Youthful stranger, how are you today? ...That greeting gives nothing away, does it?
Seeing as you've seen through me, we'll just need to keep going like this! We are but an ordinary couple on a date at this café - understood? Good! Nothing can go wrong now!
Whuah?! You're undoing my disguise!
H-how did you see through my disguise, Commander?! I could swear that it was flawless...
W-wait! What you're doing now... ruins my ability to complete my mission!
Attention! Your missions remain undone!
Heheh! My mission has been completed flawlessly! This is nothing for an exemplary Templar Knight!
Curses! The target is getting away!
Emerald-class light cruiser -Enterprise.

I am Enterprise, an Emerald-class light cruiser belonging to the Royal Navy. In the great war, I participated in support, escort, and transport missions, and even participated in combat from time to time. At the Bay of Biscay... Ahem, forget I mentioned it.

I am the Royal Maid, Enterprise. I have been assigned to this port starting today. As part of the maids, I am in charge of cleaning, and my hobby is reading about all kinds of trivia. That's all I have to report.
I see you've arrived, Master. Here is your schedule for the day.
Doing the bare minimum is unacceptable, whether for the maid or for the master. Please pull yourself together.

Given your current efficiency, it seems unlikely that you'll be able to finish your work today, Master. Since Emerald won't be of any use, shall I call upon some of the other Royal Maids for assistance?
Glasgow, I really enjoyed the manga you recommended the other day. What would you recommend next... Master?! I'm not up to anything, I swear!
Please leave the cleaning to me. I'll make sure to take care of it without getting in the way of your work.
Wh-what is it...?
Did you need my advice?
...I'm going to get upset.
New missions are in. They'll be done in no time if we work together.
That's all I can do for you. I'll leave you to check on the rewards.
You've got mail, Master. I'll bring it over right away.
Good work out there. Master, please head on out for your debriefing.
A commission has been completed. Please go take a look, Master.
Thank you for making me stronger, Master. I shall return this debt to you in battle.
Much easier than taking care of my friends...!
We won. Didn't take much brainpower either.
We lost... But it's not your fault, Master. I should've worked harder.
I'll wipe the floor with you all!
Keep calm, and carry on...!
I am only serving you because you are my master. There's nothing more to it.
Please feel free to call upon me whenever you need something. Be it cleaning your office or cleaning the battlefield, anything from maid work to military affairs fall within my purview.

There's a girl you're interested in? Well then, if you'd like me to investigate more about her, please tell me her name. While I'd criticize you for being tactless, if it's your order... You won't tell me? Understood...
You want to know how to confess to a girl you're keen on... E-even if you ask me, I wouldn't know anything about that... Don't you think I'm the wrong person to ask about love?

This has to be some kind of joke. You're just trying to make fun of me, aren't you? ...N-no way... Of all people, I can't believe the person you were interested in was me all along... I can't believe it...

From the way the celebration hall is decorated, to the blessings I've received from my friends, there's nothing lacking... I, I truly can't believe that I'm exchanging vows with you, Master... Ahh, I must be dreaming...
This can't count as a gift, right? It's totally a bribe...
Let's make quick work of this!

ex.line: Master, what will you start off with today? How about leaving your clerical duties to me and heading out to start with some training exercises?
Even if you say I'm too methodical... T-that's just the kind of girl I am, so I can't do anything about it. ...If you don't like it, why don't you just ask another girl to do it for you, huh?
You look like you're ready to take on the world. ...Sheffield told you that as well? I-I see... I'm not jealous at all, alright...?
I enjoy reading both manga and literature. Speaking of which, what are some of your favorite books?
You need something cleaned? Sure thing, I'm on my way...!
I-if you just want to chat, we can do it later...
I'm sure you do this to the other girls too, don't you? That's why you're doing this to...W-wah?!
Well done. Um, how about taking a short break before reviewing your plans...? Come on, look at how tired you are...
This is just as important... as taking care of my Master!
We won. Master, thank you for always creating the best battle plans for us.

You want to know how to invite someone you like on a date...? Huh, there's no way I'd tell you. I can't believe you'd ask someone you've exchanged vows with to tell you how to take other girls on dates... Huh?! T-then why don't we go on a date right now...? You should have told me that it was about me in the first place!

lines.line: Marconi-class submarine - Leonardo da Vinci.
I'm Leonardo da Vinci, the Marconi-class submarine who completed many patrol missions! My hobby is inventing fun things! Like this little lion - just push the button here and a flower pops out of it!
Heya, Commander. I'm the Sardegnian submarine Leonardo da Vinci, but you can just call me da Vinci. Now that I'm finally here at the port, I hope every new day is a wellspring of inspiration!
Welcome back, Commander! Me? I've been here all morning. Heheh, stunned by my sheer vitality, aren't ya?

Behold, Commander! My latest invention - the mechanical spaghetti winder! It saves two minutes per serving, so assuming two servings a day, you save 1,460 minutes over a year! Hah-hah! Am I a genius or what?
I've got an idea for an automatic seal stamper! You just put it on a ready document and it stamps it for you, saving both time and energy♪
Take a break? But I don't need one! I'm just fine. Besides, my brain fires on all pistons when I'm searching for inspiration♪
Whoa, my mind just birthed a fresh idea... Commander, let me borrow your pen! And your ruler and compass! Okay, it's something like this... *scribbles*
This little guy's my Autonomous Dive-Bombing Sneak-Attacker Minisub! Huh, you think that's too long? Then, uhh, let's go with Canguro! Make sure the two of you get along!
Ah... I just came up with a new idea! Commander, keep it up!
I see there's a blueprint here! Time to see whether it can be built or not, Commander!
Whuh?! Wh-where do you think you're touching?
New missions, you say? Let me at 'em! I can do it all, from drafting to completion! ...What? It's a task only you can get done?
Mission complete! Surf the waves of accomplishment to the next challenge♪
Got a letter for you! I brought it here at max speed♪
Awesome work out there! ...You're running on fumes, huh? Unfortunate. I'd give you half my energy if I could~
Commission rewards have arrived! With fresh materials come brand spanking new ideas~ Heheheh♪
Mhm! I'm getting all sorts of new ideas here♪
I've already worked out an angle of attack!
Talk about a cakewalk! Well then, my search for inspiration continues♪
Crap, I goofed that one up...
Let's see how you like THIS!
Think, da Vinci! How will you get out of this pickle?!
I should probably build some sort of gadget that sounds an alarm when you're nearby...
Now, Torricelli, behold my latest invention! ...Huh? Where'd she go? Don't tell me she went hiding in some dark corner again!
Whenever I get a new idea, I sketch it down and store it in my satchel. I love keeping a physical record of all the inspiration I get!
Are you free, Commander? Then have a look at this blueprint as well as this, this, and this and tell me whatcha think. Two heads are better than one, and I want your feedback!

Commander! You free again? Like they say... Look below you for ideas, look around you for inspiration! Time: from dawn 'til dusk - place: every nook and cranny of the port! Heheh! I'm bound to come up with something new this way!

What you're saying with this is that you love me, correct? It goes without saying that I love you too♪ On another note, looking at this shiny ring is giving me an idea... Namely, a ring that literally glows! Let's make one, Commander!
Ooh, yeah. I'll keep this one safe!

ex.line: You're looking alive today, Commander! Heheh, must be thanks to my li'l works-like-charm alarm clock♪
I wanna thank you for always giving me input and listening to my rambling by inventing something that'll be of use to you~ Just tell me whatcha want♡
Not all ideas are feasible to materialize, but that's no reason not to try! As they say, the proof is in the pudding♪
Commander! I've got another brilliant new invention to... Darn, you're busy. I'll give it a show to Torricelli instead.

I may be a short sleeper, but you need your beauty sleep. I also know what it's like to be in the flow, which is all the more reason why you need to call it a day! Come on, it's time to go to bed, Commander!
Heheh! Charging complete!♪ Now I'm at full throttle again!♪
You got an idea outta the blue? Quick, here's a pen and paper - write it down before you forget it!
Heheh, I knew you were being too modest up to now♪
It's time to test out my machine that replicates your signature! ...No? Come on, there's no harm in automating that bit!
Mission complete♪ You know what you get for shutting down my brilliant idea? A thorough tickling!
Good going on that sortie! Feeling beat, don'tcha? Let's fix those stiff shoulders with my massage-o-tron! Have a seat in my lap and just relax♪
Commission rewards are here. Let's check out what we got and see what new things we can come up with!
I've got a brilliant plan B, so do your worst!
We won, Commander♡ Heck yeah, that look of surprise is just what I wanted to see~

That pillow cover drying in the sun is of course the one with your darling da Vinci in a raunchy pose♡ ...You thought I was serious? So you're saying you WOULD own that... Guess I'll just have to make one♪

lines.line: Here to watch me rehearse just like these deer, Commander? Isn't it wonderful being surrounded by the beauty of nature? For a performance based on a fable such as this one, ambiance is key. Ehehe~♪
Here to watch me rehearse just like these deer, Commander? Isn't it wonderful being surrounded by the beauty of nature? For a performance based on a fable such as this one, ambiance is key. Ehehe~♪
Dancing among the beautiful flora and fauna makes me feel like I'm becoming one with nature.
If ballet and invention have anything in common, it's that they both take inspiration from animals. So, dancing among animals is a great way to get new ideas♪
If only there was a device that could accurately translate the cries of these deer... Guess I have to invent one myself, eh?
Do you reckon I could fly with these wings if I scaled them up? Imagine the midair dances I could do. They'd be stunning!
Watch closely, Commander! Here comes my grand fouetté en tournant♪ Wheee... Oh god, that made me dizzy... Th-that was kinda overkill...
Ballet's actually not hard. Come on, just take it slow and repeat after me~
D-d-d-don't sneak up on me like that!
Hey, I rehearsed a bit while you were out! Though I'm still nowhere near Roma's level.
Ah, Commander! I got a flash of inspiration when I swung to the top just now! Let the magic show begin now!
Ah, Commander! I got a flash of inspiration when I swung to the top just now! Let the magic show begin now!
Commander? Did you see me perform just now? I was just testing a little theory. I wanted to see if being suspended in midair makes one's inspiration a bit "lighter"♪
Maybe we should make a portable swing? That way I'll be able to whoosh around wherever I go!
This sense of weightlessness, of speed, it's completely different from when I'm lost in inventing... Ah, I just came up with a new idea!
Si cominica! Commander, next up... Waaah?! All the cards in my hat... they all turned into design sketches?!
Heheh, don't forget to fix my ears back the way they were♪
Are you just going to watch? Come on, gimme your hand! Let's fly high enough to touch the stars♪
Eek?! Commander, you're such a tease. Are you looking for inspiration in the middle of a performance?♪
Welcome back, Commander! Would you like to watch my swinging tricks? Or maybe just relax together?♪
What an easy win~ And I get lots of applause and inspiration as my reward♪
So long as you're watching me, I know I could pull off any magic trick, even in the middle of a high swing. This sense of safety... that matters more than any inspiration♪
Duca degli Abruzzi-class light cruiser - Giuseppe Garibaldi.

I'm the final variant of a line of treaty cruisers... I think? Anyway, my time in the limelight was after the war rather than during it, for various reasons. You still wanna know more about me? Like what - my achievements, or the stats of my weaponry?

Is everyone doing well? Now, let's put our hands together for the port's latest arrival - light cruiser Giuseppe Garibaldi of Sardegna! ...Oh, Commander? I was just updating my shipgirl profile... And that does it! Who am I? Didn't you just hear me say Giuseppe Garibaldi?
Good morning, Commander. Phew... Sardegna's splendor is shining as brightly as ever today~
What are you standing there all stiff for? Make yourself comfortable. I'm not gonna punish you for it. You're not the type who fusses over a noble's manners, are you?
My duties as a dignitary? Ehh, don't give a rat's ass about 'em. My sis and I are worlds apart in that regard.
If what you're doing isn't hugely important, just wing it. If you mess up, someone will come and fix it.
I usually go to tea parties with like-minded people. You interested, Commander?
Obbedisco! Just tell me what you need.
Well, I'll be damned.
We've got new missions. Time to do what you signed up for.
Mission complete... Which is to say, you've performed your duty as a dignitary.
A letter? Open and see what it says.
Oh, you're back. Go ahead and take a seat. What for? The after-action review, obviously. Were you expecting something else?
Hey, you completed a commission. You should remember that, even if I forgot.
Pretty good. Nothing to complain about and much to love. Like my new firepower.
Let's get this done in a flash.
I've won. My name is light cruiser Giuseppe Garibaldi. Easy to remember, right?
Hmph, so you got us good this time. I'll be back.
Here's what I can REALLY do!
Knock it off...!
You call yourself the Commander, but you're really just a nobody. Hmph.
I'll follow your orders no problem, but please don't demand more of me than that. It's just easier for us both that way. Besides, you don't like being a slave to formality like Abruzzi, do you?
It's not like a dignitary's duty is too much for me or whatever. I'd look like a fool if it was. I'm just easygoing - don't you wanna be that too, Commander?
Leading and protecting your friends is what's important, not petty etiquette or manners. I've known that since day one. Heck, I'm protecting you right now... Well, in my own way.

Can't you take it easy at least for today? You have all these supportive girls by your side - rely on them for once. Think of it like this: I'll never be able to fulfill my duty as a dignitary of protecting you if you're always working around the clock.
I'm guessing you want me to look after you forever and ever? You got it. Simply always being there for you is a total breeze when you're Abruzzi's sister.
I'll take it then~
I'll do as a dignitary and take the lead!
Sweet rigging. I want one like that.

ex.line: You know the drill - we must again strive to spread Sardegna's glory. Heehee.

Not trying to throw any shade here, but can you really handle standing up for so long? Stop fretting over appearances and have a seat. Alternatively, go ahead and punish me for being too lax. Just kidding♪
How about a Sardegnian signature drink on your afternoon break? It'll reinvigorate you, I promise. Heehee.
Look, you can honestly just wing it if the task's not important. Didn't I tell you someone will fix any errors you make? Mainly me, your secretary.
Leander, put some extra sugar cubes in my tea if you don't mind. Commander, are you good with 8 for each of us?
Your bidding is my command and whatnot.
No way, you actually just touched me...
Have a seat. I'll go get you a quick meal, so take the chance to get comfy before it's time for the review.
Commission complete. Do you actually remember when you sent them out?
You're all under my protection!

lines.line: I am the evil swan Odile! Where oh where is my prince? ...Oh, it's you, Commander. My lines aside, pretty good performance, right?
I am the evil swan Odile! Where oh where is my prince? ...Oh, it's you, Commander. My lines aside, pretty good performance, right?
It took getting through a storm to finally clock in, eh?
Both the white and black swan are meant to be played by the same person, right? Doesn't that make Roma and me rivals?
Da Vinci's the kind of girl who really gets into her role, unlike me. Good for her if she enjoys it. Me, I just can't do it.
Is Abruzzi watching me? Aw crap, then I'll have to do hardcore practice or she'll chew me out. She should play a role herself if it's so damn important...
Will you swear your love to me? Heehee~
It's no big deal, but something feels off about this...
You've got new missions. Wonder if one of them is like, make a lovers' pact and you'll be rewarded, or something?
A dignitary never goes back on their promise. Mission complete.
Watching me dance ballet is fine and all, but I think it's time you do your after-action review. People are waiting, you know.
Heavy cruiser - Bolzano.

I'm Bolzano, Sardegnian heavy cruiser. I took part in naval reviews before the war, then fought in live battles during it. A streak of bad luck left me irrepairable, so I was stripped of my rigging and ultimately sunk in a harbor. *sigh*...
Sardegnian heavy cruiser Bolzano, reporting in. I am hereby under your command. Um, if that's all then I'll be taking my leave now.
I'm the secretary... Welcome back, Commander. Here is today's schedule.
Anything... I will perform any task if you think I'm suited for it. Ah, I'm just saying IF! Please don't go out of your way for me if it's more trouble than it's worth.
Gorizia, you're not like me - you can keep fighting... I'm doomed to stay like this forever...
I've gathered the documents for your meeting. What would you like me to do next? Please don't hesitate to give me orders.
I should start thinking about how to spend my next day off... Maybe doing something where you can still call me in at a moment's notice...
Yes? I will do anything you deem me suited for.
Wh-what are you doing...?
We have been informed of new missions. Please stand by until all ships have received the sortie order.
Mission complete. Mhm, this is good.
There's a letter for you, Commander. Here you are.
The Commander has returned. All ships, prepare to repair and restock, then gather combat data on the mission.
The commission team has arrived in port. Phew... I'm glad they're okay.
I'm steadily becoming stronger. Thank you.
Allow me to prove myself in combat!
Victory is ours. Let's move - our friends are waiting for us.
We... have failed. I knew I'm not cut out for this...
Bolzano, commencing bombardment!
I don't want to be locked up in the dock again...!
Please stay away from us! You don't deserve any support from the girls with how you are acting now.
I'll take my leave now if that will be all... Zara asked about me? Oh... Well, I'm perfectly fine. Forgive me for making her worry...
You're still worried about me? I appreciate the concern... Zara may be right with what she said about me inadvertently distancing myself from people...
You'd like to take me somewhere on your day off? If that's your order, then okay... Um, I'm afraid I don't have a favorite movie! I prefer things like books and theater over movies, you see...

I'm sorry for ruining it by forgetting about you and bursting into tears from the performance... I've always been so easily moved by these kinds of stories... And that's despite how overjoyed I was that you invited me to see the play...

Um... I'm hesitant to say this after you've been so kind to me, but... are you sure I'm the one for you? I just sincerely hope you're not giving me this out of pity or concern. If not, then... Then I'll g-gladly accept!
Thank you very much! Ah... Sorry. I didn't scare you, did I?

ex.line: I'm with you as your secretary... Welcome back, Commander. Let's do our utmost as always, shall we?
You'd like to have a word? Of course, you can tell me anything! You believe in me, so it's the least I can- Oh, it's nothing especially important?
Trento pampers you far too much on a regular basis... No, I really don't have the right to say that, considering I'm so dependent on you.
A tea party? Oh, I'd love to accompany you on one! Heehee... I can hardly wait.
Would you like to watch a play with me on your next day off? I-I'll try to pick one that won't make me weep like a baby!
...Commander...?
I've confirmed we have new missions. You may issue the sortie order now, Commander.
Welcome back! Please get some rest for the time being. This port - YOUR port - is a safe haven.
The commission team is back in port. Commander, please get ready to leave.
I feel ready for anything right now. To battle!
Victory is ours! Commander, we should go reunite with the others.
I can't let this turn into a streak of defeats... Ugh...

Heheh, heheheh... Oh, sorry! I couldn't help but laugh at the main actress' performance... It feels like I've been laughing a lot today? That's because I'm over the moon, just like that actress, and I've wanted to smile.

lines.line: I've never had a knack for dancing or exercise unlike Zara and her sisters... but if asked, I will dance as best as I can! Please keep your eyes on me, Commander!
I've never had a knack for dancing or exercise unlike Zara and her sisters... but if asked, I will dance as best as I can! Please keep your eyes on me, Commander!
This is improper attire for a secretary... A-are you sure you don't mind?
So this is Swan Lake... I believe there's one production where everyone is left inconsolable in the end. I'd probably cry if I saw that one...
While my outfit bears some resemblance to Arizona's, the overall styles differ considerably. Oh, Zara didn't say that!
You don't know whether it's right or not to look at me? Um, should I change clothes after all? Although then my rehearsals won't feel right...
Am I doing something wrong?
Oh gosh...
Welcome back, Commander. Would you like to watch the others rehearse after you've finished your combat analysis?
I'll try my best!
I just hope this was thanks to my cheering... Wait, I'm the MVP?
So... The premise is that you and I were shipwrecked and ended up on a desert island... Is that right, Commander? I see... But if we weren't actually shipwrecked... what is this treasure, then?
So... The premise is that you and I were shipwrecked and ended up on a desert island... Is that right, Commander? I see... But if we weren't actually shipwrecked... what is this treasure, then?
"Escape from Pirate Isle." I see. Do let me know if you need any assistance, Commander.
I believe that Tempesta girl has her sights on the port's treasure. Then again, the treasure you know of isn't exactly buried or hidden, is it? Heehee.
How will we bring this treasure back to the port, I wonder... Oh, they're simply props, so I don't have to worry about it?
(Given the situation, I have to be conscious of not distancing myself from the Commander... Unless being in a swimsuit has something to do with this...?)
You may take my shawl if you feel cold, Commander. We wouldn't want you catching a cold, right? Me, I'll be fine, don't worry.
O-only because we're alone out here, okay...?
New mission orders have come in. Commander, I'm ready to sortie at your command.
Outstanding work. Would you like to rest for a while with me?
The commission team has returned. If anyone is lugging real treasure around, it has to be them.
I prepared so much for this festival only to run off and hide again on instinct... Oh, Commander?! Um... Are you here to see the fireworks? Or are you here to see... me?
I prepared so much for this festival only to run off and hide again on instinct... Oh, Commander?! Um... Are you here to see the fireworks? Or are you here to see... me?
Could you please come here, Commander? I, um... I just think you'll get a better view of the night sky from here.
"The moon speaks words of love to the flowers, and the flowers blossom with affection"... What a beautiful sentence. Commander, I hope you understand my feelings on a night such as this...
You are the moon in the night sky, and your gentle words are like its silver light, burning away my hesitation...
Doesn't it feel like a wish is more likely to come true if you make it the moment fireworks go off? Heehee. Although... my wish has already come true.
Are you interested in these lights taking to the sky, Commander? Well... I made a small lantern myself. Do you want to see it?
Mgh... Commander, please - you might undo my braids.
Huh? Is that your way of saying you... want me to come a little closer?
Ahh... Are we doing it? Under the moonlight?
Commander, I've prepared some snacks for recovering your strength... Hm? You want some of what I have, too? Well, in that case, please help yourself... *blushes*
The commission team has returned. That's a relief. Now we can all enjoy this festive night sky together.
This will make the festival even more lively.
"Blessed be the month, and the time, and the moment"... On this wonderful night, ever since the moment our eyes met... I have been spellbound by you.
Vittorio Veneto-class battleship - Roma.

I am battleship Roma. Sadly, I did not get to enlighten the world with my splendor during the war. You've given me a second chance, and for that, I'm in your debt. A favor to me is a favor to Roma, and Roma always repays her allies.
I am Roma, the inheritor of Romulus' will. Commander, Protector of the Seas, Guider of the Port, Leader of Our People - how would you like me to address you?
The clock is ticking, Commander.
Veneto's idea of a thermae party is one that I adore. When people strip naked, they unconsciously lower their guards and let their secrets slip. Furthermore, bathing itself is quite enjoyable.
Have you ever gazed out from the port's highest vantage point? If not, I suggest you try it sometime.
Negotiate with the enemy? I'd rather not waste my time. However, I can gladly draft a declaration of war if you so wish.
I do not fear danger, because I am more fearsome than danger itself. Hah!
Do you wish to obtain my blessings, Commander?
What do you seek from Roma? Come, offer your tribute.
You needn't be shy to admit whether or not Roma has conquered your heart, Commander. I already know the answer.
Mission instructions, you say? I do not appreciate having orders imposed upon me.
You've completed a mission? It may be time to grant you the title of "Fulfiller of Duties."
A new letter? Perhaps it is a declaration of surrender from afar.
Now is a good time to assess which place to conquer next.
Commission rewards have arrived. Splendid. We need these for our next plan.
The key to defeating a strong enemy is to be even stronger.
Be crushed by Roma's exalted light!
But of course. The foundation of my glory is built upon those who stood in my way.
Commander, I'm afraid I need more legionaries.
I shall liberate you from the toils of war.
Where is my legion?!
Beacon of Incompetence, the Loathsome One, or the Savage Brute - which title do you feel suits you best, Commander?
Are you apprehensive of me? Good. I do not get along with frivolous people who act unnecessarily friendly around others.
Commander, which do you find more gratifying - conquering land, or conquering hearts and minds? ...Both, about as much? I see you're an insatiable soul.
Why did you intervene when I took wares from the store earlier? ...It's against the store's rules? Hmph, is the purpose of great power not to rewrite the rules?
How tragic it would be to conquer a world and have no one to share it with. Commander, should I meet an unfortunate fate, it shall be you who inherits Roma's splendor.

You and I are now as one, bound together unto eternity. In other words, defiance against you is defiance against me... Be a little more considerate of others, you say? Very well. If that's what you wish... then I shall try.
This is an interesting gift. I like it.
Show me a battle worthy of Captain Pompeo's name!
Yes, Impero is great.

ex.line: Now that you're here, let us begin today's tasks.
I'm quite weary myself, so I propose we hold our conversation in the thermae. Hm? Is something the matter? Yes, I am asking you to join me.
You need some fresh air? Allow me to assist. I can punch a hole through this window with my- Oh, I suppose I'll open it like normal.
When my ambition is one day realized, I shall engrave your name upon my laurel crown. Come that day, I want you present to see this moment with your own eyes.
Kindly make your request to Roma. You need not offer tribute on this occasion.
How very bold of you... You're becoming more and more like Romulus.
Congratulations on your triumph, Commander. I've determined our next destination. Let us march onward.
The commission team has returned. Oh, I shall accompany you? I assume you want me to discipline the slackers among- Ah, nothing of the sort. I see.

lines.line: You seem to have known that I would be here. Then stay and spend the night with me. Just the two of us.
You seem to have known that I would be here. Then stay and spend the night with me. Just the two of us.
Our march fades into the blackness on nights with dim moonlight. That is likely the reason I why couldn't detect your presence here.
A bath is a great way to wash off the fatigue of dancing. I say that not just for myself, but for both of us.
You wish to see me perform on the stage? I'd be happy to if it would spread Romulus' splendor... However, I ask that you be patient until I've perfected my dance.
While the cursed princess-turned-swan can only reassume her human form at midnight, I can dance whenever I please.
Garibaldi, despite the nonchalance she ordinarily displays, plays the black swan quite well. I sincerely acknowledge her skill.
This is what a pas de deux is like? How novel.
New missions? I'm afraid now is not the right time for those.
A mission has been completed. Strange, as I could've sworn you've been here from the start... Are you able to clone yourself? Heehee.
You have a new letter. I believe it's a ballet invitation. Shall we attend, or are you too busy? I shall dispose of it if so.
I told you to stay here, didn't I? To make up for leaving, you shall spend twice as long rehearsing a pas de deux with me.
New commission rewards have just arrived.
Nobody is allowed to disturb the peace tonight.
Hmph... The flames of war have sullied my gorgeous tutu.

I see, so this is the kind of vacation you meant. It's quite pleasant, feeling like the queen of the world even when I'm doing nothing. That said, simply sitting here is not enough. Come, Commander, and entertain me as best you can.
Oriani-class destroyer - Alfredo Oriani.

It's-a me, Alfredo Oriani, name ship of my class of destroyers! Conserve vowels and just call me Alfredo! Go ahead and send me to the front where all the action is - I've covered world wars, you know! Heheh!

Whoa! Here comes the mastermind behind the curtains, the one mark I really want to use all means possible to investigate - the legendary Commander! Let's get on to the interview, but first, allow me to introduce myself! The name's Alfredo Oriani! I'm a journalist, as you see!
Morning, Commander! It's the perfect day for a close cov- I mean! For work! In more ways than one. Heheh...
If you wanna know others' secrets, you gotta give me something of equal value. Don't worry 'bout getting duped - I deal fair and square!
Wherever you'll find scoops, you'll find me! Heehee~
You feel like you're being watched? Weeell, I'll bet that's just your fatigue speaking! Yup, hundo percent sure of it!
So you wanna become a mature big sister, do ya, GB? Heh, I've got heaps of pics of girls like that. Although, I guess photos won't really help you achieve that goal.
What's this? You trying to score points with me?
My camera's inner workings are top secret! No peeking!
Whuah! ...Dammit, I didn't have time to snap an incriminating pic!
New missions? If we're talking quick errands, I can do 'em!
A mission has been completed! ...So, Commander, what are your thoughts on this latest development?
A confidential letter... It'd make for a juicy story, but top-secret stuff has to stay that way!
Cheese! Welcome back! I snapped a photo of you and the fleet looking badass out there! It's gonna blow up in the news! ...In a good way! Heehee!
The commission team is back! I'm gonna go snap some group photos!
Nice! Lens aligned, picture perfect!
We're live, so remember to look photogenic!
First question: how does it feel to be the- Wait, what? I'M the MVP?!
I-I guess I'll hide this blunder at the back of the newspaper...
Smile for the camera!
D-don't lash out at me just 'cause I'm a journalist!
I-I-I'm so sorry! I'll stop with my journalism if it offends you! Just please show mercy!
Commander~ Think you could make some time for a Q&A later? It'll be basic stuff! You know, hobbies, likes, your taste in girls, things like that!
Just between you and me, info about you is currently worth... this much! Heheheh! Interested? Then lemme interview you some more~
Hm? You like me? Ahahahah! I'm nobody special, I'm just a smalltime journalist who loves gossip~ Forget about me - who else do you fancy? That's valuable information!

The more I learn about you, the less I wanna share my knowledge with others... even though I could make big bucks by selling it... I think I might've fallen for you, Commander! S-s-settle down, Alfredo! G-g-get a hold of yourself!

Hold up! This doesn't make any sense! I'm just a gossip-loving, devil-may-care, occasionally ill-mannered journalist, Commander! You have zero reason to marry someone like... Nononono! I'm not saying I hate you in any way! Oh geez, if I don't cool off now I'm gonna frickin' explode! I accept the ring, okay?! We'll talk later!
Hmm... I might have to put in a few good words for you in my next article...
Let's see who can snap the best photos!
Hey, you wanna trade scoops?

ex.line: Morning, Commander! Time to do what we each do best!
You curious about another girl? I could look into her if you wa- Wait a sec! You better not be thinking about cheating on me!
It's not easy finding new scoops! Especially at this port where competition is stiff. You gotta help me out, Commander! Someone's gonna overtake me if you don't!
Huh. Turns out, I've snapped a bunch of photos of you hard at work... I'll make a solo exhibition out of these at some point! ...Huh? That's a no-go? Why?

I forget I'm the name ship of my class all the time! Guess it's 'cause I'm kinda childish compared to the oldest sisters from other classes, plus I'm a shortie... Still, you married me, so that's gotta mean I have SOME unique charm!
You know how to make a girl happy~ Heehee~
There's yesterday's combat report, here's some random outdoors photos I took, and this... Ummm! Forget you saw that!
H-hold your horses! I need to mentally prepare first!
Mission complete! Today's headline: "The Commander and Alfredo Overcome Tough Task Together"!
Look into the camera, Commander! Cheese! This shot of your heroic return is going into my collection!
The commission team has returned! I'mma go snap a group photo of them! Come along, Commander!
Commander, I'm the MVP! Come stand next to me for a victory selfie!

Oho? You look bored out of your mind, Commander! Tell you what, I know this spot at the port with a killer view - how 'bout we head there and take some pics? Plus a date selfie while we're there... Of course I'm not gonna sell them to anyone! I just want new things for my personal collection, that's all...

lines.line: Found you, Commander! How would you grade this outfit of mine? ...No, no, I wasn't asking if it looked cute or pretty, I wanted to know if I was wearing it right in the first place! You know what though, I think I'll take those compliments~

Found you, Commander! How would you grade this outfit of mine? ...No, no, I wasn't asking if it looked cute or pretty, I wanted to know if I was wearing it right in the first place! You know what though, I think I'll take those compliments~
Commander, tell us who you'd most like to dance with today! ...You can't say? Figures it wouldn't be so easy... Well, we'd better find you a dance partner soon!
Tadah! Heehee, what'd ya think of my dance? I got advice from my Sardegnian friends on how to blend in with the crowd while gathering scoops! Although I may have gone a bit overkill with it...
There are crowds of girls vying to be your partner, Commander! That heartwarming piece of info comes from yours truly♪
GB! I snapped a bunch of photos of ladies being ladies! Here! Feel free to reference it~
Commander! I've got gorgeous pics of Sardegnian girls mid-rehearsal! Interested? ...Then you know what I want in return. Heehee~
You typically ask for a dance by holding someone's hand, not by patting their head...
Aha! So I move my feet like... Hang on, why am I here learning dance moves from you?!
I'm not hiding anything! There's nothing I CAN hide to begin with! Use your common sense!
A new letter? It might be a personal invitation for you! Let's find out!
Oh yes, this is a good angle! This photo's gonna make a good... C-C-Commander?! When'd you get here?! I'm not up to anything, nuh-uh! I-I need to get back to rehearsing my dance!
This is Alfredo, reporting live on- Hey, the battlefield's no place to fret over dresses!

Let's see today's hottest article... "You Won't Believe Who's the Commander's Dance Partner"... W-wait, it's ME?! It's over... This is gonna spread around the port like wildfire... "It's fine, I'm here with you"? Um... Excuse me, I need to go cool off my burning hot face!
Navigatori-class destroyer - Emanuele Pessagno.
I am the Navigatori-class destroyer, Emanuele Pessagno. Back then, I managed to serve Sardegna commendably, but if only I had been more careful during that final escort mission...
I'm the Sardegnian destroyer, Emanuele Pessagno. Umm... Commander, you look way different in-person than through my telescope... Must be because I can get a closer view.
Hrmmmm... Yeah, you really do look nothing like what I saw through the telescope... N-nevermind. Welcome back, Commander.
You have to take good care of telescope lenses... Otherwise, they might get scratched up, and that's a huge problem.
I like to gaze out into the distant scenery. What your eye can perceive... is so much greater than what your fingertips are able to touch.
There should be a lot of great observation spots around the port, right? I'd like to jot them all down when I get the chance.
Da Recco, if you're going to go out, wouldn't it be safer to take a more... charted route?
Is there something wrong with my ribbon?
You want to try looking through my telescope? ...Um, sure, but be careful...
P-please stop that...
There are still missions that need doing. Commander, you seem to be having a rough time... Need to take a little break?
Here's the mission completion report... Need help looking over it? If a typo slipped its way into the final submission...
You've got new mail. It's from... somewhere I can't see... Hrmm, someplace far, far away?
......Oh. Sorry, I was taking in the scenery outside and didn't notice you returning...
Our friends from the commission team have returned. Look, they're over there--
Am I able to see farther now...?
Enemy spotted... Commencing attack!
Did we manage to win? That's a relief...
Excuse me, um... Commander, you don't need to feel too down about it.
I see you...!
I mustn't drag the others down...
I'm sorry, but please leave me alone...
Commander, you've tried looking through the telescope, right? ...So, what do you think is the difference between seeing something through the lens and seeing something up-close?
A telescope makes it possible to see things clearly even from a distance... From a place far, far away, where I won't bother anyone...
Imprinting a beautiful scenery into your memory after seeing it once is already good enough... But, sometimes, the more you see something, the more you want to touch it, feel it...
Umm... Commander, do you have any free time next week? There's a place I really want to go to... Um, I want to take you sightseeing... Is that okay? I-it's always been really important to me...
Eh? Th-this is for me? Thank you... I'll make sure to treasure it, no matter what... Ehehe, I don't have to keep gazing from a distance anymore... After all, happiness is within my reach...
I-I'll treasure this!
O-on to a new journey... Ugh, I can't say it after all...

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander! ...Oh, um, there's something stuck on your face... Hold on just a moment. I'll get it for you...
My telescope can bring the most distant of sceneries right before me, but I won't be able to touch them. It's a rather lonely feeling... The same goes for people I like...
The same scenery can look completely different when sharing it with someone else, as opposed to viewing it alone... Ehehe, maybe I'm not so envious of the others anymore.
Da Recco drafted a route map for me, but something doesn't seem quite right with it... Commander, would you mind checking it out with me...?
Um, C-Commander...?
I wish there was a telescope that two people could use at once...
You know I'm not good with these kinds of things, right...? (*blushes*)
Ehehe, I saw you coming back from a long way away. But, it still feels more comforting to welcome you in person like this...
It's our victory. I'm really glad that I was able to be of help to you and the others.

When I travel alone, I keep all my emotions buried deep inside me... But when I'm with somebody else, I feel like I can open up my heart... Ehehe, I'm so glad that I get to share this journey with the person I love...

lines.line: Eek! Wh-why are you guys tugging at my stockings... P-please stop that... C-Commander, please... Hurry and come help me! Waah...
Eek! Wh-why are you guys tugging at my stockings... P-please stop that... C-Commander, please... Hurry and come help me! Waah...
Th-thank you... for coming all this way to see me... Phew... I've finally managed to calm down a little, and I don't think I'm as nervous as before...
Commander, um, can you ask Alfredo to put me in some inconspicuous corner when she's writing her review? ...I, I don't want to stand out too much...
I have to stand up there in front of everyone as a part of the set... Just thinking about it is making my heart pound like crazy...
If you're talking about my telescope, I let my friends hold on to it. Y-you want to use it to look at me since you're sitting pretty far back...? P-please stop teasing me...
Now that I think about it, this outfit is pretty risqué... I wonder why Laffey doesn't seem to mind at all...
Th-the microphone isn't clipped on crooked, right...?
I, I can put these shoes on myself. There's no need to bother the Commander...
Y-you shouldn't do something like that...
Commander, can you grab a comb for me? There should be one in the next drawer over...
Commander, umm, can we go somewhere together? I want to see some familiar scenery before the performance begins, to relieve some of my nerves... And, whenever I'm with you, I feel even more at ease.
Type 1934A destroyer - Z16 Friedrich Eckoldt.

I'm the one-and-only Friedrich Eckoldt, Iron Blood destroyer, but you can just call me Z16. If only I had gotten a better look back then, I wouldn't have... Ah, screw it! This time, I'll make sure I don't get friend and foe mixed up!

Hey, you over there, you're the Commander, aren't you? That's right, I've checked my papers a bazillion times already! I'm the one-and-only Iron Blood destroyer Z16, also known as Friedrich Eckoldt! Heh heh, I can't wait to get my hands dirty, so hurry up and sortie me already!
Stop right there, scoundrel! What are you doing sifting through the Commander's room-- Huh? Oh, it's you, Commander.
The best way to get your enemies to chill out is to beat the crap outta them! Isn't that right, Commander?
Gross, all the letters are so close together that my eyes are getting sore... I give up, I'm getting all cross-eyed...
I'll chew you up and grind you to itty-bitty pieces! Hehehe, thanks for the candy, Commander! Got any more for me?
Commander, if you start getting drowsy, lemme give you a good chomp! That'll get you on your feet real fast! ...Eh? That's a no-go?
Huh? Why are you touching me all of a sudden?
Eyy! Where are you stickin' those hands?!
Missions? Ugh, there's only boring stuff here... Get me out!
Mission complete! So now we gotta stamp everything right here? Lemme do it!
Mail? You talking about this flimsy envelope here? I brought it with me, but is it really that important?
You're back? Heh, I'm sure you had a blast on that sortie. You get to slug it out with all kinds of enemies! ...You didn't just hide in the back, did you?
Our friends from the commission team have returned! Uhh, how many people were there again? I can't really see from here...
Heh heh, you'd better get ready for what I'm about to do!
We brawlin'? Helllll yeahhh!!
Heheh, number one goes to the one-and-only ME!
Don't hold me back! Those bastards made my friends cry... and I'm not gonna forgive them!
I'll blow you away!
Barely a scratch! Like hell I'd let that scare me!
Tell me who's bullying you! Don't be scared! I'm gonna get payback for you!

I'm no good with the complicated stuff, but all I know is, you beat up the bad guys and protect the good guys - can't go wrong with that, right? As for who's good and who's bad, I can tell with just a glance!

There are all sorts of bad guys out there. Some can be reasoned with, others won't repent until you threaten them with a good beatdown. Then, there are the real assholes who force me to get serious... Well, you already know what happens to them!

Commander, if you ever turn into a bad guy one day, I'd have to steel my heart and beat the evil out of you... That's why you should work hard to be a good person beloved by everyone, so something like that never has to happen!
Oh, Commander! Hehehe, just seeing you is getting me all fired up~! So, we sortieing today? Just leave it to me! Now if you had some sweet candy for me, I'd be even more fired up!

Commander, this must be one of those special rings that let you talk to the other person wearing it no matter how far the two of you are apart, right? Huh? It's just a normal ring? I see... Hmph! But that doesn't matter! Even without a ring like that, I can sense if you're ever in danger and rush to your aid at any time!
Woooah! I looove this!
Uhh, w-we're cool, right...
H-Hipper, it's you, right?
If YOU'RE a shark, then I'm a huge shark! Raaawr!

ex.line: Yo, Commander! Hehe, didn't get the wrong person this time~ Let's get started with the day's work!
Commander, you can do the thinkin' with your noggin, and I'll do the thumpin' with my fists! Ehehe, the two of us make a good team!
Commander, these mint candies are out of this world! Here, I'll give you one! Huh? You're not supposed to bite on them?
Commander... Commander! If you ignore me, I'm gonna bite you! ...Hmph. I was just joking around, but that's what you get when you don't pay attention to me. I don't really bite...
Ehehe~
H-hey, I told you to cut that out!
A mission? Freaking boring... Well, whatever, I don't mind doing it for you, Commander!
After we're done with missions, it's time for the usual stamping, yeah? Lemme do it!
I left the flimsy ol' envelope over there on the desk.
Ugh, took you long enough. There's nothing to do here in the office except that stupid headache-causing paperwork... Next time, bring me along to your sortie! You'd better keep your promise!
I'll tear you to shreds!
Did you see that, Commander? I'm the one-and-only top shark!

lines.line: Heh heh! Count your lucky stars, Commander, because you're just in time - to witness the one-and-only Z16 knock this thing right outta the ballpark!
Heh heh! Count your lucky stars, Commander, because you're just in time - to witness the one-and-only Z16 knock this thing right outta the ballpark!
Hey you! That suspicious person sitting on the bench! What are you- Oh, it's you, Commander. Sorry, I couldn't tell right away...
Bogue! Give me your best pitch... W-wait, hold on! You don't need to throw it THAT fast!
I'm sure Z24 would make a great catcher with those huge metal gauntlets of hers! ...Oh, she went to join the tennis tourney? So much for that...
Hyah! How's that? With how far that baby's flying, that's a home run for sure! What, it's a foul ball?!
You've gotta stay focused in the batter's box! Commander, throw me a mint candy!
I'm totally fine! I can swing this bat a hundred more times with ease!
Y-you're gonna get bonked!
Owww... *cough* *cough*... Just got pegged by the pitching machine by accident! It's nothin' to worry about, seriously!
I'm ready, so put me in already!!
Hooooome run! Another point for Z16!
Wh-where did that baseball come from?!
O-class battlecruiser - Brünhilde.

I am the Iron Blood battlecruiser, Brünhilde. I am a Plan Z ship that was never completed, just like some of my fellow ships you've met already. I shall fulfill my duties to the utmost of my abilities, so you need not worry when entrusting missions to me.
I am battlecruiser Brünhilde, Walküre of the Iron Blood. As fellow bearers of great responsibility, let us hone one another as we press forward.
Looks like you showed up to work on time. Though it may be your duty, your strength of will is admirable.
This music box? Ah, it lost its voice many years ago, but I figured it'd be a shame to throw it out, so I held onto it.
I would like you to hold on to the armaments I've used instead of throwing them out. That way, when I look upon them, I will be able to remember those who fought at my side.
Let me check that list one more time. I'd like to prevent any failures from small mistakes getting overlooked.
That object on your desk looks like quite the antique. Where did you get it? Oh, it's no big deal, it just happened to catch my eye...
Cut to the chase. I prefer keeping things to the point.
I wonder when I'll be able to fix this nasty habit of yours.
We've been issued a new mission. Let us strive to not let the other party down.
Done with the mission already? You work pretty efficiently.
Here's some mail for you. Oh... Don't mind me. I suddenly felt like putting pen to parchment for some reason...
Have you returned safely? The battlefield is cruel indeed. Do not allow a single victory to make you forget that fact.
The commission team has returned to port. Hurry and go see them - you made a promise, and ought not to break it.
Thank you. Call upon me for your next sortie.
The smell of gunpowder... Yes, I have returned to the battlefield once more!
I won't let anyone down, regardless of who it may be.
Valhalla will have to wait... For now, we retreat!
I'll run you through!
Hardly even a scratch.
Further displays of weakness will only earn you more contempt from me.
I love antiques. When I look at them, I feel as if I'm being transported back to a bygone era. But, for me, the word "past" refers to something far, far more distant.
My love for antiques is akin to a yearning for something one cannot have. "If I were born in that era, how would my life have been different"...I wonder if thinking this way is just human nature?
Have you ever wanted to go back in time? To feel nostalgia from your youth, experience something again, or resolve something you regret..? Do you ever think about those things?

So your desire for a better future outweighs your nostalgia for your past? Quite the astute answer. Then, promise me this—don't stop until you reach that future you dream of. If you ever feel like giving up, I'll be there to remind you of this promise you made with me.
One day, when I look at this ring engraved with the runes of time, I may remember the moment we first met. Let us hone one another as we press forward, as bearers of the same great responsibility...
Quite tasteful. Where did you get this?
Hmm, let's go for a drink when we return.

ex.line: That pen looks like it's been pretty well-used... Ahem, Commander. Would you mind telling me the story behind that pen? I'd really like to know...
Rather than questions such as, "Does Valhalla exist," or "Where do souls go after death?"... What matters to me is that I hold the hand of my beloved as long as my heart still beats.
I want you to share your feelings with me, whether they are good or bad.
*sigh*... Just do what you want...
So you've returned safely. The fact that you've returned from countless battles unscathed proves that you are no ordinary human. Hehehe.
Even should I sortie a thousand times, I shall not fall short of my expectations. Because they are your expectations, Commander..
I admire your determination to cross over... but our time has not yet come. Let us retreat.

lines.line: Hah! This donut now belongs to Brünhilde! Alright, now for the finish line... C-Commander? Sorry, but there's no time for chit-chat... I'll be going now!
Hah! This donut now belongs to Brünhilde! Alright, now for the finish line... C-Commander? Sorry, but there's no time for chit-chat... I'll be going now!
Oh, you're back? Judging from how much you're sweating, your battle must've been grueling as well... In any case, want to help untie this rope first?

Not only are we supposed to run with our hands tied behind our backs, but we're also supposed to jump and carry bread in our mouths while we're at it... This so-called "sports meet" is probably more entertaining for the crowd than for us.
Ägir, why don't you try this bread-eating race? Don't say you can't do it, do it for the Commander, won't you?
Was that... Isuzu and some Meowfficers that just sprinted past us? What kind of event are they participating in...?
Racing is a sport that originated a long time ago. Try as I might, however, I can't understand all of the weird rules that have been added to it...
I'm grateful that you brought me something to drink, but I can't exactly bring it up to my mouth right now...
You're really such a... Once you untie this binding, I'm going to give you a piece of my mind.
...What an interesting texture. ...Oh, Commander, thanks for setting the bread up again.
Victory at all costs!
Heh. This point now belongs to me!
I guess even I have my off-days...
Akizuki-class destroyer number six - Wakatsuki.

Akizuki-class destroyer, Wakatsuki, is at your service! Like my sisters, I specialize in anti-air combat, but I'm no slouch when it comes to surface combat either! Don't you worry - I will never betray your orders, and will strive tirelessly to protect you!
I'm Akizuki-class destroyer Wakatsuki. I heard your summons and came promptly to aid you, Commander! Kindly call upon me whenever you have need of me.
Commander! Were you about to begin your work? Allow me to assist in whatever way I can! Do you have anything I'm able to do?
Hyah! Hrah! ...Oh, Commander! As you can see, I was just practicing my swings! Would you like to join me?
Commander, please look over here! There're some little birdies by the windowsill... Aw, they flew off... Hmm, is there some way of approaching without scaring them away?
Commander, is there any work I would be able to help with? I might not be able to understand a lot of these documents right now, but if I work at it enough, I'm sure I'll get the hang of it!
I start to feel anxious when I'm not with my friends... Do you feel the same way when you're alone, Commander?
Is this my reward? Ehehe~
My blade is very heavy, so please be careful!
Woah, woah! What are you doing, Commander? That's the kind of stuff you end up groveling on your knees and apologizing for!
Are you worried about this mission, Commander? Just let me take care of it then!
Mission complete! I don't think I've done anything worthy of praise, but it does feel great to overcome obstacles together with you!
Commander, take a look at this! A top-secret letter has come! ...Oh, it's just an ordinary letter?
I am glad you've returned safely! Ehehe, I could hardly sit still while waiting for you to come back, Commander...
A commission represents the trust of the requester. In other words, upholding that contract is righteous and good!
My body has become lighter and faster!
Vanguard Wakatsuki has arrived! Everyone, charge forward with me!
The victor has been decided! Drop your weapons and surrender! Hahaha!
I shall protect your rear, so hurry up and retreat!
Just leave it to me!
Woah, I've got to regain my balance!
Why did you have to leave me all alone? Did I do something wrong...?

My reason for helping others, huh... Hmm, I've never actually given it that much thought before. How about you, Commander? I heard you've done so much for everyone here, so what's your reason for all that?

Some people will turn their backs on their friends and their beliefs after gaining great power... You often read about these greedy powermongers in various stories! If I ever met someone like that one day... Hehe~

Are you going somewhere, Commander? ...Th-then, bring me along with you too! I'll make myself useful somehow! ...Whenever you're not here, I... Oh, you're just going on a quick patrol around the port?!
I shall protect you today, just as I do every day! ...Huh? I seem to be in an especially good mood today? Well, of course! Nothing makes me happier than being at your side and serving you faithfully!

I see! So this is a symbol of my fealty to you! From now on, I swear to always remain by your side and to protect you with my life! If you ever need anything, just call my name. I'll do anything for you!
Much obliged!
Let us fight for our Commander!
Allow me to escort you!

ex.line: That voice... A friend is calling out to us! We can't abandon someone in their time of need, Commander! Let's go help them right away!
Look, Commander, the little birdies aren't afraid of me anymore! Ehehe, that's because I've been feeding them~
Commander, I still cannot make sense of these documents, but I can certainly run errands for you! Let me deliver these papers for you! ...I probably won't get the place mixed up this time!
Commander! I heard that a good way to develop a strong bond with someone is to spar with them! Want to give it a try? ...Huh? There's more than one way to do that?
The more good things I do, the more rewards I'll get from you, right?
Commander, if you're doing this kind of stuff to other girls... I, I think you should stop that!
With your vision, Commander, our victory is assured!

lines.line: Oh nooo! Look out, Commander! ...Oh, phew... I'm glad I didn't mess up your clothes because of my carelessness! Please forgive me for my blunder! I'll clean the floor up right away!
Oh nooo! Look out, Commander! ...Oh, phew... I'm glad I didn't mess up your clothes because of my carelessness! Please forgive me for my blunder! I'll clean the floor up right away!
Welcome back, Commander! Allow me to show you to your seat! ...Oh, please watch out for the coffee spill!
If I do a good job, Musashi will pat my head! I've actually received a whole bunch of rewards today. Oh, you're going to reward me too, Commander? Hooray!
Commander, don't you think keeping a few birdies around will liven up the café?
Haguro, are you okay? Is it my fault? ...Oh, you're fine? Thank goodness. If someone falls down because of me, I'd have to get on my knees and apologize...
Commander, I just cleaned this area, so please watch your step! ...We can't afford for there to be any more victims!
Yay, I've been rewarded for my hard work! Ehehe~
Yes, I'll be right out with your order!
I, I'm going to tell my friends on you!
I can't believe I made a fool of myself in front of you... I just wanted to help everyone out with the café, but ended up causing more trouble instead... Urgh...
Blue Sparrow Wakatsuki is here! ...Commander, why are you just staring—Oh, no! I'm caught on the curtain... Aaaah!
Blue Sparrow Wakatsuki has come to bring spring blessings! Happy new year, Commander!
Jin ji du li! Commander, look at this new stance I learned! Do you want to try it?
Ah! I-I'm okay now... Thanks for catching me, Commander... How can I repay you for helping me so early in the year?
Why did I come so soon? Umm, as the Blue Sparrow, I'm here to bring good fortune for the new year, so I thought it'd be best if I came to you early!
I'm keeping you all to myself on the first day of the new year, so I hope you don't mind if I stick to you like glue all day!
You just touched a lucky blue sparrow, so your luck is about to be better than ever! Hehe!
D-don't tickle me, please, Commander! I'm losing balance!
Hyah?! Y-you're already losing patience this early in the new year?!
Welcome back! With my blessings, everything's sure to work out for you today!
Wakatsuki leads the charge!
Deutschland-class armored cruiser - Admiral Graf Spee.
I'm Admiral Graf Spee, Deutschland-class armored cruiser of the Iron Blood. I'm stronger than regular heavy cruisers because I've got a bigger bore than them!
Hi. I'm Admiral Graf Spee, from the Iron Blood. Umm... I hope I can make lots of friends here... Will you be my friend, Commander?
Oh, welcome back, Commander. I'm glad I'm not alone anymore. Hehehe...
I'll keep you safe when danger shows up. That's just what friends do for each other!
You're so focused on work that we barely have time to play... *sigh*... But I know I shouldn't annoy you, because I'm a good girl!
Commander, put this on. There we go! Now you can use steel hands of your own!
Talking to my friends is fun! We talk about food, funny stories, and even... Hehehe, well, everything!
Oh, it's totally empty... Um, this bag of snacks, I mean. The crunchy cones. Can I go to Akashi's store and buy more? Please?
World's... Cutest...? Deutschland, why do you have this sign?
Whuah! Y-you surprised me there...
Give me another hug, Commander! Hehehe...
Um, Deutschland said she'll tear you limb from limb if you touch me here... I-it's okay, I'll make sure she doesn't!
Will you stay with me after our missions are done, Commander? I-if there are still lots to go, then forget I asked...
A mission's been completed? Alright! I wonder if I'll ever get to help with them one day...
Here's a letter for you, Commander. Darn it, the envelope is so small it's hard to hold on to...
Zzz... Mgh... Commander... When will you be back...?
Wow, look at all these rewards! Are these all from the commission team?
I'll use this new strength to protect my friends!
I'll do whatever it takes for my friends!
We've taken out all the baddies, Commander. That means there's no one left to bully us.
Ugghh... I wanna go home, Commander...
Don't bully my friends!
I, I can't take much more...
Please, Commander... don't leave me all alone...
You're the first friend I've made since I came here. Hehehe, I thought you'd be too scared of my big steel hands. I try to only use them to scare bad people.
Ajax is a good friend. We play together all the time. But Deutschland says she's a big meanie... Also, what does it mean when Ajax calls someone her "piggy"?
Thanks for always being here for me, Commander! I've made tons of friends, and I'm getting better at fighting... Life here is so much fun! Hehehe, can I give you a hug as thanks? Hehehe~

You're my best friend and I love you, Commander! I wanna pinky promise with you that we'll be friends forever! But I guess that'd be hard since my hands are so big... Okay, how about shaking my pinky instead?
Weee! I'm flying! Now I'm even taller than you! ...There we go... Hehehe, um, can you keep hugging me? Also, you have to super-duper promise you'll always stay with me!
Wooow, amazing! I love you!
You don't need to watch over me all the time...
You're not a meanie... right?
W-will you be my friend?

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander! Hehehe, I want my daily hug now!
Honestly, I don't like fighting much... But I know we have to defeat the baddies so me and my friends can all play together every day!
Oh. Don't worry about me, Commander! I'm a good girl and I'd never distract you when you're trying to work!
Do you want some snacks too? Okay! ...Oh, wait, I need to take the steel hands off...
I've made lots of new friends, but I promise I'll never forget about you, Commander! Because you're my best friend ever!
Hey, look, it's Little Renown! Renown, over here! ...Huh? She's ignoring me... Was that really not Renown after all?
Hehehe, this makes me happy...
I love it when you hug me...
Hm? What's special about this part of me? Do you do this with everyone else too...?
Do you have new missions, Commander? I wanna help with them, even if just a little!
Mission complete. Hehehe, even if it wasn't much, I did manage to help!
Hehehe, I've gotten better with my steel hands... Oops! I gripped too hard and squashed your mail! S-sorry...
Zzz... Zzzzz... The Commander's still not home... I just wanna see you again...
I'll do whatever it takes for my friends, especially my best friend, the Commander!

lines.line: J-class destroyer - Janus.
H-hello, I'm Janus, a J-class destroyer from the Royal Navy... I'll work hard so that I can be of use to you and everyone else here! ...Ahh, I'm still so nervous...

(Y-you can do it, Janus! It's just a simple greeting!) ...Ah, um! Commander, p-pleased to meet you! I am Janus of the J class! Please forgive me if my sudden visitation was discourteous to you in any way...
...Commander?! Wh-when did you... I mean, my apologies! Um... W-w-w-w-welcome back!
So much stuff happened today... Mm, I should record it down in my diary... C-Commander?! Th-this is just an ordinary diary... Sorry! I can't let you read it!
(...I don't hear anything from the office... I'll end up disturbing the Commander if I walk in right now, won't I...)
I hope the seas will remain calm today... and that my friends who have set sail will return home safely...
Um, if Jervis happens to say something rude to you, please don't hold it against her! If, if anything, I'll apologize in her place!
That feels so nice... Pweh?! S-so sorry! I was completely distracted by something else just now...
Hyeep?! ...S-sorry! That just startled me a bit...
*whimpers*... I-is this my punishment for being a burden...?
Commander, um, about the mission... S-sorry! I wasn't trying to specifically bring that up right now!
Wow, you're already done with your work? How impressive... I-it was only possible because of me...? Th-thank you! I'm glad I was able to be of help!
Commander, your mail is here! ...Phew, I'm glad I was able to deliver it to you promptly!
C-Commander! Great job on your sortie! Is there, um, anything I can do to help?
The commission team has returned... P-please allow me to come with you! ...Well, actually, it's fine if you don't...
Just getting stronger isn't good enough. I also have to keep working harder...
Don't worry, Janus, you can do this! You can totally handle those enemies!
Did you see that, Commander? I, I did it!
Ugh... I lost... What's this tight feeling in my chest...?
P-please stand aside!
I mustn't drag the others down... I have to be strong!
I knew it... I can't do anything after all... or be of use to anyone...

I still have trouble talking to people who aren't my J-class sister ships, but... I can at least greet the Commander normally now! I'll keep working hard to make sure I can help a lot more people from now on!

Jervis said something terrible to the Commander again today... Even though I'm sure she didn't mean that... If I were to say something like that to the Commander... Actually, there's no way that'd ever happen...

Spending time with the Commander is always so much fun, and I feel my courage growing as well... I hope that we'll always be together, tomorrow and every day after that... It might be wishful thinking, but I hope this silly dream of mine comes true...

Whenever I can't be with the Commander, my chest aches... Jervis said this wasn't a sickness, but rather 'covetousness'... Am I a covetous girl? Do I crave the Commander's attention so badly...? Commander, I don't want to be a nuisance to you, but I don't know what I should do...
Huh? The two of us, oathbound? ...C-Commander, I never realized you... Oh, it's nothing! I'm so glad! I'll never stop working hard so that I can be of use to you, Commander!
Is it really okay for me to keep this? I'll take good care of it!

ex.line: Don't worry, Janus, you've already done this a whole bunch of times before... Ah, Commander, welcome back!

Commander... D-do you still want to read my diary? I, I suppose that isn't an impossible proposition... Alright, I'm leaving a bookmark right here... But! You're absolutely not allowed to look past the marked page!
Are you sure I can come talk to you whenever I want? ...I, I see. I'll try my best to find a suitable time to come bother you then... Gah, that came out wrong! I didn't mean it that way...

Whenever I found myself too afraid to move forward, I used to try to encourage myself to keep my spirits up. But now, with you and my other friends at my side, I have all the courage I need and no longer need to resort to that. Ehehe.
I, I still don't think... I can handle stuff like this yet... Ugh...
Commander, the new missions are... Y-yes, if you require my assistance, I'll do my best to help out!
The commission team has returned. Please allow me to come with you as well! I... I can do this now!
Commander, I'll be fine! I'm... not afraid of failure anymore like I used to be!

The day we exchanged oaths was the happiest day of my life... I have to work harder in every aspect of my life so that this happiness may last forever! ...Oh, but if I let the Commander read this, then everything I wrote before will... >///<

lines.line: D-don't worry, Janus... There's no such thing as Halloween ghouls... Hyeep?! A c-cat?! *whimper*... Jervis, Commander, please come save me...!
D-don't worry, Janus... There's no such thing as Halloween ghouls... Hyeep?! A c-cat?! *whimper*... Jervis, Commander, please come save me...!
I'll be just fine, I can handle going out alone on Halloween night... C-Commander, I'm sorry! I need your help after all...

If I fill out my diary, it's just going to be chock-full of spooky stuff! Um, anyways, I'm just going to write down the non-scary things... "I ran into the Commander, and then we spent Halloween together..." --That's good enough, right?
C-Commander, it's not your fault. I wasn't watching where I was going... No, I'm sure it was because I was too jumpy and ended up spooking the kitty...
All my friends around the port are dressing up for Halloween, huh... By the way, what is this supposed to be a costume of? It has cat ears, but bat wings...
Commander, are you not scared of Halloween? Well, when I think about it a bit more... I'm the only one who's scared of Halloween, aren't I? Oh no, I'm sorry for bringing up weird things...
Don't you worry, Janus, there's nothing to be afraid of... Jervis and the Commander are here!
Commander, there's new mission here! Err, umm... I hope you can come back sooner... S-sorry!
I'm a bad girl, aren't I? For wearing this to try to get Commander to notice me... A-actually, p-please don't look at me after all! *whimpers*...
Hyeep?! ...Oh, that was just the commission fleet coming back? Thank you very much...
Jervis is going to be worried about me... Ugh...

I ended up causing all sorts of trouble for the Commander... But I'm so glad we got to spend Halloween together, even despite all that apologising... Ugh, bad Janus! That doesn't count as a date... You have to get the Commander to agree beforehand...

It's okay, Janus. You're just getting dressed, so do it like usual, and everything will be fine... Hwuh? Commander? S-sorry! I'm the one who told you to keep your eyes closed, so why did I go and talk to you?!

It's okay, Janus. You're just getting dressed, so do it like usual, and everything will be fine... Hwuh? Commander? S-sorry! I'm the one who told you to keep your eyes closed, so why did I go and talk to you?!
Ah... I-I'm sorry for making you wait. Just a little longer...
Commander, don't look there! ...Phew... I-it's nothing! It's not like I hid my diary there, or anything... Eep...
It's okay, Janus, the Commander's focused on work... But I must be a distraction, right? What do I do...?
Jervis said she'd come and pick me up... I-if I don't get changed quickly, she might misunderstand the situation. Then, the Commander might get called weird names again...
Oh, no! I don't think you're a bother or anything, Commander! Did it seem that way? Oh, no...
Don't worry, Janus. The Commander won't do anything weird... Just don't worry!
I get it. It's my fault for making you wait... Ack! *blush*
A new mission? I see. You would have new missions, Commander... M-may I join you in taking care of them?
W-w-welcome back! Once I'm dressed, umm, could we leave together...?
The commission team is back? Okay! I'll go and meet them... right away...!
I hope my skirt's fine like this...

I brought the Commander to my room... I didn't want to be a distraction, but I did it anyway... You need to stop this, Janus! Jervis is going to worry about you! The Commander didn't teach you to be bad, so why did you turn out to be such a bad girl...?

It'll be alright, Janus! Nothing bad's going to happen to you just because the light went out and you're all alone... Umm... Hyeep?! C-Commander? D-did you come to pick me up because you were worried...?

It'll be alright, Janus! Nothing bad's going to happen to you just because the light went out and you're all alone... Umm... Hyeep?! C-Commander? D-did you come to pick me up because you were worried...?
*sniffles*... Had you not come to get me, Commander, I'd probably still be crouching in the same place...
I wrote about my experiences with the Royal Maids in my diary. If y-you're interested in hearing about it... w-we can maybe read it together next time?
Maids are truly amazing... They spare no effort in providing the best service they possibly can...
Being able to experience being a part of the Royal Maids firsthand was a lot of fun. I feel like I'm... a little more courageous now!

Ark Royal is a very dependable person. She handles everything thrown at her with ease, and she's always looking after me and helping me out... I wish I could become as reliable and mature as she is...
Th-thank you... Holding hands makes me feel a lot safer...
*whimpers*... I, I don't think we should be doing this...
Commander, wh-where did you go just now...? I, I tried finding my way around in the dark by myself, b-but, I just can't do it...
The commission team is back... Huh?! Y-you're going to make me greet them in this outfit? Umm, uhh... m-maybe next time?!

Hypothetically, if I were to become Commander's personal maid... I'd do the cooking, draw the bathwater, make the bed, and, umm... maybe also have to do this or that... Ahh, just thinking about it is making me blush...
Don't worry, Janus, they'll leave you alone soon... Hwah?! C-Commander? I-I'm sorry! I didn't come up here on purpose. These kitties just, umm, chased me...
Don't worry, Janus, they'll leave you alone soon... Hwah?! C-Commander? I-I'm sorry! I didn't come up here on purpose. These kitties just, umm, chased me...
I'm sorry! Can we delay the pool lesson to another time...? Ahh... I'd really like to change into a different pair of tights...
Commander, umm... C-can you go a little slower for me? I'm trying to memorise the rules... Ahm... Here, I'll just write them down...
There are so many different ways to play pool... If not for you, I'd never have known.
I came up here to escape these kitties, but my outfit, um... Ahh...
Wow! All that in one shot... How long will it take me to get as good as you? I-I wonder if you'll keep teaching me... Ahh... Never mind...
You're trying to comfort me...? I-it's okay! I'm fine!
Umm, lower your waist, and spread your fingers... Eep... A-a little close...
Ahh... H-here? M-maybe that's not such a good idea...
Welcome, Commander. I'll set up the pool table right away... Huh? Y-yes! I will get down first...

The Commander tried so hard to teach me, but I didn't learn a thing... When we're that close, I can't focus on anything other than that. I can hardly even hear... Ugh, Janus! At this rate, you're just going to waste the Commander's valuable time!
It'll be okay, Janus... it'll be okay! You're safe up here... so it'll be okay! Ahh, it's totally not okay... C-Commander, c-could you hold me steady... please?
It'll be okay, Janus... it'll be okay! You're safe up here... so it'll be okay! Ahh, it's totally not okay... C-Commander, c-could you hold me steady... please?
Commander, I-I... I'm too scared to go in by myself! C-could you please share some of your courage with me?!
Oh... I wrote down some swimming tips in my diary and read them again and again... but then I got too overwhelmed to even remember them...
I should probably untie this part to get the sunscreen on, shouldn't I? W-wait, I don't mean it like THAT! Just that it would be easier without these strings in the way... Oh, gosh!
Hyeep, the wind! What if my swimsuit blows away...? Ahh, Commander, I need you to pull this part tight for me!
You like the view...? C-could you please tell me which view you're talking about?
Are you trying to encourage me? Th-thank you! I feel more confident now!
The sunscreen is nice and even now... Thank you, Commander! Heehee, I can finally swim without worrying!
Ah, umm! Y-you know, when I hold you like this... I don't feel scared anymore!
Y-you're finally back, Commander! Um, I was thinking about going out and looking for you... then I got too scared...

(I spent the day in a wonderful place with the Commander... W-wait, Janus! Didn't you make a promise to swim together? And then you were so happy just to be with the Commander that it never happened. Well, at least the Commander had fun...I think...)
Keep cool, Janus. Just smile... Today's the most important day of your life. I-it's just... Commander, I'm scared of heights...
Keep cool, Janus. Just smile... Today's the most important day of your life. I-it's just... Commander, I'm scared of heights...
Now that you're here holding my hand... I'm not as scared anymore!
