Ah... S-sorry! I was thinking about how I can remember every moment of this day, but the harder I try, the more I forget... D-do you think I should just focus on having fun? O-okay! I'll focus really hard on enjoying every single second with you!
It's okay, Commander... I'm not scared anymore. All I feel is happiness like I've never felt before!
You think I look like an angel...? Th-then I'll protect you forever as your guardian angel!
As your partner, I'll always do my best to become braver and stronger until I'm worthy of you... Then, I can hold my head high as I walk alongside you!
Will you pet me like that every day from now on?
Th-the swing is swinging... Commander, hold my hand tightly! I'll do my best to protect you!
Moving is a little scary right now... L-let's do that after I get down, okay?
Commander, the sun is rising. Hehe, it's my gift just for you...

I was wondering if I should write this in my diary, but this time, I want to tell you directly! "Today's sunrise heralds a new future for you and me to walk together, hand in hand... I love you, Commander, now and forever."
Centaur-class light aircraft carrier - Albion.

I am the Royal Navy light carrier, Albion. I was constructed along with Centaur after that great war, and was one of the first aircraft carriers to carry out newly-developed tactics. Please watch over my growth under the tutelage of my Elders, Commander.

My name is Albion, sister ship to light carrier Centaur. As a Childe to this fleet, I hope to receive guidance from everyone in this fleet-- Um, Commander, that also makes you one of my Elders, right?
Light carrier, Albion, at your service. I await your orders.

You want to know about my appearance? Unlike Elder Centaur, my name is not based on a mythological creature. If I had to say, the land where those with my appearance lived in the ancient times when legends roamed the world... Oh, am I talking your head off?

If you require a change of pace, I would like to suggest taking a stroll through the forest with Elder Centaur. I would especially recommend the forest by the hills, as the wind there feels particularly nice. Hehehe.
The ships of my class use a variety of arms in battle, so I don't think trying to copy their fighting style will be of much use to me. Instead, I can learn from their battle-readiness.
Grey Ghost...? I'm not sure I can shoulder the burden of sharing a nickname with Elder Enterprise... I-if you're fine with it, I do suppose you can call me that, if you wish...
U-um, go ahead... So long as you don't touch the rigging of my bow...
H-how embarrassing... Ugh...
Let us work towards the completion of your missions. It is by following your example that we shipgirls reach new heights.
The rewards for your completed missions are here. Should I... check the address to confirm whether they've arrived at the right place?
There seems to be some new mail... Would you like to take a look?
You did a great job, Commander. Please call for me if there's anything I can do to lighten your load.
The whispers of the wind... tell me that the girls have returned from their commissions. Let me know when you're ready to meet with them.
The strengthening was a success. Commander, please see for yourself how the ride feels next time we head out.
With courage and loyalty, we shall prevail!
The unblemished Albion thus claims this victory!
How did I manage... to be so clumsy...
Please watch what I can do, my dear Elders!
I've got to dig my heels in... I don't want to be a burden to my Elders!
Was there something amiss with the way I conducted myself...?

As a Childe of the fleet, I can only hope to learn from the examples my Elders set in battle, as well as from how you manage the fleet. There is much for me to learn in terms of techniques, mental attitude, as well as everyday customs.
Hmm... Perhaps I need a new way of addressing my Elders of the destroyer class... And then there are the blueprint ships as well... But they're still my Elders... What should I do...?

Elder Commander, should I leave these documents over here? Urgh, I knew it would feel weird to call you that... Calling you one of my Elders doesn't feel respectful enough, and frankly, feels quite strange to say out loud...

How should I address the Commander then? Lord Commander? I'm sure my Elders have much more intimate ways of address... Ugh, I can't believe I sabotaged myself from the start, even though I'd like to have a closer relationship... Maybe I should try a different approach, like a date or something...?

A... Promise Ring? Um, I don't recall ever asking for one though... You're giving it to me because you love me? O-oh! Yes, I see! I apologise for being so thick-skulled that I didn't have an inkling of your feelings for me. Ehehe, thank you... very much. ♥
A gift bestowed upon me by my Elder... Heehee.
Elder Hermes, I'm right behind you!
Elder Centaur, don't push yourself too hard!

ex.line: I want to be a more capable secretary like Elder Centaur... Oh, Commander, I'm awaiting your orders.
While Elder Centaur tends to take after our other Elders and follow what they do, I prefer to learn from them instead. Indeed, I prefer using my brain, just as you do.
If I could instruct the others in my unique fighting style, we could perhaps implement new tactics in battle. It's certainly not because I want to be called an Elder myself or anything. Heehee.

Elder Enterprise really can do just about anything... Though if there's any area I can exceed her in, it's probably cooking, housework, or making my way through the forests like Centaur... Um, huh...?
Commander, could you tell me what your favourite book is? I was planning on studying your tastes, just as I have been doing with the other Elders here.

Secretary duties aren't so difficult after all now that I've gotten used to things. The bigger issue is how I can take the initiative... I suppose I'll start by taking on some of the Commander's work... Yes, I think that's exactly what I should do.
I shall indulge the inquisitive Commander's curiosity. Please, take my hand and hold it tight.
Yes, Commander. Our hearts are connected, now and forever.
Well done, Commander. As for the after-action report... You'd like me to handle it? Naturally, I'd be delighted to!
Commander, the girls have returned from their commission~ Heehee, that's not the whispers of the wind you're hearing, but rather my breath~ Did you enjoy it?
Phew... It really does take lots of consistent effort to live up to my Elders' expectations. Nevertheless, the unblemished Albion thusly claims this victory!

Commander, did you need me? I know you didn't call for me, but I could just feel it. As our hearts are now connected, I heard your desires upon the wind... Oh, m-my apologies for getting worked up on my own... Umm... love you, my dear.

lines.line: Ah, umm... If you keep staring at me like that... Oh, um, Commander, this is supposed to be a Royalty of the Night costume, right? In that case... Would you mind kneeling for me first?
Ah, umm... If you keep staring at me like that... Oh, um, Commander, this is supposed to be a Royalty of the Night costume, right? In that case... Would you mind kneeling for me first?
Tonight, I shall make a servant of you, Commander. Um... Excuse me, but could you do this favour for me please? *bows*

I-I apologise for making a fool of myself... If it's alright with you, can I tag along with you for a bit longer? I'm sure if I try hard enough, I'll be able to step on you more satisfactorily... But don't worry, I'm just playing a role.
Shall I become a faerie, a vampire, or even a succubus...? Hmm, I wonder, which of these do I see myself being?
Elder Vampire has taken me under her tutelage, but it's quite difficult to walk in this outfit... Oh, I'd be just fine with you by my side, though.
It feels quite awkward having to give you orders... You know what? You should be the one ordering me around after all. Just say the word, and it shall be done.
This outfit is a bit too tight around certain places... Ugh...
So this is what you're like when you've been seduced... I'll have to keep this in mind... Whew... *blushes*
Impeccable results. Oh, I suppose I should have a more condescending attitude towards you...? Umm, I suppose those were... passable results?
A victory as unblemished as... Oh, I wonder if I can still say that in these black clothes... I-in any case, a victory is a victory!

Commander, please continue serving me until the end of time. If you keep your end of the bargain, I swear that I... ehehe, will always take care of all your needs. Both faeries and vampires live long lives, so regardless, I'll always be with you~♪
Hand brushing my hair behind my ear, eyes toward the camera... Mm, filming promotional material isn't easy... Commander, will this do?
Hand brushing my hair behind my ear, eyes toward the camera... Mm, filming promotional material isn't easy... Commander, will this do?
I must learn to be a proper model, at least until I'm worthy of this dress... Oh. Welcome back, Commander. Do you have orders for me today?
You can let me know if there's anything you ever need, Commander, whether it's for advertising or not. I would love a chance to see my seniors taking such charming photos...

Feeling the nighttime breeze on the veranda, the comforting fragrance of flowers... Hm? You thought that looked good and took a picture? U-umm... Th-that's a little sudden, no? I wasn't even posing yet...
Relaxing walks in the forest are nice, but there's a slightly more unique vibe right here. Do you feel it, Commander?
Is it easy to move in this dress? Umm... Well, I can fight and do chores just fine... Oh, shall I wear it to secretary duty tomorrow? Hm? You won't be able to focus? But why...?
Tickles a little... Do you want a photo like this, Commander?
C-Commander, perhaps we should show restraint for now...
Thank you for your leadership in battle, Commander. Would you like tea? Our seniors in the Dragon Empery taught me, so I hope you like it...
Heehee, I heard a little whisper just now. The breeze blowing against my ears and the wafting scent of flowers tell me that our hearts are connected, Commander. Do you hear it, too, Commander?
Good morning, Commander. Umm... I was excited to prepare a perfect breakfast for you, but I made some mistakes. Please wait a moment. I'll remake it in no time!
Good morning, Commander. Umm... I was excited to prepare a perfect breakfast for you, but I made some mistakes. Please wait a moment. I'll remake it in no time!
Ugh, I even spilled the milk... It's not on my clothes, is it? Phew. I'd better get this fixed up before the Commander wakes up... Huh? Commander, you're... already awake?
I wanted to make you a tasty, healthy breakfast... Umm, when I was checking the milk temperature, I remembered your warmth, lost my wits for a moment, and... Well, I'm sorry...
Did you sleep well last night? I slept so soundly, and even had a warm dream - with you by my side... Would you like to know what it was about?
You want to make breakfast with me? Umm, sure, I don't mind. I'm certain it'll taste better when we make it together.
What a beautiful sunny day... Commander, what say we go out for a walk after breakfast?
I don't have to worry about it too much? Okay... Thank you.
C-Commander, may I have a good morning kiss? Oh, goodness... I managed to say it, but it's so embarrassing...
Huh? More milk...? Umm, Commander... Can it wait until after breakfast?
Missions? This early? Don't worry about me. I'll bring breakfast to you as soon as it's ready!
Commander, are you done with your missions? Great. I just made a new breakfast for you.
The smell of something burning woke you up? Um... Sorry. I burned the toast.

Waking up next to you, making breakfast together, and basking in the morning sun... Life feels so warm and happy. Is it too much to hope that every morning could be like this from now on? Am I being too greedy...?
Sailing frigate - Royal Fortune.

My history? Well, I was a rough and tough pirate just like in the stories, bullying those I didn't like and ne'er living two days the same way~ Then I got into a fight with a real tough bastard and that was game over for me. Bad luck, that's what it was.

You're looking at the mysterious, heartstopping Royal Fortune! ...Hm? Scared you, did I? C'mon, don't be so uptight! Now, where are we headed? The fabled Treasure Coast? The cursed Black Reef, littered with shipwrecks? I don't care where we're going; let's just hoist the sails!
Ahahaha! There you are, Commander! Hurry up and finish your work so we can set off on another grand adventure!

Alright, lassies, it's time to go night-night. The pirate bedtime stories will have to be another time. Hm? You wanna hear them too, Commander? Then maybe an adult story would be more to your tastes, huh? Hahahaha♡
Movies! Video games! Ah, modern entertainment is bloody amazing! It's easier than ever to stave off boredom even while not out at sea!
Gambling simply boils down to a test of who's luckier. It's not about winners or losers - it's about scamming poor sods who aren't as lucky as they thought.
Even we pirates have our own code of conduct. How are you supposed to keep people in line without rules? Speaking of which, what kind of rules do you have?
Hey! I don't like it when people touch my hat without permission!
Hahaha, tired of boring ol' paperwork and ready for an adventure? I'm always ready to sail with ya♪
Between drinking lethal poison, a sword through the neck, or being thrown overboard... which one would you prefer? ♪
New missions, eh? Let's have a gander... This one's high risk, but high reward too... Alright, let's do it!
Mission complete! Speaking of which, what's the secretary's cut of the rewards?
A letter? Ahah! Is it a wanted list? Say, if you had a bounty on your head, how much do you reckon it'd be worth?
You made it back! Brought back any exciting tales of your adventures? You know, like being caught in a storm, chased by sharks, and swept away by the waves before finally escaping with your life?
The commission team is back with a boatload of booty! They're waiting for you to divvy it up, so get going!
Now that I'm stronger, shall we set out for a more thrilling, heart-throbbing adventure?
Go, go! Fortune favours the fleet-footed!
Heheh~ Time to feed these scalawags to the sharks!
Grah! I hate swallows! Shoo with the lot of you!
I'll blow you all to bits!
Let's find out who fortune favours!
Ugghh. If this were the olden days, I would've fed you to the sharks or dumped you off on a deserted island.
Living in the moment means doing what you enjoy and forgetting all your troubles and concerns! ...That still doesn't mean I have the right to plunder? Laaame!

Even to this day, lots of people go wild for pirate treasure! I suppose very few can resist the alluring shimmer of gold and silver, eh... Hm? Where do ya find said treasure? Sorry, no hints! If you want treasure, you gotta find it yourself~

You don't sail the seas with me just to find treasure, do ya, Commander? I don't think you're in it just for the novelty either... It can't be ME you're after, right? I mean, there's no way... Woah, you're not gonna deny it?

Since you don't have a destination in mind, why don't I plot your course for you? For instance... to that deserted island said to have buried pirate treasure I've heard about. Heheh, don't you worry - worst case scenario, we only end up stranded and have to live there, right? C'mon, let's go!

Sooo... you're sure about this? Living with me's not gonna be easy. You can't just change your mind later, ya hear? ...Well, alright, then take my hand and put the ring on. Once we're done, get on my ship and hoist sails!
Whoa, bloody amazing! I'll take that!

ex.line: Look who's back! Let's team up and get this paperwork done lightning-quick!
Port law article four! Be good and switch off the light before going to bed! Which means no worky-work either! Nighttime means leisure time!
While I do hate gambling, I'm not opposed to making bets. On that note, I bet I can win your heart with just one single date! Wanna find out?
Booze? God no! Just taking a whiff of that stuff makes my head spin, and drinking it leaves me out cold until morning... In other words, keep it away from me.

I'd like one small favour from you, Commander... That you don't pull an all-nighter! Back in the day when curfews were in place, people got on just fine, didn't they? So, absolutely no staying up late tonight! Got it?
If you're on board with it, we can make up some quick excuse and get out of here right now... Come on, you still don't have the courage?
L-look, even I shy away from some stuff...
Mission complete! When it comes to my cut... I don't need material stuff, just some break time to smell the roses!
Here's a letter for you! And no, it's not a wanted list. But if you did become an outlaw, you can always flee to some barren corner of the earth.
Those who do the most work get the biggest cut!
Commander, I trust you to divvy up our booty!

lines.line: Tonight's dessert is not a cake or a pastry... What are you looking around for? YOU'RE my dessert! Heheh, scared you, didn't I?
Tonight's dessert is not a cake or a pastry... What are you looking around for? YOU'RE my dessert! Heheh, scared you, didn't I?
Happy Halloween! On this frightening night, I am Royal Fortune the naughty succubus! Ahahah! I'm on the hunt for a tasty treat!
Hey, hold it! Get back here! Commander, don't just stand there! Catch these thieving birdies and get me back my desserts!
Mmm! Sho good! Desserts are a rare luxury out at sea, you know! This sweetness will linger in my head for a looong time!
Would be cool if we lived in a world where monsters are real! I get pumped just imagining what it'd be like!
That Janus girl sure has got a spicy costume for how shy she seems... Aha, does that happen to be one of your weaknesses, Commander?
You're in too deep to pull out now~
Wh-wh-whaddya think you're doing?!
Who did this?! Who put liquor fondue on my desserts?! Urgh... It's hitting me hard... I'm gonna go lie down a bit...
Hell of a proposition, this. Keeping an eye on your booty for the whole day so nobody steals it. But I said I'd do it, and a real Tempesta always keeps her word. You're all mine for today♪
Hell of a proposition, this. Keeping an eye on your booty for the whole day so nobody steals it. But I said I'd do it, and a real Tempesta always keeps her word. You're all mine for today♪
Back, eh? Let's continue, then♪ "Continue what"? Our daylong date, duh!
You're my golden treasure today, so don't you go anywhere♪ That's right, stay where you are if you don't wanna get grabbed by my tentacles! Ahahah!
Hm-hmm-hmm♪ There's a million ways to have fun at the beach! And the pirate's way is pretty widespread, eh? Brilliant!
A cocktail? Whoa, it looks so vibrant and tasty! ...The hell?! It's got alcohol in it! Are you trying to get me hammered, Commander?!
Port law article eleven! On holidays, everyone should let loose during the day, then feast, sing, and party during the night! And participation is mandatory, Commander.
So, what're we doing next?
You've just earned yourself a kicking! Take this! And that!
Oi, what happened to spending the WHOLE day with me? Other girls can have their turn later! Heehee, caught you♪
Commission team just got back! Let me handle 'em.
Urgh... That drink was NOT non-alcoholic...
Essex-class aircraft carrier - Hornet II, Hull Number CV-12.

It's me, the mighty, new-and-improved Hornet, now an Essex-class aircraft carrier! Well, to be honest, besides the history, the outfit, and the combat power, I'm still pretty much the same girl inside! ...Hey, just because I look a little different doesn't mean I'm not real grateful to you~
"The Grey Ghost" Hornet that everyone's talking about is me! Haha, maybe it's time for everyone to start calling me Ma'am! Anyway, let's keep getting things done, Commander!
The new and improved Hornet has arrived at the office! Hahaha, that's a good mornin' to ya, Commander!
Ahaha, have you fallen in love with the new and improved me all over again? No need to be ashamed about it; it was written all over your face~
I'm not worried about catchin' up to Enty's shadow anymore - I'm now thinkin' about how to become stronger and faster than her! After all, I can't be playing second fiddle to her forever~
Is that... Northampton? Hey, Northampton! ...Ahaha, stubborn as always~ Or is she just shy around you?
Even if you're confident, you're still going to lose if you don't assess the situation carefully. The victor is decided before the battle even begins.
Need me to lend a hand?
E-even I'll get embarrassed if you touch me like that...
The weather's great and I'm raring to go. It's a perfect day for tackling some missions!
Your mission rewards are in! Make sure none of 'em leaked out first though.
Perfect! It's the Magic Carpet Delivery System! ...Hmm, I don't know how to feel about that name...
Whew~♪ Commander, you looked spiffy out there as always! Here's an ice-cold one for ya... Woah! Are you okay there?
*yaaawn*... Shoot, can't be dozing off now... Uhh, our commission buddies are already back?
I've powered up~!
Battle station connection established, attack formation ready to go - All ships, let's slug this one out!
That win was a pretty good workout! How 'bout you, Commander? Work up a good sweat?
The new and improved Hornet... ain't gonna fall here!
Now, you're done for!
This ain't over! I'm just getting ready to make my comeback!
Say, Commander, are you really that dumb, or just playing? I really can't tell sometimes...
I've prepared some home cooking for my beloved Commander! Dig right in~♪ Look, it's totally different from what Enty and Yorktown make, right?
Hmm? You prefer it better when I'm pouty versus when I'm lovey-dovey? Well, that's too bad. Because... it all depends on who I'm dealing with. Yup~
Leaving Enty aside, I wouldn't mind if you went out with Yorktown. I'd be totally fine with Zuikaku, Ty, or Northampton too... Nope, don't mind at all. Me? Being surly? Why, I'd never.

Well, there's no point being hung up on it, and it's not like I can control who you see. All that matters is that I'm your Hornet, and that's enough for me. Eeeyup! And I'll always love you, no matter what!
Hoo... Haah... Alright, I'm ready! C'mon, Commander, are you ready to put a ring on it? Even if nothing is really gonna change, the ceremony is sometimes what matters!
I shoulda known you'd know exactly what I like, Commander!
Ty, where are you headed on your next day off?
Let's show 'em our teamwork!

ex.line: Paperwork, check. Alcoholic drinks for unwinding, check... Oh, Commander! Sorry, I didn't expect you this early. Now let's get to work~♪
I-it's pretty embarrassing when someone says they've fallen for you all over again right to your face... Ahahaha... Y'know what? I've fallen for you all over, too, Commander~♪
You might not realize it, but Yorktown really wants you to pay attention to her. Same here, too, but... Ahaha! Popularity can be rough, huh, Commander?
Is your brain overheating, Commander? Look, there's steam rising from your head... Kidding, kidding! Take a break, 'kay?
Ohh... D-do you want me to feel a bit more... flustered...?
Mission bonus received! Great teamwork, Ty and Princeton!
Lookin' good, Commander! How's about a drink to put some pep in your—Ooh, nice catch! Even if... Well, I just handed it to you.
Looks like the girls are back from their commission. You know what you gotta do, right? Hahaha, of course you do!
Kaboom! Just like that!

lines.line: The title of fastest in the port is miiiine, hahaha! Commandeer, did you see how badass I was just now? There's a whole lot more I'd like to show you, but it'll hafta wait 'til the next race... Well, I'll let you ride with me later, so look forward to it~♪

The title of fastest in the port is miiiine, hahaha! Commandeer, did you see how badass I was just now? There's a whole lot more I'd like to show you, but it'll hafta wait 'til the next race... Well, I'll let you ride with me later, so look forward to it~♪
Oh, Commander~! Ahahaha, sorry! Did I get you all wet? Well, just think of it as having had a big wave crash down on you~!
Heheh~ Has my bewitching, swimsuit-clad figure stolen your heart? No need to be shy about it. That was my aim from the start, after all... Just kidding~♪
Isn't Yorktown's swimsuit simply breathtaking? You know, I was the one who picked it out. If it knocked the wind right out of your lungs, it's all thanks to me, hehe!
I've finally come to the beach to have some fun, so it's time to enjoy the day to the fullest!
The beach is loads better than the pool. This wind, this feeling of freedom~! Whew~ It just feels so darn good~!
Want a ride, Commander? I'll cheer you on~
C'mere, grab on tight from behind... Wha, wha?! Commander?!!
Whew... Worked up a good sweat... You want one as well, Commander? A nice can of Oxy-Cola after exercise... Nothing beats ice-cold pop after a workout~
The girls are back from their commission~ I'll go on ahead to greet them~!
Rigging energy supply connected, all systems go! Time to send 'em flying!
Just means you were no match for Hornet, conquerer of waves!
Independence-class light aircraft carrier - Langley II, Hull Number CVL-27.
Say hello to the new and improved Eagle Union aircraft carrier, Langley! My fighting and instruction have been perfected. Just you wait and see, Commander. Heheh!

Ahem! I am the new and improved Langley. How do I look? Perhaps more refined than before? Better prepared to receive more demanding orders, even? Hehe... I hope you're excited to see what I can do, Commander!
Welcome back. Hard at work, I see. I, Langley, am here to support you to the fullest as always! Just make sure you're ready.
I can't help but notice that you're staring at me. Do you have a question for Ms. Langley?
Tighten up, Commander! Learning the rules is important; they've come from a long history of lessons.
Instead of praying when you're in trouble, you must prudently prepare for everything, Commander!
Commander, you must perpetually be a good example for the sake of all shipgirls' growth—Wait a second. Are you daydreaming again?! Goodness...
Commander, is this your way of telling me that you want one-on-one lessons?
Ahem, hello? Have I reached the military police? Yes, it's happened again... I trust you know who I'm referring to.
I've already sent you a new homework assignment, Commander. Make sure you get it done on time!
There you go! Good work. I expect that same effort next time, Commander.
Leaving mail in your mailbox forever won't solve any of your problems!
Congratulations on your latest victory. Now, where do you think you're going? The lecture's only just begun!
The girls from the commission team are back. I hope they remember my pointers...
Hmm... A welcome improvement.
Students who refuse to listen... need a proper lecturing.
Okay, I'll just add this victory to the next edition of my textbook...
Urk... Does this mean I've been teaching them all wrong?
Take notes, everyone!
Oh, you mischievous students...
Is it just me, or are you intentionally trying to upset me?
How is your work going? Remember, spending time with the girls is just as important as your paperwork... Goodness. There are so many things I still have to teach you!
Good, good! You're doing great work today. So, have you noticed that Ms. Langley's instruction has helped you progress in your studies?
A date... with me? Ack, what am I saying?! Of course not. Students shouldn't try to grow up so fast! N-not that... I'm entirely against it...
You may have earned Ms. Langley's favor, but don't think you can get away with just anything. Though... I will allow you to take it a little easier when we're alone.

I've taught you so much already, but Commander, there are still plenty of places where you need to apply yourself. In other words... Ms. Langley has much more teaching to do! Expect this class to go on... f-forever!
Are you trying to earn Ms. Langley's favor with this present of yours? H-hmph! Don't expect it to work twice!

ex.line: Welcome back. Oh, you'd like to go out with Ms. Langley? Only after you finish your work for the day!
You'd like to see Ms. Langley's sweet, delicate side? Th-th-that isn't something to say to your teacher! P-perhaps when we're in private...
You think I'm too strict? Only because I care about you, Commander. But... I will keep that in mind.
Eyes on your work, please! ...Don't look at me, either! Goodness...
I keep telling you not to treat me like a child!
You mustn't do that to your teacher! A-at least, not when I'm acting as your teacher...
Welcome back—Hold on there! Good, you're not hurt... Okay! You're free to go now.
Haha! Did you learn anything, Commander?

lines.line: Pheeew... Being able to kick back and relax on such a sunny day is just the best! Oh, Commander! If you'd like to come chill with me, I have watermelon and cold drinks!
Pheeew... Being able to kick back and relax on such a sunny day is just the best! Oh, Commander! If you'd like to come chill with me, I have watermelon and cold drinks!
The sunlight is so warm! Ahh... Commander, why don't we relax somewhere comfortable?
Taking adequate breaks is important. This is a rare vacation, so why don't we talk about studies another time?
Phew, that gentle breeze just makes me want to go swimming in the ocean. B-but I'm not a child, you got that? You really look like you want to tell me, your teacher, to be careful in the water.
I chose this swimsuit myself. Even I like to change things up once in a while, you know? But mature and sexy just don't mesh with me...
Commander, why don't we swim over there? You're always exhausted, which is exactly why you need to kick back once in a while.
Mm? You don't have to fuss over me, you know. But I understand... Some students need a more watchful eye on them, don't they?
This teacher's about to get really, REALLY mad!
Where have you been? ...What's so wrong with your teacher worrying about you, exactly?
I, Ms. Langley, will not allow you to disturb my precious time off from work!
Essex-class aircraft carrier - Yorktown II, Hull Number CV-10.

I am the resurrected Fighting Lady, Essex-class aircraft carrier, Yorktown. ...Heehee, I'm actually still the same Yorktown you've always known. To allow me to fight alongside my friends in this new form, you're just as amazing as ever, Commander. Hehehe.

The second ship of the Essex class, "The Fighting Lady" Yorktown, has returned to your side. Even the darkest night must always give way to the resplendent dawn of happiness. Commander, let us step into the future together!
Good day, Commander. What's first on the agenda today? Don't worry, all of us have your back.
Though diplomacy may be a show of etiquette before the war, it also is the only way to put an end to war. I'm sure that means you'll have your work cut out for you though...
Hammann? You look totally different... Oh, now that I think about it, I wonder if I've changed as well... Hmm...

I appreciate your concern, I truly do. But, I also don't understand why you're paying so much attention to me alone. Your time is valuable, Commander, so please make sure to look after our friends as well.
I see, so this is how you use this rigging... Thank you, Essex. We're all a part of the same class now, so there's no need for so much deference.
Lexington, when's your next performance? I'll bring Enterprise and Hornet along to cheer for you~
Just as how we are not here only to fight, Commander, you are not here only to work. If you're not making progress, take a break and come back refreshed later.
Maybe I should try getting you to pamper me like a little child~?
Enterprise, I hope you're doing alright...
The mark you've carved into me will always be here.
My, what's wrong, little eagle? I see, the mission has been completed... I will let the Commander know.
Thank you, little eagle, I see that the mission rewards have arrived. Oh, I can't actually understand what it's saying, but I do get the gist of it~
This is... a delivery from Hornet? I see. That means it's your mail.
Let us raise a glass to our Commander's triumphant return. Don't worry, it's just one glass. I'm glad you're worrying for my sake, but... Hehe, don't you think you're taking after Enterprise?
The commission team has returned safe and sound. It's not good to keep them waiting, okay?
Strengthening complete. I'm becoming more and more used to this power.
For freedom and victory!
Oh- Sorry, I wasn't watching my step... Thank you, Commander. I'll consider your embrace just now as reward for my MVP.
The dawn that the Commander brought us... must not be lost here!
With this power, I'll open a path to the future!
I can't let something like this keep me down!
This must be a trial... to see if I am able to stand on my own legs... That must be it, right?

Commander, you showed me the light of dawn and offered me salvation. I've long stopped seeing our relationship as one between superior and subordinate... Instead, you're more like... Um, oh my, this is rather embarrassing...
Um, ahem... Oh, no, I'm in perfectly fine physical shape. I'm just not sure how I should act around you now that I'm in this form... I'm really alright.

It's not just you, but also Enterprise, Hornet, and Hammann. They're all looking after me as well. Commander, you're the one who has made my blissful life at this port possible, and the person I dedicate my entire life to.

As the light of the dawn of happiness, what should I do for the Commander who reached out to take my hand? Heehee, we'll live happily ever after, right? I understand now - that is how we can share this joy with everyone.
I swear upon the freedom and peace borne within the name of Yorktown, upon the life of happiness that I so desire, and upon my pure love... That the warmth of my lips now belongs to you-
Thank you, Commander. You've made me so happy.
Fight on, Enterprise!
I'm doing perfectly fine. Heehee~

ex.line: Good day, Commander. How is your work going? If ever you need my aid, don't hesitate to ask.
Come to me with any worries you have, okay? When I see that you're troubled, I start to feel so down... And then that's two people for everyone to worry about. Heehee!
You're not worried? You just want to spend time with me? Okay. I... feel the same way.
The past matters. There may be things that we want to forget, but they're part of what makes up who we are. My happiness today is only thanks to everyone's tireless efforts.
Commander, what plans do you have for your next day off? We don't have to go far; I'm sure there are places around the port you haven't been to... Heehee.
Something troubling you, Commander?
There, there. Good Commander... Heehee!
Why don't we crack open some celebratory wine? Don't worry, I'm limiting myself to one glass. Honestly, I was hoping I could be a little bolder if I drank enough... Oh, n-never mind! Ignore that.
The commission team is back safe and sound. Shall we go and meet them together?
U-umm... "Wow, I sure hope the Commander rewards me for being named MVP!" Ahahaha... Th-this doesn't really suit me, does it?

lines.line: How does this look? ...Ah, it's nothing to worry about. Do you think I should adjust the string a bit...? Hmm... Eek!!! I'm so sorry, Commander... A-are you alright...?
How does this look? ...Ah, it's nothing to worry about. Do you think I should adjust the string a bit...? Hmm... Eek!!! I'm so sorry, Commander... A-are you alright...?
Everyone's gathered on the beach. When we finish the shoot, let's go and join them. The beach is more fun with everyone around.
If Hammann saw me like this, she'd probably get the wrong idea... Wh-what if Enterprise does too... Oh no, what should I do...?
I usually don't see them in their swimsuits, but it seems that most of them are wearing some daring ones. I see, that's why Hornet... Hehehe, that has to be it.

Sigh... Oh, don't worry about me. I was just at a loss, since this outfit is so different from what I usually wear. Not only that, but the one who chose it was Hornet... Umm, how about we continue...?
The next pose... goes like this?
R-right... I should be more frank with my feelings as well...
Oh my, I lost track of the time while gazing at the scenery... You picked out a fantastic location for the set, Commander.
My outfit has no impact on my fighting ability!
I just had a little aperitif... How am I already so drunk? C-Commander, wait a second. I'll make you a cocktaaail... Where'd I put that shaker?
I just had a little aperitif... How am I already so drunk? C-Commander, wait a second. I'll make you a cocktaaail... Where'd I put that shaker?
Commander, about that special cocktail... Do you have any requests? Or would you prefer... a surprise flavor?
You look like you've got something to say, Commander... What is it? Or is my cocktail just so delicious that you want seconds? Heehee!
Hmm... Not over there, not over here... Where in the world did I put that shaker?
Does this getup make me look a little too bold? As long as you like it... I-I'm fine with that...
Shaking drinks takes a certain level of skill. Hehe, don't worry. I might not look it, but I'm very capable!
I heard that adding lemon juice can enhance the mouthfeel of a cocktail. I'll try... Eep?! Commander, are you okay?!
Geez, now isn't the time to tease~
Oh, Commander... You're so greedy... *blush*
How about you work on your leftover missions while I search for that darn shaker?
Wanna celebrate another mission well done? Then I'd better make some more cocktails!
Commander, new mail just came in. Ah... Everyone might be surprised if they see me picking it up in this outfit...
Welcome back, Commandeeer~ Hehe, could you get that cup there? It's a cocktail for you. Drink it - I think you'll like it!
The commission team is here. Why don't you go see them first? I'll have the perfect drink waiting when you get back.

I was originally just trying to get your attention, but before I knew it, I was already in your arms... Next time I make you a cocktail, I won't let you taste-test it. Hehe... Who knew that being bold could work out so well?
Welcome to my... no, YOUR own bar, Commander. Relax a little and enjoy exclusive service courtesy of yours truly. Umm... Okay, what now?
Welcome to my... no, YOUR own bar, Commander. Relax a little and enjoy exclusive service courtesy of yours truly. Umm... Okay, what now?
Good day, Commander... Ah. I guess I should say "welcome in" right now, shouldn't I? Heehee.
This is my first time letting you see this outfit... Heehee, that look on your face is adorable~ I'm glad it came in handy!
I'm still not used to waitressing, but seeing that surprised look on your face made it all worthwhile!
If you see any room for improvement in my service, don't hesitate to say so. Consider it making me a better Yorktown.
How do I like waitressing? Hmm... Well, I do enjoy being able to gaze at you more.
Hmm... I thought I was the one serving you, so why does it feel like I'm being taken care of?
What is it? Wanna share some gossip?
C-Commander... Is this the kind of hospitality you expected?
Commander, your quota today is... Ahem. I mean, you have unfinished missions.
There you go! Quotas are all met. Now, Commander, what reward would you like?
Mail for you, Commander. Take it.
You want to share the joy of victory with me? I'd love to! I'll grab some champagne right away.
Everyone from the supply commission just returned. Go say hi to them. You don't wanna focus on me all day, do you?♪
Are you enjoying tonight's service...? It was meant to be just a temporary role, but part of me wishes this night would go on forever. Something about taking care of you just makes my heart race...
Oregon City-class heavy cruiser - Northampton II, Hull Number CA-125.

I've said before that I truly regretted not being able to bring Hornet back safely... but I never thought we'd both have a chance to ride the waves together again. For this journey ahead of us, I'll be there to witness the scenery with you!
We meet again, Commander. It's me, Northampton. For you to know exactly where I'd show up again, I guess we really are two peas in a pod. So... Are you pleased with how I turned out?
Commander, I'll be counting on you for today's training as always.
Hmm? What's up? Are you that curious about my new look?
Houston... Hornet... I wonder if it's because I've spent so much time with them, but it seems that I've changed a bit as well. Umm, for example... I don't hate busy places anymore...
Commander, it's nice out. Umm... Ah, um, sorry, I just wanted to come up with a topic to talk about...
It got quiet all of a sudden. I suppose it's fine... to focus on your work.
Oh. Sorry, I'm a bit ticklish...
Ugh! What's with you...
A new mission? Want me to help?
Mission complete. Don't forget to collect your rewards.
It's a letter for you. Yes... Should I leave it on your desk?
I've confirmed that everyone has returned safely. Good work, Commander.
Commission complete. Let's go welcome our friends back.
Want me to test out my new armaments?
No need to think too hard... Just head out!
There's nothing better than returning home safely with sweet victory in your hands.
Sorry. It wasn't supposed to go this way...
I see you. Right there!
Things aren't looking so good.
I guess we aren't two peas in a pod, after all...
Even though I used to not talk that much, I feel like I've started to change. Though, it's still hard to think up topics to talk about...
Commander, today, uhh... um... How's your work going? Oh, I'm not keeping tabs on you, I just wanted to say hello... I guess I couldn't strike up a conversation again...
I don't need to come up with anything specifically and should just try to be natural? I see, I'll give it a try. Umm... Oh, sorry. I-I end up getting nervous as soon as I see your face...

You want me to be with you for a bit... and I don't need to do anything but just be there with you? Then, I won't have to try so hard to think up a topic...? I see. Then I'll be here by your side until you feel satisfied.

I'm truly thankful that you started up the conversation on your own. Knowing me, I don't know how long it would've taken for me to open up. Ahaha... As members of the overcoming-awkwardness alliance, let us work hard together.
This is for me? Yeah, thank you.
Let us fight together!

ex.line: Commander, for today's training... and other matters, I'll be counting on you.
Commander, it's nice out. Umm... Ah, uh, sorry. If it's fine, want to walk for a bit...?
A quiet office, unusual peace of mind... How nice.
H-hold yourself back a bit...
It's good that everyone made it back safely. And you came back safely too... That's the most important part.
It's also thanks to you, Commander.

lines.line: Whew. How many laps have I done since my last break...? Oh. Commander, are you here to hone your swimming skills too?
Whew. How many laps have I done since my last break...? Oh. Commander, are you here to hone your swimming skills too?
What wonderful weather to go for a swim. Mm, I'm sure everyone who's come to this pool has thought the same thing.
The submarine girls love playing at the bottom of the pool. They even brought along little toy torpedoes. I'm kind of envious of them... but also worried at the same time...
I've heard that you're the port's best-kept secret when it comes to athletic prowess. I'd like to see it for myself.
Unlike when I'm wearing my rigging, I get to stretch my body when I go swimming. In that sense, it's a kind of relaxation, isn't it?
Hornet? I've heard that she prefers the beach to the pool. You might run into her if you head on over.
Ahahaha... I told you I'm ticklish...
S-stop that...! *blushes*
Houston, wait up... Sigh... How many times have I told her not to run off randomly...
Phew... This getup does help me get into the festival mood. It looks nice, and it's supremely comfortable, but I can't shake this embarrassment... Huh? Commander? When did you get here?
Phew... This getup does help me get into the festival mood. It looks nice, and it's supremely comfortable, but I can't shake this embarrassment... Huh? Commander? When did you get here?
Commander, is today's training about to start? Okay, I'll change - Hm? Rest first? Okay, I guess I'll... scoot over for you...?
Commander, umm... Do you want to lie down next to me? Let your heart be calm... "Free from worldly cares"? Is that what they call being comfy and cozy here?
As long as I'm with you, I feel relaxed... um, no matter where we are.
I'm used to things being noisy, but being alone... It's nice. Right?
Whoa! Come on, I always tell you I can't take being tickled...
L-let's wait until we get back before we go further...
Welcome back, Commander. The sunlight and temperature are just perfect... Why don't you come lie down with me?
Commander, I hear the Dragon Empery's new year celebration is a day to be with family. So, umm... Does that mean you can stay here with me?
Edsall-class destroyer escort - Hammann II, Hull Number DE-131.
Hmph. No matter what, I'm still me. Now I've told you all about Yorktown, there is nothing else you need to say. I-if you really wanna do anything for me... Err, I take that back!
Wh-what do you think you're looking at, pervert?! You say it's irresistible...? And you think I'm going to believe that?! Here I was thinking I'd introduce myself properly... I'm gonna remember this!
Hmph! I don't care whether you're here or not, okay?!
Wh-why have you been staring at me for so long?! Could it be that you're actually a perv—Oh, you're just examining my rigging? I-I don't believe you!
Stupid Commander, are you just gonna work all of our time away? ...I-I didn't say anything! You just do your own thing!
How am I adjusting to my new rigging? Hmph, I'm just fine! Worry about me when it actually matters!
Heheheh, now I can really show I-168 who's boss... Y-Yorktown, wait! I'm just trying to make friends with her, I swear!
I've never understood why some girls at the port get so excited when you pat them on the head... That didn't mean I want you to touch me!
Ack?! Don't touch me out of nowhere! You scared me!
Pervert! Degenerate! I'm gonna tell Yorktown... I-if Yorktown doesn't get mad at you, then I still have ways to get back at you!
Stupid Commander! You're forgetting all these missions you haven't finished!
Excuse me! You've got something waiting for you to pick it up! ...I mean the mission rewards, idiot!
Commander! I brought your mail in for you!
Why isn't the Commander back yet... Eep?! D-don't just sneak over without saying anything!
Go and greet the girls who just got back from their commission! And... Make sure you come back quick!
Ugh, I can't say no to you...
Hmph! Witness my newly obtained power!
I won! ...Wh-what?! Just so you know, your compliments don't make me happy at all!
Aww, now the Commander is gonna lecture me... H-hey, you didn't hear anything from me!
Don't underestimate me!
I can't stand this...!
Hmph! I don't even care anymore!
Yorktown might trust you, but you won't win me over that easily! Hmph! ...You say you'll try to work on your worst qualities? W-well, either way, I'm watching you, bub!
You wanna know why I'm staring at you now? Does it really matter?! Oh, I get it - you think I'm a stalker, right?! I'm just worried that you're gonna do something weird if I don't keep my eye on you!
H-hmph! Since you've been good recently, I'll show my appreciation with a rare compliment! ...Th-that doesn't mean I've totally accepted you, though!

Hmph! Every time I look away, you glue your eyes to some other girl... Hyah?! Wh-what's gotten into you?! O-okay, now your face is way too close to mine! I get what you're trying to say, alright?! Geez… That was seriously not the time for that.
D-don't say a word, and just hug me, okay? But don't look at my face! And stop laughing! So this is what I get for being brave and baring my emotions to the person I like...
You can be pretty considerate sometimes, Commander.
Don't worry, I'm all grown up now!

ex.line: Finally, you're back! I was so tired of waiting... I-I mean, never mind! Whether you're here or not, I'm just fine!
L-look. I'll always be hard to deal with, so if you've got a problem—ack! Okay, okay, I get it! You're not the kind of person to change your mind, I get it! Geez... *blush*
Comman—H-hmph. I shouldn't interrupt your work... Besides, you look c-cute when you're focused on work... I-I didn't say anythiiing!
Test out my new rigging? A-alright, here goes! ...Ah. Th-that wasn't... I-it's your fault, Commander!
Wh-what the heck do you want...?
P-perv... *blush*
Hey, stupid Commander! I don't know how to brew tea, so I brought you some refreshing juice... I-If you're thirsty, then just drink it already!

lines.line: Hmph! I only promised to come to the beach because I was worried you'd be lonely! There's no deeper meaning—w-wait! What are you doing?! Stooop!
Hmph! I only promised to come to the beach because I was worried you'd be lonely! There's no deeper meaning—w-wait! What are you doing?! Stooop!
You're the one who invited me out, so why are you late?! ...Hmph!
How long are you gonna stare? Do you l-like my swimsuit that much? ...Why am I not calling you a pervert? C-come on, you have to be teasing me now!
Beach volleyball? Eh, I'll pass... Wh-what? If you wanna play that bad, then go. See if I care! Hmph!
You're giving me a drink? Look, buttering me up won't get you—Th-thank... you...
Sims, wait! I am NOT on a date with the Commander! ...Darn it, Commander, back me up!
Hyah?! W-was that on purpose?!
Pervert! Lecher! I'm never going to forgive you for that!
If you're tired, then I guess you can come here... H-hey, I'm saying you can sit NEXT to me! Dummy! U-ugh, forget it.
A-almost missed my chance... Ahem! N-newbie maid Hammann will... cast a scrumptious spell on you♡ Delicious, delicious, be delicious♪ Moe moe pyun! ...G-gosh, what am I doing?!
A-almost missed my chance... Ahem! N-newbie maid Hammann will... cast a scrumptious spell on you♡ Delicious, delicious, be delicious♪ Moe moe pyun! ...G-gosh, what am I doing?!
Hyah?! My skirt! Ugh... This maid uniform is so frilly and hard to deal with. Wait, doesn't that make you a perv for coming here just to see it?!
It's really hard to work when you stare like that! Hwuh? You still haven't gotten the dessert you ordered...? I-it's almost done! Until then... I'll chat with you to pass the time!
Fluffy fluffy, moe moe, meooow~... Is this spell really supposed to make food taste better? Sounds too easy to me... Hey, don't scarf it down! Was it actually good...?

These shoes are just for the job. I definitely didn't get them so I could bring you your orders faster... Whoa?! I'm gonna fall - oww! H-hurry up and help me... Hey, watch where you're putting those hands!
Apologies for the wait, Master. Here's the "Hammann Feeds You with Love Special"... Wh-who the hell put that on the menu?!
I-I get it! You wanna hold hands, is that it? Look... I can do it for you just this once! Hmph!
P-pervert! I'm gonna punish you with REAL magic!
Welcome back! M-master... Why do I have to call you that? Ugh!
Chapayev-class light cruiser - Kuybyshev.

Project 68-K, Chapayev-class cruiser Kuybyshev, at your service. My construction was halted before the war, robbing me of my opportunity to contribute. I have to admit that I have my regrets, but I plan to do all I can now to make up for it. You have my full support, Commander.
It is an honor and a joy to meet you, Commander. I am Kuybyshev, light cruiser of the Northern Parliament. Let us steel our hearts to weather the war ahead.
Ahh... Good morning, Commander. If you find yourself cold, come to me. I can warm you with my rigging.
I'm not afraid of being hurt. If it means protecting you and the others, I'll take that bargain every time. Heehee.
Nnh... I'm fine. Today's document review is another behemoth. Thank you for all you do.
*blows*... That should do it. Here's your coffee, Commander. Warm yourself while it's still hot.
Believe in yourself. Your accomplishments in bringing peace to these blue seas are more than worthy.
I'm fine. Your concern is much appreciated.
Worry not. I am here for you.
Tell me, are you familiar with the phrase "summary offense?"
Unfinished missions await. If there's anything I can do to help, don't hesitate.
Back from another mission? Why don't you rest with a warm bowl of borscht?
Your mail has arrived. Why don't you reply to it while the feelings behind them still burn?
Welcome back. You got a little wet during that last battle, didn't you? Best change your clothes before you catch cold. Here, give me your hand.
The commission team has returned. I'll escort them back to port.
We must be ready for our next battle.
Fear me! Then, follow my lead!
What a wonderful, heart-warming victory.
It doesn't matter if I fall, as long as my comrades make it out!
Can you take the heat?!
Ugh! I must... withstand this!
Perhaps I must discipline you as Chapayev would.
The port is chilly at night. You must have some reason for being here at this hour. Would you be willing to share why?
Fancy meeting you here again. Aren't you cold? I don't just mean your body; I want your heart and mind to be warm and healthy evermore... Heehee.
There, there. You can go back to being the Commander everyone leans on tomorrow. Until then... You may stay here with me.

Isn't the moon beautiful tonight? You know... I only feel this heartwarming sensation when I'm with you. You've shared your worries and vulnerabilities with me... I don't want to take my eyes off of you. Heehee, but don't turn to me; keep your eyes fixed on the moon for just a while longer.
Take this to heart, Commander. If humanity ever betrays you, do not be saddened or angered. I will stay by your side and keep you warm until the snow stops and the sky is clear.
You didn't have to put yourself out for me... Thank you.
Chapayev, I'll take the lead!

ex.line: Phew... Commander? Did you turn the AC on? Th-thank you...
Ouch! Sorry for making you wrap these bandages for me... Don't worry about me. It's better if we go all-out during these exercises. I'm used to this, anyway.
Is something on your mind? I could... Oh. You say you're just daydreaming? I see... *sigh*
Back straight! Fix that posture! Head up! Heehee, there! Now this feels more like an outing.
*blows*... Ack! I forgot to move the tea out of the thermos... O-oh, ignore me! I don't burn that easily, I swear, haha...
I'm fine... Oh, that's not why you're touching me? H-heheh... My mistake.
Is this a distress signal from our poor, dependable Commander? Heehee~!
Your hands are so warm, Commander...
This is a rather paltry reward... Perhaps I should look into this?
Commander, over here! You're finally back. Come enjoy some piping-hot borscht.
The Commander is watching! All shipgirls, with me!
Such a passionate celebration. It's beyond warm—why, I'd call it downright fiery! Heehee.
...We mustn't retreat! Ours is the final line of defense!
Solving your problems and warming your bed are both my responsibilities... Haha! I'm kidding. I do it all because I want to, after all. Oh? That's not what you expected the punchline to be? Well...

lines.line: ...Thus marks the end of this tune. The Dragon Empery has graciously allowed me to perform in their Spring Festival celebration. Are you here to listen, Commander? In that case... How did you like the song? Heehee.

...Thus marks the end of this tune. The Dragon Empery has graciously allowed me to perform in their Spring Festival celebration. Are you here to listen, Commander? In that case... How did you like the song? Heehee.
Though they say spring has come, the wintry wind has not yet left. Be careful you don't catch a cold, okay?
Oh, you're curious about my bandages? I hit my head while I was decorating... Sorry to worry you.
The subtle serenity of life as winter, the radiant merriment of fellowship as spring... The Dragon Empery's music is so delightfully expressive.
Are you lost, Miyuki? Don't worry; we'll see you home to your dorm, isn't that right, dear Commander?
Today, we forget the fighting and savor song and music instead. Commander, you should try and relax, too.
Speak up if you have any requests, okay? Heehee!
No touching allowed, Commander.
Why not kick back and enjoy the music? There's no need to overwork yourself today.
Tighten up! This is a battlefield!
I'm glad this victory was worthy of celebration.

Can't sleep, hm? Have some warm milk and put on classical music, and I'm sure you'll drift right off. Today is a day to be with family, so why don't I stay here with you until you're sound asleep? Heehee♪
Commander... You smell like rain. Let me warm you. The bandage? It's a part of the service. Take a guess as to how it's used... Heehee.
Commander... You smell like rain. Let me warm you. The bandage? It's a part of the service. Take a guess as to how it's used... Heehee.
Welcome back, Commander. Let your humble Kuybyshev wash away the day's fatigue for you.
This outfit really catches the eye, doesn't it? If it's managed to surprise or relax you, then I'm happy.
What do you want to start with? Snacks? Music? Or perhaps you'd like to inspect my "injuries" first?
You look a little tired, Commander. Make yourself at home and I'll read a story for you. Or I could simply quietly keep you company for a while - that's fine by me.
Are you comforting me? I should be the one doing that to you...
Commander, if you're wondering... this bandage is just decorative. Not sure why you're so curious about it...
Mmh... This part of me is unscathed. Or... are you looking for some other kind of "injury"?
Commander, it looks like you have some unfinished missions.
Nice work on completing that mission. Now you can focus entirely on receiving my care. Heehee.
Heheh. You're back safely. These wounds of mine are unimportant. Your and everyone else's well-being matters more.
I suppose... this will let me shoulder more of your burdens.
While it's true this outfit may just be a part of the set dressing, my desire to be embraced by you is completely genuine. Heehee. Do you want to prove it, Commander?
Colossus-class light carrier - Theseus.

Colossus-class light aircraft carrier Theseus, at your service. Sadly, I just barely missed my chance to fight in the war, but that's okay. Much like my namesake's ship, nothing will change who I am now.
I am Theseus, Colossus-class light aircraft carrier. Well met, Shepherd of the Fleet. If you ever need someone to carry out combat, housework, or an incantation, just call my name.
Good morning, Guardian Knight of the Port. Hope you slept well. You can call on us anytime if you need a word.
I spy with my little eye a naughty cat who's snuck into my room to snoop around for secrets... Got you! Hm? No, Commander, this the creature in question - not you.
Hi there, Unicorn. Do you mind if I take little Yuni on a tour de dessert again? ...Huh? What is it? Did I say something odd?
All this work piling up reminds me of herbs brewing in a cauldron... Eyes open, Commander. I'll have this done in a flash.
They say to strike while the iron is hot, but I'd say strike even if it's not. What I'm driving at is: let's take a break and clean the office, shall we?
I'm here and listening if you need someone to talk to♪
Whoa! What's gotten into you?
Ah, missions... Got it. Shall we do them together, Commander?
Heehee. These are more rewards than you can shake a stick at. How lovely.
Oh, this letter is addressed to you. I just assumed it was for me, since it arrived by homing pigeon.
Splendid work, our Eagle of Victory. Before you go reflect on your performance, shouldn't we celebrate this triumph first?
The commission team's come back. Do you know what comes next, Commander?
Eyes open for my newfound strength!
The battle is on. Everyone, stick close to me!
How'd I do? Did I successfully realise the plan you had in mind, Commander?
Well, we lost... Commander, let's retreat for now and have another go later.
Eyes open for my might! Taaake THIS!
I will not... succumb so easily!
Don't cross that delicate line, Villainous Fiend - or else I'll do everyone a favour and eradicate you.
Funny our paths should cross here, Commander. Were you looking for me, perchance? Heehee, you're like a doggy, sniffing around in search of its friends♪
Care to join me? The woods are the perfect place for a tea party... Picnic? Hmm, I suppose it is more like a picnic, now that you say that...
How's your evening, our Champion? Not too much work? Not feeling burnt out? Heehee. Do give me a call if you need anything. I'll do everything I can, and still consider the things I can't do.
Eyes open for my marvellous... Heehee, oh, it's nothing important. I simply used an incantation that tells me whenever you're in a spot. Saves you the effort of having to tell me. Convenient, no?
I understand. You've given me the ring, but aren't sure how to profess your love. I'll do the honour, just... Oh, you worked up the courage? W-well, that's good! Heehee. Did I do a good job?
Wow! A gift from my Champion! ...My eyes are wide open~♪

ex.line: Good morning, my Honourable Knight. May luck be on our side today. Heehee.
Ah yes, there's the black cat, hell-bent as always on spying on me... Heehee. Don't be alarmed, Commander. You are always welcome to my room.
Hey, Perseus! Are you in the mood for another tea party with Unicorn? Those biscuits we had last time were simply divine!
Office is all tidied up and I've struck upon the solution to our next task. It's time to... Wait! First, I have to brew some tea for you, Commander!
A swim in the river in the woods? Sounds good! I'll pack my tea set, biscuits, and... Hang on. This sounds an awful lot like a picnic to me...
Need something? Heehee, that's my cue. Eyes open, now!
There, there. You're my sunshine, Commander.
Welcome back, our Seagull of Victory. You've fought admirably. Do you want a pat on the head? Or should I recite an incantation that'll take you straight to dreamland?
The commission team is back in port. I'm going make like a Sakura cat and beckon them to... I've got it wrong?
Eyes open for my - and the Commander's - prowess!
Victory is ours. Hehe, so, do you have any praise for me, my brave lion of a Commander?

Oh, something on your mind, Commander? Heehee. I don't reckon you need an incantation. You're here for the sole purpose of seeing me, isn't that right? Missing me is still a problem, and I know when you have one of those.

lines.line: Steaming hot manjuu buns, ready to be served! Let us have a big feast then gather rosebuds, Commander. Oh, a "holiday gathering" doesn't involve literal gathering?
Steaming hot manjuu buns, ready to be served! Let us have a big feast then gather rosebuds, Commander. Oh, a "holiday gathering" doesn't involve literal gathering?
Like the saying goes, the early bird catches the worm. We'd better get a move on before people snatch up all the food, Commander.
Eyes open for my catering skills, Commander! Oh, shoot, this is actually tough to balance... Maybe this is best left to the professional Royal Maids.
Gosh, there are so many restaurants. Makes you want to check them all out, doesn't it, Commander?
You're meant to have yum cha tea with these manjuus? Sounds questionable... These buns are a far cry from biscuits at a tea party.
Unicorn, you and I have... quite different outfits. See, this is an Empery-style dress. The wings make me look a bit like a swan. Heehee.
Oh wow... *blushes*
The commission team is back. I have some carp ornaments on hand, so... Yeah, let's go hand out some gifts!
Seaplane carrier - Hwah Jah.

I am a seaplane tender of the Dragon Empery, just like Chen Hai. Unfortunately, my treasured blade was never completed, and I was condemned to a life of mediocrity... But let's not dwell on my dark past. Commander, didn't you promise that the two of us would find lots of fun things to do?

Commander, it is an honor to meet you. I am Hwah Jah of the Dragon Empery. Now that it's just the two of us here, I'll get straight to the point - Ahem... Is there, um... anything, y'know, super exciting or fun going on around these parts?
Commander, are you still working? ...C'mon, let's play hooky. A little bit of fun won't kill you~
That reminds me, a while ago, I raised my hand to try to join one of the Eagle Union girls' parties, but they all looked at me like I was crazy... Is there anything wrong with that?
Commander, how do you normally reward yourself? Maybe binge out on a sumptuous meal? Or stay up late playing around? As for me, I... Err, I just wanted a point of reference, yeah!
Be courteous to others so that they will listen to you respectfully. As for those unwilling to give you that respect, there are always more "direct" methods you can employ~
Mapo tofu? There are hundreds of ways of preparing tofu, and there's no rule saying it has to be spicy. Besides, I'm not great with spicy food...
Commander? Is this my reward for being a good girl? Heheheh...
Meh, don't sweat it. Even if I slack off right now, nobody's gonna find out.
So basically, I'm allowed to exercise self-defense now, right?
I've heard that some missions can be quite fun. Commander, mind if I tag along next time?
Mission complete. So, does that mean I can shoot the breeze for a while?
New mail's in. Come to think of it, Commander, don't you get invited to all sorts of events? Think you can bring me along next time?
Hmm? Commander, what were you doing just now? Don't tell me you were off partying behind my back... Heehee, just kidding~
The friends from the commission fleet are back. Wanna throw a little party for them?
I won't let you down, Commander. Not after the goodwill you've shown me.
In other words, we can go all-out now, right?
Heh. The character "Jah" in my name symbolizes number one. Quite apropos if I must say so myself.
I'll remember this humiliation... and pay it back twofold!
If you won't listen to reason, then you can talk to my fist!
Ugh, I let my guard down...
No matter what happens, life must continue on. Just let it go...

People are always gonna be hesitant to let someone barge into their group, no matter how cordial you try to be. Luckily, I know someone who can help me make some inroads with the folks here. Isn't that right, Commander? Help a buddy out, won'tcha?

So, not too long ago, I went to a haunted house with my friends for the first time. Pretty cool and all, but the best part was seeing the looks of panic on everyone's faces. Tell me, Commander, are ya 'fraid of ghosts?

After hanging out with my buddies for a while, I've come to realize that it's pretty hard to stand out from the crowd... But, maybe there's some way of getting a head start- Hmm? Oh, I was just talking to myself, so don't worry too much about it. By the way, Commander, you interested in what the girls have been saying about you lately?

After knowing me for so long, you should already be aware that I'm not actually that well-behaved. As for the reason why... That'd be your fault, Commander. Aren't you the one who introduced me to so many ways of "acting up?" Heehee~ In other words, I'll need you to take responsibility~

I don't expect to occupy the front and foremost spot in your heart; but seeing as how the two of us have exchanged vows, I will be very, very angry should you run around and desert me. So angry, in fact, that I have no idea what I might do. Heehee. But, it's simple, really. Just be good to me, Commander~
I'll always remember this kindness.
Would you please teach me how to use a seaplane?

ex.line: There's not a whole lot of stuff to get through today, Commander. Why don't we come up with some plans for what we can do afterwards?
Thwap. ...Oh, I didn't need anything from you. I just felt like giving you a good smack over the head with a fan for no reason. Heehee, no harm no foul, right?
Whoa. That one got my heart racing~♪
So I was thinking... If you aren't busy, how about we head out and have some fun with our friends~♪
Ooh? Commander, you're gutsier than I gave you credit for.
By any chance, were you flirting with other girls while you were out? ...Heehee, I was just messing with you. I wanted to see how you'd react, that's all~♪
Thanks to you, Commander, I'm able to go all-out.
Credit for the greatest contribution should belong to you, Commander.

lines.line: I am Hwah Jah, now in zombie form. It is an honor to see you- hmm? What's wrong, Commander? Everyone else is getting dressed up for the occasion, so I figured I'd get in on the action too... Is there something wrong with that?

I am Hwah Jah, now in zombie form. It is an honor to see you- hmm? What's wrong, Commander? Everyone else is getting dressed up for the occasion, so I figured I'd get in on the action too... Is there something wrong with that?
You're back? Let's go find our other friends and see if they're up to anything interesting.
Hmm? You think this outfit's a bit too revealing? Weird. I thought it's pretty in line with what everyone else is wearing... Besides, what's wrong with standing out a little?
The mandarin duck hotpot, as its name implies, is a special hotpot for couples... Just kidding. Actually, this partition is just to accommodate people's different tastes.
Hmm? Hai Tien made an incredibly spicy baozi? I sure hope she marked it properly...
The jiangshi in the movies all hop around due to the whole rigor mortis thing. So, it's kinda like this... hip, hop. Err, umm... this feels a little inappropriate.
I'm not actually dead, y'know, so I can't just make my hands turn ice-cold.
You're gonna be cursed if you remove the seal...
Boo! ...Guess I couldn't spook you at all, Commander. Maybe I should take a page from Fu Shun's playbook next time and bring a flashlight...

Oh, Commander. I'm just doing some last-minute tidying up before the trip. By the way, I've never shown you this lacquered jewelry box, have I? It's one of my most prized possessions. Go on and take a look. Shall we go on a deep dive into its many wonders together?

Oh, Commander. I'm just doing some last-minute tidying up before the trip. By the way, I've never shown you this lacquered jewelry box, have I? It's one of my most prized possessions. Go on and take a look. Shall we go on a deep dive into its many wonders together?

You've got a sharp eye, Commander - you noticed my treasure in no time. It took over a hundred polishings and the addition of powdered shells and gold leaf to bring out such refined, understated luster.
The true beauty of lacquerware lies in the time and care it takes to bring forth its captivating sheen... It's a lot like human relationships, don't you think?
"Though I've scored a thousand trees in pursuit of lacquer, my jar has yet to fill." Collecting lacquer demands great effort - we must cherish each and every artisanal piece.
Do I look excited for our next trip? That's because I am! You and I might just discover the perfect view for my next lacquerware piece, after all!
Whoa... You're even more mischievous than me, Commander~
Come and feel the texture of this lacquerware for yourself. I think you'll love it♪
Hyah... Try not to jostle the table, okay?
I'm wondering what accessory would go best with this outfit. Do you have any suggestions for me, Commander?
Lacquerware cradles pearls and jade just as the courtyard cradles the splendor of spring. Similarly, I made space in my heart for a one-of-a-kind treasure... I mean you, of course.

As you can see, Commander, I've completed my retrofitting. So, umm, are you surprised by my new appearance? Don't worry, though. I'll always be the same Hwah Jah you know and love~ Though, if I had to pick something different about myself... I might be a bit more open towards some fun and exciting things~♪

As you can see, Commander, I've completed my retrofitting. So, umm, are you surprised by my new appearance? Don't worry, though. I'll always be the same Hwah Jah you know and love~ Though, if I had to pick something different about myself... I might be a bit more open towards some fun and exciting things~♪
Commander, I know your job is important and all, but like, can we please do something a bit more fun and exciting?

Oh, right! So, I've recently discovered the joys of throwing house parties. I get to bounce all kinds of crazy ideas and opinions off with everyone else, and it's created a brand-new explosion of possibilities~♪

Oh, Commander! If I ever get the opportunity to open a teahouse, I'd like to incorporate some elements of street performance, like fire jugglers! Wouldn't that be a great way to attract customers? Huh... you think that'd spoil the entire atmosphere?

I still believe in treating others with courtesy and speaking with sincerity, just as always. However, I think I can be a bit more "persuasive" now towards those who don't want to sit down and have a civil discussion~
Ultra-spicy hotpot? Haha... Sure, I did say I'm more receptive to new experiences than before, but... I'm afraid I'll have to pass on that one...
Oh my... Does this mean I've been an extra good girl recently? Heehee, just kidding~
Hmm? Wanna head outside and shoot the breeze?
Um... Are you testing how "open" I'm willing to be?
Got something fun and exciting for me to do? Lemme give you a hand, just as always~♪
Hmm? All done with work? Heehee. In that case, if you have nothing else scheduled, how about letting me suggest something?
New mail? Hopefully we get an invitation to do something fun and exciting, rather than the usual boring administrative stuff. Wanna go through it together, Commander?
Finally back, Commander? So, I found a fun-looking place that seems pretty promising... If you're not too busy, wanna come with? I think we could both go for a change of pace, right?
The commission team's back? Perfect, I've just finished preparing their thank-you presents. Pretty awesome timing on my part, huh?

I might have changed in certain regards, but you like me this way as well, right? Heehee. After all, this is what I've picked up from following your "guidance"~♪ Now then, I hope you'll continue to take on the responsibility of looking after me in the future, yes?
Munition ship - Ting An.

I am Ting An of the Dragon Empery's First Fleet. I once served as a seaplane tender before being converted into a transport ship. Outside of that... Oh, I wonder if little Yat Sen is here? I'm sure that girl must've grown a lot since I last saw her. Heehee~

So you're the Commander, yes? I've heard your name whispered far and wide. I am Ting An of the Dragon Empery; may our relationship be a fruitful one. Oh, this mountain of stuff next to me? Just consider it... a little business gift of sorts?
Welcome back, Commander. Heehee, please make the important decisions while you're still clear-headed.
Akashi has a monopoly on this port's commerce, and she seems to have some unscrupulous dealings every now and then. Now, if I could muscle my way into- Hmm? These are the regulations? Boo...
Pay close attention to your checkbook, and remember that a penny saved is a penny earned. Hmm? There are too many people here who always want it all? ...Ahaha, how awfully capricious of them...
Were you planning to upgrade the equipment in your office any time soon? If so, would you mind letting me take care of it? I'll be sure to meet all your needs at the lowest budget.
Commander, have you read today's news? Keeping your eyes out for the latest developments puts you in a prime position to capitalize on opportunities of all sorts, in business and battle alike.
What about my outfit? Oh, hmm... I suppose they are rather breezy...
Jeez... If you keep this up, I won't give you any more advice...
Commander, you've got a new mission. I suppose this is a "primitive" form of capital acquisition...?
The mission rewards have arrived. Heehee, now how should we use them to turn a greater profit?
Your mail's here, Commander. The contents might seem useless, but you never know where business opportunities lay hidden.
Well done on your sortie. During your absence, I took it upon myself to seek out the items in need of restocking discussed earlier... Please take a look at the details here.
A commission has been completed. It seems we've gotten some equipment in addition to the regular awards. Hmm, let me appraise it to see how much it's worth...
I will not let the Commander's "investment" go to waste.
Fight to your heart's content. I shall watch your backs, everyone.
Another sailing route made safe. Hmm... maybe I can use this opportunity to establish a new trade route...?
Hmm... I must say, these losses are rather severe...
It's time to close up shop!
Hmm... With this, I might have to consider some higher-risk options...
As the old saying goes, time reveals the character of one's true heart. No matter how well you wear your disguise, you will be seen through sooner or later.
Woah... Commander, you have decorations from every corner of the world in your office... Were they all gifts from your friends around the port? Heehee, you must be quite the charmer~
Are any of your friends interested in some of the Dragon Empery's collectibles? If so, I'd appreciate it if you could introduce them to me~♪

This is my present to you, as thanks for helping me out a while ago. Go ahead and take it - there's no need to be polite. It's not like I'm planning anything in particular; I just wanted to return the favor, that's all. Everything here is pretty mundane stuff helpful in your daily work, so there's nothing for you to worry about.

Once the war is over, I want to open a little shop and sell antiques and paintings. Heehee, by combining my sharp business senses with your connections, we should be able to live pretty laid-back lives. How does that pitch sound to you, Commander?

When it comes to relationships, you can't deal in profits and losses, or expect returns on your investments. I'm sure you thought carefully before deciding to give this to me... Yes, I understand. And my answer to you is, I accept. Allow me to repay your feelings with my eternal devotion~♡
You have a discerning eye. Heheh, I'll gladly accept it.
Don't worry. We're all with you now.

ex.line: How are you feeling, Commander? If there are no problems, let's get started with today's work.
Old-fashioned decorations accentuate your refinement, whereas modern decorations attest to your good taste. Combining the two appropriately can leave a good impression on those who visit, Commander.
This article is... 'The Commander's Preference on Secretary Ship Selection'... It seems that one of your friends wrote it. Heehee, how intriguing.
Commander, right now... might not be the best time for that.
Oh, do you remember the statement I gave you earlier? Some new ideas suddenly dawned upon me... Since nothing has been implemented yet, shall we give it another pass?

lines.line: I see, so this is how you're supposed to knead dough... Hmm? Commander? As you can see, I'm currently trying to make baozi. Would you like to help out?
I see, so this is how you're supposed to knead dough... Hmm? Commander? As you can see, I'm currently trying to make baozi. Would you like to help out?
*pant* *pant*... Phew. I didn't know that kneading dough took so much physical endurance... Urgh, I'm all sweaty now...
Why does this store have to make dough from scratch instead of using premade wrappers? ...Why is this sort of commitment necessary...?
For the last step, I had Ning Hai and Ping Hai steam the baozi. Though I did learn a few things from watching them, the amount of heat and length of cooking time still seem hard to master...
Hai Tien said she wanted some baozi stuffed entirely with chilies... But if Hwah Jah were to get her hands on one, I'm sure that scene would be a total disaster...
