Oh right, I heard that some Dragon Empery antiques arrived at Akashi's shop. If you're worried about buying counterfeits, I can come with you.
Commander, do you also know how to make these? Wow... You really know how to do everything...
Ugh, now there's flour all over me...
Welcome back. Take these presents as a token of my appreciation for helping me out. Please, I don't want to feel like I'm always in your debt.

Umm... Alright, time to take a photo in the on-set mirror and send it to Commander... And there. Just as Commander said, it'd be disastrous if my new swimsuit's design were to get leaked... B-but if I don't do this, our plans will totally be ruined!

Umm... Alright, time to take a photo in the on-set mirror and send it to Commander... And there. Just as Commander said, it'd be disastrous if my new swimsuit's design were to get leaked... B-but if I don't do this, our plans will totally be ruined!
*pant*... It's not that far, but just walking has me exhausted... Is it because I was putting so much effort into staying undercover?

*sigh*... To win a share in the swimsuit market, you need to do more than just come up with the perfect design and cost. You also have to try them on yourself and experience real use-case situations to suit customers' needs... I-isn't that right, Commander?
Don't worry, Commander. Everyone else should be asleep right now, and the girls on patrol won't notice us... right? Eep...!
(The Commander and I are just doing market research... Yeah! It's necessary for business! Surely I'm not awakening to something and getting pleasure out of this... Surely!)
C-Commander? If you're cold, we could huddle under my coat? I'm also a little... Achoo!
Sh-should we snap another pic?
*pant*... Commander, if we make any noise, someone will... Hyah?!
When you complete missions, everyone doing business at the port profits. We appreciate all you do.
Mission complete! Where should I invest next...?
Good work, Commander! Ahaha, isn't it hard to go out without anyone noticing? If not for this convenient room, I doubt we'd even be able to meet up like this... Phew.
I think the commission team is back. Commander, umm, try not to take too long when you go... *pant*...
Urk... I need to be careful!
We won! Oh, maybe I should show off this new swimsuit at the victory party!
*pant*... It's really hard to fight without blowing my cover...

After we check things out here, where will we go next? ...You'll show me around all the rides? Hmm, that does sound like a good rehearsal for when I wear this swimsuit around you again... Ah... N-no, I promise, I'll do my best!
Implacable-class aircraft carrier - Implacable.

I was made as an improvement to the Illustrious class. Sadly, like many late arrivals to the war, my name is only an insignificant footnote in the chronicles of victory. Be that as it may... have you started thinking about how you're going to "use" me, Commander?

A most blessed meeting, Commander. I am Implacable, Royal Navy armoured carrier. There's no need to be in such a hurry to tell me about yourself. Your past, your future; your mind, and your body - heehee, shall all be revealed to me in due time. So, let's get to know each other, slowly but surely, little by little.
May blessings find their way to you, Commander. Through who? Yes, who indeed.
Tea parties with the Illustrious sisters are fun... until it's my turn to brew tea. Do you know how this suppressed yearning feels, Commander?
Why the long face? Concerned about your friends at sea, or simply stressed over work? Don't bottle up your feelings - let it all out.
Tell me, among the four Illustrious sisters, whose tea is your favourite? ...Ah, you want to know mine? Hmm... I'd say it's the robust Assam.
Showing neither mercy nor pity, never being appeased, stopping for nothing - that's what it means to be implacable. Perhaps you'd like to test me, Commander?
Trouble concentrating, Commander? Let's get you back on track with a rousing distraction. Go on, take a look~♥
Brain fog, you say? I may have just the cure - Royal Navy cuisine, enhanced with tongue-sizzling spice. Care for a taste?
Excuse me? Do you want the same done to you? Heehee♥
People have many reasons for pursuing physical contact. What's yours, Commander?
Say, Commander... Are you just playing around, or are you being a sinful little thing? Heehee~♥
Are you tired of performing your neverending duty? Heehee. Here I thought you enjoyed it, considering how unswerving your commitment is.
A mission's been completed, has it? Heehee. May this bounty bring you joy one doesn't find every day.
There's a letter for you. Remember, people have high hopes for you, and you're not one to disappoint.
Oh, welcome back... The stuff in your cup looks off? You mean the tea I brewed for you? Why?
The commission team has come back. You arriving on scene quickly to thank them is the best reward they could ask for.
A blessing, straight from you? Heehee. Allow me to give you my own blessings~
In Her Majesty's name, I shall vanquish the wrongdoers.
We should celebrate this triumph. After all, Lady Luck only lifts the hem of her dress to those who'll look♪
This defeat is like a stain on a white veil... Tiny, yet vexing.
Think you can stop me?
Heehee. I'll get you for this.
Surrender to darkness if you wish, but where should those who see you as their light go?

My name suggests I'm vindictive: unwilling to offer mercy or compassion. In truth, I simply believe in my loyalties and convictions. As someone with great responsibility, surely you agree it's best not to fixate on the little things.

What I desire is more than a mere symbol of victory - I crave someone who will answer my thoughts, sentiments, desires, and expectations. In other words... Indeed, if you do not know how to do so, why not try listening to my every word from now on? Heehee~♥

Strong sentiments - be they faith or lust - do not necessarily lead to sin. There's no fun in being a slave to your conscience. If I were to offer myself to you, no strings attached whatsoever, gladly accepting is the right thing to do.

Love arises from the human's primordial desire for companionship. Once someone beckons you, it only makes sense to cast aside your doubts, and indulge in that sweet, succulent euphoria... Heehee. Yet, you seem to have difficulty accepting this. Deny yourself all you want. Seeing how long you can fight your urges is fun in its own way.

You still deny yourself? Heehee, I understand. The shackles of inhibition are hard to break. Just close your eyes, relax, and empty your mind as I've taught you. I'm going to give you a mark of pleasure that will never go away♥
What a magnanimous gesture this is... it makes me wonder if there isn't some ulterior motive? Heehee. An offering is made when one seeks to have a desire fulfilled. There's no shame in it~♪
How's your day, my prim and proper sisters?

ex.line: While there are many who'll give their all for you, I'm the only one who can answer your prayers at the moment. Heehee♥
If you're bored, we can go look if the canteen's offering anything new. Let's also pop down to the shop and see what's on sale. Heehee. If you want to kill time, might as well do it with me, right?
You're grimacing again... Fine. Come here and lie down. I'll help you let out all those woes and pent-up stress.
Idols, hmm? I suppose Illustrious and the rest have what it takes. I'd also say that you're like the entire fleet's idol, Commander. Heehee♥
I don't mind if you're biased or pick favourites, just don't look away when we're all to ourselves. If you do... Well, I'll put a curse on you. Heehee♥
Virtuous people losing their way, heroes giving in to corruption... Those who've grown bored of conventional stories find a guilty pleasure in such things.
While Illustrious is a great teacher during exercises, Indomitable seems hellbent on always cutting corners... Maybe they bore her and all she wants is to go home and chat over tea. Heehee.
My prayers are with you, Commander. Now... and forever.
Will you say the words, or do you want me to do it? Heehee♪
You wouldn't hesitate on the battlefield, would you? Go on, show me how brave you are♥
Say... Isn't there even a chance you'll drink my tea? You could at least pretend to sip it to let me feel good about myself.
On the Commander's name, I shall smite all who stand in our way.
I dedicate this victory to you, my beloved Commander.

It's wrong to pray only for you and nobody else. However, you're the very person who pushed me in this direction. It is your mistake - do you know what you must do to rectify it? Yes, you do. You have to throw reason to the wayside and let your throbbing... heart take over. Heehee~♥

lines.line: Oh my... It seems I've shown you a rather unseemly side of me. Would you help me clean up here, Commander? You know... before any of the other girls find out. Heehee~♥
Oh my... It seems I've shown you a rather unseemly side of me. Would you help me clean up here, Commander? You know... before any of the other girls find out. Heehee~♥
You will surely have a blessed day. Why? Because I'm attracting all the bad luck♪
Would you rather be a teacher or a pupil, Commander? Imagine being the pupil everyone looks up to, but you have naughty thoughts about your teacher... What a stimulating scenario that would be~♥
Gosh, I'm soaked... What a pain. Should I go get changed after all?
As it turns out, the cafeteria's "ultra spicy" meal isn't very spicy at all. Maybe I'll make note of that on the next school survey.
I assume you've already given some thought to how to deal with "eccentric" pupils? Heehee. I'm interested to see how you "educate" those who step out of line♥
Oh my, are you trying to take advantage of me when I'm vulnerable~?
My button's come undone? Heehee, thanks. So, Commander... What are you really getting at here?
You've been waiting for this chance to make your move, haven't you? Heehee♥
Commander, have you seen the tea I made earlier? No? Maybe a Royal Maid mistook it for something dubious and poured it down the sink...
The supplies seem to have arrived. Hmm... Surely you don't plan on making poor little me fetch them?
It's time to see the results of your studies. Don't let me down♪
Nothing makes a teacher happier than seeing her pupils get good results♪
Ugh... Sorry, I should've been more diligent.
I see that passionate look in your eyes... Do you crave this fine wine, or is there something more intoxicating you'd like to indulge in?
I see that passionate look in your eyes... Do you crave this fine wine, or is there something more intoxicating you'd like to indulge in?
Such a fine drink... is my blessing for you. May I propose a toast to our union?
Oh, my... I spilled it. I'm such a mess now♥ Commander, can you clean me up?
This hairpin is all the rage in the Dragon Empery. Does this different side of me awaken anything in you? Heehee.
Your eyes look a little hazy. Are you drunk already? I made tea to help us sober up... Hmm? Wait, you sobered up already?
Mm... Phew. Wine tastes better when you drink from here, doesn't it? Heehee.
Mm... Do I smell like wine now?
Mmnh... I'm starting to go numb... Oh, you'll relieve it for me? Well, I hope you'll take good care of me♥
You look awfully tired... Why don't you come lean on me? I bet you I'm softer than any pillow.
It's all empty... Well, the night has only just begun. Instead of sharing empty words, let me help you release that pent-up fatigue with my own hands, okay?
R-class battleship - Royal Oak.

Introduce myself again? Okay... Umm, my name is Royal Oak, and I'm a Revenge-class battleship from the Royal Navy. I was able to accomplish something in the Battle of Jutland, but I ended up getting badly damaged after... I just hope I can escape my bad luck here at this port.
I am Royal Oak, battleship under the Royal Navy. It's an honour, Lord Commander... I hope to overcome my weaknesses and pull my weight here, so... I-I'll be counting on you...
Hyah! Sorry, I wasn't standing behind the door on purpose... Umm, I'm okay, okay? You don't have to worry or apologize...
I was watching the girls perform a training exercise, and a stray training round hit me... N-no, I'm not injured, but... It really hurt...
Excuse me, Lord Commander! Oh, I didn't mean to interrupt... Umm... I'm not a fan of such quiet places. They make me remember painful things...
Lord Commander, don't stray training rounds come at you when you leave the window open...?
I at least have to see these documents delivered... Yes, I'll do my best to be back as soon as possible!
Ack! D-don't touch me out of nowhere, or you'll scare me...
Eeeeek! *pant* *pant*... P-please, no more!
Lord Commander, you might want to finish those missions soon...
Thank goodness... Back home safe from another mission. Ah, Lord Commander, I hope I wasn't holding you back!
Ah... There it is! Who in the world folded the mail into a paper airplane?
Lord Commander, thank you for your efforts. Is there anything I can help you with? ...Anything is fine, really...
The commission team is back. Would you mind if I went with you to greet them? I'm a bit of a slow walker, but...
"The Mighty Oak." Do you think I can live up to that...?
P-please don't charge ahead so fast...
Phew. I managed to do my job... right?
Why is this happening? I tried so hard...
Don't hate me for this!
Why does this keep happening to me...?
I just know you turned out this way because I was holding you back, Lord Commander...
I'm among the most senior Royal Knights, but I can't lead anyone. Heck, it takes all I have just to keep up... This fleet doesn't need a shipgirl like me.
I think my speed should be enough for patrol work from now on. Okay, I hope this next one goes safely... Please, please don't let me run into any submarines!
Oh, my... Was I really so helpful, Lord Commander? The old me would never have believed that... Umm... P-please let me handle even more missions!

Not only did you not abandon me, but you've been considerate and even given me confidence in myself... S-say! If it's alright with you, could you teach me about more than just fighting and working...?

I-is this real? I'm not dreaming... Lord Commander, you'd really give me something this valuable? Of course, I've always hoped that I could have this honour someday, and I'm as happy as can be! Umm, anyway, I happily accept!
Thank you! I shall treasure this with the greatest respect!
D-d-don't come any closer!
Royal Knights, charge!

ex.line: It is good to see your safe return, Lord Commander. Erm... You don't have to be so considerate when you're just opening the door.
Lord Commander, has a training round ever come your way during an exercise? I see... Knowing that it's happened to you is a bit of a relief... I-I promise I'm not teasing you!
Revenge, w-wait! Geez... She left before I could tell her where those papers were going. What do I do now?
When I'm with you, Lord Commander, I feel like I don't have to worry about stray bullets... Uh, that was just an example! I promise I'm not trying to use you as a human shield!
D-d-do you need something? I'll do everything in my power to tackle whatever problem needs solving!
If this is something I can do for you, Lord Commander... *blushes*
I'll do my best to keep up with everyone...!
I-I can fight if I put my mind to it!

lines.line: Commander? Oh, what a coincidence... Were you slacking- err, I mean, taking a break, too? I can make some room for you if you'd like?
Commander? Oh, what a coincidence... Were you slacking- err, I mean, taking a break, too? I can make some room for you if you'd like?
Lord Commander, there's no teacher or hall monitor behind me, is there? Phew... Good.
P.E. is a nightmare. I don't want to drag my friends down in the relay race, and I don't want random baseballs hitting me... I wish there was some way to skip it.
I'm not the worst at classroom learning. If there's anything you don't understand, I-I could help...?
If you want to pass the time, how about reading? For some reason, there are lots of confiscated novels and manga here...
By the way, how does Her Majesty normally spend time at school? Huh? She's actually bad at P.E. just like me?
The others might realize something's up if we go back now...
I-if a hall monitor sees this, everyone will know!
Lord Commander, you don't need to fret over me. Though I am happy to have you here with me...
Light aircraft carrier - Argus.

"Know me as Argus, oldest carrier in the world. With the glory and tradition of the Royal Navy at my back, I come to you to lead the next generation of heroes"... I could never say something that grand with a straight face. I'm... looking forward to working with you, okay?

"Know me as the Royal Navy's own Argus, bearer of a hundred all-seeing eyes, the primordial standard aircraft carrier and first to possess a full-length flight deck." W-will that do...? Sorry. As you can tell, I'm no good at introductions...
Shall we get to work, Commander? It's getting late. I don't think we should wait any longer...
"You may enter. Come, and witness the glorious history and tradition of Argus"... I-I mean... If you don't mind...
"Fall before the might of my ancient, glorious power"... U-umm, could you go a little easier on the office work, please?
Houshou? Oh, thank you for the treats! Are these meant for a tea party? No?
You're going out? Okay, I'll take care of the place—Oh, but if you think you'll be out late, please remember my curfew...
You'll make a new hat for me?
Is this... a lesson?
B-be gentle, please... *blush*
We have word of a mission. Are you sure we shouldn't take a look at it...?
Is the mission complete? Phew... That's great to hear.
A letter's arrived. As for the envelope... Umm, should I just cut it open with scissors?
Phew... Welcome back, Commander. *pant* *pant*... I managed to make it back in time before curfew...
The commission team has returned. Just like carrier-borne craft, you have to welcome the girls back after you've sent them away!
"My rigging, tempered a thousand times over"... I just hope this is enough to help me hold my own in a fight...
Training... Aircraft carrier Argus is present and prepared!
Me, MVP? You're not joking? I can't believe it...
Urgh... Is this my punishment?
Come back safe, please...!
B-but the Royal Navy's tradition and glory...!
Ah! If you don't need anything, I'd best be taking my leave! Phew...
"With the ancient wisdom gathered by sending off countless fledglings, I will lead you, Commander"... May I lead you? If you'll have me, anyway.
You'd like to take me around on your off day? If it's no trouble, then I'll gladly take you up on that offer. Oh... But I'll need you to bring me back to my dorm before curfew...

Thank you for another lovely day, Commander. Oh, it's getting late... I'd best get back to my dorm soon, but I-I'd like to take a walk together, first! I'm sorry... May I ask you to indulge me a little?

Phew... Ehehe, curfew's come and gone already. Say, Commander? What if we kept hanging out together and gazed at the night sky together? There's no point in going back to the Royal Navy dorms, since it's past curfew already.
I swear on the tradition and glory of the Royal Navy that I, aircraft carrier Argus, will always work my hardest for our mutual happiness. Commander... Would you hold my hand, please?
This is... for me? ME?!
I will wield my power as the oldest carrier!

ex.line: Zzzz... Ah! Is it already time for work? Sorry for oversleeping... I was so excited to be your secretary that I stayed up really late...
The outfit I wore during our outing is right over here. I went ahead and ironed it, so there's not a single wrinkle on it! Heheh, maybe I'll wear it again... next time we go out?
Ugh... I hope these numbers are right. I'd be a failure of a secretary if I had to ask Langley and the others for help...
Hood, you're even prettier than usual today. And you, Commander, look even... No, you ARE cooler than ever!
If you're going out, let me go with you! Why? Well... We can call it a date! Teehee!♪
Would you like me to hold your hand and lead the way?
Yes, good. Please dote on me.
Oh, was there correspondence regarding a mission? R-right... Got it!
Welcome back, Commander. You return victorious as promised, I see. Good job! *pat pat* Heehee!
The commission team has returned. Our home is by your side, Commander.
I'll prove that I can fight...!
"My hundred eyes have already foreseen your defeat." And so did the Commander!

lines.line: Yaaawn... Umm, did I doze off again? Oh no... Organising school events gets so hectic I always end up working right up until curfew... Just give me one more minute, please...
Yaaawn... Umm, did I doze off again? Oh no... Organising school events gets so hectic I always end up working right up until curfew... Just give me one more minute, please...
Sorry you had to come and help me, Commander... Umm, so what were today's tasks, again?
Hosting school events is really such a task. I've been so sleep deprived lately... *yaaawn*... No, that's enough yawning. I still have work to do...
Achoo! ...Thank you. Of course sleeping here all the time would lead to me getting a cold. I should be more careful...
There are strange things going on at the haunted mansion? C-Commander, I'm sorry... Would you mind accompanying me?
Implacable! You can play that game at home, but you can't bring it to the festival! What do you mean, why? A-aren't you embarrassed?!
Is it time for the next item on our schedule?
Whawha?!
There are still things to be done before the school festival... Let's begin with these missions.
Welcome back, Commander. We have some time until our next plans, so feel free to take a little break.
Costumes, materials, and printed materials are all done. I've contacted the commission team, as well... Things are really coming together. Phew...
We won! None can rival the Royal Navy's glorious tradition!
"Gaze upon this glorious dress. Admire its brilliance, tremble, and..." If you don't mind, would you please take Argus' hand?
"Gaze upon this glorious dress. Admire its brilliance, tremble, and..." If you don't mind, would you please take Argus' hand?
Does this look right? Let me try spinning around—Hyah?! C-Commander, I'm sorry...
"Take a good look upon the majesty and poise of Argus as she graces the venue." ...I feel much better practicing my bearing with you, Commander. Heehee.
How long will this party go on? If it goes too late, my curfew... N-no, I'm not just trying to go home, I swear!
In fairy tales, girls lose their fancy clothes after midnight... And that means I... Eep... A-Argus, stop thinking such shameful things...
Don't drink too much at the party, now. If you get drunk, how am I going to change clothes? ...You want me to get Hermes and the others to help? G-good idea! Why didn't I think of that?
Am I really wearing it to perfection...? Commander, do you see any issues? Y-you can feel for yourself, if you want...?
B-be gentle, please...
The mission correspondence...? R-right! Now, where did I put it...?
The Commander picked this dress for me, so I need to wear it right... Commander? Welcome back. Did the mission go well...?
The commission girls are back. Why don't we invite them to the party?
I-I'm a little worried about my back...
"This attire will do perfectly for the parade celebrating my triumph." Phew...

"When the honourable and dignified set out to achieve greatness, they must never be ashamed of exposing themselves"... I prepared this swimsuit for special training, and yet... Just putting it on requires... a great deal of courage.

"When the honourable and dignified set out to achieve greatness, they must never be ashamed of exposing themselves"... I prepared this swimsuit for special training, and yet... Just putting it on requires... a great deal of courage.
Commander, I'm still trying to work up the courage to show myself to you... Aaah, this is so embarrassing...
"Behold, the Hundred-Eyed Giant, training in the majesty of a swimsuit" - Aaah... Th-this swimsuit is quite skimpy at the back...
"With the glory and tradition of the Royal Navy at my back, I stand proud, my heart pure..." The sun is so warm on my skin... Ah?! No, I did not come here to sunbathe, of course...!
Aaah... The string on my back is coming loose... It bothers me, but I cannot afford to check...
Commander, once we finish training, could you walk me back to my quarters? I'm worried about curfew...
Mm... When you praise me, I feel as bashful as a little pet... But... Nnn...
T-touch me...one more time... That should make for good training...
I-is this part of my training, too? Mm... Very well... Behold my... resolve...
Welcome back, Commander... Um, I managed to carry out my training... without running away!
Normally, I'd have swooned from shame by now... But knowing I have you with me, Commander, nothing else matters... Don't blame me, no matter how this turns out. Ehehe♪
Dido-class light cruiser - Scylla.

Dido-class anti-aircraft cruiser Scylla, ready to serve. I served as an escort carrier flagship in that war, but I was unable to perform any major exploits. But now... I am only a Royal Maid, here to devote heart and soul to you, Master.

Delighted to meet you, Master. Hopefully it is not too forward of me to greet you in such a manner. I am Scylla, Dido-class light cruiser. Heehee, as you can see, I am nothing more than an ordinary maid.
Welcome home, Master. I got everything ready for you, so all you need to do is sit here... and get right to work!♪
You know, Master, I think only the most outstanding maid should have the right to serve her Master... What do you think?
Is there something you're looking for? I know where everything related to the Royal Maids' work is. Don't hesitate to ask.
I couldn't help but notice that another girl was cleaning your office... Oh, it's fine, Master. But allow me to do it next time; I'm the maid taking care of you right now.
I'm happy to help with whatever you can't or don't want to do. There's nothing wrong with accepting your shortcomings and relying on your maid♪
A reward, for little old me? Heehee, I'm delighted!
Is something the matter? If there's anything I can do for you, please don't hesitate to ask.
A maid must be willing to give her everything to her Master. Please do as you wish.
Do you have unfinished business? That's no good... Allow me to help you, Master♪
Another mission complete. Heehee, I think your exploits are worthy of a medal.
Master, you seem to be forgetting some mail addressed to you. Heehee, you're so forgetful!♪ But it's okay. I happened to bring it with me.
Don't worry about a thing. Everyone is safe at home in the port, and I'm prepared to devote myself to you. So... May I have my orders, Master? Heehee!
A commission has been completed. Master, I hope you aren't forgetting to welcome the team back? ...Good. I'm ready to depart any time.
Your favour is much appreciated, Master.
Trust in your leadership and give the command!
Please accept my sincere congratulations, Master.
So this is how you look when you've been beaten... Heehee♡
Don't try to escape, now.
Do not fret, Master. I swear that I will return to your side.
Don't ever think that I might leave you, Master. It is a maid's duty to care for her master, even if said master happens to be a little... wanting.
Commander, you have a choice: me, or my friend and excellent Royal Maid Charybdis, who comes running whenever you need her? ...Heehee, you don't have to answer that. I just felt like asking.

Is something wrong? Have you perhaps made a mistake, Master? Don't fret. Tell me everything, and let me think about it with you. No matter what, Master, you have our eternal respect as the great Commander♪
You are the Master, and I am your personal maid. Why should there be any secrets between us? Heehee, don't you hide a thing. You want to rely on me more and leave more to me, don't you...?

Heehee. Do you find yourself feeling that you can't do anything without me around? Poor Master. I'll just have to manage your everyday... Oh, I don't mind. I'm the only one who's seen your few shortcomings—your occasional spinelessness, indolence, and indecision. Yet even I still consider you the best Commander and the best Master ever~♡
Have you finally found the determination to leave your everything to me? Heehee, of course I accept. Leave it all to your personal maid Scylla while you drown in my love forever and ever!♡
You're quite the flatterer, Master. Do you treat the other girls the same way?
Shall we fight together?
I won't abandon my Master. Teehee!

ex.line: Welcome home, Master. Do you... need me to tell you what must be done?
Is there something you need me to do for you again? Yes, yes, I'll do it. Just be patient. I suppose... I'm the only person who knows that you can't do this, Master?
Dido is a bit of a problem for me. She never loses things, so she doesn't need me to find things for her. And since she's so capable, she never needs my help.
Master, if you have a lot of lost items, why don't we do a big hunt for all of them? I promise I'll find them all. Heehee, we won't need to trouble anyone else.
The more things you can't do yourself, the more you'll rely on me, and the more I'll get to manage you... I'm pulling your leg. Is that really the sort of life you want, Master?
Let me see your indulgent side, Master♡
Leave everything to your maid Scylla, my poor, adorable Master♡
My, Master. Should I really need to remind you to do such simple missions?
Well done, Master~ Thanks to me, you've managed to complete your missions.
Master, you seem to be forgetting some mail addressed to you. Heehee, don't worry. I'll remind you as many times as it takes.
Don't worry about a thing. Everyone is safe at home in the port. By the way, Master... Is it just me, or do you worry about the others more than you do me?
The Master who brings us victory, the Master who everyone praises, and... the Master only I know. Heehee♡

You're pushing yourself, aren't you? Heehee, don't bother anymore. Leave everything to me now, and let me see more of your pathetic side, Master... Everyone else knows the cool and composed Commander already. The Commander before me... is mine alone~♡

lines.line: Did you come all this way just because I asked you to, Master? Or... would you prefer I call you "Senpai" here? If we're at school, then there's no reason for me to act maidly, now is there? Heeheehee♪

Did you come all this way just because I asked you to, Master? Or... would you prefer I call you "Senpai" here? If we're at school, then there's no reason for me to act maidly, now is there? Heeheehee♪
Welcome home, Master. Rather... "Senpai"? Did you finally remember our little promise?"
I'm your maid, Master, so I'm glad to be used however you see fit. Or do you... want to be "used" yourself, Master? Heehee...
"Senpai," do you need my notes from last class? I wrote all the important points, so it'll be just like you actually listened to the lecture!
Where has Lady Argus gone? Oh, she's in remedial classes for failing grades? Goodness...
We're just two good friends—in school, anyway. But outside this campus... Heehee, shall we call that our little secret?♡
My, Glasgow, were you watching us? You were excited to see what Master's like at school, too, weren't you? Heehee, don't worry. I'll get plenty of pictures for you.
My eyes are up here, "Senpai"~♪
Is this the kind of stimulation you seek? Heehee, you're so naughty~♡
This shameful begging isn't like the "Senpai" everyone relies on, now, is it? But it's okay... Leave this mission to me.
It seems you've finished all of your missions, "Senpai." Good job! You couldn't have done that with my help, right? Heehee!
"Senpai," your phone is ringing. Is that a call from someone? Such as... another girl, perhaps?
What brings you back here? Do you not have it in you to leave me alone? Or... Is there something you want me to do for you?
"Senpai," I'm about to show the other girls that look you had on your face. Are you sure you're ready for that? ...Heehee. Next time, don't forget to greet the commission team upon their return.
Well done, "Senpai." Look, everyone's cheering for you.

There's no point trying to hide it, "Senpai." You're just going to have to give up and... Got you!♪ I could never show another girl how pitiful you look right now. But of course... If you would like the others to see, I would gladly obey♡
Good evening, Master of mine. I hope I didn't make you wait long. Oh? That look on your face... Were you excited to walk on the red carpet with me, arm in arm?
Good evening, Master of mine. I hope I didn't make you wait long. Oh? That look on your face... Were you excited to walk on the red carpet with me, arm in arm?
Greetings, Master. ...You'd like to hold the leash for once? Heehee, the thing you should be holding is not the leash, but my hand♪
I may be acting as your partner instead of your maid at the moment, but I mean to serve you the same either way. We must let everyone know that Scylla sees to your every need♪
Are there any more preparations we need to do before the party? Heehee, I don't mind if not. I'm happy to get you good and ready, Master♪
Did you practice dancing already? Who in the world did you... Oh, don't mind me. From now on, I'd just like you to practice with me and me alone.
Master, your collar's already a mess after so little time apart from me. Allow me... Phew. I think you'd best stay by my side, Master.
The outfit I picked out for you looks lovely on you... Heehee, next time you're not sure what to wear, come see me. Yes, it's perfectly okay to rely on me more, alright?
I'd be delighted to let you take my hand, Master.
Master, is the urge becoming irresistible? Heehee, show me how you really feel♥
Oh? The party is about to begin, and you still have missions left on the table? You're helpless... Allow me to assist you.
The mission is complete, and everyone knows now that you need me by your side. Heehee♥
Hm? A message, at a time like this... Heehee, do you think others are trying to take my role as your partner, Master?
You seem tense. Don't worry... I'll support you seamlessly, so just leave everything to me. Heehee...
Such a wonderful victory is worthy of walking on the red carpet, don't you think, Master?

Outfits, manners... It was none other than I who so perfectly prepared you, Master. You can keep leaving everything to me - and I mean not just preparing for parties, but everything in your day-to-day life as well. Keep relying on me, my dear, beloved, valiant, and pitiful Master♥
Welcome, my dear Master - no, I suppose you're just a traveler at this moment? I'd like to say, "All who pass through here must be judged," but I wouldn't be against simply letting my Master through.
Welcome, my dear Master - no, I suppose you're just a traveler at this moment? I'd like to say, "All who pass through here must be judged," but I wouldn't be against simply letting my Master through.
If you want to receive my judgment, then I'm more than happy to oblige. I'll even do it over and over until you're satisfied with the result... Heehee.
This outfit is very different from what I typically wear. The style of the Nile, I suppose... Master, I noticed you staring. Don't avert your eyes now.
Please, Master, show me your truest side. I'll do the same thing in return.
"Sorry, but it seems you're hellbound." If I said that to you, how would you react? Heehee♥
Your fate is like putty in my hands... Far too much power for one maid to wield, but doesn't it sound exciting?
If you want, I could join you in your travels. To leave my role behind and work only as your most loyal maid... Really, I'm more accustomed to that to begin with, heehee.
Oh, Master? You'd entrust me with both your life and your fate? I'm more than happy to accept both.
You seem to enjoy how I accept your sinful acts, Master...
It isn't always optimal to rush through your missions. Finish them at your own pace, Master.
Your missions are completed. A job well done, I say. Heehee♥
There's mail for you. Reading it, replying to it... Add to your list of good deeds one at a time.

Welcome back, Master. If you'd like an appraisal of the previous battle, then don't hesitate to ask. Whether you'd like to rejoice in victory or be punished after defeat... Well, you just leave it all to me.
I only gave them the proper punishment for defying you, Master. Heehee.
My, are you that worried about your daily deeds now? Don't worry. I accept every bit of you. My pitiful Master, my anxious Master, my poor Master, my sinful Master... All of them are mine♥
H-class destroyer - Hero.

Oh yeah? You wanna hear about my history? Heheh, if you insist. I escorted a bunch of battleshiiips, I was in Operation Excess and stuuuff... Honestly, what I really wanted was to enjoy the October sunlight in the comfort of a port~♪
Sooo... Hey you, derpy-looking grown-up over there. You wouldn't happen to be my Commander, would you? Laaame, but oh well~ The name's Hero, Royal Navy destroyer. Try not to let me down, okay~?
Aww. Just a few more seconds and you would've been late. We were sooo close~
What's up? You need my help? Teehee~ Make it worth my time, and maybe I'll give you a hand.
This? I'm a hero, and every hero needs a sword~
Nice office you've got here~ When it's just you and your secretary, you can do whatever you want to her and nobody'd know. Teehee♪
Hardy's adorkable~ Especially when she acts like a girl scout when in reality she's craving cake. Me? I'm not bothered by that so I do as I like.
Oohh, so you manipulate naive girls with headpats! Sorry, doesn't work on me~
Woow, so you're into cutting boards, Commander? Good to know, heehee~♪
Aww, why'd you stop? I thought you were gonna "correct" me? Teehee♪
Heeey, you wouldn't leave quests unfinished, would you?
Fiiinally you finished a quest. Here's your "world's biggest procrastinator" trophy~
The inbox is nearly overflowing. Should I bother telling the Commander~? Teehee♪
Back with a victory under your belt. I'm starting to kinda get why people like you, Sidekickommander~
Commission complete~ Well, Commander? You just gonna leave those girls hanging?
Wooow, I thought you'd forgotten to raise my level~
Look, a bunch of mooks. Let's have a go.
MVP? Pfft, I can do this with my eyes closed♪
Aww, we lost! You better reflect on your mistakes when we get back, Sidekickommander.
Give up already, loser~♪
Like hell the hero's gonna go down to a bunch of trash mobs!
Wooow, you've already gone bananas? Lame. Guess I'll go do something more fun~
Oohh, you're here to see me? I'm honoured, but it'll take a little more than that to get on this mean little hero's good side~
Oohh, paying me another visit? Let me guess - you don't have any friends to talk to, so now you've come to me for help? Teehee~ You poor, poor little thing~
Aww, you really have it rough, Commander~ Are you just being nice to us all? Do you have to keep an eye on me? Ooor... Teehee~ I know exactly what's on your mind right now♪

Y'know, Commander, a little bullying never hurt anyone. 'Cause look, I'm mean to you aaall the time, and you've never fought back. Hey, wait a sec... Do you LIKE my bullying? If you seriously do, your sick, degenerate ass is beyond redemption~ Pfft, ahaha♪

Aww, you're already throwing in the towel~? Heheh, it's no surprise your sidekick ass loses to a hero like me. When someone's as sad, pathetic, and hopeless as you, the love a hero like me can give you is the most you'll get♪
I guess I'll behave nicely for you today, seeing as you got me a gift!
Hey, don't try to steal my EXP!

ex.line: Wooow, does time just mean nothing to you? Ooor... are you just that desperate to see me~? Teehee~

Commaaaander, I wanna eat cake! Not any old cake, either. I only want that super limited-edition one you got for Hardy that other time~♪ If you do that for me, who knows, maybe I'll return the favor~?
Nobody's forcing you to be the people's hero. A sidekick like you just has to be MY personal hero. Or, y'know, being my loyal little puppy works just as fine.
Hm? Isn't it obvious I'M gonna be the star of the next exercise? Teehee~ Or what, are you gonna try to correct me on that?
Oh yeah, aren't you a master of uncanny smiles? I wanna give Hans a little fright the next time we meet♪
Nobody's stopping you if you wanna be a bully. Teehee~
Naughty girls who bully people need to be corrected mercilessly~ Am I right, Sidekickommander? Teehee♪
Not bad at all. I suppose even a Sidekickommander needs some time in the limelight~
Everyone knows the hero is the star of the show! Those nobodies never even stood a chance♪

lines.line: Morning, Commander. Looks like our desks are right next to each other~ Whee~☆ Hmm? What's up? Is there something on my skirt? Teehee~♪
Morning, Commander. Looks like our desks are right next to each other~ Whee~☆ Hmm? What's up? Is there something on my skirt? Teehee~♪
Yesterday's subjects sure were tricky~ You done your homework yet, Commander? Need to copy mine? I'll let you, for a cost♪
They're selling some delicious new blueberry cakes in the canteen, and they sell out instantly if you're not quick! So, go get a slice for me, Commander~♪
The school festival? Right, that's in a few weeks... Oh, you trying to find a partner to look around with? Teehee~ Bullseye, huh?
School is sooo lame... You wanna swap notes with me next lesson? The teacher doesn't give a damn.
You forgot your compasses? Aww, what a stupid but lovable Sidekickommander~ I guess it's time to be the hero who saves your day♪
Lemme guess - praying for a peek at my undies? Teehee♪
Hang in there, Commander - school's not out just yet~ Teehee♡
Wooow, your classes are over? Don't you wanna go out and play with your classmates?
The school festival supplies have arrived. You gonna help with those? I'll be there... in spirit♪
Heavy cruiser - Kursk.
I'm Kursk, a hunter from the snowy tundras of the North... That's too brief? Ugh, what a waste of time... I hate socializing. If you want to get along with me, then keep your distance.
You're the boss around here? Good. Don't bother trying to tell me what I can and can't do; I'll prove my worth to you my own way. That's all I wanted to say.
Morning, boss. I was going to leave you a note before I left, but decided to just tell you in person after all.
I'm used to working solo. Even if it doesn't snow here, I can still cover up my tracks... if I want to.
Hunters are loners by nature - only helpless prey form groups. I walk a solitary road for that reason.
Tactics? Those are a chore. I follow my gut instincts. Nothing can tamper with that.
Snow, huh... I love when it snows. Makes it easy to cover up my tracks. It's as though it was made for ambushing.
Why are you acting like we're that close? I don't get you people...
Something urgent? I'll do it, if you want.
What are you trying to do?
You need my help with this new mission? Fine, you rest in the meanwhile. I'm not a team player.
Mission rewards have come in. Go check 'em. Everything that's there, you've earned.
Left a letter for you on the desk. I don't care what it's about, so check it yourself.
Oh, you're back... Did you win?
Commission completed. Enjoy the job-well-done party yourself - I'll pass.
The thrill of gaining power... makes me crave more.
The hunt is on!
Ahh... The smell of gunpowder and victory. Just what I like.
Urgh... My hunt can't end in a place like this...!
I'll rip you to shreds!
The thrill of walking the line between life and death... Give me more, more!
Stay away from me.
Swords become dull if not sharpened. It's why I still go back to the tundra and hunt like I used to - skills, like swords, need to be maintained.
I'm not so much a lone wolf, I just choose not to get involved with people. I operate on efficiency and ruthlessness, so I steer clear of cowards and weaklings for their sake, not mine.
People say I'm cold, but I just don't feel the need to pay attention to every little shift in other people's moods. Getting caught up in emotions is a waste of everyone's time.
Even though I've adapted to solitude, I somehow don't feel repulsed when I'm around you. Maybe... Maybe you've rubbed off on me.
...You serious? You want ME, the lone wolf of the tundras? Heheh. Let's see if you have what it takes to tame me.
It's almost unsettling how well you know my preferences... I'm saying it's a good gift. Thank you.
You smell of danger... Interesting.
There won't be enough prey to go around with this many hunters.

ex.line: Welcome back. What are we doing today? Work, first of all? Fine. I'll wait here in the meanwhile.
Here to see me? 'kay. No need to cover my tracks... Truth is, I wanted to see you too.
I do things my way... but if need be, I'll follow your commands. I trust your better judgment.
The Northern Parliament's having a party? I don't mind liquor, it's just... Ah, forget it. I'll go, if only to make you look good. When it's time for chitchat, back me up.
Those white tundras and snowy valleys still hold a special place in my heart. I'd happily take you with me to see them sometime.
If you really must...
I'm right here. I'm bad at reading emotions, so if you need something, just say it.
It's time I taught you who's the hunter and who's the prey.
You've got new missions. I'll help you... in the way I know best.
Mission complete. Hah, we're starting to look like a team.
*sniff*... I smell gunpowder on you, but not blood. Good to know you're unharmed.

lines.line: This steamy hot spring... is a rather novel experience. I left a spot for you, so come sit down already - Wait, why haven't you taken your clothes off yet?
This steamy hot spring... is a rather novel experience. I left a spot for you, so come sit down already - Wait, why haven't you taken your clothes off yet?
Hmh... The water's nice. What are you waiting for, Commander? Get in.
...Am I cold? Not really. If I can handle an ice bath, a hot spring is nothing. You, on the other hand, should be careful of the night breeze.
Seems the Sakura Empire has the most hot spring enthusiasts. Not that I don't want to bathe with them, but as you know... I'd rather be alone.
The hot steam causes the cold air to fog up, impeding visibility and making this an ideal place to set up an ambush... Heh. Don't worry. I'm right here.
How's the temperature? If you want, I can turn up the heat using my rigging.
While I hate rubbing shoulders... I can tolerate you being around.
You want to get up close and personal, huh? Heheh.
A new mission just got handed down. Go ahead and take a look - we'll have plenty of time to relax later.
I left your letter in a less humid spot. Don't want your important papers getting wet, do we?
Where have you been? ...You didn't want to pass out from dizziness? Don't worry about that. Worst case scenario, I'll just carry you back home.
There's no reason I cannot go into battle like this. The hunt is on!
Seems I'm still wet behind the ears...
I prefer talking face-to-face, but if you really insist... Heavy cruiser Kursk sits in an office chair, donning a Dragon Empery dress. What's next, Commander?
I prefer talking face-to-face, but if you really insist... Heavy cruiser Kursk sits in an office chair, donning a Dragon Empery dress. What's next, Commander?
Welcome back. You don't need to count me in at the party. If you start missing me, just give me a call.
Boisterous parties are not my thing. Still, I changed into an Empery dress to fit in with the festive mood. Yeah, it's a high slit, up to the waist. Can you guess what I'm doing now as we speak?
I've put my legs up to get more comfortable. Yeah, it's exactly what you think... "Not a very Kursk pose"? It's called changing strategies to catch valuable prey.
...Nice fireworks. If I can hear the booms from over here, we mustn't be very far apart. Keep searching, Commander, and you might just get a look at me.
Hm? You're coming back already? The prey yearns to be caught, it seems.
...If you're going to pat my head, say it to my face.
I like honesty in both words and actions. If you want something, just tell it to me straight.
Well, well. You want me to change my pose? Can do.
Alright, you don't sound hurt. Seeing you safe and sound makes me happier than hearing you win or lose.
I'll admit, this new approach is interesting, but I've never done it with you before. Who will top who? We'll find the answer shortly. Heehee.
Gangut-class battleship - Sevastopol.

Dreadnought of the Northern Parliament and flagship of the Black Sea Fleet, Sevastopol, has arrived. Hahah, I am the very ironclad willpower of the revolutionary vanguard, always under attack but never falling! Got it?

Ahahahaha! So you're the Comrade Commander. I'm the Northern Parliament battleship, Sevastopol. Revolution doesn't happen on tea parties alone, comrade. Think of me as any ordinary young lady, and you'll regret it!
Good morning, Comrade Commander. Come and show us who we will do battle with today!
Well met, comrade. Would you like to learn more about my revolyutsiya? Heheh, you hardly have to ask. I know you like the back of my hand, comrade.
Comrade Commander, join me for a drink! Waaait, you're not telling me you don't know Northern Parliament tradition, are you? ...You don't like vodka? Crappy excuse, sorry. See? We've got wine, too!
Carrier-based aircraft? Let me just say, bring 'em on. We'll see if they can beat Sevastopol!
Social standing matters not when it comes to revolution. Heh, as long as we share the same willpower, we're comrades through and through!
Huh?! H-hands off!
We are two comrades. I will gladly exchange a handshake with you!
Comrade Commander... What exactly do you think you're doing?
You have a new mission. Do your best, and keep your eyes on the prize: a celebration full of vodka!
Ahahahaha! Another step closer to revolution! M-maybe I'd better tone down the drinking for today...
Comrade Commander, there's mail for you. If you plan to reply, do it promptly. We don't want to make them wait.
In celebration of our comrades' victory... A toast of vodka! Ack! *chokes*... I-I'm fine!
Transport of goods, especially to battlefields, is a difficult thing. You should be thankful for the efforts of your commission team.
What revolutionary growth. Hahahahaha!
If you don't want to die, stand aside!
Ahahaha! All who seek to obstruct the revolution are fated to fall!
As long as I have not sunk, I will continue to stand time and time again! That is the meaning of revolution!
Glory to the revolution!
Urgh...! I'm not even drunk!
You certainly have the qualifications to be a proletariat, but you don't quite understand the revolutionary spirit...

I could trounce you with ease, but as people with similar goals, I will treat you as an equal. Heh, you should be thankful that you've become an ally of the Northern Parliament instead of sinking beneath our iron billows.
I don't know what those battle-addled idiots think of you, but if nothing else, you might make for a fine drinking partner. Heh, don't get too carried away; keep on applying yourself.

*hic*... C'mon, you haven't even finished half your glass yet. Pfft, heheheh... Waiting for me to drink myself under the table, are you? Well, too bad... No matter how much I drink... *hic*... I'm not goin' down...

*hic*... Comrade Commander, I like you. Hell, I love you. If I win this, I'll be your eternal partner and join you in the final battle. Now, I'm not dead-drunk yet. How about you just... accept defeat?
...Mm? Where am I? Oof, I might've drank too much. Comrade Commander, what's with this ring? You mean I... snatched it from you and put it on my self? I-I really did that?!
I like it! I-it is for me, isn't it?
Ooh, I smell vodka...
Politeness? Pssh, who cares about that?!
Don't get too full of yourself now~♪

ex.line: Good day, Comrade Commander. Revolution isn't all fun and games. Can I trust you to guide us all to battle once more?
My, Comrade Commander? Did you come to see me because you wanted an invitation to our drinking party, or officially, "tea" party? I've already slipped one into your office drawer~♪
I'd look miserable if I got drunk at work. Listen! You'd better stop me before I get drunk! ...Cheers!
Aww, someone looks like they're ready to learn. Okay! Sevastopol, dreadnought and training ship, would be happy to teach you!
There is no end to revolution. Rest easy; you will forever be my Comrade Commander.
Ask me for anything. As a comrade, I intend to do everything in my power to help you.
C-Comrade Commander... What was the point of that, exactly?
I brought some beer! Heh, unlike Gangut, you'd get bored of only drinking vodka pretty fast, right?

lines.line: Phew... This is... Comrade Commander? Fancy meeting you at this time of night. Me? Heh, heheheheh... You wouldn't believe me if I said I got too drunk and went in first, would you?
Phew... This is... Comrade Commander? Fancy meeting you at this time of night. Me? Heh, heheheheh... You wouldn't believe me if I said I got too drunk and went in first, would you?
Aww, you just got here? Hell, I guess I wouldn't mind going back in with you, Comrade Commander...
Come to think of it, when did I even put this on... I-I mean, gotta dress right for a hot spring bath, right?! See? Look, I even tied the sash right!
(I-I'd better not tell the Commander... that I wandered over to this hot spring alone after Gangut got me drunk! Urk...!)
Voroshilov? Don't worry about her. I don't know if she gets by through grit alone, but she's the kind to never get dizzy in a hot bath.
The joy of getting out of a hot bath? Umm... How about you go first, comrade? Erm, I'm just feeling a little, y'know...
(The wind feels nice... O-oh, right! I need to put on a cool front so the Commander doesn't notice I'm drunk!) ...Achoo?!
I'm soaked? ...Haha, well, yeah? I was bathing in the hot spring, so duh...?
A new mission... Once it's over, how about we celebrate with wine instead of vodka?
(This hot spring is so comfy... I didn't even realize I was drunk until the Commander arrived.)
The commission team is back. Think it's their turn to come in after us?
Kirov-class light cruiser - Voroshilov.

Kirov-class cruiser of the Northern Parliament, Voroshilov, at your service. Do you already know Kirov? I make the plans, and she carries them out... Oh? You say we give off completely different impressions? Fair; our comrades often say the same.
We finally meet, Comrade Commander. I am Voroshilov, light cruiser of the Northern Parliament. Hm? I don't think I was waiting that long... I mean, it was only a few hours. That's not so bad, is it?
Welcome back, Comrade Commander. I didn't know when you'd return, so I've been standing by here... Is that not part of the secretary's job?
From here to there, and then... Oh, Comrade Commander. I was just devising an emergency escape route from your office. Would you like to look over it? It may come in handy someday.
There is a saying about Kirov and me: "As hot as an inferno, yet as cold as ice." O-or... something like that.
Comrade Commander, what time is it? ...Phew, thank you. So I haven't missed it.
Ways to kill time? I like to put ice down and watch it melt... How about you, Comrade Commander?
Why would you do that?
You're going out? Do you wish I wait here, Comrade Commander?
D-don't act like you get to touch me whenever you want...
The piled-up snow may melt, but your missions won't do the same. Comrade Commander, perhaps we'd best get them done?
Comrade Commander, the mission is complete. According to our plans, the next task is...
Comrade Commander, you should check your mail. The sender may not be so patient with us.
Sort the delivered documents, deal with any and all minor issues, and I'll be all ready when Comrade Commander— Oh. When did you get back?
Huh? It's already that time? ...Th-thank you for letting me know. I almost forgot that the commission team was coming back...
Absolute power is an effective insurance policy for our subsequent missions.
I've undergone countless practice drills. I won't fail!
As long as your information is ample and your strategy is thorough, there's no chance of failure.
I'm sorry, Comrade Commander. Allow me to rectify my mistakes by my hands...
Melt!
Hang in there... Just a little more...!
You and I just aren't on the same wavelength, Comrade Commander. I'm sorry.
If you don't have any business with me, don't waste time looking for me. We should just do our own jobs and keep an appropriate distance. Wouldn't that be best?

I often read books on tactics to gain inspiration for my plans. If you have any interest, Comrade Commander, I could lend you a few. For example, this volume: "Using Neglect Play to Make Your--" ...Ermm, sorry. Wrong one...

Comrade Commander, how is your mission progress? ...You've finished all of them? What of the commissions? You've arranged them, too? I see. You're doing quite well. (whispering) My plan to get us closer ends in failure again...

Comrade Commander, what's the matter? I'm the same as ever, so I don't think there's any reason for you to be extra worried... (whispering) It's okay. I'll keep on waiting until you look my way. My "Conquer the Commander" master plan must succeed...

(whispering) Was my "Conquer the Commander" strategy a success? ...O-oh, ignore that! I'm happy you and I seem to feel the same way. Huh? Y-you always knew?! I see... I should've been more straightforward to begin with...
Ah, I've had my eye on this for a while... Never mind. Thank you.
With Kirov here, I know this will work out!

ex.line: Welcome back, Comrade Commander. You think I shouldn't wait for you all the time? ...It's okay. I was looking forward to seeing you.
Do you still think I'm as cold as ice? Haha, well, that ice melted long ago thanks to you.
Kirov told me that if I want something, I should be bold. I understand that logically, but shouldn't I be more careful when it comes to emotions? I mean, this is my first time, so...
I'd always thought that absence is what makes the heart grow fonder. But staying so close to you and chatting... Heehee, it's pretty nice.
I don't... quite understand... *blushes*
Your hands are cold... Would you like me to warm them up?
We should both be more straightforward... *blushes*
Ah, Comrade Commander. I was so focused on work that I didn't notice your return. I would've liked to give you a more special welcome, but I lost track of time... Sorry.

Dates must be planned as thoroughly as a battle. These three should do... "Port Dates and You," "Top 100 Dating Techniques," and "How to Steal the Commander's Heart on a Date." ...Oh? You say I should leave the planning to you? I-if you say so...

lines.line: Comrade Commander, is the bath to your liking? I'm glad. Heehee, it's a good thing I trusted that "Top 10 Dates for Snowy Days" article and chose this secluded hot spring.
Comrade Commander, is the bath to your liking? I'm glad. Heehee, it's a good thing I trusted that "Top 10 Dates for Snowy Days" article and chose this secluded hot spring.
It's cold enough to snow, but the hot spring will warm us up in no time. Let's not dally, Comrade Commander. The hot spring awaits.
Gangut and Sevastopol went inside with vodka. I hope they don't seriously plan to have a drinking contest in the hot spring... Comrade Commander, we'd best stop them before it's too late.
The cold wind blowing through, the steamy water... They could be likened to fire and ice, couldn't they? Heehee.
You say I'll get dizzy if I soak for too long? Maybe I'm an exception... After all, I'm used to waiting. But Comrade Commander, don't hesitate to say something if you're not feeling well.
What would I do right now if there was an emergency? Oh, I shouldn't waste this date thinking about such things...
Hm? Is there snow on my head or something?
I hear you're supposed to hold hands on dates. Comrade Commander, should we...hold hands?
Should I get a little closer? Well, okay...
A new mission, hm? I'll add it to our to-do list for later.
New mail? Mm, who could possibly be planning to cause Comrade Commander trouble at a time like this?
The Sakura Empire girls brought over some dango. You came just in time, Comrade Commander. How about we give them a try?
Don't worry. I've gone through my fair share of emergency battle drills!

Somebody once told me that people are more honest when they're in a hot spring. Heehee, that means this is my chance... Comrade Commander, I've always had feelings for you. I thought that keeping a distance from you would make you more interested in me, but... I suppose when people say "awkward," they're referring to people like me...

Don't move, please. You're playing the patient, and I'm playing the nurse, so it's only natural that the distance between us is different from usual... Hm? What does that have to do with this pose? Ahem. Now that you mention it, umm...

Don't move, please. You're playing the patient, and I'm playing the nurse, so it's only natural that the distance between us is different from usual... Hm? What does that have to do with this pose? Ahem. Now that you mention it, umm...
I plan to use medical equipment, of course, but no physical is complete without direct questioning and physical contact. Your body may have been tampered with, so I must be thorough.
I've already studied many texts and learned a lot from my friends. All that's left is to treat you and receive your evaluation... Heehee, go easy on me, okay? I'll do the same for you.
It feels like you're on fire, and then you're freezing? Hmm... Such severe symptoms demand a much more thorough examination...
Comrade Commander, can you come closer? I can't measure your heart rate from this far. Or if you can't come to me, may I come to you?
My plans? Hmm... I'll stay with you until your fluid transfusion is done. Don't worry, counting the drips is enough to entertain me for hours... But we could chat, if you'd like.
It's just going to feel like a little pinch. Relax, okay?
Comrade Commander... I'm ready for you...
Leave your mission correspondence to me, Comrade Commander. You just hold tight.
You finished your missions? Good. Now we can focus on your physical.
Congratulations on a successful mission. Are you hurt? Sick at all? And your mood? Umm... I mean whether you're in the mood for your "physical."

I'd gladly take advantage of the opportunity to make you mine if you DID fall ill, but I'm not the kind of girl who'd want that to happen. My plan will have to go undeployed for now, forever a fantasy... Ah! *blush* You'll make it reality... for me?
Illustrious-class aircraft carrier - Formidable.

Illustrious-class aircraft carrier number three, with a promising future of becoming an armoured carrier. Commander, I humbly request your aid in training me to become a proper lady... Huh? What kind of sweets do I like? Why are you asking me... I like all kinds of sweets!

Hmm... Are you the so-called "Commander"? You don't look all that scary, but maybe this is what they call camouflage...? Hmm... I dunno... Oh! I'm the third Illustrious-class ship, Formidable. It's... a pleasure to meet you?
W-welcome back... I suppose I should start my etiquette training now, right? For example, practicing how I stand and sit...
I hear that you're an evil taskmaster who punishes shipgirls when they don't do exactly as they're told... Hwah? That's not true? I dunno, you're kinda suspicious...
I'm about to go to a tea party with the others... Commander, do you have a mirror? I want to make sure I'm looking sharp... No, you don't need to help me! I can do it myself.
Little Bel, how much longer are you going to be? "It's only been three minutes"? You mean you've ALREADY taken three minutes!
One of my Royal Maid sisters told me I'd turn "plump" if I ate too much cake. Does she think I believe these childish lies? ...C-Commander, that is a lie, right?!
Hawawah! D-do not rustle the hair of a proper lady!
I-it is rude to touch a lady without her permission!
Just you wait! I'm gonna go tell big sis Illustrious aaall about all the bad things you did!
Missions? Can we eat candy if we finish them all?
Commander, the missions are all done now, so you should take a break. ...You're too busy? It must be hard being grown-up...
Commander, I brought your mail. I heard that's part of a secretary's job... I-is that right?
While you were away, a few of the older girls visited. They all left messages, which I wrote down on this sheet of paper for you... (whispering) The Commander's really suspicious...
I heard there's tasty milk chocolate in the commission supplies... I-I didn't say anything. How about we go greet the commission team?
Wooow. You can use airplanes for this, too?
Evildoers! I'm not scared of you!
Hmph. Do not underestimate Formidable!
Th-the Commander's gonna lecture me... Urk...
Evildoers, begone at once!
Don't hit me, don't hit me! Ah...
I-I'm sorry! I-I'll listen better from now on, so don't get mad at me...

Do you need something? Ladies of the Royal Navy are quite busy, I'll have you know—You say there's a party full of sweets? And we don't have to be all stuffy and formal? AND big sis Illustrious said I can go? Hmmm... O-okay, I'll go! I'll go!

You want to know if ladies of the Royal Navy get tired? It's not so bad; we only have to constantly mind our manners and carry ourselves with elegance... Ugh, it's a hassle! I just wanna lie on the couch and eat candy—Ahem! F-forget you heard that!

You're a lot like me, Commander. Every day is so full of things you must do, you're only able to do what you want to do in private. Even grown-ups have it rough... But it's okay! I will do whatever I can to help you! Not that I know exactly what that entails...
I always thought you were a strict and scary person, so I acted cold to you... N-now I know that you're a good person and fun to be around! Commander, you're my best friend! Ehehe!
People tell me that you only give these to those you really care about... Does that mean I'm your best friend, too? Ehehe, I'm overjoyed! I'd better go tell big sis Illustrious about this!
Woah, I've always wanted this! ...Ahem, I mean, umm... th-thank you very much!
F-for love and peace!
Hm? Umm... Are you okay? It looks like you're asleep...

ex.line: Commander! You've finally returned! Did you bring that Iris dessert I said I wanted to try? ...Wow, thank you, Commander!

Etiquette training does suck, but I'll keep doing my best to become a dependable lady of the Royal Navy! ...Ehehe, this is how I'll hide my true self in front of others so that only the people I really care about get to see the real me! Yep, that's perfect!
At tea parties, you have to sit straight up and deal with all these dumb, annoying manners... But when I'm with you and my sisters, I can relax! I wish I could always eat tasty foods without a care!
Commander, you know one or two of Her Majesty's secrets, don't you? For example... Maybe she's not all that elegant in private? I promise I won't tell anyone else!
I recently learned about this "rock" genre of music. I rather like it! My sisters say it's not ladylike, but... What about you? Do you like "rock," Commander?
Hawawah! I put so much effort into brushing my hair just right... You'd better get it back to how it was!
If you're free right now, then let's have a tea party together! We can leave out all of the boring manners and stuff.
I-i-i-it is far too soon for me to be participating in such acts!
A new mission? If you're going to be busy, then I guess I'll have to pass the time alone... How sad.
Mission complete! Commander, shall we take a break? You look tired, so I'm worried about you...
Commander, you've got mail! I brought it right away! Do you have a reward for me?
Commander, come over here! There there, pat pat, good Commander! Hm? Big sis Illustrious taught me this! She said this is the best way to help you relax.
Going out with you to greet the commission team... I know what this is! This is what they call a "grown-up date"! ...It's not?
I won! Look, Commander, I'm in first place!
Urk... Commander, they're bullying meee...

lines.line: Type 1937J destroyer - Otto von Alvensleben.

Feast your eyes. You're looking at none other than Type 1937J destroyer Otto von Alvensleben! Well, what do you think? Why are you being so silent? This is the part where you're supposed to heap praise upon me!

Oh? I've heard no shortage of heroic tales about you, but you sure look spindly in person. Then again, I suppose it only makes sense for you chessmasters to be more brain than brawn. I'm Otto von Alvensleben, Iron Blood destroyer. Let's see what you can do.
Put your nose to the grindstone, Commander, and you may just impress your secretary.
What's your deal? ...Oh, I know! You're madly in love, and now you can't take your eyes off me? You should've just said so~
Wrong document. Not this one either. Where is that damn... ARGHHH! Now they're all out of order!
You keep a bunch of spare uniforms around, don't you? 'Cause if you get splashed by a wave during a sortie, well... Heehee♪
Looks like some paperwork is too troublesome even for the legendary Commander~ Let me see at what's so hard about... Err, yeah, this is all nonsense to me...
What are you even trying to do?
Hmm? Wow, Commander, I never thought you wanted to do "that" with me~?
W-wait, time out! Y-you can't be serious about this, right?!
This mission should be a cakewalk for you, no?
You STILL haven't touched your mission rewards... It's nearly been a whole day now!
You're really so helpless you need your secretary to fetch your mail, huh... W-wait, didn't I get this just a minute ago?
How was your sortie? The breeze didn't get to your head, did it? Good to hear.
The commission team has returned. Aren't you going to check what they brought back?
In a real rush to make me stronger, huh? Heehee♪
I don't have time to waste on you small fry.
I could do this with my eyes closed.
How could I have messed up so badly?! This has to be some kind of mistake!
Think you can keep up with me?
Nobody warned me the enemy was THIS strong!
*sigh*... This is all you've got? You're nothing like the stories claim.
You're in luck, Commander. It's not every day someone as cute and talented as me joins your fleet. Heehee~♪
I wish we shipgirls could all move underwater like submarines. Still, better to move freely on the water than to be stuck on land like you. Heehee~
Hey! Who left this thing lying in the corridor? Someone could trip and get hurt! ...I don't need your help! I'm not some klutz who stumbles everywhere she goes!

Hey, why don't we go on a date today? ...Did that really throw you for a loop? Hah, I knew it would... W-wait, you have a list of spots to go? You prepared all that in advance?! Ugh... Okay, you got me this time...
Whoa, whoa, whoa! This is WAY too sudden! I-I mean, not that I don't want to... No, that doesn't mean I don't mind! Ugh... You're obviously teasing me, but why am I fine with that?!
This is pretty nice. I think I'll take it~

ex.line: Well, well, if it isn't you. Are you gonna try to impress me with your hustle again?
A table of contents... Not a bad idea. I can sort them according to their listed order, and... W-wait, my labels are all wrong?
Being the secretary's easy! Whatever problems come our way, you solve them... Come again? Oh, I'm not saying my hands are free, not at all!
Wh-what are you driving at?
I already know there's no beating you...

lines.line: Hmph! You really think this brainless trap can keep me entangled forever? I don't need your help! I can break free by myself! ...Umm, what the hell? Why can't I do it?!
Hmph! You really think this brainless trap can keep me entangled forever? I don't need your help! I can break free by myself! ...Umm, what the hell? Why can't I do it?!
Morning, Commander. I feel on top of the world today, so don't worry about me. Yeah, I... I'm totally fine...
Grrr... Once I find out who's behind this prank, they'll have hell to pay!
Why are you just standing there watching me? Is this funny to you- watching me struggle, trying to break free?
There's a sign outside, warning people to stay away because of traps? S-someone must've put that up AFTER I got ensnared! There's no way in hell I didn't see it!
Hmph. This isn't a problem if I imagine it's a quirky hammock. I'm resting here, that's all... Ugghh... G-get the sun out of my eyes...
St-stop shaking the vines!
Th-th-there's a line, and you've crossed it!
You finished a mission? So? What's that got to do with my situation?
Yeah, you've got new mail... But do I look like I'm in any position to fetch it for you...?
Had your fun? Hmph, I can tell you've been messing around with a bunch of girls.
No other choice- gotta fight like this!
Urgh... I can't get them off... Huh?! C-Commander?! When did you get here?! This just, um... It just kind of happened! Help me get loose!
Urgh... I can't get them off... Huh?! C-Commander?! When did you get here?! This just, um... It just kind of happened! Help me get loose!
Commander! Why are you just staring? Long story short, I ended up like this by accident! There's no kinky reason for it! Ugh! Stop wondering about it and just undo these binds!
Hrrnngghh! Agh... This dumb tape gets tighter the harder I try to break it! Commander, I'm gonna tire myself out if you don't help me soon!
Why there's a pillow on the sofa? I think it's pretty obvious! It's so my head won't hurt while holding this pose and... Wait, were you goading me into saying it?!
Commander! You've been staring for a while now! Have you still not figured it out?

(Ugh. It's so humiliating to be seen like this. I doubt I'll be able to free myself, so I'll just have to rely on the Commander... but I don't want it to be known how I ended up like this. What should I do?!)
Huh?! I know you did that on purpose! And I'm powerless to resist... Stop ruffling up my hair!
So you finally figured out what to do! I knew I could count on... What? Why am I bound even tighter than before?!
Eek! H-how could you do this to someone who's in need of help?!
A new letter? I'll go and get it for you if you'll help me with... Huh? You just want me to read it aloud to you?!
You're finally back, Commander! So, did you find a way to help me with this? You didn't? Okay, well... Huh?! Why do you need me to tell you why I bound myself up?!
I should be able to break free now that I'm stronger... Okay, that's tight!
Y-you're telling me to fight like THIS?!
Jade-class aircraft carrier - Jade.

Refitted aircraft carrier Gneisenau—Sorry, that's a little inside joke. I'm Jade, an aircraft carrier. While I may not be able to pull off any major feats myself, I promise I will obey you♪ Leave it all to me, Commander.
I am Jade, an Iron Blood aircraft carrier. From your looks, I assume you're the Commander? Goodness, you don't have to introduce yourself- I already know everything about you. Heehee~♪
Good morning, Commander. Did you sleep well? Staying up late is naughty, you know.
For how organized your room is, there sure is a lot of dust everywhere. Look here, and over here. Do you even know how to clean properly? Get to work already. I'll supervise you~♪
What do you want? I'm busy talking with my friends. If you need help, ask someone else~
I thought I saw something weird on Juustagram, but turns out it was just you. Since I'm such a good girl, I will gladly share something with you: you made a typo here. Haha~♪
I am a good girl, so I would never call you a lowly creature or anything. See? I didn't.
Yeah, I'm short. Got a problem with that?
Shake hands? Sit first, doggy! Hehe, I'm kidding~♪
Hyah?!
I'm a good girl, so I'll do it with you~ It, as in your mission~♪
Your missions are done. Oh my, did you not notice?
What's in that letter? No nasty gossip about me, hopefully?
What's the matter? I have plans with friends, so I don't have time for you. My, now that you mention it, I haven't congratulated you for your efforts yet. Too bad! I need to get going right now~♪
The commission team's back. Think they brought souvenirs?
Thank you! Heehee~♪
I'm a good girl, so I'll give this fight all I've got~♪
Heheh. Lick my shoes. Go on, stick your tongue out~
Tch. How annoying...
This ought to do it~♪
Why'd this have to happen to me?!
You're rude and a huge jerk, so I'm sure nobody else likes you either. Heehee~
*sigh*... Why must this happen to me... Hm? Don't worry about it. I'm just looking something up for the greater good. It has nothing to do with you, of course.
Changing status to... "In a relationship with Jade." ...Heehee, seems like nobody's noticed anything yet. Eep! Commander? Don't barge into a girl's room without knocking!
Let's see where your "Work" folder is, Commander... Huh, not here either. I wonder wh- Woah! Commander? Didn't I tell you not to barge in without knocking? Doesn't matter if this is your room!

"Invited Jade over to my room"... Ehh? Aww, busted again. What's the big deal anyway? I'm a good girl, so of course I wouldn't sneak into your room and mess around with your stuff~ You'll back me up, Commander, won't you? Teehee~♪

Well, I'm not surprised. I've known for a looong time now that you were preparing for this behind the scenes. Sooo, what if I told you that I'm not interested? Haha, I'm kidding~♪ Would you be surprised if I told you, I'm totally into you too~?
If I accept this, I'm sure it'll cause a lot of misunderstandings... Heehee, but thank you anyway~♪
Yes, yes. I know you're a bad girl, Elbe.
You've known the Commander for how long? ...Excuse me?

ex.line: *yawn*... Hm? We're late? Isn't that your fault, naughty Commander? Heheh~♪
Heehee~♪ I've gotten lots of reactions on the photos of our date! Wanna see, Commander?
Where are your documents? I dunno~♪ Unlike Elbe, I'm a good girl, so I'd never play pranks.
Commander, you look troubled. It's okay. I might just help out a little, if you ask nicely, that is~♪
Hrmph... Are you comparing me to Elbe?
You're so very naughty, Commander~♪
I was ready to make you write a letter of apology if you neglected me any longer, but... I suppose I'll let you off this time.
A congratulatory present? Aww, were you looking forward to getting something? Hmm? Did I say I'd cook for you? I dunnooo...
...I don't remember asking you to pat me on the head, you know?
What might I do if you don't pay attention to me~? Aww, you don't have to worry so much. Have I EVER done anything to cause trouble for you? Heehee~♪

lines.line: *lick*... Hmm. The fact that you can just stand there must mean that you don't mind the heat. It's okay, though. If you don't come in, I'm more than happy to have this pool all to myself~♪
*lick*... Hmm. The fact that you can just stand there must mean that you don't mind the heat. It's okay, though. If you don't come in, I'm more than happy to have this pool all to myself~♪
Be careful not to get heatstroke, okay? You'll worry everyone if you collapse, especially me.
*siiiigh*... It really is hot out. Commander, how do you deal with this every year?
Wow, everyone's swimsuits are so wild... Hmph. What's wrong with something a bit more innocent like mine?
Oh, I forgot to tell you, the water gets deeper over there~♪ Heehee. You alright over there, Commander?
Go, go~ You're almost done! Do a good job, and I'll... *slurp*~♥
Want a little treat, Commander? *Sluuurp* Here you go~ Heehee~♪
Ahaha~♪ Ehehehe~♥
Aren't you hot? Why not jump in the pool and cool off? I'm not like Elbe, so you don't have to worry about manners or anything.
*Shlurp*... What? I'm simply enjoying the reward you gave me, Commander.

That's right, I'm the witch Jade, the most famous idol in all the world! Did you come running when you heard my name, hero? I was just about to broadcast my new song, so you'll be the perfect helper. Heheh♪

That's right, I'm the witch Jade, the most famous idol in all the world! Did you come running when you heard my name, hero? I was just about to broadcast my new song, so you'll be the perfect helper. Heheh♪
