So even the great hero can be late? Did someone decide to be naughty and stay up late last night? Heehee!
Adventure? As a witch idol, I have no interest in that. Though I could consider it if you hold an even flashier concert for me!
Atmosphere is important, so I should use magic after all. Hm? What magic do I want to use? Heehee... Mwah! This spell makes your heart flutter♡
For the concert, I need... new speakers, a magic phone for the livestream, candles, glow sticks, and my own hero to put to work... Heehee, that last one was a joke.
Heheh, I've got just the hat for today... Whoa whoa! Don't take my hat!
Oh, you want these glow sticks? Then hold out your left hand! Now your right! Heehee, you're so obedient. Here you go~
What a wicked hero you are♪ Are you planning to do naughty things to me?
Concert preparation is important, but so are your quests. Or were you neglecting them specifically to bait me into helping you?
You have so many quest rewards waiting. Make sure they're all accounted for!
Hmm? My concert livestream? It ended a while ago now... I can't believe you really missed it. Haha, I'm kidding! It hasn't even started yet♪

What am I doing after my concert? Joining you in your adventures, of course. Those weren't just pretty words. You're the one who came to see me, and I plan to return the favor. Besides, you can't progress without my magic, can you? Heehee!
M-class light cruiser - Regensburg.

Iron Blood light cruiser, Regensburg. While I have no particular history to speak of, I'll prove that I'm not so easily controlled by you. Regina, let's show our inferiors what we're made of! (Roooar!)

I am the Iron Blood light cruiser Regensburg, wielder of the Darksteel Dragon— and I already know all of your tricks. Hahaha, do not think I will be so easily manipulated like the other girls! (Roooar!)
Hey, you're right on time. I wonder if you were born dutiful, or if someone had to whip it into you... Either way, get to work.
Well, well. So even you have a hard time handling my rigging. Unsurprising, a mere human cannot tame its great power. Heehee.
(Roooar...) What, Regina? Is it feeding time? Shouldn't you be taking a break as well?
Our balance sheet is... What kind of operation are you running here? Don't tell me you think it's okay to overlook such wastefulness.

Every faction has its own ways of breaking in their rigging. It's something you also might want to pick up on, just in case. Even if they won't help you fight, they might come in handy some other way.
Wha?!
Want to try petting Regina?
Someone needs to be disciplined...
Let your superior do the fighting, and in the meantime, you may do your so-called missions. It's decided then.
Rewards? Shame you won't get the chance to hoard them. Hahahaha!
We've got a new message. What did Eisen break this time, Regina? ...Oh, it's something else?
Tch, putting me through all this... No, I'm not talking about you. This is a problem between me and my rigging.
(Roooar!) Silence, Regina! ...What's that? The commission team is back?
Heheh. Are you sure you want to consolidate my power at the top of the food chain even further?
Deploying rigging! Now, tremble in fear!
(Roooar!) Now do you understand where you sit on the food chain?
How could I lose to this... trash?!
Roar, Regina!
I shall not... be defeated by lesser beings!
In the end, you humans deserve to be on the collar side of the leash. Know your place!
Hahaha! I never thought it would be so funny to see an inferior being pushing their luck. Do not misunderstand; me disciplining my rigging and you giving me orders are two very different things.
You're not half bad for a human. Even I acknowledge that, which is why I deign to obey your orders. What of it, you ask? I hope you don't think of me as below you in anything but name only.

I won't accept it... I won't! I refuse to believe that commands from someone like YOU would draw out more of my power—What? You say this is your power, not mine? No... Do you mean to say... You're stronger than me?!
To think that I, Regensburg, would lose to this... this Commander! What manner of monster are you?! If I continue to let you draw out my strength, that will make me your subordinate... This can't be!
Kh! Why am I... unable to refuse a lower being such as you...? Damn it, how did you become... stronger, and more superior? ..A ring? Do you mean to tie me down?!
Step aside, Regina. This is Commander's gift to me. ...Good grief, is it really that precious?
Support us, Regina!
Your sorcery isn't needed. Just leave this to me!

ex.line: (Roooar!) I've been waiting. I already know how dutiful you are. Go on; get to your next job.
I don't need your help. Relying on you any more would soil the name of Regensburg- stop trying to help without my permission already!
(Roooar...) What? Did you get spooked by the smaller riggings again? Hmph. Regina, you ought to know that your appearance is meant to symbolize the might of a superior being...
Looks like my piggy bank is full again. Hmph, don't underestimate savings. Every little bit counts, and every penny saved is a penny earned!
(Someday, I will find the Commander's weakness and prove my superiority... Until then, I'll have to cope with this!)
(Roooar...) Regina? You've... taken a liking to the Commander?!
Kh...! This frustrates me to no end, but...!
Missions? Hmph, I'll help you. It'll make me stronger, too.
(So many mission rewards... Commander, just how far have you surpassed me?!)
The commission team is here. It's time to do your job.
Good. Draw out even more of my power!
(Roooar!) This elation, this sense of fulfillment... Is this the feeling of a victory wrought by the Commander?!

(If the Commander gave me an order right now, I'd obey without protest... Rgh, what shame! I ought to be able to crush the Commander between my fingers at a given moment, but I'm like a mere servant!)

lines.line: Wanted to feast your eyes on this, didn't you? Haha, there's no point trying to deny it. All your petty desires are clear as day to me, so why not just be honest about it?
Wanted to feast your eyes on this, didn't you? Haha, there's no point trying to deny it. All your petty desires are clear as day to me, so why not just be honest about it?
Hehe, even someone like you is powerless before my allure. Those ruled by their emotions are easy to control, just like riggings.
Hm? What are you trying to... Hyeep?! G-get your hands off my tail this instant! Didn't you hear me?!
(Rooooar...) Looks like Regina's gone pretty far out to sea. Hope it doesn't run into any trouble.
Since you're here at the beach, surely you have a thing or two you'd like to do? Come on, let yourself loose already.
(That's right! Bare your weaknesses to me as I pretend to be subservient...!)
Huh?! Wh-why do you know where my weak spot is...?!
A job? What job could be more important than enjoying your time off at the beach?
One can never get enough rewards. Same is always true regardless of what form they come in.
Looks like Regina's having a good time with its friends. Why don't you take a break as well? Surely you're not trying to test the limits of your weary body.
(Grooooowl...) Oh, is the commission team back already?
If only Regina were here, I wouldn't be bested by... the likes of you!
(You're looking at girls other than myself? Impossible! I'm clearly best-suited to be your... Huh?! What the hell am I thinking? How could I be... experiencing jealousy?!)
Hmm... Who knew this stuff was in a warehouse, of all places? Heh, I think this will help quite a bit with disciplining that rigging that gave you so much trouble.
Hmm... Who knew this stuff was in a warehouse, of all places? Heh, I think this will help quite a bit with disciplining that rigging that gave you so much trouble.
You're the one who offered to help me clean this place, so work! Or do you need discipline, too?
If we discipline the rigging as such, even if they do not become fully subservient... Hey, are you listening? Wh-why are you staring?!
More pocket change... I've found quite a bit. Go find a piggy bank to put all this in, Commander.
I'd best go check on Regina. I had to leave her outside given how cramped it is in here... You ought to take a break, too. Go out for fresh air, if you want.
...Leave that stuff for now. It might be useful for disciplining naughty rigging.
A-a greater being such as I need no flattery!
What? Do you require my teachings as your superior?
Tch! K-keep this up, and I...!
You got home and came straight here? How obedient. Check this area for me, then.
Put the supplies the commission team brought here for now. We'll inventory the old stuff, and then we can sort them out.

Heh. You know, this style of discipline might work on lesser beings such as yourself, too... What?! You think I'm the one who needs to be disciplined?! U-unthinkable! I am superior - surely I can't lose to you again...!
Bismarck-class battleship - Bismarck.

My lust for power once dragged me down to the depths of hell. No matter how much I regretted it, it was already too late... I never dreamed that I would be given new life in this manner. Much seems to have changed during my slumber, but I am now ready to take on everything. Having you, a fellow leader, show me the way forward is the best thing I could ask for.
Guten Tag. I am Iron Blood battleship Bismarck. While this may not be our first meeting, perhaps you find my new attire surprising? As a fellow idealist, I'm happy to once more fight by your side.
Let's get to work, Commander. A port this vast requires a leader's management.
A private workspace? No, that's alright. I don't need preferential treatment- simply being able to work with you is enough.
The two of us have much in common, as leaders who bear the expectations of their peers. If there's anything you have difficulty confiding to others, feel free to turn to me.
Geryon is being rather rowdy... Regensburg, how'd you manage to calm him down the last time? Mind showing me again?
While you could call Eugen my right-hand woman, she can often be frustratingly difficult to read... You think so, too? Heh, I'm glad we're on the same page.
With this new power, I finally have the opportunity to leave my regrets behind in the past. Wait, we're going to a café with Tirpitz? Right now? Umm... give me a moment to sort out my emotions...
I like slow classical music- it helps me relax. As for the war... Yes, there will come a day when that, too, is history.
Want to try my cap on? ...Hehe, it suits you well.
Has my sword caught your eye? You may hold it if you want.
Are you purposely trying to get under my skin?
A new mission? Let me have a look. I can lend you a hand.
Mission complete. Remember to claim your rewards. They belong in your hands.
A letter for you, it seems. Give it a read, promptly. You wouldn't want to miss potentially vital information.
You're back. If you have the time, could you compile an after-action report? In the meantime... I'll put myself in our foes' shoes and see if I can't develop a better strategy.
Munitions have arrived. Come, let's not waste any time. Those girls would like nothing more than a warm welcome from you.
It's time for routine maintenance. Geryon, be quiet now.
That sheer courage to stand in my way is worthy of applause.
Excellent, the path before us has been cleared. Forward!
I do not intend to shoulder all the responsibility myself... but I will ensure our safe retreat!
Truth can only be found within my range!
None shall tarnish Iron Blood's honor!
I thought you a brilliant leader and followed your example. I now see that I was misguided.

I do not want any preferential treatment. All I ask is that you treat me as you would any of our other colleagues. That's right, Commander. I look forward to working with you in the days ahead. I'm sure we'll become the best of friends.
There are times I wonder what I would do if you were ever to become my enemy. Of course, it's just a thought experiment, but it helped me realize- I'm glad we're on the same side.

I'm comfortable discussing anything with you, from office matters to coffee break gossip. Being this sincere, this forthright, is something a leader conscious about appearances strives for. Heehee. I always enjoy my time with you.

I hope you will remain by my side, as more than an ally and close friend you can talk to about... *sigh*, never mind. It's all good as long as you know what I'm trying to say. See, I'm... I'm still not used to speaking my heart...

I know about your resolve, your feelings. What I don't know... is how to meet your expectations for this unforgettable ceremony. Let this be a rare case where I ask for a favor and say... could you take the lead? Heehee.
Heh. Not bad. I appreciate it.
That's the Eugen I've always known.
Join me in battle, Tirpitz.
I'm not the Bismarck you know, but I seek your aid all the same.
I haven't forgotten your knightly promise.
Whatever happens, I will always protect you.
How long has it been since we last fought together?
I shall lead Iron Blood towards a glorious future. To do that, I need your help.

ex.line: What will it be today - tea or coffee? Heehee. Only you could have me as a handmaid, so allow me to serve you for... Hm? This isn't what you had in mind?
Once we wrap up here, why don't we go someplace nice? As a refresher, you know... Asking for a date? D-does it come across like that? I see... If you want, you're free to think of it like one...
Sometimes, I envy Blücher. If only I could be as open and honest about my feelings as her... But maybe you don't want me to be like her?
I'm planning to set some time aside just for U-556... Hm? The U-boats are all playing hide-and-seek tomorrow? That's, well... I'll find time for her some other day.
I've read that listening to the same music can put two people in the same mood... Why don't we give that a try, Commander?
The leader of Iron Blood, allowing the Commander to pet her... I mustn't be seen like this.
What do you mean by this?
How am I supposed to respond to this...?
New mail, hmm? Do you think someone's thinking of you from afar?
Welcome back, Commander. There's much to reflect on, but for now, enjoy a well-earned break.
The commission team has returned in one piece. Let's go welcome them back. They're waiting to see you.
At long last, I, Bismarck, have returned to the battlefield!!
All who oppose us have been eliminated. Awaiting your next order, Commander.
Commander, take everyone and retreat, now. We cannot eke out a victory here.
I, battleship Bismarck, shall forge a brighter future!

lines.line: Ah, you've already gotten changed, Commander? I'm just... Well, I need to do something about my hair before I go back in the water.
Ah, you've already gotten changed, Commander? I'm just... Well, I need to do something about my hair before I go back in the water.
The water feels perfect. Commander, come join me after you finish your warmup exercises.
I reserved this whole swimming pool. We all want to be left undisturbed sometimes. Especially now, when... You know what I mean, don't you?
U-556 told me that submarines love playing in the pool. While I agree it is a fun time, I wish she'd understand why I can't exactly mingle with submarines...
My swimsuit? Why yes, I chose it myself. In truth, I did ask Eugen for suggestions, but all the swimsuits she picked out were... the kinds that draw undesirable attention. Let's just say that..
Incidentally, would you consider what we're doing here a date? ...Thinking of it like that makes me feel a bit tense...
Hold on. My hair is still soaked.
If you want a break from swimming, we can always sit on the deck like this.
To follow my heart in this scenario or not, that's the question...
A letter? Why in here, of all places... Dry your hands before you open it.
The swimming pool floor is slippery, so watch your step, Comma- *sigh*... I told you so. Be more careful.
Emergency sortie, Geryon. Come with me.
All enemies have been dealt with. I hope this will go swimmingly for at least a while.
I wanted to tune up today, but unsurprisingly, you can't fight when you're not fully prepared...
This necklace's glimmer and texture in the steam is truly splendid... Oh, Commander. Would you care to come in and share in this scene you've gifted me?
This necklace's glimmer and texture in the steam is truly splendid... Oh, Commander. Would you care to come in and share in this scene you've gifted me?
Most people would take off their necklaces before going into the bath, but I'm reluctant to. I want to remember this feeling.
Look, Commander - the light reflecting off of the water makes my necklace glow all the more. I'm very fond of this gift of yours.
Flower petals, music, and aromas. Heehee - even I have a sense for romance.
I feel weak... I must've soaked for too long. Commander, could you... wrap the towel around me?
The necklace feels vaguely warm to the touch... Care to feel it for yourself, Commander?
Hm? Is there a petal stuck to my hair?
You wish to see it from a different angle? Of course. Go ahead.
Heehee. Let us immerse ourselves in this wonderful scenery.
Yes... The water is the perfect temperature. It washes away filth and fatigue alike.

I'm bad at expressing my emotions, and I struggle to naturally show my feelings toward you... Still, I want you to view it like this necklace: As long as you look with your heart, its splendor should reveal itself to you.
Taihou-class aircraft carrier - Taihou.
I am the Sakura Empire's cutting-edge armored carrier. No bombs, torpedoes, or anything else can even scratch me. My Commander, I will systematically eliminate all who dare threaten you.
I've finally found you, my Commander~ Why do you keep avoiding me? Is my love not enough for you? Then take this - a token of my unrestrained love~❤
Heehee... I've waited here this whole time for you~
Do those big-boobied women... distract you, my Commander? Heehee... When I grow up, I'm gonna be the center of your world, and I'll never let you ogle any other girl again~
That Akagi, she sincerely treats you as her slave? Heehee... Let's see if I can't wring an apology out of her~
Has anyone else ever gifted you a toy, my Commander? Oh, no reason... I just thought I'd ask.
My Commander, do tell me when you'd like a break. I'll go and hang an "on break" sign on the office door immediately. That will ensure nobody comes and disturbs you~
Heehee~ Oh, my Commander~♥
Ah, a show of affection~ You make me so happy, my Commander❤
I get it, my Commander. You just couldn't wait any longer❤
A mission? Why should I let something so insignificant detract from my time with you? Just delegate it to someone else~
Mission complete. You wanted to finish it with me, didn't you? Heehee~ Getting work done while spending time with me is truly two birds with one stone♪
You've received a new letter... Oh, I was just testing it for poison~
Back already? Did you miss me that much? Heehee... I know eeeverything about you~
The commission team is back? Since they do it all for you, I'll come along and thank them~
You are head over heels for me after all~❤
You'll regret ruining my sweet time with my Commander... Heehee...
This fate is what befalls all who get between me and my Commander~
It's your fault my Commander is sulking... It's ALL your fault!
Would you please perish?
Why is that stupid, stupid moron here? Why, why, why?!
Is my love still not enough? That's fine. I've got ways to express much, muuuch more of my love...
There's nothing I won't do for you, my Commander~ Simply say the word, and I'll write you another 100 love letters♥
I have to get my hands on the key to the office... Oh, hi, my Commander~ Clumsy Taihou left something in your office. Can I borrow your key and go get it? I'll be right back, I promise~
My Commander, won't you go on a date with me? I'm only a child, so all those grown-ups would never suspect it's actually a date~ Heehee❤

What's wrong? Is it not a given that you should care for a prepubescent child? It makes sense for us to live in the same room - nobody would bat an eye at that! Heehee~ I won't let anyone take you from me, my Commander♥
So you finally admit it~ Even if our relationship stays the same, this officially proves that I've stolen your heart, my Commander~ You are the love of my life, now and forever♥
I'm glad to hear that you love me sooo very much❤
Slave? The Commander is MINE!

ex.line: I've been waiting for you this whooole time, my darling~♥
What's your favorite food? I can make it for you~ I'm a little girl with lots of spare time, so I can practice whichever dish you like.
Do you feel worn out, my Commander? I'll get you a snack to munch on~ I'll also feed you it, so you can simply lie back and relax.
Heehee... You can't forget about my touch, can you? ♥
Could you please lie down for me, my Commander? See, this is what's called a "lap pillow" and it helps you really unwind~
Heehee... Now I can finally be alone with my Commander~❤

lines.line: Andrea Doria-class battleship - Andrea Doria.
I'm Andrea Doria, the lead ship of my class. While I don't have any accomplishments to brag about, I really try to look after those close to me! S-so, come to me if you need help.
Greetings, Commander. I am Andrea Doria, Sardegna Empire battleship. I'm honored to be working with you. Oh, and if anyone in your fleet needs a helping hand, I'll support them as best as I can.
Getting to work this soon, Commander? Why not have a hot cup of milk before you begin?
*sigh*... Commander, do I seem dependable to you? I don't want those who look up to me to see me as incompetent... Yeah, exactly. I have to be a role model to people.
Do you want more hot milk? I'll heat up some more right now. Enjoy it while it's warm.
Sometimes I just want to relax, but I can't let my guard down in case someone comes by... *sigh*... Do you ever have that problem, Commander?
Commander, am I doing a good job keeping up appearances? I'm not too nice to people, am I? I'm bad at self-evaluating...
Mmh... Do you find this relaxing, Commander?
N-now you're being naughty...
You have a new mission. Why not leave it to someone else as a bit of practice?
Mission complete! I'm glad to see everyone doing so well.
There's a new letter. Maybe the milk I ordered has arrived already?
A few girls stopped by while you were gone. Oh, and I wrote a note of what they wanted to tell you. You can read it, if you'd like.
Commission complete. Let's go give our thanks to those hardworking girls.
That's right, a role model can't afford to fall behind!
I won't embarrass myself in front of the people who look up to me.
I hope my results will inspire others.
It's okay. We might have lost this time, but next time, the Commander will lead us to victory!
Don't come any closer!
H-hold steady just a while longer!
What happened to you, Commander? If it's help you need, I'm here for you.
There are all kinds of shipgirls at this port, some of whom are naughty and cause you headaches, I'm sure. But when you're at your wits' end, you can rely on me.
Something on your mind, Commander? It's not healthy to bottle up your emotions... How did I know? Heehee. Because you're like me - when you feel bad, it shows in your expression.

*sigh*... Am I doing the "cool role model" thing right? I feel like people don't think I'm someone they can rely on... You think I'll find out by instead relying on them for a while? Okay, in that case... Can I rely on you, Commander?

It's exhausting always trying to be there for everyone... But, as long as I have you, I'll always get back up whenever I'm near my breaking point. It's like you, uhh, refill my energy and confidence... I suppose? Heehee~ You're my bosom buddy, Commander♪

For you to acknowledge me in this way is the highest honor in my opinion... Will things stay the same, moving forward? Of course! I'll do whatever you ask, whenever you ask! Maybe I'll even ask you for something from time to time... Heehee♪
For me? Oh, it's not that I don't like it... Quite the opposite, I love it! H-hehe...

ex.line: Here's your daily cup of hot milk. Enjoy it, and then let's get to work♪

I'm glad to have someone to rely on, but I feel bad doing it when the Commander already has so much work to do... Ugghh... I won't work this out myself. Guess I should ask Trento and the girls for advice...
I should probably make some time for just you and me so I can carry on my always-there role model attitude. But... then it's like I'm keeping you all to myself...
Some girls love doting on you, and some love being doted on by you... I'm not sure how to put it, I just feel a little nagged about that...
Yes? Do you want me to pamper you? Heehee.
Indulge yourself as much as you want♪
You have a mission. How about we complete it together for a change of pace?
Mission done and dusted. You're awesome, Commander! Come here for a hug... The rest of you will get one later♪
You've been out on nonstop sorties lately, haven't you? So here, I sorted your paperwork to make it easier to read. That should extend your break by a solid ten minutes. Heehee.
Commission completed. I'll tally up the rewards for you.
I'm fine, because I have the Commander with me!
Now this is how a role model rolls! Heehee~

lines.line: "I'm your stewardess, Andrea Doria, here to ensure you have a pleasant flight"... Did I sound natural, Commander? ...Still a bit on the stiff side, huh? *sigh*, this job really isn't easy for first-timers...

"I'm your stewardess, Andrea Doria, here to ensure you have a pleasant flight"... Did I sound natural, Commander? ...Still a bit on the stiff side, huh? *sigh*, this job really isn't easy for first-timers...
Commander, we're landing soon, so fasten your seatbelt. Should I take your bags and stow them away for you?
"Thank you for flying with us today"... Uhh, do you think my delivery is okay? I'm new to this and I don't wanna screw up...
"I'll now demonstrate how to use a life jacket"... Erm, Commander, how do I do this again?
What drink would you like - juice, coffee, or soda? I have hot milk as well, of course.
You there, please keep quiet on the aircraft! I'll get the Commander if you don't simmer down.
Give me a call if you ever need anything.
I told you to stop being naughty, Commander...
What the...? Is this compartment broken? The door won't close... Commander, could you help me out there?
The commission team has come back? Let's bring them some drinks as a show of thanks!
Capitani Romani-class large destroyer - Attilio Regolo.

My name is Attilio Regolo, and I'm a Capitani Romani-class destroyer from the Sardegna Empire! Don't you think a shipgirl and her Commander are like a fairy tale princess and her knight? Though some seem to think we're the knights, while you're the princess...
Vowed to protect me forever, and bound by the red string... You are my fated knight, Commander! Finally, I found you! Hehe, go on—welcome me to your castle!
Commander, I lined up your paperwork like paper soldiers for you! Now you just gotta knock 'em out!
Commander, you gotta protect all of our friends in the castle, too! You're so cool and strong, I know you can do it!
I hope the Onion Monster and Evil Pepper don't show up in my lunch tomorrow... B-but I know you'll save me, Commander!
Commander, I'll rub your shoulders for you! Let me and the cute bunnies soothe you together.
I love your castle, Commander! I can play with the bunnies and kitties whenever I want, I don't have to go anywhere far, and I don't have to be in the sun!
Ehehe... Squishy...
Come play with me and the bunnies!
Hahahahaha~ Th-that tickles~
What's a mish-shun? Does that mean I'll get a reward if I help with work?
Commander, our rewards came! Let's go take 'em into our castle!
Commander, you got a letter! I'm like a bunny delivering mail!
Commander, you're back! Hey, did you meet the Dolphin Knights and Captain Shark? I wanna know all the fun stuff you've been up to outside of our castle!
The older girls brought lots of stuff back! Were they out adventuring?
I'm getting stronger!
Watch this! I'll drive off all those baddies!
We won! My friends and I really trounced those baddies!
F-forget that just happened! Next time, you and I are gonna teach them a lesson!
I'm not gonna lose!
Whoa, whoa! I'm gonna lose to the baddies...!
C-Commander, are you actually a minion of the Onion Monster?!
Mr. Birdy, come down here! I'll give you some tasty dried fish! ...Hmm. Why do they always fly away as soon as they're done eating?
Commander, look! Here's the White Bunny, here's the Black Bunny, and here's Duke Monochrome Bunny! Captain Kitty and the Manjuu Guard are here, too! Everyone, let's have fun with the Commander!
The Black Bunny and White Bunny play every day, so they're the bestest friends! You and I play every day, too, which also makes us the bestest friends!

All the good people should be happy, all the bad people should get punished and learn to be better, and everyone who loves each other should end up together... That's what I want. What about me? Hehehe, as long as I'm with you, I already have what I want!

Hehe, I love you, Commander! Hey, can you squat down for a sec? There you go... Now I can give you a big kiss on the cheek! Mmm-mwah! We're gonna live together forever, just like the princes and princesses of fairy tales~
Whoa! You mean this is for me? It's so cute!
You go, Captain Pompey! You're the coolest knight in the castle!
Whoooa, you've got bunny ears! Can I touch them?

ex.line: Commander, I missed you so much! Hehehe, huggies, huggies!
Commander, let my bunnies soothe you! Hup... Commander secured! Do you mind if I keep hugging you?
With the Commander by my side, I'm a real princess! Hehehe, I love you, Commander!
Hehe, you're my favorite person to play with!
This feels weird... I dunno how to feel about it...
We have lots of mish-shuns to do! Let's do our best and get lots and LOTS of rewards!
Commander, we've got rewards! Yay, hooray!

lines.line: Welcome to my humble abode! Bunnies, kitty-cats, and the Commander... The gang's all here! Today's tale is gonna be a wild one!
Welcome to my humble abode! Bunnies, kitty-cats, and the Commander... The gang's all here! Today's tale is gonna be a wild one!
You're just in time, Commander! Sit right there, okay? I wanna draw you all chibified and cute! It won't take long.
You write the words, and I'll draw the pictures! We'll make a really happy story together!
If you turned into a kitty, I'd be able to snuggle and pet you all I wanted... Heehee!
Vice Captain Pen, it's up to you! Aww, I wish you could just draw in my place...
Kitties and bunnies, get along, okay? Whoa! Don't scratch the bunny's ears! And no jumping around my desk, either!
Hey, what is a princess carry like? I wanna be princess carried!
Hahahaha, haha... Haha... C'mon, that tickles!
Commander! Y-you're good at computers, right? It's not working... D-did I make it mad, or something?
I wanted to try making a fairy-tale entrance. Did I look good, Commander? When you saw me come down from the sky, did you sense destined romance?!
I wanted to try making a fairy-tale entrance. Did I look good, Commander? When you saw me come down from the sky, did you sense destined romance?!
Commandeeer! Heheh, it's time to jump into fairy tales. Hurry up and take my hand!
Hmm... Y'know, I think it would be cooler if we could swap how we appear. Seeing you descend from on high... Heheh, just imagining it is exciting!
I've been practicing a lot so you can see my cutest side! ...You think I look like a real angel? Hehehe~
Whoa, my parasol's making a weird noise... Am I gonna fall if it breaks?
With Duke Monochrome Rabbit~ We part the clouds and light up the day~ To my fated one, I'm on my way~
Floaty, airy... Commander, do you like this? Wanna try it?
Ahahaha... Come on, that tickles! I'm gonna lose balaaance!
Commander, you've got letters! Don't I look like a mail delivery girl now? Heheh!
Commander, welcome back! Heheh, what do you think? I bet you never get tired of seeing me float down from above!
For me, being with you is the greatest joy of all! My heart feels even fluffier than a cloud... Hehe... This is the kind of love you see in fairy tales, isn't it?
Zara-class heavy cruiser - Gorizia.

I'm Gorizia, Zara-class heavy cruiser. I fought hard in the war, but didn't achieve anything you could call career-defining. People say I'm very lucky, having survived an attack unscathed even though I didn't move an inch. I'm not sure how to feel about that...

Ahh, we finally meet, my dear Commander. Yes, I am Sardegna's heavy cruiser Gorizia, your one true- Uh, excuse me? Aren't you supposed to say, "Gorizia, I've been waiting so long for you" right about now?!
Oh, you poor thing, you look exhausted... Please share your pain with me and ease the burden on your- E-excuse me? You want me to, umm, sort paperwork?
*stares princessly*... (Should I break the silence? No, wait, the Commander should be the first to speak... Alright! I'll wait as long as it takes!) *continues staring*...
I don't get hurt easily because of my nature, but it sometimes makes people avoid me... They say I'm too different.
Isn't it the norm to chat about stuff to break the ice during downtime like this? Why isn't the Commander paying attention to me?
(I said I'd watch a play with Bolzano on our next day off... That being the case, I've got to figure out some way to catch the Commander's notice!)
(I hope the Commander will keep patting my head if I pretend not to notice...♪)
What is it? Oh... Do you have something to tell me?
Whuh?! Wh-what's gotten into you?!
New missions have come in. Oh, my dear Commander, will you let me decide which one to complete first?
(The Commander's attention is solely on the rewards, not the fact I helped retrieve them...) Huh? Oh, please, it was nothing. You don't need to shower me with praise.
(Where's the love letter I sneakily left on the Commander's desk... Wait, what? Did it get lost under the new mail?)
Oh. Welcome back. Thank goodness you're still in one piece... Um, can't you react to me coming here just for you with a little more emotion?
A commission's been completed. Aren't you going to thank the team in person? ...Y-you're going alone?
Thank you for making me stronger, but I wish you'd be a little more... gentle, I guess...
Me, of all people, being sent into battle?!
I daresay I did pretty well. *stares princessly*
An unfortunate setback... but, I'll get back on my feet!
Now I'M going to hit them!
How have I been hit this much?!
So this is it... This is who my true love is... *sniffle*...
*stares princessly*... (The Commander isn't coming any closer... Why not? Is this not the perfect time to invite a lady to dinner?)
Do you take me for an easy flirt? You're very mistaken! I won't be courted with merely an intent gaze... What I'm saying is, I'm not going to open up until you start getting on my good side!
The Commander still hasn't floated the idea of a date... My feelings should be clear as day, and yet... Maybe I need to give up on playing hard to get...?
Umm, my dear Commander, if you're free then why don't we go somewhere? Anywhere is fine, even within the port! I know a place with a good view, and also tons of great date spots Pola told me about!
You finally came forth and did it! I'm so happy... So happy I could cry! Now we can be lovey-dovey all day when- Oh, forgive me, I haven't answered yet! Yes! I will, gladly!
Oh, thank you, Commander! *sniffle*... I'll cherish this!
I can't simply sit back while you take the spotlight!

ex.line: *fidget, fidget*... Where's my good-morning kiss? ...You need time to gather your courage? Come ooon!
*stares coquettishly*... Hm? What is it? ...You want to go somewhere with me since the weather is nice today? Oh, um... Yes, I'd love to!
If you ever end up in danger, I'll protect you. Don't worry, I could stand completely still and not get hit.
I-if you don't know what to talk about, do you mind if I pick a topic, my dear Commander?
M-my dear Commander... could you keep doing that? Just for a little longer...
I'll be counting on you to escort me today, my dear Commander.
It's not me you want, but this, right? ...You're so predictable... *blushes*
Hey, mission complete. Y-you could praise me a little, you know...
Welcome back, my dear Commander! I'm glad you're safe! I've been here, praying for you the whole- Err, of course I've made you something to eat!
The commission goods, my dear Commander.
Please tell me you're watching, my dear Commander...
Tell me how magnificent I am! Heheh!

lines.line: These stockings are so annoying to wear... Mmrgh... *sigh*. You can't give up already, Gorizia. If you want the Commander's attention... this is what you have to do!
These stockings are so annoying to wear... Mmrgh... *sigh*. You can't give up already, Gorizia. If you want the Commander's attention... this is what you have to do!
(Working late into the night while my beloved boss just... Gosh, enough of that! I need to finish my tasks quickly so I can chat with the Commander!)
I can help if you have too much work on your plate, my dear Commander. Just say the word. Even if we can't finish everything, I'll stay right here with you!
(I think I've put on weight again... Why did I bluff about it and let Zara pick a size that's too small for me...)
Once I wrap this task up, I'm going to muster my courage and ask out the Comma- Huh? You're working overtime today?
It's just me and the Commander now... If it wasn't for these damn stockings I could try to make a move... *sigh*...
Y-you'll show me how it's done? ...Hm? On the contrary; you need my help?
Y-you like this kind of stuff? I... I'm so done with you, perv!
That sound again... Must be a new message.
Did your operation go well? Oh, and don't worry, I completed all my office work while you were away♪
Oh nooo, how aaawful, I've been captured, and my suit is toootally in pieces... W-wait, why can't I break free? This ruins my plan of intentionally getting caught to perform an investigation...
Oh nooo, how aaawful, I've been captured, and my suit is toootally in pieces... W-wait, why can't I break free? This ruins my plan of intentionally getting caught to perform an investigation...
...This is the part where you look down at me with that penetrating gaze and say, "Gorizia, all your efforts were in vain," and... Huh? My dear Commander, why are you laughing?
*stares princessly*... You're gathering intel on me, and I'm doing the same on you, my dear Commander.
This isn't exactly what I planned, but it's not so bad since I get to chat with you face-to-face... If nothing else, your eyes are glued to me now.
*stares princessly*... (What are you doing, Commander? Have you noticed me? I'm here! Look at me!)
Huh? My USB stick! It's going to slip out! *huff*... *puff*... Ugh! This is getting out of hand!
I'm only not fighting back because I'm tied up. Th-this totally doesn't feel nice or anything... Are you really not going to touch me anymore?
You're going to untie me? ...Wait, why did you pull your hands back?
I-if you push me any further, I'll... Eek!
D-did you come back so soon because you worried about me? Oh, right! I definitely wasn't scouring the room in secret, and I certainly didn't put any confidential data on this USB stick.
I still won even while tied up like this. It's no big deal. *stares princessly*...
Th-this won't do! A professional spy shouldn't let her heart race as soon as her target walks into the room!
La Galissonnière-class light cruiser - Marseillaise.

I am La Galissonnière-class light cruiser Marseillaise, the Iris's fighting angel. I feel no fatigue, fear no pain, and swing my blade only to uphold peace and justice. I am resolute in my belief that one day, all unrighteousness in the world shall be vanquished.
I am Marseillaise, fighting angel of Iris Orthodoxy. Speak to me your orders, Commander.
I, the fighting angel Marseillaise, await my Commander's arrival.

An awe-inspiring melody can inspire soldiers to carry out their sacred duties. Commander, I would like to bring this song to the battlefield- Oh, um... Actually, do you find the fact that my rigging can play music strange, by any chance?
Sincerest apologies. Though I may be your secretary ship, I am unable to assist in your sacred charge... If only I possessed skills outside of combat...
La Galissonnière? Sure, she can be a bit of a pain at times... but it doesn't matter. That Tribunal girl is no match for the fighting angel.
Is the R&D department busy right now? I suppose it'll have to wait until next time then... Oh, it's nothing. I simply wanted to ask for some advice.
For justice, peace, and the Holy Iris, I shall carry out your will.
Hmm? Commander? I'm not sure I understand the meaning of this...
A new mission? There has to be something I can do to help, right...
Mission complete. I shall escort you as you go to retrieve the rewards.
You have mail, Commander. Shall I open it up using my blade?
So this is how you raise the morale of your troops... I would expect nothing less of my Commander.
Commission complete. A hard-fought victory... Hmm? Did you not risk life and limb to seize these from the enemy?
Peace and justice are sacred duties that cannot be accomplished through ideals alone.
All those who would oppose the Orthodoxy... must be eradicated.
The Iris's sacred blade annihilates all who would oppose the Orthodoxy.
Bitter... defeat... I am sorry to have let you down.
Marchons!
I shall uphold my sacred duties, until the very end!
Commander, you are the last person I wish to consider an enemy... Please repent, and be born anew.

I hope that I may become a source of inspiration for my compatriots, just as the name bestowed upon me implies. Raising the banner, standing on the front lines, cleaving a path forward- Heeding the will of the divine, I shall lead us to victory.
Both Iris Libre and the Vichya Dominion were once parts of the same Iris Orthodoxy... Here, at this port, my friends are able to come together once more. Thank you so much, Commander.
I hardly know anything that does not pertain to fighting... I'd appreciate it if you could instruct me, but... where would I even start? Umm, I don't even have much experience in being taught...
S-sincerest apologies. I've caused you nothing but trouble since my arrival... But despite that, I've never had so much fun before. If at all possible... I'd like these times to continue forever.

I, the fighting angel Marseillaise, swear upon this blade: as long as I still draw breath, I will protect my beloved Commander from all enemies, and punish all those who seek to harm us in the name of the Holy Iris.
Thank you. I'll keep it safe.
Please, La Galissonnière, show some more dignity!
It is an honor to stand alongside the Cardinal.
I'll leave the other half of enemies to you, let's wrap up this battle swiftly!
La Pucelle, let us both fight for the Iris Orthodoxy!
So, you stand with the Iris Orthodoxy this time...
Just as you believed, hope has arrived!

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I've already prepared the tea... Huh? Wasn't I supposed to pour the leaves into the cup? I thought it would be best to fill it up as much as possible...
Affixing your stamp here signifies your approval, right? In that case... Umm, does multiple stamps signify strong approval?
If we were to further retrofit this rigging and amplify the volume... Alright, let's give it a try right now!
You want me to fold you within my wings...?
I don't quite understand, but... if it pleases you, that makes me glad...
So, it's possible to open the letter without using my blade after all... I understand now.
Commander, how are you able to inspire our friends to such an extent? Every time we go on a sortie, I find myself thinking about it.

For someone like me who knows nothing outside of battle, being able to experience so many different things... makes me truly happy whenever we do things together, Commander. Might this be... true love?

lines.line: Alright, aim at this part of the ball, and drop my hips... Nngh?! I, I'm alright! The fighting angel, Marseillaise, will not be defeated by this... Hyeep?!
Alright, aim at this part of the ball, and drop my hips... Nngh?! I, I'm alright! The fighting angel, Marseillaise, will not be defeated by this... Hyeep?!
Are we going to train together again today? I do hope I'm not inconveniencing you, Commander...
I cannot strictly rely on my rigging to fight; I must also train my body to respond to various situations, just as you said.
If only I could spread these wings, those mistakes could've been avoidable- Hmm? That doesn't count as training? I understand...
Hmm... Commander, how does this look? Umm, if you could give me some tips on how to improve my posture...
Many of my friends listen to music while working out. Haha, I really want to ask around and see what they're listening to.
Phew... Sorry, I'll go wipe off my sweat now...
Even though you're helping me... Nngh... This is still difficult...
Umm, maybe like this... Eek?! ...Oh, Commander, thank you very much. You've completed another one of your sacred trials of combat, yes?
Phew. May the Holy Iris bless you-
Joffre-class aircraft carrier - Painlevé.

I am aircraft carrier Painlevé, and I stand here only because of wishes. Making our wishes come true isn't easy - it comes with sacrifices and regrets. But despite all that, we can never stop wishing.
I am the second Joffre-class aircraft carrier of the Iris Libre, Painlevé. It is a pleasure to meet you... May you and your companions receive the Iris's protection.
Oh, Commander... I'm not done praying yet. If you don't mind... could you please wait a bit?
Only by truly wishing for it can we continue to reach greater heights. Commander, as someone who travels with the blessing of the Holy Iris at your back, do not forget this.
Commander, making wishes isn't all-powerful. Don't make too many wishes, or you may invite divine retribution...
Commander? The thing is, I... No, never mind. Forget I said anything...
Astrology, tarot cards, tasseography, bagua... Which one should I choose today?
Commander... Is there something you want me to do?
S-sorry! I don't really want that right now...
Missions... I wonder if there's a lucky process to them. Oh, what I mean is, maybe there's a specific order you can do them in to make good things happen, or... something.
Our missions are all done. Did my lucky process work for you? Maybe you got more rewards than usual, or...?
New mail... *sigh*... I hope it's good news.
I've been praying here ever since you left, Commander. ...Oh, and I prepared drinks and snacks, too. Would you like to partake together?
Our commission team is back. I sent them off with today's lucky item, so I'm sure they bring great results!
Umm... if this is your wish...
Today is a lucky day, I'm certain... Everything will be okay!
Our prayers... have been answered.
Why...? Were my prayers not enough? Did I miss some sort of ill omen?
This, too, is the Holy Iris's wish-
Answer my prayers...!
Ever since I met you, I've noticed so many more ill omens. Why could that be...?
Ah... Umm... Yes, I understand your wish. As for me, I'd prefer to maintain an appropriate distance...
Please accept this blessed lucky item. ...Yes, I'm certain that it'll bring you good fortune!
You always know exactly what I'm thinking, Commander. Hahaha, you know... I don't mind the feeling of having someone see through me without so much as a word.
Whenever I pray, images of you well up in my mind. I always end up looking forward to it... Wh-what am I saying right now?!

I have more wishes than I can count, but right now... Heehee, there's only one on my mind, and it's about to come true. Commander, thank you for making my dream a reality. I'm so glad... I came to love you.
I've never said that I wanted this, so how did you... Th-thank you very much!
Our trial... has begun!
T-to the Templar Knights' triumphant return!

ex.line: Oh, wow... I just happened to think of you while I was praying, and there you are... Heehee.
What do you wish for, Commander? ...N-no, you don't have to tell me! Heehee, it's just that I heard that if you and your loved one wish for the same thing, it helps you grow even closer...
The luckiest time to set sail is... any time, of course!♪ Haha, I'm kidding. Any time you set sail is a lucky time, Commander—I'm constantly wishing for your good fortune.
My wish... Umm, my wish is... for you to... N-no! I shouldn't be greedy...
U-umm... It's not a good idea to meet the Commander today? That can't be... There must be a mistake here.
Okay, but just a little...
I'm wearing a lucky color today... if you get what I mean...
Thank you for helping the one I love triumph... O-oh, you heard that? I'm sorry, I didn't mean to be embarrassing...
Commander, shall we greet the commission team together? ...Oh, can't leave without my lucky item... There! That should be today's.
You and I wish for each other's happiness, and our two wishes intertwine to make one. That's what gives us this dreamlike, blissful time together. I'm glad I fell for you, Commander...

lines.line: Phew... Commander...? Would you like to... hnnngh... stretch with me? Don't worry, it won't hurt. We have plenty of time, so we can take it slow...
Phew... Commander...? Would you like to... hnnngh... stretch with me? Don't worry, it won't hurt. We have plenty of time, so we can take it slow...
Oh, good morning. You're just in time for today's calisthenics session, Commander.
This pose is a little embarrassing, isn't it... Oh, i-it's okay! I wasn't telling you to look away...
Commander, can you push down on my back please? Yes, just a little more...
It's okay, just relax a little more... Heehee, this is important for stretching.
C-Commander? What was that crack I just heard? Are you... okay...?
I-I don't think I have that much extra fat there...
S-sorry... I'm all soaked with sweat...
Relax your body now, and... Hnnngh!
Mm... Aah, that hits the spot! I just hope my prayers are answered and it suits the Commander's tastes... Heehee, maybe if I personally feed-eep?! C-Commander? D-did you just hear that...?
Mm... Aah, that hits the spot! I just hope my prayers are answered and it suits the Commander's tastes... Heehee, maybe if I personally feed-eep?! C-Commander? D-did you just hear that...?
Welcome back, Commander. My prayers have made this parfait even more delicious, so please, eat up. ...Okay, open up, and I'll feed you.
You have a little request? And the request is that you want to feed me? I-I see... Come to think of it, I happened to have a similar little request...
Commander, umm... N-no, I shouldn't be greedy... b-but I want to be with you forever... *blush*
You want to talk about wishes again? Heehee, tell me one of yours. I'll do my best to help you achieve it.
The shape of the melted parfait can divine today's fortune... Umm, today, let's see... Oh! It's a very lucky day for a date!
Does this mean... you like my new outfit?
U-umm... I'm going to spill my ice cream!
It's almost that lucky time of day... Commander, I think you'll see great success if you do your missions now.
Did you see great success in your missions?! So the lucky time really did help! Thank goodness.
W-welcome back, Commander. ...You're wondering why I haven't eaten any? I just thought it'd be better if I waited for you to get back so we could eat together... *blush*
Has the commission team returned? Umm... Here's today's lucky item. When you go greet them, please bring one of these back.
Commander, I have something important to share. In the time we spent together, I've gained a new wish. A sweet, happy wish... A wish about the two of us.
Suffren-class heavy cruiser - Suffren.

I'm Suffren, the lead ship of my class. There are a few minor differences between me and my sisters, but that doesn't really matter since we're all Suffren-class at the end of the day! Always a pleasure to chat with you, Commander!
I'm Suffren, Iris Libre Templar Knight! You can finally rest easy, Commander! There'll be no more problems ever again now that your lady knight in shining armor has arrived!
*yaaawn*... Whuh? Commander? W-wow, so you're an early bird! I'm proud of you!
While I'm usually super nice, I've earned the nickname "Admiral Satan" from how terrifying I am when I'm ticked off! Like this - grrr! Isn't that scary?
*yaaawn*... Mgh... The port on the whole is pretty great, but I wish I could sleep in a hammock rather than a bed... Hmph. I like hammocks more than beds, that's all.
What's nice about being a Templar Knight is how few rules dictate what and when you can eat. You can't fight on an empty stomach, after all.
Commander, know that I'm right here if you need to get something off your chest. You and Iris Libre will always have a friend in me♪
Whuh?! Stop whatever you're doing!
Commander? You got something you wanna tell me?
That's weird... Could've sworn I was about the same size as Foch...
Ah, missions... Get 'em done quick, Commander! I don't want you working late into the night; it's bad for you.
Mission rewards have arrived. Hope dinner tonight is gonna be something special♪
You've got a letter. By the Holy Iris, let this be good news... Okay. You can open it now.
Great work on that sortie! Sit down and have a think about the battle! Your documents are right- Uhh, I... I don't know where they are... Ahaha...
The commission team's back with rewards. Go on and accept 'em, Commander.
Thanks, Commander! I'll do my best to live up to your hopes♪
Get ready to cross swords with a Templar Knight!
See? The Suffren class means business! Ahahah! I'm always happy to assist♪
Commander, it's time for a tactical retreat! We'll get 'em another time!
Now's your chance if you want to surrender!
A Templar Knight does not tremble!
I don't want to lash out at you, Commander. Get your act together.
Feels kinda weird that you're looking after me. I mean, I don't hate it or anything... It's just, y'know, I'm usually the one looking after others, since I'm a big sister figure and all.
Assisting with your work, protecting you when a battle breaks out... Yeah, the stuff I can do for you is pretty much the same as anyone else... What can I do to stand out?
Gimme just a minute, Commander. Your fair and reliable Suffren is gonna cook you a delicious- Oh nooo! I burned the ingredients! And I forgot to turn off my vacuum cleaner! Commander, help!
I'm an elegant Templar Knight and a reliable big sister - it takes more than one little failure to break my spirit! So, Commander, tell me what you need! I want to show you how far I've come!

You wanna exchange vows? Perfectly fine by me♪ Heehee~ I get to look after you for the rest of our days, and you can enjoy being spoiled rotten - it's a total win-win! ...Sounds completely focused on you? Well, I love you, so I can't help it!
Wow! How'd you know I liked this so much? A-am I that easy to read...?
Foch, be careful when you throw that thing!

ex.line: Huh? Commander? You ruined everything! I was gonna get up early for once and surprise you!
Hmph. Feels like you've been looking after ME all the time lately... I just want the chance to shine on my own once in a while.
The bed at your place is way cozier than any hammock I've been in... Am I just not used to sleeping in beds?
Me, Foch, and some other friends are going shopping on our next day off. You wanna come with us, Commander? Heehee~ We'll stop by loads of good restaurants along the way.
Commander, I'm always here if you want someone to talk to... *tummy rumble*... Perfect timing! Let's have a chat while we munch on some sweets!
You wanna shoot the breeze? Sure♪ Let's talk about whatever!
Hey, uh, Commander, groping 'em that hard won't make 'em bigger!
Mission rewards have arrived. Now the question is - what're you making tonight, Commander?
Well fought out there! Your documents are on your desk - read 'em before you review your battle! Oh, and I didn't forget to make you tea and snacks♪
I'm Templar Knight Suffren, the beautiful, awesome, and reliable big sister - who else?
Commander, are you ready to get coddled and looked after? 'Cause today, you're gonna see a different side of me♪ Heehee♡

lines.line: Hm? The door's open! ...Commander? Oh, ahaha... Silly me, I should've put up a card with "occupied" on it... Then again, I... I guess I don't mind if you're the one who sees me~
Hm? The door's open! ...Commander? Oh, ahaha... Silly me, I should've put up a card with "occupied" on it... Then again, I... I guess I don't mind if you're the one who sees me~
Hang on, Commander! You can't go out now, or you'll look so suspicious! For now, uhh, you should just lock the door and wait it out in here!
Thoughts, Commander? You don't get to see me in this outfit any day. Heheh. Truth be told, I'm just as fashion-savvy as Foch or Algérie!
Commander, are you good or bad at sports? Not any one in particular; I mean on the whole. I'm just curious.
Oh, I know. Since you're already here, you should get changed and exercise with me! Then nobody will suspect anything! ...You doubt it?
Dunkerque is an evil woman... She's always making tons of delicious pastries, I tell you! She has no idea how hard I have to fight the urge to eat them! It suuucks!
I'd be lying if I said I don't mind this at least a little... but it's just you, so it's fine! I think so, anyway...
C-cut it out, Commander! I can't undress while you're doing that!
I know you're not peeping, but this still feels weird... Hey, wait, there's no point in leaving NOW!
The commission team is back? Let me get changed real- Uhh, my zipper's stuck...
They served us this elegant victory on a platter! Heheh!

Oh, Commander. Were you waiting for little old me? You've gotta take your time sorting out your dress if you wanna look snazzy! Heheh, feast your eyes on this cute little kni- Uhh, how are you supposed to tie this thing?

Oh, Commander. Were you waiting for little old me? You've gotta take your time sorting out your dress if you wanna look snazzy! Heheh, feast your eyes on this cute little kni- Uhh, how are you supposed to tie this thing?
C-Commander! Give me a minute! Your knight needs to make herself look pretty for... Dammiiit! Forget it - help me ooout!
If you need to rest, you can come and do it here. Your charming- I mean, your dependable Templar Knight will shield you! ...That's not what you need?
If I'd known you'd see me in an embarrassing spot like this, I would've asked Foch or someone else for help... I really fumbled this one...
You think I look like something out of a painting? In that case... Heehee♥ How does this look, then? Is that pushing any of your buttons?
Having a few is fine and all, but don't drink TOO much, okay? ...Yeah, partly for the obvious health reasons, but mainly because I don't wanna have to carry you home in this outfit!
H-hey! I JUST got it to look good!
Hey, you, Commander! I'm ready to hear what you think about my dress!
C-Commander?! Y-you know, it's pretty cramped if we both sit here...
As reward for all your hard work... how about a night together with your charming knight?
Oh, Commander! You must be tired after that sortie! You should fetch that wine and steak for me so I... I-I mean so YOU can eat it! I'm not saying I want to, not at all! Probably not...
Commission rewards have arrived? Then let's go speak to theEEEEM! Geesh, I nearly tripped!
I feel a bit different today, don't I? Heh!

You're so cool and reliable, and I need to act all pretty and adorable to match that! Come on, picture it - me, taking you by the hand and leading you to... Wait, what? How come even I can't imagine it anymore?!
Vauquelin-class destroyer - Kersaint.
I am Kersaint, Vauquelin-class large destroyer of the Vichya Dominion. In Toulon during the war, I was forced alongside Tartu and others to... Oh, maybe my prayers weren't fervent enough...
I'm Kersaint, a Vauquelin-class large destroyer. May the Iris bless you, Commander... And may you patiently lead me despite my shortcomings...
I devote this prayer to the pure, divine Iris. Please let this day be a peaceful one, and please give the Commander your sacred blessing...
How many times do I pray per day? Well, once at dawn, once at sunrise, every few hours, in the evening before I go to bed... Eight, maybe?
Hmm, can I put the documents... over here? Hup... I hope this makes your work easier, Commander.
If I'm a distraction, um, don't hesitate to say so... With regards to, erm, certain parts of me...
I get so antsy when you stare at me... Sorry, it's my fault for not being used to this.
I-if you'd have me, Commander, I'm happy to listen to your worries... While I can't guarantee that I'll solve anything, I can at least pray...
A-are my proportions distracting you, Commander...?
Your mission list is here—S-sorry. I didn't touch your hand on purpose, I promise...
Congratulations on your successful holy mission. What should I do with the rewards, Commander?
You've received some letters. Commander, may I ask you to read them...?
Thanks and prayers to the Holy Iris for returning our Commander safely to port. Commander, would you like to... j-join me?
The commission team has returned to us.
My thanks to you, Commander. May the Holy Iris's blessing be upon you.
May the Holy Iris guide us!
The Holy Iris has led us to victory. I'd like to express my sincere gratitude.
M-maybe my proportions aren't built for battle...
O holy light, come to me!
If I keep on praying...!
It's all my fault that you've become so unruly... Urk, all because my prayer wasn't enough...
Compared to the others, I don't know if I have much help to offer you... If I could just pray enough to send you blessings, then maybe...
Sometimes, Tartu asks me how she can be a more gentle, charming woman. Do you have any advice, Commander? It's honestly beyond me...
You think I'm plenty charming already...? I appreciate that, but if that means distracting you from your work, I... Y-you say it's fine?
There may be times when my charms can help you, right, Commander? Okay, th-then please feel free to call on me whenever you please. I'll do anything for you, be it prayers, help, or anything else!
I offer a prayer to the glorious Iris. Please, give me and my Commander eternal happiness... Beloved Commander, please continue to look after me forevermore.
Thank you very much. If you wouldn't mind, an offering for the Iris would be...
I didn't grow like this because I wanted to...
How to be more mature? I don't know why you're asking me...
I hate the limited mobility more than standing out...
Implacable, how can you be so confident...?

ex.line: Let us pray to the shining Iris. Please give us another peaceful, blissful day, and give your sacred blessings to the Commander...
I appreciate your praying with me, b-but don't feel too obligated, okay? It would defeat the point if it caused trouble for you, so... Umm, please forgive me...
(Let this prayer imbue the Commander with focus and inspiration. Please...)
Commander, I noticed you stopped working... Are you distracted by my—Goodness, how can I say such impure things?!
Why do I feel so fidgety? I should be used to being a secretary ship by now...
Confession? Of course. Go ahead and tell me all of your sins, Commander.
C-Commander, get a hold of yourself...

You'd like to pray with me? O-of course you may! Umm... Thank you for protecting us from storms during our voyages, for leading us safely home to port, and for granting my wish to give the Commander faith... U-umm... Forget you heard that last one...
The Commander also helped lead us to victory, so I should thank the Commander, too... Ah, um...

lines.line: Phew... Commander? So the Iris brings us together once again... I-I'm sorry for being so sudden, but... Would you like to join me on my run?
Phew... Commander? So the Iris brings us together once again... I-I'm sorry for being so sudden, but... Would you like to join me on my run?
*gasp*... *gasp*... A prayer to the Holy Iris. Please... let this day be a peaceful one... and give the Commander... boundless energy...
After a run, my daily prayers... Commander—Oh, you're going back to your office? I-I see... Your mornings are busy, after all, so we can't... A-actually, may I come with you?
I'm running, um, for the sake of losing weight... Yes, I feel a little too heavy in some places... What about you, Commander?
Does listening to music make running easier? Hmm... Marseillaise did recommend a hymn to me. Would you like to listen?
Dunkerque's sweets... They do tempt me. As soon as I eat one, I'm hopeless to stop, and I end up falling into sugary hell... Eep...
Is there anywhere you'd like to stop on the way...?
They feel even heavier from all this sweat... Urgh...
Commander, would you like... to keep going? Oh, I mean running, not praying! Sorry. I know you only just got back...
C-Commander, p-please hurry and stop this creature! Otherwise! You might! Get hurt! ...WoooooOOOOAH! Phew... That was a close one... Haah... Praised be the Holy Iris... Urgh...
C-Commander, p-please hurry and stop this creature! Otherwise! You might! Get hurt! ...WoooooOOOOAH! Phew... That was a close one... Haah... Praised be the Holy Iris... Urgh...
Commander, watch out - Hyah?! Why did it calm down as soon as it saw you...? Either way, thank you...
Commander, do you have any tips and tricks on how to tame animals? ...Loving them is important, but so is having the determination to master them? I-I see...
I hear this is an Eagle Union matador's costume... But it's so unlike Europa's. Have we verified that claim...?
You seem even more worried about me since I changed into this outfit. What a sin I've committed...
I should have discussed this with Lady Clemenceau first. If only I knew caring for animals was such a difficult task... No. This must be a trial given to me by the Iris... Right? Right?!
Do you have a confession? O-okay! If you don't mind that I'm dressed like this!
I-I can't move another inch...
Changing the hay, cleaning the stable, the daily milking... There! A complete list of today's holy duties!
Phew... That holy duty was a tough one. Thank you for your efforts, Commander.
Welcome back, Commander. Th-things seem to be fine right now, but if it gets out of hand later... I hope you'll be willing to help again... Oh, me...
I'd better keep this creature in check until the commission team returns... Whoa whoa?!
Oooh... We managed to win, but I'm so dizzy... I think I'm about to faint...
*pant*... It finally calmed down... Ugh, I can't believe this happened...
It may be hard work, but caring for animals is another holy duty. Besides, if it means helping you... I-I'm always happy to put my heart and soul into any task!
Lyon-class battleship - Lyon.
The Iris has guided me, Battleship Lyon, to shepherd the lost and banish the wicked. Let us fight together—and prevent the scourge of the great war that once plagued us from ever occurring again.

May the Iris's absolving light be upon our fleet, and may its solemn judgment find our sinful foes- I, battleship Lyon, hereby rush to your aid, Commander. I pray that the Iris's blessings reach you, wielder of powers unsanctified.
Good day. Would you like to hear the teachings of the Holy Iris?

There may be little demand, but if anybody from the port wishes to repent... Rather, if anyone needs guidance, please let me know. Hm? You already have others doing the same thing? I'm happy to hear that.
By performing good deeds, showing gratitude to others, and being compassionate to the weak... You, too, can be saved even without faith, Commander.
You look like you're struggling with some difficult dilemmas... Should we perform the rite of wisdom? It might be able to help you.
Holy knight Saint Louis... She may be skilled at arbitration, but I think I have her just barely beat in that regard. Heehee!
Yes? I'm happy to offer you guidance.
What are the motives behind this action? I'd love to know.
Uncompleted missions await you. I think you'd best clean them up quickly.
You have rewards waiting. Ensure that you do not forget to offer gratitude upon receiving them.
You have mail. I pray that it's good news.
Our victory is all thanks to divine guidance. Before we look back upon our victory, let us offer a prayer of gratitude.
Our fellows who left on a commission have returned. Commander, you confirm the rewards, and I shall thank them for their work.
I'm stronger now. You have my gratitude, Commander.
Let the Festival of Lights commence!
Please forgive me, merciful Iris, for I need this strength to topple our foes.
Remain calm and withdraw. Our sacred duty has only just begun.
All I do is for the sake of destroying the enemies of the Iris.
Please, give me the strength to overcome this peril!
Do not deviate from the righteous path. If the time comes when I must destroy you, I will show no mercy.
Sincere and righteous deeds will be repaid, both in prayer and in everyday relationships. Even without complex rituals, others will feel your love for them.

Rituals and ceremonies often become complex as a direct result of the feelings in them. We know in our hearts that such things are unnecessary, but we can't stop ourselves from trying to show off. Maybe that's just what it means to be human.

I admire you as much as anyone else, so I understand the desire to work hard and earn your attention. Hahaha, don't think too much of it. No matter how it ends up happening, I'm certain that your love will come across just fine.
Commander, did you get a glimpse of my feelings for you? Heehee, I won't let you lie about that. If you value appearances so much... then I'm happy to stick to you like glue all day and night.

Now, we must exchange eternal vows in this blessed place and tie our sacred bond with a kiss. Don't be so nervous, now. I'm excited, too, because I get to perform this ceremony for myself for once... Heehee.
Ooh! Ah... I'm sorry. I seem to have lost my composure upon seeing this.

ex.line: Good day. Would you like to hear the teachings of... Hahaha, lovely. Then I'll put you on my schedule after work.
Whether you're struggling or not, please know that you can tell me anything. ...Yes, sometimes, I just want to chat with you. Heehee, is that so wrong?
Are you listening to Richelieu? May I join you...? I happen to be capable of jealousy, too, you know.
My favorite animal? Lions, I say. They're brave and dignified, much like my beloved Commander. Hahaha!
If you're tired, then let me take over. I want to do more for you than just pray.
If you don't mind, I'd love to share my troubles, too.
I understand that you want to be pampered. If you think I'm up to the job, then I'm willing to help any time.
I would like to thank my allies for carrying out this sacred duty, and my beloved Commander who led us. ...Heehee, is something wrong? I didn't say anything strange, did I?
Geez, Commander. I'm glad we won, too, but we shouldn't get too excited over it.

lines.line: Mmh... Pilates may be easy to learn, but it seems difficult to master... Are you still okay, Commander? Me? I-I can keep going...
Mmh... Pilates may be easy to learn, but it seems difficult to master... Are you still okay, Commander? Me? I-I can keep going...
Do you have it in you to keep going, Commander? If it gets too strenuous, just say the word...
Did you know that this exercise is also called Contrology? It's all about using ideal posture and exercise to control your body and mind... I can see why it's such a profound field.
(The neck is fine, but it's a little tight around my chest... Am I doing something wrong...?)
(Now that I really think about it, this pose is really embarrassing. But the Commander is watching, so I can't just stop... Should I stay like this...?)
(The Commander took time out to exercise with me, so it'll all go to waste if I yield first... Okay. I'll just wait for the Commander to suggest we take a break.)
(Hmm... How long is it going to take before I can do this stretch correctly...?)
Ah?! ...Commander, no more of that, please...
Missions...? Of course. Once we're done here, let's check them out right away.
Mission rewards? Aren't these a touch too luxurious as a reward for simple effort? Heehee.
(The Commander is out of breath, too... I may be tired from battle, but I'm still happy to be able to sweat with you. Um... I just hope you don't mind the smell...)
The girls out on commission should return soon. If you'd like, we could go and greet them together once we're done here...?
De Grasse-class light cruiser - Guichen.

I'm Guichen, a De Grasse-class anti-aircraft cruiser. As you can see, I'm just your average witch without any history to speak of. But now that I've been given this lovely new home, I'll do my very best to be worthy of it.

I am anti-aircraft cruiser, Guichen. May heaven's blessings be upon you- Though, that doesn't mean much coming from me. Heehee, I am but a humble witch of the Iris Orthodoxy. It's a pleasure to work with you, Commander.
You're a steadfast worker. I wish I could put that much work into my magic research! Ahaha!
Sufficiently advanced technology may look like magic, but there are times when human miracles are treated as sacraments. Don't you find it wonderful that humans can perform such divine works?
Not everyone from the Iris Orthodoxy is necessarily religious. What do they call that again? Stereotyping, right?
I'm a lot better at magic than office work. Casting spells, making dubious potions, riding brooms... Wait, you actually believe me?
Prayer and spells aren't a waste of time if they touch your heart. If anything, aren't miracles only possible because they can be conceived of by human hearts?
You need help with something? I don't mind, though I'm not sure I have much to offer...
You know, there are legends about witches attacking hapless, ordinary people... Want to find out more firsthand?
You have unfinished missions. Some of them might disappear if you ignore them for too long, so are you sure you don't want to give them a second look?
There are rewards here with your name on them. Leave them alone, and they might get away!
Your unread mail is stacking up. Are you trying to act like a big-shot? Why, exactly?
Excellent work. Let's not worry about the battle reports for now; more importantly, find anything interesting?
I wonder if the girls on commission duty will bring any herbs back for me...
Works better than a magic spell. Heehee.
Oh, fine, if I must~ But only a little.
Oh, I'm in first place? Don't show too much favoritism toward me, or the others might get jealous♪
I'll blow my cover if I go all-out, so this is all you get for now~
Magic, or cannons? Heheheh♪
Well, this is a bit of a problem...
Now, now. I'm sure you can recover from this blunder in no time, Commander.
Calling myself a witch of the Iris Orthodoxy... may be a little misleading. I'm just a shipgirl, and one of your subordinates at that. Heehee~♪

People are saying I have a weird cauldron in my room? Well, yes, I have one for boiling down herbs... Why would people spread rumors about that? Is it something about the cauldron, or is it something about me... Heehee. Curious, isn't it?
Welcome to the witch's abode. More normal than you expected? But of course. You treated me as a friend rather than a witch, after all. Or were you hoping to see something more... magical?

As you know, we witches are better at deceiving human hearts than making miracles. In much the same way, I'm going to show you one essence of the magic that is love. Your heart is as good as mine, Commander♪
Hm? You can't move? I wonder why that might be? Heheheh, I won't keep you long, so just do as I say for now. Here... Put on this ring. I got matching ones for us!
This is just delightful. Thank you.
Why don't you show me what you've got?♪
It's about time I pulled out all the stops, too♪

ex.line: Do I seem like I'm in a better mood than usual? Strange... I wonder why? Heehee♪

Do you know about the magic of love? It's like... a miracle that makes it so you can do anything for the person you love. Haha, of course, even you can use this brand of magic... as long as you love me, that is?
The Iris has a lot of surprisingly flexible girls, like Béarn. Did you know that? Ahaha... Well, you are the Commander, after all. I guess that's natural.
Faith is important, but you shouldn't go too far. Even I can't make potions that heal the wounded.
If you need help with love, I'm happy to oblige! Heehee.
Want me to attack you? Either way, I don't mind♪
You know, Commander, I'm always so excited for you to come back. After all, you bring back both victory and delightful stories!
It's about time for the commission team to come back. They're just in time to replenish our materials.
Oh, I'm only MVP because of the Commander's favoritism. It wasn't just my magic at all, haha!

A poor Commander, robbed of bodily control by a devious witch's magic and doomed to be her plaything... It's a tale as old as time. Heehee, why don't I try a few more things while you're still immobile?

lines.line: Advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic—and that goes for this icy stage, too. Commander, please enjoy this demonstration of our heaven-bestowed sacrament until the very end~♪
Advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic—and that goes for this icy stage, too. Commander, please enjoy this demonstration of our heaven-bestowed sacrament until the very end~♪
The gliding Sorcière on Ice... Witness the most artistic of sacraments. Heehee!
Right now, you should be calling me the Sorcière on Ice. ...Too far?♪
I'm going to rehearse with girls from Sardegna later. Any advice? ...No using my magic? Heehee, what could you possibly mean by that?
What's the secret to learning ice skating? Haha, all you have to do is freeze a lake so you can practice in all seasons! ...I'm kidding♪
Commander... Come, dance with me.
Heehee, you caught me, Commander~♪
You'd like another dance? I'm more than happy to join you, if that is what you want. No matter how wonderful a performance may be, it's nothing without an audience.
It's almost time to wake up, dear guest... Don't open those eyes just yet. Let me use my magic to spirit away that last bit of sleepiness.
It's almost time to wake up, dear guest... Don't open those eyes just yet. Let me use my magic to spirit away that last bit of sleepiness.
You were sleeping so comfortably, Commander. Did you have sweet dreams? Good... Now, make your day sweeter with breakfast in bed!
I'm here to give you the relaxing afternoon you've been waiting for... Heehee, when you wake up, I want you to think to yourself, "Oh, I'm being loved and cared for."
Milk, or kisses? Which warmth do you crave right now... Commander?
Which service would you like next? Pudding? Hot milk? A sweet little bedtime story? Or maybe you'd just like me to stay by your side... In that case, I'd feel like I was the pampered one!
Drink slowly so you don't choke, okay? It's okay... As long as I'm around, time will slow down for you, Commander.
Your magical maid is ever by your side.
Is it so hard to resist what your magical maid has to offer...?
You rang my bell. Is there anything you need from your magical maid? Anything goes!
I managed to seize victory even under these circumstances... One must assume it was all thanks to you, Commander.
Well, it looks like I only have one service left for you. Ring this bell, and your personal magical maid will come with pudding, hot milk, and a blanket in hand to give you lots of love!
Are you awake yet, dear guest? My hypnotic magic had quite an effect. Now... Why not try some special milk? It's perfect for a sleepy afternoon.
Commander, Commandeeer, wake up. It's time for an intimate afternoon with your magical maid! Which one do you want first? Milk, or pudding?
Awake yet? Or do you want to nap next to me for a little while longer?
Come a little closer~ Doesn't the pudding smell so sweet and sublime? ...Hmm? The milk? I drank it all♪
