I have a few other magical services, you know. For example... I could cast a spell to put you right back to sleep!
Our public menu only has ordinary services available, but don't worry. Your magical maid has plenty of secret methods to help you relax~
My next service will be even more pleasurable for you~ Oh, but my skin is getting a little dry... Say, dear guest... If you don't mind... Could you help me out a little here?
Heehee, are you satisfied with my spellbinding services?
Ah... Dear guest, you know that touching me won't come cheap♪
Dear guest, lie down next to me... Good. Next, you'll enjoy this delicious pudding~ Open up... Mwah! Perfect♪ Heehee, this is just the start of my private services.
Richelieu-class battleship - Clemenceau.

I am the third of the Richelieu class, the never-completed Clemenceau. Unlike Richelieu and Jean Bart, who made a name for themselves, I was abandoned during that great war. However, my lack of history or honors is also my greatest asset - that's right, nobody ever notices the shadow lurking behind the curtains. Heehee~

If it isn't the Commander! I, Vichya Dominion battleship Clemenceau, am honored to fight by your side. I'm essentially a nobody compared to you and your world-renowned deeds. Now... Before we get to business, do you have any questions for me?
Welcome back, our ever-so-sought-after Commander. Heehee, is there anything I might be able to help you with?

Whenever I want to play with the cute little Meowfficers, they naturally gather around. And as soon as I need to do something else, they will also leave on their own. Heehee... I suppose this is one aspect of me that makes Richelieu and Jean Bart green with envy~

Commander, you are both the director on the stage, as well as the staff working behind the scenes. Which role do you enjoy playing more? Or... does our Commander actually wish to be just another spectator? Heehee~

Enjoying one of the Royal Navy's elegant tea parties or downing vodka with the Northern Parliament are both effective methods of bridging the distance between parties. Though, vodka... can be a bit of a struggle...

Those who do not scheme enjoy the levity that comes with having nothing to worry about, whereas those who do enjoy the fruit borne by their plans. Having that said, it is not my place to judge. Regardless of who we are, we all have our ways of getting along with one another... Wouldn't you agree?
Oh my, Commander. You look like you want to ask something~
Hmm? Commander, do you really want me to exploit your weakness so badly?
There's still work left to finish. I'd assume it has already made its way onto your itinerary, yes?
Mission complete. Yet another item on the itinerary dispatched efficiently... So this is the Commander in work mode.
A new letter has arrived. It's not urgent, so you can take a look after you've finished what you're working on right now.
Shall we review our previous operational strategy? If time permits, why not try to ascertain an alternate possibility?
Take these gifts over to the girls in the commission fleet, won't you? ...Hm? When did I prepare them? Why, is that something you absolutely have to know? Heehee~♪
Commander, don't forget to keep improving yourself as well, alright?
The curtains rise on a splendid play.
With this one additional weight... the scales of victory tip ever in our favor.
Oh my, it seems that I've been bested... But just so you know, I'm the type to hold on to grudges... Heehee~
Attendre et espérer.
Oh my, I seem to have let my guard down.
I see now. So, the upstanding Commander is just a made-up facade? Hmm... Au contraire, I actually find that quite dull.
A person who is worthy of praise and adulation, yet is not revered as an idol... Is it because you walk alongside your troops? Hmm... how thought-provoking.

I see you're on your guard, just as always. Perhaps Jean Bart told you a little thing or two? ...Heehee, just as I thought. Speaking of which, Commander, how did the two of you get on such good terms? I expected her to be quite difficult to get along with, no?

If you don't mind, Commander, could you tell me about some of your likes and hobbies? That way, I would be able to cater to you in all sorts of ways~ Heehee. Even if you don't feel like telling me, I could always ask some of our friends.

This port is truly a battlefield in its own right, seeing as how many of your companions are vying for you. By the looks of things, I won't be able to win over your attention without some ingenuity... Heehee. Commander, I do wonder, what do you think the odds of me winning are?

I'm an evil woman. Which is why I can do things like this without a second thought... For example, orchestrating a date, creating a time and place just for the two of us, or getting jealous over who you've been with- Heehee, can you handle someone like me?
How charming. Where did you learn to do this? Heehee.
I appreciate the prayer. Now, let us focus on the enemies in front of us.
Jean Bart, how long are you going to keep wearing your grumpy face?
Marco Polo, let's try not to get too ahead of ourselves~
Fighting angel Marseillaise, pass judgment upon the Holy Iris's enemies!
Seize victory, the Tribunal's way.

ex.line: Oh, right on time. To be honest, I wanted to see what you're like when you're late and scrambling to get here... Just for curiosity's sake, of course. Heehee~

"Clemenceau, that wicked woman. She somehow managed to snatch the Commander away from right under our noses..." Oh my, I didn't realize there were such outrageous rumors going around already. Heehee, it would appear that I'm not able to fly under the radar anymore.
Heehee, I wonder why you're spacing out all of a sudden~? Are you thinking about your other allies... or about some other girl~?
Richelieu, I thoroughly enjoyed the cat café you recommended to me the other day. Why yes, of course the Commander was with me. You know what they say about good company, don't you? Heehee~
The relationship between the two of us doesn't need to be so stiff and formal, you know? Unless... you're afraid that I'm going to do something to you? Heehee~
Don't forget this- the more "sins" you commit, the more you will have to "repent"~♪
Rumor has it that when some of the girls are coming by to deliver your mail, they're also sneaking in some personal effects- Haha, forget I said anything~
Let's try exploring other possibilities from the last operation a bit more thoroughly. Will you play the role of the enemy, or shall I do it?
An enemy capable of outwitting both Clemenceau and the Commander at the same time? How interesting... Surely you're not going to let this one slide, are you?

Shhh-- Just take my hand, and come with me. Where to? Naturally, a place free from the prying eyes of others, where we can be our true selves. Look- even though you have your doubts about me, you're still coming along. In other words, that's proof that you trust me, right?

lines.line: The skies are blue and the wind is calm, a perfect day for golfing... Commander? I didn't bring you here just to watch the scenery, you know? Brace yourself, because you're in for a long day with me.
The skies are blue and the wind is calm, a perfect day for golfing... Commander? I didn't bring you here just to watch the scenery, you know? Brace yourself, because you're in for a long day with me.
Let's start from here. Why don't you show me what kind of condition you're in today?
If you're getting tired of swinging the golf club, why don't we take the cart around and enjoy the scenery? Heehee, and of course, you'll be the one driving.
Hmm? I'm measuring the wind speed. Or, would you rather me say... that I'm enjoying the warm, gentle breeze?
Don't worry too much, and play however you see fit. This isn't a competition, so relax a bit.
Richelieu holds back too much, worrying about where the ball might fly off to. Jean Bart swings too hard, without worrying about anything at all. Looks like fun, doesn't it?
Oh my, Commander. Your hands don't seem to be able to calm down.
You've received the commission rewards? Excellent, let's see if there's anything we can put to use.
Looks like our precious leisure time will be cut short.
Phew, problem solved. I won't let any uninvolved parties get in the way of our leisure time.

Commander, when I'm with you, I feel a sense of safety that makes all the thoughts in my head go poof. ...Oh, you too? What if I told you, I was just telling you what you wanted to hear? Heehee. Hey, Commander... Don't let yourself get fooled by the sweet flattery of other bad girls~
Heavy cruiser - Unzen.

I am Unzen, a heavy cruiser made as part of the sixth shipbuilding plan. I'm unused to traversing this plane of existence, so I may lean on you for aid, Commander... But if you will accept me, I am more than happy to help—no, serve you. Heehee.

The threads of fate stretch far, I see. I am heavy cruiser Unzen, and I shall avail myself of your hospitality for the time being. Ah, not that I am planning to leave you, Commander, but I do intend to take time off for personal matters every now and then. Heehee, I do enjoy letting the wanderlust take over.
Commander? You're quite early today. ...I, on the other hand, was tardy considering my role as your secretary ship, for which I apologize.
Ah, I'm feeling just fine, thank you. As a wanderer, my body is used to going days without eating or drinking... But you say the others would worry? Of course... *sigh*
Are you thirsty? If you'd like tea, I'll bring some right away... But you look like you need a nutritional drink.
Looking for a diversion? You could take a little walk. Actually, there's a sacred mountain only three days away... Oh? That's too far for you?

I don't just know about seals; I have some knowledge of feng shui dragon veins, too. There are other girls in the port who know much more than me, though, so I suppose you don't need to ask me... *glance*
The Guardian Fox's little sister asks you questions incessantly? I suppose that would be difficult if you don't know the secret to victory. Commander, sometimes NOT answering is an option.
Sometimes, fleeing from work and human relationships is a viable option. I won't tell you to forsake society, but maybe you could learn a little about the hermit mentality?
Hmm, I'm not too sure about this...
If I suit your needs, then please ask anything of me.
I know this training method... Would you like to try it on me, Commander?
You have a backlog of missions. Heehee, I understand. It's only human to procrastinate until right before your deadline.
You have some unchecked mission rewards. Heehee, don't worry. It's nice to watch them build up, isn't it?
You have mail, Commander. Don't you think you should at least skim through it before you leave it in the box?
Welcome back, Commander. Would you like to take a warm bath? It must be hard to meet with friends with the stench of battle still on you.
The commission team is back. I can't wait to hear their stories, heehee.
I'm even stronger now. Heheh.
Let us expel evil and bring purity to these blue seas.
Rokkou's manifestation, Kaimon's divinity. Victory comes as holy mounts rise through the clouds.
Clearly... I've neglected my training.
Boundless heaven and earth, expunge all sin and impurity--
I mustn't inconvenience the Commander...!
Normally, I would consider consigning people as immoral as you to death, but... I'm just joking. Please get a hold of yourself, Commander.
Your care is appreciated, Commander. Whether it be battle, odd jobs, or caring for your affairs, please ask me for anything you may need.
You'd like to know what I want? Well... Hmm... Ummm... I can't really think of anything, but don't presume I'm without desire. But... Hmm, this is a quandary.
Commander, I came up with an answer to your question. Looking back, I've never felt... tied down. So I'd—oh, Commander? What's the matter?
It seems my answer from before has you in a dilemma. But understand that, as long as it's you, I really don't mind... Oh, or do you happen to have other inclinations?
I'm deeply honored by your proposal. While I don't feel deserving, I graciously accept... Heehee, it seems I'll have to train to be a bride, won't I, Commander?
Commander, you're really going to give this to me? I'll make sure to put it to good use.

ex.line: My, Commander. What a coincidence, us arriving at the office at the same time. Heehee, I'm kidding. We've been together since we left your room, after all♪

*munch munch*... Commander, is something wrong? You say I eat a lot more than you'd expect? I believe in not wasting things, whether they're clouds and mist or the five grains. That's doubly true when I made it for you... Heehee.
*sigh*... Looks like today isn't your day... I should cook something to raise your spirits later...
So you wish for a bit of a diversion? Okay, then... Commander, find me a place nearby where you and I can be alone for a while.
Reunited even when you're apart, growing ever closer without realizing... I think that describes our relationship well, Commander.
The Dragon God didn't like the sweets I made the other day... *sigh*... The word "flavorless" was used...
So you have relationships with other girls, too... Heehee, it's fine. I know that's just the kind of person you are, Commander. Isn't that right♪
I'm so helpful, aren't I? Am I a good girl? Heehee♪
If you want me, then who am I to say no? Heehee...
Phew... Now this is heavenly. Oh, Commander, well done on your most recent battle. Erm... I'm sorry, but I just got in, so if you don't mind...
Commander, I shall go and make quick work of these enemies.
That was a difficult foe... is what I WOULD say, if not for your leadership, Commander. You made it easy.
Commander, do you have plans later? Oh, I don't plan to drag you around for weeks. Just one or two days... No! May I ask for just a few hours of your time... for a date?

lines.line: Commander~ Come over here~♥ Heehee, you look surprised... I don't think I'm dressed strangely at all. Or... is this swimsuit not enough to satisfy you, Commander?
Commander~ Come over here~♥ Heehee, you look surprised... I don't think I'm dressed strangely at all. Or... is this swimsuit not enough to satisfy you, Commander?
Commander~ Heheh, come sit over here with me. It may be... a little cramped, but it's enough space for two, isn't it?
Would you like to join me, Commander? Soak your feet and feel heaven and earth's energy through the land, sea, and ocean breeze...
There are some underwater hot springs nearby. How about you and I visit them later? They're quite close—it's just two days if we swim.
Commander, when you go on vacation, you should have fun. Yes, it's a rare opportunity to... move your body a little, don't you think?
This feeling of liberation... I'd love to feel more of this place's energy with my bare skin... Oh, I can't?
You'd even do that out here...? Heehee♥
It seems there are letters waiting for you. It's okay. You may enjoy your break first and read it later.
Commander~ Welcome home~♥ I see, so this is what makes you happy? It seems I still have much to learn... Heehee.
A shipgirl's power isn't tied to appearances... In other words, victory will be just as easy in this swimwear!

Ah, Commander... What a predicament you've discovered me in. Hoping to put my skills to the test, I attempted to imitate so-called "ninjutsu." No, not the temporary paralysis one - I was trying to use the transformation jutsu.

Ah, Commander... What a predicament you've discovered me in. Hoping to put my skills to the test, I attempted to imitate so-called "ninjutsu." No, not the temporary paralysis one - I was trying to use the transformation jutsu.
This is the ninja sage's ultimate transformation technique... Hyah! Commander, have I failed again...?

I've seen ninjutsu many times throughout my travels, but they were unlike those spoken of in the port. The world is more diverse than I ever imagined... Oh? You think the girls at port are telling me tall tales? Heehee, well, isn't that interesting...
You think I don't have to take this role so seriously? Honestly, I'm not sure what part of this you think is "serious"...
It is a ninja's duty to come when her lord calls... I see. That must be why everyone is hiding in the ceiling of your office. Haha!
The fact that you seem unmoved makes me wonder... Is this ninjutsu meant to be performed while tied up, after all?
I still have much training ahead of me...
The rope is far too tight. I may have made... a mistake.
So you want to see me restrained, do you?
It's good to see you've returned, Commander. I was just practicing my next jutsu. I did want to honor you for your services, but, well...
Imagine, if you will, that I was a ninja assailant whom you managed to detain. What would you do next in that situation, Commander? Show me, with your own hands, what you might do... Heehee♡
Kii-class battleship - Owari.

I'm Owari, Kii-class battleship number two! I was originally supposed to get built out, but that never happened for whatever random-ass reasons. Doesn't bother me one bit though. All that matters is, I'm gonna give it my all with you in charge~♪
I'm Owari, and you must be the boss o' this here fleet... Nah, you're obviously the Commander! Ahahahah! Nice meetin' you!
Ah, Commander. Good timing. I just got some crazy fresh veggies. You wanna give 'em a taste?
I let others do the thinking - me, I'm just the brawn, pretty much. Complicated stuff kinda goes over my head... Haha~♪ Bein' dumb has its benefits, y'know!
What? I messed up? Maaan, that's soooo lame... Huh? Commander?! How long 'ave you been there? S-stop lookin'!
An operation? I'm not very book smart, but I'm guessin' you put a lot of thought into it? Alright, I'll get Suruga in here to explain it to me!
You said you'd come 'n eat my home cooking, remember? You can bet yer behind it's gonna be good!
Ughhh, I give up! I don't have any clue how to solve this puzzle! Kii! Come help!
Hm? Whatcha doin'? You ain't gonna get three wishes for rubbing my head. Though, it does feel real nice!
Yeah? You wanna hold hands with me? Sure thing~♪
So you get a kick outta touchin' me, huh? Good to know~♪
Huh? You've still got unfinished missions? What's up with that? Hmm... If you've got your hands full, I could help.
What's this? This mission's done and dusted... Unless I'm imagining it? Surely not.
Commander, there's a letter for you. Better check it sooner than later.
Oh, 'sup, Commander? You sure look beat... Was the battle that much of a drag? How 'bout we go kick it at the teahouse to unwind?
Oh, right, the commish team just got back. Aight, better tell the Commander~
Woah, hot dayum... Is this stuff dope as hell or what?!
Show me whatcha got! Ahahah♪
Don't ya dare diss the bonds between us!
Maaan. This is seeeeriously lame~
I'll show you hip and trendy~
I'm not 'boutta whine over a little damage and disgrace the Kii class...
You're, like, kind of a crappy person. I just don't like being let down so much, y'know?
Try not to ask too much from Kii 'n Suruga, aight? If you've got a problem, bring it to me first of all! I don't mind one bit.
If I wasn't doing what I'm doing now, whaddya think I'd be doing? Me, I'd wanna run a shop dealin' in seasonal fruits and stuff... You feel me? We could totally set one up together.

Ain't nothin' in the world people get right on their first try. War is like that, and love too - it becomes natural once you've practiced it... Whaddya mean, "What do you mean"? C'mon, Commander, put two and two together!

Oh, man... I can't get you outta my head, and I can't focus 'cause of it... I give up... Whenever this kinda stuff happens, ya just gotta do or die and go straight for the goal! Commander, I l-love... *blushes* Wait, lemme get ready first!
God! I just can't stop thinkin' about you, whatever I do, like you're literally stuck in my head... What I'm getting at is: I'm crazy for you! Might as well stop fighting it and... accept it, y'know?
Woah, this is suuuper cute! Huh? You're giving it to me? Wooow~ you rock~♪
Hey, Kii, you wanna hang out after this is done??
Man, your smarts are on, like, a whole other level...

ex.line: Hey, Commander, we'll hang out today, won't we? I've really been lookin' forward to this, so expect fun times ahead♪

I'm not the sharpest tool in the shed, but I can at least keep up with you! ...'Cause, you know, love blinds people 'n all that? But love won't change me, it'll only turn one of us into a dummy. Haha♪
When I look at you, I get all weak and squishy and stuff... Is this what bein' obsessed is like?
Askin' you for help every time I'm in a tough spot, that's not cool. I've gotta solve some problems on my own♪
We've got some crazy tasty veggies here at the port! Heck, I used some in my last recipe! Even harvested 'em myself, of course.
Uhhhh, there're people around, so... Phew, that was close. Like, even I feel awkward bein' watched by a ton of people...
Hol' up! You've got unfinished missions?! You get sick or somethin', Commander? Or is the whole freakin' sky about to fall?!
Oh hey, this mission here's all done too. Damn, Commander, you sure know how to bust yer butt.
Watch this! I'm totally gonna style on 'em!
Howzat? See, now you understand how badass I can be, don't ya?
Dunno why, but I feel on edge when I stand next to you... like I'm not myself, somehow... Creeps me out. Wonder why I'm like this... Any ideas, Commander? ...Lovesickness, huh. What's that even mean?

lines.line: I love hammocks and water beds 'cause they make you feel like you're floating on waves. It's the most relaxing thing ever~♪ You oughta hop on and try for yourself, Commander~
I love hammocks and water beds 'cause they make you feel like you're floating on waves. It's the most relaxing thing ever~♪ You oughta hop on and try for yourself, Commander~
Hehe, did I surprise ya, Commander? I think I threw together a pretty stylish bed... Wanna see for yerself?
I don't mind kickin' it with Kii and Suruga, but y'know, we could also keep relaxin' over here. If there's anything you want, these li'l guys will bring it right over~♪
A barbecue's not a terrible idea, but if you ask me, it's fruit 'n ice cream weather right about now.
A vacation on a floating bungalow sounds pretty dreamy~♪ Oh, but wait, what if that turns me into a total couch potato? That'd suck.
I don't think anyone's gonna kill ya if you enjoy a little naptime with me... You down, Commander?
Heheh, you like how that feels, don't ya?
What are ya plannin' to do next? I wanna see where this goes~♡
Heya, Commander! Good goin' out there. Want a towel? A drink? Or maybe... a piece~ of~ me~?
Welcome, guest, to the Dwelling of Demons. I own this place. I will grant you any wish in exchange for a suitable price... Yeah! Recited it all in one go! I'm so goated!
Welcome, guest, to the Dwelling of Demons. I own this place. I will grant you any wish in exchange for a suitable price... Yeah! Recited it all in one go! I'm so goated!
Welcome back! So, figured out your wish to me yet? Anything's valid, remember that! Don't underestimate my abilities!
I got like, devilish servants creeping 'round in the dark, so you might wanna watch yourself... Keep you safe? Well, it'll cost you. Let's say... some seasonal fruits, how's that?
The whip? Oh, it's for the naughty kids who don't keep their promises! It's got other uses too, 'course, like for instance... Hm? You wanna try it?
Man, fresh veggies are so delish. You think so too? Cool, then wanna harvest the field with me later? ...What? Demons aren't supposed to eat veggies?!
Huh? You wanna grant MY wish? Pretty gutsy proposal ya got there. Aight, I'm gonna think about my wish for later!
Watch it so ya don't cut your fingers! If you spill any yummy-yummy blood of yours in the Dwelling of Demons, you're gettin' eaten! Probably.
Huh? You sure you wanna get THAT close to me? Aight, then as the lord of this place, I allow you to sit here!
Already satisfied? Sure there ain't nothin' else you wanna do? Remember - I'll grant ANY wish you have♡
Work ain't over yet? You shouldn't be workin' down here in the... Whatevs, I'll help ya out! In return, you gotta grab a bite with me after we're done!
Huh? Already finished your work? But I haven't lifted a finger yet... Oh well! Time to get some food!
I looked through all the letters addressed to you. They ain't cursed or nothin', so go ahead and read!
You want a break? That's your wish, then? Aight, I'll grant your wish if you gimme a hug♪
Sheesh! That looks mighty dangerous! Lemme have a look at it. A demoness can handle herself!
Here's the dub you wanted, Commander!

You wish for... my love?! Daaamn, Comma- Ahem! My guest! That's nuts, just professin' your love like that to the lord of the house... O-okay, then the price is your lifelong freedom! 'Cause you're never leavin' my side♪
Akizuki-class destroyer - Hatsuzuki.

I'm Hatsuzuki, Akizuki-class destroyer. During the war, I helped my allies and fought hard until I got ripped to shreds. I might just work my butt off again to help you, if need be... Th-there'll be no need for that? Oh...
Heehee, so this is where you were, Commander~ Hope you don't mind that I'm here now, too♪ Isn't it wonderful to have me so close to you? Also, you won't be able to run if I come any closer~
I know this is your chair, but you'll let me sit on it if I ask, won't you? Great! Then, let's say only I can sit here♪
Where are you looking, hmm? Heehee~ You didn't realize I was behind you? Oh, Commander, for a tactical genius, you sure can be inattentive♪
Say, Commander, aren't you forgetting something? Oh, I think you know what~ Try really, and you'll remember what you might've forgotten♪
Are you in a pickle, Commander? Because if you are, you can ask me for help. Helping you is the whole reason I'm here~
Honestly, Zuikaku is too laid-back. If she'd take my approach and go straight for you, you two would have a thing going by now... Heehee, it's better for me this way, though♪
I got this red string that will tie you and me together! Also, you can keep patting me♪
Oh! Commander! ...No, it's nothing♪
Hmph. If you're gonna touch me, at least be honest about it...
Want me to help with your missions? I bet you do. I'm your secretary, after all.
Mission complete... Don't you care about the rewards?
A letter... Is it really your secretary's job to read your letters before you do? Heehee.
I'm first to welcome you back♪ Heehee~ No, that's not a given just because I'm your secretary~
The commission team is back. I'll come along and welcome them back with you♪
Something tells me that you're reliant on me♪
Go on, sink for me♪
MVP! Nobody says I can't hoard all the rewards from the Commander, right?
We lost... Hmph.
Don't worry, I'm on the case♪
I can take a lot of punishment, you know...!
Huh? You're... not gonna pay attention to me? Why not, Commander? I don't understand... Uhh, should I say sorry, or something?
(A note. It reads: I've gone somewhere far away. Please don't come looking for me. I hope you and everyone else have a good life. Yours truly, Hatsuzuki.)
Did you think I was serious about going away? Oh. Well, uh... Sorry? I thought it'd be a funny prank - I didn't mean to actually make you worry... Ugh...

I'm right here, and I'm not going anywhere. You don't have anything to worry about, Commander... I hope saying that while patting your head will make you calm down... Good. I know how important I am to you, so this should do the trick.

Hehehe... Wait! I'M supposed to be comforting YOU, not the other way around! When did this happen? It's supposed to be MY turn to court you right now! ...Y-you can stop patting my head any time, you know... *blushes*

I knew it - you need me in your life♪ Now tell me, what's our life together gonna be like, going forward? Sugary sweet, or down and dirty? Either way sounds like pure bliss to me and I can't wait! Hehehehe♡
I was going to have you guess what my favorite thing is... Ehehe, but since you already know, never mind~♪
Sp-spooky monsters don't exist, okay?!
I hope Chitose is doing okay.
Don't stray too far from me!

ex.line: I know what we can do if we both wanna sit in your chair - this. You can't move? Well, yeah, not with me right in your lap~ Heehee♪
Whooo's there? Heehee, the answer is me♪ You've fallen for another one of my tricks... There's someone behind me? Y-yeah, right, like I'll believe that!
You've forgotten again, Commander! ..."A date with me"? Wait, I don't remember anything about that... Did you just make that up? You dummy! *blushes*
I can't function when you're not around♪ Same with you, right? Ahaha! You're totally dependent on me~
Even if other girls start coming on to you... will you stay true to me? Hehehe... I mean, of course you would. You're madly in love with me, after all♡
Hmm-hm♪ Are you wondering why I talk you up even if I don't need anything? Heehee~
H-huh?! Wh-what's gotten into you all of a sudden...? *blushes*
Need help with your missions? Okey-dokey♪ Since I'm the only one who can do it right now~
Mission rewards have arrived. Isn't that nice~♪
We're more than just secretary and Commander - we share a fate. Which is to say, I'm your girlfriend, your partner... e-even your wife! So of course I'm first out to welcome you back♪
I'll add this to the Commander's list of achievements!
Maybe I could hoard not just the Commander's rewards, but the Commander as well... F-fine, if you say so...
Heheh, now hold still~ ...So what if I'm sitting on your lap? I'm still helping you with your job. If you really want me to get off, why don't you rest your head on my lap instead? Heehee♡

lines.line: Peace~♪ Do I look good in the pic? Don't I look so adorable you'll never wanna delete the photo, and have to stare at it every day to feel at ease? Heehee♪
Peace~♪ Do I look good in the pic? Don't I look so adorable you'll never wanna delete the photo, and have to stare at it every day to feel at ease? Heehee♪
Why don't you snap another? Oh, oh my~ You'll do it because you wanna, and not because I told you to?
(Aaand set on home screen♪ Now the Commander will see my adorable swimsuit forever and ever♡)
Hmph. Why are you looking at other girls? I'm not saying you can't, I just want you to look at ME right now.
Silly Wakatsuki, if you wanna have fun, just change into a swimsuit and jump into the pool... Although, it's too late to nab the Commander now - I have exclusive dibs♪
Heeheehee♪
Ahahah! Are you teasing me back now?
I know I can't do anything about it... Still, I'm sorry they're not bigger...
Welcome back with aaa... big splash! Heehee~ Get wet from head to toe!
Looks like the commission team's back. Are you really gonna go alone?
Peace, peace♪ Tell me how perfect I am♪
Now I'm gonna snap pics of YOU in your cute swimsuit♪ Don't worry, I won't show them to anyone else! ...That's it, give me a big, big blush~
You said anything's fine as long as I think it's good, right? Well, tadah! I'm going to give you a delectable, delicious drink! Watch closely now!
You said anything's fine as long as I think it's good, right? Well, tadah! I'm going to give you a delectable, delicious drink! Watch closely now!
This is a special day for you and me, you know. Isn't it the obvious thing to throw a grand celebration and make merry? Heehee♪
You're the one who said anything I like is fine, so it's too late to take it back now! Besides, you look like you wanna find out how it tastes... Don't play so hard to get!
You're bound to get thirsty sooner or later after chatting with me for so long. Heheh. Hope you're grateful for how forward-thinking I am♪
Now look, I'm going to pour it riiight- Eek! Y-you don't want the carpet to get dirty? Huh? Come again?
Ahaha♡ You'll have to come closeeer!
Y-you could lick that spot... *blushes*
You need motivation to do your missions? Heehee - alrighty, I'll comfort you as much as you need♪
Your mission rewards have arrived? But I'm not done indulging you...
Welcome back! Heehee. Your seat is on the couch over there - and MY seat is on your lap♪
Whuah?! Wh-what is it? The commission team's back? You should've just said so!
Hooray! Now if only you'd be mine, everything would be perfect, Commander!

You just can't help how much you love me, I know. You can't blame me for wanting to tease you, though! So, are you gonna even the score? Don't you wanna teeease your beloved Hatsuzuki? Be my guest♡ Heehee!
Get a move on, Commander! I've been waiting here so we can cross together. I heard that, when two lovers cross this bridge together, their bond will last a lifetime! Heehee♪
Get a move on, Commander! I've been waiting here so we can cross together. I heard that, when two lovers cross this bridge together, their bond will last a lifetime! Heehee♪
Look, Commander! Pretty, huh? No, I DON'T mean the scenery - I mean ME!
The snow is blessing our union, Commander~ Do you hear it? It's saying, "May your bond be as eternal and pristine as this world of snow!"
Whether it's sweet love or toxic romance, I'm game for anything... More than that, I'm dying to experience it!
Commander, come and hold the umbrella with me! Now we... spin it! Whooosh! Hahaha! Look at the snow swirling everywhere!
Do you like this outfit? I picked the whole backdrop, too! Hehe, now take my hand, and let's wish to never be apart again♪
This red string? Don't worry about it... The only red string I need is the one binding our hearts together♪
My hands are a little cold... Can you warm me up, Commander?
Hyah?! W-we're not there yet... At least wait until we... *blushes*
Commandeeer! If you don't hurry, I'll leave you in the dust. Heheh, just kidding~ I wouldn't abandon my beloved. But I did love seeing that concerned look on your face just now!
Hey, do you want me to confess to you again? Okay, lean in a little closer and listen... I love you. So I'm giving all that I am to you... okay, Commander?
Kamikaze-class destroyer - Asanagi.

I am the eighth Kamikaze-class ship, Asanagi. They once rudely called me number fifteen, but either out of sympathy or because they recognized my power, they've given me a new name. Now, if you're to be my Commander, you'd best straighten up! Otherwise, I'll have to instill some gumption in you!

Well, well... Hmph. What a weak little child you are! I am Asanagi, of the Kamikaze class! I will be your subordinate from today on, but listen well! Cause me trouble, I will jab you! Annoy me, I will strike you! Do anything unbefitting of your status as Commander, and your tummy shall know the wrath of my fist!
So you finally arrive, Commander! What in the world were you... Hey! Do not ignore me!
Hmph, know that I am a member of the glorious Kamikaze class! If you don't give me the respect I deserve... Oh? You made dango to share with me? Y-yes, yes, very thoughtful.
What? You made tea for me? H-hmm, how thoughtful... You deserve praise! Expect a New Year's gift in your future!
There you go messing up again! Prepare to feel my iron fist... You say no, it hurts too much? I-I suppose I don't mean to hurt you... Very well. One painless tummy strike, incoming!
Oite, where did you hide my shoes?! Oh... They were a mess, so you sorted them all into the shoe box for me? H-hmm... Well, er... Thank you.
Th-this is mortifying! Why don't I sink my fist into your stomach and see how you feel then?!
Ah, right there... Mm~ Commander, you are just a master of massage.
And what do you think you're doing, fool?! Goodness... What is so fun about touching me?
Hmm, Commander... Do you know how many missions you have piled up? They'll keep piling if you ignore them, so how about you get to work?!
Mm, wait a second... This mission is completed! Goodness. Don't neglect your rewards now.
Mail's come for you, Commander. Don't just ignore it! Read it already!
Commander? Finally returned, hm? You have some nerve, ignoring me—Oh, you didn't see me? But I'm right in front of you!
You there, Commander! I hear the commission team is back. If you don't want a solid blow to the stomach, you'd best make them treats and meet them in person!
Well, I suppose I feel a little stronger... Only a little! A little, I say!
Show me what you've got!
This is your punishment for underestimating the Kamikaze class!
Rrrgh! I-I just held back a little, that's all!
Get ready for a faceful of my fists of fury!
Th-this is far from enough to make a Kamikaze-class shipgirl submit!
Mm... Don't disappoint me so much, please. That is all I have to say.
Hmph. You underestimate me... Normally, I would punish you with a hundred punches... But very well. I'll let you get away with one this time.
Work must always be done quickly and efficiently. Oh, come now, I'll be here to help you. That should keep you from running into any trouble. You may rely on me from now on.
What? You finished your work before me...?! No, I mean, you must be going faster because of my help, or... A fluke! It must be a fluke, of course!
Whoa! ...N-no, nothing's wrong. I wasn't just neglecting my work because I was so focused on you, or anything! I mean, uhh! Yeah! You're doing this on purpose to distract me, aren't you?! Fess up!

Heheh, that you'd give me this must mean that you want to depend on me forever! What? No? You want ME to depend on YOU? Wh-who would ever rely on you?! ...I'll accept this ring, but I still won't do it!
You've got quite an eye for aesthetics! Mmhmm, that's worthy of praise!

ex.line: Commander, you're late! You don't know how long I've been waiting... for you, patiently! Show me your gratitude!
I cannot deny that you've done much for me, Commander... How am I meant to repay you?
You've made time for me tonight? I-I see... That's a good idea. I look forward to your companionship.
Matsukaze, I'll care for the Commander's worldly desires, so you don't need to worry—Why are you making that face at me?! D-do you mean to say I'm not capable?!
Mmm~ Yes... Ouch, ouch! No! Bad place! Not there... Ow, owowowowowoww!!
H-heheh! Do not underestimate my charms... Wait, you're stopping already?!
Mm, you still have some missions remaining. Did I not tell you that you'd start making mistakes if you worked yourself too much? I'll help you, so let's take it slow, now.
This one, and this one too... All of them are done! Now that's our Commander for you!
Commander, let's punch their lights out!
Hrmm. Did I overdo things a little?

lines.line: *yaaawn*... Goodness me, there I go falling asleep. You understand how pleasant the sea breeze is, don't you? YOU calling ME a slacker!
*yaaawn*... Goodness me, there I go falling asleep. You understand how pleasant the sea breeze is, don't you? YOU calling ME a slacker!
Late again. You weren't out there playing with other girls on the beach, were you?

It's not as if we fight at all hours. You'd be better off if you learned how to relax. As someone who leads shipgirls to battle over the sea, you'd benefit the most from learning how to enjoy the ocean.
If you fall for another shipgirl... you know what'll happen, don't you? My fists haven't dulled one bit.
Say, Commander, why don't we take a break and watch the ocean over some tea? Calm seas are so relaxing.
I notice you've been staring at my tummy...? Ah! Could it be... You plan to take your revenge over my previous punches?!
Urgh, the sunlight is too strong... Don't blame me. I sunburn easily by nature!
Look how covetous you are~ Does the sight of me in a swimsuit excite you so?
Here, a towel. Your hair and clothes get wet during battles, don't they? Make sure you don't catch a cold.
Heheh, yes, yes! Continue to sing my praises!
Cleveland-class light cruiser - Houston II, Hull Number CL-81.
...You think I seem a lot more stable now? Heheh, thanks for the compliment! I think I come off that way because of how composed I've become.
Commander, I return to you in a whole new style. ...I look like a different person altogether? Heehee, that's what they call growth, isn't it?
Welcome back! Now, let's get to today's work... Huh? Where should we hang out after? But we haven't even started... Focus, Commander!
Like they say, knowledge is power—and I'm just overflowing with power right now. Commander, I'm ready to exceed expectations any time!
Yahoo? Kinda takes you back, huh... How long has it been since I last said that? If you wanna hear it again... Y-yahoo~☆
Which Houston is your type, Commander? The energetic, happy-go-lucky one? Or the cool and calm one? ...Both? Heheheh~
You can't master something overnight. Time and effort are key... Keep an eye on me while I do my best, okay, Commander?
That feels good... Pat me more, Commander...
Commander? Something wrong?
You just never stop being a perv, huh?
Commander, you have unfinished missions. Let's take care of them together!
I'll go check for any missed rewards just in case.
Commander, you have a letter. Oh, do you want me to bring it to you?
Heheh! Another huge combat mission victory for Houston!
Mister Rocket and Mister Plane are friends~... Commander, were you listening?! U-umm! The commission is done, so you'd better go check it out!
I'm so strong now, I bet I could hit escape velocity with ease!
I'm in top form... Let's start today's work!
Thanks for the praise! Heheh...
I lost... I'd better review my mistakes carefully...
Three, two, one... Lift-off!
May our return to the port be a safe one...
Am I misremembering? You used to be more, uh...
It's been so long since we played, Commander~ And it's even more fun than I remember! Heheh!♪
*whispering* N-no, Houston, you can't hang around the Commander all day every... Huh? N-nothing, Commander! So, how about we take a walk together?
Why do I look troubled? Listen close! ...D-do you hear my heartbeat, Commander? It's thumping and pounding all because of you...
Commander, do you remember what I said to you long ago? It's okay if you don't. Either way, I'm going to confess again... *exhale*... L-listen carefully, please!
Th-that's weird... I wanted to answer normally, but now that it's really happening, I'm so happy that I don't know what to say... *inhale*... *exhale*... For realsies?! I love you, too, Commander!☆
You actually remembered, Commander... Thanks! It's my treasure!
You've changed, too.

ex.line: Yahoo!☆ Here's my warmest welcome, Commander~... Is it nostalgic for you? Heheh, well, you said you like me this way too, right?☆
Commander, am I doing a good job? Heheh, I know exactly what you're thinking these days!☆
I get to hang out with the Commander! Yahoo... Hey, you just laughed! Gosh, you promised you wouldn't!
Are you cold? Then take my coat... Eww. I wanted you to WEAR it, not SNIFF it!
Ah, Commander... You wrote about all the days we've spent together? Heheh, let's look back on our memories together some time... I'm sure it'll be fun!♪
Mmhah... Th-that feels nice, but... You really didn't need to take a whole day off just to pet me all day...
Maybe I should call you the Kinky Commander from now on...

Now that I really think about it, I've loved you ever since we first met. But I didn't understand my feelings back then... I'm really glad I didn't miss my chance... Umm, so... Can't forget to do this. Ahem... Y-yahoo~☆

lines.line: Thank you for waiting! Houston is here and ready to serve! Mm... I've never worn a costume like this. It's kind of embarrassing... And is it just me, or is it a size or two too small?
Thank you for waiting! Houston is here and ready to serve! Mm... I've never worn a costume like this. It's kind of embarrassing... And is it just me, or is it a size or two too small?
Welcome, Commander... Hm? Should I call you Master? I'll be serving you today, so please relax and enjoy.
So you're the type to eat the cake's strawberry last... O-oh, you left it for me?
Awwww... I dropped the cake... I didn't even get to eat any... Th-that doesn't mean I'm gonna eat it off the floor, or something!
You're going to tell everyone at the restaurant to greet the customers with "yahoo~☆"? Th-that is a joke, right? I'd be so embarrassed...
Whoa... I-if you keep touching me, my bunny ears will fall off...
I'm always here for you♪ Do you need my help, Commander?
Here's the shortcake you ordered. Should I draw something on it?
Now I can make even more delicious cakes!
Let me show you my service spirit!
Thank you so much! Commander, keep watching me while I rack up wins!
Today's sales... Not super great...
Ack! It's so busy that my head is spinning!
In the past few days, I've learned a lot from the maid team! For example, the kind of service that you like, Commander... Heheh, wanna let me practice on you later?
Sailing frigate - Golden Hind.

Caught you~ Heehee. What do you wish to know about? My name? My eternal beings, or should I say, my adorable tentacles? Well, my tentacles have been to the end of the world once~ There is no end of the world? Whatever you say♡
Greetings, my darling Commander. I am Golden Hind. I've heard much about you and am pleased to meet you at last... Heehee, my, what a rousing body you have~♡ *squish squish*
There you are, my darling. Heehee, I have fresh meat and vegetables, hand-squeezed juice and liquor, everything you can think of, if you want a taste~♪ *squish*
You really do have a stunning body, my darling~ Heehee♡
My apologies~ It seems some of my ooze got stuck on you.
Are you interested in my remains collection? Don't you worry, I'll tell you aaall about it and the stories behind it in thorough detail♡ *squish squish*
Movies, games, books... There are so many pastimes at this place~ I wonder, though... would you be interested in an onboard concert?
You're quite gentle with those hands, my darling...♡
What is it? Do you want to feel my tentacles? Heehee... Go ahead~
You've finally caught on, Commander... *squish squish* Now, come to me. I will take everything you have to give♡
Heehee, my darling~ You must read the fine print carefully before you sign the pact♡
As a reward for completing your mission, I invite you to my bosom♡
Here's your letter, darling~ *squish* ...It's sticky? Heehee, think of it as my liquid passion for you~♡
You're finally back, my darling~ How rude of you to leave me behind, when I prefer taking the lead rather than lying down... Oh? What's this mango? A treat for me? Heehee~ Why, how kind of you~♡
A commission's been completed. Would the team mind bringing me the enemy's remains?
This will help me procure more remains♪
I will add you lot to my collection♡
Now the victors have the right to do whatever they please~
It's alright, my darling Commander. My severed parts will grow back in no time~
Join the others in my collection!
I can't regenerate quickly enough to keep pace...
Your body is the only good thing about you... What a shame.

I brought these lychees with me on a recent cruise~ Heehee, they're juicy, sweet, and delectable~ Want to try one? Let me just peel the skin and take out the annoying core, then I'll bring it to your mouth using my tongue♡
I can come closer, you say? Heehee, I feel the passion emanating from you~ *squish squish* Heehee. Is this better, my darling Commander? Can you feel MY passion? ♡
Too close? Heehee, my urge to top you has only grown stronger since I laid eyes on you, my darling... There's no escaping your fate now♡

Oohh, so this is how you answer... You get dominant when you want to affirm your feelings, I see♡ If I'd known this when we first met, I would've done something more... Heehee, never you mind~ I can't wait to experience our future together♡

Is this...? Heehee, I see now~ It's a promise about a home, isn't it, my darling? Heehee... I've roamed freely up to this point, going wherever my whims dictated, but now I have a place that accepts me. Well, Commander, what are you waiting for? It's time we indulged in each other, forever and ever♡
Thank you, Commander. This will be the pride and joy of my collection♡

ex.line: Ohh♡ You bumped into me while trying to avoid my tentacles, hmm? Heehee, there's no escaping me~ Your body belongs to me, my darling Commander♡
*squish squish* My darling Commander, do you like my tentacle massage combined with... Heehee, goodness, I don't know what this is called♡ Will you tell me? Surely you would know~?
Quiet, quiet... Heehee, oh, my darling~ My little ones can't help but get fidgety whenever you're around♡
My most prized possession? Oh, my darling, you are too good at feigning ignorance... It's your body, your soul, your stories - I always look forward to them♡
I have a one-of-a-kind advantage when it comes to concerts - I can play the whole orchestra using my tentacles~ Now, I dedicate this next performance to my darling Commander♪
My little ones are easier to follow than me, you say? Heehee, I suggest that you don't test my patience~ Tease me too much, and I might just suck you dry, my darling Commander~♡
Do you want to feel my little ones' embrace? Or maybe... Heehee~ Come here~ I'll satisfy your every desire~♡
How do you like this~? Heehee, how careless of you to be caught by my tentacles as soon as you come back~ Just relax and I'll make you feel better♡
It's too late once I've caught you~♡
You're going to rot, rust, and corrode anyway, so why not become a part of my collection? Heehee♡

I'm puzzled. I've done it with you so, so many times, yet I still need so much more... Even now, I'm having dirty thoughts while just standing next to you... Heehee♪ My little ones might snap and cover you in ooze, so if that happens, please don't get mad♡

lines.line: How do you feel about this look, my darling? ...Not scary enough? How odd... I thought Mary Celeste had the right idea. Wait, I know~ What if I hold this axe, hmm? ♡
How do you feel about this look, my darling? ...Not scary enough? How odd... I thought Mary Celeste had the right idea. Wait, I know~ What if I hold this axe, hmm? ♡
I've been waiting for you this whole time, Commander♡ ...Did I run into anyone while you were gone? Heehee, you're so sweet when you're agitated♡
...Why not give all my tentacles an axe? Heehee, you sure get funny ideas, my darling~ That would turn this into a Halloween comedy, not a horror flick.
Hm? Hmm? Seems my tentacles got ooze on my clothes... Wouldn't you say that's an upgrade, though, my darling Commander?
"You cheated on me! Die!" ...Hahahah! Was that a bit too intense? Now I'm curious what kind of Halloween bride you do like♡
My veil hardly covers anything because of this antler... Oh, you think it suits me perfectly? Thank you, my darling♪
Could you re-tie the knot on my skirt, please? Heehee, of course, you'll need to untie it first... ♡
A lonely newlywed in a deserted castle... This is how our loving starts, my darling♡
Welcome back, my darling Commander~ ...What am I doing with the axe? Why, I'm looking for a way into your office without the key~♡
Heeere's Hindey~♡
The tentacles are for rewards, the axe is for punishment~
Sailing frigate - Mary Celeste.
I am Mary Celeste, a seaborne ghost birthed by a storm. Hmph, the legend surrounding me... It's merely one of the truths you can't see with the human eye.
Hmm, so you're the Commander? I'm Mary Celeste - the fabled ghost ship. And this one's name is... Argo, for short. Hahah! Don't be scared of her. She's just fond of this busy world, just as I.
Ah! You've returned, Commander! What would you like? A cup of hot tea, or coffee? Or perhaps you yearn for my ghostly embrace?
When you have woes, spill them to me. Though I cannot give you warmth, I can give you company.
I suggest wearing warm clothes if you want to hang around a ghost ship like me, Commander.
Eeek! A-a fire?! ...They're just cooking barbecue? Ugh... I'm going to vanish for a while, Commander!
People say I'm friendly? I don't know about that... I'm so used to living alone that I've just become a good listener, I think.
My horns've caught your eye, eh?
Hmm? I'd be wary of frostbite if I were you, Commander.
Hahah! Your hands are so warm.
Hmm... It's been untold years since someone relied on me. Makes me feel cherished - something I miss.
Mission complete. Now come here and I'll pat you on the head! Good, good~ ...Hahah! My touch is nice and cold, isn't it?
Let's say your new letter floated into the office by itself - how do you feel about that? ...It would scare the younger shipgirls? Now that you mention it, I suppose so...
You're back! Admirably done, Commander! Let's start you off with a chilling hug! ...It looked like I was waiting for you? Heh, yes, because I'm always watching you.
Commander, we ought to set up a fright for the girls who just returned from their commission!
Heh. From the dark is where I protect best.
There's no fleeing from a ghost!
Mwahahaha! Another victory with no surviving witnesses!
We'll be fine. The enemy cannot pursue us.
Where's Mary? Right behind you!
Wh-where's the fire?!
Hey, Commander... Are you lonely? It's alright. I'll be here with you.
From the shadows, I emerge... Eek! St-stop putting firewood into the stove at once! ...Ahem! C-Commander, just so we're clear, you did NOT hear that... Got it?
You want me to stop hiding like a ghost and reveal myself out in the open? Hmm, that's honestly a lot to ask... What? You're telling me to do it right now, in the office?!
It's weird, but I've developed this need to be around you in order to feel peace of mind... Huh? You noticed I've started caring about my appearance? Uh, thanks...
I'll let you in on a secret, Commander. Us ghost ships have our own place to call home. Where, you ask? *hug*... Th-there, is that a good enough answer?

You're giving this to me? It's like saying you want to spend your life with me... Hahah! I'll gladly do that. From this day onward, you walk the same path as me. Your heart will be my home, from which I will always receive warmth.
For me? Well, thank you. I'll repay you.
You're a real fighter, li'l Vampire! Why don't you join my band of pirates?
Borrow "my Force", you say? I don't know what that means, but sure.
Hahahah! We're a bona fide ghost fleet!

ex.line: You're back. First, drink this to warm up, then I'll help myself to your body... You're so warm I feel like I'm burning up. Ahahah!
Teach you how to turn invisible like me? It's... not something you can learn. Putting aside whether you can or can't, how am I supposed to be by your side if I can't see you? Heh.
You feel like the temperature around me has gone up? Hahahah! I don't think you're just imagining it. I feel shy around you, which heats me up...
You wanna have a good time? Sure. We could sing, or go to the beach, or even... C-cook barbecue? Okay, that's enough teasing me... *blushes*
Heheh. Thanks for looking after me, Commander. It's refreshing. This feeling of codependence makes me think I won't be lonely again.
You... like the curvature of my horns? Didn't think you'd care about them... Now I'm a li'l self-conscious... *blushes*
Getting to feel your warmth in this way... It's pretty nice.
If it helps you cool down, then I suppose... Wait, huh? Umm... *blushes*
Okay, I'll support you on this mission! When do we start?
Feel like you're on fire after that last battle? Hahahah! That's where I come in. C'mere and cool your face in my chest! *hug*
You'll draw their attention, and I'll appear from behind and spook 'em. Alright! We've got a plan!
May the storm take you!
Never forget - Mary is always by your side.

Shh. I know it's just you and me here, but you don't want anyone to hear us, do you? While I can always vanish from sight if someone shows up, you can't. That's why you have to be quiet. Same goes for me.

lines.line: I am Mary Celeste, the silent reaper of the moonless night... Aye, this attire befits a ghost ship such as I.
I am Mary Celeste, the silent reaper of the moonless night... Aye, this attire befits a ghost ship such as I.
Hahahah! Welcome to the rim leading to the afterlife! I will protect you on this moonless night! ...Hm? N-no, I wasn't feeling lonely, I swear.
It really is more heartening to walk the earth with you than to wander through the dark night alone.
Wow, these bats remind me of Argo in that they're very docile. So, Commander, be nice when you give them orders.
Bats hate fire, and vampires hate fire as well, so it makes perfect sense that I hate fire. Aye.
The red thing on my head? It's a spider lily petal... Probably.
Do you like my wings? ...They make me look even cooler than before? Oh... Th-thank you... *blushes*
Mhh... Hahh... Hey, should I really be wearing an outfit like this?
I had the bats bring your letter. They don't get lost even in pure blackness.
Nicely fought! Yours truly has been waiting for you! ...Sorry for being late? It's fine. Loneliness never had a chance to take hold, because I knew you'd be back.
I bring death to all turncoats.
The spider lilies bloom... for me?!
Sailing frigate - Adventure Galley.
Someone in your position must know at least SOME of my history. Yes, I've sailed with pirates, but don't lump me together with them. I've never seen myself as one, you know...
I'm Adventure Galley. I've got nothing else to tell you. Then again, you're letting me stay at this port, so I guess let's get along, Captain. Sorry... "Commander," was it?
You're back. Here's your schedule for today. Try not to let others know about it - nothing good will come of it.
These chains? They follow me like the memory of when I was deceived and betrayed, whispering to me - "you can't trust people"...
Oh, pardon me for staring. It's just, I've made a habit of keeping tabs on people around me... I'm not singling out you in particular.
You promise nothing I'm worried about is going to happen here? You sound certain. Perhaps this place will be good.
While I have worked with pirates, there is no trust between us, only the desire for profit. It's nothing like this fleet you lead, Commander.
Wh-what are you...? Ehh...
What do you want from me?
Huh. More interested in me than my fortune, are you?
You have a new mission. Let's get it done with people we can trust.
Mission complete. Surely booty is considered legal income, right?
Check your new letter while you're ahead. Also, don't tell anyone else what it says.
Look who's finally home. Nobody turned on you mid-journey, I hope?
The commission team is back. Be sure to review the booty thoroughly.
I can better protect my fortune with this new firepower.
I will plunder all you have with these iron claws!
You have some damn nerve, trying to steal MY treasure!
Where did I go wrong? No, don't tell me... I've been betrayed again?
May the sea bury your ambitions and doubloons!
You will NOT put the noose on me!
My trust is worth more than gold, and you betrayed it...
My treasure still rests where I left it. Alas, it cannot stay there forever - someday, I need to relocate it to a safe place... Who knows, maybe that will be this port?
I feel relieved when I return to port and drop my anchor at the pier, like I've come home. Maybe... it's because I know you're waiting for me, Commander.
Until very recently, I always thought the only one I could TRULY trust was myself. You've changed me, Commander. It's really nice, having someone you can put your faith in...
I'm considering moving my treasure to this port and building a secret treasury for us. "Am I sure"? Why shouldn't I be, when it'll always be under your watchful gaze?
Of all the treasure I've gathered, this is by far the most precious. In exchange, I offer my body, my soul... and my unconditional trust. Take them all, and please, store them in a safe place!
Nice gift. I love it! I'll just go store it with my treasure.
Let's race to see who can seize all the treasure the quickest!
Stay away from me...

ex.line: Welcome back. Here's your daily schedule. Take some people you can trust with you... and me.
I'm heading out to inspect my treasure. Do you - the person I trust more than anyone else - want to come with me?
I get fidgety when you're not in my line of sight, for some reason... Oh, it's not that I'm worried you're doing something behind my back, I just start wondering if you're okay.
I've never stayed at a port for this long... This will probably be my home forever, and I will always be by your side.
Heehee. You can keep doing that, if you want.
I will give you whatever you desire.
Such thirst... You should plunder me to satisfy it♪
Phew... You're back, safe and sound. I can finally relax... If you don't want me to worry, take me with you next time.
The commission team is back. They brought quite the haul!

Now when I look at my dear treasure, I feel like it's worthless compared to you, Commander. That's not to say it's lost its value, just that you're so much more valuable than anything else... The question is, where can I hide you, my biggest treasure? Heehee♪

lines.line: "Ahahahah! I've finally found yooou, Master! Dinner is ready, so just follow me to the... You're not hungry? Aww, but the meat is fresh off the bone..." Commander? Why are you backing away?
"Ahahahah! I've finally found yooou, Master! Dinner is ready, so just follow me to the... You're not hungry? Aww, but the meat is fresh off the bone..." Commander? Why are you backing away?
Welcome home, Master! I've prepared dinner for you, loaded with savoury meat. If you're still left feeling hungry... I can find more meat for you.
This set is brilliant for building atmosphere. Ahem, let's see... Ahh! There you are!
How can I get you to love me and me alone? ...Aha! I'll just take my blade and cut up anyone who stands between you and me... Hehe, hehehe♪
I'm so sorry, Master. The screams of our to-be-dinner must be annoying. I'll go make them quiet down... Oh, but don't come and look, okay?
What was that for?! There goes the mood I'd set up!
Yes, Master? What can I do for you?
You still love me, despite how much I've changed... Heehee...
"A letter? The writer of it will be my next kill..." Actually, this might be an important letter. You should check it now.
Welcome home, Master! I've been waiting with bated breath for you this whole time and sharpening my blade, like this - shwing, shwing...

"I want to be with Master forever and ever... But how... Oh, I know! If we just eat each other... Heehee..." Cut! How did that sound? Hm? That wasn't ALL acting, you know. I meant at least a little... What about the eating each other part? W-well, THAT was obviously just my line!
Sailing frigate - São Martinho.
Turn your gold into the most magnificent palaces - turn your battles into the most valorous poems. Bathed in the glorious golden light, the Invincible Armada continues its campaign to this day.
São Martinho - the Invincible Tempesta, flagship of the Armada, and retainer of the golden light - greets you. Whereto is our next grand campaign, Commander?
Commander, what grand undertaking shall we begin with today? ...This paperwork, you say?
I am the inheritor of the Invincible Armada's glory. You surely know the burden I carry, Commander, you being the head of a fleet just as I.
These wings are a sacred gift from the golden light. Do you wish to touch them?
You wish to hear the Invincible Tempesta's many poems? Then you need only wait. Come the battle with our despicable enemy, my sails shall tell you my tales.
Pay close attention to fleet logistics, and in particular, the rations supply line. I say this based on my own experience.
I will under no circumstances sail when a storm is raging. Hm? No, not because I'm afraid, but rather... because rain makes my wings heavy.
You must hold your tongue even in the face of pain. Showing strength is important, because neither storms nor foes are merciful on the weak.
Is this a physical examination?
Why do I feel warm...?
A new mission? Very well. Remember to perform a hull inspection and repairs before you embark.
I do hope these mission rewards were worth the effort of our expedition.
A new letter? Hmm... Actually, it's best if you read it yourself, Commander.
Now that you've returned, let me examine you... Arms and legs are fine. You're in perfect health.
The campaign fleet has come back, returning the treasure to its rightful place.
Gracias.
Let us play a melody of destruction for our foes!
The golden light shall shine upon the path of victory.
Let us await the opportunity for redemption.
O Invincible Armada, heed my order!
I can still... hold steady!
I thought you had promise as a fellow head of a fleet... It seems I overestimated you.
Commander, I ask you to stay close to me during our expeditions. The golden light will protect us all.
I offer prayers for victory and peace whenever I embark on a campaign. Commander, I will pray for you too, and grant you the golden light's blessings.
A storm is coming. Commander, take shelter under my wings and... Hm? Rubbing shoulders, you say? Well, that is to be expected...
Commander, I've located a calm anchorage where we can be alone and... "Return treasure to its rightful place"? No, a-all I want is some private time with you...
I swear to you this oath upon the golden light. My lance shall pierce your foes, and my wings shall keep you from harm, even at the cost of breaking them if there is no other choice.
It's clear that you have good taste. I'll give this pride of place, don't worry.
I would never have imagined I'd sail with Golden Hind.
All fortunes must return to their rightful place.

ex.line: There you are. Bask in the glory of the golden light... Um, all I wanted to say is, "welcome back."
I've been receiving fruits and vegetables from my friends around the port, surely as offerings to the Invincible Armada... They're just "worried I'll go hungry otherwise"? That can't be true!
When the going gets too tough, don't push yourself - come to me for help. That is what you preached to me, and now I am preaching it to you.
Fan you with my wings to cool you down? That is not what they're meant for! But, if you want me to give it a try... There, how's that?
I could use a hand with grooming my wings.
This stirring in my chest... tell me, what is it?
Let us both read your latest letter.
Welcome back. It's time for your routine examination... Good, you look fine.
No need to put on appearances in front of you, I suppose...

lines.line: Here you see the opposite side of the retainer of the golden light. Be not afraid. I am still me, and my feelings and my beliefs have not changed. Still, if it unnerves you, perhaps you should get to know me again?

Here you see the opposite side of the retainer of the golden light. Be not afraid. I am still me, and my feelings and my beliefs have not changed. Still, if it unnerves you, perhaps you should get to know me again?
Not to say you're late, but I did wait some time. My heart ached for you.
I am the shadow cast by light, I am the dark inversion, and I am São Martinho, retainer of the golden light. This fact will never change.
The golden light casts a shadow. This shadow is indispensable to our glory's continued existence.
I've dyed you in my own color... Heehee, no, this darkness is only meant to protect you.
This hunger, it yearns to be quelled... with lots of food. Hm? I mean a loooot of food, Commander.
You wish to see me fight in my dark form? Hmmmm. It almost sounds like you prefer the way I look now.
The "old" São Martinho? Silly you. I am still me; I'm not a fallen angel or corrupted by the dark. There is no "old" or "new."
I feel you've become more reliant on me. Good.
What a delicious feeling...
Welcome back to the port. I will keep a keen eye open to see who out there is able to hurt you.
The shadow follows the golden light's course.

You wonder how differently the light and dark versions of me feel about you? Regardless of appearance, the retainer of the golden light loves you, Commander. From start to end, I am me, and my feelings for you remain the same.
Sailing frigate - Whydah.
I've got no interest in swashbuckling and plundering like other pirates. Storms are scary, so I'm fine just chilling back at port. Plus... the pillow is real cushy...
*Yaaaaaawn*... Surrender all your valuables to meeeee... Oh, I was just saying random stuff. No need to take it so seriously... *sigh*... What a pain...
Welcome back, Commaaaaaander... Fwuh? You brought me a new flavour of crisps? You sure know how to get on a girl's good side, huh...

*Yaaaaaawnnnn*... Commander, you also interested in the legendary pirates' treasure? Hmm... Since you brought me crisps and cola, I suppose I could hand it over to you. But it's been such a long time... and picking it all up's gonna be a huge hassle...
I may be a pirate, but I'm also a pacifist. *siiiigh*... That's because fighting's a huge hassle...
Bweh... Back to work again? How about I hand all my treasure over to you and go back to lying down?

Commander, mind hooking me up with a lifetime supply of crisps? No good, huh. What if I buy it with my own money? What do you mean that's also a no-go? ...I'm not growing any taller because my diet's too imbalanced? ...Why you...!

You want to make an exhibition out of the stuff I collected? ...I guess that's fine, as long as you don't make me show up. Huh? You'll buy me a new gaming console? Hrmm... Fine, I guess that's not the worst deal in the world...
You're gonna stunt my growth... *sigh*... Well, saying no is too much of a hassle... so I guess just do whatever you want?
*YaaaaAAAAawn*... Commander, you're really good at back rubs... It feels so nice I'm drifting off to sleep...
Th-that place is off limits...! Even if you try bribing me with cola!
Commander, it might be a good idea to knock those missions out quickly. When too much troublesome stuff piles up, you'll eventually give up altogether.
Woah... Didn't think you'd get this motivated to finish all your work... But, don't forget the most important thing: the rewards! Otherwise, you won't be able to buy crisps for me, right?
New mail's here... What a pain... Sorry, Commander, but can you check it yourself?
*Yaaa↗aaa↘aaa↗aaaa↘wn*... Welcome back... Did you run into a storm? Sure must suck going outside... Huh? It'll be fine if we go together? Wh-what are you even... *sigh*... What a pain...
Looks like the commission team's back. Go greet them for me, yeah? *sigh*... I seriously don't wanna get up... Commander, how about you just take some crisps to them for me...?
Am I stronger now...? What a pain...
...Another fight? Can you swap the little guys in for me instead?
We won? *Yaaaaaawn*... Finally, time to go home.
A storm? ...What a pain... I never shoulda left my room...
So I can go back home sooner and get my beauty sleep... Sink!
I never should've left home...
*sigh*... Guess I'll just go play games in my room...

I normally send the little guys to run errands for me, so I can just lie down and have crisps delivered straight to me... But, I guess I am still a Tempesta pirate at the end of the day, and doing some stuff on my own... is probably a good thing?
Warm sunlight over a peaceful port... Yeah, that's the good stuff. So good it makes me want to take a nap... Commander, wanna join in? Nothing beats basking in the sunlight right next to the window.

Some girls are real junkies for treasure hunting, but it's way too dangerous out there with the storms and hurricanes and whatnot. If you want treasure, Commander, you can get it straight from me... as long as you trade me lots of crisps of all kinds of different flavours.

Before I knew it, we ended up in a dating relationship, and you're asking me where I want to go...?! How about just staying in my room... No good? How about the nearest fast food restaurant then? But then I'd have to go outside and interact with all those people... Wait, but what if I bought the store and moved in next door? Th-that way, I'd be able to go on dates with the Commander AND drink cola every day!

How strange. Whenever I'm with you, I don't feel scared anymore... If I put this on, does that mean it's okay for me to rely on you even more from here on out? ...Okay then. In return, I'll share my crisps and my treasure with you. Mhm, we'll be together forever from now on, right?
This is even more tempting than potato chips! I'll trade you some treasure for it! Huh? It's free? Thank you...
You get it! Storms are totally scary, aren't they?
An adventure? ...Nah, I think I'm good.

ex.line: Welcome back. I had the little guys clean the office... so you'll reward me with those crisps and cola as promised, right?

I heard there's this place called "Potato Chip Rock." Think it's stuffed full of crisps? Commander, let's move it over to the port. ...Huh? There are no crisps there, nor is there any way of moving it?
Holding a conversation is such a pain... Wish I could make my coat big enough so I could hide myself entirely. Oh, but you'd be welcome to join me inside, heehee.
It's important to take breaks. Put all that work aside and go see if there's any cola in the fridge. Your fatigue's gonna melt away the moment you take a sip.
Patting my head again? I'll have to pay you back for that. Crisps or cola? Take your pick.
...Hm? You're all done with work, Commander? ...What a sneaky way of reminding me.
C-Commander, are you going on another treasure hunt...? Fine, fine. You should've just asked me first...
Yeah, yeah, I'll go get the mail. What a pain... But since it's for your sake, I suppose I'll have to.
Commander, if you spend more time with me... I might not be such a scaredy-cat then.

Commander, are you sure it's fine for me to sit in your lap this whole time? Doesn't it get tiring...? But, being in your embrace really calms me down... There's no wind here, or rain, and it's really warm... I want it to last forever...

lines.line: You've summoned the angel of tricks and treats... Huh? Why am I dressed like this? Meh, it's too much of a pain to answer that... In any case, gimme candy or else! Commander, time is of the essence here. The sooner I can go home, the sooner I can continue my gaming session...

You've summoned the angel of tricks and treats... Huh? Why am I dressed like this? Meh, it's too much of a pain to answer that... In any case, gimme candy or else! Commander, time is of the essence here. The sooner I can go home, the sooner I can continue my gaming session...
Oh? Ohhh? ...Noo, just a tiny bit short! ...Commander? Hurry up and sit down already. Put the work aside for now - it's gaming time~

Hmm... You want to see some spooky Halloween pirate treasure? But, you're empty-handed right now, so in theory, that's a no-go... But saying no to you is always such a hassle... Well, whatever. I guess I'll take a look around...
Fluffy... pillows... and the Commander is even lying down next to me... *yaaaaaaawn*... Zzzzzz...
Want some crisps, Commander? I've got every flavour you can imagine. Go ahead and take your pick.
Candy, crisps, and cola... Perfect. Now, I'll never have to leave my room ever again.
Woah! That was a close one... My hairband almost fell off... Jeez, Commander. I told you not to mess with my halo.
Commander... I can't concentrate on my game at all if you do that...
New mail... I wonder if a new game just released?

Welcome back, Commander~ That's right, what you see before you is Whydah of Tempesta, completely drained after changing into a Halloween costume and now unable to go outside... Well, since you're already here, why not play some games with me?

Shoo, shoo. Go on now, go outside and play... Oh, coming! Commander... Um, are you free today? I just got my hands on a new two-player co-op game. Wanna give it a try with me? ...Oh, and if you get tired, we can always lie down together...
Allen M. Sumner-class destroyer - Laffey II, Hull Number DD-724.
...Allen M. Sumner-class? That sounds right. Commander, do you like Laffey's new rigging? I'm not waiting for you to compliment me, or anything... Don't know why you'd think so...
*yawn*... Laffey's ready, raring, and more motivated than ever... My rigging is the only thing that changed, not me... So don't touch these ears, Commander. They're not real...
Yep, Laffey took a good nap, so I'm awake and ready for work... probably. What about you, Commander?
Yeah... You're always looking after Laffey, Commander... That makes me happy...
I wanted to sit on my rigging and fly directly to the academy, but that wouldn't work, so I ended up walking. I wish I could ride instead of walk...
When Laffey needs to remember something, I can just type it into my display panel... So convenient.
Does Laffey look stronger now? ...Because I can sleep sitting on my rigging? No? Hmm...
This new cargo space is great... All of my favorite drinks are in there... Here. This one's cold, so you can have it...
Don't worry about Laffey... Even when I'm asleep, I'm plenty alert... Yep...
Commander...? You want to take a break...?
When I sat down, I fell asleep... Nnh... It's okay, I won't fall down...
Commander... You really are a pervert...
A new mission arrived. Commander, it's time for work... Aww, I have to, too?
We have rewards. Want to see them, Commander?
Commander, Laffey put your letters... right here.
Commander... *yaaawn*... Welcome back... Zzzzz...
The commission team returned... Did you know that already? Okay, then I'll go back and sleep...
...Can I nap a little longer, please...?
First things first, we gotta beat the baddies... Yep, hurry...
I won... Back to sleep now...
My battle... isn't over yet... Nope.
Connection established. Deploying...!
As long as I can shoot, I won't give up...
Why'd you wake me up... Do you need something, Commander...?
Does Laffey look unmotivated? You're just imagining it... I'm so motivated... Zzzz...
I'm not fully awake yet, but... My body and mind are ready for a fight...
What do you think when you see Laffey... Nope, I don't care. Not one bit...
Sometimes, even Laffey can change... But no matter how much I change, I'll never stop wanting to be with you, Commander...
...I'm only the Laffey I am now because of how much you care, Commander... Because you're always watching over me... Yep, I promise... Laffey will be together with you forever...
Thanks... I'll put it next to my pillow...
Yep. I'm in great condition... What about you, Nevada?
Let's take a nap together after this... Yeah...
Laffey's ready, too. Let's launch together...

ex.line: Welcome back... No, I wasn't waiting for you to wake me up... Nuh-uh.
When you're here, Laffey can relax... When I fall asleep, my body will go all limp, too...
Commander, want to join the napping club? Well.. You can nap with me even if you're not in the club...
Commander, lean on Laffey if you want... Actually... I'd rather lean on you...
Zzzz... Mmnh...? Commander...? Zzzz...
I'm not thinking about how I want to put my head in your lap and fall asleep... Not one bit.
You're so weird, Commander... But I guess I'm used to it now...
New missions... After we finish them together, I'm gonna take a nap... Yep, yep.
Mission complete... Hm? Laffey can have a reward, too? Okay... Then I want time alone with you, Commander...
Commander, don't forget to check your mail...
It's not like Laffey wants to be with you for a little longer... Nope, not at all.
Commission team's home... Just five more minutes of sleep... Nnh, but I wanna go see everyone with the Commander...
Laffey and the Commander are super motivated...
Targets eliminated... Wanna go rest together, Commander?
Urk... Sorry for worrying you, Commander... It's okay. I won't be disheartened...
"The Ship That Would Not Die" won't go down that easy...
Commander, can I have a second? It's okay... Laffey just wants to nap next to you... I'll be quiet. Zzzz...

lines.line: Laffey's helping out around the pop-up shop... Commander, sit wherever you want... Any open seat is probably fine.
Laffey's helping out around the pop-up shop... Commander, sit wherever you want... Any open seat is probably fine.
I haven't been looking all over the place for you... Nope, not at all.
My uniform's covered in bunnies, my shoes have bunnies... I love it. Do you like it, Commander...?
Laffey's job... is to deliver food to the tables... It's not boring because you're here, Commander... Yep.
