If Ingraham made a conveyor belt to deliver the food, would Laffey not have to anymore...?
I came to help out... so I'll keep doing my best... I'm not thinking about slacking off with Allen... Nope, not at all...
Commander... I'm not eepy, I swear... Okay? Got it?
My bouncy bunny ears look fun to touch...? Umm... I don't understand...
Commander, you pervert... You're gonna make my bunnies fall off...
Mission complete... Commander, I'm gonna take a nap... Zzzz...
Commander, your order...? "Anything as long as I'm with Laffey"? Aw, thank you...
Our commission team just got home. The pop-up shop... is about to get really busy...
I won... Cheers, Commander...
Oops, I spilled it... It's okay, though...
I almost slipped... Phew...
Can't get motivated to work... I'm not thinking of slacking off and going to see the Commander... Of course not. Obviously.
Mmm, eepy... The honorable Lady Laffey of the Castle of the Bunnies requires rest... Commander... I mean, Magistrate... Our tour must wait for now...
Mmm, eepy... The honorable Lady Laffey of the Castle of the Bunnies requires rest... Commander... I mean, Magistrate... Our tour must wait for now...
Welcome back, Magistrate... How much of our tour do we have left? A whole day...? Can Laffey change the setting of her territory's size?
Honorable Lady Laffey owns a big castle full of... umm, pillows? I'm tired... I forgot the setting we agreed on...
Cute, fluffy bunnies... Warm and comfy... Magistrate, come pet them...
The bunnies are sleeping... Everyone worked hard, so it's time to rest...
You can decide where we go next, Magistrate... When are we going? We can think about that after a nap...
Magistrate, do you like my bunny ear headband that much...?
Magistrate, do you like cool places? It's nice and cool next to Laffey...
The knot came undone, so Laffey's clothes are about to fall off. Magistrate, you are a pervert...
The government of the Castle of the Bunnies needs our help... You are permitted to take care of it yourself, Magistrate...
Our government affairs are dealt with. Back to our tour...
The bunnies brought mail for you, Magistrate. Take it with you...
Yaaawn... When I wake up, my Magistrate is back... I'm happy. As a retainer of Honorable Lady Laffey of the Castle of the Bunnies, you can't leave my side without my permission...
As my most important retainer, Commander... I mean, Magistrate, you'll always be mine... No, Laffey isn't trying to monopolize you. Nope, not at all...
Alaska-class large cruiser - Guam, Hull Number CB-2.

I'm Guam, 2nd ship of the Alaska class - still working on a nickname! I only made it for the tail end of the war, but I still dazzled everybody! Am I a super cruiser, a large cruiser, or a battlecruiser? Eh, they're all basically the same thing, so say whichever you want.

Morning, everybody! This is Eagle Union CB-2, Guam, bringing you another report! Hey, you must be the famous Commander! Tell us how it feels to welcome a new and beautiful shipgirl presenter to your fleet! Ahah, try to keep it short♪
Whatcha got planned today? Can I tag along? ...Where? Wherever you're going, duh!
You need a dance partner for the upcoming banquet? So basically you wanna cut a rug with me - got it!
Ugh, paperwork... Can't you just half-ass it, since this is basically just a time sink for grownups? No? C'mon, don't be such a stick in the mud~
Time to pick out the best pic the cameramanjuu crew took... Wait a sec, this is you, Commander! When'd they take this? It completely snuck under my radar!
Oh shoot, it's almost time for my meetup with Dandy Siego... Then again, she never shows up on time anyway, so I guess there's no rush♪
Commaaandeeer! Ahahah! Got your attention! C'mon, let's blow this joint~ You've lost your focus now anyway!
A presenter's gotta be multiskilled! 'Cause if I can do anything, people entrust me with more things!
Heehee, heeheeheehee♪
Basically, you wanna shoot the breeze? Hahah! Tell me all about yourself!
Ahahah♪ Try harder if you wanna catch me!
Mission commencing! Now get going! I'll stay here and report on your performance!
Mission complete! Wow, you got that done quicker than I could finish my daily lessons♪
Letter for you! Gotta say, this one was a pretty hard read.
Guam here, I just received word that the Commander is back! Let's hear what fierce battles were fought... after a review of this breaktime snack! Ahah♪
Commission complete! Cameramanjuu crew, boogie on with me to the dock!
Guam here with the news: I just powered up! ...You already knew that?
Basically, I just gotta knock 'em all out, yeah? Gotcha♪
Basically, I'm the Commander's number one, yeah? Am I wrong? C'mon, you know I'm right~
Retreat! Strategic reposition! Or let's just call it bailing out!
I'm not sure what I'm doing, but I'm doing it!
What the-?! Now I've beefed it...
Stay tuned to find out how the Commander makes things right! That's the idea, no? I get you.
Cameramanjuu crew, cameras ready for this legendary pic - snap! Ahahah♪ Lookadat, a dual selfie of the beautiful journalistic sensation Guam and her dear Commander! Perfection!

There's all kinds of presenters, y'know. There's the dodgy type, the smooth type, the mature type, and so on... Which one am I? I'm, uh... Crap! I've always just been myself, so I've never really thought about it!

So, Commander, whaddya think is attractive about me? Do you think I'm a head-turner? ...I'm not the brightest, and I think I have a good figure, but I can only really flaunt it to you, and lastly, I guess I always speak my mind... Huh? Is that all I need?

Basically, all I need is for YOU to love me, is what you're saying? Phew... Thank god. I was literally about to have a freakout over what I'm gonna do in the future... Then again, even if I did, I'd be fine as soon as I'd see you♪

Whoa, what?! You just gave me an extraordinary gift... You mind if I go flaunt this to everybody? I wanna show it off even if you say no! 'Cause this gift is mine and mine only, and it's something special... *blushes*
So what you're saying is you love me? I'm right, aren't I? Knew it♪
Let's just all agree that I'm stronger!
A bridal lecture on how to steal the Commander's heart... You serious?
I wanna be number one too!
I'm no wordsmith, so I'll leave writing the battle report to you!

ex.line: Commandeeer! Morning! You're such an early bird, I had to really push myself to catch up with you.

I got your special gift, so it's only fair I get special treatment, too. You know, like getting morning cuddles, free lunches, and the most tasks during battle... You can't do that last one? Aww... *blushes*
Doing math is sooo hard, and using a calculator takes too long... Gneisenau, what's the number here? Ah, appreciate it♪
My clothes feel tight... Maybe I've been eating too much lately... What can I do, though? Your cooking and snacks are just too delish to pass up on, Commander... *blushes*
Wonder when I'll become more like Dandy Siego... Hm? I DO genuinely admire her. I mean, she's got a ton of stars, she shines like a star, and she's the star of our port, period.
Studying is so not my thing, but I'll learn anything if you want me to! That's my motto from now on! Look forward to hearing it♪
So basically, you wanna go have some fun, right? Alright, then I'll come with... Hey! Cameramanjuu crew! You don't need to snap photos of this!
C'mon, Commander, you can do better♪
C'mon, cameramanjuu crew, get more shots of the Commander! Yeah, it's fine to get pics of me, but at least get both me and the Commander in frame... Ahah☆ Welcome home, Commander!
Commander, the commission team is back! Go tell 'em hi for me!
Basically, I'm the only one fit to lead this operation? I gotchu covered!

Being so in love your mind goes blank is nice, but doesn't it suck if you can't tell what your partner's thinking? Hmm... How about this - let's both not use a single one of our brain cells! No thoughts, head empty as we go on walks, eat, play, and... Huh? What were we talking about?

lines.line: Bunny idol, on the stage♪ Commander! You're in for a banger performance, so just forget about everything else and keep your eyes on me!
Bunny idol, on the stage♪ Commander! You're in for a banger performance, so just forget about everything else and keep your eyes on me!
Guam here, wishing you a good evening from the stage! Did you not realize how late it is, Commander? Ahah☆ I'm joking, I'm joking - it's all just visual effects♪
Don't I look better than Dandy Siego with this fit on? Ahah☆
Whoa... This bunny idol thing is popping off! I need to thank Laffey for the idea later!
"Where are you looking? I'm right over here~" Ahahah! Stop looking away, Commander~
Cameramanjuu crew, remember to get some shots of the audience, too! Don't you try to hide, Commander!
(Crap! Jumping up here is pretty dangerous... But with the Commander watching, maybe it's worth the risk?)
Yeah, Commander! I love you! Now say "I love you too," loud and clear!
Save it for AFTER the show, okay? Ahahah♪
Aren'tcha happy you get to see me perform the moment you come back? I know you are! So forget all your troubles and be happy♪
It's so easy being the MVP when you're the Commander's number one!

Kunoichi Guam, arriving in style! Brought to you live, this episode features a ninja with zero ninjutsu knowledge trying to enter the Commander's room to- Aaahhhh! Owch... This infiltration mechanism's so hard to use... No, wait, Commander, don't stop the camera! Little accidents are just part of a variety show♪

Kunoichi Guam, arriving in style! Brought to you live, this episode features a ninja with zero ninjutsu knowledge trying to enter the Commander's room to- Aaahhhh! Owch... This infiltration mechanism's so hard to use... No, wait, Commander, don't stop the camera! Little accidents are just part of a variety show♪
This is kunoichi Guam, sneaking right into the Commander's room and- Aaahhh! M-my custom-made outfit got caught on something!
How would Dandy Siego get out of this sticky situation? Think, Guam, think... Wait, no, Dandy wouldn't think at all in this case! I'm screwed!
"Try figuring it out on my own first"? Look, Commander, I may be multitalented, but even I have limits on what I can and can't do!

The beautiful kunoichi Guam's in a real pickle! Now the Commander's gonna interrogate her! ...You reckon I should just play it straight in this case? Alright, then how are you gonna punish me for showing up out of nowhere, huh? Heehee♪
Chill, it's fine! Sure, some inappropriate parts might be showing, but it's all good as long as we have fun... right?
Oh, no, my clothes... Hey, you can't show this on TV!
Ahaha♡ Are we heading in a sexy direction after all?
Welcome back, Commander! My feet are getting kinda numb here... Be a darling and come help me! Getting a little massage would be sweet, too!
The commission team? So you're saying you'll help me AFTER you've gone and greeted them, right? No problem♪

Hm? When you REALLY think about it, I'm no professional kunoichi! And who cares if I make an oopsie once in a while? Besides, handling a little accident is what I do best as a multitalented presenter! And if I fail a mission, I'll just use my ultimate skill - Direct Declaration of Love! I love you, Commander!
Lexington-class battlecruiser - Constellation, Hull Number CC-2.

I am Constellation, hull number CC-2. It was a little unfortunate that I couldn't sail forth with my sister ships. It became my routine to gaze at the stars while I awaited my own time to shine. Commander, how is the view of the night sky from this port?

Stars - shining in the clear night sky, their glow traveling countless lightyears. To see it with your eyes, to witness and embrace this glimmer from space, 'tis romance. Lexington-class battlecruiser Constellation greets you, Commander.
*yawn*... Welcome back, Commander... A little out of it, you say? Sorry, I stayed up late waiting for a meteor shower last night. I'll manage, so don't you worry.
A beginner-friendly stargazing spot... Maybe parks, or mountaintops? Sparse suburbs and remote beaches are good, too. If it's my personal favorite you're asking for... That's much harder to choose.
Do you know about the Daily Horoscope Reading channel, Commander? Heehee, truth be told, I'm the one who runs it. Shall I tell you your fortune for today?
I watch the stars at night and sleep during the day. I'm sad that I miss meetups with my friends, but I don't know what else I could do...
I've been thinking about how much overtime you do, and it worries me. I'm going to stay here with you today.
Does the thing on my head get in the way of stargazing, you ask? Nope. I can even make it go away. Like this.
Commander...? Are you going to take me somewhere?
Eep! H-here I thought you only had eyes for the stars...
You've received a new mission. Commander, there is quite a lot of paperwork to process... Which do I start with? This one? Or this?
Gosh, this is so hard... You may be the only one who can finish all these missions efficiently, Commander.
Commander, you have new mail... Fetch the latest Astronomy Monthly while I'm here? Heehee. Of course.
Great. You're back. It's a relief to see you again, Commander.
The commission team has returned. I'd like to go to distant lands, if I get the chance... A sea far from all the lights would be the ideal stargazing spot.
Stars more far-flung are now in my view.
Hmm... Y-you leave me with no choice! Swarm them!
To describe this feeling, it's like a happenstance meeting with the stars. It's majestic, serene, and lifts the spirit.
The clouds have gathered... The stars are with us no more... Ugh...
Gaze upon the stars and travel the cosmos!
The stars are dimming...
Oh... So you're also measuring mine and other girls' worth...
On a stroll, Commander? ...Me? I'm waiting for the stars... Ahem, what I meant to say is... I'm just feeling the wind in my hair.
The stars told me your fortune. They said - your prayer will be answered positively; you can be at ease, Commander.

I brought you some Astronomy Monthly mags... Was it tiring, you wonder? They weren't exactly THAT heavy... Um, the reason I brought them all is because I couldn't decide on just one. You choose whichever looks the most interesting!

What's on my mind? Nothing too complicated. Just pondering which telescope to buy, comparing their designs and features... It's not about how I'm going to use it, because I'm gonna give it to y- Ahem! I-I'm only gonna use it to see what's out there in deep space! *blushes*
You're giving this... to me? It's like wearing a star on my finger... F-from now on, you'll be my star and mine alone. Heehee... Because the only one I'll be gazing at is you♥
Are you giving this to me? And you're sure I can have it? I-I like it so much that I almost feel I shouldn't...
Idols really are people who bring dreams to life.
W-wait for me...!

ex.line: You can see it even from the port. That ephemeral, beautiful silver band that spans the nighttide... Yes, the Milky Way.
That one - the brightest star over there. Can you see it? Yep, exactly. It does shine as brightly as I do... Wait... H-huh?!
Gather a group and go stargazing together? Oh, so Wasp and Intrepid enjoy it too... Alright, I'll do that. The more, the merrier, right?

Mhh... You're trying to take the scenic route home, I see... By the way, did I do a good job of helping you finish your excess work early? Heehee, great. Oh! You see the stars so clearly from here! Ohh... They're beautiful...
I never thought I'd get to lean against you and watch the stars...
The stars will always be there for you.
That's enough stargazing for tonight. Whew... It's late, Commander... Shall we go home?
This photo of the night sky over the sea is so pretty. Oh, you're giving it to me? You remembered... Thank you, Commander.
Hm? I'm not going stargazing today. I'm staying here so I won't miss the moment you return.
I-intercept now!
I can endure it... My mind is set on it!
To see not just the stars when you look up, but also the lights in space even beyond that... Commander, this telescope is for you. Keep watching the stars by my side!

lines.line: Welcome, Commander. If you want me to take your order, please subscribe for one month to my horoscope reading on Juustagram... Heehee, I'm joking. If you have any questions, I will gladly answer.
Welcome, Commander. If you want me to take your order, please subscribe for one month to my horoscope reading on Juustagram... Heehee, I'm joking. If you have any questions, I will gladly answer.
Here's our drink menu for today. What would you like, Commander? ...My recommendation? Hmm... Err... *whimper*...
You don't have to worry about me feeling like I stick out. Just because I miss some get-togethers doesn't mean I don't like a lively party. Especially if it means I can stargaze with everyone.
Here's the drink you ordered. Uh, no, I'm still not used to this. I've just been practicing.
Isn't this planetarium gorgeous, Commander? ...Only because I'm so beautiful? G-gosh, where did that come from?!
Do you notice anything different about me today?
Are you sure I should have your drink? I'm working the refreshments bar, so...
*sigh*... Fine. Only because you're the star in my eye♪
There's a mission you should tend to. I feel bad for you, having to prepare for work even as you're trying to enjoy the drinks...
You got that mission done in the twinkle of an eye. If I were you, I'd still be fumbling over which one to start with...
Great job, Commander. Take your time and relax... You want to know your horoscope for tomorrow? Okay, umm... Just don't take it too seriously, this is only for fun, OK? Ahahah...
Independence-class light aircraft carrier - San Jacinto, Hull Number CVL-30.

I'm Independence-class aircraft carrier San Jacinto. During the war, I took to the water, fought, and watched over the flight of the young eagles... Frankly, I would've rather spent my time traveling around the world. Hahaha!
My name? I can't just go around telling strangers all that~ I'm kidding, I'm kidding♪ I'm San Jacinto, an Independence-class aircraft carrier. I'll be one of your new friends from now on~
I'm on day duty today~ Commander, were you expecting any... romantic developments?
Is work going okay? Your strategies working out? Heheheh, so you're doing just fine... Are you sure you want to tell me that? That means one less girl worrying about you~
My heart's beating faster... Commander, come closer and listen... Hahaha! You look a little embarrassed, Commander~
Finback... She's done a lot for me. Now it seems like it'll be your turn to do the same, Commander. Heheh!
I'm an expert at taking care of airplanes and friends alike. Heehee, maybe I'd be good at taking care of you, too, Commander...?
You're gonna mess up my hair, you know. Still wanna do that?
Commander, can I drink that cola on your desk? Oh, you already drank some...? Well, don't mind if I do~ Heheheh♪
You are getting to be that age~
Commandeeer! Keep slacking off, and you'll never finish your missions. That would be funny to watch, though~
These are the only rewards you get? Have you considered applying for a raise?
New mail arrived. I hope it's good news.
Welcome back, Commander. You look tired... Should I carry you over to the couch and help you—Oh! Wooow, so you can walk on your own~
What am I supposed to say now... "Commission complete." Right, Commander?
Heehee, it looks like I've grown a little~
The enemy formation is full of holes~ Heheheh.
Whoa. It's already over? Eh, not that I'm all that disappointed~
We lost, huh~ What now?
Sleep peacefully~
I can't cause trouble for the Commander, not now...
You did that on purpose, didn't you, Commander~ Huh? Y-you were serious?
I hear you take care of everyone, but who cares for the carer? If nobody's doing it, I could... Well, maybe my worries are unnecessary~
You still have a whole lot of work left today, huh... Commander, would you like my help? In return... go out with me when we're done~
Goodness, Commander, your clothes are dirty. May I clean them for you? Yes, here and now. Let's hurry up and get those clothes off of you~

Heehee, I get to visit your room today~ What will I be doing? Taking care of you, of course. You've been so kind to me, and I want to thank you, and also... Oh! Let's not just stand here and talk. Hope you don't mind if I borrow a spot in your bed~♪

The ceremony of exchanging vows, the proof commemorating it... I can tell you put so much thought into it~ Commander, may I be a little picky myself? Heehee. Close your eyes, lean in, and try giving me a little kiss♪
Goodness, what a lovely present! What would you like in return, Commander? Nothing's off the table~
Okay, everyone! Attacking positions!

ex.line: Day duty... That means I get to be alone with you, so it's just a win for me! Heehee.
The operation went smoothly, and that makes work easier... Hmm. At this rate, I won't get to worry about you~ ...Heehee♪
Commander, there's rice stuck on your lip~ ...Mm, tasty~ Is there some on mine, too? Heehee, well, I'm waiting!
The pillow Bataan recommended for me? Would you like to try sleeping on it some time, Commander? Hmm, I'm just not sure if a Hellcat plushie counts as a pillow...
I don't mind if there are other girls who are good at taking care of you, Commander. It'd be worse if you were so perfect that there was nothing I could do for you! Heheheh.
Commander, would you like a drink? Heehee, I'll pop one open right away~
Am I really that attractive to you~? Heehee♪
You're so cool when you do all your work, Commander~
Have a towel, Commander♪ For what? Wiping away your sweat, of course. Or were you looking forward to something else? Heehee. Okay, then we can do what you were looking forward to later...
Commander, I won~ Anyway, where's my usual reward? Hm? You know EXACTLY what I mean♪
Hm? I'm just in the middle of waiting for someone I love. In fact, I just found said person! Heehee, where should we go now? It's a date, you know~ A date♪

lines.line: Would you like me to recommend a drink? Hmm... You're quite the drinker, Commander~ Let's see if you can handle my favorite♪ Heehee!
Would you like me to recommend a drink? Hmm... You're quite the drinker, Commander~ Let's see if you can handle my favorite♪ Heehee!
Thank you for waiting, Commander. I've brought you my favorite drink. Mind if I fill two glasses? Of course I plan to drink with you~
Hahaha, you must love these uniforms, Commander~ Oh? No, you say? Are you suuure?
You're not bad at drinking~ Who trained you? ...The Northern Parliament girls? Well... That does make sense.
You want to sit next to me? Be my guest~ You've been drinking, so careful you don't fall... Whoa, whoa?! Th-thank you...
Commander, c'meeere~ Whoa, stop, stop♪ Haha, your face crashed into my finger~
Heehee, I might've drank a liiittle too much♥
Missions, huh~ I'm trying to open this drink, so can it wait a minute?
Yaaaay♪ Good job finishing your missions~ As a reward from me... let's pop this one open~
If you're worried about anything, try getting a little tipsy to forget about it! I'm with you, so I won't let any of the others see you drunk, okay? Heehee.
Northampton-class heavy cruiser - Louisville, Hull Number CA-28.

I'm the Northampton-class heavy cruiser, Louisville. During the war, I supported aircraft carriers, helped as a training ship, intercepted battleship fleets... Oh, hmm. My training ship era may have been earlier in my career...? Um, I'm not quite sure...

Heavy cruiser Louisville has come to port. From now on, I work for the Commander... Say, where was the Commander's office, again? Not here... Over there, maybe? Umm, can I trouble you to help me find it...?
Today's schedule is... observing the port, confirming the drill plans, sitting in on a friendly meeting... Hm? Which one was the first thing in the morning, again...?
Do my best to remember your plans for today...? I-isn't that a little too easy...? Your next item of business today would be... U-umm...
I go drinking with Lucky Lou all the time~ Oh, but the next day, I never remember what happened... Even when I don't get drunk...
Of course I remember my job. Even I can remember things if I really put my mind to it! Yep!
When you get focused on work, you can tend to lose sight of what's around you and forget what needs remembering. No matter how tight your schedule is, make sure to work in moderation, okay?
Hmm...?
Do you need something, Commander?
Ah...? Did you just touch me?
I feel like there were missions to be done... Commander, would you mind checking again?
Mission complete. I think you should accept those rewards before you forget.
You have mail. Let's open this one first... Huh? Which one was the new one, again...? Do you remember?
Welcome back, Commander. I made a nutritious meal for you, so eat up... You want to eat together? Okay! In that case... Oh, my. I didn't make any for myself...
Did someone just come home? ...Hmph, of course I know it's the commission team. Commander, please don't tease me.
My power-up was a success. This is just amazing, isn't it~
Lady Lou is here to fight!
Louisville wins the title of MVP! Isn't that just lovely~
It seems I've failed... Let's escape through this route, okay, Commander?
Focus on the target... and fire!
Secure an escape route, just in case...!
Never hurt your friends or make them sad. If you remember only one thing, let that be it.
Commander, it's almost break time. I brought you some snacks... Oh? You say I just brought you drinks? Now that you mention it...

Commander, I'm here to help you with your work today. You always seem so tired, so I want to help out... Wait, I told you yesterday that I would? A-ahahaha... Goodness, is there something wrong with me?
Commander, I finished sorting your documents. ...The time? Oh... I'm sorry. I always lose track of time... I-it's not like I'm done working, so I might as well continue...?
Zzzz... Oh, no. I fell asleep in the Commander's office... H-huh? Why am I here...? I was helping you work? Did I really offer to do that...?

What are you just staring for, Commander? Aren't we supposed t o exchange vows—Hm? You want to kiss first...? I-I understand you're not forgetting the order. You're just trying to skip a step or two... W-we can skip ahead even more, if you want...?
You memorized my preferences? My! I should study what you like too, Commander...
Is it just me, or does my outfit not match...?

ex.line: Let's see what your schedule for today... Patrolling the academy, checking equipment, a date with Louisville... Come again? Actually, the only item on the schedule today is our date? O-oh...
Today's agenda... Going to the movies, inspecting the new set, and eating out... Of course I remember, Commander. They're OUR plans, after all!
We drank together yesterday, Commander. Don't you remember? O-oh... You got super drunk along the way, and then... N-nothing happened! *blush*
Commander, you already signed this document. Goodness, I told you I'd do my best not to forget things... See? It's signed. Hmph!
*sigh*... Huh? O-oh, it's nothing! I wasn't so absorbed in gazing at you that I forgot to work, or anything... Ack...
Have you forgotten something?
Nnnh... *blushes* Y-you just touched me, didn't you? My brain might forget, but my body remembers.
Commander, welcome back. Shall we eat lunch together? Heehee, don't be shy, eat up~ Seeing you enjoy my food is what nourishes me~
Commander, the commission team is back. Shall we deliver nutritious meals to the pier?
Lady Lou and the Commander set sail...
Zzzz... Mmm... Oh? Commander, why are you in my room... Hm? I see, so this was your office all this time... Why would I make such a mistake? Umm, are you sure this is your office...?

lines.line: Commander, here's your order of... Umm, it's written on the ticket, right... Huh? Where did I put that thing? Oh no, I'm in real trouble if I mess up the Commander's order...
Commander, here's your order of... Umm, it's written on the ticket, right... Huh? Where did I put that thing? Oh no, I'm in real trouble if I mess up the Commander's order...
Commander, would you like a refill? This isn't a real restaurant, so it's not like you have to pay...

I do remember that you like these bunny outfits, Commander, but I have to wonder... Oh, no; it isn't that I don't like wearing it. But I wonder how much of it is interest in the outfit, versus how much of it is interest in me...
Put the sugar cube on the fork, light it on fire... Haha! Even when you're always drinking the same thing, it's nice to get creative with how you drink once in a while, no?
Ask me for more drinks any time you want. I-if possible, ordering the same thing again would help me... No! I'll do my best to remember!
Houston's outfit looks a little more tight-fitting than usual, or is it just me... Huh? Is mine the same way...?
It's awful hard to carry these trays...
Umm... Is this a part of your order, too...?
What snacks go well with liquor? I'm glad you asked! Let me introduce Louisville's own special menu! People say it's full of mature and nostalgic tastes. Heehee♪
Gato-class submarine - Flasher, Hull Number SS-249.
I'm Flasher, Gato-class submarine. I cry a lot, but... *sniffle*... it's not... *whimper*... I-it's not because I'm a wimp or anything. When it comes to a fight, I've got you alright!

Hello, Commander. I'm the Gato-class submarine Flasher, SS-249... *sniffle*... I-I'm crying because... w-well, not because I'm sick or scared or anything. It's just that I... *sob*... shed tears when I'm moved.
Good morning, Commander. It's a lovely day today. Can we go hunt some enemies?
I did the frills and the appliqué on my clothes. I even made this sunfish plushie! I'll aaalways be safe as long as I have it with me, and it'll never get scared and run away.
I hate arguments because I always cry before I even say anything, even when I've come up with a retort... *sob*...
Everyone here is so nice. Whenever something happens between me and my friends, we settle it peacefully. They even apologize even when I did something wrong... *sniffle*... Why are they THAT nice?
I make cosplay clothes for people when I'm not fighting. Commander, do you... have a character you wanna cosplay? I can... *sniffle*... make their outfit for you.
I don't mind it if you pat a little more. Mhm. Thanks.
Your touch makes me happy... Ow! I forgot I was holding a needle! Waahhh! I pricked my finger! *whimper*...
*whimper*... Sh-should we really be doing this?
A new mission... Are you gonna do it now, Commander?
Mission completifications! They even gave us some goodies. Whoa! A lot of them, actually!
Excuse me! Commander, there's a new letter for you.
I guess your foes didn't give you much trouble. Phew... That's a relief.
The commission team is back, and it looks like they brought a biiig pile of stuff with them.
You really care about me... Thank you!
If you think you can run, think again!
What a perfect sinking... *sniffle*... Heehee.
Waaahh! We lost... But next time, victory will be mine!
You're not getting away!
This is nothing! Hmph!
Target sighted! Umm... So... I-I'll be on my way now, Commander.
Wow... You complimented me! Heehee... I only did my job, but still. Heehee... I'm kind of humbled. *sniffle*...
I often visit the aquarium when I have time. It's so quiet and peaceful there underwater, compared to the sea. And it's so calming to watch the fishies blow bubbles.

Commander, your uniform's second button from the top is a little loose... You'll let me replace it? Well, I don't have a sewing kit on me right now, and I promise I wasn't after your button, and... *whimper*...

Heehee. I'm making a plushie, Commander. Look! This is a seal, and this one is... Huh? You've seen this button before? Well, yeah, you gave it to me... I'm making a plushie of you so you can always be with me.
Gosh, you're taking this so seriously... D-don't get me wrong, I am happy, I just don't know how to... *whimper*... N-now I'm in tears... *sob*... I'm so happy... I'll be with you forever and ever!
I'm gonna sew a bag to put this present in!
Group up, and let's all howl like wolves!

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Oh, a thread has come loose on your cuff... Wait just a sec and I'll fix it with my sewing kit. I'll be done in no time!
Commander... do you like my sunfish plushie? I'll make another just for you!
Have you been waiting long, Commander? *whimper*... Sorry for taking so long getting ready when I'm the one who said we should go to the aquarium... *sob*...
Um... I was thinking about the date we're gonna go on, and, uh... I couldn't get a blink of sleep last night! Heehee...
You get attached to the fishies so easily, Commander. That's a mood for me, though. I love it when you're around, too... Heehee.
Heehee... This is relaxing.
When I prick myself with a needle, I just lick my finger and the pain goes away. Whoa! Commander, th-that tickles!
Commander... You're gonna stretch my plushie's fabric!
I'm gonna go after bigger prey!
I wonder if my plushie of you gets lonely when I'm not around... Hm? Just make a plushie of myself and let them be together? G-good idea! I think I'll do that!

lines.line: W-welcome, Commander... I-I as the manager will be serving you today, so l-let's hear your order... *sniffle*... I'm so tense it's making me cry...
W-welcome, Commander... I-I as the manager will be serving you today, so l-let's hear your order... *sniffle*... I'm so tense it's making me cry...
*sob*... Welcome back, Commander! Hmm? Why am I crying? Th-the tears started flowing when I saw you...
Let's hear your order, Commander! ...Wh-whatever I want to have? A mango sundae, a parfait, and... W-wait, no! I'm supposed to be taking YOUR order!
Thanks, but I can bring it out myself... Hm? It's right for a manager to accept a customer's help? I-is it, really?
Heehee. I'm actually quite good at math, so don't you worry! I can man the register just fine, too. Your total comes to... Yup, just what I thought!
Hmm? I'm the manager, and you're the server? I guess there's some truth to that...
Waahhh! I-I'm gonna drop the receipt!
Welcome back! Have a drink to take the edge off!
There! I totally nailed that order! Heehee...
Waahhh... I-I got it wrong...
Heehee, I'm so happy to be with you. *sniffle*... B-but you've got work, so you should get going... It'll be fine? And you can be with me more than the usual today? Oh, that's great!
1913 Naval Expansion Project 26,000-ton battlecruiser - Huan Ch'ang.

I am Huan Ch'ang, battlecruiser of the Dragon Empery. Though the past cannot be rewritten... Kun above, Kan below - success in all things to come... Heehee. I took this opportunity to divine the future, and I see only good things to come.

I am Huan Ch'ang, battlecruiser of the Dragon Empery. And you must be the Commander I've heard so much about? Now that I've seen you in person... Heehee. Does your mettle measure up to your vaunted name? Very well. Allow me to be the judge of that.

You've returned? I've already placed today's itinerary on your desk, and stand ready for any operation- Hm? I've done well to prepare for a rainy day? It seems rather inappropriate to praise me with such words given the situation at hand?
You'd like to get to know me better...? Just know that what I am about to tell you can be either fact or fiction. One's heart is not something that can be penetrated so easily~

Though I use these hexagrams to divine heaven's will, such results are not to be believed blindly. After all, there exist special individuals who can challenge destiny. And you, Commander, are one such individual.

Remain patient, and do not sway even in the face of change. As the situation develops, your opportunity will inevitably arise... Huh? You don't think this reading is accurate? You want to know how it pertains to the r-relationship between us? ...Th-the result probably wouldn't change!

Fu Shun and Fei Yuen are such energetic girls... It's n-not like I'm trying to dote on them or anything. ...Huh? I always give off different vibes around them than when I'm with you? I mean, those girls are my family, and you, umm... I guess you kind of count too?
...Ahhn~ W-wait, I'm not some child who needs to be comforted...
...If you don't need anything from me, I will return to my training.
Today's reading said that prurient acts shall be met with terrible fates. Are you sure you wish to continue with that?
Here's a list of today's missions. You said you intended to knock everything out right away, so-- Where shall we begin?
Here are the rewards for completing our objectives. Please take a look, Commander.
I've sorted through the mail for you. I've set the important material aside, so please make sure to look over it.
Kun above, Zhen below. Obstacles give way, and good fortune arrives. ...See, I performed a divination for you, and you've returned safe and sound.

Commander, you should go welcome back the girls in the commission fleet. I've prepared some thank-you gifts for them, and would appreciate if you... I-it's not like I'd be too embarrassed to deliver them myself!
Heehee. This power... shall become your sturdiest pillar.
From glyphs sixfold, all principles arise. Master them, and all of creation is yours to command.
And thus, heaven's will be done. A splendid victory indeed.
...What a miscalculation. I was one step behind.
Break their formation, and cut off their command!
...Surely I can muster more than this!
Looks like you're not what you were chalked up to be. Though, I never should've expected anything greater in the first place.

Commander, I've brought you today's itinerary. Please take a look- Why, yes. Underneath that is my personal schedule... Hmm? Why do I have so many additional training sessions? That's because... it's far too soon to start becoming complacent.

Heehee. It's rare to see you have spare time on your hands... Would you like to enjoy some sweet osmanthus wine with me? Though, this particular cup has been made to suit my tastes- C-Commander?! How come your eyes are glazing over after just one sip...?! Even though I only added half a jar of sugar...?!

Sometimes, I wonder if I, as an unfinished ship that was nothing more than a plan, can truly be of use... With no history to speak of, I often feel as if this power I possess is nothing more than a fleeting dream... Will I truly be able to protect everyone? Will I truly be able... to protect you?

I try to come off as strong and confident to others, but around you, I can finally take my mask off and reveal my weaknesses and insecurities... How strange it all is... Commander, do you mind if I stay like this for a bit longer? Your embrace... is so very warm.

This has to be... some kind of prank, right? Wait, no... Xun above, Gen below... To a young lady, congratulations are in order... Huh? Are you serious? W-wait, give me a moment to process this... Um, ahem... C-Commander, thank you... For accepting my weaknesses, for taking my hand and granting me new strength... F-from now on, we'll always be together, until the icy depths do us part.
Hm. You went all-out just to flatter me...
Harbin, hands off my osmanthus wine!
Shhh! Don't tell the Commander that I don't like bitter or spicy food!

ex.line: Heehee. You're back? What would you like to start the day with? ...Don't worry. No matter what you decide, I'll be right there with you.

Lung Wu's mastery of the culinary arts is certainly impressive, but she could stand to gain a greater appreciation for sweetness... Hm? What do I think is the proper amount of sweetness? I mean, one can of sugar would be the bare minimum...

Hm? You're wondering why I can tolerate the bitterness and spice of alcohol, but can't handle bitter melon or chili peppers? Those are completely different things-- Wait! How'd you find out about that?!

...I knew it, you can no longer tell the fortunes of those too close to you. What am I sighing over? ...Take a look at this. It's the hexagram for your love life. What in the world is this convoluted web? Surely there must be some kind of mistake...
If you don't need me for anything, I'll go back to divining your future, okay?
...We're still outside, you know?! At least... wait until we get back!
Looks like we've got new work. ...You're tired? I guess a short break can't hurt.
Commander, the rewards are in. Want to do a quick look-around?

Well fought out there. You didn't get hurt, did you? ...Even if you say that, I'm still a bit worried. Mind if I do a little check-up? --Hm? Why didn't I just do a divination? Um, well... I was too worried about you to focus on that...

lines.line: Happy New Year, Commander. Hmm? I look a bit different from usual? Why of course, it's because it was chosen to suit your tastes by none other than Chi An. Even this mask is brand new. I look "like a fairy from the sacred mountains," you say? I wonder... who taught you to say something like that?

Happy New Year, Commander. Hmm? I look a bit different from usual? Why of course, it's because it was chosen to suit your tastes by none other than Chi An. Even this mask is brand new. I look "like a fairy from the sacred mountains," you say? I wonder... who taught you to say something like that?
Welcome back, Commander. Hm? You think that I tend to give off rather... grim vibes? My apologies. I'll try to be more mindful of that in the future...

Hm? Why did I choose this spot? ...B-because, it's embarrassing to be in this outfit! I wanted to go somewhere without a lot of people, but before I knew it, I made the place seem as if it was haunted...
You brought me some warmed osmanthus wine? Ehehe... I'll be helping myself then~ Eep! Hot! D-don't say a word about this to anyone, you hear? I totally do not have a sensitive tongue!
I made some new masks to match my new outfit, but I can't decide on which one to wear... Oh, I know! Why don't you help me pick one out?
Hmm? If there's anything you need me for, please do not hesitate to let me know. Anytime, anywhere.
Heehee~♪ Right here? How bold... and awfully reminiscent of a certain Empery ghost story~

Congratulations on the successful operation, Commander. Let me do a quick inspection... Mm. Everything looks fine. Just a bit of soot on your clothes, but otherwise... thank goodness you've returned safely.
Alas, how can the light from fireflies above rotten grass ever compare to the brilliance of the moon above?
Hmm? Am I cold in this outfit? Not particularly~ See, take my hands - warm, aren't they? That's just how I'm built. If you're cold, however... You're always welcome to come give me a hug~
CNT Shipyard 1,800-ton small protected cruiser - Chi An.

I am Chi An of the Dragon Empery. I am a light cruiser created through an improvement upon the design of the Novara-class cruisers. As for how I came to be... Have you ever heard of the designation, CNT-65? Hehe, I'm actually a lot more knowledgeable than you would expect~♪

Greetings. I am Chi An, light cruiser of the Dragon Empery. Now that we've gotten these stiff introductions out of the way... Commander, should you ever have any worries on your mind from now on, you can always turn to me~♪
Good day. You seem to be in high spirits today, heehee. I'm sure today's work will go smoothly.
What's on your mind? If you're ever feeling indecisive, lost, or anxious about the future... you can always come talk to me~

It is said that war is the art of deception, but in reality, the resources at your disposal are limited. Do you seek to make micro-level changes, or do you seek macro-level stability? This.... is the difference between a tactician and a strategist.
I do enjoy a good game of Go. ...No, I don't particularly care for the tense clash of wits. It's just nice to have a pleasant conversation with my opponent.
...Now, this is quite unfortunate. Even Fu Shun doesn't want me going into the kitchen. Do you think you could help me improve my cooking skills, Commander?
Why don't you let me pat your head instead, Commander~
Oh my, are you interested in trying some of my home cooking? "Anything but that"? Aww...
Oh... My, oh my... Heehee. How wonderfully daring of you~♪
Commander, please remember to complete your missions. The greatest advantages begin with small steps taken daily.
Mission complete. Slowly but steadily, this is how great advantages are accrued.
There's new mail for you. Oh, looks like my cookbook has arrived as well~
Welcome back, Commander. Oh, your collar's all messed up... Heehee. That should do the trick.
The girls from the commission team have returned. Naturally, you should go express your gratitude to them. Cultivating harmonious relationships is important, you know?
Mm. That feels pretty nice~♪
Strike while the iron is hot~♪
Strategies devised in the command tent can determine the outcome of battles waged thousands of miles away~♪
Soldiers know well both the sweetness of victory and the bitterness of defeat. The more important thing is to try again.
The flow of battle is mine to control!
This has gotten rather troublesome...
Jeez... I know I said you could always come to me if you had any worries on your mind, but... If this is how you're going to be... *sigh*, oh well...
The girls are saying that I can make any problem melt right away? Heehee... I think they're exaggerating a bit. I'm simply a good listener, nothing more~

Even though I choose to be everyone's listener, there's a reason why I don't make suggestions or decisions for them. "True knowledge lies in knowing that there are things you do not know." Heehee... Commander, this is an adage you understand well, right?
Oh my... Did you want to vent your frustrations? I'm glad you remembered what I said. Heehee. In return, you wouldn't mind if I try to get to know you a bit more... intimately, would you?
...By the way, Commander, do you think you'd be willing to lend me an ear now? I won't take too much of your time. Umm... Actually, this time, um... it's about plans for this year's Qixi festival...

An important discussion, hmm? Heehee. Is this what you meant? My, I suppose I was caught off guard this time by your bold and decisive move. Though, I do hope you've prepared yourself, because my counterattack is going to be even more passionate~♡
Aww, isn't that cute?
You certainly have a different way of doing things.

ex.line: Good day. Are you ready to take care of today's work? Heehee. I'll lend you my full assistance.
Care for a game of Go? No matter what you might have on your mind, the board is the perfect place to vent.
You managed to win by half a point with Chen Hai? Oh, I doubt it's solely because I instructed you well. But, a win is a win... So, can I expect a reward from you?
Thanks to your special training course, I was finally able to earn permission to enter the kitchen. Mmhmm~♪
You'll teach me how to cook? I'm so glad to hear that~
Oh my, surely you don't think I'd just let you end it there~?

Out of curiosity, Commander, are you free today? Would you like to spend the Qixi Festival with me? ...It's too early for that? Hmm, are you sure there isn't something wrong with your calendar? Because according to my calendar, today is Qixi, and so is tomorrow, and the day after... Every day is Qixi, you know...

lines.line: May blessings reach you this coming spring. Hm? My outfit? Heehee. Since the ever-so-busy Commander came to see me on this special occasion, I naturally had to put in some effort too- Now then, set aside all your worries, and come enjoy this wonderful evening with me~♪

May blessings reach you this coming spring. Hm? My outfit? Heehee. Since the ever-so-busy Commander came to see me on this special occasion, I naturally had to put in some effort too- Now then, set aside all your worries, and come enjoy this wonderful evening with me~♪
Commander, you're right on time. Hurry, let's enjoy a night cruise along the lively river~♪

How do you think our lovely little cruise will end? In the festive and bustling streets, in a wondrous display of fireworks, or amidst the endless lanterns illuminating the river? Let's take in all the sights and sounds until the very end, together. How does that sound? Heehee~

Um... Ehh? There's a branch in the river up ahead? Should we go left... or right? I can't believe a strategist such as myself can get lost like this... Ugh, stop making fun of me already and help me figure out which route will be more interesting to traverse~

Come to think of it, the flower lanterns floating down the river are said to contain everyone's wishes for a smooth year to come. Seeing all the lanterns gathering around us like this makes me think that our relationship will follow suit as well... Heehee~♪

Oh, look~ There's a row of food stalls next to the pier over there. I have a feeling we'll be able to find lots of novel food! Want to head over there in a bit and buy something? Of course, I'd share with you~♪
Hmm? You'd like to share a flower lantern with me? Of course that's fine, but... you'll have to come sit in my lap~
Oh my... I know exactly what you're thinking~♪
Oh my, the rivers converge here once more. Now then, Commander, what sights did you witness along your particular route? I'm simply dying to know~

You've made me a very happy girl, you know? Look, we got to enjoy this wonderful scenery, and also shared this night cruise together... Hah, how nice it would be if we could be together like this... forever.
Phew... Fancy seeing the person of my dreams AFTER I've woken up! Heehee, if this is as fate decrees... Weary traveler, come to me and rest your tired legs.
Phew... Fancy seeing the person of my dreams AFTER I've woken up! Heehee, if this is as fate decrees... Weary traveler, come to me and rest your tired legs.
Oh, it's you. Heehee, even the winds and sands can't stop my destined partner's arrival.
Oh? Do you find this whole "traveler and nobility" shtick a little awkward? But everyone dressed up for it! Relax and role-play a little, Commander.
I know you've seen much in your travels, but surely you must need a peaceful place of rest. Maybe here is the place for you to unload your burdens.
If you find this exposition plain, then why don't we do it over a game or an exotic meal... Oh? You don't want my cooking? Aww, but why?
Everything here is so perfect, yet I know that you will someday leave... Ah, how I wish you could stay...
Your tenderness always warms my heart, Commander.
Hm? Do you have a question for me? I'm happy to answer~
Oh, my... This traveler is a naughty one.
Do you still have unfinished tasks? Heehee, then let me help you take care of them all. Then we can resume our fun...
You've got new mail... A call to new adventure, perhaps?
You must be tired from your journey. Don't be afraid~ There's a soft, fluffy bed with your name on it right here.
The commission team is back. Let's get back to this after we've welcomed them, okay?
Heehee... Destined partner, traveler from my dreams... If the fates so favor our love, then why don't you turn this sojourn into a permanent one? Let us weave a future together in this palace.
Vulcan Stettin 1,000-ton torpedo destroyer - Lung Wu.

Dragon Empery destroyer, Lung Wu. I'll pass on the fighting and paperwork stuff, but if you need anything food-related, just leave it to me! So, what's your favorite type of cooking? Grilling, frying, stir-frying, broiling, steaming? You name it, I'll cook it!
The name's Lung Wu... Dragon Empery destroyer. Um... uhh... have you seen Hu Pen around? Also... which way is it to the kitchen?
...Uhh, welcome? You wanna see today's menu? Here you go! Just lemme know if anything catches your eye! Recommendations? Uhh, I have so many specialties, I'll have to think about that one...
Tips for stir-frying? You need high heat, and oil! That's how you get that rich, wok hei flavor!

...Me, go on a vacation outdoors? Ehh... I think I'll pass. Not really interested in that... What AM I interested in, you ask? Researching recipes, of course! Recently, I've come across a method of making red-braised pork belly even more delicious! Wanna give it a try, Commander?
Xiaolongbao with chocolate filling? Mapo tofu with strawberry jam?! ...Gaaaaah, I've had it! From now on, only people with business here are allowed inside the kitchen!

...You want to observe me while I cook? That's fine and all, but if you pull any funny business like Fu Shun... I'm being too strict? Nonsense! You're being too lax, Commander! The kitchen is a battlefield!
H-how am I supposed to read the recipe like this...
Feeling peckish? I have spring rolls right here. That ought to fill you up a little bit.
...Steamed, stir-fried, deep-fried, or pressure cooked. Take your pick.
We've got new work. Are you sure you want to leave it for later? Can you just take care of it now? I'll have dim sum waiting for you when you're done.
Mission rewards are in. Don't forget to pick 'em up. As for what's inside... we'll probably be able to buy all sorts of fancy, high-end ingredients~♪
There's mail addressed to you, Commander. Don't forget to read it-- Hm, I wonder if we got any letters with recipes inside...
Welcome back, Commander... Umm, are you hungry? ...You are, but you don't know what to eat? Then, how about a full course of the Eight Great Cuisines?!
The commission team is back, huh... I'll go prep a banquet. Everyone's gonna be able to eat to their heart's content.
Did it work...? Mm, good... Oh! I've gotten even better at controlling the heat now!
Combat... calls for great firepower, just like cooking!
We won...? Phew... Now, I'll be able to head back and research new recipes...
Ugh... That was a bust... Was it because I wasn't able to adjust the heat properly?
The quest for supreme flavor never ceases~
Bweeeehhh! It's going to burn!!
Commander... You have no appreciation for my cooking...
Hungry? I've prepared osmanthus cake, roast duck, crawfish, pan-fried bao, and... Hmm? Where'd I get all this food? Uhh... just business as usual for me, you know?

...You really enjoyed my cooking? Oh, uh, thank you very much... Well then, um, would you like to try some other stuff? I have Buddha's Temptation, cabbage in supreme soup, and-- Huh? It's too much effort? For the important task of serving you, is this not completely appropriate?
I can prepare any dish for you, seasoned any way you want it! I've always heard that cooking exists to bring joy to others, and I want to do my very best to make you happy!

I've packed your lunch. Ehehe, you'll find a new surprise waiting for you. I made it just for you, based on your favorite ingredients and flavors-- It's super delicious? Phew, glad to hear that! Then, umm... would you mind if I made it for you every day~?

Th-this is... Really?! G-give me a moment to get my thoughts straight... I mean, I can't do anything other than cook... *huff* *huff*... Alright, Commander... If you don't mind, I'll be in charge of all your meals from now on, and make sure everything is healthy and delicious!
Whoa! Is this for me? That's amazing!
Would it kill ya to stop trying to drag me outside...

ex.line: You've kept me waiting! Even after I cooked all these dishes for you-- It's way too much? It's just going to go to waste since you can't finish it? Don't worry about that! I already have an idea in mind~

...I'm tipsy? Nonsense... Uhh... I just ate some drunken crab, that's all... Also, Commander... aren't you hungry? I made... some mapo tofu, spicy boiled beef, and mala chicken... If that's not enough, I can also whip up a hotpot...

Ugh, didn't make enough rice... It's all because the food pairs too well with rice, and I inadvertently ended up wolfing down eight bowls... Huh? Commander?! Did you hear what I just said? ...Uhh, it's just because I didn't want to waste food, that's all!

You think I've been leaning too much into one type of cuisine? I suppose that's true... I don't usually take the initiative to cook Sichuan food since it's on the spicy side... Hm? The boiled beef I made earlier was really good? Huh, I don't seem to recall making that recently...
Commander, I'm not some little kid... Do you really like patting my head that much?
Do you like my tail? You think it's cute? Really? (*wags vigorously*)
I'm not sure... this is the best place for that...
You've got new missions. After you finish up, I'll whip you up something sweet as a reward. As for what specifically... You're fine with tangyuan, right?
Done with your missions? Well done, Commander~ As promised, here's a bowl of fresh tangyuan~ ...Hmm, it's still piping hot, so let me cool it down for you first~♪
Commander, you've got new mail. Hmm... I took a quick glance, and yeah, it's a total wall of text... Yeah, I think I'll go make some dim sum instead~
Welcome back, Commander! I've prepared a special homecoming feast for you! By the way, please try the new dishes I've been developing~♪

...Huh? You don't need me to make lunch for you for the time being? Wh-why?! Did you get tired of my cooking? --Hmm? It's because you've been putting on too much weight? Phew... You had me scared for a moment there...

lines.line: Happy New Year, Commander... Having that said, the others said they had a surprise for me, but then ended up banning me from the kitchen... I didn't do anything bad, did I? I'm real worried... Can't I at least take a look at what's going on there? Ugh... How about you go check it out in my stead? P-pretty please, Commander!

Happy New Year, Commander... Having that said, the others said they had a surprise for me, but then ended up banning me from the kitchen... I didn't do anything bad, did I? I'm real worried... Can't I at least take a look at what's going on there? Ugh... How about you go check it out in my stead? P-pretty please, Commander!
Happy New Year, Commander. Hmm? Lucky money present for me? Thank you very much... That makes me very happy~♪
What in the world is this baozi?! The texture of the dough, the exquisite flavor of the filling! I hate to admit this, but it's better than what I can make! I, I need to research this later...!
Commander, I hope everything goes well this coming year~ Ehehe. Please let me handle all of your daily meals as well. I'll make sure everything is delicious and healthy~♪

Heehee~ I snuck into the kitchen earlier to make those spring rolls I put on your desk. ..Too spicy? Spicy is good! You're supposed to welcome the new year with a bang! Ugh, my head is spinning... Who swapped out all the cooking wine in the kitchen with Hua Tiao wine?
Nngh... If my hair gets all messy, you'll be responsible for combing it back...
Hmm? Commander, want some baozi?
Commander... H-Hu Pen can still see us...
New missions, huh? Let's work together to get things taken care of. The food's gonna go cold if we take too long.
Mission complete! Let's count up the rewards, then head back to enjoy a nice New Year feast!
So many messages... Are they all cards wishing you a happy new year?
Welcome back! Want some tanghulu? Ning Hai and Ping Hai brought some over. They're really tasty~
Commander, on this special day of coming together as a family... You kept us company, and we enjoyed a delicious feast together and watched the fireworks... You have no idea how happy that makes me~♪
Woah, the corals look so pretty as they swish and sway... There's a whole world of color underneath the sea... I can come visit again any time I'd like? Thank you so much, Commander!
Woah, the corals look so pretty as they swish and sway... There's a whole world of color underneath the sea... I can come visit again any time I'd like? Thank you so much, Commander!
Commander, you're finally here! Let me help you adjust your diving mask!
I didn't think you'd invite me to go diving with you... Well, umm... the world beyond the kitchen is surprisingly fun... *blushes*

Please be considerate of the delicate ecosystem of the corals and all the other marine life, and don't go around touching things carelessly... Huh? Oh, um, it's something I learned while talking to the submarine girls.
Since you're the one who invited me, I had to do my part and dress up a bit... Huh? I look c-cute? ...Oh, um... th-thank you... *blushes*
To keep this ocean scenery as beautiful as always, let's do our best to clean up all the garbage! If we work at it enough, we might even be able to improve the environment one day!
Commander, my hat's going to get washed away...
Eek... Commander, could you go grab my hat?
S-slowly, please... T-try not to bump into the corals, okay? *blushes*
Hmm? You've been picking up the trash around here to help protect the coral reefs? Thanks for doing that! I'll treat you to some delicious food when we're back~♪
Looks like the commission team is coming back. Hrmm... I can't cook anything for them right now...
We won! Phew... I hope I'll get to enjoy the ocean with Commander now...

For someone like me who spends all day in the kitchen, getting to see this beautiful aquatic landscape and these magnificent corals is such a rare experience... Thanks to you, my most, most, most beloved Commander... I, I was able to see something so wonderful...
Vulcan Stettin 1,000-ton torpedo destroyer - Hu Pen.

The name's Hu Pen, and I'm a member of the Dragon Empery's Lung Wu-class destroyers! This tiger can handle any task for you, no matter how trivial! ...Heehee~ What'd ya think? Did I come off as having the awesomeness of a tiger?
Gooooood morning, Commander! I am Hu Pen of the Dragon Empery! Yeoooowch! Gah, just stubbed my freakin' toe...
Quietly now, stealthily... Fwaaah! C-Commander, g-good morning! Just gettin' this out of the way, but I totally didn't oversleep, you hear?
Kitty Kabam Punch, at the ready! Huuuh? That name's already taken? Seriously, there are girls here with the same naming sense as me??

Roooooar! When the tiger roars, forests shiver and mountains quake! ...Huh? I'm not a real tiger, and the only forest here is a few stalks of bamboo? Ehh, let's not sweat the small details. What matters most is the vibes!
Lung Wu's a bit too obsessed with food, don'tcha think? Maybe I should go help give her a hand... Huh? What do you mean I'm too helpful for my own good?!
Anyways! Here's the plan: I'm gonna help Lung Wu finish up her dishes, and then we're gonna go outside and play! You help as well, Commander!
Why'd I go with Kitty Kabam Punch instead of Tiger Kabam Punch? Well, uhh, it doesn't roll off the tongue the same way...
Pat a tiger on the head, and nothin' but good fortune will follow you! Ehehe~
Oh, um, about that! Can you please keep that whole sleeping-in thing a secret from my sis? Thanks a million, Commander! You're the best~!
Woooah! ...Woaaaooaaaaoaaah!
Horses might be respectable opponents, but there's nothin' respectable about horsing around on the job! That's why you've gotta finish your missions on time!
The mission rewards are in! Hurry up and go take a look!
I've got mail for you, Commander!
Welcome back~ I whipped up some snacks for you! Come on over and give 'em a taste!
The commission team is back! Time to call up the kitchen!
I'm freakin' awesome! Groooooar!
Hu Pen, charging straight ahead!
This tiger is strong! Grooar!
Oopsies... Looks like I goofed up a little... Teehee~☆
Tiger Thrasher!
Crap, that wasn't supposed to happen!
Hmph! Who are you calling grumpy? I'm not grumpy! ...Eh? You'll give me a stuffed tiger doll? Hooray! Thanks, Commander!
Commander, have you heard the news? Apparently, the mold for the key to your office has been going around for quite some time! The other day, I saw... Hwuuuuh? When'd the wall grow freakin' ears?!
Mwahaha... I know about all sorts of rumors, Commander~ What do you wanna hear about first? That one time I made a total mess of the kitchen? Sure, you got it-- Eeehhhh? Ehhhhhh?!
"There are lots of talented girls at this port, so I should try learning from them"? I mean, you're not wrong, but a tiger's gonna do as a tiger pleases! Hehe, I'm sure you'll support me, won't you?
Speaking of talented girls at the port... I'm definitely one of them! Commander, thanks for believing in me and supporting me! I'll continue to work even harder from here on out!

Ehehe, I can tell that you're always helping me out! You're the only person who has the patience to sit down with me and teach me things over and over again... So that's why you're a super-important person to me!
Wooow! You can really tell what a tiger's thinking, huh, Commander?
Lung Wu, let's do this together!
Twin tiger combo! Rooooar!

ex.line: Quietly now, stealthily... Woah! Why are you conked out in the office? Hey, you can't be doing that!
Kitty Kabam Punch, Rev I, at the ready! --Huh? Is there a Rev II? Ehehe, no idea!
I'm a fully-fledged kitchen assistant now! You can place your trust in my cooking skills even more now~
Heheh~ Commander, I've come up with another amazing plan! I'll be the head chef, you'll be my assistant, and Lung Wu won't be allowed inside the kitchen!
Uwaaahh! I surrender, I surrender! There are way too many dishes to make, and I can't possibly keep up! I give up on cooking!
Ehehe~ If you promise to change your bad habits, I won't spill the beans on you pulling an all-nighter yesterday! --Mmhmm, negotiation complete!
...Woah, woah! Just because you do this stuff all the time doesn't mean it's the new normal!

There are lots of talented people all around the port... and I'm one of them, aren't I? ...I still have a lot left to learn? Ehehe~ In that case, I look forward to you teaching me a whole lot more stuff!

lines.line: Let's usher in the New Year with the sound of gongs and firecrackers~! Whaddya think? Lion dances are pretty awesome, aren't they? So, Commander, who's got more oomph in their dance steps? Me, or Lung Wu? C'mon, hurry up and decide~!

Let's usher in the New Year with the sound of gongs and firecrackers~! Whaddya think? Lion dances are pretty awesome, aren't they? So, Commander, who's got more oomph in their dance steps? Me, or Lung Wu? C'mon, hurry up and decide~!
Quietly now, stealthily... Wahey! How was that? Starstruck by my mighty Lion Dance mode?
The lion is a lucky beast that drowns out disasters~ But then, so is the tiger! If you spend your Lunar New Year with me, you're sure to have good luck!
To do a proper Lion Dance, you need both a head and a tail. Oh! Commander, wanna come join me?
Left, right, left, right... Ehehe! You're in perfect sync with me~! All righty, let's go have a dance-off with Lung Wu!
Commander, you wanna be the head? Fine by me! We're basically in sync with each other without even having to say anything, so I know it'll work out!
Hwaaah! H-hey, I'm in the middle of the Lion Dance right now!
Oh! Commander, you're back! Here, I bought some xiaolongbao while I was on break~
Ehehe~ I'm a better dancer, aren't I?
Lion Lasher!
Chang Feng-class destroyer - Fei Yuen.

I am Lady Fei Yuen, Chang Feng-class destroyer. Despite my appearance, I'm quite an adept "adventurer"! If you're interested, Commander, I would not mind passing down my knowledge! Of course, I wouldn't snitch on you either, heehee~

Fei Yuen of the Dragon Empery's Chang Feng-class destroyers is at your service! And, you're supposed to be my Commander? Heheh~ Then, please refer to me as Lady Yuen from now on~♪ Do so, and I shall protect you and take you on grand adventures!
La la la~♪ Have you returned? Then, shall we begin with today's work? Naturally, Lady Yuen is already good to go!
Mmrp... Hrnnh... Zzzzz... Gah! L-Lady Yuen would not just randomly fall asleep! Hey, I said I wasn't sleeping!
Commander~ Come take a look! Master Hai Tien taught me how to draw this! Hmm? I'm good at drawing monsters? B-but... I was trying to draw a picture of you... *sniffle*...
Commander~ Let's go on an adventure together! What is an adventure, you ask? Hmm... for example, a quest to replace all the sugar in the kitchen with salt? No, it's not just a prank!
Lady Yuen shall assist you in placing all these sorted documents onto the shelves... Hwaah?! Owww... Everything's a total mess now... I'm sorry, Commander, I was just trying to help...
T-to think that you'd pet Lady Yuen's head without her express permission... But, that feels nice... S-so, I shall allow you to continue that for a bit longer!
Hmm? What's the matter, Commander? Oh, did you finally decide to accompany Lady Yuen on an adventure?
Commander... Did you break?
W-woaahh... What a crazy long list of missions... Commander, Lady Yuen shall assist you!
Commander! A whole bunch of supplies are piling up in front of the port! Hurry up and pick up the rewards so you can buy a present for Lady Yuen!
All of these are letters addressed to you, Commander! Don't forget to read them!
Hmm? Oh, you've returned. Did you remember to bring a souvenir for Lady Yuen?
Our friends in the commission fleet have returned! Ehehe~ I wonder what sort of souvenirs they've brought back for Lady Yuen~
Woooooah! I can feel power coursing through me!
Let us embark on an epic adventure!
Hmmhmm~ And this is what happens to those who look down upon Lady Yuen~
It, it's just one little loss... Lady Yuen would certainly not cry over something as minor as that!
Behold Lady Yuen's magnificence!
Lady Yuen's great adventure... isn't going to end here!
Commander, at this rate... Lady Yuen isn't going to want to take you on adventures anymore...
Oh, Commander. I was about to go out on an adventure with Fu Shun. Hmm? Don't go overboard with the pranks? Pranks? What could you possibly be talking about? I have no idea...

Commander~ Come play with me! You can't because you have work? Why's that? C'mon, come play, come plaaaay! Lady Yuen abandoned today's adventure to play with you, you know? So, set all that work aside and come play with me!

Commander! Lady Yuen has finished tidying the bookshelf! ...Hm? You pulled those books out because you were planning to reference them? S-sorry! I didn't do it on purpose... I, I was just trying to be helpful... *sniffle*

Commander! Would you like to go on an adventure with Lady Yuen? ...Hm? You still have work left to do? I shall patiently wait for you to finish then! ...You'll treat me to a reward for being on my best behavior, won't you? Ehehe~ You're the best, Commander~♪

You're giving this to me? Ehehe... That makes me so happy! There's a lot I still don't understand about this, but basically, you'll play with me forever and ever as long as I put this around my finger, right? See, it's on already! So, stay with me forever, Commander!
Yay, a present! Hehe, you're the best, Commander.

ex.line: Commander, you're finally back! I've been waiting a really long time for you, you know?
Commander... I accidentally knocked over a flower vase and a desk lamp... I just wanted to help tidy things up a bit... I wasn't trying to do it on purpose...
Just sitting next to you is already helpful? Then, um... what if I hold onto your arm like this? That's really helpful? Ehehe~ Yaay~♪
Why haven't I been going on any adventures lately? Well, adventures are fun and all, but spending time with you is even more fun~
Y-you can touch me even more, you know... Ehehehe~♪
Lady Yuen's cheeks are soft and squishy? Ehehe, yours are too, Commander~♪
Hmm, this kind of stuff makes you happy? ...Then, umm, it makes me happy too!
Welcome back~! If you got hurt anywhere, allow me to nurse you back to health- ...Hm? You're perfectly fine? Well, that's good to hear~♪
Zzzz... *yaaaawn*... For whatever reason, I always get sleepy when I'm around you... Oh! I know why! It must be because your scent makes me super relaxed... Zzzzzz...

lines.line: H-Happy New Year, Commander... Umm, uhh... C-could you please help me down first? ....Waah, I promise I won't have any more "adventures" in the kitchen...
H-Happy New Year, Commander... Umm, uhh... C-could you please help me down first? ....Waah, I promise I won't have any more "adventures" in the kitchen...
Waaah... You're back, Commander? Can you hurry and get me down from here...?
Why am I hanging off a drying rack? Umm... Well, actually... I was just having an adventure in the kitchen and got caught... S-sorry... After that? And, umm, I won't do it again...
Fireworks! Fireworks! If you leave me like this, I'm going to miss the fireworks show! At least turn the rack towards where they're going to be setting them off!
My outfit is... cute and classy? Ehehe, it's a Lunar New Year gift that the others got for me. Also, I heard something about "Damascus silk"... Commander, do you know anything about that?
What is that sign the manjuu is holding up supposed to mean?! I totally wasn't trying to sneak snacks from the kitchen...!
Ehehe~ Pat my head more~ Wait, no! Help me down from here first!
Ahahahaha! Stop poking my tummy already! It tickles!
Okay, but... please get me down from here first! We can do whatever you want after that!
Lady Yuen sees no shortage of goods piled up in front of the port. Is that our New Year's gift?
Commander~ Lady Yuen sees that there's new mail addressed to you~
W-welcome back, Commander! Would you like an apple?
Hmm? Commander, it seems that the commission team has returned already. Look, they're over there~
"Making enough candied strawberries for everyone at port?" Waaah, i-it's too much hard work! I don't wanna!
"Making enough candied strawberries for everyone at port?" Waaah, i-it's too much hard work! I don't wanna!
Open up, Commander... Aren't Lady Yuen's candied strawberries delicious? Hehe, so, are you ready to relax a bit with me?
*sniffle*... I won't cause trouble on my adventures anymore, I promise! Huh? Just by adventuring, I'm already causing trouble? I-I didn't know that!
Now that I'm trying it, I think I'm really good at making candy! It's just that the pot is a little burnt, there's syrup everywhere, and the strawberries are a bit mushy...
Come to think of it, what if I replaced some of the strawberries with chili peppers? Ack?! N-no, Commander, I wasn't thinking up a prank!
There's candy in my hair? Then you should taste it, Commander! Is it good?
Heh heh heh. I'll cover you in syrup next, Commander!
W-w-wait, Commander! My hands are all sticky right now! At least let me wash them...
W-wait a second! I'm about to coat them with sugar! I won't mess up this time... Ack?! Nooo, I've been hit!
The team we sent out just came back! I hope they found the legendary sweet strawberries I put on the list.
Wait... I can make more candied strawberries now? But I don't wannaaaa!
Hehehe, having you here makes boiling syrup way more fun... Whoa?! O-oh, no, the syrup is burning!
Project 30K Ognevoy-class destroyer - Ognevoy.

I'm Ognevoy, Project 30K-class or Ognevoy-class destroyer! I didn't get to fight in the war for a myriad of reasons! Also, I don't like violence! But don't be alarmed, Comrade Commander! I'll still do what my job demands!
Hi, Comrade Commander! I'm Ognevoy, Project 30K destroyer of the Northern Parliament! Check out my rigging! Isn't it the cutest you've ever seen?
*yaaawn*... I'm still sleepy... Do you always arrive this early, Comrade Commander?
I don't like wrecks! They're not cute, and the smoke they emit makes me cough! But, if I have to leave wrecks in my wake to protect my friends, then I won't hesitate to pepper my foes!
Comrade Commander, if you're feeling down, let me give you a hug to cheer you up!
These ribbons are for my quarters, these butterflies go on my rigging, and these plushies are presents for... Oh! I'll cute up your office while I'm at it!
Why I like hugging people? Umm... It makes me feel all warm inside! It warms both me and the person I'm hugging, so it's really like that "two birds with one stone" thing!
...I'm gonna ruffle YOUR hair too after this! Hmph!
What is it? Do you need a big hug?
...You want me to shoot you, is that it?
Comrade Commander, we got word of a new mission! We should give it a look!
Hmm... Looking at this goods list... It's probably fine! Comrade Commander, please review it!
New letter♪ New letter♪ Are these all for you, Comrade Commander? There aren't any for me? Aww...
Oh! You're back, Comrade Commander! Will you take me with you next time, please? It's so, sooooo painful to just sit here and wait!
The big girls are back from their commission! I've got a bunch of cute decorations ready to give out, so let's go talk to them!
Am I stronger now? Then can I put more cute stuff on my rigging?
Firepower at full throttle! Let it rip!
That's why you don't mess with cuteness!
Comrade Commander, we should retreat quickly for everyone's safety!
Cute heart, fire!
Oh no! My power is dropping!
Hmph! You're not ever getting a hug from me again!
Comrade Commander, have a look at my new weapon! Heehee! What do you think? Isn't my rigging the cutest ever? All these ornaments are brand new!
There aren't many decorations around your office. Do you really prefer it that way, Commander? Because after today's work is done, we could buy some stuff and I'll spruce the place up for you!

Excuse me! I know you're really busy, it's just... could I come with you the next time you decide to go out? I won't be a nuisance, I promise! ...I'm asking because I really, reeeally didn't like being all alone in your office!
If my hugs make you feel not alone, then I'll hug you tightly wherever and whenever you want! I'll always, always be right by your side, Comrade Commander!

Whoa! So cute! Is this for me? Heehee, thank you! ...Huh? Wait, what was that about "getting married"? You? And me? We're getting married? Oh gosh... I'm feeling lightheaded... B-but if this will make me never feel lonely again, then please put it on! I'm ready!
Aww, cute! Thank you for the present, Comrade Commander!
Let's show them the power of cuteness!

ex.line: Commander! I missed you... It was lonely without you, but I stayed positive and waited for you.
Hold still for a minute, Commander! I'm going to put a ribbon on you! ...It's over-the-top cute, so it doesn't fit you? Don't say that! Everything cute looks best on you!

I've finished all the paperwork now! Is there anything else I can help you with? ...I'm free to do whatever I want? Okay, then I'll wait for you right here! I want to spend more time with you, heehee!
Commander, Commander! Can I put up more decorations around the office? ...You're sure? Hooray! But I'm not allowed to decorate you? Aww! But you'd look so good covered in cute stuff!
Hmph... You'll have to style my hair into something cute later!
Hm? Are you giving me this ornament? Wooow! It's sooo cute!
Here and now? You're awfully bold today, Commander!
Commander! We've been informed of a new mission! I can help you finish it before you know it!
The mission rewards list checks out! Please put a cute checkmark here!
Way to go, Commander! You can have a hug as a reward! ...Did that make your fatigue go away? That's great, heehee!
I will protect you, Commander! Retreat, now!
Isn't it nice to just huddle together quietly and do nothing sometimes? ...You don't want to bore me? It's not boring! I'm never bored when I'm with you!

lines.line: I'm Ognevoy, the newest policewoman on the block! I've come to arrest you, fugitive! Give yourself up now! I'm going to- Ah! Oh gosh! ...Can I please get a cuter role instead?
I'm Ognevoy, the newest policewoman on the block! I've come to arrest you, fugitive! Give yourself up now! I'm going to- Ah! Oh gosh! ...Can I please get a cuter role instead?
Welcome back, fugitive! ...Huh? My tone toward you should be stricter?
Don't get cheeky with me just because I'm a rookie! I'll arrest you right- Oh nooo! I somehow handcuffed MYSELF! Commander, Abercrombie, Svirepy, help me out! The set is gonna blow!
Hmm. These handcuffs are so normal... Oh, I know! I'll spruce them up with some cute ribbons and stickers! ...I can't, or it'll make laughingstock of the force? Awwww!
Why is Svirepy- Er, the graffiti artist helping the fugitive?! Please stay where you are! You're both under arrest!
Pl-please be more gentle! It takes so, so long to tie these braids!
I-if you think you can bribe an honest police officer with cute accessories, think again!
