Huh? But I'm a police officer, and you're a fugitive... Oh no! This is forbidden!
We have a new mission! I will arrest you in the name of the law!
There's a letter for you, fugitive! Could you please let me have the cute little stamp attached to the envelope?
Great job, Commander! I would hug you, but we're about to start filming, so I can't...
I will protect you, Commander! Retreat, now!

If I weren't a police officer and you weren't a fugitive, maybe things could've ended differently... Aww, why does the story have to end like this? The me and you outside the story should've been together forever and ever, right?
Project 7U-class destroyer - Svirepy.

I'm Svirepy, Storozhevoy-class destroyer. I'm an evolution of the Gnevny class and pack not just nutty firepower, but also... "Sensitive to low temps and prone to catching colds"? Only 'cuz I'm not used to these environs and I ain't got enough rest! Get off my case!
Storozhevoy-class destroyer. Name's Svirepy. Heh, I don't respect you just 'cuz I've heard of you before. If you wanna be tough like me, you've got some catchin' up to do!
Finally back? Better get your act together quick, 'cuz a new challenge is coming!
Ah... Achoo! ...Why're you lookin' at me like that? Damn nose got itchy, is all! It's not a cold, alright?! ...Stop dressing me up! You dumb or what?! *blushes*
Cute? The graffiti on my rigging? Damn right it is! That's 'cuz this Northern Parliament symbol was drawn by a world-class graffiti master - me!
I've had three plates of torpedo tempura, two plates of naval curry, and five glasses of honey beer, sooo... some snacks and oxy-colas should stave off the hunger during my late-night studies.
I get sick all the time 'cuz the water here isn't what I'm used to! I frickin' hate it! When am I ever gonna get to show off how nasty I am?!
Eeeeeek! The hell are you doing?! Hands off!
Yeah? You checkin' out my gun-axe here?
Seriously? You trying to get cut or what?
What're you lookin' at? Supplies ain't gonna pop outta thin air. If ya want goods, do some damn missions!
Checked the rewards. Ya better have another look at... "Thanks for the help"? Ahem... I just... It was nothing.
I left the letter on your desk. Just... remember to actually read it, got it? Don't go missin' out on important stuff.
You're back. Props for not gettin' hurt out there.
Hey, you, get out there and greet the commission team. They're back now! Tch... Don't make me remind you about every little thing!
Hmph! ...Heh, this ain't bad. These fangs got a nastier bite now, know what I mean?
Fight me, assholes!
Ahahahah! You losers should be honored that I whooped your asses!
Didn't try hard enough... Next time, though! Next time is gonna be it!
Spray paint! Paint 'em red!
You're fine, Svirepy! Just a little more!
God's sake... Did I mess up and pick the wrong person or what?
I always thought I slept late, but you go to bed even later than me. Man. Is your job THAT big a drag? ...What do I do to stay up so late? Hey, that's something else entirely!

Only by pushin' myself and never stopping can I live up to my name - "Fierce"! ...Huh? I shouldn't go crazy with it 'cuz I'm already doing great? A-are you serious? ...Hey, I know you're just recognizing my hard work. Thanks.

Zzz... Wait and see... I'm gonna prove how capable I am... Whoa! Wh-why was I sleeping?! ...Whuh? Why're you pattin' my head totally unprompted? Wait... Don't tell me I said somethin' weird in my sleep!

I'm self-centered, I'm rude, and I get sick often 'cuz I'm not used to these waters... However you cut it, people just don't like bein' around me. But you, you always treat me warmly, you acknowledge me, you compliment me... L-look, if you like bein' with me... then I'm cool with hanging out with you.

Hm. Guess this doesn't look half-bad on my finger... What? An oath ring? Whoa, whoa, hang on! That can't be... What? It's for me? You serious?! Thank go- Ahem! Okay, thanks! I'll always, aaalways be with you!
You know exactly what a girl likes! Guess I'll have to repay you somehow...
MY graffiti is the cutest!

ex.line: Welcome back. Nice, you're lookin' full of life today!
The time has come to unveil the graffiti master's latest work! Whaddya think? Ain't it the cutest thing you've ever seen? Heehee, I knew you'd like it♪
You're glad I've been pullin' fewer all-nighters lately? Yeah, 'cuz... You keep complimenting me for my hard work, so I feel I can relax and have fun for a bit too...
Ah... Achoo! Would you PLEASE turn up the temp on the AC, Commander?!
If ya like touching me... then fine, I-I'll let you!
Whoa, whoa! We're in public! Wh-wh-what the hell are you thinkin'?!
You've got a new mission! Let's do it together!
Look who's back. You did a killer job out there! And not even a scratch! Heehee!
Hm? The commission team's back. Aren'tcha gonna go meet 'em?

When we're apart, I feel like I have to push myself endlessly to prove my strength, to prove my value... "Like pulling back a bow's string too hard"? Yeah, something like that... I really don't know how I'd manage if you weren't here.

lines.line: Let's hear it for the graffiti master that's taken the world by storm - Svirepyyy! You people are in real luck, gettin' to witness the birth of my new piece! And if you ain't got any taste, watch yourself!

Let's hear it for the graffiti master that's taken the world by storm - Svirepyyy! You people are in real luck, gettin' to witness the birth of my new piece! And if you ain't got any taste, watch yourself!
Too late! This place is my turf now! But I'll let you have a li'l slice of it as a show of appreciation!
"Playing myself"? You sayin' I'm perfectly in-character? ...Oh, yeah! As thanks for the compliment... I'll improv something the next time you forget your line.
Ahahaha! You pigs think you can arrest me? Keep dreaming! The whole city's gonna be covered in my art by the time I'm done! And you, you'll help, won't you?
I've got a brilliant idea! If I sign my graffiti with your name, the pigs will go after you instead of me! Heehee!
Nooooo! Don't take my spray paint! I'm sorry for what I did, okay?!
Yeah? These cat ears feel all hard? Uhh, maybe that's 'cuz they're not real.
I know we're filming and all, but I'm freezing my ass off in these clothes... Ah... Achoo!
Can we not wait with this until AFTER we're back?!
If I were to spray paint the rewards that just arrived... Hey, I was just kidding! Don't take it seriously!
I left your letter right here. Don't forget to pay the fine... Ugh. N-no, it's got nothing to do with the fact I left your name when making graffiti...
Back, huh? Heh, my latest piece is almost done... No, obviously it's not HERE. "Then where"? That's a surprise for when it's done.
Hey, hurry up and go greet the commission team already. They're back now! For cryin' out loud... I don't wanna have to go over this again.
Aw yeah! Hit it out of the park!
Hmm... Gotta say... Your drip is pretty boring. Heehee, that's why the graffiti master is gonna cute and color your fit-up! ...You don't need that? Too bad, I'm doing it anyway♪
Gangut-class battleship - Poltava.

I'm Poltava, Gangut-class battleship of the Northern Parliament. While Gangut herself may be more famous, my abilities will not disappoint you. Got a work issue, a personal issue, or any issue at all? Just come to me!

Mmh. You're Comrade Commander, aren't you? I'm Poltava, Northern Parliament battleship, and I'll be aiding in your work starting today. Since you're the face of this port, I will hold you to a high standard of conduct and etiquette. Hope you're ready♪
Someone still looks sleepy. You need to shape up... or I'll be displeased. Heehee♪
Making problems disappear is what I do best. From requests that came out of the blue, to brutes who have no manners... Think of it as a part of learning, heehee.
Manners aren't things you do to appear cultured, they're a mindset of paying attention even to the littlest things. Yes, it's about whether you have an eye for details or not. Remember that.
Sometimes you need to be strict to get a person to take something in earnest. What are your thoughts on that, Comrade Commander?
How time flies... Why don't we have dinner together? Heehee. Oh, and do try not to drink too much.
My, how assertive. I like it♪
Curious about my rigging, are you? Heehee, it may look rough on the outside, but it's sophisticated and industrial on the inside.
Heehee... Should I interpret this as a formal invitation?
These incomplete missions are piling up... I won't stand for this. I suggest you stop slacking before I have to discipline you.
You've completed every last mission? How excellent. Your pluck and focus bring a throbbing to my heart♪
Time is valuable. I'll sort your letters and you just stay focused on your work.
You've returned, Comrade Commander. Come, sit down next to me... I'm not asking you, I'm telling you to.
Those girls who went out on a commission are back. It's your job to welcome them back, so start getting your things in order.
My chains are even stronger now. How lovely♪
Follow orders and neutralize them in order!
Every second matters. On to the next fight.
Even in defeat, you should have order in mind as you retreat. Because if you don't... Heehee♪
Yield to my chains!
Things are getting dire... I need to be quick!
Heehee... It seems I must take firmer measures to discipline you.
A single nail was misplaced, and thus a war was lost. What I'm telling you is not merely a fun story, Comrade Commander.
...Yes? There is no more than meets the eye to these chains. And don't worry, I don't have a kink for wrapping things up in them.

I tie my bagage down tightly because I don't want it collapsing. Same with my furniture and ornaments so they don't fall. I want them to be stable... You don't get it? That's fine, heehee. You'll know what I mean when trouble befalls you.
Heehee, you've figured it out, my smart comrade. Love is a kind of chain. A chain that wraps around us both. A chain that links and keeps us together when the world wants to separate us.

Oh my... This is a statement, saying you want to be together forever. And if you're giving it to me, you must be ready to forever be connected. Heehee. Whatever comes next, we'll get through it together... sweetheart♡
How sweet of you. I accept.
After this is over, wanna go for a drink?

ex.line: Well, hello, sweetheart. I love to relax as much as you, but you're supposed to be working right now. Please be mindful, lest you get on other girls' nerves♪
Oh, do you want to play with Pirozhki, too? Heehee, sorry, but no. You have your work to deal with - namely, figuring out the cost of the Ganguts' drinking party♪
No need to be on your best behavior, sweetheart. There's nobody around♡
Go drinking? Sweetheart, please, do you think I'm the same as Sevastopol? ...Heehee, too late to pull out now. You're going to learn just how much we Parliamentarians can guzzle.
This isn't the chain that binds you... THIS is♡
Heehee... I know you're trying to provoke me into something, sweetheart♡
Way to go, sweetheart. Go on, sit down and let me take care of you. Who's my little soldier? Heehee, yes, you are.
Ah, the girls who went on a commission are back already. You're linked not just with me, but with them as well. Heehee.
Aren't you amazed by how quickly I neutralized them, sweetheart?

lines.line: Heehee... Oh, are you ready for your audience with me? Remember the important thing - minding your manners. Queen Poltava's time is very, very precious indeed.
Heehee... Oh, are you ready for your audience with me? Remember the important thing - minding your manners. Queen Poltava's time is very, very precious indeed.
Heehee. Great timing, Comrade Commander. I got my hands on the script for the next scene. Want to go through it with me?
"You don't treat me as a friend and you refuse to call me 'Queen'"... What an impactful line.
If you want to strike a deal, come up with a reason I can't refuse. Heehee, my character is quite the arrogant one.
So, who is playing my rival? ...Sovetsky Soyuz? Heehee. Her, against a mafia queen... They gave her quite the important role.
Heehee. A drink, Comrade Commander? The glass may be a prop, but the liquor is the real deal.
Heehee... I might have to add an improv scene♥
Thanks for setting up all the props, Comrade Commander. Now... how about a nice full-body massage from Queen Poltava?
Oh my, the oranges are in the frame with you.
Heehee. Another huge and historic victory for Queen Poltava.
Tribal-class destroyer - Nubian.

Nubian of the Tribal class extends you a greeting! Heheh, I'm not just a fully-fledged Royal Maid, I'm also a decorated and famous warship. When you need somebody to clean the seas, come straight to me!
I'm Nubian, and I'm good at housekeeping! Do you need my cleaning services, Commander? Uh, why do you look like you're about to cry? ...Normal maids like me are a rare gift? Uh, okay...
Good morning, Commander! I've finished sweeping your office! Have a productive day!
Welcome to my little corner of the port! Whether something's bothering you or you just want to chat, my ears are always open. Your secrets are as safe as can be with this Royal Maid!
Commander, do you need any help? It doesn't have to be strictly housework-related. I can file paperwork, too. Probably.
Maids these days are a lot different to my idea of what a maid should be. Like how many of them are so strangely... "service"-oriented. Yeah...
Ding-dong! It's cleaning time! That means you need to leave the office! A battle between me and dust is about to unfold!
I heard this is what the maid of the modern age wears, but isn't it kind of... Oh, wait. It must be another one of those trends...
Oookay... Is this that "reward" people keep telling me about?
What's on your mind, Commander? ...Do "the thing"? What do you mean? I don't know what this "thing" even is...
Um, okay...? What the heck are you doing?!
You've got a new list of targets to clean up. Get out there and deal with them!
Cleaning complete! Don't dally, go confirm your rewards!
Commander, you have a new letter! I brought it straight to you!
Welcome back, Commander. What will it be? A massage, perhaps?
Oh, look at that, the commission team is back. You'd better go out and greet them.
Heheh! My cleaning skills have improved!
Let the cleaning begin!
That's the cleaning done! Feels fresh!
Ugh, dammit... My pride as a Royal Maid has been tarnished...
It's cleaning time!
Eeeeek! There's so much dirt!
...Keep this up, and I'm gonna have to clean YOU, Commander! That means purifying you from inside out, starting with your heart!

*sigh*... You know, I just feel like I've not been particularly helpful to you, Commander. I've got a lot to learn from my maidly friends. But what's your take, Commander? What should I do to improve at my job?
My friends are going to host a maid gathering to help deepen my understanding of a modern maid's duties, and I'm feeling kind of anxious... "Steer clear of any weird indoctrination"? Uh, I see...
So, I went to the maid gathering... Good god! Commander, are modern maids all like that? ...Like who? Like Sirius and her ilk! Don't tell me I'M the one who's out of touch here!
Ahh... Wait! C-Commander! You need to know that I'm a very normal and traditional girl! I'll only have... you know... with someone I love, and... G-god, what am I even saying?! *blushes*

You're giving this... to me? O-okay, so you feel like this was the time to do it... Heheh, heheheh... In truth, I've had feelings for you for the longest... Ahem! What I meant to say is - I vow to be with you, now and forever!
I really like this! Thanks, Commander!

ex.line: Morning, Commander! I'm ready to "serve" you now! What should we start with?
How'd you like me to serve you, Commander? I'll do anything you want, heehee. I've mastered all the in things with maids these days!
Heheh! Dido and a few others taught me all the basics of being a modern maid! What do you say - wanna try my special services package?
Ding-dong! It's cleaning time! Heh, if there's one thing I haven't forgotten, it's this! Now put on a mask and let's get your office looking sparkling clean!
Commander, how'd you feel if I wore a slightly shorter skirt? ...Huh? You like the way it is now? Really?
Heheh... Hehehehe... ♪
Huh? I mean... What'll it be first? Dinner? A bath? Or maybe... H-hey, why won't you let me finish?!
Mmh♡ I'll let you have your way with me.
Welcome back, Commander! Heehee, what'll it be? Ear-cleaning? A lap pillow? Or maybe... you just want a nice and simple hug? Heehee!
Fooound you♡ Hooah! How's that? Did that hug cheer you up? If you need more, I can... What? It's fine to just act like myself? Wow. I really can't wrap my head around your tastes...

lines.line: I'm Nubian, the master concocter of magic potions! What kind of potion do you want, Commander? ...Huh? It's been so long since you visited a normal potion maker who brews using a cauldron so you don't know what to order? ...Come again?

I'm Nubian, the master concocter of magic potions! What kind of potion do you want, Commander? ...Huh? It's been so long since you visited a normal potion maker who brews using a cauldron so you don't know what to order? ...Come again?
Welcome to my brewing hut, Commander! I can make any potion you can think of as long as you have the right ingredients!
Welcome to my brewing hut! If you want something, just let me know! I'm a fully-fledged potion maker and can concoct almost anything!
Heheh, what potion do you want? Come on, don't be shy. I can even make a love potion if that's what you want.
Heheh, you'd be surprised to know I did my research before choosing to become a potion maker. Pretty good foresight on my part, right?
Why won't I call you "Hero"? Well... I'm not used to saying it yet, I guess. "Commander" feels much more natural!
Come to think of it, maids and potion makers have some things in common... Huh? Wait, doesn't that make witch is the most popular profession among modern maids?
Uh-oh... No, no, no! It's gonna overflow!
Uh, what...? You're doing this NOW?!
Heheh, I knew you'd become a regular here. So, what fascinating ingredients have you brought me this time?
Have a taste of this confusion potion!

Heheheh, is there a potion you want to make, Commander? I can make an elixir, a potion of happiness, anything you want. And of course, I'd be happy to join your party. Being with you is the best thing of all!
Uh, teehee! I was trying to make chocolate, then I slipped for some reason! ...Hang on a minute! How did I slip? Even a modern clumsy maid wouldn't blunder like that... Would she?!
Uh, teehee! I was trying to make chocolate, then I slipped for some reason! ...Hang on a minute! How did I slip? Even a modern clumsy maid wouldn't blunder like that... Would she?!
Sorry for the oopsie-woopsie in the kitchen! ...Okay, okay! I'll start cleaning up, so quit laughing!
How would a modern maid get herself out of a sticky situation like this... Ask someone like Devonshire? Not a chance! If I asked, they'd know I'm behind the times!
There's nothing to worry about, I can clean this up in a jiffy, just you watch! Believe it or not, housekeeping is my forte!
Maids these days don't wear anything beneath their aprons? There's NO way that's true! Seriously? Some actually dress like that?!
If at first you don't succeed, you try and try and try again! I wouldn't cut it as a traditional Royal Maid if I wasn't determined!
Sorry, Commander, I made a big oopsie! ...H-how was that? Do I sound like a clumsy maid? I'm not cut out for this, am I?
Are you TRYING to make the kitchen messier than it already is?!
Nooooo! Touching is fine, just don't lick me! ...Huh? That's NOT what you were doing?
Welcome back, Commander. If you need a Royal Maid's service, just ask for anything other than chocolate. Teehee!
My chocolate-making was a bust, but this was a brilliant success!

I can make chocolate just fine! It's simply making Valentine's chocolate like a modern maid that I failed at. When I make yours, I will NOT fail, no way! Not only does my pride as a Royal Maid hinge on it, but my love for you does, too!
Gloucester-class light cruiser - Liverpool.

I'm Liverpool, pennant number C11, Gloucester-class light cruiser. I've got a decent amount of experience under my belt, and I've served in a fair few fleets... Aerial torpedoes? Ahahaha... Those don't scare THIS happy-go-lucky maid!

Hello, Master! I'm Liverpool, Gloucester-class light cruiser! Come on, get over here! 3, 2, 1, say "cheese"! ...Yeah, that's a nice smile! Oh, and if Gloucester asks about me, will you do me a solid and say you haven't seen me? Cheers.
Morning, Master! It's a new day, so let's see a smile! Like this!
Let's see a smile, Master! When you smile, Lady Luck smiles upon you! Smiling makes you live longer, too!
Can't exactly say I'm a natural at maid work, but I do my job decently. I've got the energy to tackle all problems when they arise!
I got sooo many snacks today! Everything from dried fruits, to donuts, to roasted eel... How come, you ask? Heheh, because I'm everyone's BFF, that's why!
Hmm... I look too silly in this pic, and too cold in this one. Maybe this one... Oh, I know! Master! Come take a selfie with me! 3, 2, 1, say "cheese"! Alright, looking good!
Hooray! Master gave me headpats♡
(Whew... Psst, Master, don't you wanna ditch this place? I'll come with you. "What about my maid work"? Ahaha! I wasn't gonna do that anyway, so it's alright!)
Ahahaha... If you're so desperate to turn into eel food, then fine!
A new mission list has... Blimey, that's long! And you've really got to do every task on here?
...Check the mission rewards? Ahaha! Nah, I don't work in that capacity. But I can snap a pic of you doing it, if you want.
God, look at this pile of letters! Oh no! It... It collapsed!
Welcome back, Master! I've got tea ready for- Oh! It's gone cold. Lemme put the kettle on again!
Master, remember to smile when you talk to the commission team!
I've gotten stronger! Maybe my smartphone camera's specs improved as well? Hm? That's not how it works? Ah, I hear you.
Brighten up and show 'em who's boss!
Victory's ours! Now come here, Master! I wanna take a selfie with you!
Ahahaha... Here I thought a happy-go-lucky maid could solve just about anything.
Let the chase begin!
Hahaha! This is awesome!
Gosh, if this keeps up, I'LL be the one lecturing YOU instead of the other way around.
You think I'm much more lively than the average Royal Maid? I mean, having energy to spare and being happy-go-lucky is just my nature! Or what, do you take me for some kind of bimbo?

Master, would you rather have an eel bowl or lobscouse? Got it, you're fine with either. Then I'll just make both! Heheh, they're both my speciality dishes. Truth be told, I wasn't gonna let you choose anyway♪

You think I've been acting weird? I haven't really. Why are you telling me this all of... My face is red? I'm not sick, I just- Whoa! Oi, don't cling to me like that... A-and stop trying to take my temperature!

M-Master! I've, uhh, got something I wanna tell you... Nervous? Am not! Anyway, listen... Um, I love you! Oh, err, you don't need to say anything back right away! In fact, I'm not sure I'm ready yet to hear your response...

You've got a present for me? Uh-huh, and what's in the box... Wait, WHAT?! A-and you've got something important to tell me? O-okay! I'm in the right headspace for this... My answer is yes! I will gladly stay by your side forever!
This is for me? Thank you, Master!
Oh no! I'm sorry for everything I ever did, just let me off the hook this one time!
Oi, Manchester! Come and take a pic with me!

ex.line: Master, remember to keep that smile on your lips! No long faces!
Don't you worry, Master, I've been polishing up my maid skills! If I just put in enough effort, I'll one day be an honest-to-god proper maid!
Hmm... A dish made by combining eel and lobscouse... Oh! Master! Don't you wanna try a new dish of mine? ...Huh? Why are you backing off?

No matter what bad things happen to you, you just need to smile for your luck to turn around! Yup! Whether you're facing a strong enemy or dreadful maid training, your luck will improve! So, Master, smile!
Master? Heeheehee♡
(Psst, Master, there anything you wanna do? And I mean anything. Accompanying her master is a maid's duty, after all!)
I mean... This is pretty sudden... But that's not to say I hate it!
You've got new missions! Get them all done and I'll treat you to twice the food today! ...You can't eat that much? Fair enough...
Oooi! Wake up, Master! You've got new mission rewards! (Oops, maybe I yelled too much...) N-no, I didn't say anything!
Oh! Welcome back, Master! Brought any loot? Heheh, this calls for a self- I mean, a picture of you and your spoils!
I've gotta impress my Master!
Woohoo! Master! Oh, we can't take a selfie while I'm hugging you? Ahahah, right... One sec. There. We good now?

I'm a maid, and yet it feels like all I ever do is burden you... So, I've got to pay you back for being such a kind and benevolent Master! We should go on a bunch more dates! And take a lot more selfies together... and make so many more memories together!

lines.line: Holy Wind! Blow them away! ...Oh no! The wind's so strong it's lifting up my dress! Um, Master, y-you didn't... see anything, did you?
Holy Wind! Blow them away! ...Oh no! The wind's so strong it's lifting up my dress! Um, Master, y-you didn't... see anything, did you?
Here I am, Master! Let's go on another fun adventure together! And give me a smile!
"God has granted us this solace." Heehee, now let's let loose and have fun, Master!
"May you be blessed by the holy light"... Heehee, how was that, Master? Did I sound like a cleric?
Weird... I just chanted some nonsense and it cast some OP-arse holy spell... "That's because you're a cleric"? Ahahah! Yeah, I guess you're not wrong!
So - holy protection, a good-luck blessing, or just an ordinary strength blessing? Hmm... I'm not sure which to choose...
Bollocks. I've got a role to play, but I've still been calling you "Master" instead of "Hero"... I plead whoopsie-daisy! Heehee!
Hm? You want some blessings? You got it, Master! Watch this! I know a holy spell to make our adventure more fun - it's called smiling!
Heehee. I mean, if you wanna top up on mana... I can let this pass.
Did you get any new quests? Master, you can't be turning a blind eye to people in need!
Quest rewards are here! Maybe there're some ingredients... Ahahaha, no, I'm not expecting anything.
Welcome back, Master! Do you want a cup of tea blessed by the holy light?
I offer a prayer for my Master's victory... Hey, uh, how did the prayer go again?
Ugh... Seems there are some problems even a happy-go-lucky cleric can't solve...
Heheh, you ready, Master? Hold the camera steady and capture the moment I unleash a cool-arse spell! ...What's it for? To celebrate our date in Adventureland, duh!
London-class heavy cruiser - Devonshire.

I am Devonshire, London-class heavy cruiser. I have many achievements as a Royal Maid, such as traveling around the world and escorting important personnel. You think that would have broadened my perspectives? "Heehee, you're too sweet."

"Pleasure to meet you, Commander. I'm the London-class heavy cruiser Devonshire. I happen to know some things about combat and maid duties. From now on, I will serve you as your personal maid. I look forward to working with you." I tried giving off a different vibe with this greeting. Did it come off too cold?
Oh, you're here. Is it time to begin today's work? ...Don't worry. I've gotten everything ready.
Mm, yes, I do like that expression. The surprise coloured by a charming shade of panic... Let's practice it in the mirror a little more.
As your maid, I have put together a perfect schedule for you. Yes, and I've ironed your clothes for your important meeting for you.
A sudden change of plans? That is quite the change... "Tch. If I must, I'll rearrange EVERYTHING for you. Again."
Ahem. I've had enough of being-a-reliable-maid mode. Cutie-patootie mode engaged. "What do I do? Aw, what a jam... I wanna eat the port sweets store's new donut sooo bad~ Commander, buy it for me!"
Commander? I don't presume you're treating me like a child?
Yes? Would you like me to switch to service mode?
Right here? Commander, you're awfully bold today...
Commander, you have incomplete missions. Please do not forget them.
If the rewards are donuts, then I will gladly take them in your place.
I finished organising your mail. Commander, when would you like to see it?
Welcome back. I made tea and pastries, so enjoy a nice break.
The commission team is back. Please change into formal clothes when you welcome them. I believe you must always be aware of your patina as Commander.
Technology advances quickly with the passage of time. Such palpable growth... I must thank you, Commander.
Cleaning mode engaged.
That took one second longer than expected. I will be more alert next time.
I've failed to take out the trash. Please retreat just in case the situation may get worse.
Killer mode engaged!
Tch... I lost my composure for a moment there...
*sigh*... Looks like I have to switch to business mode when dealing with you, Commander.
Baking sweets is such a basic thing for maids, so I'm confident in my skills~ Teehee, try my home-baked donuts, Commander! Just be warned, they're bonito-flavored!
Commander, how do you prefer your Devonshire? "A cutie-patootie?" "A cool girl who knows no sympathy?" "N-nervous mode?" I am happy to suit your preference.
"Cutie-patootie mode comes in lots of little variations! Gimme a request if you want a little something special!" ...You want to know me as I am? How... difficult you are to satisfy.
You really are a greedy one, Commander, so seriously pursuing the truth of who I am. But I accept your feelings... In return for your authenticity, I will try to show you my unabridged self as well.

A truly skilled maid must be able to respond to all kinds of situations. It's only natural that we get used to putting on different facades... However, there is only one truth to how I feel about you, Commander. That will never change.
Thank you. I accept this gift, along with the feelings you've poured into it.
London, you're far too gentle.
Gee, Sussex, don't be so nervous all the time!
Quit getting distracted in the middle of battle. Hmph!

ex.line: Commander, welcome back. You know... I think Master would be a more affectionate term of address. What do you think?
I maintain a facade of elegance and politeness in reliable maid mode, but you don't seem especially interested in that. This is a problem... How should I interact with you?
Favours must be repaid in kind with donuts. That is the first law of nature.
Work mode disengaged. "Now I'm in 'Commander, spoil me' mode! M-Master~ I made donuts for you. Wanna try them... hehe, in my room later?"
Do you think this child's play is enough to satisfy me?
Are you interested in what's inside my skirt?
Geez~ I didn't know you had such special interests.
If you're tired, I'm sure nobody will mind if you take a break before you handle your missions.
Your rewards are right this way. "Aww, no donuts? So sad~... You'll really buy me some? Hooray♡"
Welcome back, and well done on your mission. Here are some fresh donuts and black tea. Please enjoy a well-earned break.

The truth can occasionally be cruel, so exposing others to it won't necessarily lead to happiness. Sometimes, spending life behind a mask is the easier way. But with you, Commander... I can sincerely feel comfortable showing you my true self.

lines.line: Roleplay mode engaged. "I am Devonshire, the greater demon who controls this land. If you understand the difference in our power levels, you will leave and train yourself in a beginner dungeon for three hundred years. Adventurers such as you will never make it through here alive."

Roleplay mode engaged. "I am Devonshire, the greater demon who controls this land. If you understand the difference in our power levels, you will leave and train yourself in a beginner dungeon for three hundred years. Adventurers such as you will never make it through here alive."
"You didn't just set up a save point here, did you?" Was that good, Commander?
I've prepared a new mask based on this setting. Behold this expression, a mixture of coldness and contempt... This is the fruit of my efforts.
Roleplay mode engaged. "Don't press your luck! The very thought that you can defeat me... Wait! Wh-what was that technique?! N-no, stooop!"
Correct. You must defeat me to proceed in this scenario. ...Hm? Why are you shaking your head? You don't want to hurt me?
Left, right, left, right, B, A, B, A... I heard this is a secret way to win. Commander, would you like to try it?
"The insolence! A mere adventurer, laying hands on me?!" I see... This is how you want me to treat you?
"It's too late to apologise now!" Mm... It lacks energy, doesn't it?
Heheheh... Can I take this as a sign of surrender?
A request with a reward... Hmph. Do you mean to say that this is worthy of a greater demon's attention?
You made money off of quests? Good. Use it to buy donuts and pay tribute to me!
"Back so soon? You're not as weak as I thought." I'm afraid I cannot serve refreshments while I'm in roleplay mode. My apologies.

"Even knowing that this is a game, you refuse to hurt me? You seek out a peaceful resolution?" *sigh*... Roleplay mode disengaged. Allow me to communicate my honest feelings... I love you for being so loving, Commander.
Commander, third ship and idol of the Illustrious class, Formidable, humbly makes your acquaintance. Please do enjoy the show... Heehee, doesn't that just make you shudder with excitement?

I, Formidable, shall bring my elegance as a Royal lady to the stage as a member of the idol group, Alizarin! From now on, I will do my best to express my unique style, so please look forward to my performance!
Commander, third ship and idol of the Illustrious class, Formidable, humbly makes your acquaintance. Please do enjoy the show... Heehee, doesn't that just make you shudder with excitement?
Hm? Commander, you're early. In that case... Maybe now is the perfect time to give you a taste of my solo performance♪
Heheh♪ Commander, what do you think of my - huh? V-very cool? Ahem! At least let me finish asking first... *blush*
What song will I choose? This one, of course! Feast your ears upon Formidable's own style of rock-and-roll! Don't you love that dynamic sound, Commander?
Right this way, Commander... Why, you ask? Because I want you to get closer to me, of course!
Illustrious's show was just breathtaking... Oh! I can't let her go uncontested! You'd best be an impartial judge, Commander!
I-I'll have you know I am working as an idol right now! Aah! Put that hand back! No pulling!
Hmm? Do you want to be my number-one fan, Commander? Yeah! That must be it!
Commander, don't think you can get away with calling this a joke. Heheh, I won't let you explain it away.
Here is today's mission list... No matter how busy you are, don't neglect those missions.
Heh heh heh... Which is more important? My performance, or a fat stack of mission rewards? Knowing you, I bet you'd place equal value on them.
There's fan mail for you here, too, Commander. Don't forget to read it.
The intermission is over... Commander, I look forward to your support and your cheers!
Ding dong, ding dong♪ The commission rewards have arrived. The equipment for our show came, too, so why don't we go look together?
Now that's satisfying! Heheh♪
Witness how a lady rocks and rolls!
Heheh, a perfect performance! I think our group has made our feelings clear now.
We didn't rehearse well enough... Th-the next performance will be a perfect one, I swear!
Time for my encore!
Wha...?! Well, that's one way to play!

You think I looked despondent during my show? I can only imagine it's because of a certain someone who OBVIOUSLY doesn't get me... Eep?! You're getting too close! D-dummy! Okay, I forgive you! I forgive you!
Commander? You're here early. Heehee, did you decide to come to rehearsal because you were just sooo excited to see my performance?
Wow, you're really comparing my performances to Illustrious's? You've got some nerve! ...So? Obviously, I'm the winner... Ahem. I didn't say anything!

Hmm? Why did I decide to join in the Muse System tests? Because I want to be true to myself. I don't need to act like a royal lady, I can play the music I like, and I get your attention... Heheh, doesn't it sound like a nice deal?

Welcome, Commander. Are you here to watch my lessons again? Wait, is this... my promotional poster? Wow, I didn't think you enjoyed my shows THAT much! Of course! I'd be happy to show you my cutest side in return!

This is... more support than I'd expect from just one fan. Is this how you feel when you see me on stage, Commander? Okay... I understand exactly what you're trying to say! I'll give you the most unique show you've ever seen to show you how I feel in return!
Th-this is... Commander, I've received your feelings, loud and clear!
Illustrious, I'm taking center stage today!
You won't outdo me today!
Let's liven up this show even more!
I am heavy cruiser idol Prinz Eugen, a participant in the Muse System experiment. You look interested in my outfit, Commander. Heheheh... You can expect my usual exploits and more!

Third ship of the Admiral Hipper-class ships, Prinz Eugen. Right now, I'm a member of the idol group Alizarin, too. Heheh, do you love me more than ever now? Well, keep your head on straight until my performance starts!
I am heavy cruiser idol Prinz Eugen, a participant in the Muse System experiment. You look interested in my outfit, Commander. Heheheh... You can expect my usual exploits and more!
You sure showed up early today, Commander. Are you here to observe us rehearse, or were you that desperate to see me? Surely you don't expect me to believe that this was for "educational purposes"~
I'm in top form right now. If you insist, though, what part of me do you want to examine? My voice? My stage performance? Or my general "condition"?
Try and give me a stage I can shine even better on. I'll reward you handsomely♪
Luck and ability are both important to idols. Of course, I've got both!
When you hear my voice, don't you feel me... engulfing your heart and soul?
Oh? There's peeping, and then there's this. If you wanna see me that bad... then look all you want. Heehee.
Hmph, someone went and messed up my hair and makeup... You're gonna pay the price for that later.
Commander? Have you fallen head-over-heels for my idol form?
Touching an idol? I'd better scream for help... Just kidding! As you wish, I'll let you get a little taste... Heheh♥
Are you just gonna keep staring at me instead of checking on your missions? Heheh... Are an idol's charms just that irresistible?
Your mission rewards won't run away, but don't think I'll let YOU get away without checking them, got it?
New mail, huh? Think it's fan mail? I don't care much about your average fan mail, but if it's a love letter from you? Then I'm interested.
Commander, what do you want to do now that I have a break between lessons? Go on a date? Or maybe throw in some... private instruction?
The commission is complete? Sounds like fun is waiting just around the corner. I'll go greet them with you.
Hard work doesn't lie... This is the result of my training, for sure.
Aufführung beginnt!
Maybe we should ramp up the difficulty of those lessons...
Maybe I should put more effort into being an idol...
The opening performance isn't over yet!
Heh... You're nothing but noise to me.
If you don't get your job done, I'll punish you... Kidding! Hm? You wanna know how you'll get punished? Keep thinking weirdo thoughts like that, and you won't get to be our producer anymore.
You've been working hard these days. Yeah... I can reward you for that. For example, an idol's massage...? Oh, you don't want to trouble me? You're such a little sweetheart, Commander.
Commander, I notice you're keeping your distance today. You can't guide me from that far away, can you? Come closer. Take in the sight of my movements, my gaze, and every little change in expression.
Liiisten, Commander... *exhale*... What was I doing? I'm just practicing my breathing for when I sing. Now, one more tiiime... *exhale*... You feel the force of my breath on your neck, don't you?♥
Ever since the day you became my producer, our fates became one. Keep supporting me forever from now on, okay? My singing, dancing, and performances are all just for you, Commander. Heehee♥

Directly confessing to a subordinate, and an idol at that... You're not much of a producer, Commander. Haha! As for whether I'll accept this... You've known the answer for a long time now, right? Keep those eyes fixed only on me from now on!
You know exactly what I want, huh? Thank you~♪ Mwah~
You should cut back on the sweets a little.
Heheh, if you're amping up the energy, then I won't be bested either!
Agano-class ship number two, Noshiro, will now begin the Muse System test. I'll put my all into both my idol work and my mission, so you have no reason to worry.
To meet Agano's and your expectations of me, I, light cruiser Noshiro, will do my best to complete this idol training mission. ...Was that good? Are you satisfied with me as a member of Alizarin?
Agano-class ship number two, Noshiro, will now begin the Muse System test. I'll put my all into both my idol work and my mission, so you have no reason to worry.
Welcome back, Commander. I finished drawing up today's lesson plan. See? Oh... You say this is your job, not mine?
Calmly reflect upon the lessons you've learned, and even a momentary performance will shine eternal. That is the kind of idol that I aspire to become.
I'm an idol, so I need to be even more mindful of my nutritional balance... Say, why don't you let me plan your meals for you too, Commander?
Improvising is great and all, but doing things without a plan does make me uncomfortable...
It's important to rest between your work, okay? Want me to bring you tea? Don't worry, I won't make it too hot.
Hm? My hair's messed up? Thank you for telling me.
Commander, you did that for the sake of instruction... right?
Please... cut it out...
Do you need my help completing your missions, Commander? Heehee.
Mission accomplished. You really are a reliable help.
A letter...? Is it a new concert mission?
Nnh... Zzzz... Ah, C-Commander... Welcome back. I'm sorry, I just fell asleep... Do you have a new training mission for me?
The commission is complete. Just as you planned.
I'm becoming even more refined.
Fight just like we rehearsed!
With my singing voice and the courage given to me by the Commander, I cannot lose!
Did I not train enough after all...?
Now's my chance!
Brace yourselves, everyone!
Commander, this course of action will have negative effects on my training.
Thank you for coming all this way to see my lesson. ...So? Was there anything I could do to improve my performance? Heehee.
This is exclusive Alizarin merch and my autograph... Would you like to have them? Heehee, it's nice to be a little childish once in a while.
You think I look cool when I sing? Th-thank you. Does that mean I'm still far from being consistent, though... Haha, I thought you might say that. You love praising me, don't you? *blush*
This... is special merchandise just for you. Please take it... The red mark there is, umm... I kissed... Never mind! It's nothing!
This day came so much sooner than I expected. ...I know. You're ready and raring for us to move on to greater heights, aren't you?
Thank you. I'll cherish this gift.
Let's do our best together.
I'll do my best, too. You don't have to tell me!
I'm Kongou, with the Muse System unit Cyanidin. You'll witness my elegance and idol charms, Commander. Heheh, get ready, because you'll never forget the sight of me on stage.

I'm Kongou, the first Kongou-class ship. Every idol needs elegance and vigor, so my presence is sure to liven up Cyanidin even more... Heehee, how was that, Commander? Have you been taken in by my charms?
I'm Kongou, with the Muse System unit Cyanidin. You'll witness my elegance and idol charms, Commander. Heheh, get ready, because you'll never forget the sight of me on stage.
Greetings, Commander. There's still time before work. Shall we take a stroll together?
Why am I dressed to look like a cat? Well, they're equal parts composed, elegant, graceful, and charming. Don't you think they're a lot like me?
I have black tea here. Commander, would you like some... Oh. Um, I already drank from that one...
*sniff, sniff*... What is that wonderful smell? Oh, my, it seems to be you, Commander!
You want to touch the ears? That's okay, but... Wait, you meant mine instead of the cat ears?! ...You were interested because they were all red? Th-that's just because my tea is so hot!
Your hand is so warm that I find myself wanting to rub my cheeks against it like a cat. Oh... Do you think the kitty ears are influencing my brain?
Well well, Commander. Do you have any requests?
Okay... Don't be so greedy, now, okay?
You have new missions. Want me to go with you? Heehee, if you don't answer quickly, I'll take that as a yes!
Mission completed. As a reward, you may touch my hands... No, not the kitty paws on my rigging. MY hands.
How about we plan our next performance based on the latest trends?
Commander, wanna sit on these kitty paw cushions together? You'd be surprised how comfy they are.
Leave afternoon tea preparation to me. Heehee, you do know the commission team has returned, don't you?
Phew... This show ought to be an easy success.
Let our melody resound!
An idol's victory must be elegant, after all. Heehee.
Is this because I'm still not used to being an idol...? We'll have to retreat.
It's time for the climax!
Ah, I'm losing my balance...
Geez. You're lacking elegance, Commander.
Affinity, enthusiasm, sincerity, and most important of all, elegance. These are all necessary to be a first-rate idol.
It's time for idol Kongou and the Commander's photo op! This is your special right - better yet, my special service for you.

You've been taking such good care of our photo together... Heheh, in that case, I'd better take ten photobooks... no, a hundred photobooks of selfies for you! No, I'm sure you'd want a hundred photobooks of us together instead of just me, right?

Why did I volunteer for the Muse System? Heheh, I thought you might ask. If pressed, I would say that I want to use my singing and dancing to spread love and hope... Pfft, I'm joking. Really, all I wanted to do was show you my most elegant and beautiful side.
Oh, this is a... It seems clear that the love in my songs has reached your heart. Of course, your feelings... are clear as day when I hold your hand, too. Heehee♡
Presents are nice and all, but... I'd prefer if you stayed behind as well~♪
Try not to rush ahead too much, please.
Let's match our tempo.
I am the Le Hardi-class destro- Wait, no! Right now, I'm Tem, AKA Le Téméraire, an idol with the unit Cyanidin! Keep your eyes peeled for my debut performance, Commander!
I'm Le Téméraire of the Le Hardi class! Just you wait - I'm gonna give you the best, most elegant performance you'll ever see from Cyanidin!
I am the Le Hardi-class destro- Wait, no! Right now, I'm Tem, AKA Le Téméraire, an idol with the unit Cyanidin! Keep your eyes peeled for my debut performance, Commander!
I'm gonna try to be the best idol I can every day!
I've been working on a new dance the whole day... Tired, you ask? Heehee, I can take it if it means putting on a great concert for you!
Commandeeer! Heehee! I've got a surprise present for you - a biiig and warm hug! Feeling charged up on energy now?
Ow-ow-ow... Got a leg cramp. This choreography is so tricky... Whoa! Commander, how long have you been here? ...You'll give me a leg massage? Oh yeah... Heehee, I think that's helping a bit!
What's beyond the door? Ahaha! A room where these huge mushrooms grow. Pretty cool, right? Even if it's just stage dressing!
You want to be part of my performance? Yippee!
Eep! Commander, I've got a concert soon! This isn't the time to mess around!
Commander, you have a new mission! Let me help you with it!
Mission complete, Commander! The rewards have been claimed, so let's go have fun!
There's a letter for you! Buuut you can always read it later! Heehee!
Welcome back, Commander! Now have a break. Heehee, you need regular breaks if you wanna deliver your best performance!
We could welcome back the commission team with a song and dance! What do you say, Commander?
My rehearsing has paid off!
The concert's starting!
Now you know what makes me so great!
Dang it... Back to rehearsals for me...
Louder, for the audience!
Oh no! I went off-key!
Commander... Has the stress been getting to you?
Commander, my concert is just around the corner! It's gonna be amazing and elegant and you don't wanna miss it!
Commander! Whew... How's that? Have I gotten more elegant? Heehee! I've been rehearsing SO hard to get to this point!

Commander, are you free today? I don't need a favor from you or anything, I've just been working extra hard on some moves that I wanna surprise you with a demonstration of... Oh no! I gave the surprise away!

You think I look like a real star up on stage? Heehee, you say that, but if you ask me, the real star here is you! ...When I put it like that, maybe you're actually better suited to be an idol than me!

Heehee. Honestly, I've wished for this ever since the day I became an idol. In my dreams, you've already put the ring on my finger a thousand times... but now that it's happening for realsies, I'm feeling tense. Could we just... hold hands for ever and ever?
Is this for me...? Yay♪
I've got your back!
Let's up the tempo a bit!
I'm Cyanidin light cruiser, Boise... Huff, puff... Umm, does this outfit get your attention better? Good...

This is the first time... I've experienced what it's like to be a pop star! It's as if every moment is a dream... Haah... Haah... Which is why I have to do my best to bring you a dreamlike experience!
I'm Cyanidin light cruiser, Boise... Huff, puff... Umm, does this outfit get your attention better? Good...
Huff... Puff... The scent of nature, with a little bit of... Just a tiiiny bit of... Oh, that's the Commander's smell. Good morning, Commander.
Puff... Being an idol is hard. So many lessons every day... Cyanidin is full of such great people. I'd better not hold them back...
Huff puff, huff puff... I switched to a mask that better fit my stage clothes... Do you think it makes me a little more friendly?
Oh, I can wear this mask all the time since I'm an idol, right? I don't know if I could handle taking it off onstage...
This dance is a little hard... B-but I'll do my best to learn it! Because you're looking forward to my performance!
Do you like this hair accessory...?
The theme of this outfit is fairy tales... Do you like it, Commander?
Huff... C-Commander, does it have to be... now?
Commander, it's important to do your missions every day. They're just like rehearsing for shows.
We completed the mission. You already know that though, right?
Commander, you have new mail. When I was practicing my dancing, I almost let it get snatched up by a passing bunny...
Welcome back, Commander. I-I'm in the middle of practicing a new dance... Do you want to watch...?
Commander, the team is back from their commission. I'm an idol, but I still can't handle crowds... L-let's go greet them together...
My breathing has gotten a little more stable. I need to keep doing my best.
Huff... I have to be more serious.
Top performer... We win, Commander.
We lost... Did we not have enough lessons...?
Keep up this rhythm...!
It hurts even worse when you trip and fall on stage...
Commander... If you keep this up, I won't be able to go out onstage...
Going up on stage for the first time is nerve-wracking... But we've stuck to our practice for so long now. I'm sure we can make this show a success!
Am I doing a good job as an idol? If you really mean it, Commander... then I'll work even harder and harder!
The VIP seat I got for you is right over here. There's still a little while until the show, but... It's dedicated to you, so don't miss it, okay?
Why am I working and training so hard? Well... I've been given a chance to shine, and I want to shine my best for you, Commander...
Oh, my... Giving this to me at such a dreamy moment... My heart is pounding. Huff, puff... Huff, puff... I-I'm still an inexperienced idol, but... I'll do my very best for you!
Wow... I'll treat it like a treasure.
Tem, wait up. I can't keep up...
Kongou, the way you move is so elegant...
You... are the one this one has seen in my dreams. Wonderful... This one feels relaxed around you... But it seems you need this one's guidance, don't you?
...Yes, this one is Shinano. Everything else can wait. The world is unpredictable, and the future is unknowable. Let things come as they may, and let this one drift off into the world of dreams...
You... are the one this one has seen in my dreams. Wonderful... This one feels relaxed around you... But it seems you need this one's guidance, don't you?
*yawn*... Greetings... As you can see, this one is searching for the perfect place for an afternoon nap...
Hmm? You're interested in this one's pillow? That is understandable, but this is actually my rigging... Why do you look surprised?
Mm... Your office is undoubtedly the perfect place to sleep. Allow this one just five more minutes...
Would you like to dream together? Wonderful... Hm? How do you know that my dream... Could it be?! H-how embarrassing...!
This one cannot sleep... The sound of you flipping pages was just incessant! Come rest with me...
Mmm, mmnh, nnh... G-gentle on the ears, please...
Zzzzz... Heehee... D-do not tickle...
Sit, you! This calls for a lecture!
Zzzz... If this is a dream, then why has a mission... Ah! A new mission...?!
*yaaaaawn*... Th-this one completed the mission! Please handle the cleanup work... Zzz...
Here is your mail. Messages carried here from distant places must be important.
Zzzz... Heehee... Fruit candy, cheese, sweet melon... Mm? Oh. You're back... Zzzz.
*yaaawn*... The commission team has returned... Mm, let this one wash my face first...
This one feels a sudden surge of motivation, yet the thought of a sleepless night... Nnh, how troubling...
Go forth. This one believes in you all...!
An easy win... *yawn*... Off to sleep...
I-is this defeat...?
Woe, nightmares be upon ye!
Ah...! Th-this one mustn't lose...!
Clearly, this one must educate you...!
Hm? You're here, too... Have you come to take a nap? Oh, you're just here to think about your problems? Mmm... Okay, then this one will nap for a little while you do...
Ngh... This one is too worried to sleep... What problem troubles you so? Fate? Hmm, this sounds complicated... But this one does not believe in it... Well, I don't think I do...
Commander, may this one... s-sleep by your side tonight? Lately, nightmares have plagued me... Wh-why are you laughing? You're the one bothering this one about fate...!
With you, this one can feel at ease... Nightmares scare me no longer... Yes, let's keep sleeping together♪
This... is proof of our vow... Then this one will do everything in my power. Let's see all of our dreams for a happy future come true... together.
Woah! This is really nice!
Remember to get ample sleep.

ex.line: *yawn*... Good day... Allow this little one to lay on the sofa in your office again...
This way, Commander... *hug*... Mm, this one wanted to try lying in your arms. Such a warm embrace... is the ideal bed, indeed...
If dreams can be created... then we could make the perfect amusement park just for us... Heehee♪
...Hm? Shall we drift off to dreams together?
Zzzzz... Oh, you're back... There are snacks, sweets, and tea... Relax as you please.
Heehee, Commander, do you want to nap together? This one made a lovely dream and wants to share it with you♪

lines.line: P-class armored ship - Friedrich Carl.
I am Friedrich Carl of Iron Blood, that's all you need to know... My goodness, little one, don't be so hung up on the details. A great mission of filling the world with love awaits us!
I am Friedrich Carl, P-class armored cruiser and the embodiment of love. Come, little one - let us get to the core truth of love and bring happiness to the whole world.
Are you ready, little one? "Ready for what"? Heehee... To lean in close and hear my words of love.
It was love that brought us together, and it is love that binds us to this fate of being together forever and ever. Heehee♥
Did you sleep well last night? Heehee, looks like you did. Then let's go out and spread the good word of love to all we know!
Ahh, love and music are such wonderful things. I want to make songs about loving yourself, loving your friends, loving strangers, and loving your passions and play them to the world!
That radiant love radiating out from your heart... It touches me so much, I'm compelled to write a love song for you.
Heehee, oh, you silly little thing - shouldn't it be ME doing this to you?
Would you like to hear music bursting with love, little one?
I understand. I shall fill you up with love, little one♥
There's still work to do on these missions. You can't put our preaching of love on the backburner!
Mission rewards are here? Heehee, sounds like our efforts have been repaid by love.
There's a new letter for you. Aren't you going to read it? There could be a new sheet music in there for you, little one!
Welcome back, little one. Heehee, seeing you work so hard to teach people about love is making me tremble with happiness!
The commission team? They must be back from their voyage full of love.
My love grows stronger, and so do I.
The time hath come for tough love!
We are one step closer to realizing a world brimming with love!
Oh dear... Perhaps I got a little too carried away.
Heeere it comes!
Now you're making me mad!
Goodness me. All this time, you've been a naughty child who just won't listen... I suppose some kids are born to be unruly.
Heehee. That face you're making just screams "pleeease coddle me." Well, ask and I shall give - come into my arms. I'm always ready to give you my love.
Sometimes, when I'm with you, my heart starts aching for love. Heehee, well, little one? Will you help me out?
I feel your love deep inside of me, little one... But, please remember that loving me means to love yourself, okay? Then again, it's okay if you forget. When you do, I'll give you my love again♥
Can you feel it, little one? All the love inside of me is on the brim of bursting forth. Heehee, we're going to make so much love together!

Finally, the day has come for us to acknowledge each other's love. Now, take your proof of love and put it on me. Heehee... Tonight, I'm going to show you a deeper, more wonderful kind of love... darling♥
Heehee... I can feel how deep your love is~ Thank you~
Goodness, you can be such a child...

ex.line: There you are, my dear little one! The world is now on course toward the love-filled future that we dream of.
Heehee, your love is just as strong as mine at this point. Yet it's still not enough. Together, we're going to cultivate an even bigger, stronger love♥
Every second I spend with you gives me new inspiration about love. Do you want to hear a snippet?
Heehee, it's quite fun being on the receiving end of this.
Do you want to create a passionate musical number?
Heehee, your appetite for love really is bottomless, little one.
Welcome back, dear little one♥ No matter how far you go, I know you'll always come back.
Even though we're already a couple, my love for you just keeps growing. No-no, you don't need to do anything. You can just relax and slowly bask in all the love I have for you, little one♥

lines.line: Alright, little one! Now that we have some time off, why don't we play a game? If you win, I might just give you... the reward of love♥
Alright, little one! Now that we have some time off, why don't we play a game? If you win, I might just give you... the reward of love♥
Great timing, dear little one! Heehee, I just got done setting up the game. Do you wanna play?
My, my, you REALLY want to win. Are you that thirsty for my love reward?
Does playing this game with me make you happy? ...Oh? You could play this all day? Me too♥
It's lovely how our tastes in video games are so similar. This must be what they mean by "lovebirds of a feather flock together."
Heehee. Mischievous as ever, aren't you?
You better not be thinking you'll win through cheap tricks!
Heehee. Now it's time for a hands-on round of the game of love♥
You haven't finished these missions yet. Do that first, then we can continue our love-filled game.
My, straight back to me as soon as you're back at the port. You're such a sweet little thing. Heehee, should we continue our game while I hold you tight?

Heehee, you're a greedy but lovable little rascal. Seems playing a game with me just isn't enough - you want ALL of my love! Well, you'll get it! All the pleasure and love in the world belongs you to, my dear little one.
Are you ready, my beloved little one? I'm giving you all of me, so apply your love - the sunscreen - ever so thoroughly, so gently, please.
Are you ready, my beloved little one? I'm giving you all of me, so apply your love - the sunscreen - ever so thoroughly, so gently, please.
Mmm... I feel the love slipping between your fingers. It's even hotter than the scorching sun...
Even the power of love might not be able to beat the summer heat... Well, that's not true. Your love saved me from the heat, after all. Love wins again♥
*sigh*... I just want to jump in... No, I need to wait, or else the sunscreen will go to waste.
Hmm? Didn't you just put some on me? Is the heat making you lose your wits, little one? Heehee.
If you're tired, then lie down with me. Is it too cramped? I'm sure the power of love can fix that little problem♥
Be a little bolder, if you want. Heehee♥
There, too...? Well, love does need to be applied evenly♥
Missions? Under the blazing sun? Spreading the word of love is a difficult path...
Mission rewards~ See if there's anything that can cool me down in there.
Ah, you're finally here, little one. I feel like I'm drying out from the heat of the sun and my love...
The bed's already soaked with sweat. I'll have to lie on my back... Don't forget to apply your love here, too, little one♥
Alsace-class battleship - Alsace.

This one is Battleship Alsace - Sacrament of the Unified Orthodoxy, an unreachable dream, and guardian of- This one already said that? No matter. One's introduction is memorable and thus bears repeating. Take the mask off, you say? Um... I-I can't... Or else my emotion module will overheat and explode...
This one is battleship Alsace - Sacrament of the Unified Orthodoxy, an unreachable dream, and guardian of the Holy See. Commander, let us work together to cleanse the world of evil.
One is ready following a full system reboot. When does our holy task begin?
Commander, why do you gaze upon this one for so long? Is it the mask? Well... You shouldn't, because... This one's emotion module- Er, I mean, my heart isn't ready for this!
Commander, it seems evil has gone into hiding out of fear of you. Today, we may lower our guard for just a while.
The purpose of this mask is to deepen one's calm and raise one's efficiency... a-and to scare enemies, too, of course.
Battleship Alsace - the noble blade of the Orthodoxy and your protector - hath arrived! How's that? D-do you think that sounded cool?
One observes. One protects. One awaits your orders.
Hm? Commander, what are you doing?
Would you mind giving one a physical inspection, Commander?
Status report... I feel... h-hot and bothered... I-I'm gonna burst!
A mission? Delegate it upon this one and... Hm? You'll handle it yourself? B-b-but... But then what am I supposed to do?
Thus one announces - a holy task has been accomplished. Commander, forget not to claim the spoils.
Thus one reports - a new letter has arrived. Speaking of which, this one should send you a letter sometime.
(To carry out a holy task so swiftly... You are everything they say and more, Commander.)
Thus one declares - the commission team has returned. One believes they bring a good haul.
One grows stronger. Perhaps this newfound strength will bring us a little closer together.
Behold the Sacrament's manifestation!
Holy task has been carried out. One will return to designated area.
Gah... I couldn't... This isn't my fault...
Judgment hath come!
Activate reserve tanks!
Commander... I don't know how to talk to you anymore after all you've done.
Maintenance complete. Emotion module functioning as norm- This isn't normal at all! Ugh, god... Commander, you keep doing this! My emotion module has nearly blown up so many times because of you!

One has had no hardware upgrades, yet this one's operating efficiency is steadily increasing... Is this because of your daily staring? Have you... Have you been secretly exposing this one to your brainwaves?!
*stares robotically*... Yes? What is this one doing, you ask? Reply: I'm trying to beam my brainwaves into you!

Da-dim... Da-dum... Da-dim... Attempting indirect connection with Commander's emotion module... Connection attempt failed. Attempting direct physical connection. Commander, please help! This, umm, connection task is really important!

Seems I didn't need to connect to your emotion module to see what's inside your heart... Are you zapping me with your brainwaves again? Y-you can't, not after making me put this ring on! I feel like my emotion module will explode just from looking at you! Fine, if that's how it's gonna be... L-let's f- Let's get freaky!
I-I love this almost as much as I love you!
One shall bring you victory, Richelieu of the Holy See!
Allied frame detected. Providing holy assistance.
Forge a path to the Orthodoxy's future!

ex.line: Good, you're back. One is ready to commit one's body to the holy task... of... Commit one's body to... I didn't mean to phrase it like that!
(The Commander just keeps ogling my unmasked face... I-I can't do this... One must get back to battle, to the holy tasks, before... before I start having the wildest fantasies...)
I'm starting to feel... warm. H-h-how am I supposed to deal with the heat? Oh, I know! Transfer it to something with a colder surface temperature! C-Commander, I need your embrace!

"The noble blade of the Orthodoxy and the Commander's protector." One could add that to one's preamble... Ahem. This one is a Sacrament of the unified Orthodoxy, an unreachable dream, the guardian of the Holy See, and the noble blade that protects the Commander!
Are there really no holy tasks for this one to perform? You know, I'd really like some holy tasks. A buuunch more... ♡
The secretary manual describes а procedure called "the wake-up call"... D-don't you think it's vulgar? ...What part of it? A-all of it, the whole thing!
Hahh... C-Commander... H-how long are you going to keep patting me?
Ahh... C-Commander... Touch the darkness inside me... ♡
Status... report... O-one has already overheated... Pl-please help repair my frame... ♡
There are holy tasks to be done. The punishment for neglecting them is... Oh god... Stop thinking primal thoughts, brain! ...C-Commander?! Sorry for that... I got distracted.
If one claims these rewards now, one shall receive a reward later... R-reward... Noooo! My emotion module and logic pathways are going to explode!
A new letter? One wonders who it's from. Perhaps it's the very letter that this one wrote earlier... Don't open it! I need to read it first!
(No-no-no-no... You're going to lose control of your emotion module before the Commander even comes ba- Ohhh! Why?! Why does just imagining the Commander looking triumphant turn me on like this?!)
Come again? The commission team is back? Forgive me... I was wholly absorbed in beaming my brainwaves into you.
One's emotion module has been upgraded... Even if it can only last one second longer, that still counts as an upgrade!
A holy task has been seen through. Now one shall- Whuah?! Y-you can't just appear in my line of sight without warning!

Da-dim... Da-dum... Da-dim --Now, to hack right into Commander's emotion module... Wh-why'd I take my mask off? Um... Well, it's to make you lower your guard... Ahaha! Ahh~♡ Ahhhn~♡... Haah... Commencing physical synchronization~♡!

lines.line: Thish one ish battleship Alsace - a-artifact of the unifuh... guardian of the Holy See, donning summer clothes... One's frame is overheating and the only fix is submersion in water... Aahhh...
Thish one ish battleship Alsace - a-artifact of the unifuh... guardian of the Holy See, donning summer clothes... One's frame is overheating and the only fix is submersion in water... Aahhh...
Goodness, you're panting and drenched in sweat... Did my bikini do this - making you hot and craving action in broad daylight? ...N-no, Alsace, you mustn't harbor these thoughts!
Wheeew... Aahhh... Huh? H-how did you know I was sending brainwaves into you? I'm still wearing the brainwave interceptor...
Me, fuming even more than usual? Well, yes, because this cruise with you is just that fun... You've rendered my barely-serviceable emotion module completely nonfunctional.
You think this bikini looks cute on me? N-now you're going out of your way to make me overheat! And it's working so well it's making me all dizzy! Ahh... Give it to me already... ♡
W-wait! My brainwave interceptor fell off... Thank you... Aahh... Am I imagining it, or is the pool heating up all of a sudden?

S-so, we're the only ones here... Try not to lose control of yourself like I do, okay? Ahh, hahh... Oh god... Just thinking about having you all to myself is making me have all kinds of wild thoughts... ♡
A headpat? One doesn't particularly need it... W-wait, one must turn on the Commander brainwave interceptor... Aahh! Hahh... N-nooo... Don't beam me so hard! You're making me hot even in the water!
It doeshn't make senshe... I'm underwater, and I'm shtill sho hot...
Ahh... Commander... I won't stop you if you wanna do it here... ♡
Commander, there are still holy tasks awaiting you... This one's talking "like that" again? Yes. The temperature has decreased slightly in one's emotion module.
A holy task has been accomplished. One needs to get back in the pool immediately... *pant*... Before the temp gets too high...
Your letters would just get wet if I brought them... Pl-plus, I'd make you... you know.
Wheeew... Okay, one needs to stay in the water to keep one's emotion module regulated. Just don't think of the Commander... Commander... Ahh... Hahh... ♡
The commission team is back? I can't leave the pool now, so... You do the reception thing, please.
You think this one looks even hotter than usual in the summer sun? Ahh... Don't say another word or I WILL overheat and stop working!
I need to do this quickly, or I'll be late to see the Commander!
One shall bring a bikini-clad victory!

One is in a bikini and underwater, thus one's cooling capabilities are at their all-time highest. You can come closer if you want- Ahh! Identification error has occurred in vision module, and logic pathways have shortcircuited... Why is my Commander resistance value still at zero?!
This one is Battleship Alsace - the Sacramental Blade, the Swordbearing Oni Protector of the Backwoods. One has awaited your arrival. *burp*... Um, pretend that didn't happen, Commander...
This one is Battleship Alsace - the Sacramental Blade, the Swordbearing Oni Protector of the Backwoods. One has awaited your arrival. *burp*... Um, pretend that didn't happen, Commander...
Welcome, Commander. The holy task awai- Mrgh! N-no, it's... It's nothing...

(I'm powerless to resist anything the Commander does to me in this pose... I thought I'd get to flaunt my cool side, but I just can't stay composed around the Commander... Oh, god... My emotion module... Drinking this sake has made its temperature go up... Ugh...)
You needn't fuss over form when atoning for a sin. Doing good deeds and accomplishing holy tasks are one and the same.
This one adorned this mask to suppress one's emotions and act in adherence to one's role... a-and also because it looks cool... *blushes*
About the alcohol you recommended - it wasn't sake, but rather Armagnac... which is causing problems for one's emotion module...
Maintaining this pose is a simple task thanks to one's balance function... M-my clothes, on the other hand... Oh, god...
Hahh... Eek! C-Commander! My mask!
Are you checking this one's ventilation function?
Eek! This one's sensors are... overheating! Detecting sudden temperature increase!
You carry out your holy tasks... So, too, shall this one fulfill one's role.
Do not forget to claim the rewards of your holy task. And to give this one a reward.
Commander, let us drink every drop of this sake... Ahh. Your heroic performance has been duly logged in- Gah! Th-the cup!
Message received: The commission team has returned. One shall get down and- Mgh?!

Detecting error in sensor functioning... But you're not even touching this one, so how- Eek! M-my sensor's sensitivity is acting up, so you shouldn't touch me there... Hahh, ahh... You'll make me turn into a real oni and attack you!
Mogador-class large destroyer - Mogador.

I'm Mogador, lead ship of my class, and I serve the Vichya Dominion... Ohh, I'm practically exposing myself here, talking about myself right under your gaze... Hehehehe... We need to do this more often.
Hi, I'm Mogador, the lead ship of my class and a judge of the Orthodoxy. Hehehe... Commaaander... Please use and abuse me all you want...
Commaaander, welcome baaack. Hehehe... Boy, it suuure is hot in here. Ahah... ♥
I've organized all the intel. Up next - planning the mission. Whooh... It's so hot... I'm gonna take off my cloak.
Are you wondering about my cloak? It's specially made for us Tribunal judges. It's breezy, lightweight, and comfortable. Ohh, it feels really nice...
Honestly, I wish I didn't have to wear this cloak, but between covering myself up and being punished by the Tribunal, I'll take the first option... Heheh.
*sniff sniff*... Commander, do you use perfume? Or is that just how you naturally smell? Heheh...
Commaaander! I've finished sorting the reports! Oh, that's a mission briefing from the Tribunal... Pretend you didn't see that.
Don't worry - my hair isn't sticky.
You shouldn't come too close, Commander... You'll get my sweat all over you.
Hehehe... This is one of the reasons why I wear a cloak. A cloak is all you need... ♥
New mission orders are in. Give them a look-see. Heheh, this looks like work a judge like me can handle.
Mission complete. Ohh, that's the good stuff. Now let's go take a shower, Commander!
Here's a letter for you... and here's the postwoman bringing it to you. Take a good, looong look!
*sniff sniff*... Something here smells really good... Aha! I knew it was you, Commander! Welcome back!
The commission team is back? Ohh. So that gets your attention. I'm gonna start undertaking commissions, too!
My axe has grown sharper... Hehehe.
I shall become the axe that judges!
They're in shambles... and we're basking in glorious victory. Hehe, hehehe...
I'm so sorry. I'll bear full responsibility for this humiliating defeat!
Judgment unto sinners!
That huuurts! But you're gonna hurt a hundred times more!
Commaaander, you shouldn't come too close to a judge of the Orthodoxy. You might have an... accident. Heehee♥
While I am an Orthodoxy judge, I'm your secretary first and foremost. Your orders take precedence! I will follow all your orders... no matter what they may be.
*sniff sniff*... You smell really good, Commander. So good it's making me... heat up. Hahh... Ahh...
Commander, there's still sooo much I don't know about being a secretary... Can you come to my room later tonight? Heheh... For some hands-on tutoring.

Commander, could you... Heheh, exactly. Come to my room tonight and give me secretary tutoring... Don't worry, I'll turn down the air conditioning this time and get myself ready. I promise you'll be satisfied.

On my name as an Orthodoxy judge, I swear my fidelity to you. Henceforth, I will be your axe... Heheh. I will follow your every order and take your every punishment, without any objection or complaint... ♥
I knew it... You DO understand me, Commander♥
Lady Clemenceau, I shall deal with these insects!
Let's see whose axe cuts best. Heheh.
Ugh, it's you... Yes, I'm wearing my cloak today! See?

ex.line: Commandeeer, take off those stuffy clothes and get naked! Feel the cool air when you're working! Mmhh... Ahh...
That's right, I'm the kind of girl who goes buck naked when she can. Heheh... What can I say? I'm sensitive to heat.
Since you don't mind how sweaty I am... if you want, I can do my work while sitting on your lap today.
*sniiiff*... *sniiiff*... You smell really good today... I could lick you clean... Ahah♥
Commander, can I engrave the phrase "the path to salvation lies inside" on my axe? ...I should write it on my cloak instead? You really think so?
Mmhh... Commander... That feels sooo good♥
Commandeeer, touch me more! Heheh... Ahh... Ohh... Heheheh...
Hahh... Ahh... Commandeeer! If I pass out, just keep holding me tightly... ♥
Commaaander, how about you give me a rousing kind of mission?
Don't forget to claim your rewards after completing a mission. Speaking of rewards, I've got a reward for you that'll make your knees weak♥
A letter for you. Heheh... My coat doesn't have any pockets, so I just carried it under my armpit♥
Welcome back, Commander! Good job on that mission. *sniff sniff*... Aahh! I'll never get tired of your smell!
The commission team is back. Go talk to them and get back here quickly... so we can be alone♥
Commander, about my secretary work... Heheh... Same place, same time as usual. Doesn't matter if you come empty-handed, I'll relieve you of your troubles all the same♥

lines.line: Commaaander! I'm struggling with my swimsuit. Come and give me a hand. Oh, that's fine - I locked the door as soon as you came in here. Don't be shy, I'm all yours now... Heheheh♥
Commaaander! I'm struggling with my swimsuit. Come and give me a hand. Oh, that's fine - I locked the door as soon as you came in here. Don't be shy, I'm all yours now... Heheheh♥
Commaaander, welcome baaack. My skin is all sticky and soft and cool... I think you'd really like touching it. Heheheh♥
There's just us two in this quiet, cramped little place... Ahh, my heart is beating through my chest! Come closer and listen, Commander♥
You look awfully hot, Commander. You're sweating even more than me... *sniff sniff*... God, smelling both our odors at the same time is next-level stuff♥
I wasn't lying when I said I wanted to swim with you, I just had a change of heart. This is a rare situation and I need to jump on it. Heheh...
All this moving around has made my bikini strings mighty tight... Come loosen them up for me, Commander♥
C-Commander... Talk about sudden... Ahah♥
Commandeeer! Between this and my usual clothes, which do you like touching more?
Hahh... Ahh... Yes, this is exactly what I locked the door for!
Commandeeer... Do you have any "missions" I can do here and now?
Wooow, completing missions despite your current situation. Impressive, Commander♥
Go ahead and read your letter. In the meanwhile, I'm gonna have my way with you... Heheh...
Commaaander! Welcome baaack! *sniiiff sniiiff*... God, you should really mark this place with your scent.
I hear footsteps. The commission team must be back... but I can't let you leave already♥
You know, I always wear breezy clothes, but your gaze just makes me feel sooo hot... I know why that is, I just want to hear you say it... Heheheh♥
