Commaaander♥ You pressed the call button, so here I am... You don't remember that? Heehee♥ Do you have a fever or something? Gosh, you poor little thing...♥
Commaaander♥ You pressed the call button, so here I am... You don't remember that? Heehee♥ Do you have a fever or something? Gosh, you poor little thing...♥
*sniiiff*...♥ *sniiiff*... ♥ This is a physical... or should I say, olfactory checkup, so it's perfectly fine. God, you smell so good, Commander♥
Medical record complete. It's time to change your dressing now, so stay still. Let's see... I'll have to touch you in a few places, but it's either that or doing it a much more convoluted way.
Hahh, ahh...♥ Commander, it's time for your regular checkup! Let me take a good, long look at your body...♥
Wow, your body feels so warm... Heh♥ Heheheh♥ You know, mine's hot too, and it's making me lightheaded... Makes me wanna undress right about now...

I'd like to give you an injection, but your clothes are in the way... Just roll up your sleeve? Uhh, I don't remember saying the shot was meant for your arm - do you? Exactly, so you'll have to fully strip... Ahah♥
The Tribunal has this thing called the Sacrament of Healing. It draws your blood, applies strange ointments, stuff like that... I, on the other hand, will heal you with more conventional methods.
Ahah♥ Now pull me into bed with you...
Commander... There's no one but us here, so you don't have to hold back♥
Ahh♥ Hahh♥ Commander... You can just... stay put for now♥
Your missions can wait, just focus on my healing...♥
Mission complete? Wait, when did you do that missions?
There's a letter for you. I rarely wear clothes, so I almost forgot I'd put it in my pocket.
Commander, let me check your body for injuries. *sniff sniff*... Ahh! The fresh smell of your sweat after a sortie... *sniff sniff*... This is so good it's making my mind blank out♥
Seems the commission team is back. Just stay where you are, Commander. I'll go and receive them for you.
I hate it when you get sick, but I do love an opportunity to practice like this♥ Although, if you keep staring at me like this... I think I might cave in to temptation before you do♥
We're jumping! Ahah♥ Isn't this feeling of weightlessness just the best? You and me, Commaaander, falling and pressed together... You want this to last forever too, don't you?
We're jumping! Ahah♥ Isn't this feeling of weightlessness just the best? You and me, Commaaander, falling and pressed together... You want this to last forever too, don't you?
Ahah♥ Commaaander, we're getting closer and closer♥ What, my clothes are getting blown around...? Don't worry. Just let me fly and dive into your arms!
Commaaander! I can't hear what you're saying! But it's okay. Just hold me tight and feel all my love and sweat♥
Hahh... The wind blew all my sweat away, but the places I'm smooshed up against you still feel hot♥
I feel like the wind's going to blow away these pesky clothes... Hold me tight, Commaaander~ Otherwise I might end up totally naked♥
Hmph, the wind's so strong that I can't smell your scent. I'll have to do twice... no, three times as much sniffing when we land to make up for it♥
Can you hear what I'm saying, Commaaander? Alright, I'll whisper it once more into your ear then♥
Mmm... Haaah! No matter how strong the wind gets, it'll never erase your scent on me... Hahh... Aah♥
Angh... I'm about to get even sweatier...♥
You're so mean, Commander... You really are. And I love you for it♥
I'm calling you from the sky! Let's keep falling together... endlessly♥
Are you full to the brim with me, Commander? Hehehe... Same here. Your scent's taken over my whole mind and body... Ahah♥
Are you ready to take a dive with me, Commaaander? Hehehe, I'll push right up against you so you can feel every tremble and heartbeat... *pant pant*... Become one with me...♥
Are you ready to take a dive with me, Commaaander? Hehehe, I'll push right up against you so you can feel every tremble and heartbeat... *pant pant*... Become one with me...♥
Commaaander, we're about to jump! The engine's really loud, but so is the thumping of my heart... Hehe♥ Want to take a listen?
I've finished checking the safety mechanism... This is going to bind us so tightly together, isn't it, Commander? Hehehe♥ I'll hold you even more tightly than any belt♥
Check my parachute buckle, won't you, Commaaander? Ahah♥ The touch of your fingertips... I think I'm going to start sweating again♥
Will you hold my hand, Commaaander? No, it's just to make sure we're safe before we jump... but I got my hopes a little too high, and now my palms are all damp♥
The wind's really blowing... If I lose my balance, I might just jump into your arms♥
Hehehe, I chose this outfit to be nice and cool... but I'm still sweating so much... Haaah, haaah... It's so hot...♥
Haaah♥ Haaah♥ My hair's all damp with sweat, but you're running your fingers through it...♥
Ahah♥ The wind's nice and cool, but everywhere you touch me just heats right up... I think our world is warming, Commander...♥
Ahah♥ I think I want to keep diving with you, right into the clouds of love...♥
Commaaander, I want you to look at me and only me. Hehehe, it's almost time to go♥
Now you won't have any distractions, and jumping with me will be all you can think about, right?
I've been waiting for you, Commaaander! I'm ready to go, so come and dive into the clouds with me... We'll hold on so tightly to one another the whole way down♥

When I think about flying together with you, Commander... my body feels full with your smell, and I get so hot I can't bear it... Haaah♥ Haaah♥ I'm getting so excited, I think I'm melting from the inside out♥
C5-class heavy cruiser - Brennus.
I am Brennus, a C5 cruiser designed to protect against a new threat. Swordbearer of prophecy, I will fight on to the end for your sake.
My name is Brennus. I am the sword born of oceans of fantasy in order to usher forth change in this world. Now, Swordbearer of prophecy, answer this question of mine - are you prepared for change?
How do you do, Swordbearer? What string do you wish to pluck today?
...To be reborn in the material world, one must first remove their fetters. The stage for decisive battle will soon appear. Swordbearer of prophecy, hold your sword tight.
The sounds of strings may be intangible, but for me, they are tangible things that can be woven together. Even something as fine and delicate as thread can be used to hurt others.
I can't always be flawless... You do have a point, Swordbearer. Maybe there are times when I should rest, too...
Through the strings' vibrations, nothing becomes something before once again returning to nothing. The world walks atop one vibrating string, ever waiting for the sound of bells...
...Hmm. Is this the stress reduction method you mentioned?
Hm? You're interested in how I hold my sword? ...Then allow me to play you a verse now.
...Nh?! P-people like you are just... *blush*
There are missions that require your attention, Swordbearer. Our deeds today serve as the foundation for tomorrow - do not forget that.
Mission complete. Ensure that your reward list contains no errors.
Swordbearer, there's mail... Hm? There's a pink envelope in here...
Welcome back. The quivering strings have settled - well done.
The commission is complete. Let us witness our allies' triumphant return together.
The strings have become even more taut.
Now, behold my pure wrath.
And so it ends, in unceremonious silence.
Urgh... I won't give up...
Accept your judgment!
Is this... a trial?!
It seems you'll need to apply yourself before you're ready to bear any sword...
Do you know the trial of Sisyphus? The final battle I look to is the same, pushing a rock up a hill only to see it roll back again. Anxiety-inducing, indeed...
Do I seem a little too tense? Well, the final battle approaches... Of course I understand what you want to say, Swordbearer. "Life goes on, and you need to enjoy the present," right?
I do feel a sense of fulfillment pushing that rock up that hill, but... You're right. As long as I fight on, the resistance is never truly over.
I see. As you claimed, the human world is full of fighting spirit, too. Then I accept your invitation - "amusement parks" must be bursting with fun, no?

This is... Of course I know what that is you're holding! Then you're asking me for... Hm? You think I'm attractive when I'm lost in thought? I-I... O-of course, I'd be happy to -Nnh?! A-aaah... You didn't even let me finish my sentence!
Hmm. I didn't know such fascinating things existed.
Fighting side-by-side with former enemies... How interesting.

ex.line: Greetings, Swordbearer. What are your plans for today?
I'm lucky to be able to travel with you... Once this is all over, I'd like to see this world again.
When I let go for a moment and relax, I feel the world has changed... You say the way I talk to you has changed, too? I-I would ask that you not mention that!
Heehee, the strings I pull are just the laws of science... This is just a bit of sophistry on my part.
(whispering) How in the world did I come to enjoy this...?
...I'm happy to do whatever you want...
Welcome back. You look like you're in a good mood. Another victory, I'm guessing?
Kh... Wh-why are these "crane games" so much more devious than even Sisyphus's trial?! S-stop laughing and help me, damn you!

lines.line: Swordbearer, you've come at the perfect time. I need your help. Hm? What's with that look on your face? You didn't expect it would be a difficult feat to arrange the clothes you requested I wear, did you...?

Swordbearer, you've come at the perfect time. I need your help. Hm? What's with that look on your face? You didn't expect it would be a difficult feat to arrange the clothes you requested I wear, did you...?
Good evening, Swordbearer. The night is beautiful. Come sit with me, and let's watch the fireworks.
Indeed, I call this outfit "Wielder of Twin Swords - Underwater Performance." ...You think I should just call it a swimsuit? I refuse.
The fireworks are being set off so close by, but strangely, it calms the heart. Yes, I feel a state of perfect peace... But of course. You're here, after all.
Wearing the "Wielder of Twin Swords - Underwater Performance" makes tuning a more formidable challenge. Making music that moves the heart will prove a difficult task...
Now is the perfect time to confirm the effects of this outfit. Shall I play you a song? The mood is just right...
...Mm. If you want to touch me, wait until after I finish tying, please.
Hmm? You want to help me because I look like I'm struggling?
...C-come, then. I'm ready...
Welcome back... What song would you most like to hear now?
My goal is still far away, so I need a breather now and then... Swordbearer, permit me to hug you and enjoy a dreamy night together with you...
An encounter under the moonlight - the work of fate, or the very laws of their world? Ah, Swordbearer... Those weren't rehearsed lines, but a simple greeting to you.
An encounter under the moonlight - the work of fate, or the very laws of their world? Ah, Swordbearer... Those weren't rehearsed lines, but a simple greeting to you.
You've done well to come here, Swordbearer. Let us enjoy the moonlight, accompanied by my melody.

If you wish to restore the material world, then your resolve must be firm. The stage is set. Swordbearer who leads the army of salvation, are you prepared to overcome the countless difficulties awaiting you?
A distant realm, illuminated by moonlight... Though it is very literally a mere stage, there's no limit to what stories may play out with you.
I am accustomed to redefining my existence depending on the role I must play. Umm... In short, I'm an experienced actor.
Existence can only manifest in limited forms in a closed time-space continuum. Swordbearer, you exist as my lover for now, so please act like it.
Is this moon real, or a mere reflection upon the water?
Mm... Y-you didn't tell me there would be ad-libbing...
Clamorous strings, now as still as water... Welcome back.

The boundary between reality and fantasy can shift based on one's will. Even with the awareness that this is a fleeting dream, we must savor it until we wake. Swordbearer, my one true love... do you feel the same way?
Le Hardi-class destroyer - Fleuret.

I'm Fleuret, Le Hardi-class destroyer and the Vichya Dominion's flower. Don't dismiss me just 'cause I've got a cute name, 'kay? I can handle anything you throw at me, from being a Templar Knight to serving as your bodyguard!
I'm Fleuret, Le Hardi-class destroyer and Templar Knight of the Vichya Dominion. And you must be the Commander, heehee. We're gonna get along juuust fine, you and I!
Ah, here comes the Commander of our Dominion! Heehee, do you wanna play a game? How about... card guessing? You pick a card, and I'll sus out which one it is.
I always look forward to doing magic with you. You have such funny reactions to every trick I show you! Ahahah!

You've been giving me suspicious looks as of late, Commander. VERY suspicious looks by Orthodoxy morals. Heh, do you have a crush on me? Yeah, right... Huh? I was right? I think I've actually developed telepathy!
Where'd I leave the documents that were on your desk? I disposed of 'em all. Hah, just kidding! I processed them and put them right here.
How about instead of performing magic, we play "greater than less than" with cards next time? And whoever loses has to be the winner's mount!
Heehee, aren't I cute? Feel free to keep patting!
Heh! You wanna see a new kind of magic, do you?
Eeek! Stooop! Touching a lady like this is criminal! ...Ahahaha! You should've seen the look on your face!
Still got holy tasks you need to do, huh? C'est la vie. Let me help you out!
Heheh! Mission complete! See? I knew you needed my help!
Commander, there's a letter for- What? You're worried it's boobytrapped? Come on, who do you take me for?!
Welcome back! I took a leaf out of someone else's book and made you tea. Don't worry, I didn't add anything to it - enjoy your perfectly normal tea!
A commission's been completed. Head out and talk to the girls!
This'll let me pull great tricks!
Heheh, you small fries are in for a bad time!
Nice and simple! This is easier than practicing my telepathy trick!
Hrmh... Clearly, I wasn't fast enough.
You're annoying!
Oww... That really hurts!
Hrmh. You're hopeless the way you are now. Then again, hopeless people still have their charm. Heehee.
Loooser, loooser! You're a loser! ...There, happy now? You really make weird requests sometimes.
I'm "surprisingly well-behaved"? What's that supposed to mean?! I've always been more principled than mischievous! I take my job as a Templar Knight seriously!
I can do more than just write cards. Tadah! Have a rose! Heheh, surely you of all people know the meaning a single flower can hold.
You've gotten to the point where you can't imagine life without me, haven't you? You've got to make a move on me already, or there will be consequences!
Ahahaha... I-I didn't think you'd actually do it. Come on, don't stare daggers through me as a way to get an answer... That's playing dirty! L-look, my answer is: yes, happily!
Wow. I've never told you what I like. This is really impressive, Commander!
Keep it together for at least a minute!

ex.line: Commander! I'm feeling reeeally needy today. Heehee... Does hearing that excite you? You really are a simple person.
When you'll get to see a new trick? Soon, I can tell you that much! I've been researching ways to make a part of your body "disappear" into something else. Look forward to it!
I've heard that resting your head on your partner's chest helps you relax! I wanna see if it's true or not! Oh, you could do it to me, too, if you want.
Hm? You saying you wanna chat with me?
You've really figured out how to use those hands!
Welcome back. I made you tea! Whoa! You drank it all in one go. Heehee, not very scared that I spiked it with something, are you?

You think I've gotten more mischievous? Heheh, is that a problem? You know, we swore an oath together, which means I should be annoying you more, if anything... Yeah, right. Fine, I'm sorry! I apologize!

lines.line: Welcome, welcome! I'm Fleuret, your game master. Are you ready to make a wager? Heehee!
Welcome, welcome! I'm Fleuret, your game master. Are you ready to make a wager? Heehee!
You took an awfully long time shuffling the deck, Commander. Huh? You suspect my cards are marked? Why, I'd never do anything like that!
Really, Commander? I explained all the rules of the game and you're still spacing out. Is it my outfit? Is it distracting you? Heh, just kidding. You're a sweet little bean, Commander.
Commandeeer, you ready yet? Staring at the cards won't transform them into new ones. Well, probably not. Maybe they will!
Look at you, eyes darting around! I don't blame you, though. You did lose your every last chip to me. How will you pull yourself outta this one?
If you're feeling tired, come here and lie down. You won't get my cushions, but you're free to rest your head on my thighs.
Heheh, you trying to butter me up to make this easier for you?
Commander, you're only meant to touch the cards in my hand.
Eeek! I'll have you know there are hidden cameras in here! Not really, but I bet you bought it!
You got a message? Fine, you can check your phone. Normally, that would be cheating, but I'll tolerate it in this case.
Welcome back, Commander! Once you're ready, take a card! Relax, we're not playing a game - this is magic!
Whoa, the commission team is back. There's no rule saying you can leave in the middle of our game, but I'll allow it this time!
Ahaha! This is great! I thought about using card magic, but I didn't need even it to easily beat you! Heehee, now, as the winner, what should I ask from you?
Le Hardi-class destroyer - Épée.

Greetings from Épée, Vichya Dominion Le Hardi-class destroyer... A-as you can see, I'm a little scatterbrained, but I do my best every day to get better... I-I hope I can cause as little trouble for you as possible...
Phew... Deep breaths, now... You can do this, Épée... Haaaah! C-Commander! I'm Épée, a Templar Knight of the Vichya Dominion! Nice to meet you! I-I dunno... Will that be good enough?
C-Commander, welcome back! It took a while, but I got aaall of your important documents together... Hehe...
I have a holy duty to protect you and make you happy... Right! I might cause a little bit of trouble for you now, but I'll do my very, VEEERY best...!
*staaare*... Huh? Is there something I wanna say? N-no... I just couldn't stop myself from staring at you, is all...
E-excuse me! I wanted to wash your clothes, but when I was scrubbing them, they started tearing... Oh, Commander, I'm sorry...
I-I might not be helpful to you yet, but... I'll do my best! A-after all, I want to be a knight who can protect you... Hehe...
H-hey, so, I don't mind if you mess up my hair...!
Umm... If there's anything I can do for you, don't hesitate to ask...!
I-if it's fun for you, Commander...!
Commander, you have unfinished missions... D-did you leave them undone because I'm such a nuisance? That must be it...
Thank goodness! A successful mission... I can't wait to find out if I helped at all...
There's mail for you, Commander! Ack... I'm really worried that I might have dropped any mail that is really important...
Commander, welcome back! I-I'm really glad you're not hurt... Huh? I shouldn't run? Why - Aaah! Aww, I fell just like that...
*staaare*... C-Commander, may I come with you to greet the commission team...?
Do you think I can help you more now?
I-I'll try not to make it hurt!
Phew... I'll help lead you all to victory!
Th-this is just too much for me...
Stay out of my way!
I don't wanna accept defeat...!
C-Commander... It's totally my fault you turned out this way, huh? Ugh...
*staaare*... (Th-the Commander can't tell I'm watching, right? Urk... I can't take my eyes off of you when you're working so hard...)
I've been studying more ways to help you out, Commander! You wanna see the results? O-okay! First, how to clean up your clothes... Oh. Ooooh... I tore them to shreds again...
*staaaaare*... (Whoa?! Whoawhoawhoa?! W-we made eye contact! Urk... My heart pounds so hard when I look into the Commander's eyes...)
C-Commander, why are you staring...? Huh? You wanted to try talking with your eyes like I do...? Ah! Whawha?! C-Commander, you knew all this time? Oooooh, this is really embarrassing...

Y-you mean it? You'd give a ring to someone like me... Someone who's not fun, or charming, or skilled... Me, of all people? W-waaaah... I'd be happy to be with you forever, and ever, and ever, Commander!
*sniffle*... You really remembered... I'm so happy!
Fleur, b-be careful...

ex.line: Commander, welcome back! Hehe, just seeing you makes me happy...
I-It's my holy duty to protect you, so I can't stray too far... I'm clumsy, though, so all I can do is try to help you have fun... Hm? Commander, why are you looking away?
I-I haven't shredded any of your clothes lately, so I think I'm getting better...! Do you think so, too?
"Templar Knight, Defender of the Commander, Épée!" I-I'm wondering if I should make this my line for dramatic entrances... Commander?
Phew... That's relaxing... *nuzzles*
C-Commander... Do you wanna hold hands?
You're too sweet, Commander... Okay, you may... *blush*
Welcome back, Commander! Get this! I didn't trip or fall on my way to greet you this time!
Thanking the commission team? I'll pass. You're better at... Ugh, yes, it might make me a better communicator, but...
This isn't my victory. It's our Commander's... Ah! G-glory to the Commander!
C-Commander... No matter what happens, I'll never fear! If I'm clumsy, I'll do my best to fix things! A-after all, I'm your knight... Yeah, I am!

lines.line: Oh, wh-what do I do now... Fleur and the others are doing so well, and I can't even clean a table without messing up... If I worry the Commander, then... Whah?! C-Commander?!
Oh, wh-what do I do now... Fleur and the others are doing so well, and I can't even clean a table without messing up... If I worry the Commander, then... Whah?! C-Commander?!
"W-w-welcome to the cruise~" Aw, if I get that nervous just from a greeting, I'll never be able to serve the Commander...
*staaare*... Wait, it embarrasses you when I stare at you? Oh, wow, I'm sorry...
I wonder if the security here is good... D-don't worry! If I have to, I'll protect you even if I have to fight hand to hand!
Nothing's going to happen if we wait here...? Okay, but I'm here to entertain you, so I don't see much reason to go anywhere else...
Commander... Please let me stay here with you for a while…
So this is what I have to do to help you have fun right now, Commander! No...?
*sniffle*... I should be the one coming out to welcome you, and now you're stuck comforting me...
I'm supposed to entertain you, but the only thing I can do right is shut myself away in the corner with you... Oh, Commander, do you really still like me when I'm like this?
Battleship - Friedrich der Große.
Friedrich der Große, mysterious melody of the Iron Blood fleet, happy to meet you. What music shall we play together, my child?
Welcome, my child. What would you like to enjoy together today? Your talents? Glory? Or youth? Heheh, you may surrender it all to me.
Today's performance is about to begin. Sit, my child.
Do you want to hear my performance, my child? It might bring your confused state of mind back to order.
The phonograph was ahead of its time. Thanks to this, even music can be something that contains dear memories... Would you like to preserve some dear memories together?
Logic, sensibility... Heehee, just like the balance discovered in a melody.
Heehee, let's play. Let your emotions gush out like hot magma...
How fun. Now I want to do the same to you, my child.
Hm? What do you want to hear today, my child?
Heehee, is this your decision?
Trading actions for the things you desire... Heehee, is a mission really anything more?
Go get your mission rewards, okay? Hmm... I wonder what song I would need to play to be rewarded with you.
Mail for you, my child. Oh? There's a postcard that plays music.
Welcome. Heehee, I'm devising a glorious symphony to celebrate your triumphant return, my child.
Our friends are back from their commission. Shall we play a song of celebration?
I feel radiant.
Fade with the music!
Victory's encore has only just begun.
An unharmonious trill... I'll need to tune things better.
Let us play the Fifth Symphony!
Hmph... A final cadence?
Hmm. Ah... This performance is a little disappointing...
"What is real is rational," said one philosopher. Don't think too much about why I'm here - just immerse yourself in my melody.
Hmm... In what unexpected ways will the courage that wells up on the battlefield affect this movement?
Why don't we do something fun, right here and now? For example... We both bite into opposite ends of a pretzel and see... where things end up? Heehee.
Do you want me to pamper you, my child? Or do you want to pamper me? Heehee, either way, today is your only chance♪
This is... Heehee, do you understand what this means, my child? As you wish, I will entrust my very life to you. And I will see yours given to me, as well...

ex.line: Object of my overwhelming love, what performance would you like to hear from me today?
The songs recorded on a phonograph can be shared with others, like precious memories. My child, share your joys and your worries with me.
A song played by the heart that equally balances logic and sensibility, known as love... That's what I hear from you, my child.
Behold my passion, my child!
Welcome. Heehee, listen to the triumphant melody I've composed for you!
When I say that I'll accept all of you, that isn't just pretty words. Go on... Surrender all of yourself, everything, to me. I'll put you in the utmost place in my heart... Heeheehee...

lines.line: O-class battlecruiser - Alvitr.

I am Alvitr of the Iron Blood, a warrior come to serve you and a companion come to accompany you. How do I know so much about you? Heheh... That would be the result of analyzing existing information, efficient and precise observation, and rigorous deduction.

I'm Alvitr, O-class battlecruiser and Walküre of the Iron Blood. My name symbolizes ultimate wisdom, and I plan to prove the worthiness of that name. You may rely on me - I will manage your affairs now.
Good morning, Commander. I've already prepared a daily action plan for you. Feel free to reference it.

The daily action plans I provide should be 99% consistent with the plans you make yourself, not because of predictive powers, but because I've tracked your actions. A logical conclusion based on analysis of ample data.
All so-called foreknowledge and omniscience are simply the result of finding every last detail and applying adequate analysis and deduction. From my point of view, you're very capable of the same.

I monitor every last one of your movements, specifically because I have the responsibility to protect you and look after you, though I must accept that my own desires differ... Yes. I trust you understand.
Here's the file you were looking for, Commander. Hm? How did know? I saw your gaze shift to the desk, and then unconsciously moved to gather the scattered documents. Simple as can be, no?
How cute.
There's dust on me? ...Thank you. (whispering) So this is how the Commander justifies touching people...
I... couldn't have predicted this... *blush*
Commander, do your missions in the order of priorities I've assigned. Ensure they do not affect other plans adversely.
Mission complete. Please accept your rewards quickly... Also, I should thank you for following the proposal I made.
You have new mail. Beyond the contents of the mail, there's much to be gleaned from the sender's name and address, the ink they used, their handwriting, and more.
Hmm? Why did you return at a time inconsistent with my calculations? Give me details... It took extra time for you to buy me a gift? Oh... I-I see...
The personnel in charge of the commission are back at port. I made a reward list for you.
Changing the present means changing the future.
A Walküre's spear points the way to victory!
A victory based on thorough calculation and deduction.
Did I overlook something...?
Pierce and penetrate!
This is within the expected range of damage. Continue the battle!
You've strayed so far from my calculations. Hmph... Fine. I'll devise a stricter plan to get you back on track as soon as possible.
My desire is for you to rely on me. Hmph, this doesn't come just from confidence in my own abilities, but also because I exist for you to rely on me.

(The Commander replaced the flowers in the office with calla lilies today. We're the only ones in and out of the office lately. Is this your attempt at getting me to deduce the meaning of those flowers? Calla lilies mean "pure and pious love"... Eep!)
(The Commander said my name 93 times today. Upon staring at me for up to a minute without looking away, the Commander's uncertainty and body heat rose. I knew it... You're in love with me!)

Hm? Why did I call you here so suddenly? Based on your recent behavior, I judged that now was your ideal time to confess to me... Huh? You just happened to change the flowers that day? And when you stared at me and heated up, that was just because overtime had you exhausted? N-no, that can't be...!

You think I didn't calculate this moment long ago? W-well... You're right. I was so focused on your every little move that I'd already removed this possibility from my deductions... Phew. Basically, umm... What a welcome surprise!
Did you figure out what I like from watching me? I like that.
Don't underestimate how important minor details can be.
Walküres, form up! Today, we seize victory!

ex.line: Welcome back. I have already put together an action plan for you based on your recent routines. Once you're ready, let's see it put into action.

Hmm? Why'd I put an ice pack and wrist brace on the table? Well... You've blinked especially hard eleven times, and you rubbed your thumb joint seven times. These items can help relieve your troubles.

Your breathing frequency, blood flow, and heart rate are all rising to the point that you're shaking. I see, I'll go start the shower-Hm? That's not it? You're just realizing how much paperwork you have left to do...?
(My failed deduction led to me revealing my feelings first, but now that I think about it, I haven't properly confessed. What now, Alvitr? Do you put it all out there?)
Yes, I'm right here.
This is how you like to touch me, yes? Heh, I knew it.
Your time of return differs from the necessary time I calculated for your battle command... Did you think I would say that sincerely? Nice try. I got you a gift in return this time.
Phew... Commander, I know I'm late saying this, but... Well, I love you very much. My love reaches to the end of eternity and Valhalla beyond... engraved firmly in the passage of time.

lines.line: Oh, Commander. You may have noticed that the air conditioner is busted. I surmised from its volume levels that it was at its limit, but now that it's broken... life has become a struggle.
Oh, Commander. You may have noticed that the air conditioner is busted. I surmised from its volume levels that it was at its limit, but now that it's broken... life has become a struggle.
You're just in time. Let's start reviewing today's lesson results. Heh, I'll be the perfect aide for you.
You also noticed the sound the air conditioner was making and brought a toolbox to come fix it? ...You're getting more and more conscientious, Commander.
The heat makes it impossible to think straight. For example... I can't tell if how you're reacting is because of the heat, or because of seeing me like this...
I have one question for you to ruminate over, Commander. Did I predict that you'd come to the staff room at this time?
You'd tie up my hair for me? Thanks.
I think you should take off your jacket, too.
Just as impatient as I expected... *blush*
Hmm... Off again. Did you have detention, or something? Oh, that thing in your hand... I see. You bought ice cream for me.

Sometimes, using our limited ingenuity to play little tricks on someone we love can make life more fun. Huh? You've been waiting outside the door for me to get ready with exactly that in mind? A-aah...
Type 1936C destroyer - Z47.

I'm Z47 from the Iron Blood. I like Juustagramming, fashion, and keeping up with trends. IRL convos are my kryptonite, so just shoot me a DM if you need me. Don't worry, I'll see it - you're at the top of my contacts.
I'm Z47. Whew... Do you wanna add each other? Hm? My avatar? It's a black and white kitty. Looks just like my hairpin.
You're here, Mandy. I was just browsing the newest hairpins. Look pretty cute, don't they?
I like messaging you by phone. Feels like we're never apart this way.
My phone's almost outta battery... Um, Mandy, what should I do? ...What? Charge it up with static electricity? Seriously? Your jokes are so cringe. Although, it did cheer me up a bit, somehow.
Mandy, check out this funny meme I found. What? You don't get it? Okay, uh, want me to explain it to you?
Hey, uh... Do you think I'm a cold person? I'm not TRYING to be. I just don't know how to talk to people... Really? You don't? Phew, good.
Will I gain a few inches if you keep headpatting me?
Yeah? Found anything funny?
Whuh? The heck is this...?
You've got unfinished missions? I'll set a few reminder alarms, then.
Sooo, about those mission rewards... I should've got 'em all with me...
You've got a DM from a stranger. Also a DM from me. Read it.
Look who's finally back. Did you read my DM yet? ...Oh, had your hands full commanding the battle. Fair enoughski.
Commission team's back. I DM'd 'em a "welcome back." Tossed you a DM, too, you know...
Can I hurt the baddies more if I get my vroom-vroom on?
This blows. Let's just get it over with.
Victory. Gonna post this to Juustagram and get a ton of likes.
I didn't feel like actually trying, that's all. It feels cringe.
Vroom-vroom time!
Annoying... So damn stupid...
Not even leaving me on read... You're straight-up ignoring me again...
When you message people daily on this app, a cute li'l rabbit appears and keeps growing. Chat with me every day so the rabbit can grow, Mandy. Pretty please.
Um... I tossed you DM, so why won't you take your eyes off me? It feels REALLY awkward...
Mgh... Wearing this eyepatch all day is so tiring. Hm? Hey, don't take it off. It's an essential part of my fit. Appreciate the concern, though. You're really kind, you know that?

We can both use this app, y'know. To send DM's to each other, to share what we're up to at any given moment... Hm? You don't need an app for that when we're already together all the time? I mean... Yeah, true.
Whoa... You're gonna repeat what you usually say in DM, but IRL this time... Oh geesh... I-I'mma be real, dumping THAT much love on me all at once is gonna give me an overload...
C-can I really have this...? I'm so, so happy...
"Bewitching eyes"... That's adorkable.
"Fellowship of Justice"? When'd you establish a fandom?
Hey, how do you say this word?

ex.line: Hey, look who's here. I'll put my phone down if you come and cuddle with me.
A nickname? I mean, I'm fine with whatever. Z47, Forse, sweetheart, GF... Call me whatever you want.
I, um, found this recipe online and gave it a shot... It's my first try, so I dunno if it's any good... W-wanna give it a taste?
Gee, I'd love to watch a movie! If only someone would ask me on a date! I might just put down my phone and say yes! *stares eagerly*...

Mandy, check this out. This here's our plans for today - ride a Ferris wheel, munch some marshmallows, and tour the amusement park while holding hands. Sure is a busy schedule, eh? Better set out as soon as we can!
Hm? Heehee...
Mgh... It might look like I'm always browsing, but truth be told, I'm always thinking about you.
That feels sooo good, Mandy. I want more...
Missions, eh. Let's see what's left on the to-do list...
Oh, Mandy! Yeah, I just dropped my phone to hug you. That's how much I missed you.
Yo, commission team's back. I DM'd you about it, but since you check so rarely, I figured I'd notify you the old school way, too.
I'm the MVP. I'm da best. Heehee.
Heehee... I hope I'll see you in my dreams by sleeping with you, holding hands... That'll put me in an amazing mood tomorrow.

lines.line: Mandy, you getting distracted? No looking around on my watch. I've put down my phone for once, and I want you to only look at me while we're on the see-saw.
Mandy, you getting distracted? No looking around on my watch. I've put down my phone for once, and I want you to only look at me while we're on the see-saw.
This time for sure I'mma plop down and launch you sky high!
I can push harder if I take off my shoes? I dunno, sounds like you're trying to trick me.
Ugh... *rubs eyes*... My eyepatch? It's got nothing to do with us playing. It's just what's in fashion right now... Use eyedrops if my eyes are hurting? Eyedrops are the LAST thing I'll use, thanks.
I'm a bit angy 'cause I can't use my phone during classes. Luckily, playing with you makes me feel all yippee.
Ah. This is a breeze to you, I see.
Easy, Mandy! Take it easy! Whoooaaa!
Mmh... Soft, aren't they?
You'll play on the seesaw with me, won't you? I've still got fun to squeeze out of it.
Really? You'll piggyback me home to make up for checking out other girls? That's, like... not necessary? Let's just play a li'l longer then hold hands on the way home.
Stand here, raise the bat, and do a full swing when the ball comes flying - that's what Mandy just told me. Eyes open... for my full power.
Stand here, raise the bat, and do a full swing when the ball comes flying - that's what Mandy just told me. Eyes open... for my full power.
Observe the trajectory... Determine the time to hit... And then... Hiyah! I got it! ...What? Start running? I'm supposed to do a lap around this place?!
Aaand hit! Sheesh, that one sure went flying... Is that a home run?
Kay, I've got the rules all worked out now. You explained 'em way better than the breakdown I found on my phone.
So mind-numbing, doing these practice swings by myself... Oh, you'll root for me on the side? I guess that'd be... nice...
Yeah, I can bat even with my eyepatch on. Plus, isn't it way more lit if I hit a home run with one eye closed?
My hair ornaments? Eugen put 'em on for me. You think they're cute? Good. She did say they'd catch your eye when you step up as the pitcher.
Aw man, that's my third strike... Does that mean I'm out?
What?! H-hey, we're playing a game here!
Welcome back, Mandy. The pitcher's mound is free. Oh, don't worry - I'd never let one of my hits hurt you.
I won! Mandy, did you see that grand slam I pulled off?! ...Hm? Reward me? 'Kay... Then could you hug and carry me back home? I'm all out of juice, so...
Type VIIA submarine - U-31.

Name's U-31. I'm an Iron Blood VIIA-type submarine. Fighting and ensuring your safety are my middle names! Let me be your personal bodyguard for now. I'll keep any shifty girls at arm's length from you!
Ahah! You must be that "Commander," right? I felt all fidgety inside the moment I saw you. You and I are gonna be SUCH close friends♡
Hey, you're here! Hold still for a sec. I'm gonna give you a smell check, then a patdown... Alright, looks like nobody's wiretapped you.
It's time for your security check! You can never be too sure when it comes to these things. Hold still, now. I'm gonna give you a full-body search!
Yup, there're shifty girls trying to approach you alright. But that's no biggie. I'll keep my eyes on you and make sure nobody pulls anything on you!
Hold it, Commander! Stay right there! *sniff sniff*... Hmm. You've got a smell on you - but whose? Ahah! It's just mine!
For a while now, I've been feeling lazy during the day but then full of energy come nighttime. I should pick up the night shift... and keep you safe from right by your bedside♪
Heeey, you can't be content with JUST a headpat. You wanna go further, don'tcha?
Is this a sign, asking for your daily security check?
You best not be thinking anything rude like, "I wish they were bigger"!
Oh, Commander, you've got unfinished missions. Before you ask - of course I'll help!
Mission complete. Want a reward? Or would you rather have me?
Check complete. Your letter is perfectly safe! Buuut, I had to confiscate a few ones that came in suspicious pink envelopes♪
Welcome back. You sit over there and I'll go lock the door! Hm? Why lock the door? It's to keep you safe, duh!
Oh, the commission team is back. Let's head out and meet them together! That way you can do your thing, and I can keep you in my sight.
I've gotten even stronger! And I couldn't have done it without your guidance.
Heheh! You're getting no mercy from me!
Woe is me for being so dang strong!
H-hey! Didn't they use weapons that're against the rules?!
Sink to the bottom of the sea!
Oookay, this is getting dodgy...
I feel like taking a leave from being your personal bodyguard.
What kind of hair do you like? Twin ponytails? Straight and long? Or maybe side ponytails like mine are your favorite?
You don't know what this is? It's able to capture any and all sound in your quarters and your office. It's essential to ensuring your safety!
Y'know, I picked up you saying some weird things in your sleep. Wanna know what? Give me a nice hug and I'll tell you♪

I've got plenty of strengths as it stands, but maaaybe I could stand to be a little more mature. You don't think so? Ahah! I see, I see. I'm in your strike zone, is what you're saying. I knew you had an eye for quality, Commander♪

The time is finally here. I've been holding myself back for so long! Heehee. I've been pondering ways to pop the question, only for you to get to the finish line first! Gosh, I'm so happy I can't think straight. You'll just have to take the lead and do as you please♡
Ooh! You mean I can really have this? Hooray! I'll give you a special reward tonight~

ex.line: *sniff sniff*... *sniff sniff*... Heheh. Once again, my odor is the only one I smell on you. Good to know you didn't get caught up in any "risky" business.
Hmm? Well, yeah, I'm clinging to you because I'm your bodyguard! If that makes it hard to walk, so be it! I've got to be ready to protect you from every which way♪
Commander, time for a surprise inspection! Let me check if your phone's been wiretapped. Alrighty... There, I set our selfie together as your wallpaper!
Heehee. I've already sent all those ne'er-do-wells packing. Use this opportunity to give me a biiig hug!
Heheh! Come closer if you wanna!
What's up? Do you want a hug?
Eek! G-gosh, THAT was exciting...
Welcome back, Commander. Go on and get comfortable. Don't worry, I'll make sure nobody interrupts me for- I mean, interrupts YOU for a while♪

Hey, which would you choose between plain milk and chocolate milk? It's gotta be chocolate milk, right? Ahah! Chocolate milk is just like me - titillating, multi-layered, and rich... Do you want a taste?

lines.line: Why I didn't leave after classes were over? 'Cause I wanted to wait for you to come pick me up, duh! And I waited a looong time! Heehee, now that we're alone... maybe we could do something fun together!

Why I didn't leave after classes were over? 'Cause I wanted to wait for you to come pick me up, duh! And I waited a looong time! Heehee, now that we're alone... maybe we could do something fun together!
Maaan, you know how to keep a girl waiting! Make it up to me by fanning me. I wanna cool off a bit.
Ahah! You look like you're about to pass out! Want some candy to wake you up? Right in your mouth, like... this! Pretty sweet, huh?
Man, it's kinda hot in here. I suppose they do they turn off the AC after classes are over... Anyhoo, it's just you and me now - you don't HAVE to keep your coat on, just so you know.
Try and guess what flavor this candy is. Get it right, and I might give you a "treat." Ahah! Don't act like you don't know what I mean by "treat."
Mmh! Heehee. Keep going if you wanna.
Mgh... Want me to shift over a bit?
Do you like the way I look?
This is a cozy little spot. You oughta come lie down if you're feeling tired. There's no rush for us to get home, y'know.

It's not easy, chasing off naughty girls who wanna mess with you while also attending classes every day. I wanna stay here and relax for a bit before we head home. You don't mind, do you? Think of it as a reward for my hard work!
Type 1936B destroyer - Z43.
You may approach, Augur of Destiny! I am the Iron Blood's Z43, most powerful devil in all the world, descended to protect you from Dark Requiem... Heheheh, be proud of this fated encounter!
Heheh... You may approach, Augur of Destiny. Z43, the demon-eyed devil, rebel against evil, she who chases the light even when cursed with wings of dark, welcomes you!
Ooh! Augur of Destiny, come! ...Hey, you're late! H-hurry and help me uncover the evil conspiracies of Dark Requiem, the organization of darkness!
Dark Requiem - DR, for short. Treacherous scoundrels who delight in deceiving the masses... Hm? I mean the enemies we fight with at sea daily, of course.

Interested in why they call me the rebel against evil? Well, I parted ways with the bad guys and dealt a major wound to them... Hm? Who are the bad guys? Sh-shut up! No more questions! I haven't put that much thought into my backstory...

Where are my familiars? Heheh, Dulce has shapeshifted into this bag I'm wearing, and Delaman is the eyepatch that seals my demon eye as we speak. Heheh, cute, right? I designed it all... Ahem, TAMED them myself!

Augur of Destiny, tell me something! When you fight enemies, do you have a... personal boss battle theme? I'd pick something jazzy for you... Yeah! Jazz is great for symbolizing the confidence of the Fellowship of Justice!
Gaaah! Stop touching my head! You're ruining my power to detect darkness!
Kh! You've broken my barrier?
C-C-Commander! At this rate, my magic will run wild and destroy the very fabric of the world!
Have caution, Augur of Destiny! If you do not complete your missions, then I will be unable to see my justice done!
Mission complete. The rewards... Mmm, it'll take too long to check all of these... I leave this job to you, Augur of Destiny!
My demon eye has already seen the contents of your mail... Ack, I'm kidding! I wouldn't peep at your mail!
Heheheh... My servants, Delaman and Dulce, informed me of your arrival, giving me time to make sweets! Come, eat your fill!
Our allies are back from their commission. Heheheh, DR could not foil their mission this time!
Heheheh... My magic grows ever stronger!
The battle with Dark Requiem is mine to fight!
The glory of victory is mine - and by extension, yours!
Kh... Has this happened because of the stirring of my left eye's seal?
Let them witness our true power!
Kh! My barrier has been broken?!
Hmm... So the dark encroaches even into you...
Augur of Destiny, be aware that the Fellowship of Justice has investigated you and is considering for a leadership position! Hm? Who investigated you? Me, of course!
Plotting, strategies... All of it is so small and frivolous before my eternal demon eye! Like mere ants... Huh? W-wait! I'm not saying YOU'RE like that, Commander!

Behold, Augur of Destiny, the avatar I designed for you! In your left hand, a devil-summoning magical book! With your right, you wield a magic circle that can subvert the laws of this very world! On your back, twin wings of white and black! ...I-it's cool as hell, right?!
Come, Augur of Destiny, and place your hand on mine! I will now link our hearts... Oooh! This feeling... Heheheh! I knew it! You cannot resist the charms of this rebel against evil!

Ahem. Yes, I was trying to get your attention... Huh? You like this, Commander? ...Ack, ahem! Do you wish to renew our covenant? A covenant for all eternity, one that can never be broken-wh-what?! You agreed that easily?!
Heheheh... This seems to be imbued with immense magical power...
Huh? Z36, are you supposed to be a devil, too...?

ex.line: Comma-no, Augur of Destiny! Why are you always so late? It makes me so nervous that I can't even sleep in!
Augur of Destiny, Delaman has taken a liking to you! Wanna put on an eyepatch with Delaman's essence in it? I made it myself, so it's extra cool!
You really don't find me strange... Huh? You actually like that? H-hmph! Because of your presence, I might just be able to reside in this world for a long time!
A-aaah, finally... Finally! Thanks to your patient teaching, I can finally check the rewards all by myself! Heheheh, leave it to me next time!
Heheheh... F-feels good, huh?!
Heheheh, I feel the pulsing of magic!
A-are you trying to make my magic overflow again...?
Heheh. Is this my reward for seeing my justice through? Then let's see what we've got! Uh... Oh, I don't get any of this... C-Commander, help!
Augur of Destiny, sit down and rest! We got the couch nice and ready for you to relax! ...Who is "we"? Heheheh, my servants Delaman and Dulce, of course!
Heh heh heh... This is the power I gained from joining hands with the Augur of Destiny!

I know I say a lot of nonsense, and I often brag about my strength... Maybe I'm just trying to escape the fact that I'm powerless to change reality. But now... I won't ever let you go! And I won't let anything bad ever happen to you!

lines.line: Why can't I wrap this damn bandage... Hnnngh! Ow, ow, ouch! ...Huh? Comma-A-Augur of Destiny, help me! My magic-suppressing bandages have taken on a mind of their own...!
Why can't I wrap this damn bandage... Hnnngh! Ow, ow, ouch! ...Huh? Comma-A-Augur of Destiny, help me! My magic-suppressing bandages have taken on a mind of their own...!
Heed my words, Augur of Destiny! Now that you've discovered my secret base... you may come and hang out any time you want!
I'm just trying to put this bandage on to seal my magic as usual... Why can't I get it on today?! Have the late nights working on homework ruined my control over magic?
The papers on the slide up there? Heheh, those would be my magical sigils, my plan for justice, and a guide to lead lost lambs... h-heeey! Commander, don't leave!
Mmmgh... No matter how I try, I can't do it! Augur of Destiny, hear my command! Wrap my bandages right for me! ...I-I know! This is a TRIAL!
Y-you still don't have it wrapped, Commander?
T-time out a sec! Don't tie it theeere!
Huh? How has mail come when my base is secret? Augur of Destiny, do you wield some sort of mail-collecting magic?
Welcome back to our own secret base! Umm... M-my math homework is really hard... Can you help me out?
My demon eye beholds... Ah, yes! The return of our commission-bound comrades!
Alone in our secret base... My fantasies have become reality... Aargh, damn it! If not for this stubborn bandage, it'd be perfect... Ugh...
Dunkerque-class battlecruiser - Strasbourg.
I'm Strasbourg, member of the Tribunal. I am both a listener and a player. As my coworker, try not to bore me.
I am Strasbourg, Knight-Virtuosa of the Tribunal. And you must be the one who I've heard so much about. I see. Heehee, I look forward to seeing what you're capable of, Com~man~der~♥
Greetings, Commander. Oh, I'm surprised you've already started your holy task.

The domain of music is free of lies and treachery. There, I and my instruments can become logical and perfect beings. How fantastic it is to swim in the sea of melody and harmony - wouldn't you say so?

Though I'm not a judge, I've learned much from my Tribunal colleagues who perform the "dirty work"... Though, one thing I'd like to know is, how on earth your espionage skills have come to rival that of our intelligence officers.
Dunkerque made this dessert for me. And this one is for you, heehee. Now you owe me.
So, what did you think of my improv piece today? ...You REALLY liked it? You don't need to be THAT direct with your words... Still, thank you... *blushes*
You're hopeless, Commander... *blushes*
What, pray tell, is your goal with this intimacy?
Well, well... Want to know what it feels like to have both your arms tied up in strings?
You have new missions. Seems you have your work cut out for you, no?
Mission complete. Wonderful - like a song played to perfection.
There's a new letter for you. I've left it over here. You'll do the wise thing and read it at once, no?
You've returned. Shall I play a melody to mellow out your tense nerves? ...No, that was not an expression of affection for you. I-I said it's not, so it isn't!
The commission team has returned to us. The inventory list I made is right here. Do read it, Commander. G-good job, you say? W-well, I won't refuse a compliment...
Good. I'm not opposed to power.
Open your ears for this requiem is for you.
The performance has ended.
This can't be! I... never lose...
I offer you this mercy.
Agh... Has something gone awry?
I don't see you as a listener, and you don't see me as a player. Thus, we are at an impasse.

The song I played had a mellow sound to it? Why, thank you for your kind words. Playing the music that suits the listener's tastes is, after all, an instrumentalist's job - quite similar to how we interact with people, don't you think?
(Whew... Okay, I got that out of my system. Hm? Who's that at the door?) ...C-Commander?! Why are you here? ...You heard terribly violent music playing? Wh-why, yes, that was me.

I found out that nobody has been using this room, so I converted it into my private music room. W-wipe that look off your face! We all have our secrets... and this is mine, the secret no one else knows. From now on, you must bear my secrets and my stress together with me.

*sigh*... Commander, when I look at you, do I really see the person who I adore so much? I've grown so attached I can't deny it anymore. I'm in love with you. Do your eyes see the love in me? Gaze upon me, and don't look away... Please...

For... For me? Really? Why? You have no shortage of other admirers... Wait, let me just confirm this one last time! It's me - I'm the one you want, yes? Because if so, I will really stop holding back, embrace you tightly, and make sure nobody can ever take you from me.
Th-this is for me? What do you want in return? You can ask for anything!
Will you... make more desserts for me?
The Tribunal shall support you.
Here we shall play. Lead the charge.

ex.line: Hello, Commander. I've already gotten started on the work. Don't worry, I can do this all by myself today - that's how used to it I've gotten now♪
Commander. Hey, Commaaander. What are you thinking about? It better not be anything except work and me. Or else...♥
Dunkerque's desserts... Mmm... I can't stop eating them. Makes me want to do nothing but eat them together with you all day.
Why don't we visit the music room after work is over? I'll "play you a song" nobody else nobody else gets to hear♥
I do like this, so don't be afraid to go even bolder, Com~man~der♥
You look VERY content. Good. Now stay focused on me♡
You have new missions. The more of them pile up, the more you'll need my help, right?
Mission complete. Wonderful - like the freshness and comfort of a newly baked dessert.
You've kept me waiting for far longer than is reasonable, Commander. You better be ready to make up for how much I missed you. Come, we're going to the music room.
Commission complete. Yesss! ...Well, Commander? Is there any praise coming?
I'd looove some dessert as a treat. Heehee. Make it extra delicious this time, please.

I was always a woman who was anxious and acting tough - until you came along and changed me completely. I'm going to hold on to you tightly, hog all your attention, and make you never choose anyone else over me. This is my crime, and it is your punishment... because I'm now the happiest woman in the world.

lines.line: Commander? I can't believe you found me... As you can see, I'm finishing up this car's pre-race checks. If you have time to spare, would you mind lending me a hand? Oh, and of course, keep this a secret between the two of us. I can count on you for that, yes?

Commander? I can't believe you found me... As you can see, I'm finishing up this car's pre-race checks. If you have time to spare, would you mind lending me a hand? Oh, and of course, keep this a secret between the two of us. I can count on you for that, yes?
Commaaander - what are you looking at? I said, "what are you looking at"? Heehee... Have you fallen under my spell within moments of arrival, hmm?

Race cars are like instruments - they have a clear logic to them, their physical framework is evident, and they warrant studying... Buuut, as soon as you arrived, all my attention went straight to you.
Everything's ready. Should be good to go... You know, we're starting to get REALLY synchronized, you and I. Let's keep this up.
I'm so tired... Stay still, will you? Don't move so much or I might trip and get stuck. Heehee, you've made me like this - will you take responsibility for it? Come closer so our bodies may touch♡
Hey! C-Commander! Leave my headphones alone.
Oh? Need my help?
Are you THAT eager to do it? Alright, but let's continue this INSIDE the car♡
The race is over, Commander. Want a cold drink? Or maybe a bucketful of cold water over your head? Or maybe you want...♡

Cheering on the racers together, getting ready for a race together, playing the piano together... The track is brimming with my memories with you. Now there's only one thing left to do. Why don't you take the wheel of the vehicle known as... me? ♡
Le Fantasque-class destroyer - L'Audacieux.
I am L'Audacieux. I strive to be a bold and courageous Chevalier worthy of this name. Will you bear witness to my growth?
I am L'Audacieux, Chevalier of the Holy Iris. Commander, are you this blade's new master?
You've arrived, Commander. Now, what is our schedule for today, pray tell? Rest assured, your loyal Templar Knight shall be with you throughout any and all matters!

Humility, honesty, mercy, courage, justice, self-sacrifice, spirituality, and honor - these are the eight virtues of the Chevaliers that I uphold. Upon my name as a mighty Templar Knight, I shall protect all our comrades!
I seem to have my act together, you say? Why, yes! Ahem... A level head and a sound heart are foundational for a Chevalier.
It feels as though I've been treated like a child again today... A Chevalier won't be so easily fooled.
One with strength but no wits is no more than a hothead. With wisdom comes true courage. Through deliberate thinking do you seize true victory. These, Commander, are the learnings of the Chevaliers!
I will say... this does feel pleasant...
Commander, do you need any help?
C-Commander? Is this a part of a Chevalier's duties?
You have new missions, Commander. Shall I prepare anything in advance for you?
Mission complete... and I was on guard duty yet again... It's okay! Endurance is one of the Chevaliers' virtues... I think!
You've received a new letter! Here - I fetched a letter opener for you!
Excellent work, Commander. Your commanding was truly a sight to behold! You never cease to amaze!
The commission team has returned, Commander. They returned with these rewards. A flawless victory, I'd say.
Yes, I feel a surge of new strength. It is for you, Commander, that I continue to swing this blade!
Tremble before the might of the Holy Iris!
You fought risking life and limb to the very end... This, I respect!
I will hold off the enemy's pursuit. Everyone else, fall back!
Justice is here!
I can take it!
You've turned your back on the Holy Iris and fallen far, but I will never give up on you!
Nearly everyone at the port has nothing but glowing things to say about you. This could only mean you're an exceptional and strong individual! Perhaps you're even suited to be a Chevalier!

The closer I get to you, the more I realize my own shortcomings. However, the more I find, the more I feel like I'm growing! For you, Commander, are my idol, and so every step closer I get to you is proof of my own growth!
To be worthy of a place by your side, I must become stronger and better! Or else I will end up a Chevalier abandoned by the master she pledged herself to... I will not let that happen!
If I may be abrupt, I've been having these feelings lately... I don't merely want to pledge myself entirely to you, I also want to be with you forever... Huh? Th-this is what they call "love"?

Does this signify that... we've made vows to one another? I would still protect you, with or without having received this ring... What? This ring means that we've officially become wife and... Wait, whaaat?! That's what it signifies?!
A-a gift? For me? W-wow!

ex.line: Commander, y-you've come! Is there anything I can d-do for you? A massage, for instance... I'll give it my all!
You may say I can loosen up around you, but I fear then I'd turn into a lazy blob... Maybe not being a Chevalier for just a moment is fine. Yeah!
B-being short or tall neither has any bearing on your strength, nor does it determine if you can become a Chevalier! ...Am I really that short?
You'd like to swing my sword? Certainly. You hold it like this... then do this... Whoa! Be careful!
Are you feeling lonesome?
S-so I hold you tight just like this? ...Am I doing it right?
Whoa... Simply incredible, Commander! I must follow your example and become a sharper blade!
When I think about the time I confessed to you without even knowing it, my face gets all hot... but as long as I can convey this feeling of love, it doesn't matter how hot it gets...

lines.line: Urgh... As a Chevalier, I simply cannot get used to wearing an outfit like this. But, if I tell myself it's for the Commander's sake... Alright! I shall complete today's sacred duties to the utmost of my abilities!

Urgh... As a Chevalier, I simply cannot get used to wearing an outfit like this. But, if I tell myself it's for the Commander's sake... Alright! I shall complete today's sacred duties to the utmost of my abilities!
Whew... There you are, Commander. You're welcome to stand beneath my parasol and cool off before the race starts!
Speeding cars, rising smoke, fiery hot enthusiasm in the air... I never knew races were such adrenaline-charged things, in every right rivaling jousting matches.
Strasbourg and the girls are much more natural at this than I am, plus they have those proportions... No, what am I saying? I can't lose heart now! Get it together, me!
Is this how one should pose with a car? What about my... Move my parasol a bit further back? Okay, this should do it. Please start snapping pictures, Commander.
I'm actually quite interested in motorsports. It's just that I'm more preoccupied with my holy tasks. Say, once this race is over, do you think you could teach me the fundamentals of driving?
I look sweet in this sun visor? Y-you really think so?
Would you like me to strike my coolest pose for you?
C-Commander?! What's gotten into you?!
There next race is starting soon. Are you going to be spectating, Commander?
You completed the race! Um, you could use something to wipe your sweat... Where did I leave those wet tissues?
Victory is a foregone conclusion with you on our side. That was incredible, Commander!

Whenever I see your satisfied smile, I feel warm inside and get butterflies in my stomach... I'd like to, um, revere your smile some more! Perhaps I could do something to... I know! How about I shade you with my parasol?
Suffren-class heavy cruiser - Dupleix.
I'm Dupleix, a Suffren-class heavy cruiser and a concierge for the Vichya Dominion. Commander, let's get our holy duties done together.
I am Dupleix, concierge for the Vichya Dominion. Doesn't look like time's on our side today, Commander... Now then, here's today's timetable. Shall we get started on our sacred duties?
We're getting today's work done, TODAY. I hope you're ready, Commander.

Not finishing today's sacred duties can ruin your time-efficiency and poses a risk of a snowball effect the next day, so I won't rest until the day's work is done. You know how you feel when your work never ends, and you hate yourself because you really need to take a break from it? That's the worst, isn't it?
Holy duties, holy duties, holy duties holy duties holy... Gah, there's another. How am I supposed to handle all of this... Eep?! Ahem, Commander? How long have you been there?
Not there, either... I can't find the stuff I just bought... C-Commander, help. What do I do?!
If I had Lady Clemenceau's aptitude for planning, I could secure break time for you... Sorry.
Work-life balance, huh... Are you saying you want me to take a break? Thanks, Commander.
Oh, my... Is this how you relieve stress? Very unique...
C-Commander, where do you think you're putting your hands?!
New missions... Don't you think you have too much work to do? Share some of the burden with me.
Mission compleeete! Strike one holy duty off the list... In no small part thanks to you, Commander.
Mail for you. Commander, you should check it soon. Don't forget, you got that?
Welcome back, Commander. I did some of your work for you to match what I did of my own. Let's use this extra time to rest. It's already break time, so...
The commission is complete, Commander. Here's the list of materials they received. Look over it for me.
My hands and feet feel so warm... It's nice.
Disappear without a trace, please, so that you don't add even more to my sacred duties!
We'd better get back while the battle is fresh in our minds. I can write up a good report on this...
Reviewing the loss, accounting for lost materials... H-hahaha... So much for my sleep and our date plans...
Don't underestimate a clerical worker!
I'm really not cut out for this stuff!
I found the cause of all my extra work... It's you. You're at fault, aren't you, Commander?!
You impress me, Commander. Even faced with so many holy duties, you don't look worried at all. I should be a little stronger, too. After all, I'm... I'm like your big sister now!
When I'm with you, I can't help but relax and end up depending on you... Ugh, I can't be like this! I need to be the kind of woman you can depend on!
Commander, wanna make a bet? If I can finish my holy duties ahead of schedule, I get aaall of your break time... You mean it?! Okay! I'm definitely gonna win this!
So our contest starts in earnest tonight... My plans are as perfect as can be... W-wait, why am I getting more holy duties at a time like this?!

Commander, what's gotten into you? Coming to me as soon as you finished your holy duties... You want me to close my eyes? Okay, but why... Huh? I-is this... for me?! I-I feel like I'm about to cry... Oh, finally... Finally, I get one of these...
Heehee, aren't you sweet, Commander.
Suffren, wanna go out next time we're off, or...
I'll back you up, Foch.

ex.line: I organized your files in order of priority before you came here. A-and if you're free after work, we could go somewhere... M-maybe?
(Huh? What is this about a "forced no-overtime day"?! Commander, you bully... Tch... But if that's what it takes for us to get our date... then I'll just have to deal with it!)
You'd be surprised how many fields I work in. Heheh, the eve of battle... The sunken Alma... If you'd like to see my movie, Commander, why don't we make it a date?
Holy duties... Wait, we're all done with them?! Hooray! Now... Huh? It's already dawn! Th-then how about we take a walk and watch the sunrise...?
Achoo! Chilly... Huh? You'll warm me up? Heehee, you really are warm, Commander♡
With you around, I hardly need pillows. Ah, paradise...
Commander... You don't think my proportions are weird, do you?
Welcome back, Commander. You're on a break right now, but get this - so am I. I-in other words, umm... You get what I want to say, right?
This time, it's definitely perfect... I'm alone with the Commander, and my winning gear is ready... Yeah. I'm basically invincible!

lines.line: Good timing, Commander. There are some parameters I need you to check... Come on, this is safety we're talking about. As an inspector, I can't just ignore them. Anyway, come sit next to me so we can get started.

Good timing, Commander. There are some parameters I need you to check... Come on, this is safety we're talking about. As an inspector, I can't just ignore them. Anyway, come sit next to me so we can get started.
When did this checklist get so... C-Commander?! Wait a second, I'm just finishing up!
As a vehicle inspector, it's my duty to inspect as thoroughly as I can before the race. Everything has to meet safety standards, and that includes your equipment, Commander.
Even after the race, we'll have never-ending work... Just thinking about it tires me out.
(After this inspection, I'm gonna find the best spot to watch the race. No shot I'm missing the Commander's race!)
It's hot... Hm? For me? Th-thanks... That was really nice of you, bringing a drink just for me.
Seat belts, check... Fire extinguisher, check. All should be well, Commander.
After the race, things are going back to usual, huh? Say... Commander, what would you say to a date before we're inundated with work again?
Hyah?! Commander, at least wait until I'm done here...
Thanks for all your hard work, Commander. I just reached a pause in my duties... Shall we take a breather?

Work has been busy, but the memory of seeing you on the racetrack gives me the energy to accomplish anything. That doesn't mean I wouldn't like a reward, though... You'll take care of me, won't you, Commander?
Baltimore-class heavy cruiser - Pittsburgh, Hull Number CA-72.
I'm Pittsburgh, a Baltimore-class heavy cruiser with the Union. As for the "McKeesport" thing... Well, I can tell you about it sometime if you really want. In my room, if that works for you.

We fiiinally meet, Commander. I'm Pittsburgh, a heavy cruiser... Oh, no. I forgot to bring a gift for you. Okay... Instead, ask me for anything, and I'll give it to you. And I mean anything, Commander... Heehee~
Commander, mind helping me straighten out my outfit a little before we get to work?
Inspection, huh... You can check anywhere you like, except for my neck. If you don't know where to start... I'd be happy to guide you.
Commander? What's so fun about staring so fixedly at me? If there's something you want to do with me, then just do it.
Wanna guess where your folder is? Hint: it's not in my clothes, but... Heheh♪
McKeesport... How do you know about that, Commander? Tease me, and you'll be in big trouble.
The button on my upper chest? Oh... Of course, I left it unbuttoned on purpose. Heheh...
Hmm? Hinting at something, are we? Heehee.
Well? Is that all you want? Commander...?♡
Mind if I teach you a little trick, Commander? It'll make things more pleasurable for both of us♥
Go do your lame missions, okay? I'll show you something fun later.
I'm not really interested in mission rewards. What I AM interested in is the reward you'll give me, though♪
Commander, mail for you. Ah... No, nothing. I was just wondering if I should write something on my skin for you, instead of on paper...
Commandeeer! Welcome baaack! ...Hm? No, I'm not drunk. Who'd get drunk off of one glass of juice? ...My face is hot? Well, how about you check somewhere else? Like... Here? Am I hot here?
Hm? The commission team is back? Should we cut things short for now, then? Heehee♪
Does my rigging fit me a little better? Come get a closer look.
Don't interrupt my time alone with the Commander!
That was so easy, it was almost boring. Hey Commander, do you wanna do something more fun?
Has to be because of that typhoon...
I'm as strong as Viper!
My neck's starting to ache...
Oh. So this is how you are? Boring.
Heehee! Gee, I wish you'd be even more fun, Commander~ Just kidding♪
This juice is my favorite flavor... Wanna guess what it is? Oh, but I already finished it, huh? What a conundrum... Say, maybe you can still taste it on my lips? Heehee♪
Commander, I think we've gotten past the "seeing if we're into each other" phase. It's time for our reckless, passionate love phase, don't you think? Heheh...
I'm not drunk at all. It's just that strong love and desire get me a little hot... Why are YOU so hot when you haven't even had my juice? C'mon... Tell me why~♪
Aww, is this for me? You understand what this means, don't you? Heehee, this means you'll never get to escape. You'll have to keep satisfying my lust forever and ever♥
You've had your eye on me all this time, huh, Commander? I like that... Heheh, I'm getting tingles again.
As cool as ever, heehee.
Keep yourself in tip-top shape.

ex.line: There you are, Commander. I missed you so bad~ I can hardly contain myself anymore... Heheh♥
Ooh. Yeah, I like that look in your eyes♪ Keep looking at me like that.
Hey, is there anything I can help you with? Let's get that boring work out of the way so we can have fun♪
Heehee! What an adorable reaction... Is that all it takes to distract you?
My chest button... What do you think? Wanna button it for me, or open it up more? The choice is yours.
A loving touch...? Okay, wanna let me pet you on the head, too?
That isn't enough to satisfy me at all. You know that, don't you...?
Mmm♥ Very nice... You're great at this, Commander.
Welcome baaack, Commander! Hey, wanna try out this juice? It's okay~ I didn't put any weird "flavors" in it~ Ooor... Would you like MY flavor in it?
You made me so much stronger with just a little guidance. Heheh, you really know my body in and out, Commander.
I feel like... you make me feel good, not just physically, but emotionally as well. I like the feeling. Keep on filling me with your love, Commander.

lines.line: Welcome to the saloon, Commander. Be it drinking juice, or playing games of chance, I'm happy to join you. And I offer more special services, too...
Welcome to the saloon, Commander. Be it drinking juice, or playing games of chance, I'm happy to join you. And I offer more special services, too...
Would you like some juice, Commander? A smoked malt? Don't worry... There are plenty of ways to quench your thirst.
Sometimes, it can be a little fun to do it in a dirty little saloon, right? Heehee, or even out in the wilderness♥
Isn't this dress just lovely? See, if I grab here and pull... Heehee, it comes right off.
Commander... Oh, should I call you "legendary bounty hunter"? Really? That gets you more in the mood, doesn't it?
How's about a wager? Whoever wins gets to do whatever they want to the loser. For example... Bang♥
Here's the juice you ordered. ...Oh, I spilled a little on me. Still want a taste of it...?
Do you like it more when my hair's a little disheveled?
You like seeing me in this dress, don't you? Heehee♪
Let's gamble on it. If you win, I'll let you take the next step♪
Commandeeer, you're finally back~ Hahaha, I'm tired of roulette. Let's do something more fun... What? Everyone can see us? Let them watch~ Heehee♪
Heehee♪ I win! I'm ready for my reward, Commander.
Wow, the last bullet is still in there. You win, Commander... God, there's something fascinating about you. Just looking at you gets my mind racing... Time for you to take responsibility, Commander♥
Fargo-class light cruiser - Fargo, Hull Number CL-106.

I'm Fargo, the lead ship of my class of light cruisers. The great war was over by the time I was born, so I didn't earn much glory. I don't care about wars anyway, I'm more into business, and I run my own shipping company. Would you consider becoming a partner?

Hello, Commander. I'm Fargo. According to my emotion factor analysis, raising my happiness index by 45.36% would be ideal for our first encounter... Let me start over. Hiii, Commander! I'm Fargo, here to discuss moving cargo with you. Nice to meet you!
Commander, your emotion forecast for today is happy, depressed, stressed... Hmm. You have all these feelings going on inside, but you don't let it show... I'm confused.
My customer profile graphs describe a phenomenon known as impulse buying under abnormal emotional states. I don't quite understand it. Would you explain it to me, Commander?
You want me to guess what you're feeling right now without any analysis? Okay... You're feeling gloomy. What? You're actually feeling happy? Why's that?

Let me know if you ever need anything delivered. I can do it within a day. Oh, and if you can, ask the recipient to tell me how they felt when they got the package so I can record it for future reference. Don't worry, I only want it for data-gathering purposes.
I'm doing market research on finance and travel, among other things... Are you SURE you don't want to partner with us, Commander?
Your fatigue index has reached 63.34%. Put your work on hold for the time being.
Headpats are typically an expression of affection or adoration. I'll interpret it as such.
Did that regulate your emotions?
"Eek. You creep." That's the emotion I'm meant to express, right?
A leader must be able to efficiently complete their missions, Commander.
Mis-sion com-plete! Re-mem-ber to claim your re-wards!
A seaplane just arrived with a letter addressed to you, Commander.

Judging by the fact your happiness index stands at 74.6% right now, I can infer that your sortie was a succe- You're happy to see me, that's why? I see. Then I should increase my own happiness index by 64.3% as well.
The commission team is back. You should raise your happiness index by 2.3% before you go greet them.
The emotion index has been successfully updated. I can now analyze emotions more accurately.
Emotion index recording has been initiated.
We wooon. Hooraaay.
We looost. Boooo.
Supeeer power!
Dis-tress... Sad-ness... Des-pair...
After much data gathering and analysis, I've reached a conclusion - you are not exactly the ideal choice for a business partner.
Lacking emotional intelligence impairs one's judgment in business decisions. For that reason, I could use your help.
I did? I smiled? People typically smile to express positive feelings like happiness or pleasure, which means... I see now. That warm and fuzzy feeling I get when I'm around you is happiness.
My heart's beats per minute far exceed the baseline and my ratio of positive emotions has risen remarkably... Upon comparison, this data points to the emotion that is commonly described as... "love"?
While this isn't an unusual emotion forecast, I'm still surprised I fell into that pattern... You've really enlightened me in many ways, Commander.
Analyzing present emotion state... Although, I don't need any data to sense what's in your heart. We're both feeling the exact same thing right now, aren't we?
Thanks, Commander.
You should raise your calmness index by 1.11%.
Try to keep your titillation in check so it won't affect the battle.

ex.line: Ah, the Commander I ordered has arrived... That was just a joke. Surely you can tell?
Your gaze has been increasingly drawing my attention for a while now... This situation is quite abnormal and warrants thorough analysis.
I'll be personally delivering all your packages for the time being. Make sure you can be physically present to sign them off.
How's this smile? Should I raise the corners of my mouth by another millimeter? ...You prefer it when it's natural?
You've been staring at me for an awfully long time. If you want something, just tell it to me straight. I'll grant your request as thanks for being my emotional consultant.
Feeling fatigued? Then come over to me and have a rest.
Are you doting on me?
What emotion drives you to touch me? I'd love to know.
Mmhh... Listen, Commander... this feels kind of weird... Is this what "embarrassment" feels like?
Letter for you, Commander. I'm here to deliver it.
Welcome back, Commander. This happiness index... and embarrassment index... and stress index... Oh, um, I was just... analyzing my own emotions just now.
The commission team is back. Do go and claim your rewards... with a smile, of course.
I've grown stronger. I feel happy about that.
Since we achieved this victory together, I suppose I should be happy, yes?
