Commander, a thousand and one fresh roses arrived by air mail. Kindly claim them for... Hm? Is this not how lovers express their feelings? What emotion should I be feeling now, then? Should I be embarrassed?

lines.line: Milk the cows? Okay, I'll give it my best shot. Firsthand experience helps me better emulate emotions, after all... Although, isn't it way too hot outside for milking?
Milk the cows? Okay, I'll give it my best shot. Firsthand experience helps me better emulate emotions, after all... Although, isn't it way too hot outside for milking?
Depression index sits at 40.4%... Hm? How long have you been here, Commander? Oh, sorry, the heat is making me dizzy...
I shouldn't be seen in such a humiliating state... Now I understand embarrassment and humiliation a little better... And since I do, please stop looking, Commander...
Ugh... Uggghhh... It's so hot, I'm so dehydrated, and there's so much getting in the way of my emotion recording... I feel like I'm gonna choke...
When I ordered this outfit, it arrived after a mere two hours. Heh, that's the convenience of express delivery! But, I'm still baking in the sunlight despite how airy these clothes are...
Yuck, this milk is so sticky. Makes me want to get nake- Oh, hey, this must be what unpleasantness feels like.
SO HOT! SO FRICKIN' HOOOT! ...Is this "airing my complaints" in the correct manner?
Does this hat look good on me?
Doesn't it feel unpleasant, touching someone who's covered in sweat and milk?
The milk's gonna get all over my- Aahh! Y-your hand is so hot!
There's a letter for... Sorry, some milk got on the letter.
How about a glass of cold, fresh milk to cool down with? I just squeezed it myself.
Experiencing different environments directly helps me study emotions. I hope you'll guide me next time we head out for some field work, too... No, let me rephrase that - will you stay by my side?
Gato-class submarine - Herring, Hull Number SS-233.

I'm the Eagle Union submarine Herring. While I didn't achieve much of note in the great war... Well, that doesn't really matter. Anyway, if any girls start try'na pick on ya, they're gonna regret it. I've got your back - and I'll handle everything from daily chores to tricky work for you!

Oh? You must be the Commander. And guess what - you're just my type! Right, better introduce myself... I'm Herring, the Eagle Union submarine. Hit me up if you wanna talk about anything from combat to everyday stuff or even work.
Mornin', Commander. I'm helping out today, so I'll be riiight here if you need anything!
I'm booored... Maybe I should go fishing up in the Arctic... Hm? What about the cold? Heheh, me and the cold get along juuust fine. Also, when'd you get back here?
Whew... I've been sweating so much lately... I'm gonna need more handkerchiefs, I swear... C-Commander?! When'd you get here?!
Skiing, snowmobiling, winter swimming - I love 'em all! Don't have to worry much about sweating when it's cold. We should do winter stuff together sometime!
There are Dragon Empery girls who're interested in my herring dishes? Heh, good food DOES bring people together.
I heard ya were curious about canned herring, so I'll share one with you. Here! Just kidding, it's my own cooking. Smells good, doesn't it? Give it a taste!
Oh, you wanna pat my head? Uh, keep your distance - hands only...
Well, uh, I'm kinda sweaty, so be sure to wash your hand later, 'kay? Good.
W-wait, I haven't wiped the sweat off from there yet...
Still got missions to do, don'tcha? Relax, if you've REALLY got your hands full, I'll help you out.
Missiooon complete! Here, have a sippy of my special drink and get comfy. There's no herring in it, don't worry.
A letter for you, eh? Heheh, no embarrassing secrets in there, right? Want me to help you deal with it?
Welcome back. Need a pick-me-up? I've got my special herring hot chocolate ready for ya!
The commission team's back? 'Kay... Truth be told, I wish I was out there, getting some exercise, too.
Mmh! Feels like moving's gotten a bit easier. Not bad.
Heheh! Gotta show what I'm really made of since the Commander's here!
Maaan. They made it so easy it looked like I was bullying 'em!
Urgh! *cough cough*... Ch-choked up for a moment...
Too slow!
Hahahah... You've got me on the edge now.
Yeah... Could ya, like, give me some space? I get uncomfortable when people stand too close to me.
Hey, I use this handkerchief for wiping off sweat. I wouldn't touch it if I were you.
Y'know, herring and canned herring both taste pretty good if you prepare them right.
Whew... I took a dish you'd probably like and added herring to it, so... wanna try it? Umm... You just sniffed the FOOD, not me, right...?

You can't keep secrets from the one you love, so I'll just be upfront! The reason I keep my distance is because I'm afraid of grossing you out 'cause I sweat a whole ton. I'd rather you hate me for this than keep my feelings in check anymore- Whoa, whoa! Why're you getting so close all of a sudden?!

Ugh... First you sniffed me from head to toe, now you've gone and done this... You're teasing me, aren't you? Ya act all serious and love being pampered, when really you're a mischief-maker at heart... Even so, this makes me happy and I'll accept it. Thank you...
That's for me, huh? Thanks!
The battle's started, girl. Try to take this seriously.

ex.line: Found your weakness! Take THIS! How do ya like being hugged so tight you can't breathe, huh? Better give in while y- Ahahahaha! That tickles! And stoooop sniffing me!
Why do some people actually LIKE sweat? Weird... You're being awfully quiet there, Commander.
You know, I'm grateful for that signed handkerchief you gave me... but it's got YOUR name on it instead of mine... Wiping my sweat with a handkerchief like that just feels weird.
Heheh. You know how I can handle the cold really well? Maybe one of these days I'll hide in your fridge and spook you!
So, about all that ski gear you gave me the other day - why? I'll sweat like no tomorrow if I wear that. Don't tell me that's what you're after!
Heehee. What to do, what to do... Since you love doing this, I guess I'll let you touch me.
Hmm♪ I've wiped this spot dry. Feels nice and smooth, doesn't it? ...What do you mean you liked it better when it was sweaty?
Ahh... Heh, whaddya think? Do ya prefer feeling me directly or through my clothes?
Welcome back! Get this herring sandwich in your mouth and taste the nutrients! Hey, why are you running away?!

Heehee. I've started clinging to you so badly ever since you told me I can get as close as I want. Makes me happy when you touch me and pat my head, too... but I've also started sweating more 'cause you're touching me, and that's... not great...

lines.line: Well, well. I was wondering who owns this polite little horsy - surprise, it's you! How about you trade me 'em for a blown kiss? And if you catch up with me, you can have the rest of me for free♪ Mwah♡

Well, well. I was wondering who owns this polite little horsy - surprise, it's you! How about you trade me 'em for a blown kiss? And if you catch up with me, you can have the rest of me for free♪ Mwah♡
Welcome, Commander. Where d'ya wanna go today? How 'bout you hop on and we ride to the end of the world together?
Calling your horse back just by whistling? That's cheating! But I'm a woman of my word, so now we're gonna travel together.
I'll bet your back hurts after riding your horse for so long. Want me to give ya a massage? C'mon, don't be shy!
Oh, you've got dust on your face. Lemme wipe it off with my handkerch- W-wait a sec, why'd you ask me where I got it from, what the heck?!
*cough cough*... Y'know, that smoke grenade I just threw to get away... it was actually a modified herring can. Anyway, herring saved the day and let you get out unscathed!
Make 'er go faster, you say? Alrighty, then hold on tight!
C-Commander... Touching me's fine and all, but ya gotta holster that gun first before it goes off.
I made some western dishes perfectly tailored for ya! Starting with this herring crepe!
We're boned. Let's get outta here!

Come to think of it, I really don't sweat much in this outfit. Means we can both ride the horse without any problems! What? You LIKE the way I smell? You're the only person who thinks that. Not gonna lie, I DO like hearing it from you, though.
Fletcher-class destroyer - Bell, Hull Number DD-587.
I'm Bell, a Fletcher-class destroyer, and I'm a great bodyguard! When it comes to your safety, you can trust me, Commander.
Commander, it's an honor to finally make your acquaintance! I'm Bell, a Fletcher-class shipgirl, and I'll be your personal ninja... I mean, your bodyguard, from now on!
I'm right here, Commander. I already sorted out all of your work for today!
I'm not particularly good at anything specific, but I'm confident I can protect people! Let me handle guarding the fleet, okay?
"The shinobi bursts from her cocoon like a graceful butterfly!" Yeah, that's where the shadowy protector shines best!
Commander, how'd you like that movie we watched together? I thought the ninja in it was awesome! A silent watcher in the shadows, ever protecting their master... That's an ideal guard for you!
Ahem. As your bodyguard, it's my responsibility to direct you to rest. So hurry and take a break! Leave that work to me, 'kay?
Phew... Commander, umm, this is kinda embarrassing...
Don't worry, it's okay. I'm right here by your side.
C-Commander, I dunno if this is a good idea...
We have a new mission... Should I go for this one?
Mission complete! What rewards will we get? I can't wait to find out!
Mail's here, Commander. Can I leave it right there?
Good work today, Commander~ Grab a soda and relax a little!
Mission complete. Commander, wanna go check it out?
I have to use this power to protect everyone...
I'll protect everyone!
Big sorry! Victory belongs to us, not you.
I'll secure an escape route!
Not gonna happen!
Urk... I gotta stand strong...!
Looks like there's no need for me to protect you...
A bodyguard doesn't just protect her charge - she also has to care for their everyday needs. If you have any requests, let me know, okay?
You get nervous when I'm not around...? Aww, you got used to me being here so fast! Hehe!
Suddenly, I feel like protecting you and being protected by you isn't enough for me... Huh? N-never mind, I didn't say anything. You didn't hear anything, right? Right?

Ugh... Honestly, I was so confident in my ability to protect you that I thought that just being by your side would make me happy. B-but now you're letting me in even closer... It's so confusing! I don't know what to do anymore!

Commander, you're choosing me? Really? ...I-I'd be happy to, of course! I love you, Commander, and I want to be with you forever! ...Heheh. From now on, I can be your shadow - your NINJA! Because you're the person I want to protect most of all!
You really know what I like, Commander!
I'll keep you all safe!
Whoooa! A-a real ninja? For real?!

ex.line: I'm right here, Commander. I organized your work for the day, so don't slack off, okay?
You've always been protecting everyone in your own way... Kinda like the legendary ninjas I've seen in movies! Oh... Maybe ninja isn't all that apt a comparison for you...
A ninja protects her lord - that's what I like most about them. Staying ever by your side like a shadow is just like how I am now, don't you think? Hehe!
I see... You take my presence for granted now. Heehee, I can hardly bear to leave your side, too!
Commander, you can't sleep here! Even if you're tired, no means no! ...Come on, at least go sleep in your room!
I'm holding hands with the Commander... Hehe...
Commander, d-does it... have to be here?
As a reward for going out to battle, would you like the red soda, or the blue one? Don't tell me to mix them both in one bottle.
What rewards should we prepare for the people coming back from their commission trip?
With the Commander's help, victory is an easy feat!

There are so many girls who are more impressive than me. I mean, all I can do is bodyguard work... But you still accepted my feelings and chose me. That made me the happiest girl in the world! So happy that I can't even think of the words to express it!

lines.line: Welcome to our saloon... Oh, no! I can't hold all these mugs! ...C-Commander? Why are you here?
Welcome to our saloon... Oh, no! I can't hold all these mugs! ...C-Commander? Why are you here?
Commander, what are you ordering today? You'd like my recommendation? Hehe, okay!
There are rumors of a really attractive ranger coming by the tavern. Can you guess who it is? It's you, of course! Next drink's my treat.
If you hadn't helped me, I would've been in real trouble... Oh! Some got on your clothes! You'd better get changed before they're all sticky, okay? I-I'll show you to a private room!
Commander, let's take a walk to the river later. We could pan for gold!
Lately, things around the saloon have gotten kinda restless... What if you stayed here to keep things orderly? We have a room and suitable pay!
Urk... Thanks for trying to make me feel better. Next time, I definitely won't trip over!
Commander, do you want seconds?
Commander, I'm at work...
Phew... I can't let the Commander handle every problem that comes up. It's time for me to act!
Problem resolved! Commander, wanna see the rewards we got?

It's been so much fun spending time with you! U-umm, if you don't mind... Could you stay a while? This tavern needs an owner, or whatever... If it's okay with you, I want you to be here with me... forever and ever!
Aircraft carrier - Amagi.

Who could have imagined that such a frail, sickly girl would be able to attain a new form, and once again sail upon the clear, blue seas? I would like to express my sincerest gratitude to you, Commander, as well as all my friends who never gave up hope. Yes, I, Amagi, have returned to you.

I, aircraft carrier Amagi, am here to pay my respects. Time marches on, and the world has changed profoundly in my absence... Commander, what manner of enemy do we now face? Heehee. There's no need to worry yourself about my health this time. I'm fine now.
Commander, it is good to see you. I have already devised a plan for today's operations. Please have a look, if you would.
Commander, even now, do you still seek a plan where "nobody has to get hurt"? Heehee... I understand perfectly.
Commander, isn't it interesting how these "carrier-based aircraft" have completely altered the landscape of war?
Commander, if it's not too much trouble, I'd like to ask your opinion on something... Do you think that I'm not spending enough time with Akagi? How do you think I should rectify this?
...Oh, the medicine cabinet is empty. Time to restock... Hm? Commander? Oh, it's not that. I only take tonics now.

Kaga came to visit me the other day. From battlecruisers to aircraft carriers, the two of us are both riding the waves of the changing times into the future. Heehee. Naturally, I'll have to work hard so that I don't get left behind.
Commander, your hands... have grown so much stronger than before.
Commander, if you are tired, come and rest awhile. Would you like to use my tail as your pillow?
Commander, I think you should hold off on that for a little while...
Heehee. I've already put together a plan for the next mission. Would you like to look it over, Commander?
Let these rewards pave the way towards your next great achievement. Yes... I'll have to come up with some plan to procure us even greater rewards...
Commander, new mail has arrived. I'm sending it over via carrier-based aircraft, so please take a look when you have time.
Commander, let us celebrate your triumphant return. Heehee. Perhaps the tacit understanding we share is the key to your continued victories.
Commander, a commission has been completed. Shall we head down to meet our friends at the warehouse?
This power... I will make sure to put it to good use.
Everyone, carry out your part of the plan, and bring victory to the Commander!
May this victory be the foundation for our next. Impeccable leadership as always, Commander.
A disadvantageous situation. Commander, I recommend that we ease up on the offensive and regroup before continuing to fight.
Now then, let us take flight.
Ahaha... Time to switch to a more effective strategy.
Times change... and so do people.

Commander, I used to worry about how I should face my friends, and how to situate myself in this new environment... But after seeing you again, I quickly realized that those doubts and worries had no basis for being in the first place.

Commander, the next time you head out to battle, please allow me to accompany you. I no longer wish to stay huddled in the rear, waiting for your return. I want to stand with you, along with all our other friends.

In my eyes, you are the panacea that cures any and all of my ailments. But as the saying goes, the strongest medicine can also be the deadliest poison... Heehee. Even were that the case, I would still gladly drink every last drop.

"Since time immemorial, unto a future eternal, the sun and moon hang in the firmament. As long as that firmament still stands, so too will my love." Heehee... Commander, do you understand what I'm trying to say?

I am no longer the weak and naive Amagi that I was before... just as you are no longer the same naive Commander you were before. And so, I vow to never leave your side again. The world remains in turmoil, Commander, so let us join hands and continue our good work.
What an adorable little present... Thank you very much, Commander.
Thank you for always looking after me, Kaga.
Let us dedicate this victory to the Commander.
Since the Great Veteran is still fighting, perhaps I'll have to step up as well.
Lady Nagato, you, too, have changed greatly.
I'm glad to see that Akagi's juniors seem just as capable.

ex.line: Commander, please avail yourself of this newly-arrived, freshly-brewed tea. How about a cup before you start work?
"No matter how much things change, the Commander always remains the same." —Indeed, I could hardly ask for better news upon my return.

Commander, the fact that you have a massive amount of work is even more reason for you to learn to strike a good work-life balance. Right now, you should be relaxing - and I don't intend to budge on this point.
My, you've bested me in this match... Haha, of course I was not going easy on you, Commander. You've simply grown to the point where you are now able to outwit me.
Dango, yokan, or castella cake... What should I have today? Deciding is such a hassle. Commander, could you help weigh in on this matter?
Commander, would you like to go on patrol around the port with me later? I'm very eager to see what has changed here since last time.
You really do act like a rambunctious child at times, Commander... Heehee~
Heehee... Have you gotten bolder knowing that my constitution has improved?

"O brilliant moon in the sky, though your light fills my eyes, you remain distant and untouchable." ...Though in this case, the moon known as Amagi is already at your side... Isn't that right, Commander?

lines.line: So you've finally come, Commander. I have been waiting for you— Ahem. Heehee, please step forward. In this castle of dreams, this throne... belongs to you and me equally.
So you've finally come, Commander. I have been waiting for you— Ahem. Heehee, please step forward. In this castle of dreams, this throne... belongs to you and me equally.
Commander, welcome to Castle Amagi. Please set aside your worries and revel to your heart's content.
Commander, many unknowns yet lurk in the depths of this castle. Should you be willing, I would like to accompany you on your next exploration.
Hmm? You've noticed that it's been clear and sunny every day here since you arrived? Heehee... How observant of you. I would expect nothing less.
"A chance encounter between a world-weary castellan and a lost visitor"... Hmm, don't you think that makes for a wonderful fairy tale theme?

Since you're already in a dreamland paradise, why not take advantage of the opportunity fully and indulge yourself? Heeehee... Commander, shall we try all the sweets here together? Starting with the yokan~

I am in charge of all the keys to the doors here that cannot be opened. I would be glad to give these keys to you, as long as you fulfill my wishes. So, Commander... One wish per key. Does that sound like a good deal?
Hmm? Commander... Am I not keeping you entertained?
Hmm... Commander, I do believe I've already caught a glimpse of your true intentions. Heehee.
Ahhn... Commander... I, don't have to rein in my urges any longer, right...?
A new mission, huh? Worry not, for I am with you.
Commander, there's nothing to worry about. All your missions have already been completed. All you need to do now is rest and relax.
Commander, your mail has arrived. Umm... If you don't mind, maybe we could share the throne and read them together?
You have returned victorious, just as I predicted. I have already called for a celebration, so please follow me to the venue, if you would.
The commission team might've brought back something surprising. Commander, shall we go take a look together?

Commander, in this fleeting, illusory castle, there are no other people besides the two of us. So, please set aside your burdens, let your troubles melt away, and enjoy this moment of peace and joy with me...

These deep, dark waters are a world of my own creation - a stage you won't find anywhere else. Commander, I ask that you put aside your worries from the surface for a while and enjoy yourself to your heart's content here.

These deep, dark waters are a world of my own creation - a stage you won't find anywhere else. Commander, I ask that you put aside your worries from the surface for a while and enjoy yourself to your heart's content here.
Commander, I want you to keep gazing at me with those eyes and touching me with those hands. I will... return the favor.
Will you continue watching me dance, Commander? Or would you like to join me and feel the pounding of my heart for yourself?
The ripples I make with my fingers represent the feelings I hope will reach you, Commander. Don't they look beautiful as they shimmer in the water?
The waters are so quiet. I can hear the racing of my own heart as I sense your presence, Commander. Can you feel my heartbeat too?
Hehehe, would you like to know how mermaids swish their tails? Come a little closer, Commander, and I'll show you.
We finally have time to take in the underwater scenery. Would you like to take a tour of the area with me, Commander?
Aah... Even underwater, I can feel the warmth of your palm, Commander.
Commander... Were you hoping to exchange oxygen with me?
Did you see that? The surface of the water was glowing so gently, as if it were welcoming you back... Hehe, all that time I spent waiting was nothing more than sweet torment.
These bubbles are meant to fizzle out in an instant, but they're still wrapping around us. They stretch and expand, but they stick close to us. Yes, they remind me of our bond, Commander.
"In joy and in sorrow, in sickness and in health..." Commander? Heehee, this isn't foreshadowing. You don't need to worry about your beloved Amagi anymore.
"In joy and in sorrow, in sickness and in health..." Commander? Heehee, this isn't foreshadowing. You don't need to worry about your beloved Amagi anymore.
Welcome back, Commander. Allow me to present today's special brew... That's right. It's the same tea we picked out just recently.
You may not change, Commander, but I need to. To be someone who's worthy of standing by your side, to be able to protect everyone for as long as I can... I must improve on myself, little by little.
Perfect timing, Commander. Take a break and let me handle your affairs. Behind every great Commander is a great wife, no?
For my next move... *sigh*... I'm no match for you, Commander. You've taught me a lot today, heehee.
*grumble*... Oh, no. Thinking of today's dinner has made me hungry already. I'm sorry you had to hear that...
Your daily work, combat, caring for everyone at port... With all due respect, Commander, don't you think you should worry about your own health rather than mine?
Well, well...
Please guide me, Commander.
You're such a flirt...
Triumph is all but expected by now, so there's no need to celebrate? Is that so? Heehee, then I'll just celebrate your safe return. I do consider that more worthy of joy, regardless.
Brilliant leadership, as always. We must use this victory to pave the way to greater endeavors.

The flowers of spring, rains of summer, leaves of autumn, and snows of winter... There would be no greater honor than to walk by your side and experience all of these things with you. May we never be separated again, Commander.
Type C44 light cruiser - Watarase.

I'm Watarase, a modified Agano-class light cruiser with the Sakura Empire. My first life ended without fulfilling any expected purpose... but I will use the new power I've been given to protect you and yours, Commander.
I am light cruiser Watarase of the Sakura Empire. It is a pleasure to meet you, Commander. With this blade, I shall protect the honor of the fleet.
Commander, how about a cup of tea or coffee before work? I always have a cup before training... It helps me focus and regulate my mood.
Hmm? My sleeve? Heehee, I made some corrections to it for aesthetics' sake. Don't worry - it won't get in the way in battle.
Did you lose a button? I'll sew it back on, so just stay still for me. Oh... We're a little close, huh? M-maybe you should take your shirt off instead...?
Hm? I'm sharpening my blade right now, so please be careful. It'll hurt if you bump into it.
If you're having trouble focusing, then how about a break? Efficient work only comes from ample rest.
Are you curious about this? This is a bill for a commissioned kimono from Akashi. As for the price... Er, let's keep that a secret.
This hair accessory might look unusual, but I actually made it myself.
Hm? Curious about the fabric? If you like it, I'd be happy to make you an outfit with it.
Oh?! Commander, do you dislike my modifications here...?
Take your missions seriously, please. Oh, but don't forget to take regular breaks. I'll be sure to remind you.
Good work, Commander. How about a quick massage... Acupuncture? I do use needles often, but not for that... I use them to sew.
The pattern on this envelope's wax seal might work on a skirt... Oh, I'm sorry. Just spaced out a little. Here's your mail, Commander.
You've done great work, Commander. If you're tired, why not sit down and rest for a while? Whether you're commanding a battle or practicing martial arts, rest is vital.
Commander, the girls on commission have returned to port. Let's go meet them. Supplies are vital on the front lines of war.
This training session came with remarkable results. Phew... How about we all head to the training grounds and spar a little?
Allow me to set the stage for you.
I'm happy that my blade could bring you victory, Commander.
We must retreat! Hurry, before anyone else gets hurt!
With flowing shadow, pierce the waves!
Ngh... I can't fall... Not here!
Your taste in attire is a little worrying...
My blade has no past - it descended unto the material world alongside me. However, its reason for existence is clear. It is here to aid me in protecting the people I love.

I come to this courtyard often. Watching the flowers and birds, listening to the shishi-odoshi... Through this, I calm myself and nourish my spirit to hone my swordplay for the coming battle. Aren't you bored just sitting here, though? If there's anything you want to do, I'm all ears.

You're still stuck on work? Being faithful to duty is a good thing, but relaxing and letting yourself recover is important. Here's a sachet I made. It'll calm your nerves and help you sleep... Go ahead and put it on, please.
I made this charm for you, Commander. It'll protect you and ward off evil. Heheh, it's not enough on its own... but don't worry. I will train harder and endeavor to protect you with my blade as well.

Commander, do you know the legend of Princess Shirataki? The promise made between the weaving princess and her lover, the korinseki stone that witnessed it... What you just put on is our own korinseki. May this ring oversee our love to the end.
Thank you very much, Commander. I really like these.
Let's compete together at a more suitable time!
I'd love to see your latest clothing design.

ex.line: Commander, I'm leaving some coffee, tea, and a hanky for you. ...Hm? The pattern looks familiar? Heehee, that's because I embroidered a cute little version of you!
Oh? You'll measure me? B-but... you want to order clothes for me? In that case, okay...
Hmm? Did you say something, Commander? Sorry, I'm learning a new type of embroidery to incorporate it into my next design... I think it'll turn out well.
Oh? If you want to hug me, let me put my blade down first. Okay, I'm all yours~ There... Is that as rousing as you'd hoped?
Ah, sorry. I wasn't spacing out - I just wanted to stare at you. Heehee, I finished my training, so I'm taking a break.
Heheh, did you already notice? The pattern I embroidered on the inside of your clothes symbolizes love. Cute, isn't it? Heehee.
The way you pet me is almost calming.
You'd like me to teach you some martial arts soon...? I won't hold back just because you're my partner... Haha, I'm kidding!
There's still much training left to come, Commander... Now isn't a good... Mmnh!
Commander, it's almost time for missions... Hm? Did you let them pile up that fast? Heehee, okay. I'm happy to help.
Commander, a fabric order came along with the mail... Hm? You ordered it for me? Thank you!
Come sit down and take a break. ...Heehee, lie down in my lap, if you'd like. Is the room too bright? Here... I'll shield your eyes.

Am I slacking off on my training lately? Not at all, Commander. I simply believe that rest is just as important as work! Heehee, besides, I'm confident that I can protect you already. Love always wins, after all.

lines.line: Commander! Oh... Umm, perhaps it would be more fitting to address you as "Milord" for this occasion? Since, you know, the two of us have the evening together... Now, if you don't mind, your hand please — Heehee, make sure to sit tight!

Commander! Oh... Umm, perhaps it would be more fitting to address you as "Milord" for this occasion? Since, you know, the two of us have the evening together... Now, if you don't mind, your hand please — Heehee, make sure to sit tight!
Commander, it's time for the fireworks to start. Let's leave our work and daily training until after they're done, okay?
I designed not just this outfit, but the carriage as well. Heehee, isn't it as dreamy as a fairy tale?
Is the carriage uncomfortable? This is my first time designing anything other than clothes, so there were a lot of unknowns...
What if I just spirited you away in my carriage to watch the fireworks together? A little too selfish, perhaps?
Want to guess what spell the fairy cast on me? Okay, I'll tell you. It lets me find you no matter where you are... Heehee, just kidding.
Am I blushing? I-it's probably because of this... I do feel a little tipsy. Mind if I lean on your shoulder...?
I made this crown to match my outfit, too~
Would you like to dance under the night sky? Just take my hand, Commander♪
Umm... P-people will see us here...
You're still working? But it's time for your break... Fine, I'll just have to help you. Once we're done, we're going to have fun together, got it?
Now that we're done with all that work, it's time to focus on enjoying the fireworks show♪
There's a letter for you, Commander. If it's an invitation to a dance party, then may I join you as your partner?
Dancing is no easier than combat training. You must be tired, too, Commander. Please, come rest in my pumpkin carriage with me.
Commander, the commission team brought back spare fireworks.
I'll need to improve the mobility of this outfit...

Commander, listen - the clock just struck midnight! But my magic won't disappear like in the fairy tales, and you won't have to search for me, my prince. I'll find you, return to your side, take your hand, and weave the perfect tale just for us!
Sendai-class light cruiser - Ayase.
I-I'm Ayase, a Sakura Empire light cruiser... I was originally planned to be Sendai-class, but I was canceled... So I'm very happy to be in your fleet now, Commander! I'll... I'll do my very best!

P-pleased to meet you, Commander... My name is Ayase, of the Sakura Empire... Umm, y-yes, once again, it's an honor to be here! I l-look forward to working with you! Ah! Umm, yes, I brought my pet bunny here... Good girl, good girl, go say hello to the Commander...
Be good, don't run around so much... C-Commander?! Welcome back... Uh, umm, would you like to drink some carrot... I mean, eat some tea... o-oh, what am I saying...
Ah, I can't see down to my legs... Urk... Hwuh?! C-Commander? Were you watching...? I'm sorry. I shouldn't have been training here... It's embarrassing to know that people can see me.
I do want to talk with everyone more, b-but... I always mess it up. Can you help me practice, Commander?
C-Commander... Umm... My bunnies want to stay here with us. Is that okay...? Th-thank you! They're grateful, too!
Commander... Would you like to go hiking with me? Chatting with the critters in the mountains is r-really fun...
Thanks to you... I feel a lot more confident now, Commander! Th-thank you so much!
You want to hug my bunny, too...? O-okay! She says she wants to give you a big hug, too!
Hyah?! Wh-what? D-do you find this part of me strange, too...?
Commander, h-have you finished your work? Oh, it's not like I doubt you... I'm just wondering if you're tired.
Yes, I've received all of your mission rewards for you. Please, take a look...
The mail for you is right here. Do you like traditional letters, too...?
C-Commander... You're not hurt? I made yomogi mochi! And... I even grew the mugwort myself! Umm, my little bunnies thought it was good, too!
The commission team brought back so many supplies... I-is it because of my prayers, you think? Th-thank you! I'll keep doing my best to help out!
Yes... I-I'll keep trying harder and harder!
Safe and healthy return, hale and hearty... S-setting sail now!
Commander, the fleet has seized victory, and everyone made it home safe! Thank goodness...
Aah... Commander, we need to retreat right away...
Urgh... I'll do my best!
Oww... That hurts...
C-Commander, you're scary... Eep...
Commander, do you want to see me d-dance? I-I'll do my best! But... not now!
I pray for your safety and happiness... This prayer isn't just for the sake of duty. It's... what I really want...
I have to confess... I once prayed that you'd give me attention over the others... It looks like that came true, huh? I'm really happy... Ooh...
Phew... If this is your desire, Commander, then I... I offer a dance of blessing to you! May it bring you safety and happiness... Here goes!
C-calm down, Ayase...! C-Commander... I'm really, REALLY happy! Just once, give me this one opportunity to pray for us... *inhale*... *exhale*... "May our love continue as long as we breathe!"
Thank you very much, Commander! I really like it! Oh, and the bunnies seem to as well!
Daisen, your hair... Are you a bunny?
What is a "Planet Bunnyian," exactly...?
They make your shoulders stiff, too, right? Same!

ex.line: You're finally home, Commander. My bunnies were so impatient to see you... Oh, and so was I.
You want to watch me practice dancing? That's fine... b-but I'll get nervous with your eyes on me...
M-my lap? ...N-no! I'm not against it, but... I won't be able to see your face if you do that...
Commander, the mountain critters want to see you so badly. Next time you're free, can we go visit them?
Commander... Umm, how do I post a "Juust"? I wanted to make records of our time together...
U-umm... May I hold you, too, Commander?
C-Commander... The bunnies are watching. Aah...
Hm? Did you bring the Commander's mail for us? Aww, who's a good girl?

Congratulations on a successful mission, Commander! Have these snacks I made and replenish your stamina... Do they taste good? Umm... I still haven't given them to my bunnies yet. I wanted you to be the first...
I'll protect everyone. Not just with prayer, but with my strength as well!
Commander, I've been learning a new dance... O-oh, no! It's not a prayer dance. It's meant to convey my love. I-if you don't mind, I'll perform it now. Please... watch me closely, Commander!

lines.line: C-Commander?! ...H-huh? It's already p-past the scheduled time? Awawa... B-but, I still haven't finished changing yet... I, umm... P-please give me just a minute!
C-Commander?! ...H-huh? It's already p-past the scheduled time? Awawa... B-but, I still haven't finished changing yet... I, umm... P-please give me just a minute!
Huh? Is my bunny back...? Wait, C-Commander?! Awawa... Awawawa...
May this party go smoothly, may everyone have a fun time, and may the Commander and I... Oh. There I go praying again... Huh? Y-you heard all of that?
Commander, c-can we practice a little more for tonight's party? I promise I won't step on your feet...
Commander, umm... I don't really understand... how to tie this belt. Does this work...?
I've never been to such a formal dance party. I-it's making me nervous... So, umm, thanks a lot for being so patient and staying by my side...
A-are you telling me I shouldn't be so worried?
C-Commander, did I dress wrong somehow?
Hyah?! Commander... M-my clothes are going to fall off...
More work... C-Commander, let me help! After all... It's my fault for wasting your time... Ooh...
Commander, our work is done! Let's hurry to the party! I'm really excited for it!
There's mail for you, Commander. I'll go get - ack... I can't get my shoes on...
Commander... W-wait just a moment, please. I'll be dressed right away... Sorry. You offered to go to the dance party with me, and here I am wasting your time...
The commission team brought supplies for the party! C-Commander, can you do inventory on it for me? Umm, I still haven't gotten my socks on yet...

Wh-when I remember that you're here, I start shaking from nervousness... Not that I don't want you here! I-it's just... knowing you can see me... It makes me so nervous that I feel like my heart will jump out of my chest...
Yuugumo-class destroyer - Suzunami

I'm Suzunami, 10th destroyer of the Yuugumo class. I gave it my best in the great war, but didn't achieve much of note. Now I'll try my hardest to work with you to repel our enemies... and make friends with others in the fleet.
Greetings, Commander. I'm Suzunami of the Sakura Empire, 10th ship of the Yuugumo class of destroyers. I hope we can be, um... friends...
I left a summary of today's tasks here. Yes, it's that many. Better get started. I'll help you out.
You're always staring at me - am I hard to approach? Huh? You're just waiting for the right time to come closer? I mean, I don't have a problem with you... I just need some time to get used to you.
This is a snow bear I made. You can have it if you want. I'll leave it here. It'll stand guard for you on when I'm not here.
Mmh... Do you want a taste of this strawberry-flavored shaved ice? ...You like it? Heehee. Huh? No, I wasn't smiling. You're just seeing things... *blushes*
Cats run away when they see me, but they're never afraid to walk up to you... I'm not jealous. Not jealous at all...
Mmh... Your hand feels so warm... I'm not used to that...
Do you know a good way to make friends with animals? Can you teach me?
Huh?! I-I'm not accustomed to... physical touch like this...
Commander, you really can't put off your tasks any longer.
Great work. I had a look at the mission rewards. Get some rest now.
Commander, I've brought all your mail. Can I write you a letter too?
Welcome back. I made you some tea. Oh, it's freezing cold? Yeah, I added a whole heap of ice... Was that a weird choice?
Commander, the commission team is back. You want me to come along and welcome them? Sure.
Wow, thanks for making me stronger. I'll try to work harder from now... and try to be more cordial.
What an honor to fight with you all. Rest assured, I will accomplish the mission.
We won, Commander. I think I work pretty well in a team, don't I?
Rigging is burning... Requesting permission to retreat!
Freeze!
The fire is spreading!
Sorry. You actually should keep your distance.
Will you come with me to the zoo on our next day off? With you around, the animals shouldn't all run away from me. You're warm, and they like that...
Hm? I smiled? I was simply thinking about you. D-don't give me that look... I'm not used to it...
For a while now, my heart has started racing whenever I'm around you... I'm not even nervous, and yet...

I think I understand why everyone likes you so much. I've been wanting to stay by your side for a while now... D-does that bother you? If not, I'm gonna sit next to you to take in your warmth... Heehee...
Commander... I've never felt the way I do now. I'm so, so happy... Am I allowed to be this happy all day, every day?
Thank you, Commander. Ehehe... Huh? I, I smiled?
This is the might of a cutting-edge destroyer.
Wanna play in the snow?

ex.line: I'm gonna be right here beside you and we'll get this work done together. I feel more motivated when I'm next to you.
Should you really stay with me all the time? If you're here too long, people will think we're unapproachable... No? Then it's fine. Heehee.
Ice cream hot pot? That sounds weird... Buuut, if you wanna try it, then I'll try it, too.
You're not gonna believe this - cats stopped avoiding me now. Heehee. I'm so happy. Must be because I've been around you for so long.
Your hand is really warm... I don't mind it.
So you don't really know a good way to befriend animals either? Okay, in that case... we can look for one together.
You, umm... Do you... like touching that?
Welcome back. I made some tea for you. Don't worry, it's at a drinkable temperature for you. I'm not getting it wrong again.
I can't go back to my old ways... I can't be away from your warmth, and I can't suppress this urge of always wanting to be with you. I'm very selfish, aren't I?

lines.line: Sorry for calling you here this early, Commander... I was just hoping you could check if I'm wearing my dress right. I'm not a dress person, so...
Sorry for calling you here this early, Commander... I was just hoping you could check if I'm wearing my dress right. I'm not a dress person, so...
You have work you just have to finish before the banquet? Okay. I'll help you with that after I'm done straightening out my dress.
You stare way too much, Commander... You have to so you can see if everything's in order? Oh, okay...
This garter belt feels kind of tight... I don't want it to restrict my movement when we dance. Maybe I'll loosen it a little...
I've heard there's going to be some really lavish shaved ice at the banquet. I can't wait. Do you wanna eat it with me?
Do you think cats will be friendlier with me with this dress? Let's find some cats later and try it.
Hm? Did my ribbon come undone?
Eep! M-measure my waist? Fine, I guess... You just scared me when you came close out of nowhere... Here is the measuring tape.
Y-you think I should adjust this part more? Well, I can do that myself...
You still have work to do? I'll help. It's best that we finish it before the banquet.
That's all the work finished. Let's head out once I've straightened out my dress.
I can't see the back in the mirror... Hm? Welcome back, Commander. Could you, um, check my dress from behind? I can't see it on my own.
This is a mess... I don't think I'll make it to the party...
When I think about how I get to wear this dress, dance with you, and feel your warmth, it makes me so happy and excited... It's going to be a warming, wonderful night.
Sailing frigate - C Ganj-i-Sawai.
Well met. I am Ganj-i-Sawai - I'll be docking here for the foreseeable future. In the name of the wind, blessings be upon you and your port. May our days together be filled with bliss and wonder!

Greetings, Commander. I'm Ganj-i-Sawai. It's a pleasure! Is this place your port? My, it's so much bigger and grander than I expected! Do you mind if I walk around? And if you could join me, that'd be even lovelier. Heehee.
I made you some coffee, Commander. I also threw in some spices. How does it taste? Personally, I can't get enough of this stuff!

I was just drafting a renovation plan for your office. It's the most important place in the port, and I believe it should feel more special. For instance, by adding a dome to the ceiling and inlaying it with gemstones.
La-laa-la-laa♪ Do you like it, Commander? I've been studying some, um, "modern" music, I suppose?

*sniff sniff*... This scent... It could use some spices to really take it to the next level. Some black pepper, some cardamom, ginger, prickly ash, turmeric, cinnamon, cayenne pepper... That should be plenty!
I read about all sorts of interesting ancient ruins in the port's travel brochure! Let's go visit them sometime. Pleeease? Come with me!
Top ten classic wine bottles? There's no way this magazine is right. I have heaps upon heaps of bottles like that in my storage.
Oh? Is this your way of conferring blessings? Thank you kindly!
Ah, do you wish to see my dance? Certainly!
Hmm. Commander, this is rather poor manners.
Shall we begin on the day's work, Commander? Delaying won't do you any good.
Mission rewards? Where? Oh, you mean these? I thought they were random things just left there... You must forgive me. Please don't be mad!
I've brought all your letters, Commander. Read them at your leisure. I'll be waiting right here.
Welcome back, Commander. I see your mission went well. May I come with you sometime? I'd love to see the sights along the way. After the mission is complete, of course.
Are those girls your entourage? My, they're so cute!
My command over the wind grows stronger!
O storm, grant me strength!
Heehee. Underestimate not the might of a storm.
O rain, heal our wounds and ease our pain.
O storm, sweep away all disasters!
My remedy won't reach me in time!
I'm off to look at that unique building over there! By myself, I mean. You just focus on your own business.
I yearn to build a grand, beautiful palace in this port! Won't you look at my blueprints? ...Looks good? Thank you. Then while we're at it, could I receive your approval?
You're free to take whatever you like out of my storage, be it treasure, art, or whatever else. You needn't even ask for my permission. Frankly, I don't remember what is in there!
So, are you feeling better? By putting our foreheads together, I can direct my healing energy to you! Oh, why are you blushing all of a sudden? Don't be shy, now!
I shall be your closest companion, and you shall be mine and mine alone... There, I cast a spell of love on you. Now we will always be together, no matter what may happen!

I've already started picturing our future together! We'll hoist sails and embark on far-flung voyages, we'll sleep in a curious and magnificent building we built ourselves, and we'll sing and we'll dance... Regardless of what the future has in store, I'm excited to be experiencing it with you!
Thanks! I love this gift! What about you, Commander? If there's anything you want, it's all yours~
Ah, yes, having too much treasure truly is a burden.

ex.line: Ah, I'm making some tea! Incidentally, are there any spices you dislike? I'll leave those out of the mixture.

Give me your hand, Commander... There, I wrote a protective spell on it. Now clench. I only wrote it with my finger, but the effect should be the same. Heehee. Wherever you go now, the wind will watch over you.
It's too quiet here... Shall I sing for you? What song would you like to hear?
You can't just sit down all day. Give me your hand and let's dance! Dancing is at its most fun when excitement is in the air!
Give me thy blessings and grant me everlasting protection... Heehee, I'm done praying. Now it's time to make you a very special dish!
Commander, look here! *snap*! I did it! Taking photographs with these smartphones is so convenient. It lets me collect sweet pictures of you whenever I want. Heehee. I'll treasure these dearly.
Hmph! You're getting it if you ruin my hair! Getting it, I say! ...Hahaha! I'm just joking!
Why I want to dance? Because I'm happy! Why am I happy? Because I got to see you! Heehee.
Mmhh... You're making me angry! Not really♪
Whydah told me about a thing called a "smartphone" which can create "photographs" of wondrous sights and things instantly. Could you bring one of those along the next time we leave the port?
Have a gander at my newly-sorted display shelf! Everything on here is from our travels and memories together. I hope to expand my collection substantially and add many more shelves! Heehee.

lines.line: You heard my song? Thank goodness... Someone has finally come for me! Say, could you please remove the seal on me?
You heard my song? Thank goodness... Someone has finally come for me! Say, could you please remove the seal on me?
My energy wanes further and further. Please undo the seal quickly... Hm? You think I look full of energy? Well, that's because I'm happy to see you!

I put a seal on myself for fear of being taken by the disaster, and when I awoke, my powers had purified the sea, yet I could not undo the seal. Please, traveler who heard my song, I have no one else to turn to! Help meee!
Oh. The bandages around my arms came loose. They have nothing to do with the seal! Only YOU can undo it!
Once you've undone the seal, I'm going to search the undersea ruins, then... Hm? You want to come with me? Sure, but by then you'll already be- Err! Never mind I said anything!
Hm? You adore my singing? Ah, then I will keep singing for you! I'll sing for you forever... and ever... and ever...
Destiny has chosen you to rescue me, so it will be child's play for you to undo the seal. N-no, there's nothing dubious about it all!
I'd hate to let go of such a reassuringly warm hand...
Curious about the body of a mermaid? Come closer and have a better look. That's it, take it aaall in.
Eep! M-my, that's quite bold... You will pay for doing this! I hope you're prepared!
Go ahead and do your work. I'll be here, waiting.
Are you finished with your work? You look exhausted - come here and rest by my side. I'll sing a song to ease your heart.
You're still in touch with the outside world? Heh... That's okay. Soon, you'll be mine.
You seem rather tired, Commander. It must be the influence of a disaster... I'll protect you, but you must undo the seal on me first!
Your entourage has entered the area? And they're transporting goods for you? You should go speak to them, then! Oh, but don't tell them about me.
Why are you making that face? Soon you will be one with me, one with the disaster... Heehee. Merging to be forever together is just another form of love!
Sailing frigate - C Fancy.
Nice to meet you. Hm? Is that not what you say on your first meeting? I see. Your explanation is quite interesting... As are your body temperature, body odour, form, mass, and texture, too...

Good morning, human. I am Fancy. If I'm to follow your customs, I suppose I should call you... "Commander"? Yes. I'm glad you don't seem to fear me, even though I'm known as a "being of the abyss." I'll be watching you to see what sort of human you are.
Welcome back, Commander. That's okay, right? Heehee, don't worry. I'll keep your "nest" safe while you're away.

Some predators use their gorgeous looks and beautiful voices to lure prey in. Heehee. Me? I'm simply following my instinct as a being of the abyss to communicate with you... Truth be told, even I don't really know whether I'm a monster or something else.
Commander! Oh, Commander! Heehee. Does it make you happy when I call you like this?
I won't treat you as prey anymore. Are you happy? This isn't because you're inedible, it's just... Hmm... I still need time to determine which category to put you in.
My interests? What does that mean? What is there beyond surviving and eating? For a human commander, you sure say funny things.
Hm? What is it?
Hm? You want to see my eyes? No.
Mm... Is this... another custom of yours? Okay then.
You still have missions to do. Get to it.
There's not a single edible thing among these mission rewards...
A letter? Heehee. I'm curious how you engage with other humans.
Do you want a good drink to wash away your fatigue?
That commission team is like a school of fish, swimming from place to place.
Commander♡ Commander♡
Roll up the waves and tear the sea apart.
Repulsive. Not even worth a taste.
We were just messing around, no? Should I take this more seriously?
Cling clang. Turn to scrap.
Hm? Heehee. You must really want to be torn to pieces.
You bore me, human. I'm starting to think food is all you're good for.
If nothing fun happens soon, I will raze your port to alleviate my boredom.
You smelt nice yesterday. You feel nice today. You- Hm? No, I'm not going to eat you. If I do, I won't know what you'll be like tomorrow.
Remember, Commander - I wear this mask to protect you. Acting on your curiosity to see the "real me" will only hurt you.

You still want to see the "real me"? If the truth is worth more than your life, then I'm not one to deny you it... There, happy? Did it scare you? Do you regret it? Can you only tremble in fear as you wait for the end? ...No to all of those? Now I see those eyes you've been looking at me with the whole time... my Commander.

I can't understand you, and yet, without you I would dry like I hadn't had water, atrophy like I hadn't eaten food, and tire like I hadn't slept. Therefore, my instincts tell me to accept this from you. Heehee. Now we'll be together forever.
I feel weird. What should I say... Thank you?

ex.line: Welcome back. Since you've accepted the "real me," I'm not going to "protect" you anymore. I will just be myself and strive to deepen our relationship.
This emotion known as "love," superficially similar to hunger... why have I never felt it before? It's strange - incomprehensible, even... I'm becoming increasingly hooked on you.
Can you tell me what it is that lovers are supposed to do? In exchange, I'll gladly help you with anything.
Heehee. I heard a story of a monster who'd climb a tower with their lover and make enemies with the whole world just to be with them. I've started to really understand why someone would do that.
Oh... This is an act of closeness. I finally figured that out a while back.
Oohh... Heehee. Suddenly I have the urge to bite you.
Aaahhhh... Feels strange. Was I drooling?
Heehee. I've heard that hugging someone from behind can relieve their stress. Is it working?
Gurhhh... That was delicious. Your home cooking is excellent.

Heehee. When you're happy, I'm happy. Is this what "love" feels like? ...Hm? Before now? I've never had complicated feelings before, so I simply pretended to be happy. I get it now... When you're here, my "real self" can be truly happy. That's wonderful.

lines.line: Oh... You've found me. This is horror fashion, and I've heard it's pretty popular. Boo. Scared?
Oh... You've found me. This is horror fashion, and I've heard it's pretty popular. Boo. Scared?
I'm once again going to show you my frightening side today to get you to pay more attention to me.
Heehee. How do I look? Does this assortment of horror elements send terrifying chills down your spine? ...Hm? Explain them to you? Well, there's the mummy bandages... and that's about it. Hahaha.
Heehee. I'm now going to launch a surprise attack on you as the incarnation of fear. A fear that follows you like your shadow. Are you ready to shake in your boots?
Oh. Am I still not scary enough for you? Fine, time for something else. My tentacles and I will teach you the fear of being hunted by a predator.
By the way, what even is "fear"? Despite everything I've done, you're still not afraid. Was there something wrong in the knowledge I learned?
Heehee. I'm even more frightening than usual, and you still want to touch me?
Heehee. Do you dare to... stick your finger inside?
Ahh... Even I've started to... derive pleasure from you doing this...
Come inside and lie down with me. I'll massage you from every which side.
I've heard that you can imprint yourself upon humans' hearts by giving them various kinds of stimuli. This must be true of you as well. That's why I'll continue scaring you to make you remember me.
Sailing frigate - C Amity.

Feigning a shipwreck while loading your cannons, then once your targets get close, you take them by surprise and sink them all in one fell swoop - don't you think that kind of strategy suits me just perfectly?
Ahh, Commander. I'm Amity. Here's hoping we'll get along. So, let's cut to the chase and get to know each other, shall we?
I've brought all your papers, Commander. Eeevery last one. Time to get to work!
My trick to making friends, you ask? There isn't one. I just read the room, gauge reactions, and say what sounds right... What was it called? "Getting on their good side," was it?
Here, Commander. You were looking for these papers, no? I found them for you. "How did I find them"? Don't you dare assume that I walked off with them by mistake.
What? Your juice tastes quite bitter? Oops, that's my fault. I accidentally got you iced coffee instead of juice! Excuse me while I go and get you the right drink.
I'll gladly help with your work if you'll do me a little favour. I haven't thought of what the favour is yet, but I'll figure it out later.
How does it feel to touch my silky-smooth hair, hmm?
Commander, could you open this bottle for me? ...No, you see, I'm asking for help because I really can't get it open. I'm serious.
Do that one more time and I'll stab you with my horn.
You've got a lot of missions. Better get started. That work isn't gonna do itself.
Commander- Whuah! Don't freak out! All I did was nudge your face with this drink I brought for you.
Commander, I've brought a letter for you. How will you reward me, hmm?
Welcome back, Commander. Heehee, I see you've brought back a real haul. Bravo!
The commission team is back. Let's go and see if they've brought back anything good.
Ooh, getting stronger feels nice.
They've taken the bait.
This was child's play - yet again.
Since things are looking dire, let's fall back.
Sink!
If that's how it's going to be...
Oh, could you keep your distance? I think that'd be best for both of us.
If you've got nothing better to do, tell me about yourself. I'll tell you all about me in return. It's only fair that we both know one another, no?
Let's leave together when your work is done. The port is a vast place, and I'm liable to get lost on my own. Heehee, that's not an excuse, I'm serious! Come on, let's go together.

I've come up with a way you can thank me for helping you earlier. How about you come with me on a seaside stroll after work is over? ...Ah, wonderful. Then get your work done and clock out on time! Naturally, I'll help you along the way.
Hm? You look like someone who wasn't expecting to see me here - am I right? I've been waiting here for ages, and I'm starving. You'll do the right thing and join me for a late-night snack, won't you?
I've got the ring, so it's too late for second thoughts. You're mine, which means there's no getting away. Of course, I'm also yours, so you better hold my hand so I can't run off.
Commander, thanks for the present~ I really like it!
What are we hunting this time?

ex.line: Oh, looks like you have lots of work today. Well, what's it going to be? Your only option is to ask me for help.
Oh, is this treat for me? Heehee, are you trying to get on my good side, hmm? You must REALLY want my good graces♡
Hey, why don't you rest your eyes for a while? Heehee, I promise I won't prank you this time.
Your schedule sure is packed tight... Let's see if I can't pull some strings so I can have you all to myself today.
Let's leave together when your work is done. I'll even help you get it done sooner. Relax, I'll do it for free this time!
Oh nooo, you caught me! What are you going to do to me now? I can't wait to see.
I'll let you do this as long as you want.
New missions have come in. I'll help so they'll get done faster.
The hunt begins!
I win! Now it's up to me to decide my reward. Gosh, what should I pick...
Have you decided where we're having late-night snacks tonight? I've got a few ideas, buuut... I'll let you decide this time and I'll pay! Sound good? Come on, choose a place so we can go!

lines.line: Well, well, look who's got nowhere left to go. Kidding, kidding. I win again, so I'll be taking your treasure! Follow me down if you're brave enough to jump.
Well, well, look who's got nowhere left to go. Kidding, kidding. I win again, so I'll be taking your treasure! Follow me down if you're brave enough to jump.
I've been waiting, Commander. Think you'll manage to catch me this time, hmm?
Why don't you come with me, Commander? Then I won't run away again even if you catch me!
You can just about make out the streets below... How does it feel to overlook everything, hmm?
Go on, guess which is more precious to me - the treasure I stole, or you.
Do you want me to take off my hat?
Come cloooser, Commander. You'll never catch me from that far away!
Can't keep your hands in check, hmm? Heheh, you must really want to be tied up.
Your mission is over, and yet you're still going to chase after me?
I'll be taking this letter of yours!
Wow! You're on my tail. I've been looking forward to the day that you finally catch me!
If you're going to keep ignoring what the commission team brought back, I'm just going to take it.

You yourself clearly made the choice to jump off - and the fact is, you've played right into my hand. Have you still not figured it out? I stole the treasure to make you chase after me. All this time, the real treasure I was after was you.
Sailing frigate - C Portsmouth Adventure.

Ya wanna get to know me? Takes guts to just ask like that, so I'll tell ya whatever ya want. I much prefer outspoken folks like you over stiff bluecoats! ...So when're we talkin'? Oh, when I've got time and plenty of booze and food on my hands, THEN we'll talk!
Yooo! You that Commander I've heard tons about? Damn, you look pretty capable. So, where we goin'? My eyes're set on claiming not just you, but all the treasure in the whole wide world! Mwahahaha!
There go Commander 'n' Portsmooouth♪ Set sail for great treasure forthwiiith♪ - that'll be our sea shanty next time we sail!

Booty! Booze! Grub! I want as much as I can get! Didn't think there was a like-minded person out there who could satisfy me, but you might just be the one! So, whaddya say you 'n' I go on an endless adventure to appease them desires, eh?
Try THIS! Mwahaha! Betcha can't breathe while you're caught between my legs! This is my new knockout move! Ain't it- Wait, what? You passed out?
Gaaahhh! I'm done being a frickin' secretary! *chug chug*... Can't believe you do this crap day in, day out... *chug chug*... I pity you! So much I just wanna eat you up! Heehee♥

Check it out! I busted my butt gettin' my hands on this stupidly expensive but tasty booze! First sip goes to me! *chug chug*... PFFFT! THAT'S SOUR AS HELL! It's worth the price, but it's not my thing... Here, it's yours!
Yeah? This hat's proof of my might. If ya want it, ya gotta work for it!
Heeey, I've only had a feeew! Hehehehe... Y'want some booze too?
This how you make friends 'round here? Lemme give it a shot♥
Still got unfinished missions, don'tcha? C'mon, no laziness allowed on the path of conquest and plunder!
Finished a mission? Well, I didn't do nothin', so the spoils're all yours!
Got a letter... Readin' too many words affects my appetite, so you take care of it.
Yo-ho! Back on land I see, Commander! Betcha brought back a huge haul, judgin' by that smile! Need a hand inspecting all them goods?
Oh! Commission team's back! Let's go rob 'em! ...Oh, they're on our side? Right! Silly me, I forgot!
Ahahaha! I'm plenty mighty as it is!
Hahaha! I'mma show you what it looks like to break through the seas!
Cough up them valuables, now!
This is just as frustratin' as when I get a smaller share of the booty!
I'm unstoppable on the open ocean!
Hey! You're pissing me off!
You're NOT gonna make it out to sea with me if ya don't get it together!
*yaaaaaawn*... Sooo bored... Let's have a strength contest! You win, ya get a box full of gold! ...What? Ya care more 'bout what's in my bottle? Yeah, we're not gonna discuss that.
Mornin', Commander! Mind if I step in as the secretary? Been wanting to just be around you lately, so, y'know... Bein' a secretary entails tons of paperwork? Ugh... Urggghhhh!

What the sticky black stuff all around my body is? It's my miracle remedy! Ya can drink it or rub it on yourself, and it's got all kinds of mind-blowin' benefits! Oh yeah, said your back hurt the other day, didn'tcha? Well, I can spread some of this on there 'n' give ya a massage with my feet!

Tonight, we're having a sleepover at your place to deepen our bonds, my bestest buddy! Also, I roll A LOT in my sleep, so I miiight end up squishin' ya with my- *grumble*... Man, I'm hungry! Let's look around 'n' find some grub 'n' drinks!

Huh? What's this? I'm guessin' this is, like, proof of our buddyship? On the finger it goes, then! Oh yeah, I'm in an amazing mood now! So, what do I do now! The choice is all yours! We're buddies who sail the seas together, after all!
A gift from you? Mine now! All mine! Thanks!
Fancy, cut it out with those weird noises! It's creepy!
That's what you mean by "getting along"?
It's piratin' time!

ex.line: There go Commander 'n' Portsmooouth♪ Set sail for great treasure forthwiiith♪ - h-hey, stop starin' at me while I sing! It's embarrassing! Cut it out!
Hey, gotta ask you somethin'! That thing we did earlier... It's what lovers do, yeah? I mean, you really like me, and I really like you... C'mon, you know that already!
What? Ya figured out how to handle my knockout move 'n' want me to use it on ya again? No! That's dangerous! Ugh... Fine, if that's what you're into...
(It's only hittin' me now that being 'round the Commander gets me all excited and hot... Dammit! I've gotta make a move!)

Said you were curious 'bout what's in the bottle before, didn'tcha? Well, it's my strongest booze! Want a taste? ...What? Don't dare to try it? Ugh... Do it! Just drink it! Drink it 'n' submit to meee!
Sure, ya can wear my hat if ya want... Huh? Ya just wanted to pat my head?
Eep! Y-y'know, for a while now... I've been gettin' these feelings when you start touching me!
C-Commander, we're still on the clock 'n' I might pounce you if... Wait, no! I didn't mean it like that!
Yo-ho, Commander! You're lookin' like all went well! ...Huh? My face is all red? I just had a lot to drink, that's all!

Heehee... How ya likin' this high-ABV booze I saved for a special occasion? Feelin' hot? As you should! I made you drink a whole ton of it, so yeah... Heehee... Now all you can do is try to quench MY endless thirst...♥

lines.line: Wait, Commander?! You're here way ahead of time! N-no, this is NOT what my special surprise is supposed to be!
Wait, Commander?! You're here way ahead of time! N-no, this is NOT what my special surprise is supposed to be!
I'm NOT in the mood to sing right now! ...Wait until my mood improves? Hey, how about HELPIN' me here, huh?
Grrr... This trap was supposed to immobilise you, but I tripped and, well... Is this karma for tryin' to prank my best buddy?
Pretty nice idea for a trap? Uh, thanks? Forget about that! When are ya gonna help me get unstuck?!
If you're gonna pull, start from my legs. If that doesn't work, my waist... L-leave my head for last, alright?
Ugh... Are ya even gonna try to help me? You BETTER not be thinkin' about leaving me like this! We won't be able to sail the seas!
Th-the horns look real scary, don't they? ...That's not an invitation to grab 'em!
You're gonna have to try harder!
Eek! W-well, if this'll help ya pull harder, then go ahead...
A new mission? Yeah, you bet! Your new mission is to help me!
You're gonna read letters NOW? Fine... Just watch yourself so ya don't end up like me.
Grrr... Can't move... It was supposed to be the Commander getting stuck like this... Oh, hey, haha... Welcome back, Commander...
The commission team's back? Well, I can't do much like this...
I'm stronger, but I'm still stuck!
Ugh... Help me loose here 'n' ya can do whatever ya want to me! ...Huh? You can do anything to me right now anyway? Well, I guess that's true... Hey, wait! Wait a sec!
Sailing frigate - C Dolphin.

I'm Dolphin, and I'm a pirate, but it might be more accurate to say I'm a treasure hunter. Anyway, if you can call it a treasure, I can locate it! If you come up with any treasures you want, let me know. I'm an expert at tracking treasure down!
Hmm? Are you that Commander everyone's been talking about? Pleasure meeting you. I'm Dolphin. Now let's do a handshake of friendship! Glad to be working with you.
You've arrived. Let's get started on today's work. Hmm, there's quite a lot, but it's only half as much if we split it. We can do this!

This is a fossil of a weird creature with five tentacles and three eyes! Bristol asked me to find it! If there's any treasure YOU want, just let me know. I can find anything in the world with my special ability!
*yawn*... *yaaawn*... Oh, look at the time! Boy, these games are all so fun. Just gonna play a little longer... Do you wanna join me, Commander?
Alrighty. You can eat this octopus, or keep it as a pet if you want. It's all yours, Commander! Oh, eww, my hands got all slimy... I'm gonna go wash them!
It's so fun, being able to talk to the fishies at the aquarium. We should go there again sometime, Commander!
Hm? Is my hat the real deal? Uhh... I dunno. I just wear it 'cause it's cute.
Heehee! You're not gonna be able to surprise me, Commander! I can hear every sound you make from a mile away.
Whuh?! What are- Hey! You can't do that!
Keep at it, Commander! There's still work to do.
Job done! Let's check the rewards... I've never seen gold and items like these before.
Hm? Is this one of those "e-mails"? How do you open it? ...Whoa. I didn't peek, though.
I knew you were back! I heard it from all the way over here. Seriously! I can hear sounds from super duper far away! ...How? Well, that's just my special ability! Heehee.
The commission team is back with treasure. Yup, I was right about that spot!
Whew! You made me stronger. Wait until you see me in action!
Focus, girls! We're setting off!
We won! Did pretty well, didn't I? Let me hear a bit of praise!
It's okay! We'll win next time! At least we're all okay!
Found you!
Owch... It's okay. I'm not out of the fight yet!
Sorry, I'm not in a good mood. You should stay away for a while...
Hmm... You're fun to look at, but my eyes will tire if I stare all day. I'm gonna rest my eyes for a bit and... It's obvious I'm peeking through my hands? Heehee, you're right. You got me.
You can pick any key from my hat you want. They each open up a different chest filled with my treasure. As for where the chests are, the fishies will show you where!
Look, Commander! I used my special ability to make the fishies form a big heart! I made it just for you, heehee. Do you like it?
Hey, Commander, these fishies will point you to my most valued treasure... Hm? Why did they all gather around you? Gosh, I have no idea! Heehee. Can you guess why?

I accept this unique ring, and the thing that's more valuable than any treasure in the world - your love! I'm going to treasure this dearly! Come here! I'm spreading my arms because I want a hug, silly. Heehee. Hold me in your arms!
Treasure! Thanks, Commander~
I know where the treasure is! Follow me!

ex.line: *gurgle gurgle gurgle*... Oh, it's done? Commander, I've figured out how to use the coffee machine. Expect fresh coffee every morning from now on!
You said you wanted this a while earlier, didn't you? I found it with my special ability, and now it's yours! If you wanna thank me, then a hug is in order! Heehee.
Are you not feeling good? Give me your hand. Whew... How's that? I shared some of my good feelings. Will you manage now?
Hm? You weren't searching for me? But I DID detect that you wanted... Whatever! Since I'm already here, I'm gonna sit next to you.
The deep sea is a fun place. There are blobfish, fangtooths, and more, and they're all so sweet. You should visit sometime! Or I could catch a few and give them to you.
Pat-pat... Heehee. I love it when you pat my head.
Alrighty, show me your hand. Tadah! This tiny pearl is for you. Why a pearl, you ask? Well, take a guess!
Ahh... I wouldn't do this... with anyone but you... *blushes*
You're back. Whew... While I can tell it's you from the sound, seeing you in person is more reassuring. Now let's see a warm hug!
My memories of you are locked away safely in here - inside my heart! Heehee. And there's still lots of empty space for us to create more memories.

lines.line: *yaaawn*... Was it you who awoke me? Heehee, thanks. Oh, don't be scared! Sure, rising out of a coffin is a bit creepy... but still, I'm not going to hurt you. Promise.
*yaaawn*... Was it you who awoke me? Heehee, thanks. Oh, don't be scared! Sure, rising out of a coffin is a bit creepy... but still, I'm not going to hurt you. Promise.
The rain isn't stopping anytime soon, so we just have to wait it out. Have a nap, if you wanna. How do I know it's not stopping? Umm, instinct, I guess? A prediction? I'm not sure either. Heehee.
Owch... These stitches kind of sting... The pain will go away if you give me a warm hug, though!
Why was I sleeping in here? Probably due to the curse... What's your guess? Because I have no clue. I don't remember anything that happened before I fell asleep.
Look at that spider on the ceiling! Heehee. I've never seen one that weird before! Do you want me to go and catch it for you?
The rain still hasn't stopped. If you're feeling bored, how about we look around for secret treasure in here? Places like these always have treasure! Sometimes!
The screw on my head? I think it's just decorative. I'm not too sure, myself!
Thanks. Keep hugging me and the pain will all disappear.
Wanna hear my heartbeat? ...Hm? You don't hear anything?
A mission? What kind? Let me have a look.
Is this mission done? That didn't seem so hard. Let me have a shot at the next one.
A letter for you? Weird. Where was it sent from? How did it make its way here?
Fooound you, Commander! Heehee. I said I'll always find you no matter where you go, remember? I have an ability that lets me pinpoint your location!
The rain stopped? No, it didn't. It'll keep raining as long as I'm awake. See? It started again. Now be good and stay here. Now that I'm awake, I don't wanna be left alone again.
Grossflugzeugkreuzer (large aviation cruiser) A Type II - Fritz Rumey.

By pairing aerial superiority with immense firepower, one can repel the enemy even when surrounded and without relying on aircraft. This is the concept for which I was designed. Far-fetched though it seemed then, now, my existence is proof of its feasibility.
Guten Tag, Commander. I am Rumey. You've surely read my file. Forget the pleasantries - just tell me all the details of our next operation.
For one who commands, punctuality is the bare minimum of what's expected of you. Try to arrive sooner so you may serve as an example for others.
Smooth talk does not yield victories, and wild aspirations alone cannot achieve success. Be pragmatic, Commander - that is the quickest way to achieve these things.
What are you fighting for, Commander? You need not answer. You need only know the answer in your heart.
Sometimes, I carry out missions alone. While it is dangerous, the greater risk comes with corresponding gains.
Organizing and reviewing combat records is child's play. My finished work will be distributed to your subordinates in your name later.
Commander, here is the finalized operation plan. Give it a final overview, just to be safe.
Is something the matter?
Now is not the time for rest. At attention! Your service has not concluded!
Sort yourself out, Commander.
New mission objectives have been relayed to us. Begin drafting a plan, Commander.
You got it done on time, did you? Good work.
Only by reading your letters can you guarantee the timeliness of their contents, Commander.
Commander, reflect on your previous battle once your quick rest is over.
A commission has been completed. You should begin writing that report.
Gut.
Advance and annihilate the enemy!
An exceedingly ordinary victory. Continue working hard, Commander, lest you get complacent.
The operation is a failure. All units, retreat in an orderly fashion!
Advance! Onward!
I will turn this battle around!
Your lack of discipline is a shame upon our navy. Shape up! Only you can redeem yourself!
Reach the top, Commander. Then you will see the most beautiful sight, with no one to block your view.
It's time for a break, Commander. Drop your work immediately. Foolhardily working for longer will, by itself, only halve your productivity. What you require now is rest.

You had many highlights in our war game today... However, by going to such lengths to avoid ally casualties, you exceeded the time limit and failed. Mind you, I'm not saying your strategy was bad. I'll improve upon it, then we'll switch sides next time.

You reversed the situation of last time and then employed specific countermeasures in this war game... I have to admit, your strategy posed a serious threat to me, which is good. Remember this feeling - and know that I am eager to witness your performance next time.

I already know why you summoned me here. I will gladly take this vow. As you surely know, I have many feelings that I struggle to put into words. Put this ring on my finger - how my hand trembles is my answer to your question.
This gift... I only hope you carry over these same observational skills to your work.
Equal devastation to all our foes!
Time is of the essence. Blitzkrieg!
I am deeply honored to fight alongside you.

ex.line: I've made coffee for you, Commander. See? Arriving sooner gives you breathing room to start work on more comfortable terms.
You shouldn't be so stiff in private. This is a time to relax. Save the work talk for later.
What am I fighting for? I fight for the good of my Iron Blood comrades and for you.
I conducted a risk appraisal for the next operation. Once you've verified that all is in order, give it to your subordinates who are due to sortie.
If there's something on your mind, be it a private or work-related matter, you can share it with me. We'll figure out a solution by thinking about it together.
Hm? What is it?
Don't dread the work in front of you. Put your hands to work and remember that I'm right by your side!
Commander, we're still on the clock. Control yourself.
Word of new missions has come in. Let us carry out your plan, Commander.
I placed your new letter in the "awaiting answer" pile. Remember to read it and claim any attached items.
Commander, you need a break. I will take care of the after-action review.
A commission has been completed. Let us review the report together.
The strategy we discussed earlier has proven effective. Only by constantly learning from experience, Commander, can we better prepare for the next battle.

The next war game? You just finished your work - surely you can save this for later? *sigh*... I don't want you to overwork yourself to the point of exhaustion. Let me handle everything and get some rest at once.

lines.line: Hm? It's you. Surprised by my appearance? Hmm... My apologies. I was thinking about how to rectify discipline inside the shop. At any rate, welcome.
