Hm? It's you. Surprised by my appearance? Hmm... My apologies. I was thinking about how to rectify discipline inside the shop. At any rate, welcome.
Punch the clock when you start and finish work. Be on time, and don't leave early... Oh, Commander. That wasn't aimed at you.
I am the head of our pop-up shop - its "boss bunny," in other words. I uphold discipline to ensure your comfort in... Just take it easy, you say? No! Every aspect of your experience must be perfect!
I'm scaring people, you say? Well... As the manager, I don't at all mind being strict if it can better your experience at our shop.
The experience Lord Bismarck imparted unto me has made my job significantly easier. I must thank her when I get the chance.
Stealing food from the kitchen, leaving work early when they see you're not coming... Such terrible work ethics. It's high time I established a set of strict rules for the employees.
As our single and very important customer, you should stay and rest up. Whether you're a soldier or a paper pusher, your work must be balanced with rest.
These ears don't look like rabbit ears to you? I see...
I do admire your bravery, but...
Another mission. I will help you with it. You cannot afford to be lazy.
Commander, get a feel for the service in our shop. Naturally, I will take notes of your feedback.

I never thought I'd be told by you of all people to slow down and take my time. Very well - I'll consider your suggestion... What? You want to stand watch while I rest? But there is no one else here... Ahem. It's nothing. Allow me to rest, then!
Type 1944 destroyer - Z52.
I'm Z52 from Iron Blood, and long-distance ops are my specialty. I didn't get to fight in the war, but I've done plenty of combat sims! Heehee. Now I'm here to help you out!
Z52, reporting for duuuuaaahh! Shouldn't have run so faaast! ...Phew. Hah! So you're the Commander? You look capable enough! Just throw me your orders when you want someone for work or for a fight!
Oh, you're here! So is all this stuff work that you have to do? Let's see here... Hey, this looks kinda fun! Let me take a shot at it!
Are you a rigging geek, by any chance? I love that stuff, so tell me all you know! ...Uh-huh. Huh? What? Whoa, slow down! You're making it too complicated for me!
What's that on the ceiling? A bug I've never seen before? Lemme climb up and have a look at- What? DON'T climb the bookshelf?
Hey! Commander! There's this dessert that's exploded in popularity! You should try it! I got curious, so I went and bought some from the shopping district! ...Yeah, obviously I ran there!
Takeoff! And landing! How was that, Commander? The Kong Vault is pretty sick, huh? Heheh! ...Well, yeah, I'm just practicing. I know I'm not allowed to do parkour in your office!
Let's open the window and get some fresh air in. Good air brings good vibes, and good vibes bring... Ow! I got sand in my eye! ...You'll blow it out for me? Umm, thanks... *blushes*
Did my Thunderheart here catch your eye? Heh, it's a mask that lets me see the essence of everything! Pretty sick, huh? ...How does it do that? I'm, uh, trying to figure that out myself!
What is it? Found any fun stuff? Let me have a look!
Wh-what?! Why are you so keen on touching this?
You've got new missions, Commander... Hey, how do you do this thing?
Great work! I already checked the rewards, so you just lie down and... Huh? I did it wrong? Ugh, alright, then show me how it's done!
Whoosh! Here I am with your letter, Commander!
Where'd your sortie take you this time? Ohh, that's a place I've never been before... So, saw anything fun? Had any good food? I can zip-zoom over and have a look!
The commission team's back! Let me go with them next time! I specialize in long-distance missions, so I swear I'll be useful!
There's no obstacle I can't run through!
Thunderheart, unleash the burst!
Whaddya think? Blows you away how awesome I am, right? Heheh!
Are we sortieing, Commander? They run all they want - I'll still catch up and whoop 'em good!
Thunderheart, burn and send 'em flying!
Is my Thunderheart broken or something?
Listen! You can't keep skipping out on exercise!
Do you play any sports? ...Ohh, that one! I'm pretty dang good at that, so we should totally play together sometime!
I applied for the port's parkour contest! Be there and cheer for me! All I need is you in the audience and that first-place spot will be in the bag!

Regensburg tweaked Thunderheart a bit and now it can read people's minds! Right now, you're thinking about... Huh... Why's it not showing anything? Maybe I gotta get closer... Um, uh, why are you hugging me?
I'm here, Commander! Need anything? ...So what if it's not a big deal? I'll come running as soon as you call for me, and that's that!

Oh gosh! I'm the happiest girl alive! Thank you, Commander! I'll treasure it always! ...Commander? Hellooo? Was I too fast with my super happy spin? Oh no! Sorry! I shouldn't have gotten so excited! Sit down and I'll get you some water!
Ooh... What is it? Can I open it up right now?
Rawr! How'd I sound?
Whoa! What energy drink do you drink?

ex.line: I organized your documents, so check and see if- I got it wrong again?! But I worked so hard! Fine... Then show me how to do it right! I'll get it next time, I promise!
Hm? Unusually laid-back today? Well, that's 'cause I was just in a parkour contest and I'm aching for some rest. Besides, isn't it nice to just relax with each other sometimes?
Zzz... Huh? Did I doze off? Dang it! I promised to help with your work... Wait, was it you who put this blanket on me?
So, Commander, U-31 instructed me on how to protect you, and I wanna put it to the test as soon as... Huh? There's no need for that? Why not?
Hey, your brow's furrowed. Something on your mind? Come here and let's blow those troubles away! Oh, I know! Wanna go for a run? It'll make you forget all the bad stuff!
You hungry, Commander? Want me to go buy you something? How about some crispy chicken or schweinshaxe? With my speed, I guarantee it'll arrive still piping hot!
Yeah! That motivated me! Now I've got the drive to do anything!
What's that? A scratch? I probably got it while practicing parkour... A band-aid? I don't need one... B-but... Thanks.
Whuh? Yeah, I guess I am pretty big... *blushes*
Look ooouuut! ...I had the idea of running out to meet you at max speed, and then you arrived sooner than expected and I couldn't really stop. Heehee...

I swear to keep you safe, Commander! Doesn't matter what enemies or obstacles come your way, I'll drop everything else and come running right to you! And no, I didn't pick that line up from somewhere, that's just how I really, truly feel!

lines.line: Let's see... Where's the shop again? It should be... Oh, Commander! I'm not late, am I? I ran here as fast as I could!
Let's see... Where's the shop again? It should be... Oh, Commander! I'm not late, am I? I ran here as fast as I could!
Uhh, just a sec. I'm putting on this anti-slipping silicone tape on my clothes... Yup! I went to the shopping district to buy this stuff, and that's why I was late!
Motorcycles are pretty cool - and more fun than I thought! You should ride with me after I finish work!
I've never worked wearing this outfit before, so it's pretty novel. Wonder what the job itself is about... Hm? You're making a face like you know what! C'mon, tell me!
I've wanted to see what it feels like to ride a motorcycle, so I took a ride on one! Buuut... I think I prefer going fast with my own two legs.
Oh, these? They're raffle tickets. I brought some, hoping we could check out the raffle event later. Speaking of which, what prizes does the raffle even have?
Here! Pick a drink. Z47 said they're both tasty as heck, so I bought one of each!
Is my hair all ruffled up 'cause of my helmet?
You'll carry my stuff for me? Thanks!
Th-that's where you stick the tape? I thought it should go on my clothes...
Did you just get here? ...What? You wanted to check if I'd gotten lost? Um, well... Thanks!
I'll go with you wherever you want - to the shop to chat, on a ride, or even to the raffle! As long as you're jumping for joy by the end of tonight, that's all I care about!
Whoooa! Commander, watch out! Phew... Good thing I didn't crash into you. Good reflex... Oh! Since we're here, why don't you come play in the water with me?
Whoooa! Commander, watch out! Phew... Good thing I didn't crash into you. Good reflex... Oh! Since we're here, why don't you come play in the water with me?
Whoosh... I'm here! Are you ready to go swimming with me? Hm? Don't worry! I brought plenty of gear! Let's get going already!
I got my hands on new gear! Isn't this surfboard the coolest thing ever? Hehe, wanna see just how fast I can surf on this baby?
What do you feel like doing now, Commander? Roller skating, surfing, or snorkeling? Oh, hey, let's just do all of them! Go, go, go!
Can we try tandem surfing together? Just relax and hold on to my waist. Here we go!
If you go fast enough, you can leave all your troubles in the sea! Let's pick up the pace, Commander! ...Huh? Did you say something? I'm going too fast! I can't hear you!
Whoa?! M-my hat's gonna blow awaaay! Hehe... Thanks for catching it, Commander!
Which gear do you want? Hurry and choose so we can go!
Whoa?! C-Commander?! Th-this isn't how you play in the ocean...
Welcome back, Commander! The sunlight is strong today - let's go snorkeling! See? I brought diving gear, too!
Don't worry, Commander! Even if you come empty-handed, I'll have everything you could ever need! Ehehe, let's keep speeding ahead together from now on!
M-class light cruiser - Duisburg.

I'm Duisburg of the Iron Blood, and I've got all kinds of hobbies. Good-looking and good-tasting food, collecting cute and elaborate accessories... I'd love to open my own little shop one day. But right now, I only have eyes for you, Commander♪
Well, well, we finally met. Commander, right? I'm Duisburg. Let's be great friends, okay? Heheh♪
You came right on time. It kinda feels like we're meeting up for a date, huh?
Whoa~ So you're the kind of person to pry into someone's private junk right off the bat? Heheh♪ I don't mind sharing with you. You just have to tell me your own secrets in return.
You want to see my nails? Okay... Let's intertwine our fingers... Your skin tone looks great complimented by mine, Commander.
Liverpool told me about this popular restaurant's new drink menu. Gee, I sure wish I had someone to go with me♪ ...Aww, you will? Thank you!
I want to open my own shop someday, but I don't know what kind... Oh, you're interested? Then how about we brainstorm together?
Huh? ...Whuh? What's gotten into you?
Ooh, what is it? Got some gossip for me?
C-Commander... No, I won't believe you if you say that was an accident.
You still haven't done your work? Heheh♪ About time you asked me for help, don't you think?
Ooh. Finished your missions, huh... Wanna check those rewards while they're still fresh in your mind?
Hmm? Was that sound an unread mail notification?
Welcome back, Commander~♪ Did anything cool happen today? Come on, you know you wanna gossip.
The commission girls are back. I hope they brought some fun gifts!
Well, well. You made me stronger AND cuter!
I'm not losing, not today.
All thanks to everyone's help, heheh♪
What the hell? This is the worst day EVER!
I'm not down yet!
I can't let the Commander see me like this!
Ahaha... I-I don't really get what you're saying. Should I look it up?
I'm kinda bored. I had plans to go out with Dido, Zara, Pittsburgh, and Hipper later... You wanna come with, Commander?
(Hmm... The Commander's been a little cold to me lately. Does my makeup look bad, or...) Huh? O-oh, aren't you supposed to be reading paperwork? Why are you staring at me now...?

Huh? You think I suddenly look cuter? ...Heheh, I might've used a little magic... Just kidding♪ All I did was fix my makeup when you weren't looking. Do you like this lip gloss more? Get a closer look, if you want.
Hey, Commander~ I hear there's a way to test someone's willpower. See, if I sit in your lap like this and give you a hug... If you last long enough, I'll give you a little reward♥

Do you already wanna use the reward I promised you before? Heheh, feels like a bit of a waste, doesn't it? After all, I'd do whatever you wanted even without you using up your token... But it's too late to go back now. Let's get even closer♥
I see you've been quietly observing my preferences? Thank you...
Can you teach me to do my makeup better?
How about we check out that shop we were talking about?
Maid work sure is tough~
You should try this new juice I got!

ex.line: Commandeeer♪ Heheh, I've been waiting for you. After work, how about we go out? On a date♥
What do you wanna know about me today? Trade one of your secrets, and I'll tell you anything... Huh? Wh-why that... What do you want to know that for?!
That look in your eyes is suspicious... Hmm? You're just looking at the waist of my outfit? O-okay, do you want a closer look...?
Hey, Commander♪ I bought a new drink. They say the theme is "young love." Wanna drink it together?
I hear that if you do business alongside someone you love, it deepens your bond... How about a coffee shop, Commander? Sound good? I agree♥
Heheh. That look in your eyes told me everything.
Th-that tickles... What's got you so worked up?
Heheh... If you've got a good enough excuse for me...♥
Welcome back~ Want a hug? Here, bury that head right in my arms♥

Hmm... I'm no good at straightforward confessions. But I also feel bad, since you've been so proactive, so maybe I should try... Ahem. I-I love you. I always have... H-how was that?! You knew? So I didn't have to push myself to say it? Wh-what kind of answer is that?!

lines.line: C-Commander... Huh? If we're training, I should call you Master...? M-Master... You don't have to stare. Let's just get started, please...
C-Commander... Huh? If we're training, I should call you Master...? M-Master... You don't have to stare. Let's just get started, please...
Welcome back... Master. Huh? More passionately? I-I get it...! P-please continue to train me...
M-Master... I'm okay. I'm the one who came up with this idea, anyway... Please keep training me, f-for the sake of the pop-up shop... Okay?
Don't you think this outfit's going a little TOO far? I know I'm the one who picked the wrong box of clothes, but surely you've noticed I'm not wearing this intentionally, right?!
W-wait... You want me to serve you drinks like this? No way, I can't do it...! I can't!
Feels good, doesn't it? Yeah, I thought you might think so.
Ah?! ...I-if it please you, Master...
You did that because I'm "too cute"? Bad excuse! I won't let you get away with saying that a second time... Okay?!
Welcome back, Master. What drink would you... *sigh*... As if. We barely have any left at this time of day.
O-obviously, I only won because of the Commander... I-I'm just telling the truth! That wasn't part of the training!
I know I'm only calling you Master during training, but... i-if you like it... I could keep doing that? Even after I finally open that shop I want... I'll say it whenever you want me to...
Type 1934A destroyer - Z9 Wolfgang Zenker.
I'm the Iron Blood's Type 1934A destroyer, Z9, Wolfgang Zenker... I promise I'll fight and work better than I did before, so don't abandon me...
Greetings, Commander. I'm Z9, a destroyer from the Iron Blood, also known as Wolfgang Zenker... I'll do anything I can to help you. Please, just don't abandon me... *sniffle*
Commander... *sniffle* W-welcome back... I thought I'd done something wrong and made you leave forever. Ooh... I'm sorry, it's hard to stop crying once I've started...
C-Commander, of course... *sniffle*... You found me again. I'm okay, just let me be alone for now... Ahh, actually, stay with meee...
I-I did the paperwork, but I'd like to look over it again... Show it to you first? Okay... It's perfect?! Oh, thank goodness!

Commander, umm, look at this birdie and rose living happily ever after that I drew... The ending of this book I'm reading was so sad that I wanted to redraw it... Hmm? The bird is right here. Does it not look like one...?
Commander, umm... May I sit here? No real reason, I just wanted to be near you...
Pet me more, Commander.
Commander, where are you going? Oh... Just getting water? Okay, I-I'll come with you!
Eep?! U-umm... I-is that an order?
Commander, your missions aren't done yet. I can help... No, I'm not tired. As long as I can be with you, I'll never tire.
Missions are done... Say, umm, now that you have time, what if we read a book together?
I brought your mail. I even sorted it...
Good work, Commander. Umm... I can go on missions, too, you know. I-I'll prepare well so I'm not a bother!
The commission team came back to us. I'll go inventory the supplies!
Keep getting better. Never let the Commander down!
Prepare to launch! I think nothing will go wrong...
Phew... I won. Commander, did I help out? H-hehe...
Aww... I'll try harder next time, I promise. Don't leave me behind...
I'll do this, and I'll do it right!
Urk... I'll be left behind at this rate...
Say... Commander, if you're in a bad mood, I could lend you my coat. Hide in there, and nobody will find you...

Commander, I'm sorry. I messed up again...! Basically, I tripped up and made a mess of your documents. I'll organize them right away... *sniffle*... Huh? You want to treat my bruises first? Thank you...!
In this book, the prince and princess get separated... I'd draw a much better ending for them. Do you have any ideas? Umm... Maybe we could draw it together?
A-am I doing a good job? Really?! Okay... Umm, may I have a hug, then? A reward for my good work. Oh... *sniffle*... It's so very warm in your arms.

I used to be so worried that I'd never do anything right. But you accept me, praise me, and never abandon me... *sniffle*... I'm going to do my best and get better at my job... as long as you let me stay by your side forever!
Commander? If you're giving me this, that must mean... you'll never leave me, doesn't it? You also want to see me smile more...? *sob*... Ahh, umm, oh no... I need to hold back these tears!
Ehehe... Thank you, Commander. I really love this...
You're so cool! I wish I could be like you... *sob*...
Fei Yuen... You're so good at art...
We're going to win... together!

ex.line: I did some of your work before you got here... Oh? Nothing looks wrong? Hehe, I'm glad to have helped♪
*sniffle*... I should've done better, Commander, I'm sorry... May I still hug you despite my failure? Oh, thank you...
I drew us together... H-here you go. This one's me, see? No, it's not a puppy!
The coffee tastes salty...? Did I mix up salt and sugar again... Urk, I was so busy thinking about you that I didn't even notice.
Huh? It won't affect your work if I sit in your lap? I-in that case... I-I'd be happy to...!
Hehe... I love you, Commander...
May my hugs soothe you as well as yours do me!
U-umm... If that's what you'd like, Commander, ahh...
Zzz... Huh? C-Commander, welcome back! I'm sorry... I fell asleep in your chair. Umm... Your scent just relaxes me so.
We won! I'll try to do even better next time...!
*sob*... It hurts. I want to go back to the Commander...

You think I cry less often now...? Y-you're right! I think your help has done wonders for me, and besides... Just as you encourage me with your warm hugs, I want to be able to encourage you with my smile...! Hehe...

lines.line: Commander, umm... Would you like to try our new drink? It's very sweet and tasty... Ahh, why am I so nervous? I need to do better...
Commander, umm... Would you like to try our new drink? It's very sweet and tasty... Ahh, why am I so nervous? I need to do better...
How about a drink before you start work? I-I'll go get... Aaah! I almost fell over... *sniffle*...
You think it's weird for me to dress like this, too, don't you? *sniffle*... J-just don't leave me... Ohh, what do I do? I wanna hide in my coat...
Huh? I did a good job? Thank you... *sniffle*... I'm so happy to have your approval...
It's weird... I usually feel relaxed around you, but lately, I'm so nervous... Is it because of this outfit? *sniffle*...
If you want to try our new drink, I'll prepare it right away... Oh, I don't mean the stuff in this glass! I-I'll just go get some fresh stuff...
Okay... I'll do my very best!
You don't mind that I'm a little sticky...?
Ah?! I-is this because I'm a little different today...?
Mail for you... I-it's okay! I promise it's not wet!
Commander, thank you for your hard work! Are you thirsty? D-does it make you want to order a drink?
Drink supplies just came. I'll bring you the new flavor right away!

Try this one, too, Commander... I left it for last because it's not one of our big sellers, but... I-I wanted to share my favorite one with you. It's sweeter and tastier when I drink it with you... Hehe.
Type 1934A destroyer - Z11 Bernd von Arnim.
I'm Z11, Bernd von Arnim of the Iron Blood... M-make me your secretary, Mandy! I can game with you and clean your office! I-I'm not just asking because I hate going outside, or anything!

Hi hi♪ I'm Z11, the Iron Blood's own Bernd von Arnim! Nice to meetcha, Mandy! ...A-ahahaha... It leaves a good impression if I act really happy to see you, right?! Huh? I-it doesn't tell you anything about me? I'm sorry!
Morning, Mandy! Ready already~? I-i-i-if we're working... I've steeled my heart!
Bleugh... The sun is a deadly laser... If it melts me like chocolate, I won't be able to help the Commander anymore...
Commander... C-can I go home now? I'm sorry... I said I wanted to help, but I really just wanna go home...
Do you like my outfit? Special, isn't it? ...D-do you have to think about it for that long?
I wish I could just play games all day forever. You must agree, right? Then we could stay up all night together, and... Ack! I'm sorry! There I go fantasizing again...
Heeeek?! I-I'll do my job, really...
Hyaaaah?! Wh-wh-what's going on?!
Y-you're gonna make me melt...!
Mandy, do your missions, or else... O-or else nothing, I guess...
Y-you finished your missions? Did I help...?
I organized your mail... I-I'm doing a great job, aren't I?!
M-Mandy, welcome home~... I-I'm doing my job, I swear! It's just taking a while.
They're back from their commission...? Oof, being outside all day must be rough...
I-I'm stronger now? Really...?
Huh? ...What? Me?
*pant*... I'm still alive?
Ahh... This is why I never want to go out...
Go away, bad things!
W-wait, am I anemic?
I think I'm just gonna head out... Hahaha...
I-I-I'm not nervous! See how I'm smiling like I rehearsed a thousand times... Wait, d-don't stare...
Finally... I can breathe easy next to the Commander...
If I suddenly faint, I want you to catch me... I'd be so embarrassed that I might die, yes, but if I'm gonna die, I'd like it to be in your arms... No, I didn't mean it like that!
I thought I wouldn't have to be nervous with you anymore. But my heart is beating so fast, and I'm so short of breath... Why? Commander, do you know why?

I-I know this is just a prank... I see it all the time. Things would never go the way I dream they would that easi-y-you're serious?! Ah, aaah... I think I'm having a heart attack... I'm so happy I might die!
C-Commander, you even knew all that about me...?! Ahh... ahhh...*blushes*
I-I said leave it to me!
What's a demon king? ...My role?
Z23, help... I wanna go home...

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I'll help you work. Hehe... If I pretend it's a date, it's no big deal.
W-work is hard, but I'll do my best to finish it! For the Commander's sake!
C-Commander... If you have time later, can we game together? Just a little won't interfere with your work, right...?
Would the Commander like me more if I wore cuter clothes? Hmm... What's your type, I wonder...
I-I've studied dates plenty! Take a look at this plan I stayed up all night making! If we do exactly what it says, I think it'll work out...!
Urk... C-Careful, Commander. This might get addictive...
Eep?! I-I'm sorry, I'm still not used to this...
I-if you're up for it...
MORE mail...? Y-you're so popular, Commander! No, I'm not jealous... Not jealous at all!
Welcome back! Umm, I brought my game console... Heheh, I just wanna spend more time with you, is all...
A victory for me and the Commander! Heheh, we won, right?
I've been thinking, and thinking, and thinking of how to get you to like me more... But I'm so stupid, I can't figure anything out! Commander, tell me how! Tell meee!

lines.line: I wanted to help at the pop-up shop so I could buy a special-edition game, but I ended up in debt somehow. Commander, help... I'll do anything...
I wanted to help at the pop-up shop so I could buy a special-edition game, but I ended up in debt somehow. Commander, help... I'll do anything...
C-Commandeeer! You finally came to help?! ...Huh? You paid off all the things I broke? Oh, thank you, thank you!

I wanted to serve you and help here so I could afford a game, but... Work is hard, and I'm losing more money from breaking stuff than I am making money... Thank goodness I have you, Commander. I-I'll do everything I can to pay you back!
I hear that game I want is a two-player game. I-if you want, maybe you and I could...?
Part of the reason I wanted to help out was because the outfit was cute... What do you think? Does it look good on me? Ahh, I'm sorry... I guess now isn't an appropriate time...
You paid off my debts AND bought the game for me? Ah, aaah... Commander, you're too nice to me... How can I ever repay you?
T-touch me all you want...! Consider it my thanks for your help!
I-I'm sorry... Let me just curl up in a ball and die...
Huh? Y-you like me, even when I'm like this...? Th-thank you...
Ahh... Commander, s-sit anywhere you like! I've been out of my room for so long that I'm totally unstable... I don't wanna work anymore...
C-commissions? But I've already worked so hard today...
If you like how this looks on me... I-I can wear it again for you. That isn't enough to repay your kindness, though... Ahh, what do I do...
CNT-68 armored cruiser - Chien Wu.
I am Chien Wu, of the Dragon Empery. Yes, I have little to speak of in the way of service history, but never mind that - just see me for who I am now.

It's a pleasure to meet you. I am Chien Wu. I take it you're this port's Commander? I see you're wearing a fairly elegant uniform, although it could be improved in a few ways. We have 30 minutes left for this meeting... That's just enough to tailor you a new set of clothes.
You've arrived. I'll say, your fashion sense has improved somewhat. Keep wearing my suggested outfits and you'll be like a new person in no time. Heehee.

I'm designing the next season's fashion - do you have something to discuss with me? ...Not really? Alright, then could you fetch me the fashion magazine lying over there? Since you have nothing better to do.
I'm busy. Whatever you want, it'll have to wait. Also, Commander, your schedule says that you should be focusing on your paperwork, not sitting here lounging around.
You want some fashionable and comfortable clothes, do you? Find someone else, then. It's not in my style to compromise for the sake of comfort.
Perfect clothing not only changes your outward appearance, it also gives you inner strength. As a professional, my every stitch and every thread must be flawless.
Is squandering time like this a hobby of yours?
Is this your way of complimenting my attire? It's gorgeous, I know. I went through great pains to cut the cloth just... Pardon? It was ME you were complimenting?
Interested in this, are you? Do you want to go a step further? Then you'll have to work for it♥
My schedule for later is packed, so make it snappy with those missions of yours.

Impressive - you finished your missions on time. A reward, you say? Heehee. I suggest finishing your work ahead of instead of on schedule next time. If you can manage that... Well, I'll consider a reward.
It's time to check your mail. Don't forget.
You've returned earlier than expected, so I assume your mission went quite well. Similarly, I've finished most of my work. I just need to review a few more... Oh, get me a cup of coffee, would you?
The commission team has returned on time. I'm concentrating on designing new fashion, so kindly fetch and inspect the supplies by yourself.
Allow me to demonstrate the perfect combination of fashion and power.
Our enemies? You mean those tasteless rubes?
It's over already? That was more fun than I anticipated.
Uncultured swine. This is not over, you hear me?
You're going nowhere, swine!
It will take more than that to defeat me.
Your naval cap is poorly shaped, your uniform's shoulders don't fit, and your pants are sagging... God, your fashion sense is just... Here, a list of proposed improvements. Take it and leave.
The moment you had the best sense? Good question. When you appointed me as your secretary, perhaps?
I don't chat with you because I want to. I'm just concerned that you may not grasp my fashion principles. Still, I'll admit that having conversations with you is enjoyable.
I'll fix your uniform, so hold still for a second. After all, I understand your appeal better than anyone else. There. Now you're all good.

As the times change, so do people's aesthetic tastes. I was once ready to chase the ever-changing trends of fashion... then you showed me something different: The truth that there is some unchanging beauty in the world.
For me? It'll go well with my attire... Heehee. I suppose I've rubbed off on you, because your tastes are getting better all the time. Go on, don't just stand there - put it on my finger.
Thank you. You have good taste.
You call those old rags "clothing"? Get rid of them and let me tailor something for you!
When designing clothes, you ought to incorporate new elements.

ex.line: You've arrived... Why aren't you wearing the clothes I made? ...You want to keep them in pristine condition? There's no point - I can always just make more. I made those clothes just for you, so go and put them on right now.
These outfits I designed for myself, and here is a list of elements that you like. It was just for reference. I didn't use the ones that didn't match or were too tacky.
I'm busy, so keep it brief. Mh... No, I can set some time aside just for you.
Your collar is too tight? Let's see if I can change it... I'm not compromising for the sake of comfort, I'm simply not opposed to some variety.
You want to try your hand at sewing? It just so happens I have a minute. Here, take this sewing kit. Oh, and please be careful not to prick your fingers.
Using your time on such pointless things again? Remember to comb out my hair later.
You want to see me in a different style of dress? Sure. While I'm at it, I'll prepare a matching set of clothes for you.
There are clothes better suited for this occasion... Heehee. Satisfy me and I'll let you see them♥
Get started on your missions. Finish them ahead of schedule and I'll give you a reward.
You completed your missions? Alright, come here for your reward. Iiit's... a chocolate sandwich! Heehee. What did you imagine you were going to get? The pleasure of doing something to me?
Get me some coffee with... No, I knew you'd be too busy to remember, so I already made my own. Hmm... Why does it taste so odd? I could've sworn I made it the right way...
The commission team has returned. Remember to inspect the wares. I'll go as soon as I finish drawing out this design.

I used to only care about clothes and the wearer's looks. Now, I place more importance on the wearer themselves. You've changed my perception, and that's allowed me to create even more perfect garments. For that, I'm grateful, Commander.

lines.line: There's still time. Let's set out once I've finished adjusting my dress... If you have nothing better to do, at least put on some tea.
There's still time. Let's set out once I've finished adjusting my dress... If you have nothing better to do, at least put on some tea.
You're here quite early. Judging by that look, this design of mine is a hit. Heehee♪
This perfume is your favorite? Good taste. It goes well with my dress for tonight, so I'll be sure to use it.
If you have something to say, now's the time. I'm almost finished here, so I could certainly have a chat with you.
Oh? The train of my dress is a mess? It's hard to fix if I have to reach behind me, so give me a hand.
Tired, are you? While you're free to rest on the bed, you'll first have to take off your tuxedo. So it doesn't... get wrinkles, you know?
Do you like this accessory? I'll make a brooch version of it for you. It would go perfectly on that empty breast pocket on your tuxedo.
Are you trying to help adjust my outfit? Or... were you doing something else?
If you want it that badly, wait until after the party. There'll be plenty of time then♥
We'll be late to the party at this rate, so get those missions done quickly. I'll help you... depending on how sincerely you ask for it, I suppose.
Mission complete. Let's get going now.
I can't believe you're still this busy before the party. *sigh*... Take a break. There's some free real estate on your tuxedo, so I'll go get some accessories for you.

My outfit looks different to what you're used to? Well, I'm coming with you this time, so naturally I need to dress accordingly. While on the topic... Your tuxedo being eye-catching isn't as important as it matching my look♥
Don't just stare - help me... Look, I meant that in the "help me balance" sense... Are you trying to take my shoes off?
Don't just stare - help me... Look, I meant that in the "help me balance" sense... Are you trying to take my shoes off?
There is no work to be done, so I'm going to rest tomorrow... Say, if you're not busy, how about you stay the night?
Hey, Commander, you smell like my perfume... Perhaps we mingled a little too closely at the party.
Anything you want to do during our break? Depending on your answer, I might even let you do it to me♥
I put on high heels and sacrificed comfort for looks, so standing around for extended periods is pretty tiring... If you're not busy, might I ask for a foot massage, hmm?
You want to peel off my stockings? Ah, you and your tedious ideas... Fine, come here♥
Well, I'm off duty anyway, so I guess it's fine to be a little dishevelled.
Huh? Are you trying to mess with me? My, you've grown quite bold.
Careful, or you'll ruin my... Hah! Kidding. The party has ended, so I'll let you have your way this time♥
Yet another mission? What a mood-ruiner... I'll give you 30 minutes. Finish it before then.
I see you completed a mission. Now your time is mine♥

Your tuxedo has too much going on, making it hard to take off? Sounds like a you problem. Fine, I'll help you take- Hey, you feel warm to the touch... Is that because you've drank, or is it... something else?

Since we don't often get to spend time together, we should make the most of... Hmm? I stepped on my dress's train? Yes, I suppose keeping the dress on is inconvenient... Heehee. Were you expecting something different?

Come here instead of staring blankly at the door. It took me all night to tailor-sew these details. It should perfectly meet everything you requested... Come closer and I'll listen to your important feedback before anything else.

Come here instead of staring blankly at the door. It took me all night to tailor-sew these details. It should perfectly meet everything you requested... Come closer and I'll listen to your important feedback before anything else.
Finally, you're here. Do you know what you should do? Put on some coffee, first of all. Straighten up. You don't have all the time in the world to watch from the side.
Come closer... That's it - you can see all the fine details at this distance. Heehee. Seems like you grasp the meaning of the hidden design elements - right, Commander?
Designing the back straps took quite a lot of work. Now, I'll give you a chance - feel it with your fingers, then give me your appraisal.
Why aren't you saying anything? Can't find the right words? Or are you so content that you're left speechless? Use your words. I don't like having to guess.
Take a seat and observe again from this angle. Appreciate how it fits and how it looks from new angles and different lighting. Oh, and don't rush it with your feedback. We have plenty of time.
Hah... Is this your way of expressing affirmation? I'll graciously turn a blind eye to it this time.
Heehee... You have a keen eye. Yes, I paid special attention to this design.
Mgh... Seems I've more than met your expections...
Don't you still have missions left? Go and get them done. I'll reserve your observation session for when you come back.
You finished your missions? Excellent. Let's resume our observation session, then.
You're a little late. Oh well - I used the time to tweak a few minor things anyway. Now, tell me what you think. I want to hear your first impression.

If you don't have any feedback, then could you acknowledge this special permission I've granted you? Carefully memorize the aesthetic, the texture, and the feel in your heart and on your fingertips... Okay?
Hai Yung-class protected cruiser - Hai Yung.

I am Hai Yung of the Dragon Empery. I hope to be on good terms with everyone in this port. You? O-of course I intend to b-be on good terms with you! Just professionally, though! It's not like I want to be friends with you or anything! Hmph!

Please to meet you. I am Hai Yung. If you really are a first-rate commander, I assume you already know who I am? Huh? You don't? Hmph... Well, I'll have you understand sooner rather than later! In any case, if you need anything done, just leave it to me!
Welcome back, Commander. I hope you came to work ready to give it your all. Naturally, I'm already in tip-top condition.
I heard washing pots and pans with lemon water is good for removing stains... Huh? It'll just make them corrode faster?

The creativity of the desserts in this cookbook makes them all look so appetizing... What, you want to try them? O-of course I don't mind making these to share. M-maybe I'll make some for you too! Hmph!

Apparently, certain colors are associated with different emotions, so I've color-coded your files to help you organize them more effectively. See, watch me find exactly what you need— Wait, huh? No way... Is this method not useful after all...?
Hmph! Stop staring at me and focus on your work! Huh?! I wouldn't notice if I wasn't also staring at you? Wh-who would ever want to stare at you?! Hmph!
Ermm... Wh-what's your deal? You're messing up my hair... H-hey, stop staring at my forehead!
That's right, I came up with this fashionable ensemble all on my own! If you want some advice... maybe I could lend you an ear!
Eek! P-please stop that! They're not going to get any bigger no matter how much you touch! Even I know that!
Commander, you're not done with your missions, are you? ...It, it isn't because I'm concerned about you or anything! ...That's right! I have to keep a close eye on you because you're a known slacker!
Mission complete. Let's take it easy for now and have some honey water. I've been keeping this super-special honey stashed away for years! ...Huh? Expiration date? Honey doesn't expire... does it?
Commander, there's new mail for you. I'd urge you to read and reply as soon as possible.

Welcome back, and good work out there. H-huh? Why am I being so nice to you all of a sudden?! I just wanted to say something nice b-because it looked like you were having a rough time! ...Hmph! I knew I should've just kept being strict with you!
Looks like the commission fleet has returned. Shall I go bring them the sweets that I made?
Heh. Look, I'm even stronger than before. Try not to rely on me too much, got it? Well, umm... actually, it's okay to rely on me just a little bit!
Commander, I... I want you to pay close attention to us!
It's only natural that the victory is mine. Y-you were watching me closely, right?
Is everyone okay? Please pull back to avoid further damage!
Watch me carefully, Commander!
You dare underestimate me? I'll have you know, I drank ginseng root coffee this morning!
S-stop staring at my forehead already! I'll have you know, it's a trendy hairstyle! Got a problem with that? Hmph!
Chi An said that I'm always talking about you...? N-nonsense! Wh-why would I be going on and on about you in public anyway? Hmph!

Commander, are you trying to make coffee by any chance? Make sure the water doesn't get any hotter than 96 °C, or else the brew will go bitter. Wh-what are you looking at?! I just don't you to waste the coffee!

I've been craving sweets a lot recently, so let's look into why this might be happening... Craving sweets is often associated with falling in love...? Huh? Wait, does this mean I'm falling in love with the Com— Commander?! H-how long have you been here?!

You want me to try being nicer to you? It's not like I'm trying to be particularly harsh with you or anything... Like, I'm pretty normal in front of everyone else, but when it comes to you... I get all nervous and my heart starts pounding real fast, and even if I try to be nice to you, I can't... I'm not normally like that at all, so it has to be all your fault! Hmph!

I fully understand what you're trying to convey by giving me this gift. Which means, during these moments, I need to seriously and carefully consider your feelings and respond to them... So yes, I'd be glad to accept this. Thank you for accepting me for who I am... b-but it's too late for take-backs now, got it?! So hurry up and put it on already! Hmph!
Th-this is so thoughtful... Hmph. Thank you.
So, help a girl out? What's trendy and fashionable these days?
Wanna go hang out after this?

ex.line: Commander, I trust you're in tip-top shape to begin today's work. Before that, though, do you notice something different about me? Heheh, right, it's my makeup. After all, I... A-actually, it's not like I wanted to get dolled up or anything! Ahh, jeez! Fine, I just wanted to give you a little surprise, okay? Hmph!

I'm taking some sweets over to Chen Hai and her friends shortly, but there aren't any for you! ...H-hey, why do you look so disappointed? Here, I baked a caramel cake for you instead as a way of expressing my feelings! So go get it yourself!

What's wrong? You look awfully beat. Has work been too stressful? Here, give me your hand... I read a book that says, holding hands with someone is a good way to relieve stress. So, do you feel better?
I've already completed my work to perfection, so what's wrong with me looking at you? You, on the other hand... Seeing as how you still have time to pay attention to me, have YOU finished your work?
Ugh, I knew you had something against my forehead— Huh? You LIKE it? ...S-seriously?!
So you finally noticed what's different about me? ...I-it's not like I did it or anything because you said you liked it or anything! Hmph!
Just because this isn't the first time we are doing this... doesn't make it any less embarrassing! Jeez!

Welcome back. I brought you tea and some towels. Dry yourself off, take a seat, and relax... I'm being pretty thoughtful? W-well, yeah! I want to try being more open and straightforward... Hey, what's with that look on your face?!

I thought that the heart-throbbing honeymoon phase was supposed to be short-lived... so why does my heart still pound like crazy whenever I'm near the Commander? ...Ugh, whatever, forget that stupid book! What's more important is that we can both move forward into the future while being truly happy!

lines.line: Very well, Commander, I'll leave the photography to you. I entrust you to capture my grace and elegance and record it into memory! Just so you're clear though, th-this is just an outfit that's in vogue... It's not like I chose to wear it for you or anything!

Very well, Commander, I'll leave the photography to you. I entrust you to capture my grace and elegance and record it into memory! Just so you're clear though, th-this is just an outfit that's in vogue... It's not like I chose to wear it for you or anything!

You came at just the right time, Commander. The scenery here is quite wonderful, so how about going on a stroll with me to soak it all in? Though, umm... It might be a bit hard to move around in this dress... Wh-what do you think?
Hmm... If I raise my arms a bit and turn slightly to the side, I'll probably look slimmer...? Wh-what? I-I didn't say anything! I was just thinking of how to get the photo to come out better!
Commander, why don't we take a photo together? Come a little closer then. The lighting here is the best... I-it's not like I made preparations for this or anything! Isn't that obvious? Hmph!
This place really is breathtaking, huh? Next time, I should invite the others as well... Hey, I never said I wasn't going to invite you! It's just... I already brought you here the first time, right?
You know what they say... "You have to get closer to really make your photos pop." So, umm... Hey, Commander, can you come a bit closer? Just for the sake of the photos...
Did you only notice my hairstyle? You really ought to appreciate my clothes more too! ...I, I just want to make sure my aesthetic sense isn't off, that's all! Hmph!
Oh, are you f-fixing my clothes? Thanks...
D-did the design of my clothes catch your eye?
There you are, Commander. I was just reading up on how a wider aperture lens is good for enhancing the atmosphere, making it easier to take close-up shots. Want to try taking some photos?

I've been putting a lot of effort into researching fashion and photography recently, and I look pretty good today as a result of that hard work, right? B-by the way, I heard that photos taken under maple leaves symbolize eternal love... I-it's not like I planned this out or anything! It's just something I happened to notice!
Chang Feng-class destroyer - Chang Feng.
I am Chang Feng, lead ship of the Dragon Empery's Chang Feng-class destroyers. Word has it that my sisters have been quite a handful for you, so I do believe a scolding is called for~

Good day, Commander. I am Chang Feng, name ship of the Chang Feng-class destroyers. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance. Should you need anything done, be it missions or housework, please leave it to me~♪
Commander, please give me a moment? I'm still tidying up the room... I know it's already sparkly clean, but... I just can't help myself!

Oh, Commander... I've been posting videos on Juustagram giving people housework tips, and the responses have surprisingly been very positive! I'm really glad I've been able to do something to help others!
Commander, I've brought you tea and snacks. They might not be anywhere as good as Lung Wu's, but please don't hold that against me. I'm also working hard to improve my cooking!
Commander, Fei Yuen and Fu Po aren't roughhousing around in your office, right? Phew... I'm just glad they're not causing you trouble.

Um... Commander, would you happen to have a ladder or something of the sort? I'd like to... dust off some of the cobwebs on the ceiling. Hmm? You'd like to help too? Okay~ I'll grab you a rag and a duster.
Heehee. Isn't this scarf-folded-into-kitty-ears cute~?
My apron's still dusty from all the cleaning, so maybe it's best not to touch me too much right now...
Hwuh?! P-please don't do something like that so flippantly... I, I'll have you take responsibility, you know!
Commander, you still have some missions left to complete. I've compiled them all here, so please work through them as soon as you can~
Mission complete. I washed and hung out the blankets and sheets, so now you'll be able to enjoy a good night's rest~
There's a letter addressed to you, Commander. Don't forget to reply~
Commander, thank you for your hard work. I've prepared a fresh change of clothes for you, so please get changed at your convenience and rest awhile~
The commission fleet has returned. It's a tough job out there, so I'll go bring some tea and snacks out to them.
May I wield this power to be of even greater service to you.
Very well. Everything has been prepared to perfection~♪
A clean victory! I'm so happy for you~!
It's hard to see through the fog... I'm so sorry...
You're not going anywhere!
Ugh... It hurts... and my skirt's getting dirty too...
...You really ought to tidy up your office more.
Though Fei Yuen and Fu Po tend to leave a mess in their wake and I have to pick up after them, they're still so, so adorable~♪ What do you think about those two, Commander?

Commander, I put some snacks on your desk. Please make sure you wash your hands first before eating, though. If there's anything else you'd like to have, just let me know. I'll cook anything you want~♪
Oh, just give me a minute to finish folding your laundry— Huh? Th-this is your, umm... Oh my.... *blushes*

Commander, I've finished washing your sheets and airing out your mattress. I hope you'll be able to sleep well tonight, accompanied by the fragrance of the sun... And maybe, you'll even carry my sincere sentiments towards you into your restful slumber... Ehehe~
I suppose this makes us loving members of a new family now... From now on, I'll keep the house nice and clean for you every day, waiting for you to come home to me. Heehee~
Thank you, Commander. How can I possibly return the favor... Give me some time to think about it!
Don't cause trouble for the others, okay~?
Huh? Cleaning, with a gun?

ex.line: The documents have been organized, the desk has been wiped clean, and tea is ready... Now, Commander will be able to work with peace of mind~
If you do this, then this... you'll be able to fold your laundry quickly and neatly. Convenient, right? More time to spare is more time to spend with you, Commander~
Hm? I'm reading the recipes for your favorite dishes, given to me by Lung Wu. If I can memorize them all, we won't have to go out to eat anymore~ After all, I can just make them for you at home~♪
Why is this place such a mess...? Oh, I see. Fei Yuen and Fu Po came by? Well, I suppose I'll clean up first. The scolding can wait until later. Heehee.
Commander, do you have a ladder I can borrow? I'd like to dust off the top of the bookshelves... Huh? Y-you can just lift me up? O-okay then... *blushes*
Mmhmm~ Getting headpats from you always fills me with motivation~
Hm? What's wrong? Are you in a bad mood? Come to me, then... There, there~ Everything will be okay~
Please don't do this in public, Commander... At least wait until it's just the two of us... Hauuu... *blushes*
Commander, I know you've been hard at work. Would you like to unwind by taking a bath? I've already made the tub nice and clean for you, and I'll even give you a massage if you'd like~
Commander, I've made the bed for you— Hmm? What's wrong? You'd like me to stay with you...? Sure, I don't mind~ But first, let me take a shower, then change into some clean pajamas~♪

lines.line: Oh, Commander~ Please give me a moment; Fei Yuen, Fu Po, and I are still finishing up our spring cleaning. Why don't you come inside for now and have some warm tea?
Oh, Commander~ Please give me a moment; Fei Yuen, Fu Po, and I are still finishing up our spring cleaning. Why don't you come inside for now and have some warm tea?
Commander, the New Year is just around the corner, isn't it? Hm? You haven't started on your spring cleaning yet? Well, I'd be more than glad to lend you a hand~
There's a lifehack when it comes to wiping windows, so I'll make a Juustagram post about it later. Oh, but Commander, if you ever need a window wiped down, just let me know~
I've almost finished preparations for our New Year banquet. Will you join us for dinner on New Year's Eve?
Fei Yuen and Fu Po? Heehee, don't worry. I gave them an earful for knocking over your vase earlier~

I'd like to nudge that bottom-most lantern over a bit. Do you think you could help me, Commander? ...Putting up lanterns together during the New Year really does make the two of us feel like a family...
Mhm! I'll give this spring cleaning my all!
It's pretty cold out there, isn't it? I have the heater on, so come on in~
Commander, you can't do that... I'm still in the middle of spring cleaning!
Phew... And now, for the finishing stroke... Ehehe, Commander, this little heart is for you. Thanks for all your hard work~
This red plum branch is for you, Commander. I pray that it brings you, peace, fortune, joy, and smooth sailing. Hopefully, the warmth of spring will return to us sooner as well.

Commander, this is the new Ru-ware tea set I just purchased. Absolutely beautiful, isn't it? We have a custom to bring out the best things for those you care about, which is why I decided to invite you~♪

Commander, this is the new Ru-ware tea set I just purchased. Absolutely beautiful, isn't it? We have a custom to bring out the best things for those you care about, which is why I decided to invite you~♪
Commander, I've finished preparing the tea and snacks. Yes, this is the Ru-ware tea set I told you about the other day! A wonderful work of art, wouldn't you agree?
Once I've finished cleaning and my sisters settle down a bit, I usually enjoy making some tea and taking time to enjoy the scenery. You don't find that boring, do you?

Commander, please take a look at this~♪ Don't you think these flowers match perfectly with this Ru-ware vase? Ru-ware ceramics are very hard to make, which is why we must put even more effort into picking out the perfect flowers and arranging them to bring out its beauty!
I've been fascinated with Ru-ware celadon as of late, so I've been reading up on them. Commander, would you like to read about them together?
Commander, I see you've been appreciating this Ru-ware tea set with great care. Have you taken a liking to it? ...I had a hunch you'd like it, so I bought an identical set just for you~♪
Yes, this is my cat-eared scarf. I thought you'd like it, Commander. Ehehe~

"After the rain's passing comes blue skies, after the cloud's parting comes new hues." ...The colors of the glaze on Ru-ware celadon are truly beautiful. In fact, I've drawn inspiration from them for this outfit. Do you like how I look?
Oh my.... *blushes*... Commander, could you please... put the teacup down first...?
I thought we'd be able to share a relaxing afternoon together, so I didn't expect there to be a mission... It must be hard having your job, Commander. Please let me know if there's anything I can do.
Finally, the mission has been completed. Are you hungry? Would you like me to make something?
Commander, please have some tea. It's just the right temperature to be enjoyed~

Even though I have tasted this tea every day, it somehow seems different today~ Mellower, sweeter, with a gentle aftertaste... Could it be that this tea set has imbued the tea with greater fragrance than usual... or, is it thanks to you being here that this moment is sweeter and more joyous?
Chang Feng-class destroyer - Fu Po.

I'm Fu Po, second of the Chang Feng-class destroyers! Ehehe~ By the way, I stuck a little surprise on you— Wait, huh? Why's it on the ground... I'll go pick it up... How come a bug toy is running so fast!?

Heya, Commander! Fu Po, cleverest of the Chang Feng-class destroyers, is reporting in! One look at this place, and my brain's already overflowing with prank ideas... Err, I mean, uh, plans! Battleplan ideas!
You're here, Commander! Here's a nice and soft cushion for you to sit down on~ Hurry up and sit down already! ...Huh? Why isn't the cushion making a sound?!

Now I'll glue this to the Commander's fountain pen... Whuh? Commander?! When'd you get here?! N-nothing, I wasn't doing anything at all! Wait, why's my hand... stuck to my clothes? Commander, help meeee!!
AHHHH!! Commander! What are you doing with my notebook?! Give it back to me! All my secret plans are in it... Hey! It's not a doodle pad!!
Ehehe~ Well, well. Aren't you the most perfect plan I've ever cooked up. I'll just wait until sis goes to do her cleaning to sneak away, then— Huh? Commander?! Why did you bring Chang Feng here?!
While you're busy with work, I'm gonna tie your shoelaces together~ Wait, huh?! You don't have any laces?!
Ehehe... Step one: get you to lower your guard~ Heehee~
AHH! You stuck something weird on me! Where is it?!
You're a meanie, Commander!
Commander, hurry up and finish up your missions! I put your itinerary in the desk drawer— Wait, huh? You went and got it just like that?! But what happened to all the balloons?!
It's all thanks to me and my plan, right? Ehehe~ Wh-what do you mean, my scribbles made no sense to you at all?!
Commander, your mail is— WoooOOOah! Phew, nearly slipped and fell... Ugh, who the heck splashed water here?! ...Oh, maybe it was me...
...Commander!! Boo!! Hehe, did I scare ya? Huh? N-not at all? Because my shadow gave it away?! No freaking waaaay!
The commission team is back! Go greet them right away! ...And in the meantime, I'll... I-it's nothing, I didn't say anything!
I'm suuuuuuper strong now! ...I think!
Heh heh~! My plan is PERFECT! Let's freakin' gooooo!
Ehehe~ That's the ever-so-clever Fu Po for you!
Uwaaaaah! Sis, Commander, help meeeee!
Ehehe, I just came up with a GREAT idea!
Owww! Stop hitting me! Waaah!!
You're going to chew me out again, aren't you...? W-well, in that case, maybe I just won't play with you anymore...
It's not my fault the cup fell over! The wind from the AC was just too strong! ...Okay, okay! I get it! Stop looking at me like that! It was my fault! I'll go clean it up...

Waaah... Commander, sis chewed me out again... and said that I'm not allowed to play pranks on people anymore... Waah! (Wait a sec, what if I peel down the inner layer of Commander's cap and slip a little froggy inside...)

All done! Look, Commander! I've finished drafting an epic adventure plan for Fei Yuen and Fu Shun! Pretty amazing isn't it? ...Hm? It'd be better if I did it this way? ...Huh, you're totally right... Wait, Commander? Since when could you decipher my drawings?!
...How'd you spoil my prank yet again?! W-wait, stop going through my pockets! ...Here, it's just my favorite candy! I'll share some with you!
Is this some kind of new prank item or something? Lemme see... Wait, huh? Is this what I think it is? HUH?! It's for ME?!
Oh, this! I've had my eyes on this! Thanks, Commander!
Sis, I'm heading off!
Ehehe~ Let's sneak over to the kitchen later!

ex.line: (......Why aren't you heaping praise on me yet?! I even prepared a surprise for you by putting away all your documents! ...Huh? Wh-what's going on? Why do you have such a stern look on your face...?)

I'll just glue these pieces of paper together, then draw a little sump'n sump'n on it... and voila! What an ingenious idea! ...AH! Commander! Don't touch that—AHHHHH!! Our hands are stuck together now! What do we do?!!
Commander, take a look at my next plan! It's already perfect, but I'm willing to take your input! ...Huh? What do you mean you don't get it? You're right here, and Fei Yuen's right here...

Commander, I made a matcha latte for you~! Ehehe, I'm not playing around this time, so go ahead and drink it! ...Huh?! Is it really that nasty? Let me try, then... *cough* *hack*! BLEHHH... Wait, was that a can of wasabi powder?!
While you're busy with work, I'm gonna replace your shoes with cute animal plushie slippers... H-hey, I can't get them off...! Commander, lift your feet up!
H-hey! I didn't even do anything!
I'll just sneak up behind the Commander and— Huh?! How'd you know I was there! Nooo! Now I'm being hugged!!
Wh-what is this?! This wasn't in the plaaaan!
...Welcome back! Pa-POW! ...Huh? Why isn't the popper going off? Lemme see—WHUUUUAH!! Why'd it explode all of a sudden?! That was freakin' scary...
The commission team's back! Let's go greet them! ...Oh, give me just a sec. Lemme grab some prank items to give them a little scare... Huh? No good? Aww...
Commander, let's go grab some cake together! Ehehe, this time for sure, my plan will— Hey, hey! Don't just swallow the thing in one go! I wrote you something on a slip of paper! Spit it out!

lines.line: Oh... Well, shoot, you found me... Shhhhh! Don't tell anyone that I'm here though! Seriously, Commander, I'm begging you!
Oh... Well, shoot, you found me... Shhhhh! Don't tell anyone that I'm here though! Seriously, Commander, I'm begging you!
Huh? How did the Commander see through my plan so easily? Ugh, I thought it was absolutely foolproof... Just where did I go wrong?

Commander, you're not leaving yet? You're drawing too much attention if you stay here! Oh, right! Why don't you hide under the desk here with me and join in on my New Year's prank... I mean, uh, New Year's surprise!
So, what do you think? This night stealth cloak of mine is pretty cool, huh? Heh heh~ It's not just cool, by the way. It also helps me blend into the darkness... but only if you turn off the lights!
Drat! How did Fei Yuen manage to find me as well?! How long have you known— Wait, Fei Yuen! Shhh! Keep it down, or... Oh no, I already hear Chang Feng's footsteps! Commander, save meeee!!
Heh heh, want me to give you a rundown on my plan? Take a look. So, this is me hiding in the kitchen. After lights out... No! This is me wearing my stealth cloak! Not a monster!!
Commander, your hands smell real nice... *gasp*, I bet you've been sneaking food!
You like my stealth cloak that much? Well, maybe if tonight's plan goes well, I'll give it to you as a present!
H-hey! No pranks here! The strings are gonna come undone!
Commander, hurry up and finish up your missions! I put your itinerary in the desk drawer— Wait, huh? You went and got it just like that?! But what happened to all the balloons?!
It's all thanks to me and my plan, right? Ehehe~ Wh-what do you mean, my scribbles made no sense to you at all?!
Commander, your mail is— WoooOOOah! Phew, nearly slipped and fell... Ugh, who the heck splashed water here?! ...Oh, maybe it was me...
Waaah! Commander, if you stand there, everyone's going to start gathering here! Ugh, looks like I'm going to have to resort to my backup plan... W-wait, are those footsteps I hear?!
The commission team is back! Go greet them right away! ...And in the meantime, I'll... I-it's nothing, I didn't say anything!
D-don't worry! Times like these are when you gotta learn to think on the fly! If Chang Feng asks, tell her that we were playing hide-and-seek! That'll cover everything up perfectly! Promise me!
Type UP41 battleship - Raffaello.

Grazie, my beloved Commander! I'm Raffaello, a Sardegnian girl who cares little about hierarchies and stuff and more about defining herself as an artist committed to capturing beauty. My plan is to draw every single moment we spend together in painstaking detail - and especially to draw the little things even you yourself don't notice!

You're that famous Commander, huh? Lemme get a reeeal close, intimate look at you... Oh, excuse me! Yet to introduce myself, haven't I? I'm Raffaello of the Sardegna Empire, and I am NOT a freak! Hope you don't mind if I make every beautiful moment in your life into a painting! I'm gonna paint all the less flattering ones too, just so you know.
Heyo! There you are, my wellspring of inspiration and favorite research subject. I can't wait to see what fun encounters you and I will have today☆

A-ha, you wanna know more about me, don'tcha? Well, be my guest - ask all the questions you want! Later, I mean - 'cause I've been staying up and drawing for a whole week straight and my head isn't on straight right now. Let me just make a staw-and-cup telephone and we'll do some direct brain-to-brain communication instead!

The natural lighting in your office is just perfect! Can I make this my temporary studio? I already brought my sleeping bag! ...Huh? You're worried I'll get carried away and not go outside for a whole week again? I mean, I go outside when I've got no inspo. When I do, though, I draw 'til the well's completely dry!
You've been getting reports of some weirdo hanging out on rooftops 'round the port? I was just... drawing in different places, that's all. Is that not allowed? Even if I do it for free?

A casual observer might say you've made the same serious look while reading papers today, but I counted at least seven different types of gazes! When you're reading something especially unreasonable, you unconsciously look up and to the right...You knew I've been observing you this whole time? Well, you're welcome!

Imagine if we covered all your office walls with mirrors - then I could observe you from dozens of different angles! Hm? That'd make it harder for others to navigate? That's kinda what I was going for, you kn- Err, I mean! It's all for the sake of art!
Oohh! The inspo is kicking in! Ogh, ohh!
Oh, Commander, next time you wanna get my attention, can you form a cross with your index and middle fingers? From my point of view, that composition will look so peak!
Ohhh... Oh, frick yeah... You got my heart pumping now!
Hey, you've still got missions to do. Mind if I sit beside you and draw while I wait? I'll pour you some coffee while I'm at it!
Lessgo! Mission complete! Let's balance these pens on our chins and run 'round the office for a change of pace! ...No? I'll do it just by myself, then!
New letterino! Hey, why don't we fold it up into a paper boat and send 'er down the river?
Ah, back you are! Hold on a sec... There! Your side profile looks suh-frickin'-preme from this angle!
Commission complete! I'll go say hi with you! Promised the girls I'd draw the moment you meet up with them, y'see!
Props for building me! I'll be sure to draw many, many more masterpieces of you♪
Let's go! I'm gonna make a masterpiece as destructive as a meteorite strike!
A perfect victory, and a perfect source of inspo!
Fiddlesticks. I won't hold back next time!
Get a load of the power of ART!
Hmm. Getting kinda fed up here...
You were a blank sheet with so much potential, and you turned into an old painting you can't change... Man, what a disappointment.

Still doesn't feel like we're that close, you and I... Be calm, though! My methods guarantee we'll get closer! Oh, also, it feels like our pace is faster than usual today... Dynamic beauty like that still makes for a good painting, though!
I'm sorting through my refs, and it's going well! You know, every single thing you do really DOES inspire me! I'mma draw every last one of these then hang 'em all over your office while you're out.

Seems you've gotten used to me observing you - from your first cuppa joe in the morning, to how you grimace while reading paperwork at night... It still ain't nearly enough for me, though! Lemme put a microcamera on your collar - I need my fix! What? Is that a step too far?

I'm happy to report that after extensive, detailed, and intimate observations, the conclusion I've come to iiis... you really are my endless source of inspo! O flawless God of Inspiration of mine, let me depict every little part of you♪

Finally... Finally this precious moment has come. The gentle touch of your fingers will forever be imprinted upon my heart... Heehee. Allow me the honor to depict every moment of our lives together from now on, using the most pious brushstrokes!
Ooh... I-I've never been given such a perfect gift. Have you been watching me, Commander? YES? Hahaha☆
Have you cooked up some new scheme? Can I hear about it?
Mmhh, this atmosphere... It's Roma!
We're gonna make works of art that transcend time!

ex.line: My precious companion, my personal gemstone of art... It makes me so happy that I get to see your gentle eyes before anyone else! I'm gonna draw every little part of you in incredible detail today!
My room's getting full of reference materials. Hm? It's high time I sorted it all out? But each and every one is a source of inspo! Besides, my collection is a lot more modest than it used to be!

I've been studying sketching from different angles lately! Like by hanging upside-down from the ceiling like this... Aww, you won't let me, huh? Oh well! I did figure out that your smile looks 3.7 degrees gentler from this angle.
Even though this pencil is almost completely used up, sharpening it down to this length feels the most comfortable to draw with... Hm? Did I get the desk dusty again? I'll clean it up right now.
Hmm... From an architectural point of view, your office would be perfect for installing a secret door somewhere. It'll be convenient to have - for all sorts of purposes!
Ooh! I need to take your hand... and sculpt a copy of it!
Ahh, no matter how you touch me, it makes my heart skip a beat!
Ooh... I-I've gotta draw what you just did!
Welcome back, my beloved Commander! Gotta say, once again... you make my heart flutter from every angle today!
First I gazed at you, observed you, then came closer and drew you... and now, you've become an irreplaceable part of my life. My pen and my heart - they both belong to you, my beloved Commander♪

lines.line: Heheh! You were not invited to this place, and as its guardian, I must punish you by... Oh, wait, wait, stop! This angle... This outline... It's simply perfect! Turning you into stone would be a waste, so just stay here and let me observe you every day!

Heheh! You were not invited to this place, and as its guardian, I must punish you by... Oh, wait, wait, stop! This angle... This outline... It's simply perfect! Turning you into stone would be a waste, so just stay here and let me observe you every day!
What's this? Trying to escape today? Sorry, that's not gonna happen until you finish this Eternal Beverage. Be good and stay put so I can observe you♪

Don'tcha agree that the role of Protector of Love and Beauty fits me like a glove? Presiding over a holy domain, watching an eternal collection... Ooh, just putting it into words is giving me tons of inspo!
You wanna leave, huh? Heh. You've entered my domain, my eternal tra- You know the drill! You're the best ref I could ask for, and I'm gonna draw out each and every one of your expressions!
Whoa there, intruder! You're in my holy domain, so you must remain under my watchful gaze! Heehee. This is a great chance to draw some art, so hold real still!
A common invader means nothing to the Protector of Love and Beauty - but I didn't expect a mortal to show me such beauty... Heehee. You're staying by my side from now on!
I'll let you go if you manage to drink all the liquid in this pot. Hm? You keep drinking but it never runs out? Heehee! The gifts of God are endless!
Hmm? I'll forgive that transgression just because you're so beautiful!
Hmm? Want a refill?
Ohh... This behavior is so blasphemous... but so good!
How dare a lowly intruder leave an unfinished mission in the domain of a god? Unacceptable!
Something just arrived... Oh, since I laid eyes on these mission rewards, they're mine now!
No matter where you run, you'll always return to me in the end. That's your bound fate, my dear collection piece♪
Ah, a commission from the mortal world? I shall permit you to briefly leave this place, then!

Despite you being a hapless invader in a god's domain, I knew from first glance that you were the perfect collection piece I've been searching for... As the Protector of Love and Beauty, I shall bind you to this place forever! Yes, because you're worth drawing for all of eternity!
Welcome to the Circus Art Roadshow! What do you think, Commander? Did my present make your heart race? I used everything I have to complete this art... And I mean EVERYTHING♪
Being a work of art is really hard! I can't move, so if I ever get an itch... I'm gonna need you to touch me right here, real gentle. Aaah♡ A bit higher~ Yes, just like that♪
Welcome to the Circus Art Roadshow! What do you think, Commander? Did my present make your heart race? I used everything I have to complete this art... And I mean EVERYTHING♪
Oooh! Seeing my perfect Commander step into my painting melts my heart away♡ Come, join my magic, and join my art☆
Being a work of art is really hard! I can't move, so if I ever get an itch... I'm gonna need you to touch me right here, real gentle. Aaah♡ A bit higher~ Yes, just like that♪
Nhaaa! The paint splotches you left behind just gave me a flash of inspiration...!
Are your eyes fixed on me, Commander...? Come, get a little closer♪
Isn't the painting's background lovely, Commander? Reach your hands out to me... Ahaha☆ Did you touch it?~
Would you like to add a stroke on me with your own hands? Let beauty guide you and leave your own unique, creative mark on your favorite spot♪
Please don't touch the art without permission...! But keep giving me inspiration please♪
Are you curious about how the colors you apply blend together? If you wanna know, you should try it once and see for yourself♪
Can't restrain your creative urges anymore?♪
Welcome your very own art magic~ Come and immerse yourself in this world I weaved from my warmth and color☆

I thought this artwork lacked soul, so I decided to liven it up into a trick painting and made it truly complete by incorporating myself as part of the art... Just kidding☆ What it was really missing was you! My inspiration, my muse, my beauty incarnate, the miracle in my magic♡
Marconi-class submarine - Maggiore Baracca.

I'm Maggiore Baracca. I may have a penchant for stimulating experiences, but I stop just short of getting into actual danger, so don't worry about me. And yes, I've been pranking you lately to get you mad at me. It's more exciting than playing with danger. Of course, I know my limits - I just want to see you scowl at me!
Ciao, Commander. I'm Maggiore Baracca, but just call me Baracca. Heehee, you look like you're lots of fun. Let's be friends♪
Oh, you're here early, Commander. Heehee. I tried to "sort" your paperwork while you were gone, but, well... Now that you know who did it, it's time to punish me♥
Commander, you wanna come with me and see if the port has any restricted areas or buildings you can only reach by scaling a wall? Don't worry about you getting hurt, because I'll be there!

Hm-hmm-hm♪ Hm? Where I went? Well, there's a crevice here that leads to the attic. It gives a great view of your office. Wanna go have a look? ...What? You don't? Alright, then I'll keep the best seat.

These missions today are so plain. How about something more exciting? Like if I were to intentionally miss my torpedoes during today's exercise... I'm not participating in any exercise? I guess not...
Commander, I organized your work files. The ordering might be a little different from what you're used to... That's reason enough for you to punish me, right?
Huh? What a letdown... I mean, thanks for the headpat! I guess...
Commander... You're gonna have to be more forceful than that.
Mgh... You're an audacious one, Commander... Oh, is this your way of punishing me? Okay, continue...♥
Seems you have new missions. Wanna try completing them under a time limit?
You completed a mission. About those rewards... Will you punish me if I hide them somewhere?
I have a letter for you, Commander. Heehee, I didn't do anything to it. Nope, nothing at all!
Hey, Commander, I didn't follow your orders the other day, did I? You know what that- It worked out in the end, so no punishment for me? Dang...
A commission's been completed. What do you say we go and receive the girls?
Heehee. Someone's in for a world of pain... Oh, I was talking about the enemy, that's all!
I'm the flagship? But I might suddenly appear or disappear!
Heheh. Told you that an improvisational fighting style is more efficient!
Well, safe to assume the Commander will punish me for this...
Let's make this more dangerous!
Is this the time I finally sink? Yeah, right!
Even after all my blunders, you still won't get mad at me... How disappointing.
Oh, doesn't look like you really react to my pranks. I suppose I'll have to take them a step further, then!
You've been pretty interesting as of late. You finally understand me, don't you? Heehee.
Lately, it's been making my heart race whether you scold me or smile at me... I've never felt it beat this fast before...♥
Even just spending time with you gets my heart pumping now... but I still wanna tease and prank you. Heehee. I can't help it, it's just so cute when you lecture me♥

Oh, you're serious this time? Oh, dear... You really caught me. You're awful, scolding me while presenting that thing to me. What if I said no? Will you be harder on me? This is a tough choice... but my answer is yes!
Hey, Commander... There's something I want even more than this, you know...
You'll have to try harder if you want the Commander's punishment... That's not what you're after?

ex.line: Commander, I've "redecorated" your office and paperwork. By that I mean I attached some pictures so you'll think of me.
Say, Commander, could I slip in under your desk? ...There's not enough room? So you believe, but I like to think I'm quite flexible.
Heehee. Let's get some serious work done today. Hm? I mean it. I want to make you happy!
How about we go outside and take a break? I'm not saying we should go anywhere dangerous, just nearby where we can run around.
Ugh... Even being gently headpatted makes my heart race...
Oh? Do you have a sortie story to share?
Commander... I'm going to hug you from behind without warning as payback.
Welcome back. I did my work exactly as instructed. Heehee... I love how you look when you're surprised♪

It used to be that I'd prank you just to see your reaction, but now, my heart races just from being around you... Hm? I never said anything about not pranking you anymore. You scolding me is the best reward I could ask for, you know♥

lines.line: Oh, I wasn't expecting that you'd come here, Commander. As the God of Death, I will have to pass "judgment" on you♪
Oh, I wasn't expecting that you'd come here, Commander. As the God of Death, I will have to pass "judgment" on you♪
You came at just the right time. I just found out about a fun game... Yes, the loser has to take a punishment. Wanna play with me?
Heheh... This is pretty comfortable. Do you wanna lie next to me? Sure - if you can beat me at a game. Win, and I'll let you do whatever you want!
Oops... I "accidentally" squirted fruit juice at you. How will you punish a God such as me, I wonder?

Weighing your soul and passing judgment accordingly is so trite. To spice things up, I came up with a few exciting games. Heehee. Since you're here, why not play with me? You're certainly not getting away if you don't!
Hm? Such blasphemy, headpatting a God... Oh well, it's you, so I'll let you off the hook!
Hmm? Do you want me to judge you that badly?
Oh dear... I am a God, and yet you're so violent with me... Heehee. It's exciting... and novel.
You have unfinished missions. Why don't we incorporate them into a game of sorts? Then it'll be easier to beat me.
Maybe I hid the mission rewards here... You'll have to come closer to find out!
You've received new messages? Heehee. Don't even think about asking for help. It's just you and me in here.
Ah, welcome back. Want a taste of these offerings to God? You are eligible to take a bite.
Oh, the commission team is back? Hmm... Alright, I'll come with you - partly to make sure you don't escape.
Heehee. I'm not surprised YOU were able to beat a God like me... You think I lost on purpose? That I did. What can I say? I want to be punished so badly♥
Oriani-class destroyer - Giosuè Carducci.
Giosuè Carducci. Third Poeti-class destroyer. Affiliation: Sardegna. This introduction ought to be more convenient for a written report, no? ...Hm? This isn't meant to be written?
I'm Giosuè Carducci, a Sardegnian poet. Pleased to meet you. Should I get to work right now? If I have time before I start, I'd love an opportunity to visit the port library first.
Commander, this document seems to be in need of revisions. For example, here and... Ahem. Sorry for rushing you. Please, sit down.
