...Hm? Commander, how long have you been here? Sorry, I was a little too engrossed in my book. This is a Royal Navy poetry collection - want to join me? Lovely! Let's read it together.
This document... Hmm. There's a typo on the word "commission" here. It's a small problem, but we should fix it.
Curious about my notebook? I've collected and analyzed everyone's linguistic habits in it... Oh, this page is yours. I'm still collecting yours.
Watching da Vinci's experiments reminds me of purgatory as written in poetry... Well, frankly, purgatory seems more promising than her works.
This is a laurel wreath - the utmost honor to a poet.
Phew... Finally, the archive is perfectly organized. ...Hm? Did you call me, Commander?
That one's going into my Collection of Boorish Acts.
You're worthy of a poem even when you're acting slovenly, but is now really the time? Brace up and handle your work, Commander.
It looks like your missions are done. Good job, Commander. Take a break while you can... Oh, me? I just happened to get a flash of inspiration, so I'm jotting it down before I forget.
There's mail addressed to you, Commander. Wait, not that one... That's a poem I was in the middle of writing. Ahem... You may see it once it's done.

Dropping anchor, mooring... No, we can do better... Hm? Commander, you're just in time. I'm trying to write a poem about returning to port. You must know more about this than me. May I borrow your knowledge for a bit?
Commander, the commission fleet is back. I checked the material manifest, and nothing seems to be out of line, but some of the terminology seems inaccurate...
Inspiration is surging within like never before!
Preparations are complete. Let us depart.
To you I offer a hymn of honor and glory.
We must retreat. It's not too late to sort out our findings and try again.
The shudderings of Etna and whirlwinds of the Alps upon you!
I'm fine. I can still fight!
If I were to write your words just now into a poem, I would have to express it as akin to verbal vomit...
You found my notebook?! Thank you... It's full of many of my favorite phrases. If you hadn't found it, I'd... Well, thank you.

Welcome to my personal collection. As you can see, I've divided literary works into sections by faction... What do I do with books in languages I can't read? Well, learning the language and trying to translate it is a perfectly enjoyable challenge.
I use this page to analyze your linguistic habits. Why do I analyze even simple small talk? Even the simplest of phrases can undergo all kinds of subtle modifications!

"From you have I been absent in the spring... Yet seem'd it winter still, and, you away, as with your shadow I with these did play." Commander, I made a bookmark for you. I wanted to present it along with one of my favorite poems.
You felt the same way all along? Thank you... I promise to love you with every breath, every smile, and every tear for all my life - and even after I've been sunk, if it may be...
Thank you. I really like... No, I think it would be more accurate to say that I love it.
Alfredo, you should put your articles through another revision phase... or three.
Hai Tien, I brought a collection of poems for you in return.
It's an honor, Brest. I adore your poetry!

ex.line: Commander, I brought suggestions on optimizing the language in your documents. I have three ideas... Oh, right. I made coffee, so have a drink while you read.
Commander, would you like to read a poetry collection together? Come sit. They're love poems, so I'm sure there's much fun to be had.
Do you need a grammar check? No? It's a poem... for me? Let's see... Oh, very nice. I like it! ...Though your diction COULD be improved a little.
My notes here aren't just for analyzing your linguistic habits. I also just... want to remember your words, too...
They say morning is the most beautiful time of day. Next time you're free, let's watch the sunrise together - just the two of us.
Your approval is the greatest compliment I could ever want.
Oh...! I-I understand your desire. It's described as beauty in many poems... I'm still a little embarrassed, but...
Here you drop your sail and lie by me... Hm? Commander, welcome back... Yes, I'm working on that poem I mentioned before. Now that we're together, the things I want to express have changed a little.
"The forests feel thee, and with a cool shiver awake; up soars the falcon, flashing in eager joy." This is a poem I wrote for you, Commander.

lines.line: Traveler from afar, allow me to pen a welcoming verse with this dance... Why'd I stop? Umm... S-silence is golden, as they say...
Traveler from afar, allow me to pen a welcoming verse with this dance... Why'd I stop? Umm... S-silence is golden, as they say...
Traveler, enjoy this banquet. Delicious food and wine, supplemented by bewitching dance... A moment frozen in time.
"The grace of one's advance, such is the true beauty of dance..." Sorry, that may have been too pretentious. I'll work on it.
Dance and poetry are a lot alike. They both have a rhythm and tempo you need to adhere to... It's just a little harder when it comes to dancing.
I may not be able to do the whole dance, but if you only looked right now, wouldn't you call me beautiful?
It's just like writing poetry. Careful use of empty space can rouse the imagination... So I'll leave the rest of the dance to your imagination, Commander!
Shall I remove my veil?
You'd like to see other dance moves? Sorry... I may not be able to do that.
I'm losing balance!
Would you like to dance with me? Oh, you'd like me to teach you... I'm happy to, but these are the only moves I know. I hope that's okay...

The time I've spent dancing with you here in this palace... no, every moment we're together has been special. My dance may leave some to be desired, but I'd like to commemorate this with a poem. When it's done, I'll share it with you.
Giussano-class light cruiser - Bartolomeo Colleoni.

I'm Bartolomeo Colleoni, staff officer and mission support of the Sardegnian fleet. I've put a lot of time into studying tactical analysis and combat deployment... Really, don't you think it's better for a soldier to be seen as uptight? Umm... You disagree? O-okay. I'll try to be better...

I am Bartolomeo Colleoni, staff officer and mission support for the Sardegnian fleet. Don't worry - when it comes to tactical analysis and combat deployment, I... Oh, there I go again. Umm, I look forward to working with you, Commander.

Good morning, Commander. I've finished preparing the materials for today's strategy meeting... Oh? Am I being needlessly uptight? I-I'm simply presenting the professional front that any officer should!

My colleagues say that I'm too uptight, but on the battlefield, a moment's inattention can beckon death. ...Though when I'm up late at night writing reports, I do enjoy the occasional break with milk tea and romance novels... Ahem! Milk tea is just a tactical drink for replenishing my energy! And the novels... Umm... Don't tell anyone about those, please.
Commander, I've finished today's plan... Oh, I'm sorry. Already talking about work again. You said it's okay to relax once in a while, right...?
Hm? What am I reading? Th-this is a book about how commanders and their subordinates can improve their relationships! U-umm... It's just for the sake of teamwork...
Do you think I'm well-dressed today? As a soldier, personal grooming is the most basic of basics... C-Commander?! Why are you coming so close?!
Huh?! C-Commander, this is hardly appropriate for two military folk... But I actually don't mind that much...
Hm? Do you need something?
Th-this is inappropriate. Please stop at once!

Commander, you have missions that still need to be handled. As your staff officer, I suggest you get to work immediately... But of course, if you're too tired at this moment, I'm willing to do them for you.
Well done. I finished my report, so make sure you get your rewards... Huh? I doodled in the corner?! Pretend you didn't see that, please!
Commander, you've got new mail. Shall I sort it out for you?
Your missions are going well, I see. Ah, I've already compiled the combat report. Detailed notes and addendums are - oh, this? I-I only use pretty fonts to make it more engaging for you...
The commission fleet has returned to port. I've summarized their mission for you in this report here. Please have a look.
I'll use this power to the fullest for the Commander's sake.
With my military pride on the line, I swear, I will bring the Commander victory!
Heh. When I serve as the front-line staff officer, victory is but a matter of course.
N-no way... Were my plans incomplete?
Calculation complete. Commencing annihilation!
I'm fine. An injury like this isn't even worth writing in the report!
You've disappointed me today, Commander. As a soldier, you should maintain basic discipline.
I appreciate your cooperation, Commander, but we really should keep a professional distance given our working relationship...
When I work with you, I feel oddly... giddy. Oh, I-I just mean I'm happy that my efficiency has improved, of course! Nothing else... N-no hidden meaning at all, nope!
Maybe the strategy in my novel will work...! A-ahem, Commander, do you have a minute to join me for tea, or... N-no, I just wanted a meeting to discuss our strategy for the next battle...!

When I'm with you, it seems like I don't need to be so uptight... Mmm... How long has it been since I felt so relaxed? Maybe... Love really does change a person, just like in my romance books... O-oh goodness, I didn't just say that!

Hmm? Is this a document you need me to work on... Wha? Whaaat?! A-a contract?! I've imagined this so many times, but I don't feel ready at all...! Oh, my hands are shaking so much... Wh-where do I sign? I can hardly hold the pen steady. Help me, Commander!
Ah! C-Commander... You don't have to be so considerate of me, you know. We have a lot of work to do... b-but let me be clear, the gift does make me very happy. Thank you!

ex.line: Let's do our best today, Commander. ...My notes here? They're not for work. They're, um... my research on how to get closer to you... D-don't laugh at me, please!
Umm... I made lunch for you today, Commander. Of course, it's normal for a soldier to eat in the cafeteria, but I just wanted you to eat more nutritionally balanced meals...
Hey, thanks for all of your hard work. I brewed black tea if you'd like to take a break. It'll help you be more efficient, right...?
In one of the romance novels I read recently, there was a girl like me who gazed vacantly at her beloved's profile... Oh, w-was I saying that out loud?! Forget that, please!
Mm... It's far from appropriate, but I could get used to this...
Yes, I'm here.
C-Commander... There's a time and a place for this...
Welcome back, Commander. You're unusually early today. If you'd like, umm... I-I happened to find this lovely café, and my book says that they're a great place for... d-discussing work!

I've written about all of our time together in my diary. Sometimes, I draw my memories with you... It's frankly childish behavior for a soldier, but when I look upon them, I remember you. It makes me... so very happy.

lines.line: Hrmm... Romance novel analysis shows that this pose is the most likely to succeed... Ah. C-Commander, there you are... Ahem. "What business do you have in my private chambers?"
Hrmm... Romance novel analysis shows that this pose is the most likely to succeed... Ah. C-Commander, there you are... Ahem. "What business do you have in my private chambers?"
Welcome, ahem... to my... chamber. Urk, th-this is just too embarrassing to stand!
Staff Officer Bartolomeo reporting! Whoops, right, I'm supposed to be playing the part of an empress... It's hard to give bedroom eyes the whole time, though.
Do you like my outfit, Commander? Is it too different from the usual? Maybe I should change... Huh? You think it's cute? Th-then I'll keep it on! Behold a soldier's tenacity!
According to my schedule... You and I should be in bed having... P-pretend I didn't say anything! Commander, do NOT look at this schedule!
Some fruit, Commander? Ahem... "I-I bequeath this reward unto you. Partake, lest you disappoint me!"
Heh... Heheheh... "H-how bold of you."
Huh? N-no, I'm not spacing out! What was... I supposed to do next?
The book says I should be bolder, but this is just... Ooh, it's too much...
I know role-playing is fun, but don't forget your work. You have missions that need doing, Commander.
"Graciously accept the mission rewards I've bestowed upon you..." Ugh...
New mail? That's weird... I don't remember that being part of the plan.
Welcome back. Umm, please wait a moment. I prepared fruits for your return... Ugh, where did I put them?!
I'll go take care of the commission team... "Commander, you may remain here where you belong - in my chamber."

You know... I spent a lot of time secretly putting together this outfit and room. I might seem clumsy or indiscreet, but this was my plan to show you a different side of me and conquer you, in a word... Umm, basically... I did this because I hoped it would make you like me more...
Essex-class aircraft carrier - Franklin, Hull Number CV-13.

I'm Franklin, Eagle Union Essex-class aircraft carrier. I like getting out and exploring more than just sitting around. Will you come with me on an adventure? I guarantee it'll be an unforgettable experience, heehee♡

Heya, Commander. I'm Franklin. It's nice to meet you. Gosh, I'll bet you're a mighty busy person, so do you mind if I just explore 'round the port? Ooor... should I get straight to giving you a hand instead?

Oh, it's you. I was just working out the route for my next adventure. As you suspect, I'll be exploring the unknown and doing some extreme sports... What do you mean it's "that kind of adventure"? What did you think I meant?

Improving the hardpoint on this hook and rope should make it more convenient to use... Hm? When'd you get here, Commander? ...It's fun to watch me tweak things? Heheh, alright, then come sit next to me for a better look.

When it comes to outdoor exploration, equipment isn't the only important thing - you need experience and courage, too. Of course, it's also vital to have companions with you. Wanna come with me sometime?
...You're amazed that I can eat Chi An's food without as much as flinching? I mean, have you ever had raw caterpillar paste? Chi An's dishes are still tasty compared to that.
Ah, interested in my journal, eh? You're one curious cat, Commander. Wanna look through it with me? I don't imagine you can see much from that far away. C'mon, come a little closer♡
My goggles? They're made to work in all kinds of scenarios. For instance, catching your eye like right now!
You hurt your hand? Then you need to wrap it in gauze and... Oh, it's just a scratch? Okay. Here I thought you'd need some first aid.
Oh? Don't you want to go a step further, Commander? Heehee♥
Guess the adventure will have to wait until all these missions are finished... Come on, get 'em done. Any way I can help?
Mission complete. You're a real reliable one, Commander. So, I know tons of ways to unwind after work - wanna try one?
Commander, there's a new letter for you.
Welcome back. Yep, that trinket on the table is a souvenir for you. Pretty unique shape, right? ...Huh? You don't need to give anything back. I'd be happy if you just came along on an outing.
The commission team's back. Gathering materials is a ton of work, so I'll bet they're exhausted. Let's go talk to them.
I've gotten stronger again. Now I should be able to explore that deep-sea cavern I have my eyes on...
Equipment is all good! Let's roll!
Easy win. Nothing to write home about.
Bummer... Commander, you need to get more involved next time.
Time to demonstrate my expertise!
Hmph! You'll have to do worse than that!
As it stands now with you... I'm better off going out alone.
Commander, get your outdoor supplies in- Oh, you've got it all ready. I'm impressed. Although, you should get some quick-drying clothes too. Better safe than sorry, as they say!
Ah, a power outage? No worries. I'll go get my flashlight and spare batteries... Oops! Sorry, I think I bumped into the table. I'll get off of you now, heheh♡

While flipping through my journal filled with precious photos I took with everyone on adventures, I realized there aren't many pics of just you and me together. We should make some really special memories together, you and I♡
The first lesson of wilderness survival is: Never let go of what's important. That's why I'm never letting go of your hand now, Commander! Heehee. Stay by my side forever♪
Whatever happens in the distant unknown, I will always face it with our hands held together. This I promise, Commander. Now let's set off on the best journey of discovery of our lives♡
A gift, huh? You don't see these just anywhere. Let me try and guess where it's from.
So, where are we going on this adventure of yours?
Let's show 'em how strong the Essex class is!
I found this mysterious cavern. Wanna check it out with me later?

ex.line: Ah, Commander, you're here! There's not much work today, so how about we get the easy stuff done then find a quiet place to chat? Heehee. Learning more about you is a kind of adventure, too♪

You want me to remodel your office chair? I'm not exactly a carpenter... Does sitting on it wear out your back or something? Then what you need is more exercise. Heck, I'll help you with it! Let's start with the easiest ones♡
Yeah, I'm still working on our journal of adventures through the port - just feels like I've kinda got writer's block... Hey, why don't we go and "do something" together to find some inspiration?
These are cans I got from Herring. She said they'll be useful on my adventures, so I took 'em... Hm? Why are you making that face, Commander?
I found the best hidden gem of a beach ever, so what do you say we go on an explor-vacation? Y'know, just us two♡
That enough for you? I won't stop you from doing it more.
Hm? A scratch on my hand? A simple scratch doesn't demand any treatment. A little kiss from you would be more than enough. Heehee♡
Oh? Keep doing this and I might do it back to you. Conveniently, I learned a fun little technique just a while ago... Heehee♥
Welcome back, Commander. I brought you some souvenirs. So, what can I expect in return this time? Maybe a welcome-back kiss, hmm?

Did you know, Commander? While I've been on countless adventures and seen many unforgettable wonders, none of them come even close to matching the excitement I felt when we first met. Aww, are you blushing? If you're blushing now, I wonder how you'll react to what I'm about to do. Heehee♡

lines.line: Phew... Sorry I took so long, Commander. I'll be your examiner today. Ah, you're wondering how good I am as a nurse? Heehee. Let's just say you'll find out by... touch♡
Phew... Sorry I took so long, Commander. I'll be your examiner today. Ah, you're wondering how good I am as a nurse? Heehee. Let's just say you'll find out by... touch♡
I just got here, and I just got changed, too. My vibes are pretty different now, aren't they? Do I... look good?

Phew, the bleeding isn't too bad. Now I'll use glue or a lighter to... Well, I don't usually do this, but the circumstances demand it, so... Look, don't be so nervous. I promise I won't do this again, okay?
You think I should be gentler when treating my own injuries? Um... Are you feeling sorry for me, Commander? Aww♡
Since you're already here, should we do a physical exam while we're at it? I've already got all the tools. Why don't we start by taking off your clothes so I can check your heartbeat?
Wondering if you're allowed to bathe? It should be fine if your wound's exposed to water. If you're concerned about getting an infection, I could help with that. Heehee♡
Phew... Could you pat me dry, Commander?
I rushed over as soon as I heard you were here. Worked up quite a sweat, so maybe I should shower before I... Huh? You don't mind?
Oh, you'll pat me dry? Doing it while standing is a pain, so... how about we do it in bed, hmm?
You've got a new mission. You just stay put and rest. I'll take care of it.
Welcome back, Commander. Did you get hurt out there? Aw, you careless thing... Take a seat and I'll tend to you.
There's no hurry, is there? You've been "hurt," so what you should do is lie down and get some rest. Heehee. You might not know it, but I'm quite good at... looking after people♡
Cleveland-class light cruiser - Santa Fe, Hull Number CL-60.

I'm Santa Fe, a Cleveland-class light cruiser from the Eagle Union! If you need someone to work, do battle, take care of you, or exchange some gossip, I'm your girl! Ooh, yeah, I know that look on your face... You wanna know Union gossip! Oh... You just wanted to discuss work? Lame.

Commander, I'm Santa Fe, here to represent the Eagle Union... Ooh! That's a whole lot of documents you got there! You're as busy as everyone says, huh? Heheh, just leave all this to me! I'll sort 'em out... Huh? You say I'm actually just making a mess?
Morning, Commander! I took care of your docs for you! Tadaaa! Great job, huh? ...Hm? What are they sorted by? By the color of their cover pages, duh! Nyahaha!

Psst, hey, have you heard? Yesterday, New Jersey got so drunk off her juice that she got naked in the plaza! ...What, that's not right? New Jersey did drink some juice, but Pittsburgh was the one who got drunk, and Mogador was the one stripping...? Huh?! How do you know so much?!

You say everyone's acting weird lately? Putting on bunny girl outfits to come see you, helping you with your documents while in swimsuits...? Hmm. That is weird, but it got your attention, right? So my advice is working! Ack... There I go running my mouth again...
Why do I like gossip so much? Because it helps me get to know people's interesting sides faster! Heheh, and I've learned some cute fun facts about you, too!
What were you just talking about with Enty? Just work stuff, huh? Pssh, yeah right. What work talk would make her blush that hard? Nyahaha! Have I just witnessed something incredible?
What's up? Got some tasty gossip for me?
Commander, this help wanted notice for Akashi's maid café says she's looking for "a hard worker who understands the Commander's needs." That's LITERALLY me, isn't it?! So why did she reject me?!
I-If you want to do that, it's fine with me... Huh?! What? I-it was an accident?!
Commander! I just heard this crazy rumor - Oh... Work comes first? Th-then let's get it done quick!
Whaaat?! You finished yours already? I better not fall behind... NOOO, I spilled my drink!
You have new mail, so don't forget to read it! By the way, do people send you any secret confessions? No? ...You sure about that? Come on, tell me!
Welcome back! Did anything happen during your mission? No?! That can't be right. I noticed how Helena won't even look you in the eye!
The commission team is back! I'll go help them do inventory... Hm? You're coming with? Ooh, I see~ You don't wanna leave my side, right? Nyahaha!
Nyahaha! I'm even stronger now! Leave all those battles to me, 'kay?
I'll take care of this♪
Nyahaha! I told you I could take care of everything!
I can't win this! I need to seek refuge in the Commander's arms...
See if you can withstand my full power! Nyahaha!
Oof, that hurt! But it's not enough to bring me down!
Uuugh... Commander, you're so boring.
Aw, man! I promised Alfredo I'd help her get some dirt on you, but I broke her camera! Aaaargh, now I'll never get to write my awesome gossip column!
What was in that package Fargo gave you just now, huh? A bouquet of flowers, maybe? ...Chocolate? For me?! Wooow, thank you, thank you!
Sorry, Commander... I messed up again, and I need your help! ...You need me to stop clinging to you first? Aww, okay... I guess...
FleetChat's going crazy right now. What does everyone talk about? Ooh... Now that's an exciting title! "Who's meeting the Commander in secret every night? It must be Santa Fe!" Whaaat?! ME?!
What's my answer? "I do," of course! Wait, did you just hear that shutter noise?! Oh, no... Are we about to be all over the headlines tomorrow?
Wow! Thanks, Commander! This is exactly what I wanted!
Got any juicy gossip... Uh, I mean, news for me?
Hey Sis, let me handle this one!

ex.line: Good mooorning, Commander! I sorted your documents for you! Don't worry - I'll never mess them up again! See, THIS time, I alphabetized them by file name! Nyahaha! ...Bwuh? That's wrong, too? How?!

I heard a lot of gossip at the party last night! Like how Napoli got lost in the Empery's kitchen, ate some dubious food, and fainted... Or how Akagi and Shoukaku got into a serious argument at a clothing store... But the most important ones were stories about us being lovey-dovey, of course! Nyahaha!
You say people have stopped being as weird lately? Urk... Don't look at me! I'm not giving everyone advice anymore, a-and besides... I want you all to myself!
Is it just me, or is this office stuffy? It's bad for you to not have circulation, so I'll open a window - Aaaah! The wind sent papers flying everywhere!
Commander, get this! I saw Miss von Hutten feeding a kitty in secret! She acts so cool all the time... Huh? The papers? Aw, darn it! I forgot you wanted me to get papers from her!
You must be thinking, "How the heck is Sante Fe so cute?" That's it, isn't it? I knew it!
I offered to help Owari with her garden, but she said no. Why did I want to? Because I'd get to bring you fresh fruits and veggies every day, duh.
You did that on purpose, didn't you? Not that I'm against it. Just... Don't touch anyone else, okay?
Staaare... I heard you and someone were getting awfully close during your last battle. Is it true? Tell me! Commander, come on!

Commander, I booked the restaurant for our date! Tonight, we'll have the most luxurious candlelit dinner for two in a Ferris wheel! Nyahaha! Are you surprised? Well, we'd better leave now... H-huh? Uh, why can't I find the reservation details...?

lines.line: Huh? You're already in bed, Commander? Come on, it's time for late-night gossip! Nyahaha! Let me slip into bed with you so we can chat the night away!
Huh? You're already in bed, Commander? Come on, it's time for late-night gossip! Nyahaha! Let me slip into bed with you so we can chat the night away!
Why did I come here? To see you, duh! You must be so sad and lonely here in this hospital bed, right? Nyahaha!
Are you SURE the nurses haven't left you any exciting notes? Aww... Okay, then I will! I'll write a hundred to start! "I love you, Commander! Call me anytime!" Bam.
You thirsty? I'll get you some water... Aaagh, I spilled it! I'll wipe it up first... Uhh, i-it spilled in a pretty private place, huh... Y-you do it!
I brought the softest pillow they have! Let's talk until morning, whether it's gossip or stuff about you!
Commander, you and Franklin were alone for a looong time. She wasn't just treating you, was she? Ooh, you're averting your eyes! Even more suspicious. Nyahaha!
You want me to sleep? At least tell me some juicy bedtime stories!
I'll tuck you in! O-oh... I didn't just touch your wound, did I?
Whoa?! If someone saw that, we'd be all over the news tomorrow!

If you need anything, let me get it for you. I'm healthy, so... Oh, you need a nurse to change out your fluids? Leave it to me - aaaack! I almost fell... Geez, who just tripped me over? Oh... It was a bandage.
Hehe, I'm not bored at all! Even if we can't gossip, we can still chat. And I'm happy to be so close to you, too! You heard me - no matter what, I'm happy as long as I'm by your side! Nyahaha!
Fletcher-class destroyer - Miller, Hull Number DD-535.

Heheh, you wanna know more about this GOAT? I'm pretty famous for being a bad girl, ya know. ...People say I'm sweet and helpful?! WHO?! I can't have people spreading lies behind my back... Hwuh? Everyone did? Urrrg...

Heheh! The strongest, baddest girl in the port, Miller the GOAT has finally arrived! Hey you, are you ready to turn this place upside down?! ...B-bwuh? Why isn't the Commander saying anything? Was my carefully practiced greeting weird...?

Umm... O-oh! I-if it isn't the Commander! What's with the bucket in my hand? Uhh... Well, uh... It's kind of a mean prank, so I only put a LITTLE bit of water in it, but I don't want to get your documents wet... so I was just putting it away!

When the Commander usually wants lunch... Your favorite tea... The last time you praised me... Mm, I give it two stars. I'll start practicing my new cool look tomorrow - Aaaargh! H-how long have you been there?! Stop peeping when I'm journaling, stupid!
Heheh, I modded my uniform again today. Now I'm even badder... You think it's cute how I'm dressed up? Nuh-uh! Bad girls don't dress up cute!

Hm? All of my sock holes are in the same spots? Yeah, duh, because I made them on purpose... Ack! I mean, they're all keepsakes from my dirtiest deeds! It's just a coincidence that they're all in the same spots! I did NOT do it on purpose!

Heheheh! See those documents there, Commander? I shuffled them all out of order! Now you'll never find the important ones, 'cause they're on the bottom... WHAT?! That made it EASIER to plan out your work?!
Hey! No touching the GOAT's head... Whoa, you listened?! Stay a little longer!
Hm? What's the matter? Need something from the GOAT?
I-I may be a bad girl, but rules are rules! Go write an apology letter, NOW!
Commander... How do you still have so much work left over? ....Because you know I'll take care of it later? I-I'd never do that! It's the elves living in your floorboards! Th-that's gotta be it!
Mission complete! Wait, why are there only rewards for you? Bah, forget it. The GOAT needs no charity.
(Hmm... My notes say we should have work mail coming right about now...) Oh! Commander, you've got new mail! How do I always notice first? H-how should I know?!
Miller the GOAT has cleaned up your office for you! ...Thanks? No thanking me! I didn't do it for you - I did it so I'd have more fun wrecking the place!
Oi, Commander! The commission team's back, so how about we go see them? I-I wanna help... I mean, I wanna help PRANK them!
Yeeeeah! I'm the baddest girl around!
Heheh, Miller the GOAT is ready to kick ass!
I told you I'm the strongest, baddest babe out there! (Heheh, this cool smirk is sure to steal the Commander's heart!)
Damn...! Does this mean I still haven't worked hard enough?!
Behold my power!
This GOAT never loses...!
Hmph. I knew you wouldn't understand me - just like everyone else. I wouldn't... I wouldn't be sad about that...!
Would I look badder if I had an arrogant smirk? Man, it's hard... Hwuh? C-Commander? No, I'm NOT practicing how to smirk like a bad girl! This is the wicked coolness this GOAT was born with!
(Keeping up this bad-girl persona is going to be hard, but will the Commander like me if I don't?) 'Sup, Commander. Here to beg the GOAT to stop wreaking havoc on your life?

Commander! Check out this new prank I thought of! It's really original... Whoa! Don't turn the page! "Being bad to attract the Commander's attention"? You must've misread it! Turn it back already! Uuugh... Give me back my notebook, please...

Umm... Commander, I might not be as cool and bad as I present myself... Do you still like me, though? I'm so selfish and annoying... Huh? You think that's actually cuter?! C-cut that out! ...I like you too, okay?

Mm... If I take this, I'll have to act a certain way to keep your attention, won't I? I'll have to be a good girl, won't I? ...Y-you don't care, as long as everything's in moderation? Y-yeah, you're right! That's how the GOAT operates! I knew you'd understand me!
A p-present for me? If you care that much... I'll take it, okay?
Hmm... Is that supposed to get the Commander's attention?
You call yourself a good girl?

ex.line: Hm? Commander, you're back? I-I wasn't waiting just for you, no! I just thought, since we're together and all, I should pick you up once in a while... Th-that's okay, right? Ugh, why are you laughing?!
Our relationship is totally different now, but that doesn't mean I'll be sweet forever! That said... If you like that more, I can try...?
I gotta work hard to keep up my cool bad-girl persona today! ...You like me more when I'm not pretending? Urgh... I-I mean, I have no idea what you're talking about!
Commander... Remember to eat regular meals and take breaks, okay? I-I'm just doing my job as your secretary, that's all!
Commander, try this coffee I made for you! Heheh, the wasabi I put in the mug startled you, right?! H-huh... You found it unique and interesting?!
I told you not to touch my head... Okay, fine, I guess I can let you just this once...
Hmm? Your GOAT is right here~
C-Commander... Just because we're together, that doesn't mean - Aah! That doesn't mean NEVER! ...Hyah?! A-anyway, not today!
(Alright, I'll use this new pose to capture the Commander's heart!) Welcome back, Commander! Wanna see my super-sick new pose?! Heheh, cool, right? ...Huh? Whaaat?! Y-you saw me practicing it? Aww...

When I'm with you now, I realize I don't have to act all bad... You'd accept me no matter how I am, wouldn't you? But that doesn't mean I'm giving up on badness! It's one of my charms, and you're cute when you're getting pranked... Ah, ignore that last part! Forget it!

lines.line: Don't move, Commander! ...Heheh, looks like it's time for the GOAT to take the stage. That was a sick entrance, right?! Hm? N-no, I'm not here to help you out! I'm here to, uhh... Yeah, to take revenge on the scientists who experimented on me!

Don't move, Commander! ...Heheh, looks like it's time for the GOAT to take the stage. That was a sick entrance, right?! Hm? N-no, I'm not here to help you out! I'm here to, uhh... Yeah, to take revenge on the scientists who experimented on me!
W-welcome back~ Did you find the exit? Oh, okay... (Maybe I should just make an exit? I don't wanna hurt the Commander, though.)

Why am I an experiment gone wrong when everyone else is a nurse or a doctor? Umm... 'Cause it's cool? I can't get your attention if I go along with all the other sheep! Heheh, besides, wouldn't it be unforgettable if the monster saved you?
Commandeeer! My tail's cool as hell, right? *wag* *wag* ...Huh? I look like an attention-seeking kitten? Grrr... I'm a scary monster!
It's okay, Commander, let this bad monster girl... that is, Miller the GOAT, rescue you! Just take my hand - Huh?! You can't get a grip?!
Mmgh... Here, Commander. It took a lot of work to get these keys! I wanted the two of us to escape together, but there's no choice now! Hurry! I'll hold them back!
Mm! It feels weird? Well, what do you want me to do about it?
Hm? Did you find a way out?
Hyah?! Th-these claws are sharp, so be careful...
Do you have missions to do? I didn't think you'd be so focused on work at a time like this...
Mission rewards... Do they have any clues to help us get out of this mess?
Commander! New mail for you! Ugh, I told you to stop asking why I always know first!

Where'd you go? You gotta tighten up - what if bad girls catch you and... Well, I guess the coolest, strongest, baddest, GOATiest experiment out there will have to save you~ (I could use an opportunity to show the Commander my skills!)
You're going to see the commission team? Hmph. Then I'll have to buy time here!

Heheh! I might be a monster, but as long as you know I'm a good girl... I mean, the baddest and coolest girl out there, it doesn't matter what anyone thinks! ...You think I look cute like this, too...? G-geez, now isn't the time for that!
Type 21 battleship - Kazan.

I'm Kazan, shipgirl of the Northern Parliament. I have cozy blankets and warm tea or hot milk all ready for you. Stay by my side forever, and I'll protect you from threats and the cold alike. For you see, that is my duty and my desire.
I'm Kazan of the Northern Parliament, here to serve you. My job from now on is to make you snug and cozy - indeed, that's the sole thing I live for.
Ah, Commander. How was the weather outside? If you're chilly, I can make tea and hot chocolate for- Hm? You'd prefer vodka? Well, if that's what you want, alright.

Sometimes, I worry that I'm a bit too involved with your day-to-day life. From managing your meals, to your sleep schedule, and even your room's temperature... it's all because you mean a lot to me. I just don't want to overstep my boundaries or come across like a... guardian.
Commander, you should use my blanket if it gets cold at night. It's incredibly soft, and if you wrap yourself up in it, it'll feel like I'm giving you a big hug. Heehee.
You slept soundly last night, didn't you, Commander? Oh, how did I know, you ask? Because I went to check on you. You looked so at ease - you must've been having a wonderful dream.

I made some hot milk for you to warm yourself up with. Whew... Let me check the temp before you drink it... Hm? You're not a kid? Heheh, well, in my eyes, you'll always be a sweet little child... Here you are - enjoy!
Ahh... It's my job to look after you, and yet you're so kind to me... It fills me with joy.
I'll warm your hands for you.
Hm? Are you feeling cold? ...Okay, then come into my arms.
Hmm... While I don't want to burden you too much, you do need to finish your missions. Heehee... Would you like me to help reformulate your plans?
Commander, you have yet to claim your mission rewards. They're all the recompense of your hard work. Heehee.
Commander, a letter came in. Will you read it after a quick rest? I'll leave it here for now, then.
Ah, welcome back. Get some rest... is what I would say, but first I need to check your forehead temp. Heehee, don't be embarrassed, it's just some family bonding.
Commander, let us go and receive the commission team. Hrmh... No, I'm not peevish, I just want to look after you more.
Nicely done, Commander. I'll get you a hot treat as a reward.
Let's begin. I won't any danger come even close to the Commander.
Heehee. This is naturally how powerful my feelings for you are, Commander.
Retreat right away... I have your back.
Don't you dare take one step further.
This is nothing... I can take it for the Commander's sake!
I'm disappointed in you, Commander. Not because you did anything wrong, but because you don't understand that you need my warmth... This needs to change.
Doesn't look like you've accepted my tender care yet... Don't worry, everything I do is for your sake. In cold lands such as these, warmth is the one thing everyone needs the most.

Could you tell me who made the tea on your desk? The teacup has a gorgeous design, sure, but I want you to drink MY tea. I know better than anyone else the kind of warmth you like... Oh, forgive me - did I cross a line there?

Once in a while, I wonder if I should let you be more independent... then every time I see how tired you look, I can't help but feel like I need to be there to protect you. Do you know what that's like?
Over time, my desire to protect you changed and gave birth to a new kind of emotion... Be that as it may, I still want to protect you and keep you warm. That, to me, is the peak of happiness.

I see... You love me just as I love you, and you want to protect me. I understand. From this day on, I'll do more than just protect you - I will support and warm you as your partner, and you'll do the same for me. What do you say we build a loving, warm family together?
Ah... You remembered what I like. Hehe, I just want to hug both you and your gift really tight~
You can't go on being such a klutz.
Do NOT do anything that might endanger the Commander.

ex.line: Welcome back, my beloved. Let's give it our all today while we support one another. I still can't help but want to fawn over you sometimes, so I hope you'll keep sharing your warmth with me.
I used to focus only on protecting you, and now I've become helplessly reliant on you. Heheh, maybe me changing so radically is proof that I've grown a bit? And it's all thanks to you, Commander.
I made your favorite tea. Best to drink it before it goes... Oh, lip marks? Heheh, oops, I must've left those while checking the temperature a second ago. Heehee.

You've seemed pretty exhausted as of late, so how about tonight, we go to my place and I'll read you a story? Then you can fall asleep in my lap, then... Hm? My place is a little cramped? Yes... I suppose it's high time I put away all my stuffed teddy bears.

I know I agreed to falling asleep with you, but I just can't rest easy without seeing you asleep with my own eyes... At least I don't need to come see you every single night, since we're always sleeping together.
This used to simply make me happy, but now it makes me wanna be spoiled... Keep going...
Do you want a hug? Nowadays, I want some of your warmth too.
Yes, I understand... Come into my embrace♡
Welcome back, Commander. I've made fresh bread and meat soup that'll warm your heart. I just checked and it's the perfect temperature for eating.

Every now and then, I wonder if destiny brought you and me together... My feelings for you have stayed the same between me initially wanting to "protect" you and now when we've become a pair. What I am now is your protector, your partner, and someone who couldn't be happier that you love me just as I love you. You can imagine how I feel, can't you?

lines.line: Ah, you're up, Commander. Heehee. Good morning. It's so sunny today that even the kitchen is a bit hot. That's okay, though - I've made a refreshing breakfast for you. Go wash your face, then it's time to dig in.

Ah, you're up, Commander. Heehee. Good morning. It's so sunny today that even the kitchen is a bit hot. That's okay, though - I've made a refreshing breakfast for you. Go wash your face, then it's time to dig in.
Here just in time for breakfast... Oh, hang on a second. Let me check your forehead temp... Heheh, no, there's no real reason for it. I just wanted an excuse to come close to you.
Heehee. In truth, I've always wanted to be by your side with a more homely look. For instance, like this... in the kitchen in the morning, welcoming a new day together as family...
I thought you might be getting tired of just drinking hot milk lately, so I made some coffee this time... What's that? You're suddenly craving milk now?
Let me know if there's anything you want to eat. I'll cook it up for... Hm? That's spoiling you a little too much? Heheh, making food is for granted, I'd say.
Need a hand? Sure, just sit there and wait a minute. I absolutely love taking care of you, so don't sweat it and let me handle it for you.
Heheh... It's a little embarrassing, but it does make me really happy.
Oh my... Are you asking me to spoil you by any chance? Heehee.
First thing in the morning? Seems you've gotten a bit clingy with me. Heehee.
Excellent work, Commander. Does the nice smell of breakfast help you relax? Maybe you want something to drink?

Making breakfast for you every morning, feeling the temperature in the kitchen, watching you eat with a smile on your face... This casual happiness is my irreplaceable treasure, the one I've been after for so long.
De Zeven Provinciën-class light cruiser - De Zeven Provinciën.

De Zeven Provinciën, Kingdom of Tulipa's own light cruiser, speaking. Would you like to know about my home? It has colorful flower fields, spinning windmills... I think you'd love it. Oh, you want to know about ME? That's fine... Heehee, how about we walk and talk?

Hello there. I'm De Zeven Provinciën, a light cruiser from the Kingdom of Tulipa. It's a pleasure to meet you... Heehee, the plants of the port are so properly maintained. I can tell you take good care of them!
Good morning, Commander. Klein Groentje welcomes you, too... Who am I talking about? Heehee, my little plant here. For you~
Hum hum... Ah, Commander. I was just watering Klein Groentje here... Hm? Did you like the song I was humming? Heehee, then I'll keep going for you~
Commander, can I turn the space behind your office into a little garden? If I just plant some flowers and the like, they'll be right there to help you relax.
Why isn't the printer working... Huh? It's just out of paper? I see...
Why did I give Klein Groentje such a difficult name? Well, I don't think it's difficult. It just means Little Green, actually.
Are you tired? Let's go to the park and take a relaxing stroll. It's okay, you don't have to worry about me~
Are you feeling down? You can tell me about it. Oh, but not if you don't want to. I'll just stay here by your side, okay?
Do you like? Heehee, if it excites you... then touch more. I don't mind~
Commander, there are new missions for you to handle... It's not too many, so just keep at it for a little while. Give it your best~♪
Good work, Commander. Leave the rest of the work to me while you unwind.
Commander, there's new mail... You want me to read it to you? Umm, this is how you open the menu, right... H-huh? Where'd the mail go?
Welcome back. Umm... Can you take a look at the coffee machine for me? I followed the manual, but when I pressed start, smoke started coming out...
Commander, the girls who went out on commission are back. Go see them, okay? I'm sure they all miss you.
This power didn't come easy... I'll use it to the fullest!
Let's press on. We can win this!
Thank goodness we won... It's all thanks to you, everyone!
It's okay. Let's regroup and try again.
May this battle end swiftly.
Ngh. Is everyone okay...?
Commander... You should really be more considerate of everyone.
I could clean so much better if I could handle a robot vacuum, but I just can't figure it out... Push here, maybe? Or... *cough* *cough*! Wh-why is there so much dust...
I'll give the white one, Klein Witje, to Evertsen. She likes little flowers... Do you, Commander? Okay, then I'll grow one for you as well~
Commander, I prepared the garden. Are you free later? I made flower herbal tea, so let's have a little tea party there to celebrate.
Commander, I grew these roses for you... Heehee, aren't they pretty? I raised them with sooo much love! That is... love for you♡
Commander, come closer for me... I want to see your smile and feel your warmth, so that I can remember the most important day of my life forever...
Aww, how kind of you. I'll treasure this~
Can I offer you any plants for your newest experiments? Or any help whatsoever?

ex.line: Commander, you're back~ I'm glad you didn't miss these babies' peak bloom... Heehee, they bloom so beautifully that I just knew I had to see them with you.
You can't water this one too much, and this one needs frequent exposure to the sun... Hm? How do you take care of ME? Heehee, I just need your warm hugs and sweet kisses every single day♪
Commander, how about a walk in the garden? You've been hard at work for a long time, so take a little break... Or just consider it spending time with me.
Oh, no... Where did that file go? Commander, I think I... Huh? You found a backup? Phew... Thank goodness! I was trying to help you, and I didn't expect...
Commander, what name would suit this yellow tulip? ...Hm? How'd you know I would name it Klein Geeltje?
Are my bangs getting a little too long...?
Indulge all you want~
There are lots of ways to relieve stress~ Heehee... Wanna try one with me?♡
Welcome back, Commander. I'll make tulip tea... Oh, you want coffee? Umm... So, you know how you fixed the coffee machine the other day? Well... I broke it again. I'm sorry.
Now, we just pack the soil tight... There. I can't wait to see the rosebud peek out of the soil♪ It's a new life planted by you and me... Say, should we give it a name while we're at it?

lines.line: Good morning, Commander. Did you sleep well? Oh, there are petals in your hair. I'll get them for you~
Good morning, Commander. Did you sleep well? Oh, there are petals in your hair. I'll get them for you~
Are you awake? ...Why didn't I wake you? Hmm... Because you looked too cute in your sleep. How could I take my eyes away?♪
How happy I would be if I could wake up next to you every day... Commander, if you like this place, then why not stay a few more days?
I'll get you a glass of water. ...Is something wrong? Oh, you don't want me to leave? Hmm... Okay, the water can wait~
Do you like my sleepwear? Heehee, how about you pick for me next time?
You wanna close the curtain? Is the sun too bright? ...You're worried people will see? It's okay; we're surrounded by greenery. Nobody knows a thing♪
Do you want me to stay, too? I'd be happy to sleep with you for a while longer♪
You want to get closer? Be my guest~ I'll share half my pillows!
Hm? You want to go another round? Geez, did you really recover so fast?♡
Commander, you have new missions. We can't lie around for much longer... Oh! Can you work from bed?
Stay in bed for a while~ I'll go make breakfast. Will milk and toast do? Oh... Right, I broke the toaster yesterday...
You've been too busy lately. You finally have time off, so come and have sweet dreams with me... Heehee, close your eyes... Mwah.
Admiralen-class destroyer - Evertsen.

I am Evertsen, an Admiralen-class destroyer of the Kingdom of Tulipa. I'm currently observing and researching the ecosystem of this port. If you're interested in my findings, then come along - quietly, please.
Hmm. Are you the Commander? I'm Evertsen. ...Wait. We can talk after I finish recording this data.
Work efficiency trends upward in environments with a lot of greenery, so I've brought a few pots of air plants and cacti. They're easy to care for... Stop staring and focus on your work, please.
Quiet, please. I'm observing this club silverline butterfly laying eggs.

Commander, focus on your job rather than my plants, please. ...Hm? I did just call them all plants for simplicity's sake, but if you're really curious, I can introduce you to each. AFTER you finish your work, of course.
Does the mini pine tree look healthier than before? Well, I did use magic on it. I also wrote care instructions on a sticky note and put it on the pot.
Want to look at this through a microscope? This thallus has a darker color than usual, indicating a higher chlorophyll content... One of nature's many mysteries.
Is this a kind of healing magic?
Perfect timing. My growth experiment needs an assistant. Can you come and help me?
Aah?! Please stop... This is embarrassing.
Don't forget your missions, Commander. Shall I spruce you up with a little magic first?
Your missions are all complete. Well done, Commander.
You have mail. Don't forget to check it.
You're going right back to work even though you just got back? I'll use magic to cure your fatigue. Sit still, please.
The commission group is back. This destination... seems ripe for research. Commander, let me go there next time.
My magic grows stronger...
When you're ready, let's get going.
We won. Very good.
Is anyone hurt? I'll help treat you.
Be reborn.
I'm okay. I can treat these wounds myself.
Quiet, Commander. I'm busy observing this moss.
This is a miniature tropical rainforest ecosystem. If you're interested, come and observe data with me.

This moss is growing much faster than expected. See how the sporangia develop 37% faster than the control group... Hm? Why are you looking at me like that? Did I use too many big words? ...You like seeing me smile?

Commander, don't touch the plants in this room. They contain trace toxins as part of an experiment... Ah, there it is. I made this balloon flower bookmark for you... It explains the language of that flower on the back.

May I sit next to you and work on my latest observational data? Okay, thank you... Huh? Does it bother you how close I am? But this is the only place I can sunbathe while I work... If you don't mind being just "bothered" a little, then it's fine if I stay, yes?
Commander, I brought a bunch of baby's-breath for you. I'll preserve it in its most beautiful state with magic so that it never withers... Yes, like my love for you, it will remain eternal.
I love it. Thank you for the thoughtful gift.
The parrot tulips aren't growing very well... Can you take a look at them?

ex.line: Commander, you're here. Come and look at this! The plant I brought here is blooming.
Shush... Actually, come over here. Quietly if you can. This bee-eating philanthus is hunting prey, so don't startle it.
Commander, focus on your work... Your staring at me is distracting...

The lady of the night has truly fascinating characteristics. I'd love to tell you about it... Wait, you're really interested? It's going to be a long one... Okay. Let's find a sunny place to relax, okay?

Do you want my magic to help you keep working? I'll have to refuse. If you want to energize yourself, then we should go out together. Interacting with nature is the best way to eliminate fatigue for me.
Mm... I really feel healed now...
Do you want a hug? Umm... I just handled a sample, so I'll do it right after I wash my hands!
My rising temperature, my hastening heartbeat - both are normal bodily reactions... because I love you...

Do I look tired? Well... Yes. I've been organizing data on symbiosis between fungi and termites over the past few days... Phew. Honestly, seeing you has made me feel so much better. Maybe you have your own sort of "healing magic."
Just as plants need sunlight and water, I need you, Commander. It's so very simple and easy to understand... A natural truth, you might call it.

lines.line: Commander, relax wherever you like. ...Why so far? You won't get any sun there.
Commander, relax wherever you like. ...Why so far? You won't get any sun there.
Let's sit by the window together. Ah... Watch your step. I have notebooks, um, lying about.
There's no need to be quiet today, so... shall we chat? I want to know more about you...
What are you looking at? Are you interested in the regular deviations of monarch butterfly migration paths? I'll gladly tell you all about it.
This is just an ornamental plant. It isn't poisonous, and it won't bite, so look closely if you'd like... Here. I made room for you to view it.
Are you still not used to seeing me on days off? Even I need breaks, you know... and so do you. Relax a little, why don't you?
Hm? You want to be next to me?
Why not join me and change into pajamas? You'll be comfier.
By the window is a little, umm, embarrassing...
This data has a few abnormalities. Let's do another control... Ah, Commander. I'll get you water - oh, my experiment? It's no hurry. We can do it after.
This is my first time doing something like this... just relaxing and basking with someone I love. It's comforting. Don't look so confused, Commander - the person I love is YOU, of course.
Do you see where the little egrets descended, Commander? That is where the mangroves we planted together are. And now, they are a home for the birds.
Do you see where the little egrets descended, Commander? That is where the mangroves we planted together are. And now, they are a home for the birds.
Let's do some deep breathing together. Mmmh... Haaah... The crisp air around the mangroves does much to uplift one's mood.

There's only so much that healing magic can do. Yet, these mangroves not only provide a habitat for marine organisms and migratory birds, but also protect the ecosystem. They're even more impressive than magic.
I resemble the guardian fae of the mangroves, you say? Then, would you perhaps like to join me in protecting them, Commander?
The mangroves' roots have spread farther since the last time I was here. Would you like to see them up close? I'll give you a detailed explanation.
Are you too hot? Then come over here and we'll dip our feet in the water together. Let's give ourselves over to the pleasant breeze while we're at it... Well? It feels lovely, doesn't it?
Come here and take a rest next to me. It's nice and cool...
What's the matter? If you're worried about the stability of this perch, then please hold my hand.
The animals are watching...
I'm taking water samples. Come over here if you're interested. I'll teach you how to do it.
Mangrove roots are special. They intertwine, supporting one another without ever letting go. I want us to be like that, too... supporting each other, and becoming one.
Bogatyr-class protected cruiser - Oleg.

I am Oleg! The port's one and only genius scientist specializing in bringing components back to life! Give me some parts and I can make miracles happen! Things may sometimes blow up along the way, but explosions are the mother of invention, so it's fine!

Oh. Ohhh... If it isn't my test product evaluator... No, I mean my Commander! Heheh. I am Oleg, an ingenious scientist capable of turning components into fabulous inventions! Pleased to be working with you.

Woohoo! You've arrived, Commander! I was just sorting out the equipment I'll bring with me today. Let's see... Extendable claw, portable collector, screwdriver kit - all good! Want me to examine your stuff, too, Commander?

Fusing wires with my hands and adjusting gears with my feet whilst enjoying a chat with you - that is the kind of efficiency a genius possesses. Controlling the flow of water with my feet to make tea? I certainly haven't tried that yet, but perhaps if I put the teapot on a rotating platform...

Wahaa, Commander! I repurposed those junk components I found in the depot into a mechanical canary that can sing! ...What? What's it used for? Tsk, tsk, your eyes do not see. Inventions are not bound by the need to be useful!
Mmh... While I may LOOK unoccupied, the truth is, I am busy as can be. If you need a hand with something, I might just have to use my feet instead.
"Junk"? How rude! All of these components are treasures with limitless potential inside of them! They each have their own destiny and will shine if just given the chance!
Fascinating... The temperature, grip, and headpatting tempo of your hand are all quite pleasant... Hold it! I must make a mechanical hand that replicates this sensation!
Hmm? Hrrmm... I'm jogging my noggin at present, you see...
Nooo! Y-you touching me without warning made me drop the circuit board that I JUST welded! *sob*... My precious...
Hey, Commander! The mission reminder birdie I made has been buzzing for ages! What that means is you've got super-important missions left to do!
Looks like SOMEONE hasn't claimed their mission rewards! Do you not need them?! If so, I'll gladly take them!
Ooh, my letter-bringer birdie has brought your mail! ...Hm? The letter's caught in its beak? Roger-dodger, I'll go fetch a wrench right away!
Whoa, Commander! You're back! Pray tell, what new and shiny components have you brought back to me? Believe me when I say I have a BOATLOAD of ideas I wanna give form to!
Yahoo, the commission team is back! Which is to say, my adorable components have come home, yes?! Let me go see! I promise I only need a tiny handful of components!
Whoooa! Feels like my inspiration circuit has opened! Ah, wait, no - my toolbox has merely gotten lighter...
C-combat?! But I've been so busy all week that I haven't had a wink of sleep!
Heheh... These components are all mine now!
Guhhh... My inspiration has eluded me...
This is my creation, brimming with chaos!
Egads! My flame of inspiration is gonna go out!
You don't seem very interested in my invention. A failure though it may be, I still put a ton of work into it... Oh well. It's okay. I still have a bunch of other ideas to develop on!

Oh, hang on a moment, I need to make a note of an idea I just got... Huh? Octopus? No, this is no octopus! It's a mechanical arm that sorts paperwork automatically! Do you want me to explain what all these symbols mean?

The knob on your office door is so normal and dull. Its security aspects leave much to be desired as well... Would you like me to give it an identification and automatic counterattack system? If some ne'er-do-well touches it, it'll administer an electric shock, and then...
*sob*... Commander, my invention just won't work! I'm at my limit here - please charge my batteries up with a hug... Heehee, your embrace is so warm... I think I got my motivation back!

I've learned how to classify components thanks to you, and my inventions have become considerably more practical. Ah, yes, as thanks, allow me to sing you my invention song! Spin-spin goes the drill♪ Being an inventor's such a thrill♪ My love's by my side and I'm fulfilled♪

Whoooa! I've never seen something so shiny before! You're giving it to me? Heehee, I'll gladly accept! I'm of course aware of the implications of this. I'm going to add a heartbeat and body temp sensor to this and it will keep our minds connected forever and ever!
*sob*... It's so sparkly... Is it really all for me?!
Whoa... Whoooa! Such a disposition full of love for inventing!
Do you need a hand optimizing your program?
Care to try my latest neck massager?

ex.line: Commander! Your impeccable timing is much obliged! I just finished organizing all the components in the depot into two categories: "Will probably explode" and "will absolutely explode"! ...Hey, I'm kidding! I organized them in just the way you taught me!
You know, I try to make coffee every morning using my latest invention. Granted, I do burn my hands pretty often... Hm? Why don't I just use a coffeemaker? Because that's so boring!

Behold my mechanical lobster repairer! This thing can do my repairs for me, giving me more time to spend with you! ...Why is it shaped like a lobster? Because those are the parts I happened to have on hand! Don't think too hard about it!

*sigh*... I wanna lie down and read a book while fine-tuning my blueprints... Hm? How do I do all that at the same time? Commander, don't tell me you forgot I'm adept at using my hands AND feet for work!

I used to only think about inventing for the sake of it - "What fun things can I make with these components?" and such. Nowadays, I'm more interested in seeing you smile when using my inventions. I've really grown as a person! Heehee.
Hmm... The mechanical arm I made doesn't even hold a candle compared to your hand...
Yeah? I'm trying to focus here... That said, if you need me for something, I'll make that a priority.
Eek! C-Commander... I'm not saying you can't... just tell me first next time, okay?

I used to care only about making things, but I've learned so much ever since we met. Sorting and categorizing things, considering usefulness, taking safety measures for others and myself... and of course, that your warmth and smile cannot be substituted by any invention.Heehee♪

lines.line: *yaaawn*... Nothing beats relaxing after a nice bath! Now that I've changed into my warm pajamas, what should we do next? Hm? Go to sleep? No, no, it's too early. I only yawned because I was getting comfortable!

*yaaawn*... Nothing beats relaxing after a nice bath! Now that I've changed into my warm pajamas, what should we do next? Hm? Go to sleep? No, no, it's too early. I only yawned because I was getting comfortable!

Come here and have a seat, Commander. Heehee, how do you like this cabin outfitted with my personal choice of automated systems? I just fine-tuned the temperature control and safety program on the fireplace, so now it's perfectly safe and pleasant!

These pajamas look light on the surface, but they're fitted with temperature regulation systems on the inside! I also installed an emotion sensor on the tail so I can express my feelings for you without even saying a word♪
Whew... The fireplace is so nice and cozy... And so are you... I think I might... *yaaawn*... Mmmgh, no! I can't doze off now!
It's pretty nice and fulfilling, just being with you on vacation and not thinking about inventions at all. I've never done this before!

Everyone tells me that giving you a lap pillow will make your affinity for me skyrocket... Personally, I think giving you a tummy pillow should raise it by twice as much! I mean, tummies are squishier than thighs after all!
Mgh... Mmhh... I'll fall asleep again if you won't... stop doing that...
Mgh... Mmff... No, I'm not sleeping... I wouldn't doze off on our vacation... Sleeping it away would be such a shame...
C-Commander, I'll have to bathe again if you get me sweaty... Unless this is how a vacation... should be?
My mission reminder birdie is chirping again... Dang it, maybe I shouldn't have brought it along!
Can't you just... claim your mission rewards later? I can make a machine that'll claim them for you tomorrow.
Have you considered answering your mails with an automated reply system? ...Huh? That won't fly?
Buhhh... Whuh? Did I... doze off? Oh, are you still on the clock, Commander? Your laptop screen is still on, so...
Hmm? Oh, that commission is finished... Right now, though, I just wanna be with you... and watch a movie on the couch...

Hm? It's bedtime already? But the movie isn't over yet... It's all your fault. It was so late by the time I got out of the bath... Look, we're finally on vacation, and I don't wanna waste it! ...What? We can go on vacation together another time as well? Alright, I'll hold you to that... Heehee.
Battle-class destroyer - Trafalgar.
My name is Trafalgar, Battle-class destroyer with the Royal Navy. Please leave strategic and operational work to me. ...That's my whole self-introduction.
Greetings, Commander. I'm Trafalgar, a member of the Royal Navy. It's an honour. (Was that too cold? I didn't want to talk too much and sound rude...)
Today's work plans, Commander. Documents to be processed are over there. If you have no questions, let's begin.

I've drawn up some exercise plans for this week. Here is the first, here is the second, and here is a backup I made in case of inclement weather. And these... would be my personal notes. Don't pay them any mind.
Are you holding a party in your office? Then I'll take my leave and go on patrol. (This is an opportunity to get to know the others, but a party's too much. I should just go on patrol...)
About today's meeting... (I actually wanted to talk about something else, but it's safer to talk about work...) Huh? You'd prefer to talk about something non-work-related?
Here's the latest combat report. Nothing is out of the ordinary, but feel free to take a look.
...Yes, I am the one who cleaned your desk. But you don't need to thank me; it was no big deal.
Ah. Mm... (Maybe I am too cold... Oh! The Commander pulled away...)
My collar's wrinkled? Oh. Thank you.
Huh?! Wh-what are you... (How am I supposed to react at a time like this?!)
Ah... Commander, here is your new mission list. Please take a look. (Our fingers just touched...)
Well done, Commander. Your mission rewards are right this way.
I brought your mail.
Commander, I made coffee. If you'd like some, feel free. (People are so good at this in movies. Why am I too awkward to do it?)
The commission team has returned, Commander. Allow me to check the goods with you.
Just you watch over my growth, Commander. (Did I sound too smug there?)
For the glory of the Royal Navy!
The glory of the Royal Navy shall never fade!
Commander, execute plan B!
Engrave this moment upon the sea's memory!
Things have changed. So must our plan.
Commander, are you also this rash on the battlefield?
Ahem. Commander, requesting permission to join the next mission. (Phew... There have been a lot of parties lately, it would be rude to refuse directly, I'll use combat as an excuse...)
(This is how the Commander processes documents. Better remember that...) Oh, me? No, I wasn't spacing out. I was just thinking about our next battle plan.

C-Commander, I put the wrong document in here... Don't look at it, please... No, it's not a battle plan. It's my personal notes... (Goodness, how could I have forgotten my Commander research notes in there?!)

I always feel uncomfortable in lively social situations. I tend to overthink things because I don't want to disappoint people, and then I end up not talking at all. *sigh*... This is the first time I've told anyone about this. I'm sorry you had to hear that embarrassing speech, but I had a feeling that the Commander I know wouldn't tease me...
Okay... I want to explain my feelings with actions rather than words. From now on, I'll be ever by your side, protecting you with this very sword.
Thank you so much! (Was I a little too excited...?)
A party...? (Should I refuse, or...)
For the glory of the Royal Navy!

ex.line: Before we start today's work, I want to say, umm... I missed you a lot. (I finally said it... The Commander looks happy, too!)
I finished the plan for our, umm... date tomorrow. Please give it a good review. I made contingency plans for various emergencies, as well.
If everyone's coming to the party, then maybe I should give up my space... You want me to stay? But I'm not good at this stuff. It is okay if I just stay by your side?
Phew... The weather is lovely... D-do you mind me talking about it?
Commander, I organized the materials you requested. You look tired... Might I suggest a break first?
Should we discuss our next battle plan? Then let me take a look at what we know... Oh, you want me to sit there? (I-in your lap...?)
Mm, mmnh... Oh. I don't have a weird look on my face... do I?
Commander, your collar... Don't move, please. I'll fix it for you.
Mm... Yes, I know very well that you enjoy this.
I made sweets... Would you like some? (Page 7, line 5 of my notes... I made exactly what it says the Commander likes. This should be perfect...)
(The last method of attraction I tried didn't work too well... It must be because the Commander is so one-of-a-kind.) Oh, Commander... I'm not spacing out. I was just... thinking about you...

lines.line: The breeze is nice, isn't it? Do you want to have a drink with me? (This is exactly how my movies go, so this should work... Is my face too stiff?)
The breeze is nice, isn't it? Do you want to have a drink with me? (This is exactly how my movies go, so this should work... Is my face too stiff?)
Umm... Did you come for a breath of fresh air, too? (Oh no, am I being too boring?)
You think it's a little weird that there's a hammock in the pool? Well, I think it's fine... I see it a lot in movies, and stuff.
Mmm... The sea breeze is wonderful, don't you think?
A cloudless night full of stars, just as I... Ahem. Just as the weather forecast said. (I hope the Commander didn't notice that slip of the tongue...)
Would you like to try my drink? I haven't put my lips on it yet... It would be okay if I did?
Phew... Lying down here is so comfortable. Want to join me...?
Your hand is as gentle as the sea breeze... (This might be too corny.)
Do you like it when girls dress like this? (Yeah, this should be exactly what the Commander likes...)
Eep?! Th-this might be easier... in the pool... (What am I saying right now?!)
Since you have new missions to do, why don't we take care of them together? Then we can come back together, and...
(The Commander's here. Everything's according to plan so far...) Fancy meeting you here, Commander! What a coincidence...

It's easier when I'm alone because I don't have to worry as much, but... when it's just you and me, I don't stress out as much from just chatting and sharing our feelings. So I like this more... Do you understand how I feel, Commander?
Dido-class light cruiser - Cleopatra.

I'm Cleopatra, a Royal Maid and an expert on the Nile civilization. Heehee... Interested in my tan lines? They're the marks of Ra's blessing and favour... Hm? You've never heard of that? Ahaha... Anyway, let me tell you about the meaning behind my accessories!

I am Cleopatra. A Royal Maid in body, but an inheritor of great wisdom... Hm? Are you my master? Well, I'm both a skilled maid and a born wisewoman. You must know the 72 ways of hospitality of Nile tradition, surely? Because I do.
Oh, welcome home. I was just thinking of fascinating phenomena - specifically, why your chair keeps scooting left... There must be mysterious forces at work!

Hmm... The person who sold me this amulet said it was authentic, but it says "Made in Port" on the bottom... That must mean there was a trade relationship between the Nile and the port in olden times!
Master, do you see these designs on my dress? They're based on, umm... someone VII's dress... Ugh, I forgot her name already!
Heehee... According to my divination, you should spend today's afternoon tea with the most sage of Royal Maids. That will bring you good luck!
Do you know why so many cats live at port? Allow me to explain~ They're actually agents that I sent to monitor you, haha!
Hmm... There was a book that said frequent petting brings good luck, now that you mention it.
Heehee. Do you need my service, Master?
Eep?! M-Master... I was focused on a very important thought...
Master, you still have missions that need doing. Do you require my help?
There are mission rewards, you say? Hmm... None of it interests me.
There's new information for you. I just can't believe it wasn't written on papyrus with a golden quill pen...

Welcome back. Let me brew a cup of the Nile civilization's most popular black tea... Huh? You say black tea didn't exist back then? Th-then do you know what vessels they used to drink water? Good! I'm happy to explain!
Master, behold! A commission has been completed! I calculated the time using astronomical observation... Huh? I can just set an alarm on my phone? B-but I was right!
Ooh. Has my tan gotten even prettier?
I'll divine the perfect route for us.
Only through Master and the gods' blessing, heehee!
I-I'm sorry, Master...
Behold power blessed by the Nile gods!
Don't worry. I brought a medical tome... Wait, this is a cookbook!
Legend has it that those who ignore the words of the wise will become cacti in the desert...
Master, I learned another new means of divination! Let's... Huh? I don't have the right tools here? Umm, I'm sure playing cards will work just fine!

You understand me more by the day. By the way, I was gifted with the most interesting prophecy... "When the wise meets their destined one, two rainbows will shine above." It's just like when we first met!
Do you suppose I only think about Nile culture all day, every day? I happen to take my maidly duties seriously! I make daily schedules, prepare meals, and even do little things like making beds!

Master, have you ever heard the story of queen and her lover? Don't you think their first meeting was a lot like ours? Heehee, but I think your legend will be even more glorious! After all... You have a wise maid by your side!

Hmm... According to this record of Nile civilization, the Ring of Promise should be worn on... Huh? This finger? My Master is ever so knowledgeable! I look forward to receiving more of your sage wisdom from now on♡
Aww, you'd give me something with so much cultural value? Okay... I'm happy to accept it!
Let's tan together. Tans are a sign of Ra's blessing, you know♪
I'll teach you the Nile's cultural dishes!

ex.line: Welcome back, Master. I used mystical powers to fix your chair. What powers? Umm... I fixed the wheels... Hahaha.
Heehee, I found some time to read some books about ancient oath ceremonies. Ours was different, but I'm sure the gods have blessed us just the same, right?
My divination says... today is the perfect day to study old texts with my Master!
Hehe, my heart beats so much faster when we're together now... Is this a curse, or... Huh? The curse of love? Nooooo!
You've been working so hard, Master. Some of the books in my collection say that when a master is tired, their maid should... umm, explain Nile history to them! Wouldn't that be nice?
Your hands... are as warm as a god's...
We may be closer than ever now, but I'm still your maid forevermore. Do you need my service, Master?
Eep?! M-Master, right now...?
Welcome home, Master! Time flies when I'm with you, so I made a water clock... Why not use my phone? Because it's more ceremonial!
Did you know? The double rainbow on the day of our meeting, and the warmth in my heart right now... the old texts consider them both omens of happiness. I'm certain this time! I double-checked♡

lines.line: Ah, Master, welcome. How do you like the set I put together? Has your heart been stolen? This book describes how the gods arrange their rooms when they look upon the stars... It's not quite a perfect replica, but isn't it pretty?

Ah, Master, welcome. How do you like the set I put together? Has your heart been stolen? This book describes how the gods arrange their rooms when they look upon the stars... It's not quite a perfect replica, but isn't it pretty?
Heehee... I had so much fun with you today~ Huh? Do I smell like the sea breeze? But I washed up... Oh, you were just joking?
You like my swimsuit...? Heh, it's the most unique of all the Royal Maids', isn't it? I made it myself~
Heheh, I put a lot of thought into these decorations! Huh? You think they're a little... seductive? Oh, goodness, umm... Is it just me, or is it getting hot in here?
I'll explain the constellations' secrets and astrological wonders to you tonight! If you want to hear me more closely... th-then you may rest your head in my lap...
Does this swimsuit highlight my tan lines? Hehe, I'm glad you've come to see their charms!
Heehee... Your warmth reminds me of the sun. It makes me want to worship you instead...
Oh? Which star are you interested in, Master? I'll tell you all about it.
M-Master... This is the perfect time and place...
Umm... You have missions left over. Now isn't really the time for this...
Thank goodness... Your missions are all done, so will you finally come back to my side? Huh? You still need to get the rewards?
New mail? Who could this wisdom be from?
Welcome back, Master! You must be exhausted after our long day together. Come lie down with me, and I will tell you the stories of the stars above.
Master, the commission team is back! I want to gaze at the stars with you, but... it should wait until after we've received them!

Is it because of the set... No, I think it's because you're here! Whenever you're with me, the stars seem to shine more beautifully... Heehee, the legend of the wise woman and her fated one is closely tied to the stars. Would you like to hear more?
G-class destroyer - Gallant.
I'm Gallant, Royal Navy G-class destroyer! I'm also the captain of the Port Guards! I will keep the order around here for you, Commander!

Fwee-fwee! On-site security is in position! Commitment to maintaining order: Resolute! I've come as prepared as can be for this meeting! ...Ah, right, I've yet to introduce myself. I am Gallant, captain of the Port Guards! The honour is all mine!

Mornin', Commander! Oh, uh, the "only authorised personnel" sign on the door? It means exactly what it says. Without it, random people would make up some half-arsed reason to come in! We can't let folks freely come and go into important places!

Heheh! Look here, Commander! I installed some barriers leading up to your office, so now nobody will enter without... Hm? Nobody can enter it at all now? Well, now that you mention it... Umm, give me a minute to think!
Commander, I'd like to make and put up 20 "no loud noises" signs around the office! ...Huh? I should quit my habit of blowing my whistle instead? Why?! I do it to maintain the order!
Hrmh... You allowed Mogador and her ilk to come near you again... Hrmmh... This is a danger that needs to be... Oh! I've figured out how to stop them!

Commander, here's the flowchart for entry into your office! One has to present a written request, then pass a facial recognition security check, then... Hm? Why are you clutching your face? Do you feel ill? I'll get the medicine box!
You're NOT supposed to pull on my emergency light!
What is it? Got trouble? We need to lock down the- Owch! Stubbed my toe on the desk! Ow, ow, ow!
If you don't stop, I'll... I'll blow my whistle! And I'll sound the alarm!
Fwee! Commander, we have to get to work ASAP!
All the work is done! You must be tired, right? I've laid out a camping mattress that you can lie on! ...Hm? Why do you look so put off?
