I feel like there are security risks in your mail system... I'll tell Nakhimov to upgrade the network security, then get her to join the Guards while at it!
Welcome back, Commander! I request your cooperation in a routine inspection!
The commission team is back! Give me a moment while I finish the security check, Commander. You can see them after that!
I will defend you with all my might!
Follow the leader's signals! Onward!
Kept the order pretty well, didn't I? Heheh!
Fwee! Stay calm and retreat in an orderly fashion!
To protect the order!
Sound the alarm!
Whaaat?! Everything's going to be a mess if you set a bad example and disturb the order!
You're an embodiment of justice! It's only natural that I'd protect you, being the captain of the Port Guards!

What are the Port Guards, you ask? We're a police force that upholds the port's order and keeps you safe! We were established a few days ago! I'm the only guard so far, but I've already established 121 vigilance points around the port and I inspect them every day, which eliminates all kinds of dangers!
I'm considering writing my name in all the secretary-on-duty slots... No, no, it's not fair to keep you all to myself! Hmm... But then again, it IS the captain's duty to be your personal bodyguard...

Commander! You've, umm, disturbed the order by stealing my heart, so as the captain, I sentence you to never be apart from me! ...Heeey, stop laughing! I actually worked really hard to come up with that line!
I-I'll keep this nice and safe. I've... Wait, is that a commotion over there? Get behind me, Commander! I'll take care of- Hang on, my whistle... Fwee-fwee!
Thanks! So you do appreciate my guard work, huh?
Won't you join the Port Guards?

ex.line: ...You're here, Commander! I was just thinking I should come and meet you - firstly for your safety, and secondly because... I want to be with you more, of course!
No matter how strict I make the security or how many barricades I erect, there's no end to the people sneaking into your office... I really think I should be here 24/7 for your safety!
*pant*... *pant*... Have you seen Bristol and Fu Shun? Ugh, I've TOLD them not to run in the corridor... So was I? Well, that's because I was trying to catch them!
Commander, I wanna come along on the next party! You do need someone to maintain order around the venue, and besides... umm... don't you want a female companion by your side?
I know that expression - you're raring to go out on a break, aren't you? ...Yippee! I got it right! I'll start making safety preparations right away!
I'll take my hat off! I won't get to feel the warmth of your hand otherwise!
If you want a change of pace, how about making my emergency light shine like the rainbow?
I-I can't focus when you do this... You're making it hard to protect you...
Welcome back, Commander! I request your cooperation in a routine inspection - also so I can check if you were hurt!
Commander, I'm here to patrol your office! ...Hm? That's the 17th time today? Oh boy... Uh, this is embarrassing to admit, but I, um... I just ended up here because I can't stop thinking about you...

lines.line: Can you see me, Commander? I'm here to deliver your takeaway and a parcel! I've already made sure there's no danger out here - oh, and look, my ID! Just like the staff regulations stipulate! Come on, it's safe to open the door!

Can you see me, Commander? I'm here to deliver your takeaway and a parcel! I've already made sure there's no danger out here - oh, and look, my ID! Just like the staff regulations stipulate! Come on, it's safe to open the door!
Alright, you finally answered. Open the door quickly, before your takeaway gets cold and loses flavour! Also, I want to see you!
The delivery drone broke down during the holiday, so I came to help! Ensuring the orderly distribution of goods is also one of the captain's duties!
I got here 30 minutes ahead of time? Ahahaha... Well, I sort of prioritised your delivery. That's against the rules, so don't tell anyone!

It looks so nice and breezy inside your house. Mind if I take a quick break inside? I've, um, still got time before my next delivery, so... Alright, cheers! Let me also just take this off... No, I was talking about my jacket!
Why I came here on a regular bicycle? Well, um, Fargo and Akashi DID provide an e-bike, but I was in such a rush that I ran into something and broke it...
H-hey! I'm covered in sweat!
You want me to stay? Alright, let me just first check if the delivery drone has been repaired!
Commander... I'll be late for my next delivery if you won't stop...
You've got an urgent mission? Well, that happens. The lunch will have to wait until the mission's done!
Heehee. Mission comple- Oh, blimey, I'm gonna be late for my next delivery! Excuse me! Enjoy your meal!
I was worried what might've happened since you weren't answering your door. I was THIS close to putting up police tape and everything!
...Exhausted? Nonsense! I'm only covered in sweat because I wanted to see you as soon as possible. Yes, of course I obeyed the traffic laws!
Fiji-class light cruiser - Trinidad.
I'm Trinidad of the Royal Navy. Want to know more about me? Okay, then look at this - there's my red nails, then the aroma in my hair... everything about me hides a secret waiting to be found by you.
Heehee, you look like a fun one, Commander... Let's find out whether you'll go on the offensive or run away like prey would♪
Your collar is a little loose. I can adjust it for you. Want me to spray some heartening perfume on you while I'm at it?
Oh, you think I adore red colours too much? Personally, I think beautiful, dangerous colours suit me. What do you think?
Aww, my nails aren't quite coming together. Commander, mind if I repaint them right away?
Can I interest you in a game, Commander? I'll hug you from behind, and you have to guess who it is - well, I suppose there'd be no guessing involved♪
Work this, work that... I'm dying for a break, so why don't we have some tea? No? Why won't you just answer, "Okay, let's"?
Ooh, your hand feels kind of cold... Want me to warm it up?
Hm? I'm watching you.
Ahh... You're awfully dominant today... You gonna stop here, or will you keep going?
My, you've got some unfinished missions. Shall we do them together? It's not good to be lazy, you know.
You haven't claimed your mission rewards? Is that because you're hoping for some special reward from me?
Commander, a new letter has arrived. Want me to whisper its contents to you?
Good work out there, Commander. If you're tired, want to rest in my lap? Oh, is that a blush I see?
Commander, the commission team is back. Shall we go and see them? Let's also take a detour while we're out and about♪
Heehee. Want to see how much I've grown?
You like it when I get serious? Okay, then watch this.
Oh my, your eyes are glowing, Commander. Was my performance that charming, hmm?
Whew... I might've lost my cool back there...
Caught you!
It's alright. A true hunter always finds a chance to strike back.
Now I know the kind of person you are. So disappointing. Maybe I'll resume my little hunt...
Heehee... You seem unwarrantedly wary of me. Oh well. If anything, I like it when my "prey" is like that.
Your blushing face is so much more fascinating than I imagined. I wanna see more of it.
That ba-dump, ba-dump I hear whenever I come near you... I wonder if it's coming from you - or maybe it's from me. How amusing...
How unexpected - I fell for you, and not the other way around. Which of us is really the prey, and who's really the hunter? Well, it's not like it matters now.

From now on, you're prey who belongs to me and me only... Ah, or perhaps I should say you're my "partner!" You chose me of your own accord, after all - we need to keep our game of cat and mouse going forever♡
My, my.. Your taste in gifts has gotten better and better. This is quite wonderful. I'll have to... think of a way to "return the favour"~♪
My, I see you and I are going hunting today♪

ex.line: Come a little closer... That's it - by transmitting the scent of my perfume onto you, everyone else will know that you're MY prey!
Our game of cat and mouse hasn't stopped just because you put a ring on me. I mean, it's more fun when the chase is still on, wouldn't you agree?
My perfume is starting to wear thin on you... I'd better reapply it. Alright, now come closer!
My, my, that look in your eyes... Did you grow more daring after our relationship deepened?
Heehee. You think my nails are gorgeous today? If you really like them so much, why not take my hand and examine them directly?
Heehee... You're really making my heart race right now...
My, what a happy "accident" that we touched just there♪
Heehee... Well? What are you going to do to me?
Welcome back, Commander! You must be exhausted. Why don't you have a rest on my lap? I wouldn't permit anyone but you to do that♡
Heehee. It looks like I've wound up as your prey. That said, this feeling of being caught by you is surprisingly nice♪

lines.line: Oh dear... You found me already? Here I thought I'd surprise you with my swimsuit... Oh well, what's done is done. Wanna go swimming? And don't worry, I'm as gentle as they get when I play the instructor♪

Oh dear... You found me already? Here I thought I'd surprise you with my swimsuit... Oh well, what's done is done. Wanna go swimming? And don't worry, I'm as gentle as they get when I play the instructor♪
You got here at just the right time, Commander. I was about to put on suntan lotion, heehee. I'm saying, of course, that you'll do it for me.
Relax, I AM wearing my swimsuit. Hey... Wait, did you think I wasn't, or something?
You can't just barge into the changing room, Commander! What's that? It's your private changing room? Yes, I'm quite aware!
Care to guess the colour and design of my swimsuit, hmm? If you get it right... maybe something nice will happen!
Heehee. I feel the coolness of the sea breeze on your hand.
Doing THIS in the changing room... You're a bold one, aren't you?
Eek♡ If I lied to you by saying, "I'm wearing a swimsuit," this would cause a real uproar.
Oh, you have missions left to do? Gosh, did my swimsuit really distract you that badly?
Go and claim those mission rewards. It's not like I'm going anywhere. Heehee♡
A new letter has come in. Then again, you're in no position to read it right now♡
Did you enjoy your swim? Not to be rude, but I think there's still room for improvement in your technique. Want me to enlighten you?
The commission team has returned. Before we go see them, could you check if my swimsuit is on properly?
You're pretty bonkers for this swimsuit, huh? Setting up an ambush for you really was the right call... I wonder what will happen now that we're all alone in the changing room♪
Heavy cruiser - Anchorage.
Heavy... cruiser, Anchorage! With the Eagle Union! I love Teacher the most...!
Anchorage... is here! Com-man-der? Hmm... Anchorage will call you... Teacher!
Anchorage really, really... really wanted to see you!
Drawing... done! This is Teacher... and this is Anchorage! We're in the sun...!
Teacher... Hold hands! In my sleeve!
Teacher, what's your favorite color? Anchorage likes... rainbow!
Anchorage's tongue... is blue? Because of candy? Why...? I don't get it!
Teacher... Do you like this thing on my head? You can have it! Hnnh... It won't come off...!
Teacher... Anchorage wants to fly high!
Warm hands... Touch, touch!
Work... again? Good luck, Teacher! Anchorage will do my best to help...!
Work... done? Teacher... Let's go outside!
Mail...? Anchorage doesn't get it... Can I fold stars with it?
Teacher... is back! Anchorage has been folding bunnies... I like the red and blue ones!
Everyone is back... Anchorage is excited. Let's play together...!
Anchorage... is amazing! I can protect Teacher... the best!
It's time... to fight! Teacher, everyone!
Anchorage and Teacher... won? Yay... I'm so happy!
Aah... Anchorage is scared! Teacher, help me...
Anchorage isn't scared!
Owwie... Anchorage is scared... *sniffle*
Teacher... Is something wrong? Are you sick? Anchorage will take care of you!
Teacher working... Anchorage isn't lonely, though! Teacher is here... That's all I need!
Anchorage likes candy the most! You can have some!
Teacher's hands are so warm and soft... They feel good! Anchorage is happy...! I like it! Teacher... Keep going! Yeah...!
When will there be... a shooting star? Anchorage wants to make a wish... to be together forever and ever... with Teacher!
Anchorage... has seen this in books! Wearing it on your ring finger... is a promise! Teacher and Anchorage... together forever! Yay!
Teacher... Anchorage loves... all of your gifts!

ex.line: Teacher, huuug... Warm... Anchorage loves you!
Teacher... Choose a block color! We can make a castle... together! A castle for you and me!
Anchorage is sleepy! Nap time...! Teacher... Hold me?
Princess and Prince, hugging... Do you like it? Anchorage wants a hug from you...!
Pink candy for you...! It turns your tongue pink! Like mine...!
Anchorage will be good... Pet me more, Teacher!
Wooow! Teacher... I'm so high up!
Anchorage... likes this! I'll touch Teacher, too!
Teacher... You're back! Lots of bunnies... for you!
Teacher, Anchorage will fold... so many stars for you! Shooting stars! Make lots of wishes...! Like being together forever!

lines.line: Type 1928 battlecruiser - Admiral Zenker.
I'm Admiral Zenker, a battlecruiser for the Iron Blood. My birth here was unexpected, but as you've given me a reason to exist, I plan to live up to your lofty expectations of me.

Battlecruiser Admiral Zenker reporting for duty. I've put together a strategy based on the port's current conditions, so if you'd take a look at that first... Huh? You want me to go on a tour first?! W-wait, this doesn't fall under the twelve potential scenarios I planned for!
Commander, I sorted files for review by priority. Just check them in order, and you'll be fine.
I already simulated this move in my brain. Next, you'll... W-wait, that's not what I thought you'd... I have to recalculate this... A-am I going to lose?!
Commander, I've planned our next mission's defensive deployments and offensive routes. There are six things I need you to check on, though, so please take a look.
You need a pen? You can have the grey one in the blue pen holder... Put it back when you're done, please.
I've simulated this strategy countless times. It should be theoretically perfect... Ugh, I still need backup plans.
Huh?! D-don't do that without warning, please!
Commander, your next affair is... a last-minute appointment? Okay, I'll handle your work... Wait, it's a date with me?! I-I wasn't informed of thiiis!
W-wait, not that yet... M-my heart isn't ready!
Commander, please finish your missions soon. Else they'll conflict with other work I have scheduled for you later.
Finished ahead of schedule? Then you've earned a good break until our next assignment.
Commander, it's time to check your mail. Please begin as soon as possible.
Commander, you're home later than expected. Did you run into any issues? Huh? You were just taking a little walk? D-did my schedule unduly stress you? I'll fix it right now!
The commission fleet is back on schedule, and their goods have been inspected. Here's the list for your perusal.
These power-ups are, of course, all part of the plan.
All according to plan... Commence combat!
Perfect. The rest of the operation should go just as I planned.
The situation has changed?! I-I'll revise my strategy right away...
Dance in the palm of my hand!
It's all under control!
You do nothing but disrupt my plans. It's troubling.
Commander, I've finished preparing a battle plan for your review. Please provide any revisions in the next thirty minutes.
Your tactics come so far out of left field that they throw my strategy into disarray. What a Commander you are... Let me think! I'll turn the tables here, I promise!
It's hard to focus on work when you stare at me... Umm... I guess that's my own problem, though...

All of my plans fall into disarray when it comes to you lately... It's not your fault! I just can't control my feelings well. I need to calm down more, but just thinking about you drives me crazy... You must understand, surely.

I've rehearsed every little word and action of this little moment so many times now, but when I'm faced with you, I realize it was all unnecessary... There are so many things I want to say to you, but I don't know where to start. Commander... Please, let me take my whole lifetime to share it all with you!
Oh... Goodness, I love it, thank you! I never thought you'd get me this...
Let's seize a perfectly planned victory!

ex.line: According to the schedule, we have reports first... B-but first, can I have a minute of your time for a... a hug?
Did you learn a new trick?! If I learned this, I could take the enemy by surprise and land another... Oh, not you, of course. After all, you're my... Urk, you already know what I want to say...
Commander, you've been working long enough... Take a break while you have time. I'll make you a cup of coffee.
...Tickets for the exhibition this weekend? Yes, I'd love to join you... Oh, but I had plans for Saturday. Hmm... I've changed my plans. I did it the moment you invited me!
Commander, where's that pen I gave you? It was definitely here before... Huh? You take it everywhere with you? I see... That's great!
Wait, my hair's not done yet... U-umm, okay, you can touch it...
Your next plan is... a date with me... I haven't made detailed plans, so it's up to you to decide what happens... Okay?
Following your heart instead of a plan... is nice once in a while.
Commander, you're home later than expected. Did you run into any issues? I-I was worried about you... Heehee, you did come home safe, so I'll get back to work.

I take pride in my maturity and reason, but they don't help at all when I'm with you... Now I find myself HOPING for little surprises. Thank you, Commander... You made me realize that the most important thing in life isn't the perfect plan, but time with the people you love.

lines.line: You want me to spill the beans? Heh. Hate to disappoint you... Phew... Did that sound good? I thought up other responses I could try, too.
You want me to spill the beans? Heh. Hate to disappoint you... Phew... Did that sound good? I thought up other responses I could try, too.
Urgh, the light... Ah, you're here. Still haven't given up yet, I presume? Wait, I don't think that came out right. It's hard to be mean when I'm dealing with you.
You think my lines and performance are perfect? Well, I did practice a lot on my own... This is the first time anyone's ever taken my rehearsals seriously.
There are a whole lot of people out there who wanna see you dead. Why waste time on little old me? I'll never give you my true identity.
You know your measly interrogation isn't enough. This will amount to nothing.
This is my first time being in a movie. It's fun to prepare and perform with everyone. I just wish people would stop being late and disrupting plans.
Too bad for you, you'll never get a look inside my mind. Heh.
You can leave the cuffs as they are - they don't hurt. It's easier to get immersed in the role, too... Are you worried about me, Commander?
Ack?! Are we ad-libbing?! U-umm, let me think of how to react to this... Hmm...
Commander, isn't it your break time? Are you sure you can change your plans just to help me practice lines? ...You just wanted to be with me? Heh, you always know just how to surprise me...
Why won't I look you in the eye? Umm... The script does say that I should, but when I do, I suddenly forget my lines. Um, let me try again... Nope! Not happening...
Type VIIC submarine - U-552.

I was part of all kinds of operations, and that busy bee lifestyle just wasn't for me. That's why I'll be taking things at my own speed at this port. I'm gonna rest when I want to and wrap things up quickly when I gotta fight. The perfect, comfy rhythm of life!
*yawn*... Guess it's work day again. Or maybe you and I can skip work together. Either way, gimme your orders.
Whew. Nice work. Man, I really gotta find a cozier place to lie down than the bottom of the sea. Mmgh...
Whenever you wanna raise efficiency or save energy, I'm your girl. I can even teach you my tricks to recharge your batteries in a flash.
Commander, your office couch is placed perfectly for me to take a nap in the warm sunlight. Mind if I borrow it? It won't interfere with your work, promise!

Check out this best desserts list I just found. This pudding looks like the perfect thing for recharging my batteries. Will you buy some for me? In exchange, I'll do some good work... for five minutes.

Your working efficiency still stands to be improved. I mean, look, you could change your schedule to this and free up an hour for rest. A healthy work ethic ensures long-term combat ability, you know?
Mmh... Your hand is so nice and warm.
Hey, I'm in a comfy spot here, so don't ruin it for me.
C-Commander?! Don't do that while I'm resting!
Yo, Commander, you've got a boatload of unfinished missions. It's a lot of effort, I know, but someone's gotta do 'em before things get real bad.
Not in a rush to collect those mission rewards, huh? Looks like we're both the laid-back type.
Commander, new letter's here. I'm only gonna notify you about this once since it's such a chore.
Mission complete. Just in the nick of time. 'Kay, so, let's go find a sunny place and have a little break.
Commander, a commission's done. I'll hold the fort while you go and collect the stuff.
Hmm. Feels like I'm lighter on my feet.
Wait, I'm the flagship? I don't like the responsibility, so let's get this over with!
Heh! Did you see that? My fighting skills are outta this world.
Hmm. Can't afford to get too sloppy, eh. I'll take it a little more seriously next time. Dealing with the aftermath sucks, and I'd hate to make you do that, Commander.
This is how you fight in power-saving mode!
Dammit... Let my guard down... but I'm still in the game!
Ugh... So tiring. Seriously, working with you is exhausting. Since I don't even get basic time to kick back, I'm gonna have to reconsider this job.
You've got an interesting work ethic, Commander. Could be more efficient, but hey. Teaching you my energy-saving method would be too much work, so it's fine the way things are now.
I recently realized that I get less time to unwind after working with you... What's weird is it makes me tired, but I'm fine with it. Pretty novel feeling for me. I'll have to read up about this!

Here, I made you some hot chocolate... Hm? Tastes sweet? Yeah, I added some syrup I've been reading about... Ah, never mind the deets! I just took some measures to efficiently replenish your energy 'cause you looked drained.
I thought being in love would take too much time and effort to be worth it. With you, though, I don't think that at all. If anything, I naturally feel like giving even more to you.
Hm? Wedding? Man, formal occasions are such a chore... Eh, it's a vow shared with you, so I'll take it seriously. Let me be with you, now and forever.
Hm? You bought this just for me? Wow... You remembered just what I like.
I wanna get this done quickly so we can take it easy!
Heh! The wolfpack comes when you least expect it!

ex.line: Whew. Perfect timing, Commander. I just found a sweet place to lie down. Wanna go there with me? It's way more refreshing than coffee, I guarantee it.
I'm a pro when it comes to saving energy, but I have tons of it to spend just on you. Don't go around telling people that, though.
I moved your couch so the sun can shine on us both. Come here and we'll have a relaxing afternoon together.
Were you spying on me sleeping AGAIN? Heh. If you're tired, just say it. I can give you a lap pillow at least every once in a while.
I've been feeling so incredibly at ease when you're around lately. It's probably 'cause... Never mind. It's too embarrassing to say out loud!
Hey. You said you'd let me rest today... Then again, your hands are really warm. I guess you could keep going for just a little while.
Commander, you wanna get lazy with me?
Commander, I know we're an item, but... you know, it's just... Like, at least... Hey! That's not what I'm getting at!
I'm getting some solid work done, aren't I? It's cause I'm doing it in the most efficient way. Anyway, as a reward, let me rest on your shoulder!
Did you know that my favorite part of the day isn't naptime, but rather the time I spend staring while you work? As much as I think you need to ease off, seeing you in action always moves my heart.

lines.line: Ahem... Excuse me, since you've come aboard on our special sightseeing tour, please do try to keep up with me. Rest assured, this bus is perfectly safe and I can promise you a good time.
Ahem... Excuse me, since you've come aboard on our special sightseeing tour, please do try to keep up with me. Rest assured, this bus is perfectly safe and I can promise you a good time.
Hello and welcome aboard our sightseeing bus. Today, we'll be... Ugh. I've had enough. No one's here yet anyway, so can't we just keep it real? This "trip" is gonna get interesting soon.
This uniform sucks... Just gotta bear with it so I don't get found out. Hey, do you think I look like a proper tour guide?
The next stop is... Psst, I'll take you to that secret base before they catch on to us. But first, want some sweets?
Are you still thinking about the script? Hmm... You could add a scene with some chemistry between the tour guide and the customer. I think it'll make the "trip" more natural.
Ahem. Pardon me, I'm supposed to be working right now...
Mmh... This uniform doesn't fit right... Dear passenger, this is not the time or place for this!
C-Commander! You can't do that now! ...Hey, cut it out!
Pardon me, but you can't put your feet up yet. You still have missions to be focusing on, no?
Oh, you finished a mission? Great, but my mission's still ongoing.
Dear passenger, the latest edition of Tourist's Digest is here. I've sorted it for you, putting the most important destination info at the very top.

It's finally over... Having to act like this is so exhausting. I guess it's not so bad if you think of this like a special date between you and me. I still want a more laid-back role next time, though.

I may not look it, but I'm overjoyed to be in the same play as you. Although, playing a secret agent pretending to be a tour guide... Ugh. It's so much work. At least you're covering for me, so all my hard work feels worth it. Hey, what do you say we... go on a real date next time?
Type 1934A destroyer - Z13.
Iron Blood destroyer Z13, cross-sector consultant, at your service. I offer professional solutions for everything you can think of, from port construction to combat deployments.

Heheh, I'm Erich Koellner, otherwise known as Z13. I know you like the back of my hand, Commander, and I've set up some long and short-term stretch goals for you. We'll discuss the details later when we have the time♪

I think we should remodel your office using my expertise, heehee. Based on the latest studies on residential environments, I suggest you move your desk 3.5 degrees to the southeast for improved productivity.

Interesting. So this is what they mean by attrition warfare... Ah, it's you, Commander. I was just watching a military TV show. We consultants need to stay up to date on the latest tactics to give innovative advice, you see!
Are you drafting the next operation? I think we should start by researching the enemy's psychology... How do we do that, you ask? Ah, well... it's a long-term commitment...
Hey, you, the workaholic! Eat some fruit. It's got vitamins that help soothe your nerves, and it's already washed. Come on, open wide!
I conducted some detailed research on the market's seasonal prices and bought this fluffy accessory! I love it! You can hug it to sleep whenever you want! I recommend it if you want to do just that!
Nice sunglasses, aren't they? They're optimized with funnel analysis!

Here's an easy stress relief trick you can do in your office! Start by taking six and a half deep breaths, then... What? How to take half a breath? That's the important part of this trick! Come on, do it with me!
Wow, don't you think this is a horrible way of relieving stress? ...I'm kidding! Go on, keep at it!
Commander, a new mission list has arrived. Allow me, your professional consultant, to provide you with some reasonable solutions!

Mission complete! Exemplary work, Commander. Why don't we wind down by playing a game? ...You think I play games too much? Tsk-tsk-tsk, you're clearly not in the know. Games are an excellent way of relieving stress!

I've marked your mail to denote priority and the like! There are seven types in all, and... Hm? There are so many marks that they're effectively useless? Uhh... This is actually just to practice my sorting skills!
Here, have a taste of my specialty nerve-soothing drink! You see, milk has a calming effect, and tea relieves stress, so... "That's just milk tea"? Why, yes, it IS milk tea!
Commander, if you want to solve a financial difficulty, start by considering how your cash flow... Hm? A goods inspection first of all? Um, that's kind of outside the field of consultancy.
More or less the same as in my combat simulations. Heehee.
We're going in fast! Focus on their core! Go!
An effortless win! You get that and more when you leave it to me!
Defeat? No, no, no - it's called showing them your weakness to then catch them off guard!
Target elimination! Suppressive fire!
Watch out for depth charges!
*sigh*... Not even you can keep up with the groundbreaking genius of my strategic mind...

Commander, make me your development advisor! We'll start by expanding into maritime tourism, leisure industries, and niche food industries. Within three years, I'll turn the port into the world's biggest corporation!

See - doesn't my advice work wonders? Heheh. This is just scratching the surface, I'll have you know. Remember: You can always come to me with questions! I'll answer to the best of my knowledge and offer the best solution I can!

Speaking as your personal consultant, you ought to put your work down for a moment and do some relaxing activities with me. I know you doubt me, but don't give me that look! This is for YOUR sake! Now come on, let's start with a warm hug! How about it?

Commander, have you heard of the "palpitation syndrome" that's been all the buzz lately? It apparently makes you way more productive. Wanna try it? You put your hand here, like this... Did you feel my palpitations? Hm? Aww, you can be so cute! Let me guess... you feel the same excitement as I do, don't you?

I've been doing a lot of research into the psychology of love, and I think you made the optimum choice by going for me. How can I prove it? Well, right now, I can't! That's because all the love hormones are flooding my head with thoughts of you! Heehee♡
I really like this! Commander, did you run a funnel analysis on me?
Don't cry now! Wanna talk about it?
The plan is... Hey, don't go rushing in!

ex.line: Commander, based on the latest findings in residential environment research, we should move your desk about 20 centimeters closer to your window. It'll give you just the right amount of sunlight. You just sit back and relax and I'll do it!

Oh, Commander! I'm just researching the behavioral science of love here. Heehee - it so happens I'm on the part about lust, and there's a surprising amount of depth to it. How about we both read it and see if all the theories hold up in practice? Heheh♡
Commander, you need an optimal recovery position to get the most out of your rest. There's an easy one, actually - just lie down, then place your head in my lap... There we go!

You want everyone at the port to get more friendly? Okay, then you'll have to work on improving cross-field integration! There are lots of ways to do it, but in short, make them share more meals. If you'll be present, let me know when in advance and I'll come with you!
My outfit's pretty good, don't you think? It's made to strictly comply with the rule of thirds and color theory. Hm? It's "puppy-like" on the whole? Heheh, maybe you like puppies like me, then, huh?
According to theories on emotional management, patting someone's head like this makes them... Mmh... Your hand feels so nice I totally forgot what I was gonna say.
A massage? Yeah, of course! If I give you advice, I sure as heckfire can give you a... Hm? You want to give ME a massage?
No need to hold yourself back - you can go a little further. Through the lens of love in practice, this is a perfectly normal thing!

Commander, I made coffee for you. Just remember that while coffee does keep you awake, you shouldn't drink too much of it. I've been studying nutritional science and I know a thing or two, so I'm gonna start making healthy, refreshing drinks for you every day!
Commander, the commission fleet is back! Allow me to handle the resource management side of things.

Commander! I've come up with a plan to manage our relationship. Firstly, we have to share a hug every day to uphold our intimacy; secondly, we need to express our love to one another to stay holden to our commitment; thirdly, we need to engage in... activities to maintain our passion. I think you get what I'm hinting at!

lines.line: ...Yes, I know I'm on the clock, but taking productive breaks helps raise your working efficiency afterward! You should take one, too - come sit and kill time wi- Ahem! I mean, come sit and have a break with me!

...Yes, I know I'm on the clock, but taking productive breaks helps raise your working efficiency afterward! You should take one, too - come sit and kill time wi- Ahem! I mean, come sit and have a break with me!
Hm? You here to watch me work? I'm not slacking on the job! This is what's called a strategic break period!

That Long Island, I swear... It's like she doesn't grasp the importance of holding on to areas. I would fire a barrage of advice her way, but getting up would be such a pain... I know! I'll type out a message with my feet!

According to the latest research, wearing matching clothes - uniforms, maid outfits, et cetera - sharply increases team synergy! How about we make it a port-wide thing? You, of course, can wear whatever you want.
Do you like this color? I can strategically change my clothes if you're not a fan, but if you are... want me to paint some hearts on your nails, too?

Come on, Commander, you of all people should know how important a work-life balance is! Take a seat already and... Oh, no vacant seats? Alright, then why don't you just take mine and I'll get real comfy on your lap?
Wear a sleep mask and experience what it's like to have my vision blocked? Sounds interesting. Heehee!
You asking to borrow my ID card? Sure thing, although I can't use my hands right now since I'm waiting for my nail polish to dry. Just go ahead and take it by yourself♪
My cubicle is in a bit of a blind spot, so we can get up to anything we want and nobody will ever know!

Commander, efficiency matters even when conducting inspections. I've come up with some plans for you and divided the office into four sections and... What? You're not here to watch? So... are you here to see me, then?

Hey, Commander! Heehee - you know, we're having drinks and watching a stream - isn't this basically a date? ...What? No, 'cause we're on the clock? Well, we're on a date in secret, then! Doesn't the notion of a secret office romance make your heart race? Heheh.
Large cruiser - Ägir.
All the territory I can see from up on my throne belongs to me! That includes you, obviously! Now kneel before me! Ahahahaha!
Heheh! I'm gonna show you how amazing the god of the sea is! ...Huh? Why are you laughing! Stop it! Don't you treat me like some kid!
Oh, it's you! Do you wanna see my toy- I mean, my abyssal kingdom?
Commander! How do you like my kingdom? It's still pretty small, but with your help, it will become something truly legendary!
This juice is so sweet. It's so much better than those adult drinks, isn't it? Heheh! It has to be!
Commander, come walk with- No, I mean, tour my kingdom with me!
You've not given me enough snack offerings, Commander. Hm? I'll get cavities if I eat too much? I-I don't care! I'm not scared of cavities!
Hmph! The god of the sea doesn't yield so easily... Mrgh... Ah...
Hm? Do you have an offering for the god of the sea?
Whoa! Th-there's a limit to how much rudeness I'll tolerate! I'm going to smack you with my treasured sword!
You still have unfinished work to do, don't you? You're not allowed to be lazy! Go get it done then come play with me!
And this is why I picked you, Commander. Go get your rewards. Oh, and pour me some juice to celebrate!
Huh? A new letter? Can you read it out to me?
Heheh. You're back, huh? Have you brought offerings for the god of the sea? ...I'm talking about that! The juice in your hand!
The commission team is back? I hope they brought some fun toys along.
I've grown stronger! Time to celebrate with some juice! ...*cough cough*! I drank too fast and it got in my lungs... *cough*...
Set sail! Protect the abyssal kingdom!
Hahaha! Do you get it now? That's the power of the god of the sea! ...Hm? Why are you laughing, Commander?
They cheated, that's all... It... It had nothing to do with my short feet or being unable to catch up with them!
Feel the power of the god of the sea!
This is nothing for me!
Hmph! You're a meanie who won't even drink juice with me. I'm sending you to toy prison so you can think about what you've done!
You want my approval that much? Okay, then start by giving me some yummy snacks and fun toys to play with!
Commander, let's play hide-and-seek! It'll be your super-special trial!
Aww... Where'd you go, Commander? My kingdom needs you...
I've come to a decision, Commander! You're going to play with me forever and... No, wait, you're going to be my servant and serve me forever! Got it?

Today is a special day! I've made up my mind - you're not just gonna be my servant, you're also gonna be my trusted knight! Your job will obviously be to protect me, your lord, but also... to always play with me!
Wow, you're giving this to me? ...I-if you insist, I suppose I wouldn't mind. Heheh~♪

ex.line: Ah, my knight is here. Do you wanna pla- I mean, tour the kingdom? We could also sit on the throne together.
This is my toy castle- Err, the palace of my abyssal kingdom! But now it's also your house... By that I mean, your knightly guard station! Stop laughing!
Playing with you is my favorite thing... Huh? Y-you didn't hear that, did you?!
Maybe I should make my throne bigger. It needs to be big enough to fit us both.
Listen, you! Just because I treat you differently doesn't mean you get to treat me like a child!
This is just... Don't tell anyone about this, okay?!
Doing this to me isn't your job! Your job is to protect me!
Th-that tickles! You are so discourteous! I'm gonna punish you!
Welcome back! What kind of juice do you have this time? ...Ahem! I'm asking 'cause I wanna drink it with you! I just want us to relax, that's all.

You know, my favorite thing is playing with y- I mean, governing my abyssal kingdom with you! Look, you know what I'm trying to say! I've grown used to you looking after and protecting me, so you'd better never leave me!

lines.line: Type 1913 battlecruiser - Masséna.

I'm Masséna, Iris Orthodoxy battlecruiser... I guess. People say I've been blessed way too much and need to taste what failure's like. It probably tastes bad, so I'm not too keen to experience it. If you hate the taste of failure, too, then I know a way to avoid it - just bring me wherever you go.
You're the Commander... Uhh, do I have to follow your orders? Okay. I mean, I'll try... By the way, could I have some of those snacks you got in your pocket? They look really yummy.
You're here. I was just getting bored. Are we doing holy tasks again? Why don't we do something fun before that? I think we'll have an easier time after.

Eat yummy food and fight battles you can win. Food that's yucky to you is still somebody else's favorite food. When you end up in a losing battle, there'll be reinforcements coming to help. Hmm... That's me in a nutshell, I guess? If you think this covers me well enough, I can accept that.
I found loads of coins while at the beach today, so I used them all on snacks and... Oh, right, I also found a button. It's the one you said you lost the other day, right?
Hm? Okay... I see... Whew... I listened to the whole thing. To your battle plan. Can I have the snacks in your pocket now?
Shoot. I won't make it in time for the apple pie... Hm? Are you eating apple pie right now? Nom. I made it in time. Heehee.
Uhh... Does doing this grant you a blessing? It does feel pretty nice, so it's not like I have a problem with it.
What? ...My "power" can help you? Then use it as you like!
Ahh... Hahh... Will this... bring you good fortune?
You've got missions. If you're not gonna do them, hang out with me.
You completed a mission. That took you a while. Can we enjoy ourselves now?
You should give me a hug before you read your letter. It'll turn all the contents into good news.
It's you... *growl*... I smell something yummy. Is all that food for me? Wonderful - everything should go perfectly for you today. As long as you stick around me, that is.
Commander, the commission team is back. Their haul of goodies looks really appealing... Yeah, I have a feeling there's some delicious food in there.
Hmm... You should keep following my gut feelings. Victory comes more easily when you do.
Let the battle begin! Victory's all but guaranteed.
Oh. It's over. Did I even do anything?
Huh? We lost? There's no way.
Blessed be my power!
Ugh... My strength's running out... I need some snacks...
Ugh. You don't smell like tasty food anymore...
I'll help you fix the things that trouble you. As long as you give me snacks or hang out with me, at least.

Commander, this one, this, and this - they're all delicious. See? I collected their packaging to show you. Hm? They're already in your drawer? Open it up and let me see... Just a look-see, that's all.

I've been looking for your missing badge ever since you told me about it. I ate all the snacks I bought with my spare change, and I still couldn't fit it... I don't understand why... Can you hug me, Commander? Because I feel like I've just tasted something gross...

What you want most is to keep winning forever? Then you have to keep hugging me forever. Your biggest wish should come true that way. Hm? You already have what you want most? ...You mean me? Okay... Hey, can I take a small bite out of you? Nom... I love you, Commander...

I will give myself to you and protect your future. Your wishes are my wishes, and your commitments are mine as well. When you need me, I'll come running... even if there's a pile of snacks in front of me!
Thank you, Commander... Can I take a bite now?
Smells good... Can I have a bite? Just one!

ex.line: I was just thinking about you, Commander. Let's hang out a little bit before work. I'll even give you a hug so your work will go perfectly.
Today I encountered an enemy that retreated without a fight and a really, really delicious Commander... Nom. Oops - I felt so happy I couldn't help but take a bite.
Oh. There's something on your lips. Let me just... *lick*... Heehee. Sweet and tasty, just like you always taste♪
*poke poke*... Are you sleeping? Then you need a blanket to- Oops! Sorry, I tripped over the blanket... On the bright side, your embrace feels... so calming.
Commander, I want to help you with all sorts of things, but nothing I've tried has worked. Maybe... if you take me out today, we'll cross paths with all kinds of delicious food. I mean, right?
Mhm. You can keep patting me as long as you want to.
There's nothing under my skirt. Nope, I'm not hiding snacks under there.
There's no room for snacks here... Do you still want a blessing? Well, um...
What's that lovely smell? ...Oh, you're back, Commander. Is that, umm, the smell of food or the smell of you? Do you mind if I check real quick?

All the things I've done for you somehow ended in failure. *sigh*... This might be the first time I've tasted this "failure" thing. Hm? "Don't do them for me, do them for yourself, because seeing you happy makes me happy, too"? I'm so glad to hear you say that! Um... Could you have... just a small taste of me? Just... give me a little chomp?

lines.line: Commander, this spring has a sweet taste to it. You should try it.
Commander, this spring has a sweet taste to it. You should try it.
Ooh... This spring feels so nice. It's a bit too hot, though... Commander, could you fetch me a cold towel?
Come into the water, Commander. It'll sweeten you up and make you delicious, I think.
My towel doesn't do much if I use it like this, you say? Well, could you adjust it for me?
Just gonna lie on my stomach... Ahh, that's good... I wonder - if my body turns as soft as a marshmallow, will I taste good?
These cherries are sooo sweet. Ahh... Wow, they're so sweet it feels like I'm on a cloud... Hm? And now I've fallen into your arms? Heehee - the water must have made me dizzy.
This one tuft of hair just won't flatten out, even in the bath.
Your hand feels colder than the water. You should warm it up.
D-don't take away my lucky blessing, or I won't be able to stand up...
Splash, splash... Blub-blub-blub... You got a new mission in the middle of a bath?
Come here, Commander... I see you brought snacks for me. I'll just dig right in! Nom♪

Commander, my face feels so warm, and my heart's racing... but I think we're the same temperature. Heehee. Your heart's racing, too, and your face... looks so yummy. It must taste sweeter than a cherry. Heh. Nom♪
Independence-class light aircraft carrier - Bois Belleau.

I'm Bois Belleau, a light aircraft carrier under the Holy Iris banner. But I'm more interested in you... Strip for me so I can examine you, please. Why? As I recall, I already told you that ensuring your health is my most sacred of duties...

Bois Belleau. I handle logistics and care for the Iris Orthodoxy. I also keep an eye out for everyone's health - particularly yours, Commander. Keeping you healthy and sane is the most sacred of my duties.
...Ah! Right, let's begin today's work.
Tch, more and more sacred duties... Hm? You're going to work overtime? That isn't necessary - leave it all to me, and you can go home and rest.
Your work environment meets health standards. Continue your sacred duties without worry. I'll be here to help in case you have any problems.
Hm hm♪... Soft music is good for relaxation. Try it out, Commander. Sleep well, and have good dreams... I'll take care of the remaining work.
Staying late again? Okay. I'll work with you and try not to suddenly fall... Zzz... Hnh?! It's okay. I'm definitely... not... falling asleep...
Nnh... I'm not sleeping. Wh-what do you want?
What's the matter? Do you need health counseling, or... is there work you need me to do?! (Why am I so flustered? It was just a light touch. Calm yourself...)
Wh-wh-what are you doing?! How unholy, how... You can't DO that in the midst of our sacred duties! It's obscene!
New missions have arrived and require urgent attention. I'll help you, so don't worry.
I'm glad we've finished our sacred duties on time. Now I can finally sleep...
Mail's here. I'll get it... Say, don't you think you rely on me too much now? Is that really what you want?
Thank you for your efforts. We still have many sacred duties... Nnh... Okay, that's everything! Hm...? Oh, we just started? Sorry... I must've dreamed of finishing it all.
Break time is over. Let's go greet the commission team.
With greater power comes more plentiful responsibilities... Tch, whatever. I guess that's what I'm here for.
I'm not done yet. We will win.
Outstanding victory, everyone. Nnh... Sorry, I fell asleep. Let's make arrangements for our next battle.
...We lost? This is going to double my work... Tch, whatever. What matters now is a timely retreat.
One after another, endlessly... Time to finish this all at once!
There are still people in need of help... Back to work!
I'm limiting our communications solely to work situations. Is that a problem for you?
Among my sacred duties, the most important is caring for you - that is, maintaining your health. But don't mistake that for meaning that you can neglect regular medical examinations.
I've done all of the trivial work available, so that should lighten the load on you for... Zzz... Ah! No, I didn't do an all-nighter. I just stayed a little extra...

Looking good. I feel my efforts are working... Hmm? You're actually following my health advice? That's great. Ideally, you'll put the same effort into your sacred duties. I'll be there to help you, of course.

Wait, I'll finish my work right away so we can talk... Argh, I messed up! Stupid... I know I can't balance sacred duties and physical affection at the same time, but I still try... Hm? You'll be with me to help? Haha... I didn't think you'd be the one taking care of me this time...

What is it that makes me want to be so close to you? We were only together for work, but we've become so intimate. It's as if you're caring for me... How did you turn the tables like that? *sigh*... I'll keep performing my sacred duties for you and take better care of you than ever from now on.
You went through the effort of finding out what I like? Thank you for the thought.

ex.line: Commander? I dealt with all of the urgent work already. Say, for the sake of our health... Would you nap with me? You'll just have to wake me up on time...
Hmhmhm♪~ Does this melody calm you? O-oh, is that the first time I've hummed for you? Well... Did you like it?
...Smile? If you want me to, I'll try... H-how's this? Cute...? Wh-what are you going on about?
Zzzz... Hm? Just let me work... So much left to do... Hwuh? That was last night? Was I just dreaming about work, then?
I'm getting sleepy, but I haven't finished my advance work yet... Huh? I can stop for today? Okay... I guess I don't have to push myself in front of you.
Zzzz... Mmm, Commander... That feels nice...
Ahem... Are you feeling unwell? Lie down, and I'll examine you.
W-we're doing sacred work right now! We can't... O-oh, fine, then...
Good work today, Commander. Would you like a head massage? Y-you can lie down in my lap... As long as it helps you relax...

Your advice helped me out a lot. I stopped working late every night, and now we mutually care for each other. Umm... You know, persistence over the long term is important when it comes to caring for others! Will you stay with me for as long as it takes?

lines.line: Finished your sacred work? I looked into hot spring therapy a little to help you relax a little. It's the warmest and most pleasant healing method I've ever seen. Would you... come in with me?
Finished your sacred work? I looked into hot spring therapy a little to help you relax a little. It's the warmest and most pleasant healing method I've ever seen. Would you... come in with me?
After your hot spring treatment, you should be able to focus more on your work than before. Now, let's get to it. Want me to play some calming music?

Can you feel it? The water's warm, soft embrace... Your mind sinking into a sea of clouds, drifting away quietly... This hot spring therapy is incredible. It's so comfortable, I can't help but feel like I'm healing alongside you.
Your deliverables still aren't done? Well, if you work while you bathe, you probably won't get tired... I know that's impossible for you, though.
Ugh... My legs are numb from sitting like this for so long. Commander, we should get out for a while. Umm... Can you carry me?
It's easy to slip in here. Can you pull me up - Hyah?! Ah...
Mmm... Ah, now you've gone and healed ME, Commander...
I'm not giving you a massage in the hot spring. Try all you like, but I'm not indulging you this time...
Your heartbeat is quickening... Is your blood pressure spiking? Is it because of the hot spring... You're certain it's not? O-oh...
Zzz... Ah?! I-I could've slept until morning... Long baths really do make me sleepy.

You think... just being with me is enough to relax you? It sounds as if you're denying medical science... but if what you say is true, then would this be a kind of "couple's" hot spring therapy? While the hot spring soothes you, I myself am soothed BY you...
Duquesne-class heavy cruiser - Duquesne.

I am Duquesne, Templar Knight. My time spent on the field of battle is likely longer than you suspect. My hobby is to roam in search of sceneries new and specialties local. That should suffice for an introduction. If you thus desire, I shall be your glaive that cuts through the raging waves.

A view so fair and a townscape so welcoming... Ah, apologies. I am Duquesne, Templar Knight. Think of me as a pilgrim who fancies scrumptious food. If you'd ever like to hear about the Mediterranean's culture and geography, come and see me.
Ah, you've come early. I've laid out the paperwork that requires your attention. Oh, you flatter me. I did only what's expected of an adjutant.

I am packing my luggage for my next journey. Clothing, food, coinage... Yes, one person's worth. Journeying alone allows one to choose destinations on the spot. It's much more flexible than traveling with a caravan.

You've come. I'm presently recreating a dish I savored long ago in a foreign land. Ground beef is added to clarified butter with spices and gently cooked, its flavor most rich when it reaches medium rarity. Would you care for a taste?

Are you familiar with Demera? When I visited the port of Addis Ababa, I witnessed the people setting alight a giant bonfire after nightfall. That moment, when the flames rose and the entire plaza burst in excitement, is ever etched onto my eyelids.
The extent to which I've grown astounds me... Whew... This gauntlet of challenges is precisely the journey I've longed for.
This is certainly one way to convey one's feelings...
I offer you these photographs. They're of a city I visited whilst touring the Mediterranean. Beautiful, are they not?
Commander... Will the scenery unfolding around me... leave an imprint upon your memory? *blushes*...
A new mission, you say? I shall aid you. The diligent execution of plans is my strong suit.
A mission has been completed. Aye. It pleases me to be of service.
It appears a new letter has come in. Is it perchance the postcard I sent to you in my journey prior?
Salutations, Commander. Yes, I'm having fine tea from the port of Casablanca. Its flavor invigorating, it quenches thirst and clears the mind. Help yourself.
It seems the commission team has returned to us. What heroic tales bring they back with them this time, I wonder?
This power will give peace of mind to my comrades in arms.
We stand at the front lines.
With your command, nary a soul can impede us.
A sword broken still carries more dignity than a cannon rusted.
Line up! Charge!
Prepare for retreat. I shall guard the rear. Worry not, for this duty is ours to bear.
This place is no more than another stop on my journey. I beg your pardon, for I must go.
Flattered am I at times that you put this much trust in me... No, it's nothing. Wherever you go, I shall always be in tow.

It is to me a blessing of the highest order to stand shoulder to shoulder with a commander as accomplished as you. I ask for your continuing permission to undertake missions great. I swear that I will not disappoint you.
The understanding of what a person needs in the moment is the greatest dish, and one's heartfelt feelings are the greatest seasonings. What flavor do you crave in this moment? I may very well know.

Once, my journeys were made alone. I walked beneath the dome blue and circular of a church in a town of pure white; I crossed a field of lavenders dancing purplishly in the wind; I left imprints upon the dusty floor of an old lighthouse symbolizing hope... Now, what I look forward to most is my next journey with you in accompaniment.

I once witnessed during my travels a particular matrimony. Amidst sands unbounded, in a region of cactused forests and the sunset's alluring glow - there, sacred vows were exchanged... This moment that we've arrived at together is the most blessed in all of my life. I have now but one possible place to be - by your side.
I can feel the love you put into this, Commander. Allow me to express my sincere gratitude.
An adventure? My apologies, but I prefer my food cooked.

ex.line: I have prepared breakfast for you, Commander. Bon appétit. Ah, a little too hearty, is it? Let us partake of it together, then.
So it caught your notice. Yes, I've changed to a larger suitcase. It's, well... Fitting the luggage of two people requires a rather large one.

In the birthplace of dishes such as this, it's customary to pick up the food with one's hands. Care to try it, Commander? Or perchance you'd like me to feed you? Alright, then open your mouth... Say "ahh"... Heehee - so delicious you had to savor it with eyes closed, I see.
There are feasts and carnivals to be found wherever one goes. People wish to forget their lonesomeness with festivals... I, on the other hand, found in your eyes a celebration most lasting.
Which color of bath towel do you like, Commander? I'm packing for the next journey, you see... What? We can just share the same one? Um, I suppose that's... fine... *blushes*...
Commander, how about you experience the sensation I feel? Pat, pat... Pat, pat...
Commander, I've brought the camera. I wish to preserve, as one might a treasure, the time we share together.
The sight that is my being has also been etched into your heart... *blushes*...
Welcome back, Commander. Now... allow me to give you a hug to soothe your mind weary. Heehee.

If we... Hypothetically, if we were to go on a honeymoon, have you a place you wish to visit? In my case, a picturesque city with flavors fine and plentiful would be ideal. May I get to decide? Ahahaha...

lines.line: This wine bath mustn't be wasted. One must strip off their clothes and submerge themselves deeply in this rich bath of life. Be not so reserved, Commander, just... Huh?! N-no, I would never peek whilst you got changed!

This wine bath mustn't be wasted. One must strip off their clothes and submerge themselves deeply in this rich bath of life. Be not so reserved, Commander, just... Huh?! N-no, I would never peek whilst you got changed!
This pool of crimson mist - beautiful, is it not? I will wholeheartedly etch into my mind this time we spend together.
A wine bath is not made merely by pouring red wine into hot water - rather, residue from the winemaking process is suitably added so that one will not get drunk so easily. Supposedly.
Mmgh... Basking in your gaze invokes strangely a warmth in me... W-would you turn around if just for a moment? Whew... I all but forgot how to breathe there...
This Cabernet Sauvignon wine seems to be one of the treasures of this place. What a fragrance, so mellow and enticing. Would you care for a taste, Commander?
One, two, three... Why are there three of you, Commander?! P-perhaps... I am already inebrious.
Hmm. I feel as though I slightly better understand your thinking now.
Is the wine getting to you as well, Commander? Ah... Weakness is supplanting strength within my body...
If you're thirsty, Commander, then I offer myself. Drink of me until you're quenched.
You're back, Commander. This place, I believe, is a worthy reward for your labor.
Wine that has turned sour deserves not to be drunk...

Grapes are picked, crushed, and fermented, thus sublimating the sweetness into a rich wine aroma. After a lengthy period spent growing closer, the fruit most precious may be harvested. It's just like our relationship...
Le Hardi-class destroyer - Le Hardi.

I'm Le Hardi, lead ship of the Iris Orthodoxy's Le Hardi class of destroyers. As you see, I'm just a regular, frail little girl... Oh, and this is Peureux, my weapon. I know it looks imposing, but I'm not lying when I say I'm weak.

I'm Le Hardi, the lead ship of the Le Hardi-class destroyers. I'm nowhere near as big or strong as anyone else, so I'm probably going be reliant on you for all sorts of things... Huh? I just said I'm reliant on you... Aren't you gonna look after me?
It's such a pain for me to walk. Commander, can you carry me? ...I mean, I'll give you a loving hug in return, obviously? And don't say you "don't need it."
I suppose I'm so weak that you simply can't leave me be. Fine - I'll permit you to attend to me for a short while.
...Everyone loves cute girls. I'm a good example of that - everyone likes me, and we all have fun.
You're so huge that it's annoying, Peureux... People shouldn't be able to see a weapon from a mile away. It affects how they view me... Hey! St-stop eavesdropping!
Um, Commander... I was feeling hungry, so I ate your lunch. You're not gonna punish me, are you? ...You won't? Oh, that's great! Next time you're hungry, I might just whip up something for you.
Mmh... I'll permit you to touch me a little longer. That's how I reward subservience.
Eek. You're so mean, Commander. You could have made weak little Hardi trip with just a small touch.
Eek! I'm so weak that I don't know how I could possibly impede you... Huh? Why'd you stop? Did I not make it clear that you can do as you please?
New missions? Just let Peureux sort them out. You're not gonna leave frail little Hardi all by herself, are you?
Mission complete. Whew, I feel like I'm gonna pass out from exhaustion... I hope you'll reward me well for this, Commander...
A letter's arrived. I sent Peureux out to get it. Why didn't I go, you ask? Well, you know, because I'm just a frail little girl...
You're back already? You really are the best in the world! Please keep me under your protection.
The commission team is back? Okay, let's go, then. I'm willing to try my best when it comes to making new friends.
Becoming stronger just increases the burden on your shoulders...
Eek, oh nooo, I'm so scared.
Mmh, ahh... We won? Didn't even have time to go easy on them.
They beat us... Ugh. I had a feeling this was coming.
This is what you get for underestimating me!
Now watch as Peureux retaliates!
Commander, did you know? If someone grows too weak, they might vanish one day without a trace.
Why are you looking at me like that? It's scaring me and making me feel faint... "Just looking a normal amount"? There's no way it's "normal." I look irresistibly cute when I'm weak.
Why do you always conduct yourself so casually around me? You should bow before me. Yes, that's it. Lower. There we go. Remember: Always look up at me in reverence like this!
When things get dangerous, you're the only one I can rely on... Well, I say that, but if it ever gets TRULY dangerous, I will step up to the plate and protect you.
Gosh, I... Ahem! I'm NOT swooning, and my heart is NOT racing! If you wanna get me to admit such things... you'll need to work much harder!
Whoooa... You're actually using glitzy jewelry to please me! Heehee. Okay, as a special privilege, I will allow you to remain by my side and serve me for many long years to come♪
You've made me happy. Keep on doing that, okay...?
If you need help, just say the word.
Bleh... I'll never reach that level...

ex.line: Target sighted! I'm going in! Here we go... Owch! I hit my head... Pat it to make it better...
You know, your biggest strength is that you know your place. Yeah, you're MY Commander, and you're going to listen to whatever I say!
Whoooa! This feels awesome! Let me ride on your shoulders again! Take me higher! Yeah, higher! Now let me stand up! ...Hey, wait... Don't! Don't look up!
The place on your shoulders is reserved for me! If you break the promise between us... you're gonna be subjected to a BOLD prank!
Ahaha! Did me popping out from under your desk spook you? ...No? It didn't? Hmm... Clearly, you're just as magnanimous and lenient as I am.
Just once? You're free to pat me twice. Come on, do it more... If you wanna stop, you need to show sincerity. Heehee... I'm just kidding.
Do you wanna armwrestle? Sure, I'm weak and powerless... but that doesn't mean you should underestimate me.
Eek! Nooo! How'd that sound? Heehee - nobody will hear us no matter how loud we scream. Heheh♪
How rude of you to make me wait THIS long. Next time you get home late, I'm gonna hide ALL your paperwork! That's what you get.
I, um... l-l-luh... love... you... No, it's YOU who loves ME, isn't it? So I have to say that for the sake of... Hey, stop with that smug expression!

lines.line: Gulp, gulp... Ahh! That hits the spot! Cold and refreshing... There's nothing in the world like a glass of cold milk after steaming in the sauna.
Gulp, gulp... Ahh! That hits the spot! Cold and refreshing... There's nothing in the world like a glass of cold milk after steaming in the sauna.
Ahhh... Feels like my head's about to start fuming... Commander. Hey, Commander! Could you bring me some cold milk? Yeah, I want all of it!
Bweeeh... I used the sauna for so long that I can't stand up... Sorry, but I can't do anything unless you hold me♪
Wheeew, I'm so sweaty... Hey, don't I look even weaker than usual when I'm drenched in sweat?
Heheh! Surpriiise! Did I spook you? ...Hm? That's odd... We both left at the same time, so how come you're so dry? Rub, rub♪
I'm so sticky... Is it because of all the sweat? Ugh, it's even dripping off of me... Why don't we take a shower together afterwards?
My hair's so wet and heavy... Mind holding it for me, Commander? I need to dry it after I'm done with this milk. Heehee, yes, like that. This way, I can go slow and savor the taste♪
Want some of my milk? ...Oh, you were just trying to wipe off some that I spilled? Oh nooo! Look away, look away! Don't look!
If you go any further, I really will start screaming, "Help! Heeelp!"
Commaaandeeer! Are you back to protect me and my precious milk?
When... did you stand up? You haven't been peeking at my chest, have- You haven't? O-okay, then come closer... That's it. Heehee. This is my favorite kind of... scenario♪
Duguay-Trouin-class light cruiser - Duguay-Trouin.
I am Duguay-Trouin. The Holy Iris guided me to this land in order to take possession of all impure items, and I do mean ALL. Relax, Commander. Hold out your hands and let me purify them now.

By the guidance of the Holy Iris, Duguay-Trouin has come to serve. Do you seek sacred protection? I already know the answer to that. The devil's essence resides in your epaulet - shall I begin by purifying it?

Long time no see, Commander. I've already helped countless others in need today... Oh, you saw me sneaking into the warehouse? Lies. The devil deceives you... Come to me and repent, before it's too late.
Remember to bring valuables when you come to confess. I'll examine them closely, and if any are impure, I'll gladly relieve you of them.
Commander, can you start prepaying for your purifications? Hmm? Yes, I purify your things, and you reward me in return - do you have a problem with this arrangement?
The ominous auras that occasionally fill others are warnings from the Holy Iris. You don't need to worry, though - by confessing and handing over your impure goods, you can avoid evil.
Heehee, children are too easy to deceive. Simple wordplay was enough to get me so much treasure... Hmm? Ark Royal is looking for me, you say?
Curious about my treasures, Commander? Heehee, that's right - it's all hidden in my wimple.
Don't worry about who's around. Be bold with me!
Oh, Commander, you're so bold today... You'd better come close and give me a good confessional...
This mission is sure to yield precious goodies! Let's do it! Now!
I just knew you'd come back with valuable loot, Commander. I'll help you identify it right away.
There's mail for you. Please read it yourself - I'll see if there's anything I can swipe... er, I mean, purify.
Welcome back, Commander. Stand there a moment... There. I've used my gaze to purify you. Now that my job is done, I'll gladly take my share of the rewards.
Our friends are back with many spoils. I wonder what treasures they've brought... Heehee. Don't disappoint me, now!
OOOH, HOT DAMN! This power feels too ****ing good!
Destroy the devil's army at once! Then, plunder them dry!
Haha♪ What a beautiful harvest!
Aaargh! That wasn't just a loss - it was a downright disgrace! God ****ing dammit, everything's ****ed!
If I just kill you, the treasure will be all mine!
Trying to steal from me? You're in for it now!
Boooring. You don't have ANYTHING good?
Aah... I just can't resist temptation. This must be the devil's influence! Commander, I must have the warehouse key - it demands purification by tomorrow!
Hmm? Why do I take things instead of just purifying them? Well, impure items must be kept safe to minimize their negative effects. You do understand what I mean, yes?

Commander, I've finished purifying this batch. See if any of it is yours... Oh, all of it was? What a funny coincidence! Look at me, being all helpful and kind. Go on - take it. Don't forget to reward me for my efforts, though!

Commander? You haven't listened to my prayers for a long time... Why, I think it's been a whole day at least! I'm so very lonely... Hmm? You'll let me hold you while I pray? Th-then I'll do just that... Okay? U-umm... Right, how does the prayer go, again...
To think that I would be the one giving up my valuables... Heehee... My heart may be yours now, but I'm not satisfied yet. I'll take your heart and body alike... Prepare yourself, Commander♥
Heehee. You know exactly what I'm into, Commander!
Heehee, I'll be taking your impure wares.
Er, you want me to take your cloak? I'll pass, thank you!

ex.line: I've been waiting for you. Come on - give me all of your valuables! Yes, yes, good! Next... I'll be taking YOU, too.
Heehee, I knew you'd come, so I turned down all of the other purification requests I got... What would you like to confess to today?
Cups, pens, badges... Is there anything else you can give me? I'm ready to purify!
Robber, swindler, bandit - all old nicknames of mine. Heehee, that's all in the past now. What do you want to call me now, Commander?
You think my outfit is mere performance? What are you getting at, Commander? I'm not ALWAYS acting out a part. Besides, my true self is what you should really fear...
I already moved my treasures. Instead of rustling my hair, about you just give me a big hug?
The devil's power lurks in your left hand... Heehee, let me purify that. Don't let go, now!
My body... Hnnh! It's being controlled by the devil! Commander, you must forgive me! I can't control myself - I'm going to do something shameful to you!
You'll let me have all of your time that isn't devoted to missions, won't you?
Heehee. Did you finish your missions so fast just because you wanted to see me again?
Why not let me handle your mail correspondence from now on? After all... Control over that will help me win your heart.

Welcome back, Commander. Let's skip the purification and get straight to the "giving me things" part. Specifically, I want full control over you for a day... Heehee, though I’d happily settle for a half-day.
It's time to receive our loot, Commander. You get to choose first this time.
The stronger I become, the easier it'll be to steal my Commander away.
While I do love the spoils of war, you're still the one that excites me the most.
YOU MOTHER****ING ******BAG! Get over here so I can **** you up!
Commandeeer, turn toward me. When our foreheads touch... Do you hear my heart's prayers? Oh, you can't? Then here... Mwah♥

lines.line: Commander, this is where we'll be praying today. Nobody can disturb us here... You already know what to do, I'm sure?
Commander, this is where we'll be praying today. Nobody can disturb us here... You already know what to do, I'm sure?
Ah, Commander, I can't see anything through this steam! Heehee... If you tried anything right now, I'd have no way to stop you. Getting excited yet?
You'd confess before a naked nun, now of all times? Incredible... You know, Commander, this is a rare opportunity. Don't you think we should be doing something more... special?
Worried that my wimple will get wet? Then you can take it off for me. This is an important ceremony, so I trust you'll treat it with the gravity it deserves.
Oh, should we warm up before we get in? I thought you only do that before swimming. Or... Are you expecting a bit of roughhousing in the hot spring? Heehee, my, my!
The wind is bitingly cold! Don't you think we should "warm up" together in the water?
What is it about my hair that attracts you so? Go on, my covetous Commander... Indulge all you want.
Oh, are you finally going in with me? Would you like to take me by the hand, or will you carry me instead?
Aaah... You want to do this on the shore? We could hide in the water, but you'll do it out in the open instead? Heehee, of course I don't mind...
We've come this far - there's no need to keep up appearances. Why not... take off that towel?

*sigh*... I'm heating up awfully fast. Is it just the hot water, or is it my restraint melting away...? Commander, do you know what predators do when they're at their hungriest? Keep playing dumb, and you might get eaten up...
Project G14 aircraft carrier - Hakuhou.

It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Hakuhou, a Sakuran Project G14 aircraft carrier. Born from picturesque fantasy, I've finally come to your side. Please disrobe so that I may instill you with my refreshing aroma.
I've been waiting for you! You know, it's tradition to light incense to welcome distinguished guests. That should tell you how delighted I am to meet you today, Commander.
Good day, Commander. Today's fragrance is named "morning dew"... Savor this fleeting aroma with me.
Commander, I'm shaping ashes for a tea ceremony. You push them with this special tool, make a little mountain with them... See? Heehee, someone's watching a little too intently.

Commander, when do you think fleeting life is the most beautiful? A flower's first bloom? The lush growth of leaves? Or the falling of those leaves? Heehee, maybe the moment we return to dust is the most beautiful of all...
Goodness, the cutest critters always avoid me. It's as if they're scared... I wonder why?
Beautiful... heehee, I accidentally dropped my tea whisk into the brazier. See, Commander? The way the bamboo strands are warped... Doesn't it resemble the last dance of life?
You have such a good relationship with my sister, don't you? Heehee... I see. Not as a pet and its owner, but as two equal human beings?
Aww, are you loving on me right now, my Commander? Heehee...
Oh, do you like my scent? Do you know what part of me smells the best, I wonder? Heehee...
Interested in me, are you? Hehe...
New missions, hmm? If they relate to ceremony at all, then don't hesitate to ask for my help.
All done♪ As a reward for your efforts, may I burn a new stick of incense?
You have new mail. Heehee, I gave it a scent for you. Do you like it?
Welcome back! You weren't bored in my absence, were you? Did you sense my... longing for you, at all?
Are you going to meet the commission team? I've prepared a welcoming ceremony, so allow me to join you.
My etiquette is perfection personified.
Let the Commander's light illuminate the deepest dark.
Rest in these depths, never to laugh or cry again...
The weather today is hardly suitable for violence.
Sleep, sleep, and never feel pain again...
This is the moment in which I'm most beautiful!
...I thought my Commander to be perfect, but now you're as timid as the waning moon. How... fascinating♥
I hear my sister has been causing you trouble. Don't worry... My aromas will send all evil things running for the hills.
It's perfect weather for a flower-viewing. May I trouble you to join me in the fun, my Commander?
*sniff*... Aah... Your scent has permeated me. How can I keep it to myself forever, I wonder? I know... If I can just keep you by my side forever, then that will do the trick.
When I'm with you, I don't feel lonely anymore. Why is that? Is it your fingers? Your gaze, or your lips? Or... all of you? I want to keep you forever, Commander... And I do mean forever...
I'm so... so happy... You really do care for me, don't you? Oh...? Are you sleepy, my Commander? Then rest a while. I'll stay here with you throughout this eternal night...
Heheh... What an interesting offering~♪ I shall cherish it~
We finally get to fight together. Why do you seem so glum?
Good day to you, Unzen. Let's fight elegantly.

ex.line: You'll always return to me, won't you, my Commander? Now and forever, alive or otherwise...
How can I keep you to myself for all eternity? I would cast aside my status, possessions, and all, just to make you mine...
I'm delighted that you want to be mine, and I'll accept no outside objections to our union...
My Commander, you'll never leave me... How can I be so certain? Heehee, that's a bit of a secret...
I have a collection of ceramics. They're so beautiful that they take my breath away, but when I touch them, they shatter to bits...
You look sleepy, my Commander. Let me put you to sleep~ Yes, close your eyes... Good night, my love. My beloved, cherished, dearest Commander...
Mm... Ah... This isn't enough. I need... so much more...
I'm tired of silly small talk about the weather and the seasons. My Commander... Why don't we try something a little unconventional?
My Commander, it's time you fill the void inside me...
Welcome back, my Commander. I can't help but notice... there's an unfamiliar scent on you. Heehee, let me just purify you for a moment.
I admire everything about you... Your fingers, your lips, your gaze... My mysterious, beloved Commander, what are you made of? Please, show me...♡

lines.line: You amaze me, my lord. Not only have you foiled this kunoichi's assassination plot, but you've also repaid my treachery with kindness and mercy... Heehee, you wouldn't reject my desire to remain here and serve you, would you? My lord...

You amaze me, my lord. Not only have you foiled this kunoichi's assassination plot, but you've also repaid my treachery with kindness and mercy... Heehee, you wouldn't reject my desire to remain here and serve you, would you? My lord...
You have me in your clutches now. What will you do to me? ...Oh. You'll release me? That's... unexpected.

I've clearly picked the wrong role this time... Next time, can I be the noblewoman who is plagued by unrequited love and resorts to using poison? Heehee, it's just a game, so you don't have to take it too seriously.

My lord, do you have any advice for this failed assassin? For example, techniques to improve my stealth... Heehee, you think I should try harder to hide my malice first? I can't believe that's what did me in.
How did I pinpoint your location so easily? It's because of the scent I left on you, of course!
You still have a lot of rope left over, I see... Please make good use of my love for you, my lord.
*pant*... *pant*... I'm trying to offer my everything to you. Is there no room for mercy?
Have I pleased you, my lord?
Caught you! Hehe, that's for approaching me so carelessly.
You're my captive now, my lord... Heehee.
New missions require your attention, my lord. Allow me to join you, and I'm sure I can help.
Back so soon? Why is your blade unsheathed? That's dangerous, so you'd best put it away... If I begged desperately, you would have mercy on me, wouldn't you?
It all makes sense now. My "assassination attempt" failed because you already knew how I felt. Heehee, but my love will endure in your heart even if my body turns to ash... Isn't that right?
Yuugumo-class destroyer - Taekaze.
I'm Taekaze, a Sakuran Yuugumo-class destroyer! I've never had the chance to show off my true power before, but now, you'll get to see it as my Commander! Don't blink - transformation jutsu!
