Ba-duuum! This hide-and-seek game is over! The Yuugumo-class destroyer and kunoichi who floats on the wind sneaks onto the scene! Now that you've discovered me... Bam! Smoke bomb! Another successful escape!
Bam, smoke bomb! Heheh, did my entrance startle you... *cough*! *cough* *hack*! The smoke... it's in my throat!
Hmm? Your hat got blown off? Y-yeah, the wind sure is something today! You definitely didn't get it snatched away by a certain kunoichi...
I'm learning how to make these black pills! No, they're not ninja tools. They're tasty candy... Ahem, I mean nutritious soldier pills! Try eating one, Commander!
Wow! You caught me! Too bad, though - bam, substitution jutsu! Hehe, try and get me again!
Commander, look! I can walk on water... Gaaaah, I got distracted thinking about dinner BLRBLBLRF! Help meee!
Gaaaah, no no no! Number one rule of ninjas: you need to be unpredictable! I don't CARE how good it feels when you pet me, you can't... Ooh...
D-don't grab my tail! Gaaah! Okay, I promise I won't disguise myself as your chair anymore!
Huh? Wha? Whaaaat?! C-C-Commander?!
Got your mission requests here! Are they sneaky infiltrations? Or intel gathering? I can take care of any of them without leaving a trace!
Your mission rewards came! I'll just take these... Heheh, you'll have to catch me if you want them!
New mail arrives on swift winds! Will there be shocking news within? Open it and find out!
Wachaaa! Welcome back, Commander! Did that startle you? Heheh... Huh? You saw my tail?!
I came back with the commission team! ...Why was I disguised as a supply box? Because ninja training, duh!
My ninja training has just begun!
Kunoichi master Taekaze will take them by surprise!
Ever elusive, coming and going without a trace, the kunoichi master of disguise brings you ultimate victory once again!
Ugh, they saw through my disguise... Bam, substitution jutsu! Another successful escape!
Ninpo: Secret Wind Technique no Jutsu!
Ouchies! Gonna need some ointment for that one...
Wow, you're really boring. I don't even wanna prank you at this point...
A bonsai plant, a tree, or a manhole cover... What should I disguise myself as next? Any thoughts, Commander?
Ninja training was sooo hard today! Commander, rub my shoulders for me... C-Commander? Why are you holding a log? Ack! I'm sorry! I accidentally used my substitution jutsu.

Zzz... Zzzz.... Hah! I-I wasn't sleeping! Protecting her Commander is a kunoichi's duty! I'm going to stay right here by your side until you finish your work... I won't fall asleep, I swear... Zzzz...
Heheh, so you've finally seen through my disguise! Better hug me quick, or I'll slip right out of your hands! ...Well? Hurry up... I'm trying so hard to let you catch me...
So this is the bond called love... Elusive but indestructible, just like the wind. But sometimes... even the elusive can be caught. Hold me tight, and I'll never leave your arms.
Ooh! I've always wanted one of these!
Let's train together after this mission!

ex.line: You're finally here! Commander, I'm ready to protect you all day! Mm... It's tough to do ninjutsu while I'm sticking to the ceiling... I think I'll just do it from your lap instead!
Ack! You got me again! You know all of my hiding places now... This is no fair! Boooo, no fair!
I already thought up my next disguise! A pillow would be a great idea, right? ...Why? Ahem... Because I'd be perfect for hugging while you sleep!
Commander, check out how my training went today! Heheh, heart-shaped bentos are part of my training, too!
...You've noticed I disappear less often now? Yeah, duh. Because I need to be near you to protect you!
That feels good. Touch me more... Even the best kunoichi need to relax...
Rub my tail some more, Commander. A little higher... Ooh, yeah, right there... That's the stuff.
I-I don't know what to do here... I'll just let you decide!
BOO! Heheh! That totally scared you, right?! I disguised my tail as a broom this time... Huh? You saw it wagging from far away? Th-the broom...?
I'll always be here for you, Commander. Today, tomorrow, the next day, and the next day... Basically forever! If you ever don't see me nearby, try looking closer!

lines.line: Aaah, I'm gonna faaall! H-heheh... Morning, Commander... I-I'm just, uh, training right now! I wasn't trying to surprise you, or anything.
Aaah, I'm gonna faaall! H-heheh... Morning, Commander... I-I'm just, uh, training right now! I wasn't trying to surprise you, or anything.
Hyah?! Huh? Commander! H-help me out here, or you're gonna see something REALLY inappropriate!
I-I'll let go now, so you better catch me... Why are you opening your arms THERE? I can't fly that far!
I was gonna hide in this tree outside your office and find the perfect chance to scare you. It was a flawless plan! ...So why did I mess up? It's your fault for not going the way I thought you would!
Phew... Climbing is easy, but getting down is another story. C'mon, Taekaze, you can do this! Three, two, one... Never mind, it's too high up!
Oops! My bag came untied and dropped my kunai everywhere! Ugh, now I'm in serious danger if I fall...
You're rubbing my ears right now? No fair... I seriously can't feel my arms!
Wawawawah! Don't pull there, or else... I-I'm gonna lose balance!
Hyah?! Commander... Why are you doing this when I'm struggling?!
New mission alert! Help me down before you go, please...
Perfect timing! My arm's are getting numb. I don't think I can hang on...
Phew, I'm finally safe... I-I actually know lots of escape tactics, but you showed up, so... Hehe, I thought the best way to get out would be for you to catch me in your arms!
I-400-class large submarine aircraft carrier - I-404.

I'm I-404, Sakuran large submarine aircraft carrier; the biggest, sublimest submarine in the world; the boat that fights alongside a seadrake. I'm also the strongest precisely because I was never completed. Heheh - got anything to say about that?
I'm I-404, Sakura Empire submarine. I crossed depth after depth to answer your call, and now I'm here. Hmph! I demand cheers! Feast your eyes on my glorious wave-spanning might!
What, time for work already? The sea is as sublime as lapis lazuli, and the breeze is calm... Can't we change that "regular meeting" in the schedule into a diving session?
Alright, let me reintroduce you - this is Kotama, my seadrake rigging! It deserves part of the credit for my sublime victories. Hm? No, my sublime dancing is solely my own effort!
The clouds today look a bit like sand patterns on the sea floor... I've got it - it must mean the sea is calling for me! Come on, we're going diving once you finish your work!
Knock... Another knock... Is that the sound of someone practicing kagura? I'm going to go and have a look, Commander!
...Ahh! Man, I love diving! Oh, you've been looking for me for a long time? Uh... Ahaha... Oopsie. I forgot the time.
If you're asking what the sublimest place I've seen under the water is... Hmph. That's obviously a secret. If you want to see it, you'll have to spend more time with me and the sea.
Hmgh?! Urgh... Mgh... Don't do that while I'm eating sea urchins!
Swim or dance? I can do both! But whichever it's going to be, we better start now!
Heehee. I know exactly what you want. Alright, if you want to make me yours, you've got to do it with your own two hands♪
Look at all these unfinished missions... I think I'm going to go diving!
Were you looking for me? Heheh. I snuck through the water and got here first.
A letter's arrived. You'd better stop ignoring it before I sublimely claim it for myself.
Must've been a sublime battle. How do I know? Because I had front row seats in the water and witnessed it from start to finish.
The commission team's back. Seems they got a pretty sublime haul, too... Hm? Precognition? No, no, I just saw them while diving. Telling the future is not one of my abilities.
Oho... You're saying I can still get stronger and sublimer?
I'm taking the lead? Okay, I'll be sublime about it.
With sublimity, my enemy was vanquished. Kotama also had fun.
This is not the kind of "going down" I wanted to do!
May your body be pierced into a bottomless abyss!
Bloodshed is what makes a battle so sublime!
Move discreetly and dive stealthily... Can't find me, can't find me...
Mh... Hm?! Hang on, is... Is that first-grade sea urchin you've got there?! Heheh! I knew it was a good idea to come with you! Man, you're the best!
Diving with you is so much fun. That reminds me, when we were in the water just earlier and a school of pilchards showed up, you were looking at me instead of the fish, weren't you?

Spacing is hugely important in the Sakuran arts. From the fingertips stopping for just a moment, to a pause where a breath is taken, there's a thousand words and feelings put into each one. If you wanna learn about my dancing, start by following my steps! Come on, Commander! Let's dance!

Hmm... If you ask me, I think the feeling of love is the world's sublimest miracle. It's like the excitement of finding a beautiful coral reef deep underwater, then turning around to see you right next to me.
Heheh. You still don't get it, huh? You are mine even without this ring. Still, this is a great opportunity for you to finally realize it - that my essence is cut into you and your whole body.
Ahaha. Pretty sublime. This is exactly what I wanted! Thanks♪
Dragon God, let us dance!

ex.line: You've arrived. So, how do you want me to conquer you today?
An underwater stage with dancing waves is the ideal place for my grand performance. Oh, and while I'm at it, how about I show you how to make some waterspouts?
Wow, look at all those fish swimming in circles around you. You know, I bet they're so enthusiastic about you because you're mine.
Have a look at this new dance I came up with! ...Well? So sublime you don't even have words for it, right? ...Okay, enough with the silence - say something! See? Kotama thinks it's amazing!
You look grumpy. What's the matter? Is it work? Or are you hungry? Want me to treat you to a nice sea urchin dish? A real premium, sublime one.
Heheh. I dedicate this next dance to you alone♪
Nom... This sea urchin is so fresh and tasty! I'll feed you a bite, so come on - open your mouth♪
Hm? We just went for a dive, and now you wanna go for another? Fine by me. I'll come along wherever you want to go.
You've "humiliated" me time and time again, and I've actually sucked it all up... Heheh - this is starting to get dicey.
Another sublime victory for us. You, once this is done, your spare time is going to me and the ocean.

My treasure and sublimest possession of all is... my time spent with you. Now, come on, let's dance! No need for difficult moves - just follow your heart's beat and mine, and feel the wonderfully sublime rhythm!

lines.line: Commander! Help me out here! Can't believe I walked into a trap while trying to beat this place... Ugh! This suuucks!
Commander! Help me out here! Can't believe I walked into a trap while trying to beat this place... Ugh! This suuucks!
These ropes are pretty fun. I can swing around wildly and they won't- Ack! My face nearly smacked into the floor there! Hey! Why'd you have to pull on the ropes all of a sudden?!
With us working together, I'm confident we'll sublimely beat this place! I've also got this to prevent myself from screami- What?! A trap?!
This stupid gag is so annoying! Sure, there's no worry about biting my tongue, but it won't even let me speak properly!
Using these ropes is so much easier than bending the waves! See? Just like this - I can move however I want!
It makes no sense for a haunted house to have such a dangerous trap... By the way, since I'm managing to hang so sublimely, can't you feed me a little sea urchin to reward my efforts?
I'm tired after all this... Before we resume our adventure... I'm just going to have a sublime little nap... Zzz...
That's good... *slurp*... Ah! Crap! I got saliva on it!
Commander, witness my sublime rope dance!
You'd rather conquer me instead of the haunted house? Hey! Stop messing around!
Alright, Commander, are we resuming our haunted house adventure? Great! Now come here and untie me already.

Do you think I'm completely at your mercy right now? Inside, my heart is screaming for me to conquer and make you mine right here, right now. Beating the haunted house - hmph, that's just a side objective now♥

Mmmff... Mgh?! Mrmmff?!
Kii-class battleship - Oumi.

"Unheard of even in the legendary age of the awesome gods: Tatsuta River in scarlet, and the water flowing under it." I am Oumi, the fourth Kii-class battleship. Events prevented my completion once upon a time, but I've finally come. Will you be my quilt of autumn leaves, Commander?
Noble and majestic Commander, Oumi is here to serve... Hehe, I just wanted to say that. You don't care about boring formalities, do you? Instead, let's celebrate this meeting with a glass of wine.
Is that you, Commander? Hehe, I hope you didn't just come because you wanted one of my drinks... The weather is lovely. Let's indulge in the finer things - a boat ride on the lake, drinks, poetry...
"Beneath the moonlight, shadows of flowers rustling, a path to be tread." Come, Commander. Let's walk amidst the flowers under the moon.
Baijiu is too strong, but red wine is a touch too sour... If you're a drinker, how about you try some Sakuran sake? The aftertaste is to die for.
A haiku suddenly appeared on the wall? Ah... I might've written that while I was drunk and excitable. I don't remember what I wrote... You liked it? Then recite it for me, please.
"The lights are lit, on the islands far and near: the spring sea." How about you and I go on the lake and raise a toast?
Hmm? How about you wait until I'm a little tipsier?
Hehe. Ready to while away the time with me, Commander?
Heehee~ Commander, does this count as a refined matter?
If you don't finish your work, you'll miss out on nature's beauty. Say goodbye to fun and elegance, I guess.
Did you finish your missions? Then let's go out on a boat together. I have the perfect drink for today's scenery.
Hmm? Did the wine I ordered arrive? Hehe, just kidding. There's mail for you, Commander.
Welcome back, Commander. Want to relax with some Sakuran sake?
Oh, are the commission girls back? Hmm... Why don't we welcome them with ample drinks?
Oh yeah, that feels good. I feel ready to write a tanka.
Hehe... Don't interrupt my reading, please.
Another battle done. Yaaawn... Time to go home, have a drink, and enjoy the scenery with the Commander...
Life is full of ups and downs. Let's not dwell on every misstep.
Heehee, the scent of wine can be dangerous~
Hmph... I'll have to get serious.
You don't really understand my verses lately, do you? Even this fine wine has become too bitter to swallow...
Which of these two drinks do you think is better? Hmm? They're both fine? Hehehe, so you enjoy tea and wine equally. You understand elegance, Commander.
When I compose poetry, I tend to scrutinize every little word so I don't lose the rhythm. But when I get tipsy, I wear my heart on my sleeve. I'd like you to hear that some time, Commander.

Hehe, it's a beautiful day, and I have the wine you liked so much. Yes, everything's ready for our feast... Now, Commander, sit - Ah. I just used that cup... I guess you wouldn't mind that though, would you?

I feel as if you and I might have shared a bed last night... Why do I sound uncertain? Hehe, because we were drunk, of course. Our cups were full of moonlight, and flowers were all around... Why, I'd share a thousand cups of wine with you if only to savor that elegant moment.

No matter how bland daily life can be, wine is enough to fill it with poetry. As long as flowers bloom in my heart, the whole world can be like a beautiful painting. Commander, let's keep walking through life's picture scroll together.
This is lovely! Close your eyes, Commander, so I can return the favor... Mwah!
I already have the perfect wine to celebrate our coming victory.

ex.line: Mm, I'm still a little dizzy... Did I drink too much last night? Oh, thank you for the turmeric... Let me lean on you until it clears up, okay?
I know exactly what I want to do... Drink? No. Recite poetry? Not that, either! Hehe, the correct answer would be to do both of those things with my Commander.

"For your precious sake, once my eager life itself, was not dear to me." Umm, the next part was... D-don't stare, you're making it harder... Hm? "It may long, long years endure." Heehee, looks like you win...
...You found a tanka on the wall? Yes, I wrote that there yesterday. I saw you sleeping, and I wanted to share my joy with you. Heehee.
Yaaawn... Hmm? Did I fall asleep in your arms again? Goodness, maybe I shouldn't drink so much... By the way, your hand is still on my tail. Hehe, does that make us even?
Hmm? Are you suggesting I come drink in your arms?
Just a little more drink, and then... Heehee, what poetry will I leave on your body this time?
Home already? Come and warm up with some hot sake I brought from a Sakuran brewery.

When we first met, I didn't think you'd understand the finer things. But you're not just refined - you're a maestro of romance. Now that I know that... I won't believe you when you say you did something because you were "too tipsy to think straight."

lines.line: Ngh... Hah... Commander, can you help me for a moment? ...Why don't you say anything? Don't tell me... you prefer me this way?
Ngh... Hah... Commander, can you help me for a moment? ...Why don't you say anything? Don't tell me... you prefer me this way?
As you can see, my escape technique isn't quite perfect. Can you get a little closer, please?
I was practicing my escape artistry, but clearly I'm not good enough yet... Would you please come over and help me, Commander? Yep, just like that... Keep going...
Ugh... Tying the knot was hard enough. I'm amazed that it's even more difficult to untie... Commander, if you untie it for me, I'll teach you an even more enticing way to tie it.

"In the sea of heaven, the waves of cloud arise. And the moon's ship is seen sailing, to hide in a forest of stars." That reminds me of when you and I sailed together. Um... Actually, maybe you should untie me before we reminisce?
Frankly, I'm not sure how we can share a drink in this state. I mean, this posture doesn't lend itself to the act very well... Hehe, you're right! Desperate times do call for desperate measures, no?
Hehe... Come over here, and you can touch me more freely.
I hope you're not plotting anything evil right now...
Oh, my... You're certain that I can't move, aren't you? Of course, there's only one thing in this world that can truly bind me - and that's you.
I'd really like to be untied right now, but your missions come first, I suppose...
Mission accomplished, hmm? How did I know? Come closer, and I'll tell you.
Oh, you're finally back... Can you untie me this time, please?
Come a little closer, Commander. Support me so I can relax... Hehe, got you! As punishment for not untying me right away, you're stuck with me until I'm satisfied.
Improved Suzuya-class heavy cruiser - Asama.
I am Asama - an improvement upon the Suzuya class of heavy cruisers, and a hollow being who never was. Even so, I wish to be with you in this fleeting, beautiful world until my last moment.
Are you the Commander? I am Asama, and long have I waited for you. *sigh*... Although joyous times are as fleeting as bubbles in water, I still wish to step into this brief dream with you.
Hm? Ah, it is you. No, it's nothing. It is good to be in peace.
Just as the water downstream is not the same as at its source, neither are people nor their homes the same as they once were. Do you concur with this notion, Commander?
My mere presence makes you... relax, you say? Perhaps the aroma of my medicine has a soothing effect on your soul.
Commander, do you perchance feel under the weather? Oh, no, that simply will not do. I shall make for you a medicinal dish, so please wait for just a while.
You have never wavered in your path, whether or not you'd be rewarded for it... That takes such strength, and it is so beautiful.
Hm? Are you offering to tie up my hair?
...Dosage makes the difference between medicine and poison, Commander. Please exercise care.
Mmh... This delight, this affection that we share... It will remain with me for some time.
New missions have been bequeathed unto us. Do not rush - adhere to a plan.
Thus, your work stands completed. May I propose having a pleasant bath to reinvigorate? It would be you and me, all to ourselves.
One must not let useful information slip past. Your letter demands your attention.
Welcome home. Does anything ail you? Then please do not worry. I have prepared a medicinal meal for you.
Are you leaving to receive those returning from a commission? Then kindly allow me to accompany you.
This strength you've given unto me... I fear losing it.
Let us bring an end to our foes.
For a sideshow, it was quite entertaining.
*cough cough*... We lie defeated... as dictated by destiny.
Look on with awe, then turn into ash.
*cough cough*... It seems I've overexerted myself.
Flowers blossom beautifully, then inevitably scatter off - nothing in this world lasts forever...
I thought I had seen everything there was to see in this life - until I met you...
Even when subjected to something bitter, you accept your suffering with a smile. That, to me, is truly astounding. Won't you please allow me to gaze more at your beautiful smile?
I will cherish the fleeting present and preserve in my heart even the smallest of happinesses - this truth that you bestowed upon me is more precious than any treasure.

Like how cherry blossoms scatter to the wind, all living things are destined to one day become dust. However... it matters not how much time passes, for the memories we've made will always remain in my heart.

I see that you've made up your mind. That being the case, I vow to take your hand, now and into eternity. The warmth that your hand imparts... it urges me to stay by your side and, together, behold the passing of the seasons.
True joy is able to leave people speechless... I thank you.

ex.line: Welcome back. Ah, I seem in good spirits, you say? Heehee. Yes, that's because all I need is you to be content.
Commander, may I please ask to hold your hand? Yes, you speak true... This world shall never wither away for as long as you draw breath.
May I... propose that we visit the hot springs together? I of course refer to the one that made you so... enthusiastic the last time.
Heehee... Now your palm smells much like my medicine.
This, you ask? Heehee... This is the mark that you left upon me.
The marks that you gave me flower much like blossoms... only more beautiful.
Has another new task been given to you? Let us complete it as quickly as possible before it cuts into our private time.
I see you've finished your task. Let us be on our way, then. The bath is ready for us.
Welcome home. Please... allow me to cherish this moment together for a little longer.
Ah, the time we have to ourselves is all too short... However, even if we can be together for but a moment, the warmth of your embrace shall remain in my heart forevermore.

lines.line: Commander? Your expression seems to signal that you are not content with just ghost stories, yes? Ashamed am I to admit that I am still afraid... May I ask you to remain with me? There is something I wish to tell you.

Commander? Your expression seems to signal that you are not content with just ghost stories, yes? Ashamed am I to admit that I am still afraid... May I ask you to remain with me? There is something I wish to tell you.
Welcome, Commander. May I interest you in some tea if you're feeling thirsty? Heehee - I shall keep you company tonight.

I've heard a tale... A tale of the spider woman who lures in travelers and then consumes their flesh when the chance arises. You need not fear, however. No such thing will happen to you for as long as I'm here. Heehee...
Hm? You saw an ill-boding thing, you say? Heehee. It was surely just your imagination. There is no one here but you and me.
You're certain that the temari moved? Heehee. Your eyes are merely playing tricks on you. If it bothers you so, then may I suggest closing your eyes in my embrace for a while?
It is said that shadows are reflections of the heart. One must wonder what form my attachment to you, my Commander, may take...
Well? Do you feel that you were mistaken now? Heehee. There are no horns on my head after all, are there?
Ah, do you wish to see the mark that you left upon me? Or perhaps... do you intend to give me a new one tonight?
Heehee... There is no escaping now, Commander... Mgh... Mmh...
We have been assigned new missions. Please, Commander, do be careful of spider's silk while walking the streets at night.
You've finished a mission? Then let us resume our play.
A most splendid result. Shall we take this chance for a bit of merriment? With a condition that, should you lose... I shall take possession of you.

It would be nice if one could simply flee from demons and monsters, but such is not the case in reality. Once you return to your senses, you may already be in my grasp. Heehee... Now, will you please come to me gently on this night most wonderful?
Sendai-class light cruiser - Minase.
I am Minase, a Sendai-class light cruiser of the Sakura Empire, and I'd like to make Sakuran hot pot to warm your heart and soul. Trust me to take care of you from now on, Commander.
There you are, Commander! *sniff*... Mm, you smell hungry. Don't worry, I'll bring fresh hot pot for you right away.
Great work today, Commander! Hehe, this hot pot helps with fatigue. Give it a try!
Some people say goose barnacles shouldn't go in hot pot, but they taste great if you prepare them properly. I want everyone to try mine!
Have you ever made hot pot, Commander? What ingredients do you typically use? Call me next time you want to. It's even more fun as a team!
Be a little bold in your selection of ingredients and cooking methods, and you might just discover a new recipe.
(The Commander is making an odd face at my hot pot... Wait. Is the combination of tuna eyeballs and watermelon too much? It tasted good when I tried it, at least.)
Mm... Hehe. When you pet me, I imagine I must smell like I'm overflowing with joy.
Hyah?! N-not my ears, please... Eep...
C-Commander! The kitchen is no place for that. Do you WANT me to spill the food?
Commander, you still have untouched missions. Let me help you sort them out.
It's important to check your rewards, too. After all... you do love them, don't you? *sniff sniff*
New mail came for you, Commander. *sniff*... It doesn't smell weird, so it should be safe to open.
Welcome back, Commander. *sniff*... You smell like the ocean breeze. Very nice!
The commission team finished their job, and I have hot pot ready. Let's go greet them with it and have a big feast together.
*sniff*... Wow. I can distinguish scents even better than ever!
Let's end this before my seafood hot pot finishes cooking.
Looks like the seasoning of success will be going in today's pot.
Defeat is ever so bitter...
*sniff*... Now!
Things are just going to get worse at this rate...
Commander... I made calming hot pot. Would you like some? Umm... I just want you to feel better...
*sniff*... Your condition seems off right now. Are you sure you aren't overworking yourself to exhaustion? I'd better make a meal full of nutrients for you!
I tried putting different seasonings in my hot pot this time. *sniff*... Hehe, I can smell excitement on you. You always look forward to my new creations, don't you?
*sniff*... You smell really good right now, Commander... (Is it me, or is this smell... possessing me? I want to get closer... It's like I can't think straight anymore.)

Commander, I've been searching for the perfect seasoning that can balance all flavors... and I think I've found it. It's the seasoning called love... When love overflows and simmers into the hot pot, the person you love is reflected in the flavor.
This is the taste of love... It's more enticing than any other ingredient. Hehe... How blessed I am to know that I'll get to be with you forever, Commander.
*sniff* *sniff*...this smell! It's the thing I've wanted this whole time! Thank you so much, Commander!
I brought fresh hot pot for everyone!

ex.line: Today is another day full of love. Hehe, I wish I could spend all my time wrapped up in your scent... Oh! The hot pot is almost ready! I'll dish up a serving for you first.
Huh? My hot pot tastes different from the usual? Hehe, I've actually been adjusting the recipe according to your mood. I can see even the slightest changes in your attitude, after all.
Hyah?! C-Commander! Don't play around while I'm cooking... Here, you can hold me in your arms. Getting to cook hot pot in my Commander's arms... I must smell of bliss right now.
Have you seen those double-headed straws with hearts in the middle? They're the perfect item for people in love! Hehe, want to try one out right now?
Ah, Commander? I'm choosing ingredients for today's hot pot right now. Did you pick something out? ...Hmm? You won't tell me? Come ooon, show me! Why are you being so secretive now? Hmph!
You're a big fan of my hair, aren't you? Hehe, touch it all you want.
Commander... If you want to touch my ears that badly, then let me touch yours, too.
Commander... My room is ready for the two of us♥
Commander, welcome home. My hot pot of love is ready for you. Hmm? By hot pot of love, I mean one I've made just for you. Eat up, okay?
My scent? Commander, you can tell now...? Hmm... Even I can't discern it. Your scent has permeated mine for so long now that I can't tell the difference between us anymore.

lines.line: Mmmm... That was a nice nap. *sniff*... Oh, Commander? I was just practicing meditation. This is the best place for it. Come and join me, if you'd like.
Mmmm... That was a nice nap. *sniff*... Oh, Commander? I was just practicing meditation. This is the best place for it. Come and join me, if you'd like.
The sunlight is warm, the view is lovely... The only thing that could make this better is a nice bowl of hot pot.

Why am I meditating? Hmm... That's a secret. I can share it just with you, but listen - the roof of this shrine is the perfect place for meditation. Lie down here and close your eyes, and you'll discover the secret for yourself.
When I'm meditating, these cute little creatures all start gathering around me. Heehee... Does this little fox want to train, too?
Huh? You want me to try just jumping down when I leave? Hmm... That would be faster, but I didn't bring footwear. Oh? You'll go down first and catch me? Then... m-maybe we could try...
Did you know that your senses sharpen while you meditate? For example, when you're sneaking glances at me... *sniff*... I can tell~
Mm, hehehe... Your hands are warm. It's very calming.
Eep?! C-Commander... Do you like fluffy things? Nnh... S-someone is going to see us if you keep that up!
Zzz... Zzz... Nnh? Commander... Come take a break, would you? It'd be nice to have someone to meditate with.
I can start meditating easily when you're here, but if you're not, my mind tends to wander... Maybe the red string of fate has bound us too tightly to ever be untied.
Sailing frigate - Queen Anne's Revenge.
I'm Queen Anne's Revenge. The name's written on my stern, so read it your bloody self. Don't nark me if you don't want to end up on the seabottom. Heheh...
I'm Queen Anne's Revenge, and brilliant treasures are my favourites. Hm... You're the Commander, no? Then help me pack up this pile of stuff. I want to admire it later tonight.
You've come. I'm preparing to go out, so I'll be just another minute. If you're free, then bloody clean the place up.

Look, it's just a giant bother. If I wanted to go outside, I'd have to dig my room key out of my treasure chest, then find the way from my bed to the door. That said, I do go out when there's something valuable for me to collect.
Impeccable makeup, flawless fashion, and a perfect Queen Anne's Revenge. I'm right chuffed. Hm? No, I'm not planning on going out.
If I encountered someone like you whilst pirating, Commander... Heheh... Now that would be exciting.
There's STILL a water leak in the bathroom? Heh. Heheh... I'm going to send the mechanic to the bottom of the sea.
As long as you don't mess up my hair ornament. *sigh*... Don't worry. There's nothing naff about making friends with octopuses in the sea.
I'm drop-dead gorgeous, I know. Now will you adjust my bloody hems?
You couldn't resist how beautifully I was dressed? Heheh... Are those your final words, then?
Hankering for a break when you've not even finished your missions? Go on. Treasure doesn't grow on trees.
Is that everything? I know a way to make more dosh quickly, if you're interested. Heheh...
Saw a letter addressed to you just a minute ago. If you don't go looking for it now, you may never find it again.
Oh. You're back in one piece. Say, isn't my makeup terrific today? Then bloody say something good about it already.
Time to go and greet the commission team. If they found any glittering treasure, bring it all to me.
Heh. Now I can sink all of my foes...
What a bother... Can't I just give orders from home?
Heh. I lay claim to everything.
Meddlesome sods... Next time, I will sink you all myself.
You'll be fish food when I'm done with you...
You got my dress dirty... I won't even spare you the time to write a will!
If you whinge any more about my plans, your documents won't be the only things getting burned.
Clean my room? If it nags you so much, then do it yourself, why don't you? I've got better things to do.
You look deft at cleaning up a mess... Help me out with this. It'll be done in five minutes. If you want me to do it, well... I think you know which option is the best.
Quiet. I just need another 30 bloody minutes. It takes time to get into a dress as posh as this. If you're so keen, why don't you come in and give me a hand, eh?
You can have this ring. No, it's nothing special. I've got loads, so pick whichever you like. But first, answer me this: Crows covet sparkling things, so... do you want me in that same way?

I've finally got it... The glittering oath ring I've seen in my dreams. Heehee. It goes perfectly with my beauty, doesn't it? Once you put it on, you'll never get to regret it for the rest of your life... You wouldn't dream of regretting it? Heh. Good.
Such an exquisite treasure... I'll take good care of it.
You'll get your share when we divvy up the booty.

ex.line: Mmgh... It's so sodding early... I don't wanna get up yet. I might consider it if you'll do my hair for me.
You got everything ready for me to go out? Well, sorry to say, but I want to get changed, so you have to start over.
Hey, try not to come back too late. Or else my room will go back to how it used to look.
Put the stuff I'm not using into my storage? Not happening. It's already chock-full of your presents. The fault lies with you. Heehee.
I think this ring would look terrific on you. Hold still and I'll put it on your finger... Heheh - yep, my aesthetic sense is always right.
Tangled my braids again... Well, I guess this is a chance to try a new hairstyle.
You wanna see me in these clothes? Maybe. Just maybe. If you'll help me put it on, though...
Heh... I hope you're ready for the consequences.
It's dawned on me that there are traces of you all over my room. One way or another, I've wound up wholly reliant on you...

lines.line: You, lost mortal, have awakened an indescribable supreme being. You will become my retainer and aid me in completing my ritual.
You, lost mortal, have awakened an indescribable supreme being. You will become my retainer and aid me in completing my ritual.
All is in order for the ritual to proceed? ...Eh? A god doesn't involve oneself with such faff.
I am a being trapped by the shackles of an ancient curse, sealed forever within the temple's shadows... Huh? You've undone the seal? But I never said anything about wanting to leave.
I have a sacred task for you, my devoted retainer - clean my noble body. Thoroughly. Down to every last tentacle.
Is the jewelry for my tentacles ready? Cracking. They're quite a bit prettier now. And don't get the wrong idea - it's all a part of the ritual.
You're doing some marvellous work, my diligent retainer. Remain here and continue serving this grand, ancient one. Refusal will be met with being devoured as an offering. Heheh.
What do you seek from your god? Go on, say it. I might just make your wish come true. Heh.
Offering up your body to an indescribable supreme being? Heehee. You're brave, I'll give you that much.
Your missions are done, and the ritual nears its completion... You know, you're an excellent worker, my retainer.
There is nowhere left to run. Faithful one, fulfill our eternal contract with your labour and devotion.
Since everything is in order, let the ritual commence. Don't worry, the tentacles won't harm you. Just relax and slip into the abyss of nothingness with me...
Sailing frigate - Lyme.
I'm Lyme, a monster hunter. My technique is to calmly and adeptly deal a crushing blow to my target. Needless to say, your orders take precedence. I won't interfere with your plan.
Wait... Alright - the safety level is acceptable within this zone. Greetings, Commander. I'm Lyme. I will fight by your side from now on. Your orders?
I'm right here, Commander. I'll keep watch so you can work with peace of mind.
What are your orders for today? Hunt monsters? Or help organise your workflow? ...You want me to play sports with you? Of course. I won't let you win so easily.
I've finished defining a new workflow. Take a look, Commander. If you find any issues, I'll deal with them.
Stacks of papers are put so close together that they risk getting mixed up, and ornaments are placed around seemingly haphazardly... Has your working environment always been like this, Commander?
One more time, Commander! I'll finish the mock battle faster, with better results this time! Give me another chance!
Commander, physical contact outside the battlefield makes me lower my guard.
Commander, are you nervous about our coming battle? Don't be. You'll be fine as long as I'm here.
Commander, this outfit is special... Only I can take it off.
New missions have been added. I await your orders, Commander.
All objectives have been met and exceeded. The mission was completed flawlessly.
New letters have arrived, Commander. Do you need me to sort them?
Commander, did you find leads on the enemy? I see. Then I'll go on another patrol.
A commission has been completed. I'll report the details to you later.
I'm getting stronger. Good.
Commencing annihilation.
Where's the next battlefield?
We lost? I will correct this mistake.
Face your fate!
I won't back down just because of a few wounds.
Commander, I'm going to reevaluate the necessity of your orders.
Commander, it's most optimal when the things on your desk follow the centre line, so I went and organised them. I adjust the balance and angle so it ought to be perfect.
This is now the fourth time you've slid your cap today. Do you like it when I stare at you or something?
You've defeated me again. There must be some way to clear this more efficiently... Hm? Games are meant to be relaxing, so I shouldn't take it so seriously? Maybe so, but I don't like being defeated.

To more efficiently carry out your orders, I need to get to know you better and be able to guess what you're thinking. Then, once I manage to defeat you, that will be definite proof that I'm able to carry out your orders. Probably.
So this is a pledge of love. I see. I, Lyme, accept your pledge, and I swear with my strength the following oath: Your whole being is irreplaceable to me.
This is a good present. Thanks.

ex.line: Commander, I'd like you to give attention to the office's layout during your breaks. For instance, you could put the same ornament here to make it nice and symmetrical.
Commander, I want to play that game again so I can learn to carry out your orders better! Also, could you explain why I lost last time?
Commander, I've revised your workflow. I verified it, and it should avoid 99.99% of all risks.
Hmm. That should do for a remodel of the office. Symmetrical, tidy, and orderly. A place worthy of doing rational work in!
Even minute changes can have drastic repercussions due to the butterfly effect... For that reason, I need to always carry out your orders to a T during battle.
My strength is entirely yours. Leave all dangerous matters to me.
Aha, ahahaha! I-I'm not ticklish, so there's no point in this!
Oh... Um, taking this outfit off requires a bit of technique, so...
Welcome back, Commander. Again, no enemies sighted in the area, I suppose... Hm? You found signs of enemy movements? Retreat to a safe area immediately! I'll go and have a look!

I... won?! Oh! I did? I thought I never stood a chance against you no matter what happened... Wait, was this part of some plan of yours? Well, you've admitted defeat, so it's too late to pull out now!

lines.line: Ugh... Where am I? Why do I feel so weak? Did I... trigger a trap that corrupts its prey? Grgh! Was it you who laid the trap? You will pay for this!
Ugh... Where am I? Why do I feel so weak? Did I... trigger a trap that corrupts its prey? Grgh! Was it you who laid the trap? You will pay for this!
Are you here to save me? Wait, no! You're clearly the boss of my enemy! You cannot fool me!
Was it necessary to make such an elaborate set just for an act? Where did you even get these tools? And these restraints... They're so hard to break out of...
This is the enemy's stronghold, so why are you the only one here? Where are the other captives? What did you do to them?!
The enemy was wiped out, and all the captives were rescued? So you actually were the reinforcements... Does that mean I'm saved, too?
Hmm. I've memorised all my lines, that's fine, but having to act in this position does make things awkward...
Urgh... I know it's my power that you're after. Don't assume you're going to break me... so easily!
Come any closer and I'll... I'll bite you if I have to! Urgh! Argh!
The corruption is advancing... It's... taking over me...
Where did you come fro- No, stay back! I don't know what you're after, but you won't get to do as you want with me!
You've come to help, but I... I can't control myself... Come... Come closer! I can't bear this feeling any longer!
Sailing frigate - Pearl.
Greetings - I am Pearl. May this encounter help you overcome your suffering... Commander, let's walk together from this point on.
It must be fate that brought us together in this sea of pearls. My name is Pearl. I pray that hope and purity forever light your path.
I bring the blessings of moonlight and pearls. May this moment of peace dispel all your worries!
Good and evil, truth and falsity... Our world is a chaotic one. If you cannot understand yourself, then how can you demand understanding from others?
Commander, did you see my collection display shelf? Isn't the conch pearl in the middle just beautiful? I had to search long and hard for that one.
Angel? Some do call me that, yes... It's rather odd when you do, though.
My pearl jewelry and crafts are all handmade - by me, of course. Do you happen to like any of them...?
Is this your gentle side, Commander? Heehee, I like it!
Your palms are so warm, Commander. Every time we touch, I feel special power well up in my wings...
Is this... how you communicate your feelings? It's novel, I'll give you that...
Your workload is... troubling, to say the least. Allow me to help you!
What kinds of rewards did you get? Any rare jewels, maybe?
Commander, you just got a delivery. Should we check on it?
You've returned safe and sound. Give me your hand... I'll always be supporting you. Never forget that.
The commission fleet has returned with a bountiful harvest. I hope nobody got hurt...
Gentleness and strength. Are they contradictory, or are they intrinsically linked?
Surrender now, and the goddess may still forgive you yet.
Could this lead to true salvation?
I will fight on - until all of our allies have made it to safety.
May this gentle glow soothe all the world's pain.
Lower your weapons. This is your final warning.
Ah, Commander... I can't help but cry when you get like this.
Victory isn't won through hurt. Only through wisdom and charity, only through finding a way to make both parties happy, can we achieve a loving victory.
Commander, don't you think these pearls look like miniature moons? They're all for you! I hope they'll watch over your sleep when the moon cannot.
Commander... I want to be a part of your world. It's my belief that there are no real walls between fellow people. If you are willing to accept me, then... you and I...
I used to think that love was selfless and fair to everyone. But now I realise... Sometimes, you find that a special someone has stolen your heart. Do you know what I mean, Commander?
Is this the physical embodiment of love? Everything else pales in comparison to it. I'll treasure it and protect it forever, so that it shines eternally.
What a thoughtful gift! I love it, Commander.

ex.line: When your work is done, why don't we do some handicrafts together? You see... I found the perfect pearl for you, so I wanted to make matching rings for us...
Hmm... I really need a flash of inspiration... Commander, would you like to come walk on the beach with me? Let's let our minds wander atop the waves.
Commander, what are you thinking about right now? If you have any troubles, you can come to me.
Just between you and me... the tears I shed become pearls. It's like a blessing from the goddess, but it's also a tiny bit embarrassing...
Doing the right thing can take a lot of courage. I wonder how long it'll take for me to become as brave and kind as you, Commander.
Commander, do you like the wings on my head? I made them myself~ They're fluffy and good for warming up my ears when it's cold.
Heehee, that tickles! You seem so restless today, Commander... Do you need a hug from my wings?
Umm... That pearl string there isn't for you to play with, Commander...
Welcome back, and well done~ Come to me. Yes, of course you're free to lie down in my lap for a while!
Pearls are the tears of the sea, the crystallisation of tenderness. No matter what trials await, I will continue to protect you gently. Forever... and ever.

lines.line: Oh sweet hero, you who charged into this forbidden and dangerous castle alone for the sake of your beloved angel... What a scene you've arrived to. The power of potions is really something, isn't it...

Oh sweet hero, you who charged into this forbidden and dangerous castle alone for the sake of your beloved angel... What a scene you've arrived to. The power of potions is really something, isn't it...
Do you want to save me, brave hero? If you want my obedience... then it's going to cost you.
My sweet salvation isn't gone yet - I mean you, Commander. Stay with me and use your unwavering faith to restore my fallen heart to grace... If you can, that is~
A dark castle, a fallen angel bound in chains... Do you like this situation, brave hero?
Oh no, I've spilled this potion all over me! Brave hero, would you mind... cleaning it off of me? Heehee! You can even taste a little, if you want.
Set aside that silly mission of yours and follow your heart... right to my side.
Mmm... Ah... Sweet hero, you still caress me as gently as you used to...
I'm a fallen angel, but my wings haven't turned black... How odd.
Mmm... Sweet hero, let me wrap you up in my wings... so the white can shield us from prying eyes as we fall into depravity together.
Back again, are you? Oh, sweet hero... Heehee, do you long for me so?
Angels are born for the sake of love - nothing else matters nearly as much. Stay with me, my brave hero, so we may while away this enchanting night...
Sailing frigate - Royal James.
I'm Royal James! Where there is fun, you'll find me! Whenever you encounter something interesting, let me know immediately!

Ahoy! Over here! It's me, Royal James, touching down! No time for explanations, Commander, let's just set off! ...Set off where, you ask? Hmm. I'm not sure quite yet. Never mind that - anywhere that's fun is fine by me!
Wow, you are here only now? That must mean you DIDN'T stuff your alarm clock into your stomach!
You found a fun place?! Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go! Uhh, "submit a departure request"? When did we add that stinking buzzkill of a procedure?

Commander, I heard there's a fight on the beach between scallops and starfish! I wonder which side is stronger! Let's go and have a loo- Oh, the toilet in the dormitory exploded?! That sounds fun, too!
Commander, looking at this plan, I feel like it's lacking originality! Want me to think of something? I'll make it look completely new!
How does ramen taste if you eat it with your nose? Now I'm curious! Let's find out! *snort*... That's odd! The flavour's hardly any different!
Ooh. Who'd have thought getting headpatted would be so interesting?
Here comes the takoyaki! Whoosh! ...I-it looks weird to you? Okay, have another!
A-ha! I knew it! You've got funny stuff on your mind!
Commander, why do you think we need to finish missions as soon as possible? The answer is: Because fun things wait for no one!
Mission complete. Boooring... I'm fed up with this stuff.
A new letter has arrived! Alright, let's open it! You never know if it might contain a treasure map!
You're back! You probably had all sorts of wild encounters out there, eh? You should bring me along next ti- No, right now!
The commission team has returned! Wonder what interesting places they'll go to next... We should follow them in secret!
Hang on, getting stronger is THIS easy?!
Whoa-oh! They won't know what hit 'em!
Easy peasy. I already popped a bottle of victory champagne! I've still got some left, so help yourself!
Let's have another go, Commander! One more time! Right now!
Boooring! Take this!
Oh, owch... Now things are getting fun...
*sigh*... I can't be bothered to do anything when it's this boring...
The hardest choice to make in this world is between two things you want to do at the same time! How do I decide? Please help me out, Commander!
Did you hear the news, Commander? Someone caught a humongous octopus! It was thiiiiiis big! I want to see it for myself!
You work overtime way too much, Commander! How will you have the energy to have fun with me if you never get proper rest?

Ahahaha - even though it's true that I often cause a lot of trouble, my happiest times are when I can say "oopsie" with you! Hm? What do you mean, "I'm the only one making an oopsie"? You're there making it with me!

Didn't you say there was a fight between barnacles to watch? Wh-what's this talk about a marriage? Only a nutter would answer such a sudden question with, "Yes, I do"! ...Huh?! I didn't say I WON'T say that! If it means becoming an item with you, then... I guess I'm fine with being a nutter!
Whoa! I'm having fun just looking at this present!
Let's go treasure-hunting!

ex.line: Commander! I've been waiting for you! Next time, I'll spook you with a big "Boo!"
Oh! Commander! I just saw a star! If I ever discover a new star, I can name it after you and me! Wouldn't that be wonderful?
How'd you like the treasure-hunting plan I gave you yesterday? Oh, um, you want a little more detail? I can fill those in another time! Right now, I just want to set off with you!
Commander, how about you put your work down and go to the supermarket with me? I saw they have a really sparkly chemical mop! I bet you also want to see some flashy-sparkly midnight cleaning!
I demand more headpats, Commander!
Commander, are you bored? As it so happens, so am I!
I've always wanted to try this kind of fun stuff before!

No matter where we go, no matter what happens, no matter how fulfilled I am, no matter how caught up I get in something fun... I will never ever leave you all alone! I'll use every trick in the book so we'll be together!

lines.line: Where... am I? Brrr, it's cold... What am I supposed to- Oh, you look pretty warm, stranger. Would you mind... sharing a little of your body heat?
Where... am I? Brrr, it's cold... What am I supposed to- Oh, you look pretty warm, stranger. Would you mind... sharing a little of your body heat?

So you're an investigator, and you came to this cellar to investigate a forbidden being made by an occult society... Wow, that sounds really fun. What about me? What am I? Am I... the forbidden being in question?
I'm a forbidden being... created through some occult society's wicked experiment, huh? Hmm... So much stuff I don't understand.
The barrel is totally filled with nutrient liquid. It feels nice to soak in, and it can sate your hunger, too. Why don't you give it a try, Investigator?
These tentacles? I don't know why, but they obey my commands. If you try to run away, I'll make them bind you down!
This role-playing is starting to get boring. Can't we do something fun? For instance, like a drift-swimming competition in the nutrient liquid!
Raaawr! You'd better tell me about some fun stuff, or Miss Forbidden Being is going to eat you up!
Are you asking for help with your investigation? How should a forbidden being help someone?
This feels... kind of good, maybe. Hey, do that again!
I've memorised your odour! I'm not letting go of you until I'm tired of it!
I feel like something's been missing ever since I awoke. Is it... a heart? Investigator, could you give me your heart? If you can't, I'm fine with taking your whole body instead!
Sailing frigate - Adventure.

Good to meet you, Commander. I'm Adventure, and these are my new digs! If you wanna come over, you have to tell me ahead of time! Or else you'll fall into one of my traps, and trust me, you do NOT wanna do that.
Commander, is this the new place you got for me? It's bigger than I expected... Hey, where are all the security measures?! Can I get you to install some alarms?
*tremble tremble*... Th-th-this place is giving me the heebie-jeebies. Is something targeting me? Commander, we gotta run before it gets us!
I-I'm not paranoid, okay? I'm just trying to ward off threats effectively! Check the record - you'll see I've never fallen victim to an attack, not ONCE. That means I'm right!
Adventure's on an adventure♪ Saving the day between missions♪ Finding little hideouts all over while she looks for a home♪
Can you make the safest doomsday bunker ever? Please! I wanna live there!
Commander, I installed a tripwire alarm right here. It'll let me know right away if there's danger!
Heheheh... That's weirdly calming.
This is a tool I use in my adventures! You can see it if you want, Commander.
Ack! Y-y-you just touched me! I knew this outfit wasn't safe!
Hmm... You don't have any adventuring or exploring missions? Those could be fun!
Commander! Hurry up and grab your rewards! You don't want someone stealing those.
I made sure the mail is safe. You can read it now.
Hyah?! O-oh, it's you... You scared the hell out of me. I thought I was about to get my throat slit, or something.
The commission team is back! Should we send someone to keep guard over the rewards, or something?
If I get stronger, will that make my bunker safer, too...?
Time for a brand-new adventure!
Phew... I think we got a lucky win!
Gaaaah, th-th-this place is too dangerous for me! Let's leg it!
I'd better eliminate these threats!
Aaaah! T-t-too much danger, too much danger!
This place is unsafe... I'd better move out...
Huh? I don't get to move homes?! I just wanna live somewhere safe. Isn't that plenty reasonable? Come on, Commander, pleeeease?
Have you heard the story of the three little pigs? They got eaten because they didn't predict danger coming!
Commander! I found this great hiding spot, so I'm building a new house there! Nobody gets to know but you... Hmm? Why not just keep living where I am? It isn't safe to live in the same place forever!
Hmm... Y'know, I think the safest place for me is right next to you! Is it because of the port's top-notch defences, or is it because you make us all feel safe...?

Commander, will you stay with me forever? Every minute of every day? You won't ever regret it? Phew... Good. To celebrate finding the safe harbor I've always dreamed of... Put that ring on my finger, you!
Ooh! I like this. No, I love it!

ex.line: Commander, where should we stay tonight? A cabin halfway up the mountains? A villa with an ocean view? Your office? Or maybe... the hideout I made just for you and me!
I feel so safe with you. Hmm... I shouldn't let my guard down, though. It's my job to make you feel safe, too!
Tadaaa! I finished prepping your own special bunker, Commander! Wanna see it? Heheh, I'll show you there right now!
Come closer... Now hug me! Yeah, just like that, don't move. Phew... That's calming.
I've already kitted this place out. It's got traps that trigger when you walk near them, surveillance cameras with no blind spots, and more. No bad guy is coming near me!
Hold it! Hold those arms out... Okay, good... Now you gotta hug me tight... Tighter... Good! Keep doing that.
Wanna see what's up my sleeve? Then come closer and... BOO! Haha! I just wanted to scare ya.
W-weird... We've done this so many times, but it still gives me such peace of mind...
Welcome back, Commander! Find any cool places to explore? I'm dying for an adventure!
Life with you is the peace I've always dreamed of! As long as I have you, I can go confidently to the most dangerous deserted islands or the deepest trenches of the ocean!

lines.line: There you are... Don't think I didn't notice you skulking around my castle! Can't believe you made it here without triggering my traps... Does that mean I'm not safe here, either?!
There you are... Don't think I didn't notice you skulking around my castle! Can't believe you made it here without triggering my traps... Does that mean I'm not safe here, either?!
Tell me, powerless intruder, why you've come to my castle! For the treasure? Or for the life of its beautiful master?!
Let you go? Oh, gladly. As long as you can prove that you wandered in here by accident and don't pose a threat! That should be easy, shouldn't it?
Ooh, now THAT'S a fascinating tale of adventure! Yet its protagonist fell into my clutches so easily... What could it all mean?
Even in such peril, you make calculated decisions and well-reasoned hypotheses... Heehee, now you've really got my interest.
Storyteller... Heheh, do you mind if I call you that? If you're thirsty, I have a wine fountain to wet your throat.
Oh? You're approaching me? Instead of running away, you're coming right to me? You're either brave or stupid... Interesting.
Stay here, you. That's an order from the master of this castle...
Well, well... You trespassed into private property, and now you're face to face with its owner. Did you think this is a coincidence?

Oh, what a conundrum. I'm not the kind of person who can be persuaded by excuses, you know, but I've changed my mind! Your stories fascinated me. From now on, you'll live here and entertain me with more stories.
Essex-class aircraft carrier - Lexington II, Hull Number CV-16.
The Blue Ghost Lexington is back from her long dormancy... Commander, thank you for waiting for me. Nothing makes me happier than knowing that we're reunited.
Hehe, nobody could've awakened the Blue Ghost from her long slumber but you. It's been a while, Commander, but I've finally come home to you.
Welcome, Commander. The weather's been fickle lately. Take good care of yourself between all of your work, okay?
Worried that I'd fall back into my deep slumber? Hehe, don't worry. I won't leave you again.
Bristol, Fu Shun, Gallant, Fu Po... Heehee, this port has welcomed a lot of delightful young ones, hasn't it?
I didn't expect the port could change so much... Commander, I'll have you know that I got lost in the dorms today!
Sara's awfully well-behaved today... Did our last little chat really make a difference?
Aircraft carriers' combat tactics change in the blink of an eye. Maybe I should be the student, for once?
Hehe, you're always so encouraging!
What's on your mind, Commander? Ready to look at today's mission reports? Or... Is it me you're focused on?
Hehe... Yeah, just like that. You remember exactly what I like, don't you?
That mission is yours, this one is mine... There. Dividing the labor makes us twice as efficient!
Phew... The missions are all done and dusted. I booked us a private trip to the hot spring, if you'd like a little change of pace.
You've got mail! Hehe, I hope there aren't any surprises inside!
I smell gunpowder... Commander, well done today. Heehee, before you get back to work, let's get you cleaned up. Go take a bath, okay?
Commander, the commission team is back. I'll go check on their results!
Now I can sing even better!
Everyone, let's win today for a greater tomorrow!
Heehee, have you fallen for this reborn Lady Lex all over again?
The enemy's gotten arrogant... Commander, once we've regrouped, let's teach them a painful lesson.
On my name as the Blue Ghost, I write your funeral dirge!
I'll have to go all-out this time.
How long are you going to keep this silliness up, Commander? It's about time you grew up.

"Being an idol is a job that brings smiles to everyone. Of course, that includes you too, Commander." Remember that? Well, for all the waiting I put you through, I'll have to make you smile twice as hard!
Oh? Your brow's all furrowed again. If you're worried about something, talk to me. We can solve it together... Hmm? When did I come get in here? Hehe, that's a secret!
The sea breeze brought news: today's the perfect day to relax. Commander, let's take the day off and take Sara on a picnic together.

Sometimes, the breeze at port reminds me of that dream again. Happy summer days, cool waves... But in the end, a dream is just a dream. In this moment, as I'm holding your hand and sharing your warmth, I am truly happy.
I understand, Commander - you put a lot of thought behind this moment, right? Hehe, you're the same as ever. My feelings are the same, too. No matter when, no matter where, we'll always be together.
Thank you. You never change, Commander♪
Sara, show me how much stronger you've gotten.
A new us, a new era... Let's spread our wings together.
Hehe, ready to fight together again, Essex?

ex.line: Wait, Commander - no working until breakfast. Quit your complaining and just do what I say, okay?

When I see the port today, I truly realize that I've woken up from a long dream. Being able to watch the younger girls grow up, to feel the sunshine and the sea breeze, and to share in joys and sorrows with you... That's the greatest blessing of all.
The weather's been nice, and the flowers on the hill are all in bloom. I love it when nice things keep happening.
Still staring at those documents? Rest a little. I might be able to help you organize your thoughts... or I could sing to help you relax?
Wanna try my powered-up home cooking? You can taste the fruits of all my lessons with Vestal!
Heehee, after you finish your work, why don't you tutor me? Professor♪
Hehe, Commander, I can tell that you want me to rely on you sometimes...
Ah... Mm, you're gonna mess up my clothes... Hehe, it's okay. I'll fix them up later.
Good work. I arranged for the other secretary ships to take care of the rest, so why don't you and I go take off early? Come on♪

Every little moment, from fixing your tie, to pouring tea for you, to watching you work, is a miracle brought about by our reunion. I'll never ask for anything more, as long as I can be with you forever...

lines.line: I guess dressing up as maids is all the rage at port these days. It piqued my interest, so I just had to try it! Together, let's make this place as clean and relaxing as it can be.
I guess dressing up as maids is all the rage at port these days. It piqued my interest, so I just had to try it! Together, let's make this place as clean and relaxing as it can be.
I think I'm starting to understand the joys of being a maid. Just doing my job well makes you more comfortable. Isn't that wonderful?
You and I are in perfect sync! We're almost done cleaning. Do you think this place has gotten more relaxing yet?
Phew... I'm almost done here. How do you plan to relax, Commander? Of course, I expect you'll be resting in my arms.
Oh? Commander, stay still. There's dust on your collar... Hehe, isn't it a maid's duty to pay attention to the little details?
I'm always telling you to leave things to me, but I didn't think we'd be this busy... It's kind of refreshing, honestly.
It's fun to change roles together once in a while, isn't it? Hehe... Yeah! It has to be both of us, together!
Mm... Is my hair sticking to you? Hehe, I might be a little bit sweaty.
Mm... I really need to be careful when I'm dressed like this, huh?
Geez, I'm trying really hard to play the part... You're not making it any easier~
Oh? You're just in time... Commander, would you please hand me that cloth?
Since I'm playing the part of a maid, I have to ask... Are you enjoying my services? Hehe, that passionate gaze of yours does make my heart race... Master♡
Independence-class light aircraft carrier - Cowpens, Hull Number CVL-25.

Heehee. I'm Cowpens, the Union's Independence-class aircraft carrier - and your new nutritionist! Relax and leave it all to me, Commander. I'll give you plenty of nourishment and fill you with energy every day~
Commander♪ I'm Cowpens, and I've come to take care of you. With my high-quality milk and bountiful nutritional knowledge, I'll make you feel better than ever. Just do exactly what I say, okay?
Commander, welcome baaack. Would you like a piping-hot cup of milk full of love? Don't be modest~ Drink up while it's still warm.
Commander~ Wanna learn more about nutrition? Or... Do you need more intimate love and care?
I don't think you're getting enough fiber lately... I'll add some more veggies to your diet tomorrow~ Commander... You'll eat them all, won't you?
Behold, my new milk enriched with even more nutrients. By the way, do you like your milk plain or sweetened? I can make both~
Commander, tell me all of your favorite foods. I'll incorporate as many as I can so your diet is nutritious AND delicious.
Mmm... Your touch makes me want to press myself up against you, Commander...
Heehee, do you want me to warm you up, silly? Don't worry. My arms are always open to you, Commander~
Hmm? Commander... Are you looking for some "special" nutrients?
Commander~ Missions are important, but keeping yourself energized is just as essential. Drink this special energizing milk I made... THEN you can go take care of those missions!
Are you tired, Commander? Hehe, time to have some of my special milk pudding! Nothing is more important than ample nutrition~
Before you check your mail, drink this vegetable juice to recover your energy. It's your favorite flavor!
Commander, welcome home. You must be sooo exhausted. Come lean on me, drink this warm honey milk, and recover your strength... I won't take no for an answer!
Commander, I hear the girls who went on commission came back~ It's great to know that they're safe.
Mmm, I feel so full of energy... I'll use this power to support you and everyone else even better than before.
Battle starts~ Don't worry, Commander. I'll protect everyone.
Heehee... The joy of victory is the best nutrient of all!
Hmm... We'll have to change our diets and get more nutrients. Make sure you eat right too, okay, Commander?
Stay still and let me give you the nutrients you crave!
Someone's a little stubborn~
Commander... This can't continue. I'll have to try even harder to take care of you.
Please don't refuse my care, Commander. It's all for the sake of your health... Drinking milk can help you relax, too.
Commander~ My diet plan is working really well, isn't it? Keep it up!
Overtime isn't good for you, Commander. To ease my worries and improve your health, you'll just have to stop... Or else my nutrition won't be able to keep up with your efforts♡
My beloved Commander... Your continued health and vitality are my greatest joy. Like milk that stays warm forever, my love and protection will never, ever cool down♡

At first, I just wanted to soothe you with the warmth and nutrients of milk... But at some point, my feelings turned into a lifelong bond. Heehee... You've given me a nutrient, too, Commander - the one called love.
You know me so well, Commander~ Why don't I make you some special veggie juice tonight? Make sure you drink it all up~
Stay close to me!
Let's hold the line together!

ex.line: Welcome back to my arms, Commander. Huuug~ Ah, how reassuring!
When I see you happily drinking milk, I can't help but want to nourish you more!
Commander~ This milk is chock full of my love. Drink up every last drop, please!
Commander, why not lean on me for a little while? My body heat will help relieve all of your fatigue~
You can pick any ingredients you want, Commander. For a nutritionist, there are no absolute must-haves or must-not-haves.
That feels nice... Commander, I need more of your nourishment.
Mmm... Your warmth is the greatest nourishment of all for me~
Hehe... Commander, you look so needy right now. Go on, then... Take all you want~
Good work, Commander. You look tired... I have hot milk, so let's get some of that in your tummy while I give you a full-body massage.
For the sake of peace and everyone's health, I'll fight my hardest!
I'm glad everyone's safe! Don't forget to replenish those nutrients when you get home!
We'd better retreat... Don't worry. Everything will be okay.

Commander, I've realized... that I want to nourish your heart just as much as I want to support your health. I want to warm you up with my hugs, milk, and love... That alone would make me feel so happy and fulfilled.

lines.line: Are you ready, Commander? You're about to get the most soothing infusion of nutrients in your life. Step one is to relax...
Are you ready, Commander? You're about to get the most soothing infusion of nutrients in your life. Step one is to relax...
Commander, you're back just in time. Come on in! My milk is at the perfect temperature now.
Isn't this material just so soft? Hehe... Has a nice mouth-feel, too, doesn't it?
I added calming honey to your milk to help you sleep~ Take a nice little nap in my arms... I'll hold you all the way through.
Physical affection can help you take in nutrients faster... Hmm? You don't think that's true? Heehee, I just wanted you to feel my body heat.
Commander~ If I do... this... do my softness and body heat feel nice and relaxing?
Mm? Hehehe... For being such a good Commander, you can touch all you like~
Commander~ Wanna try an even more amazing nutritional plan I've been cooking up?
Mmm... Are you in the mood for extra nutrients today?
Good work today, Commander~ Sit down here. The ultimate nutrients await, so drink up♪
Stay here with me forever, Commander. I'll nourish every last inch of you with my milky love, day and night.
Fletcher-class destroyer - Clarence K. Bronson, Hull Number DD-668.

I'm Clarence K. Bronson, a Fletcher-class destroyer and equipment tester working under the Eagle Union. If you have any new machines that haven't been vetted for stability, I'll examine and analyze it per my checklist to guarantee your safety.
The name's Clarence K. Bronson. I'll be testing, evaluating, and improving equipment around the port starting today. If you ever need to be apprised of our tech status, ask me anytime.
Good morning, Commander. I've finished my routine inspections. Would you like to check behind me?
The riskier and more unstable your machine is, the more meticulously it needs to be tested. That's why my job exists... I hope you provide good insurance, though.
Leave all equipment testing to me. I'll deal with any hidden risks.
Test reports for this batch are complete. I recorded potential risks and improvements, and I await your review.

Commander, did you read those test reports? The ones for torpedoes, main cannons, and aerial bombs. Do you think we should start with a smaller deployment? No worries - they all passed safety testing. The data doesn't lie.
Huh?! O-oh no, one of the machines is throwing an error. I-I'd better go check it!
You're... thanking me for my work? I-I was just... doing my job, that's all...
C-Commander...? Umm, this is going to interfere with my... sensor calibrations...
Commander, you have unfinished tasks. Doing them quickly will reduce the number of risks we face.
So you've finished your work before the deadline? Not bad. Leave the rest to me.
Commander, new mail came for you. If you forget to pick it up, I'll remind you again later.
Commander, how are your missions going? I'll check all of your equipment again before you leave. Best have everything in tip-top condition, after all.
Commander, the commission team just returned. I asked them to collect combat data for their equipment, so let's go greet them together.
Equipment performance improved... I'll test its stability now.
All combat units have passed final inspections. Ready to engage.
Hmm... Well, my combat performance seems to be within the standard deviation.
It's my fault for not detecting our shortcomings sooner...
Removing all risk factors!
My defense systems need urgent maintenance!
Don't get in the way of my work, please. You'll lower the reliability of my test results.
Equipment performance and reliability must be tested in real combat. I've made preliminary assessments of the testing risks, so don't be worried.
If it means removing all safety risks, I don't mind working overtime. You don't have to worry about me.
Commander, I have a slight technical problem. I-if you don't mind... I could really use your advice. Umm, I think your advice... would give me the spark of inspiration I need...

C-Commander, umm... Could I ask you to hold me for a while? I'm in the middle of an important test... That is, testing how important you are to me... I think I have a conclusion, too. To me, you are... irreplaceable.
You want... to make an oath with me? Th-this is uncharted territory... I have to remove the risks! First, we must make sure the ring is my size... Would you please put it on my finger, Commander?
Oh, a gift! I-I definitely don't dislike it...
That rigging... Uh, maybe it could use another round of testing?
Your new inventions are safe in my hands!

ex.line: Commander, we'll be testing everything in your office today... Huh? Nothing is throwing up errors? Umm... A-an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure!
Commander, this next experiment is a complicated one. I don't know if I can do it alone... U-umm, could I ask for extra resource allocation?
I tested your bedding and found no hidden risks... How did I test them? Through direct use, of course.
Come with me, please. I have some equipment that requires testing outdoors, and I'll need your help... Also, I don't happen to have any plans after, sooo...
Commander... Sh-should I take this to mean that I'm doing a good job?
Do you need help? I'm available for you any time.
I-I get it! You need me to test your limits!
"Being with you is... s-so much fun!" Hmm, that one still sounded awkward... Let's go again. "Being with you is-" Huh? C-Commander?! H-how long have you been there?

lines.line: Welcome, Commander. Your maid, Clarence K. Bronson, will serve you today. Rest easy and accept my special hospitality.
Welcome, Commander. Your maid, Clarence K. Bronson, will serve you today. Rest easy and accept my special hospitality.
Commander, it's time. First, I will introduce today's services. Umm... Oh, I don't have to? Okay... Then may I begin the test right away?
Rest assured, I know how to handle a whip quite well. Expect not pain, but... heart-warming stimulation. Just focus on the feeling and trust in me. I won't hurt you, I promise.
As a maid, I will do my work diligently. I won't stop even if you cry, okay? Of course, the safe word is a different story.
What level of force would be best, I wonder? I think this calls for a few iterations of testing with you.
You want chocolate? Okay. Open up... Test note: pain makes sweet food taste even better.
D-don't expect all of this praise to earn you any hidden services, or anything...
Remember the safe word? If you don't say it, I'll keep going.
This is part of my special services, too...
You must be tired from that last mission. Let me help you relax a little.
I think our Commander is in need of some punishment.
Commander, are you satisfied with my services today? Will you leave with good memories of your time here? I won't stop until you've had too much fun to bear.
Cleveland-class light cruiser - Pasadena, Hull Number CL-65.

Self-intro? I'm Pasadena, Eagle Union light cruiser. Heh - there're loads of other things I could tell you. Whaddya wanna know? My interests? Got plenty of those. My favorite, though, that's gotta be throwing celebrations with people!
Ta-dah! Here's a special debut surprise from your girl Pasadena! Did you like it? Hahah! I'll take that dub. My surprise plan was a success!
Can you guess what surprise I have in store for you today, Commander? Ta-dah! I gave your office a celebratory makeover!
Commander, I just got a frickin' amazing idea! How about we throw a musical festival at the port? People would absolutely love it!
The much-anticipated ice cream day is here! What kinda celebration should we throw? ...Hm? Never heard of an ice cream festival? Hahah! Have this frozen goodness and let's have a look!
Hey, Commander, we've been working for a long while now, so how about some house music to relax to? Let's follow the beat and go check out the surprise I've got for you!
Commander, didya see the stamp pad down there? You can get a mystery gift from collecting all of 'em! Let's give it a shot!
Ahh, I see, so this is how you show you're feeling glad? Don't mind if I do the same... Pat-pat! Here's a headpat!
Ahh... Feels much better with my hair down! Let's continue, Commander♪
Oohh, so THIS is the kind of surprises you like. I see♪
Got any missions we could make a surprise out of? If so, lemme at it!
Heheh! Claiming those mission rewards feels about as good as a celebration, doesn't it?
Commander, there might just be a surprise from me in this new letter. Heehee♪
Truth be told, Commander, I'm working on a li'l celebration! We're just waiting for you! C'mon, let's go!
Commission's done and the celebration's ready to start! Let's go check it out, Commander!
Oooh! Let's dance!
Yooo! Giiirls! Time to celebrate!
Big wins like this call for a celebration!
What?! This was no surprise, it was a shock!
Here's a bombastic celebration!
It'll take more than that to stop me!
Aww, don't like the celebrations I worked on? How about some bombastic surprises, then?
Everybody's smiling and celebrating! C'mon, Commander, doesn't this nice mood make you wanna smile?
Hey! Heehee - bought this adorbs hair ornament, and I think it'd look sweet on you! You should put it on, then we'll take a selfie together!
Commander, open your mouth! Say "Ahh"! ...How's that? Pretty banging cake, right? Heh - I knew you'd like it! Feels like I'm starting to figure out your vibe!
Check this out, Commander! It's a selfie stick! See, I'm making a video centered around us spending the day together. I wanna record some happy moments between us to look back on!
I-is this surprise from you?! Heehee - I dig it♪ Okay! Today is gonna be our commemorative day of love! Every anniversary from now on, we'll throw a huge celebration and party our butts off!
Woooah! Now this is a wild surprise!
Get the word out that I'm working on a music festival!

ex.line: Oh! I'm getting to see you again! This sure is a day full of surprises! ...Hm? To me, meeting you is enough to make me happy for the whole day!
