Commander! From now on, every weekend is gonna be celebration weekend! Why? 'Cause weekends are for relaxing, but you still do work in secret, don'tcha? That's why I'm taking you along to enjoy the celebrations with me!

Commander, I bought some shiny new accessories. Where should I stick 'em? On my collar? Chest? Also, which do you like better: Silver or gold? They're both so good and I can't decide! ...I've got it! How about we both wear one for a matching look?
Oh! That's my program for the celebration! I see it's got your attention. Maybe... that means you'll get up on stage for me?! I've gotta work in a spot for you, then!
The heart sticker on your pen? Yeah, I put that there! Marking each other's personal items is a way to show your feelings, y'know! Also, it's your turn next! Pick your favorite spot to leave a mark♥
You think I should put a hairpin here, too? Sure! I was thinking the same thing!
Yeah, my tail accessory IS pretty cute! Heheh - wanna touch it? It feels nice!
Hold still, Commander! Now it's my turn to give YOU a surprise♡
Ta-dah! Congratulations on getting the sortie bonus pack, Commander! Your surprise rewards are ready, so come with me and collect 'em!
Come here, Commander! Now close your eyes! That's it, just keep your eyes closed and wait for my instructions. Three, two, one... *smooch*! Ahaha! How'd you like that surprise?

lines.line: Surprise! How do you like my special showdown outfit? I got it specifically for the game we're gonna play! Ahaha♪ Let the Meow-Meow Celebration Service begin!
Surprise! How do you like my special showdown outfit? I got it specifically for the game we're gonna play! Ahaha♪ Let the Meow-Meow Celebration Service begin!
Hoho! You're really into this, Commander. Can't help your urge to want to school me, huh? Heheh. The sensory equipment's up and ready. Let's do this!
Already getting excited about the surprise after our showdown? Ahaha! I got loads of surprise cards for our punishment game! All with veeery different punishments.
I endured! Take this! Thirtyfold shield parry! Victory's mine. Hm? My reaction time got quicker all of a sudden? Heheh - that's 'cause this match blindfold makes me a master at this game!
Hmm... I drew the "put a mask on and meow like a cat" card... Well, alright! Meow! Meow, meow♥ G-god, I'm glad you can't see my face right now... *blushes*
Maaan, you win. My card iiis... "Paw Print: Move your paw print to a location of the winner's choice." Wonder what that means... Eek! C-Commander?!
Hm? Surprise touchy-touchy! Meow, meow! Meow, meow!
Whoa! Hey! No off-the-board tricks! Ahaha - two can play at that game!
Eek! C-Commander... Of all the cards you could draw! Mmh... Still not done? You're taking... an awful lot of time for a surprise...♡
Welcome back, Commander! Wanna continue where we left off? If you're too tired, I've got a surprise in store for you instead♪

What's this? A secret stage?! No, it's an Easter egg just for you and me! When we're together, even uneventful days become filled with surprises! *smooch*... Heehee - that was a surprise meant to make your heart race♡
Francesco Caracciolo-class battleship - Francesco Caracciolo.
I am Sardegnian battleship Francesco Caracciolo, the bound magistrate awaiting the dawn that shall never come in the eternal night.
I am Francesco Caracciolo, the magistrate of the Sardegna Empire. If you do not fear my power, then please allow me to pursue a moment of peace by your side.
When you're here, the turmoil within my mind quiets down.
You so easily pierce through my defenses... Is this a blessing, or a different form of judgment?
Your fingers bring me greater reassurance... than the cold of the chains.
Say something, won't you? Even an offhand comment can subdue the power that itches within me...
Tsk... So irritating... Commander, let me hear your voice... I want you!
Well... If this helps you relax, then so be it.
So you seek to get to know me better... Curiosity killed the cat.
Give me peace... Give me love.
Commander, you have new missions. Do not let business unfinished become a waking nightmare.
Mission complete. Let us return to the embrace of silence.
A new letter has arrived. Could it be news of a victory, or judgment for me?
I suppose... this is what it means to wait.
The commission team has returned with spoils... and turmoil from the outside.
Commander, I implore you to "discipline" me in your own way. Keep me bound to your side.
I shall judge your sins.
Let the filth be returned to dust.
Fate eventually strips us of everything...
Heehee... Now... Let all fall into the abyss!
Ugh... So irritating! Your voice, Commander! I need to hear your voice!
Why do you linger here? Nothing remains... within this shadow.
My true strength, you ask? It rests within this bound body of mine. Even I have never seen it in its entirety before.
Your existence renders unnecessary my restraints... Is this really how it ought to be?
I've walked through darkness with no stars to guide me. I hear it now... The sound of your voice, in the wind's whispers from afar.
I used to hold that life was a series of winters, until I met you... That's when I knew true warmth for the first time.
This vow is greater than the eternal night, and more beautiful than the faint light of dawn... This whole body of mine I surrender to you. Please forevermore show me the way.
An item imbued with your sentiments, is it? I will treasure it.
To think that poetry could be as sharp as a blade...
The sacred light that you depict... It's so radiant.

ex.line: Even should the turmoil continue, my heart is clearer than it ever has been before. Your light guides my way, Commander.
My heart trembles, and my thoughts are confused... Only when your warmth reaches me does my composure return.
Were I to approach, would you fly away like a frightened bird, or gently linger for me like a star?
I pray for you, for you are my one and only weakness.
Commander, this power I cannot control... It now lies in your grasp.
Could this be... a ritual of blessing?
Hahh... Commander, does this bring you joy?
Ahh... So warm... Let me take in your all with these lips.
The turmoil of my mind is letting up... I knew you'd come back.
My strength grows. To think that a lovely hope would emerge amid endless suffering...
My body is a blade that purges sin.
Another sin has come to an end.
Ah... How irritating...
I surrender these chains to you, and allow you to judge my sins and future and guide me... You are my sole and final salvation.

lines.line: Now it is laid bare before you... The shadow that even the sun's light cannot pierce. This is my complete, unfiltered confession to you.
Now it is laid bare before you... The shadow that even the sun's light cannot pierce. This is my complete, unfiltered confession to you.
...Do you wish to see more of my "truth," Commander?
My attire? I merely changed from a heavy restraint to a gentle bind. Do you think it suits me?
You say that this will capture my true self... What am I to do, Commander? Will you assist me?
The tether that coils around my body is a gentler one... Or is it, truly?
Adjust the hem? One moment... How's this?
Mgh... My hair is in the way... Could you straighten it for me again?
What did the camera capture - my pious confession, or proof of my sins?
Mgh... In darkness that even the light avoids, what do you ascertain?
Hm? A good angle, you say? Then let's continue.
Once all pictures have been developed, you will find the answer that lies hidden in each and every one - that I have long since given you my true self.
Giussano-class light cruiser - Alberto di Giussano.

Greetings, dearest Commander. My name is Alberto di Giussano! Simple victory doesn't suit me - I prefer a triumph marked with difficulty, one that will earn me looks of admiration from my peers. Working with you should give me plenty of opportunities, I trust?

Ooohohoho! Did my magnificent dancing captivate you, dearest Commander? Consider it an official greeting from yours truly, Alberto di Giussano! Why, I'd dare wager that you will fall for me in the very near future!
Dearest Commander, are you even more captivated by me today than you were yesterday? Huh? No...? Well, that just gives me something to strive for!
Do you think I'm really easy to read? When I win, I get excited. When I lose, I get angry. But I'd say that just makes me worthy of being favored by victory!
Ooohohoho! Dearest Commander, behold my dazzling dance steps! Or else... all my time spent practicing will be for naught!
Dearest Commander, let's play a game. I bet I can complete our next mission with my eyes closed... What if I lose? Then you may do whatever you want with me, of course! As if that would ever happen.
Oh dear, have you seen through me? Yes, I know some challenges can be especially difficult. But with your help, maybe Lady Luck will smile upon me!
Ah?! What is this nervous, ticklish feeling... M-my face is burning!
Oh? Are you testing my sense of balance?
O-oohohoho...! Is this a test? Well, I'll show you that I can withstand anything!
Let's finish these trivial tasks before we challenge ourselves. In fact, why wait? Why not see who can complete this work more efficiently?
See how quickly you've finished your missions thanks to my help? Awaiting your compliments now! Ooohohoho!
You have new mail! Will there be acrostic poems? Riddles, perhaps? Leave any puzzles to me - oh... I-I don't get this one. Ohohoho...
What inspiring triumph, dearest Commander! Next time, let's fight an even more formidable foe!
The commission team has returned. Do you think they've brought unexpected treasures?
Now that I'm stronger, I must aim for greater heights.
Ooohohoho! Bring me the strongest enemy!
I won! Dearest Commander, I humbly await your ample praise.
Geez! We were so close! If we do it again, I just know I can win...
Ooohohoho! Your defeat is certain!
NOW things are getting interesting!
Should I just work without you for a while, dearest Commander? It would certainly be a new challenge.
Did my glorious dance moves leave an impression? Ballet is an art that involves making mistakes and picking yourself up every time. Ooohohoho!
Dearest Commander, might I suggest a little challenge? Relax and take my hand... in an unknown, wonderful, and exhilarating dance! Ooohohoho!

How can I win your heart? This has become my sweetest challenge yet. Heehee, I just know that solving it will be beyond satisfying. Prepare yourself, dearest Commander, because I'm going to put my all into making you mine. Ooohohoho!

Maybe I'm impossible to satisfy. That's why I keep dancing, dancing, and dancing more... But when I think of you, I feel oddly content. Your light is dazzling, a source of warmth that holds me instead of making me chase after it. Is this what they call love?
Ooohohoho! I, Alberto di Giussano, have won the most precious wager of my life! Dearest Commander, are you ready for your next challenge? That would be... spending the rest of your life with me!
Goodness! How did you know my favorite? I'd be delighted to have it.
Forget the little details. Let our results speak for us!

ex.line: Dearest Commander! Hehe, I'd wager you thought about me at LEAST three times while I was not at your side! ...Oh, you say I'm correct? My intuition never fails. Ooohohoho!
Dearest Commander! Today is as normal as can be, so I decided not to prepare any special surprises for you... Hmm? You already know I have a surprise?!
*sigh*... Oh, Commander. I dreamed that I'd turned into a swan, took flight, got overly excited, and fell into the sea... Ahem. A pretty classic ending, no?
Heehee, I'm fine with pineapple on pizza. Do you have anything more challenging? Huh? P-pizza with strawberry cream pasta on it?! Just the description is fascinating!
Is that all? You don't want to see if you can accomplish making me feel so good that I lose track of time?
Mmm... It looks like neither of us is any match for the power of love.
Ooohohoho... Dearest Commander, I feel your love.
You finally came home to me. I just ran into a problem that I can't solve on my own. Help me deal with it!

Here's the plan for our date. First, we go to an amusement park. Then, we watch a movie, and we end it with mountaintop stargazing! You think we don't have enough time? Don't worry! As long as we tackle it together, nothing is beyond us! Ooohohoho!

lines.line: O-ooohohoho... Look what I've done, knocking down the clothing rack. I suppose this is the perfect time to show you my clothing collection!
O-ooohohoho... Look what I've done, knocking down the clothing rack. I suppose this is the perfect time to show you my clothing collection!
Behold, my many styles! Dearest Commander, are you ready to help me pick out the outfit that suits me best?
This one is for when we go to the beach together again, this one's for a hot spring... Oh, this one? Umm... You'll find out tonight! Ooohohoho!
When I was buying all of these, I was always hoping you'd get to see them. Heehee... I guess that wish came true early.
Ooohohoho! Whether I'm dressed or not, it's only natural that your eyes are drawn to me. Th-though... It is preferable that I am dressed!
The matching accessories are cute, aren't they? Feel free to touch them more.
Heehee... I just knew you'd love this outfit. Ooohohoho!
Mmnh... I have better attire for this, you know. But this will do just fine, too.
Tadaaa! I put on this special, limited-edition outfit to celebrate your triumphant return! Do you like it? Or do you LOVE it?
Dearest Commander, which outfit would you like me to wear for "the decisive battle"? Give me an honest answer! Otherwise... I'm going to stay in your heart and never leave again!
Navigatori-class destroyer - Ugolino Vivaldi.
I'm the Sardegnian destroyer Ugolino Vivaldi. Umm, I hear you have "paperwork-itis." I'll get you fixed up right as rain in no time!
N-nice to... meet you. My name is Ugolino Vivaldi, and I'm from the Sardegna Empire. Everyone calls me Nurse Ugolino... Keep me by your side, and I'll keep you healthy and at ease!
Commander, let me diagnose you! Hmm... You're in perfect health!
Huh? Oh, m-my health? Sorry for making you worry... I just bandaged up a few little scratches, that's all... I'm really okay!
When you're getting a shot, don't stare at the needle. If it hurts, focus your attention on me, and the pain will go right away!
Your books might "catch a cold" if they're left out of the bookcase, just like you. Let's go outside and get you some sun, okay?
Plasters, bandages, disinfectant... and the candy you gave me, of course! These are all essential supplies!
You and I care for each other and look after each other... just like family!
I love this uniform! It's both comfy and durable.
Hyah?! Th-thank you for your concern...
You do have tasks that need doing, but you should really take care of your health, Commander.
Another mission done. I'll go check on the rewards. Oh, you can just rest here while I do.
You have mail... Yes, yes, very "healthy" mail. It's safe for you to open.
Thanks for all your hard work, Commander. Let me take a look at you... Hmm. Your uniform and hat are in good "health"... You must take such good care of them!
The commission is done. I'll go ask if they need help unloading.
I'm the very picture of good health now! Thank goodness.
I-I'll take care of everyone!
N-nobody is hurt, right?
It's okay. We'll try harder together next time.
For the sake of everyone's safety!
I'll never abandon a patient!
If your body is unhealthy, it'll affect your mind, as well... May I heal you before it's too late, Commander?
Ugh, why do I keep tripping... Has something gone "ill" in my shoes? Hmm? You want to hold hands and walk slowly? Thank you... That's very comforting.
Commander, you'll need ample sleep and lots of vegetables to stay healthy! If I happen to see you sneaking work into your bed at night... I-I'll start watching you to make sure you sleep!
The thought of you actually being sick makes me feel awful... Am I the one who's suffering from some strange illness now?
If you're feeling unwell, tell me right away! I want to help you! Even if it's just a little... It would make me so, so happy. S-so rely on me more... please?
Y-you'd really let me have something so valuable? I see... I'll care for it just as lovingly as I do for you.
Oh, you're too generous... Thank you, Commander.
Here's a first-aid kit. Take it with you on your adventures.

ex.line: Commander, I wanted to try a different methodology for today's diagnosis... Mwah. I measured your forehead temperature with my lips! You're in perfect health, by the way.
If I fall, you'll help patch me up... It feels wonderful to be cared for so much.
Sometimes, I accidentally go out wearing your clothes... W-we share bath soap and detergent, after all, so it can be hard to tell the difference sometimes...
Commander, come over to my place after work! I'll prepare a nice bubble bath for us to relax together.
C-Commander, umm... Could I ask you to check on my health with a little kiss to the forehead?
Hehehe, Commander... Our shadows are touching.
Hyah?! Yes, this does feel good, but... Urk...
Oh, no... The Commander still isn't home. What if there's danger, or... I knew I should've gone with you... Ah! Welcome back, Commander!
Whatever you want from me, I'd be happy to do... Huh? Could this be a symptom of... love?

lines.line: E-examination complete... This "sick" claw machine seems to have mistaken me for a plushie... O-or did it realize how much I wanted the Commander to take me home?
E-examination complete... This "sick" claw machine seems to have mistaken me for a plushie... O-or did it realize how much I wanted the Commander to take me home?
Ah... I-I'm not a plushie. Commander, can you help me?
C-congratulations... You caught a kitten... O-ooh, this is too embarrassing...
The rare prize...? B-but I'm not a plushie! Goodness, Commander...
These plushies are so soft and fluffy... If you hadn't caught me, I might've fallen right asleep on them.
Ah... Thank you, Commander. You know just how to make me feel better.
You wanna take a picture of me because you think I look cute...? I-if you really like this outfit... then I'll do my best to look good in it!
C-Commander, you'd take advantage of me right now...?
Did you find a way to get me out of here?! Huh? Why do you have a camera...? T-to document this and prevent it from happening again? Um, w-well, I suppose that makes sense...
I-if you really want to take me home as your rare prize... I'm not one to deny your wishes. In that case... p-please take good care of me!
Yuugumo-class destroyer - Fujinami.

I'm Fujinami, a destroyer from the Sakura Empire. I might be unlucky and tend to slip up from time to time, but I have absolute confidence in my fashion sense! Hehe, that's something you'd agree with too, right?
Ehehe~ The name's Fujinami, a nice lass blessed by everything trendy! You'd better prepare yourself - starting today, I'm gonna show you the ins and outs of TRUE fashion!
Sup, Commander. Did I blow your mind with my fashion sense today?
My forte is coordinating the latest fashion trends with Sakuran-style attire! Since you're already here, Commander, come bask in my brilliance!
Commander, the socks I'm wearing today look pretty edgy, huh? Wha... you can't tell the difference from before?! Th-then, you just have to take a closer look—!
Chasing after trends is seriously lame. I've got to be the one who sets them. So, Commander, wanna come try out a new outfit I put together for you? I'm sure it'll look great on you!
Ewww... another half-rotten fruit... Next time, I'll have you pick for me. 'Cause like, I know I can trust whatever you choose!
My horns are pretty cute, aren't they? C'mon, give 'em a feel. Can't hurt you with them even if I tried!
The accessories I chose look spectacular, don't they? Ehehe, this is the epitome of Fujinami's unique fashion sense~♪
Eep! Wh-what are you doing all of a sudden? W-well, I guess I could show you the coordination of my undergarments...
Need help with your mission? Eh? Huuh? I was just being polite! If you really left it in my hands, the whole thing would just go kaput!
...I actually managed to get the job done?! Commander... you really are lucky!
Oh my, what's this? Someone sent you a love letter? Mind if I take a gander, Commander~?
Welcome back, Commander~ Don't worry, I've been hard at work! Sooo... got any rewards for me?
The commission team's back. Make sure to reward our girls appropriately for their hard work!
All my hard work has finally paid off?!
Let's knock some fashion sense into these baddies!
Yaaay, victory! Hey, hey, did you see my cinema moment?
Ugh... I knew I needed more energy drinks!
I'll send you flying with my new kicks!
My clothes are in tatters... Ugh, I seriously hate it when this happens!
It's alright, Commander. I've got terrible luck to begin with, so I'm already used to these things.
A floral ribbon... frilly garter rings... glittery pink accessories... How should I put 'em together to make them pop? Aha! Commander, how about you decide?
My ribbon keeps coming loose... Say, would you mind tying it back up for me? Why? Because, like, you're lucky, aren't you? Plus, you totally looove doing stuff like this, right?
I feel like my luck's been on the up-and-up recently... I wonder if it's because of you? Heehee... don't take it as a compliment or anything though~♪
Heeey. I bought some accessories for you, Commander. ...Th-they totally aren't for couples or anything! As if I'd lower my fashion sense like that!
Th-this is just... What? It's perfectly normal! I mean, like, you picked it out for me, so of course I'd wear it~♪ Heehee, after all, fashionable people look good no matter what they wear~♪
You put your feelings into this, so like, I really appreciate it.
Jeez... Remember to be more careful this time!

ex.line: Heheh, so you came to work wearing my hand-picked outfit... Then, you've earned yourself a most generous reward... Mmwah~♪
Commander, check out this fashion magazine! The colors that are gonna be trendy around the port tomorrow are... Wait, TOMORROW? Does that mean someone's already ahead of me?
Are you heading out later? I got you an umbrella. It's the same color as mine~♪
It feels like my bad luck's been melting away ever since I started being with you... B-but, Commander! To make sure nothing goes wrong for our date, I need to double- no, triple-check everything!
Are you, like, trying to share your good luck with me? Then, I'd be glad to take it~
You like the coordination of my outfit, huh? Weeelll, I wouldn't mind taking it off to show you the details~♪
No, no! You have to undo the ribbon first, and then you can remove the lace~ ...Ngh! C'mon, you've got to follow the steps!
...Hmm, what outfit should I wear to welcome the Commander back? ...Huh?! Y-you're back already?! D-d-don't peek! At least not until I'm done changing!
Commander, I just realized something. No matter what I wear, you're always full of compliments... Does this mean you've completely fallen for me, from head to toe?

lines.line: Welcome to Fujinami's secret fashion lab~ Look, I put together a special ensemble just for you. So, what do you think? Pretty eye-popping, isn't it?
Welcome to Fujinami's secret fashion lab~ Look, I put together a special ensemble just for you. So, what do you think? Pretty eye-popping, isn't it?
Good, you're here. So, give me your honest feedback. Don't you just love this sort of contrast?
True fashion must be refined, inside and out! Even more so because it's an outfit only YOU get to see, Commander - that calls for extra care and attention~♪
It looks a bit risqué, you say? Heheh~ then, that only means you've already burned this image of me into your memories.
Phew... At least over here, I don't have to worry about getting rained on or slipping on a banana peel. Nngh! Hwuh?! Why'd the zipper suddenly get stuck?!
The highlight of this outfit isn't on the top of my head, you know. Focus your attention on the good parts, will you?
No need to rush. I'll show you eeeverything, from top to bottom~
Mmgh... Ooh, Commander, you really get it...
Oh, you're back early. Just couldn't hold back any longer, could you? I totally get it.
The secret behind "contrast" is... only you get to see ALL of me. The good, the bad, and everything in between... And it's exactly the package deal you signed up for, isn't it~?
6,000 ton-class cruiser blueprint - Chang Wu.
I am Chang Wu, a heavy cruiser of the Dragon Empery. Tell me, Commander - in your eyes, am I worthy of being considered a precious gem?

I am Chang Wu, a jade carver from the Dragon Empery. Having crafted countless pieces of jade, I considered myself wise and knowledgeable... until I glimpsed your elegance and eminence. Thus, I have come to realize... that what I considered treasures, are naught but stones.
The tea's aroma is just starting to fade, but the leaves are still warm. You came at the perfect time, Commander.
Commander... Are you looking at me as a person, or are you sizing me up like a jewel?
Commander, new jade has just arrived on the market. Care to appraise it with me? If you find any you like, I'll negotiate on the price.
This jade is lustrous and radiant, like your eyes when you're lost in thought... Ah, I'm sorry. I misspoke...

My jade collection could fetch a very pretty penny, but I would never give them to someone who doesn't know their true value. Basically... Umm, could you help me bear the expenses of maintaining my collection?
Your touch... Are you trying to share your warmth with me, a cold jade?
Even when appreciating fine jade, one must adhere to certain principles...
Commander, um... Moderation, you know...
Commander, there are still some uncut jade waiting for you to carve them.
Mission complete. I'm sure the rewards won't disappoint.
Mail? I hope the jade I ordered came in...
Are you tired? Come, lean on me and rest for a while... May my warm embrace ease your weariness, if only a little.
I prepared hot water and food for the commission team. It may not be much, but I hope they understand... it's the thought that counts...
There's no need to hide the sharpness of my skills any longer.
This battle is but part of the carving process...
Even stones with natural beauty must be carved to reveal their true splendor.
Broken jade can still be carved anew... and this failure is much the same.
With one stroke, a gem is carved - its brilliance revealed.
A maidenly jewel shatters - bone-chilling cold awaits.
A dust-covered jade can be polished, but what of a neglected heart? Ugh... Forget it.
Pardon me... When I see a true gem of a person, I can't take my eyes off of them.
They say that warm jade is smooth and soft... It reminds me of you.
I carved this pendant while recalling the warmth of your hands. Do you think I've managed to replicate your warmth?
An uncut gem requires a master's touch to truly shine. Tell me, Commander... Do you know the passion you've ignited within me?
The contract is sealed. Now I shape not jade, but a heart - I'll be by your side forever, bringing warmth and comfort like a treasured jewel...
Excellent quality. I knew you were a fellow connoisseur, Commander.
I don't need such elaborate accessories. A single jade pendant will suffice.
I understand, budgeting is important... but how can I say no to a gem that touches my heart?

ex.line: Beautiful jade has spiritual properties because of the care given to it by its keeper. Commander, by watching you each day... one could say that I'm nurturing jade, too.
Commander, the most important part of learning jade carving is to calm the mind. Follow my guidance and feel the rhythm in your body... Yes, very good...
I carved a new piece of warm jade. Would you like to see? Good... You can take a closer look, you know...
I don't mind if you just sit there. That alone... is the most beautiful view of all, in my eyes.
Jade must be touched to be truly transformed... Commander, will you give me the same attention?
Your warmth... is more reassuring than the finest jade.
Won't you... stay by me just a little longer?
Mm... You won't find any jade there...
So you've returned. My fingertips felt cold before, but your embrace has warmed me...

Commander, look at the pendant I made for you... When carving it, I could think of nothing but your face. I traced every curve with my palm over and over, poring over every last detail... Do you think I'm, um... shameless... For being so honest with you?

lines.line: Serene is this room, and pleasing is this plum-blossom fragrance, yet... why are you yet to come inside? Here, the aroma of flowers is rich, only awaiting the arrival of the spring breeze—
Serene is this room, and pleasing is this plum-blossom fragrance, yet... why are you yet to come inside? Here, the aroma of flowers is rich, only awaiting the arrival of the spring breeze—
Which will you embrace, Commander? These plum blossoms, or me?
Forget work for a while... Let's watch the plum blossoms scatter and enjoy a moment's peace together.
Which seems more disheveled? The branches by my bed, or my hair...?
Commander, would you say... that the scenery before you is worthy of a closer look?
I've guarded these plum branches from dusk 'til night, such that you might view them... and me as well, of course...
Your hands are always so warm...
Hmm? That technique... Are you trying to polish your favorite jewel?
Even for an appraisal, this is... Ah... Mm...
When I saw the sky getting dark, I knew you'd come back soon.
The commission team is back. Commander, go and greet them now... but don't forget about the romantic mood in here, okay?
See the fallen plum blossoms... Commander, will you cherish them? This scenery, this night, and our feelings...
Hai Yung-class protected cruiser - Hai Chou.

I am Hai Chou, a perfumer. No secrets elude my sense of smell. For instance, it tells me that your heart is throbbing right now, and that your body is releasing a sweet pheromone. I want it all to myself.
I am Hai Chou, a perfumer from the Dragon Empery. The scent upon your person... is quite intriguing. I do hope our cooperation is fruitful.
You're here. Come closer... and let me imprint your scent upon my memory.
My silken mask? It blocks off unwanted smells and protects my olfactory sense. Thanks to it, I can better focus on your smell when I remove it.
You smell exceptionally delicious today, Commander.
Turning a lethal poison into an alluring perfume - that is the art of a perfumist, Commander.
Now, repeat after me. Breathe in and let the fragrant mist diffuse... then slowly exhale. Feel my scent with your heart♡
Commander, if you continue this, I fear I may... Heehee♥
Say, have you noticed that my fragrance has already filled the air around you?
Heehee... This is my favorite spot to test fragrances on. Do you not believe me? Then try smelling your fingertips.
There are missions awaiting your "mixing," Commander.
A mission has been successfully "mixed." Now just to take in the rewards.
A letter has arrived from afar. Will you read it now?
Stress causes one to emit an astringent, bitter odor akin to overly concentrated aromatic oil. You must rest adequately so your scent may return to its mellow state.
Commander, the commission team has brought back smells from afar.
The line between perfume and poison is drawn by a minuscule difference in dosage.
This scent can chew through bone.
The aroma of victory is always so intoxicating.
Gunpowder smoke and rust... Such bitter smells.
Sink below the waves...
Finally, a "smell" that stirs my interest.
My silken mask can block off not just unwanted smells, but pushy individuals as well.
It will take a little while for our scents to fully combine into one.
Perhaps I'll look different from what you imagine once I take off my silken mask. Heehee. Watch closely. This is my everything laid bare...
*sniff sniff*... Mmh... You have a deep and unique complexity, yet your essence is so warm... Truly, I can't get enough of it.
My scent has already seeped into every little inch of your skin... There's no escaping it anymore.
Mmh... I wish to apply both my mixed perfume and my concocted "poison" on you... Hmm? The antidote? Why, that's me, of course♡ Ahh...
This is a lovely present. I should make it up to you somehow... Heehee.
Care to try my freshly made perfume?

ex.line: Trying to decipher your scent is unexpectedly fun. When you're strong, you're as steadfast and alluring as a cedar, and when you're gentle, you're like a vetiver... Even though I know you so intimately, you still surprise me with these new scents.
Even through my silken mask, I can clearly discern the smell of your breath. It's a piercingly clear smell, like hoarfrost...
Come closer, Commander. Your emotions emit different scents... For instance, this sense of confusion - it's utterly delectable.
I used ambergris saved for a special occasion in my latest perfume. Come close and smell it for yourself. I'm curious to see how long its lingering smell will stay on you...♡
I've mixed a new aroma that makes one crave a hug. Care to try it?
You can't be without me anymore, Commander♥
Mmh... It's getting sweeter and deeper... Heehee - the scent on your fingertips, I mean♡
*sniff sniff*... The smell of gunpowder smoke, the sea, and fatigue... Relax. Soon you will only smell my scent.
I've at last obtained the scent I've been dreaming of... This perfume, based on the theme of love, was made with your odor as the foundation♪

lines.line: You're awake? Judging from your appearance... I wonder if our previous rendezvous has left you unsatisfied?
You're awake? Judging from your appearance... I wonder if our previous rendezvous has left you unsatisfied?
Did the curious smell on your person bring you back? ...Hm? You wish to savor it some more? Heehee. Your wish is my command...
The wrinkles on the bed, the lingering scent of perfume... They silently recount what took place prior, Commander♡
I know that look. The fragrance of my specially made perfume has captivated you.
Something smells dangerous yet alluring, you say? Well, was it the danger that drew you in, or did you stay because of the allure?
You can try to feign composure, but your expression betrays you. Look here and here... You remember everything that I did.
Huh? I'd just finished with my hair, and now you do this... Is it perhaps because you find me more alluring with my hair down?
Are you this clingy? Keep this up, and I won't be able to let you go... Commander♡
Since you're so passionate... I'll let you have your fun one more time♡
You look rather tired. Since we have time, I'll keep you company a while longer. Now, come here...
The commission team has returned. I've made a calming perfume, so bring it to them as a gift.
Now... we can have all the fun we want.
Your love, your trust... It all serves as crucial inspiration for me, and I will let no one else have it. No one but me is allowed to fulfill your whole being♡
I'm not sure if I should let you see my face right now... Oh? You really want to? IN that case... Will this satisfy you?
What's wrong? Do you prefer when I let my hair down? Or... do you have something else in mind?
You're staring... Searching for the marks you left on me? Heehee.
Mm, your fingers... *sniff*... I see. Are you that fascinated by this aroma?
Still tired? Then come to me. Closer, now... Hehe, isn't the perfume I just sprayed just captivating?
Ah?! So you still haven't learned your lesson... Well, I'll just have to really drill it into you.
Heehee. After so many little scuffles... you've gotten really good at finding my weaknesses.
Are you trying to make a mess of my hair, or my bedsheets? Pick one. We have plenty of time... I can always clean up later.
Oh my, what do we have here? Heehee, now that you've made a mess of me... you'll have to find a way to make amends.
Here is my scent - it's going to cling to you now. No matter where you go today, it will be a constant reminder of this moment... and of me.
Project 66 heavy cruiser - Moskva.

I am Moskva, Northern Parliament heavy cruiser. My hobbies are winter swimming and skiing. A little eccentric, you say? That's true. Still, this spirit of pushing through the snow and wind is what allows us to aspire for our ideal world.

Northern Parliament Project 66 heavy cruiser Moskva. Greetings, Comrade Commander. In your eyes I see the glimmer that can make our dreams come true. Allow me, as your strongest sentinel, to temper your will.
Ready to get to work, Comrade Commander? Excellent. You are our role model.
You wish to get to know me better? Sure. I can tell you anything, be it my tactical thinking, my rigging structure, or even personal things about me.
Everyone gathers at your side and chats like it were the most natural thing in the world. How do you create such an approachable atmosphere? Have I been too strict with others?
I can always offer consultation if you have any concerns over strategy. It's also my professional duty.
I'm especially fond of winter swimming on snowy days. One can better temper their spirit in cold climes, you see. Have you considered trying it, Comrade Commander?
Excuse me, Comrade Commander... How does one initiate topics unrelated to work?
Comrade Commander, our relationship has taken another great step toward the highest level of friendship, hasn't it?
Is this something that friends do? My understanding isn't wrong, is it?
...Does "friendship" include doing such intimate things?
Comrade Commander, you still have missions to accomplish. Do you want me to help rank them by priority?
Mission rewards have arrived. Your hard work has paid off.
Is that the latest battle report? Read it quickly - our comrades on the front lines are waiting for our answer.
I bid you welcome back, Comrade Commander. To protect the peace and seize victory - these are the things we set sail for.
Our comrades are back from their commission, bringing substantial spoils. They've done well.
No blizzards will impede me on our next expedition.
For freedom! For our ideals! Uraaa!
Victory is ours! This is the fruit of our collective labor.
Comrade Commander, evaluate the casualties and prepare for the next battle.
Face the end!
Don't lose focus! Victory is almost within reach!
The port's temperature is too comfortable. Sometimes, a cold breeze is needed to keep you sharp.
You want to call me "friend"? This is the first time anyone has called me that.
You ask if I ever feel lonely. The port is where you are, Comrade Commander, so the answer is naturally "no."
As I understand it, a friend is someone you share time and space with. Ergo, it makes sense for me to stay by your side.
You said you'd be my friend forever, did you not? In that case, there should be no problem with us standing this close, holding hands, heads pressed together - right?
Is this ring a proof of friendship? Very well. Then from now on, you are my one and only best friend. We'll always be together now, won't we?
Did you get this just for me? Thank you.
I didn't see you there. Now, our defense is unshakeable!

ex.line: I've been waiting for you. So, shall we start the day with some work? Or would you rather do something only close friends can do?

Before you stands your best friend, your very own Moskva. My strength, my rigging, my everything is yours to use as you please. You can come closer if you so want. It's your exclusive privilege to do so.
Comrade Commander, if you ever feel hot, come close to me. My body temperature should make you a bit more comfortable.
I read in a book today that close friends memorize each other's little habits. For instance, how you look at me when you think of me. You do, don't you?

A traveler who hesitates in the Northern Parliament's snowy plains will freeze. That's why I'm always at the front, charging forward to clear the path for those behind me. Now, I will rid your path of all the obstacles in its way.
Comrade Commander, here's a report awaiting review. Oh, if you'd like to rest, I'll sit here with you for a bit.
Yeah. This is probably right. It feels pretty intimate...
Need something to calm you down? Alright, I have you covered.
I want to learn more from you...
New missions have come in. Let's get them done together. It's more efficient that way.
Comrade Commander, can I have some of your break time later? Since we're best friends, don't you think it's perfectly natural for us to go on a date?
Relax. As long as you're behind me, my defense will never falter.

What do I think of you? I like you. A lot. That's how we became best friends, isn't it? I will fight for everything you desire and wish to protect. Of course, I do look forward to other things that you want as well...

lines.line: The extent of one's true wit is revealed within the 19 lines on the board. Ever since I began learning to play Go, I've desired a match with you. Observe now, as this next move will determine the outcome of the game.

The extent of one's true wit is revealed within the 19 lines on the board. Ever since I began learning to play Go, I've desired a match with you. Observe now, as this next move will determine the outcome of the game.
Ah... You're here. I'm reviewing the last game we played. That move of yours was utterly sublime...
Want to see how I placed my stones? You can even come a little closer. My plan from the start was to enjoy this game with you anyway.
Your opening move may have seemed mindless, but it was packed with meaning. Before long, I noticed you had me going all out...
Your turn. If you're unsure of what move to make, then I know a way to clear your mind quickly.
Seems it's my turn. Since one can't undo a move, I'd better consider the board state and act cautiously... Give me a moment to think of how to respond to your move...
Ah, what a move... You caught me, let's say, pretty off guard.
You messing with my hair isn't going to impede my judgment.
Mgh... That's where you wanted to put your stone?
Mmh... Not where you meant to put it? No, since it's come to that, I will respond in full force.
Mission rewards have come in. Shall we have a look at them after we finish this game?
Welcome back, Comrade Commander. I just figured out how to exploit the state you left the board in. Look forward to seeing it.

Fighting spirit, positioning, resourcefulness... Only you can match me to the end in these aspects. It's wonderful to have a worthy opponent, and I'm convinced that this game has further heightened the feelings we share.
Project 30K Ognevoy-class destroyer - Ozornoy.

Listen up! I'm Ozornoy, the Project 30-K Ognevoy-class destroyer. Don't let my appearance fool you, 'cause I'm a full-fledged adult! ...What's with that look? Are you doubting me? I'll whoop you down!
Hmm... So you're the Commander? I'm Ozornoy, and I'll apparently be working for you from now on. Just a heads-up: I'm gonna hold this place to the highest standards of discipline!
It's time to get to work! I don't have to tell that to YOU of all people, do I?

Life is made up of countless little things, so you can't go being lazy about anything! If even a kid can understand that, then I'm sure you can, too. Hmph - looks like there's a mountain of things I'll have to teach you.
Hmph. Don't expect me to be as polite with you as other people are. I don't even consider you my superior officer yet... Commander.

...You left the office in a mess after searching for some data last night? Hmph! I cleaned it up just earlier! If you do it again, I'll just have to teach you how to efficiently organize your materials!
More coffee? Good grief... Just leave early today and I'll give you a little help. Stop flaunting your work ethic or I'll give you a whooping!
Huh?! What are you doing?! I've told you I'm not a little kid!
Need my help with something? Heheh! Glad you finally see how reliable I am!
Y-you moron! What are you doing?! I-I-I'm gonna whoop you!
You still have missions to do! I guarantee you'd have forgotten without my reminder!
Not half bad... Just barely acceptable! Now claim your rewards!
Here, I brought your mail. Do I seriously have to help with something so basic?
I took notes of all your commands in the last battle. Hmm... Decent, I guess. Anyway, come and see me tonight and I'll give you some special training! Don't forget, or you'll get a whooping!
The commission team is back. Hurry up and check the goods before I do it all myself!
This is... nowhere near enough! I've gotta get a lot, lot stronger!
I'll deal with the toughest one!
First place. Hah. What did you expect?
Dammit! What did I do wrong?!
Don't you underestimate me!
Don't you worry about me... I can do this myself!
Still not a passing grade. Apply yourself.
D-don't get ahead of yourself! You praising me a bit isn't gonna make me all giddy! Idiot!
Hey, what's wrong with you?! You worked all night in your office AGAIN, didn't you? Do it again and I WON'T cover you with a blanket! I mean it! That was the last time!
Just so you know, I'm not really praising you when I say this... You've been, well, kind of showing that you can be reliable, and... No, it's not! I'll say it again! I'm not really praising you!

Sometimes I feel, "Maybe it's fine to embrace you and be a little needy for a while"... Not because I've gotten soft or anything! As you no doubt know, even the most mature among us need the support of someone they like... Stop looking so smug!

A-are you dumb or something?! Y-you can't just make such a big declaration out of nowhere! You're supposed to pick a time and place and submit a request first... B-but anyway, I accept! Because I... I love you! Heheh...
You're giving this to me? Well, don't expect me to go easy on you just because of this!
Take this seriously!

ex.line: I made some honey water for you. Drink it while it's warm. What? Why are you just staring at me?
Take a nap? Only little kids take naps. I mean, if you wanna take a break... I-I guess I could rest with you for a little bit...

I've studied all of it. Your favorite foods, favorite sleeping posture, the places you often go to on breaks... Oh! I-I'm not saying I've been stalking you! I just... I just wanted to learn about you to the fullest extent!
Been treating you nicer, you say? Y-you're just imagining it! Even if I had been, it'd be solely because of you... Wait, don't tell me you LIKE it when I scold you!
Ran into trouble again? Alright, I'm on it!
You... are such a stupid idiot...
Check it out! I cleaned the office while you were gone! ...Don't you have anything to say?
You've been really proving yourself reliable lately... but don't get cocky! You should rely on me a bit more instead of trying to do everything yourself! I won't take "no" for an answer!

lines.line: Don't I look so awesome in this outfit, Commander? ...Hey, wait! I-I absolutely wasn't fishing for compliments!
Don't I look so awesome in this outfit, Commander? ...Hey, wait! I-I absolutely wasn't fishing for compliments!
You're late, Commander! I already checked out all the cool spots in the area while you were away! You just be quiet and follow me!
This outfit's pretty good, I'd say! Heh - it caught my eye the moment I saw it at the Dragon Empery's clothing store! It's grand, majestic, and makes me look like an invincible hero from a legend!
You there! Don't shove when you're standing in a queue! What are you, a little kid? I can see it all from this rooftop!
You shouldn't be afraid to talk to me just because I look really awesome!
Really, now... Do you think this staff is just a toy, huh?! Hey! That's 100% what you're thinking, isn't it?! Well then... You can have a firsthand taste of its might!
Hey, hold on! It took a ton of work to style my hair! If you mess it up, you're in for a world of pain!
Where do you wanna go and have fun? Just say it!
O-out here?! You idiot... You're getting a whooping!
Oh! You picked a good time to come back! Tonight's play is about to begin! This spot has the best view, so come up here!
It's already over? This staff's pretty easy to handle!
Admiral Nakhimov-class light cruiser - Krasny Kavkaz.

I am the cruiser Krasny Kavkaz, serving the Northern Parliament. I was supposed to be as towering and impregnable as the mightiest mountain, but you conquered me in no time, Commander... *peeks*... Wh-what am I saying? Let me start over, please!
I am the cruiser Krasny Kavkaz, serving the Northern Parliament. Thank you for welcoming me. *peeks*... Hm... You look VERY reliable.
The tempo of your footsteps, how you move when you open doors, the amount of force you use... Ah, I can feel every bit of it... Eep?! C-Commander? N-never mind...
Ah, there's no need to worry... I'm wearing a blindfold, but I can see everything through more... primal means. Including you, Commander...
Do you know about mental training? Close your eyes and focus, and it'll amplify even the tiniest sensations that you'd usually miss. Ah, it's so much fun...
Mmmph! (I-I can't talk... Commander, don't look at me like that!)
Ugh... I shouldn't have agreed to go to the debate tournament with Pamiat'. I spent the whole time stammering... So embarrassing.
Ah... You want to see the color of my eyes? Now isn't a good time to remove my blindfold, but if you insist... I'll show you next time there's an opportunity!
Eep?! Commander... When you touch me out of nowhere, I... Ah! I'm not saying I don't like it! I-in fact, it makes me so happy...!
Eep?! C-Commander... This mental training routine of yours is even more... stimulating than I dared hope. Aah...
Commander, would you please entrust your remaining work to me? Ahem. Once in a while... I'd like to experience the feeling of being crushed by a mountain of work...
The work's aaall done. It was a lot... but my training has been working out great!
Commander, I sorted out your new mail. Don't forget to check it.
Ah... Even from far away, I feel your gaze. It's like a sweet caress... *pant*... A-ahem! W-welcome back, Commander!
The commission team is back. I'll go organize the supplies they brought.
The world is clearer than ever before now!
Enemy... found!
I didn't even have to break a sweat.
I'll focus more next time...
I see you...
Ouch... Oh, Commander...
C-Commander, I have mental training to get to. Could you leave, please...?
Your warmth, your heartbeat, your emotions... All of them are so special to me. Even when you're in a crowd, I can sense you clearly, like... like a bonfire atop an icy field.
What do I fear most? Hmm... Being pranked, maybe? I scream really loud when I get scared... Yours are fine, though. In fact... I'd let you scare me more, if you wanted!
Y-you've never seen me in the midst of mental training? W-well, I prefer to do it alone... with nobody else around. B-but I guess it wouldn't be so bad to let you watch... Hehe...
*sigh*... I don't know why, but when you're around, all these strange thoughts pop into my head. I start to feel all hot... T-take responsibility and cool me down...
I have so many feelings I want to share with you, but my words can't keep up with my emotions. You take up all of my thoughts, and you've seized my heart. I want to be with you... forever...
Oooh... You know everything I like, don't you?

ex.line: Hyah?! Commander, you came at me out of nowhere... I feel my knees getting weak... Huh? N-no, I'm not saying you should get away!
Ahh... The room is bursting with your musk. I want to do mental training here forever...
Cover my ears, Commander... Yeah, just like that... I can't hear, and I can't see. All I feel is the touch of your fingers... Ah, I could get used to this...
*pant*... I can't... live without you anymore, Commander... Help me finish my training, would you? Ah...
Hmm... I'm still no good at debate. Help me practice, Commander. For example... some verbal humiliation could help train my tolerance... Hehe, that's a good idea...
Hehe... Hehehe... My hair is touching my ears... Commander, it tickles... Hehehe.
Ah, ahh... D-don't take your hands off of me. Anywhere you want, any amount of pressure you want... Do exactly as you please.
Ooh! J-just like that... You found my weakness, Commander... Very, very nice...
You finally came back to me... I told you I can tell just from your sound, didn't I? Maybe it's time... we covered my ears, too?
Staying focused and withstanding external distractions is the hardest part of mental training. Pull my collar for me... Harder, please... *pant*... Now I can start!

lines.line: It's time to begin our blind mahjong practice. This is another part of mental training, after all... Heehee.
It's time to begin our blind mahjong practice. This is another part of mental training, after all... Heehee.
This outfit is chilly, but when I think of practicing together with you, I can't help but get all hot...
I've memorized all the tiles... Oh? You have, too? Then are you ready for a game? The loser gets punished with... hmm... having to take off an article of clothing, say?
Heehee... Rubbing the bumpy tiles against my body, trying desperately to endure the chilly stimulation to tell them apart... is such wonderful training...
Oh? Wrong again... This is all I have left on, though... Hm? But my tights...? Ooh?! My legs are gradually being exposed! Oooh...
Pfft... Hahaha... N-not right there! It's too much... If you tickle me, I won't be able to tell which is which... Hahaha!
Mm... Is this my reward? Heehee...
I specifically picked out this outfit, you know... It's really form-fitting, and it's perfect for tactile training...
Ah... Aaah... There are too many pieces. I need to touch them all carefully, or I won't be able to tell which is which... Oooh...
Commander, you've kept me waiting. Remember how we agreed that the loser gets punished? I've been so excited... Ahem! I mean worried sick, waiting for you...
I finally got to play a game with you, and I lost right away... Goodness, it's just too hard. Well, Commander... Are you ready to give me my ultimate punishment? Hehe... Heehee...
Bogatyr-class protected cruiser - Bogatyr.

Welcome to my laboratory. I am Bogatyr, the robotics engineer. My robots primarily assist in research and combat, but they are also outfitted with features such as cooking, cleaning, and shopping. They're very convenient.

I'm the robotics engineer for the Northern Parliament, Bogatyr. Good morning, Commander. I'm in the middle of uploading interactive data to optimize this robot's behavioral logic. Reading data... Please wait.
Adjusting robot movement functions. Current progress 79%... New access request detected. Oh... Commander?
This is a charging station designed for my robots. It's safe, portable, provides stable power output, and supports multiple charging interfaces. Would you like a demonstration?

The solution to this problem is complicated... A data processing overload triggered a forced circuit breaker flip. Restarting... Ah. Sorry, Commander, I just lost consciousness. I'm glad you were there.
I leave housework to my housework robots. Oh, you wish you had one, too? I'd be happy to give you one.

On the way here, I ran a performance optimization on my interactions with you. I did bump into a door one time and trip and fall once, but... Ah. I'm okay. That won't affect my performance whatsoever.
Core temperature rising. Overload imminent...
Hm...? I just finished synchronizing data. What's the matter, Commander?
What kind of feedback would make the Commander happy? I need... more data...
Tasks requiring completion have been detected. Dispatching work assistance robot.
Huh? You finished your missions? When in the world...
My assistance robot brought your new mail in.
Reading new robotic runtime structure... Commander? Did you just get back? But when did you leave...?
When did the commission team leave, again...?
Energy exceeding threshold... Requesting activation of root cause analysis program.
Initiating collection of robot companion combat data.
Assessing robot companion combat effectiveness... Results: highly effective.
Robot companion damage rates exceeding expectations. Preliminary analysis suggests discrepancy between design environment and combat environment.
This will make for good combat data.
Switching to power-saving mode.
Commander, do you need help from a housework robot? You seem to be struggling.
Wrench, please... Pliers, too. And the blowtorch... You don't know where they are? I'll send you the map of my lab now.
Analysis complete. After ingesting black tea, I've seen a significant improvement in my mobility. Commander, may I have more?
*stare*... *staaare*... Hm? When I'm observing you as such, my system efficiency doubles, making my processors heat up... An error has occurred. System overheating.
Thinking about you generates so much uninterpretable data... System overload imminent. Commander, catch me...

Let me think for a moment before the ceremony. When I think about our future - the mornings, afternoons, and nights we will spend in each other's arms... I feel hope and joy. Yes... My thoughts have converged on one answer: I love you, Commander.
A present from the Commander... I love it.
Your inventions... show good taste.

ex.line: I've been waiting, Commander. My robot development is going well, so I don't need help... I just wanted to see you.
My time perception module seems to be malfunctioning. I was just trying to glance at you, but before I knew it, so much time had passed...
I've confirmed a lack of energy on your part. Where is your charging port, exactly...?
My current experiment is to see how long I can stay near you without overloading and restarting... Hm? My current experiment is to see how long I can stay near you without...
Abnormal data detected. Reason unknown. Risk of overload... Mm, mmm...
I'll record and archive all of your actions in real time.
Today's experimental data... Mmm... *pant*...
I can't help that my eyes are drawn to you... because I want to record and preserve all of our time spent together.

lines.line: System error detected. Abnormal data is being generated at a rapid pace, and energy consumption exceeds normal values. Initiating emergency diagnostic protocol. Commander... stay with me until the root cause is found, please...

System error detected. Abnormal data is being generated at a rapid pace, and energy consumption exceeds normal values. Initiating emergency diagnostic protocol. Commander... stay with me until the root cause is found, please...
Restart complete... Commander, I'll find the source of the abnormal data right away. Just stay a little longer...
When you come close, the abnormal data increases exponentially... Commander, am I going to break?
Self-checking diagnostic failed... Commander, I require a more in-depth scan. Please connect to me...
Ah... Mm... An electric current is stimulating my depth sensors... Commander, help me stand up straight...
Mobility functions offline. Commander, hold my hand... I need help.
As my energy levels decrease, my scan efficiency is... increasing?
Please do not touch my cable. I may run out of energy...
Ah, ahh... So much abnormal data is flooding in...
Scan 56% complete... Welcome back, Commander. I'll be ready soon...
Abnormal data analysis complete. It isn't a hardware malfunction or a system error. It all points to a new prime directive: I want to be with you, Commander.
Unryuu-class aircraft carrier - Unryuu.

I am Unryuu, wielder of water and the first ship of the Sakura Empire's Unryuu-class aircraft carriers. Ahem... Commander, you may gaze upon my beautiful form and etch it into your memory forevermore.

Your reputation precedes you, Commander. I am Unryuu... Heehee, stunned, are we? Such a grand performance perfectly suits me. Take this bell as a token of our friendship, Commander. I hope you won't disappoint me.
If you need my aid, just touch the bell I gave you before. Oh, but it wouldn't hurt if you also said, "Please, Big Sister, I need your help!"

You'd like to see my liquid form? Heehee, not yet. But if you're so desperate, then I expect you to at least prepare hundreds of cherry blossom trees to line my path - Ah! You're not seriously going to do it, are you? Hey! Get back here!
I recently bought a bunch of antiques. They were expensive, but I thought they suited my status well. Come to my place, and you can get a good look at them.
None of the goods around here are of high quality or notable origin. I'd rather not keep them... Huh? They're expensive? Then they must have some other value...
Th-thunder?! You must be awfully scared, Commander. Big Sister will stay right here to protect you. Hold on tightly... Actually, let me be the one to hold you!
You don't think it's impolite at all to do this to me? Hmm... But it does feel nice, so I'll let it go just this once.
Oh? Best be careful, now. Touch me carelessly, and your sleeves might just get wet.
Huh? H-hold it... The flowing waters won't forget this, you know.
You still have more work to do? Remember, if you need my help, you must first say, "Please, Big Sister, I need your help!" Ah yes, very good!
What? You finished your missions already?! S-so you managed it without my help, after all...
Ah, new mail? See if there are any bills addressed to me, please. I've been splurging a little bit lately...
Commander, did you remember to buy me the most expensive dessert? You won't get past me with a half-hearted answer.
Come, it's time to greet the commission team.... But first, would you help me straighten out my clothes?
Phew... The flowing waters permeate my whole being.
Let us be as a great wave!
Over already? I haven't even used my full power yet.
We LOST? So my mastery of water is too gentle yet...
Don't fight the current!
Tch, what insolence! You'll pay a high price for this!
The bell sounds oddly dull... Did I entrust it to the wrong person, after all?
If you run into a problem, try to figure it out yourself first. If you really can't solve it on your own, come to me. I like solving worthwhile problems... Ahem. Emphasis on "worthwhile."
The flavor is a little too strong for me... What's that? It's a limited-edition dish?! Th-then I suppose I could try more... *munch, munch*... It's not bad... Let me have another bite.
Aww, did you miss me already? O-oh, you just touched the bell by accident? Well, I'm here now, so I'll stay a little longer. You'd best be grateful!
How did you feel about today's tea, soup, and bath water, Commander? Don't look so puzzled - I'm just asking because I prepared all of it for you... personally.

You'd like to keep this symbol of our bond forever? How greedy of you. But I am your dear Big Sister Unryuu, after all. Now... I promise that I will always be by your side, until all the water in the world runs dry...
Oh, goodness! Ahem... I graciously accept. Your taste isn't so bad, Commander.

ex.line: Oh, you're here. Hehe, I could hear the bell jingling from afar. I trust you're ready to spend a wonderful day with me?
Would you like to know how it feels to snuggle up with water? Heehee, then give your big sister a big hug!

Why am I not wearing that limited-edition dress we bought yesterday? Aww, Commander, you still don't understand. Expensive clothes need careful maintenance, and sometimes, the best maintenance means not wearing them at all!
If you're tired from work, come to me, and I'll wash your stress away with a relaxing current. Nobody gets this service but you, Commander.

Hehe, I splurged on a set of nice lacquerware. They're all works of art, so their value is sure to go up - not that I'm trying to profit off of them. If they DO go up in value, then... Huh?! They're already being mass-produced?!
Mm... Touch as much as you like. But if you mess up my hair, you're the one who has to fix it for me.
Commander, your hands are all dry. Shall I moisturize them for you?
Hey, Commander... Do you hear the sound of water flowing?
You're back. Come and try these snacks I prepared. These aren't easy to come by, no matter how rich you are. Savor them, and thank me from the depths of your heart.
This bell has fulfilled its purpose, so you don't need to ring it anymore. From now on, even without this simple token, I'll come to you whenever your heart aches for me.

lines.line: This mission is a piece of cake. There's no obstacle that water can't penetrate, nor any wall that it can't permeate. Watch as I break through your so-called impenetrable defenses!
This mission is a piece of cake. There's no obstacle that water can't penetrate, nor any wall that it can't permeate. Watch as I break through your so-called impenetrable defenses!
The mission begins. Commander, shall we play a little game first? Heehee... Try to find me before I blend into the night...
Heehee. Just this once, I'll forgive you for looking down on me. Now let go of my hand, please.
Am I cold? Not especially. I'm trying to accomplish great things, so I hardly have time to be bothered by... Achoo! I-I said I'm not cold!

Before we do our missions, let's enjoy a fancy dinner, buy some accessories... What does that have to do with missions? Why, everything, of course! How could I complete a mission when I'm not in the right mood?
Yeees? Would you like to go on a little mission together?
Were you just begging for attention? Would you be that lonely if I departed for my mission? Heehee.
Would you like to try... sinking a little deeper?
Did you bring a mission back for your poor big sister? Hehe, tell me more.
Hmm? Do I spy anxiety in those eyes? Hehe, I guess you need to experience my full power before we go... Prepare to be conquered by the power of water, Commander.
This mission is a piece of cake. There's no obstacle that water can't penetrate, nor any wall that it can't permeate. Watch as I break through your so-called impenetrable defenses!
This mission is a piece of cake. There's no obstacle that water can't penetrate, nor any wall that it can't permeate. Watch as I break through your so-called impenetrable defenses!
The mission begins. Commander, shall we play a little game first? Heehee... Try to find me before I blend into the night...
Heehee. Just this once, I'll forgive you for looking down on me. Now let go of my hand, please.
Am I cold? Not especially. I'm trying to accomplish great things, so I hardly have time to be bothered by... Achoo! I-I said I'm not cold!
