Yeees? Would you like to go on a little mission together?
Were you just begging for attention? Would you be that lonely if I departed for my mission? Heehee.
Would you like to try... sinking a little deeper?
Did you bring a mission back for your poor big sister? Hehe, tell me more.
Hmm? Do I spy anxiety in those eyes? Hehe, I guess you need to experience my full power before we go... Prepare to be conquered by the power of water, Commander.
Sendai-class light cruiser - Kizu.
I am Kizu - an agent of the Divine Laws dispatched from heaven. Hm? What laws, specifically, you ask? Hrmh... The Law of Thunder, the Rule of Weather, and, um... Look, it doesn't matter!

Kizu is my name, and destiny's hand led me hither to find my fated one... which is you! Heheheh - now bid me welcome with tears of gratitude! ...Why are you silent? Y-you know what - forget I said anything...
Secretary, you say? Hah, in other words, I am to serve you? If so fate dictates, I shall obey and minister to you.

Perceiving the will of nature, wielding the might of thunder, grasping the causality of all things - that is my power. What you need in this moment is... What? To know what the weather will be like in an hour? That's really all you need?
Such simple work scarcely demands much toil. O fated one, you do know how to implore me for aid, don't you?
O fated one, behold the lightning that runs at my fingertips. This is a manifestation of nature, a- Eek! It shocked me! Urgh... How could this be...
The wind rises from the tip of a blade of grass, a downpour cascading from the sky over yonder... This means rain will come ere long. Be prepared, fated one.
Eek! How dare you touch my sacred horns... Mmgh!
You... You miscreant! Urgh...
Eek! N-no... You can't... Mmph...
(Hrmh... My fated one has forgotten about these missions... Should I speak up? Will I be seen as meddlesome if I do?)
O fated one, the "cause" of your missions has borne an "effect"... No, I'm merely informing you that it's time to check on your tasks.
O fated one, I have sorted your letters. It was only a small favor, thus you need not thank me.
O fated one, the currents whispered to me the time of your return! ...Yes, yes, I admit it! I had but a brief glance at your schedule!
The commission team is back. As my sea maps guided them, their holds must be brimming with treasure!
My power has at last been made fully manifest... Y-you're not frightened by me, are you?
Follow me! I shall pave the way for you!
Our greatest weapon is our maps of the sea!
This is but a part of my self-cultivation as a messenger of heaven...
Kneel before my thunder!
My lightning... is out of control!
I clearly misjudged you...
Do you see the thunder over yonder? When the heavens brandish their might, the mortal world quakes in fear... Now, now, you needn't be afeard. I am your fortress.
Commander! You didn't get shocked, did you?! I... I merely wished to channel the lightning to aid you, only for it to backfire... Grrgh...
Heheheh... O fated one, my eyes behold the Thread of Causality that links us. Clearer is it than the trajectory of the stars, and as inescapable as thunder.
Always have I kept these paired magatama with me, and solely to you do I entrust them, my fated one... Just take them! Who else could it be but you? And don't you dare lose them!
O fated one, let us swear an eternal vow with the heavens as our witnesses. Every daybreak and every dusk, each moment until all life breathes its last, I shall forever be with you.
A gift just for me? Heheh. How thoughtful of you!

ex.line: O fated one, long have I waited so that I could first show myself to none other than you! ...M-my waiting certainly wasn't intentional, mind you!
Hrmm... I must sense what is on your mind and predict what you shall do, fated one... What you wish for right now... is to lie down with me!
(My fated one is updating the sea chart data... This is something I can assist with. I'd better speak up!)
O fated one, let us finish this paperwork and then share a meal, go out on a stroll, then return home... and be together forever! Heehee...
I can do more beyond predicting the weather. Behold! *bzzzt*... There! That raised the power of these electronics!
Mgh... Mmh... It has dawned on me that I've become accustomed to your touch...
You enjoy this intimate contact, fated one? (Then I'd better... leap into your arms and let you hold me!)
Whuh?! Y-you're doing this again... At least let me know before you start...
O fated one, I take it your journey hither was a calm one? This messenger from the heavens personally beheld it!
O fated one, I have turned my two magatama into necklaces. Now, let us place them upon one another... Hereafter, even should we be worlds apart, the bond between us shall not be severed.

lines.line: Wh-what are these lasers? My equipment, it's all... Urgh! How am I meant to continue my mission with my suit and gear all melted away?!
Wh-what are these lasers? My equipment, it's all... Urgh! How am I meant to continue my mission with my suit and gear all melted away?!
Who are you?! Might you be... the lord of this mansion? So you heard the alarm and came hither... F-forget about how I look, will you?! Urgh!
I-I know what you want! Information! But I won't give it to you! Not ever!
(I cannot believe they're employing defenses as craven as these lasers! A play though this may be, that doesn't mean... Wait, where did they even find lasers that only dissolve clothes?!)
That noise... The lasers must be charging! Heavens above... N-no! I can't afford to be hit by another!
What?! Fine, use what you will - it still won't make me budge!
Wh-what is that you're holding? A laser pointer? ...W-wait, don't point it at me! Mrgh!
Eep! Wait... Not right now... I can't... Mrgh!
Did... Did you come to laugh at me, fated one?! ...Ah, I misspoke! One more time!
Having won in this attire... brings me no joy whatsoever!
Sendai-class light cruiser - Nayoro.
I'm Nayoro, she who can summon lightning even on sunny days. Hmm? Commander, I noticed you're staring at my tail... Wanna touch it? I'll try my best not to shock you.
Are you the Commander here? You look like you're easily taken advantage of... Don't worry, though. I'll "dispose" of anything or anyone who'd cause you trouble.
Commander, would you like to touch my tail? I just finished grooming it... Hmm? It feels like it's crackling with electricity? Aw, am I leaking again?
Oh, my tail's leaking electricity again. It's your fault this time - your arrival got me a little excited, that's all... Heehee.
When you space out, you look like such defenseless prey. If I lock this door now... Heehee!
You have so many strange rules you have to follow... As far as I'm concerned, the only rule that should matter is, "What the Commander says, goes." Don't you think so?
I just discovered that I can get all kinds of odd reactions from you just by talking. It's so much fun!
Aww... Are you treating me like your pet? Heehee!
I'm ready to start fighting back, you know.
I'll pay you back double for that one!
You still have unfinished missions. I'll help you get them done lickety-split.
Mission accomplished! How do you plan to reward my efforts, hmm?
You have mail. Want me to dispose of the boring and troublesome ones for you?
Good work today. Wanna rest your head in my lap for a bit?
The commission team brought resources home. Hehe... That smile tells me you're quite satisfied with them.
I feel better than ever!
Let's mop them up all at once.
Easy win! All thanks to you, Commander.
We'd better retreat... Let's run, Commander!
Playtime is over. Get ready...
I might've played around too much... Teehee!
Commander, playing with you has gotten... boring.
May I sit next to you? Don't say no just yet... There. My tail is wrapped around both of us now... Oh? Did I shock you again?
Aww, are you going to stay with me for real this time? Great. Then I'll go ahead and clear my plans for the rest of the day!
You've already made me lose interest in everything but you. Keep being interesting for me, okay, Commander? Otherwise... I might have to punish you.
When I'm with you, I feel joy that I've never experienced before. Don't worry, Commander... I'll hold on tight and never let go again.
So the time has finally come. My heart is already yours, but in return... I'll be taking your heart, too. Through my own methods, of course!
Hmm? Thank you! I'd love to have it.

ex.line: I was just thinking about you too, Commander. Hehe, our hearts must be linked... On that note, would you like to touch my tail? It's in top form today!
Heehee... I haven't been able to stop myself from staring at you. You turned to look because you sensed how I feel, right? Aww... I love this cute side of you.
Whenever you stretch, I'm reminded of a cat basking in the sunlight. It makes me want to scratch your chin... Hmm? You won't purr for me?
It's so nice to have you all to myself... Aw, are you still nervous about the electricity on my tail? But I thought your agonized struggling was your way of asking for attention.
Mm... I have to be thorough when it comes to tail maintenance. It's your favorite thing, after all, so I want it to feel good all the time.
Go on, touch me more.
What's wrong? Do you want another hug? Okay! Get over here, you.
You don't need an excuse to do this anymore, you know. After all... I want more, too~
Welcome back. Need me to help you "recharge" a little? Heehee.
We won! Since I worked so hard, why not reward me with some play time, Commander?
You just glanced at me, didn't you? I can tell when you're in need of some love. Heehee, come here and give me a hug!

lines.line: Our rendezvous went smoothly enough... but it looks like we're being tailed by some unsavory folk. Shall we go take care of them? Don't worry - it'll be over in no time.
Our rendezvous went smoothly enough... but it looks like we're being tailed by some unsavory folk. Shall we go take care of them? Don't worry - it'll be over in no time.
Heehee, I was worried that you'd gotten wrapped up in some trouble, but you made it on time after all. Any longer, and I would've come rushing to your aid!
I prepared this weapon just for today... Why are you staring? Are you hoping I'll use it on you? Heehee, of course I will.
Let me stay with you and protect you, Commander. If you have anything else in mind, well... Zap!
I'll control my electricity during battle so I just put our enemies to sleep. How long they sleep, well... That depends on them!
My stun gun needs regular maintenance to stay in tip-top shape. Just like my tail, it's perfect for "convincing" you to stay with me forever~
You caught me by surprise, Commander... Heehee.
Are you worried about me? Don't be. I'll take care of the enemy in no time.
Do you like improvising like this, Commander? Heehee, guess I'd better play along.
You have missions to do. Let's take care of that trouble together!
Missions complete. We might be the perfect combination!
You look a little tired... It's okay. Leave the rest of that trouble to me.
Zzzap... Heehee, did that startle you?
No matter when it is, no matter where we are, I always feel furtive eyes glancing at you... I suppose the only way to keep you safe is to keep you in arm's reach at all times, huh? Heehee!
Yamato-class battleship number two - Musashi.
I am the Yamato-class battleship, Musashi! Fear not. I shall look after you, whether during work or play.

I am Musashi! Am I correct in thinking you are the Commander? Hmm... I fear I shall have to keep a close eye on you. From now on, I shall defend the peace of this port. As for you... you may simply hide behind me.
Zzz... Uguh?! Oh, it is you! Ahem. The port is perfectly safe, thanks to my presence.
Commander, have you any new commands for me? I-if you wanted to play, you could always say so...
Before going out to battle, you must decide which snacks you will eat upon your return to rouse your motivation! That is what it means to win a battle before it is fought!
Yes, another flawless patrol! The slides and swings are as safe as could be! Would you like to see for yourself, Commander?
Everybody in the port is giving their utmost. Commander, let us work just as hard and become examples for all to aspire to!
Mmmrgh... What an affront to my dignity! Th-this won't be happening again...
You wish to play with me? I-I suppose I can spare a little time.
S-such insolence... Hyah!
A new mission has appeared, Commander. Let us break through with a single push!
Did you see that? My presence makes any mission easy as pie!
New mail? Hmm... It might be related to the port's resource allocation and long-term plans... I think you should prioritize this one.

I completed a thorough patrol of the port during your absence, and discovered a place perfect for "strategic maintenance." I-it's not a playroom! Regardless, perhaps you would assist in my inspection if you are not otherwise engaged?
The commission team has returned! Naturally, it was my support from the rear that allowed everything to proceed so smoothly.
I can protect you all the better now!
Follow my lead, everybody!
With my fortune and martial prowess, victory is but a foregone conclusion!
Impossible!
Bear witness to my power!
Urgh... I must... stay strong for everyone else!
I... really do not want to talk to you right now.
I must act as your guardian, Commander! You must stay close behind me so you do not get lost!
I-if I may be frank, I enjoy myself the most in your presence... But do not let anyone else hear that!
I am incredibly powerful! But what if... IF a devilishly cunning enemy appeared, and I failed to protect everybody despite my best efforts... Would you think less of me, Commander?
It is my duty to protect everybody. However... if I could do more than protect you... if I could embrace and tend to your every need... perhaps I would be more motivated.

Wh-what is the purpose of this stuffy ceremony?! Hrmh... Starting today, I shall make you my most important retainer and... Ahem! What I mean to say is that you are the best that there is! You will stay by my side for all eternity and listen to my every order! Promise me that!
You have brought me a reward? I suppose I can accept it!

ex.line: Ah! You have shown yourself at last! I have crafted the schedule for today and left enough time for us to play together. So... make sure you do exactly as I tell you for the entire day!
I want you to hold my hand if you ever find yourself feeling uncertain. It will ease your fear.
Commander, you must try this taiyaki. I saved it just for you. It is vital that a leader maintains their vigor.
Once I have grown and become someone worthy of my name, I shall surely go on to defend even vaster seas. It is my wish that you will remain by my side, even then!
Y-you really are a handful. You will spend more time with me to make up for this, won't you?
If you are tired, Commander, you may rest your head on my lap.
Hrmh... If you wish to spend time with me, you only need say so...
Welcome back. I have prepared some refreshments to show my appreciation for your efforts. P-perhaps you would like to share them with me?

I have recently been reflecting upon the true nature of "resolve." Ahem... My resolve to defend is not about self-sacrifice. Rather, it lies in my conviction to return home by any means. For the cherry blossoms in full bloom, for the delectable taiyaki... and for the person waiting for me.

lines.line: H39-class battleship - Götz von Berlichingen.

You'd like to know my secrets, would you? Hehehe, then let me warn you: you must never let Götz von Berlichingen touch alcohol. Rumor has it that, when she gets tipsy, she can become one haughty woman... Goodness, what a handful she must be.
Guten Tag, Commander. I am Götz von Berlichingen. Sooner would I offer you a rose than my blade, and sooner would I dance with you under the moonlight than amidst the smoke of battle.
Greetings, Commander. Oh, are you taken by the sight of my wings furling? Hehehe, well... I wouldn't mind if you took a closer look.
Do you like poetry, Commander? Hehe, such beautiful rhyme and meter can effortlessly bewilder and entice prey into your clutches.
Your collar's a bit crooked. Heehee, people will look down on you if you aren't properly groomed. Especially given your position...
I've prepared some refreshments for this evening's banquet. It's only ripe tomato juice, but listen, Commander... Appearances can be deceiving.
My Iron Blood colleagues are unaccustomed to showing passion in front of others. In my opinion, though, their devotion is quite endearing. Heehee!
The sight of you so earnestly devoted to your work at all hours of the day... only makes me want to drag different emotions out of you.
Such unexpected intimacy... Have I spoiled you, Commander? Heehee.
Oh, my. The blood in your neck is coursing faster... Are you enjoying our duet?
Commander, treating a noble lady so roughly is far from a wise move.
Commander, you must understand that unfinished work is like ladies at a ball, waiting for you to invite them to dance. One mustn't keep them waiting.
The missions are complete. Shall we raise a glass in celebration?
Shall I screen your mail for you? Just understand that if I see anything "suggestive" in there, I might end up hiding it♪
Thank you for allowing me to sit in on such a masterful hunt. Leave the cleanup work to me while you rest.
The commission team has returned. I've made the logistical arrangements, so all that's left is for you to welcome our weary friends.
Your favor is noticed and appreciated. I promise to repay you.
Let's see which one of us has the more impeccable etiquette.
This concludes the day's etiquette lesson.
Hehe, they only think they've won. Commander, let's make our move!
Every rose has its thorns.
It's time for my counterattack!
Goodness. What a disappointing blunder, Commander.

The discipline of the Iron Blood, elegance of the Royal Navy, and vitality of the Eagle Union... Being able to bring together such diverse individuals and make them dance on the same floor is a testament to your innate charisma, Commander.
You look quite relaxed, Commander. Does this mean we can finally dispense with all these tedious pleasantries?
Commander, why do you think roses have thorns? It isn't just to protect their delicate petals... but to allow only the worthy to possess them.
Veiling my intentions in poetry, concealing my sharpness with etiquette, dancing in the night in search of just a drop of passion... Do you consider me dangerous, Commander?

Dear silly Commander of mine, you ought to know by now that I'M the one who pursues. If you'll offer your blood unto me and let me trace it all the way back to your beating heart... then I promise that I will plunge alongside you into this eternal dream♥
Thank you for the gift. Next time we dance, I might just have a surprise for you.
I'll lure them close while you strike them down... It's a pleasure to work with you!
Well, well. Aren't you cute?

ex.line: Another day, another mountain of paperwork... This one looks like it'll take some time. Say, why don't we work in my room? It might make you more productive♪
I'll be honest, my invitation to dinner was but a ploy. How else could I have a moment of your time all to myself?
I only drank tomato juice, but my head is spinning... Commander, come and steady me. Heehee... That's an order!
I can use my wings for some interesting purposes. For example... I could make a space just for us that nobody can disturb...
Those verses just now were slightly improvised, you know. Heehee, I replaced the lovers in it with you and me.
I drank too much again... Listen up, Commander. You are mine! If you get in trouble with anyone, you come to me! I'll... use my cannons to knock their ass into the stratosphere!
Touch me more, please. I'm already addicted to your warmth...
Oh? Was that intended as an ambush? In that case... you've earned yourself a fierce counterattack.
Heehee, if I hide us with my wings... nobody else will see what we're doing, dear Commander♥
Welcome back, dear Commander. I'm feeling a bit peckish... I don't mean literal hunger, of course. How do you intend to sate me, I wonder?
Your love may be the most entertaining struggle I've ever experienced. Will I succumb to your tenderness in the end, or will you fall into my hands? The fun is only just beginning♡

lines.line: Oh? You've finally noticed my presence, human? I've been waiting within arm's reach for a long while now.
Oh? You've finally noticed my presence, human? I've been waiting within arm's reach for a long while now.
If it isn't you, Commander♪ Shall we begin our wonderful dream together?
An upside-down succubus for an upside-down world... One where we can cast aside morality, accept this sweet curse, and indulge in our mutual desire forever...
The blood moon's ode to depravity... Hehe, such a wonderful illusion. I don't know if I can hold myself back for much longer♡
Beloved Commander, you have to hold on just a little longer. Soon... Soon, I will be right by your side♥
Perhaps only in the moment when our fingers touch can we truly discern what is reality and what is a reflection of our yearning hearts... Come closer, that we may find out♥
Are you worried that I'll fall? Heehee, don't be. I have wings to fly with - and a tail to coil tightly around you, as well.
How will you entertain this hungry succubus, Commander?
Heehee... I'll have my fill of you before long, my beloved♥
Do you like the dream I made just for you, Commander? Heehee, then let's continue...
When the blood moon sets and dawn breaks, you may notice a mark on your neck. It will continue to ache, never fading... Heehee, that's my lifelong memento for you.
XXI-class submarine - U-2501.
I'm known as U-2501, Iron Blood's blade of the deep... I was born to bring new tactics to life. Let me dedicate all that I am... to you.
Commander... I'm U-2501. I'm recording the audio of our first meeting... to be an important part of my collection. Here's a note for you... [I'm really happy to meet you, Commander! >w<]
I'm happy... to see you again. Oh. Here's a note... [Can I record the sound of you breathing, please? >w<]
My audio library has all of the sounds I've collected... and some of my own. You can listen any time you want... [I recorded them just for you~ o(*//▿//*)q]
Commander, I heard you yawn just now... Did you not sleep well last night? If so, umm... [Can I sleep with you? o(*//▿//*)q]
Commander, what sounds will you make for me today...? [>w<]
Do you like this melody? Then stay here... and listen to my song.
Am I recording? Yeah, I am... I got the sound of you breathing... [(o°▿°)o]
Mm... More... Mooore... [o(*//▿//*)q]
Mmm... My heart is pounding... [o(*//▿//*)q]
Nnh... It's going to capture my voice, too... [Recording permissions not unlocked yet! o(*//▿//*)q]
Mm... Missions... [Hurry! ☆(>o<)]
Rewards... What do you want, Commander? [A day with me, maybe?! >w<]
I canceled out all that extra noise, Commander... [Time to check your mail! >w<]
Good work today, Commander... I recorded something while I was waiting. [The sound of the waves! >w<]
The sound of the homecoming horn... Should I go with you to record your reunion?
My audio library grows... [>w<]
Silence spreads...
Do you... like the sounds of victory?
Bawww... [っ ̯ -。]
Noise... canceled!
Oww... I got hurt...
U-umm... I prefer to be alone... [<(_ _)>]
Commander... Talk more, please? [Voice capture progress: 25%! >w<]
Sometimes... I hear whale song... It's such a rare thing, but none of it compares to your voice, Commander... I must record more... [o(*//▿//*)q]
Commander, this track is corrupted... Twenty-four seconds of it are blank now. When I can't hear your voice, time feels ever so slow... [っ ̯ -。]
Listen... Your greetings, idle chatter, commands, and even your heartbeat and breathing... All of my world is filled entirely with you... [o(*//▿//*)q]
Yes... [I do!] From now on, even the shared silence between us... will be all mine. Nobody can ever erase it... It'll be safe forever.
Thank you... [I looove it! >w<]

ex.line: I wanna hear you greet me, Commander... [o(*//▿//*)q]
Hum hum♪... Are you enchanted by my voice, Commander? [>w<]
The sound of the rain drowns out noise, so we can do whatever we want... [o(*//▿//*)q]
Hush. I'm the only other person here... Can you hear it? Our heartbeats are united...
Mm, you can be rougher... Squeeze and hold on tight... [Now it's perfect! >w<]
Commander... May I lose myself in your voice? [o(*//▿//*)q]
Your heart is beating really fast... Do you like me? [I love you, too! o(*//▿//*)q]
Mm... You can keep going... [I love it! o(*//▿//*)q]
Mm... Hngh... D-don't record this...
Commander, it's time to get to work... [>w<]
Mm... Wanna check your rewards for yourself?
Commander, I missed you... My recording will prove it... [Oh, I'm too embarrassed! o(*//▿//*)q]
Say it again... Tell me I did a good job again... [>w<]
I was so used to silence, the depths, and solitude... until I heard your voice. It's given me something incredible, like I've never had before... [o(*//▿//*)q]

lines.line: Commander, I'm changing clothes... You don't have to look away. Open up the curtain of water, and I'm right here... [o(*//▿//*)q]
Commander, I'm changing clothes... You don't have to look away. Open up the curtain of water, and I'm right here... [o(*//▿//*)q]
Hum hum♪... Hmm? Commander... Would you like to listen to the water with me?
Hush. The sound of the water... and your stifled breathing... I've got it now.
Commander... Treasures don't normally surface on their own, but this time, I'll make an exception for you... [o(*//▿//*)q]
The water is chilly, but your hands are warm... Hold me. [Hold me suuuper tight! >w<]
Commander, are you more focused on the water curtain... or the sound of my heart? [o(*//▿//*)q]
Since you're here... I won't have to worry about my hair getting caught while I change clothes... [>w<]
Did I not put this on right...? [☆(>o<)]
Mmm... Your hand reached me... Phew...
I-it's time... We'd better get to business soon... [o(*//▿//*)q]
You can claim your rewards... however you like, Commander... [o(*//▿//*)q]
I hear the sounds of the sea, sun, and wind coming from you... Come closer and let me help you get changed... [☆(>o<)]

This curtain of water may blur the scenery... but it makes sounds even clearer for me... Close your eyes, open your ears. Listen to the sound of the water parting... and my heart beating just for you... [o(*//▿//*)q]
P-class armored ship - Prinz Moritz.

I'm Prinz Moritz. P-class armored cruiser, Iron Blood. I guess that makes me an upper-class demon? It doesn't matter if you know who I am. I much prefer researching and writing spooky stories over engaging with high society. Heeehehehe!

I'm Prinz Moritz, lover of ghost stories and a P-class armored ship under the Iron Blood banner. Oh, and I have another title... the Nurse of Nighttime Spooks! Ready for a full physical, Commander? Heeehehehe!
Roooar! Hahaha! Did that scare you? You'd better toughen up those nerves, Commander. How about I help you... through desensitization? Heeehehehe!
If you were in a hospital ghost story, who would you be happiest to see show up? Girls like me, of course! Right?! Hahaha! I knew you and I thought alike!
Commander, have you heard the tale of the head nurse without a shadow who floats in the night? Bristol and the others run away every time they see a white nurse uniform now. Heeehehehe!
What kind of story could scare you, I wonder... Let's find out right now!
An elegant upper-class demon... Hmm, I think a head nurse with a scary laugh is way better. Z9 gave me that descriptor personally! Hahaha!
Hmm?! Commander... Are you trying out that old urban legend about how getting headpats makes you stop growing?
These are just the necessary props to play my role. What role, you ask? The spooky nurse, of course.
Huh?! Aaah! I-is this... Wait, do you feel that way about me? Whaaat?!
Commander, missions just came in. Heeehehehe!! Let's go see if they're scary!
Mission accomplished! Hm... Are there any ghost stories about finishing missions?
New mail?! It's not from the spooky never-ending medical record cabinet, is it? Even head nurses need their rest!
Are you injured? I can wrap up your wounds just like a beautiful gift... Hm? Do I actually know how to treat wounds? Oh, I have some secondhand knowledge.
Commander, the commission team returned. I wanted to ask them about that paranormal commission, so do you want to come with?
Ooh... Now I can write scarier stories!
It's time for your physical!
Heeehehehe, how disappointing! I can hardly feel anything from you!
No! I'm not done yet!
Heeehehehe... Hahahaha!
Heheheh... I'll survive this, even if you don't!
*siiigh*... I'm tired of your stories, Commander. They aren't scary at all.
Heeehehehe! It's Nurse Moritz, making her midnight rounds! I'll keep you nice and safe, Commander~
An infinite hallway in front of the infirmary, making it so you can never leave? Commander, is it real?! Where is it? I gotta see it right now!

Aah, hahaha... I dreamed of that dark, scary infirmary... Yeah, the one you were telling me about! I could feel everything, even the fear and suffocating feelings you described... I love it... Heeehehehe!
Hmm... Why does my heart race whenever you're near? Could it be... that I'm in a trance from a real-life ghost story?!
I see... So this is the oath of love. I totally get it! Hahaha! Commander! Let's create a world of scary stories, full of chills, thrills, and love! Heeehehehe!
Ooh! How did you know I needed one of these? Now I can research even more urban legends!

ex.line: The Nurse of Nighttime Spooks' special treatment only works at night, you know. I'll put you right to sleep and lull you into my realm of ghostly dreams♪
Heeehehehe... I added a recurring character based on YOU to my new ghost story collection! I haven't planned the details yet, but I'll have you help me out, Commander!
I had a great idea! If I take all the daily antics and mishaps that happen at port and put them in my own original world, I could make amazing new ghost stories!
Heeehehehe! Welcome to my supernatural artifact museum. Which would you like to try today, Commander?
C-Commander?! I really did stop growing! What are you going to do about this? *sniffle*... Oh♡ Did I scare you? Heeehehehe, you know that stuff isn't real!
Could it be... that you want a meek and obedient head nurse, Commander?
Commander... Shouldn't it be time for the head nurse to be giving YOU a proper examination? Heeehehehe♡
Commander, I've mastered all sorts of nursing know-how! I know how to stop bleeding, apply bandages, and more... Will you let me test my knowledge on you now? Heeehehehe!

In my head, the Nurse of Nighttime Spooks is as cold as a scalpel and dangerously unhinged! But lately, my character seems to have... more emotion to her. Could it be that you're the cause? Heeehehehe!

lines.line: Are you the one who summoned me? I'm the genie of the lamp, and I thank you for freeing me. As a reward... let's play a game together.
Are you the one who summoned me? I'm the genie of the lamp, and I thank you for freeing me. As a reward... let's play a game together.
Since time immemorial, I've granted countless wishes... So this time, you'll be the one to grant mine! Fun, right? Heeehehehe!
Prinz Moritz? No, no - that was my last incarnation's name. My true name is... irrelevant! Call me Miss Genie.
Commander, I wish you'd stop staring at the night sky! Oh... Wait, that didn't count.
Want a hint? Well, too bad! I could consider it if you came over and entertained me, though. Heeehehehe!
That story you told me was pretty good. I suppose I could count that as a wish granted... Heeehehehe! Nobody said I only had one wish, though~
Heheh, there you go... Now you're getting the hang of it!
The secret to getting your wishes granted is to please me! Heeehehehe!
Huh?! H-h-how did you know what my wish was?!
Welcome back. Ready to grant my wishes yet? Huh? I still haven't told you them? Heeehehehe! But wishes never come true if you speak them aloud, remember? Use that brain of yours!
Heeehehehe! I'd best begin preparing for my ultimate wish~ Commander, have you thought of a way to satisfy me? A fun ghost story, or getting nice and close, or perhaps even... Mwah!
Type 1934A destroyer - Z14.

G-good morning, Commander... I'm Z14, a Type 1934A-class destroyer under the Iron Blood... I'm good at things like rapidly memorizing information and decoding ciphers, but... I'm not super great at physical activities.
C-Commander... I'm Z14, an Iron Blood destroyer... *rumble* Oh! Th-this here is Little Ihn... She can't speak, but she's really smart...
Hyah?! *rumble*... C-Commander, how long have you been here... C-close your mouth, Little Ihn! No growling at the Commander!
Every night, I think of all kinds of things... I start to dwell on things, and I overanalyze, and I can't fall asleep... Before I know it, it's morning already.
Someone asked me directions earlier, but I overthought it so much that I couldn't give them a good answer... Little Ihn had to show them the way. If only I could give her a speech module...
A riddle contest? Oh... Yeah, I did win one of those recently. All I did was write down my logical analysis and conclusions for each scenario based on the possibilities...
C-Commander... May I join the physical training today? Um... If I push myself to my limit, it's really easy to fall asleep...
Aah?! Commander... Mm, that feels nice... Very relaxing... Zzzz.
Y-you wanna try petting Little Ihn? I think she's taken a liking to you...
Eep?! Wh-what's going on? A-are you doing something weird to me?!
C-Commander, you still have missions to do... Umm, if we combine the two of these, I think our efficiency would go way up...
W-we finished all of those missions... We didn't miss any, right? There aren't any hidden objectives, or...?
C-Commander, you have new mail... Oh, wait. First, I'd better make sure there's nothing wrong with it...
(The Commander just yawned... Are you working overtime again? Did I make trouble by not doing enough on my own?! Ah... I-I can't bring myself to ask...)
Commander... I think the commission team is back... Huh? We're going to see them? As in, I have to go, too?!
Is it just me, or is my brain working better, too...?
E-everyone... Fight according to the plan, please...
The enemy's plan was easy to read... Almost too easy. Wait, is this a trap?!
*sob*... Commander... L-Little Ihn is still screaming...
Little Iiihn!
Urk... I-I don't know if I can take much more...
Eep?! C-Commander...
Hyah?! S-sorry, I didn't mean to do that... I-I slept so poorly last night, and... Huh? I can sleep in your office? Like... now?
(The Commander is always so nice to me, accepting me despite all my flaws... How am I ever supposed to repay that kindness?)
When I'm with you, I feel more relaxed than ever... It's a strange, but special feeling. I want to be even closer...
I can sleep next to you whenever I'm tired? Wait... You'll even hold me?! I-in that case... could you hold me right now? Hyah! C-Commander... I love you... Zzzz...

A-am I dreaming right now? Would someone like you... really fall for someone like me? B-but I've always secretly hoped that this would happen. Ooh... I'm so happy that I... I don't even know what I'm saying anymore... *sob*
Huh? F-for me...? Thank you, Commander...
D-don't be afraid... I won't leave you behind!
C-can you teach me to be an extrovert?

ex.line: Whoa whoa whoa?! L-Little Ihn, let the Commander go... H-hey, I wanna hug the Commander, too... I'm not letting go!
Commander! From now on... may I sleep in your office?! Huh? You'll come to my room and stay with me until I fall asleep...? B-but if you do that, I'll start thinking of other stuff...
I-I know you SAY I can nap in your office, but if you work overtime, then I should stay up with you!

Commander, have you heard of "quantum speed reading"? They say it helps you absorb books faster... O-of course I know it's fake, but what if you managed to master something like that? Would you... not need me anymore?
You look really sleepy... Since you usually let me sleep in your arms, I'll do my best to hold you in mine this time... C-come here!
Mm... Hehehe... Keep doing that, Commander... I-I need you to pet me for at LEAST ten minutes!
Hehehe... Th-that tickles... Huh? This is smiling practice? And you're gonna go even harder now? No, wait... Aaaah!
S-so this is what lovers do... Okay... Let's do it...
Y-you got more mail... Commander, I should check it first from now on. Then, if there's a bomb inside... you won't get hurt...
Commander, welcome back! Mmm... I feel so safe with you... N-next time you sortie, take me with you!
Little Ihn, can you sneak this into the Commander's... Hyah?! C-Commander, when did you get here? Umm, this is just... a little gift full of my love for you! I-I hope you like it...

lines.line: Eep... I-I don't have any more food... Leave me alone already, please! C-Commander, help... I'm lost, and these birds won't listen to me!
Eep... I-I don't have any more food... Leave me alone already, please! C-Commander, help... I'm lost, and these birds won't listen to me!
C-Commander, where are you...? Oh, Commander... Is that really you?! I'm not dreaming? Thank goodness...
C-Commander... I'm sorry! I picked out a swimsuit and practiced my best smile for you, but you ended up having to save me... Th-thank you so much!
I-I'm still embarrassed walking around in this swimsuit, so... I tried taking a shortcut to our meeting spot, but then I got lost... *sob*
At first, there were only two seagulls... I thought they were hungry, so I shared some of my bread, and then... And then...
Umm... I wanted to use these sunglasses as a disguise... Huh? You can still tell it's me?!
*sob*... Thank you, Commander... C-can you console me a little longer?
Ah?! Wh-whoooa?! Y-you're bridal carrying me?! Being rescued like this is just... Aaah!
Hyah?! I-I'm still a little scared...
As long as you're here, I won't be scared! E-even if those seagulls come begging for food again... I'll say no this time!
Warm sunlight, a nice breeze... When you're not here, I never notice these things. Commander... May I continue to stay by your side?
Type 1934A destroyer - Z15.
I'm the Iron Blood destroyer Z15. I don't know why, but my ride tends to malfunction a lot... If you don't want me to be in danger, you'd better keep those eyes on me!
I'm Z15 - a destroyer from the Iron Blood. Just looking at you makes my heart race... Hehe, how about we go somewhere together? We've got so much more to discuss~
Aw, you finally came to see me! I await your orders. No matter what you want, I'll do it. Oh... Paperwork, huh?
You've been staring at me for a while... Are you having naughty thoughts? I'm gonna report you... Hahaha, just kidding! I welcome your gaze, Commander~
You'll fix my ride for me? You're totally saying that so you can go home with me, right? I can tell... Huh? Wait, you're actually bringing a toolbox?
You wanna talk in more detail about this tomorrow? Sure~ I mean, we could go really in-depth right now, if you waaanted...
When you're off work, how about you ride home with me? Don't worry - nothing will go wrong this time! I'll take you on my bicycle, so there's no danger at all!
Petting?! If you're doing that... then you'd better be ready to take responsibility!
Pure, innocent girls like me have nooo idea what's going on in that head of yours~
C-Commander, what's gotten into... Hyah?! I-I'm heating up... My boiler might explode...
Commander, your work isn't done yet. Hurry up and finish it so we can do something more fun!
Your rewards are here~ But doesn't it leave you wanting a better reward, maybe from... me? Hahaha, did I guess right?
Commander, your mail's right heeere♪ Go ahead and take it. Just be careful you don't touch anything else... Hehe!
Oh hey, you're back! Hmm? Why am I stuck like this? Well, my ride broke down again... Help me out, please!
Oh, the commission team is almost back... I guess we won't be alone much longer. Too bad... I'm sure neither of us has had our fill yet~
My power is overflowing~
Get ready to be wowed!
Don't you think top performers like me deserve a little reward?
Ugh, I can't move... Why'd it break down all of a sudden?!
Hot, isn't it?!
M-my boiler's water supply pipe is failing!
If you keep hiding from me, I'm going to lose my patience with you, Commander!
Feel free to order me to do anything~ Even the most ridiculous request... I'm ready to please♥
It's really pouring outside... I guess we'll just have to hang out alone in your office... Hmm? You have an umbrella, and you'll walk me home? W-wait... Why'd you get so close?!
Um, so... Commander, I think I... Come on, you know what I'm trying to say... Ugh, how can it be so hard to say three little words?
Commander... Do you think love feels like having broken brakes? Like, I know I REALLY need to stop... but I can't stop the urge to crash into you!
Haha... Wow, what a good dream that was. The Commander's face, the feeling of that ring... Wait, that wasn't a dream?! Oh, man... Wh-what am I even supposed to say?!
You gave me such a nice gift... I'd better find a way to thank you♪
Don't be scared, don't be scared~ I'm not a baddie~

ex.line: I'm so hot, I feel like I could melt! All because I saw you, Commander...
You want me to go on your next trip? Now that sounds dangerous~ After all, you and I will be alone in a cramped space... Hm? You're worried about something else?
Lately, I've started overheating every time we hang out... You'd better pour your coolant all over me!
My finger got caught in the door! You'd better kiss it better for me... Just kidding! All I really wanted was to hold hands~
Mmm... That feels good. Touch me more, if you want...
I can tell exactly what you're thinking, Commander~
*pant*... This is my favorite part♥
Welcome back, Commander~ I waited all day for you... Hehe, you look like you've still got energy. That means you don't need a break before we get started... right?
It's time I was honest with you. No matter how much time passes, even if I'm reborn, I'll never let go of you. Heehee, that's just how deep my love for you is♥

lines.line: Commandeeer! I finally made it to you. Seems like there's something wrong with the exit of this ball... Anyway, I'm stuck in here. Can you help me out?
Commandeeer! I finally made it to you. Seems like there's something wrong with the exit of this ball... Anyway, I'm stuck in here. Can you help me out?
Oh nooo, I fell again~ It's so hard to keep my balance in here... Hmm? Did I just catch you staring at clumsy little me, Commander?
It's so fun how this ball bobs up and down... Whoa! Hehe, it's hard to stay balanced, though... I'm totally not hitting you on purpose♪
The water around here is nice and cool... Oh, oooh! I can feel everything from the fish swimming around to the heat in your hands!
Commander, you're not looking at ME, are you? Are you... counting the fish and birds around? Geez, shouldn't you be focusing on getting closer to me?
*pant*... Please, I need a little break... Stop pushing the ball around for a bit. Everything's spinning...
Commander~ Feel how bouncy it is when you touch? I can feel your warmth through it, too.
Commander, get in here and play with me! Hehe, once you're inside, I'm never letting you go~ It'll be so much fun to roll around together!

I bet it'd be even more exciting if we were rolling around in here together... Losing our balance, but never letting go of each other, floating and sinking and bouncing together... Aah, I can't hold back much longer♥
Heavy cruiser - Unzen.
I'm Unzen, a heavy cruiser. Capable as I am, I am free to roam the port as much as I please, but I'll be sure to call you if I find anything unusual.

I am Unzen - the windchaser, the cloudstrider, the one who wanders across the vast horizons... and yet I have somehow ended up floating to your side with a "fwooosh." Hrmm... the deep connection between us is mysterious indeed~♪
I memorized the entire geography of the port. Commander, would you join me in the search for new realms?
Commander, I discovered treasure belonging to the Sea God today. They may look like mere seashells, but do you see how they shimmer in the light? Maybe they have powers we've yet to uncover!
Tonight, I'd like to go on a solo journey into the world of dreams. You'll come and check on me, won't you?
Commander, I wove yesterday's wanderings into a melody for you. Allow me to play it now...
Hmm? You say I just had a snack? That was then's snack - this one is now's snack.
Nngh... You're tickling my ear...
Hold on tight to my hand, Commander. Now you won't get lost when we wander together.
What are you doing, Commander? It feels... funny...
Commander, our wandering missions are still unfinished.
Your missions are done. We got lots of rare treasures, I see.
Commander, mail just arrived. Umm... Do you think it could be a map of sacred mountains?
Commander, I just returned from my own wanderings, as well. I'll tell you all about it.
The commission team has returned home. I hope they'll have many tales for me.
Now I can journey even farther~
You shall not pass.
We won, Commander. Let's get back to journeying through new realms~
This is troubling... Can I ask for your help once more?
Step aside! Aside!
I... I won't lose!
Commander... Never mind. I'm a capable free spirit now, so I can handle it on my own.
Commander, I found another sparkly treasure... Oh! It was just glass reflecting light, I guess...
Commander, I found a new secret realm amidst my travels. I'll show it to nobody but you, so don't tell any of the other girls, okay?
May I... hold your hand on our travels today? I'm not scared, or anything. It's just that... it feels a little warmer...
The map of my travels is full of memories with you, Commander. Heehee, let's keep wandering all over the world and filling it up as we go. It's a promise♪
Commander, you... want to be with me forever? Of course, I'd be happy to! Your side is the destination of all of my travels. Hehe, I love you so much, Commander!
You'd give this to me? It's beautiful...

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. You promised to join me for a walk today - I hope you haven't forgotten!
My travel diary is full of all the things that have happened during our wanderings. Look at this page... Oh, and this one... Hehehehe...
Oof... I was running through the hall, and I ended up hitting a pillar. It hurts a little...
I wanna travel the world together... Hm? You're worried about work? Heehee, even if we go far away, I have ways to get your paperwork delivered in no time!
Commander, please pet me more... It makes me very happy.
We can hold hands wherever we like from now on, okay?
I-I'm not embarrassed anymore... as long as I'm with you...
Welcome home. I prepared tea, sweets, and a big hug for you. Which would you like first?
Whenever I think of you, my heart gets all warm and fuzzy, and my fingertips play such pretty melodies... This is my love for you, Commander♪

lines.line: Naval treaty specification 23,333 long ton protected cruiser - Cherbourg.

I'm Cherbourg, a naval treaty specification 23,333-long-ton protected cruiser under the Iris banner. As for who I am? A believer in chance, a connoisseur of chaos, and an illusionist... In this ever-changing world, I think it's a little silly to hold on to a fixed identity.

Are you the Commander? Greetings from Cherbourg, Illusionist of the Iris... Oh? Things are getting lively out there. Mind if I go take a look? I hope you and I can get to know each other better later on... Hehehe.
*yaaawn*... Your daily schedule is so rigid that it puts me to sleep. I put some thrilling surprises in your daily schedule... You'd better look forward to those. Hehehe.

One choice, one path, with countless possibilities swirling at your fingertips... Fact and fiction are irrelevant. All are simple hallucinations that disappear in the blink of an eye. What drives our choices, then? Fun, of course.
Oh, you're finally awake. We're on a snowy mountaintop! ...Oh, you think the snow is an illusion? What if the blanket's warmth is the illusion instead?
The boredom of these monotonous times drives me crazy... Commander, entertain me. I'll take ANYTHING♡
It's almost time for the girls' "Grand Adventure" to begin. Would you like to watch? These are the best seats in the house!
You're petting me? Well, this is novel...
Oh? What will you do next? I can't wait to find out.
What a sudden attack... You know just how to entertain me, don't you? Heehee.
I've put together a list of your unfinished missions. Take a look... Oh? You think I added that last one myself? Goodness, how easily you pierced my illusion...
Mission complete... Are you SURE you're not interested in the special mission I planned for you?
You have new mail~ What could it be? I'm dying to know.
That was a hard-fought battle. Relax those tense nerves, alright? I know a lot of fun places to go, and I'd be happy to show you around, hehehe~
The commission team has brought back a veritable mountain of supplies! Heehee... It's actually an illusion. Aww, now I can't bring myself to dispel it, seeing how happy they are.
The line between reality and illusions blurs even further~
Let's cause some chaos in their ranks!
Victory becomes boring the moment it's guaranteed... Let's get to our next battlefield.
Oh my, don't be sad~ Sometimes, the roulette wheel of fate just lands on red.
Don't blink, or you might miss it! Heheheh!
What chaos... Now I'm getting excited! Heheheh!
Boring.
Why are there a dozen coffee cups on your desk? Pssh, as if I would know... Try taking a drink, and you might find out. But if you pick wrong... Your coffee might just pounce on you like a cat!

I heard there's a new scratcher at the convenience store. If you get the super-rare heart pattern, you can turn it in for a mystery prize... Isn't that thrilling? Anyway, I bought a thousand. Let's get scratching!
Hmmm? Why am I following you? Don't worry about it. I'm just... discovering a new hobby of mine, hehehe.
Every decision you make opens up new possibilities for me... It fills me with more excitement than anything else. I'm totally addicted to you now, Commander.
Marriage? Why, I'd be happy to~ Just imagining the unpredictable future that we share makes me shiver with excitement... Never ever bore me, you got that?
Unwrapping a gift is always such an exciting experience~
I know the secret to becoming elegant. Just do as I say, and you'll get there in no time.

ex.line: I'm bored of everyday small talk. Let's skip the boring etiquette and have some fun, heheheh!
Why does your office door lead to my room now? Hehe, it's just a little trick of mine~ The look on your face made it all worth it.
Let's flip a coin. If it's heads, we'll go do paperwork. If it's tails... let's do something more fun... Oh. It's standing on its edge? Isn't that funny!
Tadaaa! Work's over, which means it's time for our date! Let's get going... You want me to wait? No way! I'm at the end of my patience♪
Hmm? The spot you should be touching is right here, isn't it...? I'm sure it'll be more fun and thrilling... Heheheh.
Heheheh. Are you getting bored of the dull days, too?
Aaah. Try not to bore me too soon, now... Heheheh♥
Let's go to the cafeteria together for a romantic, full-course Iris-style meal. Imagine the looks on everybody else's faces while they're having quick meals! Heheheheh!

I used to think that fun things were like sand on a beach - you can't have them all, and they'll slip through your fingers eventually. But then... I met you, Commander. You're my one-of-a-kind, inexhaustible treasure.

lines.line: *pant*... It's really hot inside the teddy bear suit... I bet that dynamic entrance took you by surprise, didn't it? Heheh!
*pant*... It's really hot inside the teddy bear suit... I bet that dynamic entrance took you by surprise, didn't it? Heheh!
I didn't think I'd run into you quite like this... First I tripped and fell, and then, I almost crushed my one and only audience member... What a coincidence! Hehehe.
How did you like my teddy bear magic show? Wasn't it amazing? Or... Are you only focused on what you see spilling out of the costume?
As an actor, I've managed to draw you, my viewer, into the spectacle... What should I do now, you think? Heehee!
Hm... This position is really embarrassing... Oh? Are you enjoying the sight, Commander? Surely not~
Was this all part of my plan? Nooo, it was just bad luck~ All I did was think about you. Isn't fate just an incredible thing?
Don't worry. My outfit is soft, so it's a good cushion... To be quite honest, I'm having fun right now... Hehehe.
Aw, you're helping me up? Thank you... Oh nooo, I'm falling again~
Taking advantage of a poor girl in distress? You're a real bully, Commander... Heheheh~
Hey, can you come over and hold me already? I'm a little chilly. Heheheh... Ah, I can feel your warmth...
Colossus-class light aircraft carrier - Arromanches.
Arromanches, the Colossus-class aircraft carrier, takes the stage! Wherever excitement goes, I follow! Apart from combat, I'm great at acrobatics - a real pro, you know! Hey, don't call me wild!
Hello, hello! Nice to meet you, Commander! I'm the acrobatic dancer of the Iris Libre, Arromanches! Rumors of a lively port brought me here! Come on - time to show me around my new home!
Woohoo! It's another high-energy day, Commander! Let's do some gymnastics together to warm up!
Commander! Wanna see my warm-up spins with Marteau? ...Hmm? You think that's too much effort for a warm-up? The word "tired" doesn't exist in my dictionary! All I know is "again"!
Hehe, I won a prize in another competition today! What kind? Hmm... I don't remember... Hahaha! I joined partway through!
Look, Commander! Five turns in midair, followed by a 720-degree spin, and finally, a steady landing with Marteau... Whoa! I made a crater in the ground!
Commander, I stopped a fight today! All I did was stand there with Marteau, and suddenly, they calmed down...
Oh, wooow! Your encouragement is making me feel more energetic than ever, Commander!
Commander, you wanna high-five? Awesome! Let me just charge up, and... HYAAAH!
Hyah?! You sneaky little... Take this! And this!
Mission alert, mission alert! Let's get it done, Commander!
Mission complete! Let's wrap it up with a high-energy acrobatic performance!
Ooh! This mail... must be an invitation to a dance party! Hurry and open it.
Ooh, welcome back, Commander! Did you like my triple backflip? Pretty cool how I landed square in front of you too, right?
Things are getting lively over there... Our commission team must be back~
Power up!
Time for Marteau to shine!
Huh? I just finished warming up, and it's already over?!
I've got so much energy, but nothing to do with it...
Marteau Tornadooo!
Nkh... This is starting to hurt.
Sorry, I'm busy!
Com-man-der! Let's do gymnastics together! I'll show you the ropes, so... Hey, don't be so nervous. As long as I'm around, you won't get hurt! Relax, relax~
I might not look like it, but I know how to be elegant! For example, I can... curtsy? Umm, is that what it was called?
Commander! I dunno why, but I really want to hear your opinion now! Give me feedback on my performance today, okay? If you like it... I'll be walking on sunshine all day!
I knew it... You're the perfect audience! You take my performance seriously, and you give me sincere feedback... Hehe, I love you, Commander!

I love you more than anything! I love you so much that I could do ten somersaults right now! But if I did that, I'd make a mess of the room... so I'll go for something simpler and more direct! Huuuug!
Oooh, a present from the Commander?! Yay!

ex.line: Com-man-der! Heheh... Seeing you again makes me super happy!
Commander, I just discovered this cool pose! Basically, I wrap my legs around your waist like this... and now, I can use you to do stretches!
I was playing hopscotch just now, but I accidentally held the chalk too hard and broke it to bits... It was really pretty to see it fall down like a rainbow of powder!
Commander~ It's break time! Get over here so I can show you the after-exercise massage I just learned!
Whoa! Commander, why are you watching my practice videos? ...Let me watch with you! I'll sit in your lap - it's my personal VIP seat!
Heheh... Keep going, Commander! I'll tell you when you've petted me enough♪
Hm? You wanna touch Marteau? Be my guest!
Heheh... Don't underestimate how flexible I am!
Welcome back, Commander! Great work on that last mission! May I give you a massage? ...Huh? Don't worry, I won't be too rough! It'll be okay!
With my super-invincible Arromanches Hug, I'm gonna give you all of my joy, passion, and devoted love all at once! Hnnngh... Do you feel it, Commander?!

lines.line: Focus your core, keep your center of balance... Draw the bow, and... Huh? Great timing, Commander! I was just looking for an assistant for my new performance!
Focus your core, keep your center of balance... Draw the bow, and... Huh? Great timing, Commander! I was just looking for an assistant for my new performance!
Drawing a bow while reciting my lines... i-is actually really hard! Only I can pull this off!
There's a lot of stuff I had to learn: how to keep my balance, how to draw a bow while doing a handstand, and how to aim with my feet!

Are you trying to see if I can keep my balance while you're distracting me? That's not ne... Ack! D-don't touch my hair! If you do that, I... Nkh! Hahaha?! Don't tickle my feet, either! I'm gonna drop the arrow!
Commander, can you aim the bow and arrow for me? Then, all I'll have to do is draw it and... Whoa?! I pulled too hard and broke the bow!
Huh?! Is this supposed to help me calm down? There's no way that'll... Huh. I do feel calmer now...
Hmm? You wanna see if my posture is stable? Heheh, I promise you... Whoa?! Hey, that didn't count! I'm not ready yet!
Hyah?! S-stop that, or I might collapse...

Urk... Keeping this position is starting to make my feet cold... I know! Commander, hold my feet and use them to draw the bow! It'll help me practice AND warm up my feet - that's two birds with one stone!
Hahaha! Perfect precision!
I-I'm gonna fall!
Aww yeah, my aim is perfect! Hmm? You say I didn't fire any arrows? Heheh, well... I wasn't shooting at the target - I shot your heart! Did you feel how I pierced it right in the center? Hehehe!
Le Hardi-class destroyer - L'Intrépide.
Report! Iris Libre destroyer L'Intrépide is here and full of energy! Whether it's cooking, eating, OR fighting, you can leave it all to me!
Meat's done! *blow*... *munch*... Hmm? Oh, Commander, hello! My name is L'Intrépide, and I'm with the Iris Libre... Huh? You want more details? Mm... Can it wait until I finish this?
Welcome back, Commander! I tried roasting meat with a new blend of spices. Come and give it a taste. Can't work on an empty tummy!
Hmm? You wanna know about my barbecue magic? Or... are you waiting for the food to be ready? Aww, you don't have to be shy~ Come and eat before it gets cold!
Alright, the pineapple barbecue is almost ready~ Hm? You think eating barbecue every day is bad for my nutritional balance? Don't worry - I eat different side dishes every time!
Commander, have you seen my ribbon? I thought I brought it... Oh! It's already on my head! Hahaha!
Phew... I ate a ton... Commander? Why are you looking at... Oh! Did I accidentally eat yours?! Sorry! I'll make it up with double... no, TRIPLE for you!
Ooh... The moment you gave me headpats, my tummy started rumbling. Is that magic?
Whoa! Commander! You scared me...
Whoa! You're so forward, Commander... Not that I mind!
Ah! Commander, you have new missions to do. If we do them together, we'll be done before dinnertime!
Everything finished on time! You're amazing, Commander!
Mail caaall! Let's see if it's good news, Commander!
Welcome hooome! I grilled meat for you, so hurry up and eat... Oooh, that smells good. Can I have some? Just a bite...
Everyone just got back! I've got meat on the barbecue, so bring them over for a big meal!
Phew... I cooked and ate a lot~ Now I'm satisfied.
Let's go carve us some meat!
We won! Let's celebrate with a feast - I'll do the grilling!
*sigh*... I'm sooo hungry. Can we cook the baddies, you think?
Let's roast 'em!
I'm too hungryyy!
Sorry... There isn't any meat left for you.
Eating meat together is the first step to becoming fast friends. Get over here and eat with me, Commander!
Watch closely, Commander~ Hmmm... Haah! Pretty good swordplay, huh? If you wanna eat well and fast, you need swordsmanship and passion!
*blooow*... Perfect! Open up, Commander. I've been watching this meat closely, so it should be cooked just right! Did it taste good? Hehe, glad to hear it.
You smell really good lately, Commander... Am I just imagining it? *sniff sniff*... Mmm... Huh? No, I'm not gonna eat you!
Wait... This is a ring! Huh? Wha? Whaaaat?! For ME?! Yes, of course! I'd be happy to! I'll cherish you for the rest of my life, Commander!
I LOVE it! Thank you so much, Commander!
Here we go! Chaaarge!
Barbecue? Barbecue, barbecue!

ex.line: Heheh... I smell something even better than barbecue meat. *sniff*... You smell delicious... Umm, I mean, welcome home! I just made barbecue. Come eat up!
Commander, are you tired? Wanna lie down on me and take a nap? I'll be the perfect, immobile cushion for you!
Urgh, my tummy's rumbling... Meat... Where's the meat? Do you have it? Thank goodness!
Just one more piece left... No, this is for the Commander... Huh? Can I really have half of it?!
Hehe, that feels nice. Smells good, too...
Mmm... I wanna jump into your arms and take a big whiff of your scent!
Heheh, I'm used to this, so it won't surprise me anymore. Come with me now♪
Good work, Commander! Relax and let me knead and tenderize those shoulders. Does it feel good? Hmm... How else can I make you taste even better?
I wanna give you a hug... May I? Here I come... Huggies! You and I will be together forever, like meat and potatoes!

lines.line: Heheh, here comes the grand finale! Watch in amazement as I snatch the meat from that ring of fire and put the finishing touch to tonight's feast! Don't blink, Commander!
Heheh, here comes the grand finale! Watch in amazement as I snatch the meat from that ring of fire and put the finishing touch to tonight's feast! Don't blink, Commander!
Good morning, Commander. You're looking great today! Wanna try out this super-fun fiery trail with me? Don't worry - if you keep up with me, you won't get hurt at all... I think! Hehehe!
Did you like my fiery dance just now? If you still want more... I'll use my barbecue magic to set the whole stage on fire for you!
Commander, come closer~ Just a little more... Hah, got you! Can you feel my sizzling passion and energy?
That was the BEST! I had so much fun... Let's do it again! Join me, Commander!
Success! We've got medium grilled meat! See how the inside is still a vibrant red? Do you wanna eat it as-is, or would you like to try my special black pepper spice blend?
Heheh, don't get burned by the heat of my passion!
Whoa! You really like this spot, don't you?
Commander, you're back just in time for the opening act! There will be owls performing today. You'd better find a seat so you don't miss the action!
Give me a hug, Commander! Why now? Because I want you to feel my burning passion, of course. Are you ready? Here I cooome!
Heya! My name's Neptune! Nice to meet you!
I'm the protiest of protagonists, Neptune! I'm the CPU of a country called Planeptune. What's a CPU? It's a long story, so I'll tell you another time.
Heya! My name's Neptune! Nice to meet you!
Welcome back! Let's give it all we've got, nep!
It's so embarrassing when people stare at me like that.
Heheh! How's my rigging look? It's all so Azur Laney! Looks good on me, don'tcha think?
Nep nep♪ Nep nep♪ Nep nep neppynep♪
I'm hungry... Go get me some pudding, Commander!
Ahahah! That tickles! Stop it, will you!
Hey! You can't do that, Commander!
Me, do some missions? I'll help if you give me 5 servings of pudding, how's that? ...I'm just kidding! Let's get out there and finish it!
Mission completed! Rewards obtained!
You have new mail! Now's not the time for pudding!
Oh, the pudding is calling out to me...! We gotta get back home!
Hey! Everyone's back! Shouldn't we head out and welcome them?
Chala-la-la-laaaa!
Witness the might of a protagonist!
Justice will always win! Just kidding...
We regret to inform you that Neppy has been defeated.
I'll nep up your face!
Nep?! It's not time to panic just yet!
Huh? What was that? I can't hear you, I've got bananas stuck in my ears.
Going out for some exercise every now and then isn't so bad! Hey, Commander! What do you say we go for a walk together next time?
I've got an idea! Commander, you should visit Planeptune sometime! I'm sure everyone would love to meet you!
Commander obtained! Now we're gonna play some games together! Listen: you're not getting any sleep tonight.
What should we play today? How about "who's-their-crush"? Hmm, your crush... that's gotta be me! Heheh, spot on, aren't I?

Tell you the truth, I was nervous when I first came to this world, but now after meeting you and becoming your special someone... I'm happy from the bottom of my heart that I came here. So, here's hoping for a bright future together!
Ohh! This is exactly what I've always wanted! Thanks!
Hey, Noire! Let's see who can beat the most enemies!
All right! Let's go, everyone!
Are you the commander? Hmm... Very well. I'm Noire. The CPU of Lastation. You can put your mind at ease now that I'm here.
I'm Noire, the CPU of Lastation. I wonder if I'll be able to make many friends in this new world... B-but more importantly! Give me a report on the current state of the war.
Are you the commander? Hmm. Very well. I'm Noire. The CPU of Lastation. You can put your mind at ease now that I'm here.
You're fashionably late, I see. We have much to do today, so get ready.
H-hey! What're you looking at?!
You're not neglecting my maintenance are you? Of course equipment is important, but our motivation also affects our performance, so pay attention to it.
The dresses these girls wear are quite cute. A-and I'm not just saying that because I want to try them out or anything.
Hmhhmhmmn♪ Hmmhm♪... Huh? Since when did you get here...?
Noir...! Keep your hands off me!
L-listen here... If you don't stop it right now then I will get angry.
You should check for missions at regular intervals.
If we get any rewards we can't use then I'll inform the higher-ups for you.
It seems mail has arrived.
Well done. I consider relaxation to be a legitimate training method.
It seems a commission has finished... Thank goodness, looks like nobody's been hurt.
I'm going to set my sights higher.
Watch and see what happens when I get serious!
Hah, what child's play. It'll take more than this to satisfy me.
I will never forget this defeat. And that is why I will grow stronger.
Leave this to me!
I'm fine, there's nothing to worry about.
Could you please just get out of my sight already?
Ah, you came just in time. I was just about to make lunch. Wanna join me?

A friend of mine would like to have lunch with you next time. You don't mind, right? I'll be there too, of course. I mean, someone has to be there to make sure you don't get ahead of yourself and do anything weird.

You need advice? Can't you just ask someone else? Like that girl from the other day you seemed to be having such fun talking to? Was that all you wanted to say? Well then, good luck...... Sigh, I'm such an idiot...
Hey... When I'm together with you, my heart feels like it's gonna burst. How do you feel about me? ...Actually, don't tell me. I already know the answer...

What?! This isn't just a prank, is it...? This can't be, I thought you hated me for sure... Why are you looking at me like that? That means my answer is: OK! You should be able to tell that on your own, idiot!
This is a fairly decent choice for you, Commander. I'm seeing you in a new light.
Come on, Neptune! Pay attention so I don't have to butt in all the time!
I assume everyone's ready for this?
I'm Blanc. Nice to meet you. Maybe you could introduce some intriguing books from this world to me...
I'm Blanc, the CPU of Lowee. I guess my hobbies are to read and write novels. I'm currently working on a new one.
I'm Blanc. Nice to meet you. Maybe you could introduce some intriguing books from your world to me...
Welcome back. Not much happened while you were gone.
Would you like to read a book too?
I could recommend you a book I like. Hm? There's no need for that? I see... That's a shame.
It's really windy today... Let's hurry up then, before it dies down...
Perhaps I should write about this world and make a book about it when I return to Lowee.
Hahah... I'm pretty ticklish there...
What were you hoping for?
Have you checked out today's missions?
How about we go retrieve those mission rewards?
You've got mail.
Great, now I can get back to reading my book.
A commission's done.
A level is just a number... Let me demonstrate how strong I really am.
As long as you stay calm nothing can go wrong.
That was great for a warm-up.
I'm astonished they've cornered us like this...
I'm doing it...!
I'm getting a little ticked off...
...Who are you?
I'm writing a novel right now, would you like to give it a read?
Oh, what a coincidence. I was just thinking I should come see you. Anyway, today I've got this novel for you to read...
Did you enjoy that book I gave you? You did? I'm glad to hear that... Hm...? No, it's just that nobody's ever said they enjoyed my books before, so I don't know how I should react...
You're the only one who seems to enjoy reading my novels... Nothing makes me happier than that. I hope you'll continue reading them, too.
...! I never thought I'd hear you say those words. Maybe it was fate all along for me to come to this world and meet you. Of course I hope we'll always be together from now on.
This makes me very happy. Thank you.
Ughh... I'll use those disgusting over-inflated balloons of yours as a cushion!
Let me finish them off!
My name is Vert, I am the CPU of Leanbox. I'm very good at first-person shooters, so please let me handle all combat-related matters!

My name is Vert, I am the CPU of Leanbox. My favorite things are tea, video games, and my adorable little sisters! ...Hm? I have no little sisters, you say? If I view someone as my little sister then they ARE my little sister!
My name is Vert, I am the CPU of Leanbox. I'm very good at first-person shooters, so please let me handle all combat-related matters!
Good day. I was just about to brew some tea. Would you like to have some together with me, Commander?
Ohoho, do you have business with me?
Ohoho, I will watch over you, Commander. You may rest assured and know that I can guarantee your safety.
Ohhh?! Tell me, what is that girl's name?! Please, I beg you, let me make her my little sister!
I feel completely overjoyed that there are so many cute little girls here.
Ohoho, you're quite the mischief-maker, aren't you?
If you don't treat women delicately then they will grow tired of you very fast.
Even just 5 minutes is plenty of time for you to finish a mission, no?
Mission completed! Let us go collect our rewards!
It would appear mail has arrived. I suggest that you check for it regularly.
Thank you for your hard work. Now it is time for some tea.
It seems everyone was able to make it back. Let us give them a warm welcome.
I shall set my sights even higher.
Commander, are you prepared for this?
There is no entry for "defeat" in my lexicon.
So this is how defeat feels... I see. That battle was so enjoyable that it made my heart race.
Witness the glorious power of Leanbox's CPU!
It is just as I thought; the enemy is no match for me.
Could I just return home to Leanbox?
Would you like to play an MMO together with me? Yes, of course I will assist you with everything you need to know!
I would like to hold a meetup for fellow MMO enthusiasts today! Surely you will be part of it, Commander? I will move forward under the premise that you and I will be in attendance.
May I ask you for some advice, Commander? There's a person who I've recently grown quite fond of, but I don't know how I should approach him... On second thought, never mind I said anything!
Being with you warms my heart, like a hot cup of tea. And just as I love tea, I love you. I want this moment in time to last forever, but perhaps that makes me sound selfish...?
So you wish to drink my tea till death do us apart, I see...? That makes me so happy. I will gladly make tea to just your liking, my commander... no, my sweetheart.
That's my Commander. You know my likes so well! Thank you very much!
I think books and tea go hand in hand. May I offer you a cup?
You will regret the day the you decided to make us your enemy!
Once we come back home I will give you all a big hug!
I am Purple Heart, the CPU of Planeptune. And you must be the commander. I will follow your orders from now.
I'm Purple Heart, the CPU of Planeptune. People always tell me they're amazed by how different I am in HDD form. How rude. This form is exhausting to be in, so I don't transform unless I have to.
I am Purple Heart, the CPU of Planeptune. You must be the commander. I will follow your orders from now on.
Welcome back. Shall we sortie? Do some exercise battles? Or perhaps... have some pudding?
If you're so interested in me, why don't you come closer?
I am relieved everyone here is so kind. I will have no issue fighting with all my strength.
I could really use something to drink... Would there happen to be any custard pudding around here?
Oh, Commander? Could you tell me something I should know about your world?
Ahh...! Listen, if you want my attention then you could just ask for it.
You're awfully assertive, I see. Do keep the time and place in mind, though.
Missions, huh... It seems the things a commander and a CPU do are not so different.
Mission completed. I'm curious about what rewards we'll receive.
It seems some mail addressed to you has arrived. You should read it now before you forget to.
That was a splendid workout. How about some time to take a break?
The commission team has returned. Should I offer them some assistance?
To protect the commander and everyone I know... I have to become even stronger.
I will destroy every last one of them.
It's only natural we'd win.
Everyone else ends up suffering just because I'm so powerless...
Feel the power of a CPU!
I am Purple Heart and I will not be looked down on!
I never thought you would disappoint me this badly...
Such nice weather today. Do you know of any places in this world worth visiting?
Oh, it's you. You came at just the right time. There's a stage I can't clear in this game and I was hoping you could help me with it.
I don't know why but recently I've been unable to concentrate when I'm playing games with you. Is this what it feels like to... Just to make sure you'll have to play with me some more!
I've grown accustomed to this world, and it's all thanks to you. So, grab my hand and come with me! I say we go on a date for a little while.

I see the time has finally come. I'd grown so tired of waiting! Do you understand what giving this to me means? It means you will be my partner in gaming from this day onward. I'm looking forward to it, Commander.
As expected of the Commander! You know exactly what I like! You're amazing!
I'm leaving that one to you!
Everyone, get ready! Let's make them understand the might of a CPU!
Oh, Commander? Won't you join me in a short conversation? I'll tell you things about Planeptune. Oh, and I'm eagerly awaiting the day you come to Planeptune for a visit.
I'm the CPU of Lastation, Black Heart. I've rushed here all the way from Gamindustri to lend you my aid. Be grateful.
I am Black Heart, the CPU and guardian of Lastation. Be sure to properly learn from my refined combat techniques.
I'm the CPU of Lastation, Black Heart. I've rushed here all the way from Gamindustri to lend you my aid. Be grateful.
I'll show you how a CPU fights! I'm ready whenever you are.
Hey... Don't you think you're a bit too close?
Commander, isn't that enough training? From now on, let me prove my worth in actual combat.
I was just thinking... the ocean sure is beautiful, isn't it? Why don't we go for a swim to clear our minds?

I was amazed to see the port had such a scenic place as this... Truly, you can't go without taking this view in. Right, Commander?
I was amazed to see the port had such a scenic place as this... Truly, you can't go without taking this view in. Right, Commander?
Are you here for some relaxation as well, Commander? Have yourself a nice, prolonged break from all that paperwork you're used to.
Um, Commander... Could you please not stare at me... because... it's a bit embarrassing...
What's your favorite drink, Commander? I'm partial to the... iced café au lait, I suppose.
Commander, are you good at swimming? I'm just curious to see how fast your breaststroke is!
There's nothing... off about my swimsuit, is there?
We're taking photos? Well, I'm a bit camera shy, but... okay. How's this pose? Should I stay like this?
Please... No funny business, okay?
You would think shipgirls are excellent swimmers, since they do so much battle at sea... But perhaps that isn't necessarily the case?

It's nice to meet you! From what I've heard, you're the "Commander," right? I'm Misaki. I have experience with various part-time jobs, so... I'm confident that I can be of help to you all. Let's do our best!

You want me to introduce myself? I'm Misaki, and my hobbies include scuba diving, stargazing, and... reading comics, I guess. Also, I really like mango vanilla crêpes and bubble milk tea! Oh, right, and... be nice to my sister, Nagisa!

It's nice to meet you! From what I've heard, you're the "Commander," right? I'm Misaki. I have experience with various part-time jobs, so... I'm confident that I can be of help to you all. Let's do our best!
Commander, hurry up~ Let's get to work, shall we?
I get these weird vibes from this port and the shipgirls that live here... But most of all, I get them from you, Commander. Oh, I'm just messing with you! Ahaha!
If you've got nothing else for me to do, I'm gonna head off to my part-time job... wait, I guess this is one, too...?
Mm~ I could go for some sweets right about now. Maybe a crêpe or something...
My sister might be scary at times, but she's a nice person at heart! ...Though, she might be a bit on the overprotective side...
Hey, um... This feels odd to me...
Yeees? Did you call for me, Commander?
Wah?! Geez, I'll be really angry if you do that again!
Commander, you've got new missions! Don't we get rewards for completing them?
Mission complete! Commander, don't forget to give me my share of the rewards! Oh, I'm just pulling your leg! Ahaha!
Commander, you've got mail. Come take a look!
Oh, Commander, nice work on that last battle! Now, how about a short break?
The commission team's returned! I wonder if they brought back some sweets~
What do you think? Can you feel my growth?
Aaaaall right! When you do something, you gotta do it right!
We won! Woohoo, a V for victory!
We lost... I can't believe it...
Keep your eyes on me!
This is just the beginning!
This port might be an interesting place, but you? You're not very dependable... I guess the responsibility for whipping you into shape falls on me, the part-timer~
So, I can drash across the ocean if I put this rigging on? The wonders of technology, huh!
Everyone looks extraordinary when fighting, but I guess they're really just normal girls when they're not. I've even found some friends who like comic books, heheh.
