Apparently, there's a two-for-one deal at the store for bubble milk tea right now! Two might be a bit too much for me, though... Commander, if you're free, do you want to go with me?
Commander, let's go to the dessert store~ Afterward, we can take a stroll together! I want to learn more about this place! And then, after that... um... Well, let's just get going!

Ever since I've arrived at this place, you've taken such good care for me. I can't believe that I'm about to receive something this precious from you... Thank you, Commander! I'll work even harder for you!
Wow, amazing! Can I really have this?
Sis? Oh, never mind...
I can take care of myself, so focus on yourself, sis!
A photoshoot? That'd be similar to what I did before coming here, but... um, this swimsuit is a bit much... Commander, is this what you're into? Geez... It's so embarrassing...
A photoshoot? That'd be similar to what I did before coming here, but... um, this swimsuit is a bit much... Commander, is this what you're into? Geez... It's so embarrassing...
We're doing another shoot today? I don't mind, but...
Commander, did you ask my sister to participate in some photoshoots too? Hehe~ She might act all mean on the outside, but she'll do whatever you need as long as you don't ask for something risqué~
After the shoot, wanna go grab some bubble milk tea? All right, no backsies!
Commander, are you taking some photos of the other girls as well? Let me have a look~
Commander, if you could go on a trip, where would you go?
G-geez, you're making me blush...
N-no, you can't! It's too embarrassing...
Yaaawn~ ...Oh, did I fall asleep? Sorry, the sofa was just too comfy...
H-hey, so... I think I twisted my ankle a little. Can we rest here for a little bit? There's a place we can sit over there... Is that okay with you?
H-hey, so... I think I twisted my ankle a little. Can we rest here for a little bit? There's a place we can sit over there... Is that okay with you?
I'm okay, I swear... Ah! Ouch, ouch... Maybe I'm not so okay yet.
Sitting here watching the fireworks with you, I feel something beyond just... admiration at their beauty. It's hard to put into words... Is this the magic of fireworks, too?
I hear this is the best place around port to see the fireworks! Let's watch them until the end, okay? Especially since we're alone for once... y'know?
Don't stare at me. Watch the fireworks, silly! They're pretty, so you gotta see them!
My ankle? Y-yeah, it's fine... Wait, are you asking because you realized? N-never mind! Thanks for worrying about me.
Oh, is my swimsuit coming off? Gosh, that's embarrassing...
H-hey, you don't have to rub it so much. I'm fine...
Are you sure you're not more tired than me? Let's go rest so you can catch your breath.

Are you the person who led Misaki to this port? You go by the name... "Commander"? Hmm... I don't know how you sweet-talked her into it, but you're not fooling me. The moment you do anything strange... you better be on guard! My name? It's Nagisa. You... silly dog!

Like I said the first time we met, I'm Misaki's sister, Nagisa. What I like most are soufflé pancakes, and what I hate most are green peppers. Do anything weird to Misaki, and I'll never forgive you for it, you dirty dog.

Are you the person who led Misaki to this port? You go by the name... "Commander"? Hmm... I don't know how you sweet-talked her into it, but you're not fooling me. The moment you do anything strange... you better be on guard! My name? It's Nagisa. You... silly dog!
Welcome back, Commander. ...You're quite the hard worker. Like a sled dog.
I can't believe there are so many girls at this port... You must have tricked them into coming here, didn't you?!
Hey, you silly dog. This is a gift from someone. Apparently, there are some soufflé pancakes inside, too... I-I didn't say anything! Don't forget about it later!
You're quite a hard worker, which I'd say is good... Even for a lowly dog...
Hey, is there anything I can help you with? ...Don't take this the wrong way, I'm just doing this for leverage against you.
Wh-what do you think you're doing, you dirty dog?!
I guess... you really are an incorrigible dirty dog...
Looks like there are still missions you haven't completed. Are you planning on doing them now, you silly dog?
You did this many missions on your own? My opinion of you has slightly improved... you silly dog.
Here's some mail. Are you going senile? I can't believe you neglected it until I told you.
Nice job in battle, you silly dog. But there's still a lot left for you to do, isn't there?
Hey, you have girls back from a commission waiting for you out there. You silly dog.
Thank you... What? What's the problem with me saying "thanks" once in a while?!
If I have to do it, I'll do it properly. I just have to drive them away, right?
Whew, I'm a bit tired... I wonder if I overexerted myself.
It's all your fault, you silly dog...
Say your prayers!
Oh no... At this rate...
I'm taking Misaki back. Farewell.
Not just Misaki, but all of these other girls too... You dirty dog, what kind of devious schemes are you up to?!
If Misaki's having fun, it's fine, but... the moment you do anything weird, you'll regret it!
Eh, you're saying you saw me talking to the sea? Oh, I'm a theater actor, so I was practicing... wait, you were spying on me?! You... You dirty dog!
Thanks for taking care of Misaki... I may have been wrong about you. You know, thinking that you were evil, and all. So... I'll watch you for a bit longer. That's fine, isn't it? You silly dog.

I-I understand your feelings! Geez, I'm not stupid like you are... My answer? D-don't you know without me telling you?! Like I always say, you're so slow, you silly dog! ...Hehe, I'll treasure this, you dog~
I-I'll take it. ...Thanks, silly dog.
Misaki! Be careful! Make sure you don't get hurt!
Honoka, looks like you're wearing a shrine maiden's swimsuit as well!
Whew! The wind feels great! ...What are you staring at me like that for, you silly dog? You're the one who said you wanted to go to the beach, remember? To start with, how about... we take a stroll?
Whew! The wind feels great! ...What are you staring at me like that for, you silly dog? You're the one who said you wanted to go to the beach, remember? To start with, how about... we take a stroll?
You finally came? ...It's nothing. I was just wondering if you had forgotten our promise to go to the beach together.
A photoshoot? Outdoors, like this? Fine... But no indecent photos, you hear? ...Excuse me?! Those aren't allowed, indoors or outdoors, you pervert!
I can't believe how many girls there are, playing around in their swimsuits... Hold on a sec, is this the reason you came to the beach on your day off? You dirty dog!
How long are you going to stare, you dirty dog... I'm c-cute? I don't need your cheap pickup lines!
Let me take a look at the pictures you have of Misaki. If I spot any weird ones... then you're really in for it!
Eek! What are you touching me for?!
Are you in heat? ...You dirty dog!
You worked hard that battle. Of course I'll praise you every once in a while... I-I didn't say anything, you silly dog!
Oh? You don't seem to fear me... Who might you be? ...I see, so it is you who rules over this place. Then I shall call you "Commander." I am Nyotengu. You would do best to keep me entertained, hehe.
I am undoubtedly a tengu. Oh? If you have any doubts, why not confirm it with those eyes and hands? Ah-haha...♥
Oh? You don't seem to fear me... Who might you be? ...I see, so it is you who rules over this place. Then I shall call you "Commander." I am Nyotengu. You would do best to keep me entertained, hehe.
Just arriving, Commander? Heheh, you will show me around the port, won't you?
Well, well. What shall I do for amusement now... Have you any good ideas?
In order to fly, humans created airplanes... I wonder how the view from within one is?
I'd like to drink some tea while snacking on some manjuu... Not those little ones you have here, mind you. Ah-haha.
There is a strange presence within the ranks of the Sakura Empire. Hehehe, interesting, how very interesting...
I-it tickles a bit...
Are you planning on checking my body yourself? Hehe, how daring.
Hehe, you shouldn't...♥
There are still duties left for you to do. What a forgetful one, hehehe.
You seem to have completed your tasks. Hehehe, are you tired? Go ahead and rest awhile.
"May-ull"? I am most curious as to where it came from.
After battle comes official duties, it seems. You must be suffering, so I shall lend you a hand.
Your subordinates are calling for you. You shouldn't keep a woman waiting for long.
Haha, that's not enough. Give me more...♥
Disrupting my vacation like this... I hope you're ready for what's coming. Hehehe.
It's over already? How unsatisfying.
To corner me like so... One must always be on their guard...
Haha, what a trifle you are!
The battle is just starting, is it not?
You... You are a boring human...
One year for a human is no time at all to a Tengu. ...However, that does not mean I have no interest in the world of you humans.
This port abounds with curious "take-knowledge-ease." Commander, might I ask for a tour? Hehehe, you know quite a bit, don't you?
No matter where I go, humans seem to love festivals and feasts just the same. Ah-ha-ha... That's right, I love them too♥
Oh, we're on a "date"? It seems I was taking you far too lightly, hehehe. Well, what kinds of events should I look forward to?

To think you'd try to detain me in the world of man, what inconceivable rubbish... Ah-ha-ha, that was merely a joke. My vacation is still in its youth. I shall stay by your side for the moment's passing♥
That's my Commander♥
Haha, I shall show you the power of these "carrier-based aircraft" of mine
Oh, what a curious fate it is that ties us together.
Oho! To think there was a place with this much class... Not bad! I shall hereby be enjoying my hot springs vacation right here, hehehe.
Oho! To think there was a place with this much class... Not bad! I shall hereby be enjoying my hot springs vacation right here, hehehe.
What are you doing, standing there like a fool? Don't hold back, come closer... to my side.
Your port is quite fine. With hot springs and beaches, there are plenty a wonderful place to choose... This looks to be quite the auspicious vacation, indeed, ah-haha.
More than me, you seem to be the one direly in need of a vacation.
Hehehe, Commander, won't you join me for a drink under these beautiful, crimson leaves?
What are you looking at? If there's something that interests you... shouldn't you take a closer look? Ah-haha.
Hehe, I wouldn't mind it if you... came closer.
Hehehe, what an incorrigible fool...❤
You, leaving me alone like this... Come take the place of this monkey, hurry in to the bath.
Are you the one in charge here? The "Commander"? I'm Monica, the dealer! Well, dealer-in-training. I know it's sudden, but would you care to gamble with me? The stakes will, of course, be high!
Why do I want to be a dealer? Because it's cool! Why else? Dealer distribute cards with so much style, and they've got such solid poker faces!
Are you the one in charge here? The "Commander"? I'm Monica, the dealer! Well, dealer-in-training. I know it's sudden, but would you care to gamble with me? The stakes will, of course, be high!
Greetings, Commander. What do you say to... a small bet before starting work?
High-stakes gamble are once-a-day only! You'll have to wait until tomorrow to give the wheel another spin, Commander.
Which do you prefer, Commander? Skill-based card games, or luck-based roulette?
You can wager more than just chips. Like an afternoon teatime, for instance. The loser provides the tea and biscuits!
Something... on your mind? I could offer you some insight, if you'd like. Assuming you win this next bet, that is!
Heheh. Is there something the matter?
This next gamble wiiiill... have to wait until our work is finished!
Th-there's no sleight of hand going on here!
Hey, Commander, you've got unfinished business! Let's wrap things up so we can gamble!
Mission done on time and with flying colors. You might have it in you to be a casino manager, Commander!
Don't forget your mail now, Commander!
Way to go, Commander. Here, a glass of water. Heheh, a dealer needs to keep an eye on the player, don't you know?
A commission team has returned! It was a gamble, but those lucky girls won!
The house advantage grows ever so slightly!
Heheh, I'm the wild card in this battle!
Heheh! There are no backsies in gambling!
Dammiiiiit! Next time, I swear it... Next time!
I see through your tricks!
Calm down, Monica! Focus!
You can't give up after losing just one single bet, Commander. Life, as we all know, is one big series of wins and losses!
This one time, I saw someone do a "straight up" bet with all their chips. You just have to admire the moxie it takes to bet against Lady Luck like that!
Heheh, let me show you this dealing method I learned a while back, Commander!
Are you the type that's easily influenced by pretty girls, Commander? That's not good! You need be focused at all times, or you won't win.
I really do like gambling with you, Commander. Win or lose, it's lots of fun! That's your biggest charm point, in fact. Heheh!
Huh? You're giving THIS to ME? Can I really have it? Talk about the bet of a lifetime... Heheh, I'll call your wager! Or would you rather I raise it?
Wow, is it really okay that I have this? Thank you!
Heheh! Would you like to bet on this battle?
"Welcome to Monica's Fantabulous Casino! Where you can have your every whim satisfied!" ...Oh, that doesn't sound very casino-managery? Heheh!
"Welcome to Monica's Fantabulous Casino! Where you can have your every whim satisfied!" ...Oh, that doesn't sound very casino-managery? Heheh!
Welcome, Commander! Enjoy your stay at the Fantabulous Casino! Here are your chips for the day.
"You want my fortune, do ya? Beat me in cards, and it's all yours, kid!" ...That's how they do those huge gambles in movies, right? Heheh!
Would you like a nice, cold beverage? It'll clear your head, I can promise you that!
Be it at work or at the tables, you always need a clear head and a poker face! Those so happen to be my special skills!
Don't you think it's interesting how, even though the odds are the same for everyone, if there are winners, there must be losers too?
I see you blushing there, Commander. Heheh, eyes on the prize!
You've run out of chips? Now, that just won't do! Here you are. Spend them wisely, okay?
A slave to temptation, are we? Heheh, you'll have to fix that if you want any favors from Lady Luck!
Are you having a good time, Commander? At the Fantabulous Casino, chips come free of charge! If you ever run out, do come see me!
H-hmm... Wh-where am I? ...Me? I'm Luna, a scholar. Umm... You go by the Commander? Well, I'm hungry... Do you have anything to eat? I'd prefer roasted sweet potatoes...

Hippity, hoppity... Did I look like a bunny? Sorry, but my name is Luna... Hop. I'm a scholar and a Venus, and I like roasted sweet potatoes and bunnies. Commander, will you accompany me on my field work? ...Hop.
H-hmm... Wh-where am I? ...Me? I'm Luna, a scholar. Umm... You go by the Commander? Well, I'm hungry... Do you have anything to eat? I'd prefer roasted sweet potatoes...
Good morning. Is it time for breakfast?
Commander, I like this place. The food is good, and it's full of interesting things... I'm happy here.
Being able to walk on water... is very intriguing. Commander, let us research this vast expanse of ocean.
Does this world do 3 AM snacks? ...Hmm, good. Then you're certain to have a 5 AM roasted sweet potato tradition, too. ...I'm kidding.
So many books I've never seen before... I'll never have the time to read them all. I can't wait.
A nutritional drink? Well, thank you, Myoukou... Not that it'll fill my belly.
You'll get me equipment for recording and adventuring, Akashi? Yay... That'll make this so much easier.
...Hm? What's the matter? Is it roasted sweet potato time?
...Hm? Do you have business with me? No, I mean... I guess it's okay if you don't, Commander.
Umm... I'd prefer if you didn't...
You're still not done working, are you...? Then allow me to cheer you on. Go, go, you can do it.
...Finished your work? Then that means it's time for field work.
You got a letter. Information is important, you know.
Welcome back. I made a meal for us, so if you don't mind... Let's eat together.
Everyone just came back. Heheh, I can't wait to hear their stories.
Hmm... I can feel my power growing. Very interesting...
Luna joins the battle.
I did it... Hooray, hooray.
Oh, that's sad... We lost. I'll try harder next time.
What do you think of... this?
Not yet... I'm not done yet.
Sorry, I'm just thinking. Wait a minute... okay?
Heheh. I think I'm starting to get you as a person, Commander. But you're still... very intriguing.
Excuse me, Commander? Can I have a minute? Umm... I wanted you to be interested in me, too...
Heheh... I'm ready to show you something special, Commander. Since I want you to stay by my side longer...
*stare*... Hmm, I see. Heheh, I never tire of observing you, Commander. In fact... I only end up more intrigued. You are... an incredible research subject.

This world is very intriguing. No matter how much I research, there's always more to uncover. But Commander... I'm so much more interested in your heart, yet I can't figure it out... I need you to teach me more.
Hehehe... So cute. I'm... very happy. Simply... overjoyed.
Kitty... Can you help me prepare for my next round of field work?
I wanna compare answers... Do you have time after the battle?

ex.line: Good morning, Commander. Let's continue our field work together.
Commander... It's snack time. Want to share a roasted sweet potato with me? Though I do hate to share it...
Bunnies are cute... But what about me? Hippity, hoppity... Am I cute?
Commander, I'm so interested in you and this world... Can we go on a date? Or, I mean... Field work?
Are you taking a break, too? Then... Wanna eat together? Roasted baked potatoes... would taste even better... if I ate them with you!
You'll teach me a good way to roast sweet potatoes, Edinburgh? ...Heheh, if it goes well, I'll treat the Commander.
Information on the Commander? Hmmrgh... What if I traded you this sweet potato, Aoba? ...No?
Umm, Commander... That tickles...
Are you still working? Then I'll help you. Leave it to me... Hop.
...You're finished working, so come and eat roasted sweet potato with me, Commander.
Here goooes. Leave it all to Luna... Hop.
I defeated an enemy horde! ...You can praise me, you know.
This place is full of such interesting things. The vast sea, the shipgirls, the delicious food... And you, Commander. I want to keep researching it all... So may I stay by your side longer?

lines.line: Hmm... Commander, I'm tired from all this frolicking. How about we take a break, or have a snack? You know, nobody knows we're all alone right here... Heehee~♪
Hmm... Commander, I'm tired from all this frolicking. How about we take a break, or have a snack? You know, nobody knows we're all alone right here... Heehee~♪
Commander, you and I are doing field work today. ...Hm? You really don't mind? Hippity, hoppity, hooray.
This swimsuit is... Hmm, very interesting. May I have your objective opinion, Commander?
This pose? Or maybe this one? ...Commander, which do you find more intriguing?
It's almost snack time? Well, I'll go with roasted sweet potato. ...Wanna go halfsies, Commander?
Hmm. I researched your favorite swimsuits ahead of time... How mysterious it is that there are so many. Intriguing, indeed.
Centaur, is that swimsuit? ...Not quite? Hrm, very interesting...
Albacore, how was that swimsuit of yours made? I'm intrigued. May I research it some time?
Careful. If you keep pulling there... something bad might happen...
Bzzzt. No more of that...
Thank you for your work, Commander. Would you like to rest alongside me? We can take a nap in the shade... Mmgh...
Hmm? Where am I? Ohh, I get it now... I drank way too much yesterday... Ahahah. Oh well♪ There's tons of cuties here to keep me entertained❤ My name's Tamaki. It's a pleasure, Commander❤

My name is Tamaki. I'm an ex-model turned fashion designer, and I do Venus work. My favorite things about my job are the pretty clothes, and moreover, the cute girls, I suppose♥ If you want to know more... I'll tell you after a few drinks♥
Hmm? Where am I? Ohh, I get it now... I drank way too much yesterday... Ahahah. Oh well♪ There's tons of cuties here to keep me entertained❤ My name's Tamaki. It's a pleasure, Commander❤
Good morning, Commander. My, you look rather tired. Need something to wake you up?
Commander, if you're free, how about grabbing a few drinks? Take me to a place that serves some good liquor♥
Oh, enjoying a break, Commander? I enjoy a bit of downtime as well. I know - how about we get comfortable together?
The sea breeze feels nice, but it's pretty terrible for your skin. I wonder if there's some sort of remedy to it?
Mmgh... This warm sunshine is making me sleepy... Don't you think we could have a nap after we finish this work?
Sure is hot today... Hm? A tea party to cool off? Sounds perfect! You're so considerate, Ms. Head Maid!
Incredible swordsmanship, Takao... Dare I say, you're also pretty hot♥ Why don't you sit down and enjoy a drink with me?
Oh, a pat on the head? If this is my reward, I'd like something... different♥
Hm? What is it? If you need something, you can tell me anything that's on your mind♥
Eep! Commander, please... We're still on the clock. Control yourself.
You've still got a lot of work to do... Want a hand?
Seems you've finished a job. Be sure to claim your rewards.
There's a letter here. And it's for you, it seems. Who could it be from?
Welcome back, Commander. Good going out there. Now how about I give you a massage?
Looks like those girls are back from their errand. Come on, let's go greet them♪
Heehee♪ Thanks♥ You're helping me become even more beautiful.
Let's show them what we're made of!
Ahahah! I put on a captivating show, didn't I?
Hmm. I guess I was in over my head...
You'll want to see this!
You've seen nothing yet!
Hm? Sorry, I'm busy right now. Come back later.
Are you on the clock, Commander? You poor thing. Don't overwork yourself now, okay?
Oh, Commander♪ Perfect timing♥ I missed you, you know. Stay for a while, will you?
Why are you standing there all speechless? Don't tell me... you're stunned by my beauty? Heehee. I'll make an exception for you - stare all you want♪
I'm in love with this wonderful place. There's all these cute girls... and they're led by a cute Commander. Oops, you didn't hear that♥
Heeey! Commander! C'mere! Way to make me wait. Did you want me to get drunk all alone? You've gotta make up for this, and I won't take no for an answer♪ Heehee♪ Cheers♥
Wow! Thanks! I just can't resist presents♪
I've heard you can hold your liquor! Let's get drunk someti- Hey! Why are you stopping me?
Word is, you're hiding some exquisite plum liquor! Let me have a taste!

ex.line: Morning, Commander. What are we doing today? The both of us, of course♪
Great scenery and even better liquor. I imagine we're going to have a lovely time together.
Don't burn yourself out, Commander. Practice at least a little self-care, okay? For instance, by taking a break to drink with me♥
It's ridiculous how many cuties live here. While I love eye candy as much as the next person... everyone can see you staring, Commander.
What a lovely breeze... Hey, is your work done yet? Let's have dinner on the terrace, and then, when we're all alone... You know what comes.
Even I find myself hypnotized by your curves, Atago... Say, what kind of skin care do you do?
Your outfit is eye-poppingly gorgeous, Taihou! Hey, do you mind if I take a little inspiration from you? Oh, and Commander, no peeping♥
Yeees? If you want to learn more about me... I'll tell you all you want to know.
Oh, you've still got work to do? Let me help you wrap it up quickly so we can go drinking♥
This mission's already finished. Impressive work.
Go get 'em! Don't let them out of your sight!
Alright! Let's have some drinks tonight to celebrate this victory♪
Heehee♥ A lot's happened since I came here, and I didn't expect I'd stick around THIS long. But... when I'm with you, gazing at the gorgeous horizon... time just starts to fly.

lines.line: Heehee~ I've been waiting, Commander♪ Come on, there's no need to be shy♥ I'm going to show you a lovely time, darling, so you'd better get ready♪
Heehee~ I've been waiting, Commander♪ Come on, there's no need to be shy♥ I'm going to show you a lovely time, darling, so you'd better get ready♪
Morning, Commander♪ That shower really cleared my head. Now let's get to work♪
Aahh, bath time is a gift from god♥ It's not just energizing, but also beautifying. Quite the special time, wouldn't you agree?
You need to appreciate times like this when you can forget everything and just relax♪ You'll be more productive at work with a clear mind, too♪
Heehee~ If I said, "You are cordially invited to a private shower time," you'd want to experience it, wouldn't you? Good, I appreciate the honesty♪
So, Commander... What do you think? ...Ahh, I see... Heehee~ I know I asked for your opinion, but actually hearing it feels a bit awkward.
Hey, Elizabeth, do your maids wash your whole body as part of your queenly baths? Oh gosh♥ Now I want to try it for myself♥
There's even a full-fledged sauna?! Is that really true, Rossiya? I SO want to go in that!
Well, well♪ Drawn to this, hmm? I get it. Really, I can sympathize... but that's still naughty♥
Commander, go any further and you'll cross a line. But maybe... you're ready for the consequences♥
Welcome back, Commander♥ Oh dear, you're covered in dirt. Come here, let your spiritual big sis clean you up♥
Hello, Commander! I'm the idol, Haruka Amami! I'll do my best to share my dreams with everyone in port! Let's all have a great time together!
I'm Haruka Amami! I've loved singing ever since I was little, and always dreamed of becoming an idol. It's a tough job, but I know I can overcome any challenge as long as I have my friends! Hehehe~
Hello, Commander! I'm the idol, Haruka Amami! I'll do my best to share my dreams with everyone in port! Let's all have a great time together!
Good morning, Commander! Let's roll up our sleeves and get to work!
You want to get to know me? Uhh, sure... To start with, what do you want to talk about?
What were those little kitty creatures called again? "Meowfficers"? I bet our resident animal lover, Hibiki, would love to meet one!
I'm glad to see fellow idols at the port! They're all so cute, and so pretty to boot... I hope one day we can all go up on stage together.
I've played a villain character before, and I actually really got into the role! Didn't think it would be so fun!
You like how my ribbon looks? Hehehe~ Thank you! It's my signature accessory!
Do you need something, Commander? Oh! I'm guessing you need a hand with something.
Eeeek! Wh-what are you doing?!
There's still a few tasks we need to do. If you need my help with any of them, just say the word!
Job completed! Way to go, Commander!
I think there's mail for you, Commander! Maybe it's a new job offer?
Welcome back, Commander! I made snacks while you were out. Do you want some while you take a break?
Well done on that errand, everyone! Glad to see you made it back in one piece!
I'll try to be the best, brightest-shining idol I can!
All righty, time to get fired up!
We woooon! Girls, you're awesome!
Urgh... Sorry for tripping up... I'll work on it so we win next time!
Here's a smile for all my fans!
The show is far from over!
Oops, sorry, I was busy reading the script. What were you saying?
I've loved singing since I was a kid. I especially love singing together with a group of friends!
Ow, oww... Oh, hi, Commander. It's nothing serious, I just tripped in the corridor... A bandaid? Aww, thank you so much!
That's enough rehearsing for one day, I think... Are you taking a break too, Commander? Then we could sit and relax together! What do you say?
Commander! I made some cookies today! They came out pretty good, I'd say. Listen, I was hoping you could... have a taste and tell me what you think?
It's thanks to you and all the wonderful people here that I've managed to get this far and work with a smile. I want to bring a smile to your faces, just as you have for me!
Wow! Is this for me? I'm really happy!
Let's put on a top-notch show for the fans, Chihaya!
Thanks for that tip you gave me, Ritsuko!
Don't be silly, Ami, I'm not gonna trip on- Whuaahh!

ex.line: Hey, Commander! What job are we starting the day with? Whatever it is, I'll give it my all!
Welcome back, Commande- Oh shoot, look ooooout! Ow, oww... Whoopsie, I did it again...
Owww... I tripped again just earlier. But don't worry, I'm not hurt or anything. I trip all the time, so I'm used to it.
Commander, I was wondering if I could... Oh, you're sleeping? Hehehe~ Then I'll get you a blanket and let you get some rest.
I've learned about so many new pastries and snacks since I came here! There's this one cake recipe someone told me of a while ago that I'm dying to make for myself!
Eeeeek! Please, don't do that to me all of a sudden, Commander!
We're almost done! I'll help you with these tasks as best as I can!
And that's a wrap! Let's keep up this pace for the rest of today!
All right! Let's get 'em!
Victory! It's all thanks to you, Commander!
I forgot to ask, but how'd you like that cake I made the other day? ...You loved it? Hehehe~ I get all giddy when people give me their feedback. If you want to, I could make another one for you~

lines.line: Good evening, Commander! Are you also taking a break? If so, let's go get some candied apples and have a little chat~♪
Good evening, Commander! Are you also taking a break? If so, let's go get some candied apples and have a little chat~♪
Oh, hi! I'm glad you came to the festival too, Commander! Do you want to take a look around?
I've tried to replicate the takoyaki and yakisoba they sell here, but I just can't get the flavor right for some reason. Isn't that weird?
What's wrong? Why are you hanging over there, Commander? Are you tired from wading through the crowds?
It's kind of annoying to walk around in a yukata. I've got to pay extra attention so I don't trip ov- Oh, shoot!
You came at just the perfect time, Commander! I just bought ramune and they gave me an extra bottle. Here, let's enjoy them!
Hehehe~ Don't you love festivals? Anyway, where should we go next?
C-Commander! Please stop, or you'll open my yukata's bottom!
Wow, you've really been out and about! Should we take a break and sit on that bench over there?
Pleased to meet you. My name is Chihaya Kisaragi. Are you the one in charge of this port? I look forward to working with you.
My name is Chihaya Kisaragi. I aim to become a singer that's on a higher level than anyone else. You... want me to sing for you? Well... just one song then.
Pleased to meet you. My name is Chihaya Kisaragi. Are you the one in charge of this port? I look forward to working with you.
Good morning to you, Commander. I'd like to go over today's schedule with you, if you don't mind.
Is there something you need me for? I was just about to start practicing singing though...
If there's nothing you need me to do, can I read some sheet music to pass the time? I'd like to practice the songs I'm singing at my next performance.
The people at this port all operate such huge machinery... It's very impressive. I'm not very good with machines, you see.
Lalala~♪ No, I need to put a bit more emotion into this part... Oh, Commander. I'm sorry, I'm having a hard time understanding this song...
Is something wrong?
I'm sorry... I'd like to do some vocal exercises to warm up my voice...
P-please stop. Where do you think you're touching me!
It looks like there's still work left to be done.
It looks like you've finished up the rest of your work. Well, I'll be getting back to practicing singing.
Commander, we've received some mail. I think it's a good idea to go check it soon.
Good work, Commander. Will... you be taking a short break? Understood.
Commander, it seems like people are back from commissions. Shouldn't we go and greet them?
Thank you very much. This has been an invaluable experience for me.
I'm all done warming up and ready to sing!
It's a victory. But I'm still a long way from reaching the top...
...Ugh! If only I had practiced singing a bit more...
Let this song... reach the hearts of everyone!
It's... not over yet!
Did you need something?
Lalala~♪ Oh, Commander. I was just warming up my voice.
An idol's work isn't limited to only singing. However, improving your singing skills will aid in any job... That's what I think.
There are a lot of children here at the port. You know, I've been teaching some of them how to sing at their request. Hehe, everyone has such pretty singing voices.
Um, Commander, would you mind accompanying me for a little bit? I've been practicing a new song, but I've been stuck on a part. I was hoping to get your opinion.

Having come here and been able to sing for many people... I consider this a very valuable experience. To express my feelings for the Commander who gave me this opportunity... I'd like to sing you a song!
Thank you very much! I promise I'll treasure it...!
Haruka! Let us sing together!
Azusa, let us do our best.

ex.line: Good morning, Commander. I'm in tip-top condition today! I feel like I can sing without a worry...!
Commander, if you're free, could you accompany me for singing practice?
Commander, I'm sorry for calling you over when you're so busy, but I don't really understand how to operate this equipment. I'm supposed to press this and do that? Um, it's not moving at all now...
Excuse me Commander, could I go and take some pictures of the port? I wanted to have something to remember my time at this place by.
Are you feeling tired? How about playing some classical music over at the office? I've heard that it helps you feel more relaxed...
Eek...!!! Please, stop it...!!! What are you doing all of a sudden...?!
Looks like you've still got some work left to finish.
Good job wrapping everything up, Commander. Please allow me to help next time as well.
I... can soar even higher!
Looks like we've won. This experience is sure to be a catalyst for my further growth.

When I first arrived in port, there were so many things I didn't understand, but thanks to the help you and the others have given me, I've come to really enjoy my time here. I'm truly grateful for all you've done for me.

lines.line: Oh, the fireworks display is starting. I'm planning to meet up with the others after this, but... Why don't we spend some time enjoying the view here first?
Oh, the fireworks display is starting. I'm planning to meet up with the others after this, but... Why don't we spend some time enjoying the view here first?
Good afternoon, Commander. Huh...? How long have I been waiting? There's nothing to worry about, I just got here myself.
How does this yukata look? ...It looks pretty on me? I'd be happy if that were the case...
There's a flower pattern on the inside of this umbrella. I love to look up whenever I use it because it looks as if flowers are blooming above my head, and that's so pretty.
The fireworks exploding above our heads and the fireworks reflected on the surface of the water... they're both very pretty.
Watching fireworks next to the other people really feels exciting and festive, but I also like the relaxed atmosphere of watching fireworks from afar like this.
This stone is so slippery, it's hard to stand on... Eek! T-thank you, Commander... That was a close one.
Eeek! ...Don't do something like that all of a sudden! I almost tripped!
In the summer, it's so hot, even in the evening... I'm going to go buy something cool to drink.
Hello, hello~! My name is Iori Minase! It's such a pleasure to meet you! ...Huh? There's no need for me to force myself...? Hey, wait a second, what do you mean by that?!
My name is Iori Minase! My goal? Of course it's becoming a top idol♪ You should feel honored every second you're in the presence of the super idol, Iori! Heehee♪
Hello, hello~! My name is Iori Minase! It's such a pleasure to meet you! ...Huh? There's no need for me to force myself...? Hey, wait a second, what do you mean by that?!
Good morning... Wait, what's with that pathetic look on your face? There's no way you're still half-asleep, right?
You want to come into my room? Hey, don't just casually walk in when I haven't even given you permission!
This office isn't bad at all. Still, when compared to my room, it needs work.
"Manjuus" refers to those round birdies at the port, it seems. I thought everyone was referring to the snack.
Do you really think you have time to rest? Can't you see the mountain of work piled up in front of you?
Eek! ...Hey, can you not touch me out of the blue?!
Can I help you? Don't just stare blankly, answer me!
Eek! ...Where do you think you're touching!
You still have work left to do? Hurry up and get it done!
You're finally done. Though, considering the amount, it's only to be expected.
There's some mail for you. Since I've gone out of my way to let you know, go and check it ASAP!
Oh, you're back? Perfect timing, it's time for you to accompany for tea time!
Oh, it looks like they're back from commissions. I suppose I can go greet them in person.
That's pretty good. I guess I can thank you for this.
Are these guys even worthy of being my opponent?
How naive of you to think that you'd be a match for me!
I, Iori Minase... lost? I'll take some more lessons, and I swear I won't lose next time!
Make sure you keep your eyes on me!
This is nothing I can't handle!
Oh. So you were here all along?
I'm thirsty... Huh, this orange juice is for me? And it's 100% orange juice to boot! You've got sense!
I have a close friend who's been with me all the way since my childhood. Isn't that right, Bunny-bun?
I wonder what I can do to shine more brilliantly on stage...? Sing harder? Make the performance flashier? ...Right, since you're here anyway, I'd like to hear what you think.
The view from here is so gorgeous... Eek! You! Say something if you're there! ...Well, it's fine. Why don't you come sit here and enjoy the view as well?
You've come to understand me quite well, haven't you. If you take your eyes off of my brilliant presence in the future, I'll never forgive you!
Huh... This is for me...? Th-thank you! I'll accept it with gratitude!
Ami, stop playing around! Let's go!
This much is nothing! Heehee♪
Azusa, let's go!

ex.line: You're finally here! You've got some nerve, making me wait like this!

What brings you here this time around? ...You look super tired, so I guess it can't be helped. I'll make a special exception for you this time and let you rest in my room. You should be grateful for my magnanimity!
How dare you leave me to be bored! Wait a second, don't just fall asleep on me! You're supposed to be talking with me!
The port canteen has so many kinds of food from all over the world, including ones I've never seen. It almost feels like I've just gone on a trip to many different countries!
I'd sure love to be drinking some orange juice right now~♪ ... Hey, stop complaining and get me some!
Wh...What are you doing, you complete horndog! You absolute pervert!
You're still not done? I wouldn't mind lending you a hand... you know?
Finally done with your work? I have to admit, you do deserve some praise every now and then.
I'll show you just how brightly I can shine!
Behold the true might of the super idol, Iori! Heehee♪
Hey, puff up your chest with pride. You're part of the reason I'm able to shine so brightly over here as well. ...I'll be expecting great things from you in the future as well, Commander! Heehee~♪

lines.line: Blowing bubbles while sitting on a swing... It might seem a bit childish, but there's nothing wrong with enjoying activities like these every so often.
Blowing bubbles while sitting on a swing... It might seem a bit childish, but there's nothing wrong with enjoying activities like these every so often.
Oh, it's you. You've come at the perfect time. Get behind me and give me a push!
In order to create even bigger bubbles... slowly... like this... Eek! Say something if you're there!
Spending time here with you all is actually pretty nice. What are we doing next?
Since we're here on vacation, we've just got to try some of the local cuisine. You've done your research, right?
Hey, just because it's vacation doesn't mean you can slack off! Don't you even dream of napping. Come and accompany me to the beach!
Eek! ...Hey, can you not touch me out of the blue?!
Popping the bubbles? I didn't know you had a childish side to you.
Hey, stop that! You creep! Degenerate! Absolute pervert!
Since you're back, come keep me company. It's not every day I get to take a vacation. It'd be such a waste not to enjoy it to the fullest!
Why hello, my name's Azusa Miura~ Um, this is a port, right? And these are... shipgirls? Um~ Where exactly am I?

My name is Azusa Miura. I decided to debut as an idol after graduating junior college. As for the specific reason why I chose this career... I suppose it was in hopes I'll one day find the person of my dreams.
Why hello, my name's Azusa Miura~ Um, this is a port, right? And these are... shipgirls? Um~ Where exactly am I?
Good morning, Commander. Let's have a good day of work, shall we?
You'd like to chat with me? Of course we can do that. Please, have a seat.
Some destroyers came up to me the other day and wouldn't let me leave until I played a game with them. Hehehe~ Everyone here are such lovely people.
I have a poor memory for directions, so I often get lost. I've already needed people to come find me several times at this port... It's quite awkward for me.
You have so many types of cuisine on offer in the cafeteria. And they all taste so delicious... I need to watch it so I don't overeat.
My, oh my~ Is there something on your mind, Commander? I can lend an ear if you'd like to talk about it.
My luck forecast for today is... Oh? Would you like your fortune read too, Commander?
Eek! What was that for, Commander?
My, oh my. We still have work to do. Let's tackle them one at a time.
Hehe~ Job completed. Excellent work.
A new letter has come in. Would you like me to go get it?
Welcome back, Commander. Would you like some tea and a snack while you rest?
The commission team has returned to port. What diligent girls they all are.
Thank you for helping me grow, Commander.
Fighting is by no means my forte, but I'll do the best I can.
We've finished! How is everyone? No bruises or scratches?
Is everyone okay? We should find a safe place to retreat to, quick!
I hope you'll all enjoy this next song!
I must finish what I set out to do...!
Sorry, I just... I just don't know what to talk about with you.
What is it, Commander? ...Ah, you found my lost handkerchief? Thank you so much.
Good day to you, Commander. I went for a stroll just today and got lost on the way... Would you please show me the way to the dormitory?
Oh, Commander, perfect timing. I had some free time and cooked up some food, but I wound up making way too much. Care to join me for dinner?
Sorry that I always make you lead me around the port. I've just gotten so reliant on the comfort of having you show me the way when I get lost... Hehehe~
I don't know if it was my destiny to come here and meet you and the girls under your command, but I'm glad I did, and I'll treasure this memory always.
Hehehe. I am very fond of this~. Thank you very much, Commander.
Oh dear. What is this place, Ritsuko?
Let's do our best, Chihaya!
Oh dear... Wait for me, Iori!

ex.line: There may be a lot of hard work ahead of us, but let's hang in there and get it done, Commander.
Hello, Commander. May I suggest taking a short break? I'll put on some tea in the meanwhile.
Ah, are you taking a nap, Commander? Work is important, of course, but your health should always come first. Let's see if I can find a blanket to cover you with...
The cheese they have at the canteen looks divine... I should buy some and put it on toast, just to try it... Although, I really shouldn't. I wouldn't want to put on weight.
What room is this? ...Oh, greetings, Commander. Sorry, but would you mind showing me to the dining hall?
C-Commander... Please be more delicate with your hands...
We're almost there, Commander. Just a few more tasks. I'll help with them, of course.
Job well done, Commander! I'm glad you're so diligent.
As long as I'm with you, I'm sure I'll never get lost!
I'm so glad we won. It wouldn't have been possible without everyone's help!
You're the reason I've managed to come this far, Commander. Allow me to sincerely thank you for always coming to my aid when I wander off~

lines.line: Listening to the wind flow through the chimes on the porch seems to carry the summer heat right away. Commander, would you also like to come unwind with me?
Listening to the wind flow through the chimes on the porch seems to carry the summer heat right away. Commander, would you also like to come unwind with me?
Whew, it's so hot today. Make sure you drink plenty of water so you don't get dehydrated.
Oh! Thank you for coming all this way in the blistering heat. Let's see... I should have something cool to snack on in the fridge.
As much as I love cooling off in an air-conditioned room, it's also nice to sit on the veranda and just feel the breeze.
Oh dear, the winds have died down. Then I'll instead use this paper fan to help you keep cool, Commander.
There are many kinds of wind chimes in the world. Some are made of metal, others are made of glass. I enjoy listening for the slight differences in sound between them all.
This yukata feels so much breezier than the clothes I usually wear. I recommend trying one for yourself, Commander.
Are you okay, Commander? You look like you're suffering from a heatstroke... Wait here. I'll fetch you some ice and a sports drink right away.
Welcome back from the summer heat, Commander. I'll get you a bottle of cold tea.
Pleased to meet you. My name is Ritsuko Akizuki. I was wondering what was going to happen to me when I suddenly got blown away, but... In any case, I'm pleased to make your acquaintance!
My name's Ritsuko Akizuki. I always give everything my best shot! And that includes working as an idol at this port. On a related note... Wow, you have a lot of shipgirls with potential starpower!
Pleased to meet you. My name is Ritsuko Akizuki. I was wondering what was going to happen to me when I suddenly got blown away, but... In any case, I'm pleased to make your acquaintance!
Let's have a look at our schedule and see what we have to do today, Commander.
It's important you closely read an idol's bio to grasp all her strengths. Take all the time you need.
Oops. Sorry for spacing out, Commander. I'm juggling several things at once right now...
It's good we all came here together, but that means things are as hectic as ever... Hey! Ami! Mami! Get back here! What are those shovels for?!
If we spruce up our choreography a bit, it should take our performance to the next level. Let's do it! We'll rehearse it for our next show!
Goodness gracious, your hair is even messier than mine, Commander. Please, for your own sake, pay a little more attention to your appearance!
You need a hand with your work? Of course! I'll make sure everything comes out looking flawless!
Commander! Your time is better spent on doing work than doing... that!
There's still work left for us to do! Chop-chop! Let's wrap it up quick!
Great! You've finished that task. Don't forget to claim the rewards.
There's new mail for you. Best to read it now, before you forget.
Good to see you back, Commander. Take a moment to relax before our next task.
Those girls are back from their commission. Hellooo? It's time to get up and welcome them back, Commander!
Steady progress! Everything is going exactly according to plan!
Everyone, let's stay sharp!
We've completed the job. Just as I predicted!
I suppose this means my prediction was wrong... I'll have to fix the kinks in the system!
It's showtime!
I'm not giving up until it's over...!
What about our last concert could we improve on...? Oh, excuse me, but I don't have the time right now.
Ah, Commander! Just who I was looking for. Do you have a full-length mirror anywhere? I could really use one for dance rehearsal.
Well done today, Commander. You're keeping yourself busy as always. Say, do you need help with something? I've got some spare time right now.
Your job description has a lot in common with that of a producer's. I feel I could learn new things by watching you, actually... Would you mind letting me do that, when you have time?
I've learned so much and gained experience I never would've otherwise by watching you work. I feel my horizons have expanded to the point I can come up with novel new strategies!
The things I've learned here will prove invaluable for my career, moving forward. So, allow me to say it once again: Thank you for everything, Commander!
Now that's my commander♪ You know exactly the kinda things I like, don't you?
Mami! No more mischief, got it?
Where have you been, Azusa?!
Haruka, your could improve you choreography by doing it more like... This!

ex.line: Good morning. Have you had breakfast yet? You can't live life without basic routines!
You'd like to get to know me better? My bio should have all the essential information, but okay... What do you want to know?
Are you feeling worn out, Commander? You should get some rest, in that case. We all need breaks sometimes.
This port is home to girls from all kinds of places, huh? Every time I talk to them, I feel my perspective of the world grow.
Having a hard time there, Commander? I could help, if you want. Don't worry, I know what to do. I've done plenty of office work before.
Eek! What do you think you're doing, Commander?! You need to learn some decency. Sit down so I can lecture you.
There's still work to be done. I'll assist you, so let's get right to it.
Wow! You're quite the diligent one, Commander.
My preliminary investigation was right on the mark!
It's all thanks to me? Please, you're giving me way too much credit!
You fell asleep again, didn't you, Commander? Now, now, it's time to get up. Actually... Seeing as you've been swamped with work recently, I guess I'll let you off the hook this once.

lines.line: Sorry, what? A paddle showdown? Commander, please... You play that in a kimono, not a yutaka. But if you insist... If I win, you're buying me an ice cream!
Sorry, what? A paddle showdown? Commander, please... You play that in a kimono, not a yutaka. But if you insist... If I win, you're buying me an ice cream!
Good morning. Just give me a moment while I roll up my futon... Wait, I said wait! You can't come in yet!
It's important to stay hydrated and replenish your electrolytes when exercising in the heat. Otherwise you could get a heatstroke!
Exercising? Indoors? In the middle of summer? I mean... It's better than doing it under the sweltering sun, but not by a lot...
The ventilation in here actually isn't half-bad. You just part the sliding doors and it gets almost as cool as an air-conditioned room... Okay, maybe that's an exaggeration...
Are you all right? You look like you're about to pass out. Knowing you, you're probably pushing yourself too hard. Here, take this sports drink.
Check out this serve! ...Heheh! Another point to me! It's still not too late to give up, Commander!
Eek! H-hey! It's not okay to do that stuff in the heat of the game!
How about we take a quick break? And no, before you ask: I'm NOT conceding the match. We'll pick up where we left off after I've had some water!
Nihihi! I'm the idol, Ami Futami! This place seems awfully lively, just perfect for pranking~! See you around, Commander!
The name's Ami Futami. Mami's my twin. Sometimes, I swap places with her for the day~ To tell you the truth, I might not be Ami, but actually Mami... Teehee~♪
Nihihi! I'm the idol, Ami Futami! This place seems awfully lively, just perfect for pranking~! See you around, Commander!
Still asleep~? Nihihi~ Practically begging to be pranked...
Are you that curious about me? Well, you'll have to beat me in a game first~
There are so many people at the port~! I wonder who I should prank next~♪
Yay!!! I pulled an SSR!!! I feel crazy lucky today~☆
Hey hey, Commander~ ...Hmm? What am I going to be doing with this broom? Fufufu~ That's a secret, of course♪
You planning on pranking me?...Interesting, bring it on~!
What's that? You're going to play with me? What a boss!
Ohoho~ So you're that kind of person after all~?
By any chance, is there still work left? If you don't hurry up and finish... Boss, the day's going to be over.
Mission complete~! Don't you think I worked pretty hard too?
It seems like there's some new mail~ You listening, Commander~?
Good job beating'em, Commander! I'm beat, too~ Let's have a snack break~
Everyone did a good job returning safely! I should go and praise them!
Level~up! Thanks, Commander!
Who's next on the chopping block~?
Did you catch that? My shiny performance?
Uh oh! My HP gauge is red!!! Retreaaat!
Tremble in the face of my power!
The legend of Ami Futami has only just begun!
It's hopeless... We can't clear the stage like this, Commander~ ...Please work a bit harder, Commander~
Oh, Commander! Have you seen Mami around? Hmm. We had promised to play games together though...
Let's see... Let's put a blackboard eraser above the door to the office, and a toy rat on the chair... Woaoh! You're already back, Commander?! Tsk. Foiled again~
Yeah yeah. Commander, I'm going to mimic your expression right now! ...Huh, it's not similar at all? That's strange~ When I showed my impression to everyone else, they said it was super similar~
Nihihi~ Who do you think this is! ...Eh, Ami? You're correct~! As expected of the Commander! As a prize, I'll share some of my sweets with you~
You know, showing up here, and playing with you and the others has been super fun for me~♪ I'll be relying on you to keep me entertained in the future as well, Commander!
This is one of my faves! That's my Commander!
Let's make this a super epic stage together, Mami!
Harurun, don't go tripping on us now!
Iorin! Looking stylish as always~

ex.line: Good mornin', Commander! What should we do for fun today!?
Nihihi~♪ Commander, you're quite the gamer yourself, aren'tcha~
So this is the Commander's office? Unexpected stylish... Nihihi~♪ Wonder if there are any dirty books... at the edge of this bookcase over here...
The store here carries so, so many kinds of candy! Hmm... It's a real struggle trying to pick what to buy, isn't it, Mami?
Commander, are ya slackin' off? If so, let's play some games together! I've been struggling with the last boss for a while~
Oh, Commander~ No matter how irresistible you might find me to be, that's not allowed~
Looks like you've still got some work to take care of. Right now, I'll do you a suuuper special favor, and give you a hand~♪
We're finally done, Commander! Well then, it's time for a well-deserved pudding break...
Everyone! Follow Captain Ami's lead~!
Vic~to~ry~! Hmm~ I'll take a special milk pudding as my reward♪

Hey hey, I'll be playing games with Mami on my next day off. Won'tcha join us, Commander? Make sure you bring some pudding with you when you come~! We'll make sure to bring some candy to munch on as well!

lines.line: Summer's all about the festivals, and Ami Futami's the queen of festivals! Even the fireworks soaring through the sky can't hold a candle to how brilliant Ami is, so keep your eyes on me, Commander~♪
Summer's all about the festivals, and Ami Futami's the queen of festivals! Even the fireworks soaring through the sky can't hold a candle to how brilliant Ami is, so keep your eyes on me, Commander~♪
Oh, Commander! Have you come to gaze upon my gallant figure?
Did you see my mad drumming skills~? I'll work hard to make sure everyone else feels as hyped for the festival as I am~☆
I can see the festival grounds clearly from here! Now now, I wonder where the Commander might be~?
Aren't these clothes like, super fashionable~?
Commander, let's compete in some festival games! Cork gun shooting, yo-yo fishing, goldfish scooping... Nihihi~ Just letting you know, I'm not going to lose~!
Commander, do you want to try drumming on the taiko? Nihihi, I wonder if you really can drum better than I can~
Whoa there! My sash is going to come undone~!
It's break time~ I sure would like to go around the carts and eat a bunch of tasty stuff~ *Glance*
Nihihi~♪ I'm the idol, Mami Futami! You'll get to feast your eyes on how alluring Mami is, so look forward to it, Commander~!
The name's Mami Futami. Ami's my twin. When we do our hair the same way, we look exactly alike~! You think I'm actually Ami and not Mami? Ehehe~ Who knows~♪
Nihihi~♪ I'm the idol, Mami Futami! You'll get to feast your eyes on how alluring Mami is, so look forward to it, Commander~!
Commander, are you still asleep? If you don't get up soon, I'm gonna doodle all over your face~
You want to know more about me~? If you play with me, I'll show~ it~ all~!
There are so many people at the port that I can show my pose off to! If I train like this, I'll be able to become sexier in no time♪
Hey Commander, are you dozing off? Heh, I guess I'll use this opportunity to put some 'special' pictures on their desk...
Hiya Commander! Hm? What am I doing with this package? Hehehe~ Expect great things☆
What is it? Do you want to play games with me, Commander?
Oh, Commander! If you're free, come play with me~!
Commander, has my mature allure made you fall head over hells for me~?
Commander... let's finish work quickly and get it over with, yeah?
Yay! We're done, Commander~! Now, let's go back and play games together!
Looks like there's a letter for you? I wonder if it's a love letter from someone~
Welcome back, Commander! Hey hey, isn't it snack time yet~?
Good job returning safely! To the victor go the spoils!
Don'tcha think I leveled up my mature allure stat~?
I wonder what kind of prank I should pull~
Yay, I won~! Let's see, what are the drops this time around~?
Uegh! This wasn't in the job description~! Hurry up and retreat!
Mature allure, full blast~☆
This is the part where I show off my true power...
Wowow, even though I had the Commander pull for me, I didn't get a single Rare character!
Oh, Commander! Have you seen Ami around? Hmm. We had promised to eat pudding together though...
Save me, Commander! I got caught pulling a prank, and now I'm getting chased around! Let me hide over here for a bit~!
I saw a really tasty pudding at the store earlier~! Oh, I sure want to eat some with the Commander~ ...Huh, you're going to buy some? That's the Commander for ya♪
Gotta be careful so I don't wake them up... quietly... Woah, you were awake? ...I-I'm not playing a prank on you, I was just trying to drape a blanket over you! Believe me, Commander!
Commander! I'm so very terri-bully thankful that you always play with me~! The mature, alluring Mami, will continue to work hard in the future, so please look forward to it~♪
That's my Commander! You know my absolute faves like the back of your hand!
Let's get this party started!
Uh-oh, h-how about we work together for now, Ricchan~?
That's our Iorin for ya~♪

ex.line: Good mornin', Commander! Take a good look! Don't I look absolutely dazzling today~?
Go go, Commander! Get the combo there! ...Yay~! We finished the game! Commander, you're not half bad~
Commander~! Take a look at this pose! Don't I look totally alluring? It's going right to your head, isn't it~?
Hey hey hey~ Let's go to the canteen together, Commander! I'll treat you to a ton of tasty food!
So this is the Commander's office~! Nihihi~ It's time for the bombshell treasure hunter, Mami, to hunt for treasure...
No matter how enchanted you might be by my beauty, you can't do that, Commander!
It looks like you've still got some work left to do. Let's get it over with! I'll cheer you on from the sidelines~
To the Commander who worked extra hard, extra headpats!
Captain Mami is here to lead the charge~!
Did you become bedazzled by my mature allure?
Commander, I'm here to pick you up! You promised to play games with me and the others today, right~? Come on, let's go~! ...Oh, and can we stop by the store on the way there?

lines.line: Woah~! They're starting to send up the huge fireworks! ...Hey, Commander, just where are you looking? Did Mami's alluring yukata make you go crazy with desire~?
Woah~! They're starting to send up the huge fireworks! ...Hey, Commander, just where are you looking? Did Mami's alluring yukata make you go crazy with desire~?
Commander, you're such a slowpoke! We'll be hitting up every stall, so hurry hurry♪
Why is my yukata knee-length? Well, that's to bewitch everyone with my alluring legs, of course... Huh, it has no effect on you? Come on Commander, no need to lie~
Let's see who's better at cork gun shooting first! Then when I win, you can buy me some takoyaki~♪
Don't die on me now, we're heading to the next stall~♪ Today, we're having fun 'til we drop~!
Goldfish scooping, huh... Commander, does the store at the port sell aquariums?
You look hot, Commander. I'll do you a favor and cool you off with my fan! Take this, and that~!
Fufufu~ Looks like the Commander can't win against the summer heat either~
Wow, I'm so tired~ I sure wish I was drinking some nice, cold ramune right now~ (Glance)
Um, my name is Rikka Takarada. I'm still a bit confused about what's going on, but... I guess for the time being, I'm in good hands.
My name is Rikka Takarada. My family runs a pawn shop with a café, where I sometimes help out. At least I know how to brew coffee properly.
Um, my name is Rikka Takarada. I'm still a bit confused about what's going on, but... I guess for the time being, I'm in good hands.
Oh, good morning. You're unusually early today.
What's the matter, Commander? Eh, you wanted some coffee? Um, what's gotten into you... Well, come on in, I guess...
Huh. There's even a school over here... I'm sure you learn different stuff, but it's pretty neat how similar our worlds are.
Huh? Where'd Namiko and Hass wander off to? Jeez... I came all the way from the other side of port to look for them...
Oh, Commander, have you seen Akane? I thought we were going to hang out and all...
Um... Did you need me?
Huh, you need help with work? I was going to head to the shop, but... Well, fine, I guess. What'd you need?
Just so you know, that's called sexual harassment.
You're still not done yet? Fine, fine... Just let me know if there's anything I can help with.
Good job. Looks like our rewards are in too, so make sure you don't lose track of it.
Huh, there's something in the mailbox addressed to you, Commander... People still send letters this day and age?
Good job out there. Want me to whip up a latte to help you relax?
Oh, the girls are back. Hang on, I'll go greet them.
Huh, so I'm capable of doing stuff like this too... Thanks, Commander.
I've got to do this as well!
Phew... I somehow managed to pull through.
No way, I messed up?! Hurry up and retreat, everyone!
There's... something even I can do...!
I might've slipped up... but I can still do this!
Ah... Um...
Ugh, I bought the wrong flavor of soda... Oh hey, Commander. Were you thirsty by any chance?
Hum hum~♪ Oh, good morning, Commander. Hehe, yeah, I'm in a pretty good mood...
Oh hey, Commander, there you are... I've been looking for you. Here, you dropped this pen outside your office earlier today.
At first, I was confused about the whole fighting-in-another-world thing, but I think I've gotten the hang of it. I owe it to everyone here, as well as to you...

When I first landed in this world, confused and lost, everyone here extended their hospitality to me. Especially you, Commander. I hope you'll continue to do everything you can to keep this place special.
No way... I love this stuff... Thank you so much, Commander!
With you here, Akane, I can do anything!|
Hass, I'll cover you!
Jeez... Namiko, we have to get going!

ex.line: Y'know, It sure feels weird not having to go to school in the morning...
Your coffee, Commander. Thanks for waiting so patiently. How does it taste?
Excuse me... Oh, huh. You're asleep already? Work must've been tough. I'll be waiting here until you wake up.
The shops here really have everything. I wish we had something like this back where I'm from.
This PC's not turning on? Hm, let's check if it's plugged in... (*thump*) What's wrong? Why do you look like you saw a ghost?
Whaaa?! What's the meaning of this?!
Please continue working. I'll brew something for you to drink, so stay focused until the very end.
Well done. Since you worked so hard, why not take a little break?
This time, it's my turn to fight.
Thank goodness... Everyone's safe and sound.
Back then, I wasn't able to fight the enemy head-on. But this time, I have the power to help others. Now, I swear to fight for you and everyone else.

lines.line: The train still isn't here yet? ...Oh, what a coincidence to see you here, Commander. Where were you headed?
The train still isn't here yet? ...Oh, what a coincidence to see you here, Commander. Where were you headed?
Mm-hmm~ What lovely weather. Wonder where I should go today~
A brand new look, a long train ride... All that's missing is a partner to keep me company. Yeah, as if...
I've got nothing else to do 'til the train arrives... Oh, that's right. The other day, I went to play with some of the girls back at the port...
Huh, look at all the pigeons gathering around. Well, I guess that's one way to beat the heat...
I wonder where I'll end up if I take this train to the end of the line. Well, being in a different world and all that makes me curious...
Hum hum~♪ Oh, it looks like the train is finally about to arrive.
Wh-what do you think you're trying to do in public?! There's no way you'd normally be able to get away with this!
Here, Commander. Do you prefer juice or tea?
Ack, Commander?! Geez, look, I at least want to be able to relax in my own room. Let it go just this once, okay?
Ack, Commander?! Geez, look, I at least want to be able to relax in my own room. Let it go just this once, okay?
Mm~ How about we take it easy today?
I'm always dressed like this at home... but nobody but my family sees me when I am. Consider yourself special, Commander.
I like this outfit. It's all soft and comfy.
You really gotta prioritize comfort when you pick bedroom clothes~
Don't complain about just a little mess! Gosh, you sound like my mom.
Can't take your eyes off of me when I dress casually, right? That's it, isn't it?
Wh-whoa, okay, that's a little too much touching!
You seem tired, Commander... Want to rest here with me? I can keep a secret.
Hey there, the name's Akane Shinjo. This rigging looks super cool, like it's right out of a mecha. Now if only there were some kaiju around, that'd be the best...
The name's Akane Shinjo. Apparently I'm a battleship in this universe? I'm not much of a fighter, so don't be surprised if I get done in... Juuust kidding~
Hey there, the name's Akane Shinjo. This rigging looks super cool, like it's right out of a mecha. Now if only there were some kaiju around, that'd be the best...
Oh, hey. About time you showed up, Commander.
Kaijus are freakin' awesome. I love their moves and personalities... and I love sculpting them. Are you a fellow kaiju enjoyer, Commander?
I'm totally loving how sweet these shipgirl riggings look. I wonder how they'd look in action.
The store sells like, a hundred different kinds of tomato juice. They all look so good, so I went and bought them all~
Come to think of it, this rigging reminds me of an old friend. What kind of person were they? Mm... I dunno if "person" is the right word~
Hmm... Did you need something, Commander?
The store's got books for sale, right? Let's go check it out.
Jeez, you shouldn't do that~
You know we're not done yet, right, Commander? Get back in the game.
Hey, not too shabby, Commander~
Your mail's still sitting there. If you're not going to read 'em, then I will~
Look who's back. Maybe I oughta reward you for your efforts out there... Yeah, nah.
The girls are back in port, huh? Go say hi to them, would you?
Ooh, feelin' pretty good. Thanks, Commander.
I wonder what kind of enemy we'll get to fight today~?
Ahahah! Piece of cake!
The hell? How are these guys so strong? Doesn't make any damn sense...
Take aim and... fireeeee!
It'll take more than that to get rid of me~
Ahaha... Wow, you really are worthless.
Oops! Sorry, I didn't mean to- Oh, hi Commander. Hey, don't sweat it, we only bumped into each other. Still, I'm glad you're all polite and stuff.
There you are, Commander. Want to tag along with me to the store? I need to restock my sculpting materials and all that~
An apple a day keeps the Sirens at bay, Commander. C'mon, you need some breakfast in your system. Let's get you to the cafeteria.
Y'know, I'm glad I got the chance to experience this universe and make a bunch of new friends. Especially you, my more-than-just-friends friend... Or are we~? Hehehe~
It's so nice having people I can count on. People who readily wanted to get to know me. It's changed my perspective on life, honestly. Thank you, Commander.
Ohhh, this is it, this is it! You know me well, Commander!
Really glad you could make it, Rikka.
Are you a fellow kaiju enjoyer, Mujina?
Dang, Chise! Your rigging looks sweet~

ex.line: Oh, if it isn't the Commander~ Good timing too. I was starting to get bored.
Check it out! I made a new figure! I put extra effort into the details on this one. Feel like praising me, Commander?
Zzz... Heheh... Caught you reachin', Commander. If you admit it, I might let you keep going~ Or maybe not, hehe.
Commander, are you working hard, or hardly working? ...The former? Really? All you've been doing is staring off into space though.
Good on you for keeping your office nice and tidy... How's my room in comparison? Sorry, that's top-secret.
Ah, you're what they call a hands-on person, eh?
Look at that. Unfinished missions. I'll be here for moral support if you need it.
Whoa, you finished a mission. Real nice work.
Hanging out with you all is kinda fun.
Aw yeah! We got 'em!
You hold a pretty special place in my heart, Commander... Huh? Is that a blush I see~?

lines.line: Welcome back, Commander. You sure brought a lot of goodies back for me, huh? Now then, don't just keep standing there, hurry and come to me~
Welcome back, Commander. You sure brought a lot of goodies back for me, huh? Now then, don't just keep standing there, hurry and come to me~
Huuh? ...Oh, come on in, Commander...
I hardly let anyone inside my room. You're a big exception, y'know~ ...Huh, what's behind my cushion? Is THAT what you want to know~?
What's in the bag? Stuff I bought at the store just earlier. Paper, kaiju figs, et cetera et cetera.
This cushion is super comfy. Go on, give it a feel, Commander.
What'cha doing, sitting across the room like that? C'mon, there's space right here. I don't bite.
Oh man, I'm starving. We should get some home delivery.
Ahaha... Only 'cause we're alone, all right?
Welcome back, Commander. I've got some snacks for you, a little reward for working so hard!
Hey, Commander, what's up~? You're not intoxicated by my good looks, are you? Pssh, lighten up, I'm kidding~
Hey, Commander, what's up~? You're not intoxicated by my good looks, are you? Pssh, lighten up, I'm kidding~
Mmm~ This isn't really a place you should be visiting so often... I'm kidding. You're always welcome here, Commander.
You're bold coming this far, Commander. Not that I mind as long as it's you. I don't have much in the way of hospitality... but you don't mind, do you~?
Hmmm~, what are you looking at? You should be more careful~
It's a little bit of a mess, but don't worry about it. Or what? Do you want to clean up for me?
Hmmm... There might not be enough space for two to sleep, y'know? Or do you want to try that badly?
Look, I wouldn't mind a massage...
Hmm~ Why do I feel a sense of danger?
Aww, what? You came home and you just had to come to me first? If seeing me soothes your fatigue, then knock yourself out!
Hello, I'm Hass. I was suddenly blown away to this strange place... But, I guess it seems interesting enough here. By the way, is it okay to shoot some videos here?

Full-time high schooler and part-time light cruiser, Hass, reporting for duty. In my original world, I used to stream for fun as well. Is that a thing here? Let me know if there are any legendary streamers around these parts.
Hello, I'm Hass. I was suddenly blown away to this strange place... But, I guess it seems interesting enough here. By the way, is it okay to shoot some videos here?
Look who's here. Well then, guess we'll get started now.
Huh, you want to know more about me? Well, you'll have to bribe me with some donuts first.
Wow, this is such a nice spot~ I can't stop taking pictures.
Namiko and Rikka sure are late. We're supposed to be meeting here at the central garden... Well, I guess they don't know their way around yet, so it can't be helped.
Heh, so these cat-like things are called Meowfficers. How adorable... Super fluffy too~ I just bought some sweet potato sticks, here, take one!
Hmm? If you want something, say it to my face~
Oh, nice timing, Commander. I was just starting to feel a bit listless. Why don't you take me around to some hidden gems around the port?
Hey, officer, over here.
Oh, looks like you've still got work left to do. I know you want to hang out, but... take care of your work first.
You get some pretty nice things for completing your work, don't ya. Feeling kinda jealous here, Commander.
Commander, you've got mail, you know. I'd suggest you take a look at it before it disappears under some more mail.
Oh, welcome back. Perfect timing, c'mere and take a look at this video.
Good work, everyone. Find anything interesting while you were out?
Hmm, this is what leveling up feels like? It's true that I do feel a bit stronger.
Wonder if I can record this in secret...
See, that's what you get for messing with me.
Wait, nobody told me they were this strong. I can't believe they wouldn't pull their punches against a weak girl like me!
All ready to go live~
This is where I say... the battle starts now!
Sigh... Looks like you were just another of those guys in the end...
Commander, are there any cafés around here? I was looking to snack on some sweets. Wait, you'll go with me? What a gent.
Hold up, why have you been staring at my face for so long... Eh, you want to know why I wear this mask? Well, there are a few reasons...
Commander~? What might you have been doing with that girl last night~? ...Huh? I'm mistaken? There's no way! C'mon, just tell me already~
Looks like I'm finally used to this place. Y'know, at first I was wondering what the heck I was supposed to do here. But these days, I've been having a pretty good time.
I've somehow managed to make it this far in this world thanks to you and your guidance. Well, I'll keep doing my best to live up to your expectations... Let's get'em, Commander.
Huh? Is this for me? You're magical, Commander! Thanks!
There's nothing to worry about with you around, Akane!
Rikka is so precious~
Namiko, let's get this over with~

ex.line: Yo, morning. I'm amazed you even manage to get up in the morning~
Huh, Commander? You brought gifts... Wait, are those the super popular sweets that everyone's talking about?! Yay! Come on in and share the goods!
Commander! The menu here at the cafeteria is pretty impressive! There are so many dishes I've never even heard of... I bet I'll get a bunch of likes if I upload these pictures to my socials.
Eh? Huh?? Were you... asleep? Sleeping even though the deadline is right around the corner... you've got nerves of steel...
Commander, your office might look nice and tidy, but when I open your shelf, I bet your documents are totally going to... not rain down everywhere? Welp, what was I expecting...
Hey Commander, your pranks are going a bit overboard.
You're at the final stretch with your work, aren't ya? I'll put some music on, so let's focus and wrap things up~
Good work. Well then, let's go and feast on some sweets~
Follow my lead, guys.
I'm invincible with my friends around~
Yo, Commander. I'm about to head out to hang out with my friends, wanna tag along? No need to worry, I'm sure everyone would love to see you there.

lines.line: Hass here. Tonight, we're going to take a walk around the port at night. Aaaand, we even have a special guest- the Commander! ...Psst, hey, look at the camera real quick!
Hass here. Tonight, we're going to take a walk around the port at night. Aaaand, we even have a special guest- the Commander! ...Psst, hey, look at the camera real quick!
You're finally here. Well, let me start explaining how today's shoot is supposed to go...
Sigh... I'm so tired of editing. Commander, wanna head out for some tea?
The next shop should be the last one... After we're done, let's go on a date, just you and me... Just kidding, of course. What are you getting all flustered for?
Oh, you're lending me your jacket? You're good, aren't ya.
You think I look taller than usual? Nah, I'm telling you, you're just imagining things... Oh no, wait, don't look down at my feet!
Jeez, hey. Your eyes have been glued down there for some time now. You surely wouldn't mind telling me what you've been looking at, right, Commander?
Wait, I'll get banned from streaming...
Where do we head first... to this super popular café, or to that restaurant that's about to be the next big thing... Mmn, help me think this through, Commander~
Heyyo, it's Namiko! Uhh, wait, is this that whole getting-reincarnated-in-another-world thing that's been super popular? ...It's not, huh. Well, in any case, nice to meet you!

Hey, it's Namiko. In my original world, I went to the same high school as Hass and the others. I was also in the Tea Ceremony Club... Wh-what do you mean that's hard to believe? Sit over there, right now. I'll show you not to judge a book by its cover!
Heyyo, it's Namiko! Uhh, wait, is this that whole getting-reincarnated-in-another-world thing that's been super popular? ...It's not, huh. Well, in any case, nice to meet you!
sup, Commander, good morning! Just barely beat the bell, huh?
Yo, Commander! Got some juicy gossip for me? Like, any news on who's into who~?
Huh, that's weird... I thought we were supposed to meet over here... Oh, Commander, have you seen Hass and Rikka?
Woah! That's a crazy amount of paperwork you've got on your desk, Commander. Your job's pretty rough, isn't it?
Huh, so this academy offers different classes for different ship types? That's pretty neat, but I'm not exactly the studious-- Ehh? Commander, where are you taking me?!
Heh~ heh. Got me on your mind~?
Ooh, you even have your own social media-looking thing over here. Woah, this shop's sweets look freakin' amazing. Commander, wanna come with?
Nope! No touching! Hands off!
You still have work you haven't finished, right? Shouldn't you go take care of it first?
Great job, Commander! You're all done with work!
A letter addressed to the Commander... No, no... No matter how juicy it looks, I can't just go through somebody else's mail...
Welcome back! Let's hurry on over to the café~
Great job out there, everyone! Wow, that's an equally impressive haul of rewards!
All right, now I'm all fired up! Thanks a bunch!
Don't underestimate a high-school girl!
Booyah! Pretty badass, aren't I?
Stop! Time out! I give up, so stop firing at meeee!
Let's take 'em out in one shot!
As if I'd let you stop me here!
H-hey, need something from me?
Look, look, Commander! Doesn't this parfait look absolutely wild? The girls here recommended this amazing place to me!
