Commander, you on Juustagram as well? If so, gimme your ID so I can follow you~!
Hey Commander, got some free time? There's a new set meal at the canteen that looks totally god-tier. Wanna join me?
You'd like some tea? You could've gotten black tea at the club... Huh, you're not talking about that? Well, we can always throw a big tea party with the others next time!

At first, I seriously had no clue what this port was all about, or what shipgirls were. But thanks to you, I'm having a blast here. I look forward to living it up over here, being the best heavy cruiser that I can be!
Is this for me?! I love this stuff, you know! You're seriously a genius, Commander!
Hass, let's head to the café after we're all done here!
Yume, we cool?
Rikka, I'm counting on you!

ex.line: Huh, you're pretty early today. Did something good happen?
So, Commander, you definitely have someone you're crushin' on, right? ...Seriously, you don't? C'mon, don't be like that. Just between the two of us, I swear I won't tell anyone?
Oy, Commander, wake up! Do you really have time to laze around when you still have so much work left?
Hm? Need me to help with your work? Sure, but you owe me juice afterwards~
The girls here are all such pearls, you know that? I promised to go on vacation with them the next time we have time off. I'm really looking forward to it~
W-w-w-wait a minute! Do you have any idea what you're doing?!
Huh? You're still not done with work? I'll lend a hand, so let's tackle this one step at a time.
We're finally done! Now, go get me that can of juice you promised!
Let's go all out~!
That attack... was TOTALLY BADASS!
Oh, Commander! You'd better not forget to come to the next tea party! Heh heh, I swear I'll show you why I'm awesome!

lines.line: Woo, you're here! So, how was it? This meeting spot was pretty easy to find, right? Welp, let's get going then!
Woo, you're here! So, how was it? This meeting spot was pretty easy to find, right? Welp, let's get going then!
Commander, I've been waiting for you! Got any plans on where we're going today?
Curious about what's in my bag? Commander, you should know better than to ask that to a lady. Well, it's pretty much just my wallet?
Is this... some kind of PC? I thought I saw something like it over at Rikka's place on several occasions.
Commander, I'm feeling a bit peckish... Huh? You're gonna treat me? Thanks a bunch!
Woah! Why's there an empty spray can lying around here? Thanks for the heads up, Commander, I nearly tripped and fell...
Wh-why are you acting all nervous? It's not like this is your f-first date or anything... Huh? It is?!
J-just because there aren't a lot of people around... doesn't mean you can do that...!
This mural... I swear I've seen it somewhere before. Mm, yeah, I'm sure of it...
Hello, my name is Yume Minami. I've ended up in this world for whatever reason. I'll do my best to contribute to the fleet as a heavy cruiser.

I'm Yume Minami, freshman at Fujiyokidai High. In my home universe, I fought kaijus, and in this one, I sink hostile ships out on the open sea... Go figure. Anyway, I'll do everything I can as best as I can.
Hello, my name is Yume Minami. I've ended up in this world for whatever reason. I'll do my best to contribute to the fleet as a heavy cruiser.
Hello and good morning. What are we practicing today?
You want to get to know me? Just... ask about me and I'll answer, I guess.
I've heard the Sirens pose a great threat to your world. Seems there's no such thing as a world without conflict...
What's with these big baby chicks, Commander? ...You call them "manjuus"? Huh. I guess that kind of fits...
Hum-hum, hmm...♪ Wait, was I humming just now?
Hey, wait! ...Achoo!
Access Mode: Dyna Wing! ...Welp. I suppose my rigging only looks like it. Oh man, I'm going to be so late to the meetup...
Seriously...?
I think, uhh... we should try to wrap up these last few missions.
Another mission completed, eh? Now excuse me, I'm taking a quick break.
There's a letter for you. I left it on your table. Try to read it as soon as you can.
Good to see you again, Commander. You should take a quick break before the battle.
Oh, looks like the commission team's come back.
I won't fall behind.
Access Mode! ...Oops. Force of habit.
Phew... I managed.
Okay, this is so not good... We've gotta get out of here, guys!
Something Beam!
I'm doing fine...!
Look, I... I'm sorry.
Enemies incoming, Commander? ...No, not at all? Then why'd you come to see me?
What is it this time? Hey, wait... That's one of my plushes. Thanks for bringing it to me, Commander.
Every place has its own rules and restrictions. Sometimes, though, you need to break the rules to do what's right... You know what I mean?
While I'm still getting used to living here, I wanna do anything I can to help... I'll keep fighting the good fight, even if I slip up along the way.
There'll no doubt be tons of struggles for me to deal with, but I'll tackle them with all I've got. I hope you'll stick with me throughout it all, Commander.
Huh? I can have this? ...I'm so happy.
Chise! Over here!
We're in this together, Mujina!
Namiko? Umm... Let's give it our best shot.
Cover me!
A kaiju?! ...No, now we're allies!

ex.line: Surely the Commander isn't going to be late to work, right...
Welcome back, Commander. You said you had something to ask me? Then let's sit down and talk.
Hum-hum, hmm...♪ Oh, welcome back, Commander. Sheesh, that's a huge pile of paperwork you've got. Need a hand with those?
Hey, a ring-and-string puzzle... I'm not great at puzzles or anything, but I've solved one like this before.
I'm usually uncomfortable in places with lots of people, but with how friendly all the shipgirls here are, I think I'll slowly fit in...
Umm, what are you trying to tell me...?
We still have missions to do. If I can help with them in any way, just let me know.
Mission completed. Great job, Commander.
Enemy fleet incoming... Ready up, everyone!
We were able to come together as one, right?
Hey, can you come see during break time? I want to really familiarize myself with this place, and I was hoping you could show me around...

lines.line: How lovely. From here, you can see across the entire port, as well as the shimmering ocean... Oh, Commander, here to enjoy the view with me?
How lovely. From here, you can see across the entire port, as well as the shimmering ocean... Oh, Commander, here to enjoy the view with me?
What a bright morning... Here's hoping today will be a good day.
I wonder what these flowers are called... Do you know by any chance, Commander?
Everyone's playing outside... Maybe I should ask if I can join them. Would you introduce me, Commander?
Whoa, careful there. You might bump your head on the ceiling if you don't watch out.
The view from up here would make for a great photo... But with how bright it is, it might not look so good on camera.
I'm thinking it's time to get down... Could you give me a hand? Thanks a bunch.
C-could you not start feeling me up, please?! Ugh...
Great job out there, Commander. I saw you return from up here.
You're wondering why I'm so carefree? Uhh... Because I'm comfortable with you... Let's leave it at that.
You're wondering why I'm so carefree? Uhh... Because I'm comfortable with you... Let's leave it at that.
Don't you always feel out of it when you wake up?
In many ways, getting dressed is kind of a pain in the butt...
This place being what it is, I doubt anyone would care that much if I went out like this...
We're actually kind of stranded, yet everyone seems cool with it... I know it's crazy to think, but do you have the power to make everyone calm?
Hm? What is it? Come on, you've obviously got SOMETHING on your mind... You're weird.
I'm fine. I don't feel cold at all... Although, I do appreciate the thought.
Please, I don't need help getting dressed. I assumed that was kind of obvious.
Welcome back. You look worn out, so how about you take a shower to freshen up?
Woahhh, I somehow ended up in a totally unknown place... Oh, um, my name's Chise Asukagawa! Since I might be here for a while, thanks for looking after me!

I'm Chise Asukagawa, and I'm currently an aircraft carrier at this port! It's a completely new experience fighting at sea, but it's pretty fun! I'm so glad that my arm sleeve from my former world is waterproof~
Woahhh, I somehow ended up in a totally unknown place... Oh, um, my name's Chise Asukagawa! Since I might be here for a while, thanks for looking after me!
Commander, you seem like you didn't get enough sleep? It's time to start working though, so please waaake up!
Oh, if it isn't the Commander~! I'm in the middle of playing a game, did you need something?
Hmm, so there's a school here as well. Huh, you're asking me if I want to attend? No way, I'd rather not if I don't have to!
Sit! Lay down! Paw! Oh, Commander, these Meowfficers are so dang smart! I'm taking a walk with them for a bit!
Hey, Commander! Huh, you look a bit tired... Here, I bought some candy earlier, so you can have one.
I-I don't know why, but it's a bit embarrassing...
Y'know~ It's pretty amazing how hard you work every day. Is this what it's like to be a professional?
Uegh. Is that what you're into...
You want me to handle the remaining missions for you?! ......Heh, as if I'd ever get to say that...
Mission complete~! By the way, how much am I getting paid per hour?
Commander, there's a letter for you~! I wonder if it's from your lover~?
Good work on your mission, Commander! Take me with you next time! I don't mind even if it's just as an extra!
Oh, it looks like they're back! I wonder if they brought back any souvenirs~?
Chise, powering up! Thankies, Commander!
I can fight too, you know!
Ohmygawd, ohmygawd! Did you see that! I won!
Ehhhh, no way, no way! I've actually been useless this whole time?!
This is my time to shine!|Burn to ashes! Goldburn!
The real battle starts now!
Commander, you're the exact type of person that I don't want to become when I grow up.
You want to know what's under this arm sleeve? Of course, it's a secret~! Oh, and if you try to take a peek when I'm asleep, I'll get really mad at you!
When I look at this rigging, I can't help but think of you. I wonder what you're up to, my friend, the coolest one in the world...
Looks like you're busy as usual, Commander... Oh, right. Would you mind if I tried helping you with your work? I think I could help you out with some stuff, at least.
Commander, you were my first friend in this world! Thanks for bringing me along to all of the cool places here!
Coming to this world, fighting together with everyone else, I've had tons of fun! This is all thanks to you, Commander... I'm really, truly grateful for all you've done for me!
Whoa, that's so generous of you, Commander! Thankies!
Leave it to me, Yume!
Yesterday's enemy is today's ally, as they say!
You're super cool, Akane!

ex.line: Hey, looks like you're all chipper this morning. Good ol' Commander, you~!
Commander! Take me somewhere fun~! I'm so sick and tired of watching TV in this room.
Even the Commander dozes off from time to time, huh. Well, I guess I can slack off for a bit. I wonder if there's anything interesting here...
This office is so clean, even though there are so many things here. Who's in charge of cleaning it?
This place is surrounded by the sea, right? Does that mean that I could swim every day when it's hot out if I wanted to?!
Wha, Commander! I'll call the police on you!
Chop chop, hurry and wrap up those missions, so we can go somewhere together~
Commander~! A bunch of stuff arrived because you finished those missions~!
Everyone, let's go get'em~!
Commander~! Were you watching~!
Huh? Commander? What's with your expression? ...Is there something you're worrying about? If you'd like, I'd be willing to lend an ear. We're friends, after all.

lines.line: Woaah, the sun's coming out! It feels so great outside after the rain... Oh, Commander! Let's take a stroll through the sky together!
Woaah, the sun's coming out! It feels so great outside after the rain... Oh, Commander! Let's take a stroll through the sky together!
Today's weather forecast said the sky would clear up after some rain... It's been raining since earlier, so it should be sunny for the rest of the day!
It's still raining a bit... Huh, don't you have an umbrella, Commander? Well, would you like to share this one then?
Ahaha, look at me, I'm flying! Oh, isn't that where we were deployed last time?
Mmn... I don't see a rainbow... Commander, you should help me look for one too!
Commander, come on, jump a bit higher! ...Yay, you're on! Well then, let's head out!
Commander, do you want some candy as well? I think I still have one last one in my pocket...
Eek! I-I could fall, you know!
Welcome back... Wait, Commander, you're soaked from the rain! Let me bring a towel for you!
Aww man, I hate to be seen in such a lazy-looking outfit. It's embarrassing, y'know~?
Aww man, I hate to be seen in such a lazy-looking outfit. It's embarrassing, y'know~?
Oh, hey! You playing hooky, too, Commander?
I don't have many clothes to begin with, so if I don't wash 'em right away... What's that? You'll buy me clothes, Commander?
Oooh, you look like you just can't get your mind off me~
Must be nice, being able to just relax with an empty mind all the time...
Commander, has anyone ever told you that you lack delicacy?! Meh, not that I care...
I'm fine. It's not like I'm gonna catch a cold, or anything. But... Thank you for worrying about me, okay?
Hey! I won't have anything to wear if you get this dirty!
Good work today. Whoa, you're kinda sweaty and gross... But in your case, the dirt doesn't tarnish your honor!
Kaiju Eugenicist, Mujina. I suppose I'm a battleship now. Just asking to be sure... There are no kaiju in your world, correct?
I'm Mujina, kaiju user. In my home world, I was a Kaiju Eugenicist. Now, I fight alongside those I considered my enemies... What a bizarre twist of fate.
Kaiju Eugenicist, Mujina. I suppose I'm a battleship now. Just asking to be sure... There are no kaiju in your world, correct?
Ah, you've come. What's on the schedule today?
Didn't I tell you I'm a kaiju user when I first arrived here? What else do you need to know?
You sure have a lot of leisure facilities here. Do you also have a pool or hot spring, by any chance? It's been ages since I went to one...
Riggings... Machines... Robots... Oh, nothing, just thinking aloud. Be back soon, I'm going for a walk.
Sleeping on the job when you've got so much left to do? My advice: get up and put your nose to the grindstone.
What?! A kaiju?! ...Oh. Never mind then.
Instance Domination! ...Doesn't work on Sirens, I suppose.
Um... What are you doing?
Oh, Commander, I saw you still had some unfinished missions on your desk. Are you sure you don't have somewhere else to be?
Well done. The fruits of your labor are waiting for you. Don't forget to claim them.
Your mail's here. You should probably go take a look.
Ah, you're back. That means my work here is done. Can I return to my room now?
Seems the commission team is back. Mind if I sit this one out?
Whew... That's really invigorating.
Can I leave once we're done here?
All done over here. Now it's time to... What? We aren't finished yet?
We lost... But we should be able to do better next time.
I'll handle this!|Instance Domination!
Not yet! I'm not done yet!
I don't know what I was expecting from a world without kaijus...
Good god, I'm hungry. I'd kill for a hot stew or something... Know any good restaurants, Commander?
What is my goal in this new place...? Right now, I honestly don't know. I'll figure it out one day.
You're glad to have someone helpful like me around? I see... I don't think I've done much, but all right.
What's my purpose in this world? The answer to that should become clearer as I fight alongside the shipgirls.
In my home world, I couldn't imagine what I'd do if kaijus disappeared... But after spending some time with you, I think I know what I'd do now. Thank you, Commander.
Thank you, Commander. I've wanted this for a long time.
So you're the Dyna Wing girl, huh...
Up and at 'em, Chise.
You can... create kaijus, Akane?

ex.line: Good morning. Still feeling tired? You should go wash your face.
How old am I? Well... 5,000 years... Yeah...
You poor overworked soul... Do you need a hand? I've got nothing better to do right now.
I like how lax this coat is. Although, it's not so great in winter.
Say, Commander, do you wanna watch a movie I borrowed from a friend? ...What's it about? Fairly sure it involves crabs one way or another.
These missions still aren't done? Let's get to it then. I'll assist you.
Outstanding job on that mission. Get cozy and I'll make you something to eat.
I will crush you... No matter what!
Interesting. I'm a little wiser than I was a minute ago.
Oh, time to sortie soon? Take me with you. You'll want a battleship like me... Yeah, that'll be great.

lines.line: You've come as well, Commander? In that case, let's accompany each other back while watching the gingko leaves fall.
You've come as well, Commander? In that case, let's accompany each other back while watching the gingko leaves fall.
Ah, Commander. Why are you out so early in the morning?
It's nice to wear something a bit different from usual, though it's making me feel slightly nerv- Ah! What a strong breeze...
Could we sit for a minute? Ahh, it's so relaxing being next to you. Makes me... sleepy... Zzz...
Got time to spare, Commander? Then we could go somewhere before we head home.
I got these freshly-baked baguettes at a store just earlier. They smell so good... I can't wait to get home and eat them.
Hm? We should take some time to rest? Sure. Let's check out that café over there.
D-do you do this to everyone, or...?!
These gingko leaves are so gorgeous. Autumn is in the air, quite literally.
Oh, where am I now... Ah. Good to meet you. Call me The 2nd. I'm with the Gridknight Alliance... Not that it matters in this world, I'd assume.
You may call me The 2nd. I work with the Gridknight Alliance to protect the world from all Kaiju threats... though I suppose things may be different here...
Oh, where am I now... Ah. Good to meet you. Call me The 2nd. I'm with the Gridknight Alliance... Not that it matters in this world, I'd assume.
Oh? So we meet again.
Not quite Kaiju, but similar to Kaiju... Maybe there is a reason we were brought to this world, after all.
I was certain that a Kaiju would be involved in such a large-scale disaster...
The weapons here are all smaller than Dynazenon, but they pack a real punch. How do they work?
Would this world be better off, too, without Sirens...?
Huh?! Um, what's the matter?
What's that? Something seems different? Heheh, well, you see...
Commander, you're practically begging to get swallowed whole.
Commander? Aren't you supposed to be in the middle of a job right now?
Yes, the mission is complete. Don't forget to grab the rewards.
Commander, you have messages awaiting your attention. Make sure you take a look.
Oh, welcome back. I'm glad you've returned in one piece.
The errand girls are back. Let's go greet them.
Maybe it's not so bad to pursue pure strength once in a while.
Come, everyone! Let's do our best!
Phew. It feels different from the usual... but I think I've shown that I can handle it.
Ouch, ouch... Maybe this is asking a little too much of me...
Is it my turn now?
I could really use a Fixer Beam right now... Can't do it? Figures...
*sigh*... I suppose it's all part of the job.
Do you have shops around here? Mmm... Maybe I'll go and waste some money.
Thank you for your work, Commander. You must be busy, but take breaks when possible, okay?
Oh? Commander, have I caught you during rare downtime? Then how about we go on a date? My treat!
Heehee, it's all so fun. Both our worlds are full of human activity and those who protect them... I think it's wonderful.
Commander, I can't begin to explain how thankful I am for all of your help. But I... No, it's nothing. I want to repay you, so please think of a way for me to do that.
Oh, thank you very much, Commander. I don't know how to begin to express my gratitude.
That altitude isn't enough for you, is it?
Chise, I expect you to do your best here, too.
You're here with everyone, too? Hmm, isn't that nice?

ex.line: Good morning. Let's give today our all!
You should know that I'm keeping a terrible secret... Would you like me to share, Commander?
You've done so much for me, Commander... I'll have to return the favor, don't you think?
I just hope that I can be of some help to your work...
There must be a reason I was brought to this world... I'm sure of it.
Mmheheheh...
You haven't finished your work yet, have you? Let me help.
Congratulations on a completed mission. Once you've finished checking your rewards, come for some tea.
Now, Commander, I await your orders!
Was I able to help you at all...?
Because of our duties, our meeting is a once-in-a-lifetime blessing. I've accepted that by now, but... right now, the thought of it makes me so sad.

lines.line: Would you mind waiting a moment? I just have this one report. Oh, and can I interest you in coffee, Commander? Ah... Sorry, this is my only mug. We could... share it?
Would you mind waiting a moment? I just have this one report. Oh, and can I interest you in coffee, Commander? Ah... Sorry, this is my only mug. We could... share it?
I don't have much in the way of hospitality, but feel free to relax.
I always dress like this at home. Not that it's quite my favorite, but... I tend to pick whatever is comfy and easy to wear.
My place doesn't look lived-in? Well, I'm a busy woman... How about you pick some nice things for me, Commander?
You don't know where is safe to look? Aren't you the one in the wrong for being here?!
This outfit is cheap, well-made, and comfortable. A real triple threat.
Excuse you! I'll have you know I'm well-bathed! ...Though a lot of the time, I just shower instead...
I wouldn't recommend touching me too much.
Sorry, I couldn't get dressed in time... You like it? O-oh... Well, in that case, I...

What? Where am I? Oh, umm, what may you need of me, young one? ...You don't need anything? Ahahah... Well met, person from this strange land. My name is... You know what, just call me "Princess Hime."
I am a whisperer of dragons, and... No, screw this! I hate coming off as overly formal, so can we leave it at "I'm an enigmatic princess"? It's more mysterious that way, which I like.

What? Where am I? Oh, umm, what may you need of me, young one? ...You don't need anything? Ahahah... Well met, person from this strange land. My name is... You know what, just call me "Princess Hime."
Heya, Commander. Did you sleep well? Nice, nice. It's important to always get your beauty sleep.
I don't know what brought me here... Has fate cursed me yet again? It has put yet more distance between me and him...
Hey, Commander, if you have a minute, how about some tea? Have to say, it's awesome tasting all these drinks I've never seen before.
Shipgirls blow my mind. They could go toe to toe with a kaiju, unaided... Might they be stronger than a dragon?
*sigh*, I'm getting sloppy without others to attend to me... Oh! Forget you saw that, Commander!
Uhh, not too much casual intimacy, or my Royal Guard will be livid.
Oh dear, casual contact... That ain't gonna fly. Don't forget that I'm basically nobility!
Do you know what my Royal Guard will do to you for touching me?
Commander, it's not appropriate to leave work undone and roam about.
Task complete. Well done. Now don't forget to claim your rewards.
Commander, there's a missive addressed to you. Give it a read.
Welcome back! You must be worn out. Go on, dust off and kick back.
Your errand girls have returned. It's the gentlefolks' obligation to greet the commoners, so let us move!
So this is what it feels like to gain new strength...
Listen, everyone! Take pride in wiping out the enemy! Begin the assault!
Yeah! We won! This worked out nicely, even though fighting isn't really my style.
Owch... Time to pull out! Everyone, turn around! Double-time, go!
It is time to unleash the power inside of me!
I wonder in times like this... what if I were them...
Word of advice - you should learn how to read peoples' feelings.
Food and drinks the likes of which I've never seen. A story that warms the heart... What a lovely place this is.
The people here all approach me naturally, paying no mind to my status... Although, that makes me think of HIM...
What's up, Commander? You're always looking in my direction... Oh, that's it! You've fallen for my gorgeous looks!
Sooo, listen, because of my position as a princess, I've never really been in this situation, and I don't know how I'm supposed to respond... I'd PREFER it if you'd get a clue!
I never tire of hearing the things you tell me, and time spent with you is always a treat... I thank you will all my heart for your treatment.
Huh? For me? Thanks! Wow!!! I'm so happy!
That power... Chise, you have the power to tame a dragon?
Akane... What's with you?
I'm delighted that you're joining us in battle, The 2nd.

ex.line: Heyo, Commander! So glad to see you again... No, I mean it!
No matter the era, those who wield superhuman power are labeled gods, worshipped, and feared... Although, being a god sounds terrible to me.
There's so much tasty food in this world. Especially seafood! Crab has got to be one of my favorites.
What power runs this world? It can't be dragon power, surely. Hmm... The mystery deepens further.
So hey, I'm basically of noble birth. But don't let that change your attitude towards me, okay?
You still have work to do! Stop being lazy and finish what you started.
Way to go! I'll make some tea - c'mere and rest for a bit, why don'tcha?
Raise a war cry! Show them your might! Attaaack!
Well done. I hope I was able to be of at least some use to you.
I think we've formed a true bond. However, in the truest sense, we come from different worlds. Even if we can't change this fact, we have to look to the future and not linger on the past forever...

lines.line: Oh! Guess you found me... Look, it doesn't matter what I wear when I'm drinking at home... What's that? Does me being a bit flushed from the drinks really get you that fired up?
Oh! Guess you found me... Look, it doesn't matter what I wear when I'm drinking at home... What's that? Does me being a bit flushed from the drinks really get you that fired up?
Seafood paired with a lovely cup of sake. Oh, what a delight♪
I don't ALWAYS dress up like a princess, you know. Even I deserve some private time!
Oh, the bliss of having so much fresh seafood. Straight out of the sea and ready to eat! It can't be legal to be this happy~
Hey, wouldn't you agree that sake tasting so good with food is proof that the world is full of light?
There are three things in the world you as a human being must respect. Love, promises, aaand...
Why, yes, this is made of fairly fancy fabric. That's to be expected for someone of my standing, no?
Heheh. Nope, that's off limits. I get why you'd want to try, though.
Worn out, Commander? Then why don't you sit down and have a drink with me?

Hey there! I'm Reisalin Stout, but you can just call me Ryza. I'm not really sure what this whole "shipgirl " thing is, but I'm sure I'll figure it out eventually... In any case, it's a pleasure to meet you!

I'm the alchemist, Reisalin Stout, but all my friends just call me Ryza. Alchemy is a pretty profound thing, you know. With enough creativity, you can turn even the simplest things into all kinds of neat stuff!

Hey there! I'm Reisalin Stout, but you can just call me Ryza. I'm not really sure what this whole "shipgirl" thing is, but I'm sure I'll figure it out eventually... In any case, it's a pleasure to meet you!
Oh, it's you, Commander! What new adventures will we go on today?
Hey, Commander, do you know if I can get some sort of big pot from Akashi? It'd be nice to have an alchemy cauldron I can use here...
While this place isn't as big as the royal capital, it's still bustling with activity. I've gotta keep an eye out so I don't get lost.
Yikes! Monsters! ...Oh, these little guys are called "Meowfficers?" Aww, they're actually pretty cute!
You've got a school here? I actually used to teach on the island I come from. Though, all my students were little kids since I wasn't a formal classroom teacher or anything.
So these are Augment Modules...? The nitty-gritty details are lost on me, but combining ingredients to make and upgrade something sounds pretty similar to alchemy. Mind if I watch you work on them?
Drake! I heard you're putting together a crew to go on an adventure. Mind if I come along?! ...Hooray! Alright then, let's decide where to go!
Oh! It's a barrel!
You want to know what can be made with alchemy? Hmm... I'm not sure how to sum it up neatly, but you can make pretty much anything as long as you have the right materials.
...I was just thinking about testing out this new bomb I synthesized.
Commandeeer! You've still got work to take care of. Are you sure you can just leave it lying around?
Woah, look at all these materials! Oh, Commander, are these your mission rewards?
A letter's come in! I wonder what's in it~
Welcome back, Commander! How'd your adventure go? I wanna hear all about it over some tea!
The girls are back from their errand! I wonder what materials they managed to bring back.
Mhm, I can feel my skills improving! Thanks, Commander!
Alrighty, let's make a splash!
A flawless victory! I knew I could do it!
Aww, I was so sure we had 'em... Anyway, let's retreat for now!
You're all going down!
I'm only getting started!
A quest? I'm not sure if I... Huh, there'll be rewards? Then, count me in!
Mm, what a wonderful day! Let's go explore for something new and exciting!
I bet there's all sorts of interesting materials in the mountains behind the port, right? Huh? You'll take me there yourself? Sweet, thanks a bunch!

Hey Commander, want to come fishing with me? ...Hm, you don't have any gear for it? Not a problem. I've got a special fishing rod here that I made myself! Give it a while, and you'll be able to reel in a ton of fish!
What a peaceful day... I'm sure the reason everyone is able to enjoy ordinary lives here at port is because of your hard work. Thank you for everything you do, Commander!

Eh, you're giving this to me?! I don't know what to say... This has to be the most excited I've been since I came to this world... Thank you so much, Commander. I'll have to work extra hard to reciprocate your feelings!
Whoa, I think I can make something really amazing with these materials! Thanks, I'll put them to good use!
I'm glad we get to go on another adventure together, Klaudia!
I'm counting on you, Lila!
Patty, how've you been?
Woohoo! I caught a big one!
I might be able to make a bomb with this.
I think I saw a yellow bird take off holding one of these...
Gotta be careful so this doesn't overload my rigging.
This thing is brimming with power!

ex.line: I can't wait to see what adventures we're in for today. Aren't you excited, Commander?
Hehe. Commander, welcome to my atelier! Okay, I'm just kidding. Anyway, grab a seat and I'll bring you a cup of tea!
Good moooorning- Wait, oh. The Commander's sleeping like a log. Things have been pretty hectic around here lately, so maybe I should help by synthesizing some fatigue-relieving potions.

I saw they're serving creamy pasta with Uni in the canteen today. That's Uni as in the things that grow into trees, right? Hm? They're seafood, not fruits? Huh, guess they're different from the kind of Uni I know.
These species of flowers and plants don't even exist back in my world. I wonder what you'd get if you used them for alchemy!
Teaching a whole class is seriously exhausting, isn't it, Z23? I felt at my wit's end all the time when I was a teacher. Especially with the little rebels who acted like my younger self would...
Whatcha doing there, Bristol? ...Oh, investigating mysteries surrounding the port? Sounds fun! Can I go mystery-solving with you?
Woah, woah, easy there! I know we've gotten closer, but we're not THAT close!
Looks like you've still got work to do, Commander. I'll brew an energy potion for you. Be sure to drink it so you can knock out every last task!
Great work, Commander! Come on, I think it's time for you to take a break!
Ready to do this, everyone?
Aw yeah, we won! And it's all thanks to you, Commander!
If there's ever anything on your mind, you can come straight to me! I want to do everything I can to support the person who lets us all live ordinary lives in this world!

lines.line: Hey there, Commander! Hehe, it's been a long while since I had a sleepover with someone. You know, I've really been looking forward to today. So, what would you like to do first?
Hey there, Commander! Hehe, it's been a long while since I had a sleepover with someone. You know, I've really been looking forward to today. So, what would you like to do first?
Zzzzz... *gasp*! G-g-good evening, Commander!
I love how soft and fluffy this pillow is. I'm sure I'll be getting a great night's rest. Want to give it a feel, Commander?
I went exploring in the hills this morning, and then I went to a café with Klaudia and Patty. What a great day it's been... What have you been up to, Commander?
*yaaawn*... Maybe I am starting to get sleepy after all... Oh, Commander, you're already fast asleep? Guess I'll hit the hay too then.
Good night, Commander. Let's go on adventure tomorrow!
There you are, Klaudia! We've got tons to chat about tonight! ...Oh, you think my PJs are cute? Ehehe, you're going to make me blush if you keep saying that!
I spotted Serri not too long ago. She was headed towards the front door... Where do you think she's going this late at night?
Come in, Ayanami! Hey, what's that box you've got? A game console? You can plug it into a TV and play games? Ooh, sounds fun! Show me how to use it!
I could use something to eat... Oh, right, I still have the snacks Dunkerque gave me! ...Mmm! So yummy! It amazes me how she can bake pastries that taste THIS good.
Hungry? I thought you might be, so... Tadaaah! I got us some snacks! There's cookies, chocolate, and more... What would you like, Commander?
Eep!
Great work today, Commander! Would you like me to give you a shoulder massage? ...Okay, come lie down over here!
Oh, do I have it on too high? It's burning in there... Or maybe that's just soot? Hmm... This machine is convenient and all, but I can't get the hang of it. What do I do now, Commander?
Oh, do I have it on too high? It's burning in there... Or maybe that's just soot? Hmm... This machine is convenient and all, but I can't get the hang of it. What do I do now, Commander?
Hey, umm... You mind waiting a little longer?
Akashi taught me how to use this thing, but it's just so complicated. We alchemists know that sometimes, you just gotta give it a try and see what happens!
I think I'm getting the hang of this. It's definitely not my imagination. This is going to taste good... Show 'em what you've got, Ryza!
This machine is awesome. You can't control the heat of a campfire easily, but this does it instantly. I'll have to ask Akashi if she thinks alchemy can do this.
What kinds of things can I mix in this world? I should see if I can replicate tools from our world using similar materials!
W-wait! Don't mess with it! I already don't know what's going on, and you're making it worse!
Geez! Do you want to distract me that badly?
I get too worried if I'm not watching it closely... Wait, Commander?! How long have you been there?

It's a pleasure to meet you. My name is Klaudia Valentz, and due to various circumstances, it seems that I'll be staying here for the time being. Please let me know if there's anything I can help with!

My name is Klaudia Valentz. Back in my world, I used to work for my father, a traveling merchant. When I arrived here, I was so worried I'd never be able to see Ryza and the others ever again, but I'm so glad we were able to be reunited!

It's a pleasure to meet you. My name is Klaudia Valentz, and due to various circumstances, it seems that I'll be staying here for the time being. Please let me know if there's anything I can help with!
Good morning, Commander. Let's work hard today!
Huh? You'd like to know more about me? Then, how about we head inside and have a little chat? I'll go prepare the tea and snacks.
I can't believe I'm going on yet another adventure with Ryza and the others... It's truly a miracle.
When I visited the store earlier, I couldn't help but notice Miss Akashi's business acumen. As a fellow merchant, it was quite an eye-opening experience.
The Commander's looked pretty out of it for a while... We're at a pretty good stopping point with the work, so maybe I should suggest taking a break...
Miss Shiranui is quite a proficient saleswoman. There are plenty of talented people at my company, but Shiranui would make a great addition to the team.
Miss Shoukaku's flute is a transverse one like mine, but has a completely different sound... What a distinctive and beautiful tone!
Do you need any help with your accounting? My father entrusted me with that kind of work back in my world, so I'm pretty confident in my abilities.
I've never been good at making friends... But thanks to the kindness everyone here at port has shown me, I've been having a great time and feel right at home.
If you keep this up, it's going to be awkward being around you in the future.
Commander, I believe you still have some missions left to take care of. I've already ordered them for you, so why don't you get them out of the way first?
Um, let me check on your rewards... Yup, they've arrived without any issues!
Commander, there's mail for you. I left it on your desk, so please have a look as soon as possible.
Welcome back, Commander. We still have work to do... but how about taking a little break first?
It looks like the commission team has returned. Commander, let's go welcome them back!
I never thought I could become this strong... Thank you, Commander.
I can keep going - I'm just as capable of fighting!
We won! Let's keep up the good work.
I-is everyone alright?! Hurry, we need to tend to the injured!
Take this!
I'm not done yet!
Fine. I suppose it's just business...
Looks like there's a lot of work to get through today... But, if the two of us work together, I'm sure we'll be done in no time. Let's both do our best.
Commander, it's amazing how thorough your work is considering your busy schedule. I have a lot to learn from you still...
We've barely just started, and you're already blazing through your work. What's your secret, Commander?
Here you go, Commander. This tea is supposed to help you relax. I saw it at the store yesterday and thought of you, so I decided to buy some.

I'm really glad I was able to come to this world. I was able to reunite with Ryza and the others, and I also got to meet a wonderful person - you, Commander. Let's treasure our time together and keep working hard!
Huh?! Commander, how did you know what I like...? Thank you! I am so happy!
I'm so happy to see you again, Ryza!
Miss Lila, I'll support you!
I'll let you know if I find anything, Miss Serri.
Seems like this can be used as emergency food.
They're so pretty, but Ryza probably doesn't see them as anything more than alchemy ingredients...
Looks like we found some rare plants.
Did these arrive in this world along with us?
What's this? It's completely different from what we've found in the other ruins...

ex.line: Commander, you still look pretty sleepy. Why don't you go wash up a bit? I'll get your work ready in the meantime.
Welcome back, Commander. I just finished baking some cookies. It's been a while since I last made them, but I think they turned out pretty well... Would you like to have a taste?
I'll be going out for lunch with Ryza and the others later. Would you like to join us, Commander?
I've finished looking over those documents, but are we still not done on this end? ...Oh, did I wake you up? I'm still sorting out your paperwork, so you can rest a bit longer if you'd like.
The flute has such an exquisite voice in this piece... Actually, I can play a thing or two myself. Eh, you want me to play something for you? If it's for you, I suppose I can...
So, Miss Akashi, why don't you let me in to some of your business secrets? Huh? Where'd she go?

Miss Kazagumo? Oh, you were practicing the recorder? Haha, don't worry. You'll get better as long as you keep practicing. Once you've worked up your confidence, make sure to play for someone important to you!
(What should I do? I don't want to ruin our working relationship...)
Commander, you're at the final stretch! I'll help out too, so let's finish strong!
Phew, it's finally over... Commander, you did a great job too. Want to unwind with a nice cup of tea?
We can do it if we work together...!
Thank goodness we won... Great job, everyone!
Commander, you seem pretty busy today too. I hope you're not pushing yourself too hard though. After all, you are a precious friend to me.

lines.line: Hehe, today was such a fun day... Oh, good evening, Commander. I was just writing my diary entry for the day. Since you're here, why don't you help me out?
Hehe, today was such a fun day... Oh, good evening, Commander. I was just writing my diary entry for the day. Since you're here, why don't you help me out?
Good evening! I've been waiting all day to hear more of your stories.
Feel free to pour yourself any of the drinks over there. By the way, I'd recommend the herbal tea. The fragrance is very relaxing, and it doesn't have any caffeine so it won't impact your sleep.
Whenever I reread my past diary entries, I think back at everything I've done since coming here. I've been through all sorts of things, but they've all become my precious memories.
Would you like some cookies to go with your tea? I've been baking them whenever I have the time... Oh, they're better than the ones from before? Thank you!
Thank you for telling me about all those stories. Sleep well, Commander!

What are those drinks I have in my fridge? They're special smoothies I made with the herbs Miss Serri suggested. I was wondering if my skin will become as smooth as hers after drinking them... Heehee.

After I finish my diary entry, I'll be heading to a slumber party with Ryza and the others! I haven't had many experiences staying up late with friends before, so I'm pretty excited. I wonder what it'll be like?
Today, I joined in on a study session Miss Swiftsure was hosting. I learned a lot about fighting tactics and shipgirls.

I found out Miss Tirpitz also plays the flute. We ended up talking a lot, and we're going to be performing together in the near future. It's super nerve-wracking thinking about putting on a show with someone else, but I'm really looking forward to it!
...Alright, that's a good place to leave off for today! Commander, thank you so much for helping out. So, what should we do now? Will you go to sleep? Or... would you like to chat for a bit?
Eeek?! Jeez... You almost made me spill my tea!
Good work today, Commander. I'm sure you must be tired, so please take it easy.
Are you the Commander I've heard so much about? My name is Patricia Abelheim, but you can call me Patty. It's a pleasure to meet you. I suppose I will be counting on you for the time being.

My name is Patricia Abelheim. In my world, I was the daughter of a low-ranking noble family. As my father, a knight, provided me tutelage in swordsmanship, I am fairly confident in my skills. What's that? You'd like to see my techniques? Well, I suppose if the opportunity arises...
Are you the Commander I've heard so much about? My name is Patricia Abelheim, but you can call me Patty. It's a pleasure to meet you. I suppose I will be counting on you for the time being.
Good morning. How should we start our work today?
This room is rather small compared to what I have back in my world, but it somehow puts my mind at ease...
The people here at the port are so lively. I spent a lot of time with my friends back home, but most of them were more reserved in comparison. This has been quite a novel experience.
What great timing, Commander. Would you mind showing me the way to this café? I was supposed to join Ryza and the others for tea, but I happened to get lost...
This port is a veritable bounty of cuisines. Much of it differs from what I know, but all of it is delicious. Every day, I look forward to enjoying new foods.

So that's the Knight of the Sea... I was expecting her to be rather unapproachable, but she's actually surprisingly easy to get along with. Hm? Would I like to... plant trees? I, I'm not sure why, but I don't mind coming along.
Knowledgeable about tea AND ballroom dancing? Miss Hood is a model gentlewoman. I have much to learn from her...
Wha-?! What's gotten into you?!
Eek, a bug! ...Th-thank you for brushing it off of me, Commander. I'm no good with bugs...
...Do you want to be cut down?
Your missions are really piling up. Would you like me to give you a hand?
Well done on your mission. I will leave your rewards right over here.
Hmm, something just arrived in the mail... Oh, I wonder if it's a letter for the Commander.
Welcome back, Commander... You're going right back to work? Good work ethic is a virtue, but you should still take some time to relax. I'll go and brew you some tea.
The commission team has returned. I wonder what they've brought this time...
I won't let my experiences in this world go to waste.
Don't let your guard down, no matter what kind of enemy you're up against!
Victory achieved, just as expected.
How could this happen... Everyone, please fall back immediately!
I'll show you what I'm made of!
A powerful enemy, indeed...
If you have no need of me, I shall take my leave.
Commander, do you need something? Oh? You'd like to show me around the port? Thank you very much. To be honest, I'm still having much trouble finding my way around as a new arrival.
I wonder if this stone can be used for alchemy... Ah, my apologies. When adventuring with Ryza and the others, we usually gathered materials as we walked.
It's important to speak your mind freely, Commander, if anything's bothering you, you can share the burden with me. If nothing else, I can at least listen.

To be honest, when I first arrived here, I kept asking myself, "What sort of messed-up world is this?!" But, it didn't take long for this place to become my second home. And it's all thanks to your support, Commander.

I've come to see this place as home because you've always been watching over me, Commander. I'd like to do even more for you as a way of expressing my gratitude. Once again, thank you for looking after me.
This is really precious, right? Can I really have it? ...Thank you. I will treasure it.
New place, same old Miss Ryza.
So this is how Oren warriors fight...
You know, Miss Serri's age... Eep! Nevermind!
A banquet on the beach... Oh? You call it a barbecue here? The ladies of the Royal Navy are surprisingly easygoing...
Crystals? Perhaps a source of capital for the port? Or... perhaps not.
Hm? You don't mean to tell me this is rare in your world?
Why would the Sirens be interested in meteors...?
We must learn to wield the enemy's strength well if we are to protect our friends. Let's gather what we can.

ex.line: You never cease to impress, Commander. I haven't seen you show up late a single time.
Commander, one of your buttons is about to come off. Stop by my room, and I'll fix it up for you.
I went to a tea party hosted by the Royal Navy the other day. They all conducted themselves flawlessly... As the daughter of a noble family, I have much to learn from them.
So this is your office... It reminds me of my father's quarters.
Commander, excuse m—Oh, you're sound asleep? You might catch a cold like this though... Let me see if there's a blanket lying around.
Oh? I'm invited to attend today's tea party as well? Thank you very much. In return, I'll bring more of those sweets you said you enjoyed the last time.
I've seen many maids and butlers in my own world, but none as perfect as Miss Belfast. So devoted, yet also stern at times... She's certainly someone I want by my side.
I assume you're ready to face the consequences?
Let's finish our remaining missions quickly. I'll do everything I can to help you.
Well done. Once you've sorted out your rewards, would you like to have a tea break? I've even prepared sweets.
An enemy attack! Everyone, be on alert!
That went well. Good work, everybody.

Commander, please take me with you on your next vacation. As I'm more familiar with this world now, I wanted to try taking a trip, but I don't feel safe alone. I'd be much more confident with you by my side.

lines.line: Phew, that's everything taken care of for the day... Huh?! Commander, how long have you been there?! I-I apologize for letting you see my slovenly side... Please, just come over here for now.
Phew, that's everything taken care of for the day... Huh?! Commander, how long have you been there?! I-I apologize for letting you see my slovenly side... Please, just come over here for now.
How peaceful... I don't mind evenings like this every once in a while.
When I change into pajamas, I feel myself loosening up... Hm? I'm free to relax even more? Then just this once... I suppose I could indulge myself.
Zzz, zzz... Mm... Huh? Commander, why are you here...?
What's the matter? You seem restless. I don't believe I've put anything odd in here?
Good night, Commander. I'll see you in the morning.
I ran into Miss Lila in the hallway. She seems entirely different in her pajamas. Is that what it means to be mature...?
Miss Klaudia took to work at the port astoundingly fast. I have to respect her quick wits.
Hm? What was that hooting? ...Ooh, it's Miss Perseus's bird. Those wings look so soft. I wonder if she'd let me touch them...
What in the world was with Miss Belfast at today's tea party? Um... "Little Bel?" I see... With other worlds come otherworldly occurrences.
These pajamas are wonderfully comfortable. I always sleep soundly in them.
Letting you into my room was a mistake.
Yaaaawn... No! Don't you fall asleep yet, Patty. The Commander's coming soon... Ah! Commander, good work today.

I am Lila Decyrus, an Oren warrior... I may have become a "heavy cruiser" now, but that won't hamper my ability in battle. So long as I stay here, I will carry out my duties as a warrior in your service.

I am Lila Decyrus, an Oren warrior of the Whitefang clan. I have been traveling the world to fulfill an oath I made with my clan. Even if this may be a journey with no end... I will still continue to press onward.

I am Lila Decyrus, an Oren warrior... I may have become a "heavy cruiser" now, but that won't hamper my ability in battle. So long as I stay here, I will carry out my duties as a warrior in your service.
Hmm, you're still half-asleep? As the Commander, you of all people should be alert and ready to go.
I appreciate the furniture, but the room needs a bit of tidying up first. It's just... too much of a hassle to do it myself.
I see the enemy your world faces are called "Sirens." They're very different from the Philuscha...
Great timing, Commander. Want to join in on my training? It's too peaceful here, and I don't want to get rusty.
There are so many kinds of people here. I find the Sakura Empire girls particularly interesting... For some reason, talking to them brings back warm memories.

Enterprise? She and I may be different in many ways, but she is also a great warrior who lives for the battle. The power that has earned her so many medals... I would like to witness that firsthand someday.
Oh, you want a duel, Hiryuu? Sounds good. Come at me-- Woah, taking the first swing already? Quite the impatient one, aren't we...
You need a hand? Not with a battle, but... with office work? And why should I? Do it yourself.
You want to become stronger? Well, I don't mind teaching you the warrior's code. In exchange... show me around the port, alright?
I see. So you've made your peace.
Commander, do what needs to be done first.
Go harvest the fruits of your labor. You've earned it.
Commander, a missive of some sort has arrived. The sender is unknown... but the contents don't seem to be suspicious.
You're back? Taking battles one after another is fine and all, but getting enough rest is just as important.
The commission team you sent out has returned. Now, let's see what they've brought back...
Until my purpose has been served, I will continue to press onward.
It's the enemy! I'll lead the charge!
I can't afford to stand around and do nothing.
Everyone, fall back at once! I'll cover your retreat!
This ends now! You're no match for me!
Nothing but a scratch. It won't slow me down.
Enough is enough. I have to find a way back home...
What is it, Commander? If you have business with me, keep it brief.
There is something I must accomplish. Until it is done, I have not a single moment to squander.
I journey to fulfill my oath, whereas you fight to protect the peace... We each have our own duty, and in that way, we might be similar.
I finally understand your resolve, Commander. I will acknowledge it by vowing to lend you my strength for as long as I stay in your world.
You've not only understood my purpose, but also accepted me as an ally. To repay you for your kindness... I can perhaps stay here a bit longer. Allow me to lend you my power once more, Commander.
Ho, this is a fairly decent choice. I will take it.
I'll handle this, Ryza!
You're in good form, Patricia.
Let us both fulfill our duties, Serri.
That's a big catch. Don't push yourself - let me handle it.
Using cannons to collect ingredients. What a concept.
The Sirens made this, so it goes without saying that it's no ordinary plant.
Seems shipgirl technology can't produce everything... We'll have to turn to alchemy.
I think I'm starting to get what makes them so sturdy.

ex.line: You're doing well, and that's what matters... Hm? Don't tell me you're half-asleep again. You really never change, do you?
How old am I? Does that really matter, Commander?
Go with you on a shopping trip? Ah, you must need a bodyguard. Rest assured, I've done it countless times before- Hm? Not quite?
Commander, stop sleeping on your desk and use your bed instead. You'll feel better rested that way.
Ever since you started training with me, you seem to be quicker on your feet. How about I test your abilities next time?

Ah, Bismarck... I was observing the Iron Blood exercise the other day, and her prowess impressed me. Commanding so many warriors while personally doing her utmost to lead her allies to victory... I doubt you'll find another warrior like her anywhere else.

The unsinkable Grand Old Lady who never misses a shot... While I don't know your full story, I can clearly tell you're a seasoned warrior. Now, why do you look so disgruntled? ...Hm? My build? What about it?
...Sit down over there. I'm going to teach you some manners.
Seems you still have work to do. I'm here if you need a hand.
All finished? Nicely done. I knew you could do it.
The enemy's here. Stay sharp, everyone.
Your leadership is what let me fight so well. Thank you.
What's wrong? Something on your mind? If there's something you want to get off your chest, just let it all out. It's not something I'd normally offer, but I'll make an exception today.

lines.line: You shouldn't be up this late. What, you can't sleep? You want to stay up with me? ...Fine, I'll keep you company. I haven't been able to get a wink of sleep anyway.
You shouldn't be up this late. What, you can't sleep? You want to stay up with me? ...Fine, I'll keep you company. I haven't been able to get a wink of sleep anyway.
What a nice night.
You think I sound more subdued than usual tonight? My garment is probably the reason why. Don't worry, I can still fight in this nightgown if the enemy appears.
I can hear crickets chirping... I guess even this port, busy by daytime, falls silent come nighttime.
Sitting around, doing nothing in particular but spending time with someone else... Nights like these are pretty enjoyable every now and then.
Starting to get tired, huh? Then you should head back to your room. Get ample rest to prepare for tomorrow.
I see you're up as well, Patricia. Hm? What? I got this nightgown just a few days ago. What's so unusual about it?
Ryza invited me to some sort of party. I agreed to come just on a whim, but I have no idea what sort of gathering it'll be. Also, why is a nightdress mandatory wear?
I joined Kashino in an open-air bath just earlier. Relaxing in the water while gazing at the night sky is actually very satisfying.

Is that Kasumi? It sounds like she's having a nice chat with someone, but who? ...Wait, are there beings in this world that I cannot see with the naked eye? If so, I must devise a countermeasure lest they become our enemies...
Care to go on a walk, Commander? I want to see the unfiltered moonlight.
You must think anything could happen in a place as dark as this and I wouldn't notice immediately.
Have some hot milk, Commander. Someone from around here told me that it helps you fall asleep. Drink it and try to settle down.
I am Serri of the Oren. I seem to be an aircraft carrier of some sort now. By the way, have you seen any seeds...?
I am Serri Glaus, an Oren of the Green Plume clan. I ended up here while on a journey to find something... What was I searching for? The seed of a certain plant.
I am Serri of the Oren. I seem to be an aircraft carrier of some sort now. By the way, have you seen any seeds...?
You're here. What plans do you have for the day?
I've always been traveling, so it feels a bit unusual to have my own place.
Those small creatures are called Meowfficers? A long time ago, I used to keep a pet of my own. That's why I find those things cute.
Meat garnished with vegetables... No, I don't mind. My clan just tends not to eat vegetables. However, I do drink a special smoothie made of some secret herbs from time to time.
The hills behind the port are lush and green. I wonder if there are seeds over there...
So this plant is called mugwort. It's not what I'm looking for, but it appears to have medicinal properties... Huh, there's a song about mugwort? I see, I'd love to hear it.
Yuudachi, what's this... "Meat Lovers' Recommended Restaurants List"...? Astounding. I'll put this to good use.
What do you want?
Why is my skin so smooth? Nothing in particular comes to mind, but If I had to guess... it might have something to do with my clan's secret herbal smoothie that I drink every day.
...What are you doing?
It appears that you still have some missions to complete. I'd recommend getting them out of the way first.
The rewards are here. If there are any plants, let me take a look as well.
A letter has arrived. I wonder who it's from.
You're back? Good work.
Our friends seem to have returned. It might be a good time to go greet them.
So, even I still have room for growth. Thank you.
It's the enemy. Let's take them on.
Looks like things ended without any issues.
I can't let things end here...
I will handle this.
I won't give up.
I know I won't be here forever, but still...
...Commander, I'm looking for some seeds. The ones I'm trying to find might not be here, but just in case... Oh right, do you think you can help me?
I hope that one day, that world will once again return to its original, verdurous beauty...
I've already searched most of the places around the port. Do you know if there are any other places around here with plants... Oh, you do? Then, would you take me there next time?
You've done so much for me since I came to this world. You've also helped me search for seeds. I feel the sincerity behind each and every one of your actions. Thank you very much, Commander.
I'm still in the middle of my journey to find what I'm looking for. But with all the help you've given me here, I'd like to stay in this world a bit longer. Thank you once again for all the support.
This is exactly what I have wanted. Thank you. I am so happy.
I won't give up either, Lila.
Patricia, I expect you to keep my secret.
Klaudia, have you seen any unusual plants?
The ocean's capacity to nurture... seems to remain a constant, regardless of the world.
How exactly did this island come to be?
I should bring one with me for Hanazuki's flower house.
The thing I'm looking for is not here... But for the sake of my companions, I will continue my search.
This power... is completely unlike anything I've known before...

ex.line: Good morning... Where shall we go today?
What is it, Commander? ...Never in my dreams would I have imagined inviting someone into my room. Anyway, please come on inside.
How old am I? Commander, you should know better than to ask a woman her age. But, I will say... we Orens have much longer lifespans than humans.
Looks like you're buried in work again, Commander. Is there anything I can help with? It's the least I can do.
In the midst of a journey chasing an impossible dream, spending some time like this might not be so bad after all...
I see that rabbit girl a lot whenever I'm out looking for seeds. She's almost always taking a nap though, just like right now... I wonder if I should wake her up.

I've heard you know a lot about the flowers of this world, Hanazuki. Do you know anything about a flower with great power? ...I see, thank you. By the way, that display over there is called... Ikebana? It's very beautiful.
What an incorrigible human...
Seems like you still have some missions to get through... Let's make quick work of them, shall we?
Your rewards have arrived. I'd like you to check to see if there are any plants inside...
They're coming. Everyone, stay alert.
This was also made possible because of you...
That seed isn't what I'm looking for either. But since it's something you went through the trouble of looking for... I'll take good care of it.

lines.line: An elegant verdure, a pellucid azure. I never knew there was such a lovely place at this port... Oh Commander, are you also out on a nighttime stroll?
An elegant verdure, a pellucid azure. I never knew there was such a lovely place at this port... Oh Commander, are you also out on a nighttime stroll?
The wind is quite refreshing tonight.
A wondrous place of sylvan beauty. How calming...
My hair ornament looks good on me? Thank you... I've always been fond of floral ornaments.
Being surrounded with plants like this fills me with nostalgia.
Are you heading back? I see... I'll be staying here for a bit longer. Good night, Commander. Sweet dreams.
One day, I will bring peace and verdure back to our old world. Let's start by doing whatever we can now, Lila.
I saw Patricia having a tea party with some of the girls from around here. By the looks of things, she's getting used to her life here.

Right before I arrived, I ran into a shadow of some sorts in the dorms that claimed to be a ghost. Do you think it was a real ghost...? Huh, it's just some girl called Long Island, not an actual ghost? I see...

Shinano, you should head back to the dorms if you were planning to go to sleep. Hm, she doesn't seem to want to wake up... I wonder what kind of dreams she's having right now, with that look on her face...
Aren't the stars beautiful, Commander?
...Perhaps I should be getting back now.
If you're worn out, you should take some time to rest. Don't worry, I'll wake you up if you fall asleep.
Oho. What sort of interesting person would summon me? My name is Kala Ideas, and I am the chief of the Wave Tuner clan. Perhaps I shall sojourn in this world for a spell, just as you desired.

I am Kala Ideas, chief of the Oren Songwave clan. The circumstances of my arrival may have been out of my hands, but a world with culture and history beyond my knowledge is fascinating indeed. I have been enjoying my time here.
Oho. What sort of interesting person would summon me? My name is Kala Ideas, and I am the chief of the Wave Tuner clan. Perhaps I shall sojourn in this world for a spell, just as you desired.
Those who set upon their work so diligently are a rare breed indeed. What an interesting one you are.
What's that? You're curious about the curios in my room? Heheh, they are all extremely valuable artifacts collected over the years. I'm quite attached to all of them.
Aha. So these little creatures are called Meowfficers? I've seen nothing of the sort in my own world... but they are such adorable things.
All the world's cultures gather in this port. The stories shared by all are truly fascinating.
Say, are there any dealers of rare curios in this port? Goodness! Then I must pay them a visit. Mind showing me the way, Commander?
Hah! How adorable it is to see someone who can't be true to her feelings. Take this advice from your elder: be sincere if you want your thoughts known.
A superior who looks after many... Heheh, I think you and I will be good friends. Come, why don't we chat over tea?
So you wish to treat me like a child, too? Say... I suppose I could use some exercise. Have at you!
This port is brimming with young ladies. Say, Commander, which is your... Oh? Is that topic taboo? Your life isn't an easy one, I see.
I've lived long enough now that it'll take far from this to disturb me...but I think a tongue-lashing is in order.
It seems you have some unfinished missions. What will you do about them, I wonder?
That mission must have been quite successful if these rewards are anything to go by.
Oho. Commander, you've got mail. A love letter, perhaps... What? It's not?
Well, then... Perhaps I ought to organize the things I found during our travels.
Your errand girls have returned. How I yearn to hear their stories.
Few can put me to such good use. You have my thanks, Commander.
Heehee. Who wants to face me next, hmm?
Quaint little foes, wouldn't you say so?
...These otherworldly fiends put up a surprising fight. Retreat seems to be the best course of action.
Hah! Prepare thyselves!
Oh ho. Perhaps it's finally time for me to get serious again!
You bore me...
Hrm. Suppose I ought to explore the port today. Commander, do you wish to join me?
The time is nigh to break our fast. Commander, why don't you take me somewhere I can sate my appetite?
Traveling to another world seems to shatter one's "common sense." But oddly...that isn't so bad an experience.
Heehee, this place is full of such interesting folk. I never tire of watching them... Oh, but of course, you are the most interesting of all. Heehee! Is it a relief to hear that?

Wh-what an exquisite item...! So this is a symbol of your sincerity? Very well. If it means so much to you, then I'm not one to refuse. As you wish, I will remain here and watch how this world changes for some time.
Ohh! You know me well, don't you? Thanks so much, Commander! You have my praise!
A most curious alchemist you are, Ryza.
Impressive, Whitefang comrade. How reliable!
I pray that your dream becomes reality, Serri.

ex.line: Have you awoken, Commander? Why don't you take some time off and show me around the port? I'm sure that even you need time away from work.
Hmm... I've found so many rare and fascinating curios in this world that my stash has become unmanageable. Commander, could you lend me a hand?
What's the matter? Would you like to chat with me? Heheh... No need to be shy. Come and sit next to me.
The genres of music in this world are prolific indeed. I happen to like this so-called "Classical" type. Listening to it is like rocking my heart to sleep...
Hehe, the ways of this world may be infecting me.
Friedrich der Große... Her lullaby is similar but different to the tones of our own world. But how beautiful and vigorous it is...
Yes, Ryuujou? Oh, is that a "dragon?" It's not exactly like the dragons I know... But I suppose one could say the same of this whole world, no?
*sigh*... Commander, will you ever learn to keep your hands to yourself? You are a tiresome one... Sit down and think about what you've done, you rascal.
I find myself with no shortage of free time... You know what that means. Why don't I help out with some of your missions?
Finished your mission, have you? Then allow me to pamper you as reward.
Folks, be careful not to get yourselves hurt!
Most spectacular leadership, Commander.
The fruit you gave me the other day was marvelous! It's been a long time since my heart throbbed like that. You know me well, Commander! How could I expect any less?

lines.line: I expected this sort of work to be effortless for me... but I see how wrong I was. It's not as simple as they say... Well? Are you just going to stand there and watch, or are you going to help?
I expected this sort of work to be effortless for me... but I see how wrong I was. It's not as simple as they say... Well? Are you just going to stand there and watch, or are you going to help?
You came at just the right time! Get over here and assist me, now!
I never did much baking back in my old world as it was outside my duties. It may not be easy to see, but I'll have you know that I'm enjoying myself.
Hmm. Meowfficers, will you be assisting me? Just don't stare too much - as long as you value your lives, that is.
This outfit? I'm told it's formal wear here. Hmm... You're not plotting something, are you? Why are you averting your eyes?
Wait here. You may try my homemade treats... What, you can't wait a sparse few minutes? As impatient as a child...
Oh... How in the world did cream get there? Should I be thanking you, or...?
Hmph. Do you think I can do nothing right? Or do you just want me to shove some of this cream in your mouth to shut you up?
Hmm... So far, so good. Yet it's so time-consuming... We'll have to wait.

Hello! I'm Asuka, second-year student at the Hanzō Academy! Wait... this isn't the new shinobi base at all! This place is your port, you say? Okay then... Well, no matter where I end up, I'll always train as best as I can!
I'm Asuka, second-year student at the Hanzō National Academy! I train daily to become the best shinobi I can be! Oh, and my favorite food is the futomakis my grandpa makes!

Hello! I'm Asuka, second-year student at the Hanzō Academy! Wait... this isn't the new shinobi base at all! This place is your port, you say? Okay then... Well, no matter where I end up, I'll always train as best as I can!
Good morning, Commander! Let's give it our all today, like always!
Gosh, I'm starving. I miss grandpa's futomaki rolls. They're the best ever, I tell you!
I wish I could treat everyone here to my grandpa's sushi. I guarantee you they'd love it!
While I love shinobi outfits, these "riggings" you have in this world are just amazingly cool!
The food in this world tastes amazing every time I eat it. Even your snacks are delish! Better watch my intake, or I'll put on weight.
Practice ninjutsu together with you, Akatsuki? Yes, please!
Kinu, you look like you're skilled with a blade... Are you a swordmaster, by any chance?
It's calming when someone pats your head, isn't it?
Huh?! Kat?! ...Oh, it's just you, Commander. What is it? Do you need something?
You know, your naughty touch reminds me of Kat.
What's this? You've still got unfinished missions!
Oh! Mission complete, Commander!
There's a message for you, Commander. Shouldn't you read it?
There ya are! ...Wait, sorry! Welcome back, Commander!
Looks like the girls are back from their errand! Hats off to them all.
I've gotten even stronger! I think my training's paying off.
May the best fighter win!
Phew, I'm feeling kinda sweaty! Rigging doesn't rust from sweat, do they?
It's so over...
Secret Ninja Art!
I-I think I should still be fine!
*sigh*, I can't believe you...
We're short on a lot of supplies... Huh? Go shopping together? That would be great!
Oh, Commander! If I may ask... could you teach me how to fight in your world? Ninjutsu is pretty hard to make use of on the open ocean, you see!
It feels like you've always got your hands full, Commander. Do you ever take breaks? I'm a little concerned over you!
I've started thinking there may have been a reason why I was sent to this world. It was to train here, to fight using a rigging... and yes, meeting you is a big part of it as well.
After fighting the Sirens alongside the shipgirls under your command, I've realized I'm just not up to scratch. I'm going to get much, much stronger, so please support me on the way there, Commander!
Wow! Awesome!! Commander, thank you so much! I'll treasure this♪
Ikaruga! I'll take the lead here!
Homura, I'll prove I'm better than you in this world too!
Yumi, cover me!

ex.line: Oh! Commander! I waited for you! Come on, let's get going!
I'm gonna treat you to my home cooking soon. You'll be able to taste the effort I put in!
What are your favorite things, Commander? Not just in terms of food, but also sports, music, and so on. I'm a little curious.
You say my training has paid off, but I won't feel satisfied until it pays off to an astonishing degree.
My grandpa, grandma, and classmates must all be worried about me... Even so, there are things in this world I have to do.
Shoukaku, hearing you play your flute reminds me of my home world - it strikes a chord with me!
What shinobi school are you from, Akatsuki? ...It's a secret? Thought as much. Secrecy is part of being a shinobi!
I-I'm not a fan of when you touch me out of the blue...
You've got tasks left to do. Don't worry! I'll help you with them!
Wow, you finished your tasks! You never fail to impress!
Come, let us fight!
I'd say my training has paid off, Commander.
Meeting you was, I think, necessary for my growth as a shinobi. It without a doubt had a great impact that allowed me to take the next step as a person!

lines.line: Blue skies, white sands, and oceans that stretch as far as the eye can see... I've seen this on TV before - this place is heaven on earth! Thanks so much for inviting me here, Commander! Now, it's time to have fun!

Blue skies, white sands, and oceans that stretch as far as the eye can see... I've seen this on TV before - this place is heaven on earth! Thanks so much for inviting me here, Commander! Now, it's time to have fun!
Oh, hey, Commander. Slacking? Am not! I'm just having a quick break!
Gosh, I feel so spoiled by this visit. So much fun to have, so many treats to eat... I'd be hard-pressed to call this "training" in any way.
Think I wanna give diving a shot. Should I ask the submarines for some tips?
Okay, break time! My grandpa's very strict about taking regular breaks, even when you're honing your skills.
Since we're here, nobody will get upset with me for having just a LITTLE beach fun, right?
New Jersey, do you recommend that new ice cream? I'd kill to try it myself!
Oh, it's just you, U-110~ I thought you were a real shark. I was this close to using the depth charges I borrowed from Akatsuki...
Doesn't my swimsuit look wonderful? Yeah, I love it, too!
Whoa! My bikini string will loosen if you touch me like that!
Nice fighting, Commander. How about a break in the shade? I've got cold drinks, if you'd like some!

I am Ikaruga, a third-year student at the Hanzō National Academy, serving as the shinobi class representative. How should I conduct myself in this foreign place? I would be most grateful if you would provide me with your assistance.
I am Ikaruga, third-year student at Hanzō National Academy and the shinobi class representative. But perhaps because of that, everyone says that I'm overly serious...

I am Ikaruga, a third-year student at the Hanzō National Academy, serving as the shinobi class representative. How should I conduct myself in this foreign place? I would be most grateful if you would provide me with your assistance.
I've been waiting. Shall we continue our training? Will you be providing me with a special training session today on rigging operation?
As a class representative, one of my important duties is cracking down on disorderly conduct. Do I make myself clear, Commander?
This rigging, as well as this very land upon which your port sits, is completely novel to us all. Indeed, we must study it thoroughly...

I'm not sure if it's because your instruction has been spot-on, Commander, but I feel like I've been in great form as of late. Perhaps this is a result of my training, as well as the bonds I've forged with the others...
Reading is my hobby. It's quite enjoyable to immerse yourself in books and broaden your horizons.
Iroha's clothes... look just like an ordinary swimsuit, but I wonder if they have any special functionalities...
I feel something mysterious coming from Nagato... something akin to an aura of dignity.
Umm... Please be gentle with me.
*gasp*! ...Now that I think about it, Katsuragi isn't here. When I say stuff like that, it's like I'm blaming her for everything, which really isn't a good thing...
Y-you're getting way too touchy-feely with me! This is your warning!
You still have work you've yet to complete. I believe it would be wise to make haste.
Looks like you've already finished your work. Don't delay, and make sure everything has been turned in.
It looks like some documents here are addressed to you, Commander. Want to take a look?
Well done on your sortie. How about some tea for a change of pace?
Those who were out running errands for you have returned. Let us go welcome them back.
I have become stronger. So too grows my mastery of this rigging.
I'll show you how we shinobi dance!
My training seems to have paid off. I could not be any happier.
This... calls for a retreat. But, I will not give up!
Be consumed by the soaring swallow's flames!
It's not too late... to turn this kind of mistake around!
What's your deal? ...Please stay away from me.
Are you interested in learning about ninjutsu, Commander? Very well! Be it offense, defense, espionage, or tactics, I'd be more than glad to instruct you!
Commander, if you're going to go on break, would you mind waiting a little bit? Yes, if you don't mind, I'd like to join you... Umm, only if you're fine with it though...
Has my hair caught your eye? Now that I think about it, Yomi also commented about how beautiful my glossy black hair is... Umm, I guess I don't mind if you touch it a little...
Though we each bear different burdens on our backs, our duty is nevertheless to come together as inseparable allies and defeat mighty foes.

When I found myself lost and confused, stranded in a strange new place, everyone at this port including you, Commander, gave me encouragement... and that allowed me to stand back up and move forward. That's right, let's continue that momentum, and keep trying our best.
Hm? Is this for me? Th-thanks! I'm so happy!
Asuka, you're being way too pushy! Calm down a little, please!
Homura! Please consider being a bit more cooperative!
I can't believe I'm fighting side-by-side with you, Fubuki...

ex.line: Where have you been, Commander? We've all missed you.
Commander, if you're tired, you should take some time to rest. Your efficiency will go up that way.
Now that I've finished up my shinobi training, I'd like to relax by working up a nice, easy sweat... Do you think you can provide me with your guidance?
I see quite a few people here practicing their sword techniques, but how do they maintain their blades? Are there any swordsmiths or sharpeners here?
Shopping around for some nice clothes can be quite refreshing... Commander, if you don't mind, do you think you could pick something out for us?
Miss Taihou's long black hair is always so lovely... How does she manage to take care of it?
Miss Akatsuki, are you also a shinobi just like us? Wow, to be both a ninja and a shipgirl... You must have had some superb training.
W-wait, please! Don't stare at me like that...
It's almost time for work. I don't mind helping out, so please keep it up.
Looks like everything's taken care of. Thank you for your hard work. Would you like a shoulder massage?
Behold my bladework!
Thank goodness... Everyone made it through safely.
