When I was about to give up on everything, when I felt like I couldn't continue on any further, you were the one who took my hand, illuminated the way forward, and encouraged me to press on... Because I have someone like you, I am able to keep going... So please, continue watching over me just a bit longer.

lines.line: Wow! The fish are so cute! The water's so clear that you can see everything under the waves! I've never seen an ocean like this before, and being able to relax while rocking back and forth on the water... is just like one of those "vacation paradises" I've read about in various books!

Wow! The fish are so cute! The water's so clear that you can see everything under the waves! I've never seen an ocean like this before, and being able to relax while rocking back and forth on the water... is just like one of those "vacation paradises" I've read about in various books!
Commander, do we have work to do? Is it okay if I stay here and watch the fish for a bit longer?
A place like this would normally have no connection with my shinobi duties, but for whatever reason, I feel at ease... Is this what it means to be on vacation?
Swish, swish... How soothing it is to sway to the sound of the waves and the rustling of the wind... I'm getting sleepier and sleepier...
The only time I've ever seen oceans this crystal-clear was through photos and TV screens... I had no idea a place like this really exists...
If we built a nice resort like this where I could lie down and watch the fish all day long, I'd visit every week...
Akashi, do you have a fish encyclopedia? Hmm? You charge extra for full color? Ugh, that's a rather steep price...
Is this what the world looks like through the eyes of a submarine? That makes me somewhat jealous...
Commander, please stop that! If you shake the hammock around too much, we'll fall into the water!
C-cut that out! If we fall into the water, the fish will be scared away!
Commander, thank you for your hard work. Would you like to take a little break? ...Um, do you think this hammock can support two people?
My name's Homura. I'm the leader of Homura's Crimson Squad. I was once affiliated with a school, like many others, but... stuff happened. Anyway, don't let that bother you.

I'm Homura. I used to be with Hebijo, but broke off from 'em, so I'm what's called a "renegade shinobi." While I made a clean exit, and I've still got some reservations about Miyabi... I don't regret my choice. Besides, I'm now the leader of my Crimson Squad, and I have companions I can trust.
My name's Homura. I'm the leader of Homura's Crimson Squad. I was once affiliated with a school, like many others, but... stuff happened. Anyway, don't let that bother you.
Ah, Commander! You're finally back. Let's get this started, then. Think you can keep up with me?
Hm? You wanna know more about me? Alright, I'll tell you. Wanna know how I train, or see my skill with the blade? I can do that right here, if you want.
I like a uniform that's on the simple side, but my rigging is a lot bigger than I'd like it to, maybe 'cause it's so powerful... Can't do much about that.
What, you keeping a secret from me? Heheh, don't assume you can keep it for long. It's better to come clean, before I force it out of you.
I'm craving some meat today. I need the extra calories on days when I train especially hard.
Shimakaze, while your outfit is no doubt easy to move in, it's a bit indecent... *gasp*! Maybe that's the point... Is it meant to seduce?!
"Rigging Burst Release"? Ayanami, that technique sounds... It sounds cool as hell!
Wh-what the hell are you doing? I'd have cut you down if people were around!
What's up, Commander? Got something on your mind?
Back off! You looking to get stabbed, or what?
You've got unfinished tasks. Don't be lazy - get to it.
Whoa, you completed your task. Good, 'cause unfinished business is bad.
Commander, you've got mail. Heh, I'd better read mine before it piles up.
Nice work. How'd it go? No embarrassing screwups, I assume.
The mission team is back. At least go give 'em your regards, Commander.
My training's paid off. I'm becoming one with my rigging, too. Little by little, I'm improving!
I'm gonna show you my crimson power!
Marvel at my refined strength and skill!
Dammit... What a letdown...
I, Homura, sacrifice myself to our dance!
Tsk! Shit! The real battle starts now!
...You're a real cocky bastard. Whatever happens next is up to your fate.
Hahah, you're a piece of work. I didn't take you for such a fearless one, you know that? Hey, it's a compliment.
What're you looking at?! No, I'm not mad. You staring is fine in my book.
I've still got much more training to do... What, is it THAT odd for me to grumble? (whisper) Because you're special... Nah, I didn't say anything.
I am a renegade shinobi, which means others see me as an oddity. However, that doesn't matter here. This is a place where fighting alongside you holds meaning, which is why I feel at home.

You've been my guide in this world, and it's thanks to you I've been able to concentrate on fighting. Commander, have I lived up to your hopes? ...Okay, I'm glad to hear it. I will fight by your side from this day on. I will give you my all to aid you.
Huh? This is for me? I-I see... W-well, I'll gratefully accept it.
Hey, melon mounds! Don't charge in blindly by yourself!
I'm not letting you run circles around me, Miss Class Rep.
Yumi, do NOT try to pick a fight with me here just because I'm an evil shinobi.

ex.line: Hey, welcome back, Commander. You good? 'Cause I feel bad when you don't... Ah, never mind that! Let's get to work.
It's really struck me how hard it is to follow somebody's orders. That's not to say I hate it, though.
Making bold moves is sweet. Taking the first step forward, then thinking afterwards... that's your specialty, isn't it?
While there's no such thing as training too much, I do take regular breaks so I don't make you worry.
Why do you touch me so much? Not saying I don't like it, just that it feels embarrassing past a point!
Yuudachi, I'll give you this meat if you help me with... Wait, what? Where'd the meat go? Hey! Did you just eat it whole?!
Akashi, I know you're busy, but could you have a look at my weapons? Huh? Payment? I'm not trying to sell them... What? Repair cost? Ugh, money-grubbing little...
Cut the boring crap. If you must, come at me head-on.
You've still got work to do. I'll help you out so we'll get it done quickly.
Finished a few tasks, huh? Man, you sure work hard. Then again, I like that about you.
You're about to find out how I fight like!
Heh! That's all they had? Too easy!

Fighting used to be all I had... Or, it should've been. Now I'm at a bit of a loss, 'cause casually hanging out with you is more fun than I thought. Let me enjoy this period of uncertainty a little longer.

lines.line: Fish! Heheh, that's a biggun! We'll be eating good tonight... Wait, I guess I don't need to worry about food now. Old habits die hard, it seems... Commander! Hey! I know you're over there! I'm gonna let you have a taste, so stop staring all enviously like that!

Fish! Heheh, that's a biggun! We'll be eating good tonight... Wait, I guess I don't need to worry about food now. Old habits die hard, it seems... Commander! Hey! I know you're over there! I'm gonna let you have a taste, so stop staring all enviously like that!
Hey, Commander. You finally showed up. Been waiting for you. You didn't forget we were going fishing today, did you?
Fishing is great. It sharpens your fingers' tactile sense, improves your concentration, and at the end of it all, it fills your stomach. It rocks.
I keep catching the same damn fish! Okay - sucks about the catch, but it's time to find a new riverbank...
Heheh! Check it out! Mine's 10 centimeters bigger! This has gotta be our biggest catch of the day!
Commander, come on, stop ogling me and start fishing! If you don't - no dinner for you.
Oh, hey, Kawakaze and Abukuma. Yeah, let's just kick back and enjoy some quiet time.
Since you told me to bring the catch to your place, I've gotta ask - you a good cook, Vestal?
Hm? Hey, wait! Don't touch me! My skin's sensitive since I got a sunburn... Eek!
Apply sunscreen? You're not offering just out of kindness, are you? It's written all over your face!
Now let's put you in with the other pretty fishies... Damn, this icebox keeps them looking like they're fresh outta the water!
I am Yumi, third-year student at the Gessen Girls' Academy. Though I know not why I was brought here, I am committed to justice, no matter where I go.

I am Yumi, third-year student at the Gessen Girls' Academy. I will spend every day training to achieve justice in this world, too. I kindly ask for your guidance and support to help me understand what it means to be an aircraft carrier.
I am Yumi, third-year student at the Gessen Girls' Academy. Though I know not why I was brought here, I am committed to justice, no matter where I go.
Welcome back - I've been awaiting you. It is good to see you return in good health.
You wish to know me better? Very well. I can do so in the form of combat. Actions speak more than words, after all.
Let us rest not too little, nor too much. It is important to rise again and continue on your path.
My rigging, despite its immense size, is actually quite easy to move around with.
While I believe functionality is the most important thing on the battlefield, I cannot say so easily with full confidence.
Ah, so you're able to control animals, Avrora! ...You aren't? But I've heard you use a bear to attack your enemies...
Chapayev, I find your rigging... very interesting, for reasons I'm not sure of. Particularly those ice crystals.
Quite the indecorous look on you... Heehee. I jest.
I'm afraid it startles me when others touch me so...
Wh-where do you think you're touching me?!
It seems we have a long journey to reach the end of the day.
It would appear you have completed a mission. Be sure to turn it in.
There are quite a few messages for you, Commander. Do read them before you forget, please.
I bid you welcome back, Commander. I'm certain you're weary after your mission. May I suggest taking a short break?
I've received word that your expedition party has returned. Be so kind as to speak to them, please.
Let us continue growing. Steadily, one step at a time.
All in the name of justice.
This is the power of pure justice.
A true shame though it be, we must retreat. This embarrassment will not happen again.
Freeze!
You believe this will make me step down?
Commander, don't you believe that you should reflect upon your actions once more?
You've enlightened me on so many matters, Commander... I only wish I could pay you back in some way.
I am indebted for your appraisals of me. I shall return them with even greater dedication.
Commander? Oh, I was merely cooling myself off. Speaking of which, you may find my presence more cooling than others'. I, um, invite you to get comfortable by my side, if you so like...
Oh, Commander... You've caught me in a moment of sloth. My apolo- You say it's no big deal, but it's not that simple. Although... perhaps a little sloth is forgivable, just with you.

I am not adept when it comes to expressing my feelings, and I may be hard to read as a result... However, there is no denying the faith I have in you. So, once again, it is my pleasure to be with you, Commander.
Is this... mine? Thank you very much. I'll treasure it for the rest of my life.
Asuka, bear witness to my power in this new world!
Homura, have you things you must do here, too?
To be fighting alongside you, Fubuki... If only my grandfather could see this.

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Heehee. I'm pleased to be by your side, as always.
You wish to know everything about me? Surely you jest... All you need to know is that I exist to achieve justice.
Commander, will you help me choose an outfit in the days to come? Certainly, you may pick one according to your tastes. In fact, I'd prefer that.
This port is in no shortage of curiosities. My gaze constantly switches from one thing to the next.
I wonder how everyone back at Gessen is faring... That said, Minori is there to watch over them, so I may be worrying over nothing.
I feel that my skills have synergy with the ladies of the Northern Parliament. Especially with Gremyashchy - she's diligent, so I think my way of doing things would work well with her.
St. Louis, I've heard you teach people to dance. I'd like to learn the Western style of dancing - do you think you could instruct me, please?
I am... not experienced with matters of impropriety.
It appears you have unfinished business. Could I offer you some assistance, incapable though I may be?
You've finished your assignment? Most marvelous.
Here I come!
It is an honor to fight alongside you all.
I can never repay you for the lengths you've gone for a hopeless woman with no knowledge of this world. Allow me to thank you once more, as I will again many more times to come.

lines.line: Here, Commander - shaved ice. Say "aah"... Heehee. I've not fed someone like this many times before, so please don't get mad in the event that I spill some.
Here, Commander - shaved ice. Say "aah"... Heehee. I've not fed someone like this many times before, so please don't get mad in the event that I spill some.
I've been waiting for you, Commander. May I have a moment of your time before you begin working?
Apparently, shaved ice comes in many different shapes across the world. I wonder how many it's possible to try in one lifetime?
Personally feeding another person isn't something I do often, but that's not to say it doesn't come naturally to me!
It flusters me when you stare at me like that, without even stopping to blink... You're really leaving me at a loss...
What luxury, getting to eat shaved ice on a warm midsummer day like this. What's more, getting to spend this moment together with you...
Oh? You recommend condensed milk, Kashino? That sounds appetizing, to be sure.
Kaga! While I'm sure there are people who would like the added plum liqueur, it's still only noon - I ask you to show abstinence, please.
While, personally, I don't think revealing swimsuits are my style, perhaps they're to your liking, Commander?
So it's true that you have an insatiable appetite for women in swimsuits...
Welcome back, Commander. Asuka told me that nothing beats shaved ice on a hot day, so I made you some. Please, have a seat.
I am named Fubuki. I try to keep out of the public eye, so how have I wound up in this strange place? Also, you may want to leave me to my own devices. If you wonder why, well...

I am named Fubuki. I once had reason to hide myself, and for some reason, I was transported to this world. You'd be wise to keep engagement with me to a minimum. Why? I'll let you surmise from the meaning of my other name, meaning, "Never Returning."
I am named Fubuki. I try to keep out of the public eye, so how have I wound up in this strange place? Also, you may want to leave me to my own devices. If you wonder why, well...
Welcome back. You've... returned to us. The ladies are raring to see you. Give them a warm smile, would you?
With apologies to everyone else, I'm trembling with excitement right now. If Bashou from Hebijo were here, she'd surely recite a poem about this.
I adore observing the people around the port. They are powerful, even if they aren't shinobi.
Gekkō taught me this fortune-telling method... Are there any conclusions we can draw from it?
There is so little I know of this world... and so much I'd like you to tell me about it.
I've heard you like white rice as well, Haruna. Rice really is meant to be savored on its own, without any extra seasoning on top.
Gascogne's speaking cadence is... strangely pleasing to me. It feels almost like being embraced by the most serene music.
Why are you so drawn to my hair?
Yes? What do you need? I'll assist in any way I can.
I will not overlook this as a mere jest.
It seems that you have tasks left to do. I suggest completing them posthaste.
You have yet to turn in a completed mission. Please remember to do that.
A number of letters addressed to you have arrived. Won't you read them now?
Heehee... Welcome back, Commander. I commend you on your mission.
The ladies have returned from their expedition. What will you do now?
I feel my strength growing.
Let us do battle.
We win this time. May we meet again.
Let us retreat for now - and plan our revenge...
This is your demise.
I'm only... getting started.
Alright then... What is it now?
I'm sorry that I don't have much to talk about... I've tried not to discuss private matters in my day-to-day life, you see.
Whenever we speak, there's never enough time to discuss all I want. Whether that's a good or bad thing, well...
What's important is sharing your positive feelings with your partner... You and a certain someone I know seem to have a lot in common.

I've noticed that I'm enjoying my life in this world more than I used to... Though, that doesn't mean I never want to return home, it only means that, for the time being, a part of me is content with fighting by your side.

There is a story behind my "Never Returning" second name. I attract yōma - the enemy. I feared that this ability of mine would put you - put others - in danger. Stunningly, you had the power to repel those enemies. Knowing that brings me joy.
You have a present for me...? ...No, it's a bad habit to overthink things. I will accept it gratefully.
I fear I may make this tough for you, Yumi...
Seems the new locale hasn't changed you one bit, Asuka.
I wonder what you think about the Sirens, Yūyaki...

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I've been waiting wearily for you... Heehee. That's not entirely false, you know.
You must care deeply about everyone who lives at this port. To tell the truth, it makes me slightly envious.
I'm sure Gekkō and Senkō would be very surprised if they saw how mellow I am now.
If Sirens are monsters that comprehend human language, they may have more in common with yōma than we think.
My second name, "Never Returning," would ward people off. Yet, the people of this world seem not to mind it very much.
Your apparel is quite similar to what we shinobi wear, Kuroshio. It appears to have all the same functions, too... Who made it, I wonder?
Do you do this to other ladies as well?
You have a few tasks left to do. I shall help with them.
Oh? You've accomplished one of your tasks. Shall I turn it in for you?
I shall imprint the Never Returning's might upon your memory.
It soothes my heart to see you're all okay.

You never fall prey to pessimism, and you lead us all with a positive attitude... How is one meant to stop idolizing a person such as you? Heehee... You shouldn't blush, or that blush will spread to me as well.

lines.line: Ohh, it's so wonderful, being in the calm water with you, Commander... Eek! What's this?! A fish hook's caught on to me... Please stop reeling it in, or my swimsuit will untie itself!
Ohh, it's so wonderful, being in the calm water with you, Commander... Eek! What's this?! A fish hook's caught on to me... Please stop reeling it in, or my swimsuit will untie itself!
Ah, you're back. You came running because you knew I'm here? Heehee, why, thank you.
Twilight - the time when the boundary between worlds blurs. Be aware of Sirens trying to kidnap you, Commander. I'll keep my eyes open, too.
When was the last time I played in the water leisurely like this... I really can't remember... Heehee, it's surprisingly fun.
Commander, don't you have important business to... Huh? Building rapport is crucial? If you say so...
Seeing the water gradually turn an orangish color from the sun... Doesn't it make you feel wonderful?
This sunscreen you told me about works wonders, Bremerton. If you know any other great products, please do fill me in.
Reno said she's going to aim for a spectacular splash and got out of the water... Is she going to be okay?
Do I look good in this swimsuit? I think it's rather revealing, though I'm happy as long as you like it.
Heehee. Your hand is nice and cool to the touch.
Well fought, Commander. Since the sun is setting, we could go for dinner together.
I'm Murasaki... from Hebijo Clandestine Girls' Academy. Umm... what is this place? I'd like to go home now... The outdoors are scary...
I'm Murasaki... from Hebijo Clandestine Girls' Academy. I don't really like going outside, so... can I go back to my room? Resting in my futon helps me destress...
I'm Murasaki... from Hebijo Clandestine Girls' Academy. Umm... what is this place? I'd like to go home now... The outdoors are scary...
Oh. You're back.
This is a strange place. If I hadn't changed from my shut-in days... I'd probably be so scared I'd break down crying now.
I worked extra hard, so can't I rest for a little longer? Miyabi isn't around, so...
Despite all the scary stuff... I'll be fine as long as I have Bebeby.
Your eyes scare me, Commander... Oh! Err, just a little, not a lot...
Hatsuharu? Umm, hey, would you... N-never mind I said anything!
I smell aromatic tea... Did you brew it, Belfast? Oh. Uhh... G-g-goodbye...
S-sorry... Huh? This isn't any kind of punishment? Okay, good...
Breaktime is over? Can't we rest for five more minutes, please?
St-stop it...
You've got unfinished missions, so... maybe look at the list again?
Looks like you finished a mission... Good work.
Commander... I think there's an unread letter for you.
W-welcome back. Are we done for today? Okay... Then can we relax for the rest of the day?
Your errand girls are back. I'm glad they're all okay...
Maybe my special training with Bebeby has paid off.
I so don't want to do this...
Now I can finally go home.
I'm scared... I'm scared... I wanna go home...
I dance for the honor of evil.
Ugghh... I'm afraid of pain...
No... I'm scared... Leave me to myself for a while...
You don't smell anything, do you? Good. I have a pretty sharp nose, so...
I talk to Bebeby whenever something's bothering me... From now on, though, I'll talk to you too, Commander.
You've taught me so much, and I really wish I could return the favor... So, if you ever need someone to talk to, come straight to me.
Truth be told... I don't want to fight. All I want is to go home as soon as I can. But, when I see everybody fighting for their dear lives... I feel like I can't abandon them.

Well, Commander? Am I... good enough? Thank goodness. I'm glad to hear that from you. I guess this means I'm not a burden to you, right? Maybe my sister will praise me if I can pull my weight until I come home...
This is... Huh? For me... Yeah, I'm so happy... Thanks...
Always smiling, even on the battlefield, huh?
You and Asuka look strangely simila- Eek! S-sorry!
Umm, Fubuki... N-no! Never mind I said anything.

ex.line: Welcome back. I'm glad to see you again... If you weren't here, I'd shut myself in my room.
When I first saw people wearing riggings, walking around the port, I felt like I was surrounded by superheroes... Secretly, though, I was really scared.
It's fun to hang out with people. And, as long as you're here, I don't feel scared...
Something smells friendly... *sniff sniff*... I think it's you, Commander.
I used to dislike going outside, but now I leave my room quite often... It's weird how things can change.
I-58, do you like quiet nights? Me too... I like it when it's quiet...
*sniff sniff*... You smell nice, Exeter... Like roses.
You're right up next to me... But I don't mind...
You still have unfinished missions. Maybe I could... help out, if you want?
You've finished a mission. With that done... could we have a short break?
Okay. Let's do this.
Oh, we won... Can we go back now?
I think I can push myself just a little as long as I'm with you. So please, be kind to me until we've found a way to return to our home...

lines.line: When you're in a swimsuit, listening to the waves, eating ice cream, and playing a beach game... can't you say it counts as being on the beach, even if you're indoors?
When you're in a swimsuit, listening to the waves, eating ice cream, and playing a beach game... can't you say it counts as being on the beach, even if you're indoors?
Welcome home. Well, this isn't YOUR place, but can't you still call it "home"?
As much as I appreciate everyone inviting me to go swimming... I prefer staying right here.
I'll faint if I go outside when it's too sunny. I wish Mr. Sun would take it down a notch...
I promise I won't spill my drinks... You don't mind if I keep a few around, right?
Just need to get to the next save point... I'll go for a short swim once I'm done, so please wait for me at the beach.
This swim ring you gave me is adorable... Thanks, Vestal.
Le Malin pointed me to a napping spot... But, as great as it is, I think it's a little too sunny for me...
There's arguably everything you need here to experience being on the beach.
There's no way I've gotten a tan, but... what do you think?
Well fought. You must be exhausted, so nobody should mind if you go straight home.

My name is Yūyaki... and I'm the leader of the Tohno Tengu Shinobi Group... To be honest, I'm not great around water... Bad things always happen when I'm around it... And this place is a whole ocean, right? What should I do...?

M-my name is Yūyaki... I'm the leader of the Tohno Tengu Shinobi Group. Um... I must say, this city is quite spectacular. It has so many big buildings and facilities... Huh? It's not a city, but rather a port? And it's your base of operations too? I see... Life can be full of unpredictable surprises...

My name is Yūyaki... and I'm the leader of the Tohno Tengu Shinobi Group... To be honest, I'm not great around water... Bad things always happen when I'm around it... And this place is a whole ocean, right? What should I do...?
It's good to see you again. Let's... both give it our all today. Yes, me included...

There are so many things about this port that I don't yet understand. It would be terrible if I accidentally ended up wrecking it... Though, I'm sure that's nothing Miss Nachi can't resolve with some money...
Holding a weapon is scary... and it's not something I'm good at... But I'm not going to be able to fight otherwise, right?
I like animals a lot... but they don't seem to miss me a whole lot. Why do you think that is?
The warmer it is, the more nature flourishes... just as is the case with me.
There are lots of people here with silver or white hair, huh? I don't stand out much in comparison... Miss Belfast, you're also... very beautiful.

Miss Hiei, is that the fermented food you have here? Do you mind if I have a taste? ...Huh? That takes bravery? If you put it that way, I'm sure I'd have even more regrets if I don't at least try it...
Commander, do you... enjoy touching my hair?
People in the village always used to comment on how white and beautiful my hair is... What do you think, Commander?
I'm not sure... that's proper conduct...
Do you still have work left to do? Your job is quite difficult, isn't it...
You've already finished your work? Impressive, just as expected...
I've received several messages addressed to you, Commander... Would you like to review them right now?
Well fought, Commander. What did you think of our last battle? Hopefully, we were able to be of some use...
Wow, that's amazing... So this is what everyone uses to help guide them back home? ...Oh, and if this part here is glowing, that means...
W-woah... I feel power coursing through me!
Heheheh... Just leave everything to me!
Ahh... My blood boils with victory!
S-sorry... I think... I messed that one up a little...
Ahaha! I'll cut you to ribbons!
Ugh... I've got no choice... but to do this! This is where the real fight begins!
I might've placed too much faith in you. That is something I'll have to reflect upon...
O-okay... But, that's still not enough... Eek! I, I'm so sorry! I wasn't watching where I was going... since I might've been lost in thought a little... I'll make sure to be more careful from now on.
I think my shinobi skills have improved here. That may be partly due to your help, Commander... I hope Lady Jasmine can witness this after I return home...
Don't you think you've been... coming on a bit strong recently? No, um, I'm not saying you shouldn't... If anything, I kind of like it... Um, forget I said anything...

Commander, thanks to your mindfulness, I feel like... we've been able to move forward in a positive direction. Our ultimate goal is still to return home, and we're not going to give up on that, but... beyond that, we're glad to help you in other ways.

Everyone here... and above all, you, Commander, showed me acceptance... I've come to realize, that is truly the most valuable treasure. The things that've happened here have taught me how bonds between people are formed and strengthened.
Commander, is this for me? Huh? Really?! No way... Thank you so much...
Fubuki! I'll show you the results of my training!
Asuka, Homura... You two... are breathing perfectly in sync...
Murasaki! Don't just clam up and disappear on us!

ex.line: W-welcome back. Commander, I was getting a bit lonely without you...
This place... is completely different from our village. But, after staying here for a while, it's starting to feel a bit like home... I'm getting used to it here.
As Tohno's leader, I have to do my best... but I still feel like I'm not strong enough...
I wonder how Tohno Village is doing these days... I'd really like to know, but the battle here is also very important right now.
This port has so much delicious food... I have to tell Ushi when I get back.
I always feel calm and at peace when Miss Illustrious is around.
Amagi-chan, you'll tell me all about the delicious food at this port, right?
Commander... is this what gets you going? It's... rather embarrassing...
It looks like you can't keep up with your work... Shall I give you a hand...?
Since you're done with work... How about going for some tea once you've wrapped things up?
Just leave it all to me! I'll deliver victory right into your hands!
You had the guts to stand before ME... at least, your courage is worth acknowledging!

To be entirely honest, there's a problem that I haven't been able to discuss with you. But, it'll be okay. My friends and I will find a way to get by. I'm sure that it'll be alright... because of you, Commander.

lines.line: Phew... Nothing beats a cold shower. I'm still not great with water, but this cool and soothing sensation really makes me feel refreshed. Commander, do you want to join in?
Phew... Nothing beats a cold shower. I'm still not great with water, but this cool and soothing sensation really makes me feel refreshed. Commander, do you want to join in?
Welcome back, Commander. Did you have any plans for the day? I don't mind keeping you company if you'd like...
Blue skies, white clouds, and an ocean that stretches into the horizon... It's completely different from what you see in the mountains... I never imagined I'd be able to see scenery like this...
I think... I'd prefer relaxing by the mountainside to playing by the water...
If I get a tan while wearing this outfit, it's going to leave behind imprints of my swimsuit... "But that's what makes it good?" Oh, um... I see...
I feel my body get hotter than usual... when someone stares at me so intently...
Miss Akashi, it's very thoughtful of you to bring drinks out for me, but... aren't these prices a bit excessive?
I am quite experienced with water-manipulating skills as part of my shinobi training, but not quite to the level of mastery as Reno and the others...
I can't believe you prepared all these wonderful swimsuits for us... Huh? You chose this one specifically for me? Umm... does it look good on me?
My skin's cold? Umm... that's because I just got out of the shower...
Good work, Commander. You really worked up a sweat, huh... I think you should get yourself tidied up first... Maintaining your appearance is also very important...
I'm Lala, and I'm from Planet Deviluke. What's your name? ...Just call you Commander? Okay, Commander, it's great to meet you!
Hi, I'm Lala! Lala Satalin Deviluke. I'm from Planet Deviluke~ Call me Lala, by the way. I ended up on this planet by chance, but you and your friends seem like fun, so I might stay a while~
I'm Lala, and I'm from Planet Deviluke. What's your name? ...Just call you Commander? Okay, Commander, it's great to meet you!
I souped up your chair with my Almighty Tool! Now your work will be faster than ever! Come on, give it a try!
The outfit I'm wearing right now is actually a transformed Peke! I have a version that matches Sainan High's uniform, too! Remind me to show you some time~
Where should I set up my lab~ Is there enough space in your office?
Wow! Is this one of Soobrazitelny's inventions? Neat! That's the genius of the Northern Parliament for you!
All of the food here is so good! You wanna know what Deviluke food is like? I'll cook some now~
Hey, do you get Explosive Heat: Magical Girl Kyouko here? That show is awesome! I'll invent a device that lets you watch it here!
What's up? Are you interested in Peke? It's a costume robot I made!
My tail? You wanna know about it? Actually, everyone from Planet Deviluke has one~
Whoa! None of that, now~
You still have unfinished missions. Being a Commander sounds tough!
Mission completion rewards received!
Commander, you've got new mail~ Don't forget it!
Good work on your mission, Commander! Take a nice break now~
Shipping materials, huh... You should use the D-Dial I invented! It could save you a lot of time!
I've powered up...? How did that work?!
Leave it to me!
Yaaay! I won!
Oof... Well, guess we should retreat...
Go-Go Vacuum-kun, go kick some butt!
Waaah! That huuurts!
Aww... That's kinda disappointing.
Commander, can you introduce me to everyone at the port? I wanna be their friend!
Hey, what if we all threw a party together? It's sure to be fun and lively!
Commander, we should go out into space sometime. I even had a spaceship prepared!
Thanks to you, I've made so many friends at port! Thank you! And I'm happy to be YOUR friend, too, of course!
It was an accident that brought me to this planet, but every day with you all has been fun! I think I'd like to stay here even longer~ Hope you'll have me, Commander!
Thanks~! Ehehe~ I'm so happy! I'll really treasure this!
Momo, Nana! Let's kick butt together!
Yami, you're too cool!
Haruna, be careful out there!
You look stronger than before, Yui!

ex.line: I'm gonna help you with your work today~! What's wrong? Oh, I'm still working on my invention, so I can't use it today.
I wish you had a costume robot like Peke~ Did you know it has a little sister?
Commander, I found the perfect space for a lab in your office~ I can invent new things here every day!
Alright! Today, I'm gonna clean this place up~ Peke, change into an apron! Wait, not JUST an apron, okay?!
Whaaat?! Saratoga's a magical girl? Why doesn't she get her own show?! Commander, we need to turn her life into a TV drama~
We should go explore the port together sometime! I wanna see everything~
What? Something wrong~?
Nnh... D-don't touch my tail, please...
Nooo...
Great effort today, Commander! I wish I had an invention that could make you feel refreshed! I'll have to think about one!
I'm so happy I met you, Commander! And it's great that you feel the same way about me~! Next, I think I'll invent a charm that yields good fortune.

lines.line: Go Go Vacuum-kun might be malfunctioning a little, hehe... But I'll fix it right away, so don't worry!
Go Go Vacuum-kun might be malfunctioning a little, hehe... But I'll fix it right away, so don't worry!
Hmm... How do I stop Go Go Vacuum-kun, again...? I made it a long time ago, so I forgot~ Oh, Commander! Watch out!
This is my room here at the port! I know it's a little messy... Also, I'm repairing this one, and that one's still in development. Anyway, come hang out whenever you want!
C-cut it out with my tail... I'm losing all my energy... Urk...
I can wear normal clothes while Peke charges, but Peke's just so much comfier.
Hmm... Nope, this won't do. I'll ask Admiral Nakhimov and Ingraham for help!
Phew~ It's so hot, I'm practically soaked from sweat~ I know! Let's get everyone together for a big bath!
Things tend to malfunction when you experiment as much as I do, but failure is the basis of success. Just gotta try harder next time!
I'll be fine! I can get through this!
You're gonna help untangle me? Thanks~! H-huh? Is it just me, or is it getting tighter?
H-hey...
You can prioritize your missions! I'll be there as soon as I clean up this mess!
Phew~ I managed to stop Go Go Vacuum-kun, finally~ And you finished your mission, too!
Aaaah! Go Go Vacuum-kun is sucking up all your mail! Bad vacuum, bad!
Welcome back, Commander~! It's gonna take me a while longer to fix this... I mean, it's just getting stronger! Nnngh... Commander, heeelp!
Go Go Vacuum-kun... still not working, huh?
Phew~ Finally fixed that problem! It's a good thing Go Go Vacuum-kun didn't attack you! It'd be really bad if you got hurt!
Uh-huh, so you're the Commander? I'm Nana, Lala's little sister. This port you've got here is pretty lively... Well, it was nice meeting you.
Hm? Oh, I'm Lala's little sister, just like Momo. We came from Planet Deviluke. I can talk to animals! Also, if you do anything lewd around me, I'll hate you forever!
Uh-huh, so you're the Commander? I'm Nana, Lala's little sister. This port you've got here is pretty lively... Well, it was nice meeting you.
Welcome back! Let's go for a walk or something, get some exercise. Gotta keep in shape!
I know everyone at this port loves you, but don't let it get to your head!
The vibe here at port feels kinda lonely... I think it'd be more fun if you had more cute animals around! Man, I wanna meet some animals... Take me to the zoo, right now!
Commander, I see you staring at Momo... Wait, you think bigger is better, don't you?!
You're awfully quiet in front of me. It's suspicious... I'd better watch you closely. N-not that I'm enjoying watching you, or anything!
There are so many good swimmers here... Especially that I-25 girl. Her floppy bunny ears are too cute!
Hm? What's up?
Hah! Dodged it. Don't underestimate me.
I said cut it out!
You've still got missions waiting. Is now the time to be slacking?
What's a mission reward? It's kind of like a game. Interesting...
New mail just arrived. Want me to read it for you?
Hi again. What sweet stuff did you bring back for me today?
Good work, everyone! Let me help next time, would you?
Whoooa, awesome!
Don't you worry. I'm right here with you, after all!
Heheh! That's right, be grateful that I was here.
H-hey, what the heck is going on here?
Eat this!
I-I'm getting mad!
So that's the kind of person you are...
You might not be very reliable, Commander. I'll have to keep an eye out myself.
The port's tennis court is pretty nice. How about we go play a round together?
Wh-what do you mean, you're "fine with flat"?! Nobody asked, so keep your weirdo remarks to yourself, pervert!
Thanks for coming to the zoo with me, Commander... Seeing all these cute animals really calms me down. I had a lot of fun today. Thanks again!
I accept that you're someone I can rely on, Commander. Let's stay together for a long time to come! Huh? No, I never said I LIKED you! Get over yourself!
Huh? Can I really have this...? Thank you! I'm so happy!
Nice. With all of us here, this is in the bag.
I'll show you what I'm made of.
Let's do our best!

ex.line: Welcome back! Let's do our best together today~ Ugh, it's still so embarrassing to talk like that... Let's just go back to acting normal, okay, Commander?
Don't think you can do whatever you want at port just because we're closer now! You're still unreliable, so I need to keep a watchful eye on you.
Oh, Commander, you're back. Hmm? My pet's been following you? Th-that's just me making sure you don't pull anything weird. It's not a sign of me being interested in you!
Momo might seem like a good girl, but don't let her lure you into a false sense of security. I've had enough of getting dragged into her problems.
Aww, I wish I could eat sweets with the Commander... Huh?! You bought some for us? Hooraaay!
Commander! Belfast invited us to a tea party~ I hear Royal Navy tea parties are as fancy as can be... Heheh, I should invite Lala and Momo along, too!
D-don't treat me like a kid...
Th-that tickles! Cut it out!
Y-you... beast!
You STILL haven't finished your missions? Oh, fine. I'll just have to help you!
I know you're busy, so I bought you a snack. Let's eat together before you get back to work.

What do you mean when you say I'm "blessed with natural mobility"? Are you talking about my boobs?! Well, it doesn't sound like a compliment to me! But... If it was really meant that way, then maybe choose your words a little better next time.

lines.line: There you are, Commander. I'm on a real hot streak today! Wanna come play with us and test your skills?
There you are, Commander. I'm on a real hot streak today! Wanna come play with us and test your skills?
Finally, you're here. We were just starting a new game... Come on, you know I'm not gonna let you get away.
What? Don't just stare at me. Or are you amazed by my skills?! Hah, you've got a good eye!
Luck's just another part of skill, you know. Winning games is too easy for me - ready to give up and accept defeat yet?
Heheh, I win again! Now you have to buy me snacks! ...Huh? You never promised that? Okay, then let's play again!
I could play with you all day, Commander! Oh, right, you have work... That's rough, buddy. Should I get Lala and Momo to help you?
Hey, so, I hear Long Island and Ayanami are good at video games... Does that make them good at card games, too? I dunno.
No peeking!
Whoa! You startled me... I was in the middle of thinking of a strategy!
Not another touch, I mean it!
You can play AFTER you finish your missions.
While you're focused on missions, you might as well go and pick up your rewards.
Already done with your work? Then let's get back to it. Lala and Momo are waiting.
Wow. You pick up on the rules fast, Commander. Do you play a lot of games? If so, let's play some more sometime.
Hi there. You're the Commander of this port, right? I'm Momo Belia Deviluke, but you can just call me Momo. I look forward to fighting with you, and I hope we'll be best friends♪
I am Momo Belia Deviluke of Planet Deviluke, and I'm one of Lala's little sisters. Oh, and I can hear the voices of plants. I hope we can get along well during my time here.
Hi there. You're the Commander of this port, right? I'm Momo Belia Deviluke, but you can just call me Momo. I look forward to fighting with you, and I hope we'll be best friends♪
I made you some sweets, Commander. Could you give them a try, please?
I can converse with plants, and it sounds like all the plants in your office are grateful for your care. It's plain to see that you're a very kind and caring person, Commander.
How can you stay so calm when you're surrounded by lovely women all the time?
I love how fancy the port's café is. It even has plenty of video game consoles. If only it had a garden, it would be perfect.
Huh? Do I use my plants to monitor people? Ahaha~ Commander, your imagination is just wild. Of course I can't do that, silly.
Kiev of the Northern Parliament seems to really like cacti. Just recently, she had me teach her how to grow them.
Is something wrong? Do you need my help?
Are you curious about my tail? Well, I suppose you can touch it...
My, my... That won't do, Commander.
You still have missions to do. Try your hardest for just a little longer, okay?
Mission rewards? Once you get them, let's relax with some tea.
I organized your new mail. Give it a read when you have time.
Oh, welcome home! I cleaned up your office a little. I hope you don't mind...
The shipgirls who went out for commission work are back. Would you like for me to go help them?
Oh, my... Have I changed?
I'll do my very best not to disappoint the Commander!
Yeah... I need to keep doing my best.
I'm sorry, Commander.
Don't underestimate my friends!
This is getting irksome...
So this is the Commander who leads the port... How disappointing.
How do you normally spend time with the girls of the port? I'm curious.
Everyone gets along so well here. That speaks to your impressive leadership, Commander.
Actually, I happen to have a certain... plan of my own. I'm sure it'll help you, but for now, it's my little secret.
During our time together, I've begun to understand why all the girls here love you so much. This is indispensable information for the sake of my plan.
In order to further our relationship... Yes, I need to execute my plan! Oh? You want to know what it is? Well, it's a genius plan... A plan to make everyone here love you even more!
Is this a present? Thank you very much.
Momo, Nana! Let's kick butt together!
Yami, you're too cool!
You look stronger than before, Yui!

ex.line: Commander, let's keep working on our plan today! ...Oh, but you have so much work. Thank you for all you do.
Yes... In my time at this port, I've realized how special you are. You're not just kind - you have the charisma necessary to bring everyone together, as well.
If I use this flower, the Commander should be more aggressive... Hmm... That sounds a little dangerous, so let's not.
Oh, my... You won't accept my suggestions so readily. You are earnest, yes, but it's okay to be spontaneous once in a while.
1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6... What am I counting? I'm actually seeing which faction has the most girls who love you~
Taihou of the Sakura Empire, Mogador of the Iris Orthodoxy... Hmm, yes, those two should be very helpful. Nope, still not telling you my plan♪
Heehee... You're too sweet, Commander.
Eep! Are you using me to rehearse the plan...?
Mm... You're getting awfully bold, Commander...
Welcome back, Commander. I see you're even closer to everyone than before.
You need to be more ravenous, more carnivorous, to withstand the combined love of this port. Want me to teach you what to do?

lines.line: Oh my, Commander. Did I wake you? You didn't look very restful... Were you having a nightmare? Don't worry. Everything's okay now~
Oh my, Commander. Did I wake you? You didn't look very restful... Were you having a nightmare? Don't worry. Everything's okay now~
Oh, no... Are you okay? You look like you need water. I'll get some right away.
When I passed by before, you looked like you were having an awful nightmare. I wanted to console you, but I may have been a bit forceful... I hope you're okay.
Your nightmares might come from overwork. Take regular breaks, okay? If something happened to you, so many girls would be heartbroken.
This seed grows a plant that helps relieve stress and yields good sleep. Try planting it in your room.
Maybe I should call Belfast and have her get you. You still don't look too well...
You always make the people of the port your first priority. I think that's why everybody loves you so much.
Thank you very much.
Do you need my help?
C-Commander... Feeling better already?
Your mission completion rewards? I could get them for you, if you'd like?
You have new mail, but I think you'd be better served by taking a nap before you read it.
Commander, you look better now. I'm glad you're okay.
May I give you a big hug? You always work yourself to the bone for everyone here. It's only right that I thank you.
I'm Golden Darkness. Pleasured to make your acquaintance.
My name is Golden Darkness. I came to Earth as a weapon, but I found a friend. Her name is Mikan, and she's good at cooking.
I'm Golden Darkness. Pleasured to make your acquaintance.
Going to work? Understood.
Commander, do any shops here sell taiyaki? Consider it... a daily ritual.
Are you the "master" of everyone at this port?
What kind of books do you read? I like reading, too.
Mikazuki gave me taiyaki. It was delicious.
This is my combat gear. I wear it so I'm ready for a fight at any time.
What?
Do you need something?
I hate perverts!
New missions, hm...
Mission... rewards. No, don't mind me.
Mail, Commander.
Well done, Commander.
The commission is complete? No wonder it's so lively now.
Is this... new power?
Beginning operation.
It's done.
Mission failure... Retreating.
Enough excuses.
It's over.
...Don't come any closer.
Don't pay me any mind. I'm just reading a book, that's all.
Thank you for letting me read the books in your office. You have some interesting ones...
Dinner tonight is rice with taiyaki on top, taiyaki salad, and taiyaki miso soup... Please partake, Commander.
You noticed that I'd finished your books and bought more for me... Thank you. You're kinder than I'd thought.
Is this... proof that you and I are "buddies" now? I'm happy to have met you at this port, Commander.
Thank you very much... I really like it.
Princess, take cover behind me.
Get away! It's too dangerous!

ex.line: May I help, Commander?
As I've spent time with you and the others, I've come to realize that maybe I'm worthy of being here.
Am I lonely? No, I don't think so. I have you and my other friends.
Never show me those gross, slimy fish again, please...
Princess Momo said one should be gentle with girls and I agree.

Albacore introduced herself as the Sunken Assassin, but she looked too cute to call her that. But Yuudachi called herself the Pork Bun Killer, so maybe I should call myself the Taiyaki Annihilator...?
Is there a new mission?
*staaare*...
I'll kill you!
Welcome back. Take a break - I have taiyaki for you.
Maybe it's best to simply enjoy my time with you and my friends while we still can.

lines.line: Commander, why have you entered without my express permission? Prepare to die.
Commander, why have you entered without my express permission? Prepare to die.
Don't get ahead of yourself, Commander.
A pajama party...? That sounds fun.
Is this outfit appropriate for a pajama party?
What do people DO at pajama parties?
Commander... Why are you staring?
Peeking at someone changing clothes... Unacceptable.
Are you having some perverted thoughts?
Are you plotting something?
An accident? Lies won't work on me.
I should be dressed by the time you finish getting your rewards...
Commander. Mail.
I hate perverts, I hate perverts! Don't look at me!
I hear the commission team finished their work. You should go greet them soon, Commander.
Pajama parties are lovely. I feel closer to you and the others than ever before. I'll need to express my gratitude to Princess Momo and Princess Nana.
Nice to meet you, Commander. My name is Haruna Sairenji. I'm going to be in your care for a while, but if there's anything you need my help with, don't hesitate to ask!
My name is Haruna Sairenji. I'm a second-year student of Sainan High School, but somehow I've ended up here... Life here is different from how it was in Sainan, but I'm having fun. I like it.
Nice to meet you, Commander. My name is Haruna Sairenji. I'm going to be in your care for a while, but if there's anything you need my help with, don't hesitate to ask!
Good morning, Commander. You've been busy lately, so I organized your work for today. Hopefully that helps.
This is called rigging...? And it's a weapon? How odd. I'll have to keep studying so I can learn to use it quickly.
As a class representative, paperwork is kind of my specialty. But I'm willing to try other work, too. If I don't understand, could you teach me...?
Is Mary Celeste really a ghost? So ghosts really do exist...
Is it weird to walk around port in my school uniform? What do you think?
Lala's really taken to this place. I should do my best, too, so that I don't trouble the people of this world.
Hm? Something wrong?
What's the matter, Commander? Oh, if you have time, let's chat for a while.
Eep?! We can't...
Make sure you don't forget your unfinished missions, okay?
Your missions are all done! Good job. Get some rest.
Remember to check your mail regularly.
Good work, Commander. You can go rest now. Leave the paperwork to me!
The commission team is back. Wanna go see them together, Commander?
Do I feel stronger? I do. It's weird, though...
I'm a little unconfident, but I'll try!
We won? Thank goodness! And thank you for your orders.
I'm sorry, Commander... It's just so scary...
I can do this! Yeah, I know it!
Maybe this isn't a place I can rest easy in, after all...
I was worried that I wouldn't be able to get along with the people here, but with your help, I think I'll be just fine!
You're really sweet, Commander. You pay attention to me, help me when I need it... Thank you.
I had a lot of worries at first, but thanks to you and everyone else here, I feel a lot better.
At this point, I'd feel so bad saying goodbye to everyone. I care about Sainan, too, of course... but life here has been so fun. Let's keep making lots more memories together, okay?
Is this proof that you've acknowledged me? Thank you! If there's anything else I can help you with, just tell me! I don't know how good at it I'll be, but I'll do my very best!
Thank you, Commander! I will treasure this.
Lala, let's do our best!
Impressive as ever, Kotegawa! I should to my best, too!

ex.line: Good to be working with you again, Commander. I'm your secretary ship today, so I summarized your schedule and such. Take a look, please.
I still don't understand how rigging works, but I'm happy I can fight like Lala now. It makes me not want to part with it again~
I can do any and all chores, so call me if you need housework done. I'm happy to help.
Milk is good for you and helps you get taller, so I drink it all the time. There's NO other reason! ...Have some, Commander.
That Dolphin girl really is like a dolphin. She's kind, gentle... and she also gave me a blobfish.
Commander, is it true that there's an aquarium here? Let's go there together. I bet I'll see all kinds of sea creatures that weren't in my world.
You're too nice, Commander.
Ah! I was just meaning to ask you something. Do you know if there are stores that sell good black tea leaves around here?
Geez, Commander. I'll still get mad, even when it's you...
I made a list of your missions. Does that help?
I've gotten used to my rigging AND combat, so I think I'll be able to help next time we sortie!
Yes...! We managed to protect everyone, Commander!

I think I've accomplished a lot here. I wasn't able to hold my own in a fight before unlike Lala, and I had so little confidence in myself. But thanks to you, I could muster the courage to try. From now on, I'll keep doing my best so I can be the protector instead of the protected!

lines.line: I made some black tea, Commander. We could drink it together, if you'd like...? These are my favorite tea leaves.
I made some black tea, Commander. We could drink it together, if you'd like...? These are my favorite tea leaves.
You look sleepy, Commander. It's been a busy afternoon. I think you should clock out early today.
Hearing the ocean and feeling the warm sunlight is a great way to wake up. Thanks for letting me live here, Commander. I love it.
I've been scared of these odd noises I hear from the hallway at night... Imagine my relief when I learned it was just Bristol investigating the dorms.
Sometimes, I still leave the light on when I sleep. When it's dark, I can't stop thinking about scary stories.
Lala invited me to a pillow fight party. Everyone else is coming - join us, Commander!
I'm growing these succulents. Aren't they cute? If you like them, feel free to take one.
My heart skipped a beat...
I can't sleep, either... Here's an idea. Why don't you tell me more about yourself and the people here at port?
Hyah?! No more of that, please...
You've been working this late? That's awful... Tell me if I can help at all, okay?
How about a hot drink? Maybe coffee or tea... Oh, hot milk to help you sleep might be a good idea.
Good night, Commander. Sweet dreams.

Are you the Commander? I'm Yui Kotegawa, and I'm pleased to make your acquaintance. Some strange circumstances brought me here... But if I'm to intrude on your port, then I promise to uphold discipline in return!

Yui Kotegawa, Sainan High Discipline Committee. I ended up here after an unfortunate accident, but it's obvious that discipline is a serious issue here. So I'm going to do my job - just leave it to me!

Are you the Commander? I'm Yui Kotegawa, and I'm pleased to make your acquaintance. Some strange circumstances brought me here... But if I'm to intrude on your port, then I promise to uphold discipline in return!
Back at home, we said that disheveled dress reflects a disheveled mind. What I'm saying is, you should dress better.
Hmm... There are so many girls breaking the rules here that I can't deal with them all myself. Commander, can you help me patrol?
You need to focus when you're working, Commander! No glancing around or fiddling with random things!
The port's Meowfficers look a little different from normal cats... but they're round and cute in their own way, so it's fine.
This stuff called "rigging" is awfully flashy... Why does mine have a plant stem in its mouth, though?
Wh-what? What's the problem?
What's up? Do you want help with something?
H-how... utterly depraaaved!
You have new mission deadlines, Commander. Don't miss them!
Mission complete. Phew... Maybe now I can finally get a break.
Commander, there's new mail for you. Don't let your mailbox fill up with unread messages.
Thanks for your efforts, Commander. Rest is important, so... I brought you a cold drink...
Commander, the commission work is complete. Don't forget to collect the supplies.
Wh-what is this?! Am I... getting stronger?!
I won't let even one breach of discipline pass!
Phew... It's finally over.
I-impossible!
No perverted activities on my watch!
I can still keep fighting!
You have no common sense. Just disappointing.
So many strange things around here converge on you... A Disciplinary Committee member knows no rest, I guess.
I saw a girl with cat ears the other day. I'd assumed they were just a headband, but they were real! Lala's tail surprised me, but that was an even bigger shock.
The school at port is a lot like the one we go to. But the chemical equation on the blackboard is wrong. Who wrote that...?
Before I knew it, I'd gotten so used to life here. I will continue to fight and carry out my disciplinary duties - for you, and for the people of the port!
If everyone still needs me here, then I don't mind staying here longer. But no perverted behavior while I'm here, got it?!
This is so cute... Th-Thanks, Commander.
Stop pulling out so many weird things during combat!

ex.line: Good morning, Commander. The port really is full of all kinds. I thought Lala was weird, but she doesn't hold a candle to some of the people here.
This kitty really likes you... I-I'm jealous. Can you teach me how to be liked by cats?
People listen when I warn them about breaches of discipline, but there's still too much to overlook. I have to keep it up!
As a disciplinarian, it's natural that I uphold order here. Help me out, Commander!
H-hey, if you need something, you can say it.
Commander! People like you make me so... Ugh! Kneel down and apologize!
Another new mission? Darn... I'm happy to help, if you'd like.
You finished all of those missions? I'm impressed.
Commanding a whole port sounds difficult. You should make sure you're well-rested before you take on your next workload.
Thanks for agreeing to go to the port's cat café with me, Commander. Those soft, friendly kitties, especially the Meowfficers... They're too adorable!

lines.line: Come on over, I'm not scary~... Wha, Commander?! H-hey... don't go barging into people's rooms! Look, you're scaring my new friend!
Come on over, I'm not scary~... Wha, Commander?! H-hey... don't go barging into people's rooms! Look, you're scaring my new friend!
Commander, did you come looking for this kitty here? Thanks. Umm... If you have some spare time, you know... I mean... N-never mind!
I might not look it, but I'm a busy person... But I do worry about you, so if you have something to say, go ahead.
I think it'll be fine for now. Thanks for your help, Commander - but don't relax too much, because I might need it again soon.
Algérie and I chatted about cats and took a lot of pictures together. You should take a look, Commander.
I want to take this cat to the cat café. Can you come with me? It'd be awful if she got away.
What are you thinking right now?
Commander?! Eeek! What are you looking at?! P-pervert!
This kitty has really taken a liking to you. Now I feel bad about the thought of taking her back to the cat café...
Don't you think it's time for a break? You shouldn't push yourself too much, okay...?

Next time you're free... We could go out to the cat café, or you could hang out here, even without a reason... Sometimes, though. Sometimes! I'm only offering because it'd be easier to get to know everyone and uphold discipline if you're with me, that's all!
Are you... my enemy? No... I don't sense hostility, but instead, strong willpower. So this world is full of struggle, too. You are... the Commander? I am BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER, and I will protect you.
When the world is shrouded in dark and all hope is lost, I continue to struggle and fight. I am BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER, and I will guide your way forward.
Are you... my enemy? No... I don't sense hostility, but instead, strong willpower. So this world is full of struggle, too. You are... the Commander? I am BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER, and I will protect you.
Good morning, Commander. Beware... I sense another battle ahead of us.
What meaning is in the struggles of this world? I must fight on until I know.
Azur Lane and Sirens are concepts that I've never heard of, but I understand that here, they are firm reality.
Friends can quickly become foes - a common occurrence. Even then, my promise to protect you still stands.
There's nothing better than being able to find time to rest. You should keep that in mind, Commander.
I want to compare the power of cannons with that of my ★Rock Cannon. Knowing one's strength is important.
What? Do you doubt my existence? Hmm... Yes, you may see my existence as hazy.
It's okay... I'm no illusion. I still exist in this world.
...Should I perceive you as an enemy?
Something seems unnatural about your work. Am I just imagining it?
Your work is complete.
There appears to be mail addressed to you. I recommend checking.
You're back safe and sound... Do not forget to rest.
Our allies have returned. I sense relief.
I'm stronger... though I don't look any different.
Let's go... I'll carve us a path.
Annihilation complete... Onward.
I'm not done yet...
Limiters released! It's over for you!
I've only... just begun!
Your many friends should be cherished, now and forever...
Have you ever heard... that talking with others can help you maintain a balanced heart and mind?
I was born for combat, but that doesn't mean that I can't connect with others. That includes you, of course.
You protecting me... It's almost laughable how unrealistic it is. But I do feel a sense of gratitude...
Love and hate are such powerful emotions. They can hurt others or save their lives. I could never refute these whims of the heart.
I see fire in your eyes when you speak of the future. Is it the same fire that burns in my left eye? I don't know if I'll learn the answer today, tomorrow, or ever... but I hope to know someday.
Thanks... I'll treasure it.

ex.line: Good morning, Commander. I noticed your presence and came to greet you.
I fight alone... but in this world, you all work together. I don't consider that a bad thing.
The port is so close to the battlefield, but it has a peaceful atmosphere... How strange. How much of that is thanks to your power?
Everyone here is strong. Being here has made me stronger, too. Being able to use my power productively... makes me happy.
If you're worried about something, then come to me. I'm sure that my powers can help with any obstacle in your way.
You're interested in my ★Rock Cannon? If you can improve it, then that would be a great help.
I feel your warmth. So this... is existence.
Is there any way... I can help with your work?
You finished your work without my notice. Well done.
Witness how BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER fights.
May your eyes forever look back upon this victory.
Many of the stories in this world have so-called "happy endings." That is proof of the people's wishes, and I want to see that world made - by your side.

lines.line: The babbling of brooks and the crashing of waves were once such minor things to me. As people who do battle on the sea, you all must see something greater in them, too. But I wonder... if this swimsuit isn't very well-suited for combat.

The babbling of brooks and the crashing of waves were once such minor things to me. As people who do battle on the sea, you all must see something greater in them, too. But I wonder... if this swimsuit isn't very well-suited for combat.
I can sense your presence there, even when you just stare at me in silence.
If you want to train, then you should learn to swim in your usual clothes instead of a swimsuit. That'll be more useful in combat.
The sea stretching out into the horizon... I find this blue planet beautiful. The waves receding under my feet and the scent of the sea breeze are nice, too.
Is this swimsuit for personal use? I see... I'm sorry you had to go out of your way to prepare it for me. I'll thank you on the battlefield.
Even when it comes to water fights, I don't hold back, so give me your all. No, I'm not mad that you just soaked me a minute ago.
Forgive me for being a little more alert when I'm so exposed.
Don't you find your actions overly reckless?
I think I'll swim a little while I wash off the sweat of battle... You want to join me? Well, I don't mind...

Now where exactly am I? Hmm... Well, this is a mess, isn't it? I want you to tell me everything, but if I'm here, then she must be, too... Oh, don't worry about it. I'm DEAD MASTER, and I guess I'm sticking with you for a while. There's got to be a good reason I'm here, after all.
I'm the nightmare chasing a certain girl upon her appearance in this world, both her greatest enemy and closest friend. Now, raise your sword. Let's fight.

Now where exactly am I? Hmm... Well, this is a mess, isn't it? I want you to tell me everything, but if I'm here, then she must be, too... Oh, don't worry about it. I'm DEAD MASTER, and I guess I'm sticking with you for a while. There's got to be a good reason I'm here, after all.
It's been a while... Hm, but not that long, I suppose? I'm just doing what I feel like, so don't worry about me.
Her existence summons me. It's as universal as any other natural law.
You've explained this world to me, but I still don't understand it. That must mean it isn't worth my care.
You call this the "port," but it's hard to wrap my head around what that means. I expect you to explain it clearly.
There's really no need for you to care especially about my existence here, you know.
You've never considered that mind and body might be separated? Heh, how naïve.
Are you curious about the nature of my existence? Consider it... unstable.
You'd best think about the meaning of your actions.
Oh? Your work isn't done yet. Slacking off, are we?
So you finish your work, and then you pretend it doesn't exist? How carefree.
This message is for you, apparently. I guess you're not in much of a hurry.
Welcome back. Done what you needed to do? Well, you look happy, so I'm happy.
Your friends are back, you know. Do you always leave them hanging?
Do I look different? If you say so, then it must be true.
Ready your weapons. Yes, it's time to fight.
Heehee, that was as refreshing as always.
Makes my skin crawl...
May this blow haunt you for eternity!
That's enough warm-up.
I want you to disappear without sound or trace. Oh, you think I'm joking?
Speaking with you like this feels... strange.
I'm hardly one to speak, but why do you spend time with such an incomprehensible being? You're an odd one.
Thinking about everything so far... I realize that it's strange in itself that I can stand here and speak with you.
Past, present, and future are all one and the same to me. I'm surprised that I've found someone other than her who can stand out among all that.
My war with her was the only thing that gave me shape, but a certain something, some momentary respite, has ripped me out of that cycle and won't let me go... This must be a fleeting fantasy.
Do you know what it means to give a present? Oh. In that case, I'll take it.

ex.line: You've returned. Oh, don't mind me. I came out to see you because I wanted to.
Am I just a boat drifting along with the world's rhythm? If so... maybe your existence is one of its verses.
My connection with her will never be severed, but surely there's nothing wrong with resting my legs once in a while, right?
The battles here are ceaseless... I can tell. So be careful, ever so careful...
Just so you know, our fight is similar but different from yours. But for some reason, you and I are connected now... so I'm just helping you out a little.
So? Do you feel something? Yes... I'm warm, aren't I?
This task isn't finished, and neither is this one! Goodness, what am I going to do with you?
Hmm? You finished all your work just like that? Well, you're pretty good at this.
Let's begin the battle, shall we?
I thought I would experience the same conflict and same resolution for all time, but now I want a different future for myself... When did I become such a bad girl?
I thought I would experience the same conflict and same resolution for all time, but now I want a different future for myself... When did I become such a bad girl?

lines.line: Oh? Commander, stop staring and come over here. Let's have a cup of tea and relax... Huh? You're concerned about my outfit? Aren't swimsuits common sights here, or am I special somehow?
Oh? Commander, stop staring and come over here. Let's have a cup of tea and relax... Huh? You're concerned about my outfit? Aren't swimsuits common sights here, or am I special somehow?
Welcome, Commander. If you have time, come and keep me company.
Of course I don't carry a swimsuit around all the time. I had the girls here prepare this one for me. How do you feel about it, Commander?
I'm amazed that things can be so peaceful when she and I are in the same world line... If I told my past self - or my future self - she definitely wouldn't believe me, that's for sure.
Wow, really? No, fighting is not my only reason for being. I don't mind taking things slow once in a while.
It's not that I can't swim... Really, I mean it. But whether you're in the sea or a pool, don't you think stretching out in a swimsuit is just as fun?
Oh? Which entices you more... the feeling of the swimsuit, or my skin?
Yes, I assure you I'm real. Is it so unusual to see me like this?
Welcome back. Are you tired at all? I'll make tea, so rest a moment.

Huh? Where am I? This isn't Eustella, and it certainly isn't Aladiss... Um, excuse me, stranger, could you tell me about this world we're in? Oh, I'm Yumia... Yumia Liessfeldt, an alchemist... Well, do you know what alchemy is?

My name is Yumia Liessfeldt. I'm an alchemist. Everyone has a different take on the use of alchemy. Personally, I always remind myself that everyone has to think and judge for themselves how it's meant to be used.

Huh? Where am I? This isn't Eustella, and it certainly isn't Aladiss... Um, excuse me, stranger, could you tell me about this world we're in? Oh, I'm Yumia... Yumia Liessfeldt, an alchemist... Well, do you know what alchemy is?
Ah, Commander! As always, I'm counting on you.
In my homeworld, beyond just making things, I'd also exterminate monsters. But I suppose that skill isn't in particularly high demand here... right?
I'm working on some items that can be used in battle with the enemy... I think I'll need to further research which abilities are effective, though.
Hm? What are these yellow birds? And these cat-looking creatures? They're... kind of cute.
That tracking device I once made could probably be useful here, too. I don't know how I'll get the materials, though... Alright, I'll ask around to see what materials you have here.
Oh, are you curious about my alchemy tools? Everyone I meet always is.
Does this stuff strike you as odd? I don't think my gun, my boots - or any of my items, really - are anything special...
Hey! I'll blow a gasket if you break my tools!
Looks like we still have work to do... Should I report it?
What?! You're done already? Didn't you JUST start working?
A letter has arrived. Might be urgent business...
Welcome back, Commander. How'd your sortie go? Actually, knowing you, I'll bet it was a great success.
The research team has returned to base. I wonder what they found?
It feels like my knowledge has deepened a bit more!
I'm... ready now!
Nice! It worked!
Urgh... Just one step short...
I can... still fight!
Oh, hang on. Can this wait until I'm done preparing?
Alright! Ready to get to work. Let's see if I can't put my alchemy to use!
Oh, Commander! Do you have a minute? I'm going on an expedition into the woods, and it'd be great if you could come with!
Hmm... So you don't want "the greatest discovery of the century" or "the shocking truth"? I just want to make you happy, you know.
You believe in and accept me and my alchemy, despite its status as an unknown and vague craft from your point of view... Thank you so much for that, Commander.
My, um... My heart is really racing. Ahahaha... This is a kind of throbbing that's quite different from what I feel when I discover a new alchemy recipe. Don't tell anyone about this, okay?
Huh? Can I really have something this precious?! Th-thank you so much!
Please don't run too far ahead, Nina!
Lenja! We'll do this on my mark!
Is it edible?
Some of it is dangerous, so you'd better be careful.
This pointy thing is... an Uni!
Owch! Should've known this would be a pain...
Attitude matters... There!
This should harvest it, right?
There!
This should work as a material!
I'd better not harvest too much.
Wonder what this can be used for...
I wonder if this world's fish are tasty, too?
Look out for those spikes...

ex.line: Good morning, Commander! Can we work together today?
An alchemist's studio is called an atelier, which makes the port my atelier... Would you mind if I started calling it that?
I learned alchemy by myself. Yes, it was because I didn't want to be a bother to anyone. As long as it's able to help the people of this place, then my hard work wasn't for nothing.
Your stories fascinate and inspire me, Commander. They also give me new alchemical ideas! I hope you'll keep telling me things.
This is a place where you can do so many things... That's why I think I can do even more interesting things using alchemy. That's what my gut is telling me!
You may be in charge here, but there are still things you can and cannot do!
Commander, there's still work to do. I'll help you out, so let's get it done!
Oh, you're finished. Then it's time for a break. For us both.
We'll get through this by working together!
That's a wrap! Glad everyone's alright.
When I'm able to stand by your side and use my power - alchemy - to help... Those times make me feel really honored and proud. I hope I can continue to be of use to you.

lines.line: Ah, sure. Could you wait just a minute? These are nearly done baking. Mmh, that smells wonderful! I reckon these are my pièce de résistance. Speaking of baking, I think it has a surprising amount of things in common with alchemy.

Ah, sure. Could you wait just a minute? These are nearly done baking. Mmh, that smells wonderful! I reckon these are my pièce de résistance. Speaking of baking, I think it has a surprising amount of things in common with alchemy.
Perfect timing, Commander! Breakfast is ready.
Weighing the ingredients, mixing them at the right ratios, baking them at the right temperature... It might sound really complicated, but these are the essentials of cooking. It's a lot like alchemy!

Hmm... Wish I had more varied ingredients... Need to combine everything at the correct time... Ahh, so the amount of water affects the dough's characteristics... Oh! Commander. Sorry, my mind was elsewhere just now.
Having a clear vision of the finished product is important. That goes for both cooking and alchemy. Of course, putting love into what you're making is important, too.
As much as I like making everyone happy, it feels quite special to make something for just one person... Huh?! Commander?! D-did you hear anything just now?
Hey! No snacking!
There'll be no dessert for you today if you keep this up!
Now, let's check on that dough I left to rise... Yeah, looks like it's coming along well. This will turn out delicious!
I'm Isla von Duerer! Call me Isla! I'm with the Order of Eustella and the Aladiss Research Team... So hey, why am I here?! Do you know why?

I'm Isla von Duerer, a member of the Order of Eustella! I run around doing all kinds of odd jobs, like killing monsters, and... Oh, that doesn't matter right now, huh? Anyway, you still gotta be fashionable when you're in a fight. I want to be at the forefront of style!
I'm Isla von Duerer! Call me Isla! I'm with the Order of Eustella and the Aladiss Research Team... So hey, why am I here?! Do you know why?
Alright! Here's to another great day, Commander!
I love clothes and accessorizing! It's fascinating how unique everyone's outfits are here!
I've tried out all kinds of awesome technology here. You guys don't call it alchemy, though... The world really is full of mysteries!
Back in our world, we could get pelts and stuff just by adventuring. It seems harder here... Huh? We can use sea monster skin? That does sound enticing...
I wanna try sewing an outfit or two for you... Would you be interested? I can do handsome, cute, and everything in between, as long as you're willing to model for me.
Hm? Need help, or anything? Don't worry. I'm here to help!
Hmm? Are my clothes torn somewhere? That's okay! You might not guess it, but I'm great at mending!
Huh?! Geez, what're you doing?!
If you put off all of the work you hate, that'll just make it more of a slog later.
Our work here is done! Never leave a task undone, okay?
Oh, you've got mail from everyone, Commander!
Welcome back, Commander! How'd it go? Did you win? Oh wow, I see.
Your research team is back. Let's go say hi to them!
Check this out. I'm even stronger now!
Here we go! Be careful, everyone!
Woohoo! We won!
Ouch... Ugh! Hold back a little, would you?
No problem... This is like nothing to me!
You should try being nicer to people. It'll help you out in the future.
Haha, don't be so formal with me! Let's both relax a little, okay?
Oh? Commander, if you're free, then let's go shopping. I bet it'll be fun!
Tell me anything you need, alright? We're friends. Isn't it normal... to want to help you out?
There must be a really important reason why I ended up in this world... and I think I'll figure it out as long as I stay with you.
Geez, don't make fun of me! I really didn't know how to respond to that... I mean... It's hard to accept that our relationship is really real, you know?
Huh? Is this for me? Amazing! Thanks~
I'll leave the vanguard to you, Yumia!
Nina, that attack was so cool!
Lenja, let's coordinate our next attack!

ex.line: Morning! Fancy seeing you this early. It must be my lucky day!
I've experienced a lot of crazy things like alchemy, but all the stuff that happens here is crazy in whole new ways!
I can make work clothes for you, if you're okay with that. I'll make them nice and flexible!
Commander, I wanna see some of the clothes here... Huh? You'll take me shopping? Hooray! Let's go right now.
Your job is to rest now, Commander! I'll get the weaponry ready and prepare everything for battle!
If you want a hug, just tell me that!
Come on, you still have work to do! Do your best~
Oh! Finished your work? Good stuff!
All ready? Then let's get going!
Wow... That was incredible, Commander!
