Someday, I might have to go back to my old world. But even if that happens, I won't lose the experiences I had here... No matter how it looks, the bond between our hearts will still be there.

lines.line: Hello and welcome to my wonderful cookout! I tried out all kinds of special BBQ recipes! Well, everything looks tasty, right? ...Huh? Me? I'm not on the menu!
Hello and welcome to my wonderful cookout! I tried out all kinds of special BBQ recipes! Well, everything looks tasty, right? ...Huh? Me? I'm not on the menu!
Welcome, Commander! You're just in time to try the herbal tea!
It's crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and it just melts in your mouth! Give it a try!
Have a taste! These are all my original recipes, and I'm proud of them all! Eat until you've had your fill! And when you're done, let me know what you think!
A blue sky, white clouds, and loads of delicious dishes lining the table make for a beautiful scene in my opinion. What do you think?
Commander, which do you like more - seafood or forage? Make an order now and I'll even personally feed you!
Hey, no snacking! The food is almost done, so just wait a little longer♪
Heheh, is this what you like, Commander?
Welcome, welcome! After a day of hard work, you need some nourishment, right? Which dish would you like to try first? You can have anything you like♪

Well, hello there. I'm Nina, a member of the Research Team... Not that it matters much to you. Anyway, I'm not sure what to do now... Oh? You want me to go to your house? My, my, are you sure that's appropriate?
Nina Friede. I spend my days hard at work with the Aladiss Research Team. Place of origin? Age? I keep that info secret. Heheh... It's better when a girl has a little mystery to her, don't you think?

Well, hello there. I'm Nina, a member of the Research Team... Not that it matters much to you. Anyway, I'm not sure what to do now... Oh? You want me to go to your house? My, my, are you sure that's appropriate?
Hi there, Commander. Doing well? Let's get some work done!
I'm actually a mercenary, so I took to this "rigging" pretty easily even though it was my first time seeing it. In real combat, what you have is what you have.
Everyone here looks so nice. You've got everything from cute girls to sexy big sister types. If Isla were here right now, she'd go research them all one by one.
These weapons are magnitudes stronger than the ones we're used to... Even an experienced merc such as myself might struggle to use them to the fullest.
I've really gotten into herbal tea lately. This place has all kinds of tea leaves I've never seen before. Try some with me some time... I promise I won't put anything weird in it.
Hey, now. You shouldn't touch a lady's hair so casually.
Hm? What's wrong? If something's troubling you, you can talk to me.
Heehee. That's enough of that.
Hmm? You have unfinished tasks here. Did you forget?
Wow, are we done here? Better check your rewards before you forget about them.
Commander. This mail's for you, isn't it? Check more carefully next time.
You look tired. How about I make you a cup of herbal tea? Relax a while.
Those errand girls just got back. Yes, yes, I suppose we should go see them.
Oh my, my, my. Is it just me, or are you in need of help?
Let's finish this quick!
Aww. Is that all you've got?
Well... I've gone and embarrassed myself now.
Not done yet... I'm just getting started!
I'll help you with your work. No more, no less.
Let's do our best at work today, Commander!
Strange... This doesn't seem right. Maybe if you were fluffier, I'd understand...
For some reason, I can always tell when you're looking at me. Yes, I'm surprised, too - who knew I'd care?
"I was just wandering around, and I ended up here!" Obviously, I'm kidding. This strange place, our new friends, and you... There must be a special meaning to it all.
If I didn't run into you back then, I'm sure I wouldn't be here... I'd be someone else entirely. As for what that means? Leave it to the historians to find out.
Uh, what? This is for me? Hehe. Thanks. I'll treasure it.
I swear, things never get boring when you're around.
I'm snuggling you for one hour after this. Get ready, okay?

ex.line: Ugh, how long are you going to make me wait... Haha, I'm just kidding. Thanks for all you do.
Some mercs like having long-term clients. What do you think? Interested?
I used to be a mercenary. But maybe there's a world in which this place becomes my homeland... in which wherever YOU are becomes my home.
Say, Commander, you know you can pay a little more attention to me. For example, I'm hungry and would love to eat with you right now.
Rely on me as a mercenary if you want, but I'd like it even more if you leaned on me as a person who cares about you.
Come on... Wait until the sun goes down first.
Hmm? Leaving work undone again? I just don't know what to do with you.
Is that all the work we have left for now? Then I think it's the perfect time for some tea.
Here we go!
There! It's all taken care of. We win again!
I see... That explains everything. Okay, I accept defeat. Hmm? Don't worry about it. I'm not changing - I've just made up my mind about things, that's all.

lines.line: Heehee, what's got you staring, Commander? Is it this piping-hot burger that's stolen your attention? Or... Heehee, well, that can wait for later.
Heehee, what's got you staring, Commander? Is it this piping-hot burger that's stolen your attention? Or... Heehee, well, that can wait for later.
Hello hello. Don't worry - you're early for our meeting.
There's something about nostalgic cafés that makes time here feel so special... Do you get it?
Say, you there! May I order now? Oh... If it isn't you, Commander. Are you working here? Ouch... Get some rest later, okay?
I saw a girl wearing a cat ear accessory a minute ago. Where do you get those? They were adorable.
What's good after a nice swim? Fried chicken? A bowl full of fries? Can I order something along those lines?
Heehee, I'm still a little shy. Be gentle, okay?
My, my. Keep up that mischief, and who knows what might happen?
Hi there. Doing okay? I reserved you a seat, so get over here! Let's have our first glass together, okay?
Uh, um... I-I'm... Lenja. A-although we've never met, I'd... um... I-I-I'm so sorry! I don't know anything right now, so c-could you... take me under your wing?
Err, um... I'm Lenja. I, uh... I want to help people, but... I'm not sure if I'm capable enough... Oh, um! Forget that! Please forget I said that!
Uh, um... I-I'm... Lenja. A-although we've never met, I'd... um... I-I-I'm so sorry! I don't know anything right now, so c-could you... take me under your wing?
Eek! C-Commander?! G-good morning...
I-in the tribe I'm from... we need to... s-set out on journeys to help people... *whimper*... I need to give this my all...
The sun... It's so warm... *yawn*... Mmh... *gasp*! I-I didn't doze off! I didn't! I wasn't napping, no way!
Commaaander! Are you taking a nap? Th-that's fair... since the weather's nice... Huh? Just resting your eyelids? S-s-s-sorry for making assumptions!
S-sorry, I must be a burden... I'll go over there and... Huh? It's fine if I stay with you? Oh, I see... In that case, I will... Heehee.
Is, err... Is there something weird about me?
Hey, um... Commander? Is there anything I can... help you with?
Eek! Whuah! Pl-please... wait a minute...
Huh? These missions haven't been... No, I just... Well... I'm a little curious.
C-Commander... This one's already done... N-no, never mind.
Commander, there's... Well, a letter for you. Oh, yes, that's right.
Oh, well fought, Commander. Just, um... Please don't push yourself too hard.
Umm... Their errand is done... Incredible!
H-have I gotten... stronger? At least a little?
O-on my way! I'll try my best!
H-hooray! We did it!
Aww... I-I'm sorry... I'm no good after all...
N-no... I can still keep going...
Oh, e-excuse me... I didn't catch that...
Huh? Do, um... Do you need... help?
Oh, yes! If there's anything I can help with, please just let me know!
I'm... not smart enough for difficult topics, but... I want to help my friends if I can...
Heehee... When I talk to you, I... I feel so at ease... Oh! Umm... Please forget I said that...
I, um... Err... I-I'd like to help you and support you, Commander... So if you... could ask for my help... I'd be glad.
Huh? Uh, um... This is for... me? ...Thank you... so much...!
I think I can fight better!
This really isn't the time or place to... touch my tail...

ex.line: Ah, C-Commander! Good... morning.
Both alchemy and the weapons you have here... they're not just powerful, they exist to protect your near and dear... I think.
Huh? Are you having a nap, Commander? Hello? Hmm... No response... I hope it won't scare you if I sleep next to you...
If I record everything that's happened here in my diary... will it become a part of our history?
Commander, I want to repay you somehow... Is there something you'd like from me? I'll do anything you want as long as it's not weird.
Ah! Th-th-that tickles!
Hey, um... You still have... unfinished work to do... I'll help you out.
This task is... done. Great work... Would you like to... squeeze my tail?
E-everyone! Let's give our b-best shot!
Okay, I did it... I managed to do it.
Wherever I go, I just fail over and over, I make mistakes, and I fall behind... but the fact that I can be by your side and help in many ways... That makes me really happy.

lines.line: So, um... This is my first time trying this, so... I just... Ah, right! Since we're all here, let's make the most of it and have fun together!
So, um... This is my first time trying this, so... I just... Ah, right! Since we're all here, let's make the most of it and have fun together!
Ah, C-Commander... I'm... good to go!
Even in this other world, fish tastes... delicious! I think that's... quite amazing.
Umm... Plates are ready... Ingredients are ready... Fire is lit... Everything's ready, Commander! Let's get this... "barbecue" thing started!
Uh, um... I'm glad to have someone to help. Really. But! There are things I can do, too... So... please let me help at least a little.
You'd like to cook with me? Th-thank you...
I-I've never worn anything like... this before... H-how do I look?
Heehee... You're getting my stomach wet! It tickles!
You must be exhausted after all that... Come here, sit down, and take it easy... please. Here. Have a drink.
Repair ship - Hestia.
I'm Hestia, the goddess of the hearth and fire! And since I'm a god, you just go ahead and worship me. Also, is there any part-time work that pays well in this world?
I'm Hestia, the Patron Goddess of Hestia Familia, believe it or not! What? That doesn't surprise you at all? Hmm. You're nothing like the kiddos I've seen before.
Hey there, Commander! I've been waiting a looong time for you!
In my world, we gods had familias who'd conquer dungeons. I guess in this world... you'd conquer the sea, huh?
You've got so much tasty food here. It's almost as good as Potato Poppers. I've gotta try all of it before I go back to my home world!
Commander, I found something tasty - want a bite? Don't be shy, just give it a taste.
Ow, ow, ow... Hey, Commander! Why are you lying down over here? You've gotta sleep in a bed if you wanna recover your strength.
Hrmh... Why are you staring at me like that, huh? Ah, don't call me a shortie or you're gonna get it!
You just can't get enough of me, huh? ...What? I've got dust on me? Ohh. Brush it off, would you?
Commander. Ready to face the consequences?
What, you still haven't finished this mission? I'll help.
Hey, you've got missions to turn in! Don't just leave them sitting there.
Is this... a letter for you? Reckon it might be a love letter?
Welcome back, Commander! Thought something might've happened to you. I'm glad you're fine.
Your familia who went on an errand are back. Huh? They're not familia, they're your friends? I see - you insist on that.
You're telling me I've powered up? What's going on with this world?
Come on, let's go!
Victory's mine!
Darn it... They're gonna call me a fraud goddess again over this! No way, no way!! This doesn't count!
I'll do what I can.
I'll try a little harder.
Need something? Uh, can it wait? I'm so sleepy right now.
If my side hustle and our outing overlap on the same day... Hmm. That'll be annoying.
I think it'd be nice if you'd set aside a little more time for me.
Are you here to see me? Nice, that's the sign of a good familia member. Wait, maybe not a good familia member, but a good friend?
I was really stressed when I got thrown into this world out of the blue. I'm really glad I met someone as helpful as you.
The worlds you and I live in are so far apart... or more like totally different. It's pretty wild that we met and were able to spend time together like this.
Thanks! Now, let's get this party started!
Miss Elf, I'm going in.

ex.line: Oh, Commander! You here to see me?
Commander, you're setting yourself up for punishment by ignoring me too often, you know?
Huh? Feeling a little weary, Commander? Then as a special favor, I'll give you a lap pillow! And in exchange... I'll be watching your face closely while you sleep!
Heheheh... Look who's here. Let's have ourselves a tea party with desserts, Commander!
Ugghh... Sorry I made you worry. I'm not worthy of being a goddess... I dunno if this makes up for it, but how about I make you some food?
Stop, stop! That's a no-go, Commander! I'm serious!
Still got missions to do, do you? I'll help you out - as a treat.
Finished your mission, huh? That's my Commander. A bit of praise, just for you!
I'll try my darnedest to help you!
I'm the goddess of victory!
Do I make myself clear, Commander? Don't push your luck by leaving me all by myself. I don't like being alone in an unfamiliar place.

lines.line: Hey-hey, Commander! You're finally here. I've been waiting my butt off! I've already had the full beach experience... Ah, wait, I still have things I wanna do, so do me a solid and stick around!
Hey-hey, Commander! You're finally here. I've been waiting my butt off! I've already had the full beach experience... Ah, wait, I still have things I wanna do, so do me a solid and stick around!
Heeey! Commandeeer! Come here! Get yourself in order quickly!
The beach is so much fun! The surface is deep blue and pretty and the water's nice and cool! Being here makes it feel like time is flying by.
So many tasty-looking fish and shellfish... Hey, Commander, I say we treat ourselves to a barbecue while we're here!
Careful so you don't get sunburned. The sun's intense today... I'm gonna go put on some sunscreen, so can you wait just a minute?
You wanna swim? How about we swim together, then? It feels nice to just float in the sea!
Huh? I'll hold your hand, if that's what you want... Do you not know how to swim?
Hey! What do you think you're doing, huh?
Nice job, Commander. Go and get comfortable in the shade over there. I'll get you something cold to drink!
Light cruiser - Ryu Lion.
My name is Ryu Lion. I work at Hostess of Fertility in Orario. The bountiful experience and skills I've accumulated as an adventurer should come in handy here as well.
Who are you? No - Where am I? This doesn't look like Orario. You must be the one who saved me, so thank you. My name is Ryu Lion, and I work as a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility pub in Orario.
I've been waiting for you, Commander. Have you decided on our plans for today?
Forgive me... I tend to go too far sometimes.
As I understand, you form combat parties that combine members with varying roles... Fleets, you call them? Hmm. Noted.
My apologies for the delay. Here is your tea. Cookies, understood... Hmm? What am I doing? The Royal Maids asked me to help as a waitress, a job that I'm quite accustomed to.
What an outright abusive workload... Hmm? This isn't all for one person? It's meant to be shared among everyone? I-I'm sorry. I should know better than to make assumptions.
What do you think you're doing? I sense a malicious aura emanating from you.
Enough! Any closer, and there's no telling what might happen.
Are you ready to prostrate yourself in apology?
Would you like my help?
Your rewards are piling up... Do you need me to sort them out for you?
Mail has arrived. Is now a good time to take a look?
Welcome back, Commander. Let's get you dusted off... Okay. I will make you tea soon, so rest until then.
Everyone's returned safely. Commander, prepare to welcome them home.
I suppose this is a... rank-up? How delightful.
...Let's go.
Victory... is ours.
Is it time to retreat? Now is the time for clarity of judgment.
In the name of justice, I will smite you!
I mustn't back down... Not now!
Surely you understand that your behavior is foolish.
Having so much energy in the morning is commendable, yes, but you must direct it toward your work... No. I'm not angry.
I appreciate your dedication to your goals. Yes, even I can give compliments.
Don't push yourself too much, please. Hurting yourself will hurt everyone else in the process. Being honest... I worry about you, too. Please take care of yourself.
You're very kind, Commander. I can tell that your kindness extends to everyone... and I respect that greatly.
Something is wrong... Why is my heart beating so fast? D-don't get so close! You've done nothing wrong... Oh, how do I explain this?
Hm? Could this be... Ahem. Thank you very much.
Let's go, Lady Hestia.

ex.line: Commander! I've waited so... I-I mean, um... Good morning.
How many events have led this place to be the battlefield it is today? My past, too, is... No, never mind. Forget I said a word.
Is there something on my face? Huh? No, I'm not unhappy with you... I appreciate your attention - er, I mean, umm...
My lack of experience in combat at sea left me hesitant, but I think I'm beginning to understand. I even look forward to taking on this new challenge... Would you train with me for a while?
Waitressing? Well, yes, I'm very experienced... Huh? You want to see my uniform? A-absolutely not! It's too embarrassing...
Ah, hngh! (It's impossible to keep a straight face under these conditions...)
You still haven't finished your work, have you? I guess I have no choice but to help.
You've already finished your duties? Impressive.
Here I come!
We won... all thanks to you.
What I've seen and heard here, the things I've felt in our time together, and my own thoughts... There are too many things to discuss. Could you spare some time for me, please?

lines.line: W-welcome... Don't stare at me, please. This pub's uniforms are a little revealing, so I'm nervous. I-if you insist, though, I can make time to chat after closing time.
W-welcome... Don't stare at me, please. This pub's uniforms are a little revealing, so I'm nervous. I-if you insist, though, I can make time to chat after closing time.
W-welcome... I'm ready to take your order...
Wearing this is a little embarrassing, but I am happy that you like it.
I hear you chose this uniform... Hmm? No, I'm not saying I dislike it... but I think this has told me a lot about your tastes.
Thank you for your patience. I brought your food. A drink refill? Certainly... A-a smile?! That is a difficult request...
I-I don't mind you looking, but no recording me! Also, I'd appreciate if you forgot what you've seen after you leave.
What exactly were you going to do with that hand? I expect an answer.
Wha?! We do not provide those services!
Welcome back, Commander. We've already started your dinner order, so rest easy.
Heavy cruiser - Tohka Yatogami.

I'm Tohka Yatogami, a Spirit. What is a spirit? Hmm, it's hard to explain, but you might think of me as someone with much greater power than a normal human. Hmm... Well, I suppose that makes me sound the same as everyone else here. In that case, it's only a minor distinction!

Identify yourself. Are you my enemy? ...Perhaps not. Hmm... Could this be a different world entirely? No wonder I've seen so many unfamiliar things. Regardless, my name is Tohka Yatogami. It's an important name, so you'd best remember it. I suppose I'll be in your world for the time being. On that note... I'm hungry. Do you have anything to eat?
Good morning, Commander! Let's keep up our efforts today!
Commander, what are the best foods in this world? I have much I want to ask, but that's the most important thing!
Huh? You have kinako buns here, too?! Why didn't you tell me sooner? Show me where right away. I must buy them now!
Hmm... The shipgirls? They all look powerful, but they're such good friends. What is their secret?
If there's nobody hostile here, then that makes life all the easier. And the food is delicious to boot!
Hmm... What's the matter? You want to pat my head? Well, you may.
What? Do you need me? Tell me what you require, and I'll help with whatever it may be!
Hmm? What's the matter? Is there dirt on me, or something?
What? You still have work to do? Then let me help.
Hmm, these are marked as completed. Don't you need to review them?
Is this... a letter for you? It must be important, so you should read it now.
Ah, Commander, you've returned! How was the battle? Don't spare a single detail.
Ooh! Everyone's back. We must go see them! I made snacks for them, too!
Ooh... I feel my power surging!
Come with me! I will carve a path!
We won! Moving around makes me so hungry.
It's... beyond... the reach of my power...
Now... It is over!
Split the sky and sunder the earth! —Sandalphon
Sandalphon
I mustn't fall now!
Mm... Do whatever you want. I'm going back to the others.
Oh, really? Then join me now!
Hehe. Food tastes a lot better when we eat together, doesn't it? I wonder why that is.
Hmm, you're well-beloved by the people of this port. I understand it, though. You've saved them all, in a sense... I think that's remarkable.
My goal now is to become strong enough to protect you and everything you hold dear! Will you help me? Good! Then let's get training!

Spending time here has given me so many more things to cherish. Good foods, friends... Hmm? You act nonchalant, but you count, too. Hmm... Having so many things to cherish is, in itself, something rare and worth cherishing.
What? You are giving this to me!? Wow... Thank you, I'll treasure it!
Leave it to me, Origami!
You're so reliable these days, Yoshino!

ex.line: Ooh, Commander! I've been waiting for you! Come, let's work hard together!
Hmm? I don't stay with you just for the delicious food, of course. I can't believe that you would think so. By the way... What's for dinner tonight?
Everyone in this land is so happy, and I can only assume that you're the reason... You don't think so? Hmph. I know what that is—it's called humility.
When I went to the canteen, I asked for "the usual," and they knew what I meant... Is this proof that I've made friends? Or am I spending too much on food?
When I'm running through the port, everyone greets me. It's wonderful... Hmm? Why do I run? Because exercise makes food taste better, of course!
Hyah! I-it's okay... You just startled me.
I'll help you clean up these missions! Don't worry—I owe you one, anyway!
Okay, all done! Now you get some of my special and treasured treats!
Come! Let our date begin!
Victory! Thanks to everybody's efforts, of course.

This place is so comfortable. It must be because of you and the people you lead. Though it's only temporary, I'm honored to join you... and I want to protect our time together. May our relationship be a lasting one, Commander.

lines.line: Hmm? What's the matter? Oh, this? Someone gave it to me to have as a little treat! I won't keep it all to myself, though. I'll share some with you! What would you like? Vanilla? Chocolate? Or strawberry? No, the kinako-flavored one is MINE! But you really want it? Hmm... Maybe just a little...?

Hmm? What's the matter? Oh, this? Someone gave it to me to have as a little treat! I won't keep it all to myself, though. I'll share some with you! What would you like? Vanilla? Chocolate? Or strawberry? No, the kinako-flavored one is MINE! But you really want it? Hmm... Maybe just a little...?
Ooh, there you are! Come and have a popsicle!
Nothing adds to a beach trip like popsicles! It's amazing how the taste of food can change so much depending on the place and season.
You have so many kinds of popsicles here. To think, you even have kinako flavor... I never imagined this.
Does seeing me eating happily make you happy, too? As it should! Delicious food is always the key to happiness!
You're about to go swimming, right? How about we all have a race? Whoever wins gets all the popsicles!
Hmph! Keep your hands off! I took it first!
Mm, did it drip on me? Can you wipe it off?
You're back! A job well done deserves a break. Rest is an important part of work.
Aircraft carrier - Origami Tobiichi.

My name is Origami Tobiichi, former AST Master Sergeant. I am now a high school student—and also an entity known as a Spirit. Though I was once in a precarious state, I am now stable thanks to my friends. There is nothing to worry about.

Is this... a different world from the one I came from? ...Understood. Panic accomplishes nothing. I will do my utmost to resolve this situation. I am Origami Tobiichi, former AST Master Sergeant. May I ask you to state your affiliation and rank?
Good morning. Have you decided on today's itinerary yet?
The shipgirls here have very unique designs. I find it most illuminating. ...Might this be your preference, Commander?
I believe that this "rigging" equipment holds great potential. Its meticulous tuning to maximize the wearer's power fascinates me.
I would like to purchase some necessary equipment. First, I need two CCD cameras and several ultra-compact microphones. For what purpose? I cannot disclose for now.

This? This is a special Origami-brand aphrodisiac. A certain shipgirl requested that I make it. I do not know what it might be used for after the order is fulfilled, but I was specifically asked to keep it a secret from you. Oops, I went and said it. Silly Origami.
...What is it?
Did you need something?
Openly expressing your desires often comes with a price.
I see that a mission you chose to take on has not yet been completed. You should address that, quickly.
Mission accomplished. Please claim your reward promptly.
I would recommend responding to important messages promptly.
Confirming Commander's return. Your safety holds higher priority over all else.
The girls have returned from their errands. Do you need a lecture on how to greet them properly?
Confirming all-around parameter growth. Resuming combat operations.
Enemy target detected. Commencing combat operations.
Combat over. Confirming annihilation of hostiles.
A miscalculation... in a place like this, how...
Fire!
Penetrate, O Crown of Light! —Metatron
Metatron
Combat capabilities decreased. ...But this isn't over yet.
Blind faith in some half-baked skills is a disaster waiting to happen. Let this be my advice to you.
There are many things I still do not understand, but you have helped me again and again. I hope that our cordial relationship will continue in the future.
There will surely be a limit as to what you can do by yourself. When that time comes, please turn to us for help. We are your friends, after all.
If you ever have any problems concerning the shipgirls, feel free to consult me. Don't worry. Back in my world, I was known as the Love Master.

If you wish, I can teach you the Origami-style approach to love. Several shipgirls have already attended my lessons. How to deal with advances? Simple, accept them all. That is what it means to be a commander.

Dainty, cute, or charming? Which quality appeals to you the most? ...There's no deeper meaning behind it. I simply made an assessment that this information might come in handy in the future. There's no deeper meaning behind it, but what you make of that is up to you.
Amazing... Where did you even get something like this?
Tohka, with me. We'll break through the front.
It brings me joy to see my disciples spread their wings

ex.line: Good morning. Today's a wonderful day.
What is it you desire, Commander? Of course I know. I can piece that together from your conversations as well as the monologues from when you're in your room.
I've received requests for love advice from several shipgirls, so I sent them on their way with some pick-up lines. I don't know who they'll use them on, but you should be prepared.
The intruder prevention trap I set at your request has been dismantled. The culprit must be very skilled.
I've concocted a new aphrodisiac using ingredients gifted to me by people around the port. I haven't tried it on anyone yet, but would you be interested?
Please inform me beforehand. I need time to prepare myself mentally.
Do you have any work left? If I lend you a hand, it should be done in no time.
Mission complete. Good work.
Let us begin our date.
No enemies in sight. This is a victory we seized together.

A girl's words can often carry multiple layers of meaning. If you are unable to discern these subtleties, you still have much to learn. For example, "thank you" is not only an expression of gratitude. If you want to be able to read the true emotions behind these words, you should come to me for lessons.

lines.line: What do you think about my swimsuit? As long as you like it, that's all that matters. It is a masterpiece that incorporates the opinions of many different shipgirls. During that time, I was advised that it would be better for it to include *** and ***, but I reluctantly excluded them due to my high levels of situational awareness.

What do you think about my swimsuit? As long as you like it, that's all that matters. It is a masterpiece that incorporates the opinions of many different shipgirls. During that time, I was advised that it would be better for it to include *** and ***, but I reluctantly excluded them due to my high levels of situational awareness.
Good morning. Did you have a good time last night? Mhm. Then, do enjoy yourself today.
It seems that swimsuits these days are often used for purposes outside of swimming. While this is a deviation from their original functionality, it is nevertheless a form of evolution.
The size is mismatched? Not at all, it is a perfect fit. This is a masterpiece that carefully takes into consideration many factors such as skin exposure ratio.
The sun is quite intense. Should I apply sunscreen, or deliberately work up some tan lines? Quite the dilemma.
The goddess of allure... is born. Hmm? Is "goddess" a bit much? Indeed, I am no goddess, but rather a Spirit. However, I do not intend to change the "allure" part.
Usually, these ties you see on swimwear are merely decorations. The swimsuit won't come undone just from untying them. Usually.
Are you curious about how the swimsuit feels?
Welcome back. Did your fatigue disappear as soon as you saw me? Fascinating. This is a phenomenon worth studying. I would very much like to know more about it.
Battleship - Kotori Itsuka.

The name's Kotori Itsuka. I guess you'd call me a Spirit, but... about that, the situation's pretty complicated though. I'd appreciate it if you didn't worry too much about that whole deal. As someone who knows what it's like to be a captain or commander, I hope we can have a good relationship as peers.

Where the heck am I... I can't get a hold of Fraxinus... Don't tell me, we've crossed a dimensional wall?! In any case, I need to get a handle on the current situation—Oh, got a moment? My name's Kotori. Kotori Itsuka. I'm just a schoolgirl... You'll buy that, right? Sorry, but can I have a moment to speak with you?
Morning, Commander. Let's go all-out today as well!
Back in the world where I'm from, I was the captain of an airship. But, that ship and the ships here are completely different... Like, we're talking on a conceptual existence level different...
I'm curious what it's like around here. Mind if I take a look around? Heehee, you could also escort me around while you're at it.

Even for someone like me who's used to seeing Spirits, this is kind of its own fairy tale kingdom. I mean, look—you have both magic and cannonballs flying through the air... Hmm? Looking at it that way, maybe our worlds aren't so different.
Spirits are a formidable threat, so our way of dealing with them is taking them out on dates and getting them to fall in love. I wonder if this also works for shipgirls...
Wh-what are you doing all of a sudden! I-it's not like you startled me or anything!
What do you want? ...No, I'm not mad or anything. I just wasn't expecting you to suddenly touch me.
Wh-what are you doing?! ...I-i-i-it's not like I'm mad or anything though...
There's still work to be done! C'mon, get on it already!
Oh wow, looks like you've taken care of all the work over here. See, you can do it if you try.
You've got a message. Don't let these things pile up.
Good work. Commander, how would you rate this last sortie? Hm? You'd like my personal assessment? A full 100, of course. It goes without saying.
Looks like your friends are back. Go on, go greet them already. As a commander, you should know how important the aftercare is, no?
Heheh, very good. I'll show you what I'm like when I mean business.
Let's get this done the right way. Follow my lead!
Done already? How boring.
We must keep pressing forward... even if it's one step... at a time...
Burn to ash!
Turn them to ash, Flames of Purgatory! —Camael
Camael
Look closely! This is where the real battle begins!
Um, can we set that aside for later? I don't have the time right now.
Alright, all done on my end. Next up is... Hey, why are you looking at me like you've got no skin in the game? Hurry up and help me!
What are you even saying? I'm super, duper appreciative! So that's why you get... the love-lashing~♪

Jeez, what am I even going to do with you? Fine, I'll do it for you, so make sure you pay close attention~♪ So, do you prefer me like that? Huh? You think both versions of me are cute? Well, um... if you like it so much, then maybe next time...
I know my words might be a bit harsh, but that's because I'm seriously looking out for the other person! ...Jeez, what are you trying to make me say?!

Don't you think it'd be awesome to have the kind of relationship where you can directly tell each other what you like or dislike? ...Huh? You ask what I am trying to say now? Jeez, could you pick a worse time to ask that?
Sorry, you must've gone through much trouble for me... But, thank you...
You're both soaking wet... Want me to help dry you off?
I just know you're up to something... Step out of line and you'll see me get real mad, Kurumi.

ex.line: You're late! Jeez... don't make me worry like that...
Not to brag, but I'm also a commander in the world I came from. If there's anything you'd like to discuss, feel free to consult with me.
It's nice to sometimes space out and do nothing. ...Who said I was slacking off though? This is a tactical decision after someone told me, "even warriors need rest"!
Weather's real nice today, huh? Really makes me want to take a look around the port... If only there was someone kind enough to show me around~

--"Option 1: I'd do anything for your sake!" "Option 2: Just tell me what you want already!" "Option 3: I will make even your wildest dreams come true!" --So, which one's your pick? Huh? They pretty much all say the same thing? Heh. Stop thinking so much and just pick one already. I promise you won't regret it.
...Look, even I can get flustered, you know?
Still not done yet? What am I going to do with you... Guess I'll help out.
Done already? Not half bad, you. Efficiency is sexy these days.
Now, let our date begin.
Good work. You know...I wouldn't mind some words of praise myself.

I don't want the kind of relationship where one person does all the venting and the other person has to just sit here and take it... I want one where you take the burden of hardship off each other and put your heads together to work through problems... A relationship where you both can move forward, taking everything in stride together. Doesn't that sound ideal?

lines.line: So, I got changed into my swimsuit and... What? If you have something to say, make sure I can hear it. ...Eh? It's cute and looks good on me and you want to see even more? ...D-don't say embarrassing stuff like that!

So, I got changed into my swimsuit and... What? If you have something to say, make sure I can hear it. ...Eh? It's cute and looks good on me and you want to see even more? ...D-don't say embarrassing stuff like that!
Sorry to keep you waiting—Wh-what? It's not like I got changed just for your sake!
Jeez... What even goes through your mind all the time? Playing in the ocean at a time like this? ...Well, since you're this close anyway, I guess it makes sense.
Aren't you normally supposed to say something in situations like these? Well, I suppose it helps to have some experience first... W-wait, it's not like I'm trying to rush you or anything!
Ughh... I'm not embarrassed... I'm totally not embarrassed! This level of embarrassment doesn't even count as embarrassment!
Hmph... Well, as long as you like it. At least I didn't get changed for nothing.
Oh... am I getting sunburnt? Maybe I should see if they have sunscreen here...
Hmm? ...That's quite daring of you. So, how should I pay you back?
Done with work already? Well, then you can hang out with me for a bit, right?
Light aircraft carrier - Yoshino.
Um...I'm Yoshino, and this is my friend, Yoshinon. "Just remember us as Cute Yoshinon, and Super Cute Yoshino!" Yoshinon, th-that's embarrassing...
Eh... ah... umm... "Wooow, what a spectacle. What the heck even happened to us? Where even IS this?" E-Excuse me...I, I'm Yoshino...and this is...Yoshinon. C-Can we...chat for a bit?
G-Good...morning... "Heyyo! It's a WOOONDERFUL day!"
Sorry...I'm not very good at talking to people... But...I would be happy if we could become friends.
It's nice outside... Really makes me want to go out for a stroll... "Yoshinon's got you covered! The nice ladies here gave us some sweet recommendations for places we can go!"
Heheh.. Shopping's a lot of fun, Yoshinon... "Hey, check out all the cool stores over here! The stuff here's awesome!"
Everyone at this port...is really good looking... "Yoshino's no slouch either! Just look at that Commander who's totally head-over-heels for you!" H-huh?!
Ehh? Umm... Y-your...hand...is really warm... "Yoshino, is, confused."
Eep! ...Oh, it's you, Commander... Ah, um... You just surprised me, that's all...
Uh, umm... "Beep beep! I'm your neighborhood bunny police, and you're not allowed to do that!"
Ah, um... Excuse me... "Oh, what's this? You're STILL not done with your work?"
"Wowee! What a huge boatload of rewards!" Mission...complete.
I think you might have mail... "Make sure to check your messages regularly!"
Welcome back... Is everything okay? "Good to see you back in one piece. As a reward, I'll give you a RABBIT PAWNCH!
Everyone was able to come home safely... What a relief.
"Power-up, success!!" I...I wonder if I've gotten any stronger...
"Yoshinon, movin' out!" -Moving out...!
Phew...I, I did my best... "You totally kicked ass!"
I'm so sorry...everyone... "We— goofed— up— big— time—..."
"Ready to doooo this?" Mhm... Let's do this together!
Return everything to silence...! —Zadkiel
Zadkiel
"Woah, woah! Yoshino, you doing okay?" ...Mhm, I can...still manage!
"You know, Yoshinon isn't too sure about this thing after all..." Y-Yoshinon...
Hello. The weather's quite nice today... Yoshinon, was that okay? "Yes, yes! Good job, keep it up!"
"Yoshinon will let you in on a secret. Gentle headpats are always welcome." Ah, um... H-here you go, then...
"Ding ding! A flag has been raised on the Yoshino route! Your next choice is going to be extra important, okay?" Y-Yoshinon...y-you're going to bother other people...
I'm not good at talking to strangers...but around you, Commander...I feel like I can speak naturally. "Wowee, look at you. Reckon ya might've been a bunny in a past life?"
Umm... Ah... um... "Oh, oh? What's this? Not feeling as chatty as you were before?" B-because...when I'm around Commander...I start feeling shy...
Oh, th-thank you... I'm truly...so happy.
Miss Tohka, I'll go. Just leave it to me!
Ah, um... I'll do my best! "Kurumi-chan, you'd better cover our backs! Which means, no backstabby stuff!"

ex.line: C-Commander, ah...umm...I'll try my best today...
As long as Commander...is with me...there's nothing to be scared of... "Yoshino, you and the Commander sure get along nicely." ...Y-yeah!
Huh? Did something...happen? ...Commander, you look...really worn out... "What's wrong? If you need to vent, Yoshinon's here to lend an ear."
Commander...you always look so busy. Please let us help you as well. "Yoshinon's got you covered!"
"Thanks a bunch, ship ladies!" They taught me so much when I didn't know what was going on... Everyone here is so nice...
Ah, umm...it's...very warm...
It looks like there's still some work left to do... "No slacking off allowed!"
I guess...this is the last of it. Thanks for your hard work, Commander.
L-let our date... "BEGIIIIIN!"
I hope I was...able to meet everyone's expectations...
Um... Commander, what's on your mind? If something happened... please tell me. Even though I'm not the most dependable, I still want to help...

lines.line: Um...I still tend to be a bit shy...when it comes to unfamiliar places. So...is it okay if I stay here...a bit longer? "You've already done the prep. Now what you need is the courage! Say, Commander, mind giving us a hand over here?"

Um...I still tend to be a bit shy...when it comes to unfamiliar places. So...is it okay if I stay here...a bit longer? "You've already done the prep. Now what you need is the courage! Say, Commander, mind giving us a hand over here?"
Commander... you're here. Welcome...
"Goggles, check! Snorkel, check! Yoshinon is fully geared out!" Going to the beach...is still a bit scary...
"Nyuhuhu... Yoshinon prepared this legendary swimsuit!" Miss Akashi was the one who provided it...but what do you mean by..."legendary"?
"Woah! What a vast ocean! And so many fish! I've been looking forward to this!" I think I...might be a little excited too...? But maybe...also a bit scared?
Before going to the beach...I built myself...a little place to stay. "This is the very definition of a secret base, isn't it?!"
Um...does it...look good on me? "Of course! It suits you well, don't you see?"
Um...it's not like I'm cold or anything... "Ah-ah, hands off! Who said you could get touchy-feely?!"
You're not hurt, are you? I've been waiting for you...praying this whole time...
Light cruiser - Kurumi Tokisaki.

My name is Kurumi Tokisaki, but you can just call me Kurumi. Some call me scary things like "the disaster that will destroy the world" and the "Worst Spirit", but please don't let that get to you. As you can see, I am nothing more than a weak and powerless little thing. Kihihihi~

My, my... Now, where exactly might this be? Hmm, I seem to have... crossed into another world without realizing it. Kihihihi... It looks like things are about to get a lot more interesting. Ah, but please disregard that for now. Please allow me to introduce myself first. I am Kurumi Tokisaki. What might your name be?
Good morning, Commander. May I ask what plans you have for the day?
Commander, what sort of impression do you have of me? Heehee~ Perhaps... I might not be the kind of girl you think I am.
My, my... Are you THAT interested in me? I'm glad to hear it, heehee. Buuut, I wouldn't get too tangled up if I were you.
The seaside certainly has a unique charm to it, wouldn't you say? Like, one that cleanses the soul—Oh my, is there something you wanted to say?
My my, is there any particular reason why everyone is gathering here today? Is the fact that I am here so unusual to all of you? Though, if you ask me, there are some equally eccentric people here...
My, my... Is something the matter?
My, my, are you doubting the nature of my existence? Heehee... Though it is true—perhaps under different circumstances, I might've been a very different kind of being.
My, my... That's not proper, you know?
Come on now, there's still work to be done. Let us proceed with quiet diligence.
It seems that you've finished your mission. Please go ahead and collect the rewards, then.
This letter... seems to be addressed to you.
It seems you were able to come back safe and sound. Yes, yes. I understand—but first, let us rejoice in your triumphant return.
Welcome back. I'm glad you're all safe.
Ahh, ahh! I can feel it! How exhilarating!
Kihihihi! You think you have the might to go against me?
Surely you didn't think you had a chance against me, did you?
Have I... been... defeated?
Let the feast begin!
None may escape the prison of time. —Zafkiel
Zafkiel
You should know now... THIS is where the true battle begins, understand?
Hmph... So that's how it is. Well, not like I was expecting much from the beginning.
My, my... What am I going to do with you? I suppose I'm willing to make an exception, just this once.
Heehee. You know, you're quite the interesting person. I do like how you're not intimidated by me in the slightest.
Heehee, you're a LOT more interesting than I expected. You know, Commander—I'd love to devour you right up. Kihihi, just kidding~
Good evening. Recently, you've been meeting my gaze more and more often. Are you that captivated by me? ...Hmm? If our eyes are meeting, that means I've been looking at you too...? My, oh my...

Heehee, what a truly wonderful place this is. The deep blue of the sea, the foamy white crests of the waves... It brings peace even to my troubled heart. ...Hmm? What is it that troubles me? My, my... Wouldn't it be terribly dull for me to just go and say it?
My, my... You want me to have something this wonderful? Heehee, I'll take good care of it.
Come on now, Yoshino. Let's fight together.
Heehee. It's nice to see a familiar face, Kotori. For the time being, let's be allies.

ex.line: How nice of you to finally show up... Good grief, how rude of you to keep me waiting this whole time.
Are you curious about me? Heehee. Well, I won't stop you from prying into my affairs.
You seem quite worn out. Since we've come to such a wonderful place, I'd recommend using this time to get some rest.
Ahh... the sea breeze feels so good... During moments like these, don't you just... feel like getting up and dancing? Heehee, just kidding.
What's wrong? Hmm... You could've sworn you saw me somewhere else a moment ago...? ...Is that so? Heehee. What a strange thing to say, don't you think?
My, my... I assume you're already prepared to face the consequences?
My, my, you're still not finished? I'll give you a hand, so let's get this done quickly.
A job well done. Now then, please take a moment to rest.
Now, shall we begin our date?
Heehee. This battle... is over.
What do I think about this place, you ask? Heehee... Well, I can answer you by saying that even I, as someone who "belongs" nowhere, will be staying here, just for a while.

lines.line: My, my. It seems that we've been seen, the other "Me". "Indeed. Such a passionate gaze is naturally going to make me feel flushed." ...So, how long do you intend to stand there staring?
My, my. It seems that we've been seen, the other "Me". "Indeed. Such a passionate gaze is naturally going to make me feel flushed." ...So, how long do you intend to stand there staring?
Good day to you. My, you seem quite taken aback by this outfit of mine. Heehee, do you not think it looks good on me?
Two Kurumi Tokisakis—and both are "me". So, Commander, which "me" do you prefer?
I personally think this is a bit too risque, but what do you think? "Heehee... that beet-red face says it all."
My, my... I can't believe how deep these tan lines already are—Heehee, Commander, can you see them as well?
Why are there two of me? Heehee. Every girl has her secrets, right?
Hmm, it's really hard applying lotion to your own back... My, oh my. Are you expecting something from me?
Kihihihi... How awfully daring of you~
You're back? Well then, step closer and let me loosen up that weary body of yours.
Light cruiser - Kaguya Yamai・Yuzuru Yamai.

Mwahaha... Kaguya Yamai is my name! And this Yuzuru, my other half! We are the Children of Typhoon who control the wind! Heed my word, my beloved subjects! The time has come! No foe can challenge my tyranny! Prostrate yourselves in awe and spread the noble name of Yamai across the world. "Praise. Clap clap. You're so awesome, Kaguya. Woohoo." Hey, are you being sarcastic?

Mwahaha! We are the Children of Typhoon who raze everything! Kaguya Yamai, and... "Concur. Yuzuru Yamai." Wait, what? Where are we? "Confusion. It seems we've wound up in another world." S-seriously? Wh-wh-what do we do now, Yuzuru?! "Composure. Calm down. We should ask someone what is going on. You there, please explain as much as you can."
"Greeting. Good morning." Huh? Hey! I'm still in bed here! Don't gawk!
"Inquiry. What is our reason for being in this place?" Hmm... I don't think you should think too hard about it.

"Praise. Don't you think it's very cute how Kaguya conducts herself? Moreover, her powers are a perfect 10/10." What? What're you chatting about? "We were discussing how you should work on your temper." You what?!

"Explanation. Kaguya and I were originally a single Spirit. At some point, we split into two." Huh? What kind of Spirit were we originally? Hmm... I'm not sure, but I DO know we were stronger than anyone else!
Incredible. Look how many facilities here can be used for competitions... My blood rushes with excitement! "Concur. Let's have a match, Kaguya."
Eek! Wh-wh-what're you doing?! "Supremacy. This is what is colloquially known as a 'headpat.'"
What's up? Need help with something? Fiiine, since you want it so badly. "Observation. You seem rather pleased, Kaguya."
Eek! Th-that's cold!
Commander, I'm not impressed with how you neglect your work. "Proposal. You should get it done already."
Received. Your rewards have arrived. Please have a look.
Commander, a message has arrived. Information is the key to any strategy. Read it posthaste.
Welcome back. You alright? Didn't get hurt out there, did you? "Unharmed. That is a relief."
Oh, the girls are back from their errands! Come on, let's go see them!
Ugh! This power... Be still, my right arm... "Growth. Our abilities have improved."
The time is now! Follow me! "Deploying. I'm heading out."
Alright! That's done! "Report. Victory is ours."
Sorry, Yuzuru—I messed up... "Rescue. Kaguya, hang in there!"
"Binding."Penetrate!
Bear us forth on swift wings of steel! —Raphael
Raphael
I am... immortal! "Unyielding. The true battle... begins now."
"Surprise. You're still here?" Come on, Yuzuru, let's bail.
Greeting. Good day." What, got nothing better to do? Hmm. You wanna hang out with us, then? "Concur. Casual mingling is fun.
Retainer of mine, your proven dedication to me has made you deserving of a reward. What do you desire? ...What? M-my smile?! S-such an eccentric fellow you are...

Response. Yes, what is it, Commander? Hmm. I see..." "Warning. I believe you should choose your words more carefully, Commander. Otherwise, misunderstandings are bound to occur, and these may throw the port into chaos.

"Gratitude. It is thanks to you that we've managed to survive in this place we know nothing about. You have our utmost thanks." Hey! Don't be a show-stealer! I wanna express how super grateful I am, too!

The world is a place where various causes and effects come together. When viewed that way, there must be a reason for us all meeting here. "Affirmative. At the very least, we are grateful for having met you."
"Delightful. You have my heartfelt gratitude." Wow, really? Thank you so much!
"Report. Master Origami, please behold the fruits of our training." What training?!
Over there! Kotori! Isn't that a LITTLE too much firepower?! "Analysis. She's trying to make her grand entrance with an explosion."

ex.line: Aye. Appreciate you coming, Commander! "Request. I hope we will have a productive day today."
Y'know, I get the feeling your criteria for judging people aren't based on coolness or strength, Commander. "Praise. This speaks to your noble character."

"Proposal. Whoop, bang, and finally, gwop!" What?! You're telling me to do a running jump into a hug? No way! That's embarrassing! "Smirk. That is not what I meant, but I see that's how you interpreted it." Hey!
Hm-hm-hm-hmm♪ "Shh. Kaguya is in a good mood and humming. I suggest we observe her for a bit." Hey, I can hear you!

Hmm. You're still working, I see. You're a busy one. "Proposal. How about we assist with your work?" Oh, a fine idea! Allow me to demonstrate my ability! "Doubt. Perhaps you should pick a task you are better suited for."
Shock. Perhaps this is some kind of special skill...
"Report. You have yet to accomplish your assigned missions." Heheheh. So it's come to this. I shall lend you my strength.
Proposal. Take a break once you've finished your work.
Let "our" date "begin!"
"Anticipation. I can't wait for our reward." Indeed. Do your utmost to entertain me!
Hey, it's no bother at all! I just want to help you like you helped me, Commander! "Gratitude. You need not hold back in front of us. Please don't be afraid to tell us if you have a problem."

lines.line: I now entrust this body of mine to the beautiful flow of the sea god! Come, Commander, and give me your hand! "Request. Let us hold hands so that we don't get lost in the sea." Come on, don't be shy!
I now entrust this body of mine to the beautiful flow of the sea god! Come, Commander, and give me your hand! "Request. Let us hold hands so that we don't get lost in the sea." Come on, don't be shy!
I've been waiting for you! No time to waste—let's go swimming!
"Shock. There are so many fish forming these schools..." Heh! Our sheer charm must've drawn them here! "Doubt. Maybe they think we're... coral?" Umm.... Maybe, I guess?
Heheh! Well done on the escort! Henceforth, you shall follow me as my right hand! "Doubt. I feel more like we are the ones being escorted here."
I've figured it out! Swimming underwater's not that different from flying! That being the case... My vassal! I shall reveal to you the realm of the fish beneath the great ocean!
Fear. I feel as though I'm being drawn to the sea bottom when doing this. Could you hold my hand for a little while?
Yuzuru and I are wearing matching swimsuits! How do we look? "Confidence. No answer other than 'incredible' would be acceptable."
Not THAT! My hand! Take my hand! "Shock. How bold of you... Kaguya." I'M the bold one?!
Welcome back, Commander! Surely now you've got time to play! "Attention. The Commander is tired. We shouldn't be too pushy." Tired-shmired! Come on!

Hm? Where am I... and who are YOU? The... Commander? My name is Elise. I came here to play the role of instructor, but it looks like there have been some complications. Apologies for my forwardness, but would you allow me to stay here for a spell?

I'm Elise. I was on track to go to an island as an instructor... Oh, don't worry about the "instructor" part - it's a long story, and not terribly relevant. I don't know how much aid I can offer you in that capacity, but I look forward to working with you.

Hm? Where am I... and who are YOU? The... Commander? My name is Elise. I came here to play the role of instructor, but it looks like there have been some complications. Apologies for my forwardness, but would you allow me to stay here for a spell?
Good morning, Commander. I have today's schedule here...
As an instructor, both my knowledge and my character are under constant scrutiny. Be mindful of that.
Oh? Commander, are you inspecting the port? That's a great idea. Knowing everybody's daily routines is a vital quality of leadership.
The sea breeze is so refreshing... Kicking back and relaxing isn't so bad once in a while.
Everyone lives in such peace here... Should I assume that's the result of your influence, Commander? Heehee...
Are you treating me like a child?
Do you have business with me, Commander? I can answer any questions you have.
Eep! Commander... You do know the difference between right and wrong, don't you?
Hmm... These look unfinished. You know you're only making trouble for yourself, right?
These missions are done. Don't neglect your rewards.
This mail is for you. Please make sure to read it, okay?
Welcome back, Commander. Would you like to rest for a moment? Regular breaks are an important part of work.
Your subordinates have returned from their mission... Shall I receive their report for you?
Who knew I still had room to grow? I couldn't have done it without your help.
It's time... Let's begin.
Your tactics were impressive, Commander.
The situation is unfavorable... Let's retreat for the time being.
Leave this to me!
I... can still fight!
*sigh*... Goodness. You're not giving me much confidence in you.
I see... You do have a work ethic. In that case, I'd best live up to your expectations.
Do you need additional instruction? Alright, but this is a give-and-take relationship. You'll have to agree to my terms.
You're always working your hardest, Commander... Try not to push yourself too hard. I worry about you.
You lead everyone at port so admirably that I'm not sure there's anything I can teach you... Huh? I see... Ahem, understood. If that's your wish, then I'll do my utmost to help.

The heartfelt love I've received from you is greater, more profound, and more precious than anything I've ever taught you. So I want to return the favor with something of equal... no, of even greater value. A good relationship needs give and take, after all.
Is this for me? Hehe... Thank you very much.
Patty! Quit swaying so much!
Shizuku! Focus on the battle!
Zenker, I'd like to ask for tactical advice!

ex.line: Good morning. You're right on time.
I may be the one instructing you, Commander, but... to be honest, it's a lot of fun for me.
Oh? Commander, shouldn't you be working right about now? ...I understand, but seeing me doesn't mean you have to come over just to say hi... though I am glad that you did.
What are you in such a hurry over? Huh? You were thinking about your reward? Good. Give it some careful thought... Knowing your worth makes things more efficient.
Are you zoning out again? ...Huh? You were captivated by the sight of me? Heehee! I'm just an instructor, after all... but it means more coming from you.
Hyah?! There's a time and a place... Haven't I taught you that already?
You still have unfinished work... Let me take a look and see if I can help.
This mission seems to be done. Shouldn't we follow up on it?
Let's stay calm in this battle.
Phew... We managed to pull out a win.
To be completely honest, the time we spend together has become the most precious thing to me. Could we... keep going for a while longer, you think?

lines.line: What's the matter? You look like you're spacing out... Huh? You think I'm charming? You always know just what to say. If that's how you feel, then... why don't you come and keep me company?
What's the matter? You look like you're spacing out... Huh? You think I'm charming? You always know just what to say. If that's how you feel, then... why don't you come and keep me company?
There's no need to rush. Relax a little, why don't you? I'm not going anywhere.
I'm happy that you like my swimsuit, but it is a little embarrassing... Yes, you can look at it closer later when we're alone.
Blue skies, white clouds, and the vast ocean... I never imagined that I'd be able to spend my time relaxing in such a beautiful place.
You don't have to sit there as silent as the grave. I won't get mad at you if you offer your thoughts.
I'm impressed that I could get a swimsuit like this out here... You had it made especially for me? Thank you. I'm delighted.
Sunscreen...? I appreciate your concern. Don't worry, I take good care of my skin.
Geez, you messed up my swimsuit... Was that your plan all along? Goodness.
Welcome back, Commander. I'm sorry for not being better dressed... Huh? You love it? I-I see.

Don't get caught, don't get your cover blown... Hide carefully... Ack, I'm sorry! I'll leave right away... Hm? My ears and tail? Oh, I'm just cosplaying a fox, haha... Wait, did you say there are other girls like me around here? Okay... Umm, my name is Shizuku, and I'm a fox spirit. You mind if I stay here for now...?

Shizuku... That's my name. Are you curious about my ears and tail? It's just a cosplay... Okay, fine, they're real. I know you saw through me right away, but when I saw the people at this port... I realized that having fox ears and a tail isn't weird at all.

Don't get caught, don't get your cover blown... Hide carefully... Ack, I'm sorry! I'll leave right away... Hm? My ears and tail? Oh, I'm just cosplaying a fox, haha... Wait, did you say there are other girls like me around here? Okay... Umm, my name is Shizuku, and I'm a fox spirit. You mind if I stay here for now...?
Good morning, Commander. It's another wonderful day... Kon!
You didn't introduce me to everyone as a fox cosplayer, but nobody even batted an eye... This place must be really accepting.
Everyone here is really nice. They don't even say anything when they see my ears... I feel really at ease... and happy here. Kon!
I like how quiet it is here. It's also clean, and the food is delicious... It wouldn't be right to do nothing, so I need to find a way to help out.
There are lots of people with big ears here. I thought they were all cosplayers at first, but they're not... It's incredible.
This is just a cosplay, so... Huh? You think it looks real? Have you ever actually touched a fox...?
Mm... Your hands are chilly. It feels nice... Kon...
No... Stop that. Even I'll get mad if you keep that up.
Commander, I think you still have work left... Kon.
That's a lot of stuff... Are these the rewards from your work?
This is a letter for you... Read it.
Welcome back, Commander. The kitties and birds said you had a rough day... Are you okay? Come over and rest.
The girls came back from their errand. Go welcome them home, okay?
My power is rising... This is incredible... Kon!
Cheer up. We can win... I know it.
Oh, we win... Kon!
I'm a fox, not a prey animal...
I'll show you a kitsune's power...
I'm not giving up yet... Kon!
Mm... Sorry. I wasn't thinking of you.
Found you, Commander! Can we hang out today? Yeah, I'm happy as long as I get to be with you... Kon!
Thanks for inviting me out today, Commander... Yeah, I can't wait. Where should we go?
Do you like my tail...? Really? Then it was worth taking such good care of it. I'm happy you like it.
When I came here, I was all alone again... But you found me when I was terrified, and you became my friend... It made me really happy. I hope you'll let me stay with you longer.
You're a strange person, Commander. But... You're also a kind person, especially to me. So it makes me happy to be with you... Kon!
Umm... I'm really happy. Kon!
Are bartenders... strong?
Tsukushi... Would you like to cosplay with me?
Minase, let's do it together... Kon!

ex.line: Oh, Commander! I got to see you first thing in the morning... Yay... Kon!
You still accepted me, even knowing that I was a fox spirit instead of a cosplayer... Thank you.
Mmm... The sun feels really nice today. I love this weather. Maybe we should do a little cosplay shoot...?
The girls here are all so beautiful. I bet any of them could win first prize in a competition... On that note, I'd better go tidy up my fur.
Commander, what do you think about my ears and tail...? They look fluffy and cute to you? They're actually very sensitive, though, so it's a bit of a handful...
Oh, you can touch me all you... Umm, never mind...
Commander, you still have work... If you need help, tell me.
I got a notification that your work is all done... Let's take a break.
If it's a game of cunning you want... I won't lose.
I'm so happy... Permission to jump for joy?
When you said it was okay for me to stay here... I felt so warm deep down inside. In return, I'll warm you up, too...

lines.line: Hehe, hey there. You'll get swept away over there... I love your little house! ...Oh, Commander? Yeah, I'm just playing with my little friends in the sea. This rock is the perfect hiding spot, so nobody can see us. It's really relaxing... Kon!

Hehe, hey there. You'll get swept away over there... I love your little house! ...Oh, Commander? Yeah, I'm just playing with my little friends in the sea. This rock is the perfect hiding spot, so nobody can see us. It's really relaxing... Kon!
Huh? You can see my tail? But this is a secret hideout, so nobody can see us... Besides, nobody here minds, so... Kon!
In places like this, I can see lots of little fish that usually hide out of sight. But I'd better be careful not to slip on the wet rocks...
Don't bother trying to scare me... I can tell from the sound of the water if someone's coming. I knew you were coming, too.
Watch out for crabs... Yeah, that's important. If my finger or tail got snipped... that would be really bad.
Th-there are a couple of birds on that rock over there... Do you think they're taking a little break on their journey?
Aww, you're getting my tail wet. If it gets all messy, you'd better brush it for me later.
No pranks... When I get startled, I blush like a beet, so... I'll have to cool off with the sea water. Kon...
You've been working really hard. Here, you can relax and let all that tension float away... Kon!

Oh? Good evening. What's your name? ...You saw me looking pensive and came to say hi? Hehe, well, aren't you easy? My name is Shandy... though that's just a professional alias. We have all the time in the world - come and chat with me.
My name is Shandy... It's just a professional alias, of course, but I'm sure you don't mind. I wonder what interesting things await me here... Heehee.

Oh? Good evening. What's your name? ...You saw me looking pensive and came to say hi? Hehe, well, aren't you easy? My name is Shandy... though that's just a professional alias. We have all the time in the world - come and chat with me.
Oh? Good morning, Commander. You look busy as always.
It's a bartender's duty to prepare drinks for her guests, yes... but sometimes, I like to mix things according to my own preferences.
Would you like a cocktail after dinner? What's wrong with indulging in luxury once in a while?
Mm, that's good... What am I doing? Just updating my menu... Say, would you like a taste, too?
Everyone at this port is always so busy. Maybe I ought to start work a little earlier...
My, my. Do you like more direct physical affection?
Heehee. Do you desire my warmth, Commander?
Oh, my. How serious are you, exactly?
Hehe... You naughty slacker, you. That won't do.
Hmm? Commander, are you not interested in your work once it's done?
Commander, you have some paperwork here... Heehee, I feel like a secretary.
Welcome back, Commander. Huh? You think it's rare for me to come out to greet you? Heehee, then today must be your lucky day!
Commander, your friends are back. What will you do?
Trying to get me drunk, now? What are you after?
Be gentle, please.
Oh... Is that all? Really?
Hehe... Girls don't like stubborn people.
Lose yourself in my ultimate blend.
Now that you've gotten my attention... let's see who's the last one standing.
*sigh*... I thought you would be more interesting.
Has chatting with me helped you feel a little better? Hehe, glad to hear it.
Do you ever get bored with me... No? You have a lot of fun? That makes me feel better.
Come and keep me company after work next time, would you? I'll treat you to one of my new cocktails!
Do I look bored to you? I appreciate how sincere you are, but try being a little more confident. You're starting to make me think that it isn't obvious how I feel... Heehee, what do YOU think?

I usually can't trust that other people are being sincere with me, but you're different... I can trust you. Throughout our time together, you've helped me grow and feel this way. Maybe that makes you irreplaceable to me.
Oh, my... Hehe, thank you very much.
Shizuku, your tail is adorable.
Yukino, I happen to love cute things, too.
Do your best, Laffey! Tasty food awaits.

ex.line: Good morning, Commander. Hehe... I'm happy to see you again today.
I know cocktails for special occasions, too. Hehe, unfortunately, their recipes are a secret. If you come drink with me every day, I'll make one for you eventually.
Do you want to chat with me? Hehe, just a hunch... I'm kidding. I know you well enough that it's easy to tell.
Why don't we draw lots to decide how we spend our day for a change? Hehe... I actually really enjoy leaving things up to chance.
Do you remember our promise? If you've forgotten... I might just bawl my poor little eyes out! I'm kidding, silly.
Heehee... You little pervert, you.
Heehee, do you need a hand? I suppose I can help you out a little.
Good work, Commander. I mixed a drink for you, so come take a little break.
Everything's ready. Let's get it started!
Heehee! Are you satisfied now, Commander?
Commander, I've been waiting... Oh? You think I'm kidding? Heehee, I wonder. I'll take your order first. If you have any special requests... go ahead and let them all out for me♡

lines.line: Welcome... Aww, did I startle you? Hehe, but why? I thought you of all people would appreciate this seductive vibe, Commander. Hmm... I'll pose for you, if you'd like. Just say the word!
Welcome... Aww, did I startle you? Hehe, but why? I thought you of all people would appreciate this seductive vibe, Commander. Hmm... I'll pose for you, if you'd like. Just say the word!
Commander, would you care to join me...? I think that's the vibe we're going for here. Heehee, want a shot before we get to work?
Water and skin blend together, creating a new cocktail... Is that too dramatic? But weren't you just thinking the same?
I feel a burning gaze on me... Heehee, that's right, Commander. I already know it's you.
Who in the world thought up this scenario? Could it be... the one who won't stop staring at me?
My skin's getting a little flushed... It's a good thing the steam hides it for me.
Shouldn't a swimsuit be the main attraction here? ...Goodness, you want BOTH? How greedy you are... Heehee!
Should I soak a little deeper, Commander? Hehe, you seem to like your girls wet, so...
I'm sorry that I'm not exactly dressed to welcome you... Oh? You say it helped wake you right up? Heehee, you're too naughty.

Blue skies... White clouds... A sparkly, endless sea... Hehe! What a beautiful view... Huh? Wh-where am I... Whoa?! Wh-who goes there? Huh? A Commander? You wanna know where I came from...? Umm, sorry. My name is Tsukushi. Do you know where we are, exactly?

My name is Tsukushi. Umm... I guess I'm just a student? I-I like drawing manga and stuff, too... You don't have to worry about it, though. I've seen a whole lot of cute girls around here. For someone with anxiety like me, it's basically heaven to be surrounded by all these goddesses...

Blue skies... White clouds... A sparkly, endless sea... Hehe! What a beautiful view... Huh? Wh-where am I... Whoa?! Wh-who goes there? Huh? A Commander? You wanna know where I came from...? Umm, sorry. My name is Tsukushi. Do you know where we are, exactly?
Ah, Commander... G-good morning?
Incredible things keep happening here at the port. I could draw manga for the rest of my life off of this... Heh heh heh.
This outfit might be kind of lame, but I'm not brave enough to be in my swimsuit ALL the time...
There are goddesses all over the place at this port! Heh heh heh... I think I've found heaven, after all!
Someone invited me out to lunch just a minute ago... I can't go in there! It's so dazzling, I doubt I could get a word out!
Huh?! Oh no, is my hair a mess?! Aww, this is so embarrassing...
You want me to take off my tracksuit? You mean... show off skin? I-I don't have the confidence for that!
Hyah! Y-you scared me...
Commander, you left this undone... Are you sure you shouldn't check it out?
Huh? Can I really have this? But Commander, it's your reward...
Handling mail... I feel like a secretary just in my manga!
Good work today, Commander. Wanna take a little break for now?
I got a message saying that the errand is done! Commander, let's go greet everyone!
I-I got praised for growing stronger! Hehe...
Oookay... Here goes!
Wh-what? We won?
W-we lost... Next time! I'll try harder!
S-sorry if this hurts!
*sob*... C-can we go home already?
Umm, so... I'm kind of busy right now! Bye!
Oh, Commander! Greetings... Isn't that an elegant greeting? Maybe I should use it in my next manga.
What kind of girl do you like, Commander? Um, just asking as a reference for a character design...
I was planning to draw all day, but do you have any plans, Commander? If you're free, maybe you and I could... Uh, n-never mind!

I've been racking my brain over the heroine of this manga for a while now... Now that I've spent so much time with you, I think I've gotten a rough idea. I think I've captured that sense of... endearingness? Haha, what am I even saying...

This world is full of good manga and pretty girls. If only someone as... insignificant as me could be among those shining stars. Umm... This is embarrassing to say, but I'd be really happy if you would always watch over me... Hehe.
Huh? Are you sure I can have this? Th-thanks... Hehe!
L-let's see how cool you are, Yukino!
Shandy, you're so pretty no matter what you're doing...
Raffaello, you should give me some pointers on drawing cute girls when we get back!

ex.line: G-good morning. Should we take care the day's plans... together?
The port is full of people who shine brightly, like protagonists in their own stories... I've got to do better as well! Whether it comes to manga, or other things... Ehehe♪
Delicate beauties, cosplay cuties, swimsuit chicks... You've got all kinds! Huh? You think I'm cute, too? Umm... Th-thank you very much.
Y-you scared me! Don't call out to me out of nowhere... If it weren't you, I would've screamed so loud...
I bet I could find all kinds of models here... Huh? You'll ask for me? Okay... Can I get YOU to model for me, then?
Commander! Th-that's out of the question!
C-Commander, you still have work to do... I-is there anything I can do to help at all?
Commander, can I mark this mission completed?
I-I'll do my best. Cheer me on, okay?
I won, Commander! Ehehe...

Ever since I met you, I've started to understand what it means to have feelings for someone else. This should help me make even better manga... I'll keep trying hard, so I hope you'll support me, too.

lines.line: H-hey, Commander... Do you think the people here could build one of those machines where you lie down in bed, and the machine's arms give you a full-body massage?
H-hey, Commander... Do you think the people here could build one of those machines where you lie down in bed, and the machine's arms give you a full-body massage?
Commander, do your muscles ever ache? I'm feeling a little sore myself...
Massages are really important to make sure you don't still feel fatigued the next day. If I could just get one whenever I wanted... Oh, but I need an emergency stop button in case it tickles!
Imagine using AI to analyze my data and provide the perfect massage... That'd be way better than doing it myself.
A full-body massage from head to toe... Oh, but if it kneaded too hard... Ugh, I don't even wanna imagine. M-maybe we shouldn't, Commander!
A-an introvert like me could never ask someone for a massage! This is exactly why I need a machine.
Ah! Right there... Just a little harder, Commander... Ack! Why did I just say that...
Mmmnh! C-Commander! I'm really sensitive right there, and right here... Hey, stop! I can't take anymore!
Commander, you look beat... One of those massage machines sure would come in handy right about now...

Mmm... The wind, sea, and sun all smell wonderful! *sniff*... What's that smell? Wait, who are you? A... Commander? Hello hello! Hm? Me? I'm Patty, of course. By the way, what is this place? ...Ooh, okay. I'll trust you, then! I'm not worried, since you smell like such a good person...
Hello hello. I'm Patty! Everyone just calls me Patty, so you should too, Commander. This radio is my treasure, and I love every little song that comes out of it... Haha!

Mmm... The wind, sea, and sun all smell wonderful! *sniff*... What's that smell? Wait, who are you? A... Commander? Hello hello! Hm? Me? I'm Patty, of course. By the way, what is this place? ...Ooh, okay. I'll trust you, then! I'm not worried, since you smell like such a good person...
Hello hello! Mhm, I'm all ready to go!
The radio went quiet out of nowhere. I got sad because I thought it was broken, but maybe it's just set to the wrong frequency?
It gets lonely here because I can't hear my radio, but sometimes, I hear people singing or playing instruments. It really gets me hyped...
When I go on walks, I see so many sights I've never seen before! It's even more fun because people come along sometimes!
Shopping? Let's go! Yaaay, I hope I find something I like!
So, am I cute, or what? ...Hehe! Thanks for the compliment!
Ooh, hello hello... Did something exciting happen? I wanna join in!
Hyah! Geez... You smell naughty!
Umm, let's see... Does this mark mean it's not finished?
You got a lot of stuff... Should I not touch that?
Commander, you've got mail! I can't wait to see what it says!
*sniff*... Oh, you smell tired, Commander. Come here, and let's relax together!
The girls who went out just got back! Let's go welcome them, Commander!
Hehe... What do you think? Have I changed?
C'mon! Let's move to the beat~♪
Woohoo! Patty wins!
Aww, I messed up... But I can still fight!
One, two, and... Pow!
Ugh, you're all just bullies! But I won't lose yet!
Hmm, I don't like that smell... I know! I'll go for a walk to clear my head.
Hello hello! Are you doing good, Commander? Yeah, it's good that you're feeling good! Hahaha!
Hello hello! Hey, what do you think of this outfit... Does it look good on me? ...Hehehe!
You say I should stay away because you smell sweaty...? But I like your scent, Commander. You don't have to worry about it one bit, I promise.
I love listening to cheerful songs! It puts me in a great mood. I also love talking to you just as much now. Maybe you're the source of all my energy...♪

Hmm... The smell of my heart racing is even stronger than your scent now... I don't even know what to do anymore. But I do know that I'm bursting with excitement, so let's have lots of fun together, Commander. Hehe!
Huh? You got this for me? Wow, you're the best!
Let's do our best, Elise!
That tail accessory is too cute!
Guam, let's make this broadcast a good one!

ex.line: Hello hello, Commander! What do you wanna do today? Can we do it together?
Heh heh heh... Thanks to you, my radio's playing music again! It's all songs I don't know, sure, but I'm happy that they're all so fun!
This place is full of smells. Tasty ones, pleasant ones... and I know your smell too, of course!
Everyone smells happy when they're talking to you... It's incredible. I'm having fun, so I wonder if I smell happy, too.
The trees, flowers, birds, and fish are all full of life. Every one of them smells kind... I think it's all because you're here, Commander.
Gosh, Commander, that tickles!
You've got more of those... missions? It looks like a lot of trouble... Can I help?
This is proof that you worked hard! I already know.
Okay, let's do this... Here we gooo!
Ooh, I'm feeling the rhythm today!
Your scent feels really kind, and it makes me feel happy... Is this what romance is? Can you teach me, Commander?

lines.line: Oh, Commander! Hello hello! *sniff*... Huh? You smell like you're plotting something... Is it my bunny-like softness you're after? Well... If you can catch me, you can fluff me all you want! Hahaha!
