Oh, Commander! Hello hello! *sniff*... Huh? You smell like you're plotting something... Is it my bunny-like softness you're after? Well... If you can catch me, you can fluff me all you want! Hahaha!
Hello hello, Commander! What's it gonna be? You ready for a quick match with this bunny?
Bunnies are popular everywhere, huh? They're fluffy and cute... I hope everyone thinks I'm super cute, too.
Commander, you smell really troubled right now. Hahaha! It's okay. You can look at me all you want, any time you want.
What kind of bunnies do you like? Little ones? Ones with floppy ears? Or maybe... ones that hop around like this?
Do you think I could take a picture with a real bunny? You can be in it, too!
Hehehe! Does my bunny outfit suit your tastes, Commander?
Hehe! I can smell the excitement on you, Commander!
Commandeeer, you've been working so hard! I hope the sight of Patty the Bunny lifts your spirits.

Oh, man... Where am I? This sucks... Hey you, can you point me in the right... Huh? Me? I'm Yukino. Nice to meetcha! Oh, so, I rushed here 'cause I heard Tamaki was here... Guess I'm lost now. Mind taking little ol' me in for a while? Hehehe!
I'm Yukino. Give me a nickname, if you want. I've got lots of loves... Fashion, for example! On that note, I gotta give huge props to Tamaki!

Oh, man... Where am I? This sucks... Hey you, can you point me in the right... Huh? Me? I'm Yukino. Nice to meetcha! Oh, so, I rushed here 'cause I heard Tamaki was here... Guess I'm lost now. Mind taking little ol' me in for a while? Hehehe!
Oh, heya, Commander! You about to get to work? Good luck!
How do you like this pose? Pretty awesome, right? I think it's great... Just looking at me gets you going, huh?
The beach really is the best in the morning! It feels like I've got the whole thing to myself. Do you ever feel that way, Commander?
I can even go shopping here? Heck yeah... You're coming too, aren't you?
I've got a ton of respect for Tamaki. A former model AND a designer? How perfect can you be? It's just a little overwhelming to be around her all the time...
Hm? Commander, what's up? Need something?
Hm? Interested in my fit, Commander? Or are you just into this style?
You scared me... H-hey, that joke went too far!
Oof! Your workload is insane!
Done with your work already? Wow! You're crazy good at this.
Mail, huh... All this business stuff is too stuffy for me.
Oh, there you are. Good work, boss! How are you feeling? Doin' okay? Great to hear it!
Finished those errands? Great job, girls. You're the best!
Hehehe! Thanks, Commander. That one was all you!
Alright, let's get hype!
Do we kick butt, or what?!
I got a little too hasty... Next time, though! I'll totally get it right next time!
I'm about to do something crazy strong!
Ugh, this blows...
Gosh... Not cool, Commander. I'm not into that.
You wanna hang later? Okay! Where are we going?
Ugh, there's just so much stuff I wanna do with you, Commander!
Hey, tell me more about your loves, Commander. Trying out some new things could be fun!

My fit today is a little different from the usual... You say it suits your tastes? Heheh, I really love how direct you are, Commander. I knew it was a good idea to pick something you'd like... Hehehe!
It's so fun here, because I get to find new things to love every day! It's all because you're here, so... Keep taking care of me, alright, Commander? Hehehe!
Is this for me? Wow, that's awesome... Thanks!
I'm so glad I get to be with a cutie like you, Elise!
T-Tamaki... You're making me nervous!
I like your style, Owari!

ex.line: Commander, are you free right now? Let's grab a drink together.
My three sizes are 89, 55, and... Hey, you can't go around asking people that. But if you wanna know, I could tell you... Hehehe!
Ice cream by the beach is the best! I'm happy any time I'm eating something sweet. Commander, get over here and join me, would you?
My skin hasn't been in great shape lately. I'd love to soak in a hot spring right now... You got any recommendations?
I'm plenty happy with all the good food here, but... I'd better watch my waistline, huh?
Hehehe! That kinda tickles.
Do you still have work to do, Commander? Don't let that stuff pile up. Let's go knock it out right now.
Did you rush through your work just for me? Aww, thanks, Commander!
Heh heh heh... Let's party hard!
Hehehe! I won, and I looked good doing it!
You know how you always support my loves, Commander? I think that's pretty cool of you. I wanna keep sharing more of my loves with you, so you'd better be ready!

lines.line: Ooh, is this carnivorous vibe what you're into, Commander? No prob! I'll make all your dreams come true... Roooar! Haha, did that scare you? Get your heart pounding? Hehehe!
Ooh, is this carnivorous vibe what you're into, Commander? No prob! I'll make all your dreams come true... Roooar! Haha, did that scare you? Get your heart pounding? Hehehe!
Commander, this way! Over here! You're in my territory now!
What do you think? I think this wild look is kinda hot in a new way! Make sure you take some really good pics of me, okay?
My wildness level is through the roof! How about I pose up in this tree? I'm pretty agile, y'know!
The whole jungle photo shoot didn't work out, but I love this place's vibe. Don't you?
I'm already strutting all around the beach in this swimsuit... Why don't you change into something flashier, too? Hehehe!
You don't have to stand all the way over there. Come and get a closer look, if you dare.
When you stare at me like that, I get a little... embarrassed, you know? Geez! Keep that up, and I'm gonna eat you!
Hehe, even the king of beasts needs sleep. *yaaawn*... It's cool and comfy here...
Light cruiser - Neptune.

My background? Ehehe, I am the large light cruiser who only existed on paper, Neptune, so it is understandable that you have never heard of me before. Though I have yet to step onto the battlefield, my abilities are top notch... allow me to prove that to you in live combat~
Who am I? I am the Royal Navy's large light cruiser, Neptune. I shall see to it that you will never forget my name~♪ Yes, pleased to be of service~♪
That simply will not do, Commander, keeping me waiting all this time~
Want to know about this? It's called a trident. Don't you think it's cool?
Unlike the other girls, this is my "maiden voyage" onto the battlefield. I wish to confirm for myself what this oft-touted "difference in experience" looks like.
Commander, if you get on your knees and beg, "Please, Mistress Neptune," perhaps there would be a chance for something nice to happen?
Commander, if you wish to taste my freshly-baked cake, then please first brew your finest tea~
You would like to challenge me to a game? Very well. Do not expect me to hold back though, hehe~♪
That simply will not do, Commander. You cannot seek to gain my attention that way.
Commander, I see you have allowed your unfinished missions to pile up. I am not very fond of lazy people, you know?
Commander, what do you hope to gain through not collecting the mission rewards? Perchance you are waiting for me to remind you?
Commander, there's mail for you. Hmm? I didn't do anything in particular~
You've done well to return home safe and sound.
Commander, I shall temporarily grant you permission to leave my side so that you may greet the girls who have returned from commissions.
As expected!
So this is a battlefield? Ahaha... how interesting.
Ehehe~ As a special service, I shall allow you to praise me more~♪
I shall not repeat this mistake again.
I have no intention of getting friendly with the enemy~
I seem to have underestimated the battlefield...
Commander, did you know how high my expectations were for you at first? What a shame, for you shall now never know.
Commander, I have a question. If in the future you were given the option to sacrifice me for world peace, what would you choose?
The correct answer is - to do everything in your power to prevent that situation from occurring in the first place. Heehee~ Commander, if you wish to woo me, you will have to use your brain more~
Having that said, I believe that a truly intelligent person knows how to rely on others when appropriate. Ah, that's right~ Commander, would you feed me some cake?

Commander, have you planned where we're going to go for our date? If you have picked out an outfit for me, why don't you help me put it on? Eh~? "Why don't I wear it myself?" Silly, that's what love is all about~ L.O.V.E~♡

"You are my world?" Did you think you could fool me with such flattery? Ehehe... well, I suppose there's a chance that I would let you fool me~ But first, you would have to repeat it ten times, nay, a hundred times~
Bingo! Don't forget next time, either, okay?
I-I wouldn't do something like that...
Let's seize a decisive victory, Miss Head Maid~♪
Let me see how the Maid Team fights~♪
Hehe~ I usually let the other girls have all the glory, but even I must sometimes give you something to remember me by. Merry Christmas, Commander~
Hehe~ I usually let the other girls have all the glory, but even I must sometimes give you something to remember me by. Merry Christmas, Commander~
Commander, Merry Christmas~ ♪
My daily routine is nothing but missions and sorties, so it’s nice to be able to get dressed up and have a good time. Hehe~
Commander, if you kneel in front of me and beg, you might just get something very nice in return~ Hehe~
Commander, did you already forget? If you want a present from me, you must first give me something that I’d be satisfied with~
Since joining the fleet, I’ve made a lot of friends. Especially Shropshire — she’s both a good friend and a good rival.
Commander, would you help me out with these presents that I prepared for Seattle’s party? They’re going to be for everyone~
Commander, why don’t you take a guess which box I put your mail into~?
How uncouth, spoiling the mood like this...
That should wrap things up. Commander, let’s continue our party~
Welcome to our celebration, Commander. At this breathtaking venue, I, Neptune, shall be the one to show you around, rather than the Royal Maids. Heehee~♪
Welcome to our celebration, Commander. At this breathtaking venue, I, Neptune, shall be the one to show you around, rather than the Royal Maids. Heehee~♪
That simply won't do, Commander. As you are the guest of honor, we cannot have you arriving late. You've kept me waiting, you know. Heehee♪
Commander, I know you actually attend all sorts of parties with the Royal Maids. Buuut, heehee~ Don't you think I'm a cut above those girls when it comes to these kinds of situations?
Allowing some other girl to attend you instead of choosing me? That simply won't do, Commander... Just kidding♪ I'll be waiting right here, so make sure you say hello to everyone~
Commander, have you forgotten the magic words when you want me to take you somewhere? "Please, Mistress Neptune." Remember?

Charybdis' demeanor seems rather out of place compared to the rest of the Royal Maids... Say, Commander, how would you like it if I tried to act extra high-and-mighty to get you to do all sorts of stuff for me?
That's right, the party venue is right in front of you. Heehee~♪
That simply won't do, Commander. Everything has a proper time and place, you know?
Welcome back. Now then, please take my hand once more. Oh... Is the trident getting in the way?
You, going against the Commander? That simply won't do~♪
You're welcome~♪ It was only possible because of you, Commander.
Was I too preoccupied with putting on airs...?
Step aside, officer comin' through! Oh, here already, advisor? Did you find any good clues? ...No? Heheh, watch and see how the pros do it!
Step aside, officer comin' through! Oh, here already, advisor? Did you find any good clues? ...No? Heheh, watch and see how the pros do it!
You're just in time for our scene, Commander. Hurry up and get changed... Do you want my help? Hmm, only if you say please and thank you!
There's more to this case than meets the eye. Who knows how deep the rabbit hole goes... Advisor, it's time you start searching for clues. With your help, we've got this in the bag.

These traces are suspicious. It almost feels as if they were left on purpose... Advisor, write down everything that looks... Hm? Oh, right, that wasn't in the script. Sorry - I couldn't help but rely on you!
You're doing great work. Once this case is wrapped up, let me treat you to dinner. This is a personal invitation and not from the team, I'll have you know.
Are you telling me... this wasn't the first crime scene?! Ahem. How was that one, Commander? Hmm, you think I should be more confident like I always am? Okay, I'll give it a try!
Oh? Is there a problem with how my outfit's fitting? You're free to help me adjust it.
We're on camera, Commander. Are you really so impatient?
This is a big case, and time is running out. Let's get to work, advisor.
Advisor, our fieldwork is about done for the day. Let's give it a rest... Hey, you free later?
Commander, don't you think that jump I pulled off was just perfect? I put hours of practice into it! Phew... But now I'm tired... Pass me the water, would you?
Practicing that last jump has me exhausted... Say, how about you massage my thighs for me? Yeah, just like that... Aw, you can go higher if you want, you know.
Battleship - Monarch.
I am the battleship named Monarch, one of the rejected King George V-class designs. Hmph, though I was once forgotten, now I live and breathe...
We meet for the first time. I am the battleship Monarch. Hmph, once I was discarded, but now I am needed; how ironic... Is this how low the Royal Navy has sunk?
Splendid; you're back. I, Monarch, am superior to the likes of Wales and York. Wouldn't you agree, Commander?
You are the one and only being who matters to me... Until I met you, there was nary a single soul who believed in me.
Wales and York... I despise them for bereaving me of my existence, but I cannot resent them for succeeding me.
A younger sister? If I have one, her name would be... Prince of Wales... That has a rather nice ring to it.
I will make the world understand how foolish it was not to choose me.
Is my presence needed, Commander?
Do not fall victim to those degenerate habits of theirs.
Let me handle this mission. I shall prove my excellence!
For as long as I exist, it isn't over. I am excellence itself, therefore I must exist.
You've received mail regarding the war. You would do best to check it.
That was a marvellous welcome. Hmph, were I the only one returning, would anyone welcome me at all...?
I wonder what efforts it took to materialise me... Hmph, regardless, I will see to it they are repaid in double.
Hmph, sure enough, I am the most excellent of the King George V class.
Depend on me! I will make sure this fleet returns home without as much as a scratch!
Heed my words: depend on me! I will always win!
Am I... being discarded yet again?
Not even the Queen's orders can subdue me!
If Wales were me, she would probably have sunk long ago.
Are you saying that I am inferior to them?!
I only survived in that dark world by believing that I am excellence itself, and thus irreplaceable...
Love needs no repayment. No matter how much the Royal Family neglects me, my loyalty to them is unwavering.
So, they can still laugh together... Perhaps I wasn't discarded for nought, then... I have never felt this way before.
Commander, to me, you are the most special, most dear person in existence. You always have, and always will be...
Even if the world no longer needs me, you will always need me. That is more than enough for me... Hahah, perhaps I was materialised with the sole purpose of meeting you. Even if so... I am happy.
A wonderful gift this is!
I am George, Elizabeth, and Edward... but I will never be "Wales"!
In another world, perhaps I would've been your real big sister.

ex.line: Splendid; you're back. Are you going to hunker down, or take a breather? Whichever the case, I will do the same.
You brought meaning to my existence. As a token of my gratitude, I will forever bring you victory.
It will take time to accustom myself to being wed, but as long as you're here, I will never doubt or feel lost.
It's as I feared. Being alone has become unbearable to me. I blame you for this. For... changing me for the better.
Commander, I am glad to serve you.
Mgh... Give me a moment. I need time to... accustom myself.
You've returned. Unscathed, no less. I'm certain you'll welcome me back with those same words, even should I return alone. Truly, that is a comforting sensation.
Behold, Commander! This victory I'll dedicate to you!
See that? I will never let you down.

Never would I have imagined this - that one day I, a loner with no one relying on her, would be mulling over my future together with you. Thank you, for accepting me and giving meaning to my life. You are my greatest love.

lines.line: Hmph. One's outfit is merely superficial. True nobility must come from within. Don't you agree, Commander?
Hmph. One's outfit is merely superficial. True nobility must come from within. Don't you agree, Commander?
Don't just stand there gawking, Commander. There remains much to be done today.
Stand up straight and puff out your chest, Commander. You're the only one I deign to— You're not sure where to look? Well, why not look me in the eyes then?
Shall I teach you the Royal Navy's courtly dances?
Such splendid dress is normally reserved for special occasions. But for me, every day I exist is a day to be celebrated.
You like this dress, do you? Hmph, I see you've learned the art of empty flattery from Wales. But nonetheless... thank you...
I admire your bravery. Now would you rather I stab or trample you? Or would you prefer to taste a volley from my guns?
Allow me to demonstrate the elegance with which a lady of the Royal Navy comports herself.

So, an Eastern outfit this time... Hmph. My nobility is evident regardless of what I wear. However, since you prepared this outfit especially for me, it would be unbecoming of me to not express my gratitude. Thank you.

So, an Eastern outfit this time... Hmph. My nobility is evident regardless of what I wear. However, since you prepared this outfit especially for me, it would be unbecoming of me to not express my gratitude. Thank you.
This festival comes but once a year. I shan't let you waste it working yourself to death. Come, let me handle that. The fleet will survive you taking a break.
"Paint our jubilant memories of this festival into history"? Hmph, she's as grandiloquent as ever, isn't she?
Tsk, Wales, must you always pester me with this Dragon Empery chinoiserie? I'll learn about their customs myself, without you.
A New Year's wish? Naturally, I wish to prove you were right to choose me. That isn't going to change.
Though I am a proud lady of the Royal Navy, I find myself deeply moved to have this chance to experience a festival from an exotic culture.
You desire my company? You should have said so.
Have you been afflicted with Wales's vile proclivities? Commander?

This common thief - calls herself "PhantoM" - is running circles around the Metropolitan Police. Now they've come to me for help... Bet they never thought this day would come when they demoted me to the sticks. On the bright side, we get to detect side by side again.

This common thief - calls herself "PhantoM" - is running circles around the Metropolitan Police. Now they've come to me for help... Bet they never thought this day would come when they demoted me to the sticks. On the bright side, we get to detect side by side again.
You've returned. I've organised your paperwork and written up the case in general and in detail. Heh... Now it is time to prove how much better we are than them.

You want to showcase our bond as partners and deliver a performance as realistic as possible, and so you'll keep your script hidden from me? ...Sounds like you're really enjoying this. Very well, I'll try to live up to your expectations.
This city has changed so much I don't recognise it anymore... Hmph, it's no wonder why PhantoM is so drawn to it. It's a bloody mess.
Buddy, it's time to go! To PhantoM's target! I've sent instructions to the task force already. That sodding thief isn't getting away this time!
PhantoM always knows where the force sets up traps for her... Hmph. There has to be a conspirator in our midst. Partner, who do you think it is?
I'll catch this PhantoM bastard even if it's the last thing I do. Then the whole force will see that I am the most excellent detective!
Is... this some new city etiquette I missed the memo on?
Hm? Have you found a new clue? ...No? You were just staring at me? Then why do you hesitate, my friend?
You've picked up some bad habits while I was gone. But fine, I'll turn a blind eye this one time. Only because we're partners.
Did PhantoM send you a new calling card? Read it at once.
Didn't think you'd be back so soon. Hm? What's this? You've pieced together all the clues in all the case files thus far? Bloody good job. This is why I say you're my most trusted partner.
Drop your weapons! Stop resisting!
Bugger, I blew it... I'm going to hate writing this apology.
There's nowhere left to run!
"Stay with me, my partner. There's no one else like you in the world... "That line wasn't in the script"? You're right, it's not. I added it just now.
Whew... Surely now one can argue that I'm "enjoying the beach," yes? ...Still not enough? I am laying my exposed self bare before you - what more is there I need to do?
Whew... Surely now one can argue that I'm "enjoying the beach," yes? ...Still not enough? I am laying my exposed self bare before you - what more is there I need to do?
While clothes are just a flourish, we are told to dress appropriately back home... I'd love to hear a reason for why I must wear this.

I look forward to the closing bonfire party George and the others are preparing. Will you be there, Commander? Ah, no, of course you will. They would not be making such grand preparations if you weren't coming.
I know everyone enjoys the beach in their own way, but how do you typically do it? I can't imagine you always sit and stare at people like this...
You say I take competitions all too seriously, even informal games between friends? I hate to admit it, but... you're right.
The sunshine is getting stronger. Whew... Are you alright, Commander? Should I bring you a cold beverage?
Suntan lotion? Oh, right. Appreciated...
Is it the beach you're enjoying, or is it me you're... No, forget it.
This is no time to fuss over being the most excellent. Complete your missions so we may enjoy the beach.
Mission rewards have arrived. Now we can all better enjoy the beach, can we not?
You've returned. Have you enjoyed the beach to its fullest? ...Me? I've done more than just sit here and wait for you. I think so, at least...
We must congratulate the team's efforts, regardless of how the commission went... Yes, I understand.
I shall demonstrate how a monarch enjoys the beach!
Relishing the beach and victory - that is how I celebrate my holiday with you. Hmph.

Though I may forget my duty momentarily, you have not changed in my eyes. You accepted me, guided me, and taught me how to enjoy everyday life... Hm? You've yet to teach me all the ways to have fun? Ugh - that is an unnecessary addition!
Heavy cruiser - Ibuki.

Milord, are you interested in me...? Mm... this Ibuki, who was never born, and has no history or accomplishments to speak of... Um, my hobby is poetry, and I'm skilled in swordsmanship! Are you satisfied with that? Um, also, I'm not very good around people...
Was it your voice that beckoned me from my timeless slumber? This lowly Ibuki, though still in training, shall be yours to use as you see fit.
Milord, you must be tired.
Milord, w-welcome... I wasn't able to prepare much for your arrival... but would you like some tea?
Spending time alone with Milord... somehow... makes my heart pound...
Milord, if you have no further orders for me, may I go over there to meditate?
In order to hone my swordsmanship, I practice my strokes a thousand times every day... Don't worry, Milord, I already finished while you were gone.
You'd like me to put on a show? S-Sorry... in front of other people... I can't...
Clear the mind, and purify the six roots... Eek! Mi, Milord...
We seem to have new missions. Would you like Ibuki to accompany you?
Milord, there's a big pile of stuff over there... Um, are those the rewards then?
Milord, your mail... Huh? You'd like me to read it? B-but that's embarrassing...
Milord, if you are ever injured, please allow Ibuki to treat you with this mugwort liniment. There's still a lot left.
Milord, the comm... Um, whatever these are called. Yes, they're done now.
Is this... the sensation of getting stronger? Thank you!
The battlefield is callous... Ibuki, advancing!
My skills are but party tricks, unworthy of such praise.
Ugh... I must increase my training multifold.
The pinnacle of Ibuki... resides in this single strike!
A fight with our backs to the wall? ... Exactly what I wanted!
Had I known I would have to serve a person like you, I never would have manifested during this era...
I would also enjoy a life of sitting atop the mountains, watching the clouds pass through the sky. But my current life here isn't so bad either.
I'm cool, you say...? If anything, I am somewhat jealous of how everyone can always have a smile on their faces... In contrast, I simply do not know how to express my emotions...
After spending a lot of time with everyone else, I've experienced firsthand how difficult it can be to express my emotions clearly... such as joy... and love...
The mugwort on Mount Ibuki is said to symbolize love that burns quietly... F-For example, right now, Milord... can you feel Ibuki's heart?
I never knew that having my feelings be reciprocated could be so overwhelmingly joyful... Milord, p-please don't look at me... I'm so happy that... my face must look strange...
Thank you, Milord. I'll treasure this.
Feeble though I may be... I shall give this my all!

ex.line: Welcome back, Milord. We were only away for half a day, but it felt so much longer...
Milord, would you like to relax with a cup of tea? May I... spend the day by your side?
Today, I bought some of the sweets that are most trendy... Would you like to have some with me, Milord?
Are you tired, Milord? You see, I have practiced new massage techniques... Inexperienced though I may be, allow your humble Ibuki to heal you.
With each day, I temper the blade with which I protect you, and the heart that yearns for you. Always, and forever...
...This is about you, Milord. I will be... fine.
Milord... Can you feel my heart racing? This isn't from nerves, but, hmm... It's because... I am with you...
'Tis not fair, Milord... You know I cannot say no to you...
Welcome back, Milord! Allow me to check that you are unharmed... Ah, my apologies! Ibuki was simply concerned for you...
This power... It shall become a blade with which to protect you, Milord.

Milord, you light up my world, once comprised of only swordsmanship and poetry. Made it warmer and more vibrant than ever before. I will devote my body, my heart, my everything to you... Milord, please... Embrace me, tightly...

lines.line: Milord, it's starting to snow... If it suits you, please take shelter under Ibuki's umbrella.
Milord, it's starting to snow... If it suits you, please take shelter under Ibuki's umbrella.
Milord, shall we go outside together?
I'll have to thank Houshou for this lovely kimono...
Achoo! ...I'm cute when I sneeze? D- don't make fun of me...
This is... real snow... beautiful...
Aren't there some big festivals in the wintertime? I guess you could say... I'm a little interested... only a little!
Is there someplace you'd like to go, Milord? Of course I'll accompany you.
Um, Milord, your hands are cold...
The snow is coming down outside... Milord, let me get an extra sweater for you.
The winter in my timeless slumber was silent and cold. But here, at Milord's side, I feel only warmth... Milord, would you... take my hand?
This is my first time wearing Western clothes... Um, Milord! Does this outfit... suit Ibuki well...?
This is my first time wearing Western clothes... Um, Milord! Does this outfit... suit Ibuki well...?
I am unsure how I should conduct myself at a "banquet..." Milord, may I just follow you?
These foreign beverages and teas have quite a distinctive flavor...
There are so many things at this banquet that I simply do not understand... Ah, please don't get the wrong idea... I merely realized that there is much for me to learn still.
Actually, it was Miss Seattle who invited me here... She's quite a charismatic person.
Though I prefer my outings to be a bit more... introspective, I don't mind the camaraderie and joyfulness here.
Milord, it feels nice when the wind gently strokes my cheeks.
D-do these clothes not suit me after all?
Milord, please try this cake. It's fluffy, sweet, and delicious.
The Dragon Empery's "Spring Festival" is... filled with fun, liveliness, and pure jubilation. I can feel my true feelings welling up... Maybe, an environment like this would suit me pretty well...
The Dragon Empery's "Spring Festival" is... filled with fun, liveliness, and pure jubilation. I can feel my true feelings welling up... Maybe, an environment like this would suit me pretty well...
The warm glow of the lanterns and the vivid, red decorations... it's all so beautiful...
Hmm, I'm a lot more outgoing than usual? Maybe the festive atmosphere is rubbing off on me. Milord, do you think... I'm acting strange...?
Milord, Ibuki will be performing a sword dance at the Spring Festival banquet tonight... Um, it's my first time performing in front of everyone, so I'm a bit nervous...
Milord, Miss Akashi seems to be selling firecrackers. I heard they are a bit like fireworks... Huh? They are firecrackers, right?
Milord, those things hanging on the walls are "fai chun," right? I see, there's something written in them... I wonder what it means...
Around this time, the cold begins to recede. Soon, spring shall arrive... I see, so this is why people hang "fai chun" on the walls...
I'm glad you've returned, Milord. I've changed my attire in order to better carry out your order-for us to "relax together." Now then... could you please instruct me on how to proceed?
I'm glad you've returned, Milord. I've changed my attire in order to better carry out your order-for us to "relax together." Now then... could you please instruct me on how to proceed?
*Yaaawn*... Milord, please relax and make yourself at home.
Milord, is the tea I prepared to your liking?
Milord, I shall now continue my meditation... Oh, y-you'd like to talk to me?
Milord, could you please arrange some work for me? I'm... feeling a little fidgety...
Milord...?
Milord, what would you have me do...?
Milord?! H-have I done something to displease you...?
Milord, you have new mail. Um... Shall I read it aloud for you?
Milord, I'll protect you!
Milord, I've prepared your tea. Phew... Even though we're spending all this time together doing nothing, I... still feel fulfilled. Mm, this overflowing emotion... Milord, is this what "love" is...?

Thank you for accepting my invitation... The sea breeze blows pleasantly here, but if it's still too hot for you, allow Ibuki to present you with some cold ramune... Milord, if you would like some... Wh-what's drawn in the sand behind me? I-it's nothing...!

Thank you for accepting my invitation... The sea breeze blows pleasantly here, but if it's still too hot for you, allow Ibuki to present you with some cold ramune... Milord, if you would like some... Wh-what's drawn in the sand behind me? I-it's nothing...!
Milord, you're here. The sun feels quite pleasant... Shall we take a walk along the shore... Watching the rolling waves?
Admittedly, it is quite easy to move around in this swimsuit... Eh? What did I draw in the sand...? Oh, why would you ask me when you already know... Aah...
The briny smell of the breeze is a world of difference from the crisp winds of the mountains... But any scent is soothing with you by my side, Milord.
Shall we take a walk by the beach, Milord? There is something... quite important Ibuki wishes to tell you...
Milord, burying your feet in the warm sand feels quite good. Would you, hm... like to try it with me?
Huh? The sea breeze is... messing up my hair?
Here, Milord, have some ramune. It is your favorite flavor.
Eek?! M-Milord, umm... there are no rocks to hide us here...
Welcome back, Milord. Would you like some cold ramune to relax with?
The waves may wash away what I drew in the sand, but it matters not. My feelings for you will last for as long as the sea breeze blows. Ibuki's place is forever by your side, Commander...
Battleship - Izumo.

I'm battleship Izumo, of the Sakura Empire. I existed as a proposed Yamato-class design, although they didn't construct me... But if you look down me even slightly then prepare to taste one of my main cannon volleys.
Battleship Izumo, reporting in. Are you the Commander? Sure don't look very reliable... Listen here: do anything to slow me down, and you won't hear the end of it!
Late, as always. Just how long will you keep me waiting?
If you've got time to stare at me then maybe do your work instead.
A blade requires careful maintenance. Isn't that obvious?
Sisters... eh. The Izumo class consists of just me, so I guess I'm a bit jealous.
Become stronger, Commander. Once you become strong enough to protect everyone... Once that happens, I...
Commander, you don't have the free time to endlessly chat with me.
... I-I'll slice your hand off!
What are you planning to do about these unfinished missions?
Mission complete... Good lord, would you ever have realized it on your own?
Here's a letter. It's rude to the sender to not read their letter thoroughly. Don't you agree?
Look who's back. Time's precious, so start reflecting on your last sortie immediately.
Commission complete. Why don't you go on one yourself, sometime?
My blade grows sharper.
All ships, form up! Target: enemies in front!
Victory? Of course we won!
Damn... I can... still fight...!
Feel the wrath of my blade!
P-put out the fire...!
You lack what it takes to order me to swing this blade.
This blade is my other half. Casually touch it, and you'll get hurt.
*Sigh*... Why do you always make that miserable face, Commander? It's so miserable that... it makes me want to scold you...
Hey, you've started getting just a bit into shape recently... Hmph, I suppose I'll acknowledge you've worked hard.
The path of my blade is one of constant solitude... or so I thought. Hmph, maybe being with you... isn't so bad after all.

You're making that miserable face again. I just can't leave you be, huh... Listen, today is the day I will acknowledge your hard work... or, should I say, your talent! I, battleship Izumo, swear on my blade to walk with you, both in life and death.
You really did your homework. Thank you.
You'd like to see my classical dance? Your tastes are quite refined, Commander... In that case, I'll show you the finest performance in the land!
You'd like to see my classical dance? Your tastes are quite refined, Commander... In that case, I'll show you the finest performance in the land!
My name has connections to classical dancing...? I-I see...
Dancing and my sword are much alike. Untold hours of learning and practice are for a single moment of brilliance...
Commander, if I really captivate you so... will you be able to finish your work?
Savory delicacies and mature festivities... I say why not enjoy the New Year and let loose for once? Hahahah!
... Drunk? Me? I've only had a few... *Hick*
Commander, are you insinuating you want a swift kick?
I'll remind ya, in case ya forgot...! I'm the battleship Izumo!
How stunning; how gorgeous - to my eyes, the sight of this battlefield is worth ten thousand ryo.
Finally realized I'm the bartender here? This isn't any ordinary wine, you know. Give it a try, if you're interested. Heheheh...
Finally realized I'm the bartender here? This isn't any ordinary wine, you know. Give it a try, if you're interested. Heheheh...
I'm good at more than just bartending, you know. Why don't I join you for a round of drinks? ...Worried I'll get drunk? This isn't even enough wine to get me tipsy!
This stuff is stronger than I thought... Huh? Commander?! N-no, I'm not drunk! You're just imagining things!
How can I drink the Commander under the table... If I keep this up, I'm done for...
Huh... Commander! How'd you get tied up in my tail?! Wait, why are you giving it free rein to do as it likes?!
...Did that one taste a little different? The secret is in the hole at the end of my tail. Open up, and I might just let you get a taste of the secret ingredient.
Mm... Oddly soothing...
*sigh*... That's good drinkin'... Nnh... Zzz...
I'm still not drunk yet... You'll rue this day... I-I mean, no! I'll get you back right now...!
Oh, you're back. Let's get back to our drinking contest, then. Get ready - I can hold my drink better than anyone.
The red liquid dripping from my tail isn't just for cocktails, you know. Who knows how you might change if you drank it directly? Heh... Interested? So am I. Go on, Commander... Give it a try.
Heavy cruiser - Roon.

I am Roon, the Iron Blood cruiser. In a far-off world, I never existed beyond the drawing board... But that aside, I've seen it, Commander... Deep within your heart, there's something that resembles me...
I never thought I'd end up here... Hello, I am Roon. I don't know this place very well, so could I ask you to give me a tour?
This place is so peaceful. Everyone's so nice, too...
Commander, do you have any interests outside of work? If you're okay with it, why don't we relax together?
Every time I see something beautiful get squashed on the battlefield, I just... Aahhh...
I want to do something to soothe your mind. But... what should I do...
What my hobby is? Perhaps something like "granting sweet release"?
Please open your mouth, Commander... *Giggle*, do you like it? Have I gotten better at cooking?
Hm? Do you want a hug, too? Okay~
What might this next mission be? I'm getting a little excited.
Let's give our all on the next mission, too.
It's not any bad news, is it?
I want to pummel some enemies, too~ *Giggle*... The more of them you sink, the more you prove your worth, after all~
Those commission girls must work really hard... Okay, everyone line up~ I'm going to give each of you a hug~
Thank you for that, Commander.
*Giggle*... You saw me, and now you're trying to flee...? Do you really think you can flee from ME?!
Not only did you not sink yourselves upon seeing me, you even forced me to sink you myself... YOU WILL PAY!
Aww... Did we fall prey to an ambush...?
Don't…look down on me!!
You dare hurt me...? YOU WILL PAY!
Commander... YOU WILL PAY!
How I'm faring at the base? Perfectly fine. Although... isn't it a little too peaceful here...?
It is our destiny to kill one another on the battlefield... So, wouldn't you say it's normal to revel in the killing just a little bit?
Ahhh... The feeling of tearing apart enemies with gunfire... and breaking them into a million little pieces... I can't get enough of it... You know how I feel, don't you, Commander?
*Giggle*, I get more fulfillment from being with you than from killing enemies on the battlefield... Is this the power of love? But then...

Thank you so much. But listen, I finally understand now. What filled the void in my heart wasn't slaughter on the battlefield or love, it was the hatred known as "envy"... Commander, I love you just as much as I deeply, deeply, DEEPLY hate those other girls... THEY WILL PAY!
Thank you very much. I like it a lot.
Such a delightful party with our wonderful friends in this peaceful harbor... It's wonderful, really... But, it's all so boring...
Such a delightful party with our wonderful friends in this peaceful harbor... It's wonderful, really... But, it's all so boring...
Hah hah... it's not often we have a party. Let's enjoy ourselves, Commander.
Did my dress catch your attention, Commander? ... But when I think about you looking at the other girls' dresses, I just...
When you see something so perfect and beautiful, don't you just feel the urge to... crush it?
Commander, I picked out this dress specifically for the occasion. Don't you feel like it... completes you?
All this merriment is making me nauseous... Commander, can you let me sortie when we get back?
Are you having a good time, Commander? ... Me? Oh I'm just happy to see you~
Commander... I think you can get closer than that...
You're just in time, I needed to blow off a little steam!
Hehehe... That was another lovely "banquet."
It's so nice getting away from the bustling party hall and being alone with you, Commander. I'm eager to see what we'll do now as your idea of a... "break"~
It's so nice getting away from the bustling party hall and being alone with you, Commander. I'm eager to see what we'll do now as your idea of a... "break"~
Good timing, actually - the party was starting to bore me. Thanks for pulling me out, Commander~
Mainz's favorite coffee is a nice party drink, though I think I still prefer Iron Blood beer. What do you prefer, Commander?
While I like vistas as much as the next person, I'm awfully fed up with the port's scenery at this point. Battlefields differ in that regard... Ahh... I'll never tire of seeing them.
Heehee~ Don't you worry, I'm not going anywhere. Why would I, when it's you who brought me here?
Since we have access to a piano, could you help me work on my singing? I'm starting to feel restless from sitting around for too long... Heehee~
Oh, you're back already? Then please, come here and let your heart be soothed♪
Go on - we're all alone here~♥
Welcome back! Let's give you a nice, waaarm hug♪
I can see the commission team all the way from up here. Well? Are you heading out to greet them?
How DARE you ruin my special moment with the Commander!
Heehee... Now that's what I'd call a good "break"~

Ah, so this is what you meant by "a break." It certainly is a cure for boredom, and I am happy to have some alone time with you, buuut... (I know you're trying to keep me in check, and you're going to pay for that♥)

Good evening, Commander. Here, let me give you a late-night hug~ You want to know why my swimsuit's in tatters? Heehee, I ran into an unruly little shark when I went out to get food. To think it tried to resist ending up as my meal... It's going to pay!

Good evening, Commander. Here, let me give you a late-night hug~ You want to know why my swimsuit's in tatters? Heehee, I ran into an unruly little shark when I went out to get food. To think it tried to resist ending up as my meal... It's going to pay!
You must be exhausted from playing with everyone during the day, Commander. Heehee, just leave your evening relaxation to me.
My swimsuit? Well, I thought you might like it if I tore it up a little, Commander. What do you think? Doesn't it suit me... just as much?
Ahhh, there's nothing like a sharp blade drawing a slit into flesh... Filleting fish is a nice change of pace, you know. Would you like to join me next time, Commander?
You were worried about me? I'm completely fine. I can down a battleship with a single punch, so all I need to do is flail around a bit to make a shark yield.

Letting the sea's nightly breeze caress you as you lie in a soft bed and drift into a peaceful slumber... It would be a bit too peaceful and boring to do every evening, but it's nice and refreshing once in a while. Hehe...
You're going to hug ME, Commander? Go right ahead. Nice and tight~
Want to tear it up some more? Go ahead~
There, there... Excellent job on that sortie. Phew. If you're feeling a bit more rested now, how about a light snack? This is my homemade cooking. I used the freshest ingredients.
Looks like the commission team is back. Heehee, is there something you were hoping for from me, Commander?
Shall we pick up some ingredients for a late-night snack while we're here?
Commander... don't tell me you wanted to see me defeated?
Phew... It's late, but I'm feeling kind of restless. While I think we should get to bed, I could go for one last round of stress relief♪ You will join me, won't you, Commander?
Commander? You've not only filled the void in my heart, but also wholly embraced my fervid feelings... Ah, you really make me want to do things... Unforgivable things, like opening my heart for you.
Commander? You've not only filled the void in my heart, but also wholly embraced my fervid feelings... Ah, you really make me want to do things... Unforgivable things, like opening my heart for you.
A quiet moment, you say? While it may be that way to you, my head and heart are beating so hard it's bringing my sanity to the brink.

Jealous? Well, you and I have already sworn an oath, so I don't see any need to care about anyone else. Say, Commander, why would you ask that? Why would you bring up other girls? You'll pay for that!
When you hold me tightly like this, it makes me feel... a tremendous surge of "love."

While the port can sometimes be boring, what with how tranquil it is, I'll still never tire of any place where I can always be with you. Whether it's me making a total mess of you, or you making a total mess of me... Ahh...
Has anything been troubling you lately? I'm always here to listen. If anyone - no matter who - hassles you, I will tear into them, rip them apart, and grind them into a paste with my own two hands♪
It's so exciting when you do this - touching me without being prompted to♪
The urge to ruin something for being beautiful... Heehee. You're just like me, Commander♥
Missions? I'll help you with them, just please be sure to have a reward ready for me at the end.
Mission complete... Ah! Heehee, my, I wasn't expecting this hug. Thank you for the reward.
Time for a welcome back hug, Commander! I can't believe you left me behind while you went out on a sortie... What do you have to say for yourself?
Seems the commission team is back. Let's go say hello to them... and get some fresh air while we're at it♪
Mmh! Now that was refreshing. Thank you, Commander♪

Impetus and nihility, love and hatred, a surge of desire from the heart - you'd never be the same if you accepted my all, Commander... That's fine by you, you say? I can't believe how kind you are... Heehee. You may think it's fine to wish for that, but to me... Yes, to me, that's beyond unforgivable.
Heavy cruiser - Saint Louis.

Because ruination befell my homeland, I was returned to nothingness before I was born. As I am now, I am but an illusion, a manifestation of an ideal. But as long as you continue to lead my way, I shall in return clear all obstacles standing before yours.

It is an honor to meet you at last - my prophet, my leader. I am Saint Louis, brought to your side by God's will. As long as it is justice that guides your hand, then this humble spear shall be yours to wield.
Bonjour, Commander. Please instruct me, what should we do next?
Commander, have you come here to offer your prayers to God?
Commander, your time should not be squandered here. Leave the chores to me.
If there are any disputes within our ranks, allow me to handle the arbitration. That is my specialty.
Just winning the battle alone is enough to satisfy me, but you, Commander, ought to look far beyond that.
Commander, I do not think this can be considered appropriate conduct...
I fight so that there may be peace. That is the single role that I can play.
Commander, your self-respect...
Commander, it may not be the will of God, but you do have new missions issued from headquarters.
While rewards may certainly be nice... I have no interest in them.
Commander, does it not matter if these letters remain unopened?
Suffering is the brand of a warrior. Everyone, I'm proud of you for making it through.
Commander, my sisters in arms have returned from their commission.
For the sake of the role that we all must play...
You shall all be purged equally!
Ashes to ashes, dust to dust...
My Lord, why have you abandoned me...
God's love is boundless.
This too... is God's trial...!
My sisters in arms here may be righteous, but not you. Prepare to face divine punishment, sinner.
So this is the land that I was promised... Tell me, will this place be Sodom, or Canaan?
I see my sisters in arms smile every day as if without a worry in the world. Perhaps this is their Canaan...

I feel like I have earned the acceptance of the fleet. However, is this truly the land that I was promised? ... No, I do not mean to cast doubt upon anyone. I merely feel that... I may yet have a deeper purpose.
I finally understand now, Commander. What I experience now is the same as my sisters in arms - nay, perhaps even more fulfilling. Being a part of this fleet, by your side... is truly my Canaan.

This I do swear. Your joy is my will, your victory is my glory, and the place that I can call home, is by your side... Blessed be the Lord who has brought me together with you - my commander, my love, and... my light.
Thank you.

ex.line: My sense of duty strengthens whenever you turn to look at me. I hope you will allow me to join you for your plans today.
How about a short break? This place is enveloped by a peacefulness that allows the mind to settle... It is perfect for us to spend some quiet time.
This quiet is unlike that before a battle. Instead, I am reminded of the weight of our vow. But it is far from a burden. It is a comforting weight.
What am I reading? Ah, it is a book on gardening... I was considering planting some irises on the veranda.
I thought the path I walked would lead me to countless battles, and yet here I am enjoying this peace with you... Oh, what a wonderful reward. It is far more sacred than any victory.
Your hand is enough to quell the turbulence of my heart. Can I ask you to stay like that a while longer?
Your touch reassures me more than any prayer.
Ahem. We cannot let the others witness this...
I have checked all the rewards. They are useless as far as I am concerned, but I'm happy to see they bring such a contented smile to your face.
The safety of my sisters in arms delights me more than any victory... and your safety, Commander, even more so.
I shall use this power to defend our vow.
The days I spend with you bring me a satisfaction and a happiness that I have never known before. This... is likely the home that I have been searching for.

lines.line: With all due respect, Commander, this finery and this throne are not fit for one such as myself. Despite the hallowed name I have inherited, I am nothing more than a warrior. —However, if such an arrangement pleases you, then I shall hold my objections.

With all due respect, Commander, this finery and this throne are not fit for one such as myself. Despite the hallowed name I have inherited, I am nothing more than a warrior. —However, if such an arrangement pleases you, then I shall hold my objections.
Commander, making me sit up here waiting for you by myself is a tribulation in its own right.
I have no serious objections to sitting up here, but... there is one thing I cannot figure out. Are you perhaps deriving pleasure from seeing me up here like this?
So I've managed to capture your gaze? Your eyes are... Nevermind, it doesn't bother me.
My arbitration is needed? ...Very well, please excuse me for a moment. I will make sure to hear them out.
As the one guiding this fleet forward... Commander, you are the one best suited to this throne.
My weapon is always within reach. Should you will it, I am ready to sortie at any time.
I would much rather wield my spear upon the seas of battle than sit up here like a statue, Commander.

As a servant of God, there is no need for vanity— Having that said, as the recipient of your love, you are free to make any arrangements that please you. After all, great and permissive is God's love.

Commander, regarding your next appointment... Ah, hard work is one of the highest virtues of the Iris's holy knights. On weekdays or vacations, in knights' armor or the Dragon Empery's attire, there can be no pause to my prayer, my training, or my duties as the administrator of your will.

Commander, regarding your next appointment... Ah, hard work is one of the highest virtues of the Iris's holy knights. On weekdays or vacations, in knights' armor or the Dragon Empery's attire, there can be no pause to my prayer, my training, or my duties as the administrator of your will.
Bonjour, Commander. Please determine the duty you would like to fulfill first today.
Let us also give our utmost this coming year, as to not squander the preparations everyone has painstakingly made.
The Dragon Empery's Spring Festival... the celebration of a new year seems quintessential to all. Please rest well after completing your work.
La Galissonnière... seems to be thoroughly enjoying this holiday. Rather, that girl seems to be able to find enjoyment in just about anything. Quite broad-minded of her.
The greatest joy is to be able to have a life of peace. If everyone can act in accordance with God's will, then there would be no need for justicars.
A-ahem!
Here are today's assignments. Let's work together to finish them quickly.
God witnesses all your deeds. The trials you endure today will surely bear fruit in the future.
Commander, our comrades-in-arms have returned from their commission. Let us take over their responsibilities so that they may enjoy the Spring Festival.
Be cleansed in the Iris's light!

...Commander? When did this happen...? Sorry, I must have misjudged my alcohol tolerance. Don't worry, I shall not let my guard down over something like this... Yesh... I have not let my guard down... at all...

...Commander? When did this happen...? Sorry, I must have misjudged my alcohol tolerance. Don't worry, I shall not let my guard down over something like this... Yesh... I have not let my guard down... at all...
Is your glass empty, Commander? Worry not. It seems the alcohol is affecting me somewhat... but I won't forget my duty to pour you another drink.
My body may be disobedient at present, but I still wish to conduct myself properly before you... I-I wonder whether I may be forgiven for lying down in such a manner.

The solemn duties of combat and arbitration must not be carried out with vagueness or deceit. And yet, I find myself less disciplined in your presence, Commander... so much so that I can hear my own heart pound...
I'm sorry, Commander. Forgive me for being unable to drink with you any longer. Freedom must not be an excuse to indulge. I must keep my wits about me in order to protect you.
The lights of this banquet feel much warmer than the flames of the battlefield. You have nothing to fear, Commander. I shall always be able to distinguish your light from any other.
Aaah... Zzz... Mm? Oh, forgive me. It seems I unintentionally let my guard down in your presence.
Commander... it seems I have made a terrible error.
Am I to take it that you're fond of this flavor, Commander?
Welcome back. I'm relieved to see you return unharmed. Thank you for allowing me this rest in your absence. I am now in perfect condition.

Commander, that smile of yours... is a little different than what I usually see. Is it because you saw me in a less disciplined state? How curious that I do not find the current situation to be all that unpleasant...
Light cruiser - Seattle.

Heyoooo! The name's Seattle- Err, I don't technically have a real name, but just call me Seattle! Seriously, don't sweat the small stuff! Anyhow, I was one of the prototypes for the Worcester class, and as an improvement on the Atlanta class, AA is my A-game! Just leave anything with wings to me!
Sup! You the one who woke me up? Alrighty then~ The name's Seattle! Nice meeting you!
You eat yet, Commander? If not, would you like me to whip something up real quick?
I've got a party, tea time, girls meetup, and drinking get-together to attend... Okay! My schedule is PACKED! Guess that's not really a bad thing, though!
Hey, Commander... Isn't it kinda lonely with just one secretary? Whaddya say we liven it up and get some more peeps in here?
You free once you're done with work today, Commander? Listen, I'm throwing a cool party later! You can drop by any time if you want!
I've got zilch combat experience on paper, but with everyone teaching me stuff, I'll catch up in no time!
Commander, you wanna do some dance practice? You'll rise on the girls' popularity lists if you can dance well!
Listen, if you did that on purpose, then consider my gears grinded!
New missions! We need more manpower up in here!
Mission complete! Aren't you gonna celebrate, Commander?
Commander, you've got new mail! Hell, it might be an invite to a party!
Fighting's important and all, but you gotta take regular breaks, Commander!
Yo, commission team's done, Commander. We oughta go give 'em a snack or something!
I feel like I could snipe a mosquito out of the air!
All right, let's gang up on 'em!
Victoryyyy! Let's throw a big party when we get back!
Man, if only we'd brought more firepower~
Let's get some hype up in this place!
C'mon, team, we can do better!
Hm? My party? You're not invited, so be a good commander and get back to work.
Mi amigo, you oughta let up on your jabberwocky mission talky and just live a little sometimes. Listen, I'm throwing a party later, so stop by and have some fun, alright?
I love throwing parties, but I'm not gonna FORCE anyone to show up to 'em. But I guarantee anyone who does show up is gonna have a heckin' good time, even the super-introverts!
Glad you finally understand the magic of parties, Commander! That magic being: you can make friends with anyone if you just hang out with them! As an example: me and you are best buds now!
Hey, we're BFFs, so tell me who's your crush and I'll give you some hot tips~ Heheheh~ ... It's me? Wait, hold up, you serious? Y-y-you really mean it?!

Okay, I'm 100% ready for this! Oh, and needless to say, I love you too, Commander! I wouldn't invite you to go drinking if I didn't~ So, back on topic... There's one more thing we gotta do today besides partying - it's go on a date! Dee-ay-tee-ee!
Ooh~ Thank ya very much!
Hey, you girls wanna come to my party once we're done here?
I wanna know more about these Sakura Empire banquets you throw!

Hey! Great to have you here, Commander! I've gotta ask, whaddya think of my dress? Looking real gorgeous, right? ...Phew, awesome! I was worried my dress didn't look nice and might be dragging down the party mood, that's all!

Hey! Great to have you here, Commander! I've gotta ask, whaddya think of my dress? Looking real gorgeous, right? ...Phew, awesome! I was worried my dress didn't look nice and might be dragging down the party mood, that's all!
Hey! Welcome to my fabulous party, Commander! We're the life of the party tonight, you and I! Well, kinda.
I dig how super-refined I look with this violin! It's not just for show though, I've got a little number for you! Check this out!
What kind of drink do ya want, Georgia? Ah, an Oxycola sour on the rocks? So the usual, then? You got it!
So like, you know parties are a group activity, right? Let's get you away from your drinking-alone corner and out in front of some friends!
I spy with my little eye a few peeps who don't party much... Just gimme a few minutes. I'm gonna go hit 'em up!
What's your poison, Commander? There's always soft drinks if alcohol's outta your league.
Eek! Hey pal, I think you might be a little tipsy there.
Heheh! Let's totally rock this place!

As much as I love me a hype party, I totally get the appeal of the occasional formal banquet like this. This way I can have some alone time with my sweetheart, y'know? Oh man, I'm feeling pretty dang drunk right now... Mmhh, shleepy...
Meeeerry Christmas~! Even though the party is about to start, as you can see, I'm still getting ready~ Just gimme a moment, all righty~?
Meeeerry Christmas~! Even though the party is about to start, as you can see, I'm still getting ready~ Just gimme a moment, all righty~?
Yooo! Awesome! With your help, Commander, we're gonna speed through things twice as fast... no, three times!
I've gotta show everyone who walks through these doors how passionate the Eagle Union is about our Christmas celebrations!
Georgia, the gingerbread you wanted is ready! There's a little surprise waiting for you!
Hmm, let me think, what are we still missing...? Ah! A special Christmas tree that can immediately grab everyone's attention!
The holidays give us all a reason to get together and have a good time. As for me, I'm in charge of providing the best venue for that to happen!
Pass the salt shaker this way! Thanks!
Commander, now's not the time for that!
All righty, that should about do it for the food preparations.
Supportive sorceress Seattle, comin' in hot! So, something got you down, my good pal? I'm up to talk about whatever's on your mind, but in return, you've gotta come to my party tonight!
Supportive sorceress Seattle, comin' in hot! So, something got you down, my good pal? I'm up to talk about whatever's on your mind, but in return, you've gotta come to my party tonight!
You wanna go for a dive too, Commander? Aight, then I'll be your buddy diver!
I've got a game tournament by noon and barbecue in the evening. Having so much on my schedule makes me a happy gal!
Come on, Cheshire! Stop messing around and gimme a hand! You too, Georgia! Chop-chop!
Bremerton's a real cool gal! You should totally hit her up if you need life advice or if you run into trouble at the party!
Boy, I tell ya, I just love the beach! We gotta work extra hard so everyone can have a good time here!
Remember to keep a real tight hold on my hand, Commander!
New missions are in! Maybe this is thanks to that "magic" thingy L'Opiniâtre talked about?
Recreation is important for your well-being, but someone's still gotta watch over everyone!
Got no choice but to resurface, I guess!
Battleship - Georgia.
I am the Eagle Union Battleship Georgia. My main guns are bigger than those of my distant cousins. Yes indeedy, these guns of mine take all the bad guys in front of me... and blast 'em all to hell!
I am Georgia from the Eagle Union. Fear not, for my cannons shall bring victory in your name.
Oh, perfect timing. I just finished warming up. Time to exercise? Or sortie?
It's a good idea to look over your weapons and keep it all working. You want to help?
I have a dream. A dream where the seas are free of the stink of gunpowder, and all the people of the world live in peace.
Cola sure is the best drink, isn't it? Oh, but you can't drink Oxy-cola, Commander...
If I had the chance, I'd love to travel all around the world. The Sakura Empire, the Dragon Empery, the Royal Navy... Hmm, some kind of world tour sounds nice, doesn't it?
GEORGIA BEEAAAAM! ... Just playing around! Hahaha!
Oooh? You find my guns so appealing, Commander? Enjoy them to your heart's content~
Oooh? Hey Commander, did you want me to use you for target practice...?
A mission...? If it's a combat mission, we're good to go. Hahaha!
A job's not done until a report's submitted. Commander, don't forget to double check everything.
Commander, mail here for you. Would it be okay if I kept the stamp?
Yo. Good work out there. Nothing like an ice cold Cola after work, huh?
Commission team's back. Hey, how about we serve them up some Oxy-cola? An officer has to reward her subordinates for a job well done, you know.
You'll see how strong I am next time I fight.
Who am I up against this time? I hope they're up to the task!
No matter how thick the armor... these guns can pierce it!
All we can do... is fall back?
The sound of these massive guns is your funeral march!
Ack... you scratched my armor?! You'll pay for that!
You are unworthy of my power...
Peaches are great. Tasty and nutritious. Want one, Commander?
Sorties and battles really get my blood pumping, but every once in a while it's nice to relax.
Why don't we go on a trip together next time? I think we'd have a lot of fun together.
So we head out from the Eagle Union... Drop in on the Royal Navy and Iris, then head over to the Dragon Empery... Oh! I was just planning our world tour. Don't tell me you can't go?
Ahem... I never thought you'd attack me head on, Commander... Well, I guess I'm glad I get my world tour sooner than I expected. Hahaha!
Is this for me? Then I graciously accept. Haha, you've got great taste!
Oh? Commander, did you need to get some fresh air as well? Me? Ahaha... It's a bit too stiff inside that venue, so I came out for a change of pace. Why don't we take a little stroll together?
Oh? Commander, did you need to get some fresh air as well? Me? Ahaha... It's a bit too stiff inside that venue, so I came out for a change of pace. Why don't we take a little stroll together?
It's so much easier to relax when we're alone... Don't you think, Commander?
My dress? Oh, Seattle helped me with it. We all know I couldn't get it looking like this myself...
Whew, now this is a fine place to enjoy a cola. You want one, Commander? I brought extra.
Don't you have to hurry back to the party, Commander? Lots of girls waiting for you, no?
Don't worry about it, Commander. I love the fleet. I'll head back inside in a bit.
Woah!! That was close... Thanks, Commander. Getting around in high heels isn't exactly my forte.
Commander, the air out here is delightful. Come take a breather.
I love being with you under the moonlight, Commander... Err, not like that. Unless...? I mean, I could maybe mean it like that... Sorry, I'm making it weird... This is so awkward...
Heh heh, the warm sun and the sea breeze really hit the spot, don't they? Alright, let's get out there and enjoy ourselves! That's what you've been waiting for, right, Commander?
Heh heh, the warm sun and the sea breeze really hit the spot, don't they? Alright, let's get out there and enjoy ourselves! That's what you've been waiting for, right, Commander?
Ooh, you're just in time. Commander, mind helping me set up this parasol?
Seattle picked out this lace coverup for me. She's good with this kind of thing...
What do you think of my sunglasses? I dig them, personally. Hahaha!
Nothing beats an ice cold Oxy Cola on a summer day! Here, take one, Commander... Oh right, you can't drink these. This one's for you.
We've still got some summer left, so why not try to plan a "Beach World Tour" for us?
Commander, it's really funny watching you try to figure out where it's safe to look. Hahaha!
Ah haah? Commander, you've really gotten into the spirit of the beach now. Maybe I should give you a bit more "stimulation." Like a whooping with this parasol, for instance.
Ooh, nice work on that sortie. Did you want an ice cream? I still have some here.
Happy New Year, Commander! I guess you dress up all flashy like this for the Sakura New Year. Would you escort me...? What are you gawking like that for...? Haha, am I so dazzling? Hahaha!
Happy New Year, Commander! I guess you dress up all flashy like this for the Sakura New Year. Would you escort me...? What are you gawking like that for...? Haha, am I so dazzling? Hahaha!
And just where are you escorting me today? I'm dying to find out.
The Sakura Empire's tea is good stuff! But I still feel like I want an Oxy-cola sometimes... Huh? It wouldn't look right? I can't help it if I want one.
So this "Momotarou" pops out of a peach! What an amazing little guy!
Seattle, I got an invite to this party or something. Any idea for a talent show? It has to be something better than the "Georgia Beam"!
Commander, I just finished my new drink - mixing cola with tea! Come on, try it!
Ready to be a proper escort?
Hey now, you're going to mess up my outfit.
Destroyer - Kitakaze.

Lead ship of the Super Akizuki-class... That is I, Kitakaze. During the war, I was not able to display my prowess upon the battlefield, but it is not too late to do so here. Bear witness to my agility as well as the strengths of my armaments.
Indeed, the preparations are complete... Now that I, Kitakaze, shall be assisting you with your operational command, you can now sleep more soundly at night, Commander. Heheh!
Commander, you’ve come. I am currently training this little one. Indeed, I must teach it to stand like a general.
Those who lead upon the battlefield must also carry their own blade... Worry not, this one is not heavy at all.
My Akizuki-class sisters have always taken good care of me. I, Kitakaze, swear to meet their expectations, and will work hard to protect everyone.
I prefer strategizing and leading from the rear over fighting in the frontlines... B-but I’m perfectly capable of fighting head on.
True power comes from the strength of one’s convictions. It would behoove you to not underestimate my abilities!
Being small has its advantages... Heheh. For example, don’t even try to hit me in a game of dodgeball!
Hmm... The responsibility of cleaning up your conduct weighs heavily upon me, but... please cease your crass behavior.
Shape up, Commander. You can’t afford to just leave these missions sitting there.
Effort is rewarded in kind. Given how hard you’ve worked, Commander, your rewards won’t be disappointing.
Let’s check the mail. I have a feeling that something good has happened...!
Good work, Commander. Please leave the rest of the work to me. I shall not disappoint you.
The commission fleet must have returned with a lot of goodies. Commander, you should take a look.
Even after gaining power, I, Kitakaze, shall keep a clear head.
The enemy’s movements... are clear as day! Everyone, follow me!
A single victory is nothing to be proud of. Let us prepare for the next battle.
Impossible... h-how did I miscalculate...?
My single strike shall seal your fate!
It’s not wise to swim against the current... but we have no choice now!
Commander, if you continue to squander your talents, then one day...
Hmm, you’re curious about the little one...? Very well, perhaps I will give you a demonstration when I get the chance.
My sisters always give me lots of candy whenever they see me. I, I suppose I can share them with you, Commander...
I’m not... good with the dark. I, Kitakaze, shall slowly follow behind you!
*yawn*.... I am getting a bit sleepy... and the Commander probably won’t ignore that... Indeed, the Commander would probably carry me back to bed... My intuition is seldom wrong... Hehe...

My mind is at peace whenever I am by your side, Commander... so can I always keep you company? Can we pinky swear on it then? My sisters told me... that this is enough to form a vow with a person of integrity.
I graciously accept your kind gesture. Don't worry - I'll repay you.
All the preparations are now complete... Commander, let us sally forth and conquer these festival grounds! ...But before that, can we get something to eat first?
All the preparations are now complete... Commander, let us sally forth and conquer these festival grounds! ...But before that, can we get something to eat first?
The little ones are getting restless. Let us make haste, Commander. The festival will not conquer itself.
Takoyaki! Grilled squid! ...Mmm... they even have yakisoba! Commander, help me hold onto some of this... Ah! I want that too!
As long as you predict the movements of the goldfish in advance, there is nothing difficult about this game.
Since it's a holiday, we can afford to take it easy today... But starting tomorrow, we'll have to redouble our efforts! Got it, Commander?
Commander, since you've been kind enough to explore the festival with me, I'll share some of my food with you. Would you like some candied apple? Or how about some taiyaki?
Heheh... Did you want to challenge me at one of these game stalls? Very well, bring it on!
Archery and goldfish scooping... these activities are nothing before my skills. Commander, I'm pretty awesome, aren't I!
Mm, preparations complete. If I keep it up, the production will surely be a great success. The doves have been on their best behavior too. Commander, what do you think about Kitakaze's magic show?
Mm, preparations complete. If I keep it up, the production will surely be a great success. The doves have been on their best behavior too. Commander, what do you think about Kitakaze's magic show?
Commander, you've come at just the right time! Want to help me catch all these doves that are flying around? *sigh*... Why did they decide to act up all of a sudden?
Commander, do you wish to assist me in my disappearing act? I, I do not enjoy being in that dark box, alone...
I am well versed with this magic box! You put a person inside, and then it is totally fine to chop it to pieces! Commander, hop inside and let us give it a try! ...Hm? That's not quite right?
Hanazuki, please select one of these cards... Um, these are just regular poker cards, so there's no need to be so nervous...

Magic tricks with doves are a dime a dozen. I wonder if there's anything else small enough for me to use in my performance... Oh, I got it! Commander, I'm going to see if Suzutsuki will let me borrow Pooky!
Know of any new magic tricks, Commander? Hurry up and tell me!
Wait, hold on! I'm not hiding anything over there! I bet you're doing this on purpose!
If you are getting bored backstage, how about playing a game of pop-up pirate with me? Heh heh, Kitakaze does not intend on losing!
Heheh, behold the elegance with which I run circles around my enemies.
Very well! Let us celebrate by pulling some party poppers!
C-crap... Now everyone will see through my tricks...
Large cruiser - Azuma.

I am Large Cruiser Azuma. I was designed to lead torpedo squadrons into night battles, but I never saw any actual combat. I'm quite good at commanding night battles, but torpedoes are another story... Ahahaha...

Large cruiser, Azuma, reporting for duty. As a special prototype ship, there are many things that I am still unfamiliar with... However, I will lay down my life to protect you, Commander. It would please me greatly if you would place your trust in me. Hehe~
Shall we begin the day's work? Do not worry, I will be right here with you the whole time.
I need more experience if I'm to keep up with the others... So please give me something to do. Hehehe.
This defense power will definitely be useful in battle!
My guns are very precise...? Thank you for saying so. I think it's more the result of training than any natural talent. Hehehe.
Commander, is there something you would like from me?
Oh? You want to touch me? Or would you like me to touch you? You'll have to come out and say it.
Commander? There's a time and a place...
Is it a very difficult mission? I can help.
So many mission rewards... Commander, you're fantastic.
I got the mail. Please look it over.
Welcome home. Commander, I have tea, snacks... and a massage chair here for you. Why not take a load off?
The girls you sent out on commission have returned. Would you like me to inspect the rewards for you? Commander?
Hehe, that's it~
I am to lead the fleet...? I shall not make any promises, but... I will do what I can!
This was the result of everyone's hard work. I was merely part of the team.
We lost... How will I tell the Commander...?
It's now my turn~
A little wound like this, it's nothing...!
Commander, I'm worried about you... You can do better, can't you?
I still have trouble finding my way around... Pardon me, Commander, do you think you could find time to accompany me on my patrols...?
I'd like to get to know the other Sakura girls, and the others besides. What do you think of holding a mixer...? I could provide... the refreshments! Hehehe.
You know what, Commander? The most delightful thing in the world is a happy smile... All the smiles, and of course your smile, Commander, I will protect them all.
Commander, are you tired? Hehehe. Then come here and lie down. Let Azuma clean your ears... Hmm, after a shoulder massage, I think.
Now that I understand your feelings, Commander, I will offer you all that I am, body and soul... Phew... Saying that out loud is as embarrassing as I thought it would be. Hehehe.
Getting such a nice gift from you has put a big smile on my face. Hehehe...
Miss Deutschland, if you wouldn't mind showing a bit of humility...
I still can't compare with you, Kongou.
Kitakaze, don't get lost now, okay?
Commander? Oh, I haven't quite finished changing. My hair still needs work... Sorry, would you mind waiting a bit longer?
Commander? Oh, I haven't quite finished changing. My hair still needs work... Sorry, would you mind waiting a bit longer?
Commander, the Spring Festival is a busy, exciting time. But do take care not to catch a cold when you're out having fun.
E-even if it's for a picture, holding this pose all this time is not easy...
I understand these "Tangyuan" soup balls have some association with "unity" or "gathering" in the language of the Dragon Empery, but if I eat the tangyuan, doesn't that mean I've broken the unity?
Our friends are drawing that "Fu" character everywhere, so I went ahead and tried my hand. I think I did alright... Ahahaha...
Do you need help with the decorations in your office? I'd like to give decorating a try.
Having you here, Commander, makes me feel at ease.
Don't do that! At least, don't do it right now...!
Commander, would you mind giving me a moment of your time? Only for a little bit. I'd just like to know what it feels like to monopolize you for a while... Hehehe, I'm only joking.
Are you tired, Commander? Hehe, with all this carousing it's only natural that you'd get worn out. Now then, rest your head on Azuma's bosom for a while.

Graduation is approaching, and that means it's time for career counseling. Do you want to be a great general who wins with impossible tactics, or a leader beloved by all the port? Which will it be, Commander? Or... Heehee, I already know your plan.

Graduation is approaching, and that means it's time for career counseling. Do you want to be a great general who wins with impossible tactics, or a leader beloved by all the port? Which will it be, Commander? Or... Heehee, I already know your plan.
Have you submitted all of your documents? If anything is missing, I'll help you revise them. Just the two of us...
You want me to try scolding you...? Okay... Ahem. Commander, you've seen something you shouldn't have. Go ahead and fess up - what was it? Oh... Did I misunderstand what you wanted?
I can't imagine you getting tutored. Maybe tutoring others... But I wouldn't be here in that scenario, would I?
You're the reason that the port is so undisciplined, you know. Do you understand that? Heehee!
Here you go... You like getting stepped on a little in your role-play, don't you? Ah, so I still need to improve my skills... Hm? You think I don't need to learn that?
That was a sign that you want to be touched, wasn't it?
Let's see, is there anyone outside... Phew, okay. Come on, Commander~ There's nobody around but us♡
Are you having trouble with your missions? Heehee, don't be shy. Tell me all about it.
Welcome back, Commander. What do you want to do, who do you want to be? Tell me with your words... or your body...
You really are a star pupil, Commander. Heehee!

Hmm... It just feels off to be your guidance counselor. You're our Commander, after all, but maybe if you played a different role... Aha! Heheh, it isn't quite an occupation, but what if you role-played as... my groom?
I must be dreaming, to be able to don this white veil... Haha, though, what's more important is our life together afterwards! Commander, please look forward to the rich fruit of my bridal training~
I must be dreaming, to be able to don this white veil... Haha, though, what's more important is our life together afterwards! Commander, please look forward to the rich fruit of my bridal training~
Welcome back, Commander. Be at ease, for I will always remain by your side~
