I learned some new cooking techniques from Hiei today. Commander, do look forward to tomorrow's lunch. Hehe~
Though I am rather confident about my sturdiness, I'll proceed cautiously so that you won't have to worry about me.
Commander, please have some tea! Haha, this is something I've learned after hours of practice with Kongou~
Please look after me, through both fair weather and harsh storms. I will always remain at your side and heed your every call~
Now then, if you've had your fun, I do believe it's now my turn? Hehe, just kidding~
Commander, you're quite the flirt.... *blushes*
You must be tired from your sortie. Please sit down and allow me to massage your shoulders. Mm, is this pressure to your liking?

For me, happiness means spending our days together, taking each day slowly, one step at a time... Of course I'm quite happy right now~ How about you, Commander? Does having me by your side... make you happy as well?
Battleship - Friedrich der Große.
I am Friedrich der Große, prototype H-class battleship of the Iron Blood Navy. Come, my child... If you are unable to sleep, allow me to play you a lullaby.
You've returned to my side once more, my child. Tell me, what is it that you wish for? Wealth? Glory? Or perhaps eternal youth?
The performers can wait no longer! Hurry, let us raise the curtains of battle!
My child, if you desire absolute victory, you must maintain absolute rationality.
All those emotions that you’ve bottled up through all those conflicts... Listen to my concert, and let it all out.
My appearance upon the battlefield gives off an air of cruelty? Hehe... I’ll take that as a compliment.
Even should you anger me, I’ll forgive you as long as you properly apologize.
Trying to get my attention, my child? Heehee.
If you are ever afraid, come hide behind my back.
Just like a baby... how sweet.
My child, no matter what it is that you desire, I can help you obtain it.
Now then, what kind of reward would you like?
Shall I sing the contents of this message for you?
Welcome back. Whether it’s good news or bad news, I’d be glad to hear you out.
We must properly praise the girls who have returned from their commissions.
I feel as if I can bring out even more beautiful music.
Let us play a requiem! Resound, o hatred, fear, and despair—!
What a pity. The encore had only just begun...
Please await our next performance...
The 9th Symphony... in unison!
I shall persevere yet.
I wonder if you’re properly repenting yet...?
I never should have come to exist in this world... But since I am here, there must be a higher principle behind it...
Things such as courage have no value on the battlefield. Only those who approach Laplace’s demon shall approach victory.
I do prefer this to fighting. Here, my child. Open your mouth~ ahhn~
Please dote upon me more. Yes, more... more...!
From now on, I shall share everything with you - your sorrow, your joy, your pain, and your pleasure. My child, I will always, always welcome you into my embrace...
I like this.
You should let me pamper you once in a while.
Perhaps you're unable to display your full power with me in charge?

ex.line: Let's begin the prelude to this new day together.
In great music, logic and passion must complement one another... Which part do you prefer, my sweet child?
Be more self-indulgent with me, if you'd like. I save rage for my enemies alone.
Wealth and youth are both enticing, yes, but they are both fleeting, if elegant, illusions... My child, you are my one and only priceless treasure.
What troubles you, my child? Do you need some love?
Heehee... You're getting better at this. You pluck exactly the right strings to bring me pleasure...
Flowers, music, and an embrace... Does this triumph satisfy you, my child?
Is this enough to satisfy you? Heehee, I thought not... Share with me all of your little whims and desires. My bosom welcomes all of them...

lines.line: I see, so this is a "kimono" from the Sakura Empire. Exquisitely crafted, comfortable to the touch, and elegantly designed... How to wear it? ...My child, what are you talking about?
I see, so this is a "kimono" from the Sakura Empire. Exquisitely crafted, comfortable to the touch, and elegantly designed... How to wear it? ...My child, what are you talking about?
Aren't you cold standing over there? Come to me, my child.
Mankind's ambitions know no limits. Indeed, just like these riggings of mine... they strive to expand, to become more powerful... to command more cannons, and to seize greater glory...
Sakura Empire's classical "gagaku" is said to elicit profound and mysterious emotions... I'm quite curious about it.
The release of repressed emotions can be both medicine and poison. The effect depends on how well you can control your state of being.
My child, could you help me with putting on this outfit?
Shouldn't I be the one doing this to you instead, my child?
The sensation of this embrace is the warmth of human contact... Do you understand, my child?
Do you like it here, my child? Hehehe~
Welcome back. I've prepared a beverage for you. Come warm yourself as I read the report to you.
Turn into nothingness, along with the symphony of the void!
Welcome, my child. What do you desire tonight? That which ripples in my cup? This sweet, red fruit? Or to sate the desires sleeping deep, deep in your heart?
Welcome, my child. What do you desire tonight? That which ripples in my cup? This sweet, red fruit? Or to sate the desires sleeping deep, deep in your heart?
Heehee... Will you come and visit me every night until the end of summer, my dear child?
Do you want cherries? ...Heehee, I'm so glad you're honest, my child. As a reward... I'll feed you, just like this.
Don't be afraid of spoiling my mood or angering me. Just tell me what you desire - it's my duty to satisfy that.
Sometimes, it's good to give our rational mind a break. My only desire... is to pamper you in my arms on this beautiful summer night, my child.
You really like this hairstyle, don't you, my child?
Do you wish to feel my warmth? But of course, my dear child.
Heehee... It's my job to sate your intellectual thirst...
You look tired. Come, come. Lie down with me and rest.
Hmm? You want another? ...Say it outright, and put your desires in the open. I'll give you everything you want, and more.
I've heard that in the Dragon Empery, it is customary to give out red envelopes on special occasions... Come hither, my child. Allow me to give you a special gift for this priceless moment—
I've heard that in the Dragon Empery, it is customary to give out red envelopes on special occasions... Come hither, my child. Allow me to give you a special gift for this priceless moment—
I hear cheery music playing outside... Hehe, come, my child. Let's share in the mirth together.
How soft and delicate this silk lingerie is... Heehee. If you like it, then feel it for yourself, my child.
What's in the envelope? One could say... it's your deepest, most heartfelt desire.
Do you like the decorations tonight? Hehe, then isn't there something you should say? Something other than "thank you," of course.
Ah... Let's play a beautiful serenade together on this night, my child.
Your reward isn't here, heehee...
You'd like to savor the process of being rewarded this time? Heehee, fine by me...
Yes, that's the spot... Let us celebrate your growth together, my sweet child.
Welcome back, my child. Soon, you will have your own red envelope... Go on. Reach out your hand, if you dare.
What do I wish for? Simply for my sweet child to live a happy and fulfilling life, where in my arms, all of your dreams come true... Heehee. I think you've helped me realize my wish.
My child, I am honored to have guided you through this long night, leading you to greater maturity. Now, come and savor this eve's fruits until dawn comes, as a gift for your profound growth...
My child, I am honored to have guided you through this long night, leading you to greater maturity. Now, come and savor this eve's fruits until dawn comes, as a gift for your profound growth...
What will you explore today, my child? And how will you put it into practice?
Ah... Even knowing what great accomplishments you've achieved, you're still my dear, sweet child. I'll happily spoil you any time you like...
Once you're inside, you are to strip. If you feel the cold, then come snuggle in my arms... Here is the warmest of ports for you, my child.
I'll follow your pace and lead you along the way...
Only by maintaining rationality in moments of deep desire can we truly attain bliss. Immerse yourself in my teachings, my child.
Is my hair a mess, my child?
You're doing well, but you're capable of more.
Mm... Not bad, my child...
I'd like to sing you a lullaby, but you're still full of energy. For now, I suppose I should satisfy that ambition of yours...
My love for you is boundless, and it only grows with each passing day. My child, if you have any requests, speak - I am all too eager to please.
Ahh, the dreamlike beauty of this variation... let us write down this movement so that it may continue forever, my sweet child.
Ahh, the dreamlike beauty of this variation... let us write down this movement so that it may continue forever, my sweet child.
What would you like to listen to today, my child?
What I hope to get from you? Hehe... For me, the most important thing in the world... what I hope for the most - is you, my child.
Is there something giving you difficulty? Please tell me about it. I shall take care of everything for you.
Save your cold rationality for your enemies on the battlefield. Before me, however, you need not hold back. Just indulge yourself to your heart's desire, my child.
If you are tired, lie down right here... I will bring you pleasant dreams... Good, sweet child... I'll always be watching over you.
Do you wish to touch your beloved more intimately? Come closer, my dear child.
What a selfish child... But no matter, I shall accept you unconditionally.
You can leave the report for later. Let me see your face, my child... Hehe, there's nothing amiss... Is there anything you'd like to talk to me about, my child?
My child, I will accept you unconditionally, and lay low anything that attempts to stand in your way. Come, allow me to pamper you more. Yes, more... more... give me more...
Battleship - Gascogne.
Gascogne, Richelieu-class battleship number 4, construction canceled due to wartime conditions. Purpose: engage in battle and destroy Master's enemies.
Gascogne activation process complete. Directive assigned: secure liberty and victory for Master. Gascogne commencing active service.
Identification complete. Welcome back, Master.
Analyzing armaments... Condition: satisfactory. Gascogne is able to execute orders.
"Raise the corners of your lips"... Unable to determine significance of said action.
Analysis complete. Master identified to be in a state of "slacking off." State evaluated as an impediment to productivity.
"Do whatever you want"... Analysis of strategic significance of order deemed impossible.
Discrepancy detected in the frequency of "smiles" recorded between members of the fleet, Gascogne's recollection, and expression identification database.
Awaiting Master's orders.
Body temperature abnormality detected. Requesting thorough physical examination.
Attention: confirmation required for incomplete missions.
Attention: confirmation required for mission rewards.
Attention: confirmation required for new mail.
A glass of armagnac has been prepared.
Attention: confirmation required for commission team's return.
Ability enhancements... Confirmed.
Targets identified. Commencing destruction.
Report: destruction of targets confirmed. Combat mission complete.
Failure is intolerable. Proposal: improve Gascogne's capabilities, or terminate system.
Armaments activated. Engaging at maximum output.
Combat execution systems failing, requesting support.
Gascogne is a weapon and a warship. No other definitions are applicable.
Numerous requests for Gascogne's participation in activities without strategic significance received from members of the fleet. Requesting Master's assessment.
Phenomena known as "emotions" and "impulses" occur when interacting with members of the fleet. Requesting instructions for achieving satisfactory interaction.
"Emotions" generated from physical contact were analyzed and interpreted as "comfort" and "happiness." Concluding that this holds strategic significance if this is Master's intention.

Phenomena known as "worries" and "hopes" were observed and successfully classified during routine "emotion" cache analysis. System can be updated with permissions to access and act upon "emotions" if Master so wishes. Thank you, Master.

I now understand the emotion known as love. It is the throbbing of one's heart; the gratitude, longing, warmth, and light one feels for a person who does not seek recompense. This ring is the greatest gift I could ask for. I love you, Master.
Positive effect on current functions confirmed.

ex.line: Identification complete. Welcome back, Master!
Analyzing armaments... Condition: satisfactory. Please inform me if you have any orders, Master.
"Raise the corners of your lips"... Executing order. L-like this...? I may be doing it wrong...
Analysis complete. Master is in a state of "slacking off." Slacking off is not good.
"Do whatever you want"... Master, how am I meant to do "whatever"...?
Discrepancy detected between the information in my core and the members of the fleet. Why does everyone smile?
I'm waiting for any order you may have, Master.
Body temperature abnormality detected. Master, what's happening to me...?
Attention: confirmation required for incomplete missions. Master...?
Attention: confirmation required for mission rewards. Wow...!
Attention: confirmation required for new mail. A-ahem!
Here is a glass of armagnac, if you'd like.
Attention: confirmation required for commission team's return. Whew...
Ability enhancements confirmed... Nice!
I've studied many emotions, worries, and hopes during my time in this fleet... Now I finally understand what you expect of me, Master. Thank you so, so much, Master...

lines.line: Gascogne uniform change complete. Directive assigned: have fun on the beach with Master. Requesting detailed instructions for how to "have fun on the beach."
Gascogne uniform change complete. Directive assigned: have fun on the beach with Master. Requesting detailed instructions for how to "have fun on the beach."
Welcome back, Master. Gascogne is currently executing routine database definition update of the phrase "doing whatever."
Permission to inspect Gascogne granted.
Analyzed and compared wind speeds, temperature, and weather readings with mean values of previously recorded data. Assessment: navigation at sea is unaffected.
Contact with unharmful lifeform detected. Requesting instructions for satisfactory interaction.
"Let's go for a swim" - Instructions received. Need for swim ring detected. ...Assertion that swim ring is "unnecessary" to swim contradicts existing information in database.
Unable to determine strategic purpose of Master's gaze.
Master, Gascogne has detected body temperature abnormality during self-diagnosis operation.
Gascogne has procured water and energizing edibles. Requesting confirmation of Master's need of aforementioned items.

ex.line: Gascogne uniform change complete. Directive assigned: have fun on the beach with Master. Master, what things do you do to "have fun on the beach"...?
Welcome back, Master. I'm attempting to do "whatever I want"...
Permission to inspect me...? R-right now...?
The summer winds... Master, is this what "relaxation" feels like...?
This crab seems to be saying "hello, I'm a crab!" ...Does what I said work as a "joke"?
"Let's go for a swim" - I'll go get a swimg ring... Master, are you sure I "don't need one"?
Your gaze makes me feel odd, Master...
I'm sorry, Master... My body feels strangely warm...
I have prepared us some water and food... Would you like some, Master?

lines.line: Mode change to "traveling with Master" complete. Travel navigation verified. Master, requesting new destination or observation target.
Mode change to "traveling with Master" complete. Travel navigation verified. Master, requesting new destination or observation target.
Master, requesting directions for new destination. If navigation is necessary, Gascogne can gather data in advance and plan a suitable route.

Gascogne's is in excellent condition. At the current pace, an estimated 135 hours of additional locomotion may be performed. Master, you need only give the order when you wish to rest. Do not worry about Gascogne.

From the expression "traveling is better with company," it was deemed necessary to fill the roles of scout, guard, and data logger. Detecting... a slight difference in Master's interpretation of the phrase.
Hypothesis: This clothing prepared for Gascogne puts greater emphasis on form than mobility. Master, do you similarly desire Gascogne's appearance over function?
Assessment: The act of providing food to the fish in the pond is deemed meaningful in terms of "enjoyment." Master, ahh. Standing by for you to provide food to Gascogne... No?
Do you require Gascogne's navigation, Master?
Abnormal increase in body temperature detected... Cause: clothing trapping too much heat?
Need for hydration and elegance of travel confirmed. Master, please have some sake.

ex.line: Master, where are we heading now? If you need guidance, I can go gather data and propose an optimal route.
It's said that "traveling is better with company." Am I doing a good job as your scout, escort, and memory-keeper on this trip?
My outfit focuses more on looking pretty than being easy to move in, right? Is that because you... want me to look pretty, Master?
Feeding the fish in the pond is... pretty fun, I think. Master, ahh. Y-yeah. I want to be fed, too... Are these two things that different?
Master, can I guide you?
Abnormal increase in body temperature detected... I-is it because of my thick clothes?
Something to rehydrate with and enjoy the charm of the journey by... Master, would you like some sake?

lines.line: Heavy cruiser - Cheshire.
I'm Cheshire, a heavy cruiser from the Royal Navy! Until I met you, I was just a stray in the sea of people's imagination! Which is to say, both my body and soul belong to you, Owner! Squeeeze~♡
Meeeoooow! I haven't slept like that in forever! Hrm? Are you the one who woke me from my sleep? Woohoo, that makes you my owner! "Why?" Because I've totally fallen for you, duh!
Owneeeeer! Glomp! Squeeze! Cuddle! Sniff! What, I'm "overenthusiastic?" Well, that's just how excited I get when I see you, Owner~♡

The reason I adore you is because animals take the first person they see to be their lover... Uhh, I mean, their parent! Not that that's got to do with anything! You're my owner just because, and I love you just because! It's as simple as that!
Hey, Owner, know any funny stories about the Royal Navy? Or any other faction, that's fine! I wanna learn stuff!
I'm not a cat, okay? I might be as cuddly as a kitten, but I'm not an actual cat!
Oh, Master, would you care for some tea~? Hehehe, that was my Royal Maid impression! How was it, Owner?
My kitty ears are a detachable hair accessory! You try 'em on too, Owner! Just for a quick moment, please, c'mon!
Ahah~♡ What is it, Owner? Come on, I know you want something just from looking at your face~
No more surprise touchies! At least tell me when you're gonna do it!
There's no mission we can't accomplish with our combined pawers, Owner!
Mission complete! Don't you think these tasks are a little too easy for us?
The mail's here! I wanna see what's inside! Pretty pleaseeee?
Weeelcome back, Owner! Are you okay? Gave the baddies a good beating? Didn't develop a crush on anyone else? Alrighty, then everything's all good!
A commission team's back! Let's head over there and give 'em something to play with!
Thank you, Owner!
What'll it be for dinner today? A plate of torpedoes, or a bowl of cannonfire?
We won! See that, Owner? We wooooon! Meoww~!
Why don't we slink away before they notice?
Feel the power of love!
Meowch! It hurts, but I'm not about to let my owner down!
Hrmph... Why'd the first love of my life have to be such a disappointment?
Where've you been, Owner? If you went to do fun stuff without inviting me then I'm gonna be a pouty tabby!

Hey, Owner! I was playing with this Sakura Empire girl earlier, and I got to touch her cat ears! REAL cat ears! Aren't you jealous? ...What? You did that ages ago? Hrmph, well there goes my brief moment of triumph!
Is there a chance you'll get fed up with my displays of affection, Owner? If so, I need to double down to make sure that never happens! Lemme give you a hug~♡

If it weren't for you, I'd never have materialized in this incredible world, never made so many adorable friends, and worst of all, I never would have gotten to experience being in love with you, Owner! You're just perfect, y'know that~? Cuddly wuddly~ I love you so, so much~♡

Now that you've made it clear how precious I am to you, I need to respond by saying, "I love you, Owner!" a hundred times or more! Starting right now! Stay right where you are until I'm finished! Here we go! I love you, Owner!!!
Yaaay! How'd you know I wanted this so badly, Owner?
Don't try too hard, or you'll put people off!
Yaaay! Can I floof you, please?
Yaaay! Victory is mine!
I wanna learn more about being a maid!
Yaaay! It's time to partyyyy!

ex.line: Owneeeeeer! Glomp! Squeeze! Cuddle! Sniff! Alright, that should do it for now! Cuddling you has become a part of my daily routine at this point♡
Me, spacing out? Nuh-uh! ...Well, I guess I do sometimes when I think about you, my perfect Owner~♡
Do you want tea or some juice, Owner? I personally like the orange juice they sell in vending machines! ...H-hey, just because I like premade stuff doesn't mean I'm lazy!
I got my hands on a new set of ears! Try 'em on for size, Owner! Aww, don't be like that! You'd look adorable in them!
Owneeeer! Hm? No, I didn't need anything, why? Can't I just touch you outta nowhere if I feel like it?
Mission complete! Total walk in the park for the two of us!
Weeelcome back, Owner! Are you okay? Did you have any lovey-dovey thoughts about me? Don't be shy to say it, I want to know!

Oh, Owner~! Anywhere you wanna go today? Anything particular you want for dinner? Maybe there's something you wanna say? Ask me, and I'll tell you: I wanna go wherever you're going, I wanna have dinner with and most importantly, I love you, Owner~♡

lines.line: Cheer up, Owner! Jeez, why are you so bummed out when we're at the beach... Because it's just a normal playdate instead of a romantic date? What's the difference anyway? C'mon, let's go head down to where the others are~!

Cheer up, Owner! Jeez, why are you so bummed out when we're at the beach... Because it's just a normal playdate instead of a romantic date? What's the difference anyway? C'mon, let's go head down to where the others are~!
Are you feeling good, Owner? Yay, then it's time to start our seaside date!
Don't think I didn't notice you earlier, Owner! You left to play with someone while I wasn't looking, didn't you? Not that I mind, really! But you could've at least let me known first!
There's only one reclining chair? So what~ We'll just share it, silly Owner~ I'm pawsitively fine with doing it that way♡
I'm all thirsty! Time to chuggy-chug a nice, cool drink! ...Mmhh! I feel like a new person!
Fishing? Nuh-uh, I don't wanna. Time spent fishing could be time spent playing games with you, Owner!
Need to lie down, Owner? Okey-dokey! Which headrest do you want: my thighs, or my soft tummy? Hehehe♡
Wow, there are so many cuties here besides me! But, heheh, I'm the top cat when it comes to being cute and sexy! Isn't that right, Owner?
Welcome, welcome, Owner~ If you've got any requests, don't be shy, don't hesitate, I'll try my best and sing a song that's really great~♡
I'll sing a song for you, Owner~ Ahem... Wait, I'm not sure I know any Dragon Empery songs, actually...
Owneeeeeer! ...Oopsies, that was improper of me! I'm dressed like a refined Dragon Empery lady, so I need to act the part!
Welcome, welcome, Owner~ If you've got any requests, don't be shy, don't hesitate, I'll try my best and sing a song that's really great~♡
My beloved Owner~♡ Squeeze, cuddle, sniiiiff~ I love being with you so much~♡
Sexy cleavage, trendy fashion, and obligatory kitty ears: the perfect package of cuteness~ How do you like it, Owner?
Relax and get cozy, Owner~ Now's not the time for work, it's time to hang out with me!
Is there something I can do for you, Owner?
I'm always okay with getting intimate with you, Owner~
Mission complete! Let's claim those rewards right meow, Owner~
Hey Owner, what do you think of everyone's dresses? Are there any outfits you want to see me in? ...I look gorgeous in my current one? Squeeee! I love you, Owneeeeer~♡
The girls just came back from that commission! I wonder if Drake was with them?
Nicely commanded, Owner!
"Owner~ I've come to take you to the ball~" ...That's exactly what you were going to do? Eh, doesn't matter who does it~ All that matters is we'll be there together~♪
"Owner~ I've come to take you to the ball~" ...That's exactly what you were going to do? Eh, doesn't matter who does it~ All that matters is we'll be there together~♪
We'd better get going soon, Owner! My horse here is starting to get restless~
If I were a princess, I bet you'd come to my house, sat atop a white horse and ready to pick me up~ Right, Owner?
Think we'll meet any magical creatures out in this forest, Owner? You know... Like fairies? I once read a nursery tale about those!
Owner! Lookie! I found a twelve-sided snowflake! Aww, it melted...
Offer you my hand...? I don't get it. I'm happy just to take your hand and cuddle like we always do! Rubrub~ Squeeze~
Myeh-heh♪ Your eyes are just glued to me, aren't they, Owner? Ahem... "You may feast your eyes; gaze all you wish"~♪
You're silly, Owner~ You know what I think about surprise touchies~
Owner, could you lift my dress's train for me? It'll drag along the ground otherwise... Aww, thank you~♪
Owneeer! Lookie! You'll be spending the night with a magician - me! What's the matter? Are you already head over paws for my new look? Don't think I didn't notice how you can't take your eyes off me!
Owneeer! Lookie! You'll be spending the night with a magician - me! What's the matter? Are you already head over paws for my new look? Don't think I didn't notice how you can't take your eyes off me!
Owneeer! Squeee! Cuddle! Fluff! Sniff! Hey, how does it feel to hug me? I bet it feels even better than usual!

Owner! Did you know rabbits will get sick if they're lonely? I might not be a rabbit, but I also hate being lonely! So to keep your favourite Cheshire happy, you'll need to give her a steady supply of hugs!
Are you tired after the party, Owner? You should lie down next to me! And rest your head on my thighs!
Watch closely, Owner! I'm going to perform a stunning magic trick! Tadah! I made a Cheshire appear, and she really loves her Owner!
Here comes a trick that reveals how much I love you! Abracadabra... Did you see that? It said I love you as much as physically possible!
Owner, stick your hand in my hat! Hm? You feel something soft inside? I'm sure that's just the rabbit in my hat♡
Owner, my hat's gonna fall off if you keep headpatting me! There are other places you can touch me, you know!
Owneeer! Hm? Why are you blushing all of a sudden? Has that spark inside you rekindled, hmm?
Oh, Owner. I know exactly what's going through your head! And I'm perfectly fine with it♡
Owner, you still have missions to do! Are there any that Cheshire the Magician can help with?
After you've claimed those mission rewards, do you wanna go watch the fireworks with me?
I used a magic trick to hide your letter inside this card! Ahaha, I'm just joking with you!
Way to go, Owner! Do you wanna see me do a little hopping dance? Or maybe a magic trick instead?
The commission team is back? I hope they brought the souvenirs I ordered for you!
I learned a new magic trick! I'll show it to you later!
I'll pull a shell out of this hat and it's gonna hurt for you!
Mission complete! Owner, did you like my fireworks?
Behold the magic of love!
Owie... Maybe my doves will be of some use to you, Owner?

Owner, is there anything you wish for? I can make it happen with my magic! Hm? You just wanna be with me forever? Oh gosh! An unexpected profession of love! You know, you don't need to wish for that - I'll make it come true either way! That's just what you do when you love someone more than anyone else in the whole world!
Owneeer! Look, look! I've got my wedding dress on! Isn't it frilly and floaty and just so cute? I'll bet you love me so much right now you can't think straight! Heehee♡
Owneeer! Look, look! I've got my wedding dress on! Isn't it frilly and floaty and just so cute? I'll bet you love me so much right now you can't think straight! Heehee♡
Owneeer! Come to me! I've been waiting for this moment for so, soo long!
Oh no! It's sooo windy! Owner, hold on to me tightly or else the wind will pick me up and blow me away!
Owneeer! Don't I look like I came right out of a painting? I'm just like a princess out of a fairy tale!
I want your full attention for the rest of the day, Owner!
I'm so happy I'm worried I might be dreaming... Owner, give me an extra-sweet kiss to prove this is real!
Hey, Owner! Look at my cat-eared veil! It's sooo cute!
This bouquet is for me, not for you, Owner! If you like it that much, just be patient and I'll give you a whole field's worth of flowers later!
Eek! You're taking things too fast, Owner! We'll have plenty of time for ourselves later, y'know!
Owner, if you won't come over to me, I'll come and jump straight into your arms instead! You have three seconds! Three, two... I can't wait any longer! Get ready to catch me!
From now on, you're going to share your smiles, your worries, and everything else with me! My heart has belonged to you since the moment I was born! I love you so much, Owner!
Heavy cruiser - Drake.
I'm the Royal Navy heavy cruiser, Drake. If you weren't aware of my existence before, I'll make sure you know now by showing you the power of my 9.2 inch guns!
So you're the Commander? Seems you've got some backbone. I'm the Royal Navy heavy cruiser, Drake, and I'll be joining your fleet. Just making sure, you will deploy me, right?
You've finally come. What should we start with today? It's great to think about battle plans and all, but how about sending me on a sortie first?
All great odysseys must begin somewhere, but true glory only awaits those who reach their destination... That's why you ought to stay your course until the very end!

Basically, ships arm themselves with armor and equipment—in other words, with artillery and torpedoes. Meanwhile, humans arm themselves with courage and intelligence—in other words, with perception and wisdom.
While I don't hate customs and ceremony, I do prefer the simpler things.
The dew-kissed fruit of the morning makes for the best juice. Don't you agree?
I tend to get along better with people who are straightforward. If there's something you want to say to me, say it clearly.
Huuh? You sure have some guts.
Doing mundane tasks is totally not my style. Um... Why don't we check the rewards first?
Can't complain about the bounty, but I just feel like there's "something" missing.
Here, a letter for you. Anybody find information on some treasure?
Nice job, Commander. How would you like some fresh... grapes? Hehe, come on~ don't drop 'em!
Instead of collecting supplies like this, wouldn't it be better to just raid the enemy for... Actually, never mind.
Now that's the kind of sound I want to hear from my main guns! Ahahaha!
Alright, let's do this with fanfare!
Victory always leaves you feeling nice and refreshed!
How humiliating... I'll get you back for this! Just you wait!
You won't find any mercy here!
Ugh, they got me!
I am willing to turn a blind eye to a few accidents, but if you keep doing this intentionally, don't expect any mercy from me.
Everything goes on the battlefield. Whether you fight fair-and-square or use backhanded methods, it matters not. History is written by the victors.
Oh right, Commander. Did you have any interest in navigation... or rather, adventure? I've been recruiting mates. If you're interested, let's go look for treasure or uninhabited islands or something!

Sure, it's great to travel together and all, but aren't all these places too close by? Port, the surrounding areas, and the nearby ocean... Sigh. Honestly, going to these places doesn't make me excited at all. Next time, I'm taking you somewhere farther away.
I see. So what you're telling me is that it's not the place that matters, but that if I'm with you, anywhere is fine? ... Haha... W-Wait... are you saying...

Don't you think it's strange too? This feeling that's not quite 'having my heart stolen' or 'feeling vexed,' but more just... 'feeling embarrassed'? ...Gosh, it's all your fault that I'm not acting like myself! ... But I don't quite hate this feeling either... Well? Do you get what I mean?
Aha. Now this is nice!
Let's see who's more useful!

ex.line: I mean, yes, of course I wanted to improve my artillery and torpedoes, get thicker plating, and improve my engines—but it's too expensive to do so.
How'd you like some lime juice? Yes, I do think fresh juice is the best, and you're gonna need to get used to it when you're sailing the high seas. Hehe~
Hey... What do you think you're doing while the sun's still up...
Hm, I see. This is what it feels like to be loved by someone you love. Not wanting to snatch someone away or wanting to monopolize them, but feeling excited and safe... It feels a bit strange...

lines.line: Phew... Swimming like this doesn't feel all that refreshing... Hey, how about you stop staring and come join me?
Phew... Swimming like this doesn't feel all that refreshing... Hey, how about you stop staring and come join me?
I heard this is a nice place to swim. Imagine my surprise to learn it wasn't a beach, but an outdoor pool... Still, I guess if we're just killing time, this is as good a place as any...
Artificial waves? Hmm, this might be more fun than I thought. Time to show off my swimming skills!
C-could you stop staring at me like that? You're starting to weird me out...
Hahah, seems like this manjuu needs some more practice if it's struggling with these meager waves!
*sigh*... I'm not feeling satisfied yet. Guess I'll go for another swim...
Ooh, my shoulders were starting to get a little stiff. You're not half-bad, eh~
Good exercise followed by some exquisitely cool watermelon, man, it's just the best! Hey, you'd better get over here and have a bite, or I'll finish this whole thing by myself!
Light cruiser - Mainz.
Light cruiser, Mainz. There were plans for me to succeed the Admiral Hipper class, but due to circumstances, I've incarnated in this form. You get the rest without me telling you, right?
Light cruiser, Mainz. You'll be my first Commander. Hmph. Don't you dare disappoint me.
Make sure that the wait was worth my time, Commander.
Achievements? ...Let's start racking them up today.
What do you think you're doing! Adding milk to coffee is nothing short of blasphemy! The same goes for sugar!!!
I can't believe it... though this room is so large, it doesn't even have a coffee maker...!
If only I were constructed in the Great War instead of being incarnated in this form, I wonder how much I would have been able to do... I guess thinking about it doesn't help.
What's wrong? Do you want me to comfort you?
Perfect. I can finish testing my guns by firing them at you.
Are you going to neglect all the missions?
How long... are you planning on ignoring the mission rewards?
There's new mail. There's no way you've forgotten, right?
My equipment needs maintenance, too.
The girls who went on commissions are returning. I'll be leaving my seat for a bit.
Hm. Let's test this out in a real battle.
Don't get in my way.
An expected outcome, given that I am here.
Hm. I'll consider this as valuable practical experience.
Now's the time! Begin firing!
Ugh, to think that my equipment wouldn't work...?!
To think that my first commander would be this pathetic... How depressing.
Because I was born into this world, I shall accomplish something. Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to face those who designed me.
If I am lacking in actual battle experience, there is nothing to do but humbly accumulate more. Commander, I won't mince words - please send me out on more battles.
At one point I fought to prove myself. However, I now fight for your sake. I want to prove to everyone else that you are a sufficiently reliable person.
Commander, I recognize you as the first and last commander I swear my loyalty to... But that's not all. You are the only one I've ever thought I wanted to get closer to.
My existence is no longer just about battle. My life and fate have already been tied to yours. My beloved Commander, I henceforth pledge my heart to you for the rest of eternity.
I didn't expect to receive something like this... This has made me see you in a new light.
Witness the true power of the Iron Blood!

ex.line: Here's some fresh coffee. I've made it to your taste.
Commander, are you satisfied with my battle record? I see, that's good.
Commander, I've acquired some coffee beans. Allow me to make you some fresh coffee. I'd like for you to experience the joy of coffee for yourself.
I'm grateful that I was able to incarnate into this era. To tell you the truth, it's because I have such a wonderful Commander like you.
Commander, I'm right here by your side. And I always will be.
*cough*, Commander, please hold yourself back!
Commander, I beg you, please don't forget about the missions after your break.
I'll be going to get the mission rewards...
You've got new mail. Leave the rest to me.
Für den Kommandant!

lines.line: Ah! Changed already? Just wait a minute... No, you don't have to leave. I'm almost done.
Ah! Changed already? Just wait a minute... No, you don't have to leave. I'm almost done.
I wouldn't have minded waiting longer. After all, I know you're not the type to forget a promise.
Blücher tried to wear her rigging to the bath, but Eugen and I managed to stop her. Seems like Hipper didn't want to get in with us, though...
Nngh... It's hard to tie this sash tight enough. But if it's too loose...
They didn't let me bring a coffee machine into the bathhouse, but... Heh, I did get to set it up outside. Black, of course.
The mirror? I'd assume it's fogged up from the steam. ...Look at my reflection, you say? What do you... Oh. *blushes*
You've done well, Commander. It's time to take a break.
W-wait! Don't do that, or else...!
A mission, huh? ...Let's put it off for now. It'll still be there after we take a break.
Finished your missions already? Then that gives us more time to kick back.
You have new mail. I told them to leave it in your office, so we can check it later.
Where did you go, Commander? Tiring yourself out now would defeat the whole point of relaxing.
I guess I got too comfortable...
Commander, come join me in rest. ...Hm? I look unusually relaxed? This is a rare break, and I don't plan to waste it by being stuffy.
Commander, come join me in rest. ...Hm? I look unusually relaxed? This is a rare break, and I don't plan to waste it by being stuffy.
Phew... Want me to scooch over for you?
Do you have any plans later today? If not, feel very free to stay with me.
Tea and black coffee... Entirely different flavors, but many shared aspects. For example, traditional tea doesn't include sugar or milk.
I think Hipper was interested in this dress. She was staring an awful lot... Should I have one made for her, too?
It is a little cramped, but if we try hard enough, we could both sleep here. So... Want to lie down with me?
How does it, umm... feel?
My shoe fell off? When in the world...
H-hold on! Does it have to be right now...?
Your mission rewards... Bah, they can wait. You're on break right now, after all!
Have you been working this whole time? Goodness. Get over here and relax already.

The Dragon Empery New Year is a day for family gatherings. I think it's a lovely thing, but I want to take this opportunity to tell you... that you are more important to me than anyone else. That our fates are bound tightly. Wherever you go, that is my home.
Battlecruiser - Odin.
I am the battleship Odin. I existed only within the realm of the Iron Blood navy's imagination. Destiny has brought me here to serve under you and assist in the realization of your goals.
Are you the one who summoned me here? I am Odin. I hereby take up post as your tactician.
Excellent, you're back. Have you finished work our next plan yet, Commander?
I don't understand. Why are all the people at this base so at ease?
One day, I hope to meet the Scharnhorst sisters myself.
Sometimes, things don't go as planned. You must think carefully before committing yourself to anything, Commander.
Don't blame others over things that are out of their control. Nobody can predict the future.
Yes? Has there been a change of plans?
Y-you will hear from me at the court martial!
You have missions. Leaving them unfinished would be a foolish choice.
Mission successful. Let us get started on the next one, Commander.
Mail has arrived. Could it be new intelligence?
Commander, we are in all-out war; we cannot afford to rest.
The commission team has returned. Excellent, exactly as was planned.
With strength, one can reduce the number of irregularities in a plan.
Flee while you still can.
Victory was ours since before the battle began.
Impossible... My plan should have been flawless...!
You wasted your last chance to turn back!
Carry out emergency damage control plan!
I am not even disappointed, I simply wonder how someone as lousy as you became a commander in the first place.
Names and titles are no proof of strength, that much is true. But that is fine. As time passes, you learn how futile your concerns are.
Mourn for my fallen comrades? If I were to stop and mourn for every lost soul, I would never win the war.
We make a fine pair, both in the office and the war room. But that can backfire, as I may end up becoming reliant on you...
I do not approve of being reliant on someone. Excessive intimacy is a hindrance in war, clouding one's judgment and forming obstacles to one's plans... Ah, I can't believe what I'm saying...

Understood. I shall continue to provide assistance for you, whenever- Hey, wait a minute... Th-this isn't what you said would happen! ...No, that's not to say I oppose this! I just wasn't... mentally prepared... What I'm getting at is: give me a moment to think!
Wait a second... I don't remember telling you what I like. How did you know?

ex.line: Excellent, you're back. Shall we begin on our plans for today, Commander?
I finally understand now. Everyone is at ease because they have faith in you, Commander. It all makes sense.
Though I object to sudden changes, there are times when one must revise their plans. But rest assured, my pledge to you is set in stone.
Someone made a mistake, did they? If it was excusable, then offer them a pardon. It's meaningless to scold someone over nothing significant.
Not again! Would you stop it with this unsolicited behavior?!
You're not a machine capable of working around the clock. Rest if you need to. I will hold the fort in the meanwhile.
To tell the truth, I blanked out the moment you presented this ring to me. But now, my mind is clear. Whatever obstacles we will come to face, I vow to take them on together with you.

lines.line: I thought I would never have time to pursue the fine arts, and yet here I am now. Your thoughts, Commander? Eastern as this calligraphy may be, does it not suit the connotations of my name?
I thought I would never have time to pursue the fine arts, and yet here I am now. Your thoughts, Commander? Eastern as this calligraphy may be, does it not suit the connotations of my name?
It is good to see you again. You ought to dedicate your days off to your own hobbies, Commander.
I don't understand. Why are all the people at this base so at ease? ...No, it is simply I who is always trying too hard.
Gneisenau, enjoyment of the arts will always elude you if you only think in statistics. You stand to learn from Scharnhorst in that regard.
Lord Tirpitz, whereabouts is Lord Bismarck? Forsooth, 'tis reassuring to know that thou knoweth. I shan't inquire further.
Plum trees and snow... This is an unfamiliar, but picturesque sight that I will likely never forget.
Stop it! I am trying to focus here!
To fight is to put one's whole being into something, be that firing volleys on the battlefield or turning a blank canvas into a masterpiece.
Battleship - Champagne.
Never have I received orders, nor have I ever accomplished anything. I am merely a blank slate—existing simply to become the delectable champagne presented to thee, the victor.
I am the personification of Champagne, part of the Iris Libre. Commander, please give me an order—a reason to exist.
Your orders, Commander. Whatever your will may be, I shall usher into reality.

Whether your ambitions leads you into the wilderness of unparalleled achievements, the lofty spires of world domination, or the gardens of peaceful sanctuary, command me as would best serve your will.
Commander, art thou pondering the meaning of life? Or perhaps...
The ebb and flow of tides are natural phenomena, and so are the flowing fates of humankind.
"Live, together with the fleet." Understood. I have received my newest directive from the Commander.
The warmth and sensation of being touched... How exceedingly difficult to forget.
Though your transgression may be slight, such conduct may turn others away from you.
The falcon that spreads not its wings cannot reach the sky. The ship that rows not its oars cannot reach the other shore.
Only for the gardener whose blood nurtures the soil can the iris bloom in triumphant beauty.
A notice has arrived. Is it a joyous one, or is it a tragic one? Is it a desirable one, or a hateful one?
Immerse yourself in the liberating quintessence of wine, for the mind requires reprieve. Man is naught without repose.
The birds' clarion call... It seems that our comrades have returned to us.
Even the most polished blade must eventually rot. That is to say, there is no point in chasing power.
Devote thyself not to the fleet― for that is my solemn charge.
I ensure that missions sown shall bear rich fruit.
Our true destination still awaits.
Sleep in the blue depths of the ocean...
These scars will become my aegis.
The hope you brought was but a false light. Why, Commander, must you torment me so?
This world is the surface of a calm lake— Disturbances may mar the waters with ripples, but peace must return in time.

Trees bury their roots deep into the ground to avoid being blown away, and fish swim upstream to propagate their kind. Though they know they are fated to return to nothingness, living things defy their circumstances to the best of their ability.
Commander, there is no way for you to wear the rigging—armor, main guns, and torpedoes—that is required to defend the fleet. As I am a ship, I will take on the mission to protect you.

If those who are powerless resist fate, those with power cannot stand by and do nothing. Commander, your radiance, warmth, and affection—in order to protect all of this, I offer up my body and swear my love.

Even if words stop existing, I will still listen to your voice. Even if the world loses its radiance, I will still look into your eyes. There is nothing in this world that can erase your existence from my heart. The warmth I've received from you, I shall repay with my eternal protection... These are my true feelings.
Too overwhelming is this joy - I must express my gratitude.
Let us open our eyes to this colorful world.
Let us harken, for the world speaks.
It is not against the teachings to halt one's pursuit of destiny and to surrender to the warm draft of festivities. It is mankind's prerogative to seek out auspicious portents.
It is not against the teachings to halt one's pursuit of destiny and to surrender to the warm draft of festivities. It is mankind's prerogative to seek out auspicious portents.
What I desire on the first day of the new year... a peaceful night's sleep, and a rainbow-colored dream that reflects my wishes.
Reliving one's childhood by enjoying games is one way to enjoy festivities. That being the case, I lack knowledge of the rules designated for these games...
Mountains, birds, fruits. All wonderful signs of a dream in which spring blooms forth.
Our connected memories spread out, like freshly-fallen powder snow, as our affected emotions are as if blown by the spring breeze. ...May these peaceful festivities spread much joy.
The Cardinal's favorite book was one recommended by me. Humans and ships alike desire to satisfy their curiosity...
Hm...? Did you want to know about my dreams...?
Animals attempt to break their fetters in order to satiate their desires, whereas humans challenge taboos to satiate their curiosity.
Please enlighten me. The significance of this festive garb, and the things I must do.
An ode of gratitude for the venerable Iris, echoing tones condensing to pure prayer. Seek blessings not in public worship, but in humanity's true triumph: our everlasting bonds.
An ode of gratitude for the venerable Iris, echoing tones condensing to pure prayer. Seek blessings not in public worship, but in humanity's true triumph: our everlasting bonds.
Feel, perceive. The beating of our connected hearts, the trembling of our damp lips.
Praise be this vow. Love, faithfulness, entrusted duty, ordained creed—I must be one who protects the happiness of all.
Life is fleeting. The hulls of shipgirls are transient. It is our inescapable fate to love momentary bliss.
It is the duty of Champagne to fill your cup. That means keeping you punctual and rested in equal measure...
Hymns passed down cannot fool the heart. I will celebrate your great deeds and offer you love eternal.
Your warmth, heartbeat, touch, and more seem meant to tempt me into rapture...
Even knowing eternal love, one desires momentary pleasure. I know that it falls to me to see your wishes granted, Commander...
A message is received. Is it joyful or sorrowful news? Triumphant or regretful? The answers lay in your reply, Commander.
A decision must be made. The baptism of innocent lost spirits, the flavor of filling fertility, or the indulgence of a lover's tryst?
What I am telling you are the honeyed words of a lover—let us prepare to greet those who have returned together.
I fight for the Commander's sake—That is my credo.
Unlike the fleeting bubbles dancing in the air, this victory will be remembered for all time.
A vow mustn't be broken. My protection is eternal.
Heavy cruiser - Anchorage.
Anchorage is... a Union "Heavy Cruiser"...? Baltimore and the others are my friends! You're my best friend though, Teacher...!
Com...mander? No... Teacher? Teachy-teacher. I'm Anchorage. Woohoo! Teacher! My favoritest person! Teacheeer!
Teacher~ Anchorage has been waiting for you...
"Teacher" is better than "Commander"... Anchorage likes "Teacher"... Teacher, I like you lots!
Put on the jacket... Take off the jacket... Put it back on... Ehehe~
In this picture, the girl, the prince... are very comfy... I like it!
Teacher, are you busy...? Can you stay by Anchorage's side? ...Yay!
You like... my hair? Lemme touch Teacher's too...
Anchorage likes Teacher's warm touch... Does Teacher like it too?
Squishy squish... Teacher, do you like it...?
"Mission... incomplete?" Anchorage wants to help...!
"Mission... complete?" Teacher, that's great!
"Mail"... It's too hard, I can't read it... Teacher, do you know what it says?
Teacher, where are you...? Anchorage hates being alone...
"Commissions"...? Where is everyone...? Anchorage wants to know... Is that okay?
Anchorage... will become stronger!
It's the bad guys... Teacher, everyone... Let's go together!
Yay, I won! Anchorage is a good girl...!
Oh no, I lost... Bad guys are scary...
Anchorage... will take a shot!
Owie... It hurts...
Patpat. Teacher, it's okay, don't cry... Anchorage... won't cry either... Smile like this, okay?
So many strangers... Teacher, Anchorage is scared...
Teacher~! I'll give you this bunny rabbit! ...Here!
Teacher is a special person to me... Anchorage loves Teacher very much! Anchorage is also a special person to Teacher? Yay!
Teacher... Will you be together with Anchorage? ...Yay! Anchorage with Teacher, girl with her prince... Together, forever...
A promise...? Pinky promise! ...A "ring"? You'll put it on my finger? Yay! Anchorage also made a ring! Teacher, gimme your hand!
Anchorage loves it... Yeah!
Balty... Hooray!
Wichita... Very cool!
Bremmy... Mhm!

ex.line: Teacher...! Anchorage was waiting... I missed you so, so much...
Teacher... Anchorage will read you... my new picture book! "Once upon a time..." Huh? Umm, I don't understand this next part...
Teacher... Jacket on? Jacket... off? Which is better?
In my picture books, the prince... holds hands with the girl... and hugs her. We should do that, too...!
Teacher, are you tired...? Anchorage can help...! You can rely on me... Yeah!
Anchorage will now... roll up my sleeves! And then... hold hands with Teacher!
Anchorage loves... getting petted! More, Teacher...
Do you want a hug, Teacher? Anchorage will hug you... reeeally tight!
Teacher... Your touch feels... good! I like it...!
I don't understand "mail"... Teacher, teach me! I'll write... mail for you, too!
Teacher... Take Anchorage next time! I don't want to be alone... away from you!
Anchorage knows where everyone is! Teacher told me. Thank you, Teacher...
Teacher, look! I'm even better now! Hehe...
I won...! Anchorage is amazing! But Teacher is the most amazing!
The enemy is scary... But Teacher is here. I'm not afraid...!
Anchorage loves... Teacher's smile! I'll do my best... and protect it! So you can smile forever and ever... with Anchorage!

lines.line: Mm... There... Teacher? Is Anchorage doing it right? Is Anchorage... swimming? Thank goodness... Falling into the water would be bad, right...?
Mm... There... Teacher? Is Anchorage doing it right? Is Anchorage... swimming? Thank goodness... Falling into the water would be bad, right...?
Mm... Um, Teacher...? Is Anchorage doing it right? Kick like this... I-I think I'm sinking again..
You're teaching Anchorage... Yeah... You're Teacher, not Commander! Anchorage loves Teacher!
Teacher, can you teach me even in my dreams...? Ehehe.
Baltimore's so good at swimming...! Can Anchorage learn to swim like that? Ehehe, if Teacher teaches me, then maybe...
The shark is so slippery... I'll do my best not to fall off! Yeah!
You're all wet... Teacher, are you okay...?
Teacher, do you like touching...?
Don't let the mail fall in the water... Mmm... There!
Teacher, where are you...? I can't swim on my own... Oh! Teacher! Ehehe♪
Com-mish-shuns... We have to wait until everyone's back, right?
Anchorage... Swim good, so you don't sink...!
Anchorage did it! Anchorage is doing good...!
Teacher is Anchorage's Commander... But Anchorage likes Teacher. Can you be my Teacher... forever? Anchorage and Teacher...♪
Teacher... How are Anchorage's new clothes? Do you like them...? Yeah, I do, too!
Teacher... How are Anchorage's new clothes? Do you like them...? Yeah, I do, too!
Anchorage was so lonely waiting for you... Hug me, teacher... The moon? Wow... We're gazing at the moon together...!
The wind feels good... Teacher, do you want to try? ...Hm? This is dangerous...? Okay... Anchorage will be careful!
Teacher, look...! The moon and the lights are all bright and pretty...! Anchorage is, too...? Hehehe... Anchorage loves the moon and the lights, too! And... Teacher, too!
The boat is all rocking and swaying... Spending time with you is so fun... I love it...!
...Pictures? Pose? Like this...? You think it's cute...? I do, too!
Pat pat...? That feels good... Anchorage likes it...
Touch, touch... Anchorage wants to touch you, too...
Do you... like this, Teacher? This... "pose"? I don't get it... But if you like it, then Anchorage likes it, too!
The mission is complete! Teacher, can we play now...? A boat ride, and looking at the moon...? Yay...!
Mail... It's too hard for me... You understand mail, Teacher? Wow...
Teacher, welcome back... A boat ride? Just you and me...? Okay! Let's go see the moon...!
Anchorage didn't go on the commission trip... I want to go next time...
I lost... But... I'll do my best...! Because I'm together with Teacher... Heehee♪
Anchorage is happy no matter what we do together! ...Close my eyes? Okay, but why... (*kiss*) Teacher... I love you! Let's be together forever...
Teacher found me...! Anchorage can't sleep... I wanna drink sweet milk... Please?
Teacher found me...! Anchorage can't sleep... I wanna drink sweet milk... Please?
You can't sleep either...? Want milk? Drink it... with Anchorage!
Teacher, what milk do you like? Strawberry? Mango...? Hmm... I can't read this... What does it say, Teacher?
Teacher... What milk flavor do you like? Anchorage likes... Strawberry!
Anchorage's clothes fell...! I pulled them up... and they fell again! Hehe...
Brush my teeth after...? Anchorage will remember... Yeah!
Anchorage wrote a note! It's on the... re-fridge-erator... So I won't forget what Teacher told me!
Yeah... After I finish the milk... Anchorage will go beddy-bye!
Can Anchorage... drink it on the couch? Hehe!
Hm? Teacher... Wanna touch? My clothes are big... You can reach in if you want...
Can't see... Anchorage will turn on the lights!
Teacher, welcome back... Anchorage wants milk now... Can we have milk?
Anchorage wants to drink... the milk Teacher drank! Mmm... Delicious! Thanks, Teacher! Hehe... Drinking milk together is so much fun!
Teacher... Anchorage loves you! Our oath... is special! We'll be together... forever!
Teacher... Anchorage loves you! Our oath... is special! We'll be together... forever!
Teacher... It's pretty here! Let's take a walk... before Mr. Sun goes down!
Teacher... Am I pretty? Ehehe, can we hold hands? Thanks, Teacher...!
Teacher... Look! Heart-shaped fireworks... for you!
Teacher... Mr. Sun is so shiny and pretty. Just like... my fireworks! And like you and me!
Walk... Hold Anchorage's hand, Teacher! The beach is so soft... I better try not to fall!
Today made me happy...! I'll remember it forever! You do too, Teacher...!
Pretty flowers... I like them! Do you, Teacher...?
Rub, rub... That feels good... But the fireworks are hot... Be careful, Teacher!
Fluffy dress... Anchorage, fluffy... Do you like, Teacher?
Teacher... Here's your mail! And flowers, too!
Fireworks... Let's go play, Teacher! You can light... Anchorage's fireworks!
Fireworks... for victory! Hip, hip, hooray!
The fireworks are gone... Teacher, why?
Teacher, the fireworks are over... But Anchorage's love for you won't! I love you! More than anyone else, ever!
Aircraft carrier - Hakuryuu.
I am Hakuryuu, aircraft carrier of the Sakura Empire. Let any who dares question my might face me head-on. I shall teach them the meaning of overwhelming power.
So, this brat is supposed to be the commander? My name is Hakuryuu. Listen well - try to control me, and you will make a laughingstock of yourself. Remember this!
So you've come. Color me surprised. I assumed you had overslept, but that seems to not be the case.
My room's a bit messy, you say? So what? There's no problem as long as I can find everything I need.
It is great to have access to such a wide variety of sparring opponents here... Friends? Hmph, just having one or two is sufficient.
My katana is my soul. Should it leave my side, I... Never mind, forget I said anything.
I had the opportunity to roll some rice balls during my free time. You may have them if you're hungry.
How dare you pat me without permission. Have you no fear of being cut down?
What is it? If you require something of me, speak your mind.
What, are you trying to imitate me? ...Hey, knock it off already!
Missions? I have no desire to waste my time on such trifling chores. I'll leave that to you.
See, I knew you had it in you. The ability to handle trifling chores is quite commendable.
A new missive? ...Oh, it's not a duel challenge. Boring.
M-my katana... Phew... Ahh, I really don't feel complete without it. ...Hey, why are you still here? Do you really have the free time to stand around in a daze?
Did the commission fleet come back while I was sidetracked? Oh, you're going to go greet them? See you in a bit.
Hmph. The distance between me and the rest grows ever greater.
Show me the fool that dares challenge the mighty Hakuryuu!
Hmph! They sent lowly scum to try to stop the mighty Hakuryuu? How laughable!
L-let's get out of here! ....H-has anyone seen my katana?!
Divine retribution befalls you!
How could the great Hakuryuu be damaged?!
Scum. Stay away from me.
Praise me if I do well. Berate me if I do poorly. That's just how work goes. There's no need to concern yourself over me.
Not too bad. You might actually be able to keep pace with me... Hmph. But if you become complacent or regress, I'll cast you aside faster than anyone else.
Umm, have you seen my katana...? I swear I left it here, but it's nowhere to be found... Ahem! A-a-anyways, if I don't find it soon, um... it's a really big deal, so please help me...!

Now that you've seen my secret, I can no longer afford to let you out of my sight! Hmph, from now on, we shall do everything together! ...Of course that includes going outside to play... W-wait, this kind of feels like I'm getting taken advantage of...!

You think I'd just sit there and listen to your sentimental... M-my katana?! When'd you get your hands on that?! Give it back! Please, I'll do anything you say! ...Fine, I admit defeat... Ughh, but... this somehow doesn't feel all that bad...
Since you put so much thought into this, I'll take it.
Hmm, I don't think we're going to get along...

ex.line: Oh, it's you. What are we going to do today- G-give my katana back! Y-you're training me to get used to not having it...? Whyyy?!
What a pain... Cleaning is such a chore... Hey, Commander, since you're here, mind helping me tidy up?
If it's about that fight earlier, we could've just slugged it out. What's the point of dragging the issue back to the dinner table? Ugh...
I think I should leave this backup sword with you... I mean, just in case... Just in case I drop mine, it'll be a huge help to have you around...
It's time to make rice balls! You should have some too! Do I love white rice so much because of my name?! ...What are you, stupid?
Wh-what are you doing?! Stop! Please stop that already!
F-fine, it's not like I can beat you anyway... Hyaah?!
Y-yes?! I'm here! P-please don't eat me...?! D-don't sneak up on me when I don't have my weapon...
Wh-what is it? Oh, the commission fleet is back? ...W, wait, don't pull on me! At least let me grab my katana... Ahem. Anyway, let's get going.

lines.line: All righty, one freshly-sliced plate of sashimi coming right up! ...Huh? I'm coming across too aggressive? Even after I went through all this trouble for you, you still have something to nitpick about? ...Well, whatever. Enjoy your meal!

All righty, one freshly-sliced plate of sashimi coming right up! ...Huh? I'm coming across too aggressive? Even after I went through all this trouble for you, you still have something to nitpick about? ...Well, whatever. Enjoy your meal!
Uhhh, oh no... This tingling, anxious feeling... Eek? Oh, my katana... Thanks for that... Ahem! Commander, let's hurry up and get to work!
Thanks to my little friends here, the kitchen is nice and tidy. Well, not that I mind if things are a little messy. Ahaha!
Huh? You got a problem with the great Hakuryuu's cooking, you scallywag? ...Oh, you ran out of sashimi? Got it. I'll serve you right up.
Huh? My blade isn't cut out for kitchen work? You, stop that snickering this instant! Your jaw's gonna hit the floor when you see my magnificent bladework!
Oi, you plan on watching all day or are you gonna come help me? Knowing you, I'm sure you've got what it takes!
NOBODY TOUCHES THE KATANA!! ...Oh, sorry. Got a little carried away there. Did I scare you?
Do you want this blade of mine to turn you into fine filets?
Did another order come in just now? Heh. I'll take care of it.
All done with your missions? Good timing, I just finished prepping the order.
A new letter? ...No way, are we getting challenged to a cooking duel?
*grumble*... Oh, hey you, perfect timing! C'mere and help me think up some new recipes!

Katana... at the ready. Hmph, you again? Never expected you to know anything about music, the way you've been out there conquering the waves with us this whole time. Come then, let me test how good your tastes are with this song!

Katana... at the ready. Hmph, you again? Never expected you to know anything about music, the way you've been out there conquering the waves with us this whole time. Come then, let me test how good your tastes are with this song!
Heh, how'd you like that piece? Oh, you're so awed by my skill that you're speechless, huh? Yeah?
Now this is fancy, even for a banquet venue. Heh... You already know those drunkards are going to ruin the place. Whole lot of wasted effort, don't you think?
F-forget about my katana! Just focus on the song I'm playing! Got it?!
What? I'm being too loud? Hmph, you're just as much of an unrefined ruffian as I thought. We may fight on the battlefield often, but never forget to improve your tastes!
Think I'd like a drink... Tch, we don't have any proper appetizers to go with booze, do we? Fine. I'm going out shopping.
♪~ Try and guess what song that was. ...No, it was not improvised!
My katana isn't there, either! ...That's not why you touched me?!
Wh-wh-where did my katana go?! I can't play music like this... H-hmph! You're bold, trying to take advantage of my moment of weakness! Well, I won't fall victim to your schemes!
Our commission team is back? Bring them here. I'll play a piece for you and them.
Hahahaha! Now THIS is a sword worthy of my hands! Perfect blade, perfect hilt, perfect cut - only a master of their craft could make such a beauty! Come on, let's see what this blade can do!
Hahahaha! Now THIS is a sword worthy of my hands! Perfect blade, perfect hilt, perfect cut - only a master of their craft could make such a beauty! Come on, let's see what this blade can do!
What's the matter? Intimidated by my raw aura? Hahaha, you won't be taking my katana from me today!
My katana is right here in my hands - you're too late to hide it from me! ...You weren't going to? As if I'd believe that now!
The dragon carving, my name engraved into it... Truly, this was made just for me. Heh, I must thank you!
Tamahagane must be hammered hundreds of times to forge a mighty blade. Don't forget your daily exercise! ...You think it's okay to take today off because you're halfway there? I-is that how it works?
Hmm? If you want to touch it, then go ahead... Ack! You almost tricked me, damn it!
Again, you can't have it... H-hey, that was no fair!
Any missions I can test my weapon on? ...Find one myself? But you're the one receiving the assignments, not me!
The rewards... too valuable to waste, huh? Tch. I'll go find a hay bale, or something.
Wipe off the oil, apply whetstone powder... Just as a sword needs maintenance, you need regular rest. Quit your complaining and take a break!
The commission team has returned, eh? Heheh, let's go show them my blade!
I will cut them all down with one swing!
Where's my katana... Huh? You brought it for me? Th-thank you...

A katana isn't just a weapon - it is a warrior's very heart. That should tell you why all the girls at port treasure their own weapons so much. If you ever get the opportunity to forge a sword... heh, your first one will be all mine!
Y-you! How dare you make me wear... "I thought it would look good on you, and your current outfit is too breezy"?! What nonsense! I can wear whatever I want in my room! ...Achoo?!
Y-you! How dare you make me wear... "I thought it would look good on you, and your current outfit is too breezy"?! What nonsense! I can wear whatever I want in my room! ...Achoo?!
Are you here to tease me again? I told you, I'm not wearing it! No matter how much you want to see it... G-give my katana back! Fiiine, I'll wear it!
It's not like me to tidy up? Hmph! What fool would make a mess of their room a short few days after moving in?! My katana? Where... Where is it?!
Achoo?! Ugh... I think my room is too cold. I-I'd rather turn off the AC or whatever than wear THAT!
My katana's right here! Heh, those kinds of tricks don't work on me anymore! ...Yeah, you got a problem with the room being too small to hide it?! Is that the whole reason you're here?!
A true warrior cares not for appearances. Cut down your enemy and win the day - that's what matters. You must understand this, surely.
Now that you mention it, the size really does... Did you get my measurements perfectly just by looking?
D-don't grab out of nowhere!
The room feels cramped? You clearly don't see the value of this sunlight! It is a bit rough in the summer, yes, but it's just fine if you can handle that!
Achoo! Tch... I only need my katana!
Tch... No wonder I felt weak!
Hmph. If that's what you want... I'm even LESS likely to wear it! I'll go naked before I... Achoo?! You're scared I'll catch a cold? Why didn't you say that sooner?!
Large cruiser - Ägir.

I am Ägir, named after the very same mythological ruler of the sea. Though, compared to a god who smote adversaries with storms and crashing waves, my way of dealing with my enemies is much more subdued. Ahahaha.
Well met. I am large cruiser Ägir. Your will is my command. Hehehe... Now let's find out what you can accomplish with my arsenal of talents.
Who might it be that just stepped through those doors? ...Oh, it's you. Best of luck with your work, then.
My serpents have a tendency for violence, so be aware of the risk should you dare to touch me, Commander.
Insufficiently motivated, are we? A dinner with copious amounts of beer can fix that.
You like gazing at seas in tempest too, do you? Hahaha. A sea is at its truest when a storm rages through it.
...What? You have that look on your face like I'm distracting you.
...What?!
Would you like it... if I came a bit closer?
You're brave, I'll give you that... What?! Twice in a row?!
I see we still have unfinished missions. Do them now, and I shall refrain from dismissing you as incapable.
Mission complete. I suppose you are at least qualified for your position.
A letter has arrived from afar. Read it, would you?
You wish to rest, do you? I'm afraid the heap of soon-due paperwork on your desk won't allow it.
A commission has been completed. How long must your subordinates wait for you to acknowledge them, hmm?
Prosit. The occasion warrants a toast. Mmh!
I shall tear you asunder! Ahahahaha!
Those fools were but splashes of water beneath my bow. Hahaha... Ahahahahaha!
Nobody, and I mean NOBODY denies me my victory! I shall return with a vengeance!
Ahahahahaha! Be engulfed by my maelstrom!
Caught on to me, have you...
You are undisciplined trash not worthy of my compassion.
My interests in life? Hahaha! Fighting worthy foes, savoring good beer, gazing at the stormy seas, and... What? Are you grasping at straws just to get my attention?
I'm going for a drink, and you shall accompany me, Commander. Get as drunk as you wish. I'll overlook whatever silly things you say while under the influence.
I don't mind your efforts to win my interest, but must you stare holes through me? Hehe. I suppose you're more daring when drunk... W-wait, you aren't drunk?!
You're in over your head if you thought you could drink one named after the god of the sea under the table. What's the matter? Can't move a muscle? Then I've proven my- Eek!

A symbol of our marriage? You must adore having proof of the ties that bind you to me. Prepare to double down, then. I'll find something that binds you to me. Physically... Hahaha! You shall see what I mean.
You understand me better than I thought. I'm impressed.
If you would, do mind your manners.
We shall drink later, but now, we must fight.

ex.line: You're finally here. I've compiled a task schedule for you, so give it a look. What? Is there an issue?
It feels like my little dragon has behaved well lately. Did you do something to it? ...Its owner has simply mellowed out? W-watch your tongue!
While I do enjoy the parties where we drink to our hearts' content... they just aren't the same without you. Be sure to be there next time.
Just as the seas are stormy at times, they are calm at others. Calm like me in this moment, enjoying a relaxing lull... And you're here. That's positive, I suppose.
Staring as intently as you are will distract anyone, even me! At least save it until work is finished! Ugh! Did I make a secretarial error in that document or what?!
Hey! Why are you enjoying this so much?
Oh? Mind yourself, lest the stormy seas swallow you.
Again?! Th-that's my...!
In light of your efforts, I will do your task for you. Sit over there and have a rest. Heehee.
Cheers, Commander! Ahh!
Did you see that? THAT is the divine might of the deeps! Ahahahaha!

Isn't it time you conceded victory to me? I have completely and utterly dominated you, have I not? Your eyes and your racing heart do not lie. Heehee... Eek! H-hold it! I will never be conquered by the likes of you!

lines.line: Hmph. They think being a maid is so difficult, do they? I could do this with my eyes clo- What?! H-how long have YOU been here?!
Hmph. They think being a maid is so difficult, do they? I could do this with my eyes clo- What?! H-how long have YOU been here?!
You again. Ahem... Good morning, Mast- Never mind, I'm not doing it!
Do you expect ME to do your paperwork? Who do you take me for - a desk jockey? ...Besides, you're taking it for granted that I'm cut out for the task!
Damned manjuu... You're in my way! Move! What do you think you'll achieve by being stuck under me?
Would one call cleaning a part of the banquet preparations? The hall will be a mess by end of it anyway, so why bother?
Damn you, August... I do NOT take kindly to being treated as a maid! ...Are you even listening?
...Hwuh?!
What the-?! I'll have you know I never volunteered for this position!
Mission complete. Now go claim the rewards.
I estimated you'd be back around this time, so I prepared tea and a snack. My work here is done... right?
A commission is done. I hope you're not considering sending ME out to meet the team...

New decorations, new outfits, and countless preparations to make... Lunar New Year is quite the busy time of year. Go on, see to your duties. I'm well aware how essential you are to this holiday's smooth operation. Just don't keep me waiting all day. Heehee.

New decorations, new outfits, and countless preparations to make... Lunar New Year is quite the busy time of year. Go on, see to your duties. I'm well aware how essential you are to this holiday's smooth operation. Just don't keep me waiting all day. Heehee.
You're back. Heheh, missed me, did you? Or are you just tired?
I heard the Dragon Empery regards their namesake dragon as sacred... Then why is its sign merely the 5th ordinal in their zodiac?
How does one hold a brush? Like this? Or like... this? Ugh... I refuse to believe you don't know the proper technique. Stop gawking and come show me!
So that's what their dragon dance is like... When I first heard of it, I thought they would use a dragon-like rigging, similar to what we have in the Iron Blood.
Brünhilde, is this bowl an Empery antique of yours? I must admit, the workmanship is remarkable. Hmph, I suppose you do have a refined taste.
Don't you touch my horn ornaments without my permission!
Go on a stroll together, you say? I could do that... But first, put my heels on my feet, would you?
Wha-?! You made me spill ink everywhere! I, I'll clean it up myself!
All these missions leave you with no time to enjoy the holiday... That is unacceptable. Hmph, I'll assist you with them.
Mission complete. You may now concentrate on celebrating.
Even lords of the sea need to rest. Why don't you sit down and enjoy the soothing aroma in the air?
That commission is done. Now go. Those girls deserve some appreciation for working on a holiday.
Well, I'm pleasantly surprised. A comfortable seat, high-quality beverages, and a nice private room... Hm? Are you going to stand there the whole day? Don't just stare at me like that...
Well, I'm pleasantly surprised. A comfortable seat, high-quality beverages, and a nice private room... Hm? Are you going to stand there the whole day? Don't just stare at me like that...
The seas have calmed, and no one can disturb us here. You should enjoy this moment of respite to its fullest.
Come on, get over here and help me with- Eek! Wh-why are you touching me there?! Eek!
Oh? You want to have a drink with me? You're forthcoming, for once... Probiotic yogurt? Because it's good for your health? Come on, you must have something better than that!
It's warming up in here. Perhaps I should take off my jacket... O-oh, you're taking yours off, too?
You want to sit next to me, do you? There's too little room for the both of us to... Hey!
Hm? What are you doing?
Wish to borrow my jacket?
Again?! You don't need to keep doing this just because we're alone...
Are you really hell-bent on doing missions during your break time? I'll give you a hand, so get them done quickly.
Mission complete. Now let us pour some drinks and get comfortable! Oh... A shame we only have drinks suited for children.
Tired? Do you want to sit upon this couch? Hah, I don't mind giving it up for... Hm? Where have my shoes gone?
Commission rewards have arrived. Are you going to examine the haul?
Are you really content to merely stand and watch after I calmed the raging seas for you? Ugh... I had a hunch... Just this once, I permit you to do as you please with me.
Aircraft carrier - August von Parseval.
Tis I, August von Parseval, Iron Blood aircraft carrier. I am but a vessel, but I am also the chains that bind you. Remember this, my familiar. Or should I say, "Commander?"
You've finally come, my familiar... Pardon, my "commander." I am the Unhulde, August von Parseval. 'Tis a pleasure to meet you.
Quiet, you... Your arrival has merely made my aide a little wary. Pay it no mind.
Yes, resist me. I look forward to seeing your reaction when you realize that all your struggling has been for naught.
What does being my familiar entail? You shall learn in due time.
You're awfully quiet... Have you given up already? Obedience does not amuse me.
I can read you like an open book when you stare at me, Commander.
Are you... disobeying me?
What do you seek to learn from the Unhulde?
You let your urges take control of you... Fine. Revel in the bliss of your inevitable, pathetic defeat.
I can't imagine you'll falter in the face of such simple trials. Or "missions," as you call them.
"Mission" complete. Congratulations. Another small step towards that alluring, dangerous climax.
There's a letter for you. I command you to read it at once.
I bid you welcome back, Commander. Well fought. I await the day you work up the courage to challenge me.
Your commission team underlings have returned. You know what to do now, yes?
Improving the base principles.
Bow before me!
I've achieved the victory you desired. It wasn't so hard.
For every victor, there must also be a loser...
There is no escaping me.
Tis too soon to start mourning for me.
I have nothing to say to those who cannot fight.
