To indulge in the sweet sap of sloth, or to swallow the bitter medicine of hard work? The choice is yours alone to make, Commander.
Zeppelin and I both know what you are. An insignificant insect, trying to defy your destiny. Having said that... I believe a soul like you isn't meant to blindly accept their destiny.
I enshackled you precisely so you'd want to rebel and make me submit to you. Why, you ask? Because I've been drawn to you all along. Now show me that fearsome potential that sleeps within you.
People cannot say no to their hearts. Much like I cannot refute my love for you, you cannot deny your feelings for me. That is the link that binds us together.

So you seized the chance to subjugate me first. Yes, you are at your brightest when you kick and scream in the cage known as love. Allow yourself to be bound to me and amuse me for all eternity... Darling.
I have to thank you for putting a smile on my face.
You seem like you'd know a thing or two about magic.
Your strength is worthy of admiration.
Show me the face of the Finale.

ex.line: So you've come, Commander. My aide has long since noticed your presence - but this time, she's not the restless one.
Do I seem gentler than usual? Maybe so. When I saw that look on your face, I couldn't help but want to be a little sweeter to you.
Come and embrace me until I'm satisfied. Or else... you may be subjected to my more "magical" methods.
Oh? Instead of running away, you're coming right to me for a hug? I can't wait to see what surprises you have in store...
I like it when your eyes are focused on me. Ah... I'm not asking you to look at me - I'm DEMANDING it, my dear.
Today... I'd like to be the kind of Unhulde who isn't so bothered by a few head pats.
Are you ready to receive my teachings, Commander?
Would it make this more fun if I struggled? Okay... Let's take turns trying it.
Right on schedule. You know not to keep the Unhulde waiting.
An eternal vow has tied our souls and our destinies together, never to be unbound. Struggle as you might, the fetters of love will only entwine ever tighter.

lines.line: My hair is a mess... There we go. No, I don't need a hand. I am here to serve you in this fleeting dream of yours. Enjoy it while it lasts. Hehehe.
My hair is a mess... There we go. No, I don't need a hand. I am here to serve you in this fleeting dream of yours. Enjoy it while it lasts. Hehehe.
There you are, my familiar... and "Master." I'm curious to see how you'll attempt to defy and make use of me today.
Order me around as you please. A lowly maid deserves no pity or modesty from her defiant conqueror.
You will never subjugate me if you get complacent in your temporary position. You desire permanence, but we shall inevitably return to the status quo.
I know your disposition, Master. Simply watching from a distance does not satisfy you.
You did not conquer me. I simply chose to "lose" to you. Hehehe~♡
Mgh... Yes, do whatever you please...
Yes, "Master"...?
Yes, use your maid to satisfy all your desires, "Master."
Check... your mail...
Welcome back, "Master." You may give me any order you desire... Anything you want...
This new power is no dream.
Keep on struggling through this ceaseless dream.
This is the victory you wished for, "Master." Hehehe.
I suppose my unfamiliarity with this role is to blame.
You've come, my familiar. I wondered when you'd awake from your... Hm? A little nicer than usual? Yes, because even I have my moments of placidness. Would you prefer that I was more harsh to you?
You've come, my familiar. I wondered when you'd awake from your... Hm? A little nicer than usual? Yes, because even I have my moments of placidness. Would you prefer that I was more harsh to you?
Here you are, my fitting familiar, amidst the bright sunlight... Now, allow the Unhulde to enjoy her moment. Naturally, you have no right to object.
While I do not personally grant you this sunlight and moment of reprieve, I allow you to enjoy it beside me.
What are your plans for the day? You may as well try to resist me and amuse me when you eventually submit.
You know that I can read your mind when you stare at me, and yet you continue doing it... What, I wonder, has caught your eye?
Oh? It's "unbecoming" of me to style my hair with my own hands? Then you shall do it for me, my familiar.
Will you try to pass this off as a "massage"?
*sigh*... Are you raring to struggle again, as you did yesterday?
You should have completed that mission and returned sooner, Commander.
Of course. This is your reward, my familiar. Is there anything else you wish for?
Heehee... Surely you have the time to at least open a letter.
Welcome back. Though I'm not getting changed just yet, do not take this as laziness on my part. Remember that you are in no position to order me around.
A commission has been completed? Then it's time to issue your next orders.
This shirt? Why, yes, it's the same one that you wore yesterday. What of it? Isn't it only to be expected that you as my familiar offer me a nightly tribute?
Welcome to the Unhulde's secret garden, my familiar. I have prepared this night banquet for you alone. Now then... if you would please step forth.
Welcome to the Unhulde's secret garden, my familiar. I have prepared this night banquet for you alone. Now then... if you would please step forth.
You revealed yourself at the appropriate time. Such an obedient little familiar... Now that the banquet's guests of honor are here, the stars have begun to shine for you.
The moonlight glitters on the water's surface, and even the final ripple peters out into a lull. Take my hand. The Unhulde's ceremony is about to begin.
Have you forgotten? In order to dance with the Unhulde, you must first make the appropriate preparations. It seems my familiar is a touch impatient.
My dress is beautiful, you say? Shouldn't those eyes of yours be focusing on something more valuable than my attire? Heehee.
I am satisfied with you tonight. You may have this dance as a reward... I ask that you decide when it ends.
You will put more tension into those arms and hold me tightly... that's right. Very good.
Do what you will in the Unhulde's garden. It won't make a difference.
The ceremony cannot continue until you are finished with your "missions."
I knew you would return. Heehee... Not even you can escape the Unhulde's clutches.

You have done well tonight, my familiar. The lights of this secret garden will shine for you for all eternity, and I shall wait for you here on each night that the stars twinkle. Do not keep me waiting too long.
Battleship - Marco Polo.
I am Marco Polo, Sardegnian battleship. Compare me with Veneto if you so wish, but just for the record: I could do her job much better. Ohohoho!

I hope you know what you're in for, now that you've awoken me. Hehehe... You look to be a commander of valor and culture. Magnificent! I am Marco Polo. Now, come! Our first order of business is to spread the Sardegna Empire's glory through the world!
So you've come prepared to sacrifice a portion of your time on this mortal coil in the name of productivity? Magnificent!
I don't mind you acting as my own Rustichello. In fact, I adore having someone who chronicles my life. Oh, but please do omit my mistakes!
All things of value are bound to fall into someone's hands, sooner or later. Better it be yours than someone else's.
The golden Dragon Empery... I have countless stories of it to share if you'll only lend me an ear!
Looking at the map... This port is unbelievably small. Has the thought of expanding it never crossed your mind?
I've been meaning to ask... Why do you always behave so childishly?
For what have I been summoned?
Tsk! Such boorish behavior...
New missions? Be magnificent and get them done in a jiffy, okay? Chop-chop.
You've finished those chores? Magnificent! Now we can focus on more important matters.
A letter of surrender from our enemies? Then allow me to establish our terms.
I believe the secretary should have the power to issue commands. Only while you're away, of course.
The commission team has returned. Take it from me, you really ought to venture out with them to see the sights of the world more often.
The greater one's strength, the more privileges one is entitled to. You know this, yes? Magnificent!
Soldiers, weigh anchor! For the glory of Sardegna!
They're surrendering already? So... We won? What pathetic adversaries we have.
You wretches... I will inflict this humiliation back at you a hundred times over!
Bow before my might!
Danger is an opportunity! Have at you!
If not for your position, I would've sent you away to... Never you mind. Hmph!
Oh? You're approaching me? Instead of keeping me at arm's length, you wish to get to know me? Then by all means... Hehehe!
You possess insight and views superior to those of commonplace boors. But, as it stands, you could use some more... well, ambition.
You command a whole fleet of ships, and you don't even try to use them to spread the Empire's- I mean, your own glory? It truly baffles me.
You! What is the deal with you? I never said you should "spread the glory of Marco Polo's name!" You... You... You're too ambitious for your own good!
A woman with great aspirations doesn't let commitments bind her. But... for you, I'll make an exception. And don't you dare vanish on me until your ambitions are realized!
I graciously accept this sincere gift of yours. Heheheh!
A leader who second-guesses herself is no leader at all.
For the glory of the Empire!

ex.line: Come, Commander, let us achieve magnificent things together in our sugar-sweet days. I can hardly wait to begin!

You wish to add a new chapter to the life story of Marco Polo? Magnificent. So, what will you write? You simply must include my ambition, of course... but you might wish to add something about our ordinary days of love as well!
Your talents are wasted on that trifling paperwork! The real battlefield is not here, but out there! We really need to be applying our efforts to formulating expansion and changing the game!
My domain is your domain, and my status is your status. In other words, they are the result of our combined efforts! How magnificent!
How strange... I haven't had a single response to the collaboration plan I put out. Did I overestimate their efficiency?
Does this please you? Very well. Do as you wish.
Have you thought of a way to achieve our ambitions? Not yet? Hehehe... What perfect timing, for I have an idea to share right now!
You know, no matter how much time passes, you always - Mngh?!
I organized today's work while you were absent. And now let's finish them together! For this is the responsibility we share!

It was always my dream to conquer all I laid my eyes upon. However, I have now found a magnificent dream that will bring me even greater satisfaction. That's right. It is to carve the name of Marco Polo onto everything you do and accomplish!

lines.line: Me? Serve as your maid? Oho! That's more like it, Commander! How magnificent and ambitious of you! ...Only temporarily? And you're content with that?
Me? Serve as your maid? Oho! That's more like it, Commander! How magnificent and ambitious of you! ...Only temporarily? And you're content with that?
Hm-hm~♪ Have you no orders for your maid? You're hardly the authoritative master I'd imagined.
I've been told many desire to be in a position where they can give you hands-on assistance - like a maid does. Which is to say: I am envied by everyone around me. Hehehe, hehehehe~
Interested to learn a trick, Anchorage? Watch this card... Tadah! It's gone! Oh, silly Commander. A magician never reveals her secrets.
I wonder how many maids our port has... And of them, how many are assigned to the Commander's office and personal quarters... Stop it, Marco! There's no point in pondering that question!
Is it not a maid's duty to issue a slap on the wrist when her master procrastinates? Hehehe! How magnificent that you understand!
Routine tasks, making meals, greeting guests, filing paperwork, hatching plans, doing battle... I can perform anything you require!
Hwaaah?!
You've been given new missions. Fascinating how announcing that is part of a maid's duties...
I've left your letter right over there. It's as easy to reach as possibly can be.
Where, oh where is my master who refuses to delegate work to a maid? Here, I've taken these duties upon myself in your stead.
The commission team has returned. Someone must receive them, but who?
Acting on the Commander's behalf, I raise a toast to this victory!
Welcome to Marco Polo's magic show! Make sure you watch closely, Commander, and pay attention! Don't get too engrossed in the entertainment, now! Ooohohoho!
Welcome to Marco Polo's magic show! Make sure you watch closely, Commander, and pay attention! Don't get too engrossed in the entertainment, now! Ooohohoho!
What do you think? There's nothing to it, even when I'm stuck inside a box and immobile. Now, will you engage in this thrilling challenge with me?

How strange... The box's hidden door won't open. Keep your composure, Marco Polo. You can't afford to show any weakness... Just strike a pose before the Commander realizes there's something amiss! Nrk! My arm's gone to sleep!
Time to perform a miracle... Heehee! Well, Commander, did my perfect finale blow you away?
Mmgh! Nnngh! A problem with the stage? That's impossible - I'm Marco Polo! This interval is the perfect thing to add a little excitement to my performance! I have everything under control!
This is an intriguing outfit, don't you think? Oh? It suits me, does it? Say, why are you looking at me like that?
I-I'm in the middle of my performance! What about my hat? There's nothing hidden underneath it!
It's just a little trick. You have nothing to be afraid of... Now, hurry up and come in!
Now that you have dared to come this close, I... I won't let you get away!
Come, Commander, forget about any hidden doors and focus on my show. Perhaps if you watch carefully from right up close, you might be able to see through the trick.
Did you see that? My magnificent performance!
That's quite some nerve you have. You know my objective is not as simple as it seems, yet you still chose to approach. I'm going to find it even harder to let you go than ever before!
Light Cruiser—Plymouth
I am the blueprint ship Plymouth, an alternate branch of the Edinburgh class. I give my thanks to you for manifesting me in this port. Please, use me as you see fit.

I offer my greetings to you who has manifested me, Commander. I am the blueprint ship, Plymouth. Starting here and now, I stand ready to execute your every order. May you rejoice in our blessed encounter.
Rejoice, dear Commander, for this morning is most refreshing. How shall we start our day?
A pleasure to see you today. I hope to spend another wonderful day with you today, dear Commander. Mhm, quite the reason to rejoice.
Oh, do be careful now... Miss Edinburgh, it seems that the rumors of your clumsiness were... not greatly exaggerated.
Did you need some papers disposed of. *BOOM* ...There you go. Rejoice, for I have turned your troubles into a pile of ash!
Having trouble focusing on your work? Well, I suppose I could tell you a fairy tale. A long, long time ago...
Your hand feels most pleasing upon my head. Thank you.
You'd like to hear me sing? Then, please tell me what you'd like to hear—if it's something I don't already know, I'm willing to learn.
Yes, do as you please with me. As long as it makes you rejoice, dear Commander.
A new mission has arrived, Commander. Allow me to- Hmm? You're going to do it yourself?
The mission rewards are here. Let's open it—it'll be destroyed if I fire a shell at it? Understood.
Rejoice, dear Commander, for new mail has arrived.
Rejoice, dear Commander—I have come to bring you a full-course Sardegnian meal. ...It's too heavy, you say?
A commission has been completed. Let us rejoice now, dear Commander.
Strength flows through me. Rejoice, dear Commander, for I have become "easier to use."
I shall take you on.
Victory is ours. Rejoice, dear Commander.
So this is the taste of defeat, Commander. How repugnant.
Please excuse me.
I'm ashamed to show you my unsightly side...
Rejoice, dear Commander, for you can still turn to me for help now.
You may rely on me more, Commander. After all, my duty is to help you help everyone.
I don't know too much about the Royal Maid Corps. Since I support you just as they do, there should not be much difference in our positions. Do you agree, dear Commander?

Rejoice, dear Commander, for I shall be assisting the Royal Maids today. ...With the assistance of my colleagues, I shall be able to support you to an even greater capacity -a reason to rejoice indeed.

Commander, are there any wishes you'd like to have fulfilled today? I am no longer here just to support you. Should you desire, I shall assist you, serve you, and of course, love you... Rejoice, dear Commander, for there is nothing I will not do for your sake.

Rejoice, dear Commander! Starting today, I shall become your exclusive-use shipgirl! By exclusive, I mean special... Basically, I've become someone special to you, so can I stop looking after you today and just rejoice for myself? Heehee~
I want you to be pleased, Commander, because you've made me very happy.

ex.line: Rejoice, dear Commander, for today is yet another wonderful day. Please feel free to ask anything of me.
A pleasure to see you today. As you can see, I am currently partaking in a tea party with my esteemed colleagues. Why don't you join us? Let's find you a seat... How about in my lap?
"Please leave everything to me, Master." ...How was my impression of Belfast? Hehehe.
Commander, while you look for those documents, why don't I tell you a story? That might help you focus.
How about reading a book for a change of pace? I don't mind lending you something from my personal collection. Mhm, please rejoice.
Hmmhm~♪ Please make your next song request! Ask anything of me.!
You don't need to hold back, dear Commander.
The mission rewards are right here. Other than carrying them back, is there anything else I can help with?
Commander, how do the refreshments look? I made a light snack set for you today. Well then, please help yourself!
What would you have me do, dear Commander?
Was this victory worthy of rejoicing? If not, I shall seek out another foe.

lines.line: Rejoice, Commander. I have no doubt that this refreshing sensation will bring you the utmost satisfaction. Come, let us enjoy this experience together.
Rejoice, Commander. I have no doubt that this refreshing sensation will bring you the utmost satisfaction. Come, let us enjoy this experience together.
Rejoice, dear Commander, the sun's rays shine as splendidly as usual — which means, it's a perfect day for a soak in the pool.

Are you satisfied after seeing me in my swimsuit? If you'd like to see me in another outfit, just give me your order. W-whether it's a maid outfit, or a bunny girl outfit... as long as it makes you rejoice...?
Dear Commander, if you are feeling restless, might I recommend taking a dip with me in the refreshing water?
You want some song suggestions? Well, if you're fine with the kind of screamo Miss Ulrich has been showing me, then... Oh, I don't need to sing it for you?
Will you be swimming? Then let me make the pool larger... Excuse me, would you mind getting out of range of my main battery? Oh... Dearie me.
Sure, let's laze around together.
Revel in me. Rejoice to your heart's content, dear Commander.
The mission rewards have arrived. Rejoice, dear Commander.
Good work on your mission. Is there anything you'd like me to get for you, dear Commander? Since we're at the pool, how about... some toys, some fruits, and some wine? How does that sound?
This is rather embarrassing, but...
Be it the cooling waves or the taste of victory, please indulge as much as you'd like, dear Commander.
Battlecruiser - Prinz Rupprecht.

I'm Prinz Rupprecht, Iron Blood blueprint ship. It's my way or the highway. Hmph, obviously I get to act high and mighty because I AM high and mighty. I don't HAVE to follow your orders, they are merely suggestions to me!
Ooh, so you're the self-proclaimed Commander, huh... Hmph! Commander of what, exactly? From now on, I shall be the one issuing commands around here! Now, hurry along~♪
You're late! What excuse do you have to keep ME waiting? Do you WANT me to send you packing?
Tuning my rigging should just take a little... Whoa, calm down! Heed my damn command! ...You! Stop gawking and help me! It's only the obvious thing to do!
A tea party? Who went and decided I have to spend my time on that? If anything, YOU should be spending time with ME♪
...Oh, this sweet candy? I got it from a destroyer. And no, you can't have any.
You can't even do this no-brainer work? And you seriously call yourself the Commander? ...Things would be better if I had your position.
Blep!
What's that you're staring at? Hand it over. I want to see it for myself.
Eek! Don't touch me!
Missions, eh... Do them yourself. I'm above all that busywork.
Mission rewards! I've claimed them in my na- What the hell! This is just a list!
A letter... Nothing I'd care about, it seems.
Look who's back. I suppose you have your moments as the Commander♪
The commission team has returned. I wonder what tributes they've brought me.
It's the obvious choice, because I am the strongest♪
Victory will be mine!
Me being the MVP is such an obvious outcome I don't even feel happy about it.
You're horribly mistaken if you think you'll get away with this!
Hahahaha! I'll squash you like bugs!
How?! But, I'm the strongest...!
Get out of my sight. You're an eyesore.
You should be thankful that someone such as myself would even deign to call a complete nobody like you "Commander."
Hmph. I've taken a slight interest in you since I can see a smidge of potential within you. Then again, that much should be obvious given that I call you "Commander."

You belong to no one but me, Prinz Rupprecht. That should be obvious, seeing as how I have acknowledged you as "Commander." Do you have a problem with being mine? Too bad - you've never had and never will have the right to object!
You don't want to be mine? You have some nerve, you impudent cretin. You are mine, full stop. I don't give a damn what anyone else says! You belong to me, and that's that!

Marriage? What are you talking about? This is an act of insolence on your part, one-sidedly hoping I'll exchange vows with you. Obviously, it's my choice whether to accept or refuse... If you want my hand so badly, cry and plead for it one more time! And don't try to run away!
What a sweet tribute. It's mine now!
That dummkopf is mine, you hear?!

ex.line: You actually came out to see me - that's nice. Now get back to your chair and work harder♪
Just how weak are you if this little thing is too heavy for you? ...Heehee, I'll admit, your weakness is endearing♪ H-hey, don't go away! I'm sorry I said that, just stay with me!
Forget going to some random girl's tea party - You should host one just for me. Obviously I deserve it for all my work as your secretary!
I think I'll go part hunting in Bismarck's workshop... "Don't?" Excuse me, whose side are you on?!

You've done well, now enjoy some time off... I was just talking to myself. I don't care if you- Actually! Since you belong to me, you must take a break with me... Impudent little...! Stop working at once, you hear me?!
Yes? ...Don't call me over only to ignore me!
Wh-what?! Um... (*blushes*)
Mission rewards are here. Let's not forget what's yours is mine.
Head out and thank the girls? You go do it, then come right back. You're my property, so don't wander off without my permission.
The commission team is back♪ ...Now get out there and receive them!
Hahaha! Let them have it!
I'm the MVP♪ ...Look at me when I speak. Hey, I'm talking to YOU! Look at me and tell me how great I am!

You'll obviously do anything I tell you to since you belong to me, right? Because I've been shockingly nice by calling you "Commander," accepting your ring, and even going on dates with you! Now take my hand!

lines.line: Woah, so this is the Dragon Empery's "Spring Festival" that I've heard so much about. But, why are they celebrating it in the middle of winter? And you, Commander - why are you helping with such a grandiose... Whuah?! What was that noise?!

Woah, so this is the Dragon Empery's "Spring Festival" that I've heard so much about. But, why are they celebrating it in the middle of winter? And you, Commander - why are you helping with such a grandiose... Whuah?! What was that noise?!

So for the Spring Festival, a carp is needed as decoration, which then turns into a dragon... Doesn't make any sense to me. Besides, how in the world is a fish supposed to turn into... Whuah?! What the heck was that?!
You are mine, and that means everything you make is mine as well! Nom! ...What'd you call this candied fruit thing? "Tanghulu"? It's sour yet sweet, and surprisingly tasty...
Ägir mentioned a lion that dances in the air - I want to check it out... If I SAY it flies, then it FLIES, okay?! And you're going with me, obviously!
A red envelope? Are you that strapped for cash even though you run this place? ...Hm? You're giving it to me? I don't want it! Blep!
Here's what happens to idiots who don't pay attention to me! Hahaha! That's right, run in fear from my firecrackers!
Where did that cretin bumble off to... Hyeep?! D-don't just sneak up on me out of the blue!
D-don't you dare blame it on my dress!
They've changed my port so drastically I don't know what's what anymore... I should've stayed home since the Commander's away... Whuah?! C-Commander?!
Hmph! There's your victory! You'll obviously reward me for my efforts, yes?
They... beat us? They beat ME?! There's no way...

You belong to me, which obviously means you have a duty to amuse me! Understood, simpleton? You're to give me a full tour of the port's Spring Festival makeover! Hold my hand and show me around! That's your job!
You're late! I've been waiting ages for you! ...We never agreed to meet tonight? If I say we did, then we did! Anyway, you should feel bad! That's obvious!
You're late! I've been waiting ages for you! ...We never agreed to meet tonight? If I say we did, then we did! Anyway, you should feel bad! That's obvious!
First, you're coming with me to check out all the night attractions, then we'll go somewhere quiet, and then... Go on, come up with a route plan♪
You belong to me, so this amusement park also belongs to me! That obviously means I get to ride any attraction whenever I want! ...So, which one do you wanna go on?
The fireworks are nice to look at, but we could've done so much else if you'd come sooner... Blep!
I'm feeling kind of hungry... Speaking of which, do these stalls charge money? Can't YOU get food for free if you ask for it?
Ahahaha! Take this! *splash splash*
Wh-what do you think you're doing?!
New missions... Will you stick around if I help with them?
Go get the mission rewards already! They belong to me, so obviously you should be quick♪
I waited for you here this whole time. Why didn't I just ride something by myself? *whispering* Because I didn't wanna get lost... Shush, I said nothing! I waited here because I WANTED to!
Oh, the commission team is back. Someone should receive them... b-but that can wait, can't it?
I did it! Heheh, did you see that? You must have! ...See what? Me mopping the floor with them, duh!
Hmph! I can have all kinds of fun right here! I can swim in the pool, watch the fireworks, think about all the fun we're gonna have... F-forget that last one!
Light cruiser - Harbin.

The name's Harbin, light cruiser from the Dragon Empery. What, didn't expect to see me here? Ahaha, well, life is full of surprises. In any case, I don't plan on letting you down, and neither do my guns!

The name's Harbin, Dragon Empery light cruiser. You're the Commander of this joint? Hrmm... I like the look in your eyes, and your bod's not half-bad either... Good stuff! From now on, you're rollin' with me!
Mornin', Commander. Need help with anything today? There's no need to be shy - just say the word!
Commander, if there's anything on your mind, just lay 'em on me! Let's not beat around the bush.
Commander, want to cap off work with a bit of wine? Of course, you're free to drink something else. Gotta treat yourself right after a day of hard work, right?
Hai Tien's always sayin' stuff like "you are what you eat," but she's always guzzling down those chilis like it's nobody's business. If you ask me, the best food is whatever fills your belly.
Chen Hai's out there doing divinations on the cosmos before she makes her move, but I'm the complete opposite. Hit first, ask questions later! Hahaha!
If you have time to burn, wanna see one of my comedy skits? Hahaha, I've got quite a few little hobbies outside of fightin'.
Oho? You've got guts. Real punchable guts.
Another job, huh? Just leave it to me. I'll have everything sorted out for you.
Well done! I'll hand out the rewards, so you just worry about getting rested up.
I picked up the mail for you on the way here. Hurry up and take a look!
You must be tired from all that running around, right? Want me to help you relax? I can draw the bathwater for you, or give you a massage... You in?
Oh, it looks like our friends are back from their commission! Perfect timing, Commander, let's throw a welcoming banquet!
Hahaha! I'm itchin' for a fight!
Everyone, follow me!
Hmph, absolutely pathetic. Not even worthy of being my playthings.
Retreat now - I'll handle things over here!
See how you like this!
If you think you've got what it takes, come at me!
A soldier's failure dooms one, but a general's failure dooms the whole army. You're the Commander, so get your act together already!
If you're not busy, want to step out for a chat? Haha, there's nothing to be embarrassed about. The best way to get to know someone is to have a nice, long chat with them, right?

What do you do on your days off? I... like going out with my friends, I guess. Get some good food and drinks. It's a great change of pace! Oh right, since we have free time today, let's go do that right now!
Commander, c'mon, let's get going! Go where, you say? Lemme think... Oh yeah, how about looking for some enemies to beat the crap out of? It's dangerous? Hah, not when I'm by your side!

I've been thinking, Commander. You should totally become mine. We'll go through heaven and hell together, get drunk off glory and riches together, and if you're ever in danger, I'll be there to protect you. Now that's what you call a whirlwind romance! Ahaha!

Looks like you've already made up your mind. But, this venue isn't lively enough... Let's find an auspicious day and invite all our friends over for a huge banquet. I'm gonna invite everyone, so you better yell my name out to the world!
You're too kind. You're gonna make me blush! Hahahah!

ex.line: Mornin', Commander. Did you eat already? Hmm? My arm's too close to you? Pfft, who cares? We're already an item, right?
Commander, looks like work's not going too well right now - so, I brought some wine over. C'mon, tell me everything that's on your mind, alright?

I've been hearing for the longest time about how there are a handful of girls here who can hold their liquor. Turns out, it wasn't just empty talk... Commander, you've gotta bring me to the next drinking party!
I dropped by the Sardegnian dorms last time, and color me surprised when they showed me to a massive outdoor bath! They even invited me to bathe with them... Damn, that was awesome~
If only you also had rigging like me, I'd totally look forward to fighting alongside you. But since you're defenseless, you've no choice but to stay behind me for protection! Ahaha!
Even a girl like me has her charms, huh? Hahaha!
We've got another job coming up. Why not treat it as some light exercise? You'll get rusty if you sit at your desk all day.
Another job done. The two of us make an unstoppable duo. Let's keep up the pace and pick up the rewards as well.
Welcome back. I made a reservation with the place you love going to, so let's head over once you're done. Ah, right, why don't you cool down in the shower first?
The commission team is back. Let's take a look... Alrighty! I've got everything I need to make some tasty snacks!
I'll take up the front!
A crushing victory! Let's celebrate with a banquet when we get back home!
Heh... Even if I fall here, you're not laying a finger on my friends!

I heard that a "date" is a great way for two people to learn more about each other. Well, you choose the restaurant then, and I'll cover the bill. Let's treat ourselves to some kick-ass food and liquor! ...That's not it? Did I misunderstand something? I thought that's what it said in one of those novels...

lines.line: Pheeew! I just love blue skies and a fair ocean breeze. Since you're already here, Commander, set aside all the boring paperwork and business stuff, and come enjoy the waves!
Pheeew! I just love blue skies and a fair ocean breeze. Since you're already here, Commander, set aside all the boring paperwork and business stuff, and come enjoy the waves!
Commander, you've got some damn nerve makin' me wait... Hah! Hahaha! Got you! Long as you're here, I don't care!
It's cool. If you wanna look, go right ahead! I got this swimsuit just because I wanted you to see me in it, after all!
Are those the Four Unbreakables over there? Looks like they're buildin' a sand castle together... How about we make one of our own?
They say if you hold french fries on the beach, seagulls flock you. We brought french fries, right? Wanna give it a try?!
Look, I reserved this whole beach to be alone with you so that... Huh? The other girls will see? Damn... You've got it rough, bud.
Ooh, you wanna wrestle in the water? I'm not goin' easy on you! Take this!
Look at you, goin' for it out in the open... Yikes.
Mission rewards, huh? Aw damn, they gave us frozen watermelon! Now there's a stroke of luck. I was just thinkin' of how to cool down!
Take a hot bath, and you wanna stay in there a bit longer. Go in the ocean, and you wanna start swimming. See what I mean? When people go places, it changes the way they feel.
The commission team just got back. How about we invite them along? The more, the merrier!

Hey, there you are. Remember what I said about the two of us being partners in crime? Well, actions speak louder than words, so I reserved this whole cruise for just the two of us. Whaddya say? Sound good, partner?

Hey, there you are. Remember what I said about the two of us being partners in crime? Well, actions speak louder than words, so I reserved this whole cruise for just the two of us. Whaddya say? Sound good, partner?
Finally here, eh? I've been waiting for ages! Was I bored? Nah. I had a lot of fun thinkin' about how I could cook you... Ahahaha! I'm just kidding!
Commander? What's up? Let me buy you something you want! Can't believe you're being so modest with me, of all people... You see my credit card here? Use it as much as you want!
Commander, you haven't tried a salt and milk bath yet, have you? No idea what I'm talking about, huh? I'll do it for you next time I wash your back!

Money doesn't magically appear when you're born, and you can't take it with you when you die. What I'm saying is, use it while you can. If I can make you happy, then that's enough return on investment for me!
Hahaha, wanna go play poker? Yeah, fine by me! I'll deal and get you a few free wins!
Did my button come out? Is that a problem? ...Okay, if it bothers you that much, can you fix it for me?
Hah! I'm amazed you can do that in broad daylight. You wanna get cooked, friend?
Do you have new missions? Man, and I was just getting comfy... Nah. If you've got work to do, then let me help. Let's get it done quick!
Finished your missions? Great work! Wanna spar a bit after you rest?
Someone's looking chipper. You been having fun out there? Oh, if you saw something you like, tell me. I'll buy it for you!
The commission team's back. Go see 'em! ...Hm? You want me to come, too? Then let's get going right now!
Hahaha, as long as you're happy, I'm happy!
That all you got? Next time, bring someone a little stronger!

Heyo, Commander. Are you enjoying the luxuries of the cruise I bought us? Hahaha, hey, it's no big deal. If there's anything else you want, or if someone starts trouble with you, come to me! That's what love is all about, right?
Sorry to keep you waiting, Commander. So, how's my new look? It's got me a bit embarrassed... But, well, all that matters is that you like it.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Commander. So, how's my new look? It's got me a bit embarrassed... But, well, all that matters is that you like it.
About to start on today's work? If you need any help, feel free to ask. We're practically family at this point, so whatever happens, we'll deal with it together.
By the way, d'you reckon I'm any different right now compared to my usual self? For example... a little more feminine, or something?
Even the most passionate romances eventually become tamed by time... No, no! That simply can't be! Commander, for our next anniversary, let's do something crazy!
Commander, I know we promised to go through hell and high water together, but I don't want to put you through hardships. What if you get hurt? ...Ugh, emotions really are so complicated.
What kind of food are you in the mood for? I'll take you out to somewhere nice tomorrow! You're my lover now, so how could I let you dine on anything but the finest? Ahaha!
If you want me to stay here with you, know that I'm not going anywhere.
Oho? If you're this enthusiastic, I suppose I'll take you up on it~
We've got another job coming up. Why not treat it as some light exercise? You'll get rusty if you sit at your desk all day.
Another job done. The two of us make an unstoppable duo. Let's keep up the pace and pick up the rewards as well.
Geesh, just seeing you beaten and battered by the elements like that has me feeling bad for you, even if you don't think much of it. Hurry on in and take a warm shower, alright?
The commission team is back. Let's take a look... Alrighty! I've got everything I need to make some tasty snacks!
I'll take up the front!
A crushing victory! Let's celebrate with a banquet when we get back home!
Heh... Even if I fall here, you're not laying a finger on my friends!

I heard that a "date" is a great way for two people to learn more about each other. Well, you choose the restaurant then, and I'll cover the bill. Let's treat ourselves to some kick-ass food and liquor! ...That's not it? Did I misunderstand something? I thought that's what it said in one of those novels...
Aircraft carrier - Chkalov.

I'm blueprint ship Chkalov, Project 71B aircraft carrier. I'll do a good job as long as you pay me, and if I ever ask for something, you can expect something in return. I hope we can have a mutually beneficial relationship.
Introductions? Fine, fine... I'm Chkalov, Northern Parliament blueprint ship. That good enough? Let's get back to work then; it's a better use of time for both of us, right?
Oh, so you're a real workhorse. Suppose I'll really have to apply myself as your secretary then.
You're not just here to chat, are you? If you've got something important to say, spit it out. Just don't expect me to respond right away because I'm busy.
Ugh... Wish there was some vodka in here... Your office is so much stricter than my lab when it comes to rules and the like.
I'm curious - based on what criteria do you choose a secretary? Surely it's not just good looks? ...But if it is, don't be afraid to admit it♡
I'd appreciate it if you'd let me handle data analysis in addition to office work. Work is boring, but I can stick to it longer when it involves something I'm good at.
What's up? Want me to get you some coffee?
Need to vent some stress, do you? Heehee♡
Here are some mission instructions for you. I can do overtime if it's for science, but I'd rather not for this type of work.
Mission complete. Maybe I'll get to return to my lab early today...
Letter for you, Commander. Be sure to give it a read.
Back safe and sound, I see. Here's the after-action report with all the data sorted out. I'll leave the debriefing to you.
Commission complete. That's all she wrote. Nothing special.
Well, that's one way of doing it.
Sometimes, you have to get your hands dirty.
Done already? Then, let's get moving. We're not getting paid to stand around.
Tsk... I hate writing self-improvement reviews...
How's this?
You're making this harder than it needs to be...!
I'm actually curious as to how someone can keep failing over and over. You are an awful outlier.
I sleep in my lab on most nights. There are some places to lie down, and for dinner you can always just order home delivery. Why don't you stay sometime, Commander?
Ah! ...Another blackout. Yeah, it's a problem with my lab, not the port itself. All my tinkering has made the power really unstable. Just make yourself at home and wait for the lights to come back.
You're more courageous than I took you for, Commander. What do I mean? Well, you know just how risky it is to be alone with me in this place... don't you?

I'll be frank with you. I find you fairly... no, VERY fascinating, Commander. You're the one who leads the shipgirls at this port. It's not often someone gets the chance to closely examine you from the inside and out, wouldn't you say? Heehee♡

A ring, huh... So you'll be indebted to me if I accept it - is that right? Then I'll gladly take it. Sharing a special relationship with you works out nicely... because it makes it easier to examine your mind and body♡
A gift? Don't get mad if I use this for an experiment, ok?

ex.line: I've been waiting for you. Today's schedule includes office work, your examination, and... I think that's it. Want to go for lunch once we're done?
"How can your dear Miss Chkalov help, Commander?" ...Boo, you're no fun. I just thought I'd change the mood a bit since I know you're just here to chat.
...Mmm! I love starting the morning with vodka. Want a shot, Commander? Heehee, it actually works out very well for me if you get wasted.
Hey, you're not making any progress with your work. Don't hesitate to tell me if I'm distracting you. Heehee♡
*sigh*... Another request from Kronshtadt. What is it with her? Always demanding stuff from people - unlike you.
Ah, how about we go on a rejuvenating walk?
You're excited, I see♡
Mission complete. Here's hoping you'll finish your work soon enough.
Seems you made it home with no injuries. Externally, anyway... How do you feel? Do you feel you have a headache or any stomach pains? ...No? Then all is good.
The commission team is back. With info on that date spot I had them check out, to boot. Heehee.
A juicy bonus, or an opportunity to examine you from head to toe... I'm fine with either one, Commander. Heehee.

*yaaawn*... Commander? How long have you been up? Forgive me, I really went wild last night... It's fine if you don't remember. I don't really either... *yawn*... Your combat gear... It's really nice... Heehee... Zzz...

lines.line: Oh? What made you come over here instead of heading down to the beach? Surely you didn't ditch your friends on a hard-earned day off just to see me? But, I don't mind. It's called a day off because you get to decide how to spend your time.

Oh? What made you come over here instead of heading down to the beach? Surely you didn't ditch your friends on a hard-earned day off just to see me? But, I don't mind. It's called a day off because you get to decide how to spend your time.
Hanging out, basking in the sunset's glow together... It's pretty nice, wouldn't you say?
I like the sea breeze, but the sun is a bit much for me. Life in the lab makes you sensitive to sunlight, you see. On that note, try not to spend TOO much time in your office, Commander.
I've pinned down your swimsuit preferences after tracking your eyes and analyzing your phrasing when asked for feedback. Heehee.
Still hard at work? You're hardly treating this like a vacation day. No, no, I know it's for the sake of all of us. You can expect a little something from me later.
Seeing Northern Parliament girls take off their winter coats and put on skimpy swimwear must be a real treat. For you, that is.
I feel this occasion calls for a bottle of vodka.
"Come and give Ms. Chkalov a hug!" Heehee♡
I hope inspiration will hit me as we go through these missions.
You look like you had a blast back there. I recommend getting some rest.
The commission team has returned. Oh, looks like they're running over to their friends. Shouldn't you go see them, Commander?
Will you let me examine your body later, as a reward? No?
Large cruiser - Brest.

I am large cruiser Brest, born upon Iris Libre's hallowed ground. I love hearing all the tales spanning land and sea, and spreading my own tales through song and poem. I look forward to hearing the tales you are bound to weave, Champion.
Are you our Champion? I am Brest of Iris Libre. Now that fate has brought us together, may our journey be blessed.
O Champion, what tales of heroism will you weave into the annals of history today?
Phew... Oh my, I do believe our Champion has arrived. Why yes, I'm perfectly fine. I was just struck with inspiration for a new paean and simply must put pen to paper.
Why not stop to smell the roses on your odyssey forward? Take heed of nature's marvels and friends who cherish you - there are still many things here worthy of your attention.
Every life is a wonderful story - be it an epic akin to a turbulent storm, or a lullaby as calming as the gentle sea breeze. Everything is embraced by the land and the sea, and committed to memory.
What's my favorite type of tea? Umm, whatever you'd like. As for desserts... Well, I'm fine with just about anything...
Oh? Is this intended to bring me succor...?
Hmm...? Did you need my advice, Champion?
Oh my... I suppose every champion's tale has indiscretions such as these~
There's no need for haste, Champion. Keep it slow and steady, just as you always do.
The mission rewards aren't going anywhere. There's no need for haste - we can always check them later.
New mail has arrived.
Our Champion returns triumphantly... I feel the inspiration for a new paean coming~
Our friends have returned to us from their odyssey. I wonder what kind of stories they brought back with them?
A more harmonious timbre.
Go forward with the Saintess of Victory's everlasting blessings.
And thus, a new passage is inscribed in our Champion's paean--
Setbacks are a necessary component of any champion's tale.
Thus exeunts the villains.
There's no need for haste. We have plenty of time still~
Your tale ought not to end here. Please regather yourself and press onward.
O Champion, I've heard a great many tales about you from many different people. Now, how goes the tale you narrate through your own eyes? How I wish to find out.

The oracles of legend were said to be able to foretell the fates of humans. Even though I don't have that power, I've read your story up close, and believe that you have what it takes to become a true Champion.
The bards of legend were said to travel the world, singing paeans of their champions. The paean I compose for your tale shall also be sung across the world one day.

The champions of legend accomplished feats that transcended time, but all mortals will succumb to fatigue. Should you ever feel tired, please make sure to rest. I shall nourish you with my finest song and verse.
To think that I, as a singer, would become part of my Champion's tale... What an unexpected plot twist. Heehee~ O Champion, shall we join hands and weave the paean to a more joyous tomorrow?
You'd give me such a precious item? I'm flattered, really.

ex.line: Would you like to listen to the paean I improvised for you?
By the way, the champions of legend usually take on a heroine as well. Or multiple, if you're into that. If you really can't decide, we can always improvise... Oh? My, oh my...
Oh my, such delicate yet emotional lines. Thanks to you, Champagne, I've come up with so many new verses.

It's not good to overwork yourself, Champion. A quill made to write too much will snap. A mind made to think too much will become clouded. Gascogne's "Work Module" made to operate too much will overheat.

No matter what sceneries lie ahead of us, let us bear witness to them together. Not only as the weaver of the Champion's future-spanning tale, but also as your beloved companion who always stays by your side.
The days pass, the seasons change. The flow of time grinds all things to dust - except one. Only true love can weather this trial, and continue to shine proudly through the song of life.
Have you had your fill? Then, why don't we try reversing roles?
You may consult me for anything, Champion.
Does the Champion... crave my comforts? Hehe~
Our Champion returns home victorious once again... Hehe, you are a champion, after all.
Let us write a new chapter in our Champion's tale.
I shall be the Parnassian who sings your tales of heroism, Champion.

lines.line: "I devote this paean to thee, Champion of seas blue and free." There, the song is completed. But we've come all this way... Shall we continue our adventure through these undersea ruins, Champion?
"I devote this paean to thee, Champion of seas blue and free." There, the song is completed. But we've come all this way... Shall we continue our adventure through these undersea ruins, Champion?
Gazing from a ship's deck leaves me wanting. Just imagine the fathomless secrets that lay beneath these waves.
The secret to enriching the mind is traveling and broadening your horizons—be it contemplating nature's beauty or visiting historical locales~
Champion, there is much that I wish to tell Richelieu and the others about these ruins. May I spin a hymn here and now?
An adventuring party? I would be happy to serve as your sage... Worry not. You are more than valorous enough to lead the vanguard, Champion.
We must protect these seas, including the most dangerous places—even if they have their own faults, much like my beloved Champion. Heehee!
How I'd love to take such pretty coral home with me, but perhaps it is best left as a memory.
My, my... What's come over you?
Might we be blessed with a quest to delve into these ruins?
The tide brings new mail. There... This ought to keep it dry.
Tales of adventure in the briny blue... This could make for an entertaining piece, Champion.
The tide tells a tale... Ah, Champion, so the commission company has returned.
O Champion, what manner of floral makeup would look best upon my brow? Or, could I perhaps... call upon you to apply it for me? ♪
O Champion, what manner of floral makeup would look best upon my brow? Or, could I perhaps... call upon you to apply it for me? ♪
The window's view of the moon, the fragrance of the stove... A perfect environment in which to pen poetry.

Those of the Empery often quote, "A woman dresses herself for the one who delights in her." In other words, we try to be beautiful for the one we love... Right now, that would be an apt description for me.
O Champion, do you think the red floral makeup suits me more? Good. Then I'll keep applying this one...
The way you paint my face now reminds me of lovers in old folktales.
O Champion, please come closer. You may find the scenery tonight is unique enough to warrant a moment's rest.
Should I style my hair in a Dragon Empery fashion, as well?
O Champion, do you wish to sit next to me? Here is a cushion... Oh? You want me to be your cushion?
Heehee... O Champion, put out the candles first.
O Champion, you've been hard at work. Come to me and enjoy a moment's respite.
With zither and lyric, let us weave a song of this night. Of a brief yet wonderful time, of a minstrel who desires her own part in the tale... To be forever remembered by her champion.
Aviation battleship - Kearsarge.

I'm Kearsarge, Eagle Union blueprint ship given form. My design was a hybrid between battleship and aircraft carrier, giving me the ability to deal with almost any situation or battlefield. I hope you'll put my strength to good use, Commander.

Activation sequence complete. I am aviation battleship Kearsarge, Hybrid Idealization X given flesh and blood. Henceforth, I will serve you at this port. So, which division do I belong to, and what's my mission?
Ah, Commander. Pardon me for starting work without you. Pay me no mind and begin with your own tasks.
...I'm not sleeping, I'm just letting my brain rest a while. While, yes, I did leave the door wide open, you should at least knock before you enter next time, Commander.
Save the small talk for after work. I'm concentrating on my secretary duties, so don't disturb me.
It doesn't help to always look back on the past - keep moving forward, and don't stop. Even when you want to self-reflect, you must adapt to developments as they happen.

On occasion, I neglect your will and prioritize the here and now on the battlefield. While you are the Commander, sometimes you have to let your soldiers handle things - the sooner you accept this, the better.
(Kearsarge is sitting upright on the couch with her eyes closed. Is she asleep, or...?)
...Hm? What are you doing?
Yes, I know you're here. What do you need?
How much intent is in this act you're committing?
Confirming there are unfinished missions. If you won't do them, I'll remove them from your schedule as I see fit. You sure you want that?
Confirming that rewards have come in. I'll go collect them.
Confirming that a letter has arrived. Take a look.
Welcome back, now have a breather. After-action review? Ah, right, you went on a sortie. Would it have been better if I'd joined you?
Confirming the commission team has returned. I'll go collect the goods.
Performance and fleet potential increase confirmed. Keep it up.
The advantage is ours! Strike!
Combat appraisal complete. Moving on to the next stage of the operation.
Combat appraisal complete. I shall maintain momentum while resuming formation, then launch a counterattack.
Freeze, then burst!
The operation is going awry... What is this?!
Your commanding ability has been evaluated... Simply following your orders is detrimental.

I've determined that establishing mutual trust between us is beneficial to my battlefield performance. So, without further ado, allow me to check your schedule... Hm? Is information-gathering not customary when getting to know someone?

Your individual tastes and interests... That's a good perspective. I'll ask my acquaintances for basic info later... For now, open your mouth. I made borscht, and this will help me determine your tastes. Come on, say "ahh."
Though calling it a "date" is a misnomer, a date does present a great opportunity to learn your habits and savoir-faire. Here is your schedule for today. Give it a quick read, then we'll get started.

I trust you, Commander, and I want to become intimately familiar with you. However, I'm unable to fully determine your feelings towards me due to my own ineptness... Do you trust me the way I trust you? Do you, as others would say, love me?

Confirming vitals all green. Hm? Oh, don't worry, I simply snuck a vital sensor onto you - a return gift for this ring you gave me. It's necessary to keep a regular check on your health, and to know when to come running when you need help. Makes sense, no?
Your taste is commendable. Sorry - I should thank you first.

ex.line: This time, you go ahead and set the pace. Don't worry about me, just do whatever feels natural to you. I like it better that way.
Vitals check done. All signs clear. I can't guess why else you'd visit, so... You just felt like it? Heheh, what an irrational reason, but that sounds like you alright.
What is it? Why'd you put your pen down? Your vitals all look fine to me, so... You're just taking a break? Sorry, I didn't mean to heckle you...
Still not finished? Okay, I'll order takeaway. That way I can stay with you until tomorrow if need be- Oh, it won't take that long?
I put my full trust in your ability to lead. Whenever you want to change targets, change course, use and change equipment, or give me tactical advice, just say the word.
(Kearsarge's breathing is faintly audible. Is she meditating again, or is she just sleeping?)
...Commander. If you're going to play a prank on someone, you should make sure they're asleep first.
If you want this, be my guest. I respect your will, and I've reached the conclusion that I'm fine with it, too.
Confirming arrival and receipt of rewards. I don't want to dampen your celebration, but... you should go pick up your stuff.
How did the sortie go, Commander? I know I don't need to worry about you, but disasters can always happen. Want me to check your vitals?
Confirming the commission team has returned. Hate to rain on your parade, but have you prepared gifts for the girls?
Combat appraisal complete... I'm the MVP? It's not like you to get excited about the usual. N-no, I don't mean you can't do that, just...

*smooch*... Yep. You're the same as always, and I'm in love with you. Is that all you wanted to confirm? I thought you would... as my friends have put it, "do what your heart yearns for." Are you really not going to do that?

lines.line: I am now the Hybrid Idealization given flesh and blood wearing a suit designed with my performance for you in mind. I am ready to receive orders at any time.
I am now the Hybrid Idealization given flesh and blood wearing a suit designed with my performance for you in mind. I am ready to receive orders at any time.
Eagle Union bunny girl Kearsarge will charm you tonight. Don't worry, I can keep dancing as long as you're watching my- Oh. I don't recommend staying up all night for it.

This pole is a prop to assist with my performance and is installed with a contact circuit to replenish my energy. It's multifunctional and very convenient to... Oh, I shouldn't be explaining this right now.
Confirming rise in vital signs. Heart rate, pulse, body temperature, and... Ahem. Is this what is called a "state of arousal"?
This pole was originally installed to suit your needs in all kinds of scenarios. Naturally, this performance will go perfectly... Heh.
...Oh. Right, I'm still in the middle of my pop-up store performance. Have you been watching me, Commander?
Let me show you some moves New Jersey taught me. I even made a few original modifications, based on the data from your reactions.
(Kearsarge's breathing is faintly audible. Is she meditating again, or is she just pondering what to do for her next performance?)
Mhh... Is that better?
Confirming activation of contact circuit... Oh, um, you could increase the contact area for greater efficiency...
Confirming there are unfinished missions... but right now, you're meant to enjoy my performance. The missions can wait.
Confirming that mission rewards have arrived. Would you mind getting it yourself, Commander?
Confirming activation of energy circuit. I can move more now. You should recharge your batteries as well, Commander. Just give me your order.
The commission team has returned. We'll continue after you've welcomed the girls back.
Combat appraisal complete. Energy consumption is within normal values. Commander, continue with the operation.
Combat appraisal complete. Energy consumption exceeds estimated values. Commander, provide additional energy via contact circuit.
This suit is a fusion of tradition and modernity. Your feedback would be appreciated... but first, a small issue must be dealt with. May I request your assistance in the matter, Commander?
This suit is a fusion of tradition and modernity. Your feedback would be appreciated... but first, a small issue must be dealt with. May I request your assistance in the matter, Commander?
Oh, Commander... Sorry, please stand by for a moment. I need to readjust the fitting of my shoewear.

While these clothes are less flexible than my suit, based on the data I've collected on your preferences, this outfit is the most appropriate under this circumstance. Your expression, likewise, says as much.
I've logged an ample amount of data on dumpling recipes. Shall I make some for you? ...Good cooking takes more than simply knowing the recipe?
New Year's wishes? Mine is as follows: I wish to log more data of you and get to know you better. This answer should be within your expectations.
I've heard that the size of a red envelope corresponds to the closeness between the giver and receiver... Oh, no, I wasn't trying to coax you into giving me one. Not at all.
(You feel a weight on your shoulder and hear the sound of soft snoring. Kearsarge has a small smile on her lips. She must have logged a lot of data which makes her happy today.)
...Is this kind of contact equivalent to a blessing? Oh, never mind. Keep doing it.
Oh. Thank you, Commander. I'd like it if you could prop me up for just a moment.
Mmh... Analyzing your tastes has proven... very worthwhile...
Confirming the presence of unfinished missions. While it is a holiday, you must still carry out your duty. I am always ready to aid you.
Confirming the arrival of mission rewards. Don't worry about me - let me accompany you on your supply retrieval.
Confirming the arrival of a new letter. You've received a large influx of seasonal greetings. Should I prepare a reply template for you?
Vitals are within normal parameters. Presumption: Your sortie went well. Proceeding to preparation of nourishment following completion of current task.
A commission has been completed. Don't forget to bring a treat to thank the team for their hard work.

Today, I recorded large amounts of data about you and further deepened my understanding of love. While this feeling is hard to quantify, I do look forward to spending more time with you over this new year. Not only for logging and analysis purposes, but also to... revel in the happiness of being with you.
Light cruiser - Shimanto.

I am the Sakura Empire light cruiser, Shimanto. As a blueprint ship that embodies wishes given form and the unsealed dragon of lore, I shall hereby lend my assistance to your fleet, Commander- Oh, umm... You know, you're welcome to call me by my title of Dragon God...?

Release the Seal of Denial; open your eyes and worship the great Dragon God- Heehee, don't worry about it. I am Shimanto, a fantasy given form through wishes embodied. Commander, don't be too hard on me, 'kay?
Ahem. Commander, speak your wish to me. ...Hm? Why aren't you saying it? Do you want to give your secretary a day off?

Now then, set yourself free. This is your port- in other words, our home is now synonymous with the Dragon God's domain. Well, setting all that aside, just take it easy around me. There's no need for the formalities.
What kind of offerings do I prefer? If you insist on knowing, your favorite snack will suffice... Err, ahem. I meant, anything will do.
You're not done with work yet, right? There's not much left, so keep at it. If you slack off, you might invite a curse upon yourself~

I can somewhat relate with the Guardian Fox's frustrations. Things are a lot better thanks to you, but being revered all the time can be kind of tiring... It's kind of embarrassing to be called the Dragon God all the time.
Perfect, all done. Oh, this isn't an ordinary paper airplane- it's a shikigami plane. Uhh, but, right now, it pretty much is just a paper airplane, just as you said... Mhm...
Hmm...?
Got a prayer you want the Dragon God to hear? Want me to make it rain?
Hmm... I wonder if this warrants a curse...
Duties are to be fulfilled. Go forth and do your utmost, Commander.
All done with the mission? I see. Well done, then.
Mail? Will someone drop by to deliver it...?
Well done out there, Commander. Did you have a good fight? Oh, it's not like I had anything to do with it, so there's no need for that respectful tone.
A military commission? I see. For the purpose of bringing me an offering, I presume?
Can you make me even stronger? Then I suppose I shall use this power without reservation~
Ryuujin no hougeki wo kurae--
Worship me! Fear the raging Dragon God's storm! ...Ahaha, my shikigami have reverted back to soggy pieces of paper...
I've got a lot more bad vibes on me than I expected... Urgh...
Shikigami serpent, unleash your divine might!
Upon those who would lay hands on my scales, punishment descends--
Ever wonder what it would be like to get on a dragon's bad side? Surely you're not going to go out of your way to satisfy that curiosity... right?

How you conduct yourself and the attitude you exhibit towards me can only be one of two options- either you fear and revere me as the Dragon God lest I bring disaster upon you, or you trust and rely upon me, Shimanto, as shipgirl and Commander. The choice is yours; it matters not which you pick.

You still seem somewhat reserved around me. If you do not change your ways, then I have no choice but to treat you with greater dignity as well- (*gurgle*)... Th-that wasn't my stomach growling... it, it was the rumbling of thunder!

Yes, that's right! You can chat with me and enjoy snacks with me as normal! Even if I am the Dragon God, right now, I'm just a regular friend who you can shoot the breeze with! And if you want, I can even go on a date with you! ...Umm, hey. I was totally serious about that, okay?

I'm here to go on a date with you today, Commander, so there's no need to get hung up about that Dragon God thing. Come on, show me the ropes. This is my first time doing something like this, so I wouldn't be able to put on airs even if I wanted to- Heehee, you're getting a bit better at dealing with me, aren't you?

Should we exchange vows, then an inseparable bond would form between us- indeed, this is both a blessing and a curse. Are you fine with that? ...I see. Heehee. In that case, what should we do next? A kiss? A hug? Or maybe...
The Dragon God loves this. Hehehe!
Keep a tight grip on that katana of yours. Heehee~
Do you hate green peppers that much...?

ex.line: Now then, make your wish. My power belongs to you- Wait, hold on a sec! If you want me to grant THAT wish, you'll have to double my snack allowance!
Let's set the work aside and take it easy for now. Not many people come by these parts, and even if they do, all you gotta do is say that you were praying to the Dragon God~
Don't you think the sun's been a bit too strong lately? ...Heehee, I guess that's where I come in. Shall I call down a bit of rain for you?
Tired? I guess that's bound to happen eventually. Wanna scroll through Juustagram 'til you feel better?
Whose katana is this...? Oh. Mm, mm. I see, I see... I think I'll have that girl offer me a whole bunch of snacks. Ehehe~
People are in awe of me because I have these growing out of my head... Probably...?
Do you require my power? Very well, I'd be more than glad to assist you.
You wish for even more wondrous blessings from the Dragon God~? I guess I can do that~
I suppose I don't mind helping you with your mission. After all, the great Dragon God is but a secretary now~
Oh, done already...? And here I was finally trying to make myself useful... I mean, uh, yes, well done!
Well fought, Commander. Now then, got any souvenirs for me? Hehe, it doesn't have to be an offering of snacks for the Dragon God. An interesting tale or two will suffice.
The commission team seems to have returned. Heehee, the Dragon God sees all~
"Ryuu ga waga teki wo"... Haha, I'll stop now.
Maybe I should call down a celebratory rainstorm? Heehee, just joking.
Yeah, yeah. Just like that. No need for reservation, no need to be polite. You're the head honcho here, so feel free to be yourself. I will always be your Shimanto, your personal Dragon God.

lines.line: You couldn't have picked a better time to come. Allow me to treat you to a cup of the Dragon God's benevolence- Uhh, I'll go boil some water right now, so sit tight. After you finish the tea, shall we kick back and relax awhile?

You couldn't have picked a better time to come. Allow me to treat you to a cup of the Dragon God's benevolence- Uhh, I'll go boil some water right now, so sit tight. After you finish the tea, shall we kick back and relax awhile?
Pheeew~ Hehe, isn't this cuppa a thing of beauty? Don't worry too much about etiquette or whatever. Just drink it while it's hot.

I heard that this outfit is worn when providing a certain kind of "service," but what exactly does this entail? Even the great Dragon God finds herself ignorant of some worldly things, and your guidance would be most appreciated~ Teehee~
They say fresh tea is as nectar... So what do you think? Isn't the Dragon God's tea amazing? When things are offered to me, it isn't just for show, you know.
Now then, prostrate yourself! (whispers) Wonderful. Isn't it nice and warm over here~? I don't mind if we keep staying like this~
Fwoo, fwoo... Here, that should do the trick. Huh? I accidentally made it boiling hot? Sorry, it's hard to control the temperature like this... Is that not the issue?
What do you seek from the Dragon God?
I see, I see... So THIS is the kind of "service" they were talking about? Heehee~
You've done well. Would you like a cup of tea first, or would you prefer to lie down? Either way, I've made things nice and comfy for you~
The commission fleet is back? Do we have enough refreshments? Shall I have Azuma and the others bring some more over?
Be it boiling tea or fighting, there's nothing the Dragon God can't do.

How wonderfully well-behaved you are, *pat, pat*... Enjoy the aroma of the tea, feel the warmth and softness of the Dragon God's thighs, and be whisked away into the land of sweet slumber~ Heehee. That's right, you don't need to worry about a thing~
Well, Commander, are you ready? I'm going to teach you the Dragon God's sacred training method. First, you scoop up some water, like... Achoo! Th-that one didn't count!
Well, Commander, are you ready? I'm going to teach you the Dragon God's sacred training method. First, you scoop up some water, like... Achoo! Th-that one didn't count!
Cleanse yourself like the mountain hermit, purge evil with pure water, become one with Mizuho's nature and purify your heart - this is a teaching of gratitude from the Dragon God♪

Mmhh. Nature's fresh air beats everything else... How come, you ask? I suppose you don't always have incense burning in your office, so the difference isn't obvious to you... If anything, your office smells like coffee, I suppose?
Hm-hmm-hm♪ Come into the water, Commander. You don't wanna waste this opportunity to have as much as we can, do you?
You thought this kind of training would be done under a waterfall? Uh, well... I don't really like waterfall training. It's painful.
Take Mizuho's aura within you, and let its clouds nourish you - that's one way of doing it if you're interested... Really? You are?
Eek! Now you've done it! Better get ready, because I'm going to make it rain above you!
Th-this is not what self-training is about...
Commander, there are missions left to do. I'm sure they'll be a cinch now that you've cleansed yourself.
We could set the mission rewards afloat for the others downstream to collect. Too far-fetched?
Lounge in nature's waters, draw upon the Dragon God's blessing to cleanse the karma of war... Ahem. Wh-what I'm saying is: Let's have a good time.
Seems the commission team is back! Why, yes, this stream connects to the sea, so I can tell. Heehee♪

It's not training, just practicing hygiene? Well, I guess you have a point, but it's been that way since the start, and there's my desire for you to always stay in good health... Yes, that's it! It's the Dragon God's blessing of gratitude♪
Whew... So refreshing. Nothing beats lounging around indoors after a bath. Commander, there's plenty of time before dinner, so how about we... do something to kill the time?
Whew... So refreshing. Nothing beats lounging around indoors after a bath. Commander, there's plenty of time before dinner, so how about we... do something to kill the time?
The Dragon God is unfamiliar with this stuff, so you'll have to teach me all about it. Hey... Heehee, how was that?
You want me to raise the room's humidity a bit? Excuse me, have you forgotten who I am? Offer me two rice crackers, THEN I'll give you my blessing♪
Heheh. I could use the Dragon God's power to change into loungewear whenever I want. Why don't I do it now? W-would you believe me if I said it's just too much work?
There's tea if you're thirsty. Want me to blow on it to cool it down? I guarantee I won't misjudge how much force to use this time♪
Maybe it's time to lay out the futon... Oh, I know it's early, I just wanna laze around on top of it. Heheh. Will you help?
*slap slap*... Heheh, you must love this tail massage from the Dragon God♪
S-so that's where this is going... *blushes*
You can collect your mission rewards now. What will you do first? Inspect them, or praise the Dragon God's magnificence?
Good work on that sortie. It was sunny the whole journey back, right? Heheh. You should be grateful for the Dragon God's good weather blessing♪
Should we go and greet the returning commission team? We can go back to relaxing after that.

It feels kind of odd, us just being alone like this. I get all cozy and don't feel like doing anything, but I also get antsy, like I just have to do something... You get what I mean? Sorry - I know I invited you to come and relax and all...
Destroyer - Felix Schultz.

I am Felix Schultz, Iron Blood blueprint ship. Oh, you crave my power? Easy. Just use that rotten brain of yours to please me. You should be grateful I'm even willing to allow you to worship me instead of forcing you to submit unconditionally.

My, if it isn't the Commander. Good day. Though the fact that I've been summoned here by a human is a feat in itself, you will find that trying to bind me thusly is a foolish, Sisyphean endeavor. Indeed, I, Felix Schultz, shall make you kneel before me.
Did you miss me that badly? Heehee. Surely you didn't come all the way here just for some piddling chores?
I enjoy apples, especially the kind that's been chopped up into nice little bite-sized pieces. Yes, yes, just like that- Ahhn~ Mmgh~ Want some as well, Commander?
It's gonna be sunny tomorrow? Welp, that sucks. One fewer excuse to keep the Commander by my side.
Hmm? Did you say something? Can't hear you. Come a bit closer, and enunciate more~
(Hmm... Busy working again? ...There has to be some way of getting you to pay attention to me...) Hmm? Did you need something? I'm just minding my own business over here~?
You deemed it appropriate for someone of your position to touch my forehead? Well, I suppose I'll take pity on your ignorance and forgive you.
Got the hots for me? Sure, feast those beady little eyes of yours on me, as much as you want~ Heehee, I wonder how long you'll be able to keep ogling me~
Are you finally admitting that you have the same cranial capacity as a chimp? Heehee~♪
Too much stuff on your plate? Sigh, I suppose I can help this pitiful, impotent Commander. But, I do expect you to return this favor, okay?
Ohh? You actually managed to do your job. I suppose you aren't completely impotent, then. That earns you a few extra points of affection from me, Commander~♪
You can't even get your own mail without me? Well, I suppose that's fine. I won't even ask you for repayment this one time.
An acceptable job on your sortie. I suppose I wouldn't mind poking and prodding at the sensitive spots on your frail body- Ahaha, I wonder how soon you'll cry for mercy~♪
The commission rewards have been collected and counted. So, how do you plan to repay me for using up my time and energy?
Eheh~ That put me in a pretty good mood.
Fail to show me my due respect, and I shall make you suffer.
These worthless bottom-feeders thought they could defeat me? Heehee.
Th-there were a multitude of unforeseeable variables that contributed to this defeat... Ahem! If you understand, then I'll leave the rest to you!
You're a waste of ammo!
S-stop staring and use that rotten brain of yours to figure something out!
How boring- you're nothing more than dust on the windowsill. Ah, forget it, I'm not interested in you anymore. Hurry up and blow away in the wind already.
Humans are nothing more than uppity beasts. I shall make you understand this, and you will kneel before me and wag your tail. Heehee~♪

Hmm, are you still not giving in to your urges? Do you have that much self-control, or are you just impotent? ... (Having that said, this degree of stubbornness is unusual... Am I doing something wrong? Or am I just not doing enough...?)

(Now that I think things through, the Commander's actually a pretty good person... Wait, what am I thinking? If I acknowledge the Commander, it's all over for me... But...) Hmm? What is it? And how exactly are my personal thoughts any of your business?

*sigh*... I admit defeat. Not only did I fail to get you to kneel before me, I almost ended up acknowledging you. But... that only frees me up to go after you with any means necessary. Kneel before me, or become mine. I won't back down until you break.

How beautiful... this feeling of being acknowledged and accepted. It is a thousand times better than forcing trash to kneel before me... Why didn't I realize this sooner? Tell me~ ...Commander, let's fall deeper and deeper into the abyss together, just the two of us~♪
You know just how to make me happy!

ex.line: Ahhh, you've finally returned. What will your first order be for me? ..."Get off the desk"? Heehee~♪
Want an apple? Here you go- Oh, gimme a sec- *chomp*~ Okay, here you go~
(Look at you, so hard at work again. Why are you putting yourself through that even though I'm here...?) H-huh?! Wh-why are you trying to chat me up all of a sudden?

The things on my feet keep poking you? It's said that certain things practically become a part of you once you've grown accustomed to them. I don't think you're any exception in this regard, Commander. Heehee~
Just a headpat? And you're satisfied with only that? Well, I'M not satisfied at all.
(Are you finally going to put your hands all over me?) ......Hmm? Um... You're not going to do anything? *sigh*...
Ahhn~♥ I love it when you give in to your primal urges like this~
Eheh~ Shower me with praise or I won't help with your mission~♪
Eheh~ Wag your tail or I won't fetch the rewards for you~♪
You've got new mail... but each one will cost you one kiss. Pretty good deal, right~?
If you missed me so badly, use those noodly arms and wobbly back of yours to carry me. That way, the two of us will always be together~♪
The commission fleet has returned. Shall we go greet them? Naturally, the two of us will hold hands as we go, heehee~
I'll go mop them up, Commander~
Worms should know better than to get between me and the Commander.
Would you be upset with me if I said I lost on purpose?

Commander, despite the profundity of our relationship, why are you still so indifferent towards me... Urgh, I can't just sit around until you get eaten up by one of those big sister types... You know what, I don't care what happens next...!

lines.line: My, my. I'm quite surprised you're still able to stay awake. As expected of the Commander- even a dose of Felix Schultz's special concoction isn't enough to put you under... but that ends here. It's your fault for peeping on me slacking off in the first place, so be nice and obedient and succumb to me already~♪

My, my. I'm quite surprised you're still able to stay awake. As expected of the Commander- even a dose of Felix Schultz's special concoction isn't enough to put you under... but that ends here. It's your fault for peeping on me slacking off in the first place, so be nice and obedient and succumb to me already~♪
