Oho, you're still trying to talk~? But, it must be so hard for you, with how your tongue's already tied up like that~ Maybe I should just shut you up altogether-- *smooooch*

*munch*~ In any case, Commander, you were fortunate to have come here alone. If you brought friends with you, none of this would've happened. But, you also wouldn't be all tangled up with me either... Want an apple~? Mmmfgh~♡
What did I make you drink? What if I told you it was just regular iced tea? Think as hard as you can, with that ever-so-brilliant brain of yours turned to mush~
You can't move? And your head's all hazy? Why of course. (*croons*) I, Felix Schultz, did this to you.
You want me on my knees, serving you with upturned eyes? Don't you think that's a bit too pervy? Not that I mind, though~
So you go all numb when I touch you here? You're unexpectedly sensitive, Commander~
C'mon, there's a loooot more stuff I still want to do with you~♥
I'll help out with your work, so let's keep what happened here between the two of us~
What am I going to make you do in return for fetching the mission rewards? ...Ahaha, so you do remember after all~♪
You've got new mail. Now then, where shall I leave the kiss mark?

Yes, that's right~ Doesn't it feel so much better to not have to think about anything? The two of us can slack off as much as we want here. If you're tired, you can relax however you want. If you're thirsty... then slurp it all down. You know what I mean, don't you~?
The commission fleet has returned. It's time for our walk, Commander~♪
Rise and shine, Commander. It's time to stamp out some pests.
So despite your current condition, you're still able to command~? As a reward, I'll let you have a bit more to drink. Mmffgh~
Heehee. Commander, I'm so looking forward to how you're going to... "correct" me after you get back on your feet~♪

Heehee. You know, Commander, you really are defenseless. Do you really think everyone's as well-behaved as Bismarck's bunch? Though, looks like you're in no position to answer me... Oh well. I guess I'll just have to use this opportunity to say this as much as I can- "I love you~♥"
Heavy cruiser - Hindenburg.

I am Iron Blood cruiser Hindenburg. Shipgirls such as I are apparently known as "blueprint ships"... a title I couldn't care less about. As long as you prove your might and don't bore me, I will obey the contract we've made.
Was it you who summoned me? You, a human, are my "Commander"? Very well. I'll temporarily allow this contract between shipgirl and human.
Forever toiling away for the sake of peace... Contract Binder, is this the fate you chose?
My wings? My tail? Do they really enthrall you that much? The inner workings of your mind elude me sometimes, Contract Binder.
Incidentally, what binds you and other shipgirls together? Is it trust? Money? ...Well, that's interesting.
Life here is so staggeringly boring. Contract Binder, relieve my boredom or I'll do it myself with your body.
Get me something to drink? How considerate of you to ask. I'll have coffee. Not too bitter, thanks.
My horns? Admire them all you want. Try to touch them, however, and I'm sure you already know what will happen.
Speak now, before my interest in you goes away.
I'm tempted to pound some decency into that body of yours, Contract Binder.
Do what you must do, Contract Binder... I'm referring to your missions.
Mission complete. I don't remember making a contract with a human who grows excited over measly rewards, and yet here you are.
Read your letter sooner rather than later, Contract Binder. I shouldn't have to point this out to you.
Your last battle is still on your mind, no? Were the foes interesting? Or was my performance perhaps unsatisfactory?
Commission goods have arrived? Have someone else handle it. Doing everything by yourself is a waste of your limited time.
Don't forget to pursue your own growth, Contract Binder.
Courage was your beginning, and it shall also be your end.
Pain is the best teacher for the wretched.
Gritty adversaries we have. Come our next audience, please don't disappoint me again.
Worms should bow their heads.
Seems I got a little overeager... Well played.
So be it. Our contract is now null and void. And one day, you will taste undiminished retaliation for your actions.
You wish to speak? Here I thought you were avoiding me out of fear... Very well. This is as good an opportunity as any to learn more about you.

So my summoning wasn't an officiated ordeal. It seems, then, that this was done by you as an individual with desires... Yes, it's fine to admit it. This way, I can be not just a shipgirl under your command, but Hindenburg, an individual.

You can try to manipulate a demon, but it's an undeniable possibility that the tables will turn on you. If you want the answer, seek it. I'll be waiting for you at the end of the line... No, I'm not daring you into anything. As the contract binder, this is your choice alone to make.

How delightful you've made it this far, Contract Binder. How you did it is unimportant - all that matters is the end result, namely that you are now in my possession. Dismayed? Kneeling on the ground surely isn't THAT bad.

Our current contract isn't enough for you, and you want to take it even further? How cocksure you've become, Contract Binder... I shall grant your wish and give you what you desire. That is, if your body and soul are ready for the indulgence that is to come.
This is quite nice.
You smell of danger.

ex.line: I've been waiting ages for you. Don't tell me you WANTED to incur my wrath and make me discipline you?
If you're really going to keep staring at my tail, I will use it to restrain you. You'd probably enjoy that anyway... Unless you're saying I've misjudged your character?
I've never before felt such pleasure as I do by your side... If anything, YOU may genuinely possess a devilish power to seduce others.
Maybe I should spend some time teaching other shipgirls who truly belongs at your side... Get along, you say? Very well. Only out of respect for you, Contract Binder.
Tastes like bitter mud water... Is this supposed to be coffee?
If there's no stopping you... Fine, just this once.
If you have something to say, out with it. You already know what's going to happen if you get on my nerves.
If you've forgotten how to plead for forgiveness, I'll just have to make you remember, Contract Binder.
Do what you must do, Contract Binder... You cannot afford to let distractions get between yours and my time.
Mission complete. I suppose I should give you a reward... Do you want one?
A letter for you. Take it... Yes, I gave you it with my tail rather than my hands. And what of it?
Regardless of how your last battle went, now you can relax. Focus on what's in front of you.
Supposing I were to grant your wish, what would you then do for me in return?
It's time to retreat, Contract Binder. The shame of running away matters little compared to personal safety.

What is it? Thinking of rescinding your earlier decision? Since the moment you surrendered your leader privileges, your opinions as a person have had no weight. You understand what this means, yes, Contract Binder?

lines.line: It's just the two of us now, Contract Binder. Come - play a game with me and immerse yourself in the pleasures this place offers. The loser of this game, of course, must accept a punishment tonight♡
It's just the two of us now, Contract Binder. Come - play a game with me and immerse yourself in the pleasures this place offers. The loser of this game, of course, must accept a punishment tonight♡

You're late, Contract Binder. I had a little to drink in your absence... Heehee. A few sips would never intoxicate me. Don't believe me? Watch me walk over to... Oof. It seems I've stumbled and bumped into you.
Heehee. Your fearless, unhesitant gaze tells me you must really like this outfit.
Won't you drink, too, Contract Binder? Right here. Heehee. Come over♡
This card? You dropped it earlier when you were shuffling the deck. Use your hand and take it yourself.
Drunk, you say? Hmph. I'm certainly not. I don't get drunk when I'm with you... Now, go on, show me what you're really like when you're at your wit's end♡
You touched my horn, Contract Binder... You meant to touch my bunny ears, you say? Again with the lame excuses... Just hold still and accept your punishment♡
Heehee. Why so stressed? The game isn't over yet.
Are you satisfied now? Mmh♡ ...Don't celebrate prematurely. If you want to seize the lead, now is the time... Heehee. This game will not end until I've grown bored of it♡
Missions, missions... You can surely finish those in no time, Contract Binder.
Wine, cards, chips - everything is here. Resume the game.
A precarious battle, was it? Heehee, Contract Binder, you should know that you'll find greater pleasure in an evenly-matched back-and-forth than a one-sided stomp.
Heehee. This game will be a boring one.
It's time to engross yourself in our little game, Contract Binder.
You are sorely mistaken if you think I'm going to retreat.
Royal flush. How boring.
This card here... can turn everything around.
You are a funny one, Contract Binder. You act, you react, and you struggle... Enough already. I will take the lead and eat you up. Don't you worry - I will ensure you have sweet dreams...♡
Contract Binder, have you heard of a thing called "the Dance of Control"? Heehee - yes. What do you say to a little "game" between us? Whoever is defeated... loses everything.
Contract Binder, have you heard of a thing called "the Dance of Control"? Heehee - yes. What do you say to a little "game" between us? Whoever is defeated... loses everything.
You're early, Contract Binder. I'm still warming up. Oh, are you unable to endure the wait?
The Dance of Control lures the heart and lays one's desires bare, Contract Binder. That means if you're weak of will... you will fall for me immediately.
Has watching me made you thirsty? Heehee. There's water right beside you, yet you haven't even had a sip. Are you saying you want me to quench your thirst?
The look in your eyes pleases me, Contract Binder, but I'm still only warming up. For the next part, you'll use your body to aid with my dance.
Oh? Still not ready to admit defeat, I see. Then I'd better go all-out for you, Contract Binder♥
Heheh. You want me to bow? Do remember: I'm the one on top right now.
Heh. You touched me. If you don't want to lose, you'd better keep it in as best you can.
You've been roundly defeated, Contract Binder... Next, I will take control of you and amuse myself to my heart's content♡
Heh. You missed all sorts of "views." If you'll obediently accept your punishment, then I will give you one more chance.
Has my dance already seized control of you, Contract Binder? Heehee. It'd be a shame for our game to end so easily. I never said I'd only dance for you once... did I?
Battleship - Flandre.

Alsace-class battleship? The origin... of the shipgirl Flandre? I don't quite understand... My body, and the power hidden within it, serve no other purpose than to fulfill my sacred duties. You are the only being to who I submit, and thus, I can only become that which You desire.
Your will be done, Commander. I am battleship Flandre, Your ship, Your subordinate, Your servant. Bestow upon me Your orders.
Commander, please bestow upon me Your orders for today. I shall give body and soul to see Your will done.
What is it that I wish to do? To obey Your orders, and fulfill Your wishes- such is the duty of us shipgirls, and such is my desire. Nothing else beyond that matters.
Commandments and doctrines alike... are of little concern to me. All there is for me to do is obey Your orders.
You want me to... spread my wings like one of the birds outside? ...What do you mean by this? Are You asking me to offer you a treasure from far away?
My associates have been saying that they wish to become "friends" with me. What exactly is the nature of this "friend" relationship? Commander, do You also have "friends"...?
What purpose... does this serve?
As You will, Commander.
I understand. This is the sacred duty of "consummation" expected of all secretary ships... Am I wrong?
A new mission? Allow me to handle it. ...Hm? Commander, will you be coming along as well? Understood.
Mission complete. If I have fallen short in any area, please give me Your guidance and any punishment I deserve.
It is my fault for not bringing You the mail in a timely manner so that You may check it... I am very sorry.
Congratulations on your triumphant return. Hmm? I knew not when You would return, thus have I been waiting here.
A new commission has been completed. May I check on the supplies?
I humbly accept Your favor.
For victory, and for the Commander!
The proper thing to do after victory is... to celebrate? And in doing so, I am to make a "V" with my fingers?
The defeated are deserving of their judgment. Please administer punishment upon me as You see fit.
Forgive me.
My situation is less important than that of the enemy.
It is the duty of Your ships to be commanded and to obey. This, I understand. Do not worry.
Commander, what orders do You have for me today? If there is nothing for me to do, please allow me to wait nearby.

You wish to go out with me? Very well. Allow me to equip the proper rigging... Hmm? There's no need for that? What, then, will we be doing? Just... playing outside? I see. If that is Your wish, then I shall accompany you, body and soul.

If You are going to "play" today, I shall accompany You at all times- Hmm? Do I wish to "play" as well? I do not understand. If "playing" makes one feel better, there is no reason to object to it... Actually, would it be fine for me to "play" with You?

You want me to do what I want, not just obey You? But, Commander... whether it's "playing," or making me feel better, all of that is only possible when I am at Your side, when I am serving You... I wish to remain with You. That is not blind obedience, but rather my true desire.

You want me to do as I desire, even if it means leaving Your side? But, the fact that You've given this to me means that You don't really want me to leave... If that is what You desire, then I... I shall not do as You wish. I do not wish to leave Your side, Commander. If possible, I want to be with You forever...
Is it really right for me to have this...?
Those emotions... Are they all because of the Commander?

ex.line: Commander, what are you going to do today? I promised to try to help you today...
What else do I want to do...? Is there anything the two of us can do other than "play"? If I want to try doing everything, will you be okay with that...?
My free will, and the things I hold dear to me... Yes, I wish to give more of myself for you, and for this port. That is my will.
You wish for me to be the bird that flies freely, not one that is confined to a cage... Even if that bird wishes to remain at your side, you can allow that, right?
Playing with friends makes me feel good. But it's a different kind of good feeling compared to when I'm playing with you... The "good feeling" I get from you is special...
That feels so good...
So warm... I want to keep holding on to your hand, now and forever...
I shall offer you all that I am. That is my will, Commander...
Commander, can you leave this mission to me? You look rather tired, so please rest up for now.
Mission complete. If you think I did a good job, then... could you please praise me?
Commander, I've come to deliver the mail. Is it okay that I'm a bit late...?
I've been waiting for you all this time. I've wanted to see you... even if for no particular reason...
A new commission has just been completed. I shall now go greet my companions. Commander, if you have time to spare, do you think we could...
For victory, and for the one I love!
I am victorious. If it is not too much to ask, Commander, I would like a reward from you...
I have become soft and weak. Commander, I was afraid I'd never see you again, so I ran away... I'm so sorry...
I won't let you have your way...!
I can't let things end here, the Commander is waiting for me...!

You want me to tell you everything I want to do, and everything I don't want to do...? Very well, I promise. In that case, could you tell me what you want, Commander? I want to learn more about you, and experience more things with you...

lines.line: *sniffle*... Oh, Commander, what have I done...? I was supposed to serve You, and now I've committed a grave sin of messing everything up... Where did I go wrong...?
*sniffle*... Oh, Commander, what have I done...? I was supposed to serve You, and now I've committed a grave sin of messing everything up... Where did I go wrong...?
I was given a sacred mission to help in the pop-up restaurant, but I've gone and caused trouble for you and everyone else... Commander, how must I pray to make up for this...?
Wipe down the Commander's desk... Wipe down the table. Wipe down the Commander's statue... Aaand wipe down the Commander... Heheh...
Ah! When I finish cleaning, I should feed the birds in your office... Commander, the birds and I are very happy.
To carry out the Commander's orders, I need not just strength, but the skill known as service. This is another valuable lesson.
You'd like to clean with me? Commander, I couldn't trouble you like that... *sniffle* Here I go, racking up yet another sin...
Do you still like me... even though I can't perform my sacred mission...?
Commander...?
Commander, may I... serve you, so to speak...?
Commander, might you entrust me with your missions...? I'm eager to serve...
Commander, your mail, umm... No, it's not wet!
Commander, here's your... Eep?! Thank you, Commander. I hate to cause you trouble so soon after your return... This isn't too much of a bother, you say...?
The commission is complete. I'll make treats for the team right away.
For victory! And for my master, the Commander!
My holy mission to serve may be beyond me, but I can still fight...!
Commander, umm... Your kindness only makes me feel more and more guilty...

My sacred mission today is service, so I will exhaust all of my power to serve you, Commander. ...You think a pop-up doesn't require so much effort? Even if it wasn't a pop-up, it is my heartfelt desire to serve you with all my heart and soul. Is that so bad...?
Fletcher-class destroyer - Halford.

I'm Halford, Fletcher-class shipgirl with the Eagle Union. The 127th lord of a bloodline who rides upon the night sea... Huh? You think I said 126th when I introduced myself? But... No, I'd never blunder like... I-it's probably because you make me so damn nervous!
My name is Halford. I am the 126th lord of the Fletcher-class bloodline, an extraordinarily hard worker... Ahem. Commander of legend, do you wish to join my family?
You kept me waiting, Commander. How can you sleep so soundly when your work's piled up this much... Hurry and get to work!
That look in your eyes tells me you want to be a member of my family. ...W-wait a second. At least let me finish reading this...
My rigging, Dora, is my most loyal servant. Say hello, Commander.
Become a member of my family, and you'll gain immortality. Imagine how productive you'll be! ...I-I'm kidding.
Living in the dark, yearning for the light. That is our creed, that is our - wh-why are you laughing?! I'm trying to explain my backstory here!
I'll join you for all your work, night or day. Heheh, I'm a Daywalker, if you remember my backstory!
Be careful. You wouldn't want to be devoured by my cursed power.
Aww, sharing your umbrella with me? Heehee, of course. That's another part of your job as my family.
Huh?! D-do you want my blood that badly...?
Commander. You haven't finished your work yet.
Mission complete. Here are the fruits of your work.
Commander, you have mail. Don't forget to read it.
I picked you out for your abilities, so don't expect me to be impressed by one victory. Here's your work list for today. Begin your next battle - the battle against paperwork!
The commission team worked hard today. They even finished their work before nightfall.
Limitless power roils inside me... Let's get to work already!
It's work time right now... Time to get serious!
Heheh, this is my true power! Bear witness, indolents!
Huh?! I-I LOST?!
Indolents, be judged by the night!
I can't work under these conditions...
Excuse me?! I can hardly believe that you're this lazy! Fix your work ethic before you try joining my family!
As reward for finishing your work, I bequeath you with the most delicious blood: cherry juice! It's good, Commander. Give it a try.

Vampire curses are really only a thing in novels. I think it's a fun idea, but I don't actually want you to be cursed... O-of course, I would gladly protect you if you were! So... You can come a little closer, you know?
I'll keep trying hard, doing my job, fighting, and scattering all obstacles before you to become the perfect lord. Until then... Heehee, don't take those needy eyes off of me♪

Heheh, look at this novel I've been reading lately. It's a romance story about a vampire and her servant. They get to be together in the end... What do you think, Commander? Ready to play the part of a servant embraced by their vampire lord?
I-is this... a contract that binds us forever? Then my final task for the day must be... yes, to respond to your eternal vow. As this lord's servant, you will be by my side forever!
You did your homework, huh? Thanks.
I smell family...

ex.line: My dear servant, before we get to work, I want to share this novel I've been reading. "I Was Reborn as a Being of the Night, so I Built a Workaholic Empire!" Doesn't the title make it sound so interesting?
Are you curious about my outfit? Heheheh, this is a one-of-a-kind, made-to-order, vampire-themed outfit! I bought it as a little treat for all my hard work!
Do you feel like your work's gotten easier since you became my servant? Hmm... Oh, fine, I get it. I'll help you.
Feeling that bloodlust? I chilled some freshly-squeezed cherry juice. It's delicious♪
Servant, have you seen that new book I bought? ...Huh? It was in your room?
"With great power comes great workloads." That's my motto. Don't worry. I'm way stronger than you, so you can leave it all to me.
Only you get to do this, dear servant...
Do you want more... blood?
Huh?! D-did you just bite me?
Leave those unfinished missions to me.
Work complete. Well done. Want to replenish your energy with my blood?
There's mail for you. How about I read it out to you?
Servant of mine, are you tired? Heheheh, very well... Rest right here. I'll do your work for you♪
Yeah, yeah. I'll go see the commission team with you.
Servant, do you feel my power gradually returning to me? ...Yes! You're supposed to say YES when someone asks you that!
For your sake, I'll never stop winning.
Th-this is a real blunder... I don't want you to see me like this.

Do you like the setting of this novel? If you do, I could buy you a made-to-order outfit themed after it. I'd match, of course, heheh. Oh, I hope you don't think servants have the right to say no? Heehee♪

lines.line: "Welcome, dear guest♪ Right this way~ I'm happy to join you for a treat and chat♪" ...It was good? Well, obviously. I take my work very seriously!
"Welcome, dear guest♪ Right this way~ I'm happy to join you for a treat and chat♪" ...It was good? Well, obviously. I take my work very seriously!
My job today is to be by your side and treat you to conversation. Is this really good enough, though? Seems like easy work for the lord of a proud, storied lineage.
Does this look good on me...? If it does, I'll think of a way to incorporate it into my backstory... Hmm. Like a vampire lord who morphs into a rabbit on rare occasions...?
I made plushies to resemble Dora. No matter the field, I take my work seriously.
We don't have any iced cherry juice, but the other drinks are good. Want a recommendation?♪
Akashi said she'd hold a "Special Family Team-Building Exercise" if I chatted with you. It's honestly so easy that I'm getting suspicious...
Here's a soft cushion for you. We're hanging out for once, so don't think about work for now. I'll help you deal with it when the time comes♪
Beware you are not absorbed by, uh... the forbidden power of the rabbit lord?
Everyone in my family has smooth skin. Naturally♪
Huh?! Th-this isn't part of my job, right...?
Want to order a drink? It's not my job, really, but with great power comes great responsibility. I won't feel comfortable until I put in some proper work.
Our commission team has returned. I'll go check on... Mm. No, my job is to chat with you for now.

If there's one good thing about this job, I guess it's that I get to hang out with you. We're both so busy all the time, so it's hard to get quality time. I-I want to get to know you better, after all...
Battleship - Daisen.

I am battleship Daisen of the Sakura Empire. For safety's sake, I seal a portion of my power with two anchor ropes. Even in battle, I've always held back. Please rest assured - when I can fully control this power, I will give you all that I am.
It's a pleasure to meet you, Commander. I'm unworthy of this opportunity I've been given to serve you. I'll endeavor to satisfy you to the fullest - please, do not hesitate to ask me for anything.
I already tidied up your desk for you. Start your day with a fresh office and a fresh mind.
(Each season comes with new flowers. If I change the flower arrangements with the seasons, that should put the Commander in a good mood... Yeah, let's do that!)
...You think my service is on par with the Maid Corps? Heehee, thank you, but I'm confident I can do much better than them.
I made this hair accessory. If you like it... shall I make a matching necklace for you?
Commander, do you like this bell's chime? Understood. Come closer, and I'll shake it gently by your ear...
Heehee... Do you like the feeling of my hair touching your fingertips, Commander?
Are you curious about my anchor ropes, Commander? You won't be anchored just by touching them, so feel free.
C-could you at least lock the door first...
New missions have arrived. I've already classified them, so take a look!
Commander, we've completed another mission. Here's the reward manifest, if you'd please give it a lookover.
Mail bearing your name has come. I'll leave it on your desk.
Commander, congratulations on another successful voyage. Change into some fresh clothes, enjoy a cup of matcha I brewed for you, and relax. Heehee.
Commander, the commission is completed. I'll excuse myself and head out to handle the necessary proceedings.
My power grows... I'll have to be more careful when I anchor from now on.
All ships, to your positions. The Commander's deployment strategy will lead us to victory!
Under your command, the fleet has seized another victory both elegant and brilliant. I have the utmost respect for you.
I'm sorry, Commander. It's all my fault... Allow me to cover you while you retreat.
Blessings of purity, annihilate evil!
Releasing anchors!
Revered Commander, what service do you desire today?
Commander, I reorganized the bookshelf using a few bookends and made some bookmarks with natural materials. I hope you like it.
Commander, I lit some incense. Hopefully it'll soothe your mind a little. As for your physical fatigue... I'd be happy to give you a full-body massage.

Now that I think about it, there's a fundamental difference between me and maids. Maids would struggle to stay with their master forever, owing to the limitations of status... but I am no maid, so I don't have to worry about that!
"In the morning time, the dianthus I espy. I wish they were you." Commander, here's today's flower arrangement. I hope you enjoy the haiku I wrote while preparing it.

This isn't a dream? You really feel the same way... Of course. On my oath, I, Daisen, will toil ever more for your sake from now on. If I'm lacking at all... I hope you'll not spare me the rod, my dear Commander♪
Thank you very much. I promise to treasure this gift, Commander.
You have such great control of your power. I should learn from you.
Lady Nagato, please... Don't charge too far forward!
Lady Musashi, I'm in perfect fighting form. I await your orders.
Lady Akagi... Uncontrolled fire won't ONLY hurt the enemy.

ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I checked your office supplies, picked a new blend of incense, and made tea and snacks for you. May your work day start comfortably.
Hmm, my hair's getting a little frizzy. That probably isn't very pleasant to the Commander's touch, so I should take better care... Huh? Commander?! Y-you didn't hear anything, did you?
Your files are about to get blown away? Anchors... There. Now they won't be going anywhere.
Lately, I've gained better control over my power. Is it the power of our oath that caused this, or is it your own power?
Commander, if you want to relax and have your ears cleaned, let me know any time. Heehee, of course - you can lay your head right in my lap♪
Commander, you don't need to be so gentle... I can handle a rougher touch.
Where's my tail, you ask? Hmm... It's hard to describe. If you're so curious, why don't you search for it yourself? By feel, of course.
Heehee... Dear sweet Commander, my anchor ropes can tie down many more things than you might think.
Your organized list of missions is right here. Also, I made dianthus-themed sticky notes. Check both of them out~
Commander, here's your mission reward list, and here's a batch of celebratory treats I made.
I brought your mail for you. I offer you prayers as well, naturally.
"Your absence so long, deep in the mountains' embrace. Do I wait or go?" Welcome home, my beloved Commander.
Commander, might I suggest we go out to port and get some exercise together? Heehee, the commission team is back, safe and sound.
I grow even stronger... Heehee. That means I can serve you better than ever before.
Another impressive victory, Commander. Thank you for all your work. Shall we celebrate with tea, in favor of alcohol?
Releasing anchors! Commander, I'll handle enemy pursuers. Reform our forces at once. This fight isn't over yet!
Heehee. You chose to respond to my feelings directly instead of with poetry, so allow me to do the same. Commander, I love you very much♡

lines.line: Oh, Commander! You're here earlier than I expected. Ah, I finally get to serve you in this specially made attire, stuffed full of such fantasy and dreams... I'm ever so honored.
Oh, Commander! You're here earlier than I expected. Ah, I finally get to serve you in this specially made attire, stuffed full of such fantasy and dreams... I'm ever so honored.
Commander, may I ask for your help cleaning up the decorations later?
These are actually just decorative props. What really helps is... heehee, my desire to protect you, of course.
Are you surprised? Oh, I'm sorry for my lack of forethought. I just wanted to use this opportunity to improve your prayer experience...
It really was an effort to decorate this set. These are all just props, but I thought they might make the prayer a tiny bit more effective.
What did I pray for? Heehee, it's quite simple. I prayed to live a happy, normal life with you, Commander.
Hmm? You're impressed that my hair is still in place while I'm lying down? Oh, my.
Oh, Commander. You'll help me clean up now?
Where is my tail hiding? Heehee, well, it wouldn't be very hidden if I told you.
I see. You came running despite having missions waiting for you... I'm sorry, but that poses a bit of a problem for me as well.
Another mission completed. As impressive as ever, Commander~ Heehee, now you can focus on enjoying my service.
Based on that sound... You must have just received mail. Hmm? I have good hearing? Heehee, I am a bunny, after all.
You've had a long day. Why not lie down next to me and take a break? You could even lean on me... I'd be happy to hold you.
I hear the girls who were working on that commission. Commander, shouldn't you go and greet them?

I'm most delighted that you heard my prayer and chose to accept my service. Allow me to perform a short ceremony to improve our bond even more. It will require your wholehearted devotion as well, but I hope you're willing to help♡
Heavy cruiser - Napoli.

I am Napoli, heavy cruiser of the Sardegna Empire. The reason for my creation does not warrant being recorded. I ask for your undivided trust, Commander. Give me that, and I shall grant you victory, glory, and all else you desire.
I am Napoli. It's a pleasure to meet you, Commander. I've longed for this union since I was awoken. Indeed, may this encounter of ours brighten up your day as it has mine.
Commander? I happen to pass by on my stroll, you see. Now that you're here, care to join me?

I've heard that eating too much spicy food or sweets will ruin your skin. I eat those quite a lot, but I can't spot any differences in the mirror, so... could you be a sweetheart and examine my skin for me? Yes, come closer and look thoroughly.
How about we stop and go on a stroll, hmm? The breeze is lovely, the sun is shining, the seagulls are singing... I want to take it all in with you.
Would you like to talk about something? It could be culture, art, history, or even... Oh, you want to talk about ME? Heehee.
Oh... My apologies. My mind wandered for a minute. Do you want me to bring these papers to the archive? Okay... and where is the archive?
I like to think of myself as a woman who likes traveling, rather than one with a poor sense of direction. It's the joy of going to new places and seeing new sights... Care to experience it with me?
I've heard that patting another's head improves their sense of direction. Be a dear and keep doing it, would you? Heehee.
Hm? This behavior of yours is rather uncouth. Save it for when we're alone, okay?
Hmm? Are you fond of touching these? Why? Please, I'd love to hear it. Heehee.
Allow me to help you with this unfinished missio- Oh, I don't usually do tasks like this. Let me try it.
Mission completed. Have I served you well, dear?
There's a letter for you, Commander. I'm rather curious about this gorgeous envelope it's arrived in...
Congratulations on your mission, Commander. I've made you tea and snacks to... That's odd. Where did I put them?
Let me help you verify the goods. Rest assured, I'd never make a mistake with such an important task.
I implore you to wield my strength with finesse.
I shall relieve you of your existences. Heehee.
Such exemplary commanding - impressive. You must teach me your ways, Commander.
All ships, fall back. I shall keep the foe preoccupied.
Good night, stray beasts.
This is more likely to fool them, you see...
Commander, such an ambiguous approach makes you unsuited to be a leader.
I want to stroll along the pier, though I'm quite unfamiliar with the place... Would you mind coming along with me?

Mmh... Delicious... Why am I eating pineapple pizza, you wonder? Good question... An even better question: why was there pineapple pizza lying on my desk? Was it your dinner for tonight? My apologies. I'll have someone bring in a new one at once.

Would you care for a stroll by the beachside? Don't worry about my attire, sweetie. If I get wet, so be it, and I don't care for looking formal and the like. The breeze, the sunshine, and being by your side... those are more important to me.

This wreath is for you, Commander. Heehee. I've read in a poem that wreaths represent love. Only now after making one do I finally understand why... Do you mind? Lovely, then let me put it on for you!
I'm afraid this ring won't do much to better my sense of direction. Take my hand and hold me tight, Commander. Do that, and I'll never get lost again.
Thank you, Commander. I'll keep it by my side at all times.
Won't you give me a taste of the Empery's cooking?
What are you going to do - give the Commander a physical exam?

ex.line: You're here, Commander. Yes, I didn't get lost today. I suppose what I should say is... I'm waiting for you to invite me on a stroll.
I don't want to catch those eyes of yours staring at any other girl, Commander. You'll make her get as lost in your heart as I have. We can't have that, because you're mine.
I've got the hang of paperwork by now, Commander. You can stop bothering other girls with it and leave it all to me.
Diplomats often dance at balls as part of their work, so allow me to teach you some moves. Yes, place your hands like this... Feel free to place them further down, even.
What's that? You're studying intel on the enemy? I don't see why you'd concern yourself with such a thing. Can't you just beat them down with overwhelming force?
Commander? Oh, it seems my stroll has unexpectedly brought me to your room... Perhaps you could say that's part of the fun of traveling, heehee. What do you think?
Hm? Yes, I was thinking of you, too.
I've heard that massages are good for the skin. Incidentally, may I... borrow your hands for a bit?
I've been taking good care of these as well, by the way!
Don't worry about those missions. I'll handle them.
Mission complete. I daresay I've grown quite good at this.
Would you share the contents of this letter with me? I'm rather... scratch that, just a little curious.
Have a seat and get comfortable, Commander. I've made you tea and sweets. Indeed - your favorite ones. I've committed them to memory.
Let us head out and greet the commission team together.
Whatever foes or obstacles come between us, I shall eliminate them all.
My strategy went rather well. It was all thanks to your teachings, Commander.
This is far from over.

I've thought of a myriad of metaphors for my love for you. A lighthouse out at sea, a guiding star... None of them quite hit home, though. Perhaps I ought to forego such things and just express my unadulterated feelings... I love you. I will always be with you.

lines.line: Commander... Apologies for appearing before you like this. I'll try to get up right at once... Agh... I'm still so dizzy...
Commander... Apologies for appearing before you like this. I'll try to get up right at once... Agh... I'm still so dizzy...
Won't you come here and teach me how to play cards, like you promised? I think I should be able to handle it.
What are you looking for, Commander? ...There is a card missing? Hmm. Perhaps it is under me. You're free to come closer and look for it if you wish. Heehee.
I arrived early since I did not lose my way. Whilst waiting for you, I got thirsty, so I had this to drink. Alas, what you see now is the effect it had on me...
What type of game do I want to study? Are there even games just the two of us can play? If not, you may pick any game of your choosing.
Perhaps if I close my eyes, I'll draw better cards... Hm? I can do whatever I want since you promise you won't cheat, you say? Heehee. I trust you, Commander.
This is my next card... Hm? Am I playing it wrong? Did I break the rules, then? If so, can I expect a punishment?
Being touched in this manner is rather refreshing... Kindly do it more, Commander.
You'll help me get up? Thank you. Although, I would like to practice with you a little more.
Oh, here's that card that went missing... Mmh... Could you take it for me, Commander?
You have unfinished missions, Commander. I shall help you with... Hm? You worry that I'll make mistakes? Heehee. I promise I won't.
Mission complete. I don't see any errors - do you? Heehee. Good... Hm? I'm still a tad unsteady, so would you mind carrying me back home?
I've never before had a beverage like this. Its mouthfeel is quite good. Would you care to give it a taste? ...Hm? It will make my head spin, you say? Is that really so?
The commission team has returned. Worry not, I can come with you - I don't wish to leave your side already.

While I know little of card game rules, I know the role and the meaning of the cards. The four seasons, night and day, fortune, riches... The card you hold, the red heart, is the symbol of love. Did you know that? Heehee♡
Aircraft carrier - Admiral Nakhimov.
I'm Admiral Nakhimov of the Northern Parliament. In the sea of the digital I was born, and to your side I came to aid you. While I have my flaws, I hope I can be of great help to you.
Northern Parliament aircraft carrier, Admiral Nakhimov. Are you the Commander? Standing by for further instructions.
Program inspection: complete. Go ahead with your work, Commander. Let me know if you have any questions.
My suit is made with the latest airtight materials and sports both exceptional insulation and flexibility... Why are you staring so much? Do you want a suit of your own?
If nothing else needs an inspection, I'll head back to my workshop now. Send me a message if you get any questions.
Equipment status: green. I'm relieved it's been well-maintained... Hm? You're wondering how I'm doing? I'm fine, I guess. Thanks for asking.
"Tails"? Calling my cables that sounds pretty funny, actually... Got any more ideas like that?
You want to learn the basics of gear inspection? Sure. Let's start by taking this and- Please don't touch the connectooooor! It's a d-delicate instrument...
These aren't cat ears - they're auxiliary measuring instruments.
My little cables have quite delicate connectors. I'd rather you refrained from touching them.
Mmh... Mrreow! ...*gasp*! I think you just misheard me.
You have unfinished missions. Would you like my technical support?
Doesn't it feel great to complete missions efficiently? Seems my mission assistance system is working well.
I ran a smart sorter on your letters, Commander. Don't forget to read them.
Welcome back. Please hold still while I perform an inspection on the equipment used in the last battle.
The commission team has returned. I'll inspect their equipment.
Program efficiency has been raised.
Equipment functionality: green. Prepare for battle.
Test of new equipment: successful. Further adjustments necessary.
Critical equipment error. Requesting return to port for repairs.
Aircraft status: ready to take off! Commence attack!
Equipment damage... Still functional!
I need to concentrate on my work. Please don't bother me.
I updated my program based on your commanding habits in battle. Take me for a spin and write me your feedback after. I'll further adjust it sometime later.

Two hours remaining until the latest patch finishes installing. Go get yourself some rest, Commander. Oh, and thanks for helping with that test earlier. You're worried about whether or not I'm fitting in here, aren't you? I appreciate it. I'll be sure to make a support device that suits you perfectly.

My cables have a myriad of different uses. Some can do photography and transfer data, and some react to a rise in my heartbeat, body temperature, and emotion by coiling themselves around you. As for that last part, the reason behind that warrants further research.

Commander, I sent you an encoded message and... What? You already decoded it? That was amazingly fast... Hm? You want me to read it out for you? Well... "Commander, I love..." Ugh, please don't make me say it out loud!

What is this, Commander? Some kind of... part for a machine? What? A pledge of your love? Oh, forgive me... I understand now. You already know my answer - "I do." Now put it on my... Oh no, what are my tails doing?! Cut it out! Let the Commeownder go!
Thanks. I like it, so I'll cherish it.
Let's talk technology when you have the time.

ex.line: Program inspection: complete. You can start working now, Commander. Wait, before you do that, will you... pat my head? Thanks. Meow♡
This is my workshop. Pretty dull place, don't you think? Hm? Teach you how to use my tools and gear? Sure. I'll teach you everything from A to Z.
Machine fault inspection: complete. Anything I can help you with, Commander? If not, I'll sit right here and leave you to your devices.
You want me to wear fluffy clothes? THAT came out of nowhere... but if you want that, then I'll find something to wear after work.
I've given you admin permissions for all the machines in my workshop. Oh, and keep an eye out for those red alerts.
Hey, why do you carry around medicine containing... catnip? Are you sick? Uhh, don't get any closer... *sniff sniff*... Your fingers smell so good... Meeeow♡
If you do like these "cat ears"... I'll just keep them on.
I improved my machine's durability while I gave it an upgrade. You can touch it now if you want.
That's good... Meeeow! ...*gasp*! Pl-please don't do that when everyone can see us... *blushes*
You didn't receive any mission notifications? Sounds like the feature needs some tweaking. Until it's fixed, I'll be the one notifying you.
Efficient as always. That's what I like to see, Commander.
Remember to claim your mail, Commander. I optimized the function and took away all the legwork.
Welcome back. Take a seat and get comfor- Oh, my cables are coiling around you again... I'll sever the connection and do an equipment inspection.
I'm working on an auto-confirm function for incoming commission goods. Hope it'll save you some time.
Test of new equipment: successful. Perfect synergy with the Commander's strategy achieved.
I'll need your help with the troubleshooting later, Commander.

Have a look at this code, Commander. I came up with it myself and even put it in the startup sequence of your support device... You've already deciphered it? Yeah, you've got it right. Print. "I love you, Commander. I never want to be without you."

lines.line: What are you doing on the set, Commander? Here to check on the progress? But won't this spoil your first impression of the final cut? Well, the video is made for you anyways, so consider this a preview.

What are you doing on the set, Commander? Here to check on the progress? But won't this spoil your first impression of the final cut? Well, the video is made for you anyways, so consider this a preview.
Good timing, Commander. We just got done shooting and I'm wondering if you have any suggestions... Try to smile more naturally? I'll give it a shot.
Are these... records? Frankly, I don't get the appeal of an outfit with no functionality or utility... I suppose you don't mind it, though?
The human eye and the camera lens view the same thing differently. By which I mean: Focus on the camera, not me, Commander.
Relax and take deep breaths with you? Okay. *huff*... *puff*... *huff*...
The lighting broke? I'll fix it. Don't worry, it won't impact the photoshoot. Heck, if anything, fixing it will help me relax.
Drink some water and take a break, huh? Sure. Wait... What's that smell? Is this tea made with catnip? Commander, I... Mgh... Ah... Meow♡
Yes, I've adjusted the design and color of my cat ears to match my outfit.
Straighten out a bit? What, like this? Okay, this is embarrassing stuff...
Right in front of the camera?! B-but I... Ah... Mreow...♡
I could inspect your gear if you... Just focus on the photoshoot? Alright, I will.
Commission team is back. I don't think I'm dressed to perform a machine inspection, though...
Was my smile good? Nice. Appreciate you giving me direction.
I'm just not good with cameras...

I'm currently deleting some sloppy photos I took with my remote control before you came. My pose and expression were just too stiff... Don't delete them? You think it's cute when I'm nervous and shy? In that case... I'll put them behind a password so only you can view them.

Commander, come here and plant a saxaul... Oh, I look like I'm enjoying this a lot? Yeah. It's because I don't get to do much outdoor work, since I'm always stuck in my workshop, poring over data and equipment. Also, you're here with me.

Commander, come here and plant a saxaul... Oh, I look like I'm enjoying this a lot? Yeah. It's because I don't get to do much outdoor work, since I'm always stuck in my workshop, poring over data and equipment. Also, you're here with me.
Commander, there's a vacant spot over there, so could you plant another saxaul there? ...You're not worn out, are you? Let me hold your planting tools for you.
...Oh. I'm trying to create a saxaul pattern using code for a keepsake. What do you think?
I've never done desert afforestation work before. It's a bit tiring, but it's also fun, and above all, it's worth the effort.
You need to hydrate, Commander. You're likely to catch heatstroke in places like these. Here, you can borrow my sun hat.
It's hard to walk in all this sand... Could you hold my hand, Commander?
What is it, Commander? Is there sand on my face? Hey, wait, don't just stroke my chin like- Okay... Meow!
Whoa... Was my hat about to blow off? Thanks.
Sunscreen? I've never used it much... You'll spread it on for me? Hmm. Alright.
Right here? Mgh... Mreeeow!
Saxaul planting is done. I can't wait to see how they look fully grown.
You finished planting over there, Commander? I've still got a bit to go, so give me a minute... Alright. You're in good condition and have energy to spare, so... would you mind? Thanks.
Placing: first. Congratulations on your victory, Commander. I'm glad if my cheerleading played a part... My mechanical skills also played a part, you say? True. Then I guess I'm pretty glad.
Placing: first. Congratulations on your victory, Commander. I'm glad if my cheerleading played a part... My mechanical skills also played a part, you say? True. Then I guess I'm pretty glad.
Whew... Welcome back, Commander. I'm finished inspecting your car. It's good and ready to exit the pit whenever you want.
Since this outfit is meant to cheer you on, I put emphasis on its functionality. What functionality, you ask? Ah, well... whatever is most "practical" for you, I suppose?
It's tough to do both cheerleading and maintenance, but it does mean I get to spend twice as much time with you, so I'm happy.
Opening a bottle is a good capstone to a blood-pumping race. I should probably... Hm? You thought it was vodka?
A pose that'll cheer you on more effectively... Like this? Did that make your heart skip a beat?
Ahh... The smell of oil can't cover up the smell of catnip... *sniff sniff*... Mrreow♡
Always aching to touch my ears, huh? Mrreow♡
The fabric may not be as delicate as my connectors, but it's still delicate, you know...?
Ahh, mmgh... Your scent, it's making me... Mrreow...
Ahh... Great job, Commander... Take a photo? Okay, I'll get ready right now. Just snap it whenever you want.
Commission goods have arrived. My full-auto inspection program is already running, so all you need to do is have a look.
Test of new equipment: successful. I'll install it in your car next time, Commander.
Mechanical failure... I'd better get back to my main job.

Look at this, Commander. It's how the next race is going to run. Think it's good? Well, I made a program that can calculate your most optimal route, which I reckon will be useful for- Y-you're bringing the catnip so close... and yourself...
Light cruiser - Bayard.

I am Bayard. Though I was given life in a fleeting dream, I remember the expectations placed upon my name. However, my name is not what makes me who I am now - it is because I am a knight that I cherish the name I've been given.

I am Bayard, but a simple chevalier chosen by the Iris. You are the Commander who will lead me, I presume? ...No, I need no explanation. When I saw your face, I knew that you were the one I must follow.
Commander, pray begin today's work. I will wait here until it's complete.

Without the power to restrain myself, how can I hold a weapon and claim that I am able to protect others? I don't want to be a good-for-nothing who leans purely on a title - I wish to be true to myself and worthy of the title of knight.
In war, there's a line that you mustn't cross. When you go too far, it's not war. It's just slaughter.
I am but a single, ordinary knight. I have neither status nor achievements. Even if you take away my spurs and my sword belt, even if I'm called worthless, it doesn't change that I'm a knight.
The light of peace is more valuable than any medal of honor. I take my sword in hand and face the endless trials of chivalry in order to see people's smiles.
I'm right here, Commander.
What is the meaning of this?
Commander, I urge discretion...
Missions are but another part of the trial. I will accompany you until they're completed.
Good work, Commander. Do you need help listing and storing your mission rewards?
Here's your mail. Check it soon, lest you forget.
Battles are trials given by the Iris. Overcome the trial, and you will prove that you've grown once more.
Our friends return after a successful commission. Shall I join you in welcoming them?
This power is meant to lead us on the righteous path.
My desire is to overcome all hardship.
The battle has ended, Commander. If only that could be the end of the war...
My shield may break, but my sword and I are still intact!
You'll find no salvation here!
A worthy opponent!
If thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
Le bon chevalier... I like this name very much. Commander, to be known as "the good knight" is the utmost honor, in my opinion.
When I was choosing a weapon, I opted for this greatsword. I wasn't confident that my shield could protect everyone, so I decided that my body should serve as that shield if needs must.
The more time we spend together, the stronger I believe in my own wishes and morals. Before I knew it, you became one of the forces driving me forward...
Every victory and achievement, I dedicate to you. You are every answer I seek, the rock that my heart leans on... Such insolent wishes I have. God, forgive me...

My feelings for you can no longer be restrained. All I can offer you now is my eternal, undying love... May this ring serve as proof. As for the kiss that seals it... This is my first, so please don't tease me for being unskilled...
Umm, sorry... I'm so happy that I'm not sure what to say.
I'd love another book rec after this battle's over.

ex.line: Before you start work today, allow me to set ten minutes aside to get you into the right mental space.
A true knight is not made by title, honor, or status. Anyone who has a knight's spirit may be called a knight.
Someday, we won't need weapons anymore. Knights will no longer be necessary. But that's the kind of future I want.
If one's purpose for fighting is to annihilate, to destroy, then it's my duty to stand in opposition.

I want to be fair, tolerant, humble, and pious. If my money is better suited to enriching others' lives... If my fame and honor could be used to touch others... Then I'm just fine giving all of that up.
Is this a reward? For... me?
Let me just close my eyes and stay by your side...
You've dragged me into the abyss of desire, too, I see...
Let's tackle this mission together. You don't need to worry about the workload.
Commander, I suggest taking a short break before you gather your rewards.
Welcome home. As a reward for overcoming your trials... (Bayard gives you a warm hug.)
I finished receiving the mission rewards. Here's a list of what we received... Umm? Is there something on my face?
In the Commander's name, I will annihilate you.
Commander, the battle is over. Let's cross this sea of sorrows and return home.

In my time with you, I've learned to confront my own emotions. I shouldn't suppress my love. So now, I'm letting you see my... shameful, unsightly side. Please... hold me tight, and give me your warmth.

lines.line: Welcome, Commander. ...You really don't know what I'm doing? So there are things even you don't know. This is a new means of training knights, you see. Expect ever greater exploits from me.
Welcome, Commander. ...You really don't know what I'm doing? So there are things even you don't know. This is a new means of training knights, you see. Expect ever greater exploits from me.
Commander, about your work today... Well, would you be able to focus on supervising my training for today?

Akashi tells me that only training can yield growth. But if it means maintaining this posture for long periods of time, then this is difficult training indeed... Hmm? My hands are supposed to be on both sides of my head?
I will serve you as a worthy knight would, maintaining my humility and piousness all the while.
Staying balanced, back straight, holding my fingers as such... How's this? Are you satisfied with the results of my training?
Did I startle you...? I see. I dazzled you, didn't I? Then my training was worthwhile, heehee.
Is this... a reward for my diligence?
C-Commander, it's getting hard to stay balanced...
Is this an additional trial? Then please proceed.
C-Commander... Don't worry about me. Just take care of your missions. I'll train hard in your absence.
Have you completed your missions? I'm sorry... I may not be able to help inspect the rewards for a while to come.
Welcome back. Oh, you'd like to see the results of my training? Unfortunately, umm... I'm not exactly ready...
The commission was completed while I trained. Time flies when I have your encouraging gaze upon me.

I'm not only training to be a better knight. It is also important to make my loved ones happy... such as by wearing an outfit you like and letting you see me in a perfectly trained posture. Commander... I pray that you still love me like this.
Battleship - Kansas.
Union battleship Kansas... Zzz... Oh, I'm not actually sleeping. It's just hard to be energetic... Don't worry. I'm still ready to fight for you.

Mmm... Commander? I was just resting my eyes. I didn't think you'd get here so fast... Ahem. I'm battleship Kansas with the Eagle Union, and I'm ready to fight for you any time. By the way... are there any missions I need to fight in today?
*yawn*... Another new day. I'm ready whenever, just say the word... Mind if I take a nap first, though?
My hair? *sigh*... If it's not messy, then don't worry about it. It's easier to just let it all hang... Hm? Of course... It makes it easier to sleep comfortably.
Mm... If there's no special work to be done, then let's go look at the scenery and find a place to doze... I'll let you pick the place...
Commander, you mentioned going to a seminar... Whatever it is, there must be too many people there. I don't think I have the energy for it...
I did all your work for you already... Hmm? That was too fast? That just shows how hard I worked... Yep, time for bed.
I wasn't slacking off this whole time... I just used up all my energy when you weren't looking. I'm only resting right now... so I can be ready to fight for you...
Commander, your hand... Actually, never mind. It's fine there.
Mm... Ready to fight, just say the word... *yawn*... Oh, you're just touching me? Have at it, then...
Commander, I'm awake right now...
Hmm... Are we assigning tasks now?
Missions are done. How about a nap?
Wanna... check your mail? I'll leave it up to you...
Thanks for all your hard work... Where should we go rest now? My place, or yours?
The commission's completed? Great. I'll wait here for you to come back, so you go welcome them home...
Hmm. Now I can relax in style.
Then today, I fight for the Commander! But let's get it over with quickly...
Welp, we won. How about we just head back now? There are too many people here... It's not great for my mental health.
Oh, okay. So we lost. Gather the fleet and get ready for retreat...
I have awakened. Bring it on!
*yaaawn*... I'm getting exhausted...
Don't waste your energy, Commander... Never mind. Do what you want...
Did you come to wake me up again? Mm... Okay. I'm ready to set sail at... Zzz...
Commander? The weather is so nice. Just let me lie down a little... Hmm... Or you could join me?
It's so quiet here in your office... Can I slack off - ahem, stay with you a little longer? If you need me, just wake me up... Hmm? I'm being too obvious? Who cares... Good night...

How long have you been staring at me now... I can't sleep well if you keep doing that... What? Would I rather sleep alone or with you watching me? That's a hard choice... I do sleep better with you around, though.

Commander, you wouldn't secretly make such a big decision while I was sleeping, would you? You might not realize it, but I'm always watching you... I promised I'd fight for you any time, so of course I'll stay by your side... Mm... Suddenly, I'm really sleepy. But now, I can sleep next to you all the time...
Hm? I love everything you pick out for me, of course.

ex.line: Are you here to wake me up again? Okay, okay, I'll get up... Actually, give me five more minutes...
Socializing? No, thanks. You're the only person I feel like talking to, Commander...
Shopping list? Hmm... Sounds hard. I'll do the next battle plan first... No wait, maybe the next... Oh. All of these have so many decisions to make. I feel my energy draining...
You've been staring, Commander... Are you spacing out, or do you want to rest with me? Or... Is this a sign that I should hurry up and fall asleep?
Finished with work? Good. We can do the sorting later. How about a nap for now? I'll help when my energy is replenished... It won't take long.
Do you want to go out for a walk today? Hm? I can muster the energy if you're around, and it means I get to be with you longer... We can also just sleep together, though, if you want...
*yawn*... Keep petting me, and I really will fall asleep...
Ready for bed? Then come over here. I can barely keep my eyes open...
Mm... I won't be able to sleep if you keep that up...
Missions... Even if you can't motivate yourself to do them now, they'll still be there when you wake up.
Finally... You have time to sleep with me.
New mail again? You're so sociable...
Commander, I'm happy you're home safe. Now, lie in my lap... Isn't that comfy? Let's sleep together now...
Good, the commission was a success... Hurry and go see them, Commander. I'll do my best to be awake when you get back.
Did it work? Good. Back to bed I go...
With you by my side, we can win faster than ever...!
When I'm fighting for you, I can stay focused and alert for long periods of time.
We should retreat... Relax. Everything will be okay.

Are you asleep already? Oh, no... Is it because I didn't help enough today? Will I have to lengthen my working hours and learn to take on more duties? Mm... Maybe tomorrow. For now, I'll just... sleep in your arms a little longer...

lines.line: *yawn*... That's enough rest. It's just you and me tonight... Whatever it is that you want from me, I've stored up enough energy to go all the way.
*yawn*... That's enough rest. It's just you and me tonight... Whatever it is that you want from me, I've stored up enough energy to go all the way.
Mm... When you got here, I woke right up. You're the only person who can make me feel this way...
Commander, let me lean on you for a bit. I'm not out of energy, no, it's just... Umm, I like doing it...
I can't waste my energy on trivial things. My full power must stay reserved for whenever you demand it.
Tonight, I'm at your disposal... What I do and how I do it is all up to you. I won't fall asleep first, I swear...
Hmm? You'd like to know our signature cocktails? Well... I'll make them all either way, so why not just order me, instead?
Can we stay together... a little longer?
Hm? Would you like to order? Or... Do you just want to touch me? Either way is fine.
Hmm... Maybe it's time I unleash my full power. I just hope the energy I have left is enough to satisfy you...
Commander, missions just came in... The sooner you finish them, the sooner we can get back to relaxing.
Mission complete... Let's relax and enjoy the rest of our night together.
*yawn*... Good work. I actually just built up enough energy to come see you. So... Want a drink?
Phew... I think tonight is going to be a long night.

With you here, by my side... I'd love to just sleep the night away, but I don't want to take my eyes off of you... Do you feel the same way? Hehe, I guess romantic nights come with their own dilemmas...
Battleship - Mecklenburg.

I am the Nachthexe, otherwise known as Iron Blood battleship Mecklenburg. Listen to the symphony of boiling blood and madness! To the poem of electric guitars and drums in tandem that pierces the sky! As my witchly power surges, to the lonesome, lofty sky realm shall I ascend!

Hmph, so even the famed Commander wishes to be free of the shackles of gravity... D-do you, really? If you acknowledge my abilities, I might very well... lend you this flying machine - blessed with witchly powers.

Commander, behold this impeccable weather. Even nature's ambient waste dares not show itself... You want to freely soar the skies with me, eh? Hah! Fittingly, I just recharged my flying machine. Wanna go for a ride? I said: Wanna go for a ride?!

Should the sun, to shine, refuse, the eternal blood moon will rise with you. The witch shall recite a dark incantation. The heavens shall crack from light, wings of destiny shall take flight, then comes the oracle of the dark night - this eve, who shall join me in the sky?
I've run a little short of magic components for the next-generation flying machine I'm working on... Will you come help me look for some tonight, Commander?
Ahem. What I have in my hand is the Magical Tome of the Dark Night. It will allow me to seize incredible powers that- Hm? It's a night battle notebook? A-ha! All the more reason to read it.

The flight plan for the new Dark Oracle - running on my pure witchly power, of course - is set for midnight! Its official designation shall be... Huh? "Operation: Skyfall"? No! Absolutely not! My powers would never fail and lead to a crash!

Seeing as the port has no notable events planned for tonight, it seems the airborne gatherings that I host can continue! I could bring in a rock band for tonight's climax... Ahahaha! I must continue preparing for the flying show!
Can you feel my witchly power? I'm brimming with it!
Hm? Do you want to revel in the dark night together?
Heehee... So you've fallen for this witch's charm. Care to experience the joy of falling from the sky as well, hm?
You can't forever gaze at the skies - you need to touch the ground and carry out your missions. Go forth, Commander!
Do remember to claim your rewards, alright? Or else I'll take them for my own purposes.
Is this an invitation to the Night of Witches' Flight? Consider it accepted. Off we go!
Praise to you, Commander. Rest while you can, for we'll soon make haste to the soaring witches' night gathering! ...It'll be a long ride!
The girls that went on a commission are back. Perhaps they've brought magic components for my Midnight Wings with them?
My witchly power grows and grows! Tonight, I shall rise with the blood moon!
Things are heating up, I see. I hope you've braced yourselves for the Nachthexe's wrath!
Gaze in awe! Know the Nachthexe's might!
We were THIS close! I'm SO gonna rain hellfire on them next time!
Heehee... See what the Nachthexe is truly capable of!
Urgh... Thank goodness my flying machine is intact...
You really don't understand the greatness of flying. You'll just have to walk with the rest of the commoners.
A witch defying gravity knows too well the world of loneliness. Heehee... Keep your eyes out during the night, and you'll see me flying across the face of the blood moon.
It is my fate as the Nachthexe to soar across the midnight sky. Do you know what that means, Commander? ...Huh? You know just how I feel and what I want? Okay, I understand...

You said you know how I feel and what I want, so you'll be the one to name my plan for tonight! Indeed, you and I will fly together for the entire night! A-and I really do mean the entire night, so...
Commander, these are my Wings of the Dark Night. My witchly power is concentrated in them, and they're for you alone. Do you like them? Don't worry - I'll keep you safe. I won't leave your side.

Commander, our souls are drawn to one another... Every night from this day on, I will bring you on a journey through the skies, and I will make the dark night dance for you until morning comes. This is the Nachthexe's everlasting spell.
Hmm! I love this! It's perfect for a fun evening!
Have you ever seen a flying machine brimming with witchly powers before?
Do NOT touch my flying machine! I mean it! It'll curse you!

ex.line: Commander, this next flight will not take ordinary witchly power. It will take the ultimate spell, capable of breaking through the heavens with blazing flames and leading us to the edge of the galaxy... Hm? What's with that look? Do you not believe me?

I feel it - all my witchly powers have combined into one! This time for certain, the Night Roamer will take me up to the sky and bring me to the abyss's deepest depths! Commander, will you come with me?
Commander, a more splendiferous world must lie beyond the sky. With the courage given by my witchly power, I swear that I will surpass my limits and reach that world beyond!
Ahh, I see you have plans to take over the world, Imperator... Heh, of course I knew it was your work schedule. I merely wanted to have a look.
Oh, Commander, what's that on your back? ...A parachute? What for? My power, my flying machine... and I myself will never let you have a reason to use such a thing!
The blood moon is in the sky, and the wind howls... What a splendid night. Come, Commander, and join me in a grand carnival!
More and more of your power seeps into me, my Imperator...
Hm? Did the surge of my power stir something within you?
N-never do that while we're in the air! At least wait until we've landed!
Imperator! Commander! Pretend these missions are necessary for the soaring witches' night gathering and get them done!
You finished a mission, did you, Commander? Hah. Then come and help me infuse my flying machine with power.
Commander, wanna try a spell that claims your mail for you? Making a device like that wouldn't be too difficult.
Splendid work, Commander. I'm prepared for tonight's gathering. My potent witchly power will allow us to reach new heights!
Huh?! The commission team has come back... but how are they flying so high?!
Whoa... My witchly power shall attempt to tear through the skies!
Doesn't this power strike fear even in the heart of you, my Imperator? ...I asked you a question! Say something, Commander!
When you use witchly powers, it's inevitable that something won't go the way you hoped...
Imperator - my Commander. I wish to surpass the bounds of current knowledge and keep exploring the endless abyss of the dark night side by side with you. What do you wish to do?

lines.line: Commander - I mean - Imperator! You've been seeing me far too little as of late, which has left me in a very sour mood. I will punish you by inscribing my seal on your body, so that you'll remember me! Um... How do I do this, again?

Commander - I mean - Imperator! You've been seeing me far too little as of late, which has left me in a very sour mood. I will punish you by inscribing my seal on your body, so that you'll remember me! Um... How do I do this, again?
Welcome to my shop of refreshments, Imperator. I'm glad you answered my call. Now, let this searing pain leave a mark on your memory!
Ahem... You are my Imperator alone, and I am your Nachthexe alone. This night together shall deepen our bond.
Welcome to my domain! Now come and revel in this pain that gnaws at the soul; in this pleasure that sends you to the heavens!
Hm? Why do you have a marker pe- I mean, a Branding Mark? Do you seriously mean to brand me? I'd love to see you try to- W-wait! Not my thigh! It tickles like mad!
The whip? Oh, you mean this? Yes, I felt a tremendous power flow into me the moment I took it in hand. I feel an even greater power when I swing it! Go on, you give it a try as well!
Oh? Do you want my brand more deeply imprinted on you?
Even if you'd welcome receiving my brand, it's too late to- Huh? You wanted my brand since the very start?
Agh... Why does this pleasure feel like being launched skyward?!
Go, my Imperator, and realize your duty! Complete your missions before I imprint my brand upon you!
You're finished? That was rather quick. Are you that excited to receive my brand?
Splendid! You fought well! The power granted by my brand lets you conquer everything, doesn't it?
I feel it... Power surges from within my body!
By the pact of this brand, you are to grant me the power to fly, Imperator... Not yet? Oh. Well, then let's take this time to "deepen" this bond between us. Soon, it will be time... Heehee♥
Destroyer - Vittorio Cuniberti.
I'm Vittorio Cuniberti of the Sardegna Empire. My passion is researching pioneering subjects. Of course, if you need my knowledge put into practice, I'm more than happy to oblige.

Good day to you, Commander. I am Vittorio Cuniberti, a Sardegnian destroyer. It's a pleasure. From now on... Hmm? You're hankering for an academic discussion? I'd be delighted! Tell me, what should we discuss? If mew want... I-I mean, ahem!

Your work documents are ready. Start whenever you feel like. Heheh... It was no big deal. I just considered what I would want if I were in your shoes - Oh? It looks like double your usual work? That can't be... I thought I'd reduced it...

The only subjects worthy of my study are the ones that are utterly incomprehensible to mundane minds. Hmm... The solution to this one can't possibly be as simple as it looks. Heheh... I already have an idea. Let's start the experiment right away!

Ahem... I have more than one method at my disposal to solve this. See here? This presents a totally new perspective. Huh? You've found a logical flaw? That can't be... I checked this so many times! Commander, think harder before you offer a conclusion!
*sigh*... I've explained this three times. How can people still not understand it? How do they plan to pass the exam... Huh? Do I look smug right now? H-heh...
They were doing research in this story, but they left it unfinished! Commander, we need to follow up on this! Right now! To the laboratory we go! Even if it blows up, this is vital!
Wow... The port library has so many more books than I imagined... Huh? This one is clearly on the wrong shelf... Heheh, I've studied collections management. Time to put my knowledge to practice!
Mreow?! Hands off my headband, please!
Hmm... Meow?! Geez, you scared me! ...Oh?! I just had a flash of inspiration!
I-I-I have a question! The optimal sequence of romantic development should mean that the next step is... Argh, what was it? Why can't I remember?!
A new mission? Fantastic! Let's keep our brains limber and agile!
The process of completing a mission involves the acquisition and application of knowledge... Is this how you learn, Commander?
New correspondence has come for you. I'll go get it - it's hardly fair to waste your study time on trivial matters.
Commander, work-life balance matters. Get some rest. I already know what needs to be done, so rest assured - I'll handle it.
Commander, the commission has been completed. I'll go pick the team's brains!
Heheh. Yet more knowledge for me.
We have ample intelligence and ammunition. Time to put some fear into those unprepared buffoons!
Heheh... A textbook victory.
I lost? Well, that removes one suboptimal path... Let's run it back!
Now you'll see what raw knowledge can do!
So this is real combat... It's a lot harder than my simulations!
I thought I could learn so much from you, but it looks like I'll have to be the teacher now. *sigh*...

Ahem... Commander, did you need me for something? Otherwise, I don't know why you'd be staring so much... Yes, I know - I watch you in my peripheral vision. So? Do you want to learn something, or do you think that my earnest work is worth learning from?
Commander, let's go read in the library today. Ugh, you have work? Hmm... Then I'll bring a book here! I can study anywhere as long as you're there with me!
This is such a weird feeling... My heart won't stop pounding. Could this be... love's ultimate puzzle?! Have you encountered this puzzle, too, Commander?
Commander, do you remember that puzzle I mentioned? Well... I think I've figured out the solution! Heheh, I'll show you the most beautiful mathematical proof. Just you watch!

Commander... Love is such a difficult puzzle to solve. Heheh, I'VE already found the perfect solution, but I can't just share it with you... All you need to know is that you, yourself, are the solution. Because from now on, you'll take my hand and lead the way... won't you?
I've never seen this before! Fascinating!

ex.line: Finally... Finally, I can calculate your daily workload with perfect precision! How did I do it? Heheh, consider it a logic puzzle... Ahem! Promise me a reward, and I'll tell you. What will it be, Commander?
Commander, I'm here to help you work! Hup... There, this is a good spot... Hm? Why am I sitting in your lap? To better assist you, of course. Now I can scrub your face for you, and more!
So many people have been coming to me with questions lately, even some of the top ones... Does this mean they actually like my explanations? Hmm... I like it, heheh.
Critical thinking and self-reflection will help develop good study habits! Once I've conquered this subject, you can rely on me for everything, Commander. Heheheh...!
Hmm... Cooking is harder than I thought. Oil keeps splashing onto my clothes, and the pots and pans are so easy to get burned on... Was home ec always this difficult?

Commander, I finally learned how to make cupcakes! Tadaaa! Don't they look good? ...Huh? You can't look away from your work right now? Then what if I hand-fed you... like this! Mreow?! Y-you bit my finger!
You made a total mess of my hair! Geez, you'd better fix this before I go to the library!
Staaare... I'm analyzing you right now. Heheh, I could study you for a lifetime and never get bored!
I'm even starting to understand this touchy-feely stuff a little... Check out my solution to this one, Commander...!
You've got new missions again! More tasks mean more brain activity, which enhances learning... I see. Work exists to help us learn more! It all makes sense now!
Your work efficiency is skyrocketing! Did you learn a new methodology? Teach me!
I'll go get your mail. Along the way, I'll try to figure out this tricky problem...

Welcome back! While you were gone, I encountered eleven unexpected issues in my experiments, and I found it difficult to focus on studying... Did I miss a more complex issue - the issue of missing you, perhaps?
Commander, the commission team just got back. Let's go see if they made any new discoveries!
Behold the power of knowledge!
Heheh! Victory was the expected outcome.
...I've already found our failing. Come, Commander. We must analyze it!

Commander, are you ever going to ask how I solved love's ultimate puzzle? Heheh, give me a hug, and I might just tell... Eep?! Y-you're bridal carrying me?! We're in public! But in this position, it's easy to do this... Mwah! This was the ultimate solution... that I wanted to share with you.

lines.line: To study an animal's habits, you must first learn and imitate... B-basically, what I'm doing is imitating how cats do things! Don't read into this!
To study an animal's habits, you must first learn and imitate... B-basically, what I'm doing is imitating how cats do things! Don't read into this!
Commander, I think I'm starting to understand how cats feel... Why, I'm practically dying to bat at that cat toy. Kitties must feel the same way, don't you think?!
Purr, purr... Purr, purr... This is how cats get their owners' attention. When they do that, their owner needs to scratch under their chin... Then, they'll be happy!
Commander, I'll get bored if you just keep waving around the same toy all day. Can you pick a new toy? I have yarn, and... Huh? What's with this belt? Do cats like belts?
I'm the one who spilled the milk. Cats like to do that, so... Oh! Can I play with it more?
Geez, Commander... I understand it's easy to get distracted by how cute those cats are, but we're in the middle of important research! You should be focusing on me!
