Why did I lick my glove? Because it's where you just touched. This is how a cat learns her owner's scent.
Mreow?! You should know that cats' ears aren't to be touched so flippantly!
Hyah?! C-Commander! Do NOT touch my tail without permission! I'll bite!
Commander, where did you learn to do that? I-it feels nice...
Zzz... Mmnh... Commander, welcome back... Huh?! I-I wasn't sleeping! Cats only ACTUALLY sleep for four to five hours a day - the rest of the time, they're just dozing!
Commander, I've cracked the code of feline courtship! Heheh, showing their bellies is just one way. See... Hyah?! My bra strap slid off?! D-don't look! Look, and I'll bite! Grrr, chomp!
Light cruiser - Dmitri Donskoi.
Yoohoo! I'm Dmitri Donskoi, and I'm a blueprint ship of the Northern Parliament! You know, I'm actually a super-popular star. Haha, I saw that smile! You can tell, can't you?
Yoohoo, Commander! I've been looking ALL over for you! Whaaat? YOU were looking for ME, too? Pssh, whatever - anyway, you must be so happy to meet me, right? Heheh, it's written all over your face!
Yoohoo! Look at that, we meet again! I kept your seat warm for you. Aren't you happy?
Guess who! ...Correct! High five for your BFF! Hehe.
Yoohoo, Commander! Guess what snack I brought today! Tadaaa - it's a super-rich chocolate cake! It's a perfect refreshment for a long day's work! I bought it for you, so eat up!
Commandeeer! Have you noticed anything different about me today? Haha, that's right! I didn't say yoohoo this time! Would I be just as popular this way, you think?
Yoohoo, Commander! Is anything on your mind? Talk to me, if you need to. After all... the whole reason I'm here is to help you!
Yoohoo, Commander! Everyone says you're the most popular person at port. You've gotta have some kind of secret, right? Huh? You don't? Well, I'm gonna wait here until you give me pointers!
Whoa! You can just take my hat off if you want, you know. Like this... Huh? Come on, back to petting!
Ah! Hey, Commander, how can I be even more popular? Got any advice for me?
Whoa! You're unusually bold. I like that!
You're going to let me handle this new mission, right? Right? Riiiiight?
Yoohoo, mission's done! A big win for the Commander - and for me, by extension!
Yoohoo! Reminder from the super-popular Dmitri: you've got new mail, so read it soon!
Yoohoo! Looks like I greeted you first again. If you need anything, leave it to me, okay? I'll have it done as perfectly as can be.
Yoohoo, the commission team's back! Go thank them properly, okay? And thank ME for reminding you, too!
Yoohoo! More proof that I'm your favorite, huh?
You're up against a star today!
See that? They realized they were up against a star, so they let me win!
O-oof... Don't worry, Dmitri. People won't hate you over one loss!
You'd better be happy to meet me! Smile, or you're gonna get it!
Ack! Things are getting a little hairy.
Hmm... Even I can't help you if you keep that up...
Yoohoo, Commander! It's important to keep up your spirits, so let's go to the amusement park and ride some roller coasters! I hear it's a great way to relieve stress.

Yoohoo! I'm here to help you get through your overtime work! Guess what I brought you... Ooh, does it smell burnt? That's right - I made cookies to look like you! They look just like you apart from the whole "burnt to a crisp" thing, right?
Yoohoo! I finished all the work you gave me. Do you know what you're supposed to do next? Huh? You DON'T? Then repeat after me: "Dmitri is the cutest! Dmitri is the awesomest!"
Hey, Commander? I'm not as popular as I used to be, so... I'm leaving, and I'm never coming back- Ah?! C-Commander? C-cut it out, I was just messing with you! Wait, where are you taking me?!

Finally... Finally, the day has come! I knew you cared about me, Commander! You LOVE me! Hehe... And I love and care about you a lot, too! I... super-love you, okay? Can you... prove your love to me now?
Oh, wow. This is like my favorite thing! You know me so well, Commander.
Heheh☆ Yoohoo!

ex.line: Yoohoo! Cheers to another day with my beloved Commander! I kept your seat warm, as usual... Hmm? Why am I not moving? Because I'm waiting for a hug, of course!

Oh, wow! Are you covering my eyes to make me guess something? Hm? Keep my eyes closed and hold out my arms? Did you get me a gift, or... Hyah?! Y-you actually wanted to ambush me with a kiss... Hmph! Well, I'M gonna kiss YOU, too!
Yoohoo! Tonight's special feature iiis... an all-night movie party! After our movies, we can watch the sunrise! Whaddya think? My plan's just the best, isn't it?!
Commander! Hehe, did that scare you? That's what you get for working all night and neglecting me!
Commander, tickle attack! Heheh, this is actually a stress-relieving massage I learned! Rub, rub... Huh? Hahaha... H-hey, that tickles... Hahaha!
Ahem! Dearest Commander, it's sooo hot in this coat. Why don't you help me... Pfft, what's with that look on your face? Whoa, HEY! My coat!
Hehe... Your petting technique is just the best.
Yoohoo! Got you, Commander! Now teach me how to be more popular, or I'm never letting go!
Commander! Close your eyes. This time, I'm coming at you!
Whoa, new missions again? Heheh, if you need any help, just call Dmitri!
Yoohoo! You really finished all those missions. Do you want a reward from me after all that hard work?
Ooh, new mail. Do you ever find any love letters from me in there?
Yoohoo, your favorite girl's here to greet you again! What's next on the agenda? It's gotta be "spending time with Dmitri," right? Riiiight?
Yoohoo! Our commission team has returned! Let's go say hi to them, quick!
Oh, yay! I knew you loved me, Commander!
Commander! Let's hear a cheer for your beloved Dmitri!
That was just an oopsie! Commander, let's practice a little more for next time!
Commander, I wanna be with you forever. I'm never leaving your side! You won't leave me either, right? Heheh, no matter where you run, I'm gonna come find you! Hehe♥

lines.line: Yoohoo! Welcome, Commander! How do you like your room? Does it make your heart flutter? Hehe, we've got all kinds of services - I can put you to bed with a massage, or do whatever animal role-play you're into... Bunny Dmitri's here to make all your dreams come true!

Yoohoo! Welcome, Commander! How do you like your room? Does it make your heart flutter? Hehe, we've got all kinds of services - I can put you to bed with a massage, or do whatever animal role-play you're into... Bunny Dmitri's here to make all your dreams come true!
If you're not happy with this room, I can get you into another one! ...You are? Okay, then this is our secret hideout now! Get ready to enjoy my special service, Commander♪
You wanna bake cookies? Is that the whole reason you came here? Nuh-uh! Your personal bunny is right here, Commander... What other snacks do you need?

Yoohoo! Congrats on winning the jackpot in the Bunny Dmitri Lottery, Commander! As for your prize... Tadaaa! You get 999 nights of being put to bed by me! The number doesn't really matter - I'll just do it whenever you want.

Ding-dong, it's time for my animal role-play survey! What do you like, Commander? My bunny impression, or my bear impression? Answer carefully, now. Bunnies go "squeak!", and bears go "roar!" ...Pretty good, right?
Yoohoo, Commander. Do you know what this pose means? "On the hunt"? Well, you are... Correct! Can you guess who my prey is? Hehehe~ It's you, of course!
What's up? Did my bunny ears get messed up? ...Huh?! They weren't, but they are NOW because you touched me? Well, you'd better keep going and give me more headpats!
You really like my outfit, don't you, Commander? Hehe, I can see right through you!
Commander, bunnies bite when they get mad... Ah! I'm not saying you can't touch me. I'm saying you can't LEAVE!
Yoohoo! Tired from all that traveling, Commander? You look beat. How about a massage and a lullaby, courtesy of Dmitri? They're guaranteed to get you dreaming in no time!
This room is all ours now, Commander~ I know you just love me to bits in this outfit, don't you? Heheh♪ In that case... Why don't we take things one step further?
Heavy cruiser - Gouden Leeuw.

I am Gouden Leeuw of the Kingdom of Tulipa. Vines come from nature, and magic comes from light. Look here - I can use light magic to conjure illusions of animals. Interesting, no? I do this as a reward for children who behave.

Heehee. It was you who brought the sound of nature here, yes? I hope this gift may warm your heart and soothe your body. Now, close your eyes... Become one with the sound of harmony and embrace a world of peace.

Ah, Commander. Welcome. Letting my vines stretch too freely, you say? My apologies. I was concentrating on my breathing and didn't notice... Heheh, it's a wonderful feeling, so why don't you try it with me? Huff... Puff...

Heehee. Just as the warm winds of spring are a part of nature, so, too, are the cold streams of winter. Mother Nature deserves respect in all her forms... Oh? You say my control over nature's powers deserves respect as well? My, my... I think your efforts are better spent on vigilance than flattery.
Why don't we take a walk? There are so many trees growing here. I can escort you through the quiet and vivid woods♪
Aww, Commander, are you pulling another all-nighter? That's really not in tune with nature at all. Come on, you've worked enough. Let this firefly guide you home.
Those children are ruining nature's beautiful sounds... Commander, if you keep ignoring them, my vines will take things into their own hands and punish them.

What are you listening to, Commander? A "sounds of nature" playlist? So merely listening is good enough for you? You can't even smell the flowers and plants... If it's the sound of nature you wish to hear, why not do so in my embrace?
Heheh. Yes, this is quite pleasant. Like the gentle warmth of the sun on a spring day.
Be gentle. I'm a bit ticklish, you see. Heehee.
Aahh... You may want to reconsider... before my vines tie you up.
Commander, it's time to do some missions. If you're too tired, come here and I'll look after you.
My, you're incredible! Come here for a hug. Heehee - is this the kind of reward you prefer?
Did you receive a new letter? Tell me what it's about later.
Oh, our champion returns. How about a quick break? Give yourself to the sun's brilliance, the birds' chirping, and the fragrance of the flowers. It may very well have a surprising benefit.
What's this? The commission team has come back. Come with me and we'll go see them, Commander.
Would you like an up-close demonstration of my improved strength, Commander?
Alright, Commander - it's time to show you what I'm made of.
Trying to resist nature? This simply won't do.
This is nothing but a minor setback. It's fine. Just relax and we'll give it another try.
Listen... to this lullaby of life.
Don't be alarmed. Nature will inflict this pain back on our enemy!
Goodness gracious. If something's upset you, why don't you speak to nature? It may just ease your mind.
Heheh, the nights have been oddly quiet lately, you say? That's because I've been lulling the troublemakers to sleep with my vines.
Commander, if you ever need a break, I can take on some of your work for you. Mother Nature's powers can fix anything, so don't hesitate.
Look, Commander - I conjured an illusion of you! Sadly, it doesn't have the warmth of your hands, and its heart doesn't thump like yours... I much, much prefer the real version of you!

Goodness, I was hoping you'd be wholly reliant on me, and yet I'm the one who can't get enough of you... Well, it is how it is. We are both in nature's embrace, completely inseparable from one another. Isn't that right? Heehee.

It seems we've walked into the hidden realm of love whilst blessed by nature... My time spent with you is like a vine in the nourishing sunlight, and our love grows and grows more with time... Take my hand, Commander, and let us listen to the song of nature as we walk into tomorrow.
You have such a way of always giving me what I want~ How can I possibly return the favor?
Have you made any new discoveries? Tell me about them.
Singing to your plants - that's so lovely!

ex.line: Commander, did you hear the wind blow through the trees on your way here? Heehee - the port is under nature's protection. Even her critters are keeping watch over you. Of course, I'm protecting you as well.
Never take your eyes off me, Commander. My vines are always wrapped around you!
Come, take a rest on my shoulder and I'll tell you a story about the forest. The stars that shine on the treetops, the dew that moistens the leaves - all things in nature have a long, long journey.
Commander, you can be completely relaxed when I'm here. Let us enjoy this silence just for us.
My, my, Commander... Which little animal brought you here this time? Was it the baby deer... or was it the lion cub?
Heehee. Your heart's beating fast... Is it because of me? Come, listen... Find out if my heartbeat tells the same secrets as yours does.
Feel free to run your hand through my hair. It'll feel good for the both of us.
Ah, a warm closeness that's like being held by the forest...
Ahh... Are you asking for more intimacy, hm?
It's time for work, Commander. Best of luck to you. I'll be waiting right here.
Oh, mission rewards? You can have anything you want, heheh. My vines will block the door and the windows, so I assure you nobody will see or hear anything.
Ah, there's a new letter. Let's see what interesting things are written in it.
Welcome back, Commander. Oh dear, did my vines wrap around you? Goodness, I need to be more careful... Heehee - it seems they're as fond of you as I.
It takes blood, sweat, and tears to grow beautiful flowers, Commander. This is much the same.
This new strength will help me protect you better.
Let us seize the fruits of victory. I'm sure they're delicious!
What a splendid victory! Time to stretch our muscles, Commander.
Defeat is a fleeting thing. You're still under nature's protection.

Commander? Are you already asleep? Heehee... It's so nice - listening to each other's heartbeat while in nature's embrace... We can forget about our burdens and responsibilities and enjoy this stillness just for us. Commander, I will always be there for you, be it on the blazing battlefield, or the moonlit way home.

lines.line: After all that messing around in the bathroom, it's time to clean myself. Commander, would you please assist me? I'll be still for you, of course. For instance... How about this position, hmm?
After all that messing around in the bathroom, it's time to clean myself. Commander, would you please assist me? I'll be still for you, of course. For instance... How about this position, hmm?
I do wonder what part of me you'll clean first. Yes, start with whatever you like. You're mine to spoil right now, after all.
Since you'll be cleaning me, get on top of me. Please, I insist. Be thorough and meticulous, and don't miss a spot anywhere from my toes to my chest... or my hair and my skin. Heehee.
What sorts of aroma do you like? The fragrance of ripe fruit? The smell of a quiet forest? ...The scent of my body soap? Well, then why don't you come closer?
Oh dear, I'm all covered in bubbles... You didn't have to go THAT far, Commander.
This spot next. We should be nearly done. Don't worry, I'll hold still. Heehee - you're so well-mannered, Commander.
...If there were any vines here, I'm sure they'd constrict you right up.
Well, if you wish to do it this way... Ahh... Yes, that feels lovely.
Commander, could you clean this spot for me?
Ahh... Ohh... Naughty-naughty, Commander. What should I do with you?
Welcome back. It's time we got you cleaned up. This time, I'll be the one doing it to you.

Is the cleaning done already? Heehee - you, however, don't seem to have had enough. Allow me to repay your efforts now, then. Aahhh... It's true - other than nature, you are the only thing that helps me relax.
G3-class battlecruiser - Duncan.

Sorry to keep you waiting. I am the Royal battlecruiser, Duncan. I shall assist you with any... "jobs" that might need doing. You're curious about my violin? It is a necessary part of my disguise... just like in the movies.

Royal battlecruiser Duncan, reporting for duty, Commander. I would gladly take on any task you require, from dispatching dangers outside to supporting you with paperwork and admin inside. Please allow me to be your adviser.
I am a professional, and I ask that you rely on me. I am capable of fulfilling my duties to your satisfaction, whether they be organising your daily schedule or "dealing with" any mission targets...

I modified this violin case to store weapons and gadgets, which means I am well-equipped to handle almost any scenario. Although, I prefer to deal with situations before they turn ugly. That's more efficient and professional.
The most unassuming of items can prove highly effective in the hands of a pro. Even if it's something as simple as a pencil.
Frozen meals are quick to prepare and eat. Perfect for when you need to rush out on an important mission.
It's not a "strange sound" - it's the melody of my violin. As for the intonation... As long as I look like a professional player, it's enough.
I've watched so many spy films. Each and every one of them was an absolute masterpiece. They can be unrealistic at times, but even those scenes are informative.
P-please... do be gentle with me...
Yes, Commander? Awaiting your orders.
No visible third parties are in our surrounding area, Commander. We are clear to proceed.
You still have missions to complete, Commander. Or shall I deal with them for you?
Mission complete. The target has been silenced.
There is post for you, Commander. Shall I summarise the contents for you?
Welcome back, Commander. Would you care for a martini? Shaken, of course.
The commission fleet has returned, and I have finished inspecting the rewards. I shall now give you a detailed report.
I need more firepower. Lots of firepower.
Time for a little clean up, wouldn't you say?
It seems the enemy tends to overestimate their own strength.
I'm sorry... I've troubled you with my incompetence...
I never miss.
It's time to finish this...
Should something be causing you difficulties, Commander, I ask that you confide in me.
It is enough for me to work by your side as your secretary, and to protect you with my body and weapons.
Champagne must be opened at the perfect temperature according to the years it has been aged. Why yes, I am highly detail-oriented. It allows me to close the distance between us, Commander.
Just relax and leave everything to me... I've always wanted to say that.
The time I spent with you has become my most precious treasure in this world. Commander, I shall continue to serve by your side in my own way until the very end of my mission.
A vortex of emotion rages within my chest... I have no doubt that this means I'm longing for you... Would you allow me to unleash all the overflowing love I feel upon you right now?
Thank you. I shall return the favour in kind, so please look forward to it.

ex.line: No matter how long we are apart, know this: I shall always be waiting for your return.
Completing my missions too quickly means I cannot spend as much time by your side. And yet, it isn't right that I prolong them unnecessarily either... I must find the perfect pace.
I have never looked at you from this angle before, Commander... Ahem. Do you have any plans after today's mission? Would you like to go and see a film with me?
There is a delicious curry among the meal pouches we received recently. Would you like to have some with me?
If crime would give me wings to reach you, I would - Oh, don't do that? Alright.
Are you going to assign me a mission? If not, then please continue...
Do you have instructions for me? Please whisper them into my ear so they don't leak.
You have transmitted to me both your feelings and your warmth. I shall respond with my own...
I have assembled a list of missions, Commander. Could you make a decision as to where to start?
Please do as I say and return to the safe house to rest. I shall stay up and be by your side.
I shan't waste a single minute, a single second, of my life as long as we are together. Allow me to devote my whole self to serve, protect, and love you.

lines.line: Light cruiser - Takahashi.
I am Takahashi, a light cruiser of the Sakura Empire. You may think of me as a serene and unburdened recluse. When night falls, however... Heehee, have you seen a "demon" that craves affection?♥
*yawn*... My, are you the Commander? I wonder, was it a mere coincidence or the web of fate that brought us together... Heheh~♪
Long have I trained in the cavern, but never could I have imagined such a place to exist in the worldly realm... Commander, please allow me to seek your guidance once again today.
These are... some simple trinkets I wove together. I was planning to give them away, but if anything catches your eye, please feel free to take it.
These threads are an extension of my eyes, ears, and senses... It is the very connection between the two of us. Through it, I can feel your every heartbeat... as if I could grasp it.

As the sun must set westward, so too does time flow onward, slowly and inexorably. Should your mind ever be in turmoil, Commander, take a look at the moss resting upon this stone. Take it slow and don't rush.
Commander, there's a scent on you that I don't recognize... This is... most troubling indeed... Ehehehe...
I spin threads in my spare time, though not for any practical purpose. I just don't want my fingers to be idle.
Ahhh, yes~ Touch me more... Engrave your warmth upon me~♡
Eheheh, it's as if you're testing me... Do you want to be entrapped so badly?
My, my~ You've learned how to be proactive... Ehehe... I'll have to spend this entire night repaying the favor~♥
Commander, if you are negligent in your duties, that would certainly get in the way of the nights we share... And you wouldn't want that, would you?
Great is the feat performed with neither showmanship nor boasting... Well done indeed~
Letters are like an autumnal breeze passing by. Give them a glance, then let them go.
You certainly took your sweet time, my dear Commander... Since you've kept me waiting so long, I shall not release you from the long night ahead, not even for a moment~♡
Your worldly duties are calling to you. Go now; do not keep the girls in the commission team waiting.
My threads... have grown stronger~♪
An inevitable conflict awaits...
Let go of worldly attachments. Dwell not on gains and losses, and celebrate victory.
Fortune and misfortune are predetermined. Follow the flow of karma, and you shall not go astray.
All things are transient; through karma, find form -
Let go of all wants and desires, and you shall become unbreakable...
Every meeting is the confluence of fate... but should the threads of fate be too feeble, such is all it amounts to...

Clear your mind, and your heart will naturally make room for serenity to dwell. If you are weary, why not take a seat and try meditating like me? Yes, let's first regulate our breathing... inhale... exhale...
What brings you here again? Do you seek a moment of purity, or perhaps... did you simply feel like listening to the ramblings of a bored one?
...Found you~ Heehee, did I surprise you? No matter how far you are, I can find everything about you simply by following the threads~♥
How many threads did I attach to you today? If you get the answer wrong, I'll tie you up in a corner where even the moonlight cannot reach... and then, and then... Ahhhn~♥

Alas, my beloved Commander... You have witnessed the desires I try to suppress, as well as the passionate love I drown in... yet you still wish to step into the "nest" of my heart? If that is what you truly desire... then I shall never let go of you again. Ehehehe~♥
My, my. I'll have to keep this close at hand~♪

ex.line: While you were away, I decorated your office with my threads.... Heehee, don't worry. It's only what is needed to build our nest. When I miss you, however, the threads might get a little anxious...♡

I have never revealed the location of the cavern in which I cultivated my skills to anyone else... but if you wish to leave the worldly realm behind, I can guide you there, and we can find peace together.
Mmfh... If I leave my scent on your arm, up to your neck... then, my very being will be etched upon your body~

Gift-giving is the act of forging bonds. Nest-building is the act of weaving destiny. And I have already sewn my very being into threads, threads that have woven their way into the gaps of your life... In other words, we are now bound by unbreakable karmic ties~♪
Ehehe... Just a little more, and it'll soon be finished... A perfect nest for the two of us, drenched in love-soaked threads~♥
Ahh... it's like I'm in paradise... let me indulge in this moment a bit longer~♡
The place you just touched... throbs with pain and pleasure alike... Ahahaha~♥
Ahh, what an intoxicating aroma... I simply can't resist the urge to taste you~♥
Welcome back to the nest~ Now then, let my threads clean away some of this worldly dust that has gotten stuck onto you... little by little, until you become mine alone~♥

Now matter how much affection others may have towards you, I want you to only have eyes for me. Indeed, you are my implacable obsession, the nectar that quenches my thirst... I want your gaze and your warmth to snuff out my breath~♥

lines.line: Aircraft carrier - Max Immelmann.

I am Max Immelmann, Aircraft Carrier of the Iron Blood, Ancient Dragon of Steel, and Immortal Monarch of the Welkin... Th-that's too long? You may simply call me by name, then. This is a special reward and privilege I extend to you and you alone, Dragonspeaker.

Ahh... How long it has been. The mortal-usurped welkin... I, Max Immelmann, master of steel and sky, have awakened. ...Hm? Were you the one who roused me from my slumber? Heh... Then, I shall bestow the title of Dragonspeaker upon you. Let us conquer the realm above the clouds together.

This vessel is quite adequate... It is capable of flight, suited for combat... and well-equipped to taste the world's delicacies♪ What delectable sweets shall you present me with today, Dragonspeaker?
I am a dragon - a dragon of steel roused from my long slumber. Even if I am temporarily trapped in this soft body, in your heart I am always the apex of existence, am I not? Ahahahah~♪
I would do anything for a piece of Bienenstich. Come, Dragonspeaker♪ What will you ask for in return?
August's dragon is quite impressive in its own right, but my wings are much larger and more magnificent, are they not? Who's the mightier dragon, you ask? What an adorable question. Ahaha!
Ow! ...I burned my tongue trying to breathe fire the other day. Dragonspeaker, let me cool my tongue on your cheek, okay?
Wait, you say that these... tiny, funny-looking, adorable creatures in the gallery are dragons too? They're my kin?!
Heheh, this is a genuine dragon's horn. A mere brush from it is enough to tear your clothes apart... Just like this~♪
You want to be warmed up? Perhaps I should breathe fire on you... Ahaha♪ Just kidding~♪ Now, come closer...
Dragonspeaker... You have some rather unconventional hobbies~♪
Instruction manual #1 says...a timer for unfinished tasks? Oh, it went off... 'tis quite effective, I must say.
Instruction manual #2 says... upon mission completion, register the results into the database... Hmm. This machine is quite easy to use.
Instruction manual #3 says... follow these steps to accept mail... Done. This whole work thing is easy-peasy!
You should rest after a hard day of work. Won't you roost under my iron wings? That way, I can rest easy within your heart, too.
Instruction manual #4 says... Ooh, who cares about that?! Behold that glittery loot in the port! Let us go get a look at it, Dragonspeaker!
Come. We take flight!
Come. Let's enjoy the view of our panicked foes.
To celebrate my victory... I shall stretch my wings into the firmament. Won't you join me, Dragonspeaker?
They got us... But I shan't forget how this enemy dared tarnish these skies.
A dragon's flame scorches even the firmament!
A dragon never falls!
...Even so, I shall protect you. Just as you stood guard over me as I slumbered...
You are special to me, Dragonspeaker. But remember, not all dragons fall in love with the first person they lay eyes on... 'Tis but a coincidence that I have special feelings for you.
In my long, lonesome existence, the welkin was my sole companion... But now, there is a mortal life I fret over. It is not a bad feeling at all, though.
Be wary, Dragonspeaker. My dragon's eye can spot the storm looming ahead... If you must march to the frontlines, my wings will be your shield.

Dragonspeaker, you are now as mighty as I am. Even if I am no more, you must conquer the welkin on your own... Mm? Why are there tears running down my cheeks...? I know you will never leave me. Do these tears run out of... instinct?

An oath? Why even bring it up when I've already resolved to share eternity with you... Have I not forever remained in your heart since the moment of my awakening, Dragonspeaker? Keep in your mind that I will remain in your heart... forever.
Thank you. But it would be better if you became my present, too♪
Quite the impressive dragon.
Another dragon...?!

ex.line: Your breath, body temperature, heartbeat... Dragonspeaker, you truly mesmerize me. May I lie on top of you? Can I give you a little nibble? Don't worry, I'll be careful. I wouldn't want to break you, after all~♪
Want me to help you out with anything? All it'll cost you is one kiss. Ahaha~♪
Before I met you, I never thought being alone was a particularly painful thing... Dragonspeaker, you changed me. So, please don't leave me alone too much, okay? Please and thank you~♪
Hmph... this book says that it's customary to say "I love you" every day and give roses to humans you love... "Old-fashioned," you say? I think it's quite romantic.

Steel wings and a fiery breath are not enough to conquer the skies. A variety of supportive equipment is also required, including that coffee machine of yours... In other words, I've learned how to use everything~♪ Now then, how about trying some of the coffee I brewed?
Which piece of clothing should I slice up this time~?
Oh? Have you finally grasped the importance of doing things one step at a time?
...Grab me from behind. Hurry~♥

Welcome back. Here, take this. These flowers are a token of my feelings... They're different from the last ones I gave you? Well of course. It's a surprise! It wouldn't be a surprise if they're the same~
The Dragonspeaker and Max Immelmann - Let our names resound across these skies!
Come to think of it... A great dragon roused from its long slumber is the one who needs care and pampering. Won't you give some care and affection tonight... Dragonspeaker?♪

lines.line: Destroyer - Orage.

Introduce myself? What a hassle... I am Orage, destroyer from Iris Libre, and messenger of the Holy See. Please feel to consult me for anything related to intel gathering, communications, and messenger duties.

Orage, messenger of Iris Libre, reporting for duty. So, are there any troublesome missives for me to deliver? Just give me the destination, and I'll make sure it gets there no matter what. It's my job, after all.
Messenger Orage, reporting for duty. Work sucks, but someone has to do it. In any case, do your best, Commander.

Brewing storms, unseen reefs, lurking enemies... A messenger's path is fraught with obstacles. But no matter how many times I am impeded or injured, I will see my duty through to the end... because the delivery of messages is always paramount.

The difficulty level of this new game I bought is fairly average. There are monsters and traps everywhere, your character dies in one hit, and you have to start from the beginning if you make a mistake, but it's easily clearable once you've learned the patterns. In fact, it only took me 2,315 tries.
The Holy See's approval process is pretty efficient, but it can't keep up with my pace. If they trimmed down the paperwork, I wouldn't have to do as much overtime.
...I should take some time off to hang out with my friends? I think I'll pass. I'd rather stew in my own thoughts than deal with all that noise.

Hello? ...The port's drainage is blocked? I'll send someone to fix it... There's a cat stuck in the tree? Tell it to stay put. I'll send someone over right away... The restaurant's still losing money? Yes, I know, I've already sent the business improvement plan.
...You're praising me? ...Several of my comrades wanted to express their gratitude? It's no big deal. All I did was incidentally take out some threats while doing my job.
...Oh. The instructions are all in my head. Search all you want, but you won't find anything on me.
Is this... some form of entertainment between tasks...? Well, I guess I don't mind.
...Work is work. It's always been dry and annoying. But now they're even demanding "professionalism"? ...Well, I guess someone has to do it. Move over, I'll lend you a hand.
Time to clock out. So, how do you feel? It's like a weight has been lifted off your shoulders, huh?
There's a message for you, Commander. Make sure you read it. Oh, no need to thank me. I'm simply doing my job.
I'll compile the action report, so please submit all the data to me by the end of the workday.
The commission team has returned. Please see the list of rewards. I've already cross-checked everything in advance.
This power... should help us weather the storm.
Prepare yourself. A storm is approaching.
News of your victory shall spread from east to west, your name rising above the masses.
Remember how this feels, then adapt. Next time, we must become stronger.
The storm is here.
Now you've got my attention.
It'd be more efficient for me to work alone.
Commander, it's getting late. You should go to bed. ...Don't make that face at me. I don't want a certain someone getting sick tomorrow and making it more work for me.
Huh, didn't expect someone to stick with me through the entirety of this awful shift... So, got any plans after this? ...I was going to go to this one place. Wanna tag along?

Work always sucks, but for whatever reason, things aren't so bad with you around. I'm even starting to enjoy it a bit... See what you've done? You've made me develop unnecessary feelings towards work...

I-it's not like I was following you or anything, nor do I know where you're going... We just happened to bump into each other, and now that we're here, it's my job to keep a close eye on you... So, you'd better not get too far away from me.
Yes, I accept... I thought up sixteen different ways of confessing to you, but in the end, you still beat me to the punch... Ugh, what was all that agonizing even for...?
I wonder how I should return the favor... Urgh, what a pain... Just tell me what you want, Commander. Anything is fine.
So, what kind of impossible challenge do you have for me this time?

ex.line: Thanks to you, I'm able to endure this boring job... Now that you've seen how hard I'm working, how about a stroll with me afterwards?
Ahem... Yaaay! I just cleared a no-damage hardcore run, the fastest time in the whole port! (I was loud enough for the Commander to hear me for sure, right...?)
...Remember to stay hydrated. (If I show my considerate side like this, then the Commander is sure to feel warm and fuzzy all day!)
Here, I made some food for you. (I secretly learned how to make fried rice the other day... If you like it, I'll make it for you every day.)

...You'll be out for business for a few days, so you want me to behave myself? ...That's your way of saying hello to me? ...Well, whatever. Have fun. Doesn't bother me at all... (Ohmygod it bothers me so much...)
Is it break time already? Huh, work seems to fly by these days for whatever reason...
...... (Commander's trying to get my attention... Am I about to be asked out on a date?! Umm... what's the best way of saying yes...?!)
*sigh*... If you're going to touch me, you might as well use both hands... It'll be more efficient that way...
...You're not hurt, are you? If you don't absolutely have to go, send me out instead. You don't have to leap into danger yourself every time...
I want more of you. I want more of your love... Hey, if I hold you tight like this... would you give me your everything?

lines.line: Battleship - Valparaíso.
I am battleship Valparaíso, your everlasting harbor in the storm. Whenever you need support, a place to rest, or someone to confide in... Come to me. I will always be here for you.
I am Valparaíso, the Ruby of Pedrería, matron of these distant sealanes. Having directed countless shipments of cargo to their rightful place, I, too, have found mine - here, by your side.
Commander, try touching this ruby... Let the gem's brilliance envelop you and wash away your worries and fatigue.
The ruby's brilliance, like the sunlight shimmering across the sea at dawn, brings serenity to a travel-weary heart. I hope that I can be that warm presence for you as well.
The usual blend, I take it? Heehee... If you're tired, feel free to rest. You don't need to say anything at all. I'll be right here... by your side. After all, all we need is company sometimes.
Commander, you hold the ruby's most wondrous brilliance in the palm of your hand. Has its healing aura... made you feel any better at all?
The whisper of the wind, the din of heavy machinery, the murmur of the waves... All these sounds can be heard from here, blending together into a melody most familiar to me.
Every gemstone has its own "tone." Our incantations connect us to them through the power of sound.
You need some comfort? Aww, come here and let me give you a big hug~
Hm? What would you like from me? Something warm to drink? A hug? ...Or perhaps, you'd like to hear more about this ruby?
Mgh... It's okay, you don't need to say another word. You're welcome to do whatever you want~
You still have unfinished work? Don't worry. If you're tired, just take a break. You can always pick up where you left off later. I'll be with you, as long as it takes.
You've finished your mission, yes? Now, allow me to handle the rest. I shall turn these numbers on a list into an indelible page in your story.
You've got a message. Should I read it for you? I have plenty of free time~
No matter how turbulent the waves surrounding you might be, I shall bring you serenity with this ruby's brilliance.
The commission team has returned. Shall we go check in on them? After all, cargo can only truly exert its power when delivered to the rightful hands at the rightful place.
Like a breakwater shielding a harbor, my protection has grown even stronger. Let me protect you from the perilous waves.
You shall not sully my sealanes.
All victories flow unto their rightful place.
Fret not. No sealane is devoid of storms.
Hark, the ruby's song -
It'll take more than some choppy waters to defeat me.
It's okay, there's no need to worry. You've already done what you can...
Commander, if you ever need anything, please do not hesitate to come see me. My door will always be open for you... There's no need to hold back.
You've been coming to see me quite a lot lately. So, what can I get for you today? A healing ruby? Or perhaps... a nice and quiet place to help you gather your thoughts?

Commander... Lately, whenever I'm with you, I find myself wishing you'd stay a bit longer... And whenever you leave, I can't help but wonder when you'll be back... Do you think I'm being a bit greedy?
Should you want a friend, a lover, or a mother... Heehee~ I'll be whatever you want and support you whenever you need.
Commander, I'm so glad you chose me. From now on, no matter where you go, what you do, relying on me or on your own... I will always respect your decisions and walk by your side.
This is... for me? Then, I shall return your feelings with this ruby.

ex.line: Commander, whenever you open this door, I shall always be waiting for you - this is a harbor you can always dock in.
Commander, let me see your hand. Now... close your eyes, and follow my chant... Let your burdens melt away. Feel the pulsating ruby in your heart.
I've started to develop a habit - every time I hear footsteps, I can't help but wonder if it's you...
The ore goes to the factory, the fur goes to the frigid north... Every shipment has a place where it belongs. I'm simply helping them find the way.
Commander, will you listen to my song? In this song, I am a dream that offers you solace, the one always awaiting your return, and a presence who will always keep you in her thoughts.
Yes, I'm right here with you.
The ruby will sulk if you simply give it a few pats every now and then, you know~?
Ahhn... Is this ruby... that fascinating to you?

Welcome back, Commander. Just lean against me and rest awhile - Shh, don't be in such in a hurry. Just come closer... yes, a bit more, just like that... Make yourself at ease. I'll always be here for you.
Victory is ours. May I celebrate this moment in your warm embrace?
A harbor is a cycle of greetings and partings. Cargo and ships come and go, yet there was never a moment where I thought something would stay with me forever - until I met you.

lines.line: I'm getting all fired up! The name's Hiryuu, Hiryuu from the 2nd CarDiv. As a member of this fleet, I'll obey your orders. I do hope that you are qualified to lead us.
I'm the aircraft carrier, Hiryuu. ...Right now, I am naught but a single soldier. That's all you need to know about me.
I'm getting all fired up! The name's Hiryuu, Hiryuu from the 2nd CarDiv. As a member of this fleet, I'll obey your orders. I do hope that you are qualified to lead us.
Guide my blade. Where do my enemies lie?
I'd rather you pay attention to the others. ...If you're going to keep idling around here...
Enterprise? Whether as a rival or an ally, there's no doubt that she's an existence to be respected.
Hanafuda...? Now's not the time to be indulging in entertainment.
My usual training regimen isn't designed to show off my skills, but rather to protect my allies and defeat my enemies. Am I mistaken?
If you have something to say, just spit it out. If you fuss over it too much, you're just going to end up not saying anything.
Hah?! ...Hmph! ...Next time, I'll assault you back with my blade.
These are all just trifling matters...
Though they're all just trifling matters, they're still missions proper. I'll report back to you when I finish receiving the rewards.
Please take this, Commander. It's your mail.
Don't worry about me. Simply stay focused on what it is you need to do.
It's good to count your blessings for the fortune of having plenty in the present moment. One day, it'll just be a wistful memory.
...What a shame.
Quick, let's get started! Come forth, my planes!
Such a small victory is not worth celebrating...
Sister... I'm sorry...
I'm all fired up!
Leave me alone.
Right now, I'm merely a soldier. I simply follow your directives, and that's all there is to it.
On the battlefield, even a moment's hesitation can invite total destruction. Thinking about nothing other than how to defeat the enemy - that's my fighting style.

Would you keep challenging strong foes you have no chance of defeating? ...For the sake of those you wish to protect? Since it's you, I can see that you've given it plenty of thought. I support that sentiment.

This unwavering conviction, that if it's you, there will be a way... Hmm, I guess I've still got a naive side to me... It's nothing. Commander, as your blade, I will continue to pledge myself to your service.

This is... the proof of your oath... I understand. If you will continue to value me as your blade, I will not turn my back to you. ...Though, my comparatively uncomely and unpleasant self will give you a hard time. Hehehe.
Since you went through the trouble of picking out this gift... I will accept it. You have my thanks.
Aircraft carrier Ark Royal, at your service. I hereby vow to lend you my strength for as long as you harbour honourable ambitions!
We are both soldiers, you and I. We fight to protect our loved ones. Whatever desolate wastes the streams of fate carry you to, never forget your duty.
Aircraft carrier Ark Royal, at your service. I hereby vow to lend you my strength for as long as you harbour honourable ambitions!
Ready to face another day? Splendid!
Peace is something worth protecting at any cost.
One should protect their loved ones, that is abundantly clear. In the case of the little destroyers, even more so.
My strengths lie in outranging the opponent. But, of course, I am no slouch in close-range combat either.
Developing new tactics for the fleet, are you? Do you need my expertise?
I see no resolve in your eyes! Shape up! ...There, that's better. Hahaha.
This is not the time nor place for this kind of behaviour...
One of your most important duties is to accomplish the missions assigned to you. Don't forget that, Commander.
A mission's been completed. Excellent.
You've received a new letter? Best to read it now, then. Do not live in ignorance of the latest happenings.
Have no fear. I am always ready for orders!
Our companions risked much to bring back those resources. They deserve acknowledgement. Let us go see them, Commander.
I need to become stronger to protect what I must!
Show them no mercy!
Flee to the ends of the world if you so want, I will still hunt you down!
Don't bet on all future battles ending in your safe escape.
You cannot escape me!
I will not be defeated!
Let me offer a word of advice, if you'll even listen: turn around and leave while you still can, Commander.
You need someone to escort the little destroyers, do you? I can certainly do it, but I could just as well do any other mission. I'm ready to sortie at all times.
A ship who's lost her way is fated to go under. The same is true for people. Do you have the strength to keep yourself on the right course, Commander?
Your outstanding expertise and determination are truly awe-inspiring. I have no doubt you can lead this fleet to places nobody would've expected.
Put your mind to rest, Commander. Wherever your destination may be, I will follow you to it. Be they towering waves or colossal icebergs, whatever obstacles we encounter, I will tear them down!
Is this for me? Ah... I understand. Then on this day, I vow to follow wherever you go. I'm eager to see what awaits us at the end. Hahaha!
This...?! How thoughtful of you...! You have my thanks!
Have no fear. I guarantee your safety.
Together we stand! For the glory of the Royal Navy!
Once more... the fire rises!
Were you looking for me? I am willing to lend you my power - provided that you promise not to hide anything from me.
Brooklyn-class light cruiser, Helena. As for what I'm good at, let's just say it's knowing a little more about you than the other girls.
Were you looking for me? I am willing to lend you my power - provided that you promise not to hide anything from me.
I knew exactly when you'd come back, Commander.
My SG tells me exactly where you are, but I wish it also told me what you're thinking...
Commander, call out for me, bare your heart to me, quell my turmoil, erase everything that I cannot comprehend...
Commander, looking for someone? I know much more than just what happens around the office. I see everything that happens at this port.
Knowing too much can also be a curse, if you only know but are powerless to act.
If you wish to use my powers, you must first tell me why.
I knew... you'd think twice about doing that.
Commander, your missions will not disappear just by simply leaving them alone. Do finish them diligently.
These are the mission rewards? ...Seems rather lackluster.
You have new mail. Let me help you open it.
Where did you go, Commander? I'll know whether or not you're lying~
SG has informed me that your friends will be returning soon. Let us prepare to greet them, Commander.
Greater power... but at what price?
SG, tell me where my enemies are hiding this time.
The red dots on the radar... have all been eliminated.
How could I have overlooked something? I don't understand... Very well, so be it.
I've found you~
Don't resist. I know exactly where you are!
If you intend to close your heart to me, then what happens to you is no longer of any concern to me.
Of course I like to smile. As long as you can maintain a smile on your face, your heart will always remain opaque to others.
Even if I can see everything, too often I cannot grasp any of it... I never wish to experience that sorrow again. Commander, I'm sure you'll be able to succeed where I failed.

I will always stay by your side, Commander!

I can scarcely believe you prepared this many candles and even went through the trouble of shaping them into a heart... Of course I know how you feel. Even if you hadn't gone through all this trouble, my answer would still be... B-by the way, Commander, do I look too giddy right now...?
I'll keep this as a souvenir.
Greetings, Commander. I'm Hunter. I hunt, as you might've surmised. Is this place... my new base?
I'm a hunter, and I'm under your command. Give me orders as you see fit. What do I hunt, exactly? You'll see, sooner or later.
Greetings, Commander. I'm Hunter. I hunt, as you might've surmised. Is this place... my new base?
Oh, it's you. Resuming the perpetual cycle of paperwork? Good luck to you.
Should I ever become a monster... put a swift end to my life. Please.
Not everyone can calmly deal with a sudden threat. But you lead us all, Commander. You must stay composed no matter what.
Ah... Is this the paper you're looking for? I've memorised the spots you routinely use - as any hunter would.
What's this? Tea and biscuits? Whew... I've seldom tasted such lavish food, nor have I sat idly in one place for this long.
Weary, are you? Go on and rest. I'll watch your back.
I don't understand the point of this...
New missions, eh? Who will you pit me against this time?
Another mission completed. Be that as it may, the hunt is not over.
You have a new letter. Read it, lest crucial information pass you by.
You're back. In one piece, I presume? Then relax and rest your weary bones.
The commission team is back. Those lassies - you can count on them.
My weapons grow sharper... Good.
I'll take the lead. Someone must.
Henceforth we face the real threats. Be on your guards.
Even the hunter becomes the hunted in due time...
Rest in peace.
Gah... I must calm myself!
I give up... You are an untrustworthy Commander.
So this shall be my base... Alright. It's not so bad, having a place to rest and resupply.
Hm? You're here just to see me? You didn't have to - I'm well used to lonesome returns... Regardless, thank you.
It feels almost like... my body and soul rejuvenate when I return here. I think this base has become my sanctuary...
Whew... I've never overslept anywhere but here before. Either my sense of danger is waning, or I'm losing my touch... but I doubt it's either. Perhaps I'm just... at peace.
Mh. I understand your feelings. If you don't mind a pitiable soul, I'd like to be with you until my final threat is felled... No, even beyond that, I want to walk beside you.
Sure... I'll take it.
Well met, Commander. My name is Fortune. Please don't worry about these ch-chains... They're there to... keep my power in check.

I was given the name of "Fortune," but in the end, it was I who was dragged down by fate... Um, if you insist on asking about these chains... They're, um, a self-imposed failsafe so that I do not harm those close to me...
Well met, Commander. My name is Fortune. Please don't worry about these ch-chains... They're there to... keep my power in check.
Commander... Umm, welcome back...? That is the proper way to greet you, right?
There's no need for you to worry yourself over me... More importantly, um, thank you very much...
Fate is said to both be immutable, but also something you carve out with your own two hands... What, then, is truly the nature of fate?
This uncontrollable power... is surely a trial imposed upon me by fate. It is not something I can allow to flow freely...
Commander, do you ever get the inclination that something is destined to happen to you? Oh, um, that was just my curiosity speaking, nothing more...
Umm, if these interest you that much, I suppose it's fine for you to touch them... I am capable of restraining myself...
Mmgh... Is this... yet another trial imposed upon me by fate...?
Commander, um... Just in case you forgot... There are still missions we have not yet completed...
Mission complete... I'm sure everything will be fine from now on...
Commander, there's new mail waiting for you... Um, unfortunately, I cannot hand it to you myself...
Another mission completed successfully. Commander, it appears that the trajectory of your fate seems to extend to a more fortuitous future...
It appears that a commission has been completed... Unfortunately, I don't think I'll be able to help you in my current state, sorry...
My control... seems to be improving...
Is there no other way...?
Did fortune favor me, or perhaps...
No, no... It shouldn't have been like this... How could this be? How could this be?!
P-please forgive me...
Don't make me... use this power...!
Please get away from me...! I, I'm so sorry, I don't know if I can control myself...
Our meeting surely must have been ordained by fate... right? I wonder where the winds of fortune will take me this time...

If the goddess of fortune truly exists, there are so many things I do not understand that I'd want to ask her... But in reality, whether or not those questions can be answered means so little to me now...
Whenever I am with you, Commander, I can feel the wheels of fate turning, taking me in a new direction... It's a light, airy feeling I cannot describe well, but it also fills me with warmth...
I now entrust my future and my fate to you, Commander. Even if I veer away from the correct trajectory, you'll be there to guide me back, right? Um, is it really alright for me to stay at your side?

I'm so sorry... that I am accepting your ring in this pitiful form of mine... But, I'm also so thankful that you still accepted who I am despite all that! Commander, being able to meet you is truly the happiest event on the trajectory of my fate.
I-is this for me? Ah! Um... Sorry, I got a little excited...
I am Arizona... This may be improper of me, but is it really alright for me to stay here? ...Very well, Commander. If that is what you've decided...
If there are parallel worlds out there, would "I" exist in them as well? If that's the case... I pray that I could have met you earlier, and spend a life free from tears...
I am Arizona... This may be improper of me, but is it really alright for me to stay here? ...Very well, Commander. If that is what you've decided...
Welcome back. When you are here, Commander, the office does not seem as bleak.
If given the chance, I'd like to do it all over again... But even if that were possible, wouldn't the same things just play out again? What do you think, Commander?
"Arizona's Tears"... Does that refer to me? Maybe I was seen in a moment when I could not control my emotions. I'm sorry...
It is said that staying around me for too long will afflict you with tragic dreams. Huh? You don't mind? I, I see...
Oh, what was that sound just now? Did something break again because of me?
S-sorry! If you touch me without warning, I... Huh? You're not hurt? Thank goodness...
Is this... some kind of punishment?
Do you still have missions left? I'll try to help out in whatever way I can...
We finished the missions without any major issues... Phew, I'm glad it went well.
Commander, there's a letter addressed to you... I'll go ahead and leave it on your desk.
Um, while you were gone, all the lights in the office seem to have gone out again... I'm sorry for inconveniencing you once again.
The commission team has returned. Go welcome them together? Never mind, I'll just be a hindrance anyway....
I hope this will make a difference...
I pray this is the correct decision...
Is victory... something worth celebrating?
If only I could do it all over again...
Let it all end!
No! At this rate, I...
You should stay away from me after all. Otherwise, it'll only end up with your friends getting hurt...
Would you mind keeping a safe distance from me? Oh, no, I'm not trying to push you away. "Our" Vestal warned that something terrible will happen if you don't...
You don't have horrible dreams when you're around me? Really? Um, it's not that I don't believe you, but...
Peace of mind, and comfort... When I am by your side, Commander, those feelings seem to be slowly coming back to me... But, I'm scared of losing this happiness again...

Commander, you who rescued me from the abyss of despair and suffering... You are my last hope. I'll strive to do even better. Someday, I'll show you that I can overcome these dark emotions! Until then... Commander, would you please wait for me?

You're willing to always stay by my side and watch over me? *sobs*... Oh, I'm so sorry... I just, can't stop the tears from flowing... Commander, I believe you. You are the only safe harbor for my heart...
Oh, this, um... Thank you very much...
So you're the Commander... in other words, my Master. Alright, got it. The name's Sheffield, and the game's pointing my gun at vermin - Ah, please disregard that little gesture I made just now.
I am Town-class light cruiser, Sheffield. My specialities are cleaning, marksmanship, and infiltration. What's wrong? These are basics every Royal Maid must know. Why are you acting so surprised?
So you're the Commander... in other words, my Master. Alright, got it. The name's Sheffield, and the game's pointing my gun at vermin - Ah, please disregard that little gesture I made just now.
I've finished cleaning up your office, so please get started with work. ...What's the matter? Do you find it strange that I am holding a broom and mop?

Even if we may never exterminate all pests, someone still has to do the job. Keeping your room tidy is the same. I'm sure you don't think that cleaning your room is unnecessary simply because it will get dirty again, right?
No abnormalities here... Hmm? Don't mind me. I'm just performing a routine security inspection of your office.
A maid must always take proper care of her weapon, be it gun or broom. Master, you will regret it if you let your "weapon" go rusty. Please do not forget to do your due diligence.
What's the matter, Master? You heard the sound of gunfire? That was just a blank. I do apologise for disrupting your sleep.
The safety lock is in place, so you can take a look if you want.
Fix your ways, or you'll end up a pest yourself one day.
Crack on. We've been notified of our next mission.
Do you really need me to remind you to collect your mission rewards?
Who sent you this letter, I wonder? You'd better take a look.
Was the operation successful? ...I see. Seems like you are capable of a thing or two.
Commission complete. What, are you planning to leave your hardworking companions out to dry at the piers?
My next shot will find its mark even more flawlessly.
Now, let us begin our "cleaning."
The ring of my gun's muzzle tells us everything you need to know, Master.
Don't go dying in front of me. Hurry!
Playtime's over.
Am I being pinned down? ...What a pain in the arse.
I will never aim my gun at my friends... until they cease to be such. Please keep that in mind.
If you fail to clean out pests, they will find a way of inflicting harm on you at unexpected times. Master, your compassion is a compromise that will lead only to your misery.
Master, have you gotten used to working with me yet? If not, you'd better keep working at it.
Are you concerned about me? Of course I'm glad to hear that- in your wildest dreams. Stop getting hot and bothered over a simple maid if you don't want others looking at you strangely.

There is nothing more foolish than becoming enraptured with a maid who often disappears without a word, goes on dangerous missions, and has a terrible personality to boot. But, that foolishness is precisely what I love about you.

Those who threaten the ones I love shall be greeted by the peal of my gunfire. So... Master, what kind of ending do you want for this ceremony? If your goal was to throw me off-kilter and see my vulnerable side... you've accomplished just that.
...I'll take it. Thanks.

So you are the Commander? Very well. From this point forth, you will use your courage and intellect for our purposes! ...We don't have all day, now. You are our servant, so this won't go anywhere until you swear your fealty.

We are the super-dreadnaught, Queen Elizabeth. We welcome any who wish to become our subject. Member of the Royal Navy or otherwise, we protect all those who follow us! Come, Servant; if you have any questions, ask now before our mood changes!

So you are the Commander? Very well. From this point forth, you will use your courage and intellect for our purposes! ...We don't have all day, now. You are our servant, so this won't go anywhere until you swear your fealty.
What took you so long, servant? Are you not aware that you are making us wait?
What's the matter? Are you in such awe that you cannot utter so much as a word? Hmph... Servant, if you're thinking of anything rude, you will pay dearly!
If you wish to pray, pray to your queen instead of the empty sky! We will bless and protect you!
We will prove that charisma is more than just one's physical size... Nobody shall impugn our stature ever again!
A port full of harmony and beauty... Is this your desire, servant? ...Don't worry. We were just a little happy for you.
Servant, do you not find your actions extremely rude?
You are a fearless one, laying hands on our body without express permission!
Pervert! Shameless lecher! Servants who don't know their place ought to be beheaded!
Missions? See them done, and done well. We will not tolerate you shaming our name.
Mission rewards? We have no interest in such trifles. You take them, servant.
Mail for you, hmm? What's so wrong with us asking what it says?! Of course, we do mean to respect your privacy.
Finally returned? Good. We order you to rest. You may not continue working until your queen says you may! Understood?
Servant, tend to the girls who just returned from their commission.
It is good to see that you pay adequate attention to us.
What a grand welcome. Do they mean to roll out the red carpet for us?
Hmph. Did you think such foes stood a chance at stopping us?
All forces, retreat! We will not permit any unapproved sacrifices!
Consider this a gift from your queen!
This isn't funny! Your queen does not approve of this!
It's fine. Consider this our own mistake for not being more selective. Go and do what you want; you may no longer be our servant.
Pretty yet empty words will not be proof enough that we have done our job as queen. Servant, if you have any doubts about us, we will ascertain and rectify them.

Are you still struggling to swear your fealty? Hah, your queen understands that the most talented folk fashion themselves leaders rather than followers. Do your job as you wish, but we expect your aid when it is needed.
Hm? Are you surprised that we would come here? Is it wrong for a queen to worry about her servants? Actually, why aren't you worried about us?! ...N-Not to say that's all there is to it...
Your work isn't bad, but you focus too much on working out minor trifles! In other words... Umm, focus yourself on other things! For example, erm... Your queen...

Must we still tell you what needs to be done?! Take our hand and swear that you will never betray us! ...Hmph, you belong to your queen now, so you are no longer permitted to shoulder every burden on your own! If you try to escape us, you'll be the subject of our ire forevermore!
Excellent work. Now that's what I call a faithful servant.
Royal Fleet, follow our lead!

I'm La Galissonnière, the shipgirl from hell! I've come for your soul! ...Wow, didn't even flinch. Guess it's true that you don't fear death. Heheh, let's see if I can get a more interesting response out of you next time~♪
I'm La Galissonnière, the shipgirl from hell! Don't ask questions about hell, or my job as an executioner. The only thing you need to know is that I'm damn handy to have around.

I'm La Galissonnière, the shipgirl from hell! I've come for your soul! ...Wow, didn't even flinch. Guess it's true that you don't fear death. Heheh, let's see if I can get a more interesting response out of you next time~♪
Commander, mind finding something for me to do, just like usual?
Here I thought there'd be something fun to do in this world, but apparently there isn't. Oh well, guess I'll treat this as a vacation♪
The most efficient way to solve a problem is to get rid of what's causing it. Isn't that literally what weapons are for?
I leave the planning to the people who are good at it and simply follow their orders. Speaking of, Commander, made your plans for today yet?
You can make mousse cake, AND it tastes pretty okay? ...Guess I don't know you as well as I thought...
Word of advice? Keep your hands off. My weapon, if that wasn't obvious.
You're one of those who's too fun to execute, Commander. Yeah, I'll let you off with a verbal warning this time♪
A new mission? Lemme see... Maaan, it's just sorting paperwork. That's so lame...
Mission complete! Fighters get enemies to butcher, while office workers get papers to sort. Right people in the right place, like they say.
You've got a new letter. I'm curious who sent it...
Making an executioner take care of a guard's job? Ugh, kill me already...
The commission team's brought back goodies. You mind if I smash up their cargo crates? Ahahah! I was just kidding♪
Now that I'm stronger, how 'bout letting me see some action?
Who wants a peek of hell itself?
I put 'em out of their misery. All of 'em.
Like hell I'm gonna accept this humiliating defeat... Your days are numbered! Make no mistakes - I'll be back!
Burn in hell!
C'mon! Struggle more for me!
Looks like your head might belong on the chopping block soon.
Butchering the foes in front of me and passing judgment on criminals - my job is as simple as that. How to put my skills to use, that's for you to figure out.
You seriously called me over just to chat, and you don't have any work for me? Okay, you pick a topic then. I'd better not, 'cause it'll just be a gruesome story.

Heard there are some girls in this port who like harassing you... Heheh. I know what you're thinking, but no, I'm not plannin' on taking action. I'm just wondering what exactly they did to get on your nerves of steel♪

We were practically made for each other, so why don't we stay together forever? Working with someone you can trust sure beats roaming the universe alone without a goal, too♪ Promise you won't ditch me one day, Commander?

Interesting. I'll take it.
U-556, the Parzival of the Seas, has arrived! Let's see if there's really anything I can help with here. Seeing as I'll be staying here - nice meeting you♪

Of course I remember my promise to Lord Bismarck. I just don't repeat it constantly, or I'd annoy her. Besides, she specifically asked me to continue on by myself... Anyway! I'm not forgetting about my promise anytime soon.
U-556, the Parzival of the Seas, has arrived! Let's see if there's really anything I can help with here. Seeing as I'll be staying here - nice meeting you♪
Welcome back~ Got promises to fulfill? 'Cause if someone has dibs on you, I'll take my leave♪
Promises... You've made a lot of 'em, haven't you? Were you able to keep them all? There must be some you were forced to give up on...
What does it mean to be an adult? Not having the time to play all day anymore? Heehee. No, it can't be THAT simple♪
What to do for a fun break... I know! I'll ask around the port if anyone needs help with something♪
Hey. Teehee. Whatever promises you've made to these girls, just don't forget about them.
Hm? Hmm? What'cha doing?
I don't have time for games, alright?!
Let me guess... You do this all the time, right? Teehee~
You've got new missions. It's none of my business, but won't you be worse off if you don't take care of them?
Mission complete. I'll fetch the rewards, just 'cause I feel like it♪
You've got a letter! I picked it up on the way here.
You're back? While you were gone, I may have issued a few orders in your name. Teehee♪
The commission team is back. You promised you'd welcome them, remember? C'mon, get going!
There's a limit to what you can achieve by getting stronger...
No hard feelings, but we're enemies after all~
A win is a win~
That's enough. We don't need to push ourselves any longer. I've shed tears over fallen friends too many times already.
Don't take this personally~♪
Stop getting in my way!
I think we should go our separate ways. You do your thing, and I'll do my thing. We're both square, and that's that.
Here comes the Parzival of the Seas♪ Teehee~ Does anyone need my help today? And Commander, do I have permission to give out favors in your name?
If you just vanished one day, you'd betray the trust of everyone at this port. You wouldn't walk away on your near and dear, would you, Commander?
Do you think an on-your-life promise is a childish fantasy, or just plain silly? Teehee~ I knew you'd say no♪ You're a good person, after all~

I used to want to be Parzival the Careless, playing in the sea all day with no goal or concern in the world. But I'm okay with who I am now. At least this way I got to meet you, whom I can share my heart with... Right?
You do know how much promises mean to me, right? This is your last chance to back out. Commander... Do you swear on your life that you won't betray me, that this won't end in tragedy? Promise?
I suppose I will remember you whenever I lay my eyes upon this from now on, Commander...
I... assume you're the Commander? Don't worry, I can see that you're in good health. I'm Vestal. Bring your sick to me, and I should be able to assist with treatment and repairs...
I am the repair ship Vestal. You may think of me as a doctor for shipgirls. I will, of course, also try to help if sickness should befall you, Commander.
I... assume you're the Commander? Don't worry, I can see that you're in good health. I'm Vestal. Bring your sick to me, and I should be able to assist with treatment and repairs...
Welcome back. I've sterilized your office, so it may smell a little odd... I hope it's not too distracting.
A flower, once withered, will not bloom again; a life, once lost, will not return. The weight of a life cannot be simply measured with a scale.
The most annoying thing for a doctor is when a patient lies about their health. An illness will turn grave if you let it fester.
Huh? You should set your eyes on more important things than worrying about me.
It is a doctor's job to save lives. Even when I get hurt in the line of duty, I have no regrets. Of course, I know I mustn't throw my life away. I take whatever precautions are necessary.
Do you want me to examine you?
Overdependence on the kindness of others is a sickness of its own, Commander.
You still have many missions to accomplish, but please, don't bite off more than you can chew.
Mission complete. You should give yourself some time to breathe now, Commander.
A letter from afar... I suggest reading it at once, Commander.
Are there any wounded from your last battles? I'll examine all the girls, just to make sure.
The commission team has returned with goods. I can stock up on medical supplies.
May this strength let me help more people.
Please, safety first.
Any casualties? No? Good.
We'll be in a tight spot if we suffer any more casualties...
You must take your doctor's advice.
It's alright. A little bit of first-aid, and I'll be fine.
You are ill, Commander. Gravely ill. However, you may yet be cured if you cooperate with my treatment.
While, yes, medicine is not your domain, you always lend an ear and a shoulder to the girls here who need it. In that way, I could see why someone would regard you as a doctor.
Commander, can you make some time for a physical exam? People, like ships, need regular upkeep. And just because you don't feel ill doesn't mean everything is fine.
You can bottle up your troubles, but they will come bursting out one day. Commander, when someone confides in you, listen to them. I will do the same for you, if you ever need it.
Care for you forever? You certainly are an oddball. I've never heard of anyone wanting to be nursed around the clock... But, since I enjoy looking after you, I suppose I will.
I will answer "yes" if you can promise me one thing - to take better care of your body from now on. Remember, the fleet isn't alone in needing you - I do, too.
You care for us so much, Commander. I am sure everyone here is very happy.
You must be the Commander. I am the heavy cruiser Algérie. So, what pleasures can I experience here? I do hope you won't disappoint me. Heehee~
I am heavy cruiser Algérie, and I live to enjoy. Enjoy what, you wonder? Heehee. If I had to say... to enjoy anything and everything.
You must be the Commander. I am the heavy cruiser Algérie. So, what pleasures can I experience here? I do hope you won't disappoint me. Heehee~
What brings you here this late? Surely you've not wasted time elsehere?
The opposite of fun is not pain, but boredom. Knowing that, won't you fill this gaping void with something... enjoyable?
Caring only about your own pleasure gets you labeled as "selfish." To that, I say, name-calling is low-grade enjoyment.
You seem to be struggling. Need a hand? ...Heehee. I mean, wouldn't you offer to help if you saw a kitten in need?
Pain is a kind of pleasure. It doesn't matter whether you inflict it or receive it... Do you get what I mean? Heehee.
That look of yours when you're holding yourself back from acting on an urge - it's quite exciting.
If pleasure cannot be rejected, why don't you just embrace it? Heehee♪
A mission? Why spend time on that when it could be spent on your own pleasure?
Completing a mission is more satisfying than the rewards that follow.
You've received a new letter. Isn't it fun to look forward to the unknown?
Judging by your look, you didn't enjoy your last battle. Were your foes too feeble? Maybe the mission went too smoothly for your liking?
Commission completed. Shall we have a look at the rewards? You might be pleasantly surprised.
Whew. I needed to stretch my muscles a bit.
Fighting, by itself, is enjoyable.
There's no fun to be had in an effortless victory~
Chagrin, anger... I see, so this is the taste of defeat? How delicious. Heehee♪
I never gave you permission to flee~
Yes! Yes! Now you're doing it!
*sigh*, old-fashioned people just don't understand what true joy is. What a shame...

I enjoy fighting not just because slaying my foes is satisfying, but because fighting itself is fun. To really make them suffer, or make it quick and painless... I always let my whims decide what to do.
"Possessed by the Devil"... That's merely an excuse for one's self-centered behavior. Say, have you ever used a trite phrase like that to lie to yourself, Commander?
From what I've noticed, you do know what pleasure is, but meaningless little things inhibit your drive to pursue it. Now, come to me... I will teach you the essence of human nature. Heehee♪

Ah, yes, you're a great and virtuous hero - you cannot be with a wicked devil. You need only ask, though, and I'll spoil you whenever you please. Nobody has the right to shame you for seeking just a moment of pleasure.
To tell you the truth, this is far from enjoyable; it brings me great pain. It's not the exchanging vows part that hurts, it's not knowing how long I have to wait for you. Heehee♪
For me? Heheh, you're sweet.
You're helpless... So helpless it's worrying me. Oh, also, no need to concern yourself with who I am. Just think of me as the one who'll help you get your act together.
If it's a name you want... I am Hatakaze. Are you satisfied now? Because I don't care to tell you more than my name. However, I will say this - you should keep your distance from METAs.
You're helpless... So helpless it's worrying me. Oh, also, no need to concern yourself with who I am. Just think of me as the one who'll help you get your act together.
Have you made your plans for the day? I see. It's good to see I don't need to remind you anymore.
You look like you have something to say. If you need a favor, just spit it out. Next time I see you hesitate, I'll clobber you over the head.

Inspiration is like an oasis mirage - it appears and disappears. Those who don't come upon a real oasis can only live with their thirst. If it's water you want, I could find a way to procure it for you.
I've frightened people? I have no memory of doing such a thing. All I've done is stand my ground against a few cheeky younglings.
Hm? Another request from a youngling... Good timing. Let us see to it together, you and I. We must not be indifferent to the plights of others.
Something the matter? Need a hand? Heheh, know that that's no excuse to slack off.
*sigh*... I swear with you younglings these days...
Well, you look satisfied. Completed a mission, did you? But if you didn't... I don't need to say the rest, do I?
Ah, you've completed a mission. Then you may have a break. A short one, of course.
I left the new letter for you on your desk. If you're to make me do this again, I want to add some conditions. Heheh, don't you worry. I won't shake you down over a little legwork.
There's things to be learned from successes and defeats alike. I'm sure you've heard that a million times, though. Now let's begin.
Commission complete. While I could claim the rewards for you, I can't make you complacent. You've got arms - use them to do some lifting.
Maybe you should focus on yourself rather than worry about me?
Everything is up to you now, Commander.
A splendid victory. Next time, we could be more ruthless.
*sigh*... You will reflect long and hard on this blunder once we're home.
Be witness to your demise!
You're sending the fleet into the tiger's den, you know.
Seems my hopes were misplaced... Now the question is - how to get through that skull of yours?
I am not a "good girl." I did say I'd whip you into shape, but I have my motives for doing so. Heheh, if you're curious about them, use your head first.
You're getting on well with your subordinates. Seems I won't need to lecture you on that... Hm? Am I getting along well with them? I told you before - you should keep your distance from METAs.
I considered making you a good luck charm, but didn't; my hands would curse it. So, I'll content myself with watching you from the shadows as your elder.

I've adapted to a life of solitude. Me helping others for my own selfish reasons, avoiding people - it's all normal to me. But, after spending time with you, I've begun thinking it's not so bad having someone I can rely on. For this, I blame you.

You really are an odd one. Why go these lengths for the likes of me? Fine. I will accept your love so as to not disappoint you, youngling... "It's about you, not me," you say? Speak such nonsense again and I will smack you on the forehead - got it?
Oh? How'd you know I was interested in this?

Mgh. Hmm... To stick you in a volcano, or throw you into a trench...
