They said I'd only sink deeper into hell if I didn't fight back. Threats like that don't work on me anymore, because I have you. Even if I will sink, I'll be sinking with you.
Commander, let's go on a pleasant trip today, you and I. Where? Ahaha! To hell, I'd say! And don't say no. So strong is our bond that cutting it would only make it regrow stronger. Right?
Well... I'll admit, I'm getting butterflies in my stomach over this. Giddy or not, I'll still accept your ring! It's just like you said - nothing will get between us and our shared fate! Hahahaha!
Ooh, this looks fun! I like it! Thanks, Commander!
You the Commander? Alright, say no more. Take me into battle and I guarantee ya won't be let down!
Just think of me as the Wichita you've always known! When ya have me in a battle, victory is a given and foes stand no chance! Now take me to the battlefield!
You the Commander? Alright, say no more. Take me into battle and I guarantee ya won't be let down!
You're back. Where're we going and who are we taking down today?
I didn't just stumble upon this power - I paid the due price to get it. Would be a big shame not to put it to good use, right?
War? War is never over. There's no issue between victory and you that a cannon shell cannot resolve! And even if there were, just fire one more!
As soon as ya set foot on the battlefield, there's no turning back. Never forget what you're fighting for, Commander.
Scars are a warrior's badges of honor. Being able to feel pain is proof that you're alive, Commander.
This is how you reward your soldiers? I'll take it.

More power! I need more!
Follow my lead and blitz on through! Fire!
You ain't seen nothing yet!
Fall back! I'll keep 'em busy!
Turn to ash and sink below the waves!
Not so fast! I've not keeled over yet!
Do you seriously think this shit will fly? 'Cause it sure as hell won't!
My dreams? Don't care about 'em. The battlefield is my whole world. Anything beyond that, I try not to think about.

Now that I think about it, me and this whip have been together for ages. If I ever kick the bucket, I want you to be its new owner. It's a bit long, but that makes it perfect for pointing at things on a map.
I'm afraid... I used to not give a damn, but now... Hm? Oh, Commander. It's nothing. It just that it dawned on me that I've started fearing death. Yeah? ...Learn to value my life more, you say?

I've grown attached to life, and it's all your fault. Ya know... If I buy the farm before you do, you'll be all alone, and I can't stand the thought of that. I'll take care of myself - if only so you and I can be together just a while longer.

We're not general and soldier, you and I, we're lovers... and I can't fight like my heart yearns. You've done things to me... but it's fine. We'll keep on keeping on. You are my anchorage; my port to return to. Long as you're alive, I'll be around - 'til the world itself comes to an end.
I'm surprised. You have great taste.
Let's get this battle started. I'll cover you!
You... have summoned Kasumi. Commander, what do you need of me?
I can see things that nobody else can. Not only see, but also feel. So, I am no longer alone. I am no longer afraid of being by myself.
You... have summoned Kasumi. Commander, what do you need of me?
Welcome back, Commander...
Kasumi... of the Asashio class. Commander, I can be alone now, so... where would you have me go?
Blue flames? ...Commander, you can see them too?
Loneliness... is something I've gotten used to. It's not scary anymore. Kasumi will be afraid no longer, Commander.
Do you like the tea I made for you? If so, I'll have it ready for you every time you come back.

Commander... Did you want to talk to me?
Commander, uweh... I can't believe you...

Pass through... pass through.
Kasumi... will not sink here!

Foo has gone off to a place far, far away, but will sometimes come back to see me. Every time Foo returns, I become much, much stronger...
Now that I've become stronger... do you feel like you don't know me anymore? Don't worry. I'm still the same me. Commander... You're not afraid of me, are you?

My "power" is usually sealed off, which is why Foo cannot come back unless the seal is lifted. But because you're here, I don't feel alone at all... Even before Foo disappeared, I always felt like you were someone irreplaceable to me...
Commander... You've chosen me? Really? You've always been the person nearest and dearest to my heart... so of course, I'd like to be with you. That way, I'll never have to be alone again.
Kasumi... loves this. Thank you, Commander.

I am Nagato. Nagato of the "Sakura Empire". As flowers bloom and wither, so too do people come and go... That is all you need to know. Now, enough sitting around. Go and do what you need to do.
I am Nagato, Guardian Fox of the "Sakura Empire". Tell me, why have you summoned me? For power? Or for a wish you would like to have granted?

I shall not fall... I shall not fall!

Never again shall I sacrifice one for the many. I wield this power so that I will never be confronted with such a choice ever again. Through this power, I shall bring salvation to all.

I cannot grind my existence away on the front lines for perpetuity? And why do you say this? What would you do if your friends were hurt in the absence of my protection? You want me to trust you? Hmm... Well, let's see. It all depends on how you lead.

Before I realized it, I had already grown accustomed to having you at my side. I find it amusing that you neither fear nor worship me... But, do you truly have no desires? Should you be so inclined, I can make any wish of yours come true. Why not give it a try?

First you ask me to go flower-viewing with you, then you invite me to gaze at the moon... You're plotting something, aren't you? You're trying to use your own "wishes" as a pretense to get me to open up. Listen well - I am aware of your tricks. You have one last wish to make, so think carefully about what you want.

Indeed... Your wish was well within my expectations, as the natural progression of the cosmos. But, I wonder if you truly understand the meaning of this wish... Though, I will not allow you to retract your words even if you say you don't understand. I have already accepted you; and just as flowers are short-lived, so too is the brevity of a maiden's spring. What are your plans for today? ...Working in the office all day? Umm... Maybe we could change those plans right now?
Do you have any outdoor missions, Commander? If not, oh well - perhaps we could go for a walk together instead?
While, yes, you need wisdom on the battlefield, sometimes you also need to be recklessly courageous. What we call "miracles" all begin with these two things.
A thousand-mile journey begins with a single step. You should take that first step without worrying about what could go wrong.
A banquet? Where will it be? Regardless, I'd love to attend a- You want ME to arrange it? That sounds like a lot of work, so I'm afraid I'll have to decline.

Disappear like a cloud in the sky!

This present is of utmost import to me... but my greatest treasure is no doubt your sentiments toward me, Commander.
I am Giulio Cesare, conqueror of the empire. Spare me the needless chatter. I have no desire to squander time on such things.
I am Giulio Cesare, conqueror of the empire. I came, I saw, I conquered - and then, I will return home triumphantly... in that shining land of glory.
I am Giulio Cesare, conqueror of the empire. Spare me the needless chatter. I have no desire to squander time on such things.

Orthodoxy rooster... Royal Navy lion? Heehee.

I love you. I told you about just coming out and saying what's on your mind, and so that's what I just did! I've got things I wanna say, too! So what do you have to say? ...That you'll always look after me? Seriously? Yeah, that goes without saying!

Let's go. There's still much to be done.
Look deep inside yourself. Your potential is so much greater than you think.
You're the Commander of the fleet? Nice meetin' you! I'm Hornet, the youngest among the Yorktown class. I may not be as amazing as my big sisters, but I'm still pretty capable... probably!

I'm Hornet, with the Council's 7th Special Dispatch Fleet and third ship of the Yorktown class. This is my original identity and the story that was decided for me since birth. Even though I'm the youngest among the Yorktown class, I've never actually met any of my "sisters"... Isn't that weird?
You're the Commander of the fleet? Nice meetin' you! I'm Hornet, the youngest among the Yorktown class. I may not be as amazing as my big sisters, but I'm still pretty capable... probably!
Commander, I was thinking about going for a run since the weather's nice. Wanna come with me?
Staring into space? Hey, no I wasn't! ...Alright, fine, I was. But I was just thinking about what's happened the past few years... and about my sisters.
Commander, you want some iced coffee? No need to bother with adding ice cubes, I'll just use my META powers!
Commander, I baked this pineapple pizza using my META powers. Want a slice?
Man... A port where you can just eat and sleep without a care... This place really is paradise.
What's up? If it's my hat you like, wanna hold it?
Don't worry, I've got a control device so the META corrosion doesn't seep out. You can even touch my jacket if you wanna check. Or my shorts, or my boots!
Huh?! Wait, wait, I, uhh, need time to mentally prepare! ...O-okay, I'm ready!
Get it together, Commander! You've got lots of stuff to do today!
Missiooon complete! Let's kick back with some cold sodas!
Final move: Council Mail Saturation!
Commander, let me come along on the next sortie! I'll perform as great as my sisters... probably!
Zzz... Seems a commission got completed... That's nice... Wait, crap! We gotta go and welcome them back!
Awesome! One step closer to my sisters!
Let's go when you're ready!
Heheh! How's THAT for a magnificent victory?
The situation's disadvantageous... Retreat! Fall back!
Doolittle Raid META, take off!
Crap... I'm in hot water now!
Having broken through the Veil, what awaits us is an even bleaker reality...
Weekend plans? None for the moment. Uhh... Go and watch a movie with my sisters? Man, I'd be stoked to, but... won't it feel kinda weird between us?

Commander, this port of yours - it's a very heartwarming place. Hey, tell me more about my sisters! With both of them here, there must be cool stuff happening all the time, right? I wanna know about 'em!
Commander... Is it possible all my experiences here are just another layer to the Veil? I guess as long as it makes me this happy, there's nothing wrong with it...

Pfft... I just said it in the spur of the moment last time, and you seriously had the R&D team research it? Want my help? I'm an expert at using META powers to create explosions! ...Hm? I'll get myself suspended if I do that? It was just a joke... Ahahaha!

You know... I don't care all that much about the Veil or my role now that you're aware of them. At the very least, my heart is always telling me that the present is real, and that's enough for me. I'm going to take today as an opportunity to start a new life - a life with you! Wherever you go, I'll always be right behind you, Commander!
Whoa, for me? Thanks!
I finally found you! That's another story mission of mine to scratch off the list!
Yorktown! Enty! I'm so glad we could meet!
Behold the terrifying power of the mighty Hornet!
Yo, young'un. I know you've got things under control here, but this port may not be peaceful forever. You should stay with me from now on! I'll keep you safe no matter what happens!
Experiencing that disaster made me realize that preparation is the only thing that can save you from danger. If you believe in me, I'll use everything at my disposal to protect you.
Yo, young'un. I know you've got things under control here, but this port may not be peaceful forever. You should stay with me from now on! I'll keep you safe no matter what happens!
Hold it! Let me scope this area out... Okay, safety confirmed. Hi there, Commander!
I know I'm overdoing it a little, but I'd rather be called worrisome than the alternative. You can't complain unless you're alive, get what I mean?
You think I worry too much? Maybe so, but a moment's inattention could lead to calamity.
If you don't like me being around all the time, then I'll go patrol. Don't worry, Commander. I'll protect you AND the port.
Do the things you wanna do while you're still young! Leave no regrets!
Heheh. What's up, young'un?
Urk...! Oh, it's just you. I'm all for cuddles, but warn me first, okay? You might get hurt otherwise.
Hnh?! Phew... It's you. Say something next time, please. That's a vital area right there!
Commander, you still have missions left over. Let me help you knock 'em out. I'm prepared for any and all kinds of accidents.
You've got rewards. I checked them all, so I can guarantee they're safe. ...Don't look at me like that. You can never be too careful.
Mail for you. As usual, I made sure none of it was suspicious.
Are you tired? Let me check you for wounds... Okay, I'm glad you're safe. I've got water and a first aid kit, so tell me if you need anything.
Everyone made it home safe. Let's go see them. I gotta check and make sure they're not hurt.
Heh, that feels good! I'll use this power to protect you.
Now this is a party. Let's set the enemy and the sea alight!
We won, but there's still room for improvement.
Tch, Commander, hurry and retreat! I'll hold them off!
Try again in a few thousand years!
Just a flesh wound! I'm protecting the Commander, no matter what!
I thought you'd understand how I felt. Guess I was stupid for that.
It's better to keep a certain distance. That'll help me keep cool when it's time to protect you.
Shopping...? Sure, but I won't let my guard down. For your sake.
Sometimes, I wonder if I'm a little too stubborn... But when I see you safe and sound, I know it's for the best.
I finally understand. The thing that scares me most isn't external threats - it's the thought that I might lose you. So I'm going to keep protecting you until you really trust me.

Have you prepared yourself? Giving me this means that you've accepted me as I am... I like that look in your eye. You've been raised well. I just need you to accept my one request in return - let me protect you for the rest of my days, Commander.
Oh? You have an eye for presents. Thanks!

I'm Royal Navy destroyer Grenville, returning to the battlefield in META form. Long ago, I... No, that's all in the past now. Just give me a chance, Commander. I swear to keep the fleet safe this time.

I'm Grenville... Grenville META. I used to be a regular destroyer who dreamed of becoming a refined lady, but destiny had other things in mind and I lost so much... Let me use my strength to protect your people, Commander.

I'm Royal Navy destroyer Grenville, returning to the battlefield in META form. Long ago, I... No, that's all in the past now. Just give me a chance, Commander. I swear to keep the fleet safe this time.
Welcome back, Commander. I've compiled a list of your missions for today. I've also made tea for you. I added a little something for... extra flavour.

Commander? Oh, yeah, I was just sifting through some memories. Although I've been through a lot, there's also much I'd hate to forget... Like afternoon tea with my friends or the days we spent together.
Lady... That word used to mean a lot to me. But now, all I care about is fulfilling the duty given to me - protecting you and the people here.

Oh, umm... Commander, wanna try some scones I made? Just so you know, they might have a "unique" taste. The ingredients where I come from were pretty limited... I still hope you'll like it, though. It's the flavour of... me, here and now.
My past self never understood the importance of being the flotilla leader... But now, I vow to bring everyone back home in one piece after every sortie.
...Hey, could you stop that? I'm not as vivacious as I used to be. Well... that's not to say I hate it or anything.
Hm? Do you need something?
C-Commander?! If it's a reaction you wanted... Uh, please, let go of me.
Commander, you have work left to do. If your hands are tied, I can take on the simple stuff.
Commander, claim your mission rewards. These resources are really crucial for us. I know better than anyone the dread that comes with destitution... Seriously, don't forget those rewards.
New letters came in, and I sorted them by order of importance. Thought it might save you some time.
End of combat... All that matters is that you're safe. I'm gonna go check on the team - the report can wait.
Commander, the commission team is back. If you're free, how about we go greet them?
A little bit stronger... Cheers.
I'll escort you to the best of my abilities. I WILL keep protecting everyone this time!
Victory... I only carried out my duty.
I've got to evacuate everyone!
I'm going all out in the name of everyone I care about!
I will never abandon my duty of protecting the fleet as long as I still have strength!
I'm not asking for your understanding or concern. I just want you to not prevent me from protecting people.
Commander, need a hand with anything? I can help you plan an operation, analyse information, and so on.

My memory is... Well, it gets hazy in places, yet I also remember some things so vividly it's like they're right in front of me. Quietly talking to you like this gives me a peace of mind I haven't felt in ages. Thank you...
C-Commander! I made new snacks again, and I actually measured the ingredients this time... W-wanna have some with me?
I thought I had lost everything, but then I met you... and your existence has supported me for countless nights. It's thanks to you that I can move forward.

This ring symbolises both an oath and the long path we've walked. I may not be the precocious young Grenville who dreamed of becoming a fine Royal lady, but I still want to find a future for you and me.
Wait, this is for me? It's been so long since... Ah, never mind. Thank you, Commander. I'll cherish it... I really will. Thanks again.
Good day to you, Commander. I'm the Royal Navy aircraft carrier Glorious. It's an honour to be here, and I thank you for having me.
Hm? Let's put that matter to rest. What matters is the glorious future, not my trifling past. Commander, if there's anything I can help with, do not hesitate to ask.
Good day to you, Commander. I'm the Royal Navy aircraft carrier Glorious. It's an honour to be here, and I thank you for having me.
The weather is lovely. Let's do our best to make today a productive one.
...Would you also like a cup of tea? I'll brew it right away. Please wait a moment.
Your black tea is... hmm, about 30% as strong as Implacable's? Heehee, allow me to brew some for you.
If only I could get a rematch against Illustrious, I'm confident I would win this time.
Was this dessert made by the Royal Maid Corps? It tastes just like how I remember... Thank you.
...My apologies. Was I spacing out again?
Hmm? If you need company, then I can talk for a while.
Even the most beautiful rose has its thorns, Commander.
Having superiors who would give rewards for completed missions doesn't sound bad... Commander, let's get this job done.
Well done. You've earned a good rest.
Commander, how do you use this mailbox... I'm sorry. I haven't handled mail in a long time, so it's hard to learn.
Oh, you're back already? Sorry. I was lost in thought... Let's get to work.
How long has it been since I saw a fleet so replete with supplies? ...Commander, the commission is done. Leave the rest to me.
Let's continue to seize victory together.
Glorious, of the Royal Navy, spares no foes!
To this glorious triumph.
I have failed... yet again.
Glory... eternal!
I'm used to this pain by now.
...What's the matter? You called for me, didn't you?
Commander, where are the port's nicest views? I'm in the mood to go out for a while... Don't worry. I just need some fresh air.
I passed by the Royal Navy dorms today and saw Ark Royal and the destroyers in the distance... They never change, do they?
I've started learning to make herbal tea along with my usual black tea. Would you like to try a cup, Commander?

You came all this way looking for me...? Here, take my hand and watch your step... I love being in high places. Seeing everything and feeling the breeze can be so relaxing... This moment of rest is even more precious now that you're here, though.

You've made your feelings clear, so I should be honest about myself... I am Glorious of the Royal Navy, and I was the final glory of my test site. As long as there's life in me, I must keep that glory alive... Will you still walk alongside me, Commander?
Thank you very much, Commander. I am very fond of it.
Don't push yourself too much. You're already worthy.
So you're the Commander. I am Kawakaze, a roamer of the lands. We will be walking the same path for some time. Let's be cordial.

I'm Kawakaze. My allegiance, my model number - all that vanished with the dregs of the past. Now I'm no more than a wanderer who accompanies you. What happened to me is something I... don't want to discuss. You are bright - I'm sure you can make a good guess.
So you're the Commander. I am Kawakaze, a roamer of the lands. We will be walking the same path for some time. Let's be cordial.
The same sight sparks different emotions depending on its viewer's heart... I've been waiting for you, Commander.
Do you need something, Commander? You're always welcome to just say hello. Have a seat and I'll put on some matcha tea- Ugh, shut up!
I am a masterless blade, now at your side for the time being. When you need my power, I shall lend you it.
There is no end to conflict, Commander. Whatever you do, don't fall into that spiral.
I guess it wouldn't be so bad to... spend the rest of my life in peace... Move it, snake! Out of my way!
If this brings solace to your heart, then do as you please.
I appreciate the gesture, Commander, but I don't wish to see your Lady Nagato. I am bound by my own unfinished business. She... She has her own loyal Kawakaze, I'm sure.
...Care to experience the essence of dual-wielded blades, Commander?
Why are there so many missions? Commander, if the need arises, I will cut them off at their source.
What surprisingly lavish mission rewards... Commander, I withdraw what I said earlier. It's best if the client remains alive if they provide remuneration as generous as this.
Commander, a letter addressed to you has arrived... It may in fact be addressed to me? Quit pulling my leg.
You must be weary after your series of battles, Commander. You're home now, so clear your mind of war for the moment and... Ah, it's nothing. I'll make tea for you.
Commander, a commission has been completed. You needn't have worried - a commission is not easy to fail.
I'm now one step closer... to fulfilling my long-held desire.
I by myself will suffice.
The outcome of a battle matters less than the safety of our allies... Yes, a victory is a victory. Rejoice, you courageous warriors.
I still have a mission to accomplish... I must live on... Retreat!
Close your eyes and sleep.
Bloody shadows, join me in slaying our foe!
Your judgment is correct, Commander. I am merely a blade. You needn't care about my feelings. That being said... when a blade is masterless, who can say upon whom it will descend?
These blood-red shadows? Yes, they're ferocious and dangerous... Apologies. They seem intent on following me wherever I go. I can neither control them nor shake them off... Quiet, you!
Commander, while I must thank you for being so kind, I am still bound by a duty and I will one day leave this place behind. By this I mean: Do not get too attached to me. Take that as a... warning.

Commander, I understand how you feel, but please stop trying to console me. I needn't face the past to move into the future... Yes, I am moving into the future, you cursed snakes! In spite of you sticking to me like leeches! Even if I... Shut up, shut up, shut up!

I'm surprised you've come near me again. Did the bloody shadows' outburst not daunt you? You have guts, that's for sure. Maybe I ought to follow your example and display the same degree of courage. By facing the past - by confronting the moment the bloody shadows came into being... I can't, Commander... I'm scared... Please stay here... with me...

The river is strikingly clean, the sky is refreshingly clear. The wanderer purges the mist of her mind, having found a cause to fight for and a master to serve - such a beautiful tale. Commander, even should our journey be an endless one, I will walk it with you as your blade.
It's beautiful... Thank you. I love this gift.
How interesting... How did you learn to control it?

I'm battlecruiser Dunkerque. Yes, I'm not purposefully giving you this tense look, it's just that I just returned from the battlefield. People call me things like "the Dessert Demon." Would you like to know why they call me that, Commander?
I'm Dunkerque, "the Dessert Demon." It's a pleasure, Commander. While you're here, why not taste this newest dessert of mine? ...Hey! Come back!

I'm battlecruiser Dunkerque. Yes, I'm not purposefully giving you this tense look, it's just that I just returned from the battlefield. People call me things like "the Dessert Demon." Would you like to know why they call me that, Commander?

Welcome back, Commander. Care for something sweet to shake off the grogginess? ...It tastes awfully sour? Heheh, it might be a little sour in the beginning, but you should taste the sweetness soon. Wouldn't you agree this woke you up well?
Open your mouth, Commander. Hm? It's just a regular chocolate donut. See? Delicious, no? Then how about trying this not-so-regular dessert next, hm?
Why do I fight? To protect the world's hope and all things that are beautiful, of course. I don't want my painstakingly-made desserts to be ruined by some short-tempered buffoon.
I've fought in countless nerve-racking battles to procure ingredients for my desserts. If you're curious, I could tell you about them sometime.
Even a small dessert can stir a person's heart... Don't you think they're like temptations from the devil, Commander?
Feels nice and silky, doesn't it? ...Hm? Like a chocolate fountain, you say? Heheh... Let me guess - you're hungry, aren't you?
Is it my time to sortie? Or do you finally feel like eating my special dessert?
So you crave me more than my delectable desserts... Heheh. Have it your way. Help yourself.
Quite a lot of missions have piled up... That's fine. I'll take care of all your problems with this sword.
The mission rewards are already here, if you're wondering. Are you coming to claim them?
Your mail? I organized it for you.
Done fighting? Excellent work. You must be hungry, right? Why don't you try your luck with my freshly-baked desserts? Don't worry, the worst that'll happen is it'll make you laugh.
Going to see the commission team? Bring them this dessert I made. It'll make it a real welcome-back celebration. Heheh.
Power... Heheh. This feels nice!
Shoot! I set the oven to the wrong time! You, get out of my way!
An outstanding outcome. You make me proud, Commander.
Heheh... I haven't felt this in so long... You've given me inspiration for a new dessert.
Witness the power that leads to victory!
Heheh... Such a bitter feeling...
Seems your feedback on my dessert-making won't be very useful...
I have some mouthwatering dessert. Want a taste? ...Aww, you don't? You're letting a rare experience slip by.
Still "no" even if I feed you directly? Hmm... I wonder if I can make a dessert so special that you cannot possibly refuse it...
Can I interest you in some freshly-made dessert? Rest assured, it's perfectly normal this time... Oh. You ate it without a second thought. Heheh. Well? Wasn't it delicious?

Happiness is like a dessert with a complex taste. A hint of bitterness and sweetness, blended together in an inseparable union... Care to know what it's like to indulge in this wonderful sweetness with me?

My temptations don't affect you in the slightest, do they? Heehee... Maybe, just maybe I was born to stand side by side with you. Don't worry - I will always satisfy you with the highest sweetness, even if we end up in the depths of hell.
I can sense the feelings you put into this. As thanks... would you like some sweets?
So you're the Commander? Name's Yuudachi! Think of me as a Shiratsuyu class. By the way, you guys got any food here? You do? Then we're all good!

Call me Yuudachi or Yuudachi META or whatever the hell you want as long as you lemme eat all I can! I'll even beat the shit out of someone for you! Ugh, all this talking's making me hungry... Got anything to eat? Where's the grub at?
So you're the Commander? Name's Yuudachi! Think of me as a Shiratsuyu class. By the way, you guys got any food here? You do? Then we're all good!
You're giving me all this meat and these snacks? Awright, just spit it out and tell me who you want dead!
Hmm... Zzz... Grrmh... Zzz... Hm? Commander! Is it dinnertime?!
What am I fighting for? Nothing, really. If I had to say, then because it's fun? And 'cause it's tasty?
A welcoming party? Count me out. Sounds lame and tiring. Wait, they've got yummy food there? Then I'll be there!
Saw something interesting outside the office... Hm?! What's that you got? Is it... chocolate?!
This work is sooo boring... *sniff sniff*... Smells like it's nearing lunchtime, Commander, so I'm outta here!
Don't touch me! That tickles, dammit!
After breakfast comes lunch, after lunch it's snacktime, and after that it's time for dinner, and after that, I get a late-night stack. This port place you got here is goddamn amazing!
That's it, Commander! You're getting bit! Woof!
A new mission? Ugh, what a pain in my ass... Two helpings of meat for my efforts?! I'm on it!
Nom, nom... Mmh... Commander, these mission rewards are so tasty!
Got a letter here, Commander! *sniff sniff*... Bleh! Smells not yummy!
Commander! Weeelcome back! *sniff sniff*... Hm? You got any snacks on you?
Woof?! Commission got done, I'm guessing? Boy, I can't wait to see what food they brought back this time!
Commander, I'm absolutely dying to eat something or go out and mess somebody up right now!
Heheh! This is gonna be a fun hunt!
Hah! That's all? Hope the next bunch will be more fun!
...Retreat? Do I look like a coward?! Lemme go! I've still got fight left in me!
Cut 'em up! Rip 'em to shreds!
Now you've done it... assholes!
So... hungry... Sausage... Ham... Meat pie... Steak... Where's the food...
I'm gonna go look for some food - wanna come with? ...What about the truckload of meat I got yesterday? Well, yeah, that was YESTERDAY'S food.
I ate so much and now I wanna sleep... Mmh... but I wanna go out and fight, too... Or maybe I could go to the park and catch some butterflies? Ugh, I can't decide! Commander, pick for me!
It's so weird... I was gonna eat this yummy meat all by myself, but now I wanna leave some for you.
You're nice to me, and I like you for that! A little! Once I've stuffed my belly later today, I'll give you the privilege of patting my head!

A promise ring? Commander, I'm not a little kid - I know what this ceremony's about. Basically, you'll give me tasty food for the rest of time and I just gotta fight for you, right? Then you can bet your ass I'll accept!
Woof! Who do you want me to beat up?
I'm destroyer Dewey - Dewey META - and I'm pleased to be serving as your tactical advisor. I'll provide professional strategic assistance from the sidelines which I hope will be of use to you.

I'm Dewey. Being a professional advisor, my job is to provide tactical support in the form of gathering and sharing intelligence, among other things. I hope that my assistance helps you make more accurate decisions.
I'm destroyer Dewey - Dewey META - and I'm pleased to be serving as your tactical advisor. I'll provide professional strategic assistance from the sidelines which I hope will be of use to you.
Welcome back, Commander. I've organized the files that need your attention. Please let me know when you have orders for me.

I'm presently gathering and sorting weather data on this sector of the ocean. You can't make a swift decision without accurate information! It'd spell disaster if we ran into a storm in the middle of an operation, for instance.
That's most of the important missions done and dusted. Um, Commander, could we chat for a bit? It should help relieve some of the stress from work.
The weather pattern suggests... a storm is coming? Is it yellow? Or red?
The accessories in that display window are so adorab- Ahem, I mean, they're moderately cute. Should make a note of this place and come back after work...
Y-you mustn't mess with my hat while I'm on duty!
Is something bothering you, Commander? Hopefully, my proposition might be able to help you.
C-Commander! We're still on the clock... I can't focus like this...
There are new missions. Hmm... I'll make some adjustments to your schedule.
Mission rewards have arrived. Allow me to organize the resources. Hm... Wonder if there'll be any cute things in there.
Commander, you've received a new letter. Please read it when you have the time.

So fluffy, so cute... C-Commander?! Welcome back! Um, I mean, when did you get back? Err, a-as for this plushie... I didn't expressly bring it to work, I just thought I could play with it during my break, you see...
I've verified that the commission team has returned on schedule. It's time to go greet them.
I'm now able to assist with even more professional intelligence!
Please issue your orders, Commander!
Our tactics were better than theirs. That's another victory to our name!
We should retreat immediately. After that, we'll revise our strategy!
We have the upper hand. Time to strike!
Huff... Calm down, Dewey!
I'm your advisor, so I'd like it if you'd actually listen to my advice.
Resources in all locations have now been more or less organized. Commander, have you decided on where we're going? I'm fine with anywhere!
Commander, please have a look at my new plushie! Isn't it adorable? It's so soft, and... Huh? You'd like a hug? Of course, if you want... Huh?! You meant you want to hug ME?!
Commander, it's time for a break! For dinner tonight, um... I made a boxed lunch, if I can interest you in that. I hope it'll be to your tastes.
Commander, you can come to me for advice on anything. I want to help... and support you in new and different ways. And when I do, it should ease your burden by quite a lot!
I may be a little anxious sometimes when I face an uncertain tomorrow... but that's okay, because from now on, be it in battle or at home, you'll always be there to show me the way - right?
You're giving this to me? Wow, thank you!
Commander, I'm the META Boise... It's my job to give you and your fleet the protection you all need.
I'm the Brooklyn-class light cruiser, Boise META... and I'm here to protect you. The mask is part of my power, so try not to be bothered by it. We'll be voyaging together from now on.
Commander, I'm the META Boise... It's my job to give you and your fleet the protection you all need.
I'm happy I can help you with your work today, Commander...
This mask is important. You must never touch it... It's connected to a special device, and as long as that device is working properly, I can protect you in the most dire of circumstances.
I don't feel uncomfortable at all wearing the mask. I'm used to it... Y-you wanna touch it? Umm... Well... No, you can't!
I'm always watching and protecting you, Commander. Believe me... I just try not to be too open about it.
Commander, if anybody's causing you trouble, you come to me. I'll do my best... to ask them to be nicer!
D-don't touch the mask, please.
Commander? I'm listening... Go ahead.
Huff... Puff... Nothing happened just now, right?
Commander, it's time for your next mission...
Can we call that a job well done? Good... I think I'm getting the hang of this.
You have new mail. Want me to read it out for you?
Welcome back. You look like you're doing fine, but if you get hurt, you HAVE to tell me.
The commission is done. Should we go say hi to our hard-working friends?
My mask got stronger, too...
Huff... Puff... Let's do this.
Threats removed. Is everyone okay? Good... Phew.
I still have my mask... Commander, withdraw everyone. I'll cover you!
Fight on, everyone, and rest assured that you're under my protection!
Everyone's... in danger...
Commander, how are you going to protect everyone like this...?
Diving? Well, I can dive pretty deep, yes... It isn't easy, though. Do you have a mission that requires me to do underwater recon, Commander?
Huff... Puff... Hmm? I was just taking deep breaths. It helps me calm down fast... Wanna try it, Commander?
You know, now that I'm really thinking about it, you and I have already been through so many fierce battles... It almost feels strange being able to relax together.
Do you have any special orders for me? Or do you just want to stay by my side? I'm okay with anything.
As long as I'm here... As long as I can protect everyone... I won't let anything dangerous happen. This is my answer to your vow... and a promise.
Is this for me? Thank you... I love it!
...It's a pleasure to meet you. Or should I say... we meet again. Just keep staring like that, Commander. I want to bask in this calm moment for a while longer...

...I am Yorktown META. I am an observer and an observee, and I am one who maintains the balance between existence and extinction. I hold no preconceived views, and I am not bound by worldly rules. I am simply... me.
...It's a pleasure to meet you. Or should I say... we meet again. Just keep staring like that, Commander. I want to bask in this calm moment for a while longer...
...Good morning, Commander. I've been watching you... Everything is fine.
...Why am I always observing? Because if I don't, I'll lose something very dear to me. I could explain it in greater detail, but sometimes, the journey matters more than the destination.
...Little Eagle has been rubbing her wings against me for a while now. Do you think she's hungry? ...Oh, she's just being affectionate? So that's what it is...
...Watch, observe, exist. All things must find their value through observation.
...Yes, I remember everything. Every unspoken smile we shared, the feelings that meant more than our very lives... I've not once forgotten them.
...Are you checking what state I'm in? Don't be alarmed. As long as I observe, so, too, do I exist.
